 ch/ Satthaparinnā
1.1.     suyaṃ me, āusaṃ, teṇaṃ bhagavayā evam akkhāyaṃ: 
 2.     iha-m-egesiṃ no sannā bhavai, taṃ-jahā: `puratthimāo vā 
   disāo āgao aham aṃsi, dāhiṇāo vā disāo ..., paccatthimāo vā disāo ..., 
   uttarāo vā disāo ... , uḍḍhāo vā disāo ... , ahe-disāo vā ... , annayarīo 
   vā disāo vā aṇudisāo vā āgao aham aṃsi` Ō evam egesiṃ 
 3. no nāyaṃ bhavai: `atthi me āyā uvavāie, n' atthi me āyā uvavāie? 
 4. ke ahaṃ āsī ke vā io cuo iha peccā bhavissāmi?` se jjaṃ puṇa 
   jāṇejjā saha-sammuiyāe para-vāgaraṇeṇaṃ annesiṃ vā antie soccā,
   taṃ-jahā: `puratthimāo vā disāo āgao aham aṃsi jāva annayarīo 
   vā disāo vā aṇudisāo vā āgao aham aṃsi` Ō evam egesiṃ nāyaṃ bhavai:
   `atthi me āyā uvavāie; jo imāo disāo aṇudisāo vā aṇusaṃcarai, 
   savvāo disāo savvāo aṇudisāo so 'haṃ`. 
 5.     se āyā-vāī logā-vāī kammā-vāī kiriyā-vāī ya. 
        `karissaṃ c' ahaṃ, kārāvessaṃ c' ahaṃ karao yāvi samaṇunne bhavissāmi`
    Ō eyāvantī savvāvantī logaṃsi kamma-samārambhā parijāṇiyavvā
 6. bhavanti. aparinnāya-kamme khalu ayaṃ purise, jo 
    imāo disāo vā aṇudisāo vā aṇusaṃcarai, savvāo disāo savvāo aṇudisāo
    sahei, aṇega-rūvāo joṇīo saṃdhei, virūva-rūve phāse paḍisaṃveei.
 7. tattha khalu bhagavayā parinnā paveiyā imassa c' eva jīviyassa
parivandaṇa-māṇaṇa-pūyaṇāe, 
    jāi-maraṇa-moyaṇāe dukkha-paḍighāya- 
    heuṃ Ō eyāvantī savvāvantī logaṃsi kamma-samārambhā parijāṇiyavvā
    bhavanti. jass' ee logaṃsi kamma-samārambhā parinnāyā bhavanti,
    se hu muṇī parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
2.1.          ae loe parijuṇṇe dussaṃbohe avijāṇae. 
             assiṃ loe pavvahie 
             tattha-tattha puḍho pāsa āurā pariyāventi. 
 2.          santi pāṇā puḍho-siyā. 
             lajjamāṇā puḍho pāsa. 
    `aṇagārā mo` tti ege pavayamāṇā. 
        jam iṇaṃ virūva-rūvehiṃ satthehiṃ puḍhavi-kammasamārambheṇaṃ
    puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārabhamāṇe anne v' aṇega-rūve pāṇe vihiṃsai
 3.  Ō tattha khalu bhagavayā parinnā paveiyā imassa c' eva jīviyassa
    parivandaṇa-māṇaṇa-pūyaṇāe, jāi-maraṇa-moyaṇāe dukkha- 
    paḍighāyaṇheuṃ Ō se sayam eva puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārabhai annehiṃ
    vā puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārambhāvei anne vā puḍhavi-satthaṃ 
 4. samārabhante samaṇujāṇai; taṃ se ahiyāe, taṃ se abohīe. se ttaṃ
    saṃbujjhamāṇe āyāṇīyaṃ, samuṭhāe Ō soccā khalu bhagavao aṇagārāṇaṃ 
    vā antie iha-m-egesiṃ nāyaṃ bhavai: esa khalu ganthe, 
    esa khalu mohe, esa khalu māre, esa khalu narae. 
             icc-atthaṃ gaḍhie loe. 
        jam iṇaṃ virūva-rūvehiṃ satthehiṃ puḍhavi-kammasamārambheṇaṃ
    puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārabhamāṇe anne v' aṇega-rūve pāṇe 
    vihiṃsai Ō 
 5.     se bemi: app-ege accam abbhe, app-ege accam acche; app-ege
    pāyam abbhe, app-ege pāyam acche; ... guppham ... jaṅgham ...
    jāṇum ... ūrum ... kaḍim ... nābhim ... uyaram ... pāsam ... 
    piṭhim ... uram ... hiyayam ... thaṇam ... khandham ... bāhum 
    ... hattham ... aṅgulim ... naham ... gīvam ... haṇum ... hoṭham 
    ... dantam ... jibbham ... tālum ... galam ... gaṇḍam ... kaṇṇam 
    ... nāsam ... acchim ... bhamuham ... nilāḍam ... sīsam ... ; app-ege
    saṃpamārae, app-ege uddavae. 
 6.     ettha satthaṃ samārabhamāṇassa icc-ee ārambhā aparinnāyā 
    bhavanti, ettha satthaṃ asamārabhamāṇassa icc-ee ārambhā parinnāyā
    bhavanti. taṃ parinnāya mehāvī n' eva sayaṃ puḍhavi-satthaṃ 
    samārabhejjā n' ev' annehiṃ puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārambhāvejjā n' ev'
    anne puḍhavi-satthaṃ samārabhante samaṇujāṇejjā. jass' ee puḍhavi-
   kamma-samārambhā parinnāyā bhavanti, se hu muṇī parinnāya-kamme
     Ō tti bemi. 
3.1.     se bemi: se jahā vi Ō 
                aṇagāre ujjukaḍe niyāga-paḍivanne amāyaṃ kuvvamāṇe 
   viyāhie. 
 2.            jāe saddhāe nikkhanto, tam eva aṇupāliyā;  
           viyahittu visottiyaṃ 
              paṇayā vīrā mahā-vīhiṃ 
    logaṃ ca āṇāe abhisameccā akuobhayaṃ. 
 3.     se bemi: n' eva sayaṃ logaṃ abbhāikkhejjā, n' eva attāṇaṃ 
    abbhāikkhejjā. je logaṃ abbhāikkhai, se attāṇaṃ abbhāikkhai; je 
    attāṇaṃ abbhāikkhai, se logaṃ abbhāikkhai. 
4-6.    ,lajjamāṇā ... 
                 vihiṃsai Ō 
 7.     se bemi: santi pāṇā udaya-nissiyā jīvā aṇegā. 
            ihaṃ ca khalu bho aṇagārāṇaṃ udayaṃ jīvā viyāhiyā. 
            satthaṃ c' ettha aṇuvīi, pāsa puḍho satthaṃ paveiyaṃ: 
    adu vā ainn' āyāṇaṃ: 
            `kappai -e kappai -e pāuṃ`, 
    adu vā vibhūsāe puḍho satthehiṃ viuanti. ettha vi tesiṃ no 
    nikaraṇāe. 
 8.     ettha satthaṃ ... 
       parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
4.1,2.    se bemi: n' eva sayaṃ ... logaṃ abbhāikkhai. je 
    dīhaloga-satthassa kheyanne, se asatthassa kheyanne; je asatthassa
    kheyanne, se dīhaloga-satthassa kheyanne. 
 3. vīrehiṃ eyaṃ abhibhūya diṭhaṃ 
    saṃjaehiṃ sayā jaehiṃ sayā appamattehiṃ: 
             je pamatte gu-' aṭhie, se hu daṇḍe pavuccai; 
             taṃ parinnāya mehāvī `iyāṇiṃ no, 
                jam ahaṃ puvvam akāsī pamāeṇaṃ.` 
4,5.     ,lajjamāṇā 
                         ... vihiṃsai Ō 
 6.     se bemi: santi pāṇā puḍhavi-nissiyā taṇa-nissiyā patta-nissiyā 
    kaṭha-nissiyā gomaya-nissiyā kayavara-nissiyā, `santi saṃpāimā pāṇā,
    āhacca saṃpayanti ya`. agaṇiṃ ca khalu puṭhā ege saṃghāyam 
    āvajjanti; je tattha saṃghāyam āvajjanti, te tattha pariyāvijjanti; 
    je tattha pariyāvijjanti, te tattha uddāyanti. 
 7.     ettha satthaṃ  
       ... parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
5.1.          `taṃ no karissāmi samuṭhāe 
               mattā maimaṃ abhayaṃ viittā. 
            taṃ je no karae, esovarae; etthovarae esa aṇagāre 
                                      tti pavuccai. 
 2. je guṇe se āvae, je āvae se guṇe: uḍḍhaṃ ahaṃ tiriyaṃ 
 3. pāīṇaṃ pāsamāṇe rūvāiṃ pāsai, suṇamāṇe saddhāiṃ suṇai; uḍḍhaṃ
    ahaṃ tiriyaṃ pāīṇaṃ mucchamāṇe rūvesu mucchai saddesu yāvi. 
                           esa loe viyāhie 
            ettha agutte aṇāṇāe. 
            puṇo-puṇo gu-' āsāe vaṅka-samāyāre pamatte gāram 
                            āvase. 
4,5.     , lajjamāṇā ... 
                                                     vihiṃsai Ō 
 6.     se bemi: imaṃ pi jāi-dhammayaṃ, eyaṃ pi jāi-dhammayaṃ; 
    imaṃ pi vuḍḍhi-dhammayaṃ, eyaṃ pi vuḍḍhi-dhammayaṃ; ... citta-
 mantayaṃ  ... chinnaṃ milāi ... āhāragaṃ  ... aniccayaṃ ... asāsayaṃ 
       ... cayāvacaiyaṃ ... vipariṇāma-dhammayaṃ. 
 7.     ettha satthaṃ 
         ... parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
6.1.     se bemi: sant' ime tasā pāṇā, taṃ-jahā: aṇḍayā poyayā jarāuyā
    rasayā saṃseyayā saṃmucchimā ubbhiyā uvavāiyā. 
                        esa saṃsāre tti pavuccai 
 2.          mandassa avijāṇao. 
             nijjhāittā paḍilehittā patteyaṃ pariṇivvāṇaṃ 
    savvesiṃ pāṇāṇaṃ, savvesiṃ bhūyāṇaṃ, savvesiṃ jīvāṇaṃ, savvesiṃ 
    sattāṇaṃ asāyaṃ apariṇivvāṇaṃ 
            mahab-bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ ti bemi.` 
              tasanti pāṇā padiso disāsu ya. 
 3. ,tattha-tattha puḍho pāsa āurā pariyāventi. santi pāṇā puḍho-siyā.
 4.     lajjamāṇā ... 
                                                         vihiṃsai Ō 
 5.     se bemi: app-ege accāe haṇanti, app-ege ajiṇāe vahanti, ... maṃsāe
    ... soṇiyāe ..., evaṃ hiyayāe pittāe vasāe picchāe pucchāe vālāe 
    siṅgāe visāṇāe dantāe dāḍhāe nahāe ṇhāruṇīe ahīe aṭhi-miñjāe
     Ō aṭhāe aṇaṭhāe; app-ege `hiṃsiṃsu me` tti vā vahanti, app-ege 
    `hiṃsanti me` tti vā vahanti, app-ege `hiṃsissanti me` tti vā vahanti. 
 6.     ettha satthaṃ ...  
                           parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
7.1.          pahū ya ejassa duguñchaṇāe 
              āyaṅka-daṃsī `ahiyaṃ` ti naccā. 
       je ajjhatthaṃ jāṇai, se bahiyā jāṇai; je bahiyā jāṇai, se ajjhatthaṃ
    jāṇai: eyaṃ tulam annesiṃ. 
             iha santi-gayā daviyā nāvakaṅkhanti jīviuṃ. 
2,3.     ,lajjamāṇā ... vihiṃsai Ō 
 4.     se bemi: 
             santi saṃpāimā pāṇā, āhacca saṃpayanti ya. 
    pharisaṃ ca khalu puṭhā ... uddāyanti. 
 5.     ettha satthaṃ ...  
               parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi. 
 6.           etthaṃ pi jāṇe uvāīyamāṇā 
    je āyāre na ramanti, 
             ārambhamāṇā viṇayaṃ vayanti; 
           chandovaṇīyā ajjhovavannā 
             ārambha-sattā pakarenti saṅgaṃ. 
    se vasumaṃ savva-samannāgaya-pannāṇeṇaṃ appāṇeṇaṃ akaraṇijjaṃ
   pāvaṃ kamm' antaṃ no annesiṃ. 
 7.     taṃ parinnāya mehāvī ... 
                   parinnāya-kamme Ō tti bemi.  
 ch/ Loga-vija
1.1. je guṇe se mūlaṇṭhāṇe, je mūlaṇṭhāṇe se guṇe. 
                     iti se gu-' aṭhī 
            mahayā pariyāveṇa vase pamatte, 
    taṃ-jahā: `māyā me, piyā me, bhāyā me, bhaiṇī me, bhajjā me, 
    puttā me, dhūyā me, suṇhā me, sahi-sayaṇa-saṃgantha-saṃthuyā 
    me, vicittovagaraṇa-pariyaaṇa-bhoya-' acchāyaṇaṃ me`; `icc-atthaṃ
    gaḍhie loe`. `vase pamatte` 
            aho ya rāo paritappamāṇe 
    kālākāla-samuṭhāī saṃjog' aṭhī aṭh' ālobhī ālumpe 
              sahasā-kāre viniviṭha-citte 
    `ettha satthe puṇo-puṇo`. 
 2.          appaṃ ca khalu āuṃ iha-m-egesiṃ māṇavāṇaṃ, 
    taṃ-jahā: soya-parinnāṇehiṃ parihāyamāṇehiṃ, cakkhu-parinnāṇehiṃ
parihāyamāṇehiṃ, ghāṇa-parinnāṇehiṃ parihāyamāṇehiṃ, 
    rasa-parinnāṇehiṃ parihāyamāṇehiṃ, phāsa-parinnāṇehiṃ parihāyamāṇehiṃ;
abhikkantaṃ ca khalu vayaṃ sāpehāe Ō tao se 
    egayā mūḍha-bhāvaṃ jaṇayanti; jehiṃ vā saddhiṃ saṃvasai, te va -aṃ
    egayā niyagā puvviṃ parivayanti so vā te niyage pacchā parivaejjā.
            nālaṃ te tava tāṇāe 
 3. vā saraṇāe vā, tumaṃ pi tesiṃ nālaṃ tāṇāe vā saraṇāe vā. `se na 
    hassāe, na kiḍḍāe, na raīe, na vibhūsāe` icc-evaṃ samuṭhie `aho
    vihārāe`. antaraṃ ca khalu imaṃ sāpehāe 
            dhīre muhuttam avi no pamāyae; 
              vao accei jovvaṇaṃ ca jīvie. 
                         iha je pamattā, Ō 
    se hantā chettā bhettā lumpittā vilumpittā uddavettā uttāsaittā `akaḍaṃ
    karissāmi` tti mannamāṇe. jehiṃ vā ... 
 4. saraṇāe vā. uvāīya-ses' anteṇa vā saṃnihi-saṃnicao 
    kajjai iha-m-egesiṃ māṇavāṇaṃ bhoyaṇāe. tao se egayā roga- 
 samuppāyā      samuppajjanti; jehiṃ vā . ... 
    saraṇāe vā. 
 5.          jāṇittu dukkhaṃ patteya-sāyaṃ 
        aṇabhikkantaṃ ca khalu vayaṃ sāpehāe 
                            khaṇaṃ jāṇāhi paṇḍie 
    jāva sotta-parinnāṇehiṃ aparihāyamāṇehiṃ, netta-parinnāṇehiṃ
aparihāyamāṇehiṃ, ghāṇa-parinnāṇehiṃ aparihāyamāṇehiṃ, 
    rasa-parinnāṇehiṃ aparihāyamāṇehiṃ, phāsa-parinnāṇehiṃ
aparihāyamāṇehiṃ icc-eehiṃ virūva-rūvehiṃ parinnāṇehiṃ aparihāyamāṇehiṃ. 
    āy' aṭhaṃ sammaṃ samaṇuvāsejjāsi Ō tti bemi. 
2.1.          araiṃ āue se mehāvī; 
    khaṇaṃsi mukke aṇāṇāe 
            puṭhā vi ege niyaanti mandā moheṇa pāuḍā: 
            `apariggahā bhavissāmo` samuṭhāe laddhe kāme 
                                      'bhigāhai. 
            aṇāṇāe muṇiṇo paḍilehanti; ettha mohe puṇo-puṇo 
    sannā no havvāe no pārāe. 
            vimuttā hu te jaṇā, je jaṇā pāra-gāmiṇo. 
            lobhaṃ alobheṇa duguñchamāṇe 
    laddhe kāme no 'bhigāhai. 
            viṇaittu lobhaṃ nikkhamma 
    esa akamme jāṇai pāsai, paḍilehāe nāvakaṅkhai, esa 
                           aṇagāre tti pavuccai. 
 2.     `aho ya rāo ... puṇo-puṇo`. se āya-bale, se nāi-bale, 
    se mitta-bale, se pecca-bale, se deva-bale, se rāya-bale, se cora-bale,
 3. se aihi-bale, se kivaṇa-bale, se samaṇa-bale, icc-eehiṃ virūva- 
    rūvehiṃ kajjehiṃ daṇḍa-samāyāṇaṃ saṃpehāe bhayā kajjai `pāva- 
    mokkho` tti mannamāṇe adu vā āsaṃsāe. taṃ parinnāya mehāvī 
    n' eva sayaṃ eehiṃ kajjehiṃ daṇḍaṃ samārabhejjā, n' ev' annaṃ eehiṃ
    kajjehiṃ daṇḍaṃ samārambhāvejjā, n' ev' annaṃ eehiṃ kajjehiṃ daṇḍaṃ
    samārabhantaṃ samaṇujāṇejjā. esa magge āriehiṃ paveie, jah' 
    ettha kusale novalippejjāsi Ō tti bemi. 
3.1. se asaiṃ uccā-goe, asaiṃ nīyā-goe, no hīṇe, no airitte: no pīhae!
 2. iti saṃkhāe ke goyā-vāī, ke māṇā-vāī, kaṃsi vā ege gijjhe? tamhā 
    paṇḍie no harise, no kujjhe. 
             bhūehiṃ jāṇa paḍileha sāyaṃ 
               samie eyāṇupassī, 
    taṃ-jahā: andhattaṃ bahirattaṃ mūyattaṃ kāṇattaṃ kuṇattaṃ khujjattaṃ
    vaḍabhattaṃ sāmattaṃ sabalattaṃ. saha pamāeṇaṃ aṇega-rūvāo
 3. joṇīo saṃdhei, virūva-rūve phāse paḍisaṃveei. se abujjhamāṇe 
    haovahae 
             jāī-maraṇaṃ aṇupariyaamāṇe. 
        jīviyaṃ puḍho piyaṃ iha-m-egesiṃ māṇavāṇaṃ khetta-vatthu 
    mamāyamāṇāṇaṃ; ārattaṃ virattaṃ maṇi-kuṇḍalaṃ saha hiraṇṇeṇaṃ,
    itthiyāo parigijjha tatth' eva rattā, na ettha tavo vā damo vā 
    niyamo vā dissai; 
             saṃpuṇṇaṃ bāle jīviu-kāme lālappamāṇe 
               mūḍhe vippariyās' uvei. 
             iṇam eva nāvakaṅkhanti je jaṇā dhuva-cāriṇo; 
             jāī-maraṇaṃ parinnāya care saṃkamaṇe daḍhe. 
             n' atthi kālass' aṇāgamo Ō savve pāṇā piy' āuyā 
    suha-sāyā dukkha-paḍikūlā 
             appiya-vahā piya-jīviṇo jīviu-kāmā, savvesiṃ jīviyaṃ 
                                   piyaṃ. 
 5.     taṃ parigijjha dupayaṃ cauppayaṃ 
             abhijuñjiyāṇaṃ saṃsaṃciyāṇaṃ 
    tiviheṇaṃ Ō jā vi se tattha mattā bhavai appā vā bahugā vā, se 
    tattha gaḍhie ciṭhai bhoyaṇāe. tao se egayā viparisiṭhaṃ saṃbhūyaṃ
    mahovagaraṇaṃ bhavai; taṃ pi se egayā dāyādā 
    vibhayanti, adattaṇhāro vā se avaharai, rāyāṇo vā se vilumpanti; 
    nassai vā se, vinassai vā se, agāraṇḍāheṇa vā se ḍajjhai. iti se 
    parass' aṭhāe 
             kūrāiṃ kammāiṃ bāle pakuvvamāṇe 
               teṇa dukkheṇa mūḍhe vippariyās' uvei. 
 6.     muṇiṇā hu eyaṃ paveiyaṃ: 
             aṇohaṃtarā ee, no ya ohaṃ tarittae; 
    atīraṃgamā ee, no ya tīraṃ gamittae; apāraṃgamā ee, no ya pāraṃ
    gamittae. 
             āyāṇijjaṃ ca āyāya tammi ṭhāṇe na ciṭhai, 
             vitahaṃ papp' akheyanne tammi ṭhāṇammi ciṭhai. 
    uddeso pāsagassa n' atthi; bāle puṇa nihe kāma-samaṇunne asamiya-
    dukkhe dukkhī dukkhāṇam eva āvaaṃ aṇupariyaai Ō tti bemi. 
4.1.     tao se egayā ... 
    saraṇāe vā. 
 2.           jāṇittu dukkhaṃ patteya-sāyaṃ 
    bhogām eva aṇusovanti Ō iha-m-egesiṃ māṇavāṇaṃ Ō tiviheṇaṃ ...
    vippariyās' uvei`: Ō 
 3.           āsaṃ ca chandaṃ ca vigiñca dhīre, tumaṃ c' eva, 
               taṃ sallam āhau; jeṇa siyā, teṇa no siyā. 
             iṇam eva nāvabujjhanti je jaṇā moha-pāuḍā. 
    thībhi loe pavvahie; te bho vayanti: `eyāiṃ āyayaṇāiṃ`. se dukkhāe
    mohāe mārāe naragāe naraga-tirikkhāe! sayayaṃ mūḍhe dhammaṃ

     vā nigamaṃ vā rāyahāṇiṃ vā taṇāiṃ jāejjā, taṇāiṃ jāittā se 
     ttam āyāe egantam avakkamejjā, egantam avakkamittā app' aṇḍe
     appa-pāṇe appa-bīe appa-harie app' ose app' udae app' uttiṅga-
paṇagadagamaiya-makkaḍāsaṃtāṇae 
     paḍilehiya 2 pamajjiya 2 taṇāiṃ 
     saṃtharejjā, taṇāiṃ saṃtharettā ettha vi samae ittiriyaṃ kujjā. 
 5.               taṃ saccaṃ: saccā-vāī oe tiṇṇe chinna-kahaṃkahe 
              āīy' aṭhe aṇāīe ceccāṇa bheuraṃ kāyaṃ 
     saṃvihuṇiya virūva-rūve parīsahovasagge assiṃ vissambhaṇayāe
bheravam 
     aṇuciṇṇe. tatthāvi ... āṇugāmiyaṃ` Ō ti bemi. 
7.1.      je bhikkhū acele parivusie, tassa -aṃ evaṃ bhavai: `cāemi 
     ahaṃ taṇa-phāsaṃ ahiyāsettae, sīya-phāsaṃ ahiyāsettae teo-phāsaṃ
ahiyāsettae daṃsamasaga-phāsaṃ 
     ahiyāsettae , egayare annayare virūva-rūve phāse ahiyāsettae; hiri-
paḍicchāyaṇaṃ 
     c' ahaṃ no saṃcāemi ahiyāsettae`, evaṃ se kappai kaḍibandhaṇaṃ
     dhārettae. adu vā tattha parakkamantaṃ bhujjo acelaṃ 
     taṇa-phāsā phusanti, sīya-phāsā phusanti, teo-phāsā phusanti,
daṃsamasaga-phāsā phusanti, 
     egayare annayare virūva-rūve phāse ahiyāsei acele lāghaviyaṃ ...
     ... samabhijāṇiyā. 
 2.      jassa -aṃ bhikkhussa evaṃ bhavai: `ahaṃ ca khalu annesiṃ 
     bhikkhūṇaṃ asaṇaṃ vā 4 āhau dalaissāmi āhaḍaṃ ca sāijjissāmi, 
     jassa ... dalaissāmi āhaḍaṃ ca no sāijjissāmi, jassa ... no dalaissāmi āhaḍaṃ
ca sāijjissāmi, jassa ... no dalaissāmi 
 3.  āhaḍaṃ ca no sāijjissāmi, ahaṃ ca khalu teṇa ahā' iritteṇa ahesaṇijjeṇa
ahā-pariggahieṇa 
     asaṇeṇa vā 4 abhikaṅkha sāhammiyassa kujjā veyāvaḍiyaṃ 
     karaṇāe, ahaṃ cāvi teṇa ... sāhammiehiṃ kīramāṇaṃ veyāvaḍiyaṃ
 4.  sāijjissāmi` Ō lāghaviyaṃ ... samabhijāṇiyā. 
 5.      jassa -aṃ bhikkhussa evaṃ bhavai: `se gilāmī ... 
      ... samae kāyaṃ ca jogaṃ ca iriyaṃ ca paccakkhāejjā. taṃ ca 
     saccaṃ ... āṇugāmiyaṃ` Ō ti bemi. 
 ch/8     Vimoho   
              1. aṇupuvveṇa vimohāiṃ | jāiṃ dhīrā samāsajja /
                  vasumanto maimanto | savvaṃ naccā aṇelisaṃ 
              2. duvihaṃ pi viittāṇaṃ | buddhā dhammassa pāragā /
                  aṇupuvvīe saṃkhāe | kammuṇāo tiuai. 
              3. kasāe payaṇue kiccā | app' āhāro tiikkhae; /

              4. jīviyaṃ nābhikaṅkhejjā | maraṇaṃ no vi patthae: /

              5. majjhattho nijjarā-pehī | samāhim aṇupālae; /
                 anto bahiṃ viosajja | ajjhatthaṃ suddham esae. 
              6. jaṃ kiṃc' uvakkamaṃ jāṇe | āu-kkhemassa-m-appaṇo, /
                  tass' eva antar' addhāe | khippaṃ sikkhejja paṇḍie. 
              7. gāme vā adu vā raṇṇe | thaṇḍilaṃ paḍilehiyā /
                  appa-pāṇaṃ tu vinnāya | taṇāiṃ saṃthare muṇī. 
              8. aṇāhāro tuyaejjā, | puṭho tatth' ahiyāsae, /
                  nāivelaṃ uvacare | māṇussehī vi puṭhavaṃ. 
              9. saṃsappagā ya je pāṇā | je ya uḍḍha-m-ahecarā /
                  bhuñjante maṃsa-soṇīyaṃ | na chaṇe na pamajjae. 
            10. pāṇā dehaṃ vihiṃsanti | Ō ṭhāṇāo na viubbhame, /
                  āsavehiṃ vicittehiṃ | tippamāṇo 'hiyāsae. 
            11. ganthehiṃ vicittehiṃ | āu-kālassa pārae; /
                  paggahīyataraṃ c' eyaṃ | daviyassa viyāṇao: 
            12. ayaṃ se avare dhamme | nāyaputteṇa sāhie: /
                  āya-vajjaṃ paḍīyāraṃ | vijahejjā tihā-tihā. 
            13. hariesu na nivajjejjā, | thaṇḍilaṃ muṇiyā sae, /
                  viosejja aṇāhāro | puṭho tattth' ahiyāsae. 
            14. indiehiṃ gilāyanto | samiyam āhare muṇī, /
                  tahā' vi se agarahe | acale je samāhie. 
            15. abhikkame paḍikkame | saṃkucae pasārae /

            16. parikkame parikilante | adu vā ciṭhe ahā-yae, /

            17. āsīṇe 'elisaṃ maraṇaṃ | indiyāṇi samīrae. /
                  kol' āvāsaṃ samāsajja | vitahaṃ pādur-esae, 
            18. jao vajjaṃ samuppajje | na tattha avalambae, /
                  tao ukkase appāṇaṃ, | savve phāse 'hiyāsae. 
            19. ayaṃ c' āyayatare siyā | jo evaṃ aṇupālae: /
                  savvagāya-nirodhe vi | ṭhāṇāo na viubbhame: 
            20. ayaṃ se uttame dhamme | puvvaṇṭhāṇassa paggahe. /
                  aciraṃ paḍilehittā | vihare ciṭh< māhaṇe, 
            21. acittaṃ tu samāsajja | ṭhāvae tattha appagaṃ, /

           22. jāvaj-jīvaṃ parīsahā | uvasaggā ya saṃkhāya /

ch/9-1 Vimoho /
             1. ahā-suyaṃ vaissāmi | jahā se samaṇe bhagavaṃ uṭhāya /
                 saṃkhāe taṃsi hemante | ahuṇā-pavvaie rīitthā. 
             2. `no c' ev' imeṇa vattheṇaṃ | pīhissāmi taṃsi hemante` Ō /
                  se pārae āvakahāe, | eyaṃ khu aṇudhammiyaṃ tassa. 
             3. cattāri sāhie māse | bahave pāṇa-jāiy' āgamma /
                 abhirujjha kāyaṃ vihariṃsu, | ārusiyāṇaṃ tattha hiṃsiṃsu. 
             4. saṃvaccharaṃ sāhiyaṃ māsaṃ | jaṃ na rikk' āsi vatthagaṃ
bhagavaṃ, /
                 acelae tao cāī | taṃ vosajja vattham aṇagāre. 
             5. adu porisiṃ tiriya-bhittiṃ | cakkhum āsajja antaso jhāi; /
                 aha cakkhu-bhīya-sahiyā te | `hantā hantā` bahave kandiṃsu.
             6. sayaṇehiṃ vīimissehiṃ | itthio tattha se parinnāyā; /
                 sāgāriyaṃ na se seve, | iti se sayaṃ pavesiyā jhāi. 
             7. je ke' ime agāratthā, | mīsī-bhāvaṃ pahāya se jhāi /
                 puṭho vi nābhibhāsiṃsu, | gacchai nāivattaī añjū. 
             8. no sukaram eyam egesiṃ: | nābhibhāse abhivāyamīṇe, /
                 haya-puvvo tattha daṇḍehiṃ, | lūsiya-puvvo appa-puṇṇehiṃ.
             9. pharusāiṃ duttiikkhāiṃ | aiyacca muṇī parakkamamāṇe /
                 āghāya-naa-gīyāiṃ | daṇḍa-jujjhāiṃ muṭhi-jujjhāiṃ 
           10. gaḍhie mihuṃ-kahāsu | samayammi nāi-sue visoe addakkhū; /
                 eyāiṃ so urālāiṃ | gacchai nāyaputte asaraṇāe. 
           11. avi sāhie duve vāse | sīodaṃ abhoccā nikkhante; /
                 egatta-gae pihiy' acce | se abhinnāya-daṃsaṇe sante. 
           12. puḍhaviṃ ca āu-kāyaṃ ca | teu-kāyaṃ ca vāu-kāyaṃ ca /
                 paṇagāiṃ bīyaṇhariyāiṃ | tasa-kāyaṃ ca savvaso naccā 
           13. `eyāiṃ santi` paḍilehe | `cittamantāiṃ` se abhinnāya /
                 parivajjiyāṇa viharitthā | iti saṃkhāe se mahā-vīre: 
           14. `adu thāvarā ya tasattāe | tasa-jīvā ya thāvarattāe, /
                 adu savva-joṇiyā sattā, | kammuṇā kappiyā puḍho bālā`.
           15. bhagavaṃ ca evam annesī: | `sovahie hu luppaī bāle`; /
                 kammaṃ ca savvaso naccā | taṃ paḍiyāikkhe pāvagaṃ
bhagavaṃ. 
          16. duvihaṃ samecca mehāvī | kiriyam akkhāy' aṇelisa-nnāṇī /
                āyāṇa-soyam aivāya | soyaṃ jogaṃ ca savvaso naccā 
          17. aivattiyam aṇāuiṃ | sayam annesiṃ akaraṇayāe: /
                jass' itthio parinnāyā | savva-kamm' āvahāo addakkhū. 
          18. ahā-kaḍaṃ na se seve, | savvaso kammuṇā ya addakkhū /
                jaṃ kiṃci pāvagaṃ, bhagavaṃ | taṃ akuvvaṃ viyaḍaṃ bhuñjitthā.
          19. n' āsevaī ya para-vatthaṃ, | para-pāe vi se na bhuñjitthā, /
                parivajjiyāṇa omāṇaṃ | gacchai saṃkhaḍiṃ asaraṇāe. 
          20. māyanne asaṇa-pāṇassa | nāṇugiddhe rasesu apaḍinne; /
                acchiṃ pi no pamajjiyā, | no vi ya kaṇḍūyae muṇī gāyaṃ.
          21. appaṃ tiriyaṃ pehāe | appaṃ piṭhao va pehāe /
               appaṃ buie paḍibhāṇī | pantha-pehī care jayamāṇe. 
         22. sisiraṃsi addha-paḍivanne | taṃ vosajja vattham aṇagāre /
               pasārettu bāho parakkame | no avalambiyāṇa khandhaṃsi.
         23. esa vihī aṇukkanto | māhaṇeṇa maīmayā /
               bahuso apaḍinneṇaṃ | bhagavayā evaṃ rīyante   tti

ch/9-2    Vimoho /
          1. cariy' āsaṇāiṃ sejjāo|  egaiyāo jāo buiyāo, /
              āikkha tāiṃ saya-' āsaṇāiṃ | jāiṃ sevittha se mahā-vīre. 
          2. āvesaṇa-sabhā-pavāsu | paṇiya-sālāsu egayā vāso, /
              adu vā paliyaṇṭhāṇesu | palāla-puñjesu egayā vāso. 
          3. āgantāre ārāmāgāre nagare vi egayā vāso, /
              susāṇe sunna-gāre vā | rukkha-mūle vi egayā vāso. 
          4. eehiṃ muṇī sayaṇehiṃ | samaṇe āsi pa-telasa vāse; /
              rāiṃdiyaṃ pi jayamāṇe | appamatte samāhie jhāi; 
          5. niddaṃ pi no pagāmāe | sevai ya bhagavaṃ uṭhāe; /
              jaggāvaī ya appāṇaṃ, | īsiṃ sāi-y-āsī apaḍinne. 
          6. saṃbujjhamāṇe puṇar avi | āsiṃsu bhagavaṃ uṭhāe /
              nikkhamma egayā rāo | bahiṃ caṃkamiyā muhuttāgaṃ. 
          7. sayaṇehiṃ tass' uvasaggā | bhīmā āsī aṇega-rūvā ya: /
              saṃsappagā ya je pāṇā | adu vā pakkhiṇo uvacaranti. 
          8. adu kucarā uvacaranti | gāma-rakkhā ya satti-hatthā ya, /
              adu gāmiyā uvasaggā: | itthī egaiyā puriso vā. 
          9. iha-loiyāiṃ para-loiyāiṃ | bhīmāiṃ aṇega-rūvāiṃ, /
              avi subbhi-dubbhi-gandhāiṃ | saddāiṃ aṇega-rūvāiṃ 
        10. ahiyāsae sayā samie | phāsāiṃ virūva-rūvāiṃ; /
              araiṃ raiṃ ca abhibhūya | rīyaī māhaṇe abahu-vāī. 
        11. sayaṇehiṃ tattha pucchiṃsu | ega-carā vi egayā rāo, /
              avvāhie kasāitthā; | pehamāṇe samāhiṃ apaḍinne. 
        12. `ayam antar aṃsi; ko etthaṃ?` | `aham aṃsi` tti `bhikkhu` āhau /
              ayam uttame se dhamme: | tusiṇīe sa kasāie jhāi. 
       13. jaṃsi pp-ege pavevanti | sisire mārue pavāyante /
             taṃsi pp-ege aṇagārā | himavāe nivāyam esanti: 
       14. `saṃghāḍīo pavisissāmo, | ehā ya samādahamāṇā /
             pihiyā vā sakkhāmo; | aidukkhaṃ himaga-saṃphāsā!` 
        15. taṃsi bhagavaṃ apaḍinne | ahe-viyaḍe ahiyāsae davie, /
              nikkhamma egayā rāo | cāei bhagavaṃ samiyāe. 
       16. esa vihī aṇukkanto | māhaṇeṇa maīmayā /
             bahuso apaḍinneṇaṃ | bhagavayā evaṃ rīyante   tti

ch/9-3     Vimoho /
        1. taṇa-phāsa sīya-phāse ya | teo-phāse ya daṃsa-masae ya: /
             ahiyāsae sayā samie | phāsāiṃ virūva-rūvāiṃ. 
         2. aha duccara-lāḍham acārī | vajja-bhūmiṃ ca subbha-bhūmiṃ ca, /
             pantaṃ sejjaṃ seviṃsu | āsaṇagāiṃ c' eva pantāiṃ. 
         3. lāḍhehiṃ tass' uvasaggā | bahave: jāṇavayā lūsiṃsu, /
             aha lukkha-desie bhatte, | kukkurā tattha hiṃsiṃsu nivaiṃsu. 
         4. appe jaṇe nivārei | lūsaṇae suṇae ḍasamāṇe, /
             `chuc-chuk` kārenti āhantuṃ | `samaṇaṃ kukkurā ḍasantu` tti. 
         5. elikkhae jaṇe bhujjo | bahave vajja-bhūmiṃ pharus' āsī, /
             laṭhiṃ gahāya nālīyaṃ | samaṇā tattha eva vihariṃsu; 
         6. evaṃ pi tattha viharantā | puṭha-puvvā ahesi suṇaehiṃ, /
             saṃluñcamāṇā suṇaehiṃ Ō | duccaragāṇi tattha lāḍhehiṃ. 
         7. nihāya daṇḍaṃ pāṇehiṃ | taṃ kāyaṃ vosajja-m-aṇagāre /
             aha gāma-kaṇae, bhagavaṃ | te ahiyāsae abhisameccā, 
         8. `nāo` saṃgāma-sīse va | pārae tattha se mahā-vīre. /
             evaṃ pi tattha lāḍhehiṃ | aladdha-puvvo vi egayā gāmo; 
         9. uvasaṃkamantam apaḍinnaṃ | gām' antiyaṃ pi appattaṃ /
             paḍinikkhamittu lūsiṃsu: | `eyāo paraṃ palehi!` tti. 
      10. haya-puvvo tattha daṇḍeṇaṃ | adu vā muṭhiṇā adu phaleṇaṃ /
             adu leluṇā kavāleṇaṃ; | `hantā hantā!` bahave kandiṃsu. 
      11. maṃsūṇi chinna-puvvāiṃ, | oṭhabhiyāe egayā kāyaṃ /
             parissahāiṃ luñciṃsu | adu vā paṃsuṇā uvakariṃsu, 
      12. uccālaiya nihaṇiṃsu | adu vā āsaṇāo khalaiṃsu Ō /
             vosaṭha-kāe paṇay' āsī | dukkha-sahe bhagavaṃ apaḍinne.
      13. sūro saṃgāma-sīse va | saṃvuḍe tattha se mahā-vīre /
            paḍisevamāṇo pharusāiṃ | acale bhagavaṃ rīitthā. 
      14. esa vihī aṇukkanto | māhaṇeṇa maīmayā /
            bahuso apaḍinneṇaṃ | bhagavayā evaṃ rīyante   tti bemi||
ch/9-4    Vimoho /
        1. om' oyariyaṃ cāeī | apuṭhe vi bhagavaṃ rogehiṃ; /
             puṭho va se apuṭho vā | no se sāijjai teicchaṃ. 
        2. saṃsohaṇaṃ ca vamaṇaṃ ca | gāy' abbhaṅgaṇaṃ siṇāṇaṃ ca /
             saṃbāhaṇaṃ na se kappe | danta-pakkhālaṇaṃ parinnāe. 
        3. virae ya gāma-dhammehiṃ | rīyai māhaṇe abahu-vāi, /
            sisirammi egayā bhagavaṃ | chāyāe jhāi āsī ya. 
        4. āyāvaī ya gimhāṇaṃ | acchai ukkuḍue abhitāve, /
            adu jāvaittha lūheṇaṃ | oyaṇa-manthu-kummāseṇaṃ. 
        5. eyāṇi tiṇṇi paḍiseve | aṭha māse ya jāvae bhagavaṃ, /
            apiittha egayā bhagavaṃ | addha-māsaṃ adu vā māsaṃ pi. 
        6. avi sāhie duve māse | chap pi māse adu vā apivitthā, /
            rāovarāyaṃ apaḍinne | anna-gilāyam egayā bhuñje. 
        7. chaṭheṇam egayā bhuñje | adu vā aṭhameṇa dasameṇaṃ, /
            duvālasameṇa egayā bhuñje | pehamāṇe samāhiṃ apaḍinne.
        8. naccāṇa se mahā-vīre | no vi ya pāvagaṃ sayam akāsī /
            annehiṃ vī na kāretthā | kīrantaṃ pi nāṇujāṇitthā. 
        9. gāmaṃ pavissa nagaraṃ vā | ghāsam ese kaḍaṃ par' aṭhāe /
            suvisuddham esiyā bhagavaṃ | āyaya-jogayāe sevitthā. 
     10. adu vāyasā digiñchantā, | je anne ras' esiṇo sattā /
            ghās' esaṇāe ciṭhante | sayayaṃ nivaie ya pehāe, 
     11. adu māhaṇaṃ va samaṇaṃ vā | gāma-piṇḍolagaṃ va aihiṃ vā /
            sovāg< mūsiyāriṃ vā | kukkuraṃ vā vivihaṃ ṭhiyaṃ purao, 
     12. vitti-ccheyaṃ vajjanto | tes' appattiyaṃ pariharanto /
            mandaṃ parakkame bhagavaṃ, | ahiṃsamāṇo ghāsam esitthā.
     13. avi sūiyaṃ va sukkaṃ vā | sīya-piṇḍaṃ purāṇa-kummāsaṃ /
            adu vakkasaṃ pulāgaṃ vā | laddhe piṇḍe aladdhae davie. 
     14. avi jhāi se mahā-vīre | āsaṇatthe akukkue jhāṇaṃ, /
            uḍḍhaṃ ahe ya tiriyaṃ ca | loe jhāyai samāhim apaḍinne 
     15. akasāi vigaya-gehī ya | sadda-rūvesu amucchie jhāi. /
            chaumattho vi parakkamamāṇe | na pamāyaṃ saiṃ pi kuvvitthā.
     16. sayam eva abhisamāgamma | āyaya-jogam āya-sohīe /
            abhinivvuḍe amāille | āvakahaṃ bhagavaṃ samiy' āsī. 
     17. esa vihī aṇukkanto | māhaṇeṇa maīmayā /
           bahuso apaḍinneṇaṃ | bhagavayā evaṃ rīyante   tti bemi||

1 prathamamadhyayanam (dumapupphiyā.) /
dhammo maṅgalamukkaṭhaṃ | ahiṃsā saṃjamo tavo /
devā vi taṃ namaṃsanti | jassa dhamme sayā maṇo 
jahā dumassa pupphesu | bhamaro āviyai rasaṃ /
na ya pupphaṃ kilāmei | so ya pīṇei appayaṃ 
emee samaṇā muttā | je loe santi sāhuṇo /
vihaṃgamā va pupphesu | dāṇa-bhattesaṇe rayā 
vayaṃ ca vittiṃ labbhāmo | na ya koi uvahammaī /
ahāgaḍesu rīyante | pupphesu bhamarā jahā 
mahukāra-samā buddhā | je bhavanti aṇissiyā /
nāṇā-piṇḍa-rayā dantā, | teṇa vuccantisāhuṇo  tti bemi ||
|| prathamamadhyayanam 
 Dasaveyāliya: 2 dvitīyamadhyayanam (sāmaṇṇapuvvagaṃ.) /
kahaṃ nu kujjā sāmaṇṇaṃ | jo kāme na nivārae /
pae pae visīyanto | saṃkappassa vasaṃ gao? 
vattha-gandhamalaṃkāraṃ | itthīo sayaṇāṇi ya /
acchandā je na bhuñjanti | na se "cāi" tti vuccaī 
je ya kante pie bhoe | laddhe vippiṭhi-kuvvaī /
sāhīṇe cayai bhoe | se hu "cāi" tti vuccaī 
  samāe pehāe parivvayanto | siyā maṇo nissaraī bahiddhā, /
  "na sā mahaṃ no vi ahaṃ pi tīse" | icceva tāo viṇaejja rāgaṃ 
  āyāvayāhī! caya sogumallaṃ! | kāme kamāhī! kamiyaṃ khu dukkhaṃ /
  chindāhi dosaṃ! viṇaejja rāgaṃ! | evaṃ suhī hohisi saṃparāe 
pakkhande jaliyaṃ joiṃ | dhūma-keuṃ durāsayaṃ /
necchanti vantayaṃ bhottuṃ | kule jāyā agandhaṇe 
dhiratthu te jaso-kāmī | jo taṃ jīviya-kāraṇā /
vantaṃ icchasi āveuṃ! | seyaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhave 
ahaṃ ca bhoga-rāyassa, | taṃ ca si andhavaṇhiṇo /
mā kule gandhaṇā homo, | saṃjamaṃ nihuo cara 
jai taṃ kāhisi bhāvaṃ | jā jā dacchisi nārio /
vāyāiddho vva haḍho | aṭhiyappā bhavissasi 
tīse so vayaṇaṃ soccā | saṃjayāe subhāsiyaṃ /
aṅkuseṇa jahā nāgo | dhamme saṃpaḍivāio 
evaṃ karenti saṃbuddhā | paṇḍiyā paviyakkhaṇā /
viṇiyaanti bhogesu | jahā se purisuttamo  tti bemi ||
|| dvitīyamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 3 tṛtīyamadhyayanam (khuḍḍiyāyāro.) /
saṃjame suṭhiyappāṇaṃ | vippamukkāṇa tāiṇaṃ /
tesimeyamaṇāiṇṇaṃ | nigganthāṇa mahesiṇaṃ 
uddesiyaṃ 1 kīyagaḍaṃ 2 | niyāgaṃ 3 abhihaḍāṇi 4 ya /
rāi-bhatte 5 siṇāṇe 6 ya | gandha 7 malle 8 ya vīyaṇe 9 
sannihī gihi-matte ya | rāyapiṇḍe kimicchae /
saṃbāhaṇa danta-pahoyaṇā ya | saṃpucchaṇa deha-paloyaṇāya 
aṭhāvae ya nālī ya | chattassa ya dhāraṇaṭhāe /
tegicchaṃ pāṇahā pāe | samārambhaṃ ca joiṇo 
sejjāyara-piṇḍaṃ ca | āsandī paliyaṅkae /
gihantara-nisejjā ya | gāyassuvvaaṇāṇi ya 
gihiṇo veyāvaḍiyaṃ | jā ya ājīva-vattiyā /
tattānivvuḍa-bhoittaṃ | āura-ssaraṇāṇi ya 
mūlae siṅgabere ya | ucchu-khaṇḍe anivvuḍe /
kande mūle ya saccitte | phale bīe ya āmae 
sovaccale sindhave loṇe | romā-loṇe ya āmae /
sāmudde paṃsu-khāre ya | kālā-loṇe ya āmae 
dhūvaṇe tti vamaṇe ya | vatthī-kamma vireyaṇe /
añjaṇe dantavaṇe ya | gāyābhaṅga-vibhūsaṇe 
savvameyamaṇāiṇṇaṃ | nigganthāṇa mahesiṇaṃ /
saṃjamammi ya juttāṇaṃ | lahubhūya-vihāriṇaṃ 
pañcāsava-parinnāyā | ti-guttā chasu saṃjayā /
pañca-niggahaṇā dhīrā | nigganthā ujju-daṃsiṇo 
āyāvayanti gimhesu, | hemantesu avāuḍā /
vāsāsu paḍisaṃlīṇā | saṃjayā su-samāhiyā 
parīsaha-riū dantā | dhuya-mohā jiindiyā /
savva-dukkha-ppahīṇaṭhā | pakkamanti mahesiṇo 
dukkarāiṃ karettāṇaṃ | dussahāiṃ sahettu ya /
ke ettha devalogesu | keī sijjhanti nīrayā 
khavittā puvva-kammāiṃ | saṃjameṇa taveṇa ya /
siddhi-maggamaṇuppattā | tāiṇo parinivvuḍa  tti bemi ||
|| tṛtīyamadhyayanam 
 Dasaveyāliya: 4 caturthamadhyayanam (chajjīvaṇiyā.) /
suyaṃ me āusaṃ teṇaṃ bhagavayā evamakkhāyaṃ | 
iha khalu chajjīvaṇiyā nāmajjhayaṇaṃ samaṇeṇaṃ bhagavayā 
mahāvīreṇaṃ kāsaveṇaṃ paveiyā suyakkhāyā supannattā | 
seyamme ahijjiuṃ || ajjhayaṇaṃ dhammapannattī || 
kayarā khalu sā chajjīvaṇiyā nāmajjhayaṇaṃ samaṇeṇaṃ 
bhagavayā mahāvīreṇaṃ kāsaveṇaṃ paveiyā suyakkhāyā 
supannattā? 
  imā khalu sā chajjīvaṇiyā nāmajjhayaṇaṃ, taṃ 
jahā | puḍhavi-kāiyā āu-kāiyā teu-kāiyā 
vāu-kāiyā vaṇassai-kāiyā tasa-kāiyā || 
  puḍhavi cittamantakkhāyā aṇega-jīvā puḍho-sattā 
annattha sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ, āu cittamantakkhāyā 
aṇega-jīvā puḍho-sattā annattha sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ, 
teu cittamantakkhāyā aṇega-jīvā puḍho-sattā annattha 
sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ, vāu cittamantakkhāyā aṇega-jīvā 
puḍho-sattā annattha sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ, vaṇassai cittamantakkhāyā 
aṇega-jīvā puḍho-sattā annattha sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ, 
taṃ jahā | agga-bīyā mūla-bīyā pora-bīyā 
khandha-bīyā bīya-ruhā sammucchimā, taṇa-layā vaṇassai 
kāiyā sa-bīyā citamantakkhāyā aṇega-jīvā puḍhosattā 
annattha sattha-pariṇaeṇaṃ || 
  se je puṇa ime aṇege bahave tasā pāṇā, taṃ 
jahā | aṇḍayā poyayā jarāuyā rasayā saṃseimā 
sammucchimā ubbhiyā ovavāiyā jesiṃ kesiṃci pāṇāṇaṃ 
abhikkantaṃ paḍikkantaṃ saṃkuciyaṃ pasāriyaṃ ruyaṃ 
bhantaṃ tasiyaṃ palāiyaṃ āgai-gai-vinnāyā || 
  je ya kīḍa-payaṅgā jā ya kunthu-pipīliyā savve 
bendiyā savve teindiyā savve caurindiyā savve pañcindiyā 
savve tirikkha-joṇiyā savve neraiyā savve maṇuyā 
savve devā savve pāṇā paramāhammiyā, 
  eso khalu chaṭho jīva-nikāo tasa-kāo tti 
pavuccaī, 
  iccesiṃ chaṇhaṃ jīva-nikāyāṇaṃ neva sayaṃ daṇḍaṃ 
samārambhejjā, nevannehiṃ daṇḍaṃ samārambhāvejjā, daṇḍaṃ 
samārambhante vi anne na samaṇujāṇejjā || 
  jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe 
kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi annaṃ na 
samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi 
garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi || 
  paḍhame bhante mahavvae pāṇāivāyāo veramaṇaṃ | 
savvaṃ bhante pāṇāivāyaṃ paccakkhāmi, se suhumaṃ vā bāyaraṃ 
vā tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā | neva sayaṃ pāṇe aivāejjā, 
nevannehiṃ pāṇe aivāyāvejjā, pāṇe aivāyante vi 
anne na samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ 
maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi 
karentaṃ pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante 
paḍikkamāmi nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi, 
paḍhame bhante mahavvae uvaṭhio mi | savvāo pāṇāivāyāo 
veramaṇaṃ  
  ahāvare docce bhante mahavvae musāvāyāo veramaṇaṃ 
| savvaṃ bhante musāvāyaṃ paccakkhāmi, se kohā vā 
lohā vā bhayā vā hāsā vā | neva sayaṃ musaṃ vaejjā, 
nevannehiṃ musaṃ vāyāvejjā, musaṃ vayante vi anne na samaṇujāṇejjā, 
jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ 
vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi 
annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi 
nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi, docce bhante 
mahavvae uvaṭhio mi | savvāo musāvāyāo veramaṇaṃ 
  ahāvare tacce bhante mahavvae adinnādāṇāo 
veramaṇaṃ | savvaṃ bhante adinnādāṇaṃ paccakkhāmi, se gāme 
vā nagare vā ranne vā appaṃ vā ahuṃ vā aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā cittamantaṃ 
vā acittamantaṃ vā | neva sayaṃ adinnaṃ geṇhejjā, 
nevannehiṃ adinnaṃ geṇhāvejjā, adinnaṃ geṇhante vi 
anne na samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ 
maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi 
karentaṃ pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi 
nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi, 
tacce bhante mahavvae uvaṭhio mi | savvāo adinnādāṇao 
veramaṇaṃ  
  ahāvare cautthe bhante mahavvae mehuṇāo veramaṇaṃ 
| savvaṃ bhante mehuṇaṃ paccakkhāmi, se divvaṃ vā māṇusaṃ 
vā tirikkhajoṇiyaṃ vā | neva sayaṃ mehuṇaṃ sevejjā, nevannehiṃ 
mehuṇaṃ sevāvejjā, mehuṇaṃ sevante vi anne na 
samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ 
vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi 
annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi 
garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi, cautthe bhante 
mahavvae uvaṭhio mi | savvāo mehuṇāo veramaṇaṃ  
  ahāvare pañcame bhante mahavvae pariggahāo veramaṇaṃ 
| savvaṃ bhante pariggahaṃ paccakkhāmi, se appaṃ vā 
bahuṃ vā aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā cittamantaṃ vā acittamantaṃ 
vā | neva sayaṃ pariggahaṃ parigeṇhejjā, nevannehiṃ 
pariggahaṃ parigeṇhāvejjā, pariggahaṃ parigeṇhante 
vi anne na samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ 
tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na 
kāravemi karentaṃ pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa 
bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ 
vosirāmi, pañcame bhante mahavvae uvaṭhio mi | 
savvāo pariggahāo veramaṇaṃ  
  ahāvare chaṭhe bhante vae rāībhoyaṇāo veramaṇaṃ | 
savvaṃ bhante rāībhoyaṇaṃ paccakkhāmi, se asaṇaṃ vā pāṇaṃ 
vā khāimaṃ vā sāimaṃ vā neva sayaṃ rāiṃ bhuñjejjā, nevannehiṃ 
rāiṃ bhuñjāvejjā, rāiṃ bhuñjante vi anne na samaṇujāṇejjā, 
jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ 
vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi 
annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi 
nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi, chaṭhe bhante 
vae uvaṭhio mi | savvāo rāībhoyaṇāo veramaṇaṃ || 
  icceiyāiṃ pañca mahavvayāiṃ rāībhoyaṇaveramaṇachaṭhāiṃ 
atta-hiyaṭhayāe uvasaṃpajjittāṇaṃ viharāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihaya 
paccakkhāya-pāvakamme 
diyā vā rāo vā egao vā 
parisā-gao vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se puḍhaviṃ 
vā bhittiṃ vā silaṃ vā leluṃ vā sasarakkhaṃ vā kāyaṃ sasararakaṃ 
vā vatthaṃ hattheṇa vā pāeṇa vā kaṭheṇa vā kaliñceṇa 
vā aṅguliyāe vā salāgāe vā salāgahattheṇa 
vā nālihejjā na vilihejjā na ghaejjā na 
bhindejjā, annaṃ nālihāvejjā na vilihāvejjā na 
ghaāvejjā na bhindāvejjā, annaṃ ālihantaṃ vā vilihantaṃ 
vā ghaantaṃ vā bhindantaṃ vā na samaṇujāṇejjā, 
jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ 
na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, 
tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi garihāmi 
appāṇaṃ vosirāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihayapaccakkhāya-pāvakamme 
diyā vā rāo vā egao vā 
parisā-gao vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se udagaṃ 
vā osaṃ vā himaṃ vā mahiyaṃ vā karagaṃ vā harataṇugaṃ 
vā suddhodagaṃ vā udaollaṃ vā kāyaṃ udaollaṃ vā vatthaṃ 
sasiṇiddhaṃ vā kāyaṃ sasiṇiddhaṃ vā vatthaṃ nāmusejjā 
na saṃphusejjā na āvīlejjā na pavīlejjā 
na akkhoḍejjā na pakkhoḍejjā na āyāvejjā na payāvejjā, 
annaṃ nāmusāvejjā na saṃphusāvejjā na āvīlāvejjā 
na pavīlāvejjā na akkhoḍāvejjā na pakkhoḍāvejjā 
na āyāvejjā na payāvejjā, annaṃ āmusantaṃ 
vā saṃphasantaṃ vā āvīlantaṃ vā pavīlantaṃ vā 
akkhoḍantaṃ vā pakkhoḍantaṃ vā āyāventaṃ vā payāventaṃ 
vā na samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ 
maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ 
pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi 
nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihaya 
paccakkhāya-pāvakamme diyā vā rāo vā egao vā 
parisā-gao vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se agaṇiṃ 
vā iṅgālaṃ vā mummuraṃ vā acciṃ vā jālaṃ vā alāyaṃ 
vā suddhāgaṇiṃ vā ukkaṃ vā na uñjejjā na ghaejjā na 
ujjālejjā na nivvāvejjā, annaṃ na uñjāvejjā na 
ghaāvejjā na ujjālāvejjā na nivvāvejjā, annaṃ 
uñjantaṃ vā ghaantaṃ vā ujjālantaṃ vā nivvāvantaṃ vā na 
samaṇujāṇejjā, jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ 
vāyāe kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ 
pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi 
nindāmi garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihaya 
paccakkhāya-pāvakamme diyā vā rāo vā egao vā 
parisā-gao vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se sieṇa vā 
vihuyaṇeṇa vā tāliya- eṇa vā patteṇa vā patta-bhaṅgeṇa 
vā sāhāe vā sāhā-bhaṅgeṇa vā pihuṇeṇa vā pihuṇahattheṇa 
vā celeṇa vā cela-kaṇṇeṇa vā hattheṇa vā 
muheṇa vā appaṇo vā kāyaṃ bāhiraṃ vā vi poggalaṃ 
na phumejjā na vīejjā, annaṃ na phumāvejjā na vīyāvejjā, 
annaṃ phumantaṃ vā vīyantaṃ vā na samaṇujāṇejjā, 
jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe kāeṇaṃ 
na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi annaṃ na samaṇujāṇāmi, 
tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi garihāmi 
appāṇaṃ vosirāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihaya 
paccakkhāya-pāvakamme 
diyā vā rāo vā egao vā 
parisā-gao vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se bīesu vā 
bīya-paiṭhesu vā rūḍhesu vā rūḍha-paiṭhesu vā jāesu vā 
jāya-paiṭhesu vā hariesu vā hariya-paiṭhesu vā chinnesu 
vā chinna-paiṭhesu vā saccittesu vā saccitta-kolapaḍinissiesu 
vā na gacchejjā na ciṭhejjā na nisīejjā 
na tuyaejjā, annaṃ na gacchāvejjā na ciṭhāvejjā 
na nisīyāvejjā na tuyaāvejjā, annaṃ gacchantaṃ vā 
ciṭhantaṃ vā nisīyantaṃ vā tuyaantaṃ vā na samaṇujāṇejjā, 
jāvajjīvāe tivihaṃ tiviheṇaṃ maṇeṇaṃ vāyāe 
kāeṇaṃ na karemi na kāravemi karentaṃ pi annaṃ na 
samaṇujāṇāmi, tassa bhante paḍikkamāmi nindāmi 
garihāmi appāṇaṃ vosirāmi  
  se bhikkhū vā bhikkhuṇī vā saṃjaya-viraya-paḍihaya 
paccakkhāya-pāvakamme 
diyā vā rāo vā egao vā parisā-gao 
vā sutte vā jāgaramāṇe vā, se kīḍaṃ vā payaṅgaṃ 
vā kunthuṃ vā pipīliyaṃ vā hatthaṃsi vā pāyaṃsi vā 
bāhuṃsi vā ūruṃsi vā udaraṃsi vā sīsaṃsi vā vatthaṃsi 
vā (paḍiggahaṃsi vā kambalaṃsi vā pāyapuñchaṇaṃsi 
vā) rayaharaṇaṃsi vā gocchagaṃsi vā uṇḍuyaṃsi vā daṇḍagaṃsi 
vā pīḍhagaṃsi vā phalagaṃsi vā sejjaṃsi vā 
saṃthāragaṃsi vā annayaraṃsi vā taha-ppagāre uvagaraṇajāe 
tao saṃjayāmeva paḍilehiya paḍilehiya pamajjiya 
pamajjiya egantamavaṇejjā, no -aṃsaṃghāyamāvajjejjā
ajayaṃ caramāṇo u | pāṇa-bhūyāi hiṃsaī /
bandhaī pāvayaṃ kammaṃ, | taṃ se hoi kaḍuyaṃ phalaṃ 
ajayaṃ ciṭhamāṇo u | pāṇa-bhūyāi hiṃsaī /
bandhaī pāvayaṃ kammaṃ, | taṃ se hoi kaḍuyaṃ phalaṃ 
ajayaṃ āsamāṇo u | pāṇa-bhūyāi hiṃmaī /
bandhaī pāvayaṃ kammaṃ, | taṃ se hoi kaḍuyaṃ phalaṃ 
ajayaṃ sayamāṇo u | pāṇa-bhūyāi hiṃsaī /
bandhaī pāvayaṃ kammaṃ, | taṃ se hoi kaḍuyaṃ phalaṃ 
ajayaṃ bhuñjamāṇo u | pāṇa-bhūyāi hiṃsaī /

aggalaṃ phalihaṃ dāraṃ | kavāḍaṃ vā vi saṃjae /
avalambiyā na ciṭhejjā | goyaragga-gao muṇī 
samaṇaṃ māhaṇaṃ vā vi | kiviṇaṃ vā vaṇīmagaṃ /
uvasaṃkamantaṃ bhattaṭhā | pāṇaṭhāe va saṃjae 
taṃ aikkamittu na pavise, | na ciṭhe cakkhu-goyare /
egantamavakkamittā | tattha ciṭhejja saṃjae 
vaṇīmagassa vā tassa | dāyagassubhayassa vā /
appattiyaṃ siyā hojjā | lahuttaṃ pavayaṇassa vā 
paḍisehie va dinne vā | tao tammi niyattie /
uvasaṃkamejja bhattaṭhā | pāṇaṭhāe va saṃjae 
uppalaṃ paumaṃ vā vi | kumuyaṃ vā magadantiyaṃ /
annaṃ vā puppha saccittaṃ | taṃ ca saṃluñciyā dae 
taṃ bhave bhattapāṇaṃ tu | saṃjayāṇa akappiyaṃ /
dentiyaṃ paḍiyāikkhe | "na me kappai tārisaṃ" 
uppalaṃ paumaṃ vā vi | kumuyaṃ vā magadantiyaṃ /
annaṃ vā puppha saccittaṃ | taṃ ca sammaddiyā dae 
taṃ bhave bhattapāṇaṃ tu | saṃjayāṇa akappiyaṃ /
dentiyaṃ paḍiyāikkhe | "na me kappai tārisaṃ" 
sāluyaṃ vā birāliyaṃ | kumuyaṃ uppala-nāliyaṃ /
muṇāliyaṃ sāsava-nāliyaṃ | ucchu-kkhaṇḍaṃ anivvuḍaṃ 
taruṇagaṃ vā pavālaṃ | rukkhassa taṇagassa vā /
annassa vā vi hariyassa | āmagaṃ parivajjae 
taruṇiyaṃ vā chevāḍiṃ | āmiyaṃ bhajjiyaṃ saiṃ /
dentiyaṃ paḍiyāikkhe | "na me kappai tārisaṃ" 
tahā kolamaṇassinnaṃ | veluyaṃ kāsava-nāliyaṃ /
tila-pappaḍagaṃ nīmaṃ | āmagaṃ parivajjae 
taheva cāulaṃ piṭhaṃ | viyaḍaṃ vā tatta-nivvuḍaṃ /
tila-piṭha pūi-pinnāgaṃ | āmagaṃ parivajjae 
kaviṭhaṃ māula-gaṃ ca | mūlagaṃ mūlagattiyaṃ /
āmaṃ a-sattha-pariṇayaṃ | maṇasā vi na patthae 
taheva phala-manthūṇi | bīya-manthūṇi jāṇiyā /
bihelagaṃ piyālaṃ ca | āmagaṃ parivajjae 
samuyāṇaṃ care bhikkhū | kulaṃ uccāvayaṃ sayā /
nīyaṃ kulamaikkamma | ūsaḍhaṃ nābhidhārae 
adīṇo vittimesejjā | na visīejja paṇḍie /
amucchio bhoyaṇammi | māya-nne esaṇā-rae 
"bahuṃ para-ghare atthi | vivihaṃ khāima-sāimaṃ" /
na tattha paṇḍio kuppe, | icchā dejja paro na vā 
sayaṇāsaṇa-vatthaṃ vā | bhattapāṇaṃ va saṃjae /
adentassa na kuppejjā | paccakkhe vi ya dīsao 
itthiyaṃ purisaṃ vā vi | ḍaharaṃ vā mahallagaṃ /
vandamāṇaṃ na jāejjā, | no ya -aṃ pharusaṃ vae 
je na vande na se kuppe, | vandio na samukkase, /
evamannesamāṇassa | sāmaṇṇamaṇuciṭhaī 
siyā egaīo laddhuṃ | lobheṇa viṇigūhaī /
"mā meyaṃ dāiyaṃ santaṃ | daṭhūṇaṃ sayamāyae" 
attaṭhā-guruo luddho | bahuṃ pāvaṃ pakuvvaī /
duttosao ya se hoi, | nivvāṇaṃ ca na gacchaī 
siyā egaīo laddhuṃ | vivihaṃ pāṇa-bhoyaṇaṃ /
bhaddagaṃ bhaddagaṃ bhoccā | vivaṇṇaṃ virasamāhare 
jāṇantu tā ime samaṇā | "āyayaṭhī ayaṃ muṇī /
saṃtuṭho sevaī pantaṃ | lūha-vittī sutosao" 
pūyaṇaṭhā jaso-kāmī | māṇa-sammāṇa-kāmae /
bahuṃ pasavaī pāvaṃ, | māyā-sallaṃ ca kuvvaī 
suraṃ vā meragaṃ vā vi | annaṃ vā majjagaṃ rasaṃ /
sa-sakkhaṃ na pibe bhikkhū | jasaṃ sārakkhamappaṇo 
piyā egaīo teṇo | na me koi viyāṇaī /
tassa passaha dosāiṃ, | niyaḍiṃ ca suṇeha me 
vaḍḍhaī soṇḍiyā tassa | māyā-mosaṃ ca bhikkhuṇo /
ayaso ya anivvāṇaṃ | sayayaṃ ca asāhuyā 
niccuvviggo jahā teṇo | atta-kammehi dummaī /
tāriso maraṇante vi | nārāhei saṃvaraṃ 
āyarie nārāhei | samaṇe yāvi tāriso /
gihatthā vi -aṃ garahanti | jeṇa jāṇanti tārisaṃ 
evaṃ tu aguṇa-ppehī | guṇāṇaṃ ca vivajjao /
tāriso maraṇante vi | nārāhei saṃvaraṃ 
tavaṃ kuvvai mehāvī, | paṇīyaṃ vajjae rasaṃ /
majja-ppamāya-virao | tavassī aiukkaso 
tassa passaha kallāṇaṃ | aṇega-sāhu-pūiyaṃ /
viulaṃ attha-saṃjuttaṃ | kittaissaṃ, suṇeha me 
evaṃ tu guṇa-ppehī | aguṇāṇaṃ ca vivajjao /
tāriso maraṇante vi | ārāhei saṃvaraṃ 
āyarie ārāhei | samaṇe yāvi tāriso /
gihatthā vi -aṃ pūyanti | jeṇa jāṇanti tārisaṃ 
tava-teṇe vai-teṇe | rūva-teṇe ya je nare /
āyāra-bhāva-teṇe ya | kuvvaī deva-kibbisaṃ 
laddhūṇa vi devattaṃ | uvavanno deva-kibbise /
tatthāvi se na yāṇāi | `kiṃ me kiccā imaṃ phalaṃch` 
tatto vi se caittāṇaṃ | labbhihī ela-mūyagaṃ /
narayaṃ tirikkha-joṇiṃ vā | bohī jattha su-dullahā 
eyaṃ ca dosaṃ daṭhūṇaṃ | nāyaputteṇa bhāsiyaṃ /
aṇu-māyaṃ pi mehāvī | māyā-mosaṃ vivajjae 
sikkhiūṇa bhikkhesaṇa-sohiṃ | saṃjayāṇa buddhāṇa sagāse /
tattha bhikkhū suppaṇihiindie | tivva-lajja guṇavaṃ viharejjāsi  tti bemi ||
|| pañcamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 6 ṣaṣṭhamamadhyayanam (dhammaṭhakahā.) /
nāṇa-daṃsaṇa-saṃpannaṃ | saṃjame ya tave rayaṃ /
gaṇimāgama-saṃpannaṃ | ujjāṇammi samosaḍhaṃ 
rāyāṇo rāyamaccā ya | māhaṇā aduva khattiyā /
pucchanti nihuyappāṇo | kahaṃ bhe āyāra-goyaro? 
tesiṃ so nihuo danto | savva-bhūya-suhāvaho /
sikkhāe su-samāutto | āikkhai viyakkhaṇo 
handi dhammattha-kāmāṇaṃ | nigganthāṇaṃ suṇeha me /
āyāra-goyaraṃ bhīmaṃ | sayalaṃ durahiṭhiyaṃ 
nannattha erisaṃ vuttaṃ | jaṃ loe parama-duccaraṃ /
viulaṇṭhāṇa-bhāissa | na bhūyaṃ na bhavissaī 
sa-khuḍḍaga-viyattāṇaṃ | vāhiyāṇaṃ ca je guṇā /
akhaṇḍa-kuḍiyā kāyavvā | taṃ suṇeha jahā tahā 
dasa aṭha ya ṭhāṇāiṃ | jāiṃ bālo 'varajjhaī /
tattha annayare ṭhāṇe | nigganthattāo bhassaī 
vaya-chakka kāya-chakkaṃ | akappo gihi-bhāyaṇaṃ /
paliyaṅka nisejjā ya | siṇāṇaṃ sobha-vajjaṇaṃ 
tatthimaṃ paḍhamaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ | mahāvīreṇa desiyaṃ /
ahiṃsā niuṇā diṭhā | savvabhūesu saṃjamo 
jāvanti loe pāṇā | tasā aduva thāvarā /
te jāṇamajāṇaṃ vā | na haṇe no va ghāyae 
savva-jīvā vi icchanti | jīviuṃ na marijjiuṃ /
tamhā pāṇa-vahaṃ ghoraṃ | nigganthā vajjayanti -aṃ 
appaṇaṭhā paraṭhā vā | kohā vā jai vā bhayā /
hiṃsagaṃ na musaṃ būyā | no vi annaṃ vayāvae 
musā-vāo ya logammi | savva-sāhūhi garahio /
avissāso ya bhūyāṇaṃ, | tamhā mosaṃ vivajjae 
cittamantamacittaṃ vā | appaṃ vā jai vā bahuṃ /
danta-sohaṇa-mettaṃ pi | oggahaṃsi ajāiyā 
taṃ appaṇā na geṇhanti | no vi geṇhāvae paraṃ /
annaṃ vā geṇhamāṇaṃ pi | nāṇujāṇanti saṃjayā 
abambhacariyaṃ ghoraṃ | pamāyaṃ durahiṭhiyaṃ /
nāyaranti muṇī loe | bheyāyayaṇa-vajjiṇo 
mūlameyamahammassa | mahādosa-samussayaṃ /
tamhā mehuṇa-saṃsaggaṃ | nigganthā vajjayanti -aṃ 
viḍamubbheimaṃ loṇaṃ | tellaṃ sappiṃ ca phāṇiyaṃ /
na te sannihimicchanti | nāyaputta-vao-rayā 
lobhassesaṇuphāse | manne annayarāmavi /
je siyā sannihī-kāme | gihī pavvaie na se 
jaṃ pi vatthaṃ va pāyaṃ vā | kambalaṃ pāyapuñchaṇaṃ /
taṃ pi saṃjama-lajjaṭhā | dhārenti pariharanti ya 
na so pariggaho vutto | nāyaputteṇa tāiṇā /
"mucchā pariggaho vutto" | ii vuttaṃ mahesiṇā 
savvatthuvahiṇā buddhā | saṃrakkhaṇa-pariggahe /
avi appaṇo vi dehammi | nāyaranti mamāiyaṃ 
aho niccaṃ tavo-kammaṃ | savva-buddehi vaṇṇiyaṃ /
jā ya lajjā-samā vittī | ega-bhattaṃ ca bhoyaṇaṃ 
santime suhumā pāṇā | tasā aduva thāvarā /
jāiṃ rāo apāsanto | kahamesaṇiyaṃ care? 
udaollaṃ bīya-saṃsattaṃ | pāṇā nivvaḍiyā mahiṃ /
diyā tāiṃ vivajjejjā, | rāo tattha kahaṃ care? 
eyaṃ ca dosaṃ daṭhūṇaṃ | nāyaputteṇa bhāsiyaṃ /
savvāhāraṃ na bhuñjanti | nigganthā rāibhoyaṇaṃ 
puḍhavikāyaṃ na hiṃsanti | maṇasā vayasa kāyasā /
tiviheṇa karaṇa-joeṇa | saṃjayā su-samāhiyā 
puḍhavikāyaṃ vihiṃsanto | hiṃsaī u tayassie /
tase ya vivihe pāṇe | cakkhuse ya acakkhuse 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
puḍhavikāya-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
āukāyaṃ na hiṃsanti | maṇasā vayasa kāyasā /
tiviheṇa karaṇa-joeṇa | saṃjayā su-samāhiyā 
āukāyaṃ vihiṃsanto | hiṃsaī u tayassie /
tase ya vivihe pāṇe | cakkhuse ya acakkhuse 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
āukāya-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
jāyateyaṃ na icchanti | pāvagaṃ jalaittae /
tikkhamannayaraṃ satthaṃ | savvao vi durāsayaṃ 
pāīṇaṃ paḍiṇaṃ vā vi | uḍḍhaṃ aṇudisāmavi /
ahe dāhiṇao vā vi | dahe uttarao vi ya 
bhūyāṇamesamāghāo | havvavāho, na saṃsao /
taṃ paīva-payāvaṭhā | saṃjayā kiṃci nārabhe 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
teukāya-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
anilassa samārambhaṃ | buddhā mannanti tārisaṃ /
sāvajja-bahulaṃ ceyaṃ, | neyaṃ tāīhi seviyaṃ 
tāliya- eṇa patteṇa | sāhā-vihuyaṇeṇa vā /
na te vīīumicchanti | vīyāveūṇa vā paraṃ 
jaṃ pi vatthaṃ va pāyaṃ vā | kambalaṃ pāyapuñchaṇaṃ /
na te vāyamuīranti | jayaṃ pariharanti ya 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
vāukāya-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
vaṇassaiṃ na hiṃsanti | maṇasā vayasa kāyasā /
tiviheṇa karaṇa-joeṇa | saṃjayā su-samāhiyā 
vaṇassaiṃ vihiṃsanto | hiṃsaī u tayassie /
tase ya vivihe pāṇe | cakkhuse ya acakkhuse 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
vaṇassai-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
tasakāyaṃ na hiṃsanti | maṇasā vayasa kāyasā /
tiviheṇa karaṇa-joeṇa | saṃjayā su-samāhiyā 
tasakāyaṃ vihiṃsanto | hiṃsaī u tayassie /
tase ya vivihe pāṇe | cakkhuse ya acakkhuse 
tamhā eyaṃ viyāṇittā | dosaṃ duggai-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
tasakāya-samārambhaṃ | jāvajjīvāe vajjae 
jāiṃ cattāri 'bhojjāiṃ | isiṇāhāra-māīṇi /
tāiṃ tu vivajjanto | saṃjamaṃ aṇupālae 
piṇḍaṃ sejjaṃ ca vatthaṃ ca | cautthaṃ pāyameva ya /
akappiyaṃ na icchejjā, | paḍigāhejja kappiyaṃ 
je niyāgaṃ mamāyanti | kīyamuddesiyāhaḍaṃ /
vahaṃ te samaṇujāṇanti | ii vuttaṃ mahesiṇā 
tamhā asaṇa-pāṇāī | kīyamuddesiyāhaḍaṃ /
vajjayanti ṭhiyappāṇo | nigganthā dhamma-jīviṇo 
kaṃsesu kaṃsa-pāesu | kuṇḍa-moesu vā puṇo /
bhuñjanto asaṇa-pāṇāī | āyārā paribhassaī 
sīodaga-samārambhe | matta-dhoyaṇa-chaḍḍaṇe /
jāiṃ chaṇṇanti bhūyāiṃ | diṭho tattha asaṃjamo 
pacchākammaṃ purekammaṃ | siyā tattha na kappaī /
eyamaṭhaṃ na bhūñjanti | nigganthā gihi-bhāyaṇe 
āsandī-paliyaṅkesu | mañca-māsālaesu vā /
aṇāyariyamajjāṇaṃ | āsaittu saittu vā 
nāsandī-paliyaṅkesu | na nisejjā na pīḍhae /
nigganthā 'paḍilehāe | buddha-vuttamahiṭhagā 
gambhīra-vijayā ee | pāṇā duppaḍilehagā, /
āsandī-paliyaṅkā ya | eyamaṭhaṃ vivajjiyā 
goyaragga-paviṭhassa | nisejjā jassa kappaī /
imerisamaṇāyāraṃ | āvajjai abohiyaṃ 
vivattī bambhacerassa | pāṇāṇaṃ ca vahe vaho /
vaṇīmaga-paḍīghāo | paḍikoho yagāriṇaṃ 
aguttī bambhacerassa | itthīo yāvi saṅkaṇaṃ /
kusīla-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ | dūrao parivajjae 
tiṇhamannayarāgassa | nisejjā jassa kappaī /
jarāe abhibhūyassa | vāhiyassa tavassiṇo 
vāhio vā arogī vā | siṇāṇaṃ jo u patthae /
vokkanto hoi āyāro, | jaḍho havai saṃjamo 
santime suhumā pāṇā | ghasāsu bhilagāsu ya /
je u bhikkhū siṇāyanto | viyaḍeṇuppalāvae 
tamhā te na siṇāyanti | sīeṇa usiṇeṇa vā /
jāvajjīvaṃ vayaṃ ghoraṃ | asiṇāṇamahiṭhagā 
siṇāṇaṃ aduvā kakkaṃ | loddhaṃ paumagāṇi ya /
gāyassuvvaaṇaṭhāe | nāyaranti kayāi vi 
nagiṇassa vā vi muṇḍassa | dīha-roma-nahaṃsiṇo /
mehuṇā uvasantassa | kiṃ vibhūsāe kāriyaṃ! 
vibhūsā-vattiyaṃ bhikkhū | kammaṃ bandhai cikkaṇaṃ /
saṃsāra-sāyare ghore | jeṇaṃ paḍai duruttare 
vibhūsā-vattiyaṃ ceyaṃ | buddhā mannanti tārisaṃ /
sāvajjā-bahulaṃ ceyaṃ, | neyaṃ tāīhi seviyaṃ 
khaventi appāṇamamoha-daṃsiṇo | tave rayā saṃjama ajjave guṇe /
dhuṇanti pāvāi pure-kaḍāiṃ, | navāi pāvāi na te karenti 
saovasantā amamā akiṃcaṇā | sa-vijja-vijjāṇugayā jasaṃsiṇo /
uu-ppasanne vimale va candimā | siddhiṃ vimāṇāi uventi tāiṇo  tti bemi ||
|| ṣaṣṭhamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 7 saptamamadhyayanam (vakkasuddhī.) /
cauṇhaṃ khalu bhāsāṇaṃ | parisaṃkhāya pannavaṃ /
doṇhaṃ tu viṇayaṃ sikkhe, | do na bhāsejja savvaso 
jā ya saccā avattavvā | saccāmosā ya jā musā /
jā ya buddhehi 'āiṇṇā | na taṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
asaccamosaṃ saccaṃ ca | aṇavajjamakakkasaṃ /
samuppehamasaṃdiddhaṃ | giraṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
eyaṃ ca aṭhamannaṃ vā | jaṃ tu nāmei sāsayaṃ /
sa bhāsaṃ saccamosaṃ pi | taṃ pi dhīro vivajjae 
vitahaṃ pi tahāmottiṃ | jaṃ giraṃ bhāsae naro /
tamhā so puṭho pāveṇaṃ, | kiṃ puṇa jo musaṃ vae 
tamhā `gacchāmo, vakkhāmo, | amugaṃ vā -e bhavissaī /
ahaṃ vā -aṃ karissāmi, | eso vā -aṃ karissaī` 
evamāī u jā bhāsā | esa-kālammi saṅkiyā /
saṃpayāīya-maṭhe vā | taṃ pi dhīro vivajjae 
aīyammi ya kālammī | paccuppanna-maṇāgae /
jamaṭhaṃ tu na jāṇejjā | `evameyaṃ` ti no vae 
aīyammi ya kālammī | paccuppanna-maṇāgae /
jattha saṅkā bhave taṃ tu | `evameyaṃ` ti no vae 
aīyammi ya kālammī | paccuppanna-maṇāgae /
nissaṅkiyaṃ bhave jaṃ tu | `evameyaṃ` ti niddise 
taheva pharusā bhāsā | guru-bhūāvaghāiṇī /
saccā vi sā na vattavvā | jao pāvassa āgamo 
taheva kāṇaṃ `kāṇe` tti | paṇḍagaṃ `paṇḍage` tti vā /
vāhiyaṃ vā vi `rogi` tti | teṇaṃ `core` tti no vae 
eeṇanneṇa aṭheṇa | paro jeṇuvahammaī /
āyāra-bhāva-dosa-nnū | na taṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
taheva `hole` `gole` tti | `sāṇe` vā `vasule` tti ya /
`damae` `dūhae` vā vi | na taṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
ajjie pajjie vā vi | ammo māusiu tti ya /
piussie bhāiṇejja tti | dhūe nattuṇie tti ya 
hale hale tti anne tti | bhae sāmiṇi gomiṇi /
hole gole vasule tti | itthiyaṃ nevamālave 
nāmadhejjeṇa -aṃ būyā | itthī-gotteṇa vā puṇo /
jahārihamabhigijjha | ālavejja lavejja vā 
ajjae pajjae vā vi | bappo culla-piu tti ya /
māulā bhāiṇejja tti | putte nattuṇiya tti ya 
he ho hale tti anna tti | bhaā sāmiya gomiya /
hola gola vasula tti | purisaṃ nevamālave 
nāmadhejjeṇa -aṃ būyā | purisa-gotteṇa vā puṇo /
jahārihamabhigijjha | ālavejja lavejja vā 
pañcindiyāṇa pāṇāṇaṃ | `esa itthī, ayaṃ pumaṃ` /
jāva -aṃ na vijāṇejjā | tāva jāi tti ālave 
taheva maṇusaṃ pasuṃ | pakkhiṃ vā vi sarīsivaṃ /
`thūle pameile vajjhe | pāime` tti ya no vae 
parivuḍḍhe tti -aṃ būyā, | būyā uvacie tti ya /
saṃjāe pīṇie vā vi | mahākāe tti ālave 
taheva gāo dujjhāo, | dammā go-rahaga tti ya /
vāhimā raha-jogga tti, | nevaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
juvaṃ-gave tti -aṃ būyā, | dheṇuṃ rasadaya tti ya /
rahasse mahallae vā vi | vae saṃvahaṇe tti ya 
taheva gantumujjāṇaṃ | pavvayāṇi vaṇāṇi ya /
rukkhā mahalla pehāe | nevaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
alaṃ pāsāya-khambhāṇaṃ | toraṇāṇaṃ gihāṇa ya /
phalihaggala-nāvāṇaṃ | alaṃ udaga-doṇiṇaṃ 
pīḍhae caṅgabere ya | naṅgale maiye siyā /
janta-laṭhī va nābhī vā | gaṇḍiyā va alaṃ siyā 
āsaṇaṃ sayaṇaṃ jāṇaṃ | hojjā vā kiṃcuvassae /
bhūovaghāiṇiṃ bhāsaṃ | nevaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
taheva gantumujjāṇaṃ | pavvayāṇi vaṇāṇi ya /
rukkhā mahalla pehāe | evaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
jāimantā ime rukkhā | dīha-vaā mahālayā /
payāya-sālā viḍimā | vae darisaṇi tti ya 
tahā phalāi pakkāiṃ | pāya-khajjāi no vae /
veloiyāi ālāiṃ | vehimāiṃ ti no vae 
asaṃghaḍā ime ambā | bahu-nivvaimā phalā /
vaejja bahu-saṃbhūyā | bhūya-rūva tti vā puṇo 
tahosahīo pakkāo | nīliyāo chavī i ya /
lāimā bhajjimāo tti | pihu-khajja tti no vae 
rūḍhā bahu-saṃbhūyā | thirā ūsaḍhā vi ya /
gabbhiyāo pasūyāo | sasārāo tti ālave 
taheva saṃkhaḍiṃ naccā | kiccaṃ kajjaṃ ti no vae /
teṇagaṃ vā vi vajjhe tti, | su-titthe tti ya āvagā 
saṃkhaḍiṃ saṃkhaḍiṃ būyā, | paṇiyaṭhaṃ ti teṇagaṃ, /
`bahu-samāṇi titthāṇi | āvagāṇaṃ` viyāgare 
tahā naīo puṇṇāo | kāya-tijja tti no vae /
nāvāhi tārimāo tti | pāṇi-pejja tti no vae 
bahu-vāhaḍā agāhā | bahu-saliluppilodagā /
bahu-vitthaḍodagā yāvi, | evaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
taheva sāvajjaṃ jogaṃ | parassaṭhāe niṭhiyaṃ /
kīramāṇaṃ ti vā naccā | sāvajjaṃ nālave muṇī 
sukaḍe tti supakke tti | suchinne suhaḍe maḍe /
suniṭhie sulaṭhe tti | sāvajjaṃ vajjae muṇī 
payatta-pakke tti va pakkamālave, | payatta-chinna tti va chinnamālave, /
payatta-laṭha tti va kamma-heuyaṃ, | pahāra-gāḍha tti va gāḍhamālave 
savvukkasaṃ paragghaṃ vā | aulaṃ natthi erisaṃ /
acakkiyamavattavvaṃ | aciyattaṃ ceva no vae 
`savvameyaṃ vaissāmi, | savvameyaṃ` tti no vae /
aṇuvīi savvaṃ savvattha | evaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
su-kkiyaṃ vā su-vikkīyaṃ | akijjaṃ kijjameva vā /
`imaṃ geṇha, imaṃ muñca | paṇiyaṃ` no viyāgare 
appagghe vā mahagghe vā | kae va vikkae vi vā /
paṇiyaṭhe samuppanne | aṇavajjaṃ viyāgare 
tahevāsaṃjayaṃ dhīro | `āsa, ehi karehi vā /
saya, ciṭha, vayāhi` tti | nevaṃ bhāsejja pannavaṃ 
bahave ime asāhū | loe vuccanti sāhuṇo /
na lave asāhuṃ sāhu tti, | sāhuṃ sāhu tti ālave 
nāṇa-daṃsaṇa-saṃpannaṃ | saṃjame ya tave rayaṃ /
evaṃ-guṇa-samāuttaṃ | saṃjayaṃ sāhumālave 
devāṇaṃ maṇuyāṇaṃ ca | tiriyāṇaṃ ca vuggahe /
amuyāṇaṃ jao hou | mā vā hou tti no vae 
vāo vuṭhaṃ va sīuṇhaṃ | khemaṃ dhāyaṃ sivaṃ ti vā /
kayā -u hojja eyāṇi | mā vā hou tti no vae 
taheva mehaṃ va nahaṃ va māṇavaṃ | na deva deva tti giraṃ vaejjā /
`sammucchie unnae vā paoe` | vaejja vā `vuṭhe balāhae` tti 
antalikkha tti -aṃ būyā | gujjhāṇucariya tti ya /
riddhimantaṃ naraṃ dissa | `riddhimantaṃ` ti ālave 
taheva sāvajjaṇumoyaṇī girā | ohāriṇī jā ya parovaghāiṇī /
se koha loha bhayasā va māṇavo | na hāsamāṇo vi giraṃ vaejjā 
savvakka-suddhiṃ samupehiyā muṇī, | giraṃ ca duṭhaṃ parivajjae sayā /
miyaṃ aduṭhaṃ aṇuvīi bhāsae | sayāṇa majjhe lahaī pasaṃsaṇaṃ 
bhāsāe dose ya guṇe ya jāṇiyā | tīse ya duṭhe parivajjae sayā /
chasu saṃjae sāmaṇie sayā jae | vaejja buddhe hiyamāṇulomiyaṃ 
parikkha-bhāsī susamāhiindie | caukkasāyāvagae aṇissie /
sa niddhuṇe dhutta-malaṃ pure-kaḍaṃ, | ārāhae logamiṇaṃ tahā paraṃ  ti bemi ||
|| saptamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 8 aṣamamadhyayanam (āyārapaṇihī.) /
āyāra-paṇihiṃ laddhuṃ | jahā kāyavva bhikkhuṇā /
taṃ bhe udāharissāmi | āṇupuvviṃ, suṇeha me 
puḍhavi daga agaṇi māruya | taṇa rukkha sa-bīyagā /
tasā ya pāṇā jīva tti | ii vuttaṃ mahesiṇā 
tesiṃ acchaṇa-joeṇa | niccaṃ hoyavvayaṃ siyā /
maṇasā kāya vakkeṇa, | evaṃ bhavai saṃjae 
puḍhavi bhittiṃ silaṃ leluṃ | neva bhinde na saṃlihe /
tiviheṇa karaṇa-joeṇa | saṃjae su-samāhie 
suddha-puḍhavīe na nisie | sasarakkhammi ya āsaṇe /
pamajjittu nisīejjā | jāittā jassa oggahaṃ 
sīodagaṃ na sevejjā | silā-vuṭhaṃ himāṇi ya /
usiṇodagaṃ tatta-phāsuyaṃ | paḍigāhejja saṃjae 
udaollaṃ appaṇo kāyaṃ | neva puñche na saṃlihe /
samuppeha tahā-bhūyaṃ | no -aṃ saṃghaae muṇī 
iṅgālaṃ agaṇiṃ acciṃ | alāyaṃ vā sa-joiyaṃ /
na uñjejjā na ghaejjā | no -aṃ nivvāvae muṇī 
tāliya- eṇa patteṇa | sāhā-vihuyaṇeṇa vā /
na vīejja appaṇo kāyaṃ | bāhiraṃ vā vi poggalaṃ 
taṇa-rukkhaṃ na chindejjā | phalaṃ mūlaṃ va kassaī /
āmagaṃ vivihaṃ bīyaṃ | maṇasā vi na patthae 
gahaṇesu na ciṭhejjā | bīesu hariesu vā /
udagammi tahā niccaṃ | uttiṅga-paṇagesu vā 
tase pāṇe na hiṃsejjā | vāyā aduva kammuṇā /
uvarao savvabhūesu | pāsejja vivihaṃ jagaṃ 
aṭha suhumāi pehāe | jāiṃ jāṇittu saṃjae /
dayāhigārī bhūesu | āsa ciṭha saehi vā 
kayarāi aṭha suhumāiṃ | jāiṃ pucchejja saṃjae? /
imāi tāi mehāvī | āikkhejja viyakkhaṇe 
siṇehaṃ puppha-suhumaṃ ca | pāṇuttiṅgaṃ taheva ya /
paṇagaṃ bīya hariyaṃ ca | aṇḍa-suhumaṃ ca aṭhamaṃ 
evameyāṇi jāṇittā | savva-bhāveṇa saṃjae /
appamatte jae niccaṃ | savvindiya-samāhie 
dhuvaṃ ca paḍilehejjā | jogasā pāya-kambalaṃ /
sejjamuccārabhūmiṃ ca | saṃthāraṃ aduvāsaṇaṃ 
uccāraṃ pāsavaṇaṃ | khelaṃ siṅghāṇa-jalliyaṃ /
phāsuyaṃ paḍilehittā | pariṭhāvejja saṃjae 
pavisittu parāgāraṃ | pāṇaṭhā bhoyaṇassa vā /
jayaṃ ciṭhe, miyaṃ bhāse, | na ya rūvesu maṇaṃ kare 
bahuṃ suṇei kaṇṇehiṃ, | bahuṃ acchīhi pecchaī, /
na ya diṭhaṃ suyaṃ savvaṃ | bhikkhū akkhāumarihaī 
suyaṃ vā jai vā diṭhaṃ | na lavejjovaghāiyaṃ /
na ya keṇai uvāeṇaṃ | gihi-jogaṃ samāyare 
niṭhāṇaṃ rasa-nijjūḍhaṃ | bhaddagaṃ pāvagaṃ ti vā /
puṭho vā vi apuṭho vā | lābhālābhaṃ na niddise 
na ya bhoyaṇammi giddho | care uñchaṃ ayampiro /
aphāsuyaṃ na bhuñjejjā | kīyamuddesiyāhaḍaṃ 
sannihiṃ ca na kuvvejjā | aṇu-māyaṃ pi saṃjae /
muhā-jīvī asaṃbuddhe | havejja jaga-nissie 
lūha-vittī su-saṃtuṭhe | appicche suhare siyā /
āsurattaṃ na gacchejjā | soccāṇaṃ jiṇa-sāsaṇaṃ 
kaṇṇa-sokkhehi saddehiṃ | pemaṃ nābhinivesae /
dāruṇaṃ kakkasaṃ phāsaṃ | kāeṇa ahiyāsae 
khuhaṃ pivāsa dussejjaṃ | sīuṇhaṃ araī bhayaṃ /
ahiyāse avvahio, | dehe dukkhaṃ mahā-phalaṃ 
atthaṃgayammi āicce | puratthā ya aṇuggae /
āhāramaiyaṃ savvaṃ | maṇasā vi na patthae 
atintiṇe acavale | appa-bhāsī miyāsaṇe /
havejja uyare dante, | thovaṃ laddhuṃ na khiṃsae 
na bāhiraṃ paribhave, | attāṇaṃ na samukkase, /
suya-lābhe na majjejjā | jaccā tavasi buddhie 
se jāṇaṃ ajāṇaṃ vā | kau āhammiyaṃ payaṃ /
saṃvare khippamappāṇaṃ, | bīyaṃ taṃ na samāyare 
aṇāyāraṃ parakkamma | neva gūhe, na niṇhave /
suī sayā viyaḍa-bhāve | asaṃsatte jiindie 
amohaṃ vayaṇaṃ kujjā | āyariyassa mahappaṇo, /
taṃ parigijjha vāyāe | kammuṇā uvavāyae 
adhuvaṃ jīviyaṃ naccā | siddhi-maggaṃ viyāṇiyā /
viṇiyaejja bhogesu | āuṃ parimiyamappaṇo 
(balaṃ thāmaṃ ca pehāe | saddhāmārogamappaṇo /)
(khettaṃ kālaṃ ca vinnāya | tahappāṇaṃ na juñjae || ||)
jarā jāva na pīlei | vāhī jāva na vaḍḍhaī /
jāvindiyā na hāyanti | tāva dhammaṃ samāyare 
kohaṃ māṇaṃ ca māyaṃ ca | lobhaṃ ca pāva-vaḍḍhaṇaṃ /
vame cattāri dose u | icchanto hiyamappaṇo 
koho pīiṃ paṇāsei, | māṇo viṇaya-nāsaṇo /
māyā mittāṇi nāsei, | lobho savva-viṇāsaṇo 
uvasameṇa haṇe kohaṃ, | māṇaṃ maddavayā jiṇe /
māyaṃ cajjava-bhāveṇa, | lobhaṃ saṃtosao jiṇe 
koho ya māṇo ya aṇiggahīyā | māyā ya lobho ya pavaḍḍhamāṇā /
cattāri ee kasiṇā kasāyā | siñcanti mūlāi puṇabbhavassa 
rāiṇiesu viṇayaṃ pauñje, | dhuva-sīlayaṃ sayayaṃ hāvaejjā /
kummo vva allīṇa-palīṇa-gutto | parakkamejjā tava-saṃjamammi 
niddaṃ ca na bahu-mannejjā, | sa-ppahāsaṃ vivajjae /
miho-kahāhiṃ na rame | sajjhāyammi rao sayā 
jogaṃ ca samaṇa-dhammammi | juñje aṇalaso dhuvaṃ /
jutto ya samaṇa-dhammammi | aṭhaṃ lahai aṇuttaraṃ 
ihaloga-pāratta-hiyaṃ | jeṇaṃ gacchai soggaiṃ /
bahu-suyaṃ pajjuvāsejjā, | pucchejjattha-viṇicchayaṃ 
hatthaṃ pāyaṃ ca kāyaṃ ca | paṇihāya jiindie /
allīṇa-gutto nisie | sagāse guruṇo muṇī 
na pakkhao na purao | neva kiccāṇa piṭhao /
na ya ūruṃ samāsejjā | ciṭhejjā guruṇantie 
apucchio na bhāsejjā | bhāsamāṇassa antarā /
piṭhi-maṃsaṃ na khāejjā, | māyā-mosaṃ vivajjae 
appattiyaṃ jeṇa siyā | āsu kuppejja vā paro /
savvaso taṃ na bhāsejjā | bhāsaṃ ahiya-gāmiṇiṃ 
diṭhaṃ miyaṃ asaṃdiddhaṃ | paḍipuṇṇaṃ viyañjiyaṃ /
ayampiramaṇuvviggaṃ | bhāsaṃ nisira attavaṃ 
āyāra-pannatti-dharaṃ | diṭhivāyamahijjagaṃ /
vai-vikkhaliyaṃ naccā | na taṃ uvahase muṇī 
nakkhattaṃ sumiṇaṃ jogaṃ | nimittaṃ manta-bhesajaṃ /
gihiṇo taṃ na āikkhe | bhūyāhigaraṇaṃ payaṃ 
annaṭhaṃ pagaḍaṃ layaṇaṃ | bhaejja sayaṇāsaṇaṃ /
uccāra-bhūmi-saṃpannaṃ | itthī-pasu-vivajjiyaṃ 
vivittā ya bhave sejjā, | nārīṇaṃ na lave kahaṃ /
gihi-saṃthavaṃ na kujjā, | kujjā sāhūhi saṃthavaṃ 
jahā kukkuḍa-poyassa | niccaṃ kulalao bhayaṃ /
evaṃ khu bambhayārissa | itthī-viggahao bhayaṃ 
citta-bhittiṃ na nijjhāe | nāriṃ vā suṇalaṃkiyaṃ, /
bhakkharaṃ piva daṭhūṇaṃ | diṭhiṃ paḍisamāhare 
hattha-pāya-paḍicchinnaṃ | kaṇṇa-nāsa-vigappiyaṃ /
avi vāsasaiṃ nāriṃ | bambhayārī vivajjae 
vibhūsā itthi-saṃsaggī | paṇīya-rasa-bhoyaṇaṃ /
narassatta-gavesissa | visaṃ tālauḍaṃ jahā 
aṅga-paccaṅga-saṃṭhāṇaṃ | cārullaviya-pehiyaṃ /
itthīṇaṃ taṃ na nijjhāe | kāma-rāga-vivaḍḍhaṇaṃ 
visaesu maṇunnesuṃ | pemaṃ nābhinivesae /
aṇiccaṃ tesi vinnāya | pariṇāmaṃ poggalāṇa u 
poggalāṇa parīṇāmaṃ | tesiṃ naccā jahā tahāũ/
viṇīya-taṇho vihare | sīībhūeṇa appaṇā 
jāe saddhāe nikkhanto | pariyāyaṇṭhāṇamuttamaṃ /
tameva aṇupālejjā | guṇe āyariya-sammae 
tavaṃ cimaṃ saṃjama-jogayaṃ ca | sajjhāya-jogaṃ ca sayā ahiṭhae /
sūre va seṇāe samatta-māuhe | alamappaṇo hoi alaṃ paresiṃ 
sajjhāya-sajjhāṇa-rayassa tāiṇo | apāva-bhāvassa tave rayassa /
visujjhaī jaṃ se malaṃ pure-kaḍaṃ | samīriyaṃ ruppa-malaṃ va joiṇā 
se tārise dukkha-sahe jiindie | sueṇa jutte amame akiṃcaṇe /
virāyaī kamma-ghaṇammi avagae | kasiṇabbha-puḍāvagame va candima  tti bemi
||
|| aṣamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 9-1 navamamadhyayanam || prathama uddeśakaḥ (viṇayasamāhī.) /
thambhā va kohā va maya-ppamāyā | gurussagāse viṇayaṃ na sikkhe /
so ceva o tassa abhūi-bhāvo, | phalaṃ va kīyassa vahāya hoi 
je yāvi manda tti guruṃ viittā | ḍahare ime appa-sue tti naccā /
hīlanti micchaṃ paḍivajjamāṇā | karenti āsāyaṇa te gurūṇaṃ 
pagaīe mandā vi bhavanti ege | ḍaharā vi ya je suya-buddhovaveyā /
āyāramantā guṇa suṭhiyappā | je hīliyā sihiriva bhāsa kujjā 
je yāvi nāgaṃ ḍaharaṃ ti naccā | āsāyae se ahiyāya hoi /
evāyariyaṃ pi hu hīlayanto | niyacchaī jāi-pahaṃ khu mande 
āsīviso yāvi paraṃ su-ruṭho | kiṃ jīva-nāsāo paraṃ nu kujjā? /
āyariya-pāyā puṇa appasannā, | abohiṇāsāyaṇa natthi mokkho 
jo pāvagaṃ jaliyamavakkamejjā | āsīvisaṃ vā vi hu kovaejjā /
jo vā visaṃ khāyai jīviyaṭhī | esovamāsāyaṇayā gurūṇaṃ 
siyā hu se pāvaya no ḍahejjā, | āsīviso vā kuvio na bhakkhe /
siyā visaṃ hālahalaṃ na māre, | na yāvi mokkho guru-hīlaṇāe 
jo pavvayaṃ sirasā bhettumicche | suttaṃ va sīhaṃ paḍibohaejjā /
jo vā dae sattiṇagge pahāraṃ | esovamāsāyaṇayā gurūṇaṃ 
siyā hu sīseṇa giriṃ pi bhinde | siyā hu sīho kuvio na bhakkhe /
siyā na bhindejja va sattiṇaggaṃ | na yāvi mokkho guru-hīlaṇāe 
āyariya pāyā puṇa appasannā, | ābohiṇāsāsaṇa natthi mokkho /
tamhā aṇābāha-suhābhikaṅkhī | guru-ppasāyābhimuho ramejjā 
jahāhiyaggī jalaṇaṃ namaṃse | nāṇāhuī-manta-payābhisittaṃ /
evāyariyaṃ uvaciṭhaejjā | aṇanta-nāṇovagao vi santo 
jassantie dhamma-payāi sikkhe | tassantie viṇaiyaṃ pauñje /
sakkārae sirasā pañjalīo | kāya-ggirā "bho" maṇasā ya niccaṃ 
lajjā dayā saṃjama bambhaceraṃ | kallāṇa-bhāgissa visohiṇṭhāṇaṃ /
je me gurū sayayamaṇusāsayanti | te haṃ gurū sayayaṃ pūyayāmi 
jahā nisante tavaṇaccimālī | pabhāsaī kevala-bhārahaṃ tu /
evāyario suya-sīla-buddhie | virāyaī sura-majjhe va indo 
jahā sasī komui-joga-jutte | nakkhatta-tārā-gaṇa-parivuḍappā /
khe sohaī vimale abbha-mukke, | evaṃ gaṇī sohai bhikkhu-majjhe 
mahāgarā āyariyā mahesī | samāhi-joge suya-sīla-buddhie /
saṃpāviu-kāme aṇuttarāiṃ | ārāhae, tosae dhamma-kāmī 
soccāṇa mehāvi-subhāsiyāiṃ | sussūsae āyariyappamatto /
ārāhaittāṇa guṇe aṇege | se pāvaī siddhimaṇuttaraṃ ti  bemi ||
|| navamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 9-2 navamamadhyayanam || dvitīya uddeśakaḥ /
mūlāo khandha-ppabhavo dumassa, | khandhāo pacchā samuventi sāhā /
sāha-ppasāhā viruhanti pattā, | tao se pupphaṃ ca phalaṃ raso ya 
evaṃ dhammassa viṇao | mūlaṃ, paramo se mokkho /
jeṇa kittiṃ suyaṃ sagghaṃ | nissesaṃ cābhigacchaī 
je ya caṇḍe mie thaddhe | duvvāī niyaḍī saḍhe /
vujjhaī se aviṇīyappā | kaṭhaṃ soya-gayaṃ jahā 
viṇayaṃ pi jo uvāeṇa | coio kuppaī naro /
divvaṃ so sirimejjantiṃ | daṇḍeṇa paḍisehae 
taheva aviṇīyappā | uvavajjhā hayā gayā /
dīsanti duhamehantā | ābhiogamuvaṭhiyā 
taheva suviṇīyappā | uvavajjhā hayā gayā /
dīsanti suhamehantā | iḍḍhiṃ pattā mahāyasā 
taheva aviṇīyappā | logaṃsi nara-nārio /
dīsanti duhamehantā | chāyā te vigalindiyā 
daṇḍa-sattha-parijuṇṇā | asabbha-vayaṇehi ya /
kaluṇā vivanna-chandā | khuppivāsāe parigayā 
taheva suviṇīyappā | logaṃsi nara-nārio /
dīsanti suhamehantā | iḍḍhiṃ pattā mahāyasā 
taheva aviṇīyappā | devā jakkhā ya gujjhagā /
dīsanti duhamehantā | ābhiogamuvaṭhiyā 
taheva suviṇīyappā | devā jakkhā ya gujjhagā /
dīsanti suhamehantā | iḍḍhiṃ pattā mahāyasā 
je āyariyaṇuvajjhāyāṇaṃ | sussūsā-vayaṇaṃ-karā /
tesiṃ sikkhā pavaḍḍhanti | jala-sittā iva pāyavā 
appaṇaṭhā paraṭhā vā | sippā neuṇiyāṇi ya /
gihiṇo uvabhogaṭhā | ihalogassa kāraṇā 
jeṇa bandhaṃ vahaṃ ghoraṃ | pariyāvaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ /
sikkhamāṇā niyacchanti | juttā te laliindiyā 
te vi taṃ guruṃ pūyanti | tassa sippassa kāraṇā /
sakkārenti namaṃsanti | tuṭhā niddesa-vattiṇo 
kiṃ puṇa je suya-ggāhī | aṇanta-hiya-kāmae! /
āyariyā jaṃ vae bhikkhū | tamhā taṃ nāivattae 
nīyaṃ sejjaṃ gaiṃ ṭhāṇaṃ, | nīyaṃ ca āsaṇāṇi ya, /
nīyaṃ ca pāe vandejjā, | nīyaṃ kujjā ya añjaliṃ 
saṃghaaittā kāeṇaṃ | tahā uvahiṇā-mavi /
"khameha avarāhaṃ me" | vaejja "na puṇo" tti ya 
duggao vā paoeṇaṃ | coio vahaī rahaṃ, /
evaṃ dubuddhi kiccāṇaṃ | vutto vutto pakuvvaī 
(ālavante lavante vā | na nisejjāe paḍissuṇe /)
(mottūṇaṃ āsaṇaṃ dhīro | sussūsāe paḍissuṇe ||)
kālaṃ chandovayāraṃ ca | paḍilehittāṇa heuhiṃ /
teṇaṃ teṇaṃ uvāehiṃ | taṃ taṃ saṃpaḍivāyae 
vivattī aviṇīyassa, | saṃpattī viṇiyassa ya /
jasseyaṃ duhao nāyaṃ | sikkhaṃ se abhigacchaī 
je yāvi caṇḍe maiṇiḍḍhi-gārave | pisuṇe nare sāhasa hīṇa-pesaṇe /
adiṭha-dhamme viṇae akovie | asaṃvibhāgī na hu tassa mokkho 
niddesa-vattī puṇa je gurūṇaṃ | suyattha-dhammā viṇayammi koviyā /
tarittu te ohamiṇaṃ duruttaraṃ | khavittu kammaṃ gaimuttamaṃ gaya  tti bemi ||
|| navamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 9-3 navamamadhyayanam || tṛtīya uddeśakaḥ ||
āyariyaggimivāhiyaggī | sussūsamāṇo paḍijāgarejjā /
āloiyaṃ iṅgiyameva naccā | jo chandamārāhayaī sa pujjo 
āyāra-maṭhā viṇayaṃ pauñje | sussūsamāṇo parigijjha vakkaṃ /
jahovaiṭhaṃ abhikaṅkhamāṇo | guruṃ tu nāsāyayaī, sa pujjo 
rāiṇiesu viṇayaṃ pauñje | ḍaharā vi ya je pariyāya-jeṭhā /
niyattaṇe vaai sacca-vāī | ovāyavaṃ vakka-kare, sa pujjo 
annāyaṇuñchaṃ caraī visuddhaṃ | javaṇaṭhayā samuyāṇaṃ ca niccaṃ /
aladdhuyaṃ no paridevaejjā, | laddhuṃ na vikaṃthayaī, sa pujjo 
saṃthāra-sejjāsaṇa-bhattapāṇe | appicchayā ailābhe vi sante /
jo evamappāṇabhitosaejjā | saṃtosa-pāhanna rae sa pujjo 
sakkā saheuṃ āsāe ka- ayā | aomayā ucchahayā nareṇaṃ /
aṇāsae jo u sahejja ka- e | vaīmae kaṇṇa-sare sa pujjo 
muhutta-dukkhā u havanti ka- ayā | aomayā, te vi tao suṇuddharā /
vāyā-duruttāṇi duruddharāṇi | berāṇubandhīṇi mahabbhayāṇi 
samāvayantā vayaṇābhighāyā | kaṇṇaṃ-gayā dummaṇiyaṃ jaṇanti /
dhammo tti kiccā paramagga-sūre | jiindie jo sahaī sa pujjo 
avaṇṇa-vāyaṃ ca parammuhassa | paccakkhao paḍiṇīyaṃ ca bhāsaṃ /
ohāriṇiṃ appiyakāriṇiṃ ca | bhāsaṃ na bhāsejja sayā, sa pujjo 
alolue akkuhae amāī | apisuṇe yāvi adīṇa-vittī /
no bhāvae no vi ya bhāviyappā | akouhalle ya sayā sa pujjo 
guṇehi sāhū, aguṇehi 'sāhū, | geṇhāhi sāhū-guṇa, muñcasāhū /
viyāṇiyā appagamappaeṇaṃ | jo rāga-dosehi samo sa pujjo 
taheva ḍaharaṃ va mahallagaṃ vā | itthī pumaṃ pavvaiyaṃ gihiṃ vā /
no hīlae no vi ya khiṃsaejjā, | thambhaṃ ca kohaṃ ca cae, sa pujjo 
je māṇiyā sayayaṃ māṇayanti | jatteṇa kannaṃ va nivesayanti /
te māṇae māṇarihe tavassī | jiindie sacca-rae, sa pujjo 
tesiṃ gurūṇaṃ guṇasāgarāṇaṃ | soccāṇa mehāvi subhāsiyāiṃ /
care muṇī pañcarae tigutto | caukkasāyāvagae, sa pujjo 
gurumiha sayayaṃ paḍiyariya muṇī | jiṇa-vaya-niuṇe abhigama-kusale /
dhuṇiya raya-malaṃ pure-kaḍaṃ | bhāsuramaulaṃ gaiṃ gaya  tti bemi ||
|| navamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 9-4 navamamadhyayanam || caturtha uddeśakaḥ ||
   suyaṃ me āusaṃ teṇaṃ bhagavayā evamakkhāyaṃ | iha 
khalu therehiṃ bhagavantehiṃ cattāri viṇaya-samāhiṭhāṇā 
pannattā || kayare khalu te therehiṃ bhagavantehiṃ cattāri 
viṇaya-samāhiṭhāṇā pannattā? ime khalu te therehiṃ bhagavantehiṃ 
cattāri viṇaya-samāhiṭhāṇā pannattā, taṃ 
jahā | viṇaya-samāhī suya-samāhī tava-samāhī āyāra-samāhī 
viṇae sue tave ya | āyāre niccaṃ paṇḍiyā /
abhirāmayanti appāṇaṃ | je bhavanti jiindiyā 
cauvvihā khalu viṇaya-samāhī bhavai, taṃ jahā | aṇusāsijjanto 
sussūsai, sammaṃ saṃpaḍivajjai, veyamārāhayai, 
na ya bhavai atta-saṃpaggahie cautthaṃ payaṃ 
bhavai  bhavai ya ettha silogo 
pehei hiyāṇusāsaṇaṃ, | sussūsaī, taṃ ca puṇo ahiṭhae /
na ya māṇa-maeṇa majjai | viṇaya-samāhī āyayaṭhie  
   cauvvihā khalu suya-samāhī bhavai, taṃ jahā 
suyaṃ me bhavissai tti ajjhāiyavvaṃ bhavai, egaggacitto 
bhavissāmi tti ajjhāiyavvaṃ bhavai, appāṇaṃ 
ṭhāvaissāmi tti ajjhāiyavvaṃ bhavai, ṭhio paraṃ 
ṭhāvaissāmi tti ajjhāiyavvaṃ bhavai cautthaṃ payaṃ 
bhavai  bhavai ya ettha silogo 
   nāṇamegagga-citto ya | ṭhio ṭhāvayaī paraṃ /
   suyāṇi ya ahijjittā | rao suya-samāhie  
   cauvvihā khalu tava-samāhī bhavai, taṃ jahā | no 
ihalogaṭhayāe tavamahiṭhejjā, no paralogaṭhayāe tavamahiṭhejjā, 
no kitti-vaṇṇa-sadda-silogaṭhayāe tavamahiṭhejjā, 
nannattha nijjaraṭhayāe tavamahiṭhejjā cautthaṃ 
payaṃ bhavai  bhavai ya ettha silogo 
  viviha-guṇa-tavo-rae ya niccaṃ | bhavai nirāsae nijjaraṭhie /
  tavasā dhuṇai purāṇa-pāvagaṃ | jutto sayā tava-samāhie  
   cauvvihā khalu āyāra-samāhī bhavai, taṃ jahā 
no ihalogaṭhayāe āyāramahiṭhejjā, nā paralogaṭhayāe 
āyāramahiṭhejjā, no kitti-vaṇṇa-sadda-silogaṭhayāe 
āyāramahiṭhejjā, nannattha ārahantehiṃ heūhiṃ 
āyāramahiṭhejjā cautthaṃ payaṃ bhavai  
bhavai ya ettha silogo 
jiṇa-vayaṇa-rae atintaṇe | paḍipuṇṇāyayamāyayaṭhie /
āyāra-samāhi-saṃvuḍe | bhavai ya dante bhāva-saṃdhae  
  abhigama cauro samāhio | suvisuddho susamāhiyappao /
  viula-hiya-suhāvahaṃ puṇo | kuvvai so paya-khemamappaṇo  
  jāi-maraṇāo muccaī | itthatthaṃ ca cayai savvaso /
  siddhe vā bhavai sāsae | devo vā appa-rae mahiḍḍhie   tti bemi ||
|| navamamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 10 daśamamadhyayanam (sa-bhikkhuṇajjhayaṇaṃ.) /
nikkhamma-māṇāya buddha-vayaṇe | niccaṃ citta-samāhio havejjā /
itthīṇa vasaṃ na yāvi gacche | vantaṃ no paḍiyāyaī je sa bhikkhū 
puḍhaviṃ na khaṇe na khaṇāvae, | sīodagaṃ na pie na piyāvae /
agaṇi satthaṃ jahā su-nisiyaṃ | taṃ na jale na jalāvae je sa bhikkhū 
anileṇa na vīe na vīyāvae, | hariyāṇi na chinde na chindāvae /
bīyāṇi sayā vivajjayanto | saccittaṃ nāhārae je sa bhikkhū 
vahaṇaṃ tasa-thāvarāṇa hoi | puḍhavi-taṇa-kaṭha-nissiyāṇaṃ /
tamhā uddesiyaṃ na bhuñje, | no vi pae na payāvae je sa bhikkhū 
roiya-nāyaputta-vayaṇe | appa-same mannejja chappi kāe /
pañca ya phāse mahavvayāiṃ | pañcāsava-saṃvarae je sa bhikkhū 
cattāri vame sayā kasāe | dhuva-jogī ya havejja buddha-vayaṇe /
ahaṇe nijjāya-rūva-rayae | gihi-jogaṃ parivajjae je sa bhikkhū 
sammaddiṭhī sayā amūḍhe | "atthi hu nāṇe tave saṃjame ya" /
tavasā dhuṇai purāṇa-pāvagaṃ | maṇa-vaya-kāya-susaṃvuḍe je sa bhikkhū 
taheva asaṇaṃ pāṇagaṃ vā | vivihaṃ khāima-sāimaṃ labhittā /
"hohī aṭho sue pare vā" | taṃ na nihe na nihāvae je sa bhikkhū 
taheva asaṇaṃ pāṇagaṃ vā | vivihaṃ khāima-sāimaṃ labhittā /
chandiya sāhammiyāṇa bhuñje | bhoccā sajjhāya-rae ya je sa bhikkhū 
na ya vuggahiyaṃ kahaṃ kahejjā | na ya kuppe nihuindie pasante /
saṃjama-dhuva-joga-jutte | uvasante aviheḍae je sa bhikkhū 
jo sahai hu gāma-ka- ae | akkosa-pahāra-tajjaṇāo ya /
bhaya-bherava-sadda sa-ppahāse | sama-suha-dukkha-sahe ya je sa bhikkhū 
paḍimaṃ paḍivajjiyā masāṇe | no bhāe bhaya-bheravāi dissa /
viviha-guṇa-tavo-rae ya niccaṃ | na sarīraṃ cābhikaṅkhaī je sa bhikkhū 
asaiṃ vosaṭha-catta-dehe | akkuṭhe va hae va lūsie vā /
puḍhavi-same muṇī havejjā | aniyāṇe akohalle ya je sa bhikkhū 
abhibhūya kāeṇa parīsahāiṃ | samuddhare jāi-pahāo appayaṃ /
viittu jāī-maraṇaṃ mahabbhayaṃ | tave rae sāmaṇie je sa bhikkhū 
hattha-saṃjae pāya-saṃjae | vāya-saṃjae saṃjaindie /
ajjhappa-rae susamāhiyappā | suttatthaṃ ca viyāṇaī je sa bhikkhū 
uvahimmi amucchie agiddhe | annāyaṇuñchaṃ pula-nippulāe /
kaya-vikkaya-sannihiā virae | savva-saṅgāvagae ya je sa bhikkhū 
alolo bhikkhū na rasesu giddhe | uñchaṃ care jīviya-nābhikaṅkhī /
iḍḍhiṃ ca sakkāraṇa pūyaṇaṃ ca | cae ṭhiyappā aṇihe je sa bhikkhū 
na paraṃ vaejjāsi "ayaṃ kusīle" | jeṇanno kuppejja na taṃ vaejjā /
jāṇiya patteya puṇṇa-pāvaṃ | attāṇaṃ na samukkase je sa bhikkhū 
na jāi-matte na ya rūva-matte | na lābha-matte na sueṇa matte /
mayāṇi savvāṇi vivajjayanto | dhamma-jjhāṇa-rae ya je sa bhikkhū 
paveyae ajja-payaṃ mahā-muṇī, | dhamme ṭhio ṭhāvayaī paraṃ pi /
nikkhamma vajjejja kusīla-liṅgaṃ | na yāvi hāsaṃ kahae je sa bhikkhū 
taṃ deha-vāsaṃ asuiṃ asāsayaṃ | sayā cae nicca-hiyaṇṭhiyappā /
chindittu jāī-maraṇassa bandhaṇaṃ | uvei bhikkhū apuṇāgamaṃ gaiṃ  ti bemi ||
|| daśamamadhyayanam 
  Dasaveyāliya: 11 ekādaśamadhyayanam (raivakka-cūliyā paḍhamā.)/
   iha khalu bho pavvaieṇaṃ uppanna-dukkheṇaṃ saṃjame 
arai-samāvanna-citteṇaṃ ohāṇuppehiṇā aṇohāieṇaṃ 
ceva hayarassi-gayaṅkusa-poyapaḍāgā-bhūyāiṃ imāiṃ 
aṭhārasa ṭhāṇāiṃ sammaṃ saṃpaḍilehiyavvāiṃ bhavanti, taṃ 
jahā | 
  haṃ bho dussamāe duppajīvī  
  lahussagā ittariyā gihīṇaṃ kāma-bhogā  
  bhujjo ya sāya-bahulā maṇussā  
  imaṃ ca me dukkhaṃ na cirakālovaṭhāi bhavissai  
  oma-jaṇa-purakkāre  
  vantassa ya paḍiyāiyaṇaṃ gihīṇaṃ  
  aharagai-vāsovasaṃpayā  
  dullabhe khalu bho gihīṇaṃ dhamme gihi-vāsa-majjhe vasantāṇaṃ  
  āyaṅke se vahāya hoi  
  saṃkappe se vahāya hoi  
  sovakkese gihi-vāse, niruvakkese pariyāe  
  bandhe gihi-vāse, mokkhe pariyāe  
  sāvajje gihi-vāse, aṇavajje pariyāe  
  bahu-sāhāraṇā gihīṇaṃ kāma-bhogā  
  patteyaṃ puṇṇa-pāvaṃ  
  aṇicce khalu bho maṇuyāṇa jīvie kusaggajala-bindu-cañcale 
  bahuṃ ca khalu pāvaṃ kammaṃ pagaḍaṃ  
  pāvāṇaṃ ca khalu bho kaḍāṇaṃ kammāṇaṃ puvviṃ 
  ducciṇṇāṇaṃ duppaḍikkantāṇaṃ veyaittā mokkho, natthi 
  aveyaittā, tavasā vā jhosaittā | aṭhārasamaṃ payaṃ 
  bhavai  bhavai ya ettha silogo 
jayā ya cayaī dhammaṃ | aṇajjo bhoga-kāraṇā /
se tattha mucchie bāle | āyaiṃ nāvabujjhaī 
jayā ohāvio hoi | indo vā paḍio chamaṃ /
savva-dhamma-paribbhaṭho | sa pacchā paritappaī 
jayā ya vandimo hoi | pacchā hoi avandimo /
devayā va ccuyā ṭhāṇā | sa pacchā paritappaī 
jayā ya pūimo hoi | pacchā hoi apūimo /
rāyā va rajja-pabbhaṭho | sa pacchā paritappaī 
jayā ya māṇimo hoi | pacchā hoi amāṇimo /
seṭhi vva kabbaḍe chūḍho | sa pacchā paritappaī 
jayā ya therao hoi | samaikkanta-jovvaṇo /
maccho vva galiṃ gilittā | sa pacchā paritappaī 
(jayā ya kukuḍaṃbassa | kutattīhiṃ vihammaī /)
(hatthī va bandhaṇe baddho | sa pacchā paritappaī ||)
putta-dāra-parikiṇṇo | moha-saṃtāṇa-saṃtao /
paṅkosanno jahā nāgo | sa pacchā paritappaī 
"ajja yāhaṃ gaṇī honto | bhāviyappā bahussuo /
jai haṃ ramanto pariyāe | sāmaṇṇe jiṇa-desie" 
devaloga-samāṇo u | pariyāo mahesiṇaṃ /
rayāṇaṃ, arayāṇaṃ ca | mahānaraya-sāliso 
amarovamaṃ jāṇiya sokkhamuttamaṃ | rayāṇa pariyāe, tahārayāṇaṃ /
niraovamaṃ jāṇiya dukkhamuttamaṃ | ramejja tamhā pariyāya paṇḍie 
dhammāo bhaṭhaṃ siriovaveyaṃ | jannāggi vijjhāyamivappa-teyaṃ /
hīlanti -aṃ duvvihiyaṃ kusīlā | dāḍhuddhiyaṃ ghora-visaṃ va nāgaṃ 
ihevadhammo ayaso akittī | dunnāmadhejjaṃ ca pihujjaṇammi /
cuyassa dhammāo ahamma-seviṇo | saṃbhinna-vittassa ya heṭhao gaī 
bhuñjittu bhogāi pasajjha ceyasā | tahāvihaṃ kau asaṃjamaṃ bahuṃ /
gaiṃ ca gacche aṇabhijjhiyaṃ duhaṃ, | bohī ya se no sulabhā puṇo puṇo 
"imassa tā neraiyassa jantuṇo | duhovaṇīyassa kilesa-vattiṇo /
paliovamaṃ jhijjai sāgarovamaṃ, | kimaṅga puṇa majjha imaṃ maṇo-duhaṃ! 
na me ciraṃ dukkhamiṇaṃ bhavissaī, | asāsayā bhoga-pivāsa jantuṇo /
na ce sarīreṇa imeṇavessaī, | avesaī jīviya-pajjaveṇa me" 
jassevamappā u havejja nicchio | caejja dehaṃ, na u dhamma-sāsaṇaṃ /
taṃ tārisaṃ no payalenti indiyā | uvanta-vāyā va sudaṃsaṇaṃ giriṃ 
icceva saṃpassiya buddhimaṃ naro | āyaṃ uvāyaṃ vivihaṃ viyāṇiyā /
kāeṇa vāyā adu māṇaseṇaṃ | tigutti-gutto jiṇa-vayaṇamahiṭhejjāsi  tti bemi ||
|| ekādaśamadhyayanam 
Dasaveyāliya: 12 dvādaśamadhyayanam (cūliyā.) /
cūliyaṃ tu pavakkhāmi | suyaṃ kevali-bhāsiyaṃ /
jaṃ suṇittu sa-puṇṇāṇaṃ | dhamme uppajjae maī 
aṇusoya-paṭhie bahu-jaṇammi | paḍisoya-laddha-lakkheṇaṃ /
paḍisoyameva appā | dāyavvo hou-kāmeṇaṃ 
aṇusoya-suho logo, | paḍisoo āsavo suvihiyāṇaṃ /
aṇusoo saṃsāro, | paḍisoo tassa uttāro 
tamhā āyāra-parakkameṇa | saṃvara-samāhi-bahuleṇaṃ /
cariyā guṇā ya niyamā ya | honti sāhūṇa daṭhavvā 
aṇieya-vāso samuyāṇa-cariyā | annāyaṇuñchaṃ pairikkayā ya /
appovahī kalaha-vivajjaṇā ya | vihāra-cariyā isiṇaṃ pasatthā 
āiṇṇaṇomāṇa-vivajjaṇā ya | osanna-diṭhāhaḍa-bhatta-pāṇe /
saṃsaṭha-kappeṇa carejja bhikkhū | tajjāya-saṃsaṭha jaī jaejjā 
a-majja-maṃsāsi amaccharīyā | abhikkhaṇaṃ nivvigaīgayā ya /
abhikkhaṇaṃ kāussagga-kārī, | sajjhāya-joge payao havejjā 
na paḍinnavejjā sayaṇāsaṇāiṃ | sejjaṃ nisejjaṃ taha bhatta-pāṇaṃ /
gāme kule vā nagare va dese | mamatta-bhāvaṃ na kahiṃci kujjā 
gihiṇo veyāvaḍiyaṃ na kujjā | abhivāyaṇaṃ vandaṇa pūyaṇaṃ vā /
asaṃkiliṭhehi samaṃ vasejjā | muṇī carittassa jao na hāṇī 
na yā labhejjā niuṇaṃ sahāyaṃ | guṇāhiyaṃ vā guṇao samaṃ vā /
ekko vi pāvāi vivajjayanto | viharejja kāmesu asajjamāṇo 
saṃvaccharaṃ cāvi paraṃ pamāṇaṃ, | bīyaṃ ca vāsaṃ na tahiṃ vasejjā /
suttassa maggeṇa carejja bhikkhū | suttassa attho jaha āṇavei 
jo puvvarattāvararatta-kāle | saṃpehaī appagamappaeṇaṃ /
"kiṃ me kaḍaṃ? kiṃ ca me kicca-sesaṃ? | kiṃ sakkaṇijjaṃ na samāyarāmi? 
kiṃ me paro pāsai? kiṃ ca appā? | kiṃ cāhaṃ khaliyaṃ na vivajjayāmi?" /
icceva sammaṃ aṇupāsamāṇo | aṇāgayaṃ no paḍibandha kujjā 
jattheva pāse kai duppauttaṃ | kāeṇa vāyā adu māṇaseṇaṃ /
tattheva dhīro paḍisāharejjā | āinno khippamiva kkhalīṇaṃ 
jasserisā joga jiindiyassa | dhiīmao sappurisassa niccaṃ /
tamāhu loe "paḍibuddha-jīvī", | so jīvaī saṃjama-jīvieṇa 
appā hu khalu sayayaṃ rakkhiyavvo | savvindiehiṃ susamāhiehiṃ /
arakkhio jāi-pahaṃ uvei, | surakkhio savva-duhāṇa muccai  tti bemi ||
|| dvādaśamadhyayanam
