namiūṇa jiṇa-var'iṃde tiyasesara-vaṃdie dhuya-kilese  /
viusajaṇa-bohaṇ'atthaṃ Dhuttakkhāṇaṃ pavakkhāmi  
laliya-samiddha-jaṇavayā atthi purī surapuriṃ visesaṃtī  /
ujjuya-jaṇāhivāsā Ujjeṇī nāma nāmeṇaṃ  
tīse uttarapāse nāṇāviha-kusuma-gumma-laya-gahaṇaṃ  /
mahuyari-gaṇovagīyaṃ ujjāṇaṃ Naṃdaṇa-saricchaṃ  
tatth' ujjāṇa-gihammī nāṇāviha-rūva-kamma-ṇijjuttā  /
dhuttāṇa sayāṇegā samāgayā kaha vi hiṃḍaṃtā  
māyā-ṇiyaḍi-pahāṇā akajja-ṇicc'ujjuyā niraṇukaṃpā  /
thī-bāla-vuḍḍha-vīsattha-ghāiṇo vaṃcaṇ'ekkaparā  
(Antyavipulā)
dhūv'aṃjaṇa-jogehi ya osoyaṇi-thaṃbhaṇīhiṃ vijjāhiṃ  /
sara-vaṇṇa-bheya-kusalā tesi pahū paṃc' ime kamaso  
Mūlasiri Kaṃḍarīo Elāsāḍho Saso ya Khaṃḍavaṇā  /
ekk'ekkassa ya tesiṃ dhuttāṇaṃ paṃca-paṃcasayā  
dhuttīṇaṃ paṃcasayā Khaṃḍavaṇāe ya navari parivāro  /
savvāṇa vi tāṇa pahū Mūlasirī loya-vikkhāo  
vaṭṭai ya tāṇa kālo jalaya-samucchanna-sūra-sasi-maggo  /
iṃdadhaṇu-vijju-gajjiya-jalayara-muhalo varisayālo  
sattāha-duddiṇammi ya samaṃtao bhariya-vappa-kūva-sare  /
kaya-cikkhilla-cilipphila-dussaṃcārāsu racchāsu  
eyārisammi kāle te dhuttā sīya-vaddalābhihayā  /
bhukkh'attā beṃti tahiṃ ko amhaṃ dejja bhattaṃ ti  
aha bhaṇai Mūladevo jaṃ jeṇa suyaṃ va samaṇubhūyaṃ vā  /
so taṃ kaheu savvaṃ miliyāṇ' eyāṇa dhuttāṇaṃ  
jo taṃ na pattiejjā asacca-vayaṇaṃ ti teṇa savvesiṃ  /
dhuttāṇa samuiyāṇaṃ dāyavvaṃ bhatta-pāṇaṃ ti  
jo puṇa purāṇa-Bhāraha-Rāmāyaṇa-sui-samuttha-vayaṇehiṃ  /
taṃ vayaṇaṃ samatthittā mahāyaṇaṃ pattiyāvejja  
so dhuttāṇa ahivaī mahāmaī atthi sattha-ṇimmāo  /
mā deu kiṃci kassa vi iya bhaṇie Mūladeveṇa  
te savve viya bhaṇiyā iya hou susohaṇaṃ tae bhaṇiyaṃ  /
kiṃtu tumaṃ paḍhamaṃ ciya kahehi jaṃ te samaṇubhūyaṃ  
aha bhaṇai Mūladevo jaṃ aṇubhūyaṃ mae taruṇa-bhāve  /
taṃ nisuṇeha avahiyā kahijjamāṇaṃ sujuttīe  
taruṇattaṇammi ahayaṃ icchiya-suha-saṃpayaṃ ahilasaṃto  /
Dhārā-dharaṇ'aṭṭhāe Sāmi-gihaṃ patthio suiraṃ  
chatta-kamaṃḍalu-hattho paṃthaṃ vāhemi gahiya-pacchayaṇo  /
mattaṃ pavvaya-mettaṃ pecchāmi ya gayavaraṃ iṃtaṃ  
meham iva gulaguliṃtaṃ pabhinna-karaḍā-muhaṃ mahāmattaṃ  /
daṭṭhūṇa vaṇagay'iṃdaṃ bhaeṇa vevaṃta-gatto haṃ  
attāṇo ya asaraṇo kattha nilukkāmi haṃ ti ciṃtaṃto  /
to sahasā ya aigao kamaṃḍaluṃ maraṇa-bhayabhīo  
aha so vi matta-hatthī ūsaviya-karo sarosa-ratt'accho  /
majjhāṇumagga-laggo kamaṃḍaluṃ aigao sigghaṃ  
to haṃ bhaya-saṃbhaṃto samaṃtao vidduyaṃ paloyaṃto  /
hatthiṃ kamaṃḍalummī vāmoheūṇa chammāsaṃ  
gīvāĕ niggao haṃ hatthī vi mamāṇumaggao niṃto  /
laggo vāl'agg'aṃte kuṃḍiya-gīvāĕ chiddammi  
aham avi ya navari purao Gaṃgaṃ pecchāmi raṃgira-taraṃgaṃ  /
pheṇa-ṇiyar'aṭṭahāsaṃ vaṇagaya-daṃta-kkhaya-taḍ'aggaṃ  
ummī-sahassa-pauraṃ jhasa-mayara-ggāha-kumma-pariyariyaṃ  /
juvai-hiyaya vv' agāhaṃ uyahi vva sudūra-parapāraṃ  
paham annaṃ alahaṃto to haṃ isu-veya-vāhiṇiṃ sigghaṃ  /
bāhāhiṃ samuttiṇṇo gopayam iva Bhārahiṃ viulaṃ  
to Sāmi-gihaṃ gaṃtuṃ chuha-taṇhā-parisahehiṃ sahamāṇo  /
chammāsā sīseṇaṃ dharemi Dhārā-dhar'aṭṭhāe  
dhāreūṇa ya Dhāraṃ payao ahivaṃdiūṇa Mahaseṇaṃ  /
saṃpatto Ujjeṇiṃ tubbhehiṃ samaṃ ca milio haṃ  
to jai saccaṃ eyaṃ to me heūhiṃ pattiyāveha  /
aha mannaha aliyaṃ taṃ dhuttāṇaṃ deha to bhattaṃ  
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo ko bhaṇihī tumam asacca-vayaṇaṃ ti  /
Bhāraha-purāṇa-Rāmāyaṇāṇi puriso viyāṇaṃto  
(Antyavipulā)
paribhaṇai Mūladevo so hatthī kuṃḍiyāĕ kaha māo  /
kaha bhamio chammāsaṃ kamaṃḍale tammi vaṇahatthī  
suhuma-cchiddeṇa kamaṃḍalāŏ kaha niggao ahaṃ so ya  /
niggaṃtuṃ vaṇahatthī vāl'agg'aṃte kahaṃ laggo  
(Ādivipulā)
kaha Gaṃgā uttiṇṇā bāhāhiṃ mae sudūra-parapārā  /
kaha chammāsaṃ dhariyā bhukkhiya-tisieṇ' udaya-dhārā  
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo jaṃ summai Bhārahe purāṇe ya  /
taṃ jai savvaṃ saccaṃ to saccaṃ tujjha vi ya vayaṇaṃ  
hatthī kamaṃḍalummī ahaṃ pi māo kahaṃ ti jaṃ bhaṇasi  /
ettha diyāi-pasiddhaṃ vayaṇaṃ suṇa paccaya-ṇimittaṃ  
Baṃbhāṇassa muhāo vippā khattiya-jaṇo ya bāhāsu  /
ūrūsu niggayā kira vaisā suddā ya pāesu  
Baṃbhāṇassa sarīre jai māo ettio jaṇa-samūho  /
to kaha kamaṃḍalummī na māsi taṃ vaṇagaya-samaggo  
annaṃ ca Baṃbha-Viṇhū uḍḍhaṃ ca aho ya be vi dhāvaṃtā  /
aṃtaṃ jassa na pattā vāsa-sahasseṇa divveṇa  
liṃgaṃ mahappamāṇaṃ kaha māyaṃ tass' Umā-sarīrammi  /
evaṃ jai kuṃḍiyāe hatthī māo tti ko doso  
annaṃ ca imaṃ suvvai risiṇā Vāseṇa Bhārahe 'bhihiyaṃ  /
jaha veṇu-pavva-majjhe Kīyaga-bhāiya-sayaṃ jāyaṃ  
kīo vaṃso bhaṇṇai tahiṃ jāyā Kīyaga tti bhaṇṇaṃti  /
kaha tesiṃ uppattī Virāḍa-rāy'agga-mahisīe  
tīe vi natthi putto to sā risi-āsamammi risim ekkaṃ  /
ārāhiuṃ payattā teṇa vi so sāhio caruo  
bhaṇiyā teṇa ya risiṇā eyaṃ caruyaṃ tumaṃ kuḍaṃgammi  /
bhuṃjāhi pahiṭṭha-maṇā hohī te tattha putta-sayaṃ  
sā taṃ paribhuttuṃ je vaṃsa-kuḍaṃgammi to gayā sagihaṃ  /
kassai kālassa tahiṃ Gaggali-ṇāmo risivaro tti  
vaṃsī-jāla-paviṭṭho carai tavaṃ navari tattha pauma-sare  /
accharasā ṇhāyaṃtī risiṇā diṭṭhā vigaya-vatthā  
khuhiyassa sukka-biṃduṃ paḍiyaṃ nālīĕ Kīyago paḍhamo  /
nava-ṇāya-sahassa-balo saṃjāo paḍhama-biṃdummi  
jaha jaha nijjhāi muṇī accharasaṃ pavara-rūva-lāvannaṃ  /
taha taha khirai ya bīyaṃ jāyaṃ tahiṃ Kīyagāṇa sayaṃ  
vaṃsī-ṇālīŏ risī nikkhiviuṃ niyayam ālayaṃ patto  /
so cciya vaṃsa-kuḍaṃgaṃ rāyā rakkhāvae niccaṃ  
saṃjāya-savva-gattā gahiyā devīĕ tuṭṭha-maṇasāe  /
taṃ tīe putta-sayaṃ bhaṇṇai nālī-samuppannaṃ  
jai vaṃsa-samuppannaṃ bhāya-sayaṃ Kīyagāṇa māi tahiṃ  /
to kaha kamaṃḍalummī na māsi taṃ vaṇagaya-samaggo  
vāsa-sahassaṃ Gaṃgā jaḍāsu vāmohiyā jai hareṇaṃ  /
chammāsaṃ kuṃḍiyāe vimohio vaṇagao saccaṃ  
laggo vāl'agg'aṃte hatthī ahayaṃ ca niggao kaha nu  /
jaṃ bhaṇasi taṃ suṇejjasu purāṇa-sui-āgayaṃ vayaṇaṃ  
Viṇhū jagassa kattā so kira eg'aṇṇavammi logammi  /
āgāsa-bhūmi-māruya-tasa-thāvara-jalaṇa-rahiyammi  
naṭṭha-ṇarāsura-tirie tārā-sasi-sūra-virahie loe  /
tappai tavaṃ Aṇaṃto jala-sayaṇa-gao aciṃt'appā  
tassa kira paṃkaya-ttho Baṃbho nāhīĕ pauma-gabbhāo  /
daṃḍa-kamaṃḍalu-hattho viṇiggao paṃkayaṃ laggaṃ  
evaṃ kamaṃḍalu-gīvāĕ niggao jai tumaṃ gaya-samaṃ pi  /
hatthī vāl'agg'aṃte laggo to ettha kim ajuttaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
jaṃ pi ya bhaṇasi guṇāgara kuṃḍiya-gīvāĕ niggao kim ahaṃ  /
Bhāraha-pasiddham ettha vi vayaṇaṃ suṇa paccaya-ṇimittaṃ  
divvaṃ vāsa-sahassaṃ Baṃbhāṇo tappaī tavaṃ raṇṇe  /
to khuhiyā tiyasa-gaṇā bhaṇaṃti kaha hojja se vigghaṃ  
to bhaṇai suravar'Iṃdo thī-lolo Pasuvaī-vivāhammi  /
aggīkamma-ṇiutto daṭṭhūṇa Umaṃ lhasiya-celaṃ  
khuhio bīya-ṇisaggaṃ karei vihuṇai niyaṃsaṇaṃ tāhe  /
paḍiyaṃ bīyaṃ kalase Doṇāyario samuppanno  
erisiya-itthiyāhiṃ eso khubbhejja rūva-kaliyāhiṃ  /
ko itthīhiṃ na khuhio muttūṇa jiṇaṃ Mahāvīraṃ  
Goyama-Vasiṭṭha-Pārāsaro ya Jamayaggi-Kāsavo-'gatthī  /
ahayaṃ ca surāhivaī Haro Harī tihuyaṇa-variṭṭhā  
(Ādivipulā)
anne vi evam āī tava-satta-ṇihī jayammi vikkhāyā  /
Vammaha-bāṇābhihayā itthīhiṃ karāviyā āṇaṃ  
tā gaṃtūṇaṃ sigghaṃ Tilottamā uttamā sura-vahūṇaṃ  /
khoheu tava-visiṭṭhaṃ iṭṭheṇa Piyāmahaṃ vihiṇā  
to sā saṃgaya-vesā tiyasāhiva-vayaṇa-gahiya-saṃdesā  /
gaṃtuṃ vibhussa purao divvaṃ naṭṭaṃ payāsei  
jahaṇ'uvvahaṇa-bhamirayā ucchāliya-hāra-maṃthar'ucchohā  /
ghaṇa-masiṇ'aṃsiya-thaṇahara-m-ukkaṃpiya-pelava-dugullā  
laliya-paṇay'aṃgalaṭṭhī sakaḍakkh'ubbheya-bhuya-layā-juyalā  /
rehai paṇaccamāṇī pavaṇeriya-Caṃpaya-laya vva  
daṭṭhūṇa naccamāṇiṃ Baṃbhā eg'iṃdio vva saṃvutto  /
nijjhāi aṇimis'accho ses'iṃdiya-mukka-vāvāro  
nāūṇa tassa bhāvaṃ to sā saṃgaya-maṇohara-suvesā  /
vivihāharaṇa-vihūsā dakkhiṇapāse ṭhiyā Vihuṇo  
to taṃ apecchamāṇo Baṃbhāṇo maṇasi maṇasijābhihao  /
taṃ daṭṭhūṇa sataṇho karei bīyaṃ tao vayaṇaṃ  
etto 'vareṇa taiyaṃ cautthayaṃ kuṇai uttareṇaṃ so  /
uḍḍhaṃ uppaiyāe paṃcama-vayaṇaṃ uvari-huttaṃ  
to tassa pamattassa ya Tilottamāgaya-maṇassa Ruddeṇaṃ  /
taṃ vayaṇaṃ paṃcamayaṃ naheṇa ukkhuṃṭiyaṃ sahasā  
to Baṃbhā parikuvio dāhiṇa-hattha-ppaesiṇīe u  /
uvvaṭṭei nilāḍe asarisa-ros'uṭṭhiyaṃ seyaṃ  
tatth' uppanno see balavaṃto Seyakuṃḍalī nāma  /
Baṃbheṇ' āṇatteṇaṃ ukkhitto Saṃkaro teṇaṃ  
to so bhaya-saṃbhaṃto nāsaṃto Bayariyāsame patto  /
tattha Harī niyamattho bhikkhaṃ dehi tti saṃlatto  
tā teṇa takkhaṇaṃ ciya mukka-sirā appaṇo nilāḍammi  /
Baṃbhāṇa-sira-kavālaṃ Ruddeṇa samuḍḍiyaṃ heṭṭhe  
vāsa-sahasseṇa vi taṃ na bharijjai tīĕ ruhira-dhārāe  /
taṃ ruhiram aṃgulīe Pasuvaiṇā ḍohiyaṃ navariṃ  
Baṃbhāṇa-sira-kavāle Kesava-ruhir'aṃgulīĕ Ruddassa  /
to Rattakuṃḍaliṇaro tiṇhaṃ saṃjogao jāo  
so Ruddeṇ' āṇatto pajujjhio Seyakuṃḍalīĕ samaṃ  /
jujjhaṃtāṇaṃ tāṇaṃ vāsa-sahassaṃ aikkaṃtaṃ  
to geṇhiūṇa donni vi savvehi suravarehiṃ miliehiṃ  /
dinno Sakkassa Naro Sūrassa samappio bīo  
bhaṇiyā Bhāraha-kāle Bhāraha-jujjhassa kāraṇ'aṭṭhāe  /
Bharah'avayāra-kāle uvaṇijjaha maṇuya-loyammi  
to kāle saṃpatte Sūro Kuṃtīĕ rūva-ummatto  /
kaya-saṃjoo tīe kucchīĕ jaṇei taṃ gabbhaṃ  
sannaddha-baddha-kavao Kuṃtī-kaṇṇeṇa niggao Kaṇṇo  /
to kiṃ tumaṃ na nīsarasi kuṃḍi-gīvāĕ Mūlasirī  
(Antyavipulā)
Gaṃgā aṇora-pārā kaham uttiṇṇa tti bhaṇasi me jaṃ tu  /
ettha vi paccaya-jaṇaṇaṃ suṇehi Rāmāyaṇe vittaṃ  
Sīyā-pautti-heuṃ Pavaṇa-suo Rāhaveṇa āṇatto  /
Laṃkā-puriṃ aigao bāhāhiṃ mahoyahiṃ tariuṃ  
diṭṭhāe Sīyāe piya-paḍivattiṃ suṇittu tuṭṭhāe  /
bhaṇio kaha te uyahī tiṇṇo Haṇuyaṃta so bhaṇai  
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ:
tava prasādāt tava ca prasādād bhartuś ca te devi tava prasādāt  /
sādhūnate yena pituḥ prasādāt tīrṇo mayā goṣpadavat samudraḥ  //
(Upajāti)
jai teṇa samuttiṇṇo tirieṇa mahoyahī duruttāro  /
to kiṃ tae nar'uttama na hojja Gaṅgā samuttiṇṇā  
jaṃ bhaṇasi kaha nu Dhārā chammāsā dhāriyā sireṇa mae  /
ettha vi me suṇa heuṃ diyāi-sui-āgayaṃ vayaṇaṃ  
loga-hiy'aṭṭhāe kira Gaṃgā abbhatthiyā suravarehiṃ  /
avayarasu maṇuya-loyaṃ saggāo bhaṇai sā tāhe  
ko maṃ dhariuṃ sakko nivaḍaṃtiṃ bhaṇai Pasuvaī ahayaṃ  /
dhāremi tao paḍiyā dhariyā sīseṇa Pasuvaiṇā  
divvaṃ vāsa-sahassaṃ jai dhariyā Jaṇhavī Umā-vaiṇā  /
to kaha na dharesi tumaṃ chammāsaṃ sireṇ' udaya-dhārā  
uttama-puriso si tumaṃ vinnāṇ'āgama-guṇehiṃ saṃpuṇṇo  /
niggaya-jaso mahappā vikkhāo jīva-loyammi 
____________________________________________________
aisaio Mūlasirī Kaṃḍariyaṃ bhaṇai bhaṇasu ettāhe  /
jaṃ diṭṭhaṃ jaṃ ca suyaṃ aṇuhūyaṃ jaṃ ca te ihaiṃ  
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo aviṇaya-puṇṇo mi āsi bālatte  /
ammā-pii-duddaṃto roseṇa gharāŏ nikkhaṃto  
parihiṃḍaṃto ya ahaṃ patto des'aṃta-saṃṭhiyaṃ gāmaṃ  /
go-mahisa-ajā-elaya-khara-karaha-samāulaṃ muiyaṃ  
ārām'ujjāṇa-vaṇehiṃ sohiyaṃ kusuma-phala-samiddhehiṃ  /
Ayalāpuri-sāricchaṃ bahu-ghara-saya-saṃkulaṃ rammaṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
tassa bahumajjha-dese pecchaṃ Vaḍapāyavaṃ maṇ'abhirāmaṃ  /
meha-ṇiuraṃba-bhūyaṃ sauṇa-sahassāṇa āvāsaṃ  
tassa ya heṭṭhe jakkho kamaladal'akkho guṇehiṃ parikiṇṇo  /
sannihiya-pāḍihero dei varaṃ so vara-tthīṇaṃ  
jakkhassa tassa jattā vaṭṭai bahujaṇa-samāulā muiyā  /
tatth' ei jaṇo muio dhūva-balī-puppha-hattha-gao  
ṇhāya-pasāhiya-jimio savvālaṃkāra-bhūsiya-sarīro  /
nāṇāviha-vattha-dharo caṃdaṇa-parivaṇṇaga-vilitto  
to haṃ sakouhallo uvāgao taṃ mahāyaṇa-samūhaṃ  /
jakkhassa kame namiuṃ ramamāṇe ghoḍahe pecchaṃ  
sannaddha-baddha-kavayā gahiy'āuha-paharaṇā ya aibahulā  /
kalayala-ravaṃ kareṃtā paḍiyā corā navari tattha  
to so sabāla-vuḍḍho sa-itthio jaṇavao sapasuvaggo  /
aha ghoḍaehiṃ sahio vāluṃkaṃ aigao savvo  
tattha vi te ghoḍahae ramaṃta-pecchā jaṇe ya muiya-maṇe  /
corā vi paḍiṇiyattā naṭṭho gāmo tti jaṃpaṃtā  
navari tahiṃ pasuvaggo caramāṇo āgao suvīsattho  /
ekkāĕ pasūĕ tao oiliyaṃ cibbhaḍaṃ sahasā  
sā ayagareṇa ghatthā so vi ya ḍheṃkīĕ navari oilio  /
sā tatth' eva nilīṇā tuṃge Vaḍapāyave viule  
tassa ahe khaṃdhāro navari ṭhio rāiṇo ya matta-gao  /
ḍheṃkī-pāe jamio Vaḍa-pāroho tti kāūṇa  
āuṃciyammi pāe kaḍḍhijjai gayavaro gulaguliṃto  /
to ravai meṃṭha-vaggo keṇāvi gao samukkhitto  
soūṇa tāṇa saddaṃ saṃpattā saddavehiṇo johā  /
isu-cāva-gahiya-hatthā kalayala-rāvaṃ karemāṇā  
chinnā ya tīĕ paṃkhā se sīsaṃ hatthiehiṃ dakkhehiṃ  /
sā vilavaṃtī paḍiyā pavvaya-sihara vva mahi-vaṭṭhe  
phālāviyā ya rannā poṭṭe diṭṭho ya ayagaro viulo  /
sagaḍassa īdaro viva khoḍī viva mahiyale paḍiyā  
aha bhaṇai nara-var'iṃdo phālijjau esa ayagaro viulo  /
eyassa vi mā majjhe māṇusa-tiriyaṃ ca hojjāhi  
aha phāliyammi uyare diṭṭhā sā chāliyā mahākāyā  /
tīe vi uyara-majjhe ramaṇijjaṃ cibbhaḍaṃ diṭṭhaṃ  
hī hī aho mahallaṃ ti cibbhaḍaṃ jāva jaṃpae rāyā  /
to ghoḍayā vi ramiuṃ navari ṭhiy'āojja-vaṃsa-karā  
(Ādivipulā)
niggaṃtuṃ ca pavatto vālukkāo tao jaṇa-samūho  /
jaha salabhāṇa ya seṇā reppha-bilāo viṇikkhamai  
namiūṇa nara-var'iṃdaṃ to so sacauppao jaṇo savvo  /
niya-ṇiya-ṭhāṇāiṃ gao ahaṃ pi patto imaṃ nayariṃ  
eyaṃ me aṇubhūyaṃ paccakkham ih' eva māṇuse loe  /
jo me na pattiyāyai dhuttāṇaṃ deu so bhuttiṃ  
aha bhaṇai Elasāḍho pattijjāmo na kiṃci saṃdeho  /
paḍibhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo gāmo kaha cibbhaḍe māo  
paḍibhaṇai Elasāḍho purāṇa-Bhāraha-suīsu diṭṭh'attho  /
kiṃ tuha Viṇhupurāṇaṃ kaṇṇa-sui-pahaṃ na pattaṃ te  
puvviṃ āsi jagam iṇaṃ paṃcamahābhūya-vajjiyaṃ gahiraṃ  /
eg'aṇṇavaṃ jaleṇaṃ mahappamāṇaṃ tahiṃ aṃḍaṃ  
vīī-paraṃpareṇaṃ gholaṃtaṃ acchiuṃ sucira-kālaṃ  /
phuṭṭaṃ dubhāga-jāyaṃ addhaṃ bhūmīĕ saṃvuttaṃ  
tattha surāsura-ṇāraya-maṇuya-cauppaya-mayaṃ jayaṃ savvaṃ  /
jai māyaṃ tā gāmo kaha nu na māejja vāluṃke  
annaṃ ca imaṃ suvvai Araṇīpavvammi Dhammaputtassa  /
kahiyaṃ suyam-aṇubhūyaṃ Makkaṃḍeṇaṃ ca anna-jue  
so kila jug'aṃta-samae uyaeṇ' eg'aṇṇavī-kae loe  /
vīī-paraṃpareṇaṃ gholiṃto uyaya-majjhammi  
pecchai gaya-tasathāvara-paṇaṭṭha-sura-ṇara-tirikkhajoṇīyaṃ  /
eg'aṇṇavaṃ jagam iṇaṃ paṃcamahābhūya-pabbhaṭṭhaṃ  
evaṃ-vihe jagammī pecchai Naggohapāyavaṃ aha so  /
Maṃdaragiri vva tuṃgaṃ mahāsamuddaṃ va vitthiṇṇaṃ  
khaṃdhammi tassa sayaṇaṃ acchai tahiṃ bālao maṇ'abhirāmo  /
saṃpuṇṇa-sarīr'uyao miu-maddava-kuṃciya-sueso  
hattho pasārio se risiṇā eh'ehi vaccha bhaṇio ya  /
khaṃdhe mamaṃ vilaggasu mā marihisi uyaya-vāhīe  
teṇa ya ghettuṃ hattho oilio so risī tao tassa  /
pecchai uyarammi jayaṃ sasela-vaṇa-kāṇaṇaṃ savvaṃ  
divvaṃ vāsa-sahassaṃ kucchīe so risī paribhamaṃto  /
aṃtaṃ na c'eva patto viṇiggao risivaro tatto  
jai dārayassa uyare sasurāsura-māṇusaṃ jayaṃ māyaṃ  /
to cibbhaḍammi gāmo kaha nu na māejja Kaṃḍariya  
ḍheṃkoyare ayagaro tassa pasūe ya cibbhaḍaṃ uyare  /
tattha vi ya jaṇa-samūho kaha māo bhaṇasi suṇasu imaṃ  
muṭṭhī-gejjha-sumajjhāĕ Kesavo Devaīĕ kucchimmi  /
vutto tassa ya uyare sasela-vaṇa-kāṇaṇā puhaī  
(Ādivipulā)
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo cibbhaḍa-pasu-ayagar'āi-majjhammi  /
acchaṃto kaha na mao eyaṃ me pattiyāveha  
bhaṇai ya Elāsāḍho taddiyasaṃ c'eya niggao taṃ si  /
puhaī kaha na vivajjai Vasudeva-suyassa poṭṭa-tthā  
poṭṭe kisi-vāṇijjaṃ saṃgāmā bahuvihā ya āraṃbhā  /
āvāha-vivāhā vi ya ussava-pasavā ya vaṭṭaṃti  
kaha puṇa havejja eyaṃ jayaṃ tu uyare vi jassa jaṃ vutthaṃ  /
Baṃbhāṇa-Kesavāṇaṃ puvviṃ kira bhaṃḍaṇaṃ āsi  
kattā ahaṃ ti Baṃbhā bhaṇai jao vayaṇa-bāha-ūrūhiṃ  /
pāesu ya nikkhaṃtaṃ cāuvvaṇṇaṃ jagam iṇaṃ ti  
paḍibhaṇai taṃ Aṇaṃto Baṃbhāṇaṃ saparihāsa-vayaṇehiṃ  /
taṃ si mama ceḍa-rūvaṃ na jujjae erisaṃ vottuṃ  
abbhā-bhūmiya-oṭṭhe pavvaya-dāḍhe samudda-jīhāle  /
pavisehi majjha uyare jā peccha savibbhamaṃ puhaiṃ  
maha c'eva samuppanno jala-sayaṇe nāhi-ṇiggae paume  /
Baṃbhāṇa taṃ na sohasi guru-purao ettiyaṃ vottuṃ  
avi ya
jassa pabhāveṇ' ummilliyāiṃ taṃ c'eva kaha kayagghāiṃ  /
kumuyāiṃ atta-saṃbhāviyāiṃ caṃdaṃ uvahasaṃti  
(Mahāvipulā)
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo porāṇa-suīsu kattha ya suyaṃ te  /
ḍheṃkī mahappamāṇā jass' uyare ettiyaṃ māyaṃ  
paribhaṇai Elasāḍho Dovai-devī-sayaṃvare pattā  /
jaha kira dhaṇuṃ paviṭṭhā Mahihara-ṇāgā ya Aggī ya  
Dupaya-ṇar'iṃdassa dhaṇuṃ sumahallaṃ devayā-pariggahiyaṃ  /
jo āruhio viṃdhai vāme acchimmi sūyariyaṃ  
jijjai kalāsu kusalā kira kaṇṇā tassa Dovaī souṃ  /
rāyāṇo taṃ dhaṇuhaṃ āruhiuṃ to samāḍhattā  
na cayaṃti āruheuṃ aha Sasipālo mahābalo tāhe  /
saṃdheūṇa payatto navari dhaṇuṃ taṃ ayatteṇaṃ  
to Kaṇheṇaṃ tāhe Garulo nāgā gayā ya saṃkhā ya  /
cakkaṃ naṃgala-musalaṃ Maṃdara-Merū ya pakkhittā  
saṃdhei to vi jāhe tā Sasi-Sūr'Aggi-uyahi-selā ya  /
pakkhittā savva cciya Vasuhā aha dhaṇu-hare tammi  
addh'aṃgula-mette kira asaṃdhie Kesaveṇa bāṇaṃ so  /
pāeṇa vi moyaviuṃ tāhe paḍio saha-dhaṇū ṇaṃ  
Pattheṇa ya taṃ gahiyaṃ aha aibhāreṇa na sahaī dharaṇī  /
Bhīmassa tao hatthe āruhiyaṃ taṃ payatteṇa  
kaṇṇa-vidiṇṇeṇa sareṇa viṃdhiuṃ Ajjuṇeṇa taṃ rāhaṃ  /
laddhā Dovai-kannā vīra-paḍāgaṃ haraṃteṇa  
(Ādivipulā)
jai taṃ mahalla-dhaṇuyaṃ nāg'Aggi-gayā ya aigayā jattha  /
to kaha na hoi ḍheṃkī mahaī jatth' ettiyaṃ māyaṃ  
Rāmāyaṇe vi suvvai Sīyā-haraṇe Jaḍāu-giddho tti  /
paṃkh'āuho mahappā jujjheṇaṃ Rāmaṇassa ṭhio  
teṇa vi se ruṭṭheṇaṃ Caṃdāhāseṇa lūḍiyā paṃkhā  /
to luya-paṃkho paḍio Maṃdara-siharo vva mahi-vaṭṭhe  
Sīyāe so bhaṇio sīlavaīṇaṃ saīṇa teeṇaṃ  /
daṭṭhūṇa Rāma-dūyaṃ hohiṃti puṇo vi te paṃkhā  
kassai kālassa tao Haṇuyaṃto Rāhaveṇa āṇatto  /
Sīyā-pautti-heuṃ hiṃḍaṃto āgao tahiyaṃ  
ciṃtei ya Haṇuyaṃto aho girī esa unnao 'īva  /
etth' āruhiūṇa ahaṃ pulaemi samaṃtao vasuhaṃ  
saṃlatto ya khageṇaṃ ko 'si tumaṃ eriseṇa veseṇa  /
so bhaṇai Rāma-dūo ahaṃ ti Sīyaṃ gavesāmi  
bhaṇio Jaḍāuṇā so Rāma-vahū Rāvaṇeṇa vilavaṃtī  /
telokka-ḍāmareṇaṃ Laṃkāpura-paṭṭaṇaṃ nīyā  
mā bhamasu araṇṇāiṃ Sīyā-devīĕ maggaṇ'aṭṭhāe  /
Daharaha-suyassa sigghaṃ gaṃtūṇa piyaṃ niveehi  
aham avi Sīy'aṭṭhāe jujjhaṃto nisiyarāhiveṇ' evaṃ  /
asiṇā duve vi paṃkhe chettūṇa ajaṃgamo mukko  
aha bhaṇai Vāu-putto jaṃ si ṭhio Rāvaṇassa jujjheṇa  /
jaṃ vā vi amha kahiyaṃ hohi tti tumaṃ pi piyabhāgī  
soūṇa dūya-vayaṇaṃ to se jāyā puṇaṇṇavā paṃkhā  /
āyāseṇ' uppaio gao ya saggaṃ niruvasaggaṃ  
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ:
ākhyāsyati khagaḥ svarge pitur Daśarathasya me  /
ekastrīparipālye 'pi na Rāmaḥ śaktum arhati  
Maṃdara-sihar'āgāro jai āsi Jaḍāu khahayaro giddho  /
tā kaha na hoi ḍheṃkī Kaṃḍariya mahappamāṇāo  
Elāsāḍheṇ' evaṃ Kaṃḍario jaṃpio bhaṇai tāhe  /
Elāsāḍha iyāṇiṃ kahehi jaṃ te samaṇubhūyaṃ 
____________________________________________________
aha bhaṇai Elasāḍho ahayaṃ taruṇattaṇe daviṇa-buddhī  /
dhāuvvāya-pisāeṇa bhāmio paribhamāmi jagaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
ettha bilaṃ ettha raso eso so pavvao jahiṃ dhāū  /
evaṃ lakkha-gaeṇaṃ naḍijjamāṇo paribhamāmi  
laddho ya āgamo me jaha puvva-disāĕ joyaṇa-sahasse  /
navaraṃ gaṃtūṇa giriṃ sahassavehī raso tahiyaṃ  
joyaṇa-vitthiṇṇāe silāĕ taṃ rasa-bilaṃ samucchannaṃ  /
ukkhiviūṇa silaṃ so ghittavvo kaṇaya-kuṃḍāo  
āsā-pāsa-ṇibaddho joyaṇa-saiehiṃ kamehiṃ to ahaṃ  /
gaṃtūṇa giri-paese ukkhiviya silaṃ rasaṃ gahiuṃ  
pariḍhakkiūṇa ya bilaṃ silāĕ to āgayaṃ imaṃ bhavaṇaṃ  /
to jāo me vibhao Dhaṇaya-sariccho rasa-pasāyā  
aha paṇaiṇi-parikiṇṇo thuvvaṃto taha ya māgaha-saehiṃ  /
vara-taruṇi-saṃpauttehiṃ nāḍaehiṃ ca gijjaṃto  
(Antyavipulā)
acchāmi vilasamāṇo accharasā-parigao Dhaṇavai vva  /
tālāyara-māhaṇa-bhikkhuyāṇa dāṇaṃ payacchāmi  
(Antyavipulā)
to Dhaṇaya-vihava-sarisaṃ nāūṇa mamaṃ viṇiggaya-jasohaṃ  /
corā sāmattheuṃ rattiṃ paḍiyā mama gihammi  
sannaddha-baddha-paṭṭehiṃ tehiṃ gahiy'āuha-ppahārehiṃ  /
kaya-sīha-ṇāya-bolehiṃ veḍhiyaṃ majjha vara-bhavaṇaṃ  
(Mahāvipulā)
parisaṃciyassa atthassa kāraṇe maraṇam āgayaṃ tehiṃ  /
sa-bhuya-bala-jjiyam atthaṃ na demi hariuṃ viciṃteuṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
sahasā ya uṭṭhio haṃ dhaṇuaṃ ghettūṇa sara-sahassaṃ ca  /
to bhaṃḍaṇam āḍhattaṃ corāṇa mahaṃta-bhīsaṇayaṃ  
satt'aṭṭha-dasa-duvālasa ahayaṃ ekkeṇa sara-pahāreṇaṃ  /
jatto valāmi tatto pesemi Jam'ālayaṃ core  
to corāṇa sayaṃ me muhutta-metteṇa ghāiyaṃ tahiyaṃ  /
haya-sesā sayarāhaṃ paḍiyā majjhovariṃ savve  
to maṃ khaṃḍākhaṃḍiṃ kāuṃ sīsaṃ ca chinniuṃ majjha/
Bayarīe ṭhaviūṇaṃ musiūṇa gharaṃ gayā corā  
sa-ruhira-sa-kuṃḍalaṃ ciya sīsaṃ me Bayari-taruvar'ārūḍhaṃ  /
vīsattham aṇuvviggaṃ khāyai bore kasakasassa  
taṃ sīsaṃ sūr'uyae diṭṭhaṃ loeṇa Bayari-uvarimmi  /
bayarāiṃ khāyaṃtaṃ esa sa-jīo tti kāūṇa  
majjhaṃ aṃgovaṃgā jaṇeṇa piṃḍevi meliyā turiyaṃ  /
jāo puṇo vi to 'haṃ niruvahaya-sarīra-lāyaṇṇo  
eyaṃ me aṇubhūyaṃ sayam eva imammi māṇuse loe  /
jo puṇa na pattiyai maṃ dhuttāṇaṃ deu so bhuttiṃ  
bhaṇai Saso sabbhūyaṃ kaha sakkā bhāṇiuṃ aliyam eyaṃ  /
jaṃ porāṇa-suīe Bhāraha-Rāmāyaṇe āyaṃ  
Jamayaggī āsi risī pattī tass' āsi Reṇuyā nāmaṃ  /
tīe sīlavaīe namaṃti kusum'atthie rukkhā  
diṭṭho ya ṇāĕ rāyā Assāvahio maṇo ya se khuhio  /
na namaṃti tao rukkhā tāhe Jamayaggiṇā Rāmo  
ruṭṭheṇa samāṇatto sīsaṃ chiṃdāhi duṭṭha-silāe  /
teṇa vi sīsaṃ chinnaṃ jhaḍatti piu-vayaṇa-kāreṇa  
bhaṇai tao Jamayaggī varasu varaṃ putta jo tuhaṃ iṭṭho  /
so bhaṇai majjha māyā puṇo vi jīvaṃtiyā hou  
iya hou tti pabhaṇie jāyā sā takkhaṇeṇa sajjīvā  /
jai sabbhūyaṃ eyaṃ tumaṃ pi jīvo 'si taṃ saccaṃ  
rāyā vi Jarāsaṃdho samara-parakkama-payāva-vikkhāo  /
so saṃdhio Jarāe rāya-sahassāhivo jāo  
annaṃ ca imaṃ suvvai Suṃda-Ṇisuṃdā sahoyarā sūrā  /
bala-vīriya-saṃpannā sura-loya-bhayaṃ jaṇemāṇā  
sāmattheuṃ surehiṃ Tilottamā tesiṃ vaha-ṇimittaṃ tu  /
nimmaviyā tila-mettaṃ ekk'ekka-surassa ghettūṇaṃ  
aṃgovaṃga-su-y-aṃgaya-lāvaṇṇa-guṇāgarā aṇovammā  /
kamalāgara-vatthavvā Lacchi vva sayaṃ samuttiṇṇā  
viṇay'oṇāmiya-gattā sara-sāmala-vikaya-kamala-dala-ṇayaṇā  /
namiūṇa sura-samūhaṃ mahur'ullāvā samullavai  
jaṃ kāyavvaṃ taṃ āṇaveha devehiṃ jaṃpiyaṃ iṇamo  /
Suṃda-Ṇisuṃdā sura-sattha-kaṃṭayā te samuddharasu 
(Mahāvipulā)
iya hou tti ya bhaṇiuṃ Tilŏttamā geṇhiuṃ sur'āṇattiṃ  /
pattā khaṇeṇa ya tahiṃ Suṃda-Ṇisuṃdāsurā jattha  
hār'addhahāra-keūra-bhūsiyā jaṇa-maṇ'ussava-bbhūyā  /
vithaḍ'unnaya-thaṇa-vaṭṭā do vi jaṇe te palobhei  
(Ādivipulā)
to te mayaṇa-vasagayā tīĕ kae jujjhiuṃ aha pavattā  /
nihaṇaṃ ca gayā donni vi paropparaṃ sattha-ghāehiṃ  
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ
strīṇāṃ kṛte bhrātṛyugasya bhedaḥ saṃbandhibhede striya eva mūlam  /
aprāptakāmā bahavo narendrā nārībhir utsādita-rājavaṃśāḥ  
(Indravajrā)
accharasā jai evaṃ Tilottamā nimmiyā sura-gaṇehiṃ  /
to kaha tujjha vi aṃgā lāijjaṃtā na laggejjā  
annāṇ' aṃgāvayavā jai laggā saṃmilissiyā saṃtā  /
to sasarīrāvayavā bhaṇasu tuhaṃ kiṃ na laggaṃti  
suvvai ya Pavaṇa-taṇao bālatte Aṃjaṇaṃ ti nāmeṇaṃ  /
jaṇaṇiṃ pucchai ammo ko me chuhiyassa āhāro  
rattāiṃ vaṇa-phalāiṃ āhāro tujjha teṇa aha sūraṃ  /
gahiuṃ samuṭṭhiyaṃ to teṇāvi tala-ppahāreṇaṃ  
saya-sikkaro kao so jaṇaṇī se daṭṭhuṃ taṃ paiṇṇ'aṃgaṃ  /
bhattu-sayāse gaṃtuṃ vilavai sog'āurā kaluṇaṃ  
daṭṭhuṃ niyaya-kalattaṃ royaṃtiṃ bahuvihāiṃ kaṃdaṃtiṃ  /
daṭṭhūṇa ya Haṇuyaṃtaṃ puttaṃ paraloya-saṃkaṃtaṃ  
to Pavaṇo parikuvio pāyāle pavisiuṃ ṭhio tāhe  /
sa-surāsuraṃ jagam iṇaṃ pavaṇa-ṇiroheṇa ādannaṃ  
gaṃtuṃ ca tattha diṭṭho pasāio sura-varehiṃ so Pavaṇo  /
aṃgāiṃ tassuyassa vi saṃghāeuṃ kaŏ sajīo  
ekkā ya tassa haṇuyā na ya diṭṭhā sura-varehiṃ savvehiṃ  /
haṇuyāĕ esa anno Haṇuyaṃto to kao nāmaṃ  
jai saccaṃ Pavaṇa-suo khaṃḍākhaṃḍi-kao vi saṃmilio  /
to kaha sakkā vottuṃ tujjha auvvaṃ vayaṇam eyaṃ  
Dasaraha-taṇaya-kahāe Sīyā-devīĕ haraṇa-saṃbaṃdhe  /
seuṃ saṃdhāveuṃ Laṃkā-dīvaṃ gae Rāme  
Dasamuha-Rāma-balāṇaṃ doṇha vi bhaḍa-vāyayaṃ vahaṃtāṇaṃ  /
saṃgāmammi palagge haṇahaṇaṃ sadd'āule ghore  
Maṃdoyari-daiya-bhaḍ'ukkaḍehiṃ n'egāiṃ vāṇara-sayāiṃ  /
asi-parasu-addhacaṃda-ppahāra-chinn'aṃga-m-aṃgāiṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
sattī-pahara-ṇiruddhe mahiyali paḍiyammi Lakkhaṇa-kumāre  /
Rāme sogābhihae vilavaṃte Pavaṇa-taṇaeṇa  
gaṃtuṃ Doṇa-girīo uvaṇīyā osahī jalaṃtīo  /
nissallo tti pabhāvā jhaḍitti sattī vi nissariyā  
je nisiyara-kuddh'ugghāehiṃ samarammi abhihayā pavayā  /
saṃchinna-bhinna-gattā te vi ya savve samāsatthā  
(Ādivipulā)
vivaiṇṇa-sarīrā vi ya jai savve vāṇarā samujjīyā  /
khaṃḍa-sahasso kaŏ Elasāḍha to jīvasi tumaṃ pi  
(Antyavipulā)
annaṃ ca jaṇa-pagāsā nihiyā suya-putthaesu bahuesu  /
kiṃ vā tumhehi imā na suyā Mahaseṇa-uppattī  
Himasela-guha-gayāiṃ do vi mahāmehuṇaṃ nisevaṃti  /
divvaṃ vāsa-sahassaṃ Girisuya Sasibhūsaṇo c'eva  
taṃ soūṇa pauttiṃ devā kira tihuyaṇammi ādannā  /
savv'āyareṇa miliuṃ gabbh'uvaghāyaṃ viciṃtaṃti  
suiraṃ sāmattheuṃ tihuyaṇa-ujjoya-kārao Jalaṇo  /
mahur'akkhara-vayaṇa-payaṃpiehiṃ bhaṇio suragaṇehiṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
ekkassa vi tā kīrai kajjaṃ abbhatthiehiṃ jiya-loe  /
kiṃ puṇa mahāṇubhāvo jaṃ jaṃpai sura-samūho tti  
jassa ya kaeṇa savve devā ciṃtovahiṃ samoiṇṇā  /
tassa ya jatteṇa tumaṃ Huyavaha ekko samattho 'si  
pavisittu guhā-vivare Hara-purao appayaṃ payaṃsesu  /
to tuha kayāi vilio mehuṇa-tattiṃ visajjejjā  
Vesāṇareṇa bhaṇiyaṃ ko dhāvai abhimuhaṃ muhuttaṃ pi  /
iharā vi Umā-vaiṇo kiṃ puṇa eyārise bhāve  
nara-sira-kavāla-māl'āulassa khaṭṭaṃga-vagga-hatthassa  /
jassa raī peya-vaṇe ko tassa jaṇo samalliyai  
(Ādivipulā)
jo Dāruvaṇe risi-āsamammi viṇiyaṃsaṇo palāyaṃto  /
vahio uddhuya-liṃgo ko taṃ vivuho samālavai  
kiṃ bahuṇā jaṇa-majjhe jo naccai uddhieṇa liṃgeṇaṃ  /
balavaṃto Vajjaharo tassa vi nissaṃsayaṃ bhāi  
jai kaha vi Sūlapāṇī kuppai Himagiri-guhā-paviṭṭhassa  /
ko jāṇai kiṃ me hohii tti mā saṃkaḍe chuhaha  
(Antyavipulā)
etth'aṃtare ya bhaṇio sappaṇayaṃ Bahuyaloyaṇeṇ' evaṃ  /
savva-surāṇaṃ vayaṇaṃ Huyavaha iṇamo nisāmehi  
mā bhāhi Umā-vaiṇo Huyavaha jeṇ' eriso Umā-satto  /
gaya-turaya-purisa-damaṇo kiṃ ca imo āgamo na suo  
hatthī dammai saṃvacchareṇa māseṇa dammai turaṃgo  /
mahilā puṇa kira purisaṃ damei ekkeṇa divaseṇaṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
jaṃ bhaṇai Umā-devī karei taṃ Pasuvaī akajjaṃ pi  /
kiṃ vā dehāṇugayaṃ Umaṃ vahaṃto na diṭṭho te  
muṃcasu āsaṃkam iṇaṃ Ruddo ruṭṭho vi te sarīrassa  /
na karei kiṃ pi pīḍaṃ Pavvai-cittāvarakkhāe  
iya hou tti ya Jalaṇo gaṃtuṃ Himavaṃtagiri-guhaṃ viulaṃ  /
pecchai Tiuraṃtayaraṃ rai-kajja-samuggayam aīṇaṃ  
abbhāsatthaṃ daṭṭhuṃ Mahadevo uṭṭhio samārūḍho  /
huṃ huṃ Umāĕ bhaṇio uddhuya-liṃgo 'ṇalaṃ bhaṇai  
uṭṭha(?) ni-y-aṃciya-vayaṇaṃ piba reyaṃ mā karehi vikkhevaṃ  /
Ruddeṇa Huyavaho ghaḍaghaḍassa to pāio reyaṃ  
uyara-gaeṇa ya reeṇa so palitt'aggiṇā va ḍajjhaṃto  /
muya-maraṇo saṃbhaṃto kaha kaha vi mahoyahiṃ patto  
(Ādivipulā)
dāūṇam aṃguliṃ Huyavaheṇa uggālio jale reo  /
uggāliyammi ree tāhe Jalaṇo samāsattho  
tappabhiiṃ ciya summai jaṇa-sui-vāy'āgayaṃ imaṃ vayaṇaṃ  /
reya-pabhāvā kira sāgarammi rayaṇāṇa uppattī  
(Antyavipulā)
lavaṇa-jalāo Aggī nīl'uppala-surahi-kamala-gaṃdh'aḍḍhaṃ  /
saram egaṃ gaṃtuṃ je reya-visesaṃ samuggilai  
jaṃ bhaṇṇai Kittiya saha uyaṃ ti phuḍa-viyaḍa-pāyaḍaṃ tāo  /
chakkira accharasāo taṃ pauma-saraṃ samoiṇṇā  
tā majjium āḍhattā tammi sare nayaṇa-maṇ'abhirāmammi  /
majjaṃtīṇaṃ joṇīsu tāṇa bīyaṃ aṇupaviṭṭhaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
pauma-sare majjittā puṇar avi tā jois'ālayaṃ pattā  /
paidivasaṃ ciya tāsiṃ chaṇha vi parivaḍḍhae uyaraṃ  
kāl'aṃtareṇa keṇa ya samayaṃ ciya tā tahiṃ pasūyāo  /
ekk'ekkam uttim'aṃgaṃ bāh'ūru-sarīra-ruṃḍāiṃ  
tā tā vi vimhiya-maṇā daṃsaṃti paroppar'ekka-m-ekkassa  /
pecchasu accheram iṇaṃ logammi abhūya-puvvaṃ tu  
bāh'ūrū ya sarīraṃ sīsāṇi ya niyaya-ṇiyaya-ṭhāṇesu  /
laggāiṃ takkhaṇa cciya Mahaseṇo chammuho jāo  
Komārabaṃbhayārī n'icchai maṇasā vi juvai-saṃjoyaṃ  /
savva-jaṇammi pagāso dakkhiṇa-dese ṭhio raṇṇe  
causu ya disāsu jahiyaṃ dhāvai logo bhavaṃtara-dis'aṭṭhā  /
sīseṇa ya chammāsaṃ dharei Dhāraṃ bar'aṭṭhāe  
jai Mahaseṇ'aṃgāiṃ piha-gabbha-viṇiggayāiṃ laggāiṃ  /
to tujjha na laggejjā tāiṃ kim eg'uyara-vatthāiṃ  
chinnā nāsā kaṇṇo ya laggae loya-viiyam eyaṃ pi  /
paramāṇu-pamāṇāo pagaṃpio laggasi tumaṃ pi  
(Ādivipulā)
to bhaṇai Elasāḍho puriso kaha chinnaeṇa sīseṇaṃ  /
bhukkh'atto bayarāiṃ khāeuṃ sakkae kaha nu  
bhaṇai Saso Rāhū kira sīsa-cchinno jayammi sui-vāo  /
taha viya gayaṇe hiṃḍai ābhaṃsai caṃda-sūre ya  
aha bhaṇai Elasāḍho kaha gammai taṃ vigiṭṭham addhāṇaṃ  /
kaha vā vi joyaṇa-sayaṃ kamehiṃ akkamai bhūmīe  
paḍibhaṇai Saso janne Balissa Viṇhū diyāi-veseṇa  /
tiṇṇi kame jāittā harai sa-selaṃ vasumaiṃ so  
jai savvā vi vasumaī tiṇṇi na puṇṇā kame Mahumahassa  /
ko doso jai tujjhaṃ ekka-kamo joyaṇa-sayaṃ tu  
puṇar avi Elāsāḍho bhaṇai silā sā mae aimahallā  /
kaha ukkhittā garuyā eyaṃ me pattiyāvehi  
bhaṇai Saso kiṃ na suyaṃ tumae Rāmāyaṇe kahijjaṃtaṃ  /
Rāmassa Rāvaṇassa ya saṃgāme vaṭṭamāṇammi  
Lakkhaṇakumāra-paḍaṇe Haṇueṇaṃ Doṇa-pavvao tuṃgo  /
osahi-maggaṃteṇaṃ sa-mūla-ḍālo samukkhitto  
mahai-silā-saṃghāo selo jai vāṇareṇa ukkhitto  /
joyaṇa-pamāṇa-mettaṃ ukkhivasi silaṃ na saṃdeho  
loe vi payarai suī vaḍḍhaṃtī meiṇī Mahumaheṇaṃ  /
kāuṃ varāha-rūvaṃ sa-sela-vaṇa-kāṇaṇā dhariyā  
jai teṇa samukkhittā na najjaī katthaī ṭhieṇaṃ ti  /
ukkhivasi tā tumaṃ pi ya dharaṇiyala-ttho silā do vi  
Elāsāḍho jāhe Saseṇa aisaṃdhio bhaṇai tāhe  /
jaṃ te suyam aṇubhūyaṃ kahehi savvaṃ aparisesaṃ
____________________________________________________
aha bhaṇai Saso ahayaṃ niyayaṃ chettaṃ gao saraya-kāle  /
gāmāo dūratthaṃ taṃ chettaṃ Girivar'āsanne  
chettammi ya acchaṃto tatto Pavvayavarāŏ oyariuṃ  /
ucchitto mi gaeṇaṃ pavvaya-metteṇa matteṇa  
tharatharatharaṃta-gatto hāhā gahio maeṇa ciṃtaṃto  /
vivalāium acayaṃto paribhamami tahiṃ tahiṃ c'eva  
bhī-uvviggeṇa mae diṭṭho tila-pāyavo aimahallo  /
tattha vilaggo mi ahaṃ vaṇagaya-bhaya-vevira-sarīro  
patto ya so vaṇagao ārusio tila-dumaṃ samaṃteṇaṃ  /
paribhamai gulaguliṃto kulāla-cakkaṃ vva āiṭṭho  
teṇa bhamaṃteṇa ya so cālijjaṃto tile davadavassa  /
vāsāsu jala-haro iva jala-ṇivahaṃ muṃcaī ghoraṃ  
tila-cakkeṇa vva tilā te savve pīliyā gayavareṇaṃ  /
tattha pavūḍhā sariyā telloyā nāma nāmeṇaṃ  
khutto ya vaṇagao so khala-calaṇīe ya tella-paṃkammi  /
āraḍiūṇa ya virasaṃ bhukkhiya-tisio mao hatthī  
gaya-bhaya-saṃtatta-maṇo ahayaṃ puṇa-jāyao tti mannaṃto  /
kahakaha vi tila-dumāo divas'avasāṇe samoiṇṇo  
kusio diiṃ ca kāuṃ bhario tellassa so mae hatthī  /
tāhe dasa tella-ghaḍe pāuṃ bhakkhemi khala-bhāraṃ  
tellassa supaḍipuṇṇaṃ taṃ diiyaṃ geṇhiuṃ gao gāmaṃ  /
gāma-bahiṃ taṃ diiyaṃ pāyava-sāhāĕ nikkhiviuṃ  
niyayaṃ bhavaṇam aigao puttaṃ pesemi tilla-diiyassa  /
jāhe u na pāveī rukkhaṃ pāḍittu to geṇhe  
eyaṃ me aṇubhūyaṃ sayam eva imammi māṇuse loe  /
jo na u pattiyai mahaṃ so deu mahāyaṇe bhattaṃ  
savva-kalā-patt'aṭṭhā bhaṇai Sasaṃ Khaṃḍavāṇaī dhuttī  /
atth' esa āgamo me Bhāraha-Rāmāyaṇe ya suo  
Khaṃḍā Saseṇa bhaṇiyā Bhāraha-Rāmāyaṇe purāṇe vā  /
eyārisāiṃ ya saheuyāiṃ bhaṇa kattha bhaṇiyāiṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
kaha tila-dumo mahallo tellāṇa ya kaha mahāṇaī vūḍhā  /
kaha pīyā ya dasa-ghaḍā kaha khala-bhāro mae khaio  
Khaṃḍāĕ Saso bhaṇio saccaṃ taṃ loya-bāhiro taṃ si  /
kiṃ kaiyāi suo te bālo vi jaṇo payaṃpaṃto  
jaha kira Pāḍaliputte nimmaviyā māsa-pāyavā bherī  /
to kiṃ so tilarukkho mahappamāṇo na hŏjjāhi  
suvvai ya Bhārahammi vi gayāṇa puṇa ettha dāṇa-salileṇaṃ  /
mahaī naī pavattā haya-gaya-raha-vāhiṇī ghorā  
uktañ ca
teṣāṃ kaṭataṭabhraṣṭair gajānāṃ madabindubhiḥ  /
prāvartata nadī ghorā hastyaśvarathavāhinī  
(Anuṣṭubh)
jai gaya-maya-salileṇaṃ haya-gaya-raha-vāhiṇī naī viulā  /
sariyā tayā pavattā to telloyā kaha na hoi  
rajjāŏ dhāḍieṇaṃ suvvai loyammi Bhīmaseṇeṇaṃ  /
gaṃtūṇa Ikkacakkaṃ ghoro Baga-rakkhaso vahio  
bhattaṃ taṃḍula-kuṃbhaṃ mahisaṃ taha majja-ghaḍa-sahassaṃ ca  /
jaṃ tassa bhatta-pāṇaṃ uvaṇīyaṃ teṇa taṃ bhuttaṃ  
jai Baga-rakkhasa-bhattaṃ bhuttaṃ Bhīmeṇa to kim egeṇaṃ  /
bhāreṇa vi taṃ jimio bhāra-sayaṃ kiṃ na bhakkhesi  
suvvai ya Kuṃbhayaṇṇo sutta-viuddh'uṭṭhio niyaya-kālaṃ  /
so piyai ghaḍa-sahassaṃ khāyai n'ege nara-sae ya  
jai piyai Kuṃbhayaṇṇo sutta-viuddh'uṭṭhio ghaḍa-sahassaṃ  /
dasahiṃ ghaḍaehiṃ kiṃ Sasa kiṃ pannāsaṃ na pīyā te  
annaṃ ca imaṃ suvvai purāṇa-sui-ṇiggayaṃ imaṃ vayaṇaṃ  /
asurāṇa jaha vah'atthā Agatthiṇā sāyaro pīo  
saggāo avaiṇṇā Gaṃgā Hara-jaḍa-viṇiggayā saṃtī  /
Jaṇhu-risi-āsamapayaṃ majjheṇa uvāgayā navaraṃ  
pīyā ya teṇa risiṇā vāsa-sahassaṃ ca bhāmiyā uyare  /
to Jaṇhueṇa mukkā kira bhaṇṇai Jaṇhavī teṇaṃ  
jai uyahiṃ Agatthī ṇaṃ pīyā Gaṃgā ya Jaṇhu-risiṇā ya  /
to jai dasa tella-ghaḍā pīyā ya tae kim accheraṃ  
bhaṇai Saso so diio sumahaṃto kaha mae samukkhitto  /
aha ukkhitto kaha puṇa nīo egāgiṇā gāmaṃ  
ucca-pphaliyaṃ dāuṃ hasiūṇaṃ Khaṃḍavāṇaī bhaṇai  /
nūṇaṃ Sasa na kayāi vi suo tume Garula-vittaṃto  
Kāsava-risi-pattīo Kaḍḍū Viṇayā ahesi tīyammi  /
dohiṃ vi tāhiṃ savattīhiṃ kiṃ pi kila paṇiyayaṃ chippaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
jā paṇiyayammi jippai tīe dāsattaṇaṃ ca kāyavvaṃ  /
jāvajjīvāe cciya ahavā dāyavvayaṃ amayaṃ  
Viṇayā jiya Kaḍḍūe karei dāsattaṇaṃ savattīe  /
Kaḍḍū vi savattī-vehaeṇa Viṇayaṃ vimāṇei  
(Antyavipulā)
Viṇayā kira guru-bhārā dāsatte parama-dukkhiyā jāyā  /
tatth' eva sā pasūyā tīse aṃḍa-ttayaṃ jāyaṃ  
dāsattaṇa-mokkh'aṭṭhā bhiṃdai tatth' egam aṃḍayaṃ Viṇayā  /
tattha kila aṃḍayammī jāyā vicchū asaṃpuṇṇā  
dummaṇa-maṇā ya Viṇayā paritappai aṃḍayaṃ viṇaṭṭhaṃ me  /
annaha ciṃtemi ahaṃ taṃ pi ya me annahā hoi  
muccejja parāhīṇattaṇassa ahaṃ nāma dāsa-ṇāmassa  /
kaha vi durāsāĕ mae aṃḍaṃ bhinn'atthie bhinnaṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
addhii-laddhāe vilaviūṇa āsā-ṇibaddha-hiyayāe  /
kaihi vi divasehiṃ tao puṇo vi biiy'aṃḍayaṃ bhinnaṃ  
(Ādivipulā)
biiy'aṃḍammi aṇūrū jāo kila so vi māyaraṃ bhaṇai  /
ammo tumhehi imaṃ kim akāle aṃḍayaṃ bhinnaṃ  
jo te maṇoraho ciṃtio tti so pūrio mae hoṃto  /
eṇhiṃ ayaṃgamo kiṃ karemi ahayaṃ parāhīṇo  
(Ādivipulā)
eyaṃ pi tāva taiyaṃ parirakkhasu aṃḍayaṃ payatteṇa  /
jo ko vi ettha hohī so dukkha-vimukkhao tumhaṃ  
raha-sārahī aṇūrū ṭhavio Sūreṇa jo jage Aruṇo  /
sayam eva ya Viṇayāe kameṇa tai'aṃḍayaṃ bhinnaṃ  
ahikula-bhaya-saṃjaṇaṇo jaṇavaya-vimhāvaṇo mahāghoro  /
Viṇayā-maṇa-parioso jāo ya mahābalo Garuḍo  
bālatte ramamāṇo nāge Kaḍḍū-sue vihāḍei  /
paidivasaṃ Kaḍḍūe Viṇayā khiṃsijjae evaṃ  
Viṇayāĕ dāsiyāe putteṇaṃ Garuḍaeṇa somālā  /
māriya ahi-poyalayā caṃcū-calaṇa-ppahārehiṃ  
eyārisāiṃ Viṇayā soūṇam abhikkhaṇaṃ ca rovaṃtī  /
pucchijjai Garuḍeṇaṃ roasi kiṃ kāraṇaṃ amme  
puttaya jīya-ṇimittaṃ pattā dāsattaṇaṃ savattīe  /
rattiṃ divā ya duhiyā karemi āṇattiyaṃ tīse  
kaha muccejjasi amme amaeṇaṃ taṃ ca jāṇai piyā te  /
kattha piyā Badarī-āsamammi Garuḍo gao tahiyaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
Badar'āsamammi gaṃtuṃ Garuḍo pāesu nivaḍio piuṇo  /
viyal'iṃdieṇa teṇa vi phāseṇ' uvalakkhio putto  
Garuḍeṇa jaṃpiyaṃ bhukkhio mi bhaṇiyaṃ ca Kāsaveṇ' evaṃ  /
bārasa-joyaṇa-hatthī tattullo kacchao bīo  
(Ādivipulā)
amarisa-bhuyaṃga-vasao jujjhaṃti mahāsare mahākāyā  /
rattiṃ divā ya donni vi sara-saṃkhobhaṃ karemāṇā  
bhakkhehi te tumaṃ gacchiūṇa mā putta bhukkhio accha  /
gaṃtūṇa ekka-m-ekkeṇa teṇa te do vi paribhuttā  
(Mahāvipulā)
tatto ya paḍiṇiyatto pecchai vaḍapāyavaṃ mahāviḍayaṃ  /
palaya-mahāmehaṃ pi va sa-sauṇa-kolāhalaṃ viulaṃ  
Caumuha-bīya-viṇiggayāṇa Vālakhillāṇa tassa heṭṭhammi  /
uggaṃ tappaṃti tavaṃ risīṇam addh'uṭṭha-koḍīo  
(Ādivipulā)
so tattha samallīṇo bhaggo vaḍapāyavo kaḍakaḍaṃto  /
mā hohī risi-vajjhā caṃcū vaḍapāyavaṃ guvilaṃ  
to sahasā ukkhiviuṃ chāemāṇo vva naha-yalaṃ savvaṃ  /
Kinnara-maruya(?)-ṇarāmara-vimhayam aulaṃ jaṇemāṇo  
sāgara-jala-pakkhitte bahuviha-vaṇa-saṃḍa-maṃḍioddese  /
dīvammi suvitthiṇṇe muṃcai vaḍapāyavaṃ Garuḍo  
vaḍaduma-laṃka-ṇimittaṃ Laṃkā-dīo tti to kayaṃ nāmaṃ  /
Dasasīsass'āvāso āsi jahiṃ nisiyara-paissa  
Himavaṃte gaya-kacchava bhakkheuṃ so gao piu-sayāsaṃ  /
bhaṇai ya tāya na dhāo bhakkhehi tao Nisāe tti  
bhakkheūṇa Nisāe amaya-pavattiṃ papucchiuṃ piyaraṃ  /
amayaṃ putta kahemo voleuṃ naraya-Pāyāle  
dhagadhagadhagaṃta-huyavaha-pajjaliy'āveḍhiaṃ samaṃteṇaṃ  /
rakkhijjai savva-surāsurehiṃ sayayaṃ amaya-kuṃḍaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
ko puṇa tassa uvāo amay'atthī Kāsav'aṃgao ahayaṃ  /
atthi uvāo jaha ghippai tti aidukkaro so u  
(Antyavipulā)
sappi-maho-dahi-salil'āieṇa saṃtappie 'ṇale dhaṇiyaṃ  /
gahaṇaṃ hojja na hojja va gahie vi uvaddavāṇegā  
(Ādivipulā)
Kāsava-risi-vayaṇeṇaṃ gaṃtuṃ Garuḍeṇa do vi saṃpayayā  /
paṃkhāṇi ya ghaya-mahu-pāṇieṇa saṃtappio Aggī  
(Antyavipulā)
titteṇa Huyavaheṇa ya amaya-sayāsaṃ pavesio Garuḍo  /
gahiyaṃ ca neṇa amayaṃ devehiṃ vi kila samugghuṭṭhaṃ  
amayaṃ kuṃḍa-tthaṃ ciya vihageṇ' egeṇa nīyam ukkhiviuṃ  /
soūṇam iṇaṃ vayaṇaṃ khuhiyaṃ sasurāsuraṃ bhuvaṇaṃ  
jo jatto cciya devo sahasāmayam avahaḍaṃ nisāmei  /
so ahara-phuraṃt'oṭṭho tatto cciya maggio laggo  
muggara-musaṃḍhi-paṭṭisa-gaya-kaṇaga-pparasu-bhiṃḍimālehiṃ  /
hala-musala-lauḍa-valayā-sūl'āuha-paharaṇa-samaggo  
kalayala-ravo surāṇaṃ pūrei nah'aṃgaṇaṃ niravasesaṃ  /
haṇa chiṃda bhiṃda giṇhaha mā muyaha rasāyala-gayaṃ pi  
olaggio ya Garuḍo samaṃtao deva-saya-sahassehiṃ  /
pariveḍhio ya bhaṇio amay'āhārī hao si tti  
ekkatto cciya bhuvaṇaṃ ekatto Kāsav'aṃgao pakkhī  /
kāyara-maṇa-kaṃpaṇayaṃ tehiṃ ya samaraṃ samāraddhaṃ  
suragaṇa-sayaṃ sahassaṃ lakkhaṃ koḍiṃ pi causu vi disāsu  /
pesei Jama-sayāsaṃ Garuḍo pakkha-ppahārehiṃ  
Viṇaya-suyassa surāṇa ya gayaṇayale vaṭṭae mahāghoraṃ  /
jujjhaṃ amayassa kae vimhāvaṇayaṃ tihuyaṇassa  
to so deva-samūho Garuḍeṇ' ekkeṇa raṇa-muh'āvaḍio  /
haya-vihaya-dīṇa-vayaṇo khaṇeṇa bhaggo nirāṇaṃdo  
deve ya parāhutte daṭṭhuṃ palay'aggi-jāla-sama-sarisaṃ  /
to kulisaṃ Sahasapaloyaṇeṇa Garuḍovariṃ mukkaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
kulisaṃ Garuḍa-sarīre paccupphuḍiyaṃ silāyale c'eva  /
Iṃdo bhaṇai Aṇaṃtaṃ sahoyaraṃ Garuḍa-bhaya-bhīo  
to taha vajjābhihayaṃ sa-surāsura-samara-paccaya-ṇimittaṃ  /
Garuḍeṇa caṃcuāe sayam ev' uppāḍiyaṃ picchaṃ  
Viṇhū viya pajjalio bārasa-ravi-teya-sappabhaṃ cakkaṃ  /
ghettuṃ Garuḍa-vah'atthā aṇudhāvai maggao kuvio  
bhī-uvvigga-sasaṃbhamaṃ hā hā kim iyaṃ ti gaggir'ullāvā  /
risi-gaha-Saṇicchar'āī gaṃtum Aṇaṃtaṃ payaṃpaṃti  
bho bho savvagao viya pabhū ya sasurāsurassa loyassa  /
taha vi tumaṃ nīo iva sayaṇass' uvariṃ nirāvikkho  
Garuḍo ya sahayaro te paḍisāhara vaṇa-davovamaṃ kovaṃ  /
mā mūḍho meccho iva paharasu niyaesu gattesu  
risi-gaha-vayaṇaṃ souṃ imaṃ tu cakk'āuho vi ciṃtei  /
koh'āieṇa pecchasu mae sahāo hao hoṃto  
nāṇī satth'attha-viyāṇao vi koh'aggi-jāla-saṃtatto  /
gammāgamma-hiyāhiya-kajjākajjaṃ na lakkhei  
(Ādivipulā)
Garuḍassa Aṇaṃtassa ya jāyā saṃdhī jhao kao Garuḍo  /
amayaṃ dāuṃ Viṇayaṃ moyai dāsattaṇāo tti  
jai gaya-kacchabha-vaḍaduma Garuḍeṇ' uppāḍiyā ya nīyā ya  /
to ukkhivasi Sasa tayaṃ tumaṃ pi daiyaṃ subaddhaṃ pi  
sattāha-vaddalammī dhario Govaddhaṇo Mahumaheṇaṃ  /
tā kaha na dharesi tumaṃ gaya-dīyaṃ tella-paripuṇṇaṃ  
seū-baṃdhe viya vāṇarehiṃ negāiṃ joyaṇāiṃ girī  /
ukkhiṇiuṃ uvviddhā pakkhittā uyahi-majjhammi  
(Ādivipulā)
to jai putteṇa tuhaṃ rukkho ummūlio mahāviḍavo  /
dīyam apāveṃteṇaṃ to bhaṇasu tahiṃ kim accheraṃ  
vaṇavāḍiya-bhaṃge vi ya Haṇuyaṃto mahiruhe mahāviḍave  /
ukkhaṇai ayatteṇaṃ jattha imo Khaṃdhao bhaṇio  
khajjūrī māruiṇo akammahayā palāsavaggaṃteṇaṃ  /
sīseṇa uttaraṃtī akammahayā palāsavaggaṃte  
jai te mahaṃtarukkhā tirikkhajoṇī-gaeṇa Haṇueṇa  /
ummūliyā samūlā tuha putto kiṃ na ukkhaṇai  
aisaio bhaṇai Saso Khaṃḍāvāṇīĕ tattha dhuttīe  /
Khaṃḍaṃ bhaṇai iyāṇiṃ kahehi jaṃ taṃ samaṇubhūyaṃ 
____________________________________________________
aha bhaṇai Khaṃḍavāṇā vihasaṃtī Atthasattha-ṇimmāyā  /
buddhīĕ ahiya-buddhī dhutte tulleuṃ vayaṇam iṇaṃ  
olaggiya tti amhehiṃ bhaṇaha jai aṃjaliṃ kariya sīse  /
uvasappaha jai ya samaṃ to bhattaṃ demi savvesiṃ  // HaDh_5. 2 //
(Ādivipulā)
to te bhaṇaṃti dhuttā amhaṃ savvaṃ jagaṃ tulemāṇā  /
kaha eva dīṇa-vayaṇaṃ tujjha sayāse bhaṇīhāmo  
ahavā
avi uḍḍhaṃ ciya phuṭṭaṃti māṇiṇo na vi sahaṃti avamāṇaṃ  /
atthamaṇammi vi raviṇo kiraṇā uḍḍhaṃ ciya phuraṃti  
(Ādivipulā)
pavaṇo cciya āhāro vaṃkaṃ caṃkammiyaṃ aparibhūyaṃ  /
savva-jag'uvveya-karaṃ aho sujīyaṃ bhuyaṃgāṇaṃ  
īsi hasiūṇa to sā Khaṃḍāvāṇā bhaṇei bho suṇaha  /
akkhāṇayaṃ aṇaliyaṃ jaṃ aṇubhūyaṃ mae c'eva  
āsi ahaṃ taruṇatte jovvaṇa-lāyaṇṇa-vaṇṇa-guṇa-kaliyā  /
rūveṇa aṇanna-samā jaṇa-maṇa-ṇayaṇ'ūsava-bbhūyā  
navari ya kayāi ahayaṃ uṇhāyā maṃḍave suha-pasuttā  /
uvabhuttā Pavaṇeṇaṃ rūva-guṇ'ummatta-hiyaeṇaṃ  
jāo teṇa suo me tāhe ciya jāya-mettao to so  /
āucchiūṇa ya mamaṃ katto vi gao aha khaṇeṇaṃ  
to bhaṇaha kiṃ na saccaṃ jai vāeṇaṃ havejja putto tti  /
to n'atthi kā vi raṃḍā aputtiyā jīva-loyammi  
taṃ bhaṇai Mūladevo suvvai loya-ssuīsu Pavaṇeṇaṃ  /
Kuṃtīĕ Bhīmaseṇo jāo Nīlāĕ Haṇuyaṃto  
Pārāsareṇa Vāso macchiṇi-jaṇio pasūyao c'eva  /
kajje sarejjasu tti ya jaṇaṇiṃ bhaṇiūṇa avakaṃto  
jāyā akkhaya-joṇī Joyaṇagaṃdhā ya risi-pabhāveṇaṃ  /
Saṃtaṇuṇā tīĕ suo Vicittavirio tti saṃjaṇio  
asue mayammi tammī Joyaṇagaṃdhāĕ sumario Vāso  /
saṃpatto ya khaṇeṇaṃ jaṇaṇi-sayāse risi-varo so  
bhaṇio aha māūe putta aputtā na vaḍḍhae vaṃso  /
tā taha karehi vacchaya jaha hoi kulassa saṃtāṇo  
teṇ' uddhario vaṃso Paṃḍu-ṇar'iṃdo jayammi vikkhāo  /
Dhayaraṭṭho ya nara-vaī Viduro ya mahāmaī jaṇio  
bhāu-jjāyā tiṇṇi vi bhuttūṇaṃ dei tiṇha vī sāvaṃ  /
akayaṃ tu ohayāso Vāso risi-dhamma-pabbhaṭṭho  
bhavati cātra ślokaḥ
āhāre caiva yonau ca bījakarmaṇi yaḥ śuciḥ  /
tasya kṛcchrāgatasyāpi na pāpe ramate matiḥ  
(Anuṣṭubh)
jai saccaṃ Pavaṇa-suo Bhīma-Haṇū navara paṭṭhio Vāso  /
uyara-viṇiggaya-matto to saccaṃ tujjha vī vayaṇaṃ  
puṇar avi Khaṃḍāvāṇā bhaṇai sahī āsi majjh' Umā devī  /
tīe maṃto dinno sasurāsura-loya-āgariso  
āgarisio Ravī me joisa-cakkāhio ahiya-teo  /
teṇa vi me bala-jutto jāo putto mahāsatto  
chāsīi-sahassāiṃ dahai Ravī meiṇiṃ samaṃteṇaṃ  /
kaha teṇa na daḍḍhā haṃ raikajja-samāgayā saṃtī  
aha bhaṇai Kaṃḍarīo Kuṃtī jai hoṃta daḍḍha Sūreṇaṃ  /
to ḍajjhaṃtā si tumaṃ saccaṃ taṃ n'atthi saṃdeho  
Khaṃḍā bhaṇai puṇo me Jalaṇo āgarisio sura-varāṇaṃ  /
jo vayaṇaṃ teṇa vi me putto jāo jui-mahaṃto  
dūrattho ḍahai Ravī Aggī aṃgehiṃ pharisio ḍahai  /
kaha teṇa na daḍḍhā haṃ Jalaṇeṇa samāgayā saṃtī  
bhaṇai ya Elāsāḍho Jama-pattī Huyavaheṇa kira bhuttā  /
Aggī-huṇaṇa-ṇimittaṃ Jalaṇa-gihaṃ aigayā saṃtī  
asamatta-suraya-kajjo Jalaṇo jā aigao Jamo tāhe  /
acayaṃto osariuṃ Jalaṇo tīe vi oilio  
taṃ siḍhiliya-mehaliyaṃ asamāṇiya-suraya-kīliyaṃ bālaṃ  /
oiliūṇa Jamo vi ya dev'atthāṇiṃ aha paviṭṭho  
devehiṃ ya so bhaṇio apatta-raiyassa sāgayaṃ tujjha  /
niggilai tao deviṃ tīĕ muhāo ya Jalaṇo vi  
dhāvaṃto ucchinno Jameṇa to aigao vaṇaṃ gahaṇaṃ  /
kahio gaehiṃ to so tesiṃ vāyā hiyā teṇaṃ  
jai saccaṃ Jama-pattī bhuttā Jalaṇeṇa n'eya sā daḍḍhā  /
to kaha ḍajjhihisi tumaṃ Jalaṇeṇa samāgayā saṃtī  
Khaṃḍā bhaṇai puṇo me Erāvaṇa-vāhaṇo Sahass'accho  /
āgarisio mi so vī teṇa vi jāo mahaṃ putto  
accharasāo mottuṃ kaha Iṃdo sevae maṇussīo  /
bhaṇai Saso kiṃ na suyā Goyama-pattī Ahilla tti  
Iṃdeṇaṃ paribhuttā ruṭṭheṇaṃ Goyameṇa Iṃdassa  /
kāūṇa bhaya-sahassaṃ caṭṭāṇa samappio tāhe  
daḍha-kaḍhiṇa-sarīrāṇaṃ mayaṇāṇala-jāla-saṃpalittāṇaṃ  /
baḍuyāṇa sagāsāo Sakko viddhaṃsaṇaṃ patto  
devehiṃ Goyamāo kaha vi payatteṇa moio Iṃdo  /
jaṃ tassa bhaga-sahassaṃ acchi-sahassaṃ tayaṃ jāyaṃ  
Kuṃtīe Iṃdeṇa vi putto Pattho tti loya-vikkhāo  /
jāo evaṃ jai suo tujjha vi Iṃdeṇa ko doso  
aha bhaṇai Khaṃḍavāṇā tubbhe jāṇaha kulaṃ ca gottaṃ ca  /
majjhaṃ māyā-vittaṃ bhaṇiyā to Mūladeveṇaṃ  
Pāḍaliputte nayare taṃ si suyā Nāgasamma-vippassa  /
Somasirīe dhūyā Goyama-gottammi vikkhāyā  
sā bhaṇai n'avi ahaṃ sā tumhe sārikkha-vimhiyā majjhaṃ  /
sippiya-dhūyā ahayaṃ rāula-rayayassa vikkhāyā  
bahu-dhaṇa-dhanna-samiddhaṃ amha gharaṃ rāya-riddhi-sama-sarisaṃ/
nāmeṇa Daḍḍhiyā haṃ nīyā goehiṃ kammehiṃ  
daṃḍabhaḍa-bhoiyāṇaṃ ranno aṃteurassa savvassa  /
sippiya-sahassam ahiyaṃ jaṃ dhovai majjha vatthāiṃ  
vatthāṇa mahāsayaḍaṃ bharittu aha bahuviha-ppagārāṇaṃ  /
purisa-sahasseṇa samaṃ patt'āsi naiṃ salila-puṇṇaṃ  
chaḍachaḍachaḍassa tahiyaṃ huṃ huṃ siṃṭā-ravaṃ kareṃtehiṃ  /
annunnam aisayaṃtehiṃ tehiṃ kuṃd'iṃdu-dhavalāiṃ  
dhoyāiṃ vatthāiṃ majjhaṃ purisehiṃ cukkha-bhūyāiṃ  /
to āyava-dittāiṃ uvvāiyāiṃ muhutteṇaṃ  
āyo ya mahāvāo samaṃtao pāyave ya bhaṃjaṃto  /
to teṇaṃ pavaṇeṇaṃ vatthāiṃ hiyāiṃ savvāiṃ  
gacchaha tubbhe cuiyā rayaṃ ti kammāriyā mae bhaṇiyā  /
jo doso avarāho va ko vi so hohiī majjhaṃ  
(Mahāvipulā)
rāula-bhaeṇa to haṃ gohā-rūvaṃ karettu rayaṇīe  /
āyā nayar'ujjāṇaṃ sasalila-ghaṇa-sannihaṃ rammaṃ  
viule nayar'ujjāṇe samaṃtao hiṃḍiyā suvīsatthā  /
aha pacchimammi jāme bhaya-ciṃtā me samuppannā  
gohaṃ camma-ṇimittaṃ maṃsa-ṇimittaṃ ca jaṇavao haṇai  /
to ko hojja uvāo jaha maraṇa-bhayaṃ na hojjāmi  
kiṃ hojja kayaṃ su-kayaṃ kattha gayā nivvuī lahejjaṃ ti  /
paribhamami samaṃteṇaṃ bhaya-pavaṇa-samāhayā tahiyaṃ  
bahuyāiṃ viciṃteuṃ gohā-rūvaṃ tayaṃ payahiūṇaṃ  /
rattāsoya-sayāse cūya-layā haṃ parāvattā  
dussīlā iva juvaī timira-paḍaṃ guṃṭhiyā gayā rayaṇī  /
kamal'āgara-tuṭṭhiyaro sahasā ya samuṭṭhio sūro  
dinno ya amha abhao rannā paureṇa cāu-vaṇṇeṇa  /
jaha ubbhiṃḍaṃtu tahiṃ rāula-rayagāiṃ savvāiṃ  
to so paḍahaga-saddo nava-pāusa-ghaṇa-ravaṃ visesaṃto  /
āpūrei samaṃtaŏ s'abbhaṃtara-bāhiraṃ nayaraṃ  
souṃ paḍahaga-saddaṃ to taṃ mottūṇa cūya-laya-bhāvaṃ  /
lāvanna-guṇ'āiṇṇā puṇar avi itthī samuppannā  
tassa ya sagaḍassa tahiṃ nāḍa-varattā ya tajjaṇīo ya  /
rayaṇīĕ kolhuehiṃ sāṇehiṃ bhakkhiyā savve  
aha navari majjha piuṇā nāḍa-varattā ya maggamāṇeṇaṃ  /
laddhā mūsaya-cheppā nāḍa-varattā tahiṃ valiyā  
to kiṃ etthaṃ saccaṃ bhaṇai Saso Baṃbha-Kesavā aṃtaṃ  /
na gayā jai liṃgassa u to kaha vayaṇaṃ tuha asaccaṃ  
Rāmāyaṇe ya suvvai jaha Haṇuyaṃtassa āsi laṃgūlaṃ  /
mahaī-mahappamāṇaṃ vattha-sahassehiṃ negehiṃ  
veḍhittu rakkhasehiṃ sittaṃ tellassa ghaḍa-sahassehiṃ  /
Laṃkā-purī-vah'atthā palīviyaṃ maṃda-puṇṇehiṃ  
sā devaloya-sarisā Laṃkā-puri savvaloya-vikkhāyā  /
ālīviyā samaṃtā Haṇueṇaṃ Vāu-putteṇaṃ  
jai saccaṃ laṃgūlaṃ sumahaṃtaṃ āsi Vāu-puttassa  /
to te mūsiya-cheppā kinna havai iddahā rajjū  
annaṃ ca imaṃ suvvai porāṇa-suīsu niggayaṃ vayaṇaṃ  /
jaha kira Gaṃdhāri-varo raṇṇe Kuruvattaṇaṃ patto  
rāyā āsī kira so mahābala-parakkamo ahiya-teo  /
Sakko devāhivaī parajjio jeṇa samarammi  
so taṃ ahikkhivaṃto suraguru-satto araṇṇa-majjhammi  /
jāo mahā-ayagaro rajja-pabbhaṭṭhā ya Paṃḍu-suyā  
tammi araṇṇammi ṭhiyā egāgī niggao navari Bhīmo  /
teṇ' ayagareṇa khaddho uvaladdha-suī ya Dhamma-suo  
patto ayagara-mūlaṃ sattaya-pucchāo kahayai tassa  /
uggilai ayagaro so Bhīmaṃ sāvassa-y-aṃtammi  
jāo puṇar avi rāyā jai saccaṃ to tumaṃ pi sabbhūyaṃ  /
gohā cūya-layā vi ya gaṃtūṇa puṇaṇṇavā jāyā  
to bhaṇai Khaṃḍavāṇā dhutte evaṃ gae vi kajjammi  /
majjhaṃ kuṇaha paṇāmaṃ jāhe bhattaṃ payacchāmi  
jai kaha vi parājijjaha savve vi ya samuiyā mae tubbhe  /
to tumha n'atthi loe kāṇā vi kavaḍḍiyā mullaṃ  
to te bhaṇaṃti dhuttā ko satto nijjiṇittu amhehiṃ  /
māyā-ṇiyaḍi-pahāṇo Harī vi sakkaṃ jai havejjā  
to sā avagaya-tosā te dhutte Khaṃḍavāṇaī bhaṇai  /
pecchaha ettāhiṃ ciya savve vi karemi haya-vayaṇe  
tesiṃ vatthāṇa kae rāyāṇaṃ pucchiuṃ pari-y-aḍāmi  /
gām'āgara-pura-paṭṭaṇa-jaṇavaya-parimaṃḍiyaṃ vasuhaṃ  
annaṃ ca mamaṃ cauro ceḍa-ruyā jāyayā cira-paṇaṭṭhā  /
tesiṃ ca kaeṇa ahaṃ parihiṃḍaṃtī ihaṃ pattā  
te ceḍā tubbhe hi ya tāṇi ya vatthāṇi te parihiyāṇi  /
jai vi na pattiyah' eyaṃ to deha mahāyaṇe bhattaṃ  
to te lajjiya-viliyā bhaṇaṃti aisaṃdhiyā tume amhaṃ  /
meḍhī-bhūyā eṇhiṃ buddhi-payāreṇa jāyā si  
eyassa bharassa tumaṃ ekkā joggā jayammi vikkhāyā  /
sattāha-vaddalammī de bhattaṃ savva-dhuttāṇaṃ  
sā bhaṇai vihasamāṇā puvviṃ vinnaviyayā mae tubbhe  /
bho gavvam uvvahaṃtā ohasaha jaṇaṃ abuddhīyā  
to te bhaṇaṃti suṃdari cāyo ghaṭṭo kao havai jāhe  /
tāhe sattai-jāī esā purisassa payaīo  
uppattiya-buddhīe amhe abhisaṃdhiyā tume suyaṇu  /
to savve vi bhaṇāmo amhaṃ bhattaṃ payacchāhi  
bāḍhaṃ ti bhāṇiūṇaṃ peyavaṇaṃ sā gayā subīhaṇayaṃ  /
siva-ḍāyaṇi-peya-pisāya-bhūya-sadd'āulaṃ viulaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
tūlī-gaṃḍuvahāṇaya-paḍisira-caṃdovayāṇa ṭhāṇe ya  /
citta-paḍa-paṭṭa-sāḍaya-koyaṃvaya-kāya-ḍajjhaṃtaṃ  
taru-kusuma-kesar'uppāsa-vāsa-tala-catt'-alattaya-vicittaṃ  /
luliy'addha-iṃda-pauraṃ pavviddha-kalevaraṃ ghoraṃ  
rūviṇiyāṇa thaṃbhiya-macchiya-saṃghāya-bhiṇibhiṇāyaṃtaṃ  /
maḍaya-ciy'aṃtovari-ḍajjhamāṇa-silisilisilāyaṃtaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
vijjā-sāhaṇa-rabhas'uṭṭhiyaṃta-ṇaccaṃta-maḍaya-veyālaṃ  /
bhīm'aṭṭahāsa-huṃkāra-tāla-saddāla-gaṃbhiraṃ  
(Mahāvipulā)
vasa-ruhira-kkaya-kaddama-samaṃtao bhīma-kimi-kul'āiṇṇaṃ  /
āmisa-kajja-samujjaya-ṇiṭṭhaya-bahuvihaga-jujjhaṃtaṃ  
ruhir'uggāla-bhalabhalaṃ sahassa-sūlā-vibhinna-mucchaṃtaṃ  /
vitiriccha-bhamaṃta-siyāla-kola-ṇivaḍaṃta-ghuṭṭaṃtaṃ  
(Antyavipulā)
aiduggaṃdhiya-vāyaṃta-māruyaṃ sava-savaṃta-ṇīsaddaṃ  /
bībhacch'uvvevaṇayaṃ bhaya-saṃjaṇayaṃ surāṇaṃ pi  
(Ādivipulā)
evaṃ vihe masāṇe pecchai aviṇaṭṭhayaṃ vigaya-jīvaṃ  /
acira-vimukkaṃ bālaṃ Khaṃḍā taṃ geṇhiuṃ ṇhavai  
abbhaṃgeūṇa tayaṃ jara-cīvara-susaṃgayaṃ kareūṇaṃ  /
Ujjeṇīĕ paviṭṭhā seṭṭhissa gharaṃ dhaṇa-samiddhaṃ  
diṭṭho ya ṇāĕ seṭṭhī āsaṇa-viṭṭho jaṇeṇa parikiṇṇo  /
bhaṇio ya nāĕ bhāo suttiya-dhūyā mi duggaiyā  
kaivaya-divasa-pasūyā abaṃdhavā asaraṇā videsa-tthā  /
tubbhe mahappabhāvā pii-hara-mullaṃ mamaṃ deha  
seṭṭhī vāula-citto puṇo puṇo tīĕ uccaraṃtīe  /
rusio bhaṇei purise sigghaṃ nīṇeha damiaṃ tti  
niggacchasu tti bhaṇiyā aha jaṃpai mā chiv' assa bālassa  /
annaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ bappi-kkayaṃ ti to me ma pelleha  
(Antyavipulā)
niggaccheuṃ n'icchai tehiṃ ya purisehiṃ pelliyā sahasā  /
dharaṇīyale nivaḍiā bhaṇai mahaṃ mārio putto  
hā majjha aṇāhāe nāho hohi tti ciṃtayaṃtīe  /
so vi maṇoraha-taṃtū chinno nicchitta-gattehiṃ  
bho pecchaha jaṇa samudaya imeṇa dhaṇa-gavvieṇa vaṇieṇa  /
aṭṭhārasa-dosa-vivajjiyāĕ mārāvio putto  
(Antyavipulā)
aha paharium āraddhā sīse ya ure ya sā asāhāraṃ  /
bhaṇai ya seṭṭhī majjhaṃ bhaggaṃ bhikkhā-kavālaṃ tti  
to sĕṭṭhī ādanno savva-payatteṇa pariyaṇa-samaggo  /
aṇuṇei vilavamāṇiṃ kareha mā suyaṇu bolaṃ ti  
dinnā ya kaṇṇiyā se bhaṇiyā ghettūṇa vaccasū puttaṃ  /
mā ruyasu mā ya kaṃdasu tuha ettiya jīvaṇaṃ dinnaṃ  
ghettūṇa kaṇṇiyaṃ mayaṃ kalevaraṃ ca sā tao aikkaṃtā  /
seṭṭhissa nirābāhaṃ jāyaṃ dāṇa-ppabhāveṇaṃ  
api ca
tyāgena bhūtāni vaśībhavanti tyāgena vairāṇy api yānti nāśam  /
paro 'pi bandhutvam upaiti dānāt tyāgo hi sarvavyasanāni hanti  
(Upajāti)
sisu-maḍayaṃ chaḍḍeuṃ Khaṃḍā viul'attha-lāha-parisuddhā  /
maṇi-kaṇaya-rayaṇa-mottiya-camara-samiddhaṃ gayā haṭṭaṃ  
kāūṇa ya viṇioyaṃ tesiṃ dhuttāṇa sīya-vihurāṇaṃ  /
bahu-khajja-pejja-kaliyaṃ susakkayaṃ bhoyaṇaṃ dei  
bhuttāyaṃtehiṃ tao savvehiṃ vi haṭṭha-tuṭṭha-maṇasehiṃ  /
bhaṇiyā ya Khaṃḍavāṇā sujīviyaṃ jīviyaṃ tujjha  
jaṃ te buddhi-balāo dhutta-jaṇo nijjiṇittu sayarāhaṃ  /
saṃtappio khuh'atto viuleṇaṃ bhatta-pāṇeṇaṃ  
sussikkhiyā vi purisā tāiṃ na jāṇaṃti jaṃpiyavvāiṃ  /
jāiṃ asikkhiāo katto vi lahaṃti mahilāo  
paḍhiūṇa ya satthāiṃ purisā nāūṇa tesim atthāiṃ  /
na samatthā paḍivayaṇe uppanna-maī jahā mahilā  
api ca
adhītya śāstrāṇi vimṛśya cārthān na tāni vaktuṃ puruṣāḥ samarthāḥ  /
yāni striyaḥ pratyabhidhānakāle vadanti līlāracitākṣarāṇi  
(Upajāti)
Caṃd'Iṃda-Vāu-Sūrā Aggī Dhammo ya loya-vikkhāyā  /
loeṇa dūmiyā te vammaha-rai-rāga-dosehiṃ  
suvvai ya āgamammī jaha Kaṇho savva-bīya-majjha-gao  /
suhumesu bāyaresu ya tila-tusa-mettesu davvesu  
jai savvagao Kaṇho ciṃtijjai jattha tattha so c'eva  /
ciṃteṃtao vi so cciya tamhā so kiṃ viciṃtei  
annaṃ pi aliya-vayaṇaṃ suvvai loyammi niggayaṃ iṇamo  /
jaha Pavaṇa-Gaṇāhivaī Selasuyāvayava-uppanno  
Baṃbhāṇa-samuppattī Tilottamā-Uvvasī ya Doṇassa  /
uppatti Chammuhassa ya Narakubbara āsi tāṇaṃ ca  
Kaṇhassa ya niggamaṇaṃ jaha kovā Seyakuṃḍalī jāo  /
jaha sirakavāla-majjhe ruhirammi Naro samuppanno  
jai Jāyavassa māyā-uppattī Halaharassa logammi  /
jaha jāyā Selasuyā vikkhāyā jīva-loyammi  
jai hoṃti pavvayāṇaṃ puttā dhūyā kuḍuṃba-dhammo vā  /
to taṃ imammi loe Jaṃbūdīve na māejjā  
eyāiṃ capphalāiṃ Bhāraha-Rāmāyaṇe nibaddhāiṃ  /
saṃcālaṇam asahaṃtā jaha jutti-kayaṃ suvaṇṇa vva  
eyaṃ loiya-satthaṃ gaddaha-liṃḍa vva bāhire maṭṭhaṃ  /
jāv' aṃtaṃ joijjai tusa-bhusa-busa-mīsiyaṃ savvaṃ  
to te bhaṇāmi savve kusamaya-kussui-paheṇa muttūṇa  /
savvanna-desiyammi ya laggaha magge payatteṇaṃ  
eyaṃ Dhuttakkhāṇaṃ soūṇaṃ loiyassa param'atthaṃ  /
taha kuṇaha nicchiya-maiṃ jaha darisaṇa-suddhi hoi parā  
Cittauḍa-dugga-siri-saṃṭhiehiṃ sammatta-rāya-rattehiṃ  /
sucariya-samūha-sahiyā kahiyā esā kahā suvarā  
sammatta-suddhi-heuṃ cariyaṃ Haribhadda-sūriṇā raiyaṃ  /
nisuṇaṃta-kahaṃtāṇaṃ bhava-virahaṃ kuṇau bhavvāṇaṃ  
Seyaṃbara-vara-sūrī Haribhaddo kuṇau amha bhaddāiṃ  /
jassa sasi-saṃkha-dhavale Jiṇ'āgame erisā bhattī

Hāla: Sattasaī (Saptaśatakam, Gāthāsaptaśatī)
pasuvaïṇo rosāruṇapaḍimāsaṃkaṃtagorimuhaaṃdam /
gahiagghapaṃkaaṃ mia saṃjhāsalilaṃjaliṃ ṇamaha /
amiaṃ pāuakavvaṃ paḍhiuṃ souṃ ca je ṇa āṇaṃti /
kāmassa tattatattiṃ kuṇaṃti te kaha ṇa lajjaṃti /
satta saāiṃ kaïvacchaleṇa koḍīa majjhaārammi /
hāleṇa viraïāiṃ sālaṃkārāṇa gāhāṇaṃ /
ua ṇiccalaṇippaṃdā bhisiṇīvattammi rehaï valāā /
nimmalamaragaabhāaṇapariṭṭhiā saṃkhasutti vva /
tāva ccia raïsamae mahilāṇaṃ vibbhamā virāaṃti /
jāva ṇa kuvalaadalasacchahāi maülaṃti ṇaaṇāiṃ /
ṇohaliam appaṇo kiṃ ṇa maggase maggase kuravaassa /
eaṃ khu suhaa tuha hasaï valiamuhapaṃkaaṃ jāā /
tāvijjaṃti asoehi laḍahavilaāu daïavirahammi /
kiṃ sahaï ko vi kassa vi pāapahāraṃ pahuppaṃto /
attā taha ramaṇijjaṃ aṃhaṃ gāmassa maṃḍaṇīhūaṃ /
luatilavāḍisaricchaṃ sisireṇakaaṃ bhisiṇisaṃḍaṃ /
kiṃ ruasi oṇaamuhī dhavalāaṃtesu sālichettesu /
hariālamaṃḍiamuhī ṇaḍi vva saṇavāḍiā jāā /
sahi erisi ccia gaī mā ruvvasu taṃsavaliamuhaaṃdaṃ / 
eāṇa vālavāluṃkitaṃtukuḍilāṇa pemmāṇaṃ /
pāapaḍiassa païṇo puṭṭhiṃ putte samāruhaṃtammi /
daḍhamaṇṇudūmiāi vihāso ghariṇīa ṇikkaṃto /
saccaṃ jāṇaï daṭṭhaṃ sarisammi jaṇammi jujjae rāo /
maraü ṇa tumaṃ bhaṇissaṃ maraṇaṃ pi salāhanijjaṃ se /
raṃdhaṇakammaṇiuṇie mā jūrasu rattapāḍalasuaṃdhaṃ /
muhamāruaṃ piaṃto dhūmāi sihī ṇa pajjalaï /
ghariṇīa mahāṇasakammalaggamasimaïlieṇa hattheṇa /
chittaṃ muhaṃ hasijjaï caṃdāvatthaṃ gaaṃ païṇā /
kiṃ kiṃ de paḍihāsaï sahīhi ia pucchiāi muddhāe /
paḍhamuggaadohaliṇīa ṇavara daïaṃ gaā diṭṭhī /
amaamaa gaaṇasehara raaṇīmukhatilaa caṃda de chivasu /
chitto jehi jiaamo mamaṃ pi tehiṃ cia karehiṃ /
ehijja so paüttho ahaaṃ kuppejja so vi aṇuṇejja /
ia kassa vi phalaï maṇoramāṇa mālā piaamammi /
duggaakuḍaṃvaaṭṭhī kaha ṇu mae dhoieṇa soḍhavvā /
dasiosaraṃtasalileṇa uaha ruṇṇaṃ va paḍaeṇa /
kosaṃvakisalavaṇṇaa taṇṇaa uṇṇāmiehi kaṇṇehiṃ /
hiaaṭṭhiaṃ gharaṃ vaccamāṇa dhavalattaṇaṃ pāva /
aliapasuttaa viṇimīliaccha de suhaa majjha oāsaṃ /
gaṃḍapariuṃ vaṇāpulaïaṃga ṇa puṇo cirāissaṃ /
asamatta maṃḍaṇa ccia vacca gharaṃ se sakouhallassa /
volāviahalahalaassa putti citte ṇa laggihisi /
āarapaṇāmioṭṭaṃ aghaḍiaṇāsaṃ asaṃhaaṇiḍālaṃ /
vaṇṇaghialittamuhie tīe pariuṃvaṇaṃ bharimo /
āṇāsaāi deṃtī taha surae harisaviasiakavolā /
gose vi oṇaamuhī aha se tti piaṃ ṇa saddhahimo /
piaviraho appiadaṃsaṇaṃ ca garuāi do vi dukkhāi /
jīa tumaṃ kārijjasi tīa ṇamo āhijāīe /
ekko vi kālasāro ṇa dei gaṃtuṃ paāhiṇa calaṃto /
kiṃ uṇa vāhāuliaṃ loaṇajualaṃ piaamāe /
ṇa kuṇaṃto ccia māṇaṃ ṇisāsu suhasuttadaravivuddhānaṃ /
suṇṇaïapāsaparimusaṇaveaṇaṃ jaï si jānaṃto /
paṇaakuviāṇa doṇha vi aliapasuttāṇa māṇaïllāṇa /
ṇiccalaṇiruddhaṇīsāsadiṇṇaaṇṇāṇa ko mallo /
ṇavalaïpaharaṃ aṃge jahiṃ jahiṃ mahaï dearo dāuṃ /
romaṃca daṃdarāī tahiṃ tahiṃ dīsaï vahūe /
ajja mae teṇa viṇā aṇuhūasuhāi saṃbharaṃtīe /
ahiṇavamehāṇa ravo ṇisāmio vajjhapaḍato vva /
ṇikkiva jāābhīrua duddaṃsaṇa ṇiṃvakīḍasāriccha /
gāmo gāmaṇiṇaṃdaṇa tujjha kae taha vitaṇuāi /
paharavaṇamaggavisame jāā kiccheṇa lahaï se ṇiddaṃ /
gāmaṇiuttassa ure pallī uṇa se suhaṃ suaï /
aha saṃbhāviamaggo suhaa tue ccea ṇavara ṇivvūḍho /
eṇhiṃ hiae aṇṇaṃ aṇṇaṃ vāāi loassa /
uṇhāi ṇīsasaṃto kīsa maha paraṃmuhīa saaṇaddhe /
hiaaṃ palīviuṃ aṇusaeṇa puṭṭhiṃ palīvesi /
tuha virahe ciraāraa tissā ṇivaḍaṃtavāhamaïleṇa /
raïrahasiharadhaeṇa va muheṇa chāhi ccia ṇa pattā /
diarassa asuddhamaṇassa kulavahūṇiaakuḍḍalihiāi /
diahaṃ kahei rāmāṇulaggasomitticariāiṃ /
cattaraghariṇī piadaṃsaṇā a taruṇī paütthavaïāa /
asaī saajjiāduggaā a ṇaha khaṃḍiaṃ sīlaṃ /
tālūrabhamāulakhuḍiakesaro giriṇaīapūreṇa /
daravuḍḍavuḍḍaṇivvuḍḍamahuaro hīlaï kalaṃvo /
ahiāimāṇiṇo duggaassa chāiṃ païssa rakkhaṃhī /
ṇiavaṃdhavāṇa jūraï ghariṇī vihaveṇa eṃtāṇaṃ /
sāhīṇe vi piaame patte vi chaṇe ṇa maṃḍio appā /
duggaapaütthavaïaṃ saajjiaṃ saṃṭhavaṃtīe /
tujjha vasaï tti hiaaṃ imehi diṭṭho tumaṃ ti acchīiṃ /
tuha virahe kisiāi ti tīe aṃgāi vi piāiṃ /
sabbhāvaṇe habharie ratte rajjijjaï tti juttam iṇaṃ /
aṇahiae uṇa hiaaṃ jaṃ dijjaï taṃ jaṇo hasaï /
āraṃbhaṃtassa dhuaṃ lacchī maraṇaṃ va hoi purisassa /
taṃ maraṇam aṇāraṃbhe vi hoi lacchī uṇa ṇa hoi /
virahāṇalo sahijjaï āsāvaṃdheṇa vallahajaṇassa /
ekkaggāmapavāso māe maraṇaṃ visesei /
akkhaḍaï piā hiae aṇṇaṃ mahilāaṇaṃ ramaṃtassa /
diṭṭhe sarisammi guṇe sarisammi guṇe aīsaṃte /
ṇaïpūrasacchahe jovvaṇammi aïpavasiesudiahesu /
aṇiattāsu a rāīsu putti kiṃ daḍḍhamāṇeṇa /
kallaṃ kira kharatiao pavasihaï pio tti suvvaï jaṇammi /
taha vaḍḍha bhaavaï ṇise jaha se kallaṃ cia ṇa hoi /
hoṃtapahiassa jāā āucchaṇajīadhāraṇarahassaṃ /
pucchaṃtī bhamaï gharaṃ ghareṇa piavirahasahirīo /
aṇṇamahilāpasaṃgaṃ de devva karesu amha daïassa /
purisā ekkaṃtarasā ṇa hu dosaguṇe viāṇaṃti /
thoaṃ pi ṇa ṇīi imā majjhaṇhe ua sarīratalalukkā /
āavabhaeṇa chāhī vi tā pahia kiṃ ṇa vīsamasī /
suhaücchaaṃ jaṇaṃ dullahaṃ pi dūrāhi amha āṇeṃta /
uaāraa jara jīaṃ pi ṇeṃta ṇa kaāvarāhosi /
āma jaro me maṃdo ahava ṇa maṃdo jaṇassa kā tattī /
suhaücchaa suhaa suaṃdhagaṃdha mā gaṃdhiriṃ chivasu /
sihipicchaluliakese vevaṃtoru viṇimīliaddhacchī /
darapurisāini visamiri jāṇasu purisāṇa jaṃ dukkhaṃ /
pemmassa virohiasaṃdhiassa paccakkhadiṭṭhaviliassa /
uaassa va tāviasīalassa viraso raso hoi /
vajjavaḍanāirikkaṃ païṇo soūṇa siṃjiṇīghosaṃ /
pusiāi karimarīe sarivaṃdīṇaṃ pi acchīiṃ /
karimari aālagajjirajalaāsaṇivaḍaṇapaḍiravo eso /
païṇo dhaṇurava kaṃkhiri romaṃcaṃ kiṃ muhā vahasi /
sahaï sahaï tti teṇa tahā ramiā suraaduvviaḍḍeṇa /
pavvāasirīsāi va jaha se jāāi aṃgāiṃ /
agaṇiasesajuāṇā vālaa volīṇaloamajjāā /
aha sā bhamaï disāmuhapasāriacchī tuha kaeṇa /
ajjaṃ cea paüttho ujjāgarao jaṇassa ajjea /
ajjea haliddāpiṃjarāi golāi tūhāiṃ /
asarisacitte diare suddhamaṇā piaame visamasīle /
ṇa kahaï kuḍuṃvavihaḍaṇabhaeṇa taṇuāae soṇhā /
ciṃtāṇiadaïasamāgamammi kaamaṇṇuāi bhariūṇa /
suṇṇaṃ kalahā aṃtī sahīhi ruṇṇā ṇa ohasiā /
hiaaṇṇuehi samaaṃ asamattāiṃ pi jaha suhāveṃti /
kajjāi maṇe ṇa tahā iarehi samāṇiāiṃ pi /
daraphuḍiasippisaṃpuḍaṇilukkahālāhalaggacheppaṇihaṃ /
pikkaṃvaṭṭhiviṇiggaakomalam aṃvaṃkuraṃ uaha /
uaha paḍalaṃtaroiṇṇaṇiaataṃtuddhapāapaḍilaggaṃ /
dullakkhasuttagutthekkavaülakusumaṃ va makkaḍaaṃ /
uaridaraḍiṭṭhakhaṇṇuaṇilukkapārāvaāṇa viruehiṃ /
ṇitthaṇaï jāaviaṇaṃ sūlāhiṇṇaṃ va devaülaṃ /
jaï hosi ṇa tassa piā aṇudiahaṃ ṇīsahehi aṃgehiṃ /
ṇavasūapīapeosamattapāḍi vva kiṃ suasi /
hemaṃtiāsu aïdīharāsu rāīsu taṃ si aviṇiddā /
ciraarapaütthavaïe ṇa suṃdaraṃ jaṃ diā suasi /
jaï cikkhillabhaüppuapaam iṇam alasāi tuha pae diṇṇaṃ /
tā suhaa kaṃḍaïjjaṃtam aṃgam eṇhiṃ kiṇo vahasi /
patto chaṇo ṇa sohaï aïppahāe vva puṇṇimāaṃdo /
aṃtaviraso vva kāmo asaṃpaāṇo a parioso /
pāṇiggahaṇe ccia pavvaīa ṇāaṃ sahīhi sohaggaṃ /
pasuvaïṇā vāsuikaṃkaṇammi osārie dūraṃ /
giṃhe davaggimasimaïliāi dīsaṃti viṃjhasiharāiṃ /
āsasu paütthavaïe ṇa hoṃti ṇavapāusabbhāiṃ /
jettiamettaṃ tīraï ṇivvoḍhuṃ desu tettiaṃ paṇaaṃ /
ṇa jaṇo viṇiattapasāadukkhasahaṇakkhamo savvo /
vahuvallahassa jā hoi vallahā kaha vi paṃca diahāiṃ /
sā kiṃ chaṭṭhaṃ maggaï katto miṭṭhaṃ ca vahuaṃ ca /
jaṃ jaṃ so ṇijjhāaï aṃgoāsaṃ mahaṃ aṇimisaccho /
pacchāemi a taṃ taṃ icchāmi a teṇa dīsaṃtaṃ /
daḍhamaṇṇudūmiāi vi gahio daïammi pechaha imīe /
osaraï vāluāmuṭṭhio vva māṇo surasuraṃto /
ua pommarāamaragaasaṃvaliā ṇahaalāu oaraï /
ṇahasirikaṃṭhabbhaṭṭha vva kaṃṭhiā kīrariṃcholī /
ṇa vi taha viesavāso doggaccaṃ maha jaṇei saṃtāvaṃ /
āsaṃsiatthavimuho jaha paṇaïaṇo ṇiattaṃto /
khaṃdhaggiṇā vaṇesuṃ taṇehi gāmammi rakkhio pahio /
ṇaaravasio ṇaḍijjaï sāṇusaeṇa vva sīeṇa /
bharimo se gahiāharadhuasīsapaholirālaāuliaṃ /
vaaṇaṃ parimalataraliabhamarālipaïṇṇakamalaṃ va /
hallaphalaṇhāṇapasāhiāṇa chaṇavāsare savattīṇa /
ajjāi majjaṇāṇāareṇa kahiaṃ va sohaggaṃ /
ṇhāṇahaliddābhariaṃtarāi jālāi jālavalaassa /
sohaṃti kiliṃciakaṃṭaeṇa kaṃ kāhisi kaatthaṃ /
addaṃsaṇeṇa pemmaṃ avei aïdaṃsaṇeṇa vi avei /
pisuṇajaṇakaṃpieṇa vi avei emea vi avei /
addaṃsaṇeṇa mahilāaṇassa aïdaṃsaṇeṇa ṇīassa /
mukkhassa pisuṇaaṇajaṃpieṇa emea vi khalassa /
poṭṭapaḍiehi dukkhaṃ acchijjaï uṇṇaehi hoūṇa /
ia ciṃtaṃtāṇa maṇe thaṇāṇa kasaṇaṃ muhaṃ jāaṃ /
so tujjha kae suṃdari taha jhīṇo sumahilo haliaütto /
jaha se macchariṇīa vi doccaṃ jāāi paḍivaṇṇaṃ /
dakkhiṇṇeṇa vi eṃto suhaa suhāvesi aṃha hiaāiṃ /
ṇikkaïaveṇa jāṇaṃ gao si kā ṇivvuī tāṇaṃ /
ekkaṃ paharugghāaṃ hatthaṃ muhamārueṇa vīaṃto /
so vi hasaṃtīa mae gahio vīeṇa kaṃṭhammi /
avalaṃviamāṇaparaṃmuhīa eṃtassa māṇini piassa /
puṭṭhipulaüggamo tuha kahei samuhaṭṭhiaṃ hiaaṃ /
jānaï jāṇāveuṃ aṇuṇaaviddaviamāṇaparisesaṃ /
païrikkammi vi viṇaāvalaṃvaṇaṃ sa ccia kuṇaṃtī /
muhamārueṇa taṃ kaṇha goraaṃ rāhiāi avaṇeṃto /
