----------  [2. viīo saṃdhi]  ----------
jaga-guru puṇṇa-pavittu  $  taïlokkahŏ maṅgalagāraü
sahasā ṇevi surehĩ  $  meruhĩ ahisittu bhaḍāraü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 1:
uppaṇṇaĕ tihuaṇa-paramesarĕ  $  aṭṭhottara-sahāsa-lakkhaṇa-dharĕ
bhāvaṇa-bhavaṇĕhĩ saṅkha pavajjiẏa  $  ṇaṃ ṇava-pāusĕ ṇava ghaṇa gajjiẏa
vintara-bhavaṇĕhĩ paḍaha-sahāsaĩ  $  dasa-disivaha-ṇiggaẏa-ṇigghosaĩ
joisa-bhavaṇantarĕhĩ ahiṭṭhiẏa  $  bhīsaṇa-sīhaṇiṇāẏa samuṭṭhiẏa
kappāmara-bhavaṇahĩ jaẏa-ghaṇṭaü  $  saĩ ji garua-ṭaṅkāra-visaṭṭaü
āsaṇa-kampu jāu amarindahŏ  $  jāṇĕvi jammuppatti jiṇindahŏ
caḍiu turantu sakku aïrāvaĕ  $  kaṇṇa-camara-uḍḍāviẏa-chappaĕ
meru-sihari-saṇṇiha-kumbha-tthalĕ  $  maẏa-sari-sotta-sitta-gaṇḍa-tthalĕ
ghattā:
suravaï dasa-saẏa-ṇettu  $  rehaï ārūḍhaü gaẏavarĕ
    vihasiẏa-komala-kamalu  $  kamalāẏaru ṇāĩ mahīharĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 2:
amara-rāu saṃcalliu jāvĕhĩ  $  dhaṇaeṃ kiu kañcaṇamaü tāvĕhĩ
paṭṭaṇu caü-goura-saṃpuṇṇaü  $  sattahĩ pāẏārehĩ ravaṇṇaü
dīhiẏa-maḍha-vihāra-devaülĕhĩ  $  sara-pokkhariṇi-talāĕhĩ viulĕhĩ
kacchārāma-sīma-ujjāṇĕhĩ  $  kañcaṇa-toraṇehĩ apamāṇĕhĩ
lahu sakkeẏa-ṇaẏari kiẏa jakkheṃ  $  pariẏañciẏa ti-vāra sahasakkheṃ
pīṇa-paoharāĕ sasi-somaĕ  $  inda-mahāeviĕ paülomaĕ
savva-jaṇahŏ uvasovaṇi deppiṇu  $  aggaĕ māẏā-vālu thaveppiṇu
ṇiu tihuaṇa-paramesaru tettahĕ  $  sapparivāru purandaru jettahĕ
ghattā:
jhatti surehĩ vimukka  $  caraṇovari diṭṭhi visālā
    bhattiĕ accaṇa-joggu  $  ṇāvaï ṇīluppala-mālā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 3:
vāla-kamala-dala-komala-vāhaü  $  aṅkĕ caḍāviu tihuaṇa-ṇāhaü
suravaïṇā 'ruṇa-vāla-divāẏaru  $  saṃcāliu taṃ meru-mahīharu
sattahĩ joẏaṇa-saẏahĩ tahiṃtiu  $  saṇṇavaïhĩ tārāẏaṇa-pantiu
uppari dasa-joẏaṇĕhĩ divāẏaru  $  puṇu asīhĩ lakkhijjaï sasaharu
puṇu caūhĩ ṇakkhattahã pantiu  $  vuha-maṇḍalu vi caūhĩ tahiṃtiu
asura-manti tihĩ tihĩ saṃvaccharu  $  tihĩ aṅgāraü tihĩ ji saṇiccharu
aṭṭhāṇavaï sahāsa kameppiṇu  $  aṇṇu vi joẏaṇa-saü laṅgheppiṇu
paṇḍu-silovari suravara-sāraü  $  lahu siṃhāsaṇĕ ṭhaviu bhaḍāraü
ghattā:
ṇāvaï sirĕṇa laevi  $  mandaru darisāvaï loẏahŏ
    "ehaü tihuaṇa-ṇāhu  $  kiṃ hoi ṇa hoi va joẏahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 4:
ṇhavaṇārambha-bheri apphāliẏa  $  paḍahā 'mara-kiṅkara-kara-tāḍiẏa
pūriẏa dhavala saṅkha kiu kalaẏalu  $  kehi mi ghosiu caüvihu maṅgalu
kehi mi āḍhattaĩ geẏāi mi  $  saragaẏa-paẏagaẏa-tālagaẏāi mi
kehi mi vāiu vajju maṇoharu  $  vāraha-tālaü solaha-akkharu
kehi mi uvvelliu bharahuttaü  $  ṇava-rasa-aṭṭha-bhāva-saṃjuttaü
kehi mi ubbhiẏāĩ dhaẏa-cindhaĩ  $  kehi mi guru-thottaĩ pāraddhaĩ
kehi mi laïẏaü mālaï-mālaü  $  parimala-vahalaü bhasala-vamālaü
kehi mi veṇu kehĩ vara-vīṇaü  $  kehi mi tisariẏāu sara-līṇaü
ghattā:
jaṃ pariẏāṇiu jehĩ  $  taṃ tehĩ savvu viṇṇāsiu
    tihuaṇa-sāmi bhaṇevi  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-viṇṇāṇu paẏāsiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 5:
pahilaü kalasu laïu amarindeṃ  $  vīẏaü huavaheṇa sāṇandeṃ
taïẏaü sarahaseṇa jamarāeṃ  $  caüthaü ṇeriẏa-deveṃ āeṃ
pañcamu varuṇeṃ samarĕ samattheṃ  $  chaṭṭhaü mārueṇa saĩ hattheṃ
sattamaü vi kuvera-ahihāṇeṃ  $  aṭṭhamu kalasu laïu īsāṇeṃ
ṇavamaü saṃbhāviu dharaṇindeṃ  $  dasamaü kalasu laïjjaï candeṃ
aṇṇa kalasa uccāiẏa aṇṇĕhĩ  $  lakkha-koḍi-akkhohaṇi-gaṇṇĕhĩ
suravara-velli achiṇṇa raeppiṇu  $  cattāri vi samudda laṅgheppiṇu
khīra-mahaṇṇavĕ khīru bhareppiṇu  $  aṇṇahŏ aṇṇu samappaï leppiṇu
ghattā:
ṇhāviu ema surehĩ  $  vahu-maṅgala-kalasĕhĩ jiṇavaru
    ṇaṃ ṇava-pāusa-kālĕ  $  mehĕhĩ ahisittu mahīharu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 6:
maṅgala-kalasĕhĩ suravara-sāraü  $  jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ ṇhaviu bhaḍāraü
to etthantarĕ haẏa-paḍivakkheṃ  $  geṇhĕvi vajja-sūi sahasakkheṃ
kaṇṇa-jualu jaga-ṇāhahŏ vijjhaï  $  kuṇḍala-jualu jhatti āijjhaï
seharu sīsĕ hāru vacchatthalĕ  $  karĕ kaṅkaṇu kaḍisuttaü kaḍiẏalĕ
tihuaṇa-tilaẏahŏ tilaü thavanteṃ  $  maṇĕ āsaṅkiu dasasaẏaṇetteṃ
puṇu āḍhatta jiṇindahŏ vandaṇa  $  "jaẏa tihuaṇa-guru ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇa
jaẏa devāhideva paramappaẏa  $  jaẏa tiẏasinda-vinda-vandiẏa-paẏa
jaẏa ṇaha-maṇi-kiraṇoha-pasāraṇa  $  taruṇa-taraṇi-kara-ṇiẏara-ṇivāraṇa
jaẏa ṇamiehĩ ṇamiẏa paṇavijjahi  $  aruhu vuttu puṇu kahŏ uvamijjahi
ghattā:
jaga-guru puṇṇa-pavittu  $  tihuaṇahŏ maṇoraha-gārā
      bhavĕ bhavĕ amhahũ dejja  $  jiṇa guṇa-sampatti bhaḍārā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 7:
ṇāẏa-ṇarāmara-ṇaẏaṇāṇandahŏ  $  vandaṇa-hatti karantahŏ indahŏ
rūvāloẏaṇĕ rūvāsattaĩ  $  titti ṇa janti purandara-ṇettaĩ
jahĩ ṇivaḍiẏaĩ tahĩ jĕ paṅguttaĩ  $  duvvala-ḍhoraĩ paṅkĕ va khuttaĩ
vāmakaraṅguṭṭhaü ṇiddārĕvi  $  vālahŏ tetthu amiu saṃcārĕvi
puṇu vi paḍīvaü maẏaṇa-viẏāraü  $  gampi aüjjhahĕ thaviu bhaḍāraü
sūreṃ meru-giri va pariẏañciu  $  puṇu dasa-saẏa kara karĕvi paṇacciu
sālaṅkāru sa-doru sa-ṇeuru  $  saccharu sapparivāranteuru
jaṇaṇiĕ jaṃ ji diṭṭhu ahisittaü  $  risahu bhaṇĕvi puṇu risahu jĕ vuttaü
ghattā:
kālĕ galantaĕ ṇāhu  $  ṇiẏa-deha-riddhi pariẏaḍḍhaï
    vivarijjantu kaīhĩ  $  vāẏaraṇa-ganthu jiha vaḍḍhaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 8:
amara-kumārĕhĩ sahũ kīlantahŏ  $  puvvahũ vīsa lakkha laṅghantahŏ
ekka-divasĕ gaẏa paẏa kūvāreṃ  $  "deva deva mua bhukkhā-māreṃ
jāhã pasāeṃ amhe dhaṇṇā  $  te kappaẏaru savva ucchaṇṇā
evahĩ ko uvāu jīvevaĕ  $  bhoẏaṇĕ khāṇĕ pāṇĕ parihevaĕ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu jaga-sāraü  $  saẏala-kalaü dakkhavaï bhaḍāraü
aṇṇahũ asi masi kisi vāṇijjaü  $  aṇṇahũ viviha-paẏāraü vijjaü
kaïhĩ diṇĕhĩ pariṇāviu deviu  $  ṇanda-suṇandāiu siẏa-seviu
saü puttahũ uppaṇṇu pahāṇahã  $  bharaha-vāhuvali-aṇuharamāṇahã
ghattā:
puvvahã lakkha tisaṭṭhi  $  gaẏa rajju karantahŏ jāvĕhĩ
    cintā maṇĕ uppaṇṇa  $  suravaï-maharāẏahŏ tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 9:
tihuaṇa-jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-piẏāraü  $  bhoẏāsattaü ṇiĕvi bhaḍāraü
maṇĕ cintāviu dasasaẏaloẏaṇu  $  "karami kiṃ pi vaïrāẏahŏ kāraṇu
jeṇa karaï suhi-satta-hiẏattaṇu  $  jeṇa pavattaï tittha-pavattaṇu
jeṇa sīlu vaü ṇiẏamu ṇa ṇāsaï  $  jeṇa ahiṃsā-dhammu paẏāsaï"
ema viẏappĕvi chaṇa-candāṇaṇa  $  puṇṇāusa kokkiẏa ṇīlañjaṇa
"tihuaṇa-guruhĕ jāhi olaggaĕ  $  ṇaṭṭārambhu padarisahi aggaĕ"
taṃ āesu lahĕvi gaẏa tettahĕ  $  thiu atthāṇĕ bhaḍāraü jettahĕ
pāujjiĕhĩ paüñjiu takkhaṇĕ  $  geu vajju jaṃ vuttaü lakkhaṇĕ
ghattā:
raṅgĕ païṭṭha turanti  $  kara-diṭṭhi-bhāva-rasa-rañjiẏa
    vibbhama-bhāva-vilāsa  $  darisantiĕ pāṇa visajjiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 10:
jaṃ ṇīlañjaṇa pāṇĕhĩ mukkī  $  jāẏa jiṇahŏ tā saṅka gurukkī
"dhiddhigatthu saṃsāru asāraü  $  aṇṇahŏ aṇṇu hoi kammāraü
aṇṇahŏ aṇṇu karaï bhiccattaṇu"  $  taṃ ji hūu vaïrāẏahŏ kāraṇu
loẏantiẏahĩ tāma paḍivohiu  $  "cāru deva jaṃ saĩ ummohiu
uvahihĩ ṇava-ṇava-koḍākoḍiu  $  ṇaṭṭhaü dhammu satthu parivāḍiu
ṇaṭṭhaĩ daṃsaṇa-ṇāṇa-carittaĩ  $  dāṇa-jhāṇa-saṃjama-sammattaĩ
pañca mahavvaẏa pañcāṇuvvaẏa  $  tiṇṇi guṇavvaẏa caü sikkhāvaẏa
ṇiẏama-sīla-uvavāsa-sahāsaĩ  $  paĩ honteṇa havantu asesaĩ"
ghattā:
tāma vimāṇārūḍha  $  caü-disu caü deva-ṇikāẏā
    "paĩ viṇu suṇṇaü mokkhu"  $  ṇaṃ jiṇa-hakkārā āẏā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 11:
siviẏā-jāṇeṃ suravara-sāraü  $  jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ caḍiu bhaḍāraü
devĕhĩ khandhu devi uccāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ taṃ siddhatthu parāiu
tahĩ uvavaṇĕ thovantaru thāĕvi  $  bharahahŏ rāẏa-lacchi karĕ lāĕvi
"ṇamaha parama-siddhāṇa" bhaṇanteṃ  $  kiu paẏāgĕ ṇikkhavaṇu turanteṃ
muṭṭhiu pañca bhareppiṇu laïẏaü  $  cāmīẏara-paḍalovarĕ thaviẏaü
geṇhĕvi jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandeṃ  $  ghittiu khīra-samuddĕ surindeṃ
teṇa samāṇu saṇeheṃ laïẏā  $  rāẏahã caü sahāsa pavvaïẏā
parimiu sasi jiha gaha-saṃghāeṃ  $  addhu varisu thiu kāosāeṃ
ghattā:
pavaṇuddhuẏaü jaḍāu  $  risahahŏ rehanti visālaü
    sihihĕ valantahŏ ṇāĩ  $  dhūmāula-jālā-mālaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 12:
jiṇu aviulu avicalu vīsatthaü  $  thiu chammāsu palamviẏa-hatthaü
je ṇiva teṇa samaü pavvaïẏā  $  te dāruṇa-duvvāeṃ laïẏā
sīuṇhĕhĩ tisa-bhukkhahĩ khāmiẏa  $  jimbhaṇa-ṇiddālasĕhĩ viṇāmiẏa
cālaṇa-kaṇḍuẏaṇaĩ alahantā  $  ahi-vicchiẏa-pariveḍhijjantā
ghora-vīra-tava-caraṇĕhĩ bhaggā  $  ṇāsĕvi salilu pievaĕ laggā
keṇa vi mahiẏalĕ ghattiu appaü  $  "ho ho keṇa diṭṭhu paramappaü
pāṇa janti jaï eṇa ṇioeṃ  $  to kira teṇa kāĩ paraloeṃ"
ko vi phalaĩ toḍeppiṇu bhakkhaï  $  "jāhũ bhaṇevi ko vi kāṇekkhaï
ghattā:
ko vi ṇivāraï kiṃ pi  $  āmellĕvi calaṇa jiṇindahŏ
    "kallaĕ desahũ kāĩ  $  paccuttaru bharaha-ṇarindahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 13:
tahĩ tehaĕ paḍivannaĕ avasarĕ  $  daïvī vāṇi samuṭṭhiẏa amvarĕ
"ahŏ ahŏ kūḍa-kavaḍa-ṇigganthahŏ  $  kāpurisahŏ aṇāẏa-paramatthahŏ
eṇa mahārisi-liṅga-ggahaṇeṃ  $  jāi-jarā-maraṇa-ttaẏa-ḍahaṇeṃ
phalaĩ ma toḍahŏ jalu mā ḍohahŏ  $  ṇaṃ to ṇīsaṅgattaṇu chaṇḍahŏ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi tisa-bhukkhādaṇṇĕhĩ  $  uddhūliu appāṇaü aṇṇĕhĩ
aṇṇĕhĩ aṇṇa samaẏa uppāiẏa  $  tahĩ avasarĕ ṇami-viṇami parāiẏa
kaccha-mahākacchāhiva-ṇandaṇa  $  vara-karavāla-attha ṇīsandaṇa
veṇṇi vi vihĩ calaṇĕhĩ ṇivaḍeppiṇu  $  thiẏa pāsĕhĩ jiṇu jaẏakāreppiṇu
ghattā:
cintiu ṇami-viṇamīhĩ  $  "vuttaü vi ṇa vollaï ṇāho
    eu ṇa jāṇahũ āsi  $  kiu amhĕhĩ ko avarāho
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 14:
jaï vi ṇa kiṃ pi dehi sura-sārā  $  to vari ekkasi volli bhaḍārā
aṇṇahũ desu vihañjĕvi diṇṇaü  $  amhahũ kiṃ pahu ṇiddākhiṇṇaü
aṇṇahũ diṇṇa turaṅgama gaẏavara  $  amhahũ kāĩ kiẏaü paramesara
aṇṇahũ diṇṇaü uttima-vesaü  $  amhahũ ālāveṇa vi saṃsaü"
ema jāma garahanti jiṇindahŏ  $  āsaṇu caliu tāma dharaṇindahŏ
avahi paüñjĕvi sapparivāraü  $  āu khaṇaddheṃ jetthu bhaḍāraü
lakkhiu vihi mi majjhĕ paramesaru  $  sasi-sūrantarālĕ ṇaṃ mandaru
turiu ti-vāraü bhāmari deppiṇu  $  jiṇavara-vandaṇahatti kareppiṇu
ghattā:
pucchiẏa dharaṇidhareṇa  $  "viṇṇi vi uṇṇāviẏa-matthā
    thiẏa kajjeṃ kavaṇeṇa  $  ukkhaẏa-karavāla-vihatthā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 15:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi diṇṇu paccuttaru  $  "pesiẏa ve vi āsi desantaru
dūraṭṭhāṇu jāma taṃ pāvahũ  $  jāma valevi paḍīvā āvahũ
tāma pihimi ṇiẏa-puttahã deppiṇu  $  amhahã thiu avaheri kareppiṇu
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vihasiẏa-muha-ẏandeṃ  $  diṇṇaü vijjaü ve dharaṇindeṃ
"giri-veẏaḍḍhahŏ hohu pahāṇā  $  uttara-dāhiṇa-seḍḍhihĩ rāṇā"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇami-viṇamihĩ vuccaï  $  "aṇṇeṃ diṇṇī pihivi na ruccaï
jaï ṇigganthu dei saĩ hattheṃ  $  to amhe vi lehũ paramattheṃ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ve vi avaloĕvi  $  thiu aggaĕ so muṇivaru hoĕvi
ghattā:
hatthutthalliu teṇa  $  gaẏa ve vi laeppiṇu vijjaü
    uttara-seḍḍhihĩ ekku  $  thiu dāhiṇa-seḍḍhihĩ vijjaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 16:
tahĩ avasarĕ uccāiẏa-vāhahŏ  $  mahi-viharantahŏ tihuaṇa-ṇāhahŏ
vahu-lāẏaṇṇa-vaṇṇa-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  āṇaï ko vi pasāhĕvi kaṇṇaü
celiu ko vi ko vi haẏa cañcala  $  raẏaṇaĩ ko vi ko vi vara maẏagala
ko vi suvaṇṇaĩ ruppaẏa-thālaĩ  $  ko vi dhaṇaĩ dhaṇṇaĩ asarālaĩ
ko vi amullāharaṇaĩ ḍhoẏaï  $  tāĩ bhaḍāraü ṇaü avaloẏaï
savvaĩ dhūli-samaĩ maṇṇantaü  $  paṭṭaṇu hatthiṇaẏaru saṃpattaü
jahĩ seẏaṃseṃ daṃsaṇu pāhiu  $  chuḍu chuḍu ṇiẏa-parivārahŏ sāhiu
"ajju païṭṭhu aṇaṅga-viẏāraü  $  maĩ pārāviu risahu bhaḍāraü
ikkhu-rasahŏ bhariẏañjali jaṃ je  $  gharĕ vasu-hāra pavarisiẏa taṃ je"
tāma caüddisu loeṃ chāiu  $  saccaü jeṃ jiṇu vārĕ parāiu
ghattā:
ṇiggaü "thāhu" bhaṇantu  $  sa-kalattu sa-puttu sa-pariẏaṇu
      bhamiu ti-bhāmari dintu  $  mandarahŏ jema tārāẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 2, Kaḍavaka 17:
vandĕvi païsāriẏaü ṇihelaṇu  $  kiu calaṇāravinda-pakkhālaṇu
aṇṇu vi gomaeṇa saṃmajjaṇu  $  diṇṇa jaleṇa dhāra puṇu candaṇu
pupphaĩ akkhaẏāu vali dīvā  $  dhūva-vāsa jala-vāsa paḍīvā
kara-pakkhālaṇu devi kumāreṃ  $  sasahara-saṇṇiheṇa bhiṅgāreṃ
ahiṇava-ikkhurasahŏ bhariẏañjali  $  tāva surehĩ mukku kusumañjali
sāhukkāru deva-dunduhi-saru  $  gandha-vāu vasu-varisu ṇirantaru
kañcaṇa-raẏaṇahã koḍiu vāraha  $  paḍiẏa lakkha vattīsaṭṭhāraha
akkhaẏa-dāṇu bhaṇĕvi seẏaṃsahŏ  $  akkhaẏataïẏa ṇāũ kiu divasahŏ
ghattā:
jimiu bhaḍāraü jaṃ jĕ  $  seẏaṃseṃ appaü bhāvĕvi
    vandiu risaha-jiṇindu  $  sirĕ sa ĩ bhu va-jualu caḍāvĕvi
iẏa ettha paümacarie  $  dhaṇañjaẏāsiẏa-saẏambhueva-kae
      "jiṇavara-ṇikkhamaṇa" imaṃ  $  vīẏaṃ ciẏa sāhiẏaṃ pavvaṃ
----------  [3. taīo saṃdhi]  ----------
tihuaṇa-guru  $  taṃ gaẏaüru  $  mellĕvi khīṇa-kasāiu
gaẏa-santaü  $  viharantaü  $  purimatālu saṃpāiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 1:
dīhara-kālacakka-haĕṇa  $  varisa-sahāseṃ puṇṇaĕṇa
saẏaḍāmuha-ujjāṇa-vaṇu  $  ḍhukku bhaḍāraü risaha-jiṇu
rammaṃ mahā jaṃ ca puṇṇāẏa-ṇāehĩ  $  kusumiẏa-laẏā-velli-pallava-ṇihāehĩ
kappūra-kaṅkola-elā-lavaṅgehĩ  $  mahu-māhavī-māhuliṅgī-viḍaṅgehĩ
mariẏalla-jīruccha-kuṅkuma-kuḍaṅgehĩ  $  ṇava-tilaẏa-vaülehĩ campaẏa-piẏaṅgehĩ
ṇāraṅga-ṇaggoha-āsattha-rukkhehĩ  $  kaṅkelli-paümakkha-ruddakkha-dakkhehĩ
khajjūri-jamvīri-ghaṇa-phaṇisa-limvehĩ  $  hariẏāla-ḍhaüehĩ vahu-puttajīvehĩ
sattacchaẏā 'gatthi-dahivaṇṇa-ṇandīhĩ  $  mandāra-kundindu-sindūra-sindīhĩ
vara-pāḍalī-popphalī-ṇālikerīhĩ  $  karamandi-kanthāri-karimara-karīrehĩ
kaṇiẏāri-kaṇavīra-mālūra-taralehĩ  $  sirikhaṇḍa-sirisāmalī-sāla-saralehĩ
hintāla-tālehĩ tālī-tamālehĩ  $  jamvū-varamvehĩ kañcaṇa-kaẏamvehĩ
bhuva-devadārūhĩ riṭṭhehĩ cārehĩ  $  kosamma-sajjehĩ koraṇṭa-koñjehĩ
accaïẏa-jūhīhĩ jāsavaṇa-mallīhĩ  $  keẏaïĕ jāehĩ avarahi mi jāīhĩ
ghattā:
tahĩ diṭṭhaü  $  sumaṇiṭṭhaü  $  vaḍa-pāẏaü thira-thoraü
      vaṇa-vaṇiẏahĕ  $  suha-jaṇiẏahĕ  $  uppari dhariu va moraü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 2:
tahĩ thāĕvi paramesarĕṇa  $  āi-purāṇa-mahesarĕṇa
visaẏa-seṇṇu saṃcūriẏaü  $  sukka-jhāṇu āūriẏaü
ekka-sukka-jhāṇaggi-palittahŏ  $  do-guṇa-dharahŏ duviha-tava-tattahŏ
tiẏagārahŏ ti-salla pheḍantahŏ  $  caüviha-kammindhaṇaĩ ḍahantahŏ
pañcindiẏa-daṇu-dappu harantahŏ  $  chavviha-rasa-paricāu karantahŏ
satta-mahābhaẏa parisesantahŏ  $  aṭṭha duṭṭha maẏa ṇiṇṇāsantahŏ
ṇavavihu vambhaceru rakkhantahŏ  $  dasavihu parama-dhammu pālantahŏ
sui eẏārahaṅga jāṇantahŏ  $  vāraha aṇuvekkhaü cintantahŏ
terasavihu cārittu carantahŏ  $  caüdahaviha-guṇathāṇu caḍantahŏ
paṇṇāraha pamāẏa vajjantahŏ  $  solahaviha kasāẏa muccantahŏ
sattāraha saṃjama pālantahŏ  $  aṭṭhāraha vi dosa ṇāsantahŏ
ghattā:
suha-jhāṇahŏ  $  gaẏa-māṇahŏ  $  aïpasaṇṇa-muhaẏandahŏ
      dhavalujjalu  $  taṃ kevalu  $  ṇāṇuppaṇṇu jiṇindahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 3:
sāhiẏa-ṇiẏa-sahāva-cariu  $  caütīsa 'isaẏa-pariẏariu
thiu jiṇu ṇiddhuẏa-kamma-raü  $  ṇaṃ sasaharu ṇijjalaharaü
puṇṇa-pavittu pāva-ṇiṇṇāsaṇu  $  aṇṇuppaṇṇu dhavalu siṃhāsaṇu
kisalaẏa-kusuma-riddhi-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  aṇṇettahĕ asou uppaṇṇaü
diṇaẏara-koḍi-paẏāva-samujjalu  $  aṇṇettahĕ pasaṇṇu bhāmaṇḍalu
aṇṇettahĕ oṇāmiẏa-matthā  $  cāmarinda thiẏa camara-vihatthā
aṇṇettahĕ tihuaṇu dhavalantaü  $  thiu uddaṇḍa-dhavala-chatta-ttaü
aṇṇettahĕ sura-dunduhi vajjaï  $  ṇaṃ pakkhuhaṇĕ mahovahi gajjaï
divva bhāsa aṇṇettahĕ bhāsaï  $  aṇṇettahĕ kamma-raü paṇāsaï
 $  kusuma-vāsu aṇṇettahĕ vāsaï
aṭṭha vi pāḍihera uppaṇṇā  $  ṇaṃ thiẏa puṇṇa-puñja āsaṇṇā
ghattā:
iẏa cindhaĩ  $  jasu siddhaĩ  $  para-samāṇu jasu appaü
      gaha-cakkahŏ  $  taïlokkahŏ  $  so jĕ deu paramappaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 4:
vāraha-joẏaṇa-poḍhimaü  $  maṇaharu savvu suvaṇṇamaü
caüdisu caürujjāṇa-vaṇu  $  sura-ṇimmaviu samosaraṇu
tivihu kaṇaẏa-pāẏāru pabhāviu  $  vāraha koṭṭhā solaha vāviu
māṇava-thambha caẏāri pariṭṭhiẏa  $  kañcaṇa-toraṇa-ṇivaha samuṭṭhiẏa
caü gouraĩ hema-pariẏariẏaĩ  $  ṇava ṇava thūhaĩ tahĩ vitthariẏaĩ
daha dhaẏa paüma-mora-pañcāṇaṇa  $  garuḍa-marāla-vasaha vara-vāraṇa
aṇṇu vi vattha-cakka-chatta-ddhaẏa  $  pharaharanta accanta samuṇṇaẏa
ekkekkaĕ dhaĕ ahiṇava-chāẏahũ  $  saü aṭṭhottaru citta-paḍāẏahũ
taṃ samasaraṇu pariṭṭhiu jāvahĩ  $  amara-rāu saṃcalliu tāvahĩ
caliẏaĩ āsaṇāĩ ahamindahũ  $  visaharinda-amarinda-ṇarindahũ
ghattā:
jiṇa-saṃpaï  $  jāṇāvaï  $  suravaï suravara-vindahũ
      "kiṃ acchahu  $  āgacchahu  $  jāhũ bhaḍāraü vandahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi paürāmarĕhĩ  $  kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-kuṇḍala-dharĕhĩ
maṇi-raẏaṇa-ppaha-rañjiẏaĩ  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-jāṇaĩ sajjiẏaĩ
kehi mi mesa mahisa visa kuñjara  $  kehi mi taccha riccha miga samvara
kehi mi karaha varāha turaṅgama  $  kehi mi haṃsa maūra vihaṅgama
kehi mi sasa sāraṅga pavaṅgama  $  kehi mi rahavara ṇaravara jaṅgama
kehi mi vaggha siṅgha gaẏa gaṇḍā  $  kehi mi garuḍa koñca kāraṇḍā
kehi mi suṃsuāra macchohara  $  ema parāiẏa saẏala vi suravara
dasa-paẏāra  vara bhavaṇa-ṇivāsiẏa  $  vintara aṭṭha pañca joīsiẏa
vahuviha kappāmara kokkantaü  $  īsāṇindu vi āu turantaü
vibbhama-hāva-bhāva-saṃkhoḍihĩ  $  parimiu caüvīsa 'cchara-koḍihĩ
ghattā:
pekkhĕvi valu  $  kiẏa-kalaẏalu  $  caüviha-deva-ṇikāẏahŏ
      dhāiẏa ṇara  $  kaṭṭhiẏa-dhara  $  suravara-vallaha-rāẏahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 6:
tāva galiẏa-dāṇojjharaü  $  kaṇṇa-camara-haẏa-mahuẏaraü
jiṇa-vandaṇa-gavaṇaṃmaṇaü  $  parivaḍḍhiu aïrāvaṇaü
joẏaṇa-lakkha-pamāṇu pariṭṭhiu  $  vīẏaü mandaru ṇāĩ samuṭṭhiu
uppari pekkhaṇāĩ pāraddhaĩ  $  cāmīẏara-toraṇaĩ ṇivaddhaĩ
ubbhiẏa dhaẏa dhūvantaĩ cindhaĩ  $  kiẏaĩ vaṇaĩ phala-phulla-samiddhaĩ
pokkhariṇiu ṇava paṅkaẏa saravara  $  dīhiẏa-vāvi-talāẏa laẏāhara
tahĩ aïrāvaṇĕ galagajjantaĕ  $  dīhara-kara-sikkāra muantaĕ
vijjijjantu camara-parivāḍihĩ  $  sattāvīsahĩ acchara-koḍihĩ
caḍiu purandaru maṇĕ parioseṃ  $  jaẏa-maṅgala-dunduhi-ṇigghoseṃ
vandiṇa-phamphāvaẏahĩ paḍhantĕhĩ  $  kaṭṭhiẏavālĕhĩ ḍhou ṇa dintĕhĩ
indahŏ taṇiẏa riddhi avaloĕvi  $  ke vi visūriẏa vimuhā hoĕvi
ghattā:
"mala-dharaṇaĩ  $  tava-caraṇaĩ  $  kaṃ divu bharahĕ karesahũ
      jeṃ dullahu  $  jaṇa-vallahu  $  indattaṇu pāvesahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 7:
tāma surāsura-vāhaṇaĩ  $  phalaĩ va sagga-dumahŏ taṇaĩ
jiṇavara-puṇṇa-vāẏa-haẏaĩ  $  heṭṭhāmuhaĩ samāgaẏaĩ
avaropparu cūranta mahāiẏa  $  giri-maṇusottara-siharu parāiẏa
ṇiẏa-karĕ khañcĕvi bhaṇaï purandaru  $  "uccāsaṇa-āruhaṇu asundaru
jāĩ viuvvaṇa-sattiĕ hūẏaĩ  $  turiu tāĩ āmellahu rūaĩ
thiẏa devāsura indāeseṃ  $  savva paḍīvā teṇa ji veseṃ
ṇāṇā-jāṇa-vimāṇĕhĩ tettahĕ  $  ḍhukku samosaraṇe jiṇu jettahĕ
saẏala vi dūroṇāviẏa-matthā  $  saẏala vi kara-maülañjali-hatthā
saẏala vi jaẏajaẏakāru karantā  $  saẏala vi thotta-saẏāĩ paḍhantā
saẏala vi appāṇaü darisantā  $  ṇāmu gottu ṇiẏa-ṇilaü kahantā
ghattā:
tahĩ velaĕ  $  sura-melaĕ  $  teẏa-piṇḍu jiṇu chajjaï
      gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  tārāẏaṇĕ  $  chaṇa-maẏalañchaṇu ṇajjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 8:
sura-kari-khandhuttiṇṇaĕṇa  $  vahu-romañcubbhiṇṇaĕṇa
sapparivāreṃ sundarĕṇa  $  thui āḍhatta purandarĕṇa
"jaẏa ajarāmara-pura-paramesara  $  jaẏa jiṇa āi-purāṇa-mahesara
jaẏa daẏa-dhamma-raẏaṇa-raẏaṇāẏara  $  jaẏa aṇṇāṇa-tamoha-divāẏara
jaẏa sasi bhavva-kumuẏa-paḍivohaṇa  $  jaẏa kallāṇa-ṇāṇa-guṇa-rohaṇa
jaẏa suraguru taïlokka-piẏāmaha  $  jaẏa saṃsāra-mahāḍaï-huẏavaha
jaẏa vammaha-ṇimmahaṇa mahāusa  $  jaẏa kali-koha-huāsaṇĕ pāusa
jaẏa kasāẏaghaṇa-palaẏasamīraṇa  $  jaẏa māṇaïri-purandarapaharaṇa
jaẏa indiẏa-gaẏaülĕ pañcāṇaṇa  $  jaẏa tihuaṇa-siri-rāmāliṅgaṇa
jaẏa kammāri-maḍapphara-bhañjaṇa  $  jaẏa ṇikkala ṇiravekkha ṇirañjaṇa
ghattā:
tuha sāsaṇu  $  duha-ṇāsaṇu  $  evahĩ uṇṇaï caḍiẏaü
      jeṃ hontĕṇa  $  pahavantĕṇa  $  jagu saṃsārĕ ṇa paḍiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ valu taṃ devāgamaṇu  $  so jiṇavaru taṃ samasaraṇu
pekkhĕvi uvavaṇĕ avaẏariu  $  jāu mahantaü acchariu
paṭṭaṇĕ purimatālĕ jo rāṇaü  $  risahaseṇu ṇāmeṇa pahāṇaü
so devāgamu ṇiĕvi pahāsiu  $  "ko saẏaḍāmuha-vaṇĕ āvāsiu
kāsu eu evaḍḍu pahuttaṇu  $  jeṇa vimāṇahĩ ṇavaï ṇahaṅgaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi keṇa apphāliu  $  "ema deva maĩ savvu ṇihāliu
bharahesarahŏ vappu jo suvvaï  $  mahi-vallahu bhaṇevi jo thuvvaï
kevala-ṇāṇu tāsu uppaṇṇaü  $  aṭṭha-mahāguṇaḍḍhi-saṃpaṇṇaü
taṃ ṇisuṇevi maraṭṭeṃ melliu  $  sa-valu sa-vandhuvaggu saṃcalliu
taṃ samasaraṇu païṭṭhu turantaü  $  "jaẏa devāhideva" pabhaṇantaü
ghattā:
teeṃ tĕṇa  $  païsantĕṇa  $  suraha mi vibbhamu lāiu
      "eṃ vesĕṇa  $  uddesĕṇa  $  kiṃ maẏaraddhaü āiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 10:
pekkhĕvi taṃ devāgamaṇu  $  so jiṇu taṃ ji samosaraṇu
bhava-bhaẏa-saĕhĩ samallaïu  $  risahaseṇu pahu pavvaïu
teṇa samāṇu parama gabbhesara  $  dikkhahã ṭhiẏa caürāsī ṇaravara
caü-kallāṇa-vihūi-saṇāhahŏ  $  gaṇahara te ji hūa jaga-ṇāhahŏ
avara vi je je bhāveṃ laïẏā  $  caürāsī sahāsa pavvaïẏā
eẏāraha-guṇaṭhāṇa-samiddhahũ  $  tiṇṇi lakkha sāvaẏahũ pasiddhahũ
ajjiẏa-gaṇahŏ saṅkha keṃ vujjhiẏa  $  deva vi dukkiẏa-kamma-malujjhiẏa
thiẏa caüpāseṃ parama-jiṇindahŏ  $  ṇaṃ tārā-gaha puṇṇima-candahŏ
vaïraĩ parisesavi thiẏa vaṇaẏara  $  mahisa turaṅgama kesari kuñjara
ghattā:
ahi ṇaüla vi  $  thiẏa saẏala vi  $  ekkahĩ uvasama-bhāvĕṇa
    kiẏa-sevahŏ  $  puraevahŏ  $  kevala-ṇāṇa-pahāvĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 11:
tāma viṇiggaẏa divva jhuṇi  $  kahaï tiloahŏ parama-muṇi
vandha-vimokkha-kālavalaĩ  $  dhammāhamma-mahāphalaĩ
puggala-jīvājīva-paüttiu  $  āsava-saṃvara-ṇijjara-guttiu
saṃjama-ṇiẏama-lesa-vaẏa-dāṇaĩ  $  tava sīlovavāsa-guṇaṭhāṇaĩ
sammaddaṃsaṇa-ṇāṇa-carittaĩ  $  sagga-mokkha-saṃsāra-ṇimittaĩ
ṇava paẏattha sajjhāẏa-jjhāṇaĩ  $  sura-ṇara-ucchehāu-pamāṇaĩ
sāẏara-palla-puvva-koḍīẏaü  $  loẏavihāẏa-kammapaẏaḍīẏaü
kālaĩ khetta-bhāva-paradavvaĩ  $  vāraha aṅgaĩ caüdaha puvvaĩ
ṇaraẏa-tiraẏa-maṇuatta-surattaĩ  $  kulaẏara-halahara-cakkaharattaĩ
titthaẏarattaṇāĩ indattaĩ  $  siddhattaṇaï mi kahaï samattaĩ
ghattā:
kiṃ vahuvĕṇa  $  ālāvĕṇa  $  tihuaṇĕ saẏalĕ gaviṭṭhaü
      ṇaü ekku vi  $  tila-mettu vi  $  taṃ ji jiṇeṇa ṇa diṭṭhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 12:
dhammakkhāṇu saẏalu suṇĕvi  $  cañcalu jīviu maṇĕ muṇĕvi
bhava-bhava-bhaẏa-saẏa-gaẏa-maṇahŏ  $  uvasamu jāu savva-jaṇahŏ
keṇa vi pañcāṇuvvaẏa laïẏā  $  lou karevi ke vi pavvaïẏā
kehi mi guṇavaẏāĩ aṇusariẏaĩ  $  kehi mi sikkhāvaẏaĩ padhariẏaĩ
maüṇāṇatthamiẏaĩ avarekkahĩ  $  aṇṇĕhĩ kiẏa ṇivitti aṇṇekkahĩ
jo jaṃ maggaï taṃ tahŏ dei  $  hatthu bhaḍāraü ṇaü khañcei
amara vi gaẏa sammattu laeppiṇu  $  ṇiẏa ṇiẏa-liẏa-vāhaṇahĩ caḍeppiṇu
jiṇa-dhavalahŏ vi dhavalu siṃhāsaṇu  $  paṇṇārasa-visaṭṭa-therāsaṇu
ubbhiẏa seẏa chatta siẏa-cāmaru  $  divva bhāsa bhāmaṇḍalu seharu
ghattā:
tihuaṇa-pahu  $  haẏa-vammahu  $  kevala-kiraṇa-divāẏaru
    tahŏ thāṇahŏ  $  ujjāṇahŏ  $  gaü taṃ gaṅgā-sāẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 3, Kaḍavaka 13:
tahĩ avasarĕ bharahesarahŏ  $  saẏala-puhaï-paramesarahŏ
para-cakkehi mi ṇaviẏa kama  $  jāẏa riddhi sura-riddhi-sama
mālūra-pavara-pīvara-thaṇāhã  $  chaṇṇavaï sahāsa varaṅgaṇāhã
tahŏ daha-pañcāsaü ṇandaṇāhũ  $  caürāsī lakkhaĩ sandaṇāhũ
caürāsī lakkhaĩ gaẏavarāhũ  $  aṭṭhāraha koḍiu haẏavarāhũ
koḍīu tiṇṇi vara-dheṇuvāhã  $  vattīsa sahāsa ṇarāhivāhã
vattīsa sahāsaĩ maṇḍalāhũ  $  kammantĕ koḍi pavahaï halāhũ
ṇava ṇihiẏaü raẏaṇaĩ satta satta  $  chakkhaṇḍa i meiṇi ekka-chatta
ghattā:
jiha vappĕṇa  $  māhappĕṇa  $  laïu ṇāṇu taṃ kevalu
    tiha puttĕṇa  $  jujjhantĕṇa  $  sa ĩ bhu va-valĕṇa mahīẏalu
----------  [4. caüttho saṃdhi]  ----------
saṭṭhihiṃ varisa-sahāsahĩ  $  puṇṇa-jaẏāsahĩ  $  bharahu aüjjha paīsaraï
ṇava-ṇisiẏara-dhāraü  $  kalaha-piẏāraü  $  cakka-raẏaṇu ṇa paīsaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 1:
païsaraï ṇa paṭṭaṇĕ cakka-raẏaṇu  $  jiha avuhabbhantarĕ sukaï-vaẏaṇu
jiha vambhaẏāri-muhĕ kāma-satthu  $  jiha goṭṭhaṅgaṇĕ maṇi-raẏaṇa-vatthu
jiha vāri-ṇivandhaṇĕ hatthi-jūhu  $  jiha dujjaṇa-jaṇĕ sajjaṇa-samūhu
jiha kiviṇa-ṇihelaṇĕ paṇaï-vindu  $  jiha vahula-pakkhĕ khaẏa-divasa-candu
jiha kāmiṇi-jaṇu māṇusĕ adavvĕ  $  jiha sammaddaṃsaṇu dūra-bhavvĕ
jiha mahuari-kulu duggandhĕ raṇṇĕ  $  jiha guru-garahiu aṇṇāṇa-kaṇṇĕ
jiha parama-sokkhu saṃsāra-dhammĕ  $  jiha jīva-daẏā-varu pāva-kammĕ
paḍhama-vihaṭṭihĕ tappurisu jema  $  ṇa paīsaï ujjhahĕ cakku tema
ghattā:
taṃ pekkhĕvi thakkantaü  $  vigghu karantaü  $  ṇaravaï vehāviddhaü
    "kahahu manti-sāmantahŏ  $  jaẏa-jasa-mantahŏ  $  kiṃ mahu ko vi asiddhaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 2:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi mantihĩ vuttu ema  $  jaṃ cintahi taṃ taṃ siddhu deva
chakkhaṇḍa vasundhari ṇava ṇihāṇa  $  caüdaha-vihehĩ raẏaṇĕhĩ samāṇa
ṇavaṇavaï sahāsa mahāgarāhũ  $  vattīsa sahasa desantarāhũ
avarāi mi siddhaĩ jāĩ jāĩ  $  ko lakkhĕvi sakkaï tāĩ tāĩ
para ekku ṇa sijjhaï sāhimāṇu  $  saẏa-pañca-savāẏa-dhaṇu-ppamāṇu
titthaṅkara-ṇandaṇu tuha kaṇiṭṭhu  $  aṭṭhāṇavaïhĩ bhāihĩ variṭṭhu
poaṇa-paramesaru carama-dehu  $  akhaliẏa-maraṭṭu jaẏalacchi-gehu
duvvāra-vaïri-vīranta-kālu  $  ṇāmeṇa vāhuvali vala-visālu
ghattā:
sīhu jema pakkhariẏaü  $  khantiĕ dhariẏaü  $  jaï so kaha vi viẏaṭṭaï
    to sahũ khandhāvāreṃ  $  ekka-pahāreṃ  $  paï mi deva dalavaṭṭaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 3:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi daṭṭhāhareṇa  $  bharaheṇa bharaha-paramesareṇa
paṭṭhaviẏa mahantā turiẏa tāsu  $  "vuccaï karĕ kera ṇarāhivāsu
jaï ṇaü paḍivaṇṇu kaẏāvi ema  $  tā tema karahu mahu bhiḍaï jema"
sikkhaviẏa mahantā gaẏa turanta  $  ṇivisaddheṃ poẏaṇa-ṇaẏaru patta
pujjĕvi pucchiẏa "āgamaṇu kāĩ"  $  tehi mi kahiẏaĩ vaẏaṇāĩ tāĩ
"ko tuhũ ko bharahu ṇa bheu ko vi  $  puhavīsaru dīsaï gampi to vi
jiha bhāẏara aṭṭhāṇavaï iẏara  $  jīvanti karĕvi tahŏ taṇiẏa kera
tiha tuhu mi maḍappharu pariharevi  $  jiu rāẏahŏ kerī kera levi"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi bhaẏa-bhīseṃ  $  vāhuvalīseṃ  $  bharaha-dūa ṇibbhacchiẏa
    "ekka kera vappikkī  $  pihimi-gurukkī  $  avara kera ṇa paḍicchiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 4:
pavasanteṃ parama-jiṇesareṇa  $  jaṃ kiṃ pi vihañjĕvi diṇṇu teṇa
taṃ amhahũ sāsaṇu suha-ṇihāṇu  $  kiu vippiu ṇaü keṇa vi samāṇu
so pihimihĕ haũ poẏaṇahŏ sāmi  $  ṇaü demi ṇa lemi ṇa pāsu jāmi
diṭṭheṇa teṇa kira kavaṇu kajju  $  kiṃ tāsu pasāeṃ karami rajju
kiṃ tahŏ valeṇa haũ duṇṇivāru  $  kiṃ tahŏ valeṇa mahu purisaẏāru
kiṃ tahŏ valeṇa pāikka-lou  $  kiṃ tahŏ valeṇa sampaẏa-vihou
jaṃ gajjiu vāhuvalīsareṇa  $  poẏaṇa-puravara-paramesareṇa
taṃ kovāṇala-pajalantaehĩ  $  ṇibbhacchiu bharaha-mahantaehĩ
ghattā:
"jaï vi tujjhu imu maṇḍalu  $  vahu-cintiẏa-phalu  $  āsi samappiu vappeṃ
     gāmu sīmu khalu khettu vi  $  sarisava-mettu vi  $  to vi ṇāhĩ viṇu kappeṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi palamva-vāhu  $  ṇaṃ candāiccahũ kuviu rāhu
"kahŏ taṇaü rajju kahŏ taṇaü bharahu  $  jaṃ jāṇahu taṃ mahu milĕvi karahu
so ekkeṃ cakkeṃ vahaï gavvu  $  kira vasikiu maĩ mahivīḍhu savvu
ṇaü jāṇaï hosaï kema kajju  $  kahŏ pāsiu ṇīsāvaṇṇu rajju
pariẏalaï jeṇa tahŏ taṇaü dappu  $  taṃ tehaü kallaĕ demi kappu
vāvalla-bhalla-kaṇṇiẏa-karālu  $  muggara-musuṇḍhi-paṭṭisa-visālu"
taṃ suṇĕvi mahantā gaẏa turanta  $  ṇivisaddheṃ bharahahŏ pāsu patta
jaṃ jema caviu taṃ kahiu tema  $  "paĩ tiṇa-sariso vi ṇa gaṇaï deva
ghattā:
ṇa karaï kera tuhārī  $  riu-khaẏa-kārī  $  ṇibbhaü māṇĕ mahāiu
    meiṇi-ravaṇu samuḍḍĕvi  $  raṇa-piḍu maṇḍĕvi  $  jujjha-sajju thiu dāiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jhatti palittu rāu  $  ṇaṃ jalaṇu jāla-mālā-sahāu
devāviu lahu saṇṇāha-tūru  $  saṇṇajjhaï sa-rahasu suhaḍa-sūru
āūriu valu caüraṅgu tāma  $  aṭṭhāraha akkhohaṇiu jāma
paricintiẏa ṇava ṇihi saṃcalanti  $  je sandaṇa-veseṃ paribhamanti
mahakālu kālu māṇavaü paṇḍu  $  paümakkhu saṅkhu piṅgalu pacaṇḍu
ṇaïsappu raẏaṇu ṇava ṇihiu eẏa  $  ṇaṃ thiẏa vahu-bhāẏahĩ puṇṇa-bheẏa
ṇava-joẏaṇāĩ tuṅgattaṇeṇa  $  vāraha sappāsaṅgattaṇeṇa
aṭṭhoẏara gambhīrattaṇeṇa  $  sahũ jakkha-sahāseṃ rakkhaṇeṇa
kŏ vi vatthaĩ kŏ vi bhoẏaṇaĩ dei  $  kŏ vi raẏaṇaĩ kŏ vi paharaṇaĩ ṇei
kŏ vi haẏa gaẏa kŏ vi osahiu dharaï  $  viṇṇāṇāharaṇahũ ko vi haraï
ghattā:
camma-cakka-seṇāvaï  $  haẏa-gaẏa-gahavaï  $  chatta-daṇḍa ṇemittiẏa
      kāgaṇi-maṇi-tthavaï thiẏa  $  khagga-purohiẏa  $  te vi caüddaha cintiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 7:
gaü bharahu paẏāṇaü devi jāma  $  heriĕhĩ kaṇiṭṭhahŏ kahiu tāma
"sahasā ṇīsaru saṇṇahĕvi deva  $  dīsaï paḍivakkhu samuddu jema"
taṃ suṇĕvi sa-rosu palamva-vāhu  $  saṇṇajjhaï poẏaṇa-ṇaẏara-ṇāhu
paḍu paḍaha samāhaẏa diṇṇa saṅkha  $  dhaẏa-daṇḍa chatta ubbhiẏa asaṅkha
kiu kalaẏalu laïẏaĩ paharaṇāĩ  $  kara-pahara-paẏaṭṭaĩ vāhaṇāĩ
ṇīsariu satta saṅkhohaṇīu  $  ekkaĕ seṇṇaĕ akkhohaṇīu
bharahesara-vāhuvalī vi te vi  $  āsaṇṇaĩ ḍhukkaĩ valaĩ ve vi
 $  savaḍaṃmuha dhaẏa dhaẏavaḍahũ devi
haẏa haẏahũ mahā-gaẏa gaẏavarāhũ  $  bhaḍa bhaḍahũ mahā-raha rahavarāhũ
ghattā:
devāsura-vala-sarisaĩ  $  vaḍḍhiẏa-harisaĩ  $  kañcuẏa-kavaẏa-visaṭṭaĩ
      ekkamekka kokkantaĩ  $  raṇĕ hakkantaĩ  $  ubhaẏa-valaĩ abbhiṭṭaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 8:
abbhiṭṭaĩ vaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalāĩ  $  bharahesara-vāhuvalī-valāĩ
vāhiẏa-raha-coiẏa-vāraṇāĩ  $  aṇavaraẏāmelliẏa-paharaṇāĩ
lua-juṇṇa-jotta-khaṇḍiẏa-dhurāĩ  $  dāriẏa-ṇiẏamva-kappiẏa-urāĩ
ṇivvaṭṭiẏa-bhua-pāḍiẏa-sirāĩ  $  dhuẏa-khandha-kavandha-paṇaccirāĩ
gaẏa-danta-choha-bhiṇṇubbhaḍāĩ  $  uccāiẏa-paḍipelliẏa-bhaḍāĩ
paḍihaẏa-viṇivāiẏa-gaẏaghaḍāĩ  $  acchoḍiẏa-moḍiẏa-dhaẏavaḍāĩ
musumūriẏa-cūriẏa-rahavarāĩ  $  dalavaṭṭiẏa-loṭṭiẏa-haẏavarāĩ
ruhirollaĩ sarĕhĩ vihāviẏāĩ  $  ṇaṃ ve vi kusumbhĕhĩ rāviẏāĩ
ghattā:
pekkhĕvi valaĩ ghulantaĩ  $  mahihĩ paḍantaĩ  $  mantihĩ dhariẏa "ma bhaṇḍahŏ
    kiṃ vahieṇa varāeṃ  $  bhaḍa-saṃghāeṃ  $  diṭṭhi-jujjhu vari maṇḍahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 9:
pahilaü jujjhevaü diṭṭhi-jujjhu  $  jala-jujjhu paḍīvaü malla-jujjhu
jo tiṇṇi mi jujjhaĩ jiṇaï ajju  $  tahŏ ṇihi tahŏ raẏaṇaĩ tāsu rajju"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi dukkhu ṇivāriẏāĩ  $  sāhaṇaĩ ve vi osāriẏāĩ
lahu diṭṭhi-jujjhu pāraddhu tehĩ  $  jiṇa-ṇanda-suṇandā-ṇandaṇehĩ
avaloiu bharaheṃ paḍhamu bhāi  $  kaïlāseṃ kañcaṇa-saïlu ṇāĩ
asiẏa-siẏāẏamva vihāi diṭṭhi  $  ṇaṃ kuvalaẏa-kamala-ravinda-viṭṭhi
puṇu joiu vāhuvalīsareṇa  $  sarĕ kumuẏa-saṇḍu ṇaṃ diṇaẏareṇa
avarāmuha-heṭṭhāmuha-muhāĩ  $  ṇaṃ vara-vahu-vaẏaṇa-saroruhāĩ
ghattā:
uvarilliẏaĕ visālaĕ  $  bhiuḍi-karālaĕ  $  heṭṭhima diṭṭhi parajjiẏa
    ṇaṃ ṇava-jovvaṇaïttī  $  cañcala-cittī  $  kulavahu ijjaĕ tajjiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 10:
jaṃ jiṇĕvi ṇa sakkiu diṭṭhi-jujjhu  $  pāraddhu khaṇaddheṃ salila-jujjhu
jalĕ païṭha pihimi-poẏaṇa-ṇarinda  $  ṇaṃ māṇasa-saravarĕ sura-gaïnda
etthantarĕ mahi-paramesareṇa  $  āḍohĕvi salilu samacchareṇa
pammukka jhalakka sahoẏarāsu  $  ṇaṃ vela samuddeṃ mahiharāsu
chuḍu vāhuvalihĕ vacchaẏalu patta  $  ṇibbhacchiẏa asaï va puṇu ṇiẏatta
para thiẏa urĕ toẏa-tusāra dhavala  $  ṇaṃ ṇahĕ tārā-ṇiurumva-vahala
puṇu pacchaĕ vāhuvalīsareṇa  $  āmelliẏa salila-jhalakka teṇa
uddhāiẏa cala-ṇimmala-taraṅga  $  ṇaṃ saṃcārima āẏāsa-gaṅga
ghattā:
ohaṭṭiu bharahesaru  $  thiu muha-kāẏaru  $  garua-rahallaĕ laïẏaü
    suraẏāruhaṇa-viẏakkaĕ  $  viraha-jhalakkaĕ  $  bhaggu va duppavvaïẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 11:
jaṃ jiṇĕvi ṇa sakkiu salila-jujjhu  $  pāraddhu paḍīvaü malla-jujjhu
āvīlavi kacchaü vala-mahalla  $  akkhāḍaĕ ṇāĩ païṭṭha malla
ovaggiẏa puṇu kiẏa vāhu-sadda  $  ṇaṃ bhiḍiẏa suvanta-tiẏanta-sadda
vahu-vandhahĩ ḍhukkara-kattarīhĩ  $  viṇṇāṇahĩ karaṇahĩ bhāmarīhĩ
sahũ bharaheṃ suharu karevi vāmu  $  puṇu pacchaĕ darisiu ṇiẏaẏa-thāmu
uccāiu ubhaẏa-karĕhĩ ṇarindu  $  sakkeṇa va jammaṇĕ jiṇa-varindu
etthantarĕ vāhuvalīsarāsu  $  āmelliu devĕhĩ kusuma-vāsu
kiu kalaẏalu sāhaṇĕ vijaü ghuṭṭhu  $  ṇaraṇāhu vilakkhīhūu suṭṭhu
ghattā:
cakka-raẏaṇu paricintiu  $  uppari ghattiu  $  carama-dehu teṃ vañciu
    pasariẏa-kara-ṇiurumveṃ  $  diṇaẏara-vimveṃ  $  ṇāĩ meru pariañciu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ mukku cakku cakkesareṇa  $  taṃ cintiu vāhuvalīsareṇa
"kiṃ pahu apphālami mahihĩ ajju  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ dhigatthu pariharami rajju
rajjahŏ kāraṇĕ kijjaï ajuttu  $  ghāevaü bhāẏaru vappu puttu
kiṃ āeṃ sāhami parama-mokkhu  $  jahĩ labbhaï acalu aṇantu sokkhu"
paricintĕvi suiru maṇeṇa ema  $  puṇu thaviu ṇarāhiu ḍimbhu jema
"mahu taṇiẏa pihimi tuhũ bhuñjĕ bhāẏa  $  somappahu kera karei rāẏa"
suṇisallu karĕvi jiṇu guru bhaṇevi  $  thiu pañca muṭṭhi sirĕ lou devi
olamviẏa-karaẏalu ekku varisu  $  aviolu acalu giri-meru-sarisu
ghattā:
veḍḍhiu suṭṭhu visālĕhĩ  $  vellī-jālĕhĩ  $  ahi-vicchiẏa-vammīẏahĩ
    khaṇu vi ṇa mukku bhaḍāraü  $  maẏaṇa-viẏāraü  $  ṇaṃ saṃsārahŏ bhīẏahĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 13:
etthantarĕ kevala-ṇāṇa-vāhu  $  kaïlāsĕ pariṭṭhiu risahaṇāhu
taïlokka-piẏāmahu jaga-jaṇeru  $  samasaraṇu vi sa-gaṇu sa-pāḍiheru
thovĕhĩ divasĕhĩ bharahesaro vi  $  tahŏ vandaṇa-hattiĕ āu so vi
thottuggīriẏa guru-puraü bhāi  $  paraloẏa-mūlĕ ihalou ṇāĩ
vandeppiṇu dasaviha-dhamma-pālu  $  puṇu pucchiu tihuvaṇa-sāmisālu
"vāhuvali bhaḍārā suha-ṇihāṇu  $  keṃ kajjeṃ ajju ṇa hoi ṇāṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi parama-jiṇesareṇa  $  vajjariu divva-bhāsantareṇa
"ajja vi īsīsi kasāu tāsu  $  jaṃ khettĕ tuhāraĕ kiu ṇivāsu
ghattā:
jaï bharahahŏ ji samappiu  $  to kiṃ cappiu  $  maĩ calaṇĕhĩ mahi-maṇḍalu
    eṇa kasāeṃ laïẏaü  $  so pavvaïẏaü  $  teṇa ṇa pāvaï kevalu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 4, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi gaü bharahu tetthu  $  vāhuvali-bhaḍāraü acalu jetthu
savvaṅgu paḍiu calaṇehĩ tāsu  $  "taü taṇiẏa pihimi haũ tumha dāsu"
viṇṇavaï khamāvaï ema jāma  $  caü ghāi-kamma gaẏa khaẏahŏ tāma
uppaṇṇaü kevala-ṇāṇu vimalu  $  thiu dehu khaṇaddheṃ duddha-dhavalu
paümāsaṇu bhūsaṇu seẏa-camaru  $  bhā-maṇḍalu ekku jĕ chattu pavaru
atthakkaĕ āiu sura-ṇikāu  $  titthaẏara-puttu kevaliu jāu
thovahĩ divasahĩ tihuaṇa-jaṇāri  $  ṇāsiẏaghāiẏa-kamma vi caẏāri
aṭṭhaviha-kamma-vandhaṇa-vimukku  $  siddhaü siddhālaü ṇavara ḍhukku
ghattā:
risahu vi gaü ṇivvāṇahŏ  $  sāsaẏa-thāṇahŏ  $  bharahu vi ṇivvui pattaü
    akkakitti thiu ujjhahĕ  $  daṇu-duggejjhahĕ  $  rajju sa iṃ bhu ñjantaü
----------  [5. pañcamo saṃdhi]  ----------
akkhaï gottama-sāmi  $  tihuaṇa-laddha-pasaṃsahũ
suṇi seṇiẏa uppatti  $  rakkhasa-vāṇara-vaṃsahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 1:
tahĩ jĕ aüjjhahĩ vahaveṃ kāleṃ  $  ucchaṇṇeṃ ṇaravara-taru-jāleṃ
vimalekkhukka-vaṃsĕ uppaṇṇaü  $  dharaṇīdharu surūva-saṃpaṇṇaü
tāsu puttu ṇāmeṃ tiẏasañjaü  $  puṇu jiẏasattu raṇaṅgaṇĕ dujjaü
tāsu vijaẏa mahaevi maṇohara  $  pariṇiẏa thira-mālūra-paohara
tāhĕ gabbhĕ bhava-bhaẏa-khaẏa-gāraü  $  uppajjaï suu ajiẏa-bhaḍāraü
risahu jema vasuhāra-ṇimittaü  $  risahu jema meruhĩ ahisittaü
risahu jema thiu vālakkīlaĕ  $  risahu jema pariṇāviu līlaĕ
risahu jema rajju i bhuñjanteṃ  $  ekka-divaĕ ṇandaṇavaṇu janteṃ
ghattā:
pavaṇuddhuu saru diṭṭhu  $  papphulliẏa-saẏavattaü
    ṇāĩ vilāsiṇi-lou  $  ubbhiẏa-karu ṇaccantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 2:
so ji mahāsaru tahĩ jĕ vaṇālaĕ  $  diṭṭhu jiṇāhiveṇa vettālaĕ
maüliẏa-dalu vicchāẏa-saroruhu  $  ṇaṃ dujjaṇa-jaṇu ohulliẏa-muhu
taṃ ṇievi gaü parama-visāẏahŏ  $  "laï eha ji gaï jīvahŏ jāẏahŏ
jo jīvantu diṭṭhu puvvaṇhaĕ  $  so aṅgāra-puñju avaraṇhaĕ
jo ṇaravara-lakkhĕhĩ paṇavijjaï  $  so pahu muaü avāreṃ ṇijjaï
jiha sañjhāĕ eu paṅkaẏa-vaṇu  $  tiha jarāĕ ghāijjaï jovvaṇu
jīviu jamĕṇa sarīru huāseṃ  $  sattaĩ kāleṃ riddhi viṇāseṃ"
cintaï ema bhaḍāraü jāvĕhĩ  $  loẏantiẏahĩ vivohiu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
caüviha-deva-ṇikāĕṃ  $  āeṃ kali-mala-rahiẏaü
    jiṇu pavvaïu turantu  $  dasahĩ sahāsahĩ sahiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 3:
thiu chaṭṭhovavāsĕ sura-sāraü  $  vamhaẏatta-gharĕ thakku bhaḍāraü
risahu jema pāraṇaü kareppiṇu  $  caüdaha saṃvacchara vihareppiṇu
sukka-jhāṇu āūriu ṇimmalu  $  puṇu uppaṇṇu ṇāṇu tahŏ kevalu
aṭṭha vi pāḍihera samasaraṇaü  $  jiha risahahŏ tiha devāgamaṇaü
gaṇahara ṇavaï lakkhu vara-sāhuhũ  $  vammaha-malla-ṇisumbhaṇa-vāhuhũ
tahĩ jĕ kālĕ jiẏasattu-sahoẏaru  $  tiẏasañjaẏahŏ puttu jaẏasāẏaru
jaẏasāẏarahŏ puttu sumaṇoharu  $  ṇāmeṃ saẏaru saẏala-cakkesaru
bharahu jema sahũ ṇavahĩ ṇihāṇahĩ  $  raẏaṇĕhĩ caüdaha-vihahĩ pahāṇahĩ
ghattā:
saẏala-pihimi-paripālu  $  ekka-divasĕ caḍulaṅgeṃ
    jīu va kamma-vaseṇa  $  ṇiu avaharĕvi turaṅgeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 4:
duṭṭhu turaṅgamu cañcala-chāẏahŏ  $  gaẏaü paṇāsĕvi pacchima-bhāẏahŏ
païsaï suṇṇāraṇṇu mahāḍaï  $  jahĩ kali-kālahŏ hiẏavaü pāḍaï
dukkhu dukkhu hari damiu ṇarindeṃ  $  ṇaṃ maẏaraddhaü parama-jiṇindeṃ
tāma mahā-saru dīsaï sa-kamalu  $  cala-vīī taraṅga-bhaṅgura-jalu
tahĩ laẏa-maṇḍavĕ uppallāṇĕvi  $  salilu pievi turaṅgamu ṇhāṇĕvi
samu mellaï vettālahŏ jāvĕhĩ  $  tilaẏakesa sampāiẏa tāvĕhĩ
dhīẏa suloẏaṇāhŏ valavantahŏ  $  vahiṇi sahoẏari dasasaẏaṇettahŏ
kira sahũ sahiẏahĩ ḍhukkaï saravaru  $  dīsaï tāma saẏaru pihimīsaru
ghattā:
viddhī kāma-sarehĩ  $  ekku vi paü ṇa paẏaṭṭaï
    ṇāĩ saẏamvara-māla  $  diṭṭhi ṇivahŏ āvaṭṭaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 5:
keṇa vi kahiu gampi sahasakkhahŏ  $  "koūhalu kiṃ eu ṇa lakkhahŏ
ekku aṇaṅga-samāṇu juvāṇaü  $  ṇaü jāṇahũ kiṃ pihimihĕ rāṇaü
taṃ pekkhĕvi sasa tumhahã kerī  $  kāma-gaheṇa hūa vivarerī"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi rāu romañciu  $  abbhantarĕ āṇandu paṇacciu
"ṇemittiẏahĩ āsi jaṃ vuttaü  $  ĕu taṃ saẏarāgamaṇu ṇiruttaü"
maṇĕ paricintĕvi papphullāṇaṇu  $  gaü turantu tahĩ dasasaẏaloẏaṇu
teṃ caüsaṭṭhi-purisalakkhaṇa-dharu  $  jāṇĕvi saẏaru saẏala-cakkesaru
sirĕ karaẏala karevi jokkāriu  $  diṇṇa kaṇṇa puṇu purĕ païsāriu
ghattā:
līlaĕ bhavaṇu païṭṭhu  $  vijjāhara-pariveḍhiu
    tūsĕvi diṇṇaü teṇa  $  uttara-dāhiṇa-seḍhiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 6:
tilakesa laeppiṇu gaü saẏaru  $  païsariu aüjjhāuri-ṇaẏaru
sahasakkhu vi jaṇaṇa-vaïru sarĕvi  $  vijjāhara-sāhaṇu melavĕvi
gaü uppari tāsu puṇṇaghaṇahŏ  $  jeṃ jīviu hariu suloẏaṇahŏ
rahaṇeuracakkavāla-ṇaẏarĕ  $  viṇivāiu puṇṇamehu samarĕ
jo toẏadavāhaṇu tāsu suu  $  so raṇamuhĕ kaha vi kaha vi ṇa muu
gaü haṃsa-vimāṇeṃ tuṭṭha-maṇu  $  jahĩ ajiẏa-jiṇinda-samosaraṇu
mambhīsa diṇṇa amaresarĕṇa  $  sa-vaïra-vittantu kahiu ṇarĕṇa
je riu aṇupacchaĕ lagga tahŏ  $  gaẏa pāsu paḍīvā ṇiẏa-ṇivahŏ
ghattā:
toẏadavāhaṇu deva  $  pāṇa laeviṇu ṇaṭṭhaü
    jima siddhālaĕ siddhu  $  tima samasaraṇĕ païṭṭhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pahu jhaṭṭi palittaü  $  ṇaṃ khaḍa-hāru huāsaṇĕ ghittaü
"maru maru jaï vi jāi pāẏālahŏ  $  visahara-bhavaṇa-mūla-ghaṇa-jālahŏ
païsaï jaï vi saraṇu sura-sevahũ  $  dasaviha-bhāvaṇavāsiẏa-devahũ
païsaï jaï vi saraṇu thira-thāṇahũ  $  aṭṭha-vihahũ vintara-givvāṇahũ
païsaï jaï vi saraṇu duvvārahũ  $  joisa-devahũ pañca-paẏārahũ
kappāmarahũ jaï vi ahamindahũ  $  varuṇa-pavaṇa-vaïsavaṇa-surindahũ
maraï to vi mahu toẏadavāhaṇu"  $  païja karĕvi gaü dasasaẏaloẏaṇu
pekkhĕvi māṇatthambhu jiṇindahŏ  $  maccharu māṇu vi galiu ṇarindahŏ
so vi gampi samasaraṇu païṭṭhaü  $  jiṇu paṇaveppiṇu puraü ṇiviṭṭhaü
vihi mi bhavantarāĩ vajjariẏaĩ  $  vihi mi jaṇaṇa-vaïraĩ parihariẏaĩ
ghattā:
bhīma-subhīmĕhĩ tāma  $  ahiṇava-gahiẏa-pasāhaṇu
      puvva-bhavantara-ṇehĕ  $  avaruṇḍiu ghaṇavāhaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 8:
pabhaṇaï bhīmu bhīma-bhaḍa-bhañjaṇu  $  "tuhũ mahu aṇṇa-bhavantarĕ ṇandaṇu
jiha ciru tiha evahi mi piẏāraü"  $  cumviu puṇu vi puṇu vi saẏavāraü
"laï kāmuka-vimāṇu aviẏāreṃ  $  laï rakkhasiẏa vijja sahũ hāreṃ
aṇṇu vi raẏaṇāẏara-pariẏañciẏa  $  duppaïsāra surehi mi vañciẏa
tīsa parama joẏaṇa vitthiṇṇī  $  laṅkā-ṇaẏari tujjhu maĩ diṇṇī
aṇṇu vi ekka-vāra chajjoẏaṇa  $  laï pāẏālalaṅka ghaṇavāhaṇa"
bhīma-mahābhīmahũ āeseṃ  $  diṇṇu paẏāṇaü maṇĕ parioseṃ
vimalakitti-vimalāmala-mantihĩ  $  parimiu avarehi mi sāmantĕhĩ
ghattā:
laṅkāurihĩ païṭṭhu  $  avicalu rajjĕ pariṭṭhiu
   rakkhasa-vaṃsahŏ ṇāĩ  $  pahilaü kandu samuṭṭhiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 9:
vahaveṃ kāleṃ vala-saṃpattiĕ  $  ajiẏa-jiṇahŏ gaü vandaṇa-hattiĕ
taṃ samasaraṇu paīsaï jāvĕhĩ  $  saẏaru vi tahĩ jĕ parāiu tāvĕhĩ
pucchiu ṇāhu pihimi-paripāleṃ  $  "kaï hosanti bhavanteṃ kāleṃ
tumheṃ jehā vaẏa-guṇa-vantā  $  kaï titthaẏara deva aïkantā
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kandappa-viẏāraü  $  māgaha-bhāsaĕ kahaï bhaḍāraü
"maĩ jehaü kevala-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  ekku ji risahu deu uppaṇṇaü
paĩ jehaü chakkhaṇḍa-pahāṇaü  $  bharaha-ṇarāhiu ekku ji rāṇaü
paĩ viṇu dasa hosanti ṇaresara  $  maĩ viṇu vāvīsa vi titthaṅkara
ṇava valaeva ṇava ji ṇārāẏaṇa  $  hara eẏāraha ṇava ji dasāṇaṇa
aṇṇu vi ekkuṇasaṭṭhi purāṇaĩ  $  jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ hosanti pahāṇaĩ"
ghattā:
toẏadavāhaṇu tāma  $  bhāveṃ pulaü vahantaü
      dasa-uttarĕṇa saeṇa  $  bharahu jema ṇikkhantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 10:
ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇahŏ ṇihaẏa-paḍivakkhahŏ  $  laṅkā-ṇaẏari diṇṇa maharakkhahŏ
vahaveṃ kāleṃ sāsaẏa-thāṇahŏ  $  ajiẏa-bhaḍāraü gaü ṇivvāṇahŏ
saẏarahŏ saẏala pihimi bhuñjantahŏ  $  raẏaṇa-ṇihāṇaĩ paripālantahŏ
saṭṭhi sahāsa hūẏa vara-puttahũ  $  saẏala-kalā-viṇṇāṇa-ṇiuttahũ
ekka-divasĕ jiṇa-bhavaṇa-ṇivāsahŏ  $  vandaṇa-hattiĕ gaẏa kaïlāsahŏ
bharaha-kiẏaĩ maṇi-kañcaṇa-māṇaĩ  $  caüvīsa vi vandeppiṇu thāṇaĩ
bhaṇaï bhaīrahi suṭṭhu viẏakkhaṇu  $  "karahũ kiṃ pi jiṇa-bhavaṇahũ rakkhaṇu
kaḍḍhĕvi gaṅga bhamāḍahũ pāsĕhĩ"  $  taṃ ji samatthiu bhāi-sahāsĕhĩ
ghattā:
daṇḍa-raẏaṇu paricintĕvi  $  khoṇi khaṇantu bhamāḍiu
    pāẏālaïrihĕ ṇāĩ  $  viẏaḍa-uratthalu phāḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 11:
takkhaṇĕ khou jāu ahi-loẏahŏ  $  dharaṇindahŏ sahāsa-phaḍa-ḍoẏahŏ
āsīvisa-diṭṭhiĕ ṇikkhattiẏa  $  saẏala vi chārahŏ puñju pavattiẏa
kaha vi kaha vi ṇa vi diṭṭhihĩ paḍiẏā  $  bhīma-bhaīrahi ve uvvariẏā
dummaṇa dīṇa-vaẏaṇa pariẏattā  $  lahu sakkeẏa-ṇaẏari saṃpattā
mantihĩ kahiu "kaha vi tiha bhindahŏ  $  jiha uḍḍanti ṇa pāṇa ṇarindahŏ"
tāma sahā-maṇḍaü maṇḍijjaï  $  āsaṇu āsaṇeṇa pīḍijjaï
mehalu mehaleṇa ālaggeṃ  $  hāreṃ hāru maüḍu maüḍaggeṃ
saẏara-ṇarindāsaṇa-saṃkāsaĩ  $  vaïsaṇāhũ vāṇavaï sahāsaïṃ
ghattā:
ṇaravaï āula-cittu  $  savvatthāṇu vihāvaï
   saṭṭhi-sahāsahũ majjhĕ  $  ekku vi puttu ṇa āvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 12:
bhīma-bhaīrahi tāma païṭṭhā  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-āsaṇĕ gampi ṇiviṭṭhā
pucchiẏa puṇu paripāliẏa-rajjeṃ  $  "iẏara ṇa païsaranti kiṃ kajjeṃ
tehĩ viṇāsaṇāĩ vicchāẏaĩ  $  tāmarasāĩ va ṇiddhuẏagāẏaĩ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu tahŏ mantihĩ  $  jāṇāviu pacchaṇṇa-paüttihĩ
"he ṇaravaï ṇiẏa-kulahŏ paīvā  $  gaẏa diẏahā kiṃ enti paḍīvā
jalavāhiṇi-pavāha ṇivvūḍhā  $  pariẏattanti kāĩ te mūḍhā
ghaṇa-ghaṭṭiẏaĩ vijju-vipphuriẏaĩ  $  suviṇaẏa-vālabhāva-saṃcariẏaĩ
jalavuvvuva-taraṅga-suracāvaĩ  $  kaï dīsanti viṇāsu ṇa bhāvaï
ghattā:
bharaha-vāhuvali-risaha  $  kāla-bhuaṅgeṃ giliẏā
    kaü dīsanti paḍīvā  $  ujjhahĩ ekkahĩ miliẏā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 13:
jaṃ ṇiddarisu samāsaĕ diṇṇaü  $  taṃ cakkavaïhĕ hiẏavaü bhiṇṇaü
"teṇa jĕ te atthāṇu ṇa ḍhukkā  $  phuḍu mahu keraü pesaṇu cukkā"
laddhāvasarĕhĩ jaṃ aṇuhuttaü  $  bhaïrahi-bhīmahĩ kahiu ṇiruttaü
taṃ ṇisuṇevi rāu mucchaṃgaü  $  paḍiu mahaddumu vva pavaṇāhaü
tahi mi kālĕ sāmiẏa-sammāṇĕhĩ  $  bhiccĕhĩ jema ṇa melliu pāṇĕhĩ
dukkhu dukkhu dūrujjhiẏa-veẏaṇu  $  uṭṭhiu savvaṅgāgaẏa-ceẏaṇu
"kiṃ soeṃ kiṃ khandhāvāreṃ  $  vari pāvajja lemi aviẏāreṃ
āẏaĕ lacchiĕ vahu jujjhāviẏa  $  pāhuṇaẏā iva vahu volāviẏa
ghattā:
jo jo ko vi juvāṇu  $  tāsu tāsu kulaüttī
    meiṇi cheñchaï jema  $  kavaṇeṃ ṇarĕṇa ṇa bhuttī"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 14:
pabhaṇiu bhīmu "hohi diḍhu rajjahŏ  $  haũ puṇu jāmi thāmi ṇiẏa-kajjahŏ"
teṇa vi vuttu "ṇāhi vaü bhañjami  $  cheñchaï paĩ ji kahiẏa ṇaü bhuñjami"
cattu bhīmu bhaïrahi hakkāriu  $  diṇṇa pihimi vaïsaṇĕ vaïsāriu
appuṇu bharahu jema ṇikkhantaü  $  taü karevi puṇu ṇivvui pattaü
tā ettahĕ viṇihaẏa-paḍivakkhahŏ  $  rajju karantahŏ tahŏ maharakkhahŏ
devarakkhu uppaṇṇaü ṇandaṇu  $  ṇaravaï ekka-divasĕ gaü uvavaṇu
kīlaṇa-vāvihĕ parimiu ṇārihĩ  $  ṇhāi gaïndu va sahũ gaṇiẏārihĩ
ṇivaḍiẏa tāsu diṭṭhi tahĩ avasarĕ  $  jahĩ muu mahuẏaru kamalabbhantarĕ
ghattā:
cintiu "jiha dhuagāu  $  rasa-lampaḍu acchantaü
    tiha kāmāuru savvu  $  kāmiṇi-vaẏaṇāsattaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 15:
ṇiẏa-maṇĕ jāi visāẏahŏ jāvĕhĩ  $  savaṇa-saṅghu saṃpāiu tāvĕhĩ
saẏala vi risi tiẏāla-jogesara  $  mahakaï gamaẏa vāi vāīsara
saẏala vi vandhu-sattu-samabhāvā  $  tiṇa-kañcaṇa-pariharaṇa-sahāvā
saẏala vi jalla-malaṅkiẏa-dehā  $  dhīrattaṇĕṇa mahīhara-jehā
saẏala vi ṇiẏa-tava-teeṃ diṇaẏara  $  gambhīrattaṇeṇa raẏaṇāẏara
saẏala vi ghora-vīra-tava-tattā  $  saẏala vi saẏala-saṅga-paricattā
saẏala vi kamma-vandha-viddhaṃsaṇa  $  saẏala vi saẏala-jīva-mambhīsaṇa
saẏala vi paramāgama-pariẏāṇā  $  kāẏa-kilesekkekka-pahāṇā
ghattā:
saẏala vi carama-sarīra  $  saẏala vi ujjuẏa-cittā
    ṇaṃ pariṇaṇahã paẏaṭṭa  $  siddhi-vahuẏa varaïttā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 5, Kaḍavaka 16:
to etthantarĕ pahu āṇandiu  $  so risi-saṅghu turanteṃ vandiu
pabhaṇiu viṇṇavevi "suẏasāẏara  $  bho bho bhavvambhoẏa-divāẏara
bhava-saṃsāra-mahaṇṇava-ṇāsiẏa  $  karĕ pasāu pavvajjahĕ sāmiẏa"
jampaï sāhu "sāhu laṅkesara  $  paĩ jīvevaü aṭṭha jĕ vāsara
jaṃ jāṇahi taṃ karahi turantaü"  $  ṇivisaddheṇa so vi ṇikkhantaü
aṭṭha divasa saṃllehaṇa bhāvĕvi  $  aṭṭha divasa dāṇaĩ devāvĕvi
aṭṭha divasa pujjaü ṇīsārĕvi  $  aṭṭha divasa paḍimaü ahisārĕvi
aṭṭha divasa ārāhaṇa vāĕvi  $  gaü mokkhahŏ paramappaü jhāṇĕvi
ghattā:
tahŏ maharakkhahŏ puttu  $  devarakkhu valavantaü
    thiu amarāhiu jema  $  laṅka sa ïṃ bhu ñjantaü
----------  [6. chaṭṭho saṃdhi]  ----------
caüsaṭṭhihĩ siṃhāsaṇĕhĩ aïkantĕhĩ āṇantaĕ bhittiĕ
puṇu uppaṇṇu kittidhavalu dhavaliu jeṇa bhuaṇu ṇiẏa-kittiĕ
