paramesaru jampaï jaï-pavaru  $  taï-kāla-vuddhi caü-ṇāṇa-dharu
"dhammeṇa jāṇa-jampāṇa-dhaẏa  $  dhammeṇa bhicca-raha-turaẏa-gaẏa
dhammeṇāharaṇa-vilevaṇaĩ  $  dhammeṇa ṇiẏāsaṇa-bhoẏaṇaĩ
dhammeṇa kalattaĩ maṇaharaĩ  $  dhammeṇa chuhā-paṇḍura-gharaĩ
dhammeṇa piṇḍa-pīṇa-tthaṇaü  $  camaraĩ pāḍanti varaṅgaṇaü
dhammeṇa maṇuẏa-devattaṇaĩ  $  valaeva-vāsuevattaṇaĩ
dhammeṇa aruha-siddhattaṇaĩ  $  titthaṅkara-cakkaharattaṇaĩ
ghattā:
ekkeṃ dhammeṃ hontaĕṇa  $  indā deva vi seva karanti
    dhamma-vihūṇahŏ māṇusahŏ  $  caṇḍāla vi paṅgaṇaĕ ṇa ṭhanti"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 6, Kaḍavaka 15:
taḍikeseṃ pucchiu puṇu vi guru  $  "aṇṇahĩ bhavĕ ko haũ ko va suru"
jaï jampaï "ṇisuṇuttara-disaĕ  $  jāo 'si āsi kāsī-visaĕ
tuhũ sāhu ehu dhāṇukku tahĩ  $  āiu taru-mūlĕ vi thiŏ 'si jahĩ
ṇigganthu ṇiĕvi uvahāsu kaü  $  īsīsuppaṇṇu kasāu taü
bhañjĕvi kāvittha-sagga-gamaṇu  $  patto 'si ṇavara joisa-bhavaṇu
tatthahŏ vi caveppiṇu suddhamaï  $  hūo 'si ettha laṅkāhivaï
dhāṇukkiu hiṇḍĕvi bhava-gahaṇĕ  $  uppaṇṇu pavaṅgamu pamaẏa-vaṇĕ
paĩ haü samāhi-maraṇeṇa muu  $  puṇu gampiṇu uvahi-kumāru huu"
tā
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi laṅkesarĕṇa  $  rajjĕ sukesu thavĕvi paramattheṃ
    muĕvi ku-vesa va rāẏa-siẏa  $  tava-siẏa-vahuẏa laïẏa saĩ hattheṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 6, Kaḍavaka 16:
jaṃ vijjukesu ṇigganthu thiu  $  pañcĕhĩ muṭṭhihĩ sirĕ lou kiu
taṃ kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-kuṇḍala-dharĕṇa  $  sammattu laïu diḍhu suravarĕṇa
etthantarĕ kikka-puresarahŏ  $  gaü lehu kaïddhaẏa-seharahŏ
mahi-maṇḍalĕ ghattiu diṭṭhu kiha  $  ṇāvālaü gaṅgā-vāhu jiha
vandhaṇa-vimukku ṇaṃ ṇiraẏaülu  $  vaṅkuḍaü sahāveṃ jema khalu
juvaī jaṇu vaṇṇu samuvvahaï  $  āẏariu va cariu kahaü kahaï
ṇaṃ akkhara-pantihĩ pahu bhaṇiu  $  "tumhahũ sukesu paripālaṇiu
taḍikeseṃ tava-siẏa laïẏa karĕ  $  jaṃ jāṇahi taṃ pahu tuhu mi karĕ
ghattā:
lehu ghiveppiṇu uvahiraü  $  puttahŏ rajju devi ṇikkhantaü
    purĕ paḍicandu pariṭṭhiẏaü  $  vāṇaradīu sa ïṃ bhu ñjantaü
----------  [7. sattamo saṃdhi]  ----------
paḍicandahŏ jāẏa  $  kikkindhandhaẏa pavara-bhuva
ṇaṃ risaha-jiṇāsu  $  bharaha-vāhuvali ve vi suva
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 1:
chuḍu chuḍu sarīra-saṃpatti patta  $  tahĩ avasarĕ keṇa vi kahiẏa vatta
"veẏaḍḍha-kaḍaĕ dhaṇa-kaṇaẏa-paürĕ  $  dāhiṇa-seḍhihĩ āiccaṇaẏarĕ
vijjāmandaru ṇāmeṇa rāu  $  veẏamaï-agga-mahisiĕ sahāu
sirimāla-ṇāma tahŏ taṇiẏa duhiẏa  $  indīvaracchi chaṇa-canda-muhiẏa
kaẏalī-kandala-somāla vāla  $  sā paraĕ ghivesaï kahŏ vi māla"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pavara-kaïddhaehĩ  $  gamu sajjiu kikkindhandhaehĩ
ḍhoiẏaĩ vimāṇaĩ caḍiẏa joha  $  saṃcalla ṇahaṅgaṇĕ diṇṇa-soha
ṇivisaddheṃ dāhiṇa-seḍhi patta  $  jahĩ miliẏā vijjāhara samatta
ghattā:
kikkindheṃ diṭṭhu  $  dhaü rāulaü su(?)pavaṇahaü
    hakkāraï ṇāĩ  $  karaẏalu sirimālahĕ taṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 2:
ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-thāṇehĩ ṇivaddha mañca  $  mahakavi-kavvālāva va su-sañca
ārūḍha savva mañcesu tesu  $  cāmiẏara-gatta-maṇi-bhūsiesu
paribhamira-bhamara-jhaṅkāriesu  $  ṇiviḍāẏavatta-andhāriesu
ravikanta-kanti-ujjāliesu  $  ālāvaṇi-sadda-vamāliesu
mañcesu tesu thiẏa pahu caḍevi  $  vammaha-ṇaḍa ṇāḍijjanti(?) ke vi
bhūsanti sarīraĩ vāravāra  $  kaṇṭhāĩ muanti laẏanti hāra
sundara sacchāẏa vi kaṇaẏa-ḍora  $  aliẏaṃ ji ghivanti bhaṇevi thora
gāẏanti hasanti puṇāsaṇattha  $  aṅgaĩ moḍanti valanti hattha
ghattā:
sa-pasāhaṇa savva  $  thiẏa sammuha varaïtta kiha
    "kira hosaï siddhi"  $  āẏaĕ āsaĕ samaẏa jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 3:
sirimāla tāma kariṇihĕ valagga  $  ṇaṃ vijju mahā-ghaṇa-koḍi-lagga
saẏalāharaṇālaṅkariẏa-deha  $  ṇaṃ ṇahĕ ummilliẏa canda-leha
aggima-gaṇiẏārihĕ caḍiẏa dhāi  $  ṇisi-puraü pariṭṭhiẏa sañjha ṇāi
darisāviu ṇara-ṇiurumvu tīĕ  $  ṇaṃ vaṇa-siri taruvara mahuẏarīĕ
"uhu sundari candāṇaṇa-kumāru  $  ugghāu ūhu raṇĕ duṇṇivāru
uhu vijaẏasīhu riu-palaẏa-kālu  $  rahaṇeura-puravara-sāmisālu
saẏala vi ṇaravara vañcanti jāi  $  avarāgama sammādiṭṭhi ṇāĩ
pura ujjovantiẏa dīvi jema  $  pacchaï andhāru karanti tema
ṇaṃ siddhi ku-muṇivara pariharanti  $  duggandha rukkha ṇaṃ bhamara-panti
ghattā:
gaṇiẏāriĕ vāla  $  ṇiẏa kikkindhahŏ pāsu kiha
      sari-salila-rahalliĕ (?)  $  kalahaṃsahŏ kalahaṃsi jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 4:
kikkindhahŏ ghalliẏa māla tāĕ  $  ṇaṃ mehesarahŏ suloẏaṇāĕ
āsaṇṇa pariṭṭhiẏa vimala-deha  $  ṇaṃ kaṇaẏagirihĕ ṇava-candaleha
vicchāẏa jāẏa saẏala vi ṇarinda  $  sasi-joṇhaĕ viṇu ṇaṃ mahiharinda
ṇaṃ ku-tavasi parama-gaīhĕ cukka  $  ṇaṃ paṅkaẏa-sara ravi-kanti-mukka
etthantarĕ sirimālā-vaīhu  $  kovaggi-palīviu vijaẏasīhu
abbhantarĕ vijjāhara-varāhũ  $  païsāru diṇṇu kiṃ vaṇṇarāhũ
uddālahŏ vahu varaïttu haṇahŏ  $  vāṇara-vaṃsa-ẏaruhĕ kandu khaṇahŏ"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu andhaeṇa  $  hakkāriu amarisa-kuddhaeṇa
ghattā:
"vijjāhara tumhĕ  $  amhĕ kaïddhaẏa kavaṇu chalu
    laï paharaṇu pāva  $  jāma ṇa pāḍami sira-kamalu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu vijaẏasīhu  $  utthariu pavara-bhuva-phaliha-dīhu
abbhiṭṭu jujjhu vijjāharāhã  $  sirimālā-kāraṇĕ duddharāhã
sāhaṇaï mi avaropparu bhiḍanti  $  ṇaṃ sukaï-kavva-vaẏaṇaĩ ghaḍanti
bhañjanti khambha vihaḍanti mañca  $  dukkavi-kavvālāva va ku-sañca
haẏa gaẏa suṇṇāsaṇa saṃcaranti  $  ṇaṃ paṃsuli-loẏaṇa paribhamanti
raṇu vijjāhara-vāṇarahũ jāma  $  laṅkāhiu pattu sukesu tāma
ālaggu so vi vaṇĕ jiha huāsu  $  jasu ḍhukkaï so so lei ṇāsu
tahĩ avasarĕ vehāviddhaeṇa  $  raṇĕ vijaẏasīhu haü andhaeṇa
ghattā:
mahi-maṇḍalĕ sīsu  $  dīsaï asivara-khaṇḍiẏaü
    ṇāvaï saẏavattu  $  toḍĕvi haṃseṃ chaṇḍiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 6:
viṇivāiĕ vijaẏamaïndĕ khuddĕ  $  kiĕ pārāuṭṭhaĕ vala-samuddĕ
tuṭṭhāṇaṇu bhaṇaï sukesu ema  $  "sirimāla laeppiṇu jāhũ deva"
teṃ vaẏaṇeṃ gaẏa kaṇṭaïẏa-gatta  $  ṇivisaddheṃ kikku-purakkhu patta
ettahĕ vi duṭṭha-ṇiṭṭhavaṇa-heu  $  keṇa vi ṇisuṇāviu asaṇiveu
"paramesara para-ṇaravara-sirīhu  $  olaggaï pāṇĕhĩ vijaẏasīhu
paḍicandahŏ suĕṇa kaïddhaeṇa  $  āvaṭṭiu jama-muhĕ andhaeṇa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi ṇa karantu kheu  $  saṇṇahĕvi padhāiu asaṇiveu
caüraṅgeṃ vijjāhara-valeṇa  $  pariveḍhiu paṭṭaṇu teṃ chaleṇa
ghattā:
hakkāriẏa ve vi  $  "pāvahŏ pamaẏa-mahaddhaẏahŏ
   laï ḍhukkaü kālu  $  ṇiggahŏ kikkindhandhaẏahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 7:
puṇu pacchaĕ vipphuriẏāṇaṇeṇa  $  hakkāriẏa vijjulavāhaṇeṇa
"arĕ bhāi mahāraü ṇihaü jema  $  duddhara-sara-dhoraṇi dharahŏ tema"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi dūsaha-daṃsaṇehĩ  $  paḍicanda-ṇarindahŏ ṇandaṇehĩ
ṇiggantahĩ jaṇa-ṇiggaẏa-paẏāvu  $  kiu pārāuṭṭhaü seṇṇu sāvu
so asaṇiveu andhaẏahŏ valiu  $  taḍivāhaṇeṇa kikkindhu khaliu
paharaṇaĩ muẏanti su-dāruṇāĩ  $  khaṇĕ aggeẏaĩ khaṇĕ vāruṇāĩ
khaṇĕ pavaṇatthaĩ khaṇĕ thambhaṇāĩ  $  khaṇĕ vāmohaṇa-ummohaṇāĩ
khaṇĕ mahiẏalĕ khaṇĕ ṇahaẏalĕ bhamanti  $  khaṇĕ sandaṇĕ khaṇĕ jĕ vimāṇĕ thanti
ghattā:
āẏāmĕvi dukkhu  $  andhaü khaggeṃ kaṇṭhĕ haü
    ṇiu pantheṃ teṇa  $  jeṃ so vijaẏamaïndu gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 8:
ettahĕ vi bhiṇḍivāleṇa pahaü  $  kikkindha-ṇarāhiu muccha-gaü
acchantaü paricintĕvi maṇeṇa  $  āmelliu vijjulavāhaṇeṇa
tahĩ avasarĕ ḍhukku sukesu pāsu  $  rahavarĕ chuhevi ṇiu ṇiẏa-ṇivāsu
paḍivāiu ceẏaṇa-bhāu laddhu  $  uṭṭhanteṃ pucchiu parama-vandhu
"kahĩ andhaü "pesaṇa-cukku deva"  $  ṇivaḍiu puṇo vi taḍi-rukkhu jema
puṇu paḍivāiu puṇu āu jīu  $  "hā paĩ viṇu suṇṇaü pamaẏa-dīu
hā bhāẏa sahoẏara dehi vāẏa  $  hā paĩ viṇu meiṇi vihava jāẏa"
ghattā:
to bhaṇaï sukesu  $  "saṃsaü ṇāha jievāhŏ
    sirĕ ṇikkhaĕ khaggĕ  $  avasaru kavaṇu ruevāhŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 9:
viṇu kajjeṃ vaïrihĩ aṅgu dehi  $  pāẏālalaṅka païsarahũ ehi
jīvantahũ sijjhaï savvu kajju  $  ettiu ṇa vi haũ ṇa vi tuhũ ṇa rajju"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vāṇara-vaṃsa-sāru  $  ṇīsariu sa-sāhaṇu sa-parivāru
ṇāsantu ṇiĕvi harisiẏa-maṇeṇa  $  rahu vāhiu vijjulavāhaṇeṇa
karĕ dhariu asaṇiveeṇa puttu  $  "kiṃ uttima-purisahã eu juttu
ṇāsantu ṇavantu suvantu sattu  $  bhuñjantu ṇa hammaï jalu piẏantu
jeṃ vijaẏasīhu haü bhuẏa-visālu  $  so ṇiu kiẏanta-dantantarālu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi taḍivāhaṇu ṇiẏattu  $  lahu desu pasāhiu ekka-chattu
ghattā:
ṇigghāẏahŏ laṅka  $  aṇṇahã aṇṇaĩ paṭṭaṇaĩ
   bhuttaĩ icchāĕ  $  su-kalattaĩ va sa-jovvaṇaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 10:
kikkindha-sukesahã pura harevi  $  avara vi vijjāhara vasikarevi
vahu-divasĕhĩ ghaṇa-paḍalaĩ ṇievi  $  taṃ vijaẏasīha-duhu saṃbharevi
sahasāra-kumārahŏ devi rajju  $  appuṇu sāhiu para-loẏa-kajju
vahu-kāleṃ kikkindhāhivo vi  $  gaü vandaṇa-hattiĕ meru so vi
palluṭṭu paḍīvaü ṇara-variṭṭhu  $  mahu pavara-mahīharu tāma diṭṭhu
jovaï va paīhiẏa-loẏaṇehĩ  $  hasaï va kamalāẏara-āṇaṇehĩ
gāẏaï va bhamara-mahuari-sarehĩ  $  ṇhāi va ṇimmala-jala-ṇijjharehĩ
vīsamaï va laliẏa-laẏāharehĩ  $  paṇavaï va phulla-phala-gurubharehĩ
ghattā:
taṃ selu ṇievi  $  kokkāvĕvi ṇiẏa paẏa paüru
    kiu paṭṭaṇu tetthu  $  kikkindheṃ kikkindhapuru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 11:
mahu-mahiharo vi kikkindhu vuttu  $  ucchuraü tāma uppaṇṇu puttu
aṇṇu vi sūraraü kaṇiṭṭhu tāsu  $  vāhuvali jema bharahesarāsu
ettahĕ vi sukesahŏ tiṇṇi putta  $  sirimāli-sumāli-sumallavanta
poḍhattaṇĕ vuccaï tehĩ tāu  $  "ki ṇa jāhũ jetthu kikkindharāu"
taṃ suṇĕvi jaṇereṃ vuttu ema  $  "thiẏa dāḍhuppāḍiẏa sappu jema
kahĩ jāhũ muĕvi pāẏālalaṅka  $  caüpāsiu vaïrihũ taṇiẏa saṅka
ghaṇavāhaṇa-pamuha ṇirantarāĩ  $  ettiẏaĩ jāma rajjantarāĩ
aṇuhūẏa laṅka kāmiṇi va pavara  $  mahu taṇaĕ sīsĕ avahariẏa ṇavara"
ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi  $  māli palittu davaggi jiha
    "uddhaddhaĕ rajjĕ  $  ṇivisu vi jijjaï tāẏa kiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 12:
mahu kahiẏa bhaḍārā paĩ ji ṇitti  $  tiha jīvahi jiha paribhamaï kitti
tiha hasu jiha ṇa hasijjaï jaṇeṇa  $  tiha bhuñju jiha ṇa muccahi dhaṇeṇa
tiha jujjhu jiha ṇivvui jaṇaï aṅgu  $  tiha taju jiha puṇu vi ṇa hoi saṅgu
tiha caü jiha vuccaï sāhu sāhu  $  tiha saṃcaru jiha saẏaṇahã ṇa ḍāhu
tiha suṇu jiha ṇivasahi guruhũ pāsĕ  $  tiha maru jiha ṇāvahi gabbhavāsĕ
tiha taü karĕ jiha paritavaï gattu  $  tiha rajju pālĕ jiha ṇavaï sattu
kiṃ jīeṃ riu-āsaṅkieṇa  $  kiṃ puriseṃ māṇa-kalaṅkieṇa
kiṃ davveṃ dāṇa-vivajjieṇa  $  kiṃ putteṃ maïlaï vaṃsu jeṇa
ghattā:
jaï kallaĕ tāẏa  $  laṅkāṇaẏari ṇa païsarami
    to ṇiẏaẏa-jaṇeri  $  indāṇī karaẏalĕ dharami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 13:
gaẏa raẏaṇi paẏāṇaü paraĕ diṇṇu  $  haü tūru rasāẏalu ṇāĩ bhiṇṇu
saṃcalliu sāhaṇu ṇiravasesu  $  ārūḍha ke vi ṇara gaẏavaresu
turaesu ke vi kĕ vi sandaṇesu  $  siviesu ke vi pañcāṇaṇesu
pariveḍhiẏa laṅkā-ṇaẏari tehĩ  $  ṇaṃ mahihara-koḍi mahā-ghaṇehĩ
ṇaṃ poḍha-vilāsiṇi kāmuehĩ  $  ṇaṃ saẏavattiṇi phullandhuehĩ
kiu kalaẏalu rahasāūriehĩ  $  paḍipahaẏaĩ tūraĩ tūriehĩ
saṅkhiĕhĩ saṅkha tāliĕhĩ tāla  $  caü-pāsiu uṭṭhiẏa bhaḍa-vamāla
dhāiu laṅkāhiu vipphurantu  $  raṇĕ pārāuṭṭhaü valu karantu
ghattā:
ṇaṃ matta-gaïndu  $  pañcāṇaṇahŏ samāvaḍiu
    sarahasu ṇigghāu  $  gampiṇu mālihĕ abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 7, Kaḍavaka 14:
paharanti paropparu taruvarehĩ  $  puṇu pāhāṇĕhĩ puṇu girivarehĩ
puṇu vijjārūvahĩ bhīsaṇehĩ  $  ahi-garuḍa-kumbhi-pañcāṇaṇehĩ
puṇu ṇārāehĩ bhaẏaṅkarehĩ  $  bhuẏaïndāẏāma-paīharehĩ
chindanti mahāraha-chatta-dhaẏaĩ  $  vaïẏāgaraṇa va vāẏaraṇa-paẏaĩ
etthantarĕ vāhiẏa-sandaṇeṇa  $  daṇuvaï-indāṇihĕ ṇandaṇeṇa
saẏavāraü pariañcevi gaẏaṇĕ  $  haü khaggeṃ chuddhu kiẏanta-vaẏaṇĕ
ṇigghāu paḍiu ṇigghāu jema  $  mahiẏalĕ ṇara ṇahĕ parituṭṭha deva
cattāri vi dhuva-parihava-kalaṅka  $  jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṇa païṭṭha laṅka
ghattā:
santihĕ santiharĕ  $  gampiṇu vandaṇa-hatti kiẏa
    suvilāsiṇi jema  $  laṅka sa iṃ bhu ñjanta thiẏa
----------  [8. aṭṭhamo saṃdhi]  ----------
mālihĕ rajju karantāhŏ  $  siddhaĩ vijjāhara-maṇḍalaĩ
sahasā ahimuhihūāĩ  $  sāẏarahŏ jema savvaĩ jalaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 1:
tahĩ avasarĕ chuha-paṅkāpaṇḍurĕ  $  dāhiṇa-seḍḍhihĩ rahaṇeura-purĕ
pihula-ṇiẏamviṇi pīṇa-paohari  $  sahasārahŏ piẏa māṇasa-sundari
tāhĕ puttu sura-siri-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  indu cavevi indu uppaṇṇaü
bhesaï manti danti aïrāvaṇu  $  seṇāvaï harikesi bhaẏāvaṇu
vijjāhara ji savva kiẏa suravara  $  pavaṇa-kuvera-varuṇa-jama-sasahara
chavvīsa vi sahasaĩ pekkhaṇaẏahũ  $  ṇāhĩ pamāṇu khujja-vāmaṇaẏahũ
gāẏaṇa jāĩ surindattaṇaẏahũ  $  ṇāmaĩ tāĩ kiẏaĩ appaṇaẏahũ
uvvasi-rambha-tilottima-pahuihĩ  $  aṭṭhāẏāla-sahasa-vara-juvaïhĩ
ghattā:
paricintiu vijjāharĕṇa  $  "tahŏ jāĩ jāĩ ākhaṇḍalahŏ
    tāĩ tāĩ mahu cindhāĩ  $  laï haũ ji indu mahi-maṇḍalahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 2:
juĕ khaẏa-kālĕ ṇiḍḍa (?)-ṇiḍḍālihĕ  $  je je seva karantā mālihĕ
te te miliẏa ṇarāhiva indahŏ  $  avara jaloha va avara-samuddahŏ
kappu ṇa dinti janti sirigārahĩ (?)  $  āṇa karanti vi ṇāhaṅkārahĩ
keṇa vi kahiu gampi tahŏ mālihĕ  $  "pahu saṃkanti (?) ṇa tumha ṇiḍḍālihĕ (?)
indu ko vi sahasārahŏ ṇandaṇu  $  tāsu karanti savva bhiccattaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi sukesahŏ putteṃ  $  kova-jalaṇa-jāloli-palitteṃ
devāviẏa raṇa-bheri bhaẏaṅkara  $  gharu (?) saṇṇahĕvi parāiẏa kiṅkara
kikkindhahŏ kikkindhahŏ ṇandaṇa  $  diṇṇu paẏāṇaü vāhiẏa sandaṇa
ghattā:
"gamaṇu ṇa sujjhaï mahu maṇahŏ"  $  taṃ māli sumāli karĕhĩ dharaï
    "pekkhu deva duṇimittāĩ  $  siva kandaï vāẏasu karagaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 3:
pekkhu kuhiṇi visahara-chijjantī  $  mokkala-kesa ṇāri rovantī
pekkhu phurantaü vāmaü loẏaṇu  $  pekkhahi ruhira-ṇhāṇu vasa-bhoẏaṇu
pekkhu vasundhari-talu kampantaü  $  ghara-devaüla-ṇivahu loṭṭantaü
pekkhu akālĕ mahā-ghaṇu gajjiu  $  ṇahĕ ṇaccantu kavandhu alajjiu"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu tahŏ valiẏaü  $  "vaccha vaccha jaï saüṇu ji valiẏaü
to kiṃ maraï savvu ĕu aliẏaü  $  daïu muevi aṇṇu ko valiẏaü
chuḍu dhīrattaṇu hoi maṇūsahŏ  $  lacchi kitti osaraï ṇa pāsahŏ"
ema bhaṇeppiṇu diṇṇu paẏāṇaü  $  caliu seṇṇu sarahasu sa-vimāṇaü
ghattā:
haẏa-gaẏa-rahavara-ṇaravarahĩ  $  mahiẏalĕ gaẏaṇaẏalĕ ṇa māiẏaü
    dīsaï viñjha-mahīharahŏ  $  mehaülu ṇāĩ uddhāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ jamakaraṇahŏ aṇuharamāṇaü  $  ṇisuṇĕvi rakkhahŏ taṇaü paẏāṇaü
ubhaẏa-seḍhi-sāmanta paṇaṭṭhā  $  gampiṇu indahŏ saraṇĕ païṭṭhā
tahĩ avasarĕ valavanta mahāiẏa  $  mālihĕ kerā dūa parāiẏa
"ahŏ ahŏ rahaṇeura-pura-rāṇā  $  kappu devi karĕ sandhi aẏāṇā
dujjaü laṅkāhiu samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  chuddhu jeṇa ṇigghāu jamāṇaṇĕ
rāẏa-lacchi taïlokka-piẏārī  $  dāsi jema jasu pesaṇagārī
teṇa samāṇu virohu asundaru"  $  āĕhĩ vaẏaṇĕhĩ kuviu purandaru
"dūu bhaṇevi teṇa tuhũ cukkaü  $  ṇaṃ to jama-dantantaru ḍhukkaü
ghattā:
ko so laṅka-purāhivaï  $  ko tuhũ kira sandhi kaho ttaṇiẏa
    jo jīvesaï vihi mi raṇĕ  $  mahi ṇīsāvaṇṇa tahŏ ttaṇiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 5:
gaẏa te māli-dūẏa ṇibbhacchiẏa  $  duvvaẏaṇāvamāṇa-paḍihatthiẏa
saṇṇajjhaï surindu sura-sāhaṇu  $  kulisa-pāṇi aïrāvaẏa-vāhaṇu
saṇṇajjhaï taṇu-hei huāsaṇu  $  dhūmaddhaü kuẏāri mesāsaṇu
saṇṇajjhaï jamu daṇḍa-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  mahisārūḍhu purandara-kiṅkaru
saṇṇajjhaï ṇaïriu moggara-dharu  $  ricchārūḍhu raṇaṅgaṇĕ duddharu
saṇṇajjhaï varuṇu vi duddaṃsaṇu  $  ṇāgavāsa-karu karimaẏarāsaṇu
saṇṇajjhaï miga-gamaṇu samīraṇu  $  taruvara-pavaruggāmiẏa-paharaṇu
saṇṇajjhaï kuveru phuriẏāharu  $  puppha-vimāṇārūḍhu satti-karu
saṇṇajjhaï īsāṇu visāsaṇu  $  sūla-pāṇi para-vala-saṃtāsaṇu
saṇṇajjhaï pañcāṇaṇa-gāmiu  $  kunta-pāṇi sasi sasipura-sāmiu
ghattā:
jāĩ vi ḍhillīhontāĩ  $  tāi mi raṇa-rasa-pulaüggaẏaĩ
      ṇiĕvi paropparu cindhāĩ  $  suhaḍahũ kavaẏaĩ phuṭṭĕvi gaẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 6:
tāma paropparu vehāviddhaĩ  $  paḍhama bhiḍantaĩ aggima-khandhaĩ
musumūriẏa-ura-sira-muha-kandhara  $  pacchima-bhāa-sesa thiẏa kuñjara
pucchuggīriẏa paḍipaharanti va  $  "kahĩ gaẏa aggima-bhāẏa" bhaṇanti va
joha vi amuṇiẏa-jaḍhara-uratthala  $  "kahĩ gaẏa riu" paharanti va karaẏala
saṃcūriẏa turaṅga-dhaẏa-sārahi  $  cakka-sesa thiẏa ṇavara mahārahi
tahĩ avasarĕ rahaṇeura-sārahŏ  $  dhāiu mallavantu sahasārahŏ
sūraraeṇa somu raṇĕ khāriu  $  ucchuraeṇa varuṇu hakkāriu
jamu kikkindheṃ dhaṇaü sumāliṃ  $  pavaṇu sukeseṃ suravaï māliṃ
ghattā:
"ettiu kālu ṇa vujjhiẏaü  $  tuhũ kavaṇahũ indahũ indu kahĕ
     raṇḍĕhĩ muṇḍĕhĩ jibbhiĕhĩ  $  kiṃ jo so rammahi indavahĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi coiu aïrāvaü  $  ṇāvaï ṇijjharantu kula-pāvaü
māli-purandara bhiḍiẏa paropparu  $  vihi mi mahāhaü jāu bhaẏaṅkaru
jujjhaĩ sesa-ṇarĕhĩ paricattaĩ  $  thiẏa paḍithiraĩ kareppiṇu ṇettaĩ
indaẏālu jiha tiha joijjaï  $  rakkheṃ rakkha-vijja cintijjaï
bhīma-mahābhīmĕhĩ jā diṇṇī  $  gotta-paramparāĕ avaïṇṇī
sā vikarāla-vaẏaṇa uddhāiẏa  $  parivaḍḍhiẏa gaẏaṇaẏalĕ ṇa māiẏa
cintiu varuṇa-pavaṇa-jama-dhaṇaĕhĩ  $  "pattu indu cariĕhĩ appaṇaĕhĩ
dūeṃ vuttu āsi rāẏaṅgaṇĕ  $  dujjaü māli hoi samaraṅgaṇĕ"
ghattā:
tahĩ patthāvĕ purandarĕṇa  $  māhinda-vijja lahu saṃbhariẏa
      vaḍḍhiẏa tahĕ vi caügguṇiẏa  $  ravi-kantiĕ sasi-kanti va hariẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ māhinda-vijja avaloĕvi  $  bhaṇaï sumāli māli-muhu joĕvi
"taïẏahũ ṇa kiu mahāraü vuttaü  $  evahĩ āẏaü kālu ṇiruttaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi palamva-bhuẏa-ḍāleṃ  $  amarisa-kuddhaeṇa raṇĕ māleṃ
vāẏava-vāruṇa-aggeẏatthaĩ  $  mukkaĩ tiṇṇi mi gaẏaĩ ṇiratthaĩ
jiha aṇṇāṇa-kaṇṇĕ jiṇa-vaẏaṇaĩ  $  jiha goṭṭhaṅgaṇĕ vara-maṇi-raẏaṇaĩ
jiha uvaẏāra-saẏaĩ akulīṇaĕ  $  vaẏaĩ jema cāritta-vihīṇaĕ
gampi pahañjaṇu miliu pahañjaṇĕ  $  varuṇahŏ varuṇu huvāsu huāsaṇĕ
hasiu purandareṇa "arĕ māṇava  $  deva-samāṇa honti kiṃ dāṇava"
ghattā:
bhaṇaï māli "ko deu tuhũ  $  valu paüru su saẏalu ṇirikkhiẏaü
    jaṃ vandhahi ohaṭṭahi vi  $  indaẏālu para sikkhiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu surarāeṃ  $  viddhu ṇiḍālĕ māli ṇārāeṃ
lahu uppāḍĕvi ghittu ṇarindeṃ  $  ṇāĩ varaṅkusu matta-gaïndeṃ
sahasā ruhirāẏamviru dīsiu  $  ṇaṃ maẏagalu sindūra-vihūsiu
vāma-pāṇi vaṇĕ devi akhantiĕ  $  bhiṇṇu ṇiḍālĕ surāhiu sattiĕ
vihalaṅghalu oṇallu mahīẏalĕ  $  kalaẏalu ghuṭṭhu rakkha-vāṇara-valĕ
māli sumāliṃ sāhukkāriu  $  "paĩ hontaĕ ṇiẏa-vaṃsuddhāriu"
uṭṭhĕvi mukku cakku sahasakkheṃ  $  entaü dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu rakkheṃ
siru pāḍevi rasāẏalĕ paḍiẏaü  $  kaha vi ṇa kumma-vīḍhĕ abbhiḍiẏaü
ghattā:
vaẏaṇu maḍakka ṇa vīsariu  $  dhāviu kavandhu rosāviẏaü
    ve-vāraü aïrāvaẏahŏ  $  kumbhatthalĕ asivaru vāhiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 10:
jaṃ viṇivāiu rakkhu raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  vijaü ghuṭṭhu amarāhiva-sāhaṇĕ
ṇaṭṭhu kaïddhaẏa-valu bhaẏa-bhīẏaü  $  galiẏāuhu kaṇṭha-ṭṭhiẏa-jīẏaü
keṇa vi tāma kahiu sahasakkhahŏ  $  "pacchalĕ laggu deva paḍivakkhahŏ
vahuvāraü ṇisiẏara-kaïcindhĕhĩ  $  veẏāriẏa sukesa-kikkindhĕhĩ
eẏa ji vijaẏasīha-khaẏa-gārā  $  tiha karĕ jema ṇa janti bhaḍārā"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi gaü coiu jāvĕhĩ  $  sasaharu puraü pariṭṭhiu tāvĕhĩ
"mahu ādesu dehi paramesara  $  mārami haũ ji ṇisāẏara vāṇara
seṇṇu vi ghattami jama-muha-kandarĕ  $  dasaṇa-silāẏala-jīhā-kakkarĕ"
ghattā:
indeṃ hatthutthalliẏaü  $  dhāiu sasi sara varisantu kiha
    pacchalĕ pavaṇāhaĕ dhaṇahŏ  $  dhārāharu vāsārattu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 11:
"maru maru valahŏ valahŏ kiṃ ṇāsahŏ  $  dhārāhara-makkaḍahŏ haẏāsahŏ
suraẏaṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇanda-jaṇerā  $  kuddha pāva taṃ (?) vāsava-kerā"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi dūrujjhiẏa-saṅkaü  $  ahimuhu mallavantu para thakkaü
gahakallolu ṇāĩ chaṇa-candahŏ  $  ṇāĩ maïndu mahaggaẏa-vindahŏ
"arĕ sasaṅka sa-kalaṅka alajjiẏa  $  mahilāṇaṇa ve-pakkha-vivajjiẏa
candu bhaṇĕvi jeṃ hāsaü dijjaï  $  paĩ vi ko vi kiṃ raṇĕ ghāijjaï"
ema caveppiṇu cāva-saṇāhaü  $  bhiṇḍivāla-paharaṇĕṇa samāhaü
muccha parāiẏa pasariẏa-veẏaṇu  $  dukkhu dukkhu kira hoi sa-ceẏaṇu
ghattā:
dūrīhūẏā tāma riu  $  maẏalañchaṇu maṇĕ avatasaï kiha
    siru saṃcālaï karu dhuṇaï  $  saṃkantihĕ cukkaü vippu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 8, Kaḍavaka 12:
tāma mahā-rahaṇeura-puravaru  $  jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ païsaï suravaru
pavaṇa-kuvera-varuṇa-jama-khandĕhĩ  $  ṇaḍa-phamphāva-chatta-kaïvandĕhĩ
vandiṇa-saẏahĩ pavaḍḍhiẏa-harisĕhĩ  $  vijjāhara-kiṇṇara-kiṃpurisĕhĩ
joisa-jakkha-garuḍa-gandhavvĕhĩ  $  jaẏa-jaẏa-kāru karantĕhĩ savvĕhĩ
calaṇĕhĩ gampi paḍiu sahasārahŏ  $  ṇaṃ bharahesaru tihuaṇa-sārahŏ
sasipuri sasihĕ diṇṇa vikkhāẏahŏ  $  dhaṇaẏahŏ laṅka kikku jamarāẏahŏ
meha-ṇaẏarĕ varuṇāhiu ṭhaviẏaü  $  kañcaṇapurĕ kuveru paṭṭhaviẏaü
ghattā:
aṇṇu vi ko vi purandarĕṇa  $  tahĩ avasarĕ jo saṃbhāviẏaü
    maṇḍalu ekkekkaü pavaru  $  so savvu sa iṃ bhu ñjāviẏaü
----------  [9. ṇavamo saṃdhi]  ----------
etthantarĕ riddhihĕ jantāhŏ  $  pāẏāla-laṅka bhuñjantāhŏ
uppaṇṇu sumālihĕ puttu kiha  $  raẏaṇāsaü risahahŏ bharahu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 1:
solaha-āharaṇālaṅkariu  $  saẏam eva maẏaṇu ṇaṃ avaẏariu
vahu-divasĕhĩ āucchĕvi jaṇaṇu  $  gaü vijjā-kāraṇĕ pupphavaṇu
thiu akkhasuttu karaẏalĕ karĕvi  $  jiha maha-risi parama-jhāṇu dharĕvi
tahĩ avasarĕ guṇa-aṇurāiẏaü  $  so pomavindu saṃpāiẏaü
raẏaṇāsaü lakkhiu teṇa tahĩ  $  "imu purisa-raẏaṇu uppaṇṇu kahĩ
laï saccaü hūẏaü guru-vaẏaṇu  $  ĕhu so ṇaru ĕu taṃ pupphavaṇu
kaïkasi ṇāmeṇa vutta duhiẏa  $  papphulliẏa-puṇḍarīẏa-muhiẏa
"ĕhu putti tuhāraü bhattāru  $  māṇasa-sundarihĕ va sahasāru"
ghattā:
gaü dhīẏa thavevi ṇiẏāsavahŏ  $  uppaṇṇa vijja raẏaṇāsavahŏ
    thiu vihi mi majjhĕ paramesarihĩ  $  ṇaṃ viñjhu tāvi-ṇammaẏa-sarihĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 2:
avaloiẏa vahu raẏaṇāsavĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ agga-mahisi saĩ vāsavĕṇa
su-ṇiẏamviṇi paricakkaliẏa-thaṇi  $  indīvaracchi paṅkaẏa-vaẏaṇi
"kasu kerī kahĩ avaïṇṇa tuhũ  $  taü dūreṃ diṭṭhi jĕ jaṇaï suhu"
taṃ suṇĕvi sa-saṅka kaṇṇa cavaï  $  "jaï jāṇahŏ vomavindu ṇivaï
haũ tāsu dhīẏa keṇa ṇa variẏa  $  kaïkasi ṇāmeṃ vijjāhariẏa
guru-vaẏaṇĕhĩ āṇiẏa eu vaṇu  $  taü diṇṇī karĕ pāṇiggahaṇu
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi supurisa-dhavalaharu  $  uppāiu vijjāhara-ṇaẏaru
kokkāviu saẏalu vi vandhujaṇu  $  sahũ kaṇṇaĕ kiu pāṇiggahaṇu
ghattā:
vahu-kāleṃ suviṇaü lakkhiẏaü  $  atthāṇĕ ṇarindahŏ akkhiẏaü
    "phāḍeppiṇu kumbhaĩ kuñjarahũ  $  pañcāṇaṇu uvarĕ païṭṭhu mahu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 3:
uccolihĕ candāicca thiẏa"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi daïeṃ vihasikiẏa
aṭṭhaṅga-ṇimittaĩ jāṇaĕṇa  $  vuccaï raẏaṇāsava-rāṇaĕṇa
"hosanti putta taü tiṇṇi dhaṇĕ  $  pahilāraü tāhã raüddu raṇĕ
jaga-kaṇṭaü suravara-ḍamara-karu  $  bharahaddha-ṇarāhiu cakkadharu"
parioseṃ kahi mi ṇa mantāhũ  $  ṇava-suraẏa-sokkhu māṇantāhũ
uppaṇṇu dasāṇaṇu atula-valu  $  pāroha-paīhara-bhuẏa-juẏalu
pakkala-ṇiẏamvu vitthiṇṇa-uru  $  ṇaṃ saggahŏ pacaviu ko vi suru
puṇu bhāṇukaṇṇu puṇu candaṇahi  $  puṇu jāu vihīsaṇu guṇa-uvahi
ghattā:
to uppāḍantu danta gaẏahũ  $  karaẏalu chuhantu muhĕ paṇṇaẏahũ
    āẏaĕ līlaĕ rāmaṇu ramaï  $  ṇaṃ kālu vālu hoĕvi bhamaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 4:
khelantu paīsaï bhaṇḍāru  $  jahĩ tŏẏadavāhaṇa-taṇaü hāru
ṇava-muhaĩ jāsu maṇi-jaḍiẏāĩ  $  ṇava gaha pariẏappĕvi ghaḍiẏāĩ
jo paripālijjaï paṇṇaĕhĩ  $  āsīvisa-rosāuṇṇaĕhĩ
sāmaṇṇahŏ aṇṇahŏ karaï vahu  $  so kaṇṭhaü duṭṭhaü duvvisahu
sahasatti laggu karĕ dahamuhahŏ  $  ṇaṃ mittu sumittahŏ ahimuhahŏ
parihiu ṇava-muhaĩ samuṭṭhiẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ gaha-vimvaĩ su-pariṭṭhiẏaĩ
ṇaṃ saẏavattaĩ saṃcārimaĩ  $  ṇaṃ kāmiṇi-vaẏaṇaĩ kārimaĩ
vollanti samaü vollantaĕṇa  $  sa-viẏāru hasanti hasantaĕṇa
ghattā:
pekkheppiṇu tāĩ dahāṇaṇaĩ  $  thira-tāraĩ taralaĩ loẏaṇaĩ
    teṃ dahamuhu dahasiru jaṇĕṇa kiu  $  pañcāṇaṇu jema pasiddhi gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 5:
jaṃ parihiu kaṇṭhaü rāvaṇĕṇa  $  kiu vaddhāvaṇaü su-pariẏaṇĕṇa
raẏaṇāsaü kaïkasi dhāiẏaĩ  $  āṇandeṃ kahi mi ṇa māiẏaĩ
ṇisuṇeppiṇu āiu ucchuraü  $  kikkindhu sa-kantaü sūraraü
saẏalehĩ ṇihāliu sāharaṇu  $  daha-gīummīliẏa-daha-vaẏaṇu
paricintiu "ṇaü sāmaṇṇu ṇaru  $  ĕhu hoi ṇiruttaü cakkaharu
eẏahŏ pāsiu rajju vi viulu  $  kaï-jāuhāṇa-valu raṇĕ atulu
eẏahŏ pāsiu suravaïhĕ khaü  $  jama-varuṇa-kuverahã ṇāhĩ jaü"
ghattā:
aṇṇekka-divasĕ gajjantu kiha  $  ṇava-pāusĕ jalahara-vindu jiha
ṇahĕ jantaü pekkhĕvi vaïsavaṇu  $  puṇu pucchiẏa jaṇaṇi "ehu kavaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi maüliẏa-ṇaẏaṇiẏaĕ  $  vajjariu sa-gaggara-vaẏaṇiẏaĕ
"kaüsiki jaṇeri eẏahŏ taṇiẏa  $  pahilārī vahiṇi mahu ttaṇiẏa
vīsāvasu vijjāharu jaṇaṇu  $  ĕhu bhāi tuhāraü vaïsavaṇu
vaïrihĩ milevi muha maliṇa kiẏa  $  māẏari va kamāgaẏa laṅka hiẏa
eẏahŏ uddālĕvi jema tiẏa  $  kaïẏahũ māṇesahũ rāẏa-siẏa"
rattuppala-hūāloẏaṇĕṇa  $  ṇibbhacchiẏa jaṇaṇi vihīsaṇĕṇa
"vaïsavaṇahŏ kerī kavaṇa siẏa  $  dahavaẏaṇahŏ ṇokkhī kā vi kiẏa
pekkhesahi divasahĩ thovaĕhĩ  $  āĕhĩ amhārisa-devaĕhĩ
ghattā:
jama-khanda-kuvera-purandarĕhĩ  $  ravi-varuṇa-pavaṇa-sihi-sasaharĕhĩ
    aṇudiṇu daṇuvaï-kandāvaṇahŏ  $  gharĕ seva karevī rāvaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 7:
ekkahĩ diṇĕ āucchĕvi jaṇaṇu  $  gaẏa tiṇṇi vi bhīsaṇu bhīma-vaṇu
jahĩ jakkha-sahāsaĩ dāruṇaĩ  $  jahĩ sīha-paẏaĩ ruhirāruṇaĩ
jahĩ ṇīsāsantĕhĩ ajaẏarĕhĩ  $  ḍollanti ḍāla sahũ taruvarĕhĩ
jahĩ sāhārūḍhaĩ vippaẏaĩ  $  andolaṇa-parama-bhāva-gaẏaĩ
tahĩ tehaĕ bhīsaṇĕ bhīma-vaṇĕ  $  thiẏa vijjahĕ jhāṇu dharevi maṇĕ
jā aṭṭhakkharĕhĩ pasiddhi gaẏa  $  ṇāmeṇa savva-kāmaṇṇa-rūẏa
sā vihĩ paharĕhĩ jĕ pāsu aïẏa  $  ṇaṃ gāḍhāliṅgaṇa-gaẏa daïẏa
puṇu jhāiẏa solaha-akkhariẏa  $  jaẏa(?)-koḍi-sahāsa-dahuttariẏa
ghattā:
te bhāẏara avicala-jhāṇa-rui  $  dahavaẏaṇa-vihīsaṇa-bhāṇusui
    vaṇĕ diṭṭha jakkha-sundariĕ kiha  $  jiṇa-vāṇiĕ tiṇṇi vi loẏa jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 8:
jaṃ jakkhiĕ rāvaṇu diṭṭhu vaṇĕ  $  taṃ vammaha-vāṇa païṭṭha maṇĕ
"vollāviu vollaï kiṃ ṇa tuhũ  $  kiṃ vahiraü kiṃ tuha ṇāhĩ muhu
kiṃ jhāẏahi akkhasuttu ghivahi  $  mahu keraü rūva-salilu pivahi"
dahagīva-pasaru alahantiẏaĕ  $  sa-vilakkhaü kheḍu karantiẏaĕ
vacchatthalĕ pahaü sukomalĕṇa  $  kaṇṇāvaẏaṃsa-ṇīluppalĕṇa
aṇṇekkaĕ vuttu varaṅgaṇaĕ  $  papphulliẏa-tāmarasāṇaṇaĕ
"tuhũ jāṇahi ĕhu ṇaru saccamaü  $  uppāiu keṇa vi kaṭṭhamaü
puṇu gampiṇu raṇa-rasa-aḍḍhiẏahŏ  $  jakkhahŏ vajjariu aṇiḍḍhiẏahŏ
ghattā:
"kañcī-kalāva-keūra-dhara  $  paĩ tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi tiṇṇi ṇara
    vaṇĕ vijjaü ārāhanta thiẏa  $  ṇāvaï jaga-bhavaṇahŏ khambha kiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jamvūdīva-pahu  $  ṇaṃ jaliu jalaṇa-jālā-ṇivahu
"so kavaṇu etthu ṇikkampiraü  $  jagĕ jīvaï jo mahu vāhiraü"
ahimuhu paẏaṭṭu tahŏ āsavahŏ  $  suẏa diṭṭha tāma raẏaṇāsavahŏ
"ahŏ ahŏ pavvaïẏahŏ ahiṇavahŏ  $  kaṃ jhāẏahŏ kavaṇu deu thuṇahŏ"
jaṃ ekku vi uttaru diṇṇu ṇa vi  $  taṃ puṇu vi samuṭṭhiu kova-havi
uvasaggu ghoru pārambhiẏaü  $  vahurūvĕhĩ jakkhu viẏambhiẏaü
āsīvisa-visahara-ajaẏarĕhĩ  $  saddūla-sīha-kuñjara-varĕhĩ
gaẏa-bhūẏa-pisāĕhĩ rakkhasĕhĩ  $  giri-pavaṇa-huāsaṇa-pāusĕhĩ
ghattā:
dasa-disi-vahu andhāraü karĕvi  $  orumbhĕvi gajjĕvi uttharĕvi
    gaü ṇipphalu so uvasaggu kiha  $  giri-mattaĕ vāsārattu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 10:
jaṃ cittu ṇa sakkiu avaharĕvi  $  thiu takkhaṇĕ aṇṇa māẏa dharĕvi
darisāviu saẏalu vi vandhujaṇu  $  kaluṇaü kandantu visaṇṇa-maṇu
kasa-ghāĕhĩ ghāijjantu vaṇĕ  $  "ṇivaḍantuṭṭhantaĩ khaṇĕ jĕ khaṇĕ
raẏaṇāsavu kaïkasi candaṇahi  $  hammantaĩ jaï ṇa amhe gaṇahi
to saraṇu bhaṇĕvi paḍiva(?ra)kkha karĕ  $  riu māraï laggaï putta dharĕ
taṃ purisaẏāru kiṃ vīsariu  $  ṇava-vaẏaṇu jeṇa kaṇṭhaü dhariu
ahŏ bhāṇukaṇṇa karĕ cārahaḍi  $  siri bhañjahi laggaü chāra-haḍi
ahŏ dharahi vihīsaṇa jattāĩ  $  vaṇĕ mecchahĩ piṭṭijjantāĩ
ghattā:
arĕ puttahŏ ṇaü paḍirakkha kiẏa  $  jaṃ lāliẏa pāliẏa vaḍḍhaviẏa
    so ṇipphalu saẏalu kilesu gaü  $  jiha pāvahŏ dhammu viakkhiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 11:
jaṃ keṇa vi ṇaü sāhāriẏaü  $  taṃ tiṇṇi vi jakkheṃ māriẏaü
puṇu tihi mi jaṇahũ darisāviẏaü  $  siva-sāṇa-sivālĕhĩ khāviẏaü
ṇavi caliu to vi tahŏ jhāṇu thiru  $  māẏā-rāvaṇaü karevi siru
aggaĕ ghattiu avicala-maṇahã  $  bhāihĩ ravikaṇṇa-vihīsaṇahã
taṃ ṇiĕvi sīsu ruhirāruṇaü  $  te jhāṇahŏ caliẏa maṇāmaṇaü
ṇiddhaĩ suddhaĩ thira-joẏaṇaĩ  $  īsīsi pagaliẏaĩ loẏaṇaĩ
sira-kamalaĩ tāha mi kerāĩ  $  uvaṇāĕvi dukkha-jaṇerāĩ
rāvaṇahŏ gampi darisāviẏaĩ  $  paümaĩ va ṇāla-mellāviẏaĩ
ghattā:
jaṃ ema vi rāvaṇu acalu thiu  $  taṃ devahĩ sāhukkāru kiu
    vijjahũ sahāsu uppaṇṇu kiha  $  titthaẏarahŏ kevala-ṇāṇu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 12:
āgaẏā kahakahantī mahākāliṇī  $  gaẏaṇa-saṃcāliṇī bhāṇu-parimāliṇī
kāli komāri vārāhi māhesarī  $  ghora-vīrāsaṇī jogajogesarī
somaṇī raẏaṇa vambhāṇi indāiṇī  $  aṇima lahimatti paṇṇatti kañcāiṇī
ḍahaṇi uccāṭiṇī thambhaṇī mohaṇī  $  vaïri-viddhaṃsaṇī bhuvaṇa-saṃkhohaṇī
vāruṇī pāvaṇī bhūmi-giri-dāriṇī  $  kāma-suha-dāiṇī vandha-vaha-kāriṇī
savva-pacchāẏaṇī savva-ākarisiṇī  $  vijaẏa jaẏa jimbhiṇī savva-maẏa-ṇāsaṇī
satti-saṃvāhiṇī kuḍila avaloẏaṇī  $  aggi-jala-thambhaṇī chindaṇī bhindhaṇī
āsurī rakkhasī vāruṇī varisaṇī  $  dāruṇī duṇṇivārā ẏa duddarisaṇī
ghattā:
āĕhĩ vara-vijjĕhĩ āiẏahĩ  $  rāvaṇu guṇa-gaṇa-aṇurāiẏahĩ
   caüdisi parivāriu sahaï kiha  $  maẏalañchaṇu chaṇĕ tārāhũ jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 13:
savvosaha thambhaṇi mohaṇiẏa  $  saṃviddhi ṇahaṅgaṇa-gāmiṇiẏa
āẏaü pañca vi vavagaẏaü tahĩ  $  thiu kumbhaẏaṇṇu cala-jhāṇu jahĩ
siddhattha sattu-viṇivāraṇiẏa  $  ṇivviggha gaẏaṇa-saṃcāriṇiẏa
āẏaü caẏāri puṇu cala-maṇahŏ  $  āsaṇṇaü thiẏaü vihīsaṇahŏ
etthantarĕ puṇṇa-maṇorahĕṇa  $  vahu-vijjālaṅkiẏa-viggahĕṇa
ṇāmeṇa saẏaṃpahu ṇaẏaru kiu  $  ṇaṃ sagga-khaṇḍu avaẏarĕvi thiu
aṇṇu vi uppāiu ceiharu  $  maṇaharu ṇāmeṇa sahasasiharu
uttuṅgu siṅgu uṇṇaï karĕvi  $  ṇaṃ vañchaï sūra-vimvu dharĕvi
ghattā:
taṃ riddhi suṇevi dasāṇaṇahŏ  $  pariosu pavaḍḍhiu pariẏaṇahŏ
    āẏaĩ kaï-jāuhāṇa-valaĩ  $  ṇaṃ milĕvi paropparu jala-thalaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 9, Kaḍavaka 14:
jaṃ diṭṭha seṇṇa saẏaṇahũ taṇiẏa  $  paripucchiẏa puṇu avaloẏaṇiẏa
tāĕ vi saṃvohiu dahavaẏaṇu  $  "ĕhu deva tuhāraü vandhu-jaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaravaï ṇīsariu  $  ṇiẏa-vijja-sahāseṃ pariẏariu
ṇaṃ kamaliṇi-saṇḍeṃ pavaru saru  $  ṇaṃ rāsi-sahāseṃ divasaẏaru
sa-vihīsaṇu kumbhaẏaṇṇu caliu  $  ṇaṃ divasa-teu sūrahŏ miliu
tiṇṇi mi kumāra saṃcalla kira  $  ucchaliẏa tāma phamphāva-gira
raẏaṇāsavu pattu sa-vandhujaṇu  $  taṃ paṭṭaṇu taṃ rāvaṇa-bhavaṇu
taṃ saha-maṇḍaü maṇi-veẏaḍiu  $  taṃ vijja-sahāsu samāvaḍiu
ghattā:
pekkheppiṇu pariosiẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  ṇiẏa taṇaẏa sumālihĕ ṇandaṇĕṇa
    romañcāṇanda-ṇeha-juĕhĩ  $  cumvĕvi avagūḍha sa iṃ bhu vĕhĩ
----------  [10. dasamo saṃdhi]  ----------
sāhiu chaṭṭhovavāsu karĕvi  $  ṇava-ṇīluppala-ṇaẏaṇĕṇa
sundaru su-vaṃsu su-kalattu jiha  $  candahāsu dahavaẏaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 1:
dasasiru vijjā-dasasaẏa-ṇivāsu  $  sāheppiṇu dūsahu candahāsu
gaü vandaṇa-hattiĕ meru jāma  $  saṃpāiẏa maẏa-māricca tāma
mandovari pavara-kumāri levi  $  rāvaṇahŏ jĕ bhavaṇu païṭṭha ve vi
candaṇahi ṇihāliẏa tehĩ tetthu  $  "paramesari gaü dahavaẏaṇu ketthu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇīĕ  $  vuccaï raẏaṇāsava-ṇandaṇīĕ
"chuḍu chuḍu sāheppiṇu candahāsu  $  gaü ahimuhu meru-mahīharāsu
ettiĕ āvaï vaïsarahu tāma"  $  taṃ levi ṇimittu ṇiviṭṭha jāma
vettālaĕ mahi kampaṇahã lagga  $  saṃcaliẏa asesa vi kaüha-magga
ghattā:
khaṇĕ andhāraü khaṇĕ candiṇaü  $  khaṇĕ dhārāharu varisaï
    vijjaü jokkhantaü dahavaẏaṇu  $  ṇaṃ māhendu padarisaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 2:
mambhīsĕvi mandovari maeṇa  $  candaṇahi papucchiẏa bhaẏa-gaeṇa
"ĕu kāĩ bhaḍāriĕ kouhallu  $  paviẏambhaï raĕ pemmu va ṇavallu
sa vi pacaviẏa "kiṃ ṇa muṇiu paẏāu  $  dahagīva-kumārahŏ ĕhu pahāu
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi saẏala vi pulaïẏaṅga  $  avaropparu muhaĩ ṇiehũ lagga
etthantarĕ kiṅkara-saẏa-sahāu  $  maẏa-dūsāvāsu ṇiẏantu āu
"ĕu ko āvāsiu samabhareṇa  $  paṇavevi kahiu keṇa vi ṇareṇa
vijjāhara maẏa-māricca ke vi  $  tumhahã muhavekkhā āẏa ve vi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jiṇavara-bhavaṇu ḍhukku  $  pariẏañcĕvi vandĕvi tāṇa-mukku
ghattā:
sahasatti diṭṭhu mandovariĕ  $  diṭṭhiĕ cala-bhaũhālaĕ
    dūrahŏ jĕ samāhaü vacchaẏalĕ  $  ṇaṃ ṇīluppala-mālaĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 3:
dīsaï teṇa vi sahasatti vāla  $  ṇaṃ bhasaleṃ ahiṇava-kusuma-māla
dīsanti calaṇa-ṇeura rasanta  $  ṇaṃ mahura-rāva vandiṇa paḍhanta
dīsaï ṇiẏamvu mehala-samaggu  $  ṇaṃ kāmaeva-atthāṇa-maggu
dīsaï romāvali chuḍu caḍanti  $  ṇaṃ kasaṇa-vāla-sappiṇi lalanti
dīsanti sihiṇa uvasoha denta  $  ṇaṃ uraẏalu bhindĕvi hatthi-danta
dīsaï papphulliẏa-vaẏaṇa-kamalu  $  ṇīsāsāmoẏāsatta-bhasalu
dīsaï suṇāsu aṇuhua-suandhu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaẏaṇa-jalahŏ kiu seu-vandhu
dīsaï ṇiḍālu sira-cihura-chaṇṇu  $  sasi-vimvu va ṇava-jalahara-ṇimaṇṇu
ghattā:
paribhamaï diṭṭhi tahŏ tahĩ jĕ tahĩ  $  aṇṇahĩ kahi mi ṇa thakkaï
    rasa-lampaḍa mahuẏara-panti jima  $  keẏaï muĕvi ṇa sakkaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 4:
dahagīva-kumārahŏ lahĕvi cittu  $  etthantarĕ māricceṇa vuttu
"veẏaḍḍhahŏ dāhiṇa-seḍhi-pavaru  $  ṇāmeṇa devasaṃgīẏa-ṇaẏaru
tahĩ amhaĩ maẏa-māricca bhāẏa  $  rāvaṇa vivāha-kajjeṇa āẏa
laï tujjhu jĕ joggaü ṇāri-raẏaṇu  $  uṭṭhuṭṭhu deva karĕ pāṇi-gahaṇu
eu jĕ muhuttu ṇakkhattu vāru  $  jaṃ jiṇu paccakkhu tiloẏa-sāru
kallāṇa-lacchi-maṅgala-ṇivāsu  $  siva-santi-maṇoraha-suha-paẏāsu
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi tuṭṭheṃ dahamuheṇa  $  kiu takkhaṇĕ pāṇiggahaṇu teṇa
jaẏa-tūrahĩ dhavalahĩ maṅgalehĩ  $  kañcaṇa-toraṇĕhĩ samujjalehĩ
ghattā:
taṃ vahu-varu ṇaẏaṇāṇandaẏaru  $  visaï saẏaṃpahu paṭṭaṇu
   ṇaṃ uttama-rāẏahaṃsa-mihuṇu  $  papphulliẏa-paṅkaẏa-va(ẏa)ṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 5:
avarekka-divasĕ diḍha-vāhu-daṇḍu  $  vijjaü jokkhantu mahā-paẏaṇḍu
gaü tetthu jetthu māṇusa-vamālu  $  jalaharadharu ṇāmeṃ giri visālu
gandhavva-vāvi jahĩ jagĕ paẏāsa  $  gandhavva-kumārihĩ chaha sahāsa
divĕ-divĕ jala-kīla karantu jetthu  $  raẏaṇāsava-ṇandaṇu ḍhukku tetthu
sahasatti diṭṭhu paramesarīhĩ  $  ṇaṃ sāẏaru saẏala-mahā-sarīhĩ
ṇaṃ ṇava-maẏalañchaṇu kumuiṇīhĩ  $  ṇaṃ vāla-divāẏaru kamaliṇīhĩ
savvaü rakkhaṇa-parivāriẏāu  $  savvaü savvālaṅkāriẏāu
ghattā:
savvaü bhaṇanti vaü pariharĕvi  $  vammaha-sara-jajjariẏaü
    "paĩ mellĕvi aṇṇu ṇa bhattāru  $  pariṇi ṇāha saĩ variẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 6:
etthantarĕ ārakkhiẏa-bhaḍehĩ  $  lahu gampiṇu gamaṇa-viẏāvaḍehĩ
jāṇāviu sundara-suravarāsu  $  "savvaü kaṇṇaü ekkahŏ ṇarāsu
karĕ laggaü teṇa vi icchiẏāu  $  paccelliu susamāicchiẏāu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sura-sundaru viruddhu  $  uddhāiu ṇāĩ kiẏantu kuddhu
aṇṇu vi kaṇaẏāhiu vuha-samāṇu  $  taṃ pekkhĕvi sāhaṇu appamāṇu
viṭṭiĕhĩ vuttu "ṇaü ko vi saraṇu  $  taü amhahã kāraṇĕ ḍhukku maraṇu"
rāvaṇĕṇa hasiu "kiṃ āẏaehĩ  $  kira kāĩ siẏālahĩ ghāiehĩ"
ghattā:
osovaṇi-vijjaĕ soẏavĕvi  $  vaddhā visahara-pāsĕhĩ
    jiha dūra-bhavva bhava-saṃciĕhĩ  $  dukkiẏa-kamma-sahāsĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 7:
āmellĕvi pujjĕvi karĕvi dāsa  $  pariṇeppiṇu kaṇṇahã cha vi sahāsa
gaü rāvaṇu ṇiẏa-paṭṭaṇu paviṭṭhu  $  sa-kiẏatthu saẏala-pariẏaṇĕṇa diṭṭhu
vahu-kāleṃ mandovarihĕ jāẏa  $  indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa ve vi bhāẏa
ettahĕ vi kumbhapurĕ kumbhaẏaṇṇu  $  pariṇāviu siẏa-saṃpaẏa pavaṇṇu
rattindiu laṅkāuri-paesu  $  jagaḍaï vaïsavaṇahŏ taṇaü desu
gaẏa paẏa kūvāreṃ kou hūu  $  pesiu vaẏaṇālaṅkāra-dūu
dahavaẏaṇaṭṭhāṇu païṭṭhu gampi  $  tehi mi kiu abbhutthāṇu kiṃ pi
pabhaṇiu "sumāli-pahu dehi kaṇṇu  $  pottaü ṇivāri iu kumbhaẏaṇṇu
ghattā:
avarāha-saehi mi vaïsavaṇu  $  tumhahĩ samaü ṇa jujjhaï
    ḍajjhantu vi savara-pulindaĕhĩ  $  viñjhu jema ṇa virujjhaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 8:
para āeṃ pekkhami vipaḍivaṇṇu  $  jeṃ ṇāhĩ ṇivārahŏ kumbhaẏaṇṇu
eẏahŏ pāsiu tumhahã viṇāsu  $  eẏahŏ pāsiu āgamaṇu tāsu
eẏahŏ pāsiu pāẏāla-laṅka  $  païsevaü puṇu vi karevi saṅka
māli vi jagaḍantaü āsi ema  $  muu paḍĕvi paīvĕ paẏaṅgu jema
taïẏahũ tumhahũ vittantu jo jjĕ  $  evahĩ dīsaï paḍivaü vi so jjĕ
vari ĕhu jĕ samappiu kula-kaẏantu  $  acchaü tahŏ gharĕ ṇiẏalaĩ vahantu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rosiu ṇisiẏarindu  $  "kahŏ taṇaü dhaṇaü kahŏ taṇaü indu"
avaloiu bhīsaṇu candahāsu  $  paḍivakkha-pakkha-khaẏa-kāla-vāsu
"paĩ paḍhamu kareppiṇu vali-vihāṇu  $  puṇu pacchaĕ dhaṇaẏahŏ malami māṇu"
siru ṇāvĕvi vuttu vihīsaṇeṇa  $  "viṇivāieṇa dūveṇa eṇa
ghattā:
paribhamaï aẏasu para-maṇḍalĕhĩ  $  tumhahã eu ṇa chajjaï
      jujjhantaü hariṇa-ulehĩ sahũ  $  kiṃ pañcamuhu ṇa lajjaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 9:
ṇīsāriu dūu paṇaṭṭhu kema  $  kesari-kama-cukku kuraṅgu jema
ettahĕ vi dasāṇaṇu vipphurantu  $  saṇṇahĕvi viṇiggaü jiha kaẏantu
ṇīsariu vihīsaṇu bhāṇukaṇṇu  $  raẏaṇāsaü maü māriccu aṇṇu
ṇīsariu sahovaru mallavantu  $  indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇu sisu vi hontu
haü tūru paẏāṇaü diṇṇu jāma  $  dūeṇa vi dhaṇaẏahŏ kahiu tāma
"mālihĕ pāsiu eẏahŏ maraṭṭu  $  ukkhandhu devi aṇṇu vi paẏaṭṭu
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi saṇṇahĕvi jakkhu  $  ṇīsariu ṇāĩ saĩ dasasaẏakkhu
thiu uḍḍĕvi giri-guñjakkhĕ jāma  $  taṃ jāuhāṇa-valu ḍhukku tāma
ghattā:
haẏa samara-tūra kiẏa-kalaẏalaĩ  $  amarisa-rahasa-visaṭṭaĩ
    vaïsavaṇa-dasāṇaṇa-sāhaṇaĩ  $  viṇṇi vi raṇĕ abbhiṭṭaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 10:
keṇa vi sundara su-ramaṇa su-seva  $  āliṅgiẏa gaẏa-ghaḍa vesa jeva
sa vi kāsu vi uraẏalĕ vejjhu dei  $  ṇaṃ vivariẏa-suraeṃ hiẏaü lei
keṇa vi āvāhiu maṇḍalaggu  $  kari-siru ṇivvaṭṭĕvi mahihĩ laggu
keṇa vi kāsu vi gaẏa-ghāu diṇṇu  $  kiu sa-rahu sa-sārahi cuṇṇu cuṇṇu
keṇa vi kāsu vi uru sarahĩ bhariu  $  lakkhijjaï ṇaṃ romañcu dhariu
keṇa vi kāsu vi raṇĕ mukku cakku  $  thiu hiẏaĕ dharĕvi ṇaṃ pisuṇa-vakku
etthantarĕ dhaṇaeṃ ṇa kiu kheu  $  hakkāriu āhavĕ kaïkaseu
"laï tujjhu jujjhu ettaḍaü kālu  $  ḍhukko 'si sīha-dantantarālu"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rāvaṇu kuiẏa-maṇu  $  vaïsavaṇahŏ ālaggaü
    karu ubbhĕvi gajjĕvi gulagulĕvi  $  ṇaṃ gaẏavarahŏ mahaggaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 11:
amvuhara-līla-saṃdarisaṇeṇa  $  sara-maṇḍaü kiu tahĩ dasa-sireṇa
viṇivāriu diṇaẏara-kara-ṇihāu  $  ṇisi divasu kiṃ ti sandehu jāu
sandaṇĕ haĕ gaĕ dhaẏa-cindhĕ chattĕ  $  jampāṇĕ vimāṇĕ ṇarinda-gattĕ
tharatharaharanta sara lagga kema  $  dhaṇavantaĕ māṇusĕ pisuṇa jema
jakkheṇa vi haẏa vāṇehĩ vāṇa  $  muṇivarĕṇa kasāẏa va ḍhukkamāṇa
dhaṇu pāḍiu pāḍiu chatta-daṇḍu  $  dahamuha-rahu kiu saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu
aṇṇeṇa caḍeppiṇu bhiḍiu rāu  $  ṇaṃ giri-saṃghāẏahŏ kulisa-ghāu
haü dhaṇaü bhiṇḍivāleṇa urasĕ  $  oṇallu bhāṇu lhasiĕ va divasĕ
ghattā:
ṇiu ṇiẏa-sāmantĕhĩ vaïsavaṇu  $  vijaü dasāṇaṇĕ ghuṭṭhaü
    "kahĩ jāhi pāva jīvantu mahu"  $  kumbhaẏaṇṇu āruṭṭhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 10, Kaḍavaka 12:
"āeṃ samāṇu kira kavaṇu khattu  $  ghāijjaï ṇāsanto vi sattu
jaṃ phiṭṭaï jamma-saẏāhã kāṇi"  $  kira jāma padhāvaï sūla-pāṇi
avaruṇḍĕvi dhariu vihīsaṇeṇa  $  "kiṃ kāẏara-ṇara-viddhaṃsaṇeṇa
so hammaï jo pahaṇaï puṇo vi  $  kiṃ uraü ma jīvaü ṇivviso vi
ṇāsaü varāu ṇiẏa-pāṇa levi"  $  thiu bhāṇukaṇṇu maccharu muevi
etthantarĕ vaïsavaṇahŏ maṇiṭṭhu  $  su-kalattu va puppha-vimāṇu diṭṭhu
tahĩ caḍiu ṇarāhiu muĕvi saṅka  $  paṭṭhaviẏa pasāhā ke vi laṅka
appuṇu puṇu jo jo ko vi caṇḍu  $  tahŏ tahŏ ḍhukkaï jiha kāla-daṇḍu
ghattā:
ṇiẏa-vandhava-saẏaṇĕhĩ pariẏariu  $  daṇuvaï dudama-damantaü
    āhiṇḍaï līlaĕ indu jiha  $  desa-sa ẏaṃ bhu ñjantaü
----------  [11. egārahamo saṃdhi]  ----------
puppha-vimāṇārūḍhaĕṇa  $  dahavaẏaṇeṃ dhavala-visālāĩ
ṇaṃ ghaṇa-vindaĩ a-salilaĩ  $  diṭṭhaĩ hariseṇa-jiṇālāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 1:
toẏadavāhaṇa-vaṃsa-paīveṃ  $  pucchiu puṇu sumāli dahagīveṃ
"ahŏ ahŏ tāẏa tāẏa sasi-dhavalaĩ  $  eẏaĩ kiṃ ṇa jaluggaẏa-kamalaĩ
kiṃ hima-siharaĩ sāḍĕvi mukkaĩ  $  kiṃ ṇakkhattaĩ thāṇahŏ cukkaĩ
daṇḍuddaṇḍa-dhavala-puṇḍariẏaĩ  $  kiṃ kāha mi sīsuppari dhariẏaĩ
abbhārambha-vivajjiẏa-gabbhaĩ  $  kiṃ bhūmiẏalĕ gaẏaĩ subbhabbhaĩ
kiẏa-maṅgala-siṅgāra-sahāsaĩ  $  kiṃ āvāsiẏāĩ kalahaṃsaĩ
jasu savvaṅgaĩ khaṇḍĕvi khaṇḍĕvi  $  kiẏa gaü ko vi paḍīvaü chaṇḍĕvi
kāmiṇi-vaẏaṇohāmiẏa-chāẏaĩ  $  kiẏa sasi-saẏaĩ mileppiṇu āẏaĩ"
ghattā:
kahaï sumāli dasāṇaṇahŏ  $  "jaṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇanda-jaṇerāĩ
    jiṇa-bhavaṇaĩ chuha-paṅkiẏaĩ  $  eẏaĩ hariseṇahŏ kerāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 2:
aṭṭhāhiẏahĕ majjhĕ mahi siddhī  $  ṇava-ṇihi-caüdaha-raẏaṇa-samiddhī
pahilaĕ divasĕ mahāraha-kāraṇĕ  $  jāṇĕvi jaṇaṇi-dukkhu gaü takkhaṇĕ
vīẏaĕ tāvasa-bhavaṇu parāiu  $  maẏaṇāvalihĕ maẏaṇa-jaru lāiu
taïẏaĕ sindhuṇaẏarĕ supasaṇṇaü  $  hatthi jiṇeppiṇu laïẏaü kaṇṇaü
veẏamaīĕ caütthaĕ hāriu  $  jaẏacandahĕ hiẏavaĕ païsāriu
pañcamĕ gaṅgāhara-mahihara-raṇu  $  tahĩ uppaṇṇu cakku tahŏ sa-raẏaṇu
chaṭṭhaĕ pihimi hūa āvaggī  $  aṇṇu vi maẏaṇāvali karĕ laggī
sattamĕ gampi jaṇaṇi jokkāriẏa  $  aṭṭhamĕ divasĕ pujja ṇīsāriẏa
ghattā:
eẏaĩ teṇa vi ṇimmiẏaĩ  $  sasi-saṅkha-khīra-kundujjalaĩ
    āharaṇaĩ va vasundharihĕ  $  siva-sāsaẏa-suhaĩ va avicalaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 3:
gaü suṇantu hariseṇa-kahāṇaü  $  sammeẏa-irihĩ mukku paẏāṇaü
tāma ṇiṇāu samuṭṭhiu bhīsaṇu  $  jāuhāṇa-sāhaṇa-saṃtāsaṇu
pesiẏa hattha-pahattha padhāiẏa  $  vaṇa-kari ṇiĕvi paḍīvā āiẏa
"deva deva kiu jeṇa mahāraü  $  acchaï matta-hatthi aïrāvaü
gajjaṇāĕ aṇuharaï samuddahŏ  $  sīẏareṇa jalaharahŏ raüddahŏ
kaddameṇa ṇava-pāusa-kālahŏ  $  ṇijjhareṇa mahiharahŏ visālahŏ
rukkhummūlaṇeṇa duvvāẏahŏ  $  suhaḍa-viṇāsaṇeṇa jamarāẏahŏ
daṃsaṇeṇa āsīvisa-sappahŏ  $  viviha-maẏāvatthaĕ kandappahŏ
ghattā:
indu vi caḍĕvi ṇa sakkiẏaü  $  khandhāsaṇĕ eẏahŏ vāraṇahŏ
    gaü caüpāsiu paribhamĕvi  $  jima attha-hīṇu kāmiṇi-jaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 4:
aṇṇuppaṇṇu dasaṇṇaẏa-kāṇaṇĕ  $  māhava-māsĕ desĕ sāhāraṇĕ
ubhaẏa-cāri savvaṅgiẏa-sundaru  $  bhadda-hatthi ṇāmeṇa maṇoharu
satta samuttuṅgaü ṇava dīharu  $  daha pariṇāhu tiṇṇi kara vittharu
ṇiddha-dantu mahu-piṅgala-loẏaṇu  $  aẏasi-kusuma-ṇihu ratta-karāṇaṇu
pañca-maṅgalāvattu maẏālaü  $  cakka-kumbha-dhaẏa-chatta-rihālaü
vaṭṭa-taraṭṭi-thaṇaẏa-kumbhatthalu  $  pulaẏa-sarīru galiẏa-gaṇḍatthalu
uṇṇaẏa-kandharu sūẏara-pacchalu  $  vīsa-ṇaharu suandha-maẏa-parimalu
cāva-vaṃsu thira-maṃsu thiroẏaru  $  gatta-danta-kara-puccha-paīharu
ghattā:
ema aṇeẏaĩ lakkhaṇaĩ  $  kiṃ gaṇiẏaĩ ṇāma-vihūṇāĩ
    hatthi-paesahũ savvahu mi  $  caüddaha-saẏaĩ caürūṇāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi dasāṇaṇu harisiu  $  urĕ ṇa mantu romañcu va darisiu
"jaï taṃ bhadda-hatthi ṇaü sāhami  $  to jaṇaṇovari asivaru vāhami"
eu bhaṇevi sa-seṇṇu padhāiu  $  taṃ paesu sahasatti parāiu
gaẏavaï ṇiĕvi virelliẏa-ṇaẏaṇeṃ  $  hasiu pahatthu ṇavara daha-vaẏaṇeṃ
"haũ jāṇami pacaṇḍu tamveramu  $  ṇavara vilāsiṇi-rūu va maṇŏramu
haũ jāṇami gaïnda-kumbhatthalu  $  ṇavara vilāsiṇi-ghaṇa-thaṇa-maṇḍalu
jāṇami su-visāṇaĩ a-kalaṅkaĩ  $  ṇavara pasaṇṇa-kaṇṇa-tāḍaṅkaĩ
haũ jāṇami bhamanti bhamara-ulaĩ  $  ṇavara ṇirantara-pelliẏa-kurulaĩ
ghattā:
jāṇami kari-khandhāruhaṇu  $  accantu hoi bhaẏa-bhāsuraü
    ṇavara pahattha majjhu maṇahŏ  $  uvvahaï ṇavallu ṇāĩ suraü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 6:
puppha-vimāṇahŏ līṇu dasāṇaṇu  $  diḍhu ṇiẏatthu kiu kesa-ṇivandhaṇu
laïẏa laṭṭhi ugghosiu kalaẏalu  $  tūraĩ haẏaĩ padhāiu maẏagalu
ahimuhu dhaṇaẏa-purandara-vaïrihĕ  $  vāsārattu jema viñjhaïrihĕ
pukkharĕ tāḍiu lakkuḍi-ghāeṃ  $  ṇāvaï kāla-mehu duvvāeṃ
dei ṇa dei vejjhu urĕ jāvĕhĩ  $  vijjula-vilasiẏa-karaṇeṃ tāvĕhĩ
pacchalĕ caḍiu dhuṇĕvi bhuva-ḍāliu  $  "vudavuda" bhaṇĕvi khandhĕ apphāliu
jaṅghiu puṇu vi kareṇāliṅgĕvi  $  suviṇā(?)daïu jema gaü laṅghĕvi
khaṇĕ gaṇḍaẏalĕ ṭhāi khaṇĕ kandharĕ  $  khaṇĕ caühu mi calaṇahũ abbhantarĕ
ghattā:
dīsaï ṇāsaï vipphuraï  $  paribhamaï caüddisu kuñjarahŏ
    calu lakkhijjaï gaẏaṇa-ẏalĕ  $  ṇaṃ vijju-puñju ṇava-jalaharahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 7:
hatthi-viẏāraṇāu eẏāraha  $  aṇṇaü kiriẏaü vīsa duvāraha
darisĕvi kiu ṇipphandu mahā-gaü  $  dhutteṃ vesa-maraṭṭu va bhaggaü
sāhiu mokkhu va parama-jiṇindeṃ  $  "hou hou ṇaṃ raḍiu gaïndeṃ
"bhalĕ bhalĕ" pabhaṇiu calaṇu samappiu  $  teṇa vi vāmaṅguṭṭheṃ cappiu
kaṇṇĕ dharĕvi ārūḍhu mahāiu  $  karĕvi viẏāraṇa aṅkusu lāiu
teṇa vimāṇa-jāṇa-āṇandeṃ  $  melliu kusuma-vāsu sura-vindeṃ
ṇacciu kumbhaẏaṇṇu sa-vihīsaṇu  $  hatthu pahatthu vi maü suẏasāraṇu
mallavantu māriccu mahoẏaru  $  raẏaṇāsaü sumāli vajjoẏaru
ghattā:
harisa-raseṇa karamviẏaü  $  vīra-rasu jeṇa maṇĕ bhāviẏaü
    tahĩ rāvaṇa-ṇaṭṭāvaĕṇa  $  so ṇāhĩ jo ṇa ṇaccāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 8:
tijagavihūsaṇu ṇāmu pagāsiu  $  ṇiu tahĩ simiru jetthu āvāsiu
thiu sahasā kari-kaha-aṇurāiu  $  tahĩ avasarĕ bhaḍu ekku parāiu
pahara-vihuru ruhirolliẏa-gattaü  $  ṇaravaï teṇa ṇavĕvi viṇṇattaü
"deva deva kikkindhahŏ taṇaĕhĩ  $  savvala-phaliha-sūla-hala-kaṇaĕhĩ
asivara-jhasa-musaṇḍhi-ṇārāĕhĩ  $  cakka-konta-gaẏa-moggara-ghāĕhĩ
jamu āroḍiu bhaggā teṇa vi  $  dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu vihi ekkeṇa vi
paccelliu ṇillūriẏa vāṇĕhĩ  $  kaha vi kaha vi ṇaü melliu pāṇĕhĩ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi kuiu rakkhaddhaü  $  haẏa saṃgāma-bheri saṇṇaddhaü
ghattā:
candahāsu karaẏalĕ karĕvi  $  sa-vimāṇu sa-valu saṃcalliẏaü
    mahi laṅgheppiṇu maẏaraharu  $  āẏāsahŏ ṇaṃ utthalliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 11, Kaḍavaka 9:
kova-davaggi-palittu padhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ taṃ jama-ṇaẏaru parāiu

ahi-giliẏa-gaïnda-pamutta-sāsu  $  sāsuggaẏa-mottiẏa-dhavaliẏāsu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 13, Kaḍavaka 11:
duvaī

āesu diṇṇu ṇiẏa-kiṅkarahũ  $  vajjoẏara-maẏara-mahoẏarahũ
māricca-maẏahũ suẏa-sāraṇahũ  $  indaïkumāra-ghaṇavāhaṇahũ
haẏa-hattha-pahattha-vihīsaṇahũ  $  vihi-kumbhaẏaṇṇa-khara-dūsaṇahũ
sasikara-suggīva-ṇīla-ṇalahũ  $  avarahu mi aṇiṭṭhiẏa-bhuẏavalahũ
uddhāiẏa macchara-maliẏa-kara  $  bhīsāvaṇa-paharaṇa-ṇiẏara-dhara
sahasaẏaru vi juvaïhĩ pariẏariu  $  chuḍu je chuḍu salilahŏ ṇīsariu
tāṇantarĕ tūraĩ ṇisuṇiẏaĩ  $  paṇaveppiṇu bhiccahĩ pisuṇiẏaĩ
"paramesara pārakkaü paḍiu  $  laï paharaṇu samaru samāvaḍiu"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu  $  dhaṇu karĕ leppiṇu  $  ṇisiẏara-pavara-samūhahŏ
thiu samuhāṇaṇu  $  ṇaṃ pañcāṇaṇu  $  ṇāĩ mahā-gaẏa-jūhahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 2:
jaṃ jujjha-sajju thiu levi dhaṇu  $  taṃ ḍariu asesu vi juvaïẏaṇu
mambhīsiu rāeṃ vuṇṇa-maṇu  $  "kiṃ aṇṇahŏ ṇāũ sahasakiraṇu
ekkekkahŏ ekkekkaü jĕ karu  $  parirakkhaï jaï to kavaṇu ḍaru
acchahŏ bhuva-maṇḍavĕ vaïsarĕvi  $  jiha kariṇiu giri-guha païsarĕvi
jā dalami kumbhi-kumbhatthalaĩ  $  hosanti kuḍumvihĩ ukkhalaĩ
jā khaṇami visāṇaĩ pavarāĩ  $  hosanti paẏahŏ paccavarāĩ
jā kaḍḍhami kari-sira-mottiẏaĩ  $  hosanti tumha hārattiẏaĩ
jā phāḍami pharaharanta-dhaẏaĩ  $  hosanti veṇi-vandhaṇa-saẏaĩ
ghattā:
ema bhaṇeppiṇu  $  taṃ dhīreppiṇu  $  ṇaravaï rahavarĕ caḍiẏaü
juvaïhũ karuṇĕṇa (?)  $  XXviṇu aruṇĕṇa  $  ṇāĩ divāẏaru paḍiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 3:
etthantarĕ āroḍiu bhaḍĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ kesari matta-hatthi-haḍĕhĩ
so ekku aṇantaü jaï vi valu  $  papphullu to vi tahŏ muha-kamalu
jaṃ laïu akhatteṃ sahasaẏaru  $  taṃ caviu paropparu sura-pavaru
"ahŏ ahŏ aṇīi rakkhehĩ kiẏa  $  ekku ĕ vahu aṇṇu vi gaẏaṇĕ thiẏa
paharaṇaĩ pavaṇa-giri-vāri-havi  $  āehĩ sarisa jaṇĕ bhīru ṇa vi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇisiẏara lajjiẏaĩ  $  thiẏa mahiẏalĕ vijja-vivajjiẏaĩ
to sahasakiraṇu sahasahĩ karĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ viddhaï sahasa-sahasa-sarĕhĩ
dūrahŏ ji ṇiruddhaü vaïri-valu  $  ṇaṃ jamvūdīveṃ uvahi-jalu
ghattā:
amuṇiẏa-thāṇahŏ  $  kiẏa-saṃdhāṇahŏ  $  diṭṭhi-muṭṭhi-sara-paẏarahŏ
pāsu ṇa ḍhukkaï  $  te ullukkaï  $  timiru jema divasaẏarahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 4:
aṭṭhāvaẏa-giri-kampāvaṇahŏ  $  paḍihāreṃ akkhiu rāvaṇahŏ
"paramesara ekkeṃ hontaĕṇa  $  valu saẏalu dhariu paharantaĕṇa
raṇĕ rahavaru ekku jĕ paribhamaï  $  sandaṇa-sahāsu ṇaṃ paribhamaï
dhaṇu ekku ekku ṇaru dui jĕ kara  $  caüdisahĩ ṇavara ṇivaḍanti sara
karu kahŏ vi kahŏ vi uru kappariu  $  kari kahŏ vi kahŏ vi rahu jajjariu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi uvahi jema khuhiu  $  lahu tijagavihūsaṇĕ āruhiu
gaü tettahĕ jettahĕ sahasakaru  $  kokkiu "maru pāva paharu paharu
haũ rāvaṇu dujjaü keṇa jiu  $  jeṃ pārāutṭhaü dhaṇaü kiu"
ghattā:
ema bhaṇantĕṇa  $  viddhantĕṇa  $  sa-rahi mahārahu chiṇṇaü
paṇaï-sahāsĕhĩ  $  caü-pāsĕhĩ  $  jasu caüdisu vikkhiṇṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 5:
māhesarapura-vaï virahu kiu  $  ṇivisaddheṃ matta-gaïndĕ thiu
ṇaṃ añjaṇa-mahiharĕ saraẏa-ghaṇu  $  utthariu sa-maccharu gīḍha-dhaṇu
saṇṇāhu khuruppeṃ kappariu  $  laṅkāhiu kaha va samuvvariu
jeṃ savvāẏāmeṃ muaï sara  $  lua-pakkha pakkhi ṇaṃ janti dhara
dasasaẏakiraṇeṇa ṇirikkhiẏaü  $  paccāriu "kahĩ dhaṇu sikkhiẏaü
jajjāhi tāma abbhāsu karĕ  $  pacchalĕ jujjhejjahi puṇu samarĕ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jamĕṇa va joiẏaü  $  kuñjaru kuñjarahŏ pacoiẏaü
āsaṇṇeṃ coĕvi vigaẏa-bhaü  $  ṇaravaï ṇiḍālĕ konteṇa haü
ghattā:
jāma bhaẏaṅkaru  $  asivara-karu  $  paharaï macchara-bhariẏaü
tāma dasāsĕṇa  $  āẏāsĕṇa  $  uppaevi pahu dhariẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 6:
ṇiu ṇiẏa-ṇilaẏahŏ maẏa-viẏaliẏaü  $  ṇaṃ matta-mahāgaü ṇiẏaliẏaü
"mā maï mi dharesaï dahavaẏaṇu"  $  ṇaṃ bhaïẏaĕ ravi gaü atthavaṇu
pasariu andhāru pamokkalaü  $  ṇaṃ ṇisiĕ ghittu masi-poṭṭalaü
sasi uggaü suṭṭhu susohiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ jaga-harĕ dīvaü vohiẏaü
suvihāṇẽ divāẏaru uggamiu  $  ṇaṃ raẏaṇihĩ maïẏavaṭṭu bhamiu
to ṇavara jaṅghacāraṇa-risihĕ  $  saẏakarahŏ viṇāsiẏa-bhava-ṇisihĕ
gaẏa vatta "sahāsakiraṇu dhariu"  $  caüviha-risi-saṅgheṃ pariẏariu
ghattā:
rāvaṇu jettahĕ  $  gaü (so) tettahĕ  $  pañca-mahāvaẏa-dhāraü
diṭṭhu dasāsĕṇa  $  seẏaṃsĕṇa  $  ṇāvaï risahu bhaḍāraü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 7:
guru vandiẏa diṇṇaĩ āsaṇaĩ  $  maṇi-veẏaḍiẏaĩ suha-daṃsaṇaĩ
muṇi-puṅgaü cavaï visuddhamaï  $  "muĕ sahasakiraṇu laṅkāhivaï
ĕhu carimadehu sāmaṇṇu ṇa vi  $  mahu taṇaü bhavva-rāīva-ravi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jama-kampāvaṇĕṇa  $  paṇaveppiṇu vuccaï rāvaṇĕṇa
"mahu eṇa samāṇu kou kavaṇu  $  para pujjahĕ kāraṇĕ jāu raṇu
ajju vi ehu jĕ pahu sā ji siẏa  $  aṇuhuñjaü meiṇi jema tiẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sahasakiraṇu cavaï  $  "uttamahŏ eu kiṃ saṃbhavaï
taṃ maṇahara salila-kīla karĕvi  $  paĩ samaü mahāhavĕ uttharĕvi
ghattā:
evahĩ āẏaĕ  $  vicchāẏaĕ  $  rāẏa-siẏaĕ kiṃ kijjaï
vari thira-kulahara  $  ajarāmara  $  siddhi-vahuva pariṇijjaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 8:
teṃ vaẏaṇeṃ mukku visuddha-maï  $  māhesara-pavara-purāhivaï
ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇu ṇiẏaẏa-thāṇĕ thavĕvi  $  pariẏaṇu paṭṭaṇu paẏa saṃthavĕvi
ṇikkhantu khaṇaddheṃ vigaẏa-bhaü  $  rāvaṇu vi paẏāṇaü devi gaü
paripesiu lehu pahāṇāhŏ  $  aṇaraṇṇahŏ ujjhahĕ rāṇāhŏ
muha-vatta kahiẏa "dahamuhĕṇa jiu  $  laï sahasakiraṇu tava-caraṇĕ thiu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaravaï harisiẏaü  $  īsīsi visāu padarisiẏaü
saṃgāma-sahāsĕhĩ dūsahahŏ  $  siẏa saẏala samappĕvi dasarahahŏ
sahasatti so vi ṇikkhantu pahu  $  aṇṇu vi tahŏ taṇaü aṇantarahu
ghattā:
tāma sukesĕṇa  $  laṅkesĕṇa  $  jamahara-aṇuharamāṇaü
jāgu paṇāsĕvi  $  riu tāsĕvi  $  magahahã mukku paẏāṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 9:
ṇāraü dhīrĕvi maru vasikarĕvi  $  tahŏ taṇiẏa taṇaẏa karaẏalĕ dharĕvi
ṇava-ṇava saṃvacchara tetthu thiu  $  puṇu diṇṇu paẏāṇaü magahu gaü
pekkhĕvi rāvaṇu āsaṅkiẏaü  $  mahu mahurapurāhiu vasikiẏaü
jasu camareṃ amareṃ diṇṇu varu  $  sūlāuhu saẏalāuha-pavaru
ṇiẏa taṇaẏa tāsu lāevi karĕ  $  thiu ṇavara gampi kaïlāsa-dharĕ
mandāiṇi diṭṭha maṇohariẏa  $  sasikanta-ṇīra-ṇijjhara-bhariẏa
gaẏa-maẏa-ṇaï-maïliẏa-ubhaẏa-taḍa  $  sa-turaṅgama-kuñjara ṇhāẏa bhaḍa
vandeppiṇu jiṇavara-bhavaṇāĩ  $  dahamuhu dakkhavaï ṇivāṇāĩ
"iha siddhu siddhi-muhakamala-ali  $  jiṇavaru bharahesaru vāhuvali
ghattā:
etthu silāsaṇĕ  $  attāvaṇĕ  $  acchiu vāli-bhaḍāraü
jasu paẏa-bhārĕṇa  $  garuẏārĕṇa  $  haũ kiu kummāẏāraü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 10:
jama-dhaṇaẏa-sahāsakiraṇa-damaṇu  $  jaṃ thiu aṭṭhāvaĕ dahavaẏaṇu
taṃ patta vatta ṇalakuvvarahŏ  $  dullaṅgha-ṇaẏara-paramesarahŏ
paricintiu "haẏa-gaẏa-raha-pavalĕ  $  āsaṇṇĕ pariṭṭhiĕ vaïri-valĕ
etthu vi amarāhivĕ raṇĕ ajaĕ  $  jiṇa-vandaṇahattiĕ meru gaĕ
ehaĕ avasarĕ uvāu kavaṇu"  $  to manti pavolliu haridavaṇu
"valavantaĩ jantaĩ uṭṭhavahŏ  $  caüdisu āsāla-vijja ṭhavahŏ
jaṃ hoi acheu abheu puru  $  tā rakkhahũ pāvaï jā ṇa suru"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi tehi mi tema kiu  $  saï-cittu va ṇaẏaru dulaṅghu thiu
ghattā:
tāva viruddhĕhĩ  $  jasa-luddhĕhĩ  $  rāvaṇa-bhicca-sahāsĕhĩ
veḍḍhiu puravaru  $  saṃvaccharu  $  ṇāvaï vāraha-māsĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 11:
jantahã bhaïẏaĕ vihaḍapphaḍĕhĩ  $  dahamuhahŏ kahiu kehi mi bhaḍĕhĩ
"duggejjhu bhaḍārā taṃ ṇaẏaru  $  dūsiddhahũ jiha tihuaṇa-siharu
tahĩ janta-saẏāĩ samuḍḍiẏaĩ  $  jama-karaĩ jameṇa va chaḍḍiẏaĩ
joẏaṇahŏ majjhĕ jo saṃcaraï  $  so paḍijīvantu ṇa ṇīsaraï"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi cintāvaṇṇu pahu  $  thiu tāma jāma uvarambha vahu
aṇuratta parokkhae jĕ jasĕṇa  $  jiha mahuari kusuma-gandha-vasĕṇa
ṇa gaṇaï kappūru ṇa candamasu  $  ṇa jaladdu ṇa candaṇu tāmarasu
tahĕ dasamī kāmāvattha huẏa  $  virahaggi-daḍḍha ṇaü kaha mi muẏa
ghattā:
"imu mahu jovvaṇu  $  ĕhu (so) rāvaṇu  $  eha riddhi parivārahŏ
jaï melāvahi  $  to halĕ sahi  $  ettiu phalu saṃsārahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi cittamāla cavaï  $  "maĩ hontiĕ kāĩ ṇa saṃbhavaï
āesu dehi chuḍu ettaḍaü  $  ĕu sundari kāraṇu kettaḍaü
tuha rūvahŏ rāvaṇu hoi jaï  $  laï vaṭṭaï to ettaḍiẏa gaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi maṇahara-aharaẏalu  $  uvarambhahĕ vihasiu muha-kamalu
"halĕ halĕ sahi sasimuhi haṃsa-gaï  $  so suhaü ṇa icchaï kaha vi jaï
āsāla-vijja to dehi tahŏ  $  aṇṇu vi vajjarahi dasāṇaṇahŏ
vuccaï rahaṅgu bhaḍa-liha-luhaṇu  $  indāuhu acchaï suarisaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi dūī ṇiggaïẏa  $  laṅkesāvāsu ṇavara gaïẏa
ghattā:
kahiu dasāsahŏ  $  sura-tāsahŏ  $  jaṃ uvarambhaĕ vuttaü
ettiu "dāheṇa  $  tuha virahĕṇa  $  sāmiṇi maraï" ṇiruttaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 13:
uvarambha samicchahi ajju jaï  $  to jaṃ cintahi taṃ saṃbhavaï
āsālī sijjhaï puravaru vi  $  suarisaṇu cakku ṇalakuvvaru vi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi suṭṭhu viẏakkhaṇahŏ  $  avaloiu vaẏaṇu vihīsaṇahŏ
païsāriẏa dūī majjaṇaĕ  $  thiẏa ve vi sahoẏara mantaṇaĕ
"ahŏ sāhasu pabhaṇaï pahu muẏavi  $  jaṃ mahila karaï taṃ purisu ṇa vi
dummahila ji bhīsaṇa jama-ṇaẏari  $  dummahila ji asaṇi jaganta-ẏari
dummahila ji sa-visa bhuẏaṅga-phaḍa  $  dummahila ji vaïvasa-mahisa-jhaḍa
dummahila ji garuẏa vāhi ṇarahŏ  $  dummahila ji vagghi majjhĕ gharahŏ"
ghattā:
bhaṇaï vihīsaṇu  $  suha-daṃsaṇu  $  "etthu eu ṇaü ghaṭṭaï
sāmi ṇisaṇṇahŏ  $  ṇaü aṇṇahŏ  $  bheẏahŏ avasaru vaṭṭaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 14:
jaï kāraṇu vaïriṃ siddhaĕṇa  $  ṇaẏareṃ dhaṇa-kaṇaẏa-samiddhaĕṇa
to kavaḍeṇa vi "icchāmi" bhaṇu  $  puṇṇāli asacci dosu kavaṇu
chuḍu kema vi vijja samāvaḍaü  $  uvarambha tujjhu puṇu mā ''vaḍaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi gaü dahagīu tahĩ  $  majjaṇaẏahŏ ṇiggaẏa dūi jahĩ
devaṅgaĩ vatthaĩ ḍhoiẏaĩ  $  āharaṇaĩ raẏaṇujjoiẏaĩ
keūra-hāra-kaḍisuttāĩ  $  ṇeuraĩ kaḍaẏa-saṃjuttāĩ
avaraï mi devi tosiẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  āsāla-vijja maggiẏa khaṇĕṇa
tāĕ vi diṇṇa parituṭṭhiẏāĕ  $  ṇiẏa hāṇi ṇa jāṇiẏa muṭṭhiẏāĕ
ghattā:
tāva visāliẏa  $  āsāliẏa  $  ṇahĕ gajjanti parāiẏa
taṃ vijjāharu  $  ṇalakuvvaru  $  muĕvi ṇāĩ siẏa āiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 15, Kaḍavaka 15:
gaẏa dūī kiu kalaẏalu bhaḍĕhĩ  $  pariveḍhiu puravaru gaẏa-ghaḍĕhĩ
saṇṇahĕvi samarĕ ṇicchiẏa-maṇahŏ  $  ṇalakuvvaru bhiḍiu vihīsaṇahŏ
valu valahŏ mahāhavĕ dujjaẏahŏ  $  rahu rahahŏ gaïndu mahāgaẏahŏ
haü haẏahŏ ṇarāhivu ṇaravarahŏ  $  paharaṇa-dharu vara-paharaṇa-dharahŏ
cindhiu cindhiẏahŏ samāvaḍiu  $  vaïmāṇiu vaïmāṇihĕ bhiḍiu
tahĩ tumulĕ jujjhĕ bhīsāvaṇĕṇa  $  jiha sahasakiraṇu raṇĕ rāvaṇĕṇa
tiha virahu kareviṇu takkhaṇĕṇa  $  ṇalakuvvaru dhariu vihīsaṇĕṇa
sahũ purĕṇa siddhu taṃ suarisaṇu  $  uvarambha ṇa icchaï dahavaẏaṇu
ghattā:
so jjĕ puresaru  $  ṇalakuvvaru  $  ṇiẏaẏa kera levāviu
samaü sarambhaĕ  $  uvarambhaĕ  $  rajju sa iṃ bhu ñjāviu
----------  [16. solahamo saṃdhi]  ----------
ṇalakuvvare dhariẏaĕ  $  vijaĕ ghuṭṭhĕ vaïrihĕ taṇaĕ
ṇiẏa-mantihĩ sahiẏaü  $  indu pariṭṭhiu mantaṇaĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 1:
je gūḍhapurisa paṭṭhaviẏa teṇa  $  te āẏa paḍīvā takkhaṇeṇa
paripucchiẏa "laï akkhahŏ davatti  $  kehaü pahu kehiẏa tāsu satti
kiṃ valu kehaü pāikka-lou  $  kiṃ vasaṇu kavaṇu guṇu ko viṇou
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi daṇu-guṇa-periehĩ  $  sahasakkhahŏ akkhiu heriehĩ
"paramesara raṇĕ rāvaṇu acintu  $  ucchāha-manta-pahu-satti-vantu
caü-vijja-kusalu chagguṇa-ṇivāsu  $  chavviha-valu satta-paẏaï-paẏāsu
sattaviha-vasaṇa-virahiẏa-sarīru  $  vahu-vuddhi-satti-khama-kāla-dhīru
arivara-chavvagga-viṇāsaẏālu  $  aṭṭhārahaviha-titthāṇupālu
ghattā:
tahŏ keraĕ sāhaṇĕ  $  savvu sāmi-sammāṇiẏaü
    ṇaü kuddhaü luddhaü  $  ko vi bhīru avamāṇiẏaü
kā tisraḥ śaktayaḥ prabhūśaktiḥ utsāhaśaktiḥ mantraśaktiś ceti. 
kā catasro vidyāḥ ānvīkṣikī trayī vārttā daṇḍanītiś ceti. sāṅkhyo yogo lokāyataṃ cānvīkṣikī sāmargyajurvedāstrayī kṛṣiḥ pāśupālyaṃ vāṇijyaṃ vārtā ca ānvīkṣikī-trayī-vārtānāṃ yogakṣemasādhano daṇḍas tasya nītir iti. 
ṣaḍguṇāḥ ke te saṃdhi-vigraha-yānāsana-saṃśraya-dvaidhībhāvāḥ. 
kiṃ tad ṣaḍvidhaṃ balam mūlabalam bhṛtyabalam śreṇībalam mitrabalam amitrabalam āṭavikabalaṃ ceti. 
kā sapta prakṛtayaḥ svāmyamātya-janapada-durga-kośa-bala (v.l. daṇḍa)-mitrāṇi.
kāni sapta vyasanāni pānam dyūtam strī mṛgayā pāruṣyam daṇḍapāruṣyam arthadūṣaṇaṃ ceti. tatrādau catvāri kāmajāni trīṇi kopajāni. 
ko 'riṣaḍvargaḥ kāma-krodha-lobha-māna-mada-harṣāḥ. 
kānyaṣṭādaśa tīrthāni mantri-purohita-senāpati-yuvarāja-dauvārikāntarvaśika-praśastṛ-samāhartṛ-saṃvidhātṛ-pradeṣṭṛ-nāyaka-pauravyāvahārika-karmāntrika-mantripariṣaḍ-daṇḍadurgāntapālāṭavikāḥ. 
pasāhaṇi [a]ṣṭāṅgāni te.

paharaddhu paẏāva-gavesaṇeṇa  $  anteura-rakkhaṇa-pesaṇeṇa

paharaddhu ṇarāhiu  $  seṇāvaï-saṃbhāvaṇĕṇa

PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 3:
jiha divasu tema givvāṇa-rāẏa  $  ṇisi ṇei kareppiṇu aṭṭha bhāẏa
pahilaĕ paharaddhĕ vicintamāṇu  $  acchaï ṇigūḍhu purisĕhĩ samāṇu
vīẏaĕ puṇo vi ṇhāṇāsaṇeṇa  $  ahavaï ṇaravaï-suha-daṃsaṇeṇa
taïẏaĕ jaẏa-tūra-mahāraveṇa  $  anteuru visaï maṇucchaveṇa
caütthaĕ pañcamĕ sovaṇa-khaṇĕṇa  $  caüdisu diḍheṇa parirakkhaṇeṇa
chaṭṭaĕ haẏa-paḍaha-viujjhaṇeṇa  $  savvatthasattha-parivujjhaṇeṇa
sattamĕ mantihĩ sahũ mantaṇeṇa  $  ṇiẏa-rajja-kajja-paricintaṇeṇa
aṭṭhamĕ sāsaṇahara-pesaṇeṇa  $  suvihāṇĕ vejja-saṃbhāsaṇeṇa
mahaṇasi-paripucchaṇa-āsaṇeṇa  $  ṇimmitti-purohiẏa-ghosaṇeṇa
ghattā:
iẏa solaha-bhāĕhĩ  $  divasu vi raẏaṇi vi ṇivvahaï
      maṇu jujjhahŏ uppari  $  tāsu ṇirāriu ucchahaï

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 4:
tumhahũ ghaĩ ekka vi ṇāhĩ tatti  $  suviṇaĕ vi ṇa huẏa ucchāha-satti
vālattaṇĕ jeṃ ṇaü ṇihaü sattu  $  ṇaha-mettu ji kiẏaü kuḍhāra-mettu
jaïẏahũ ṇāmaü chuḍu chuḍu dasāsu  $  jaïẏahũ sāhiu vijjā-sahāsu
jaïẏahũ karĕ laggaü candahāsu  $  jaïẏahũ mandovari diṇṇa tāsu
jaïẏahũ surasundaru vaddhu kaṇaü  $  jaïẏahũ osāriu samarĕ dhaṇaü
jaïẏahũ jagabhūsaṇu dhariu ṇāu  $  jaïẏahũ parihaviu kiẏanta-rāu
jaïẏahũ su-taṇūẏari gaü harevi  $  aṇṇu vi raẏaṇāvali karĕ dharevi
taïẏahũ jĕ ṇāhĩ jaṃ ṇihaü sattu  $  taṃ evahĩ vaḍḍāraü paẏattu"
ghattā:
vuccaï sahasakkheṃ  $  "kiṃ kesari sisu-kari vahaï
    paccelliu huavahu  $  sukkaü pāẏaü suhu ḍahaï"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 5:
paccuttaru devi gaïnda-gamaṇu  $  puṇu ḍhukku sakku ekkanta-bhavaṇu
jahĩ bheu ṇa bhindaï ko vi lou  $  jahĩ sua-sāriẏahũ vi ṇāhĩ ḍhou
tahĩ païsĕvi pabhaṇaï amara-rāu  $  "riu dujjaü evahĩ ko uvāu
kiṃ sāmu bheu kiṃ uvavaẏāṇu  $  kiṃ daṇḍu avujjhiẏa-paripamāṇu
kiṃ kammārambhuvavāẏa-mantu  $  kiṃ purisa-davva-saṃpatti-vantu
kiṃ desa-kāla-pavihāẏa-sāru  $  kiṃ viṇivāiẏa-paḍihāra-cāru
kiṃ kajja-siddhi pañcamaü mantu  $  ko sundaru saccu vi sāravantu"
to bhāraduvāeṃ vuttu ema  $  "jaṃ paĩ pāraddhaü taṃ ji deva
kajjantĕ ṇavara ṇivvaḍaï cheu  $  para mantihĩ kevalu manta-bheu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi bhaṇaï visālacakkhu  $  "ĕhu paĩ uggāhiu kavaṇu pakkhu
ghattā:
tā acchaü suravaï  $  jo ṇīsesu rajju karaï
      pahu manti-vihūṇaü  $  caüraṅgihi mi ṇa saṃcaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 6:
pārāsaru pabhaṇaï "vihĩ maṇojju  $  ṇaü ekkeṃ mantiĕ rajja-kajju"
pisuṇeṇa vuttu "veṇṇi vi ṇa honti  $  avaropparu ghaḍĕvi ku-mantu denti"
kaüṭilleṃ vuccaï "kavaṇa bhanti  $  tiṇṇi vi ceẏāri vi cāru manti"
maṇu cavaï "garua vārahahũ vuddhi  $  ṇaü ekkeṃ vihĩ tihĩ kajja-siddhi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pabhaṇaï amaramanti  $  "aïsundaru jaï solaha havanti"
bhiguṇandaṇu vollaï "vuddhivantu  $  akileseṃ vīsahĩ hoi mantu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi cavaï sahāsaṇaẏaṇu  $  viṇu manti-sahāseṃ mantu kavaṇu
aṇṇahŏ aṇṇārisa hoi vuddhi  $  akileseṃ sijjhaï kajja-siddhi"
ghattā:
jaẏakāriu savvĕhĩ  $  "amhahũ kerī buddhī jaï
    to samaü dasāseṃ  $  sundara sandhi surāhivaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 7:
vuha atthasattha pabhaṇanti eva  $  kahĩ labbhaï uttama sandhi deva
ekku vi mālihĕ siru khuḍĕvi ghittu  $  aṇṇu vi jaï rāvaṇu hoi mittu
to taü paramesara kavaṇa hāṇi  $  ahi asaï to vi sihi mahura-vāṇi
jaï sāma-bheẏa-dāṇĕhĩ ji siddhi  $  to daṇḍĕ paüñjiĕ kavaṇa viddhi
acchanti vāli-raṇu saṃbharevi  $  suggīva-candakara kuddha ve vi
ṇala-ṇīla te vi hiẏavaĕ asuddha  $  suvvanti ṇirāriu attha-luddha
khara-dūsaṇā vi ṇiẏa-pāṇa-bhīẏa  $  kajjeṇa jeṇa candaṇahi ṇīẏa
māhesarapuravaï-maru ṇarinda  $  avamāṇĕvi vasikiẏa jiha gaïnda
ghattā:
āehĩ uvāĕhĩ  $  bheijjanti ṇarāhivaï
    dahavaẏaṇa-ṇihelaṇu  $  jāi dūu cittaṅgu jaï"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ manti-vaẏaṇu paḍivaṇṇu teṇa  $  cittaṅgaü kokkiu takkhaṇeṇa
sikkhavaï purandaru kiṃ pi jāma  $  gaü ṇāraü rāvaṇa-bhavaṇu tāma
"osārĕvi dijjaï kaṇṇa-jāu  $  parirakkhahi khandhāvāru sāu
āvesaï indahŏ taṇaü dūu  $  caüvīsa-pavara-guṇa-sāra-bhūu
so bheu karesaï ṇaravarāhã  $  suggīva-pamuha-vijjāharāhã
sahũ teṇa mahura-vaẏaṇehĩ teva  $  vollijjaï sandhi ṇa hoi jeva
so thovaü tuhũ puṇu pavalu ajju  $  āvaggaü jĕ laï harevi rajju
etthu jĕ avasarĕ saṃgāmĕ sakku  $  saṅkijjaï ṇaṃto puṇu asakku
ghattā:
maru-jaggĕ dasāṇaṇa  $  jaṃ paĩ vigghahã rakkhiẏaü
    uvaẏārahŏ tahŏ maĩ  $  parama-bheu ĕhu akkhiẏaü"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 9:
gaü ṇāraü kahi mi ṇahaṅgaṇeṇa  $  seṇāvaï vuttu dasāṇaṇeṇa
"para-gūḍhapurisa ṇa visanti jema  $  parirakkhahi khandhāvāru tema
ettaḍiẏa paropparu volla jāva  $  cittaṅgu sa-sandaṇu āu tāva
pura-raṭṭhāḍavi vahu saṃthavantu  $  ṇakkhantomāliẏahanti-vantu (?)
raṇa-dugga-pariggaha-mahi ṇiẏantu  $  uttarahŏ paḍuttaru cintavantu
vahusaṃtha-vuddhi-ṇīiu sarantu  $  māricci-bhavaṇu païsaï turantu
sa-saṇehu samāicchiu karevi  $  ṇiu pāsu ṇarindahŏ karĕ dharevi
vaïsaṇaü diṇṇu saṃvāhu thoru  $  cūḍāmaṇi kaṇṭhaü kaḍaü doru
pujjeppiṇu kappiṇu guṇa-saẏāĩ  $  puṇu pucchiu "valahũ pamāṇu kāĩ"
ghattā:
vuccaï cittaṅgĕṇa  $  "kiṃ devahŏ sīsaï ṇarĕṇa
      taṃ kavaṇu dulaṅghaü  $  jaṃ ṇa vi diṭṭhu divāẏarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 10:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi parituṭṭhu rāu  $  "maĩ cintiu ko vi ku-dūu āu
jima sāsaṇaharu jima parimiẏatthu  $  evahĩ muṇio 'si ṇisiddha-atthu
dhaṇṇaü suravaï tuhũ jāsu attu  $  vara-pañcavīsa-guṇa-riddhi pattu
bhaṇu bhaṇu pesiu kajjeṇa keṇa"  $  vihasevi vuttu cittaṃgaeṇa

kari laṅkā-ṇaẏarihĕ vijaẏa-jatta  $  cala lacchi maṇūsahŏ kavaṇa matta

imu vaẏaṇu mahāraü  $  tumhahã savvahã thāu maṇĕ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ suṇĕvi sattu-saṃtāvaṇeṇa  $  cittaṅgaü pabhaṇiu rāvaṇeṇa

savvaĩ mahu appĕvi sandhi karahŏ  $  ṇaṃ to kallaĕ saṃgāmĕ marahŏ"

saṃkama vi caẏāri caüddisāsu  $  caü-vāraĩ ekkekkaĕ sahāsu
valavantahũ jantahũ bhīsaṇāhã  $  akkhohaṇi akkhohaṇi ghaṇāhã

joẏaṇa-parimāṇeṃ  $  jo ḍhukkaü so ṇaü jiẏaï
    jiha dujjaṇa-vaẏaṇahũ  $  ko vi ṇa pāsu samilliẏaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 12:
jasu ehaü atthi sahāu duggu  $  aṇṇu vi sāhaṇu accanta-uggu
jasu aṭṭha lakkha bhaḍḍahũ gaẏāhũ  $  vāraha mandahũ solaha maẏāhũ
saṃkiṇṇa-gaïndahũ vīsa lakkha  $  raha-turaẏa-bhaḍahã puṇu ṇatthi saṅkha
ehaü pahilāraü mūla-seṇṇu  $  valu vīẏaü bhiccahã taṇaü aṇṇu
taïẏaü seṇī-valu duṇṇivāru  $  caüthaü mitta-valu aṇāẏa-pāru
dujjaü pañcamaü amitta-seṇṇu  $  chaṭṭhaü āḍaviu aṇāẏa-gaṇṇu
rāvaṇa puṇu vūhahã ṇāhĩ cheu  $  amarā vi valahã ṇa muṇanti bheu"
haẏa-gaẏa-raha-ṇara-jujjhahũ taheva  $  so suravaï jijjaï samarĕ keva"
ghattā:
vuccaï dahavaẏaṇeṃ  $  "jaï taṃ jiṇami ṇa āhaẏaṇĕ
    to appaü ghattami  $  jālāmālāulĕ jalaṇĕ"
