START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 13:
indaï pabhaṇaï "sura-sāra-bhūa  $  kiṃ jampieṇa vahaveṇa dūa
jaṃ kiu jama-dhaṇaẏahũ vihi mi tāhã  $  jaṃ sahasakiraṇa-ṇalakuvvarāhã
taṃ tuha vi karesaï tāu ajju  $  lahu ṭhāu purandaru jujjha-sajju"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi uṭṭhantaeṇa  $  cittaṅgeṃ vuccaï jantaeṇa
"ṇimmantio 'si indeṇa deva  $  vijaẏanteṃ indaï tuhu mi teva
sirimāli kumārĕhĩ sasidhaehĩ  $  suggīva tuhu mi sīhaddhaehĩ
jamarāeṃ jamvava-ṇīla-ṇalahŏ  $  harikesiṃ hattha-pahattha-khalahŏ
someṇa vihīsaṇa kumbhaẏaṇṇa  $  avarehi mi kehi mi ke vi aṇṇa
ghattā:
parivāḍiĕ tumhahũ  $  diṇṇaü eu ṇimantaṇaü
    bhuñjevaü savvĕhĩ  $  garua-pahārā-bhoẏaṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 14:
gaü ema bhaṇĕvi cittaṅgu tetthu  $  sura-parimiu suravara-rāu jetthu
"paramesara dujjaü jāuhāṇu  $  ṇa karei sandhi tumhĕhĩ samāṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pavalu arāi-pakkhu  $  saṇṇajjhaï sarahasu dasasaẏakkhu
haẏa bheri-tūra paḍu paḍaha vajja  $  kiẏa matta mahāgaẏa sāri-sajja
pakkhariẏa turaṅgama jutta saẏaḍa  $  jasa-luddha kuddha saṇṇaddha suhaḍa
vīsāvasu vasu raṇa-bhara-samattha  $  jama-sasi-kuvera paharaṇa-vihattha
kiṃpurisa garuḍa gandhavva jakkha  $  kiṇṇara ṇara amara viralliẏakkha
jaṃ ṇaẏara-paolihĩ valu ṇa māi  $  taṃ ṇahaẏaleṇa uppaĕvi jāi
ghattā:
saṇṇahĕvi purandaru  $  ṇiggaü aïrāvaĕ caḍiu
    ṇaṃ viñjhahŏ uppari  $  saraẏa-mahāghaṇu pāẏaḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 16, Kaḍavaka 15:
miga-manda-bhadda-saṃkiṇṇa-gaĕhĩ  $  ghaḍa viraĕvi pañcahĩ cāva-saĕhĩ
thiu aggaĕ pacchaĕ bhaḍa-samūhu  $  seṇāvaï-mantihĩ raïu vūhu
suravara sa-pavara-paharaṇa karāla  $  ghaṇa-kakkhahĩ pakkhahĩ loẏavāla
ḍasiẏāhara rattuppala-dalakkha  $  gaĕ gaĕ paṇṇāraha gatta-rakkha
haẏa pañca pañca cañcala valagga  $  bhaḍa tiṇṇi tiṇṇi haĕ haĕ sa-khagga
ĕu jettiu rakkhaṇu gaẏavarāsu  $  tettiu jĕ puṇu vi thiu rahavarāsu
caüdaha aṅgulihĩ ṇaro ṇarāsu  $  raẏaṇihĩ tihĩ tihĩ haü haẏavarāsu
pañcahĩ pañcahĩ gaü gaẏavarāsu  $  dhāṇukkiu chahĩ dhāṇukkiẏāsu
ghattā:
taṃ vūhu raeppiṇu  $  bhīsaṇu tūra-vamālu kiu
    samaraṅgaṇĕ meiṇi  $  sakku sa iṃ bhū sevi thiu
----------  [17. sattarahamo saṃdhi]  ----------
mantaṇaĕ samattaĕ  $  dūĕ ṇiẏattaĕ  $  ubhaẏa-valahã amarisu caḍaï
taïlokka-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  suravara-ḍāmaru  $  rāvaṇu indahŏ abbhiḍaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 1:
kiẏa kari sāri-sajja pakkhariẏa turaẏa-thaṭṭā  $  ubbhiẏa dhaẏa-ṇihāẏa sa-vimāṇa raha paẏaṭṭā
āhaẏa samara-bheri bhīsāvaṇi  $  suravara-vaïri-vīra-kampāvaṇi
hattha-pahattha karĕvi seṇāvaï  $  diṇṇu paẏāṇaü pacaliu ṇaravaï
kumbhaẏaṇṇu laṅkesa-vihīsaṇa  $  ṇala-suggīva-ṇīla-khara-dūsaṇa
maẏa-māricca-bhicca-suasāraṇa  $  aṅgaṅgaẏa-indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa
raṇa-raseṇa bhijjanta padhāiẏa  $  ṇiviseṃ samara-bhūmi saṃpāviẏa
pañcahĩ dhaṇu-saehĩ pahu deppiṇu  $  riu-vūhahŏ paḍivūhu raeppiṇu
ṇivaḍiu jāuhāṇa-valu sura-valĕ  $  pahaẏa-paḍaha-parivaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalĕ
jāu mahāhaü bhuvaṇa-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  uṭṭhiu raü maïlantu diẏantaru
ghattā:
ṇara-haẏa-gaẏa-gattaĩ  $  raha-dhaẏa-chattaĩ  $  savvaĩ khaṇĕ uddhūliẏaĩ
      jiha kulaĩ duputteṃ  $  tiha vaḍḍhanteṃ  $  veṇṇi vi seṇṇaĩ maïliẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 2:
vibbhama-hāva-bhāva-bhūbhaṅguraccharāiṃ  $  jāẏaĩ sura-vimāṇaïṃ dhūlidhūsarāiṃ
tāva hei-ghaṭṭaṇeṇa karālaü  $  ucchaliẏaü sihi-jālā-mālaü
siviẏahĩ chatta-dhaĕhĩ laggantiu  $  amara-vimāṇa-saẏāĩ dahantiu
puṇu pacchalĕ soṇiẏa-jala-dhāraü  $  raẏa-pasamaṇaü huāsa-ṇivāraü
tāhĩ asesu disāmuhu sittaü  $  thiu ṇahu ṇāĩ kusumbhaĕ ghittaü
aṇṇaü pariẏattaü gaẏaṇaṅgahŏ  $  ṇaṃ ghusiṇoliu ṇaha-siri-aṅgahŏ
jāẏa vasundhari ruhirāẏamviri  $  sarahasa-suhaḍa-kavandha-paṇacciri
kari-sira-muttāhalĕhĩ vimīsiẏa  $  sañjha va tārāiṇṇa padīsiẏa
raha khuppanti vahanti ṇa cakkaĩ  $  vāhaṇa-jāṇa-vimāṇaĩ thakkaĩ
ghattā:
tehaĕ vi mahāraṇĕ  $  meiṇi-kāraṇĕ  $  rattĕ tarantĕ taranti ṇara
      jujjhanti sa-macchara  $  tosiẏa-acchara  $  ṇāĩ mahaṇṇavĕ vāriẏara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 3:
to gajjanta-matta-māẏaṅga-vāhaṇeṇaṃ  $  amarisa-kuddhaeṇa givvāṇa-sāhaṇeṇaṃ
jāuhāṇa-sāhaṇu paḍipelliu  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-sāẏareṇa jagu relliu
ṇisiẏara paribhamanti paharaṇa-bhua  $  ṇaṃ āvatta-chuddha jala-vuvvuva
pekkhĕvi ṇiẏa-valu ohaṭṭantaü  $  sura-vagalāmuhĕ āvaṭṭantaü
pekkhĕvi utthallantaĩ chattaĩ  $  matta-gaẏahũ bhijjantaĩ gattaĩ
pekkhĕvi phuṭṭantaĩ raha-vīḍhaĩ  $  jāṇa-vimāṇaĩ bhamaruvagīḍhaĩ
pekkhĕvi haẏavara pāḍijjantā  $  suhaḍa-maḍapphara sāḍijjantā
āẏāmeppiṇu raha-gaẏa-vāhaṇĕ  $  bhiḍiu pasaṇṇakitti sura-sāhaṇĕ
vāṇara-cindhu mahāgaẏa-sandaṇu  $  cāva-vihatthu mahindahŏ ṇandaṇu
ghattā:
ṇara-haẏa-gaẏa tajjĕvi  $  raha-dhaẏa bhañjĕvi  $  vūhahŏ majjhĕ païṭṭhu kiha
     vammĕhĩ vindhantaü  $  jīviu lintaü  $  kāmiṇi-hiẏaü viẏaḍḍhu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 4:
suravara-kiṅkarehĩ uttharĕvi ahimuhehiṃ  $  laïu pasaṇṇakitti tikkhehĩ silimuhehiṃ
to etthantarĕ diḍha-bhua-ḍāleṃ  $  rāvaṇa-pittieṇa sirimāleṃ
rahavaru vāhiu suravara-vandahŏ  $  paḍhamaü bhiṭṭu mahāhavĕ candahŏ
kunta-vihatthahŏ sīhārūḍhahŏ  $  jaẏasiri-pavara-ṇāri-avagūḍhahŏ
"arĕ sa-kalaṅka vaṅka mahilāṇaṇa  $  puraü ma thāhi jāhi maẏalañchaṇa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi okhaṇḍiẏa-māṇaü  $  lhasiu miẏaṅku thakku jamarāṇaü
mahisārūḍhu daṇḍa-paharaṇa-dharu  $  tihuaṇa-jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-bhaẏaṅkaru
so vi samuttharantu daṇu-duṭṭhaü  $  kiu ṇivisaddheṃ pārāuṭṭhaü
tāma kuveru thakku savaḍammuhu  $  kiu ṇārāĕhĩ so vi parammuhu
ghattā:
sirimāli dhaṇuddharu  $  raṇamuhĕ duddharu  $  dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu suravarĕhĩ
      saṃtāu karantaü  $  pāṇa harantaü  $  vammahu jema ku-muṇivarĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 5:
bhaggĕ kiẏantĕ samarĕ to sasi-kuvera-rāe  $  kesari-kaṇaẏa-huavahā mallavanta-jāe
tiṇṇi vi bhiḍiẏa khattu āmellĕvi  $  dhaẏa-dhūvanta mahāraha pellĕvi
tīhi mi samakaṇḍiu raẏaṇīẏaru  $  ṇaṃ dhārāhara-ghaṇĕhĩ mahīharu
saravara-saravarehĩ viṇivāriẏa  $  tiṇṇi vi puṭṭhi denta osāriẏa
amara-kumāra ṇavara uddhāiẏa  $  riu jiha ekkahĩ milĕvi parāiẏa
laïẏa silīmuhehĩ sirimāliṃ  $  parama-jiṇinda-caraṇa-kamalāliṃ
addhasasīhĩ sīsa ucchiṇṇaĩ  $  ṇaṃ ṇīluppalāĩ vikkhiṇṇaĩ
jaü jaü jāuhāṇu parisakkaï  $  taü taü ahimuhu ko vi ṇa thakkaï
ṇiĕvi kumāra-siraĩ chijjantaĩ  $  raṇa-devaẏahĕ vali va dijjantaĩ
ghattā:
sahasakkhu virujjhaï  $  kira saṇṇajjhaï  $  tāva jaẏanteṃ diṇṇu rahu
      "maĩ tāẏa jiẏanteṃ  $  suhaḍa-kaẏanteṃ  $  appuṇu paharaṇu dharahi kahu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 6:
jaẏakārevi suravaïṃ dhāio jaẏanto  $  "ṇisiẏara thāhi thāhi kahĩ jāhi mahu jiẏanto
vāhi vāhi savaḍammuhu sandaṇu  $  haũ dhava demi purandara-ṇandaṇu
tīriẏa-tomara-kaṇṇiẏa-ghāẏahũ  $  vahu-vāvalla-bhalla-ṇārāẏahũ
addhasasihĩ khuruppa-sellaggahũ  $  paṭṭisa-phaliha-sūla-phara-khaggahũ
moggara-laüḍi-cittadaṇḍuṇḍihĩ  $  savvala-huli-hala-musala-musuṇḍhihĩ
jhasara-tisatti-parasu-isu-pāsahũ  $  kaṇaẏa-konta-ghaṇa-cakka-sahāsahũ
rukkha-silāẏala-girivara-ghāẏahũ  $  havi-jala-pavaṇa-vijju-saṃghāẏahũ
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sirimāli paharisiu  $  suravaï-suahŏ mahārahu darisiu
"paĩ melleppiṇu jaẏa-siri-lāhavĕ  $  ko mahu aṇṇu dei dhava āhavĕ"
ghattā:
to eva visesĕvi  $  sara saṃpesĕvi  $  chiṇṇu jaẏantahŏ taṇaü dhaü
      gaẏaṇaṅgaṇa-lacchihĕ  $  kamala-dalacchihĕ  $  hāru ṇāĩ ucchalĕvi gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 7:
dahamuha-pittieṇa daṇu-deha-dāraṇeṇaṃ  $  musumūriu mahāraho kaṇaẏa-paharaṇeṇaṃ
eu ṇa jāṇahũ kahĩ gaü sandaṇu  $  cukkaü kaha vi kaha vi sura-ṇandaṇu
dukkhu dukkhu mucchā-vihalaṅghalu  $  uṭṭhiu uddha-suṇḍu ṇaṃ maẏagalu
bhīsaṇa-bhiṇḍivāla-paharaṇa-dharu  $  jāuhāṇa-rahu kiu saẏa-sakkaru
so vi pahāra-vihuru ṇicceẏaṇu  $  muccha parāiu pasariẏa-ceẏaṇu
dhāiu dhuṇĕvi sarīru raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  kūra-mahāgahu ṇāĩ ṇahaṅgaṇĕ
viṇṇi mi dujjaẏa duddhara pavaẏala  $  viṇṇi mi bhīma-gaẏāsaṇi-karaẏala
veṇṇi mi paribhamanti ṇaha-maṇḍalĕ  $  līha dinti rāvaṇĕ ākhaṇḍalĕ
suravaï-ṇandaṇeṇa āẏāmĕvi  $  kulisa-daṇḍa-saṇṇiha gaẏa bhāmĕvi
ghattā:
āhaü vacchatthalĕ  $  paḍiu rasāẏalĕ  $  pāṇa-vivajjiu raẏaṇiẏaru
      jaü jāu jaẏantahŏ  $  ṇisiẏara-tantahŏ  $  ghittu ṇāĩ sirĕ raẏa-ṇiẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 8:
jaṃ sirimāli pāḍio amara-ṇandaṇeṇaṃ  $  tā indaï padhāvio samaü sandaṇeṇaṃ
"arĕ duvviẏaḍḍha  $  mama tāu vahĕvi kahĩ jāhi saṇḍha
valu valu haẏāsa  $  maĩ jīvamāṇĕ kahĩ jīviẏāsa"
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa  $  karĕ dhaṇuharu kiu sura-ṇandaṇeṇa
utthariẏa ve vi  $  samaraṅgaṇĕ sara-maṇḍavu karevi
riu-maddaṇeṇa  $  āẏāmĕvi dahamuha-ṇandaṇeṇa
viṇihaẏa-paharĕhĩ  $  saṇṇāhu chiṇṇu tīsahĩ sarehĩ
rakkhiu sarīru  $  kaha kaha vi ṇāhĩ kappariu vīru
uppaĕvi jāma  $  kira dharaï purandaru pattu tāma
ghattā:
uggāmiẏa-paharaṇu  $  coiẏa-vāraṇu  $  antarĕ thiu amarāhivaï
      "arĕ arivara-maddaṇa  $  rāvaṇa-ṇandaṇa  $  uvariṃ vali cārahaḍi jaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 9:
khattu muevi savvĕhiṃ bhiuḍi-bhāsurehiṃ  $  laṅkāhivahŏ ṇandaṇo veḍhio surehiṃ
veḍhiu ekku aṇantĕhĩ rāvaṇi  $  to vi ṇa gaṇaï suhaḍa-cūḍāmaṇi
rokkaï valaï dhāi abbhiṭṭaï  $  riu paṇṇāsa-saṭṭhi dalavaṭṭaï
sandaṇa sandaṇeṇa saṃcūraï  $  gaẏavara gaẏavareṇa musumūraï
turaü turaṅgameṇa viṇivāẏaï  $  ṇaravara ṇaravara-ghāeṃ ghāẏaï
jāma viẏambhaï savvāẏāmeṃ  $  tāva su-sārahi sammaï-ṇāmeṃ
pabhaṇaï "rāvaṇa kiṃ ṇiccintaü  $  mallavanta-ṇandaṇu atthantaü
aṇṇu vi rāvaṇi laïu akhatteṃ  $  veḍhiu suravara-valĕṇa samatteṃ
dujjaü jaï vi mahāhavĕ sakkaï  $  ekku aṇeẏa jiṇĕvi kiṃ sakkaï"
ghattā:
teṃ vaẏaṇeṃ rāvaṇu  $  jaṇa-jūrāvaṇu  $  caḍiu mahārahĕ khagga-karu
      lakkhijjaï devĕhĩ  $  vahu-avalevĕhĩ  $  ṇāĩ kiẏantu jagantaẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 10:
dūrattheṇa ṇisiẏarindeṇa suravarindo  $  sīheṇa viruddheṇaṃ joio gaïndo
"sārahi vāhi vāhi rahu tettahĕ  $  āẏavattu āpaṇḍuru jettahĕ
jettahĕ aïrāvaṇu galagajjaï  $  jettahĕ bhīsaṇa dunduhi vajjaï
jettahĕ suravaï sura-pariẏariẏaü  $  jettahĕ vajja-daṇḍu karĕ dhariẏaü
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sammaï ucchāhiu  $  pūriu saṅkhu mahārahu vāhiu
kiu kalaẏalu diṇṇaĩ raṇa-tūraĩ  $  hasiẏaĩ saṇi-jama-muhaĩ va kūraĩ
samaru ghuṭṭhu valaï mi abbhiṭṭaĩ  $  raṇa-rasiẏaĩ saṇṇāha-visaṭṭaĩ
pavara-turaṅgama pavara-turaṅgahũ  $  bhiḍiẏa maẏaṅga matta-māẏaṅgahũ
raha rahavarahũ paropparu dhāiẏa  $  pāẏālahũ pāẏāla parāiẏa
ghattā:
melliẏa-huṅkāraĩ  $  diṇṇa-pahāraĩ  $  sira-kara-ṇāsa ṇamantāĩ
      bhiḍiẏaĩ a-ṇiviṇṇaĩ  $  veṇṇi vi seṇṇaĩ  $  mihuṇaĩ jĕma aṇurattāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 11:
jāu mahantu āhavo vihĩ vihĩ jaṇāhũ  $  indaï-indataṇaẏahũ inda-rāvaṇāhũ
raẏaṇāsava-sahasāra-jaṇerahũ  $  maẏa-bhesaï-māricca-kuverahũ
jama-suggīvahũ dūsama-sīlahũ  $  aṇala-ṇalahũ palaẏāṇila-ṇīlahũ
sasi-aṅgaẏahũ divāẏara-aṅgahũ  $  khara-cittahũ dūsaṇa-cittaṅgahũ
sua-camūhũ vīsāvasu-hatthahũ  $  sāraṇa-hari-harikesi-pahatthahũ
kumbhaẏaṇṇa-īsāṇaṇarindahũ  $  vihi-kesarihĩ vihīsaṇa-khandahũ
ghaṇavāhaṇa-taḍikesakumārahũ  $  mallavanta-kaṇaẏahũ duvvārahũ
jamvumāli-jīmuttaṇiṇāẏahũ  $  vajjoẏara-vajjāuharāẏahũ
vāṇaradhaẏa-pañcāṇaṇacindhahũ  $  ema jujjhu abbhiṭṭu pasiddhahũ
ghattā:
kari-kumbha-vikattaṇu  $  gañjolliẏa-taṇu  $  jo raṇĕ jāsu samāvaḍiu
      so tāsu samaccharu  $  tosiẏa-accharu  $  girihĕ davaggi va abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 12:
ko vi kivāṇa-pāṇie suravahū ṇievi  $  ṇa muaï maṇḍalaggu paharaṃ samallievi
ko vi ṇīsarantanta-cubbhalo  $  bhamaï matta-hatthi va sa-saṅkhalo
ko vi kumbhi-kumbhaẏala-dāraṇo  $  mottioha-ujjaliẏa-paharaṇo
ko vi danta-musalukkhaẏāuho  $  dhāi matta-māẏaṅga-sammuho
ko vi khuḍiẏa-sīso dhaṇuddharo  $  valaï dhāi vindhaï sa-maccharo
ko vi vāṇa-viṇibhiṇṇa-vacchao  $  vāhirantaruccariẏa-picchao
soṇiẏāruṇo sahaï ṇaravaro  $  ratta-kamala-puñjo vva sa-bhamaro
ko vi ekka-calaṇe turaṅgame  $  hari va viṭṭhio ṇa bharie kame
ko vi siraüḍe karĕvi karaẏale  $  jujjha-bhikkha maggei para-vale
ghattā:
bhaḍu ko vi paḍitthiru  $  ṇivvaṭṭiẏa-siru  $  soṇiẏa-dhārucchaliẏa-taṇu
      lakkhijjaï dāruṇu  $  sindūrāruṇu  $  phagguṇĕ ṇāĩ sahasakiraṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 13:
kattha i matta-kuñjarā jīvieṇa cattā  $  kasaṇa-mahāghaṇa vva dīsanti dharaṇi-pattā
kattha i sa-visāṇaĩ kumbhaẏalaĩ  $  ṇaṃ raṇavahu-ukkhalaĩ sa-musalaĩ
kattha i haẏa karavālahĩ khaṇḍiẏa  $  anta-lalanta khalanta pahiṇḍiẏa
kattha i chattaĩ haẏaĩ visālaĩ  $  ṇaṃ jama-bhoẏaṇĕ diṇṇaĩ thālaĩ
kattha i suhaḍa-sirāĩ paloṭṭaĩ  $  ṇāĩ a-ṇālaĩ ṇava-kandoṭṭaĩ
kattha i raha-cakkaĩ vicchiṇṇaĩ  $  kali-kālahŏ āsaṇaĩ va diṇṇaĩ
kattha vi bhaḍahŏ sivaṅgaṇa ḍhukkiẏa  $  "hiẏavaü ṇāhĩ" bhaṇevi uḍhukkiẏa
kattha vi giddhu kavandhĕ pariṭṭhiu  $  ṇaṃ ahiṇava-siru suhaḍu samuṭṭhiu
kattha i giddheṃ maṇusu ṇa khaddhaü  $  vāṇĕhĩ cañcuhĩ bheu ṇa laddhaü
ghattā:
kattha i ṇara-ruṇḍĕhĩ  $  kara-kama-tuṇḍĕhĩ  $  samara-vasundhari bhīsaṇiẏa
      vahu-khaṇḍa-paẏārĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ sūārĕhĩ  $  raïẏa rasoi jamahŏ taṇiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 14:
tahĩ tehaĕ mahāhavĕ kiẏa-mahocchavehiṃ  $  kokkiu ekkamekku laṅkesa-vāsavehiṃ
"urĕ urĕ sakka sakka parisakkahi  $  jiha ṇiṭṭhaviu māli tiha thakkahi
haũ so rāvaṇu bhuvaṇa-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  suravara-kula-kiẏantu raṇĕ duddharu"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi valiu ākhaṇḍalu  $  pacchāẏantu sarĕhĩ ṇaha-maṇḍalu
dahamuho vi utthariu sa-maccharu  $  kiu sara-jālu sarĕhĩ saẏa-sakkaru
to etthantarĕ haẏa-paḍivakkheṃ  $  saru aggeu mukku sahasakkheṃ
dhāiu dhagadhagantu dhūmantaü  $  cindhĕhĩ chatta-dhaĕhĩ laggantaü
rāvaṇa-valu ṇāsaṃghiẏa-jīviu  $  ṇāsaï jālā-mālālīviu
ghattā:
raẏaṇiẏara-pahāṇeṃ  $  vāruṇa-vāṇeṃ  $  saravaraggi ulhāviẏaü
    masi-vaṇṇuparattaü  $  dhūmala-gattaü  $  pisuṇu jema vollāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 15:
uvasamie huāsaṇe vaẏaṇa-bhāsureṇaṃ  $  vahala-tamoha-paharaṇaṃ pesiẏaṃ sureṇaṃ
kiu andhāraü teṇa raṇaṅgaṇu  $  kiṃ pi ṇa dekkhaï ṇisiẏara-sāhaṇu
jimbhaï aṅgu valaï ṇiddāẏaï  $  suaï aceẏaṇu osuviṇāẏaï
pekkhĕvi ṇiẏa-valu oṇallantaü  $  melliu diṇaẏaratthu pajalantaü
amarāhivĕṇa rāhu-vara-paharaṇu  $  ṇāga-pāsa sara muaï dasāṇaṇu
pavara-bhuaṅga-sahāsĕhĩ daṭṭhaü  $  sura-valu pāṇa laevi paṇaṭṭhaü
gāruḍatthu vāsavĕṇa visajjiu  $  visahara-saravara-jālu parajjiu
khagaüḍa-pavaṇandoliẏa meiṇi  $  ḍolā-rūḍhī ṇaṃ vara-kāmiṇī
pakkha-pavaṇa-paḍipahaẏa-mahīhara  $  ṇaccāviẏa sa-disivaha sa-sāẏara
ghattā:
mellĕvi riu-ghāẏaṇu  $  saru ṇārāẏaṇu  $  tijagavihūsaṇĕ gaĕ caḍiu
      jettahĕ aïrāvaṇu  $  tettahĕ rāvaṇu  $  jāĕvi indahŏ abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 16:
matta gaïnda dovi ubbhiṇṇa-kasaṇa-dehā  $  ṇaṃ gajjanta dhanta sama-uttharanta mehā
parovarassa pattaẏā  $  maẏamvu-sitta-gattaẏā
thirora thora-kandharā  $  paloṭṭa-dāṇa-ṇijjharā
sa-sīẏara vva pāusā  $  maẏandha mukka-aṅkusā
visāla-kumbhamaṇḍalā  $  ṇivaddha-danta-ujjalā
athakka-kaṇṇa-cāmarā  $  ṇivāriẏāli-goẏarā
samuddha-suṇḍa-bhīsaṇā  $  visaṭṭa-ghaṇṭa-ṇīsaṇā
maṇojja-gejja-pantiṇo  $  bhamanti ve vi dantiṇo
ghattā:
maẏagalĕhĩ mahantĕhĩ  $  vihi mi bhamantĕhĩ  $  suravaï-laṅkāhivĕ pavara
     bhava-bhavaṇĕhĩ chūḍhī  $  ṇaṃ mahi mūḍhī  $  bhamaï sa-sāẏara sa-dharadhara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 17:
tijagavihūsaṇeṇa kiu sura-karī ṇirattho  $  pariosiẏa ṇisāẏarā lhasiu vaïri-sattho
rāvaṇu ṇava-juvāṇu valavantaü  $  amarāhiu gaẏa-vesa-mahantaü
bhamĕvi ṇa sakkiu karivaru khañciu  $  rakkheṃ saẏavāraü pariẏañciu
gaü gaeṇa pahu pahuṇoṭṭhaddhaü  $  jhampa devi aṃsuĕṇa ṇivaddhaü
vijaü ghuṭṭhu raẏaṇīẏara-sāhaṇĕ  $  devĕhĩ dunduhi diṇṇa divaṅgaṇĕ
tāva jaẏantu dasāṇaṇa-jāeṃ  $  āṇiu vandhĕvi vāhu-sahāeṃ
jamu suggīveṃ dūsama-sīleṃ  $  aṇalu ṇaleṇa aṇilu raṇĕ ṇīleṃ
khara-dūsaṇĕhĩ citta-cittaṅgaẏa  $  ravi sasi levi āẏa aṅgaṅgaẏa
suravara-guru maeṇa ṇibbhicceṃ  $  laïu kuveru samarĕ māricceṃ
ghattā:
jo jasu utthariẏaü  $  so teṃ dhariẏaü  $  geṇhĕvi pavara-vandi-saẏaĩ
      gaü suravara-ḍāmaru  $  puru ajarāmaru  $  jiṇu jiha jiṇĕvi mahābhaẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 17, Kaḍavaka 18:
laṅka purandare ṇie jaẏa-sirī-ṇivāso  $  sahasāreṇa patthio patthivo dasāso
"ahŏ jama-dhaṇaẏa-sakka-kampāvaṇa  $  dehi suputta-bhikkha mahu rāvaṇa"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi bhaṇaï sura-vandhaṇu  $  "tumha vi amha vi eu ṇivandhaṇu
jamu talavaru paripālaü paṭṭaṇu  $  paṅgaṇu ṇikkiu karaü pahañjaṇu
puppha-paẏaru gharĕ deu vaṇāsaï  $  sahũ gandhavvĕhĩ gāẏaü sarasaï
vattha-sahāsaĩ havi pakkhālaü  $  kosu asesu kuveru ṇihālaü
joṇha kareu miẏaṅku ṇirantaru  $  sīẏalu ṇahaẏalĕ tavaü divāẏaru
amararāu majjaṇaü bharāvaü  $  aṇṇu vi ghaṇĕhĩ chaḍaü devāvaü"
taṃ paḍivaṇṇu savvu sahasāreṃ  $  mukku sakku laṅkālaṅkāreṃ
ghattā:
ṇiẏa-rajju vivajjĕvi  $  gaü pavvajjĕvi  $  sāsaẏapurahŏ sahasaṇaẏaṇu
     jaẏa-siri-vahu maṇḍĕvi  $  thiu avaruṇḍĕvi  $  sa ĩ bhu ẏa-phalihĕhĩ dahavaẏaṇu
iẏa cāru-paümacarie dhaṇañjaẏāsiẏa-saẏambhueva-kae
jāṇaha "rā va ṇa vi ja ẏaṃ" sattārahaṃ imaṃ pavvaṃ
----------  [18. aṭṭhārahamo saṃdhi]  ----------
raṇĕ māṇu malevi purandarahŏ  $  pariẏañcĕvi siharaĩ mandarahŏ
āvaï vi paḍīvaü jāma pahu  $  tāṇantarĕ diṭṭhu aṇantarahu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 1:
pekkheppiṇu giri-kañcaṇa-subhaddu  $  jiṇa-vandaṇa-dūrucchaliẏa-saddu
suravara-saẏa-seva-karāvaṇeṇa  $  māricci papucchiu rāvaṇeṇa
"bhaḍa-bhañjaṇa bhuvaṇucchaliẏa-ṇāma  $  uhu kalaẏalu summaï kāĩ māma"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pabhaṇaï samara-dhīru  $  "ĕhu jaï ṇāmeṇa aṇantavīru
dasaraha-bhāẏaru aṇaraṇṇa-jāu  $  sahasaẏara-saṇeheṃ tavasi jāu
uppaṇṇaü eẏahŏ etthu ṇāṇu  $  uhu dīsaï devāgamu sa-jāṇu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu ṇisiẏarindu  $  gaü tettahĕ jettahĕ muṇivarindu
pariẏañcĕvi ṇavĕvi thuṇĕvi ṇiviṭṭhu  $  saẏalu vi jaṇu vaẏaĩ laẏantu diṭṭhu
ghattā:
mahavaẏaĩ ko vi kŏ vi aṇuvaẏaĩ  $  kŏ vi sikkhāvaẏaĩ guṇavvaẏaĩ
    kŏ vi diḍhu sammattu laevi thiu  $  para rāvaṇu ekku ṇa uvasamiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 2:
dhammarahu mahārisi bhaṇaï tetthu  $  "maṇuẏattu lahĕvi vaïsarĕvi etthu
ahŏ dahamuha mohandhārĕ chūḍha  $  raẏaṇāẏarĕ raẏaṇu ṇa lehi mūḍha
amiẏālaĕ amiu ṇa lehi kema  $  acchahi ṇihuaü kaṭṭhamaü jema"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu dasasireṇa  $  vuccaï thottuggīriẏa-gireṇa
"sakkami dhūmaddhaĕ jhampa devi  $  sakkami phaṇa-phaṇimaṇi-raẏaṇu levi
sakkami giri-mandaru ṇiddalevi  $  sakkami dasa disi-vaha daramalevi
sakkami māruu poṭṭalĕ chuhevi  $  sakkami jama-mahisĕ samāruhevi
sakkami raẏaṇāẏara-jalu pievi  $  sakkami āsīvisu ahi ṇievi
ghattā:
sakkami sakkahŏ raṇĕ uttharĕvi  $  sakkami sasi-sūrahã paha harĕvi
    sakkami mahi gaẏaṇu ekku karĕvi  $  duddharu ṇaü sakkami vaü dharĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 3:
paricintĕvi suiru ṇarāhiveṇa  $  "laï lemi ekku vaü" vuttu teṇa
"jaṃ maĩ ṇa samicchaï cāru-gattu  $  taṃ maṇḍa laemi ṇa para-kalattu"
gaü ema bhaṇeppiṇu ṇiẏaẏa-ṇaẏaru  $  thiu acalu rajju bhuñjantu khaẏaru
ettahĕ vi mahindu mahinda-ṇāmĕ  $  puravarĕ icchiẏa-aṇuhūa-kāmĕ
tahŏ hiẏaẏaveẏa ṇāmeṇa bhajja  $  tahĕ duhiẏañjaṇasundari maṇojja
jhinduĕṇa ramantihĕ thaṇa ṇievi  $  thiu ṇaravaï muhĕ kara-kamalu devi
uppaṇṇa cinta "kahŏ kaṇṇa demi  $  laï vaṭṭaï giri-kaïlāsu ṇemi
vijjāhara-saẏaĩ milanti jetthu  $  varu avaseṃ hosaï ko vi tetthu"
ghattā:
gaü ema bhaṇĕvi pahu pavvaẏahŏ  $  jiṇa-aṭṭhāhiĕ aṭṭhāvaẏahŏ
    āvāsiu pāsĕhĩ ṇīẏaḍĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ tārāẏaṇu mandara-taḍĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 4:
ettahĕ vi tāva palhāẏa-rāu  $  sahũ keumaïĕ ravipurahŏ āu
sa-vimāṇu sa-sāhaṇu sa-parivāru  $  aṇṇu vi tahĩ pavaṇañjaẏa-kumāru
ekkattahĕ dūsāvāsu laïu  $  ṇaṃ vandaṇahattiĕ indu aïu
avara vi je je āsaṇṇa-bhavva  $  te te vijjāhara miliẏa savva
pahilaĕ phagguṇaṇandīsarāhĕ  $  kiẏa ṇhavaṇa-pujja taïlokka-ṇāhĕ
diṇĕ vīẏaĕ vihi mi ṇarāhivāhã  $  mittaïẏa paropparu hūa tāhã
palhāeṃ kheḍu karevi vuttu  $  "taü taṇiẏa kaṇṇa mahu taṇaü puttu
ki ṇa kīraï pāṇiggahaṇu rāẏa"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi teṇa vi diṇṇa vāẏa
pariosu pavaḍḍhiu sajjaṇāhã  $  maïliẏaĩ muhaĩ khala-dujjaṇāhã
ghattā:
"vahu añjaṇa vāukumāru varu"  $  ghoseppiṇu "ṇaẏaṇāṇandaẏaru
      taïẏaĕ vāsarĕ pāṇiggahaṇu"  $  gaẏa ṇaravaï ṇiẏaẏa-ṇiẏaẏa-bhavaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 5:
etthantarĕ dujjaü duṇṇivāru  $  maẏaṇāuru pavaṇañjaẏa-kumāru
ṇaü visahaï taïẏaü divasu entu  $  acchaï virahāṇalĕ jhampa dentu
dhūmāi valaï dhagadhagaï cittu  $  ṇaṃ mandiru abbhantarĕ palittu
candiṇaü candu candaṇu jaladdu  $  kappūra-kamaladalasejja-maddu
dāhiṇa-māruu sīẏala-jalāĩ  $  tahŏ aggi-phuliṅgaĩ kevalāĩ
ṇiḍḍahaï aṅguvaṅgaĩ aṇaṅgu  $  sajjaṇa-hiẏaẏāĩ va pisuṇa-saṅgu
ṇīsasaï sasaï vevaï tameṇa  $  dhāhāvaï dhāhā pañcameṇa
uḍḍhaṇa-āharaṇa-pasāhaṇāĩ  $  savvaĩ aṅgahŏ asuhāvaṇāĩ
ghattā:
pāseu valaggaï lhasaï taṇu  $  taṃ iṅgiu pekkhavi aṇṇa-maṇu
    pabhaṇiu pahasiĕṇa ṇievi muhu  $  "kiṃ duvvalihuẏaü kumāra tuhũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 6:
virahaggi-daḍḍha-muha-kañjaeṇa  $  pahasiu pavuttu pavaṇañjaeṇa
"bho ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇa cāru-citta  $  ṇaü visahaũ taïẏaü divasu mitta
jaï ajju ṇa lakkhiu piẏahĕ vaẏaṇu  $  to kallaĕ mahu ṇittulaü maraṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vuccaï pahasieṇa  $  kamaleṇa va vaẏaṇeṃ pahasieṇa
"phaṇi-sira-raẏaṇeṇa vi ṇāhĩ gaṇṇu  $  ĕu kāraṇu kettiu jeṃ visaṇṇu
kiṃ pavaṇahŏ kavaṇu vi duppavesu"  $  gaẏa veṇṇi vi raẏaṇihĩ tappa-vesu
thiẏa jāla-gavakkhaĕ diṭṭha vāla  $  ṇaṃ maẏaṇa-vāṇa-dhaṇu-toṇa-sāla
māro vi maraï viraheṇa jāhĕ  $  ko vaṇṇĕvi sakkaï rūvu tāhĕ
ghattā:
taṃ vahu pekkhĕvi paritosiĕṇa  $  varaïttu pasaṃsiu pahasiĕṇa
    "taü jīviu sahalu aṇanta siẏa  $  jasu karĕ laggesaï eha tiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 7:
etthantarĕ aṭṭhami-canda-bhāla  $  muhu joĕvi cavaï vasantamāla
"sahalaü taü māṇusa-jammu māĕ  $  bhattāru pahañjaṇu laddhu jāĕ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi dummuha duṭṭha-vesa  $  siru vihuṇĕvi bhaṇaï vi mīsakesa
"sodāmaṇipahu pahu pariharevi  $  thiu pavaṇu kavaṇu guṇu saṃbharevi
jaṃ antaru gopaẏa-sāẏarāhũ  $  jaṃ joiṅgaṇahã divāẏarāhũ
jaṃ antaru kesari-kuñjarāhũ  $  jaṃ kusumāuha-titthaṅkarāhũ
jaṃ antaru garuḍa-mahoragāhũ  $  jaṃ amararāẏa-paharaṇa-ṇagāhũ
jaṃ puṇḍarīẏa-candujjaẏāhũ  $  taṃ vijjuppaha-pavaṇañjaẏāhũ
ghattā:
āĕhĩ ālāvĕhĩ kuviu ṇaru  $  thiu bhīsaṇu ukkhaẏa-khagga-karu
    "kiṃ vaẏaṇĕhĩ vahuĕhĩ vāhirĕhĩ  $  riu rakkhaü vihi mi lemi siraĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 8:
kaḍuakkhareṇa paribhāsireṇa  $  karĕ dhariu pahañjaṇu pahasieṇa
"jaṃ kari-sira-raẏaṇujjaliẏa(?) deva  $  taṃ asivaru maïlahi etthu kema
lajjijjahi vollahi ṇāĩ mukkhu"  $  ṇiu ṇiẏa-āvāsahŏ dukkhu dukkhu
dasa-varisa-sarisa gaẏa raẏaṇi tāsu  $  ravi uggaü pasariẏa-kara-sahāsu
kokkāvevi ṇaravaï pavara vara (?)  $  haẏa bheri paẏāṇaü diṇṇu ṇavara
añjaṇasundarihĕ turantaeṇa  $  ummāhaü lāiu jantaeṇa
saṃcallaï paü paü jema jema  $  kappijjaï hiẏavaü tema tema
tehaĕ avasarĕ vahu-jāṇaehĩ  $  kara-caraṇa dhareppiṇu rāṇaehĩ
ghattā:
vali-vaṇḍa maṇḍa pariẏattiẏaü  $  teṇa vi uvāu paricintiẏaü
    "laï ekkavāra karaẏalĕ dharĕvĩ  $  puṇu vāraha varisaĩ pariharĕvĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 9:
to dukkhu dukkhu dummiẏa-maṇeṇa  $  kiu pāṇiggahaṇu pahañjaṇeṇa
thiu vāraha varisaĩ pariharevi  $  ṇavi suaï ālavaï suiṇave(?) vi
vāre vi ṇa jāi ṇa (?) jema jema  $  khijjaï jhijjaï puṇu tema tema
ḍajjhantaü uru virahāṇaleṇa  $  ṇaṃ vujjhāvaï aṃsua-jaleṇa
parivāra-bhitti-cittāĩ jāĩ  $  ṇīsāsa-dhūma-maliẏāĩ tāĩ
ḍhillaĩ āharaṇaĩ pariẏalanti  $  ṇaṃ ṇeha-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍaĩ paḍanti
gaü ruhiru ṇavara thiu aïṇu atthi  $  ṇaü ṇāvaï jīviu atthi ṇatthi
tahĩ tehaĕ kālĕ dasāṇaṇeṇa  $  suravara-kuraṅga-pañcāṇaṇeṇa
ghattā:
jo dummuhu dūu visajjiẏaü  $  so āẏaü kappa-vivajjiẏaü
    haẏa samara-bheri rahavarĕ caḍiu  $  raṇĕ rāvaṇu varuṇahŏ abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 10:
etthantarĕ varuṇahŏ ṇandaṇehĩ  $  samaraṅgaṇĕ vāhiẏa-sandaṇehĩ
rājīva-puṇḍarīehĩ pavara  $  khara-dūsaṇa pāḍĕvi dhariẏa ṇavara
gaẏa pavaṇa-gamaṇa keṇa vi ṇa diṭṭha  $  sahũ varuṇeṃ jala-duggamĕ païṭṭha
"sālaẏahũ ma hosaï kahi mi ghāu"  $  uvveḍhĕvi gaü raẏaṇiẏara-rāu
ṇīsesa-dīva-dīvantarāhũ  $  lahu leha diṇṇa vijjāharāhũ
avarekku raṇaṅgaṇĕ dujjaẏāsu  $  paṭṭhaviu lehu pavaṇañjaẏāsu
taṃ pekkhĕvi teṇa vi ṇa kiu kheu  $  ṇīsariu sa-sāhaṇu vāu-veu
thiẏa añjaṇa kalasu laevi vārĕ  $  ṇibbhacchiẏa "osaru duṭṭha dārĕ"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi aṃsu phusantiẏaĕ  $  vuccaï līhaü kaḍḍhantiẏaĕ
    "acchanteṃ acchiu jīu mahu  $  janteṃ jāesaï paĩ ji sahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ vaẏaṇu paḍiu ṇaṃ asi-pahāru  $  avaheri kareppiṇu gaü kumāru
māṇasa-saravarĕ āvāsu mukku  $  atthavaṇahŏ tāma paẏaṅgu ḍhukku
diṭṭhaĩ saẏavattaĩ maüliẏāĩ  $  piẏa-virahiẏa-mahuari-muhaliẏāĩ
cakkī vi diṭṭha viṇu cakkaeṇa  $  vāhijjamāṇa maẏaraddhaeṇa
vihuṇanti cañcu paṅkhāhaṇanti  $  virahāura pakkandanti dhanti
taṃ ṇiĕvi jāu tahŏ kaluṇa-bhāu  $  "maĩ sarisaü aṇṇu ṇa ko vi pāu
ṇa kaẏāi vi joiu ṇiẏa-kalattu  $  acchaï maẏaṇaggi-palitta-gattu
pariattĕvi saṃmāṇiu ṇa jāma  $  raṇĕ varuṇahŏ jujjhu ṇa demi tāma"
ghattā:
sabbhāu sahāẏahŏ kahiu puṇu  $  pahasiĕṇa vuttu "ĕhu parama-guṇu"
    uppaĕvi ṇahaṅgaṇĕ ve vi gaẏa  $  ṇaṃ siẏa-ahisiñcaṇĕ matta gaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 18, Kaḍavaka 12:
ṇiviseṇa patta añjaṇahĕ bhavaṇu  $  pacchaṇṇu hovi thiu kahi mi pavaṇu
gaü pahasiu abbhantarĕ païṭṭhu  $  paṇaveppiṇu puṇu āgamaṇu siṭṭhu
"paripuṇṇa maṇoraha ajju devi  $  haũ āẏaü vāukumāru levi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi bhaṇaï vasantamāla  $  thoraṃsu-sitta-thaṇa-antarāla
"bhava-bhava-saṃciẏa-duha-bhāẏaṇāĕ  $  evaḍḍu puṇṇu jaï añjaṇāĕ
to kiṃ veẏārahi" ruaï jāva  $  saẏam eva kumāru païṭṭhu tāva
mahurakkhara viṇaẏālāva lintu  $  āṇandu sokkhu sohaggu dintu
pallaṅkĕ caḍiu karĕ levi devi  $  vihasanta-ramantaĩ thiẏaĩ ve vi
ghattā:
sa ĩ bhu vahĩ paropparu lintāĩ  $  sarahasu āliṅgaṇu dintāĩ
    ṇīsandhi-guṇeṇa ṇa ṇāẏāĩ  $  doṇṇi vi ekkaṃ piva jāẏāĩ
iẏa rāmaevacarie  $  dhaṇañjaẏāsiẏa-saẏambhueva-kae
"pa va ṇa ñja ṇā vi vā ho"  $  aṭṭhārahaṃ imaṃ pavvaṃ
----------  [19. eguṇavīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
pacchima-paharĕ pahañjaṇĕṇa  $  āucchiẏa piẏa pavasantaĕṇa
"taṃ marusejjahi migaṇaẏaṇi  $  jaṃ maĩ avahatthiẏa bhantaĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 1:
jantaeṇa āucchiẏa jaṃ paramesarī
thiẏa visaṇṇa heṭṭhāmuha añjaṇasundarī
kara maülikareppiṇu viṇṇavaï  $  "raẏasalahĕ gabbhu jaï saṃbhavaï
to uttaru kāĩ demi jaṇahŏ  $  ṇa vi sujjhaï eu majjhu maṇahŏ"
citteṇa teṇa supariṭṭhavĕvi  $  kaṅkaṇu ahiṇāṇu samallavĕvi
gaü ṇaravaï sahũ mitteṇa tahĩ  $  māṇasasarĕ dūsāvāsu jahĩ
guruhāra hūa ettahĕ vi saï  $  kokkāvĕvi pabhaṇaï keumaï
"ĕu kāĩ kammu paĩ āẏariu  $  ṇimmalu mahinda-kulu dhūsariu
duvvāra-vaïri-viṇivārāhŏ  $  muhu maïliu suahŏ mahārāhŏ"
taṃ suṇĕvi vasaṃtamāla cavaï  $  "suviṇe vi kalaṅku ṇa saṃbhavaï
ghattā:
imu kaṅkaṇu imu parihaṇaü  $  imu kañcīdāmu pahañjaṇahŏ
      ṇaṃ to kā vi parikkha karĕ  $  parisujjhahũ jeṇa majjhĕ jaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 2:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vevanti samuṭṭhiẏa appuṇu  $  ve vi tāu kasaghāĕhĩ haẏaü puṇuppuṇu
"kiṃ jārahŏ ṇāhĩ suvaṇṇu gharĕ  $  jeṃ kaḍaü ghaḍāvĕvi chuhaï karĕ
aṇṇu vi ettiu sohaggu kaü  $  jeṃ kaṅkaṇu dei kumāru taü"
kaḍuakkhara-pahara-bhaẏāuraü  $  saṃjāẏaü ve vi ṇiruttaraü
hakkārĕvi pabhaṇiu kūra-bhaḍu  $  "haẏa jottĕ mahāraha-vīḍhĕ caḍu
eẏaü duṭṭhaü avalakkhaṇaü  $  sasi-dhavalāmala-kula-lañchaṇaü
māhindapurahŏ dūrantarĕṇa  $  parighivavi āu sahũ rahavarĕṇa
jiha muahũ ṇa āvaï vatta mahu"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sandaṇu juttu lahu
gaü ve vi caḍāvĕvi ṇavara tahĩ  $  sāmiṇi-keraü āesu jahĩ
ghattā:
ṇaẏarahŏ dūrĕ varantarĕṇa  $  añjaṇa ruvanti oāriẏā
      "māĕ khamejjahi jāmi haũ"  $  sahũ dhāhaĕ puṇu jokkāriẏā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 3:
kūra-vīrĕ pariattaĕ ravi atthantao  $  añjaṇāĕ keraü dukkhu va asahantao
bhīsaṇa-raẏaṇihĩ bhīsaṇa aḍaï  $  khāi va gilaï va uvari va paḍaï
bhibbhiẏaï va bhiṅgārī-ravĕhĩ  $  ruvaï va siva-saddĕhĩ raüravĕhĩ
pupphavaï va phaṇi-phukkāraĕhĩ  $  vukkaï va pamaẏa-vukkāraĕhĩ
sā dukkhu dukkhu pariẏaliẏa ṇisi  $  diṇaẏarĕṇa pasāhiẏa puvva-disi
gaïẏaü ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru parāiẏaü  $  aggaĕ paḍihāru padhāiẏaü
"paramesara āiẏa miga-ṇaẏaṇa  $  añjaṇasundari sundara-vaẏaṇa"
taṃ suṇĕvi jāẏa dihi ṇaravarahŏ  $  "lahu paṭṭaṇĕ haṭṭa-soha karahŏ
ubbhahŏ maṇi-kañcaṇa-toraṇaĩ  $  vara-vesaü lentu pasāhaṇaĩ
ghattā:
savva pasāhahŏ matta gaẏa  $  pallāṇahŏ pavara turaṅga-thaḍa
      (jaẏa-)maṅgala-tūraĩ āhaṇahŏ  $  savaḍammuha jantu asesa bhaḍa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 4:
bhaṇĕvi ema paḍipucchiu puṇu vaddhāvao  $  "kaï turaṅga kaï rahavara ko volāvao"
paḍihāru pavolliu atula-valu  $  "ṇaü ko vi sahāu ṇa kiṃ pi valu
añjaṇa vasantamālāĕ sahũ  $  āiẏa para ettiu kahiu mahu
ekkaĕ aṃsua-jala-sitta-thaṇa  $  dīsaï guruhāra visaṇṇa-maṇa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi thiu heṭṭhāmuhaü  $  ṇaṃ ṇaravaï sirĕ vajjeṇa haü
"dussīla duṭṭha maṃ païsaraü  $  viṇu kheveṃ ṇaẏarahŏ ṇīsaraü"
pabhaṇaï āṇandu manti sucavi  $  "aparikkhiu kijjaï kajju ṇa vi
sāsuaü honti viruāriẏaü  $  mahasaïhĕ vi avaguṇa-gāriẏaü
ghattā:
sukaï-kahahŏ jiha khala-maïu  $  hima-vaddaliẏaü kamaliṇihĩ jiha
    honti sahāveṃ vaïriṇiu  $  ṇiẏa-suṇhahã khala-sāsuaü tiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 5:
sāsuāṇa suṇhāṇa jaṇe supasiddhaïṃ  $  ekkamekka-vaïrāĩ aṇāi-ṇivaddhaïṃ
bhattāru bhaṇesaï jaṃ divasu  $  viruārī hosaï taṃ divasu"
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa mantihĕ taṇĕṇa  $  āruṭṭhu pasaṇṇakitti maṇĕṇa
"kiṃ kantaĕ ṇeha-vihūṇiẏaĕ  $  kiṃ kittiĕ vaïrihĩ jāṇiẏaĕ
kiṃ su-kahaĕ ṇiralaṅkāriẏaĕ  $  kiṃ dhīẏaĕ lañchaṇa-gāriẏaĕ
gharĕ añjaṇa samaraṅgaṇĕ pavaṇu  $  gabbhahŏ saṃvandhu etthu kavaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇarĕṇa ṇivāriẏaü  $  paḍahaü deppiṇu ṇīsāriẏaü
vaṇu gampi païṭṭhaü bhīsaṇaü  $  dhāhāviu pahaṇĕvi appaṇaü
"hā vihi hā kāĩ kiẏanta kiu  $  ṇihi darisĕvi loẏaṇa-juẏalu hiu"
ghattā:
vihi mi kaluṇu kandantiẏahĩ  $  vaṇĕ dukkheṃ ko va ṇa pelliẏaü
     sacchandehĩ carantaĕhĩ  $  hariṇehĩ vi dovaü melliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 6:
vāravāra soāura rovaï añjaṇā  $  "kā vi ṇāhĩ maĩ jehī dukkhahã bhāẏaṇā
sāsuaĕ haẏāsaĕ parihaviẏa  $  hā māĕ paĩ vi ṇaü saṃthaviẏa
hā bhāi-jaṇerahŏ ṇiṭṭhurahŏ  $  ṇīsāriẏa kaha ruẏanti purahŏ
kulahara-païharahi mi daïẏahu mi  $  pūrantu maṇoraha savvahu mi"
gabbhesari jaü jaü saṃcaraï  $  taü taü ruhirahŏ chillaru bharaï
tisa-bhukkha-kilāmiẏa catta-suha  $  gaẏa tetthu jetthu paliẏaṅka-guha
tahĩ diṭṭhu mahārisi suddhamaï  $  ṇāmeṇa bhaḍāraü amiẏagaï
attāvaṇa-tāveṃ tāviẏaü  $  chuḍu jĕ chuḍu joggu khammāviẏaü
tahĩ avasarĕ ve vi paḍhukkiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ dukkha-kilesahĩ mukkiẏaü
ghattā:
calaṇa ṇaveppiṇu muṇivarahŏ  $  añjaṇa viṇṇavaï luhanti muhu
      "aṇṇa-bhavantarĕ kāĩ maĩ  $  kiu dukkiu jeṃ aṇuhavami duhu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 7:
puṇu vasantamālāĕ vuttu "ṇaü teraü  $  eu savvu phalu eẏahŏ gabbhahŏ keraü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vigaẏa-rāu bhaṇaï  $  "ĕu gabbhahŏ dosu ṇa saṃbhavaï
jaï ghosaï "hosaï taṇaü taü  $  ĕhu carima-dehu raṇĕ laddha-jaü
paĩ puvva-bhavantarĕ saĩ karĕṇa  $  jiṇa-paḍima savattihĕ maccharĕṇa
parighitta patta taṃ ehu duhu  $  evahĩ pāvesahi saẏala-suhu"
gaü ema bhaṇeppiṇu amiẏagaï  $  tāṇantarĕ ḍhukku maẏāhivaï
vihuṇiẏa-taṇu dūruggiṇṇa-kamu  $  saṇi asaṇi ṇāĩ jamu kāla-samu
kuñjara-sira-ruhirāruṇa-ṇaharu  $  kīlāla-sitta-kesara-pasaru
aï-viẏaḍa-dāḍha-phāḍiẏa-vaẏaṇu  $  rattuppala-guñja-sarisa-ṇaẏaṇu
khaẏa-sāẏara-rava-gambhīra-giru  $  laṅgūla-daṇḍa-kaṇḍuiẏa-siru
ghattā:
taṃ pekkhĕvi hariṇāhivaï  $  añjaṇa sa-muccha mahiẏalĕ paḍaï
      vijjā-pāṇaĕ uppaĕvi  $  āẏāsĕ vasantamāla raḍaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 8:
hā samīra pavaṇañjaẏa aṇila pahañjaṇā  $  hari-kiẏanta-dantantarĕ vaṭṭaï añjaṇā
hā kammu kāĩ kiu keumaï  $  khalĕ muiẏa lahesahi kavaṇa gaï
hā tāẏa mahinda maïndu dharĕ  $  su-pasaṇṇakitti paḍirakkha karĕ
hā māẏari tuhu mi ṇa saṃthavahi  $  mucchāviẏa duhiẏa samutthavahi
gandhavvahŏ devahŏ dāṇavahŏ  $  vijjāhara-kiṇṇara-māṇavahŏ
jakkhahŏ rakkhahŏ rakkhahŏ sahiẏa  $  ṇaṃ to pañcāṇaṇeṇa gahiẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi gandhavvāhivaï  $  raṇĕ dujjaü para-uvaẏāra-maï
maṇicūḍu raẏaṇacūḍahĕ daïu  $  pañcāṇaṇu jetthu tetthu aïu
aṭṭhāvaü sāvaü hovi thiu  $  hari pārāuṭṭhaü teṇa kiu
ghattā:
tāvĕhĩ gaẏaṇahŏ oarĕvi  $  añjaṇahĕ vasantamāla miliẏa
      "ihu aṭṭhāvaü hontu ṇa vi  $  tā vaṭṭaï āsi māĕ giliẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 9:
ema volla kira vihi mi paropparu jāvĕhĩ  $  gīu geu gandhavveṃ maṇaharu tāvĕhĩ
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pariŏsiẏa ṇiẏa-maṇĕ (?)  $  "pacchaṇṇu ko vi suhi vasaï vaṇĕ
asamāhi-maraṇu jeṃ ṇāsiẏaü  $  aṇṇu vi gandhavvu paẏāsiẏaü"
avaropparu ema cavantiẏahũ  $  paliẏaṅka-guhahĩ acchantiẏahũ
māhavamāsahŏ vahulaṭṭhamiĕ  $  raẏaṇihĕ pacchima-paharaddhĕ thiĕ
ṇakkhattĕ savaṇĕ uppaṇṇu suu  $  hala-kamala-kulisa-jhasa-kamala-juu
cakkaṅkusa-kumma-saṅkha-sahiu  $  suha-lakkhaṇu avalakkhaṇa-rahiu
tāṇantarĕ para-vala-ṇimmahĕṇa  $  paḍisūreṃ sūra-sama-ppahĕṇa
ṇahĕ janteṃ ve vi ṇiẏacchiẏaü  $  oarĕvi vimāṇahŏ pucchiẏaü
ghattā:
"kahĩ jāẏaü kahĩ vaddhiẏaü  $  kahŏ dhīẏaü kahŏ kulaüttiẏaü
      kasu keraü evaḍḍu duhu  $  vaṇĕ acchahŏ jeṇa ruantiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 10:
puṇu vasantamālāĕ paḍuttaru dijjaï  $  ṇiravasesu tahŏ ṇiẏa-vittantu kahijjaï
"añjaṇasundari ṇāmeṇa ima  $  saï suddha muddha jiha jiṇa-paḍima
maṇaveẏa-mahāevihĕ taṇaẏa  $  jaï muṇahŏ mahindu teṇa jaṇiẏa
pāẏaḍa pasaṇṇakittihĕ bhaïṇi  $  maṇahara pavaṇañjaẏāhŏ ghariṇi"
vijjāharu taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vaẏaṇu  $  pabhaṇaï vāhambha-bhariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
"haũ māĕ mahindahŏ mehuṇaü  $  su-pasaṇṇakitti mahu bhāẏaṇaü
taü homi sahoẏaru māulaü  $  paḍisūru haṇūruha-rāulaü
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jāṇĕvi sarĕvi guṇu  $  attillu tehĩ tā ruṇṇu puṇu
jaṃ laïu āsi puṇṇehĩ viṇu  $  taṃ diṇṇu vihihĕ ṇaṃ soẏa-riṇu
ghattā:
sarahasu sāiu dentaĕhĩ  $  jaṃ ekkamekku āvīliẏaü
      aṃsu paṇāleṃ ṇīsaraï  $  ṇaṃ kaluṇu mahārasu pīliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 11:
dukkhu dukkhu sāhārĕvi ṇaẏaṇa luhāvĕvi  $  māuleṇa ṇiẏa ṇiẏaẏa-vimāṇĕ caḍāvĕvi
sura-karivara-kumbhatthala-thaṇahĕ  $  gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ jantihĕ añjaṇahĕ
ṇīsariu vālu aï-dullaliu  $  ṇaṃ ṇahaẏala-sirihĕ gabbhu galiu
mārui davatti ṇivaḍiu ilahĕ  $  ṇaṃ vijju-puñju uppari silahĕ
uccāĕvi ṇiu vijjāharĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ jammaṇĕ jiṇavaru suravarĕhĩ
añjaṇahĕ samappiu jāẏa dihi  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṭṭhu paḍīvaü laddhu ṇihi
ṇiẏa-puru païsārĕvi ṇaravarĕṇa  $  jammocchaü kiu paḍidiṇaẏarĕṇa
ghattā:
"sundaru" jagĕ sundaru bhaṇĕvi  $  "sirisaïlu" silāẏalu cuṇṇu ṇiu
    haṇuruha-dīvĕ pavaḍḍhiẏaü  $  "haṇuvantu" ṇāmu teṃ tāsu kiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 12:
ettahĕ vi khara-dūsaṇa mellāveppiṇu  $  varuṇahŏ rāvaṇaho vi sandhi kareppiṇu
ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru paīsaï jāva maru  $  ṇīsuṇṇu tāma ṇiẏa-ghariṇi-gharu
pekkheppiṇu pucchiẏa kā vi tiẏa  $  "kahĩ añjaṇasundari pāṇa-piẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vuccaï vāliẏaĕ  $  ṇava-rambha-gabbha-somāliẏaĕ
"kira gabbhu bhaṇĕvi para-ṇaravarahŏ  $  keumaïĕ ghalliẏa kulaharahŏ"
taṃ suṇĕvi samīraṇu ṇīsariu  $  aṇusarisĕhĩ vaẏasĕhĩ pariẏariu
gaü tetthu jetthu taṃ sāsuraü  $  kira darisāvesaï sā suraü
piẏa iṭṭha ṇa diṭṭha ṇavara tahi mi  $  asahantu pahañjaṇu gaü kahi mi
pariẏattiẏa pahasiẏāi-saẏaṇa  $  dukkhāura ohulliẏa-vaẏaṇa
ghattā:
"ema bhaṇejjahu keumaï  $  pūrantu maṇoraha māĕ taü
      viraha-davāṇala-dīviẏaü  $  pavaṇañjaẏa-pāẏavu khaẏahŏ gaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 13:
dukkhu dukkhu pariẏattiẏa saẏala vi sajjaṇā  $  gaẏa ruẏanta ṇiẏa-ṇilaẏahŏ ummaṇa-dummaṇā
pavaṇañjao vi paḍivakkha-khaü  $  kāṇaṇu païsaraï pisāẏaraü
pucchaï "ahŏ saravara diṭṭha dhaṇa  $  rattuppala-dala-komala-calaṇa
ahŏ rāẏahaṃsa haṃsāhivaï  $  kahĕ kahi mi diṭṭha jaï haṃsa-gaï
ahŏ dīhara-ṇahara maẏāhivaï  $  kahĕ kahi mi ṇiẏamviṇi diṭṭha jaï
ahŏ kumbhi kumbha-sāriccha-thaṇa  $  kettahĕ vi diṭṭha saï suddha-maṇa
ahŏ ahŏ asoẏa pallaviẏa-pāṇi  $  kahĩ gaẏa parahuĕ parahūẏa-vāṇi
ahŏ runda canda candāṇaṇiẏa  $  miga kahi mi diṭṭha miga-loẏaṇiẏa
ahŏ sihi kalāva-saṇṇiha-cihura  $  ṇa ṇihāliẏa kahi mi viraha-vihura"
ghattā:
ema bhavanteṃ viulĕ vaṇĕ  $  ṇaggoha-mahādumu diṭṭhu kiha
      sāsaẏa-pura-paramesarĕṇa  $  ṇikkhavaṇĕ paẏāgu jiṇeṇa jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ ṇievi vaḍa-pāẏavu aṇṇu vi saravaru  $  kālamehu ṇāmeṇa khamāviu gaẏavaru
"jaṃ saẏala-kāla kaṇṇāriẏaü  $  aṅkusa-khara-pahara-viẏāriẏaü
ālāṇa-khambhĕ jaṃ āliẏaü  $  jaṃ saṅkhala-ṇiẏalahĩ ṇiẏaliẏaü
taṃ saẏalu khamejjahi kumbhi mahu"  $  tahĩ paccakkhāṇaü laïu lahu
"jaï patta vatta kantahĕ taṇiẏa  $  to ṇaü ṇivitti gaï ettaḍiẏa
jaï ghaĩ puṇu eha ṇa hūẏa dihi  $  to etthu majjhu saṇṇāsa-vihi"
thiu maüṇu laevi ṇarāhivaï  $  jhāẏantu siddhi jiha parama-jaï
sacchandu gaïndu vi saṃcaraï  $  sāmiẏa-sammāṇu ṇa vīsaraï
paḍirakkhaï pāsu ṇa muaï kiha  $  bhava-bhava-kiu sukkiẏa-kammu jiha
ghattā:
tāma ruanteṃ pahasiĕṇa  $  akkhiu jaṇaṇihĕ vuṇṇāṇaṇahĕ
      "eu ṇa jāṇahũ kahi mi gaü  $  marueu vioeṃ añjaṇahĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 15:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi savvaṅgiẏa-pasariẏa-veẏaṇā  $  pavaṇa-jaṇaṇi mucchāviẏa thiẏa acceẏaṇā
pavvāliẏa hariẏandaṇa-rasĕṇa  $  ujjīviẏa kaha vi puṇṇa-vasĕṇa
"hā putta putta dakkhavahi muhu  $  hā putta putta kahĩ gaẏaü tuhũ
hā putta āu mahu kamĕhĩ paḍu  $  hā putta putta rahagaĕhĩ caḍu
hā putta putta uvavaṇĕhĩ bhamu  $  hā putta putta jhenduĕhĩ ramu
hā putta putta atthāṇu karĕ  $  hā putta mahāhavĕ varuṇu dharĕ
hā vahuĕ vahuĕ maĩ bhantiẏaĕ  $  tuhũ ghalliẏa aparikkhantiẏaĕ
palhāeṃ dhīriẏa "luhahi muhu  $  ṇikkāraṇĕ rovahi kāĩ tuhũ
haũ kantĕ gavesami tuva taṇaü  $  imu meiṇi-maṇḍalu kettaḍaü"
ghattā:
ema bhaṇevi ṇarāhivĕṇa  $  uvaẏāru karĕvi sāsaṇaharahũ
      ubhaẏa-seḍhi-viṇivāsiẏahũ  $  paṭṭhaviẏa leha vijjāharahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 16:
ekku johu saṃpesiu pāsu dasāsaho  $  akka-sakka-taïlokka-cakka-saṃtāsaho
avarekku vihi mi khara-dūsaṇahũ  $  pāẏālalaṅka-paribhūsaṇahũ
avarekku kaïddhaẏa-patthivahŏ  $  suggīvahŏ kikkindhādhivahŏ
avarekku kikkupura-rāṇāhũ  $  ṇala-ṇīlahũ pamaẏa-pahāṇāhũ
avarekku mahinda-ṇarāhivahŏ  $  tikaliṅga-pahāṇahŏ patthivahŏ
avarekku dhavala-ṇimmala-kulahŏ  $  paḍisūrahŏ añjaṇa-māulahŏ
dūvattaĕ pattaĕ gīḍha-bhaẏa  $  haṇuvantahŏ māẏari muccha gaẏa
ahisiñciẏa sīẏala-candaṇĕṇa  $  paḍa vāiẏa vara-kāmiṇi-jaṇĕṇa
āsāsiẏa sundari pavaṇa-piẏa  $  ṇaṃ thiẏa tuhiṇāhaẏa kamala-siẏa
ghattā:
tāma vidhīriẏa māulĕṇa  $  "mā māĕ visūraü kari maṇahŏ
      siddhahŏ sāsaẏa-siddhi jiha  $  tiha paĩ dakkhavami samīraṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 17:
puṇu puṇo vi dhīreppiṇu añjaṇasundari  $  ṇiẏa-vimāṇĕ ārūḍhu ṇarāhiva-kesari
gaü tettahĕ jettahĕ keumaï  $  aṇṇu vi palhāẏa-ṇarāhivaï
ṇaravara-vindāĩ asesāĩ  $  meleppiṇu gaẏaĩ gavesāĩ
taṃ bhūaravāḍaï ḍhukkāĩ  $  ghaṇa-ulaĩ va thāṇahŏ cukkāĩ
pavaṇañjaü jahĩ āruhĕvi gaü  $  so kālamehu vaṇĕ diṭṭhu gaü
uddhāiu ukkaru uvvaẏaṇu  $  taṇḍaviẏa-kaṇṇu tamvira-ṇaẏaṇu
taṃ pārāuṭṭhaü karĕvi valu  $  gaü tahĩ jĕ paḍīvaü atula-valu
gaṇiẏāriu ḍhoiẏa vasikiẏaü  $  ṇava-ṇaliṇi-saṇḍĕ bhamaru va thiẏaü
kiṅkarĕhĩ gavesantehĩ vaṇĕ  $  lakkhiu vellahalĕ laẏā-bhavaṇĕ
jokkāriu vijjāhara-saĕhĩ  $  jiha jiṇavaru surĕhĩ samāgaĕhĩ
ghattā:
maüṇu laevi pariṭṭhiẏaü  $  ṇaü cavaï ṇa callaï jhāṇa-paru
      jāẏa bhanti maṇĕ savvahu mi  $  "kaṭṭhamaü kiṇṇa ṇimmaviu ṇaru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 19, Kaḍavaka 18:
puṇu silou avaṇīẏalĕ lihiu sa-hatthĕṇa  $  "añjaṇāĕ muiẏāĕ marami paramatthĕṇa
jīvantihĕ ṇisuṇami vatti jaï  $  to vollami laï ettaḍiẏa gaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi haṇuruha-rāṇaĕṇa  $  vajjariẏa vatta parijāṇaĕṇa
tāmarasa-lhāsa-sarisāṇaṇaü  $  viṇṇi mi vasantamālañjaṇaü
jiha ubhaẏa-purahũ parighalliẏaü  $  jiha vaṇĕ bhamiẏaü ekkalliẏaü
jiha harivareṇa uvasaggu kiu  $  aṭṭhāvaeṇa jiha uvasamiu
jiha laddhu puttu bhūsaṇu ilahĕ  $  jiha ṇahĕ ṇijjantu paḍiu silahĕ
sirisaïlu ṇāũ haṇuvantu jiha  $  vittantu asesu vi kahiu tiha
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi samuṭṭhiẏaü  $  paḍisūreṃ ṇiẏa-ṇaẏarahŏ ṇiẏaü
ghattā:
miliu pahañjaṇu añjaṇahŏ  $  veṇṇi mi ṇiẏa-kahaü kahantāĩ
      haṇuruha-dīvĕ pariṭṭhiẏaĩ  $  thiru rajju sa iṃ bhu ñjantāĩ
----------  [20. vīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
vaddhantaü pāvaṇi  $  bhaḍa-cūḍāmaṇi  $  jāva juvāṇa-bhāvĕ caḍaï
tahĩ avasarĕ rāvaṇu  $  sura-saṃtāvaṇu  $  raṇaühĕ varuṇahŏ abbhidaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 1:
dūāgamaṇĕ kou saṃvajjhaï  $  saĩ sarahasu dasāsu saṇṇajjhaï
pariveḍhiu raẏaṇiẏara-sahāsĕhĩ  $  pesiẏa sāsaṇahara caüpāsĕhĩ
khara-dūsaṇa-suggīva-ṇarindahũ  $  ṇala-ṇīlahũ māhinda-mahindahũ
palhāẏahŏ paḍidiṇaẏara-pavaṇahũ  $  jāṇĕvi samaru varuṇa-dahavaẏaṇahũ
mārui saẏaṇa-jaẏāsāūrĕhĩ  $  vuccaï pavaṇañjaẏa-paḍisūrĕhĩ
"vaccha vaccha paripālahi meiṇi  $  māṇahi rāẏa-lacchi jiha kāmiṇi
amhĕhĩ rāvaṇa-āṇa karevī  $  para-vala-jaẏa-siri-vahua harevī"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ari-giri-sodāmaṇi  $  calaṇa ṇaveppiṇu pabhaṇaï pāvaṇi
ghattā:
"kiṃ tumhĕ virujjhahŏ  $  appuṇu jujjhahŏ  $  maĩ haṇuvanteṃ huntaĕṇa
    pāvanti vasundhara  $  canda-divāẏara  $  kiṃ kiraṇoheṃ santaĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 2:
bhaṇaï samīraṇu "jaẏasiri-lāhaü  $  ajju vi putta ṇa pekkhiu āhaü
ajju vi vālu kema tuhũ jujjhahi  $  ajju vi vūha-bheu ṇaü vujjhahi"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi kuviu pavaṇañjaï  $  "vālu kumbhi kiṃ viḍavi ṇa bhañjaï
vālu sīhu kiṃ kari ṇa vihāḍaï  $  kiṃ vālaggi ṇa ḍahaï mahāḍaï
vālaẏandu kiṃ jaṇĕ ṇa muṇijjaï  $  vālu bhaḍāraü kiṃ ṇa thuṇijjaï
vālu bhuvaṅgamu kāĩ ṇa ḍaṅkaï  $  vāla-ravihĕ tamohu kiṃ thakkaï"
ema bhaṇevi pahañjaṇi-rāṇaü  $  laṅkāṇaẏarihĕ diṇṇu paẏāṇaü
dahi-akkhaẏa-jala-maṅgala-kalasahĩ  $  ṇaḍa-kaï-vandi-vippa-ṇigghosahĩ
ghattā:
haṇuvantu sa-sāhaṇu  $  pariosiẏa-maṇu  $  entu diṭṭhu laṅkesarĕṇa
    chaṇa-divasĕ valantaü  $  kiraṇa-phurantaü  $  taruṇa-taraṇi ṇaṃ sasaharĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 3:
dūrahŏ jjĕ taïlokka-bhaẏāvaṇu  $  siru ṇāvĕvi jokkāriu rāvaṇu
teṇa vi sarahaseṇa savvaṅgiu  $  entaü sāmīraṇi āliṅgiu
cumvĕvi uccolihĩ vaïsāriu  $  vāravāra puṇu sāhukkāriu
"dhaṇṇaü pavaṇu jāsu tuhũ ṇandaṇu  $  bharahu jema puraevahŏ ṇandaṇu"
ema kusala-piẏa-mahurālāvĕhĩ  $  kaṅkaṇa-kañcidāma-kalāvĕhĩ
taṃ haṇuvanta-kumāru papujjĕvi  $  varuṇahŏ uppari gaü galagajjĕvi
velandhara-dharĕ mukka-paẏāṇaü  $  thiu valu saraẏabbha-ula-samāṇaü
kahi mi samvu-khara-dūsaṇa-rāṇā  $  kahi mi haṇuva-ṇala-ṇīla-pahāṇā
kahi mi kumua-suggīvaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  ṇaṃ thiẏa thaṭṭĕhĩ matta mahāgaẏa
ghattā:
rehaï ṇisiẏara-valu  $  vaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalu  $  thaḍĕhĩ thaḍĕhĩ āvāsiẏaü
      ṇaṃ dahamuha-keraü  $  vijaẏa-jaṇeraü  $  puṇṇa-puñju puñjĕhĩ thiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 4:
to etthantarĕ raṇĕ ṇikkaruṇahŏ  $  cara-purisĕhĩ jāṇāviu varuṇahŏ
"deva deva kiṃ acchahi avicalu  $  velandharĕ āvāsiu para-valu"
cārahũ taṇaü vaẏaṇu ṇisuṇeppiṇu  $  varuṇu ṇarāhiu osāreppiṇu
mantihĩ kaṇṇa-jāu tahŏ dijjaï  $  "kera dasāṇaṇa-kerī kijjaï
jeṇa dhaṇaü samaraṅgaṇĕ vaṅkiu  $  tijagavihūsaṇu vāraṇu vasikiu
jeṃ aṭṭhāvaü giri uddhariẏaü  $  māhesara-vaï ṇaravaï dhariẏaü
jeṇa ṇiratthīkiu ṇala-kuvvaru  $  sasaharu sūru kuveru purandaru
teṇa samāṇu kavaṇu kira āhaü  $  kera karantahũ kavaṇu parāhaü
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi duddharu  $  varuṇu dhaṇuddharu  $  pajaliu kova-huvāsaṇĕṇa
   "jaïẏahũ khara-dūsaṇa  $  jiẏa veṇṇi mi jaṇa  $  taïu kāĩ kiu rāvaṇĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 5:
eva bhaṇevi bhuvaṇĕ jasa-luddhaü  $  sarahasu varuṇu rāu saṇṇaddhaü
kari-maẏarāsaṇu vipphuriẏāharu  $  dāruṇa-ṇāgapāsa-paharaṇa-karu
tāḍiẏa samara-bheri ubbhiẏa dhaẏa  $  sāri-sajja kiẏa matta mahāgaẏa
haẏa pakkhariẏa pajottiẏa sandaṇa  $  ṇiggaẏa varuṇahŏ kerā ṇandaṇa
puṇḍarīẏa-rājīva dhaṇuddhara  $  velāṇala-kallola-vasundhara
toẏāvali-taraṅga-vagalāmuha  $  velandhara-suvela-velāmuha
sañjhā-galagajjiẏa-sañjhāvali  $  jālāmuha-jaloha-jālāvali
jalakantāi aṇeẏa padhāiẏa  $  sarahasa āhava-bhūmi parāiẏa
viraĕvi garuḍa-vūhu thiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  vaïrihĩ cāva-vūhu kiu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
avaropparu variẏaĩ  $  macchara-bhariẏaĩ  $  dūrugghosiẏa-kalaẏalaĩ
      romañca-visaṭṭaĩ  $  raṇĕ abbhiṭṭaĩ  $  ve vi varuṇa-rāvaṇa-valaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 6:
kiẏa-aṅgaĩ ullāliẏa-khaggaĩ  $  rāvaṇa-varuṇa-valaĩ ālaggaĩ
gaẏa-ghaḍa-ghaṇa-pāseiẏa-gattaĩ  $  kaṇṇa-camara-malaẏāṇila-pattaĩ
indaṇīla-ṇisi-ṇāsiẏa-pasaraĩ  $  sūrakanti-diṇa-laddhāvasaraĩ
ukkhaẏa-karikumbhatthala-siharaĩ  $  kaḍḍhiẏa-asi-muttāhala-ṇiẏaraĩ
pammukkekkamekka-karavālaĩ  $  dasa-disivaha-dhāiẏa-kīlālaĩ
gaẏa-maẏa-ṇaï-pakkhāliẏa-ghāẏaĩ  $  ṇaccāviẏa-kavandha-saṃghāẏaĩ
tāva dasāṇaṇu varuṇahŏ puttĕhĩ  $  veḍhiu candu jema jīmuttĕhĩ
kesari jema mahāgaẏa-jūhahĩ  $  jīu jema dukkamma-samūhahĩ
ghattā:
ekkallaü rāvaṇu  $  bhuvaṇa-bhaẏāvaṇu  $  bhamaï aṇantaĕ vaïri-valĕ
    sa-ṇiẏamvu sa-kandaru  $  ṇāĩ mahīharu  $  matthijjantaĕ uvahi-jalĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 7:
tāma varuṇu rāvaṇahŏ vi bhiccĕhĩ  $  vihi-sua-sāraṇa-maẏa-māriccĕhĩ
hattha-pahattha-vihīsaṇa-rāĕhĩ  $  indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa-mahakāĕhĩ
aṅgaṅgaẏa-suggīva-suseṇĕhĩ  $  tāra-taraṅga-rambha-visaseṇĕhĩ
kumbhaẏaṇṇa-khara-dūsaṇa-vīrĕhĩ  $  jamvava-ṇala-ṇīlĕhĩ soṇḍīrĕhĩ
veḍhiu khatta-dhammu parisesĕvi  $  teṇa vi saravara-dhoraṇi pesĕvi
kheḍiẏa aṇaḍuha vva jaladhārĕhĩ  $  tāma dasāṇaṇu varuṇa-kumārĕhĩ
āẏāmĕvi savvahĩ samakaṇḍiu  $  rahu saṇṇāhu mahādhaü khaṇḍiu
taṃ ṇievi ṇiẏa-kula-ṇeẏāreṃ  $  sarahaseṇa haṇuvanta-kumāreṃ
ghattā:
raṇaühĕ païsanteṃ  $  vaïri vahanteṃ  $  rāvaṇu uvveḍhāviẏaü
    aviẏāṇiẏa-kāeṃ  $  ṇaṃ duvvāeṃ  $  ravi mehahã mellāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 8:
saẏala vi sattu sattu-paḍikūleṃ  $  saṃveḍhĕvi vijjā-laṅgūleṃ
lei ṇa lei jāma maru-ṇandaṇu  $  tāma padhāiu varuṇu sa-sandaṇu
"arĕ khala khudda pāva valu vāṇara  $  kahĩ saṃcarahi saṇḍha ahavā ṇara"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu valiu kaïddhaü  $  sīhu va sīhahŏ vehāviddhaü
viṇṇi vi kira bhiḍanti daṇu-dāraṇa  $  ṇāgapāsa-laṅgūla-ppaharaṇa
tāma dasāṇaṇu rahavaru vāhĕvi  $  antarĕ thiu raṇa-bhūmi pasāhĕvi
"ŏrĕ valu valu haẏāsa arĕ māṇava  $  maĩ kuvieṇa ṇa deva ṇa dāṇava
jaṃ kiu jama-miẏaṅka-dhaṇaẏakkahũ  $  sahasa-kiraṇa-ṇalakuvvara-sakkahũ
ghattā:
avarahu mi surindahũ  $  ṇaravara-vindahũ  $  diṇṇaĩ āsi jāĩ jāĩ
    parihava-dumaïttaĩ  $  phalaĩ vicittaĩ  $  tujjhu vi demi tāĩ tāĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi atuliẏa-māhappeṃ  $  ṇibbhacchiu jalakantahŏ vappeṃ
"laṅkāhiva hevāiu avarĕhĩ  $  sūra-kuvera-purandara-amarĕhĩ
haũ puṇu varuṇu varuṇu phalu dāvami  $  paĩ dahamuha-davaggi ulhāvami"
docchiu rāvaṇeṇa etthantarĕ  $  "kettiu gajjahi suhaḍabbhantarĕ
ahimuhu thakku ḍhukku valu vujjhahi  $  sāmaṇṇāuhĕhiṃ laï jujjhahi
mohaṇa-thambhaṇa-ḍahaṇa-samatthĕhĩ  $  ko vi ṇa paharaï divvahĩ atthĕhĩ"
ema bhaṇevi mahāhavĕ varuṇahŏ  $  gahakallolu bhiḍiu ṇaṃ aruṇahŏ
tahĩ avasarĕ pavaṇañjaẏa-sāreṃ  $  āẏāmĕvi haṇuvanta-kumāreṃ
ghattā:
ṇaravara-sira-sūleṃ  $  ṇiẏa-laṅgūleṃ  $  veḍhĕvi dhariẏa kumāra kiha
    kampāvaṇa-sīleṃ  $  pavaṇāvīleṃ  $  tihuvaṇa-koḍi-paesa jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 10:
ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇa-vandhaṇĕṇa sa-karuṇahŏ  $  paharaṇu hatthĕ ṇa laggaï varuṇahŏ
rāvaṇeṇa uppaĕvi ṇahaṅgaṇĕ  $  indu jema tiha dhariu raṇaṅgaṇĕ
kalaẏalu ghuṭṭhu haẏaĩ jaẏa-tūraĩ  $  jalaṇihi-sadda-sadda-gaẏa-dūraĩ
tāva bhāṇukaṇṇeṇa sa-ṇeuru  $  āṇiu ṇiravasesu anteuru
rasaṇā-hāra-dāma-guppantaü  $  galiẏa-ghusiṇa-kaddamĕ khuppantaü
ali-jhaṅkāra-pamuhalijjantaü  $  ṇiẏa-bhattāra-vioa-kilantaü
aṃsu-jaleṇa dhariṇi siñcantaü  $  kajjala-malĕṇa vaẏaĩ maïlantaü
taṃ pekkhĕvi gañjolliẏa-gatteṃ  $  garahiu kumbhaẏaṇṇu dahavatteṃ
ghattā:
"kāmiṇi-kamala-vaṇaĩ  $  sua-laẏa-bhavaṇaĩ  $  mahuari-koila-aliulaĩ
    eẏaĩ supasiddhaĩ  $  vammaha-cindhaĩ  $  pālijjanti aṇāulaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi sa-ḍoru sa-ṇeuru  $  ravikaṇṇeṇa mukku anteuru
gaü ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru maḍapphara-mukkaü  $  kariṇi-jūhu ṇaṃ vārihĕ cukkaü
kokkāveppiṇu varuṇu dasāseṃ  $  pujjiu sura-jaẏa-lacchi-ṇivāseṃ
"avaluẏa maṃ tuhũ karahi sarīrahŏ  $  maraṇu gahaṇu jaü savvahŏ vīrahŏ
ṇavara palāẏaṇeṇa lajjijjaï  $  jeṃ muhu ṇāmu gottu maïlijjaï"
dahavaẏaṇahŏ vaẏaṇehĩ sa-karuṇeṃ  $  calaṇa ṇaveppiṇu vuccaï varuṇeṃ
"dhaṇaẏa-kiẏanta-sakka jeṃ vaṅkiẏa  $  sahasakiraṇa-ṇalakuvvara vasikiẏa
tāsu bhiḍaï jo so jji aẏāṇaü  $  ajjahŏ laggĕvi tuhũ mahu rāṇaü
ghattā:
aṇṇu vi sasi-vaẏaṇī  $  kuvalaẏa-ṇaẏaṇī  $  mahu suẏa ṇāmeṃ saccavaï
    kari tāĕ samāṇaü  $  pāṇiggahaṇaü  $  vijjāhara-bhuvaṇāhivaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa I, Saṃdhi 20, Kaḍavaka 12:
kusumāuhakamalā vuha-ṇaẏaṇeṃ  $  pariṇiẏa varuṇa-dhīẏa dahavaẏaṇeṃ
puppha-vimāṇĕ caḍiu āṇandeṃ  $  diṇṇu paẏāṇaü jaẏajaẏa-saddeṃ
caliẏaĩ ṇāṇā-jāṇa-vimāṇaĩ  $  raẏaṇaĩ satta ṇavaddha-ṇihāṇaĩ
aṭṭhāraha sahāsa vara-dārahũ  $  addhachaṭṭha-koḍīu kumārahũ
ṇava akkhohaṇīu vara-tūrahũ  $  (ṇaravara-akkhohaṇiu sahāsahũ
akkhohaṇi ṇaravara-gaẏa-turaẏahũ)  $  akkhohaṇi-sahāsu caü-sūrahũ
laṅka païṭṭhu suṭṭhu parioseṃ  $  maṅgala-dhavalucchāha-paghoseṃ
pujjiu pavaṇa-puttu dahagīveṃ  $  dijjaï paümarāẏa suggīveṃ
kharĕṇa aṇaṅgakusuma vaẏa-pāliṇi  $  ṇala-ṇīlehĩ dhīẏa sirimāliṇi
aṭṭha sahāsa ema pariṇeppiṇu  $  gaü ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru pasāu bhaṇeppiṇu
samvu kumāru vi gaü vaṇavāsahŏ  $  khaggahŏ kāraṇĕ diṇaẏarahāsahŏ
ghattā:
suggīvaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  ṇala-ṇīla vi gaẏa  $  khara-dūsaṇa vi kiẏattha-kiẏa
      vijjāhara-kīlaĕ  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-līlaĕ  $  puraĩ sa iṃ bhu ñjanta thiẏa
iẏa "vi jjā ha ra ka ṇḍaṃ"  $  vīsahĩ āsāsaehĩ me siṭṭhaṃ
eṇhĩ "u jjhā ka ṇḍaṃ"  $  sāhijjantaṃ ṇisāmeha
dhuvarāẏadhova taïẏalua  $  paṇatti ṇattī suẏāṇu pāḍheṇa (?)
ṇāmeṇa sā 'miavvā  $  saẏambhu-ghariṇī mahāsattā
tīe lihāviẏam iṇaṃ  $  vīsahĩ āsāsaehĩ paḍivaddhaṃ
"siri-vijjāhara-kaṇḍaṃ"  $  kaṇḍaṃ piva kāmaevassa
ii paḍhamaṃ vijjāharakaṇḍaṃ samattaṃ
________________________________________________________________________
*************************  II. ujjhākaṇḍaṃ  *************************  
________________________________________________________________________
----------  [21. ekkavīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
sāẏaravuddhi vihīsaṇĕṇa  $  paripucchiu "jaẏasiri-māṇaṇahŏ
kahĕ kettaḍaü  kālu acalu  $  jaü jīviu rajju dasāṇaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 1:
pabhaṇaï sāẏaravuddhi bhaḍāraü  $  kusumāuha-sara-pasara-ṇivāraü
"suṇu akkhami rahuvaṃsu pahāṇaü  $  dasarahu atthi aüjjhahĕ rāṇaü
tāsu putta hosanti dhurandhara  $  vāsueva-valaeva dhaṇuddhara
tehĩ haṇevaü rakkhu mahāraṇĕ  $  jaṇaẏa-ṇarāhiva-taṇaẏahĕ kāraṇĕ"
to sahasatti palittu vihīsaṇu  $  ṇaṃ ghaẏa-ghaḍaĕhĩ sittu huāsaṇu
"jāma ṇa laṅkā-vallari sukkaï  $  jāma ṇa maraṇu dasāsaṇĕ ḍhukkaï
toḍami tāma tāhũ bhaẏa-bhīsaĩ  $  dasaraha-jaṇaẏa-ṇarāhiva-sīsaĩ"
to taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi kaliẏāraü  $  vaddhāvaṇahã padhāiu ṇāraü
"ajju vihīsaṇu uppari esaï  $  tumhahã vihi mi siraĩ toḍesaï"
ghattā:
dasaraha-jaṇaẏa viṇīsariẏa  $  leppamaü thaveppiṇu appaṇaü
      ṇiẏaĩ siraĩ vijjāharĕhĩ  $  pariẏaṇahŏ kareppiṇu cappaṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 2:
dasaraha-jaṇaẏa ve vi gaẏa tettahĕ  $  puravaru kaütukamaṅgalu jettahĕ
jemmaï jetthu amaggiẏa-laddhaü  $  sūrakanta-maṇi-huẏavaha-raddhaü
jahĩ jalu candakanti-ṇijjharaṇĕhĩ  $  suppaï paḍiẏa-puppha-pattharaṇĕhĩ
jahĩ ṇeura-jhaṅkāriẏa-calaṇĕhĩ  $  rammaï accaṇa-puppha-kkhalaṇĕhĩ
jahĩ pāsāẏa-siharĕ ṇihasijjaï  $  teṇa miẏaṅku vaṅku kisu kijjaï
tahĩ suhamaï-ṇāmeṇa pahāṇaü  $  ṇaṃ surapurahŏ purandaru rāṇaü
pihusiri tahŏ mahaevi maṇohara  $  surakari-kara kumbhaẏala-paohara
ṇandaṇu tāhĕ doṇu uppajjaï  $  kekkaẏa taṇaẏa kāĩ vaṇṇijjaï
saẏala-kalā-kalāva-saṃpaṇṇī  $  ṇaṃ paccakkha lacchī avaïṇṇī
ghattā:
tāhĕ saẏamvarĕ miliẏa vara  $  harivāhaṇa-hemappaha-pamuha
      ṇāĩ samudda-mahāsirihĕ  $  thiẏa jalavāhiṇi-pavāha samuha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 3:
to kareṇu āruhĕvi viṇiggaẏa  $  ṇaṃ paccakkha mahāsiri-devaẏa
pekkhantahã ṇaravara-saṃghāẏahã  $  bhūgoẏara-vijjāhara-rāẏahã
ghitta māla dasasandaṇa-ṇāmahŏ  $  maṇahara-gaïĕ raïĕ ṇaṃ kāmahŏ
tahĩ avasarĕ viruddhu harivāhaṇu  $  dhāiu "lehu" bhaṇantu sa-sāhaṇu
"varu āhaṇahŏ kaṇṇa uddālahŏ  $  raẏaṇaĩ jema tema mahipālahŏ"
suhamaï rahu-sueṇa viṇṇappaï  $  "dhīraü hohi māma ko cappaï
maĩ jiẏantĕ aṇaraṇṇahŏ ṇandaṇĕ"  $  eu bhaṇevi pariṭṭhiu sandaṇĕ
kekkaï dhurahĩ kareppiṇu sārahi  $  tahĩ paẏaṭṭu jahĩ saẏala mahārahi
ghattā:
to vollijjaï dasarahĕṇa  $  "dūraẏara-ṇivāriẏa-raviẏaraĩ
    rahu vāhĕvi tahĩ ṇehi piĕ  $  dhaẏa-chattaĩ jetthu ṇirantaraĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pariosiẏa-jaṇaeṃ  $  vāhiu rahavaru pihusiri-taṇaeṃ
teṇa vi sarahĩ parajjiu sāhaṇu  $  bhaggu sa-hemappahu harivāhaṇu
pariṇiẏa kekkaï diṇṇu mahā-varu  $  cavaï aüjjhāpura-paramesaru
"sundari maggu maggu jaṃ ruccaï"  $  suhamaï-suẏaĕ ṇaveppiṇu vuccaï
"diṇṇu deva paĩ maggami jaïẏahũ  $  ṇiẏaẏa-saccu pālijjaï taïẏahũ"
ema cavantaĩ dhaṇa-kaṇa-saṃkulĕ  $  thiẏaĩ ve vi purĕ kaütukamaṅgalĕ
vahu-vāsarĕhĩ aüjjha païṭṭhaĩ  $  saï-vāsava iva rajjĕ vaïṭṭhaĩ
saẏala-kalā-kalāva-saṃpaṇṇā  $  tāma caẏāri putta uppaṇṇā
ghattā:
rāmacandu aparajjiẏahĕ  $  somitti sumittihĕ ekku jaṇu
    bharahu dhurandharu kekkaïhĕ  $  suppahahĕ puttu puṇu sattuhaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 5:
eẏa caẏāri putta tahŏ rāẏahŏ  $  ṇāĩ mahā-samudda mahi-bhāẏahŏ
ṇāĩ danta givvāṇa-gaïndahŏ  $  ṇāĩ maṇoraha sajjaṇa-vindahŏ
jaṇaü vi mihilā-ṇaẏarĕ païṭṭhaü  $  samaü videhaĕ rajjĕ ṇiviṭṭhaü
tāhã vihi mi vara-vikkama-vīẏaü  $  bhāmaṇḍalu uppaṇṇu sa-sīẏaü
puvva-vaïru saṃbharĕvi a-kheveṃ  $  dāhiṇa seḍhi harĕvi ṇiu deveṃ
tahĩ rahaṇeuracakkavāla-purĕ  $  vahala-dhavala-chuha-paṅkāpaṇḍurĕ
candagaïhĕ candujjala-vaẏaṇahŏ  $  ṇandaṇavaṇa-samīvĕ tahŏ saẏaṇahŏ
ghattiu piṅgaleṇa amarindeṃ  $  pupphavaïhĕ allaviu ṇarindeṃ
ghattā:
tāva rajju jaṇaẏahŏ taṇaü  $  uṭṭhaddhu mahāḍaï-vāsiĕhĩ
    vavvara-savara-pulindaĕhĩ  $  himavanta-viñjha-saṃvāsiĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 6:
veḍhiẏa jaṇaẏa-kaṇaẏa duppecchĕhĩ  $  vavvara-savara-pulindā-mecchĕhĩ
garuẏāsaṅghaĕ vāla-sahāẏahŏ  $  lehu visajjiu dasaraha-rāẏahŏ
tūraĩ devi so vi saṇṇajjhaï  $  rāmu sa-lakkhaṇu tāva virujjhaï
"maĩ jīẏantĕ tāẏa tuhũ callahi  $  haṇami vaïri chuḍu hatthutthallahi"
vuttu ṇarāhiveṇa "tuhũ vālaü  $  rambhā-khambha-gabbha-somālaü
kiha ālaggahi ṇaravara-vindahũ  $  kiha ghaḍa bhañjahi matta-gaïndahũ
kiha riu-rahahã mahārahu coẏahi  $  kiha vara-turaẏa turaṅgahũ ḍhoẏahi"
pabhaṇaï rāmu "tāẏa pallaṭṭahi  $  haũ jĕ pahuccami kāĩ paẏaṭṭahi
ghattā:
kiṃ tamu haṇaï ṇa vālu ravi  $  kiṃ vālu davaggi ṇa ḍahaï vaṇu
   kiṃ kari dalaï ṇa vālu hari  $  kiṃ vālu ṇa ḍaṅkaï uragamaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 7:
pahu pallaṭṭu paẏaṭṭiu rāhaü  $  dūrāsaṃghiẏa-meccha-mahāhaü
dūsahu so ji aṇṇu puṇu lakkhaṇu  $  ekku pavaṇu aṇṇekku huāsaṇu
viṇṇi mi bhiḍiẏa pulindahŏ sāhaṇĕ  $  rahavara-turaẏa-joha-gaẏa-vāhaṇĕ
dīhara-sarĕhĩ vaïri saṃtāviẏa  $  jaṇaẏa-kaṇaẏa raṇĕ uvveḍhāviẏa
dhāiu samaraṅgaṇĕ tamu rāṇaü  $  vavvara-savara-pulinda-pahāṇaü
teṇa kumārahŏ cūriu rahavaru  $  chiṇṇu chattu dohāiu dhaṇuharu
to rāhavĕṇa laïjjaï vāṇĕhĩ  $  ṇāiṇi-ṇāẏa-kāẏa-parimāṇĕhĩ
sāhaṇu bhaggaü laggu umaggĕhĩ  $  karaẏalehĩ olamviẏa-khaggĕhĩ
ghattā:
dasahĩ turaṅgahĩ ṇīsariu  $  bhillāhiu bhajjĕvi āhavahŏ
    jāṇaï jaṇaẏa-ṇarāhivĕṇa  $  tahĩ kālĕ vi appiẏa rāhavahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 8:
vavvara-savara-varūhiṇi bhaggī  $  jaṇaẏahŏ jāẏa pihivi āvaggī
ṇāṇā-raẏaṇāharaṇahĩ pujjiẏa  $  vāsueva-valaeva visajjiẏa
sīẏahĕ deha-riddhi pāvantihĕ  $  ekku divasu dappaṇu joẏantihĕ
paḍimā-chalĕṇa mahā-bhaẏa-gāraü  $  ārisa-vesu ṇihāliu ṇāraü
jaṇaẏa-taṇaẏa sahasatti paṇaṭṭhī  $  sīhāgamaṇĕ kuraṅgi va taṭṭhī
"hā hā māĕ" bhaṇantihĩ sahiẏahĩ  $  kalaẏalu kiu sajjhasa-gaha-gahiẏahĩ
amarisa-kuddhuddhāiẏa kiṅkara  $  ukkhaẏa-vara-karavāla-bhaẏaṅkara
milĕvi tehĩ kaha kaha vi ṇa māriu  $  levi addhacandĕhĩ ṇīsāriu
ghattā:
gaü sa-parāhaü devarisi  $  paḍĕ paḍima lihĕvi sīẏahĕ taṇiẏa
    darisāviẏa bhāmaṇḍalahŏ  $  visa-jutti ṇāĩ ṇara-ghāraṇiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 9:
diṭṭha jaṃ jĕ paḍĕ paḍima kumāreṃ  $  pañcahĩ sarahĩ viddhu ṇaṃ māreṃ
susiẏa-vaẏaṇu ghummaïẏa-ṇiḍālaü  $  valiẏa-aṅgu moḍiẏa-bhuva-ḍālaü
vaddha-kesu pakkhoḍiẏa-vacchaü  $  darisāviẏa-dasa-kāmāvatthaü
cinta paḍhama-thāṇantarĕ laggaï  $  vīẏaĕ piẏa-muha-daṃsaṇu maggaï
taïẏaĕ sasaï dīha-ṇīsāseṃ  $  kaṇaï caütthaĕ jara-viṇṇāseṃ
pañcamĕ ḍāheṃ aṅgu ṇa muccaï  $  chaṭṭhaĕ muhahŏ ṇa kāi mi ruccaï
sattamĕ thāṇĕ ṇa gāsu laïjjaï  $  aṭṭhamĕ gamaṇummāĕhĩ bhijjaï
ṇavamĕ pāṇa-saṃdehahŏ ḍhukkaï  $  dasamaĕ maraï ṇa kema vi cukkaï
ghattā:
kahiu ṇarindahŏ kiṅkarĕhĩ  $  "pahu dukkaru jīvaï puttu taü
    kāhĕ vi kaṇṇahĕ kāraṇĕṇa  $  so dasamī kāmāvattha gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 10:
ṇāga-ṇarāmara-kula-kaliẏāraü  $  candagaïĕ paḍipucchiu ṇāraü
"kahi kahŏ taṇiẏa kaṇṇa kahĩ diṭṭhī  $  jā mahu puttahŏ hiẏaĕ païṭṭhī"
kahaï mahārisi "mihilā-rāṇaü  $  candakeu-ṇāmeṇa pahāṇaü
tahŏ suu jaṇaü tetthu maĩ diṭṭhaü  $  kaṇṇā-raẏaṇu tiloẏa-variṭṭhaü
taṃ jaï hoi kumārahŏ āẏahŏ  $  to siẏa haraï purandara-rāẏahŏ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vijjāhara-ṇāheṃ  $  pesiu cavalaveu asagāheṃ
"jāhi videhā-daïu harevaü  $  maĩ vivāha-saṃvandhu karevaü"
gaü so candagaïhĕ muhu joĕvi  $  mandura ḍhukku turaṅgamu hoĕvi
koḍḍeṃ caḍiu ṇarāhiu jāvĕhĩ  $  dāhiṇa seḍhi parāiu tāvĕhĩ
mihilā-ṇāhu mueppiṇu jiṇa-harĕ  $  cavalaveu païsaï purĕ maṇaharĕ
ghattā:
"āṇiu jaṇaẏa-ṇarāhivaï"  $  ṇiẏa-ṇāhahŏ akkhiu sa-rahasĕṇa
      vandaṇahattiĕ so vi gaü  $  sahũ putteṃ viraha-paravvasĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 11:
vijjāhara-ṇara-ṇaẏaṇāṇandĕhĩ  $  kiu saṃbhāsaṇu vihi mi ṇarindĕhĩ
pabhaṇaï candagamaṇu tosiẏa-maṇu  $  "viṇṇi vi kiṇṇa karahũ saẏaṇattaṇu
duhiẏa tuhārī puttu mahāraü  $  hou vivāhu maṇoraha-gāraü"
amarisu ṇavara pavaddhiu jaṇaẏahŏ  $  "diṇṇa kaṇṇa maĩ dasaraha-taṇaẏahŏ
rāmahŏ jaẏasiri-rāmāsattahŏ  $  savara-varūhiṇi-cūriẏa-gattahŏ
tahĩ avasarĕ vaddhiẏa-ahimāṇeṃ  $  vuttu ṇarindu candapatthāṇeṃ
"kahĩ vijjāharu kahĩ bhūgoẏaru  $  gaẏa-masaẏahũ vaḍḍāraü antaru
māṇusa-khettu jĕ tāma kaṇiṭṭhaü  $  jīviu tahĩ kahĩ taṇaü visiṭṭhaü"
ghattā:
bhaṇaï ṇarāhiu "kettiĕṇa  $  jagĕ māṇusa-khettu jĕ aggalaü
    jasu pāsiu titthaṅkarĕhĩ  $  siddhattaṇu laddhaü kevalaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi bhāmaṇḍala-vappeṃ  $  vuccaï vijjā-vala-māhappeṃ
"paguṇa-guṇaĩ aï-dujjaẏa-bhāvaĩ  $  purĕ acchanti etthu ve cāvaĩ
vajjāvatta-samuddāvattaĩ  $  jakkhārakkhiẏa-rakkhiẏa-gattaĩ
kiṃ bhāmaṇḍaleṇa kiṃ rāmeṃ  $  tāĩ caḍāvaï jo āẏāmeṃ
pariṇaü so jjĕ kaṇṇa ĕu pabhaṇiu"  $  taṃ ji pamāṇu karĕvi pahu bhaṇiẏaü
gaẏa sa-sarāsaṇa mihilā-puravaru  $  vaddha mañca āḍhattu saẏamvaru
miliẏa ṇarāhiva je jagĕ jāṇiẏa  $  saẏala vi dhaṇu-paẏāva-avamāṇiẏa
ko vi ṇāhĩ jo tāĩ caḍāvaï  $  jakkha-sahāsahũ muhu darisāvaï
ghattā:
jāma ṇa guṇahĩ caḍantāĩ  $  ahijāẏaĩ kaü suha-daṃsaṇaĩ
    avaseṃ jaṇahŏ aṇiṭṭhāĩ  $  kukalattaĩ jema sarāsaṇaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 13:
jaṃ ṇaravaï asesa avamāṇiẏa  $  dasaraha-taṇaẏa caẏāri vi āṇiẏa
hari-valaeva paḍhukkiẏa tettahĕ  $  sīẏa-saẏamvara-maṇḍaü jettahĕ
dūra-ṇivāriẏa-ṇaravara-lakkhĕhĩ  $  dhaṇuharāĩ allaviẏaĩ jakkhĕhĩ
"appaṇa-appaṇāĩ su-pamāṇaĩ  $  ṇivvāḍevi lehu vara-cāvaĩ"
laïẏaĩ sāẏara-vajjāvattaĩ  $  gāmahaṇā iva guṇĕhĩ caḍantaĩ
melliu kusuma-vāsu sura-sattheṃ  $  pariṇiẏa jaṇaẏa-taṇaẏa kākuttheṃ
je je miliẏa saẏamvarĕ rāṇā  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-ṇaẏarahŏ gaẏa viddāṇā
divasu vāru ṇakkhattu gaṇeppiṇu  $  laggu joggu gaha-dutthu ṇieppiṇu
ghattā:
joisiĕhĩ āesu kiu  $  "jaü lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ sa-rahasahũ
    āẏahĕ kaṇṇahĕ kāraṇĕṇa  $  hosaï viṇāsu vahu-rakkhasahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 21, Kaḍavaka 14:
sasivaddhaṇeṇa sasi-vaẏaṇiẏaü  $  kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-ṇaẏaṇiẏaü
kala-koila-vīṇā-vāṇiẏaü  $  aṭṭhāraha kaṇṇaü āṇiẏaü
dasa lahu-bhāẏarahũ samappiẏaü  $  lakkhaṇahŏ aṭṭha parikappiẏaü
doṇeṇa visallā-sundariẏa  $  kaṇhahŏ cintaviẏa maṇohariẏa
vaïdehi aüjjhā-ṇaẏari ṇiẏa  $  dasarahĕṇa mahocchava-soha kiẏa
raha-tikka-caükkahĩ caccarahĩ  $  kuṅkuma-kappūra-pavara-varahĩ
candana-chaḍoha-dijjantaĕhĩ  $  gāẏaṇa-gīẏahĩ gijjantaĕhĩ
maṇimaïẏaü raïẏaü dehaliu  $  mottiẏa-kaṇaĕhĩ raṅgāvaliu
sovaṇṇa-daṇḍa-maṇi-toraṇaĩ  $  vaddhaĩ suravara-maṇa-coraṇaĩ

sīẏa-valaĩ païsāriẏaĩ  $  jaṇĕ jaẏa-jaẏa-kārijjantāĩ
      thiẏaĩ aüjjhahĕ avicalaĩ  $  raï-sokkha sa ẏaṃ bhu ñjantāĩ
----------  [22. vāvīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
kosalaṇandaṇĕṇa  $  sa-kalatteṃ ṇiẏa-gharu āeṃ
āsāḍhaṭṭhamihĩ  $  kiu ṇhavaṇu jiṇindahŏ rāeṃ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 1:
sura-samara-sahāsĕhĩ dummaheṇa  $  kiu ṇhavaṇu jiṇindahŏ dasaraheṇa
paṭṭhaviẏaĩ jiṇa-taṇu-dhovaẏāĩ  $  devihĩ divvaĩ gandhovaẏāĩ
suppahahĕ ṇavara kañcui ṇa pattu  $  pahu pabhaṇaï rahasucchaliẏa-gattu

gaẏa-dantu aẏaṃgamu (?) daṇḍa-pāṇi  $  aṇiẏacchiẏa-pahu pakkhaliẏa-vāṇi

garahiu dasarahĕṇa  $  "paĩ kañcui kāĩ cirāviu
    jalu jiṇa-vaẏaṇu jiha  $  suppahahĕ davatti ṇa pāviu"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 2:
paṇaveppiṇu teṇa vi vuttu ema  $  "gaẏa diẏahā jovvaṇu lhasiu deva
paḍhamāusu jara dhavalanti āẏa  $  puṇu asaï va sīsa-valagga jāẏa
gaï tuṭṭiẏa vihaḍiẏa sandhi-vandha  $  ṇa suṇanti kaṇṇa loẏaṇa ṇirandha

suhu mahu-vindu-samu  $  duhu meru-sarisu paviẏambhaï
    vari taṃ kammu kiu  $  jaṃ paü ajarāmaru labbhaï

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 3:
kaṃ divasu vi hosaï ārisāhũ  $  kañcui-avattha amhārisāhũ
ko haũ kā mahi kahŏ taṇaü davvu  $  siṃhāsaṇu chattaĩ athiru savvu
jovvaṇu sarīru jīviu dhigatthu  $  saṃsāru asāru aṇatthu atthu
visu visaẏa vandhu diḍha-vandhaṇāĩ  $  ghara-dāraĩ parihava-kāraṇāĩ

duhiẏā vi duhiẏa māẏā vi māẏa  $  sama-bhāu lenti kira teṇa bhāẏa
ghattā:
āẏaĩ avaraï mi  $  savvaĩ rāhavahŏ samappĕvi
    appuṇu taü karami"  $  thiu dasarahu ema viẏappĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 4:
tahĩ avasarĕ āiu savaṇa-saṅghu  $  para-samaẏasamīraṇa-giri-alaṅghu

ahi-visama-visaẏa-visa-veẏa-samaṇu  $  khama-dama-ṇiseṇi-kiẏa-mokkha-gamaṇu

tahĩ saccabhūi ṇāmeṇa sāhu  $  jāṇiẏa-saṃsāra-samudda-thāhu
magahāhiu visaẏa-viratta-dehu  $  avahatthiẏa-putta-kalatta-ṇehu
givvāṇa-mahāgiri dhīrimāĕ  $  raẏaṇāẏara-guru gambhīrimāĕ
ghattā:
risi-saṅghāhivaï  $  so āu aüjjha bhaḍāraü
    "sivapuri-gamaṇu kari"  $  dasarahahŏ ṇāĩ hakkāraü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 5:
paḍivaṇṇaĕ tahĩ tettaḍaĕ kālĕ  $  to purĕ rahaṇeuracakkavālĕ
bhāmaṇḍalu maṇḍalu pariharantu  $  acchaï risi siddhi va saṃbharantu
vaïdehi-viraha-veẏaṇa sahantu  $  dasa kāmāvatthaü dakkhavantu
paḍihanti ṇa vijjāhara-tiẏāu  $  ṇaü khāṇa-pāṇa-bhoẏaṇa-kiẏāu
ṇa jaladda ṇa candaṇa kamala-sejja  $  ḍhukkanti janti aṇṇoṇṇa vejja
vāhijjaï viraheṃ dūsaheṇa  $  ṇaü phiṭṭaï keṇa vi osaheṇa
ṇīsāsu mueppiṇu dīhu dīhu  $  puṇaravi thiu thakkĕvi jema sīhu
"bhūgoẏari bhuñjami maṇḍa levi"  $  ṇīsariu sa-sāhaṇu saṇṇahevi
ghattā:
pattu viẏaḍḍha-puru  $  taṃ ṇiĕvi jāu jāīsaru
    "aṇṇahĩ bhava-gahaṇĕ  $  haũ hontu etthu rajjesaru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 6:
mucchāviu taṃ pekkhĕvi paesu  $  saṃbharĕvi bhavantaru ṇiravasesu
sabbhāveṃ pabhaṇiu teṇa tāu  $  "kuṇḍalamaṇḍiu ṇāmeṇa rāu
haũ hontu etthu akhaliẏa-maraṭṭu  $  piṅgalu ṇāmeṇa kuvera-bhaṭṭu

uddāliu maĩ tahŏ taṃ kalattu  $  sŏ vi marĕvi surattaṇu kahi mi pattu
muu haü mi videhahĕ dehĕ āu  $  ṇiu deveṃ jāṇaï-jamala-jāu
vaṇĕ ghattiu kaṇṭeṇa vi ṇa bhiṇṇu  $  pupphavaïhĕ paĩ sāẏarĕṇa diṇṇu
ghattā:
vaddhiu tumha gharĕ  $  jaṇu saẏalu vi ĕu pariẏāṇaï
    jaṇaü jaṇeru mahu  $  māẏari videha sasa jāṇaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 7:
vittantu kaheppiṇu ṇiravasesu  $  gaü vandaṇahattiĕ taṃ paesu
jahĩ vasaï mahārisi saccabhūi  $  jahĩ jiṇavara-ṇhavaṇa-mahāvibhūi
vaïragga-kālu jahĩ dasarahāsu  $  jahĩ sīẏa-rāma-lakkhaṇa-vilāsu

jāṇāviu sīẏahĕ bhāi jema  $  jiha hari-vala-sālā sāvaleva
suu parama-dhammu suha-bhāẏaṇeṇa  $  tavacaraṇu laẏaü candāẏaṇeṇa
ghattā:
dasarahu aṇṇa-diṇĕ  $  kira rāmahŏ rajju samappaï
    kekkaẏa tāva maṇĕ  $  uṇhālaĕ dharaṇi va tappaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 8:
ṇarindassa soūṇa pavvajja-ẏajjaṃ  $  sa-rāmāhirāmassa rāmassa rajjaṃ
sasā doṇarāẏassa bhaggāṇurāẏā  $  tulākoḍi-kantī-laẏāliddha-pāẏā
sa-pālamva-kañcī-pahā-bhiṇṇa-gujjhā  $  thaṇuttuṅga-bhāreṇa jā ṇiṇṇa-majjhā
ṇavāsoẏa-vacchacchaẏāchāẏa-pāṇī  $  varālāviṇī-koilālāva-vāṇī

varo maggio "ṇāha so esa kālo  $  mahaṃ ṇandaṇo ṭhāu rajjāṇupālo"

ghattā:
"jaï tuhũ puttu mahu  $  to ettiu pesaṇu kijjaï
    chattaĩ vaïsaṇaü  $  vasumaï bharahahŏ appijjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 9:
ahavaï bharahu vi āsaṇṇa-bhavvu  $  so cintaï athiru asāru savvu
gharu pariẏaṇu jīviu sarīru vittu  $  acchaï tavacaraṇa-ṇihitta-cittu
paĩ muĕvi tāsu jaï diṇṇu rajju  $  to lakkhaṇu lakkhaĩ haṇaï ajju
ṇa vi haũ ṇa vi bharahu ṇa kekkaẏā vi  $  sattuhaṇu kumāru ṇa suppahā vi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi papphulliẏa-muheṇa  $  vollijjaï dasaraha-taṇuruheṇa
"puttahŏ puttattaṇu ettiuṃ jĕ  $  jaṃ kulu ṇa caḍāvaï vasaṇa-puñjĕ
jaṃ ṇiẏa-jaṇaṇahŏ āṇā-viheu  $  jaṃ karaï vivakkhahŏ pāṇa-cheu
kiṃ putteṃ puṇu paẏapūraṇeṇa  $  guṇa-hīṇeṃ hiẏaẏa-visūraṇeṇa
ghattā:
lakkhaṇu ṇa vi haṇaï  $  tavu bhāvahŏ saccu paẏāsahŏ
    bhuñjaü bharahu mahi  $  haũ jāmi tāẏa vaṇa-vāsahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 10:
hakkāriu bharahu ṇaresareṇa  $  puṇu vuccaï ṇeha-mahābhareṇa

ṇaü jāṇahũ mahilahã ko sahāu  $  jovvaṇa-maeṇa ṇa gaṇanti pāu
ṇaü vujjhahi tuhu mi mahā-maẏandhu  $  kiṃ rāmu muĕvi mahu paṭṭa-vandhu
sappurisa vi cañcala-citta honti  $  maṇĕ juttājuttu ṇa cintavanti
māṇikku muĕvi ko lei kaccu  $  kāmandhahŏ kira kahĩ taṇaü saccu
ghattā:
acchahũ puṇu vi gharĕ  $  sattuhaṇu rāmu haũ lakkhaṇu
    aliu ma hohi tuhũ  $  mahi bhuñjĕ bhaḍārā appuṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 11:
suẏa-vaẏaṇa-viramĕ dasasandaṇeṇa  $  vuccaï aṇaraṇṇahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa

tuhũ pālĕ gharāsaü parama-rammu  $  ṇaü āẏahŏ pāsiu ko vi dhammu
dijjaï jaïvarahũ mahappahāṇu  $  sua-bhesaha-abhaẏāhāra-dāṇu
rakkhijjaï sīlu kusīla-ṇāsu  $  kijjaï jiṇa-pujja mahovavāsu
jiṇa-vandaṇa vārāpekkha-karaṇu  $  sallehaṇa-kālu samāhi-maraṇu
ehu savvahũ dhammahũ parama-dhammu  $  jo pālaï tahŏ sura-maṇuẏa-jammu"

ghattā:
"jaï ghara-vāsĕ suhu  $  euṃ jĕ tāẏa paḍivajjahi
    to tiṇa-samu gaṇĕvi  $  kajjeṇa keṇa pavvajjahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 22, Kaḍavaka 12:
to kheḍu muĕvi dasarahĕṇa vuttu  $  "jaï saccaü tuhũ mahu taṇaü puttu

"guṇu kevalu vasuhaĕ bhuttiẏāĕ  $  kiṃ khaṇĕ khaṇĕ utta-paüttiẏāĕ

khīrovamahaṇṇava-ṇimmaleṇa  $  givvāṇa-mahāgiri-avicaleṇa

pekkhantahŏ jaṇahŏ  $  surakari-kara-pavara-pacaṇḍĕhĩ
    paṭṭu ṇivaddhu sirĕ  $  rahu-suĕṇa sa ẏaṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [23. tevīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
tahĩ muṇi-suvvaẏa-titthĕ  $  vuhaẏaṇa-kaṇṇa-rasāẏaṇu
rāvaṇa-rāmahũ jujjhu  $  taṃ ṇisuṇahu rāmāẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 1:
ṇamiūṇa bhaḍāraü risaha-jiṇu  $  puṇu kavvahŏ uppari karami maṇu
jagĕ loẏahũ suẏaṇahũ paṇḍiẏahũ  $  saddattha-sattha-paricaḍḍiẏahũ
kiṃ cittaĩ geṇhĕvi sakkiẏaĩ  $  vāseṇa vi jāĩ ṇa rañjiẏaĩ
to kavaṇu gahaṇu amhārisĕhĩ  $  vāẏaraṇa-vihūṇĕhĩ ārisĕhĩ
kaï atthi aṇeẏa bheẏa-bhariẏa  $  je suẏaṇa-sahāsĕhĩ āẏariẏa
cakkalaĕhĩ kulaĕhĩ khandhaĕhĩ  $  pavaṇuddhua-rāsāluddhaĕhĩ
mañjariẏa-vilāsiṇi-ṇakkuḍĕhĩ  $  suha-chandĕhĩ saddĕhĩ khaḍahaḍĕhĩ
haũ kiṃ pi ṇa jāṇami mukkhu maṇĕ  $  ṇiẏa vuddhi paẏāsami to vi jaṇĕ
jaṃ saẏalĕ vi tihuvaṇĕ vitthariu  $  ārambhiu puṇu rāhavacariu
ghattā:
bharahahŏ vaddhaĕ paṭṭĕ  $  to ṇivvūḍha-mahāhaü
      paṭṭaṇu ujjha muevi  $  gaü vaṇa-vāsahŏ rāhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 2:
jaṃ parivaddhu paṭṭu parioseṃ  $  jaẏa-maṅgala-jaẏa-tūra-ṇighoseṃ
