sampaẏa riddhi viddhi avagaṇṇĕvi  $  tāẏahŏ taṇaü saccu parimaṇṇĕvi
ṇiggaü valu valu ṇāĩ hareppiṇu  $  lakkhaṇo vi lakkhaṇaĩ laeppiṇu
saṃcallehĩ tehĩ viddāṇaü  $  ṭhiu heṭṭhāmuhu dasarahu rāṇaü
hiẏavaĕ ṇāĩ tisūleṃ salliu  $  "rāhaü kiha vaṇa-vāsahŏ ghalliu
dhigadhigatthu" jaṇaeṇa pavolliu  $  "laṅghiu kula-kamu vi sumahallaü
ahavaï jaï maĩ saccu ṇa pāliu  $  to ṇiẏa-ṇāmu gottu maĩ maïliu
vari gaü rāmu ṇa saccu viṇāsiu  $  saccu mahantaü savvahŏ pāsiu
sacceṃ amvarĕ tavaï divāẏaru  $  sacceṃ samaü ṇa cukkaï sāẏaru
sacceṃ vāu vāi mahi paccaï  $  sacceṃ osahi khaẏahŏ ṇa vaccaï
ghattā:
jo ṇa vi pālaï saccu  $  muhĕ dāḍhiẏaü vahantaü
      ṇivaḍaï ṇaraẏa-samuddĕ  $  vasu jĕma aliu cavantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 3:
cintāvaṇṇu ṇarāhiu jāvĕhĩ  $  valu ṇiẏa-ṇilaü parāiu tāvĕhĩ
dummaṇu entu ṇihāliu māẏaĕ  $  puṇu ṇihasevi vuttu piẏa-vāẏaĕ
"divĕ divĕ caḍahi turaṅgama-ṇāĕhĩ  $  ajju kāĩ aṇuvāhaṇu pāĕhĩ
divĕ divĕ vandiṇa-vindĕhĩ thuvvahi  $  ajju kāĩ thuvvantu ṇa suvvahi
divĕ divĕ dhuvvahi camara-sahāsĕhĩ  $  ajju kāĩ taü ko vi ṇa pāsĕhĩ
divĕ divĕ loẏahĩ vuccahi rāṇaü  $  ajju kāĩ dīsahi viddāṇaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi valeṇa pajampiu  $  "bharahahŏ saẏalu vi rajju samappiu
jāmi māĕ diḍha hiẏavaĕ hojjahi  $  jaṃ dummiẏa taṃ savvu khamejjahi"
ghattā:
jeṃ āucchiẏa māẏa  $  "hā hā putta" bhaṇantī
    aparāiẏa mahaevi  $  mahiẏalĕ paḍiẏa ruẏantī
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 4:
rāmeṃ jaṇaṇi jaṃ jĕ āucchiẏa  $  ṇiru ṇicceẏaṇa takkhaṇĕ mucchiẏa
lañjiẏāhĩ "hā māĕ" bhaṇantihĩ  $  hariẏandaṇĕṇa sitta rovantihĩ
camarukkhevĕhĩ kiẏa paḍivāẏaṇa  $  dukkhu dukkhu puṇu jāẏa sa-ceẏaṇa
aṅgu valanti samuṭṭhiẏa rāṇī  $  sappi va daṇḍāhaẏa viddāṇī
ṇīlakkhaṇa ṇīrāmummāhiẏa  $  puṇu vi sadukkhaü melliẏa dhāhiẏa
"hā hā kāĩ vuttu paĩ halahara  $  dasaraha-vaṃsa-dīva jaga-sundara
paĩ viṇu ko pallaṅkĕ suvesaï  $  paĩ viṇu ko atthāṇĕ vaīsaï
paĩ viṇu ko haẏa-gaẏahũ caḍesaï  $  paĩ viṇu ko jhinduĕṇa ramesaï
paĩ viṇu rāẏalacchi ko māṇaï  $  paĩ viṇu ko tamvolu samāṇaï
paĩ viṇu ko para-valu bhañjesaï  $  paĩ viṇu ko maĩ sāhāresaï"
ghattā:
taṃ kūvāru suṇevi  $  anteuru muha-vuṇṇaü
      lakkhaṇa-rāma-vioeṃ  $  dhāha muevi paruṇṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 5:
tā etthantarĕ asura-vimaddeṃ  $  dhīriẏa ṇiẏa-jaṇeri valahaddeṃ
"dhīriẏa hohi māĕ kiṃ rovahi  $  luhi loẏaṇa appāṇu ma soẏahi
jiha ravi-kiraṇĕhĩ sasi ṇa pahāvaï  $  tiha maĩ honteṃ bharahu ṇa bhāvaï
teṃ kajjeṃ vaṇa-vāsĕ vasevaü  $  tāẏahŏ taṇaü saccu pālevaü
dāhiṇa-desĕ kareviṇu thatti  $  tumhahã pāsĕ ei somitti
ema bhaṇeppiṇu caliu turantaü  $  saẏalu vi pariẏaṇu āucchantaü
dhavala-kasaṇa-ṇīluppala-sāmĕhĩ  $  gharu muccantaü lakkhaṇa-rāmĕhĩ
soha ṇa dei ṇa cittahŏ bhāvaï  $  ṇahu ṇiccandāiccaü ṇāvaï
ṇaṃ kiẏa-uddha-hatthu dhāhāvaï  $  valahŏ kalatta-hāṇi ṇaṃ dāvaï
bharaha-ṇarindahŏ ṇaṃ jāṇāvaï  $  "hari-vala janta ṇivārahi ṇaravaï"
puṇu pāāra-bhuẏaü pasareppiṇu  $  ṇāĩ ṇivāraï āliṅgeppiṇu
ghattā:
cāva-silīmuha-hattha  $  ve vi samuṇṇaẏa-māṇā
      tahŏ mandirahŏ ruẏantahŏ  $  ṇāĩ viṇiggaẏa pāṇā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 6:
to etthantarĕ ṇaẏaṇāṇandeṃ  $  saṃcallanteṃ rāhavacandeṃ
sīẏāevihĕ vaẏaṇu ṇihāliu  $  ṇaṃ citteṇa cittu saṃcāliu
ṇiẏa-mandirahŏ viṇiggaẏa jāṇaï  $  ṇaṃ himavantahŏ gaṅga mahā-ṇaï
ṇaṃ chandahŏ ṇiggaẏa gāẏattī  $  ṇaṃ saddahŏ ṇīsariẏa vihattī
ṇāĩ kitti sappurisa-vimukkī  $  ṇāĩ rambha ṇiẏa-thāṇahŏ cukkī
sulaliẏa-calaṇa-juẏala-malhantī  $  ṇaṃ gaẏa-ghaḍa bhaḍa-thaḍa vihaḍantī
ṇeura-hāra-ḍora-guppantī  $  vahu-tamvola-paṅkĕ khuppantī
heṭṭhā-muha kama-kamalu ṇiẏacchĕvi  $  avarāiẏa-sumitti āucchĕvi
ghattā:
ṇiggaẏa sīẏāevi  $  siẏa haranti ṇiẏa-bhavaṇahŏ
    rāmahŏ dukkhuppatti  $  asaṇi ṇāĩ dahavaẏaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 7:
rāẏa-vāru valu voliu jāvĕhĩ  $  lakkhaṇu maṇĕ ārosiu tāvĕhĩ
uṭṭhiu dhagadhagantu jasa-luddhaü  $  ṇāĩ ghieṇa sittu dhūmaddhaü
ṇāĩ maïndu mahā-ghaṇa-gajjiĕ  $  tiha somitti kuviu gamĕ sajjiĕ
"keṃ dharaṇinda-phaṇā-maṇi toḍiu  $  keṃ sura-kulisa-daṇḍu bhuĕ moḍiu
keṃ palaẏāṇalĕ appaü ḍhoiu  $  keṃ āruṭṭhaü saṇi avaloiu
keṃ raẏaṇāẏaru sosĕvi sakkiu  $  keṃ āiccahŏ teu kalaṅkiu
keṃ mahi-maṇḍalu vāhahĩ ṭāliu  $  keṃ taïlokka-cakku saṃcāliu
keṃ jiu kālu kiẏantu mahāhavĕ  $  ko pahu aṇṇu jiẏantaĕ rāhavĕ
ghattā:
ahavaï kiṃ vahueṇa  $  bharahu dhareppiṇu ajju
    rāmahŏ ṇīsāvaṇṇu  $  demi sahattheṃ rajju"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 8:
to phuranta-rattanta-loẏaṇo  $  kali-kiẏanta-kālo vva bhīsaṇo
duṇṇivāru duvvāra-vāraṇo  $  suu cavantu jaṃ ema lakkhaṇo
bhaṇaï rāmu taïlokka-sundaro  $  "paĩ viruddhĕ kiṃ ko vi duddharo
jasu paḍanti giri siṃha-ṇāĕṇaṃ  $  kavaṇu gahaṇu to bharaha-rāĕṇaṃ
kavaṇu cojju jaṃ divi divāẏare  $  amiu candĕ jala-ṇivahu sāẏare
sokkhu mokkhĕ daẏa-dhammu jiṇavare  $  visu bhuẏaṅgĕ vara līla gaẏavare
dhaṇaĕ riddhi sohaggu vammahe  $  gaï marālĕ jaẏa-lacchi mahumahe
paürusaṃ ca paĩ kuviĕ lakkhaṇe"  $  bhaṇĕvi ema karĕ dhariu takkhaṇe
ghattā:
"rajjeṃ kijjaï kāĩ  $  tāẏahŏ sacca-viṇāseṃ
    solaha varisaĩ jāma  $  ve vi  vasahũ vaṇa-vāseṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 9:
eha volla ṇimmāiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  ḍhukku bhāṇu atthavaṇahŏ tāvĕhĩ
jāẏa sañjha āratta padīsiẏa  $  ṇaṃ gaẏa-ghaḍa sindūra-vihūsiẏa
sūra-maṃsa-ruhirāvali-cacciẏa  $  ṇisiẏari vva āṇandu paṇacciẏa
galiẏa sañjha puṇu raẏaṇi parāiẏa  $  jagu gilei ṇaṃ suttu mahāiẏa
kahi mi divva dīvaẏa-saẏa vohiẏa  $  phaṇi-maṇi vva pajalanta su-sohiẏa
titthu kālĕ ṇiru ṇiccaṃ duggamĕ  $  ṇīsaranti raẏaṇihĕ canduggamĕ
vāsueva-valaeva mahavvala  $  sāhammiẏa sāhammiẏa-vacchala
raṇa-bhara-ṇivvāhaṇa ṇivvāhaṇa  $  ṇiggaẏa ṇīsāhaṇa ṇīsāhaṇa
vigaẏapaoli pavolĕvi khāiẏa  $  siddhakūḍu jiṇa-bhavaṇu parāiẏa
jaṃ pāẏāra-vāra-vipphuriẏaü  $  potthāsittha-gandha-vitthariẏaü
gaṅga-taraṅgahã raṅga-samujjalu  $  himaïri-kunda-canda-jasa-ṇimmalu
ghattā:
tahŏ bhavaṇahŏ pāsehĩ  $  viviha mahā-duma diṭṭhā
      ṇaṃ saṃsāra-bhaeṇa  $  jiṇavara-saraṇĕ païṭṭhā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 10:
taṃ ṇiĕvi bhuvaṇu bhuvaṇesarahŏ  $  puṇu kiu paṇivāu jiṇesarahŏ
"jaẏa gaẏa-bhaẏa rāẏa-rosa-vilaẏa  $  jaẏa maẏaṇa-mahaṇa tihuvaṇa-tilaẏa
jaẏa khama-dama-tava-vaẏa-ṇiẏama-karaṇa  $  jaẏa kali-mala-koha-kasāẏa-haraṇa
jaẏa kāma-koha-ari-dappa-dalaṇa  $  jaẏa jāi-jarā-maraṇatti-haraṇa
jaẏa jaẏa tava-sūra tiloẏa-hiẏa  $  jaẏa maṇa-vicitta-aruṇeṃ sahiẏa
jaẏa dhamma-mahāraha-vīḍhĕ ṭhiẏa  $  jaẏa siddhi-varaṅgaṇa-raṇṇa-piẏa
jaẏa saṃjama-giri-siharuggamiẏa  $  jaẏa inda-ṇarinda-canda-ṇamiẏa
jaẏa satta-mahābhaẏa-haẏa-damaṇa  $  jaẏa jiṇa-ravi ṇāṇamvara-gamaṇa
jaẏa dukkiẏa-kamma-kumuẏa-ḍahaṇa  $  jaẏa caü-gaï-raẏaṇi-timira-mahaṇa
jaẏa indiẏa-duddama-daṇu-dalaṇa  $  jaẏa jakkha-mahoraga-thuẏa-calaṇa
jaẏa kevala-kiraṇujjoẏa-kara  $  jaẏa bhaviẏa-ravindāṇandaẏara
jaẏa jaẏa bhuvaṇekka-cakka-bhamiẏa  $  jaẏa mokkha-mahīharĕ atthamiẏa
ghattā:
bhāveṃ tihi mi jaṇehĩ  $  vandaṇa karĕvi jiṇesahŏ
      paẏahiṇa devi tivāra  $  puṇu caliẏaĩ vaṇa-vāsahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 11:
raẏaṇihĕ majjhĕ paẏaṭṭaï rāhavu  $  tāma ṇiẏacchiu paramu mahāhavu
kuddhaĩ viddhaĩ pulaẏa-visaṭṭaĩ  $  mihuṇaĩ valaĩ jema abbhiṭṭaĩ
"valu valu" ekkamekka kokkantaĩ  $  "maru maru paharu paharu" jampantaĩ
sara huṅkāra-sāra mellantaĩ  $  garua-pahārahã uru-uḍḍantaĩ
khaṇĕ ovaḍiẏaĩ ahara ḍasantaĩ  $  khaṇĕ kiliviṇḍi-hiṇḍiṃ darisantaĩ
khaṇĕ vahu vālāluñci karantaĩ  $  khaṇĕ ṇipphandaĩ seu phusantaĩ
taṃ pekkheppiṇu suraẏa-mahāhaü  $  sīẏahĕ vaẏaṇu pajoẏaï rāhaü
puṇu vi hasantaĩ keli karantaĩ  $  caliẏaĩ haṭṭa-maggu joẏantaĩ
ghattā:
je vi ramantā āsi  $  lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ saṅkĕvi
    ṇāvaï suraẏāsatta  $  āvaṇa thiẏa muhu ḍhaṅkĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 12:
ujjhahĕ dāhiṇa-disaĕ viṇiggaẏa  $  ṇāĩ ṇiraṅkusa matta mahā-gaẏa
ṇa sahaï puri vala-lakkhaṇa-mukkī  $  mukka ku-ṇāri va pesaṇa-cukkī
puṇu thovantarĕ vitthaẏa-ṇāmahŏ  $  taruvara ṇamiẏa subhicca va rāmahŏ
uṭṭhiẏa vihaẏa vamālu karantā  $  ṇaṃ vandiṇa maṅgalaĩ paḍhantā
addha-kosu saṃpāiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  vimalu vihāṇu caüddisu tāvĕhĩ
ṇisi-ṇisiẏariĕ āsi jaṃ giliẏaü  $  ṇāĩ paḍīvaü jaü uggiliẏaü
rehaï sūra-vimvu uggantaü  $  ṇāvaï sukaï-kavvu paha-vantaü
pacchaĕ sāhaṇu tāma padhāiu  $  lahu halaheihĕ pāsu parāiu
ghattā:
sīẏa-salakkhaṇu rāmu  $  paṇamiu ṇaravara-vindĕhĩ
    ṇaṃ vandiu ahiseĕ  $  jiṇu vattīsahĩ indĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 13:
hesanta-turaṅgama-vāhaṇeṇa  $  pariẏariu rāmu ṇiẏa-sāhaṇeṇa
ṇaṃ disa-gaü līlaĕ paẏaĩ dentu  $  taṃ desu parāiu pāriẏattu
aṇṇu vi thovantaru jāi jāma  $  gambhīra mahāṇaï diṭṭha tāma
parihaccha-maccha-pucchucchalanti  $  pheṇāvali-toẏa-tusāra denti
kāraṇḍa-ḍimbha-ḍumbhiẏa-saroha  $  vara-kamala-karamviẏa-jalapaoha
haṃsāvali-pakkha-samulhasanti  $  kallola-vola-āvatta dinti
sohaï vahu-vaṇagaẏa-jūha-sahiẏa  $  ḍiṇḍīra-piṇḍa darisanti ahiẏa
ucchalaï valaï paḍikhalaï dhāi  $  malhanti mahāgaẏa-līla ṇāĩ
ghattā:
ohara-maẏara-raüdda  $  sā sari ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhiẏa
    duttara duppaïsāra  $  ṇaṃ duggaï duppekkhiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 14:
sari gambhīra ṇiẏacchiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  saẏalu vi seṇṇu ṇiẏattiu tāvĕhĩ
"tumhĕhĩ evahĩ āṇavaḍicchā  $  bharahahŏ bhicca hoha hiẏaïcchā
ujjha mueppiṇu dāhiṇaesahŏ  $  amhĕhĩ jāevaü vaṇa-vāsahŏ"
ema bhaṇeppiṇu samara-samatthā  $  sāẏara-vajjāvatta-vihatthā
païsaranti tahĩ salilĕ bhaẏaṅkarĕ  $  rāmahŏ caḍiẏa sīẏa vāmaĕ karĕ
siẏa aravindahŏ uppari ṇāvaï  $  ṇāvaï ṇiẏaẏa-kitti darisāvaï
ṇaṃ ujjou karāvaï gaẏaṇahŏ  $  ṇāĩ padarisaï dhaṇa dahavaẏaṇahŏ
lahu jalavāhiṇi-puliṇu pavaṇṇaĩ  $  ṇaṃ bhaviẏaĩ ṇaraẏahŏ uttiṇṇaĩ
ghattā:
valiẏa paḍīvā joha  $  je pahu-pacchalĕ laggā
    ku-muṇi ku-vuddhi ku-sīla  $  ṇaṃ pavvajjahĕ bhaggā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 23, Kaḍavaka 15:
valu volāvĕvi rāẏa ṇiẏattā  $  ṇāvaï siddhi ku-siddha ṇa pattā
valiẏa ke vi ṇīsāsu muantā  $  khaṇĕ khaṇĕ "hā hā rāma" bhaṇantā
ke vi mahanteṃ dukkheṃ laïẏā  $  lou karevi ke vi pavvaïẏā
ke vi timuṇḍa-dhāri vambhāriẏa  $  ke vi tikāla-joi vaẏa-dhāriẏa
ke vi pavaṇa-dhuẏa-dhavala-visālaĕ  $  gampiṇu tahĩ hariseṇa-jiṇālaĕ
thiẏa pavvajja laeppiṇu ṇaravara  $  saḍha-kaḍhora-vara-meru-mahīhara
vijaẏa-viẏaḍḍha-vioẏa-vimaddaṇa  $  dhīra-suvīra-sacca-piẏavaddhaṇa
puṅgama-puṇḍarīẏa-purisuttama  $  viula-visāla-raṇummiẏa-uttama
ghattā:
iẏa ekkekka-pahāṇa  $  jiṇavara-calaṇa ṇamaṃsĕvi
    saṃjama-ṇiẏama-guṇehĩ  $  appaü thiẏa sa iṃ bhū sĕvi
----------  [24. caüvīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
gaĕ vaṇa-vāsahŏ rāmĕ  $  ujjha ṇa cittahŏ bhāvaï
thiẏa ṇīsāsa muanti  $  mahi uṇhālaĕ ṇāvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 1:
saẏalu vi jaṇu ummāhijjantaü  $  khaṇu vi ṇa thakkaï ṇāmu laẏantaü
uvvellijjaï gijjaï lakkhaṇu  $  murava-vajjĕ vāijjaï lakkhaṇu
sui-siddhanta-purāṇĕhĩ lakkhaṇu  $  oṅkāreṇa paḍhijjaï lakkhaṇu
aṇṇu vi jaṃ jaṃ kiṃ pi sa-lakkhaṇu  $  lakkhaṇa-ṇāmeṃ vuccaï lakkhaṇu
kā vi ṇāri sāraṅgi va vuṇṇī  $  vaḍḍī dhāha muevi paruṇṇī
kā vi ṇāri jaṃ lei pasāhaṇu  $  taṃ ulhāvaï jāṇaï lakkhaṇu
kā vi ṇāri jaṃ parihaï kaṅkaṇu  $  dharaï su-gāḍhaü jāṇaï lakkhaṇu
kā vi ṇāri jaṃ joẏaï dappaṇu  $  aṇṇu ṇa pekkhaï mellĕvi lakkhaṇu
to etthantarĕ pāṇiẏa-hāriu  $  purĕ vollanti paropparu ṇāriu
"so pallaṅku taṃ jĕ uvahāṇaü  $  sejja vi sa jjĕ taṃ jĕ pacchāṇaü
ghattā:
taṃ gharu raẏaṇaĩ tāĩ  $  taṃ cittaẏammu sa-lakkhaṇu
      ṇavara ṇa dīsaï māĕ  $  rāmu sasīẏa-salakkhaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 2:
tāma paḍu paḍaha paḍipahaẏa pahu-paṅgaṇe  $  ṇāĩ sura-dunduhī diṇṇa gaẏaṇaṅgaṇe
rasiẏa saẏa saṅkha jāẏaṃ mahā-gondalaṃ  $  ṭivila-ṭaṇṭanta-ghummanta-varamandalaṃ
tāla-kaṃsāla-kolāhalaṃ kāhalaṃ  $  gīẏa-saṃgīẏa-gijjanta-vara-maṅgalaṃ
ḍamaru-tiriḍikkiẏā-jhallarī-raüravaṃ  $  bhambha-bhambhīsa-gambhīra-bherī-ravaṃ
ghaṇṭa-jaẏaghaṇṭa-saṃghaṭṭa-ṭaṅkāravaṃ  $  ghola-ullola-halavola-muhalāravaṃ
teṇa saddeṇa romañca-kañcuddhuā  $  gondaluddāma-vahu-vahala-accabbhuā
suhaḍa-saṃghāẏa savvā ẏa thiẏa paṅgaṇe  $  meru-siharesu ṇaṃ amara jiṇa-jammaṇe
paṇaï-phamphāva-ṇaḍa-chatta-kaï-vandaṇaṃ  $  "ṇanda jaẏa bhadda jaẏa jaẏahi" vara-saddaṇaṃ
ghattā:
lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ vappu  $  ṇiẏa-bhiccĕhĩ pariẏariẏaü
    jiṇa-ahiseẏahŏ kajjĕ  $  ṇaṃ suravaï ṇīsariẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 3:
jaṃ ṇīsariu rāu āṇandeṃ  $  vuttu ṇaveppiṇu bharaha-ṇarindeṃ
"haü mi deva paĩ sahũ pavvajjami  $  duggaï-gāmiu rajju ṇa bhuñjami
rajju asāru vāru saṃsārahŏ  $  rajju khaṇeṇa ṇei tamvārahŏ
rajju bhaẏaṅkaru iha-para-loẏahŏ  $  rajjeṃ gammaï ṇicca-ṇigoẏahŏ
rajjeṃ hou hou mahu sariẏaü  $  sundaru to kiṃ paĩ parihariẏaü
rajju akajju kahiu muṇi-cheẏahĩ  $  duṭṭha-kalattu va bhuttu aṇeẏahĩ
dosavantu maẏalañchaṇa-vimvu va  $  vahu-dukkhāuru dugga-kuḍumvu va
to vi jīu puṇu rajjahŏ kaṅkhaï  $  aṇudiṇu āu galantu ṇa lakkhaï
ghattā:
jiha mahu-vinduhĕ kajjĕ  $  karahu ṇa pekkhaï kakkaru
   tiha jiu visaẏāsattu  $  rajjeṃ gaü saẏa-sakkaru"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 4:
bharahu cavantu ṇivāriu rāeṃ  $  "ajja vi tujjhu kāĩ tava-vāeṃ
ajja vi rajju karahi suhu bhuñjahi  $  ajja vi visaẏa-sukkhu aṇuhuñjahi
ajja vi tuhũ tamvolu samāṇahi  $  ajja vi vara-ujjāṇaĩ māṇahi
ajju vi aṅgu sa-icchaĕ maṇḍahi  $  ajja vi vara-vilaẏaü avaruṇḍahi
ajja vi joggaü savvāharaṇahŏ  $  ajja vi kavaṇu kālu tava-caraṇahŏ
jiṇa-pavvajja hoi aï-dusahiẏa  $  keṃ vāvīsa parīsaha visahiẏa
keṃ jiẏa caü-kasāẏa-riu dujjaẏa  $  keṃ āẏāmiẏa pañca mahavvaẏa
keṃ kiu pañcahũ visaẏahũ ṇiggahu  $  keṃ parisesiu saẏalu pariggahu
ko duma-mūlĕ vasiu varisālaĕ  $  ko ekkaṅgeṃ thiu sīẏālaĕ
keṃ uṇhālaĕ kiu attāvaṇu  $  ĕu tava-caraṇu hoi bhīsāvaṇu

bharaha ma vaḍḍhiu volli  $  tuhũ so ajja vi vālu
      bhuñjahi visaẏa-suhāĩ  $  ko pavvajjahĕ kālu"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi bharahu āruṭṭhaü  $  matta-gaïndu va citteṃ duṭṭhaü

kiṃ vālattaṇu suhĕhĩ ṇa muccaï  $  kiṃ vālahŏ daẏa-dhammu ṇa ruccaï
kiṃ vālahŏ pavvajja ma hoo  $  kiṃ vālahŏ dūsiu para-loo
kiṃ vālahŏ sammattu ma hoo  $  kiṃ vālahŏ ṇaü iṭṭha-vioo
kiṃ vālahŏ jara-maraṇu ṇa ḍhukkaï  $  kiṃ vālahŏ jamu divasu vi cukkaï"

evahĩ saẏalu vi rajju karevaü  $  pacchalĕ puṇu tava-caraṇu carevaü"
ghattā:
ema bhaṇeppiṇu rāu  $  saccu samappĕvi bhajjahĕ
    bharahahŏ vandhĕvi paṭṭu  $  dasarahu gaü pavvajjahĕ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 6:
suravara-vandiĕ dhavala-visālaĕ  $  gampiṇu siddhakūḍĕ caïtālaĕ
dasarahu thiu pavvajja laeppiṇu  $  pañca muṭṭhi sirĕ lou kareppiṇu
teṇa samāṇu saṇeheṃ laïẏaü  $  cālīsottaru saü pavvaïẏaü

thiẏa ṇīsaṅga ṇāga ṇaṃ visahara  $  ahavaï samaẏa-vāla ṇaṃ visahara

keṇa vi kahiu tāma bharahesahŏ  $  "gaẏa somitti-rāma vaṇa-vāsahŏ"

ghattā:
jaṃ mucchāviu rāu  $  saẏalu vi jaṇu muha-kāẏaru
    palaẏāṇala-saṃtattu  $  rasĕvi laggu ṇaṃ sāẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 7:
candaṇeṇa pavvālijjantaü  $  camarukkhevĕhĩ vijjijjantaü
dukkhu dukkhu āsāsiu rāṇaü  $  jaraḍha-miẏaṅku va thiu viddāṇaü
avirala-aṃsu-jalolliẏa-ṇaẏaṇaü  $  ema pajampiu gaggara-vaẏaṇaü
"ṇivaḍiẏa ajju asaṇi āẏāsahŏ  $  ajju amaṅgalu dasaraha-vaṃsahŏ
ajju jāu haũ sūḍiẏa-pakkhaü  $  duha-bhāẏaṇu para-muhahã uvekkhaü
ajju ṇaẏaru siẏa-sampaẏa-melliu  $  ajju rajju para-cakkeṃ pelliu"
ema palāu karevi sahaggaĕ  $  rāhava-jaṇaṇihĕ gaü olaggaĕ
kesa-visaṇṭhula diṭṭha ruantī  $  aṃsu-pavāha dhāha mellantī
ghattā:
dhīriẏa bharaha-ṇarindeṃ  $  "hou māĕ mahu rajjeṃ
    āṇami lakkhaṇa-rāma  $  rovahi kāĩ akajjeṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 8:
ema bhaṇevi bharahu saṃcalliu  $  "turiu gavesahŏ" hatthutthalliu
diṇṇu saṅkhu jaẏa-paḍahu pavajjiu  $  ṇaṃ canduggamĕ uvahi pagajjiu
pahu-maggeṇa ṇarāhiu laggaü  $  jīvahŏ kammu jema aṇulaggaü
chaṭṭhaĕ divasĕ parāiu tettahĕ  $  sīẏa sa-lakkhaṇu rāhaü jettahĕ
chuḍu chuḍu salilu pievi ṇiviṭṭhaĩ  $  saravara-tīrĕ laẏāharĕ diṭṭhaĩ

"thakku deva maṃ jāhi pavāsahŏ  $  hohi taraṇḍaü dasaraha-vaṃsahŏ
haũ sattuhaṇu bhicca taü ve vi  $  lakkhaṇu manti sīẏa mahaevi
ghattā:
jiha ṇakkhattĕhĩ candu  $  indu jema sura-loeṃ
    tiha tuhũ bhuñjahi rajju  $  parimiu vandhava-loeṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi dasaraha-sueṇa  $  avagūḍhu bharahu harisiẏa-bhueṇa
"saccaü māẏā-piẏa-parama-dāsu  $  paĩ mellĕvi aṇṇahŏ viṇaü kāsu"
avaropparu e ālāva jāma  $  tahĩ juvaï-saẏahĩ pariẏariẏa tāma
lakkhijjaï bharahahŏ taṇiẏa māẏa  $  ṇaṃ gaẏa-ghaḍa bhaḍa bhañjanti āẏa
ṇaṃ tilaẏa-vihūsiẏa vaccharāi  $  sa-paohara amvara-soha ṇāĩ
ṇaṃ bharahahŏ sampaẏa-riddhi-viddhi  $  ṇaṃ rāmahŏ gamaṇahŏ taṇiẏa siddhi
ṇaṃ bharahahŏ sundara-sokkha-khāṇi  $  ṇaṃ rāmahŏ iṭṭha-kalatta-hāṇi
ṇaṃ bhaṇaï bharahu "tuhũ āu āu  $  vaṇa-vāsahŏ rāhaü jāu jāu"
ghattā:
su-paẏa su-sandhi su-ṇāma  $  vaẏaṇa-vihatti-vihūsiẏa
   kaha vāẏaraṇahŏ jema  $  kekkaẏa enti padīsiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 10:
sahũ sīẏaĕ dasaraha-ṇandaṇehĩ  $  jokkāriẏa rāma-jaṇaddaṇehĩ
puṇu vuccaï sīra-ppaharaṇeṇa  $  "kiṃ āṇiu bharahu akāraṇeṇa
suṇu māĕ mahāraü parama-taccu  $  pālevaü tāẏahŏ taṇaü saccu
ṇaü turaĕhĩ ṇaü rahavarĕhĩ kajju  $  ṇaü solaha varisaĩ karami rajju
jaṃ diṇṇu saccu tāeṃ ti-vāra  $  taṃ maï mi diṇṇu tumha saẏa-vāra"
ĕu vaẏaṇu bhaṇeppiṇu suha-samiddhu  $  saĩ hattheṃ bharahahŏ paṭṭu vaddhu
āucchĕvi para-vala-maïẏavaṭṭu  $  vaṇa-vāsahŏ rāhaü puṇu paẏaṭṭu
gaü bharahu ṇiẏattu su-pujjamāṇu  $  jiṇa-bhavaṇu pattu bhiccĕhĩ samāṇu
ghattā:
vihũ muṇi-dhavalahũ pāsĕ  $  bharaheṃ laïu avaggahu
    "diṭṭhaĕ rāhavacandĕ  $  mahu ṇivitti haẏa-rajjahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 11:
ema cavĕvi uccaliu mahāiu  $  rāhava-jaṇaṇihĕ bhavaṇu parāiu
viṇaü kareppiṇu pāsu paḍhukkiu  $  "rāmu māĕ maĩ dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu
haũ tumhevahĩ āṇavaḍicchaü  $  pesaṇaẏāraü calaṇa-ṇiẏacchaü"
dhīrĕvi ema jaṇaṇi daṇu-damaṇahŏ  $  bharahu ṇarāhiu gaü ṇiẏa-bhavaṇahŏ
jāṇaï hari halaharu viharantaĩ  $  tiṇṇi mi tāvasa-vaṇu saṃpattaĩ
tāvasa ke vi diṭṭha jaḍa-hāriẏa  $  ku-jaṇa ku-gāma jema jaḍa-hāriẏa
ke vi tidaṇḍi ke vi dhāḍīsara  $  kuviẏa ṇarinda jema dhāḍīsara
ke vi rudda ruddaṅkusa-hatthā  $  meṭṭhu jema ruddaṅkusa-hatthā
ghattā:
tahĩ païsantī sīẏa  $  lakkhaṇa-rāma-vihūsiẏa
    vihĩ pakkhehĩ samāṇa  $  puṇṇima ṇāĩ padīsiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 12:
aṇṇu vi thovantaru viharantaĩ  $  vaṇu dhāṇukkahã puṇu saṃpattaĩ
jahĩ jaṇavaü maẏa-vattha-ṇiẏatthaü  $  varahiṇa-piccha-pasāhiẏa-hatthaü
kanda-mūla-vahu-vaṇaphala-bhuñjaü  $  sirĕ vaḍa-māla vaddha galĕ guñjaü
jahĩ juvaïu chuḍu jāẏa-vivāhaü  $  maẏakari-raẏa-valaẏaṅkiẏa-vāhaü
maẏakari-kumbhu kareppiṇu ukkhalu  $  levi visāṇa-musalu dhavalujjalu
mottiẏa-cāula-dalaṇovaïẏaü  $  cumviẏa-vaẏaṇaü maẏaṇabbhaïẏaü
taṃ tehaü vaṇu bhillahũ keraü  $  hari-valaevĕhĩ kiu vivareraü
ghattā:
taṃ mellĕvi gharavāru  $  loẏahĩ harisiẏa-dehĕhĩ
    chāiẏa lakkhaṇa-rāma  $  canda-sūra jima mehĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 13:
sa-hari sa-bhajjaü rāmu dhaṇuddharu  $  aṇṇu vi jāma jāi thovantaru
diṭṭhaĩ goṭṭhaẏa ṇāĩ su-vesaĩ  $  ṇaṃ ṇaravaï-mandiraĩ su-vesaĩ
jujjhantaĩ ḍhekkāra muantaĩ  $  ṇaliṇi-muṇāla-saṇḍa toḍantaĩ
katthaï vaccha-haṇaĩ ṇīsaṅgaĩ  $  pavvaïẏāĩ va ṇiru ṇīsaṅgaĩ
katthaï jaṇavaü sisireṃ cacciu  $  paḍhama-sūi sirĕ dharĕvi paṇacciu
katthaï manthā-manthiẏa-manthaṇi  $  kuṇaï saddu surae va vilāsiṇi
katthaï ṇāri-ṇiẏamvĕ suhāsiu  $  ṇāvaï kuḍaü kuṇaï muhavāsiu
katthaï ḍimbhaü pariẏandijjaï  $  ammāhīraü geu jhuṇijjaï
ghattā:
taṃ pekkheppiṇu goṭṭhu  $  ṇārīẏaṇa-pariẏariẏaü
    ṇāvaï tihi mi jaṇehĩ  $  vālattaṇu saṃbhariẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ melleppiṇu goṭṭhu ravaṇṇaü  $  puṇu vaṇu païsaranti āraṇṇaü
jaṃ phala-patta-riddhi-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  tarala-tamāla-tāla-saṃchaṇṇaü
vaṇaṃ jiṇālaẏaṃ jahā sa-candaṇaṃ  $  jiṇinda-sāsaṇaṃ jahā sa-sāvaẏaṃ
mahā-raṇaṅgaṇaṃ jahā savāsaṇaṃ  $  maïnda-kandharaṃ jahā sa-kesaraṃ
ṇarinda-mandiraṃ jahā sa-māuẏaṃ  $  susañca-ṇacciẏaṃ jahā sa-tālaẏaṃ
jiṇesa-ṇhāṇaẏaṃ jahā mahāsaraṃ  $  ku-tāvase tavaṃ jahā maẏāsavaṃ
muṇinda-jīviẏaṃ jahā sa-mokkhaẏaṃ  $  mahā-ṇahaṅgaṇaṃ jahā sa-somaẏaṃ
miẏaṅka-vimvaẏaṃ jahā maẏāsaẏaṃ  $  vilāsiṇī-muhaṃ jahā mahārasaṃ
ghattā:
taṃ vaṇu mellĕvi tāĩ  $  inda-disaĕ āsaṇṇaĩ
    māsĕhĩ caüraddhehĩ  $  cittakūḍu volīṇaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 24, Kaḍavaka 15:
taṃ cittaüḍu muevi turantaĩ  $  dasaürapura-sīmantaru pattaĩ

ujjāṇaĩ sohanti su-pattaĩ  $  muṇivara iva su-halāĩ su-pattaĩ
sālivaṇaĩ paṇamanti su-bhattaĩ  $  ṇaṃ sāvaẏaĩ jiṇesara-bhattaĩ
ucchuvaṇaĩ dala-dīhara-gattaĩ  $  ṇiẏa-vaï-laṅghaṇaĩ va dukalattaĩ
paṅkaẏa-ṇava-ṇīluppala-sāmĕhĩ  $  tahĩ païsantĕhĩ lakkhaṇa-rāmĕhĩ
sīrakuḍumviu maṇusu padīsiu  $  vuṇṇu kuraṅgu va vāhuttāsiu
haḍahaḍa-phuṭṭa-sīsu cala-ṇaẏaṇaü  $  pāṇakkantu samubbhaḍa-vaẏaṇaü
ghattā:
so ṇāsantu kumāreṃ  $  suravara-kari-kara-caṇḍĕhĩ
    āṇiu rāmahŏ pāsu  $  dharĕvi sa iṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [25. pañcavīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
dhaṇuhara-hatthĕṇa  $  duvvāra-vaïri-āẏāmeṃ
sīrakuḍumviu  $  mambhīsĕvi pucchiu rāmeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 1:
duddama-dāṇavinda-maddaṇa-mahāhaveṇaṃ
"bho bho kiṃ visanthulo" vuttu rāhaveṇaṃ
taṃ ṇisuṇevi pajampiu gahavaï  $  "vajjaẏaṇṇu ṇāmeṇa su-ṇaravaï
sīhoẏarahŏ bhiccu hiẏaïcchiu  $  bharahu va risahahŏ āṇavaḍicchiu
dasaüra-ṇāhu jiṇesara-bhattaü  $  piẏavaddhaṇahŏ pāsĕ uvasantaü
jiṇavara-paḍimaṅguṭṭhaĕ leppiṇu  $  aṇṇahŏ ṇavaï ṇa ṇāhu mueppiṇu
tāma ku-mantihĩ kahiu ṇarindahŏ  $  "paĩ avagaṇṇĕvi ṇavaï jiṇindahŏ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu pahu kuddhaü  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālĕ kiẏantu viruddhaü
kovāṇala-palittu sīhoẏaru  $  ṇaṃ giri-siharĕ maïnda-kisoẏaru
"jo maĩ muĕvi aṇṇu jaẏakāraï  $  so kiṃ haẏa gaẏa rajju ṇa hāraï
ghattā:
aha kiṃ vahuĕṇa  $  kallaĕ diṇaẏarĕ atthantaĕ
      jaï ṇa vi mārami  $  to païsami jalaṇĕ jalantaĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 2:
païja karevi jāma pahu āhave abhaṅgo
tāma païṭṭhu coru ṇāmeṇa vijjulaṅgo
païsanteṃ raẏaṇihĕ majjhaẏālĕ  $  aliula-kajjala-saṇṇiha-tamālĕ
teṃ diṭṭhu ṇarāhiu vipphurantu  $  palaẏāṇalo vva dhagadhagadhagantu
romañca-kañcu-kañcuiẏa-dehu  $  jala-gabbhiṇu ṇaṃ gajjantu mehu
saṇṇaddha-vaddha-pariẏara-ṇivandhu  $  raṇa-bhara-dhura-dhoriu diṇṇa-khandhu
valivaṇḍa-maṇḍa-ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu  $  daṭṭhoṭṭhu suṭṭhu-vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇu
"mārevaü riu" jampantu ema  $  khaẏa-kālĕ saṇiccharu kuviu jema
taṃ pekkhĕvi cintaï bhua-visālu  $  "kiṃ mārami ṇaṃ ṇaṃ sāmisālu
sāhammiẏa-vacchalu kiṃ karemi  $  savvāẏareṇa gampiṇu kahemi"
gaü ema bhaṇĕvi kaṇṭaïẏa-gattu  $  ṇivisaddheṃ dasaüra-ṇaẏaru pattu
ghattā:
chuḍu aruṇuggamĕ  $  so vijjulaṅgu dhāvantaü
      diṭṭhu ṇarindĕṇa  $  jasa-puñju ṇāĩ āvantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 3:
pucchiu vajjaẏaṇṇĕṇa hasevi vijjulaṅgo
"bho bho kahĩ paẏaṭṭu vahu-vahala-pulaïẏaṅgo"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu vaẏaṇa-visāleṃ  $  vuccaï vajjaẏaṇṇu kusumāleṃ
"kāmaleha ṇāmeṇa vilāsiṇi  $  tuṅga-paohara jaṇa-maṇa-bhāviṇi
tahĕ āsattaü attha-vivajjiu  $  kāraṇĕ maṇi-kuṇḍalahã visajjiu
puṇu vijjāhara-karaṇu kareppiṇu  $  gaü satta vi pāẏāra kameppiṇu
kira vara-bhavaṇu paīsami jāvĕhĩ  $  païja karantu rāu suu tāvĕhĩ
haũ vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa ādaṇṇaü  $  "vaṭṭaï vajjaẏaṇṇu ucchaṇṇaü
sāhammiu jiṇa-sāsaṇa-dīvaü"  $  ema bhaṇeppiṇu valiu paḍīvaü
puṇu vi viẏaḍa-paẏa-chohĕhĩ dhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ tumhahũ pāsu parāiu
ghattā:
kiṃ olaggaĕ  $  jāṇantu vi rāẏa ma mujjhahi
      pāṇa laeppiṇu  $  jĕma ṇāsahi jĕma raṇĕ jujjhahi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 4:
ahavaï kāĩ eṇa vahu-jampieṇa rāẏā
para-valĕ pekkhu pekkhu uṭṭhanti dhūli-chāẏā
pekkhu pekkhu āvantaü sāhaṇu  $  galagajjantu mahāgaẏa-vāhaṇu
pekkhu pekkhu hiṃsanti turaṅgama  $  ṇahaẏalĕ viulĕ bhamanti vihaṅgama
pekkhu pekkhu cindhaĩ dhuvvantaĩ  $  raha-cakkaĩ mahiẏalĕ khuppantaĩ
pekkhu pekkhu vajjantaĩ tūraĩ  $  ṇāṇāviha-ṇiṇāẏa-gambhīraĩ
pekkhu pekkhu saẏa saṅkha rasantā  $  ṇāĩ sadukkhaü saẏaṇa ruantā
pekkhu pekkhu pacalantaü ṇaravaï  $  gaha-ṇakkhatta-majjhĕ saṇi ṇāvaï"
dasaüra-ṇāhu ṇihālaï jāvĕhĩ  $  para-valu saẏalu vihāvaï tāvĕhĩ
"sāhu sāhu" to ema bhaṇeppiṇu  $  vijjulaṅgu ṇiu āliṅgeppiṇu
thiu raṇa-bhūmi pasāhĕvi jāvĕhĩ  $  saẏalu vi seṇṇu parāiu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
amarisa-kuddhĕhĩ  $  caüpāsĕhĩ ṇaravara-vindahĩ
      veḍḍhiu paṭṭaṇu  $  jima mahiẏalu caühĩ samuddahĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 5:
kiẏa gaẏa sāri-sajja pakkhariẏa vara-turaṅgā
kavaẏa-ṇivaddha joha abbhiṭṭa pulaïẏaṅgā
abbhiṭṭu jujjhu viṇha vi valāhã  $  avaropparu vaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalāhã
vajjanta-tūra-kolāhalāhã  $  uvasoha-caḍāviẏa-maẏagalāhã
mukkekkamekka-sara-savvalāhã  $  bhua-chiṇṇa-bhiṇṇa-vacchatthalāhã
loṭṭāviẏa-dhaẏa-mālāulāhã  $  paḍipahara-vihura-vihalaṅghalāhã
ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇa-ḍasiẏāharāhã  $  asi-jhasa-sara-satti-paharaṇa-dharāhã
supamāṇa-cāva-kaḍḍhiẏa-karāhã  $  guṇa-diṭṭhi-muṭṭhi-sandhiẏa-sarāhã
dugghoṭṭa-thaṭṭa-loṭṭāvaṇāhã  $  kāẏara-ṇara-maṇa-saṃtāvaṇāhã
jaẏakārahŏ kāraṇĕ duddharāhã  $  raṇu vajjaẏaṇṇa-sīhoẏarāhã
ghattā:
vihi mi bhiḍantahĩ  $  samaraṅgaṇĕ dunduhi vajjaï
      vihi mi ṇarindahã  $  raṇĕ ekku vi jiṇaï ṇa jijjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 6:
"haṇu haṇu (haṇu]" bhaṇanti hammanti āhaṇanti
paü vi ṇa osaranti māranti raṇĕ maranti
uhaẏa-valĕhĩ paḍiẏaggima-khandhaĩ  $  uhaẏa-valĕhĩ ṇaccanti kavandhaĩ
uhaẏa-valĕhĩ musumūriẏa dhaẏavaḍa  $  uhaẏa-valĕhĩ loṭṭāviẏa bhaḍa-thaḍa
uhaẏa-valĕhĩ haẏa gaẏa viṇivāiẏa  $  uhaẏa-valĕhĩ ruhiroha padhāiẏa
uhaẏa-valĕhĩ ṇittaṃsiẏa khaggaĩ  $  uhaẏa-valĕhĩ ḍevanti vihaṅgaĩ
uhaẏa-valĕhĩ ṇīsaddaĩ tūraĩ  $  uhaẏa-valaĩ paharaṇa-khara-vihuraĩ
uhaẏa-valaĩ gaẏa-dantĕhĩ bhiṇṇaĩ  $  uhaẏa-valaĩ raṇa-bhūmi-ṇisaṇṇaĩ
uhaẏa-valaĩ ruhirolliẏa-gattaĩ  $  hakka-ḍakka-lallakka muantaĩ
ema pakkhu vaṭṭaï saṅgāmahŏ  $  akkhaï sīrakuḍumviu rāmahŏ
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu  $  maṇi-maragaẏa-kiraṇa-phurantaü
      diṇṇu sa-hatthĕṇa  $  kaṇṭhaü kaḍaü kaḍisuttaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 7:
puṇu saṃcalla ve vi valaeva-vāsuevā
jāṇaï-kariṇi-sahiẏa gaẏa gilla-gaṇḍa jevā
cāva-vihattha mahattha mahāiẏa  $  sahasakūḍu jiṇabhavaṇu parāiẏa
jaṃ iṭṭāla-dhavala-chuha-paṅkiu  $  sajjaṇa-hiẏaü jema akalaṅkiu
jaṃ uttuṅga-siharu sura-kittiu  $  vaṇṇa-vicitta-citta-cira-cittiu
taṃ jiṇabhavaṇu ṇiẏavi parituṭṭhaĩ  $  paẏahiṇa devi ti-vāra vaïṭṭhaĩ
tahĩ candappaha-vimvu ṇihāliu  $  jaṃ suravarataru-kusumomāliu
jaṃ ṇāgenda-surenda-ṇarindahĩ  $  vandiu muṇi-vijjāhara-vindahĩ
diṭṭhu su-sohiu sommu su-daṃsaṇu  $  aṇṇu mi seẏa-camaru siṃhāsaṇu
chatta-ttaü asou bhā-maṇḍalu  $  lacchi-vihūsiu viẏaḍa-uratthalu
ghattā:
kiṃ vahu(eṃ)-caviĕṇa  $  jagĕ ko paḍivimvu ṭhavijjaï
      puṇu vi paḍīvaü  $  jaï ṇāheṃ ṇāhuvamijjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 8:
jaṃ jaga-ṇāhu diṭṭhu vala-sīẏa-lakkhaṇehĩ
tihi mi jaṇehĩ vandio viviha-vandaṇehĩ
"jaẏa risaha dusaha-parisaha-sahaṇa  $  jaẏa ajiẏa ajiẏa-vammaha-mahaṇa
jaẏa saṃbhava saṃbhava-ṇiddalaṇa  $  jaẏa ahiṇandaṇa ṇandiẏa-calaṇa
jaẏa sumaï-bhaḍārā sumaï-kara  $  paümappaha paümappaha-pavara
jaẏa sāmi supāsa su-pāsa-haṇa  $  candappaha puṇṇa-canda-vaẏaṇa
jaẏa jaẏa pupphaẏanta pupphacciẏa  $  jaẏa sīẏala sīẏala-suha-saṃciẏa
jaẏa seẏaṅkara seẏaṃsa-jiṇa  $  jaẏa vāsupujja pujjiẏa-calaṇa
jaẏa vimala-bhaḍārā vimala-muha  $  jaẏa sāmi aṇanta aṇanta-suha
jaẏa dhamma-jiṇesara dhamma-dhara  $  jaẏa santi-bhaḍārā santi-kara
jaẏa kunthu mahatthui-thua-calaṇa  $  jaẏa ara-arahanta mahanta-guṇa
jaẏa malli mahalla-malla-malaṇa  $  muṇi suvvaẏa su-vvaẏa suddha-maṇa"
ghattā:
vīsa vi jiṇavara  $  vandeppiṇu rāmu vaīsaï
      jahĩ sīhoẏaru  $  taṃ ṇilaü kumāru paīsaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 9:
tāma ṇarinda-vāre thira-thora-vāhu-jualo
so paḍihāru diṭṭhu saddattha-desi-kusalo
païsantu suhaḍu teṃ dhariu kema  $  ṇiẏa-samaeṃ lavaṇasamuddu jema
taṃ kuviu vīru vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇu  $  vihuṇantu hattha ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
maṇĕ cintaï vaïri-samudda-mahaṇu  $  "kiṃ mārami ṇaṃ ṇaṃ kavaṇu gahaṇu"
gaü ema bhaṇĕvi bhua-daṇḍa-caṇḍu  $  ṇaṃ matta-mahāgaü gilla-gaṇḍu
taṃ dasaüra-ṇaẏaru païṭṭhu kema  $  jaṇa-maṇa-mohantu aṇaṅgu jema
duvvāra-vaïri-saẏa-pāṇa-coru  $  ṇīsariu ṇāĩ kesari-kisoru
jaṃ lakkhaṇu lakkhiu rāẏa-vārĕ  $  paḍihāru vuttu "maṃ maṃ ṇivārĕ"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi païṭṭhu vīru  $  cakkavaï-lacchi-lañchiẏa-sarīru
ghattā:
dasaüra-ṇāhĕṇa  $  lakkhijjaï entaü lakkhaṇu
      risaha-jiṇindĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ dhammu ahiṃsā-lakkhaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 10:
harisiu vajjaẏaṇṇu diṭṭheṇa lakkhaṇeṇaṃ
puṇu puṇu ṇeha-ṇibbharo caviu takkhaṇeṇaṃ
"kiṃ demi hatthi raha turaẏa-thaṭṭa  $  vicchuriẏa-phuriẏa-maṇi-maüḍa-paṭṭa
kiṃ vatthĕhĩ kiṃ raẏaṇehĩ kajju  $  kiṃ ṇaravara-parimiu demi rajju
kiṃ demi sa-vibbhamu piṇḍavāsu  $  kiṃ sa-suu sa-kantaü homi dāsu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi harisiẏa-maṇeṇa  $  paḍivuttu ṇarāhiu lakkhaṇeṇa
"kahĩ muṇivaru kahĩ saṃsāra-sokkhu  $  kahĩ pāva-piṇḍu kahĩ parama-mokkhu
kahĩ pāẏaü ketthu kuḍukka-vaẏaṇu  $  kahĩ kamala-saṇḍu kahĩ viulu gaẏaṇu
kahĩ maẏagalĕ halu kahĩ uṭṭĕ ghaṇṭa  $  kahĩ panthiu kahĩ raha-turaẏa-thaṭṭa
taṃ vollahi jaṃ ṇa ghaḍaï kalāĕ  $  amhaĩ vāhiẏa bhukkhaĕ khalāĕ
ghattā:
tuhũ sāhammiu  $  daẏa-dhammu karantu ṇa thakkahi
      bhoẏaṇu maggiu  $  tihũ jaṇahũ dehi jaï sakkahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 11:
vuccaï vajjaẏaṇṇĕṇaṃ sajala-loẏaṇeṇaṃ
"maggiu demi rajju kiṃ gahaṇu bhoẏaṇeṇaṃ"
ema bhaṇeppiṇu aṇṇuccāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ rāmahŏ pāsu parāiu
khaṇĕ kaccola thāla oẏāriẏa  $  pariẏala-sippi-saṅkha vitthāriẏa
vahuviha-khaṇḍa-paẏārĕhĩ vaḍḍhiu  $  ucchu-vaṇaṃ piva muha-rasiẏaḍḍhiu
ujjāṇaṃ piva suṭṭhu suandhaü  $  siddhahŏ siddhi-suhaṃ piva siddhaü
rehaï asaṇa-vela valahaddahŏ  $  ṇāĩ viṇiggaẏa amaẏa-samuddahŏ
dhavala-ppaüra-kūra-pheṇujjala  $  pejjāvatta dinti cala cañcala
ghiẏa-kallola-vola pavahantī  $  timmaṇa-toẏa-tusāra muantī
sālaṇa-saẏa-sevāla-karamviẏa  $  hari-halahara-jalaẏara-paricumviẏa
ghattā:
kiṃ vahu-caviĕṇa  $  sacchāu saloṇu sa-viñjaṇu
      iṭṭha-kalattu va  $  taṃ bhuttu jahicchaĕ bhoẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 12:
bhuñjĕvi rāmacandĕṇaṃ pabhaṇio kumāro
"bhoẏaṇu ṇa hoi ĕu uvaẏāra-garua-bhāro
paḍiuvaẏāru kiṃ pi viṇṇāsahi  $  ubhaẏa-valĕhĩ appāṇu pagāsahi
taṃ sīhoẏaru gampi ṇivārahi  $  addheṃ rajjahŏ sandhi samārahi
vuccaï "bharaheṃ dūu visajjiu  $  dujjaü vajjaẏaṇṇu aparajjiu
teṇa samāṇu kavaṇu kira viggahu  $  jeṃ āẏāmiu samarĕ pariggahu""
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu riu-maddaṇu  $  rāmahŏ calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu jaṇaddaṇu
"ajju kiẏatthu ajju haũ dhaṇṇaü  $  jaṃ āesu deva paĩ diṇṇaü"
ema bhaṇevi paẏaṭṭu mahāiu  $  gaü sīhoẏara-bhavaṇu parāiu
matta-gaïndu jema galagajjĕvi  $  taṃ paḍihāru karaggeṃ tajjĕvi
ghattā:
tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi  $  atthāṇu saẏalu avagaṇṇĕvi
      païṭhu bhaẏāṇaṇu  $  gaẏa-jūhĕ jema pañcāṇaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 13:
amarisa-kuddhaeṇa vahu-bhariẏa-macchareṇaṃ
sīhoẏaru paloio jiha saṇicchareṇaṃ
kovāṇala-saẏa-jāla-jalanteṃ  $  puṇu puṇu joiu ṇāĩ kaẏanteṃ
jaü jaü lakkhaṇu lakkhaï saṃmuhu  $  taü taü simiru thāi heṭṭhā-muhu
cintiu "ko vi mahā-valu dīsaï  $  ṇaü paṇivāu karaï ṇaü vaïsaï"
taṃ ji ṇimittu laevi kumāreṃ  $  vuttu rāu "kiṃ vahu-vitthāreṃ
ema visajjiu bharaha-ṇarindeṃ  $  karaï keli ko samaü maïndeṃ
ko sura-kari-visāṇa uppāḍaï  $  mandarasela-siṅgu ko pāḍaï
ko 'maẏavāhu karaggeṃ ḍhaṅkaï  $  vajjaẏaṇṇu ko mārĕvi sakkaï
sandhi karahŏ paribhuñjahŏ meiṇi  $  hiẏaẏa-suhaṅkari jiha vara-kāmiṇi
ghattā:
ahavaï ṇaravaï  $  jaï rajjahŏ addhu ṇa icchahi
      to samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  sara-dhoraṇi enti paḍicchahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 14:
lakkhaṇa-vaẏaṇa-dūsio ahara-vipphuranto
"maru maru māri māri haṇu haṇu" bhaṇanto
uṭṭhiu pahu karavāla-vihatthaü  $  "acchaü tāma bharahu vīsatthaü
dūvahŏ dūvattaṇu darisāvahŏ  $  chindahŏ ṇāsu sīsu muṇḍāvahŏ
luṇahŏ hattha vicchārĕvi dhāḍahŏ  $  gaddahĕ caḍiẏaü ṇaẏarĕ bhamāḍahŏ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi samuṭṭhiẏa ṇaravara  $  galagajjanta ṇāĩ ṇava jalahara
"haṇu haṇu haṇu" bhaṇanta vahu-macchara  $  ṇaṃ kali-kāla-kiẏanta-saṇicchara
ṇaṃ ṇiẏa-samaẏa-cukka raẏaṇāẏara  $  ṇaṃ ummeṭṭha padhāiẏa kuñjara
karĕ karavālu ko vi uggāmaï  $  bhīsaṇa ko vi gaẏāsaṇi bhāmaï
ko vi bhaẏaṅkaru cāu caḍāvaï  $  sāmihĕ bhiccattaṇu darisāvaï
ghattā:
eva ṇarindĕhĩ  $  phuriẏāhara-bhiuḍi-karālĕhĩ
      veḍhiu lakkhaṇu  $  pañcāṇaṇu jema siẏālĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 15:
sūru va jalaharehĩ jaṃ veḍhio kumāro
uṭṭhiu dhara dalantu duvvāra-vaïri-vāro
rokkaï valaï dhāi riu rumbhaï  $  ṇaṃ kesari-kisoru paviẏambhaï
ṇaṃ suravara-gaïndu maẏa-vimbhalu  $  sira-kamalaĩ toḍantu mahā-valu
daramalantu maṇi-maüḍa ṇarindahũ  $  sīhu paḍhukkiu jema gaïndahũ
kŏ vi musumūriu cūriu pāĕhĩ  $  ko vi ṇisumbhiu ṭakkara-ghāĕhĩ
ko vi karaggĕhĩ gaẏaṇĕ bhamāḍiu  $  ko vi rasantu mahīẏalĕ pāḍiu
ko vi jujjhaviu mesa-jhaḍakkaĕ  $  kŏ vi kaḍuvāviu hakka-daḍakkaĕ
gaẏavara-laggaṇa-khambhuppāḍĕvi  $  gaẏaṇa-maggĕ puṇu bhuahĩ bhamāḍĕvi
ṇāĩ jameṇa daṇḍu pammukkaü  $  vaïrihĩ ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālu paḍhukkaü
ghattā:
ālaṇa-khambhĕṇa  $  bhāmanteṃ puhaï bhamāḍiẏa
      teṇa paḍantĕṇa  $  dasa sahasa ṇarindahũ pāḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 16:
jaṃ paḍivakkhu saẏalu ṇiddaliu lakkhaṇeṇaṃ
gaẏavarĕ paṭṭavandhaṇe caḍiu takkhaṇeṇaṃ
ahimuhu sīhoẏaru saṃcalliu  $  palaẏa-samuddu ṇāĩ utthalliu
seṇṇāvatta dintu gajjantaü  $  paharaṇa-toẏa-tusāra-muantaü
tuṅga-turaṅga-taraṅga-samāulu  $  matta-mahāgaẏa-ghaḍa-velāulu
ubbhiẏa-dhavala-chatta-pheṇujjalu  $  dhaẏa-kallola-calanta-mahāvalu
riu-samuddu jaṃ diṭṭhu bhaẏaṅkaru  $  lakkhaṇu ḍhukku ṇāĩ giri mandaru
calaï valaï paribhamaï su-paccalu  $  ṇāĩ vilāsiṇi-gaṇu calu cañcalu
geṇhĕvi pahaü ṇarindu ṇarindeṃ  $  turaeṃ turaü gaïndu gaïndeṃ
rahieṃ rahiu rahaṅgu rahaṅgeṃ  $  chatteṃ chattu dhaẏaggu dhaẏaggeṃ
ghattā:
jaü jaü lakkhaṇu  $  parisakkaï bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkaru
      taü taü dīsaï  $  mahi-maṇḍalu ruṇḍa-ṇirantaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 17:
jaṃ riu-uahi mahiu somitti-mandareṇaṃ
sīhoẏaru padhāio samaü kuñjareṇaṃ
abbhiṭṭu jujjhu viṇṇi vi jaṇāhã  $  ujjeṇi-ṇarāhiva-lakkhaṇāhã
duvvāra-vaïri-geṇhaṇa-maṇāhã  $  uggāmiẏa-bhāmiẏa-paharaṇāhã
maẏamatta-gaïnduddāraṇāhã  $  paḍivakkha-pakkha-samghāraṇāhã
suravahua-sattha-tosāvaṇāhã  $  sīhoẏara-lakkhaṇa-ṇaravarāhã
 $  bhua-daṇḍa-caṇḍa-harisiẏa-maṇāhã
etthantarĕ sīhoẏara-dhareṇa  $  urĕ pelliu lakkhaṇu gaẏavareṇa
rahasubbhaḍu pulaẏa-visaṭṭa-dehu  $  ṇaṃ sukkeṃ khīliu sa-jalu mehu
teṃ levi bhuaggeṃ tharaharanta  $  uppāḍiẏa dantihĕ ve vi danta
kaḍuāviu maẏagalu maṇĕṇa taṭṭhu  $  vivarammuhu pāṇa laevi ṇaṭṭhu
ghattā:
tāma kumārĕṇa  $  vijjāhara-karaṇu kareppiṇu
      dhariu ṇarāhiu  $  gaẏa-matthaĕ pāu thaveppiṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 18:
ṇaravaï jīva-gāhi jaṃ dhariu lakkhaṇeṇaṃ
keṇa vi vajjaẏaṇṇahŏ kahiu takkhaṇeṇaṃ
"he ṇaraṇāha-ṇāha acchariẏaü  $  para-valu pekkhu kema jajjariẏaü
ruṇḍa-ṇirantaru soṇiẏa-cacciu  $  ṇāṇāviha-vihaṅga-pariẏañciu
ko vi paẏaṇḍa-vīru valavantaü  $  bhamaï kiẏantu va riu-jagaḍantaü
gaẏa-ghaḍa bhaḍa-thaḍa suhaḍa vahantaü  $  kari-sira-kamala-saṇḍa toḍantaü
rokkaï kokkaï ḍhukkaï thakkaï  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālu samarĕ parisakkaï
bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkaru kuruḍu samaccharu  $  thiu avaloẏaṇĕ ṇāĩ saṇiccharu
ṇaü jāṇahũ kiṃ gaṇu kiṃ gandhavu  $  kiṃ pacchaṇṇu ko vi taü vandhavu
kiṇṇaru kiṃ māruvu vijjāharu  $  kiṃ vambhāṇu bhāṇu hari halaharu
teṇa mahāhavĕ māṇa-maïndahã  $  viṇivāiẏa dasa sahasa ṇarindahã
aṇṇu vi dujjaü macchara-bhariẏaü  $  jīva-gāhi sīhoẏaru dhariẏaü
ghattā:
ekkeṃ hontĕṇa  $  valu saẏalu vi āhindoliu
      mandara-vīḍhĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ sāẏara-salilu viroliu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 19:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ko vi paritosio maṇeṇaṃ
ko vi ṇiehũ laggu uddheṇa jampaṇeṇaṃ
ko vi pajampiu macchara-bhariẏaü  $  "caṅgaü jaṃ sīhoẏaru dhariẏaü
jo mārevaü vaïri sa-hattheṃ  $  so parivaddhu pāu para-hattheṃ
vandhava-saẏaṇahĩ parimiu ajju  $  vajjaẏaṇṇu aṇuhuñjaü rajju"
ko vi viruddhu puṇu puṇu ṇindaï  $  "dhammu muevi pāu kiṃ ṇandaï"
ko vi bhaṇaï "jeṃ maggiu bhoẏaṇu  $  dīsaï so jjĕ ṇāĩ ĕhu vambhaṇu"
tāma kumāreṃ riu ukkhandhĕvi  $  coru va rāuleṇa ṇiu vandhĕvi
sālaṅkāru sa-doru sa-ṇeuru  $  dummaṇu dīṇa-vaẏaṇu anteuru
dhāiu aṃsu-jalolliẏa-ṇaẏaṇaü  $  hima-haẏa-kamalavaṇu va komāṇaü
ghattā:
kesa-visanthulu  $  muha-kāẏaru karuṇu ruantaü
     thiu caüpāsĕhĩ  $  bhattāra-bhikkha maggantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 25, Kaḍavaka 20:
tāma maṇeṇa saṅkiẏā rāhavassa ghariṇī
ṇaṃ bhaẏa-bhīẏa kāṇaṇe vuṇṇuẏaṇṇa hariṇī
"pekkhu pekkhu valu valu āvantaü  $  sāẏara-salilu jema gajjantaü
laï dhaṇuharu ma acchi ṇiccintaü  $  mañchuḍu lakkhaṇu raṇĕ atthantaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇivvūḍha-mahāhavu  $  jāma cāu kira giṇhaï rāhavu
tāma kumāru diṭṭhu sahũ ṇārihĩ  $  parimiu hatthi jema gaṇiẏārihĩ
taṃ pekkheppiṇu suhaḍa-ṇisāmeṃ  $  bhīẏa sīẏa mambhīsiẏa rāmeṃ
"pekkhu kema sīhoẏaru vaddhaü  $  sīheṇa va siẏālu uṭṭhaddhaü
eva volla kira vaṭṭaï jāvĕhĩ  $  lakkhaṇu pāsu parāiu tāvĕhĩ
calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu viẏāvaḍa-matthaü  $  bhaviu va jiṇahŏ kiẏañjali-hatthaü
ghattā:
"sāhu" bhaṇantĕṇa  $  surabhavaṇa-viṇiggaẏa-ṇāmeṃ
      sa iṃ bhu a-phalihĕhĩ  $  avaruṇḍiu lakkhaṇu rāmeṃ
----------  [26. chavvīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ  $  dhavalujjala-kasaṇa-sarīraĩ
ekkahĩ miliẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ gaṅgā-jaüṇahĕ ṇīraĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 1:
avaropparu gañjolliẏa-gattĕhĩ  $  sarahasu sāiu devi turantĕhĩ
sīhoẏaru ṇamantu vaïsāriu  $  takkhaṇĕ vajjaẏaṇṇu hakkāriu
sahũ ṇaravara-jaṇeṇa ṇīsariẏaü  $  ṇāĩ purandaru sura-pariẏariẏaü
rehaï vijjulaṅgu aṇupacchaĕ  $  paḍivā-indu va sūrahŏ pacchaĕ
taṃ iṭṭāla-dhūli-dhua-dhavalaü  $  sahasakūḍu gaẏa patta jiṇālaü
caüdisu paẏahiṇa devi tivāraĕ  $  puṇu ahivandaṇa karaï bhaḍāraĕ
taṃ piẏavaddhaṇa-muṇi paṇaveppiṇu  $  valahŏ pāsĕ thiu kusalu bhaṇeppiṇu
dasaüra-pura-paramesaru rāmeṃ  $  sāhukkāriu suhaḍa-ṇisāmeṃ
ghattā:
"saccaü ṇaravaï  $  micchatta-sarĕhĩ ṇaü bhijjahi
diḍha-sammattĕṇa  $  para tujjhu jĕ tuhũ uvamijjahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 2:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi paẏampiu rāeṃ  $  "eu savvu mahu tumha pasāeṃ"
puṇu vi tiloẏa-viṇiggaẏa-ṇāmeṃ  $  vijjulaṅgu pomāiu rāmeṃ
"bho diḍha-kaḍhiṇa-viẏaḍa-vacchatthala  $  sāhu sāhu sāhammiẏa-vacchala
sundaru kiu jaṃ ṇaravaï rakkhiu  $  raṇĕ acchantu ṇa paĩ uvvekkhiu"
to etthantarĕ vuttu kumāreṃ  $  "jampieṇa kiṃ vahu-vitthāreṃ
he dasaüra-ṇarinda visagaï-sua  $  jiṇavara-calaṇa-kamala-phullandhua
jo khalu khuddu pisuṇu macchariẏaü  $  acchaï ĕhu sīhoẏaru dhariẏaü
kiṃ mārami kiṃ appuṇu mārahi  $  ṇaṃ to daẏa kari sandhi samārahi
ghattā:
āṇa-vaḍicchaü  $  ĕhu evahĩ bhiccu tuhāraü
risaha-jiṇindahŏ  $  seẏaṃsu va pesaṇaẏāraü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 3:
pabhaṇaï vajjaẏaṇṇu vahu-jāṇaü  $  "haũ pāikku puṇu vi ĕhu rāṇaü
ṇavara ekku vaü maĩ pālevaü  $  jiṇu mellevi aṇṇu ṇa ṇamevaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇeviṇu lakkhaṇa-rāmĕhĩ  $  suravara-bhavaṇa-viṇiggaẏa-ṇāmĕhĩ
dasaürapura-ujjeṇi-pahāṇā  $  vajjaẏaṇṇa-sīhoẏara-rāṇā
veṇṇi vi hattheṃ hatthu dharāviẏa  $  sarahasu kaṇṭhaggahaṇu karāviẏa
addhoaddhiĕ mahi bhuñjāviẏa  $  aṇṇu vi jiṇavara-dhammu suṇāviẏa
kāmiṇi kāmaleha kokkāviẏa  $  vijjulaṅgahŏ karaẏalĕ lāviẏa
diṇṇaĩ maṇi-kuṇḍalaĩ phurantaĩ  $  candāiccahũ teu harantaĩ
tāma kumāru vuttu vikkhāĕhĩ  $  vajjaẏaṇṇa-sīhoẏara-rāĕhĩ
"ṇava-kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-ṇaẏaṇahũ  $  maẏagala-gaï-gamaṇahũ sasi-vaẏaṇahũ
ucca-ṇilāḍālaṅkiẏa-tilaẏahũ  $  vahu-sohagga-bhogga-guṇa-ṇilaẏahũ
vibbhama-bhāubbhiṇṇa-sarīrahũ  $  taṇu-majjhahũ thaṇa-hara-gambhīrahũ
ghattā:
ahiṇava-rūvahũ  $  lāẏaṇṇa-vaṇṇa-saṃpuṇṇahũ
laï bho lakkhaṇa  $  vara tiṇṇi saẏaĩ tuhũ kaṇṇahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu dasaraha-ṇandaṇu  $  ema pajampiu hasĕvi jaṇaddaṇu
"acchaü ti-ẏaṇu tāma vilavantaü  $  bhisiṇi-ṇihāu va raviẏara-chittaü
maĩ jāevaü dāhiṇa-desahŏ  $  koṅkaṇa-malaẏa-paṇḍi-uddesahŏ
tahĩ valahaddahŏ ṇilaü gavesami  $  pacchaĕ pāṇiggahaṇu karesamiḥ
ema kumāru pajampiu jaṃ je  $  maṇĕ visaṇṇu kaṇṇāẏaṇu taṃ je
daḍḍhu himeṇa va ṇaliṇi-samuccaü  $  muhĕ muhĕ ṇāĩ diṇṇu masi-kuñcaü
jāma tāma tūrĕhĩ vajjantĕhĩ  $  vivihĕhĩ maṅgalehĩ gijjantĕhĩ
vandiṇehĩ "jaẏa jaẏa" pabhaṇantĕhĩ  $  khujjaẏa-vāmaṇehĩ ṇaccantĕhĩ
sīẏa sa-lakkhaṇu valu païsāriu  $  vīẏā-indu va jaẏajaẏakāriu
tahĩ ṇivaseppiṇu ṇaẏarĕ ravaṇṇaĕ  $  addharatti-avasarĕ paḍivaṇṇaĕ
ghattā:
vala-ṇārāẏaṇa  $  gaẏa dasaüru muĕvi mahāiẏa
cettahŏ māsahŏ  $  taṃ kuvvara-ṇaẏaru parāiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 5:
kuvvara-ṇaẏaru parāiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  phagguṇa-māsu pavoliu tāvĕhĩ
païṭṭhu vasanta-rāu āṇandeṃ  $  koila-kalaẏala-maṅgala-saddeṃ
ali-mihuṇĕhĩ vandiṇĕhĩ paḍhantĕhĩ  $  varahiṇa-vāvaṇehĩ ṇaccantĕhĩ
andolā-saẏa-toraṇa-vārĕhĩ  $  ḍhukku vasantu aṇeẏa-paẏārĕhĩ
katthaï cūa-vaṇaĩ pallaviẏaĩ  $  ṇava-kisalaẏa-phala-phullabbhahiẏaĩ
katthaï giri-siharaĩ vicchāẏaĩ  $  khala-muhaĩ va masi-vaṇṇaĩ ṇāẏaĩ
katthaï māhava-māsahŏ meiṇi  $  piẏa-viraheṇa va sūsaï kāmiṇi
katthaï gijjaï vajjaï mandalu  $  ṇara-mihuṇehĩ paṇacciu gondalu
taṃ tahŏ ṇaẏarahŏ uttara-pāsĕhĩ  $  jaṇa-maṇaharu joẏaṇa-uddesĕhĩ
diṭṭhu vasantatilaü ujjāṇaü  $  sajjaṇa-hiẏaü jema a-pamāṇaü
ghattā:
suhalu suẏandhaü  $  ḍollantu viẏāvaḍa-matthaü
aggaĕ rāmahŏ  $  ṇaṃ thiu kusumañjali-hatthaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 6:
tahĩ uvavaṇĕ païsĕvi viṇu kheveṃ  $  pabhaṇiu vāsuevu valaeveṃ
"bho asurāri-vaïri-musumūraṇa  $  dasaraha-vaṃsa-maṇoraha-pūraṇa
lakkhaṇa kahi mi gavesahi taṃ jalu  $  sajjaṇa-hiẏaü jema jaṃ ṇimmalu
dūrāgamaṇeṃ sīẏa tisāiẏa  $  hima-haẏa-ṇava-ṇaliṇi va vicchāiẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vaḍa-duma-sovāṇĕhĩ  $  caḍiu mahārisi vva guṇathāṇĕhĩ
tāva mahāsaru diṭṭhu ravaṇṇaü  $  ṇāṇāviha-taruvara-saṃchaṇṇaü
sārasa-haṃsa-kuñca-vaga-cumviu  $  ṇava-kuvalaẏa-dala-kamala-karamviu
taṃ pekkhevi kumāru padhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ taṃ sara-tīru parāiu
ghattā:
païṭhu mahāvalu  $  jalĕ kamala-saṇḍu toḍantaü
māṇasa-saravarĕ  $  ṇaṃ sura-gaïndu kīlantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 7:
lakkhaṇu jalu āḍohaï jāvĕhĩ  $  kuvvara-ṇaẏara-ṇarāhiu tāvĕhĩ
chuḍu chuḍu vaṇa-kīlaĕ ṇīsariẏaü  $  maẏaṇa-divasĕ ṇaravara-pariẏariẏaü
taruvarĕ taruvarĕ mañcu ṇivaddhaü  $  mañcĕ mañcĕ thiu jaṇu samaladdhaü
mañcĕ mañcĕ ārūḍha ṇaresara  $  meru-ṇiẏamvĕ ṇāĩ vijjāhara
mañcĕ mañcĕ ālāvaṇi vajjaï  $  mahu pijjaï hindolaü gijjaï
mañcĕ mañcĕ jaṇu rasaẏa-vihatthaü  $  ghummaï ghulaï viẏāvaḍa-matthaü
mañcĕ mañcĕ kīlanti su-mihuṇaĩ  $  ṇava-mihuṇaĩ kahĩ ṇeha-vihūṇaĩ
mañcĕ mañcĕ andolaï jaṇavaü  $  koila vāsaï bhajjaï damaṇaü
ghattā:
kuvvara-ṇāhĕṇa  $  kiu mañcārohaṇu jāvĕhĩ
sūru va candĕṇa  $  lakkhijjaï lakkhaṇu tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 8:
lakkhiu lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇa-bhariẏaü  $  ṇaṃ paccakkhu maẏaṇu avaẏariu
rūu ṇiĕvi sura-bhavaṇāṇandahŏ  $  maṇu ullolĕhĩ jāi ṇarindahŏ
maẏaṇa-sarāsaṇi dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu  $  vammahu dasa-thāṇehĩ paḍhukkiu
pahilaĕ kahŏ vi samāṇu ṇa vollaï  $  vīẏaĕ guru ṇīsāsu pamellaï
taïẏaĕ saẏalu aṅgu paritappaï  $  caüthaĕ ṇaṃ karavattĕhĩ kappaï
pañcamĕ puṇu puṇu pāseijjaï  $  chaṭṭhaĕ vāravāra mucchijjaï
sattamĕ jalu vi jaladda ṇa bhāvaï  $  aṭṭhamĕ maraṇa-līla darisāvaï
ṇavamaĕ pāṇa paḍanta ṇa veẏaï  $  dasamaĕ siru chijjantu ṇa ceẏaï
ghattā:
ema viẏambhiu  $  kusumāuhu dasahi mi thāṇĕhĩ
taṃ acchariẏaü  $  jaṃ mukku kumāru ṇa pāṇĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ kaṇṭha-ṭṭhiu jīvu kumārahŏ  $  saṇṇaĕ vuttu "pahiu hakkārahŏ"
pahu-āṇaĕ pāikka padhāiẏa  $  ṇivisaddheṃ tahŏ pāsu parāiẏa
paṇavĕvi vuttu ti-khaṇḍa-pahāṇaü  $  "tumhahã kāi mi kokkaï rāṇaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi uccaliu jaṇaddaṇu  $  tihuaṇa-jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu
viẏaḍa paoha dentu ṇaṃ kesari  $  kandaï bhārakkanta vasundhari
diṭṭhu kumāru kumāreṃ entaü  $  maẏaṇu jema jaṇa-maṇa-mohantaü
khaṇĕ kallāṇamālu romañciu  $  ṇaḍu jiha harisa-visāĕhĩ ṇacciu
puṇu vaïsāriu hari addhāsaṇĕ  $  bhaviu jema thiu diḍhu jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ
ghattā:
vaïṭhu jaṇaddaṇu  $  ālīḍhaĕ mañcĕ ravaṇṇaĕ
ṇava-varaïttu va  $  pacchaṇṇu miliu sahũ kaṇṇaĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 10:
ve vi vaïṭṭha vīra ekkāsaṇĕ  $  candāicca jema gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ
ekku pacaṇḍu tikhaṇḍa-pahāṇaü  $  aṇṇekku vi kuvvara-pura-rāṇaü
ekkahŏ calaṇa-jualu kummuṇṇaü  $  aṇṇekkahŏ rattuppala-vaṇṇaü
ekkahŏ ūrū (?)-jualu su-vittharu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ sukumāru su-maccharu
pañcāṇaṇa-kaḍi-maṇḍalu ekkahŏ  $  ṇāri-ṇiẏamva-vimvu aṇṇekkahŏ
ekkahŏ sulaliu sundaru aṅgaü  $  aṇṇekkahŏ taṇu-tivali-taraṅgaü
ekkahŏ sohaï viẏaḍu uratthalu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ jovvaṇu thaṇa-cakkalu
ekkahŏ vāhaü dīha-visālaü  $  aṇṇekkahŏ ṇaṃ mālaï-mālaü
vaẏaṇa-kamalu papphulliu ekkahŏ  $  puṇṇima-canda-rundu aṇṇekkahŏ
ekkahŏ go-kamalaĩ vitthariẏaĩ  $  aṇṇekkahŏ vahu-vibbhama-bhariẏaĩ
ekkahŏ siru vara-kusumĕhĩ vāsiu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ vara-maüḍa-vihūsiu
ghattā:
ekku sa-lakkhaṇu  $  lakkhijjaï jaṇĕṇa aseseṃ
aṇṇekku vi puṇu  $  pacchaṇṇa ṇāri ṇara-veseṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 11:
daṇu-duggāha-gāha-avagāheṃ  $  puṇu puṇaruttĕhĩ kuvvara-ṇāheṃ
ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhiu lakkhaṇa-saravaru  $  jo sura-sundari-ṇaliṇi-suhaṅkaru
jo katthūriẏa-paṅkuppaṅkiu  $  jo ari-karihĩ ṇa ḍohĕvi sakkiu
jo sura-saüṇa-sahāsĕhĩ maṇḍiu  $  jo kāmiṇi-thaṇa-cakkĕhĩ caḍḍiu
tahĩ tehaĕ sarĕ seẏa-jalolliu  $  lakkhaṇa-vaẏaṇa-kamalu papphulliu
kaṇṭha-maṇohara-dīhara-ṇālaü  $  vara-romañca-kañcu-kaṇṭālaü
dasaṇa-sakesaru ahara-mahādalu  $  vaẏa-maẏarandaü kaṇṇāvattalu
loẏaṇa-phullandhuẏa-paricumviu  $  kuḍila-vāla-sevāla-karamviu
ghattā:
lakkhaṇa-saravaru  $  haü bhukkha-mahāhima-vāeṃ
taṃ muha-paṅkaü  $  lakkhijjaï kuvvara-rāeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 26, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ muha-kamalu diṭṭhu ohulliu  $  vālikhilla-taṇaeṇa pavolliu
"he ṇaraṇāha-ṇāha bhuvaṇāhiva  $  bhoẏaṇu bhuñjahu su-kalattaṃ piva

ṇaü kālu kiẏanta-mittu hasiu  $  ṇaü valaẏāmuhu samuddu rasiu
