ṇaü gaü pāẏālahŏ bhuvaṇaẏalu  $  vambhaṇḍu phuṭṭu ṇaü gaẏaṇaẏalu
ṇaü khaẏa-māruu thāṇahŏ caliu  $  ṇaü asaṇi-ṇihāu samucchaliu
ṇaü saẏala sa-sāẏara caliẏa mahi  $  ṇaü disi-gaẏa ṇaü gajjiẏa uvahi
ghattā:
siẏa-lakkhaṇa-vala-guṇa-vantaĕṇa  $  ṇīsesu vi jaü dhavalantaĕṇa
su-kalatteṃ jima jaṇa-maṇaharĕṇa  $  ĕu gajjiu lakkhaṇa-dhaṇuharĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 8:
suṇĕ ṇaravaï asura-parāẏaṇahũ  $  jaṃ ciṇhaĩ vala-ṇārāẏaṇahũ
taṃ atthi asesu vi vaṇavasahũ  $  surabhuvaṇucchaliẏa-mahājasahũ
ekkahŏ sasi-ṇimmala-dhavalu taṇu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ kuvalaẏa-ghaṇa-kasaṇu
ekkahŏ mahi-māṇadaṇḍa calaṇa  $  aṇṇekkahŏ duddama-daṇu-dalaṇa
ekkahŏ taṇu majjhu padīsiẏaü  $  aṇṇekkahŏ kamala-vihūsiẏaü
ekkahŏ vacchatthalu siẏa-sahiu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ sīẏāṇuggahiu
ekkahŏ bhīsāvaṇu hei halu  $  aṇṇekkahŏ dhaṇuharu atula-valu
ekkahŏ muhu sasikundujjalaü  $  aṇṇekkahŏ ṇava-ghaṇa-sāmalaü"
ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu vigaẏa-maü  $  ṇīsandaṇu ṇiggaü ṇitturaü
valaevahŏ calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu kiha  $  ahiseĕ jiṇindahŏ indu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ ruddabhutti calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu  $  taṃ lakkhaṇu kovāṇalĕ caḍiu
           dhagadhagadhagantu  $                 tharatharatharantu
          "haṇu haṇu" bhaṇantu  $                 ṇaṃ kali kiẏantu
           karaẏala dhuṇantu  $                 mahi ṇiddalantu
           vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇu  $                  ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
           mahi-māṇadaṇḍu  $                  paravala-pacaṇḍu
           so caviu eva  $                  "riu melli deva
           jaṃ païja eṇa  $                  pujjaï haeṇa"
ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu atula-valu  $  "suṇu lakkhaṇa" pacaviu eva valu
"mukkāuhu jo calaṇĕhĩ paḍaï  $  teṃ ṇihaeṃ ko jasu ṇivvaḍaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 10:
thiu lakkhaṇu valĕṇa ṇivāriẏaü  $  ṇaṃ vara-gaïndu kaṇṇāriẏaü
ṇaṃ sāẏaru majjāẏaĕ dhariu  $  puṇu puṇu vi caviu macchara-bhariu
"khala khudda pisuṇa taü sira-kamalu  $  ettaḍĕṇa cukku jaṃ ṇaviu valu
vari vālikhillu muĕ vandi lahu  $  ṇaṃ to jīvantu ṇa jāhi mahu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇiviseṃ mukku pahu  $  ṇaṃ jiṇavareṇa saṃsāra-pahu
ṇaṃ gaha-kalloleṃ amiẏa-taṇu  $  ṇaṃ garuḍa-vihaṅgeṃ uragamaṇu
ṇaṃ mukku suaṇu dujjaṇa-jaṇahŏ  $  ṇaṃ vāraṇu vāri-ṇivandhaṇahŏ
ṇaṃ mukku bhaviu bhava-sāẏarahŏ  $  tiha vālikhillu dukkhoẏarahŏ
ghattā:
te ruddabhutti-vala-mahumahaṇa  $  sahũ kuvvara-ṇivĕṇa caẏāri jaṇa
thiẏa jāṇaï tehĩ samāṇu kiha  $  caü-sāẏara-parimiẏa puhaï jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 11:
to vālikhilla-viñjhāhivaï  $  avaropparu ṇeha-ṇivaddha-maï
kama-kamalĕhĩ ṇivaḍiẏa halaharahŏ  $  ṇami-viṇami jema ciru jiṇavarahŏ
saĩ hattheṃ valĕṇa samuṭṭhaviẏa  $  uvahi va samaehĩ pariṭṭhaviẏa
bharahahŏ pāikka ve vi thaviẏa  $  lahu ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-ṇilaẏahũ paṭṭhaviẏa
uttiṇṇaĩ tiṇṇi vi mahiharahŏ  $  ṇaṃ bhaviẏaĩ bhava-dukkhoẏarahŏ
ṇaṃ meru-ṇiẏamvahŏ kiṇṇaraĩ  $  ṇaṃ saggahŏ caviẏaĩ suravaraĩ
viṇu kheveṃ tāvi parāiẏaĩ  $  kira salilu piẏanti tisāiẏaĩ
ṇavaruṇhaü raviẏara-tāviẏaü  $  su-kuḍumvu va khala-saṃtāviẏaü
ghattā:
diṇaẏara-vara-kiraṇa-karamviẏaü  $  jalu levi bhuĕhĩ pari-cumviẏaü
païsantu ṇa bhāvaï muhahŏ kiha  $  aṇṇāṇahŏ jiṇavara-vaẏaṇu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 12:
puṇu tāvi tareppiṇu ṇiggaẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ tiṇṇi mi viñjha-mahāgaẏaĩ
vaïdehi pajampiẏa harivalahŏ  $  suravara-kari-kara-thira-karaẏalahŏ
"jalu kahi mi gavesahŏ ṇimmalaü  $  jaṃ tisa-haru hima-sasi-sīẏalaü
taṃ icchami bhaviu va jiṇa-vaẏaṇu  $  ṇihi ṇiddhaṇu jaccandhu va ṇaẏaṇu"
valu dhīraï "dhīrī hohi dhaṇĕ  $  maṃ kāẏaru muhu kari migaṇaẏaṇĕ"
thovantaru puṇu viharantaĕhĩ  $  malhantĕhĩ paü paü dentaĕhĩ
lakkhijjaï aruṇagāmu puraü  $  vaẏa-vandha-vihūsiu jiha muraü
kappadumo vva caüddisu suhalu  $  ṇaṭṭāvaü vva ṇāḍaẏa-kusalu
ghattā:
taṃ aruṇagāmu saṃpāiẏaĩ  $  muṇivara iva mokkha-tisāiẏaĩ
so ṇaü jaṇu jeṇa ṇa diṭṭhāĩ  $  gharu kavilahŏ gampi païṭṭhāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 13:
ṇijjhāiu taṃ gharu diẏavarahŏ  $  ṇaṃ parama-thāṇu thiru jiṇavarahŏ
ṇiravekkhu ṇirakkharu kevalaü  $  ṇimmāṇu ṇirañjaṇu ṇimmalaü
ṇivvatthu ṇiratthu ṇirāharaṇu  $  ṇiddhaṇu ṇibbhattaü ṇimmahaṇu
tahĩ tehaĕ bhavaṇĕ païṭṭhāĩ  $  chuḍu chuḍu jalu piĕvi ṇiviṭṭhāĩ
kuñjara iva guhĕ āvāsiẏaĩ  $  hariṇā iva vāhuttāsiẏaĩ
acchanti jāva tahĩ ekku khaṇu  $  diu tāva parāiu kuiẏa-maṇu
"maru maru ṇīsaru ṇīsaru" bhaṇantu  $  dhūmaddhaü vva dhagadhagadhagantu
bhaẏa-bhīsaṇu kuruḍu saṇiccharu vva  $  vahu-uvavisa-viṇṇaü visaharu vva
ghattā:
"kiṃ kālu kiẏantu mittu variu  $  kiṃ kesari kesaraggeṃ dhariu
ko jama-muha-kuharahŏ ṇīsariu  $  jo bhavaṇĕ mahāraĕ païsariu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu mahumahaṇu  $  āruṭṭhu samara-bhara-uvvahaṇu
ṇaṃ dhāiu kari thira-thora-karu  $  ummūliu diẏavaru jema taru
uggāmĕvi bhāmĕvi gaẏaṇaẏalĕ  $  kira ghivaï paḍīvaü dharaṇiẏalĕ
karĕ dhariu tāva halapaharaṇĕṇa  $  "muĕ muĕ mā haṇahi akāraṇĕṇa
diẏa-vāla-gola-pasu-tavasi-tiẏa  $  cha vi pariharu mellĕvi māṇa-kiẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi diẏavaru lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ mukku alakkhaṇu lakkhaṇĕṇa
osariu vīru pacchāmuhaü  $  aṅkusa-ṇiruddhu ṇaṃ matta-gaü
puṇu hiẏaĕ visūraï khaṇĕ jĕ khaṇĕ  $  "saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu vari hūu raṇĕ
ghattā:
vari pahariu vari kiu tavacaraṇu  $  vari visu hālāhalu vari maraṇu
vari acchiu gampiṇu guhila-vaṇĕ  $  ṇavi ṇivisu vi ṇivasiu avuhaẏaṇĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 27, Kaḍavaka 15:
to tiṇṇi vi ema cavantāĩ  $  ummāhaü jaṇahŏ jaṇantāĩ
diṇa-pacchima-paharĕ viṇiggaẏāĩ  $  kuñjara iva viula-vaṇahŏ gaẏāĩ
vitthiṇṇu raṇṇu païsanti jāva  $  ṇaggohu mahādumu diṭṭhu tāva
guru-vesu karĕvi sundara-sarāĩ  $  ṇaṃ vihaẏa paḍhāvaï akkharāĩ
vukkaṇa-kisalaẏa ka-kkā ravanti  $  vāuli-vihaṅga ki-kkī bhaṇanti
vaṇa-kukkuḍa ku-kkū āẏaranti  $  aṇṇu vi kalāva ke-kkaï cavanti
piẏamāhaviẏaü ko-kkaü lavanti  $  kaṃ-kā vappīha samullavanti
so taruvaru guru-gaṇahara-samāṇu  $  phala-patta-vantu akkhara-ṇihāṇu
ghattā:
païsantĕhĩ asura-vimaddaṇĕhĩ  $  siru ṇāmĕvi rāma-jaṇaddaṇĕhĩ
pariañcĕvi dumu dasaraha-suĕhĩ  $  ahiṇandiu muṇi va sa iṃ bhu ĕhĩ
----------  [28. aṭṭhāvīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
sīẏa sa-lakkhaṇu dāsarahi  $  taruvara-mūlĕ pariṭṭhiẏa jāvĕhĩ
pasaraï su-kaïhĕ kavvu jiha  $  meha-jālu gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 1:
pasaraï meha-vindu gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  pasaraï jema seṇṇu samaraṅgaṇĕ
pasaraï jema timiru aṇṇāṇahŏ  $  pasaraï jema vuddhi vahu-jāṇahŏ
pasaraï jema pāu pāviṭṭhahŏ  $  pasaraï jema dhammu dhammiṭṭhahŏ
pasaraï jema joṇha maẏavāhahŏ  $  pasaraï jema kitti jagaṇāhahŏ
pasaraï jema cinta dhaṇa-hīṇahŏ  $  pasaraï jema kitti sukulīṇahŏ
pasaraï jema saddu sura-tūrahŏ  $  pasaraï jema rāsi ṇahĕ sūrahŏ
pasaraï jema davaggi vaṇantarĕ  $  pasaraï meha-jālu tiha amvarĕ
taḍi taḍaẏaḍaï paḍaï ghaṇu gajjaï  $  jāṇaï rāmahŏ saraṇu pavajjaï
ghattā:
amara-mahādhaṇu-gahiẏa-karu  $  meha-gaïndĕ caḍĕvi jasa-luddhaü
uppari gimbha-ṇarāhivahŏ  $  pāusa-rāu ṇāĩ saṇṇaddhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 2:
jaṃ pāusa-ṇarindu galagajjiu  $  dhūlī-raü gimbheṇa visajjiu
gampiṇu meha-vindĕ ālaggaü  $  taḍi-karavāla-pahārĕhĩ bhaggaü
jaṃ vivarammuhu caliu visālaü  $  uṭṭhiu "haṇu" bhaṇantu uṇhālaü
dhagadhagadhagadhagantu uddhāiu  $  hasahasahasahasantu saṃpāiu
jalajalajalajalajala pacalantaü  $  jālāvali-phuliṅga mellantaü
dhūmāvali-dhaẏadaṇḍubbhĕppiṇu  $  vara-vāulli-khaggu kaḍḍheppiṇu
jhaḍajhaḍajhaḍajhaḍantu paharantaü  $  taruvara-riu-bhaḍa-thaḍa bhajjantaü
meha-mahāgaẏa-ghaḍa vihaḍantaü  $  jaṃ uṇhālaü diṭṭhu bhiḍantaü
ghattā:
dhaṇu apphāliu pāusĕṇa  $  taḍi-ṭaṅkāra-phāra darisanteṃ
    coĕvi jalahara-hatthi-haḍa  $  ṇīra-sarāsaṇi mukka turanteṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 3:
jala-vāṇāsaṇi-ghāẏahĩ ghāiu  $  gimbha-ṇarāhiu raṇĕ viṇivāiu
daddura raḍĕvi lagga ṇaṃ sajjaṇa  $  ṇaṃ ṇaccanti mora khala dujjaṇa
ṇaṃ pūranti sariu akkandeṃ  $  ṇaṃ kaï kilikilanti āṇandeṃ
ṇaṃ parahuẏa vimukka ugghoseṃ  $  ṇaṃ varahiṇa lavanti parioseṃ
ṇaṃ saravara vahu-aṃsu-jalolliẏa  $  ṇaṃ girivara hariseṃ gañjolliẏa
ṇaṃ uṇhavia davaggi vioeṃ  $  ṇaṃ ṇacciẏa mahi viviha-viṇoeṃ
ṇaṃ atthamiu divāẏaru dukkheṃ  $  ṇaṃ païsaraï raẏaṇi saĩ sukkheṃ
ratta-patta taru pavaṇākampiẏa  $  "keṇa vi vahiu gimbhu" ṇaṃ jampiẏa
ghattā:
tehaĕ kālĕ bhaẏāuraĕ  $  veṇṇi mi vāsueva-valaeva
    taruvara-mūlĕ sa-sīẏa thiẏa  $  jogu laeviṇu muṇivara jema
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 4:
hari-vala rukkha-mūlĕ thiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  gaẏamuhu jakkhu paṇāsĕvi tāvĕhĩ
gaü ṇiẏa-ṇivahŏ pāsu vevantaü  $  "deva deva paritāhi" bhaṇantaü
"ṇaü jāṇahũ kiṃ suravara kiṃ ṇara  $  kiṃ vijjāhara-gaṇa kiṃ kiṇṇara
dhaṇudhara dhīra paḍāẏaü ubbhĕvi  $  sutta mahāraü ṇilaü ṇirumbhĕvi"
taṃ ṇisuṇeviṇu vaẏaṇu mahāiu  $  pūvaṇu mambhīsantu padhāiu
viñjha-mahīhara-siharahŏ āiu  $  takkhaṇĕ taṃ uddesu parāiu
tāma ṇihāliẏa veṇṇi vi duddhara  $  sāẏara-vajjāvatta-dhaṇuddhara
avahī-ṇāṇu paüñjaï jāvĕhĩ  $  lakkhaṇa-rāma muṇiẏa maṇĕ tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
pekkhĕvi hari-vala ve vi jaṇa  $  pūvaṇa-jakkheṃ jaẏa-jasa-luddheṃ
    maṇi-kañcaṇa-dhaṇa-jaṇa-paüru  $  paṭṭaṇu kiu ṇimisaddhahŏ addheṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 5:
puṇu rāmaüri paghosiẏa loeṃ  $  ṇaṃ ṇārihĕ aṇuhariẏa ṇioeṃ
dīhara-pantha-pasāriẏa-calaṇī  $  kusuma-ṇiẏattha-vattha-sāharaṇī
khāiẏa-tivali-taraṅga-vihūsiẏa  $  goura-thaṇahara-sihara-padīsiẏa
viulārāma-roma-romañciẏa  $  indagova-saẏa-kuṅkuma-añciẏa
girivara-sariẏa-pasāriẏa-vāhī  $  jala-pheṇāvali-valaẏa-saṇāhī
saravara-ṇaẏaṇa-ghaṇañjaṇa-añjiẏa  $  suradhaṇu-bhaüha-padīsiẏa-pañjiẏa
deula-vaẏaṇa-kamalu dariseppiṇu  $  vara-maẏalañchaṇa-tilaü chuheppiṇu
ṇāĩ ṇihālaï diṇaẏara-dappaṇu  $  ema viṇimmiu saẏalu vi paṭṭaṇu
vaïsĕvi valahŏ pāsĕ vīsatthaü  $  ālāvaï ālāvaṇi-hatthaü
ghattā:
ekkavīsa-vara-mucchaṇaü  $  satta vi sara ti-gāma darisantaü
    "vujjhi bhaḍārā dāsarahi  $  suppahāu taü" eva bhaṇantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 6:
suppahāu uccāriu jāvĕhĩ  $  rāmeṃ valĕvi paloiu tāvĕhĩ
diṭṭhu ṇaẏaru jaṃ jakkha-samāriu  $  ṇāĩ ṇahaṅgaṇu sūra-vihūsiu
sa-ghaṇu sa-kumbhu sa-savaṇu sa-saṅkaü  $  sa-vuhu sa-tāraü sa-guru-sasaṅkaü
puṇu vi paḍīvaü ṇaẏaru ṇihāliu  $  ṇāĩ mahāvaṇu kusumomāliu
ṇāĩ sukaïhĕ kavvu paẏaïttiu  $  ṇāĩ ṇarinda-cittu vahu-cittaü
ṇāĩ seṇṇu rahavarahã amukkaü  $  ṇāĩ vivāha-gehu sa-caükkaü
ṇāĩ suraü caccari-cariẏālaü  $  ṇāvaï ḍimbhaü ahiẏa-chuhālaü
aha kiṃ vaṇṇieṇa khaṇĕ je khaṇĕ  $  tihuaṇĕ ṇatthi jaṃ pi taṃ paṭṭaṇĕ
ghattā:
taṃ pekkheppiṇu rāmaüri  $  bhuaṇa-sahāsa-viṇiggaẏa-ṇāmahŏ
    mañchuḍu ujjhāuri-ṇaẏaru  $  jāẏa mahanta bhanti maṇĕ rāmahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 7:
jaṃ kiu vimbhaü sāsaẏa-lakkheṃ  $  vuttu ṇaveppiṇu pūaṇa-jakkheṃ
"tumhāraü vaṇa-vasaṇu ṇieppiṇu  $  kiu maĩ paṭṭaṇu bhāu dhareppiṇu
ema bhaṇevi suvitthaẏa-ṇāmahŏ  $  diṇṇa sughosa vīṇa teṃ rāmahŏ
diṇṇu maüḍu sāharaṇu vilevaṇu  $  maṇi-kuṇḍala kaḍisuttaü kaṅkaṇu
puṇu vi pajampiu jakkha-pahāṇaü  $  "haũ taü bhiccu deva tuhũ rāṇaü"
eva volla ṇimmāiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  kavileṃ ṇaẏaru ṇihāliu tāvĕhĩ
jaṇa-maṇaharu sura-sagga-samāṇaü  $  vāsavapurahŏ vi khaṇḍaï māṇaü
taṃ pekkhĕvi āsaṅkiu vambhaṇu  $  "kahĩ vitthiṇṇu raṇṇu kahĩ paṭṭaṇu"
ghattā:
tharaharantu bhaẏa-māruĕṇa  $  samihaü ghivĕvi paṇāsaï jāvĕhĩ
    mambhīsanti miẏaṅkamuhi  $  puraü sa-māẏa jakkhi thiẏa tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 8:
"he diẏavara caüveẏa-pahāṇā  $  kiṇṇa muṇahi rāmaüri aẏāṇā
jaṇa-maṇa-vallahu rāhava-rāṇaü  $  matta-gaïndu va pagaliẏa-dāṇaü
takkuva-bhamara-saehĩ ṇa muccaï  $  dei asesu vi jaṃ jasu ruccaï
jo ghaĩ jiṇavara-ṇāmu laei  $  tahŏ kaḍḍheppiṇu pāṇaĩ dei
ĕu jaṃ vāsava-disaĕ visālaü  $  dīsaï tihuaṇatilaü jiṇālaü
tahĩ jo gampi karaï jaẏakāru  $  paṭṭaṇĕ ṇavari tāsu païsāru"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu diẏavaru dhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ jiṇavara-bhavaṇu parāiu
taṃ cārittasūru muṇi vandĕvi  $  viṇaü karĕvi appāṇaü ṇindĕvi
ghattā:
pucchiu muṇivaru diẏavarĕṇa  $  "dāṇahŏ kāraṇĕ viṇu sammatteṃ
    dhammeṃ laïeṃ kavaṇu phalu  $  eu deva mahu akkhi paẏatteṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 9:
muṇivaru kahĕvi laggu "viulāĩ  $  kiṃ jaṇĕ ṇa ṇiẏahi dhammaphalāĩ
dhammeṃ bhaḍa-thaḍa haẏa gaẏa sandaṇa  $  pāveṃ maraṇa-vioẏakkandaṇa
dhammeṃ saggu bhoggu sohaggu  $  pāveṃ roggu sogu dohaggu
dhammeṃ riddhi viddhi siẏa saṃpaẏa  $  pāveṃ attha-hīṇa ṇara viddaẏa
dhammeṃ kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-kaḍisuttā  $  pāveṃ ṇara dāliddeṃ bhuttā
dhammeṃ rajju karanti ṇiruttā  $  pāveṃ para-pesaṇa-saṃjuttā
dhammeṃ vara-pallaṅkeṃ suttā  $  pāveṃ tiṇa-saṃthārĕ vibhuttā
dhammeṃ ṇara devattaṇu pattā  $  pāveṃ ṇaraẏa-ghorĕ saṃkantā
dhammeṃ ṇara ramanti vara-vilaẏaü  $  pāveṃ dūhaviu duha-ṇilaẏaü
dhammeṃ sundaru aṅgu ṇivaddhaü  $  pāveṃ paṅgulaü vi vahirandhaü
ghattā:
dhamma-pāva-kappaddumahũ  $  āẏaĩ jasa-avajasa-vahulāiṃ
      veṇṇi mi asuha-suhaṅkaraĩ  $  jāĩ piẏaĩ laï tāĩ phalāiṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 10:
muṇivara-vaẏaṇĕhĩ diẏavaru vāsiu  $  laïu dhammu jo jiṇavarĕ bhāsiu
pañcāṇuvvaẏa levi padhāiu  $  ṇiẏa-mandiru ṇiviseṇa parāiu
gampiṇu puṇu sommahĕ vajjariẏaü  $  "ajju mahantu diṭṭhu accariẏaü
kahĩ vaṇu kahĩ paṭṭaṇu kahĩ rāṇaü  $  kahĩ muṇi diṭṭhu aṇeẏaĩ jāṇaü
kahĩ maï kahĩ laddhaĩ jiṇa-vaẏaṇaĩ  $  vahireṃ kaṇṇa 'ndheṇa va ṇaẏaṇaĩ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi somma gañjolliẏa  $  "jāhũ ṇāha tahĩ ema pavolliẏa
puṇu saṃcallaĩ ve vi turantaĩ  $  tihuẏaṇatilaü jiṇālaü pattaĩ
sāhu ṇaveppiṇu pāsĕ ṇiviṭṭhaĩ  $  dhammu suṇeppiṇu ṇaẏarĕ païṭṭhaĩ
ghattā:
diṭṭhu ṇarindatthāṇu ṇahu  $  jāṇaï-mandāiṇi-paricaḍḍiu
    ṇara-ṇakkhattahĩ pariẏariu  $  hari-vala-canda-divāẏara-maṇḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 11:
hari atthāṇa-maggĕ jaṃ diṭṭhaü  $  diẏavaru pāṇa laevi paṇaṭṭhaü
ṇaṭṭhu kuraṅgu va vāraṇavārahŏ  $  ṇaṭṭhu jiṇindu va bhava-saṃsārahŏ
ṇaṭṭhu miẏaṅku va abbhapisāẏahŏ  $  ṇaṭṭhu davaggi va ṇīra-ṇihāẏahŏ
ṇaṭṭhu bhuaṅgu va garuḍa-vihaṅgahŏ  $  ṇaṭṭhu kharo vva matta-māẏaṅgahŏ
ṇaṭṭhu aṇaṅgu va sāsaẏa-gamaṇahŏ  $  ṇaṭṭhu mahāghaṇo vva khara-pavaṇahŏ
ṇaṭṭhu mahīharo vva sura-kulisahŏ  $  ṇaṭṭhu turaṅgamo vva jama-mahisahŏ
tiha ṇāsantu padīsiu diẏavaru  $  mambhīsantu padhāiu siriharu
maṇḍa dharevi kareṇa karaggaĕ  $  gampi ghittu valaevahŏ aggaĕ
dukkhu dukkhu appāṇaü dhīrĕvi  $  saẏalu mahabbhaü maṇĕ avaherĕvi
duddama-dāṇavinda-vala-maddahŏ  $  puṇu āsīsa diṇṇa valahaddahŏ
ghattā:
"jema samuddu mahājalĕṇa  $  jema jiṇesaru sukkiẏa-kammeṃ
      canda-kunda-jasa-ṇimmalĕṇa  $  tiha tuhũ vaddhu ṇarāhiva dhammeṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 28, Kaḍavaka 12:
to etthantarĕ para-vala-maddaṇu  $  kahakaha-saddeṃ hasiu jaṇaddaṇu
"bhavaṇĕ païṭṭha tuhāraĕ jaïẏahũ  $  paĩ avagaṇṇĕvi ghalliẏa taïẏahũ
etthu kālĕ puṇu diẏavaru kīsā  $  viṇaü karĕvi puṇu diṇṇa asīsā"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi bhaṇaï veẏāẏaru  $  "atthahŏ ko ṇa vi karaï mahāẏaru
jiha āṇandu jaṇaï sīẏālaĕ  $  tiha ki ṇa ruccaï ravi uṇhālaĕ
kāla-vaseṇa kālu vi sahevaü  $  etthu ṇa harisu visāu karevaü
atthu vilāsiṇi-jaṇa-maṇa-vallahu  $  attha-vihūṇaü vuccaï "ghallahu"
atthu viẏaḍḍhu atthu guṇavantaü  $  attha-vihūṇu bhamaï maggantaü
atthu aṇaṅgu atthu jagĕ sūhaü  $  attha-vihūṇu dīṇu ṇaru dūhaü
atthu saïcchiu bhuñjaï rajju  $  attha-vihūṇeṃ kiṃ pi ṇa kajju"
ghattā:
"sāhu" bhaṇanteṃ rāhavĕṇa  $  indaṇīla-maṇi-kañcaṇa-khaṇḍĕhĩ
      kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-kaḍisuttaẏahĩ  $  pujjiu kavilu sa iṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [29. eguṇatīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
suraḍāmara-riu-ḍamarakara  $  kovaṇḍa-dhara  $  sahũ sīẏaĕ caliẏa mahāiẏa
vala-ṇārāẏaṇa ve vi jaṇa  $  parituṭṭha-maṇa  $  jīvanta-ṇaẏaru saṃpāiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 1:
paṭṭaṇu tihi mi tehĩ āvajjiu  $  diṇaẏara-vimvu va dosa-vivajjiu
ṇavara hoi jaï kampu dhaesu  $  haü turaesu jujjhu suraesu
ghāu muravesu  $  bhaṅgu cihuresu
jaḍaü ruddesu  $  maliṇu candesu
khalu khettesu  $  daṇḍu chattesu
(vahu-)kara gahaṇesu  $  paharu divasesu
dhaṇu dāṇesu  $  cinta jhāṇesu
sura saggesu  $  sīhu raṇṇesu
kalahu gaesu  $  aṅku kavvesu
ḍaru vasahesu  $  velu gaẏaṇesu
vaṇu rukkhesu  $  jhāṇu mukkhesu
ahavaï kittiu ṇiva vaṇṇijjaï  $  jaï para taṃ ji tāsu uvamijjaï
ghattā:
tahŏ ṇaẏarahŏ avaruttarĕṇa  $  kosantarĕṇa  $  uvavaṇu ṇāmeṇa pasatthaü
     ṇāĩ kumārahŏ entāhŏ  $  païsantāhŏ  $  thiu ṇava-kusumañjali-hatthaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 2:
tahĩ uvavaṇĕ thiẏa hari-vala jāvĕhĩ  $  bharaheṃ lehu visajjiu tāvĕhĩ
aggaĕ ghittu ṇareṇa ṇarindahŏ  $  bhaviu va calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu jiṇindahŏ
laïu mahīhareṇa saĩ hattheṃ  $  jiṇavara-dhammu va muṇivara-sattheṃ
vāri-ṇivandhahŏ mukku gaïndu va  $  diṭṭhu aṅku tahĩ ṇahaẏalĕ candu va
"rajju muevi ve vi riu-maddaṇa  $  gaẏa vaṇa-vāsahŏ rāma-jaṇaddaṇa
ko jāṇaï hari kaddiu āvaï  $  tahŏ vaṇamāla dejja jasu bhāvaï"
lehu ghiveppiṇu ṇaravaï mahiharu  $  ṇāĩ daveṇa daḍḍhu thiu mahiharu
ṇāĩ miẏaṅko kamiu viḍappeṃ  $  tiha mahiharu ṇarindu māhappeṃ
ghattā:
jāẏa cinta maṇĕ duddharahŏ  $  dharaṇīdharahŏ  $  sihi-gala-tamāla-ghaṇa-vaṇṇahŏ
   "lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇa-lakkha-dharu  $  taṃ muĕvi varu  $  maĩ diṇṇa kaṇṇa kiṃ aṇṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 3:
to etthantarĕ ṇaẏaṇa-visālaĕ  $  eha vatta jaṃ suẏa vaṇamālaĕ
āulihuẏa hiẏaeṇa visūraï  $  dukkheṃ mahaṇaï vva āūraï
sirĕ pāseu caḍaï muhu sūsaï  $  kara vihuṇaï puṇu daïvahŏ rūsaï
maṇu dhugudhugaï dehu paritappaï  $  vammahŏ ṇaṃ karavatteṃ kappaï
tāva ṇahaṅgaṇeṇa ghaṇu gajjiu  $  ṇāĩ kumāreṃ dūu visajjiu
"dhīrī hohi māĕ" ṇaṃ bhāsiu  $  "uhu lakkhaṇu uvavaṇĕ āvāsiu"
garahiu mehu to vi taṇu-aṅgiĕ  $  dosa vi guṇa havanti saṃsaggiĕ
"tuhũ kira jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu  $  mahu puṇu jalahara ṇāĩ huāsaṇu
ghattā:
tujjhu ṇa dosu dosu kulahŏ  $  haẏa-duha-kulahŏ jalĕ  $  jalaṇĕ pavaṇĕ jaṃ jāẏaü
    taṃ pāseu dāhu karahu  $  ṇīsāsu mahu tiṇṇi  $  vi dakkhavaṇahŏ āẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 4:
docchiu mehu paṇaṭṭhu ṇahaṅgaṇĕ  $  puṇu vaṇamālaĕ cintiu ṇiẏa-maṇĕ
"kiṃ païsarami valantĕ huāsaṇĕ  $  kiṃ samuddĕ kiṃ raṇṇĕ su-bhīsaṇĕ
kiṃ visu bhuñjami kiṃ ahi cappami  $  kiṃ appaü karavatteṃ kappami
kiṃ karivara-dantahĩ uru bhindami  $  kiṃ karavālĕhĩ tilu tilu chindami
kiṃ disa laṅghami kiṃ pavvajjami  $  kahŏ akkhami kahŏ saraṇu pavajjami
ahavaï eṇa kāĩ gamu sajjami  $  taruvara-ḍālaĕ pāṇa visajjami"
ema bhaṇeppiṇu caliẏa turantī  $  kaṅkellī-thaḍa ugghosantī
gandha-dhūva-vali-puppha-vihatthī  $  līlaĕ cikkamanti vīsatthī
ghattā:
caüviha-seṇṇeṃ pariẏariẏa  $  dhaṇa ṇīsariẏa  $  "ko vihĩ āliṅgaṇu desaï"
    ema cavanti païṭṭha vaṇĕ  $  ravi-atthavaṇĕ  $  "kahĩ lakkhaṇu" ṇāĩ gavesaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 5:
diṭṭhu asoẏavacchu pariañciu  $  jiṇavaro vva sabbhāveṃ añciu
puṇu parivāẏaṇu kiẏaü asoẏahŏ  $  "aṇṇu ṇa iha-loẏahŏ para-loẏahŏ
jammĕ jammĕ mua-muahĕ sa-lakkhaṇu  $  piẏa-bhattāru hojja mahu lakkhaṇu"
puṇu puṇu ema ṇamaṃsaï jāvĕhĩ  $  raẏaṇihĕ ve paharā huẏa tāvĕhĩ
saẏalu vi sāhaṇu ṇiddoṇallaü  $  ṇāvaï mohaṇa-jāleṃ pelliu
ṇiggaẏa puṇu vaṇamāla turantī  $  hāra-ḍora-ṇeurĕhĩ khalantī
hari-virahamvu-pūrĕ ubbhantī  $  vuṇṇa-kuraṅgi va cittubbhantī
ṇivisaddheṃ ṇaggohĕ valaggī  $  ramaṇa-cavala ṇaṃ goha-valaggī
ghattā:
rehaï dumĕ vaṇamāla kiha  $  ghaṇĕ vijju jiha  $  pahavantī lakkhaṇa-kaṅkhiṇi
    kilikilanti koḍḍāvaṇiẏa  $  bhīsāvaṇiẏa  $  paccakkha ṇāĩ vaḍa-jakkhiṇi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 6:
tahĩ vālaĕ kaluṇu pakandiẏaü  $  vaṇa-ḍimbhaü ṇaṃ pariandiẏaü
"āẏaṇṇahŏ vaẏaṇu vaṇassaïhŏ  $  gaṅgāṇaï-jaüṇa-sarassaïhŏ
gaha-bhūẏa-pisāẏahŏ vintarahŏ  $  vaṇa-jakkhahŏ rakkhahŏ kheẏarahŏ
gaẏa-vagghahŏ siṅghahŏ samvarahŏ  $  raẏaṇāẏara-girivara-jalaẏarahŏ
gaṇa-gandhavvahŏ vijjāharahŏ  $  sura-siddha-mahoraga-kiṇṇarahŏ
jama-khanda-kuvera-purandarahŏ  $  vuha-bhesaï-sukka-saṇiccharahŏ
hariṇaṅkahŏ akkahŏ joisahŏ  $  veẏāla-daïccahŏ rakkhasahŏ
vaïsāṇara-varuṇa-pahañjaṇahŏ  $  tahŏ ema kahijjahŏ lakkhaṇahŏ
ghattā:
vuccaï dhīẏa mahīharahŏ  $  dīhara-karahŏ  $  vaṇamāla-ṇāma bhaẏa-vajjiẏa
    lakkhaṇa-paï sumarantiẏaĕ  $  kandantiẏaĕ  $  vaḍa-pāẏavĕ pāṇa visajjiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 7:
ema bhaṇeppiṇu ṇaẏaṇa-visālaĕ  $  aṃsua-pāsaü kiu vaṇamālaĕ
so jjĕ ṇāĩ saĩ mambhīsāvaï  $  ṇāĩ vivāha-līla darisāvaï
ṇaṃ diẏavaru dāṇahŏ hakkāriu  $  ṇāĩ kumāreṃ hatthu pasāriu
galĕ lāĕvi hallāvaï jāvĕhĩ  $  kaṇṭheṃ dhariẏāliṅgĕvi tāvĕhĩ
ema pajampiu mambhīsantaü  $  "haũ so lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇavantaü
dasaraha-taṇaü sumittiĕ jāẏaü  $  rāmeṃ sahũ vaṇavāsahŏ āẏaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vimbhāviẏa ṇiẏa-maṇĕ  $  "kahĩ lakkhaṇu kahĩ acchiu uvavaṇĕ"
tāma halāuhu kokkaï laggaü  $  "bho bho lakkhaṇa āu kahĩ gaü"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi mahihara-suaĕ  $  pulaïẏa-bhuaĕ  $  ṇaḍu jiha ṇaccāviu ṇiẏa-maṇu
    "sahala maṇoraha ajju mahu  $  parihūu suhu (?)  $  bhattāru laddhu jaṃ lakkhaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 8:
to etthantarĕ bhuvaṇāṇandeṃ  $  diṭṭhu jaṇaddaṇu rāhavacandeṃ
ṇāvaï tamu dīvaẏa-siha-sahiẏaü  $  ṇāvaï jalaharu vijju-pagahiẏaü
ṇāvaï kari kariṇihĕ āsattaü  $  calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu valahŏ sa-kalattaü
"cāru cāru bho ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇa  $  kahĩ paĩ kaṇṇa laddha riumaddaṇa"
vuttu kumāreṃ "vijja va saguṇiẏa  $  dharaṇīdharahŏ dhīẏa kiṃ ṇa muṇiẏa
jā mahu puvvaẏaṇṇa-uvadiṭṭhī  $  sā vaṇamāla eha vaṇĕ diṭṭhī"
hari apphālaï jāva kahāṇaü  $  tāma ratti gaẏa vimalu vihāṇaü
suhaḍa viuddha kuddha jasa-luddhā  $  "keṇa vi laïẏa kaṇṇa" saṇṇaddhā
ghattā:
tāva ṇihāliẏa dujjaĕhĩ  $  puṇu raha-gaĕhĩ  $  cāuddisu cavala-turaṅgĕhĩ
    veḍhiẏa raṇaühĕ ve vi jaṇa  $  vala-mahumahaṇa  $  pañcāṇaṇa jema kuraṅgĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 9:
abbhiṭṭu seṇṇu kalaẏalu karantu  $  "jiha laïẏa kaṇṇa tiha haṇu" bhaṇantu
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu hari palittu  $  uddhāiu sihi ṇaṃ ghiĕṇa sittu
ekkallaü lakkhaṇu valu aṇantu  $  ālaggu to vi tiṇa-samu gaṇantu
parisakkaï thakkaï calaï valaï  $  taruvara ummūlĕvi seṇṇu dalaï
uvvaḍaï bhiḍaï pāḍaï turaṅga  $  mahi kamaï bhamaï bhāmaï rahaṅga
avagāhaï sāhaï dharaï joha  $  dalavaṭṭaï loṭṭaï gaẏavaroha
viṇivāiẏa dhāiẏa suhaḍa-thaṭṭa  $  kaḍuāviẏa vivarāmuha paẏaṭṭa
ṇāsanti ke vi je samarĕ cukka  $  kāẏara-ṇara-kara-paharaṇaĩ mukka
ghattā:
gampiṇu kahiu mahīharahŏ  $  "ekkahŏ ṇarahŏ  $  āvaṭṭu seṇṇu bhuva-daṇḍaĕ
     jiha ṇāsahi jima bhiḍu samarĕ  $  vihĩ ekku karĕ  $  vaṇamāla laïẏa valimaṇḍaĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 10:
 taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu tharaharantu  $  dharaṇīdharu dhāiu vipphurantu
ārūḍhu mahārahĕ diṇṇu saṅkhu  $  saṇṇaddhu kuddhu jaẏa-lacchi-kaṅkhu
to dujjaẏa duddhara duṇṇivāra  $  "haṇu haṇu" bhaṇanta ṇiggaẏa kumāra
vaṇamāla-kusuma-kallāṇamāla  $  jaẏamāla-sumāla-suvaṇṇamāla
gopāla-pāla iẏa aṭṭha bhāi  $  sahũ rāeṃ ṇava gaha kuiẏa ṇāĩ
etthantarĕ raṇĕ vahu-macchareṇa  $  hakkāriu lakkhaṇu mahihareṇa
"valu valu samaraṅgaṇĕ dehi jujjhu  $  ṇiẏa-ṇāmu gottu kahĕ kavaṇu tujjhu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi volliu lacchi-gehu  $  "kula-ṇāmahŏ avasaru kavaṇu ehu
ghattā:
paharu paharu jaṃ paĩ guṇiu  $  kiṇṇa vi muṇiu  $  jasu bhāi mahantaü rāmu
    rahukula-ṇandaṇu lacchi-haru  $  taü jīvaharu  $  ṇaravaï mahu lakkhaṇu ṇāmu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 29, Kaḍavaka 11:
kulu ṇāmu kahiu jaṃ sirihareṇa  $  dhaṇu ghattĕvi mahihĕ mahīhareṇa
surakari-kara-sama-bhua-pañjareṇa  $  avaruṇḍiu ṇeha-mahābhareṇa
havi sakkhikarĕvi aparāẏaṇāsu  $  saĩ diṇṇa kaṇṇa ṇārāẏaṇāsu
ārūḍhu mahīharu ekka-rahĕ  $  aṭṭha vi kumāra aṇṇekka-rahĕ
vaṇamāla sa-lakkhaṇa ekka-rahĕ  $  thiẏa sa-vala sīẏa aṇṇekka-rahĕ
paḍu-paḍaha-saṅkha-vaddhāvaṇehĩ  $  ṇaccantĕhĩ khujjaẏa-vāmaṇehĩ
ucchāhĕhĩ dhavalĕhĩ maṅgalehĩ  $  kaṃsālĕhĩ tālĕhĩ maddalehĩ
āṇandeṃ ṇaẏarĕ païṭṭhāĩ  $  līlaĕ atthāṇĕ vaïṭṭhāĩ
ghattā:
sahũ vaṇamālaĕ mahumahaṇu  $  parituṭṭha-maṇu  $  jaṃ veihĕ jantu padīsiu
   loĕhĩ maṅgalu gantaĕhĩ  $  ṇaccantaĕhĩ  $  jiṇu jammaṇĕ jiha sa iṃ bhū siu
----------  [30. tīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
tahĩ avasarĕ āṇanda-bharĕ  $  ucchāha-karĕ  $  jaẏakārahŏ kāraṇĕ ṇikkiu
bharahahŏ uppari uccaliu  $  rahasucchaliu  $  ṇaru ṇandāvatta-ṇarāhiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 1:
jo bharahahŏ dūu visajjiẏaü  $  āiu sammāṇa-vivajjiẏaü
lahu ṇandāvatta-ṇarāhivahŏ  $  vajjariu aṇantavīra-ṇivahŏ
"haũ pekkhu kema vicchāriẏaü  $  siru muṇḍĕvi kaha vi ṇa māriẏaü
so bharahu ṇa icchaï sandhi raṇĕ  $  jaṃ jāṇahŏ taṃ cintavahŏ maṇĕ
aṇṇu vi ukkhandheṃ āiẏaü  $  sahũ seṇṇeṃ viñjhu parāiẏaü
tahĩ ṇaravaï vālikhillu valiu  $  sīhoẏaru vajjaẏaṇṇu miliu
tahĩ ruddabhutti sirivaccha-dharu  $  marubhutti subhutti vibhutti-karu
avarehi mi samaü samāvaḍiu  $  pekkhesahi kallaĕ abbhiḍiu
ghattā:
tāma aṇantavīru khuhiu  $  païjāruhiu  $  "jaï kallaĕ bharahu ṇa mārami
    to arahanta-bhaḍārāhŏ  $  sura-sārāhŏ  $  ṇaü calaṇa-jualu jaẏakārami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 2:
païjārūḍhu ṇarāhiu jāvĕhĩ  $  sāhaṇu miliu asesu vi tāvĕhĩ
lehu liheppiṇu jaga-vikkhāẏahŏ  $  turiu visajjiu mahihara-rāẏahŏ
aggaĕ ghittu vaddhu lampikku va  $  hariṇakkharahĩ līṇu ṇaṇḍikku va
sundaru pattavantu vara-sāhu va  $  ṇāva-vahulu sari-gaṅga-pavāhu va
diṭṭha rāẏa tahĩ āẏa aṇanta vi  $  salla-visalla-sīhavikkanta vi
dujjaẏa-ajaẏa-vijaẏa-jaẏa-jaẏamuha  $  ṇarasaddūla-viula-gaẏa-gaẏamuha
ruddavaccha-mahivaccha-mahaddhaẏa  $  candaṇa-candoẏara-garuḍaddhaẏa
kesari-māricaṇḍa-jamaghaṇṭā  $  koṅkaṇa-malaẏa-paṇḍiẏāṇaṭṭā
gujjara-gaṅga-vaṅga-maṅgālā  $  païviẏa-pāriẏatta-pañcālā
sindhava-kāmarūva-gambhīrā  $  tajjiẏa-pārasīẏa-paratīrā
maru-kaṇṇāḍa-lāḍa-jālandhara  $  ṭakkāhīra-kīra-khasa-vavvara
avara vi je ekkekka-pahāṇā  $  keṇa gaṇeppiṇu sakkiẏa rāṇā
ghattā:
tāma ṇarāhiu kasaṇa-taṇu  $  thiu vimaṇa-maṇu  $  ṇaṃ paḍiu siratthalĕ vajju
      "kiha sāmiẏa-sammāṇa-bharu  $  visahiu duddharu  $  kiha bharahahŏ pahariu ajju"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 3:
jaṃ ṇaravaï maṇĕ cintāviẏaü  $  halaharu ekkanta-pakkhĕ thiẏaü
aṭṭha vi kumāra kokkiẏa khaṇĕṇa  $  vaïdehi āẏa sahũ lakkhaṇĕṇa
melleppiṇu mantiu mantaṇaü  $  valu bhaṇaï "ma darisahŏ appaṇaü
raha-turaẏa-mahāgaẏa pariharĕvi  $  tiẏa-cāraṇa-gāẏaṇa-vesu karĕvi
taṃ riu-atthāṇu paīsarahŏ  $  ṇaccanta aṇantavīru dharahŏ"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi parituṭṭha-maṇa  $  thiẏa kāmiṇi-vesa kiẏāharaṇa
valaeveṃ joiu piẏa-vaẏaṇu  $  kiṃ hoi ṇa hoi vesa-gahaṇu
"laï sundari tāva tiṭṭha ṇaẏarĕ  $  amhĕhĩ puṇu jujjhevaü samarĕ"
ghattā:
lagga kaḍacchaĕ jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  kaṇṭaïẏa-bhuẏa  $  "lahu ṇaravara-ṇāha ṇa esahi
    maĩ mellĕvi bhāsuraĕ  $  raṇa-sāsuraĕ  $  mā kitti-vahua pariṇesahi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 4:
kheḍḍu karĕvi saṃcalla mahāiẏa  $  ṇiviseṃ ṇandāvattu parāiẏa
diṭṭhu jiṇālaü khaṇĕ pariañcĕvi  $  aggaĕ gāĕvi vāĕvi ṇaccĕvi
sīẏa ṭhavĕvi païṭṭha pura-saravarĕ  $  rahavara-turaẏa-mahāgaẏa-jalaẏarĕ
deula-vahala-dhavala-kamalāẏarĕ  $  ṇandaṇavaṇa-ghaṇa-tīra-laẏāharĕ
cāru-vilāsiṇi-ṇaliṇi-karamviĕ  $  chappaṇṇaẏa-chappaẏa-paricumviĕ
sajjaṇa-ṇimmala-salilālaṅkiĕ  $  pisuṇa-vaẏaṇa-ghaṇa-paṅkuppaṅkiĕ
kāmiṇi-cala-maṇa-macchutthalliĕ  $  ṇaravara-haṃsa-saehĩ amelliĕ
tahĩ tehaĕ pura-saravarĕ dujjaẏa  $  līlaĕ ṇāĩ païṭṭha disāgaẏa
ghattā:
kāmiṇi-vesa kiẏāharaṇa  $  vihasiẏa-vaẏaṇa  $  gaẏa patta tetthu paḍihāru
   vuccaï "āẏaĩ cāraṇaĩ  $  bharahahŏ taṇaĩ  $  jiva kahĕ jiva dei païsāru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi paḍihāru gaü  $  viṇṇattu ṇarāhiu raṇĕ ajaü
"pahu ettaĩ gāẏaṇa āẏāĩ  $  phuḍu māṇusa-mettĕṇa jāẏāĩ
ṇaü jāṇahũ kiṃ vijjāharaĩ  $  kiṃ gandhavvaĩ kiṃ kiṇṇaraĩ
aï-susaraĩ jaṇa-maṇa-mohaṇaĩ  $  muṇivarahu mi maṇa-saṃkhohaṇaĩ"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi ṇarāhivĕṇa  $  "de de païsāru" vuttu ṇivĕṇa
paḍihāru padhāiu tuṭṭha-maṇu  $  "païsarahŏ" bhaṇantu kaṇṭaïẏa-taṇu
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi samuccaliẏa  $  ṇaṃ dasa disi-vaha ekkahĩ miliẏa
ghattā:
païṭha ṇarindatthāṇa-vaṇĕ  $  riu-rukkha-ghaṇĕ  $  siṃhāsaṇa-girivara-maṇḍiĕ
    poḍha-vilāsiṇi-laẏa-vahalĕ  $  vara-vellahalĕ  $  aï-vīra-sīha-paricaḍḍiĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 6:
tahĩ tehaĕ riu-atthāṇa-vaṇĕ  $  pañcāṇaṇa jema païṭṭha khaṇĕ
ṇandiẏaḍa-ṇarāhiu diṭṭhu kiha  $  ṇakkhattahã majjhĕ miẏaṅku jiha
ārambhiu aggaĕ pekkhaṇaü  $  sukalattu va savalu salakkhaṇaü
suraẏaṃ piva vandha-karaṇa-pavaru  $  kavvaṃ piva chanda-sadda-gahiru
raṇṇaṃ piva vaṃsa-tāla-sahiu  $  jujjhaṃ piva rāẏa-seẏa-sahiu
jiha jiha uvvellaï hala-vahaṇu  $  tiha tiha appāṇu ṇavei jaṇu
maẏaraddhaẏa-sara-saṃkhohiẏaü  $  miga-ṇivahu va geeṃ mohiẏaü
valu paḍhaï aṇantavīru suṇaï  $  "ko sīheṃ samaü keli kuṇaï
ghattā:
jāma ṇa raṇamuhĕ uttharaï  $  paharaṇu dharaï  $  paĩ jīvagāhu sahũ rāĕhĩ
    tāma aẏāṇa muevi chalu  $  pariharĕvi valu  $  paḍu bharaha-ṇarindahŏ pāĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 7:
rāhavacandu maṇeṇa ṇa kampiu  $  puṇu puṇaruttĕhĩ eva pajampiu
"bho bho ṇaravaï bharahu ṇamantahũ  $  kavaṇu parāhaü kira aṇuṇantahũ
jo para-vala-samuddĕ mahaṇāẏaï  $  jo para-vala-miẏaṅkĕ gahaṇāẏaï
jo para-vala-gaẏaṇĕhĩ candāẏaï  $  jo para-vala-gaïndĕ sīhāẏaï
jo para-vala-raẏaṇihĩ haṃsāẏaï  $  jo para-vala-turaṅgĕ mahisāẏaï
jo para-vala-bhuẏaṅgĕ garuḍāẏaï  $  jo para-vala-vaṇohĕ jalaṇāẏaï
jo para-vala-ghaṇohĕ pavaṇāẏaï  $  jo para-vala-pavaṇohĕ dharāẏaï
 $  jo para-vala-dharohĕ vajjāẏaï
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi viruddhaĕṇa  $  maṇĕ kuddhaĕṇa  $  aïvīreṃ ahara-phuranteṃ
    rattuppala-dala-loẏaṇĕṇa  $  jaga-bhoẏaṇĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ kiu avalou kiẏanteṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 8:
bhaẏa-bhīsaṇu amarisa-kuiẏa-dehu  $  gajjantu samuṭṭhiu jema mehu
karĕ asivaru lei ṇa lei jāma  $  ṇahĕ uḍḍĕvi rāmeṃ dhariu tāma
sirĕ pāu devi coru va ṇivaddhu  $  ṇaṃ vāraṇu vāri-ṇivandhĕ chuddhu
riu campĕvi para-vala-maïẏavaṭṭu  $  jiṇa-bhavaṇahŏ sammuhu valu paẏaṭṭu
etthantarĕ mahumahaṇeṇa vuttu  $  "jo ḍhukkaï taṃ mārami ṇiruttu"
taṃ suṇĕvi paropparu riu cavanti  $  "kiṃ eẏa parakkama tiẏahã honti"
ettaḍiẏa volla paḍivakkhĕ  jāma  $  ṇara dasa vi jiṇālaü patta tāma
je giliẏa āsi pura-rakkhaseṇa  $  ṇaṃ mukka paḍīvā bhaẏa-vaseṇa
ghattā:
tāvanteuru vimaṇa-maṇu  $  gaẏa-gaï-gamaṇu  $  vahu-hāra-dora-khuppantaü
    āẏaü pāsu jiẏāhavahŏ  $  tahŏ rāhavahŏ  $  "de daïẏa-bhikkha" maggantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ eva vuttu vaṇiẏāẏaṇeṇa  $  pahu pabhaṇiu dasaraha-ṇandaṇeṇa
"jaï bharahahŏ hohi subhiccu ajju  $  to ajju vi laï appaṇaü rajju"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi paraloẏa-bhīru  $  vihaseppiṇu bhaṇaï aṇantavīru
"pāḍevaü jo calaṇehĩ ṇiccu  $  tahŏ kema paḍīvaü homi bhiccu
valimaṇḍaĕ tava-caraṇeṇa jo vi  $  pāḍevaü pāẏahĩ bharahu to vi"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu tuṭṭhu rāmu  $  "saccaü jĕ tujjhu aïvīru ṇāmu"
puṇaruttĕhĩ vuccaï "sāhu sāhu"  $  hakkāriu tahŏ suu sahasavāhu
so ṇiẏa-saṃtāṇahŏ raïu rāu  $  aṇṇu vi bharahahŏ pāikku jāu
ghattā:
riu melleppiṇu dasa vi jaṇa  $  gaẏa tuṭṭha-maṇa  $  ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru parāiẏa jāvĕhĩ
    ṇandāvatta-ṇarāhivaï  $  jiṇĕ karĕvi maï  $  dikkhahã samuṭṭhiu tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 10:
etthantarĕ pura-paramesarāhã  $  dikkhāĕ samuṭṭhiu saü ṇarāhã

garuḍaddhaẏa-maẏaraddhaẏa-pacaṇḍa  $  candaṇa-candoẏara-māricaṇḍa
jaẏaghaṇṭa-mahaddhaẏa-canda-sūra  $  jaẏa-vijaẏa-ajaẏa-dujjaẏa-kukūra
iẏa ettiẏa pahu pavvaïẏa tetthu  $  lāhaṇa-pavvaĕ jaẏa-ṇandi jetthu
thiẏa pañca muṭṭhi sirĕ lou devi  $  saĩ vāhahĩ āharaṇaĩ muevi
ṇīsaṅga vi thiẏa risi-saṅgha-sahiẏa  $  saṃsāra vi bhava-saṃsāra-rahiẏa
ṇimmāṇa vi jīva-saẏahũ samāṇa  $  ṇiggantha vi gantha-paẏattha-jāṇa
ghattā:
iẏa ekkekka-pahāṇa risi  $  bhava-timira-sasi  $  tava-sūra mahāvaẏa-dhārā
    chaṭṭhaṭṭhama-dasa-vārasĕhĩ  $  vahu-uvavasĕhĩ  $  appāṇu khavanti bhaḍārā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 30, Kaḍavaka 11:
tava-caraṇĕ pariṭṭhiu jaṃ ji rāu  $  tahŏ vandaṇa-hattiĕ bharahu āu
teṃ diṭṭhu bhaḍāraü teẏa-piṇḍu  $  jo moha-mahīharĕ vajja-daṇḍu
jo koha-huvāsaṇĕ jala-ṇihāu  $  jo maẏaṇa-mahāghaṇĕ palaẏa-vāu
jo dappa-gaïndĕ mahā-maïndu  $  jo māṇa-bhuaṅgamĕ vara-khagindu
so muṇivaru dasaraha-ṇandaṇeṇa  $  vandiu ṇiẏa-garahaṇa-ṇindaṇeṇa
"bho sāhu sāhu gambhīra dhīra  $  paĩ pūriẏa païjā 'ṇantavīra
jaṃ pāḍiu haũ calaṇehĩ deva  $  taṃ tihuaṇu kārāviẏaü seva
gaü ema pasaṃsĕvi bharahu rāu  $  ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru pattu sāhaṇa-sahāu
ghattā:
hari-vala païṭha jiẏantapurĕ  $  dhaṇa-kaṇa-paürĕ  $  jaẏa-maṅgala-tūra-vamālĕhĩ
    lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇavantiẏaĕ  $  ṇiẏa-pattiẏaĕ  $  avagūḍhu sa iṃ bhu va-ḍālĕhĩ
----------  [31. ekkatīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
dhaṇa-dhaṇṇa-samiddhahŏ  $  puhaï-pasiddhahŏ  $  jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇahŏ
vaṇa-vāsahŏ jantĕhĩ  $  rāmāṇantĕhĩ  $  kiu ummāhaü paṭṭaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 1:
chuḍu chuḍu uhaẏa samāgama-luddhaĩ  $  risi-kulaĩ va paramāgama-luddhaĩ
chuḍu chuḍu avaropparu aṇurattaĩ  $  sañjha-divāẏaraĩ va aṇurattaĩ
chuḍu chuḍu ahiṇava-vahu-varaïttaĩ  $  soma-pahā iva sundara-cittaĩ
chuḍu chuḍu cumviẏa-tāmarasāĩ  $  phullandhaẏa iva luddha-rasāĩ
tāma kumāreṃ ṇaẏaṇa-visālā  $  janteṃ āucchiẏa vaṇamālā
"he mālūra-pavara-pīvara-thaṇĕ  $  kuvalaẏa-dala-papphulliẏa-loaṇĕ
haṃsa-gamaṇĕ gaẏa-līla-vilāsiṇi  $  canda-vaẏaṇĕ ṇiẏa-ṇāma-pagāsiṇi
jāmi kantĕ haũ dāhiṇa-desahŏ  $  giri-kikkindha-ṇaẏara-uddesahŏ
ghattā:
suravara-varaïtteṃ  $  ṇava-varaïtteṃ  $  jaṃ āucchiẏa ṇiẏaẏa dhaṇa
    ohulliẏa-vaẏaṇī  $  pagaliẏa-ṇaẏaṇī  $  thiẏa heṭṭhāmuha vimaṇa-maṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 2:
kajjala-vahaluppīla-saṇāheṃ  $  mahi pavvāliẏa aṃsu-pavāheṃ
"ettiu viruvaü māṇusa-lou  $  jaṃ jara-jammaṇa-maraṇa-viou
dhīriẏa lakkhaṇeṇa etthantarĕ  $  "rāmahŏ ṇilaü karevi vaṇantarĕ
kaïhi mi diṇĕhĩ paḍīvaü āvami  $  saẏala sa-sāẏara mahi bhuñjāvami
jaï puṇu kahavi tula-laggĕ ṇāẏaü  $  haũ ṇa homi somittiĕ jāẏaü
aṇṇu vi raẏaṇihĕ jo bhuñjantaü  $  maṃsa-bhakkhi mahu majju piẏantaü
jīva vahantaü aliu cavantaü  $  para-dhaṇĕ para-kalatteṃ aṇurattaü
jo ṇaru āĕhĩ vasaṇĕhĩ bhuttaü  $  haũ pāveṇa teṇa saṃjuttaü
ghattā:
jaï ema vi ṇāvami  $  vaẏaṇu ṇa dāvami  $  to ṇivvūḍha-mahāhavahŏ
    ṇava-kamala-sukomala  $  ṇaha-paha-ujjala  $  chitta pāẏa maĩ rāhavahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 3:
vaṇamāla ṇiẏattĕvi bhaggamāṇa  $  gaẏa lakkhaṇa-rāma supujjamāṇa
thovantarĕ macchutthalla denti  $  golā-ṇaï diṭṭha samuvvahanti
suṃsuara-ghora-ghurughuruhuranti  $  kari-maẏaraḍḍohiẏa-ḍuhuḍuhanti
ḍiṇḍīra-saṇḍa-maṇḍaliu denti  $  dadduraẏa-raḍiẏa-duruduruduranti
kallolullolahĩ uvvahanti  $  ugghosa-ghosa-ghavaghavaghavanti
paḍikhalaṇa-valaṇa-khalakhalakhalanti  $  khalakhaliẏa-khaḍakka-jhaḍakka denti
sasi-saṅkha-kunda-dhavalojjhareṇa  $  kāraṇḍuḍḍāviẏa-ḍamvareṇa
ghattā:
pheṇāvali-vaṅkiẏa  $  valaẏālaṅkiẏa  $  ṇaṃ mahi-kulavahuahĕ taṇiẏa
    jalaṇihi-bhattārahŏ  $  mottiẏa-hārahŏ  $  vāha pasāriẏa dāhiṇiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 4:
thovantarĕ vala-ṇārāẏaṇehĩ  $  khemañjali-paṭṭaṇu diṭṭhu tehĩ
aridamaṇu ṇarāhiu vasaï jetthu  $  aïcaṇḍu paẏaṇḍu ṇa ko vi tetthu
rajjesaru jo savvahã variṭṭhu  $  so pahu pahiẏāha mi mūlĕ diṭṭhu
ṇaha-bhāsuru jo laṅgūla-dīhu  $  so māẏaṅgehi mi laïu sīhu
jo duddama-dāṇava-simira-cūru  $  so tiẏa-muhaẏandahŏ tasaï sūru
jaṃ rāẏahã taṃ chattaha mi chittu  $  jaṃ suhaḍahã taṃ kuḍḍaha mi cittu
tahŏ ṇaẏarahŏ thiu avaruttareṇa  $  ujjāṇu addha-kosantareṇa
suraseharu ṇāmeṃ jagĕ paẏāsu  $  ṇaṃ aggha-vihatthaü thiu valāsu
ghattā:
tahĩ tehaĕ uvavaṇĕ  $  ṇava-taruvara-ghaṇĕ  $  jahĩ amarindu raï karaï
    tahĩ ṇilaü kareppiṇu  $  ve vi thaveppiṇu  $  lakkhaṇu ṇaẏarĕ paīsaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 5:
païsanteṃ pura-vāhirĕ karālu  $  bhaḍa-maḍaẏa-puñju dīsaï visālu
sasi-saṅkha-kunda-hima-duddha-dhavalu  $  harahāra-haṃsa-saraẏabbha-vimalu
taṃ pekkhĕvi lahu harisiẏa-maṇeṇa  $  govāla papucchiẏa lakkhaṇeṇa
"iu dīsaï kāĩ mahā-paẏaṇḍu  $  ṇaṃ ṇimmalu himagiri-sihara-khaṇḍu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi govahĩ vuttu ema  $  "kiṃ eha vatta paĩ ṇa sua deva
aridamaṇa-dhīẏa jiẏapaüma-ṇāma  $  bhaḍa-thaḍa-saṃghāraṇi jiha duṇāma
sā ajja vi acchaï vara-kumāri  $  paccakkha ṇāĩ āiẏa ku-māri
tahĕ kāraṇĕ jo jo maraï johu  $  so ghippaï taṃ haḍḍa ïri ehu
ghattā:
jo ghaĩ avagaṇṇĕvi  $  tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi  $  pañca vi sattiu dharaï ṇaru
    paḍivakkha-vimaddaṇu  $  ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu  $  so para hosaï tāhĕ varu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu duṇṇivāru  $  romañciu khaṇĕ lakkhaṇa-kumāru
viẏaḍa-ppaẏa-chohĕhĩ puṇu paẏaṭṭu  $  ṇaṃ kesari maẏagala-maïẏavaṭṭu
katthaï kappadduma diṭṭha teṇa  $  ṇaṃ panthiẏa thiẏa ṇaẏarāsaeṇa
katthaï mālaï-kusumaĩ khivanti  $  sīsa va sukaïhĕ jasu vikkhiranti
katthaï lakkhaï saravara vicitta  $  avagāhiẏa sīẏala jiha sumitta
katthaï gorasu savvahã rasāhũ  $  ṇaṃ ṇiggaü māṇu harevi tāhũ
katthaï āvāha ḍajjhanti kema  $  dujjaṇa-duvvaẏaṇĕhĩ suẏaṇa jema
katthaï arahaṭṭa bhamanti kema  $  saṃsāriẏa bhava-saṃsārĕ jema
ṇaṃ dhaü hakkāraï "ehi ehi  $  bho lakkhaṇa lahu jiẏapaüma lehi"
ghattā:
vārubbhaḍa-vaẏaṇeṃ  $  dīhiẏa-ṇaẏaṇeṃ  $  deula-dāḍhā-bhāsurĕṇa
      ṇaṃ giliu jaṇaddaṇu  $  asura-vimaddaṇu  $  entaü ṇaẏara-ṇisāẏarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 7:
pāẏāra-bhuĕhĩ puraṇāĩteṇa  $  avaruṇḍiu lakkhaṇu ṇāĩ teṇa
katthaï kumbhā sahu ṇāḍaehĩ  $  ṇa ṇaḍa ṇāṇāviha-ṇāḍaehĩ
katthaï vaṃsāri samuddha-vaṃsa  $  ṇāvaï su-kulīṇa visuddha-vaṃsa
katthaï dhaẏa-vaḍa ṇaccanti ema  $  vari amhi surāẏara saggĕ jema
katthaï lohārĕhĩ lohakhaṇḍu  $  piṭṭijjaï ṇaraĕ va pāvapiṇḍu
taṃ haṭṭamaggu mellĕvi kumāru  $  ṇiviseṇa parāiu rāẏavāru
paḍihāru vuttu "kahi gampi ema  $  varu vuccaï āiu ekku deva
jiẏapaümahĕ māṇa-maraṭṭa-dalaṇu  $  para-vala-masakku dariẏāri-damaṇu
riu-saṃghāẏahŏ saṃghāẏa-karaṇu  $  sahũ sattihĩ tujjhu vi satti-haraṇu
ghattā:
(aha) kiṃ vahueṃ jampiĕṇa  $  ṇipphala-caviĕṇa  $  ema bhaṇahi taṃ aridamaṇu
    dasa-vīsa ṇa pucchaï  $  saü vi paḍicchaï  $  pañcahã sattihĩ ko gahaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi gaü paḍihāru tetthu  $  saha-maṇḍavĕ so aridamaṇu jetthu
paṇaveppiṇu vuccaï teṇa rāu  $  "paramesara viṇṇattiĕ pasāu
bhaḍu kāleṃ coiu āu ikku  $  ṇa muṇahũ kiṃ akku miẏaṅku sakku
kiṃ kusumāuhu atuliẏa-paẏāu  $  para pañca vāṇa ṇaü ekku cāu
tahŏ ṇarahŏ ṇavallī bhaṅgi kā vi  $  phiṭṭaï ṇa lacchi aṅgahŏ kaẏāvi
so cavaï ema jiẏapaüma lemi  $  kiṃ pañcahĩ dasa sattiu dharemi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pabhaṇaï sattudamaṇu  $  "pekkhami kokkahi varaïttu kavaṇu"
paḍihāreṃ saddiu āu kaṇhu  $  jaẏalacchi-pasāhiu jujjha-taṇhu
ghattā:
accubbhaḍa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ  $  dīhara-ṇaẏaṇĕhĩ  $  ṇaravaï-vindahĩ dujjaehĩ
    lakkhijjaï lakkhaṇu  $  entu sa-lakkhaṇu  $  jema maïndu mahāgaĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 9:
lakkhaṇu pāsu parāiu jaṃ je  $  vuttu ṇiveṇa haseppiṇu taṃ je
"ko jiẏapaüma laevi samatthu  $  keṇa huvāsaṇĕ ḍhoiu hatthu
keṇa sireṇa paḍicchiu vajju  $  keṇa kiẏantu vi ghāiu ajju
keṇa ṇahaṅgaṇu chittu karaggeṃ  $  keṇa surindu parajjiu bhoggeṃ
keṇa vasundhari dāriẏa pāeṃ  $  keṇa paloṭṭiu diggaü ghāeṃ
keṇa surehahŏ bhaggu visāṇu  $  keṇa talappaĕ pāḍiu bhāṇu
laṅghiu keṇa samuddu asesu  $  keṃ phaṇa-maṇḍavĕ cūriu sesu
keṇa pahañjaṇu vaddhu paḍeṇa  $  meru-mahāgiri ṭāliu keṇa
ghattā:
jiha tuhũ tiha aṇṇa vi  $  ṇīsāvaṇṇa vi  $  garuẏaĩ gajjiẏa vahuẏa ṇara
    mahu satti-pahārĕhĩ  $  raṇĕ duvvārĕhĩ  $  kiẏa saẏa-sakkara diṭṭha para"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 10:
aridamaṇeṃ bhaḍu jaṃ ahikhittu  $  mahumahu jema davaggi palittu
"haũ jiẏapaüma laevi samatthu  $  maĩ ji huāsaṇĕ ḍhoiu hatthu
maĩ ji sireṇa paḍicchiu vajju  $  maĩ ji kiẏantu vi ghāiu ajju
maĩ ji ṇahaṅgaṇu chittu karaggeṃ  $  maĩ ji surindu parajjiu bhoggeṃ
maĩ ji vasundhari dāriẏa pāeṃ  $  maĩ ji paloṭṭiu diggaü ghāeṃ
maĩ ji surehahŏ bhaggu visāṇu  $  maĩ ji talappaĕ pāḍiu bhāṇu
laṅghiu maĩ ji samuddu asesu  $  maĩ phaṇa-maṇḍavĕ cūriu sesu
maĩ ji pahañjaṇu vaddhu paḍeṇa  $  meru-mahāgiri ṭāliu jeṇa
ghattā:
haũ tihuaṇa-ḍāmaru  $  haũ ajarāmaru  $  haũ tettīsahũ raṇĕ ajaü
    khemañjali-rāṇā  $  avuha aẏāṇā  $  melli satti jaï satti taü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi khemañjali-rāṇaü  $  uṭṭhiu galagajjantu pahāṇaü
satti-vihatthaü satti-pagāsaṇu  $  dhagadhagadhagadhagantu sa-huāsaṇu
amvarĕ teẏa-piṇḍu ṇaü diṇaẏaru  $  ṇiẏa-majjāẏa-cattu ṇaü sāẏaru
jaṇĕ aṇavaraẏa-dāṇu ṇaü maẏagalu  $  paramaṇḍala-viṇāsu ṇaü maṇḍalu
rāmāẏaṇahŏ majjhĕ ṇaü rāmaṇu  $  bhīma-sarīru ṇa bhīmu bhaẏāvaṇu
teṇa vimukka satti govindahŏ  $  ṇaṃ himavanteṃ gaṅga samuddahŏ
dhāiẏa dhagadhaganti samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  ṇaṃ taḍi taḍaẏaḍanti ṇaha-aṅgaṇĕ
suravara ṇahĕ vollanti paropparu  $  "eṇa pahāreṃ jīvaï dukkaru"
ghattā:
etthantarĕ kaṇheṃ  $  jaẏa-jasa-taṇheṃ  $  dhariẏa satti dāhiṇa-kareṇa
    saṃkeẏahŏ ḍhukkī  $  thāṇahŏ cukkī  $  ṇāvaï para-tiẏa para-ṇareṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 12:
dhariẏa satti jaṃ samarĕ samattheṃ  $  melliu kusuma-vāsu sura-sattheṃ
puṇṇima-indu-runda-muha-somahĕ  $  keṇa vi kahiu gampi jiẏapomahĕ
"sundari pekkhu pekkhu jujjhantahŏ  $  ṇokhī kā vi bhaṅgi varaïttahŏ
jā taü tāeṃ satti visajjiẏa  $  lagga hatthĕ asaï vvālajjiẏa
ṇara-bhamareṇa eṇa akalaṅkaü  $  para cumvevaü tuha muha-paṅkaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu vihasiẏa-vaẏaṇaĕ  $  ṇava-kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-ṇaẏaṇaĕ
jāla-gavakkhaĕ jo antara-paḍu  $  ṇāĩ sahattheṃ pheḍiu muha-vaḍu
lakkhaṇu ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhiu kaṇṇaĕ  $  ṇaṃ jujjhantu ṇivāriu saṇṇaĕ
tāma kumāreṃ diṭṭhu sudaṃsaṇu  $  dhavalaharamvarĕ muha-maẏalañchaṇu
suha-ṇakkhattĕ sujoggĕ suhaṅkaru  $  ṇaẏaṇāmelaü jāu paropparu
ghattā:
etthantarĕ duṭṭheṃ  $  mukkāruṭṭheṃ  $  lahu aṇṇekka satti ṇarĕṇa
      sa vi dhariẏa saraggeṃ  $  vāma-karaggeṃ  $  ṇāvaï ṇava-vahu ṇava-varĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 13:
aṇṇekka mukka vahu-macchareṇa  $  vajjāsaṇi ṇāĩ purandareṇa
sa hi dāhiṇa-kakkhahĩ chuddha teṇa  $  avaruṇḍiẏa vesa va kāmueṇa
aṇṇekka visajjiẏa dhagadhaganti  $  ṇaṃ sihi-siha jālā-saẏa muanti
sa vi dhariẏa enti ṇārāẏaṇeṇa  $  vāmaddheṃ gori va tiṇaẏaṇeṇa
ṇaṃ mahiharu devaïṇandaṇeṇa  $  pañcamiẏa mukka vahu-macchareṇa
pammukka padhāiẏa ṇaravarāsu  $  ṇaṃ kanta sukantahŏ suhaẏarāsu
sa visāṇĕhĩ enti ṇiruddha kema  $  ṇava-suraẏa-samāgamĕ juvaï jema
etthantarĕ devahĩ lakkhaṇāsu  $  sirĕ mukka paḍīvaü kusuma-vāsu
aridamaṇu ṇa sohaï satti-hīṇu  $  khala-kupurisu vva thiu satti-hīṇu
ghattā:
hari romañciẏa-taṇu  $  sahaï sa-paharaṇu  $  raṇa-muhĕ parisakkantu kiha
      rattuppala-loẏaṇu  $  rasa-vasa-bhoẏaṇu  $  pañcāuhu veẏālu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 14:
samaraṅgaṇĕ asura-parāẏaṇeṇa  $  aridamaṇu vuttu  ṇārāẏaṇeṇa
"khala khudda pisuṇa macchariẏa rāẏa  $  maĩ jema paḍicchiẏa pañca ghāẏa
tiha tuhu mi paḍicchahi ekka satti  $  jaï atthi kā vi maṇĕ maṇusa-satti"
kira ema bhaṇeppiṇu haṇaï jāma  $  jiẏapaümaĕ ghattiẏa māla tāma
"bho sāhu sāhu raṇĕ duṇṇirikkha  $  maṃ paharu deva dei jaṇaṇa-bhikkha
jeṃ samarĕ parajjiu sattudamaṇu  $  paĩ muĕvi aṇṇu varaïttu kavaṇu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu lakkhaṇeṇa  $  āuddhaĩ ghittaĩ takkhaṇeṇa
mukkāuhu gaü aridamaṇa-pāsu  $  sahasakkhu va paṇaviu jiṇavarāsu
ghattā:
"jaṃ amarisa-kuddheṃ  $  jaẏa-jasa-luddheṃ  $  vippiu kiu tumhehĩ sahũ
    aṇṇu vi rekāriu  $  kaha vi ṇa māriu  $  taṃ marusejjahi māma mahu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 15:
khemañjalipura-paramesareṇa  $  somitti vuttu rajjesareṇa
"kiṃ jampieṇa vahu-amariseṇa  $  laï laïẏa kaṇṇa paĩ paüriseṇa
tuhũ dīsahi daṇu-māhappa-cappu  $  kahĕ kavaṇu gottu kā māẏa vappu"
mahumahaṇu pavolliu "ṇisuṇi rāẏa  $  mahu dasarahu tāu sumitti māẏa
aṇṇu vi paẏaḍaü ikkhakku-vaṃsu  $  vaḍḍāraü jiha taruvarahŏ vaṃsu
ve amhaĩ lakkhaṇa-rāma bhāẏa  $  vaṇavāsahŏ rajju muevi āẏa
ujjāṇĕ tuhāraĕ asura-maddu  $  sahũ sīẏaĕ acchaï rāmabhaddu"
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa kaṇṭaïu rāu  $  saṃcallu ṇavara sāhaṇa-sahāu
ghattā:
jaṇa-maṇa-parioseṃ  $  tūra-ṇighoseṃ  $  ṇaravaï kahi mi ṇa māiẏaü
    jahĩ rāmu sa-bhajjaü  $  vāhu-sahejjaü  $  taṃ uddesu parāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 31, Kaḍavaka 16:
etthantarĕ para-vala-bhaḍa-ṇisāmu  $  uṭṭhiu jaṇa-ṇivahu ṇievi rāmu
karĕ dhaṇuharu lei ṇa lei jāma  $  sakalattaü lakkhaṇu diṭṭhu tāma
suravaï va sa-bhajjaü rahĕ ṇiviṭṭhu  $  aṇṇekku pāsĕ aridamaṇu diṭṭhu
sandaṇahŏ tareppiṇu duṇṇivāru  $  rāmahŏ calaṇĕhĩ ṇivaḍiu kumāru
jiẏapaüma sa-vibbhama paüma-calaṇa(?)  $  paümacchi paphulliẏa-paüma-vaẏaṇa
paümahŏ paẏa-paümĕhĩ paḍiẏa kaṇṇa  $  teṇa vi su-pasatthāsīsa diṇṇa
etthantarĕ māmeṃ ṇa kiu kheu  $  kaṇaẏa-rahĕ caḍāviu rāmaeu
paḍu paḍaha pahaẏa kiẏa-kalaẏalehĩ  $  ucchāhĕhĩ dhavalĕhĩ maṅgalĕhĩ
ghattā:
rahĕ ekkĕ ṇiviṭṭhaĩ  $  ṇaẏarĕ païṭṭhaĩ  $  sīẏa-valaĩ valavantāĩ
    ṇārāẏaṇu ṇāri vi  $  thiẏaĩ caẏāri vi  $  rajju sa iṃ bhu ñja nta ĩ
----------  [32. vattīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
halahara-cakkahara  $  paracakka-hara  $  jiṇavara-sāsaṇĕ aṇurāiẏa
muṇi-uvasaggu jahĩ  $  viharanta tahĩ  $  vaṃsatthalu ṇaẏaru parāiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 1:
tāma visanthulu pāṇakkantaü  $  diṭṭhu asesu vi jaṇu ṇāsantaü
dummaṇu dīṇa-vaẏaṇu viddāṇaü  $  gaü vicchatta va galiẏa-visāṇaü
paṇṇaẏa-ṇivahu va phaṇimaṇi-toḍiu  $  giri-ṇivahu va vajjāsaṇi-phoḍiu
paṅkaẏa-saṇḍu va hima-pavaṇāhaü  $  ubbhaḍa-vaẏaṇu samubbhiẏa-vāhaü
jaṇavaü jaṃ ṇāsantu padīsiu  $  rāhavacandeṃ puṇu mambhīsiu
"thakkahŏ maṃ bhajjahŏ maṃ bhajjahŏ  $  abhaü abhaü bhaü saẏalu vivajjahŏ"
tāma diṭṭhu okhaṇḍiẏa-māṇaü  $  ṇāsantaü vaṃsatthala-rāṇaü
teṇa vuttu "maṃ ṇaẏarĕ paīsahŏ  $  tiṇṇi mi pāṇa laeppiṇu ṇāsahŏ
ghattā:
ettiu etthu purĕ  $  girivara-siharĕ  $  jo uṭṭhaï ṇāu bhaẏaṅkaru
    teṇa mahantu ḍaru  $  ṇivaḍanti taru  $  mandiraĩ janti saẏa-sakkaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 2:
ĕu dīsaï girivara-siharu jetthu  $  uvasaggu bhaẏaṅkaru hoi tetthu
vāoli dhūli duvvāi ei  $  pāhaṇa paḍanti mahi tharaharei
dhara bhamaï samuṭṭhaï sīha-ṇāu  $  varisanti meha ṇivaḍaï ṇihāu
teṃ kajjeṃ ṇāsaï saẏalu lou  $  maṃ tumha vi uhu uvasaggu hou"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi sīẏa maṇĕ kampiẏa  $  bhīẏa-visanthula eva pajampiẏa
"amhahũ deseṃ desu bhamantahũ  $  kavaṇu parāhaü kira ṇāsantahũ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi bhaṇaï dāmoẏaru  $  "volliu kāĩ māĕ paĩ kāẏaru
vihi mi jāma karĕ atula-paẏāvaĩ  $  sāẏara-vajjāvattaïṃ cāvaĩ
jāma vihi mi jaẏa-lacchi pariṭṭhiẏa  $  toṇīrahĩ ṇārāẏa ahiṭṭhiẏa
tāma māĕ tuhũ kahŏ āsaṅkahi  $  viharu viharu mā muhu ovaṅkahi
ghattā:
dhīrĕvi jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  kovaṇḍa-bhuẏa  $  saṃcalla ve vi vala-kesava
      saggahŏ avaẏariẏa  $  saï-pariẏariẏa  $  inda-paḍinda-suresa va
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 3:
pahantarĕ bhaẏaṅkaro  $  jhasāla-chiṇṇa-kakkaro
valo vva siṅga-dīharo  $  ṇiẏacchio mahīharo
kahĩ jĕ bhīma-kandaro  $  jharanta-ṇīra-ṇijjharo
kahĩ ji rattacandaṇo  $  tamāla-tāla-vandaṇo
kahĩ ji diṭṭha chāraẏā  $  lavanta matta-moraẏā
kahĩ ji sīha-gaṇḍaẏā  $  dhuṇanta-puccha-daṇḍaẏā
kahĩ ji matta-ṇibbharā  $  guluggulanti kuñjarā
kahĩ ji dāḍha-bhāsurā  $  ghurugghuranti sūẏarā
kahĩ ji puccha-dīharā  $  kilikkilanti vāṇarā
kahĩ ji thora-kandharā  $  paribbhamanti samvarā
kahĩ ji tuṅga-aṅgaẏā  $  haẏāri tikkhasiṅgaẏā
kahĩ ji āṇaṇuṇṇaẏā  $  kuraṅga vuṇṇa-kaṇṇaẏā
ghattā:
tahĩ tehaĕ saïlĕ  $  taruvara-vahalĕ  $  ārūḍha ve vi hari-halahara
      jāṇaï-vijjulaĕ  $  dhavalujjalaĕ  $  ciñcaïẏa ṇāĩ ṇava jalahara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 4:
pihula-ṇiẏamva-vimva-ramaṇīẏahĕ  $  rāhaü duma darisāvaï sīẏahĕ
ĕhu so dhaṇĕ ṇaggoha-pahāṇu  $  jahĩ risahahŏ uppaṇṇaü ṇāṇu
ĕhu so sattavantu kiṃ ṇa muṇiu  $  ajiu sa-ṇāṇa-dehu jahĩ pathuṇiu
ĕhu so indavacchu supasiddhaü  $  jahĩ saṃbhava-jiṇu ṇāṇa-samiddhaü
ĕhu so saralu sahalu saṃbhūaü  $  ahiṇandaṇu sa-ṇāṇu jahĩ hūaü
ĕhu pīẏaṅgu sīĕ sacchāẏaü  $  sumaï sa-ṇāṇapiṇḍu jahĩ jāẏaü
ĕhu so sālu sīĕ ṇiẏacchiu  $  paümappahu sa-ṇāṇu jahĩ acchiu
ĕhu so sirisu mahaddumu jāṇaï  $  ṇāṇu supāsĕ bhaṇĕvi jagu jāṇaï
ĕhu so ṇāgarukkhu candappahĕ  $  ṇāṇuppatti jetthu candappahĕ
ĕhu so mālaïrukkhu padīsiu  $  pupphaẏantu jahĩ ṇāṇa-vihūsiu
ghattā:
ĕhu so pakkhataru  $  phala-phulla-bharu  $  tendui-samāṇu duha-ṇāsahũ
      jahĩ parihūẏāĩ  $  saṃbhūẏāĩ  $  ṇāṇaĩ sīẏala-seẏaṃsahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 5:
ĕha sā pāḍali suhala supattī  $  vāsupujjĕ jahĩ ṇāṇuppattī
ĕsu so jamvū ehu asatthu  $  vimalāṇantahũ ṇāṇa-samatthu
uhu dahivaṇṇa-ṇandi supasiddhā  $  dhamma-santi jahĩ ṇāṇa-samiddhā
uhu sāhāra-tilaü dīsanti  $  kunthu-arahũ jahĩ ṇāṇuppatti
ĕhu so taru kaṅkelli-pahāṇu  $  mallijiṇahŏ jahĩ kevala-ṇāṇu
ĕhu so campaü kiṇṇa ṇiẏacchiu  $  muṇi suvvaü sa-ṇāṇu jahĩ acchiu
iẏa uttima-taru indu vi vandaï  $  jaṇu kajjeṇa teṇa ahiṇandaï"
ema cavanta patta vala-lakkhaṇa  $  jahĩ kulabhūsaṇa-desavihūsaṇa
divasa caẏāri aṇaṅga-viẏārā  $  paḍimā-jogeṃ thakka bhaḍārā
ghattā:
ventara-ghoṇasĕhĩ  $  āsīvisĕhĩ  $  ahi-vicchiẏa-velli-sahāsĕhĩ
      veḍhiẏa ve vi jaṇa  $  suha-luddha-maṇa  $  pāsaṇḍiẏa jiha pasu-pāsĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 6:
jaṃ diṭṭhu asesu vi ahi-ṇihāu  $  valaeu bhaẏaṅkaru garuḍu jāu
toṇīra-pakkhu vaïdehi-cañcu  $  pakkhujjala-sara-romañca-kañcu
somitti-viẏaḍa-vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇu  $  ṇārāẏa-tikkha-ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
doṇṇi vi kovaṇḍaĩ kaṇṇa do vi  $  thiu rāhaü bhīsaṇu garuḍu hovi
taṃ ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhĕvi duggammehĩ  $  paricintiu kajju bhuaṅgamehĩ
"lahu ṇāsahũ kiṃ ṇara-saṃgameṇa  $  khajjesahũ garuḍa-vihaṇgameṇa"
etthantarĕ vihaḍiẏa ahi maẏandha  $  gaẏa khaẏahŏ ṇāĩ muṇi-kammavandha
bhaẏa-bhīẏa visanthula maṇĕṇa taṭṭha  $  khara-pavaṇa-pahaẏa ghaṇa jiha paṇaṭṭha
ghattā:
vellī-saṅkulahŏ  $  vaṃsatthalahŏ  $  visahara-phukkāra-karālahŏ
    jāẏa pagāsa risi  $  ṇahĕ sūra-sasi  $  ummilla ṇāĩ ghaṇa-jālahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 7:
ahi-ṇivahu jaṃ jĕ gaü osarĕvi  $  muṇi vandiẏa joga-bhatti karĕvi
"je bhava-saṃsārārihĕ ḍariẏa  $  siva-sāsaẏa-gamaṇahŏ aïturiẏa
vihĩ dosahĩ je ṇa pariggahiẏa  $  vihĩ vajjiẏa vihĩ jhāṇahĩ sahiẏa
tihĩ jāi-jarā-maraṇĕhĩ rahiẏa  $  daṃsaṇa-cāritta-ṇāṇa-sahiẏa
je caügaï-caükasāẏa-mahaṇa  $  caü-maṅgala-kara caü-saraṇa-maṇa
je pañca-mahavvaẏa-dudhara-dhara  $  pañcendiẏa-dosa-viṇāsaẏara
chattīsa-guṇaḍḍhi-guṇĕhĩ pavara  $  chajjīva-ṇikāẏahũ khanti-kara
jiẏa jehĩ sabhaẏa satta vi ṇaraẏa  $  je satta-sivaṅkara aṇavaraẏa
kammaṭṭha-maẏaṭṭha-duṭṭha-damaṇa  $  aṭṭhaviha-guṇaḍḍhī-sarasavaṇa
ghattā:
ekkekkottariẏa  $  iẏa guṇa-bhariẏa  $  puṇu vandiẏa vala-govindĕhĩ
      giri-mandara-siharĕ  $  vara-veiharĕ  $  jiṇa-juvalu va inda-paḍindĕhi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 8:
bhāveṃ tihi mi jaṇĕhĩ dhammajjaṇu  $  kiu candaṇa-raseṇa sammajjaṇu
pupphaccaṇiẏa chuddha-saẏavattĕhĩ  $  puṇu āḍhattu geu muṇi-bhattĕhĩ
rāmu sughosa vīṇa apphālaï  $  jā muṇivarahu mi cittaĩ cālaï
jā rāmaürihĩ āsi ravaṇṇī  $  tūsĕvi pūẏaṇa-jakkheṃ diṇṇī
lakkhaṇu gāi salakkhaṇu geu  $  satta vi sara ti-gāma-sara-bheu
ekkavīsa vara-mucchaṇa-ṭhāṇaĩ  $  ekkuṇapañcāsa vi sara-tāṇaĩ
tāla-vitāla paṇaccaï jāṇaï  $  ṇava rasa aṭṭha bhāva jā jāṇaï
dasa diṭṭhiu vāvīsa laẏāĩ  $  bharaheṃ bharaha-gaviṭṭhaĩ jāĩ
ghattā:
bhāveṃ jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  caüsaṭṭhi bhuẏa  $  darisanti paṇaccaï jāvĕhĩ
    diṇaẏara-atthavaṇĕ  $  giri-guhila-vaṇĕ  $  uvasaggu samuṭṭhiu tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 9:
to kovaggi-karamviẏa-hāsaĩ  $  diṭṭhaĩ ṇahaẏalĕ asura-sahāsaĩ
aṇṇaĩ vipphuriẏāhara-vaẏaṇaĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ rattummilliẏa-ṇaẏaṇaĩ
aṇṇaĩ piṅgaṅgaĩ piṅgakkhaĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ ṇimmasaĩ duppekkhaĩ
aṇṇaĩ ṇahĕ ṇaccanti vivatthaĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ tahĩ cāmuṇḍa-vihatthaĩ
aṇṇaĩ kaṅkālaĩ veẏālaĩ  $  kattiẏa-maḍaẏa-karaĩ vikarālaĩ
aṇṇaĩ masi-vaṇṇaĩ apasatthaĩ  $  ṇara-sira-māla-kavāla-vihatthaĩ
aṇṇaĩ soṇiẏa-maïra piẏantaĩ  $  ṇaccantaĩ ghummanta-ghulantaĩ
aṇṇaĩ kilakilanti caü-pāsĕhĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ kahakahanti uvahāsĕhĩ
ghattā:
aṇṇaĩ bhīsaṇaĩ  $  duddarisaṇaĩ  $  "maru māri māri" jampantaĩ
    desavihūsaṇahã  $  kulabhūsaṇahã  $  āẏaĩ uvasaggu karantaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 10:
puṇu aṇṇaĩ aṇṇaṇṇa-paẏārĕhĩ  $  ḍhukkaĩ visahara-phaṇa-phukkārĕhĩ
aṇṇaĩ jamvuva-siva-phekkārĕhĩ  $  vasaha-jhaḍakka-mukka-ḍhekkārĕhĩ
aṇṇaĩ karivara-kara-sikkārĕhĩ  $  sara-sandhiẏa-dhaṇu-guṇa-ṭaṅkārĕhĩ
aṇṇaĩ gaddaha-maṇḍala-saddĕhĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ vahuviha-bhesiẏa-ṇaddĕhĩ
aṇṇaĩ girivara-taruvara-ghāĕhĩ  $  pāṇiẏa-pāhaṇa-pavaṇuppāĕhĩ
aṇṇaĩ amarisa-rosa-phurantaĩ  $  ṇaẏaṇĕhĩ aggi-phuliṅga muẏantaĩ
aṇṇaĩ daha-vaẏaṇaĩ saẏa-vaẏaṇaĩ  $  aṇṇaĩ sahasa-muhaĩ vahu-ṇaẏaṇaĩ
tahĩ tehaĕ vi kālĕ maï-vimalahũ  $  to vi ṇa caliu jhāṇu muṇi-dhavalahũ
ghattā:
vaïru sarantāĩ  $  paharantāĩ  $  savvala-huli-hala-musalaggĕhĩ
   kāleṃ appaṇaü  $  bhīsāvaṇaü  $  darisāviu ṇaṃ vahu-bhaṅgĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 11:
uvasaggu ṇiĕvi harisiẏa-maṇĕhĩ  $  ṇīsaṅkĕhĩ vala-ṇārāẏaṇĕhĩ
mambhīsĕvi sīẏa mahāvalĕhĩ  $  muṇi-calaṇa dharāviẏa karaẏalĕhĩ
dhaṇuharaĩ vihi mi apphāliẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ sura-bhavaṇaĩ saṃcāliẏaĩ
vuṇṇaĩ bhaẏa-bhīẏa-visaṇṭhulaĩ  $  ṇaṃ rasiẏaĩ ṇahaẏala-mahiẏalaĩ
taṃ saddu suṇĕvi āsaṅkiẏaĩ  $  riu-cittaĩ māṇa-kalaṅkiẏaĩ
dhaṇuhara-ṭaṅkārĕhĩ vahiriẏaĩ  $  ṇaṭṭhaĩ khala-khuddaĩ vaïriẏaĩ
ṇaṃ aṭṭha vi kammaĩ ṇijjiẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ pañcendiẏaĩ parajjiẏaĩ
ṇaṃ ṇāsĕvi gaẏaĩ parīsahaĩ  $  tiha asura-sahāsaĩ dūsahaĩ
ghattā:
chuḍu chuḍu ṇaṭṭhāĩ  $  bhaẏa-taṭṭhāĩ  $  melleppiṇu maccharu māṇu
    tāva bhaḍārāhũ  $  vaẏa-dhārāhũ  $  uppaṇṇaü kevala-ṇāṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 12:
tāva muṇindahã ṇāṇuppattiĕ  $  āẏa surāsura vandaṇahattiĕ
jehĩ kitti taïlokkĕ pagāsiẏa  $  joisa ventara bhavaṇa-ṇivāsiẏa
pahilaü bhāvaṇa saṅkha-ṇiṇaddeṃ  $  ventara tūraẏaphāliẏa-saddeṃ
joisa-deva vi sīha-ṇiṇāeṃ  $  kappāmara jaẏaghaṇṭa-ṇiṇāeṃ
saṃcalieṃ caü-devaṇikāeṃ  $  chāiu ṇahu ṇaṃ ghaṇa-saṃghāeṃ
vahaï vimāṇu vimāṇeṃ cappiu  $  vāḥaṇu vāhaṇa-ṇivaha-jhaḍappiu
turaü turaṅgameṇa omāṇiu  $  sandaṇu sandaṇeṇa saṃdāṇiu
gaẏavaru gaẏavareṇa paḍikhaliẏaü  $  laggĕvi maüḍĕ maüḍu ucchaliẏaü
ghattā:
bhāveṃ pelliẏaü  $  bhaẏa-melliẏaü  $  sura-sāhaṇu līlaĕ āvaï
    loẏahũ mūḍhāhũ  $  tamĕ chūḍhāhũ  $  ṇaṃ dhamma-riddhi darisāvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 13:
tāva purandareṇa aïrāvaü  $  sāhiu jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-suhāvaü
soha dintu caüsaṭṭhī-ṇaẏaṇĕhĩ  $  gulugulantu vattīsahĩ vaẏaṇĕhĩ
vaẏaṇĕ vaẏaṇĕ aṭṭhaṭṭha visāṇaĩ  $  ṇāĩ suvaṇṇa-ṇivaddha-ṇihāṇaĩ
ekkekkaĕ visāṇĕ jaṇa-maṇaharu  $  ekkekkaü jĕ pariṭṭhaü saravaru
sarĕ sarĕ sara-parimāṇuppaṇṇī  $  kamaliṇi ekka-ekka ṇippaṇṇī
ekkekkahĕ paümiṇihĕ visālaĩ  $  paṅkaẏāĩ vattīsa sa-ṇālaĩ
kamalĕ kamalĕ vattīsa ji pattaĩ  $  pattĕ pattĕ ṇaṭṭāi mi tettaĩ
vaddhiu jamvūdīva-pamāṇeṃ  $  puṇu ji pariṭṭhiu teṇa ji thāṇeṃ
tahĩ dugghoṭṭĕ caḍĕvi sura-sundaru  $  vandaṇahattiĕ āu purandaru
puraü surindahŏ ṇaẏaṇāṇandĕhĩ  $  guru pomāiu vandiṇa-vandĕhĩ
ghattā:
"devahŏ dāṇavahŏ  $  khala-māṇavahŏ  $  risi-calaṇĕhĩ keva ṇa laggahŏ
      jehĩ tavantaĕhĩ  $  acalantaĕhĩ  $  indu vi avaẏāriu saggahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 32, Kaḍavaka 14:
jiṇavara-calaṇa-kamala-dala-sevahĩ  $  kevala-ṇāṇa-pujja kiẏa devahĩ
bhaṇaï purandaru "ahŏ ahŏ loẏahŏ  $  jaï saṅkiẏa jara-maraṇa-vioẏahŏ
jaï ṇivviṇṇā caü-gaï-gamaṇahŏ  $  to ki ṇa ḍhukkahŏ jiṇavara-bhavaṇahŏ
puttu kalattu jāva maṇĕ cintahŏ  $  jiṇavara-vimvu tāva ki ṇa cintahŏ
cintahŏ jāva māsu maẏarāsaṇu  $  ki ṇa cintavahŏ tāva jiṇasāsaṇu
cintahŏ jāva riddhi siẏa sampaẏa  $  ki ṇa cintavahŏ tāva jiṇavara-paẏa
cintahŏ jāva rūu dhaṇu jovvaṇu  $  dhaṇṇu suvaṇṇu aṇṇu gharu pariẏaṇu
cintahŏ jāva valiu bhuva-pañjaru  $  ki ṇa cintavahŏ tāva paramakkharu
ghattā:
pekkhahu dhamma-phalu  $  caüraṅga-valu  $  paẏahiṇa ti-vāra devāviu
    sa iṃ bhu vaṇesarahŏ  $  paramesarahŏ  $  atthakkaĕ seva karāviu"
----------  [33. tettīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
uppaṇṇaĕ ṇāṇĕ  $  pucchaï rahu-taṇaü
"kulabhūsaṇa-deva  $  kiṃ uvasaggu kaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 1:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pabhaṇaï parama-guru  $  "suṇu jakkhathāṇu ṇāmeṇa puru
tahĩ kāsava-surava mahābhaviẏa  $  eẏāraha-guṇathāṇagghaviẏa
ekkovara kiṅkara puravaïhĕ  $  ṇaṃ tumvuru-ṇāraẏa suravaïhĕ
hammantu vihaṅgamu luddhaĕhĩ  $  parirakkhiu tehĩ pavuddhaĕhĩ
khagavaï puṇu vahukāleṇa muu  $  viñjhācalĕ bhillāhivaï huu
to kāsava-surava ve vi marĕvi  $  thiẏa amiẏasarahŏ gharĕ oarĕvi
uvaovādevihĕ dohalĕhĩ  $  uppaṇṇā vaḍḍĕhĩ sohalĕhĩ
vaddhāvaü āẏaü vandhujaṇu  $  kiu uiẏa-muiẏa ṇāmaggahaṇu
ghattā:
ṇaṃ amara-kumāra  $  chuḍu saggahŏ paḍiẏa
     ṇāṇaṅkusa-hattha  $  jovvaṇa-gaĕ caḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 2:
to paümiṇipura-paramesarahŏ  $  darisāviẏa vijaẏa-mahīharahŏ
teṇa vi ṇiẏa-suahŏ jaẏandharahŏ  $  kiẏa kiṅkara vaḍḍhiẏa-raṇabharahŏ
acchanti jāma bhuñjanti siẏa  $  to tāma jaṇerahŏ gamaṇa-kiẏa
paṭṭhaviu ṇarindeṃ amiẏasaru  $  aïbhūmi-leha-riñcholi-dharu
vasubhūi sahejjaü tāsu gaü  $  teṃ ṇavara pāṇa-vicchou kaü
pallaṭṭaï pallaṭṭiu bhaṇĕvi  $  te uiẏa-muiẏa tiṇa-samu gaṇĕvi
so uvaüvāeviĕ sahũ jiẏaï  $  amiovamu ahara-pāṇu piẏaï
pariẏāṇĕvi jeṭṭheṃ duccariu  $  vasubhūihĕ jīviu avahariu
ghattā:
uppaṇṇaü viñjhĕ  $  hoppiṇu pallivaï
       puvvakkiu kammu  $  savvahŏ pariṇavaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 3:
jaẏa-pavvaẏa-pavarujjāṇu jahĩ  $  risi-saṅghu parāiu tāva tahĩ
kiẏa rukkhĕ rukkhĕ āvāsa-kiẏa  $  ṇaṃ rukkhĕ rukkhĕ avaïṇṇa siẏa
saṃjāẏaĩ aṅgaĩ komalaĩ  $  ahiẏaĩ paṇṇaĩ phullaĩ phalaĩ
risi rukkha va avicala hovi thiẏa  $  kisalaĕ pariveḍhāveḍhi kiẏa
risi rukkha va tavaṇa-tāva taviẏa  $  risi rukkha va mūla-guṇagghaviẏa
risi rukkha va ālavāla-rahiẏa  $  risi rukkha va mokkha-phalabbhahiẏa
gaü ṇandaṇavaṇiu turantu tahĩ  $  so vijaẏa-mahīhara-rāu jahĩ
"paramesara kesari-vikkamĕhĩ  $  ujjāṇu laïu jaï-puṅgavĕhĩ
ghattā:
vārantahŏ majjhu  $  ummaggima karĕvi
        risi-sīha-kisora (va)  $  thiẏa vaṇĕ païsarĕvi

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaravaï gaẏaü tahĩ  $  āvāsiu maharisi-satthu jahĩ
vollāviẏa "ahŏ ahŏ muṇivarahŏ  $  avuhahŏ aẏāṇa-paramakkharahŏ
paramappaü appaü hovi thiu  $  kajjeṇa keṇa risi-vesu kiu
aïdullahu lahĕvi maṇuattaṇaü  $  keṃ kajjeṃ viṇaḍahŏ appaṇaü
kahŏ keraü parama-mokkha-gamaṇu  $  vari māṇiu maṇaharu taruṇiẏaṇu
sacchāĩ āẏaĩ aṅgāĩ  $  solaha-āharaṇahã joggāĩ
vitthiṇṇaĩ āẏaĩ kaḍiẏalaĩ  $  haẏa-gaẏa-raha-vāhaṇa-paccalaĩ
lāẏaṇṇaĩ rūvaïṃ jovvaṇaĩ  $  ṇipphalaĩ gaẏaĩ tumhahã taṇaĩ
ghattā:
supasiddhaü loĕ  $  ekku vi taü ṇa kaü
       tumhāra-kilesu  $  saẏalu ṇiratthu gaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 5:
to mokkha-rukkha-phala-vaddhaṇĕṇa  $  mahipālu vuttu maïvaddhaṇĕṇa
"paĩ appaü kāĩ viḍamviẏaü  $  acchahi suha-dukkha-karamviẏaü
kahŏ gharu kahŏ putta-kalattāĩ  $  dhaẏa-cindhaĩ cāmara-chattāĩ
sa-vimāṇaĩ jāṇaĩ joggāĩ  $  raha-turaẏa-mahaggaẏa-duggāĩ
dhaṇa-dhaṇṇaĩ jīviẏa-jovvaṇaĩ  $  jala-kīlaü pāṇaĩ uvavaṇaĩ
vaïsaṇaü vasundhari vajjāĩ  $  ṇaü kāsu vi honti sahejjāĩ
āẏahĩ vahuẏahĩ veẏāriẏaĩ  $  vambhāṇahã lakkhaĩ māriẏaĩ
suravaïhĩ sahāsaĩ pāḍiẏaĩ  $  cakkavaï-saẏaĩ ṇiddhāḍiẏaĩ
ghattā:
eẏa vi avare vi  $  kāleṃ kavalu kiẏa
       siẏa kahŏ samāṇu  $  ekku vi paü ṇa gaẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 6:
paramesaru puṇu vi puṇu vi kahaï  $  "jiu tiṇṇi avatthaü uvvahaï
uppatti-jarā-maraṇāvasaru  $  pahilaü jĕ ṇivaddhaü deha-gharu
puggala-parimāṇa-suttu dharĕvi  $  kara-calaṇa caẏāri khambha karĕvi
vahu-atthi-jiantahĩ ḍhaṅkiẏaü  $  māsiṭṭu camma-chuha-paṅkiẏaü
sira-kalasālaṅkiu saṃcaraï  $  māṇusu vara-bhavaṇahŏ aṇuharaï
taruṇattaṇu jāma tāma vahaï  $  puṇu pacchaĕ juṇṇa-bhāu lahaï
siru kampaï jampaï ṇa vi vaẏaṇu  $  ṇa suṇanti kaṇṇa ṇa ṇiẏaï ṇaẏaṇu
ṇa calanti calaṇa ṇa karanti kara  $  jara-jajjarihoi sarīru para
ghattā:
puṇu pacchima-kālĕ  $  ṇivaḍaï deha-gharu
       jiu jema vihaṅgu  $  uḍḍaï muĕvi taru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaravaï uvasamiu  $  ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇu ṇiẏa-paĕ saṇṇimiu
appuṇu puṇu bhāva-gāha-gahiu  $  ṇikkhantu ṇarāhiva-saẏa-sahiu
tahĩ uiẏa-muiẏa ṇiggantha thiẏa  $  kara-kamalĕhĩ kesuppāḍa kiẏa
puṇu savaṇa-saṅghu tahŏ puravarahŏ  $  gaü vandaṇahattiĕ jiṇavarahŏ
sammeẏahŏ janta janta valiẏa  $  pahu chaḍḍĕvi uppaheṇa caliẏa
te uiẏa-muiẏa dui ṇivvaḍiẏa  $  vasubhūi-bhilla-pallihĕ paḍiẏa
dhāiu dhāṇukku vaddha-vaïru  $  guñjāhala-ṇaẏaṇu pīẏa-maïru
duppeccha-vacchu thira-thora-karu  $  apphāliẏa-dhaṇuharu gahira-saru
ghattā:
vaïraĩ ṇa kuhanti  $  honti ṇa jajjaraĩ
       haü haṇaï ṇiruttu  $  satta-bhavantaraĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 8:
hakkāriẏa viṇṇi vi duddhareṇa  $  ṇiẏa-vaïẏara-vaïra-viruddhaeṇa
"ahŏ saṃcārima-ṇara-vaṇaẏarahŏ  $  kahĩ gammaï evahĩ mahu marahŏ"
taṃ suṇĕvi mahāvaẏa-dhāraĕṇa  $  dhīriu lahuvaü vaḍḍāraĕṇa
"maṃ bhīhi thāhi aṇṇahŏ bhavahŏ  $  uvasagga-sahaṇu bhūsaṇu tavahŏ"
tahĩ tehaĕ vihurĕ samāvaḍiĕ  $  adhurandharĕ garua-bhārĕ paḍiĕ
thiu khandhu samaḍḍĕvi ekku jaṇu  $  bhillāhiu abbhuddharaṇa-maṇu
jo puvva-bhavantarĕ pakkhiẏaü  $  purĕ jakkhathāṇĕ parirakkhiẏaü
teṃ vuccaï "loddhā osarahi  $  ko māraï risi tuhũ mahu marahi"
ghattā:
volāviẏa teṇa  $  kālantarĕṇa maẏa
       daẏa caḍĕvi ṇiseṇi  $  līlaĕ saggu gaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 9:
pāvāsaü paüru pāu karĕvi  $  vahu-kālu ṇaraẏa-tiriẏahĩ phirĕvi
vasubhūi-bhillu dhaṇa-jaṇa-paürĕ  $  paṭṭaṇĕ uppaṇṇu ariṭṭhaürĕ
ṇāmeṇa aṇuddharu duddarisu  $  kaṇaẏappaha-jaṇaṇi-jaṇiẏa-harisu
dullaṅghahŏ ṇiẏa-kula-pavvaẏahŏ  $  ṇandaṇa ṇaravaïhĕ piẏavvaẏahŏ
te uiẏa-muiẏa tāsu ji taṇaẏa  $  viṇṇāṇa-kalā-para-pāra-gaẏa
giri-dhīra mahovahi-gahira-guṇa  $  paẏa-pālaṇa rajja-kajja-ṇiuṇa
ṇāmaṅkiẏa raẏaṇa-vicitta-raha  $  paümāvaï-sua sasi-sūra-paha
chaddivasaĩ sallehaṇu karĕvi  $  gaü saggu piẏavvaü tahĩ marĕvi
jagaḍantu aṇuddharu ḍāmariu  $  raṇĕ raẏaṇa-vicittaraheṃ dhariu
ghattā:
paccaṇḍĕhĩ tehĩ  $  chaḍḍāviẏa-ḍamaru
        huu avara-bhaveṇa  $  aggikeu amaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 10:
vahu-kāleṃ raẏaṇa-vicittaraha  $  taü karĕvi marĕvi paribhamĕvi paha
uppaṇṇa ve vi siddhatthapurĕ  $  kaṇa-kañcaṇa-jaṇa-dhaṇa-paẏa-paürĕ
vimalaggamahisi-khemaṅkarahũ  $  avaropparu ṇaẏaṇa-suhaṅkarahũ
kulabhūsaṇu paḍhamu puttu pavaru  $  lahu desavihūsaṇu ekku avaru
aṇṇu vi uppaṇṇa ekka duhiẏa  $  kamalocchava runda-canda-muhiẏa
veṇṇi mi kumāra sālahĩ ṇimiẏa  $  āẏariẏahŏ kahŏ vi samullaviẏa
paḍhamāṇa juvāṇa-bhāvĕ caḍiẏa  $  ṇaṃ daïveṃ ve aṇaṅga ghaḍiẏa
vitthaẏa-vacchaẏala palamva-bhua  $  ṇaṃ saggahŏ inda-paḍinda cua
ghattā:
kamalocchava tāma  $  kahi mi samāvaḍiẏa
       ṇaṃ vammaha-bhalli  $  hiẏaĕ jhatti paḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 11:
kulabhūsaṇa-desavihūsaṇahũ  $  ṇiẏa-vahiṇi-rūva-pesiẏa-maṇahũ
paḍihāi ṇa candaṇa-leva-chavi  $  dhavalāmala-komala-kamalu ṇa vi
ṇa vi jalu jaladda dāhiṇa-pavaṇu  $  kusumāuheṇa ṇa ṇaḍiu kavaṇu
pekkheppiṇu paẏaĩ su-komalaĩ  $  ṇa sahanti rūi-rattuppalaĩ
pekkhĕvi thaṇavaṭṭaĩ cakkalaĩ  $  ucciṭṭhaĩ kari-kumbhatthalaĩ
pekkheppiṇu muhu vālahĕ taṇaü  $  paḍihāi ṇa candaṇu candiṇaü
loẏaṇaĩ rūvĕ paṅguttāĩ  $  ḍhorā iva kaddamĕ khuttāĩ
pekkheppiṇu kesa-kalāu maṇĕ  $  ṇa suhanti mora ṇaccanta vaṇĕ
ghattā:
diṭṭhī-visa vāla  $  sappahŏ aṇuharaï
       jo joaï ko vi  $  so saẏalu vi maraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 12:
tahĩ avasarĕ paṇaïhĩ pahu bhaṇiu  $  "khemaṅkara tuhũ jaṇaṇiĕ jaṇiu
tuhũ mahiẏalĕ dhaṇṇaü ekku para  $  kamalocchava duhiẏa jāsu pavara
kula-desavihūsaṇa jamala suẏa  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇāĩ kumāra muẏa
haẏa-hiẏaẏa kāĩ cintavasi tuhũ  $  pāvijjaï jehĩ mahantu duhu
khala-khuddaĩ dukkiẏa-gārāĩ  $  ṇāraïẏa ṇaraẏa-païsārāĩ
gaẏa-vāhi-dukkha-hakkārāĩ  $  siva-sāsaẏa-gamaṇa-ṇivārāĩ
titthaṅkara-gaṇahara-ṇindiẏaĩ  $  ṇaü khañcahi pañca vi indiẏaĩ
rūveṇa paẏaṅgu mīṇu rasĕṇa  $  migu savaṇeṃ bhasalu gandhavasĕṇa
ghattā:
phariseṇa viṇāsu  $  matta-gaïndu gaü
       jo sevaï pañca  $  tahŏ uttāru kaü"
