START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 13:
to kiẏa ṇivitti pariṇevāhŏ  $  sāvajju rajju bhuñjevāhŏ
pāraddhu paẏāṇaü tava-pahĕṇa  $  ṇiẏa-dehamaeṇa mahārahĕṇa
vihi viṇṇāṇiẏa uppāiĕṇa  $  duṭṭhaṭṭha-kamma-pacchāiĕṇa
indiẏa-turaṅga-saṃcāliĕṇa  $  sattaviha-dhāu-vandhāliĕṇa
cala-calaṇa-cakka-saṃjoiĕṇa  $  maṇa-pakkala-sārahi-coiĕṇa
tava-saṃjama-ṇiẏama-dhamma-bharĕṇa  $  āiẏa ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-taṇu-rahavarĕṇa
thiẏa paḍimā-joggeṃ giri-siharĕ  $  so aggikeu tehaĕ 'vasarĕ
saṃcaliu ṇahaṅgaṇĕ kahĩ vi jāma  $  gaü amhahã uppari khaliu tāma
puvvabhaü sarĕvi koheṃ jaliu  $  thiu rundhĕvi ṇahaẏalĕ kilikiliu
uvasaggu jāma pārambhiẏaü  $  vahu-rūvĕhĩ gaẏaṇĕ viẏambhiẏaü
paḍivaṇṇaĕ tahĩ tehaĕ 'vasarĕ  $  vaṭṭantaĕ guru-uvasagga-bharĕ
tumhahã jĕ pahāveṃ taṭṭhāĩ  $  asuraĩ dhaṇu-ravĕṇa paṇaṭṭhāĩ
ghattā:
to amhahã vappu  $  kālantarĕṇa muu
        so dīsaï etthu  $  gāruḍu deu huu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 33, Kaḍavaka 14:
to garuḍeṃ pariosiẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  ve vijjaü diṇṇaü takkhaṇĕṇa
rāhavahŏ sīhavāhaṇi pavara  $  lakkhaṇahŏ garuḍavāhaṇi avara
pahilārī satta-saĕhĩ sahiẏa  $  aṇupacchima tihĩ saĕhĩ ahiẏa
to kosala-suĕṇa su-dullahĕṇa  $  vuccaï vaïdehī-vallahĕṇa
"achantu tāva tumhahũ jĕ gharĕ  $  avasarĕ paḍivaṇṇĕ pasāu karĕ"
sahũ garuḍeṃ saṃbhāsaṇu karĕvi  $  guru pucchiu puṇu calaṇĕhĩ dharĕvi
"amhahũ hiṇḍantahũ dharaṇi-vahĕ  $  jaṃ jima hosaï taṃ tema kahĕ"
kulabhūsaṇu akkhaï halaharahŏ  $  "jalu laṅghĕvi dāhiṇa-sāẏarahŏ
ghattā:
saṃgāma-saẏāĩ  $  vihi mi jiṇevāĩ
   mahi-khaṇḍaĩ tiṇṇi  $  sa iṃ bhu ñjevāĩ"
----------  [34. caütīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
kevalĕ kevalīhĕ uppaṇṇaĕ  $  caüviha-deva-ṇikāẏa-pavaṇṇaĕ
pucchaï rāmu "mahāvaẏa-dhārā  $  dhamma-pāva-phalu kahahi bhaḍārā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 1:
kāĩ phalu pañca-mahavvaẏahũ  $  aṇuvaẏa-guṇavaẏa-sikkhāvaẏahũ
kāĩ phalu laïĕ aṇatthamiĕ  $  uvavāsa-posahaĕ saṃthaviĕ
phalu kāĩ jīva-mambhīsiẏaĕ  $  parahaṇĕ paradārĕ ahiṃsiẏaĕ
kāĩ phalu sacceṃ volliĕṇa  $  aliakkhareṇa āmelliĕṇa
kāĩ phalu jiṇavara-añciẏaĕ  $  vara-viulĕ gharāsamĕ vañciẏaĕ
kāĩ phalu māseṃ chaṇḍiĕṇa  $  rattiddiu deheṃ daṇḍiĕṇa
kāĩ phalu jiṇa-saṃmajjaṇĕṇa  $  vali-dīvaṅgāra-vilevaṇĕṇa
ghattā:
kiṃ cārittĕ ṇāṇĕ vaĕ daṃsaṇĕ  $  aṇṇu pasaṃsiĕ jiṇavara-sāsaṇĕ
    jaṃ phalu hoi aṇaṅga-viẏārā  $  taṃ viṇṇāsĕvi kahahi bhaḍārā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 2:
puṇu puṇu vi paḍīvaü bhaṇaï valu  $  "kahĕ sukkiẏa-dukkiẏa-kamma-phalu
kammeṇa keṇa riu-ḍamara-kara  $  saẏarāẏara mahi bhuñjanti ṇara
kammeṇa keṇa para-cakka-dhara  $  raha-turaẏa-gaĕhĩ vujjhanti ṇara
pariẏariẏa su-ṇārihĩ ṇaravarĕhĩ  $  vijjijjamāṇa vara-cāmarĕhĩ
sundara sacchanda maïnda jiha  $  johĕhĩ joha vujjhanti kiha
kammeṇa keṇa kiẏa paṅgulaẏa  $  ṇara kuṇṭa muṇṭa vahirandhalaẏa
kāṇīṇa dīṇa-muha-kāẏa-sara  $  vāhilla bhilla ṇāhala savara
dāliddiẏa para-pesaṇaĩ kara  $  keṃ kammeṃ uppajjanti ṇara
ghattā:
dhīra-sarīra vīra tava-sūrā  $  savvahũ jīvahũ āsāūrā
    indiẏa-pasavaṇa para-uvaẏārā  $  te kahĩ ṇara pāvanti bhaḍārā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 3:
ke vi aṇṇa ṇara duha-paricattā  $  devaloĕ devattaṇu pattā
candāicca-rāhu-aṅgārā  $  aṇṇahŏ aṇṇa honti kammārā
haṃsa sa-mesa-mahisa-visa-kuñjara  $  mora-turaṅga-riccha-miga-samvara
jaï devahũ jĕ majjhĕ saṃbhūā  $  to kiṃ kajjeṃ vāhaṇa hūā
ĕhu jo dīsaï kulisa-ppaharaṇu  $  sahasaṇaẏaṇu aïrāvaẏa-vāhaṇu
gijjaï kiṇṇara-mihuṇa-sahāsĕhĩ  $  suravara jaẏa bhaṇanti caüpāsĕhĩ
hāhā-hūhū-tumvuru-ṇārā  $  tejjā-teṇṇā jasu cakkārā
cittaṅgo vi murava paḍipellaï  $  rambha tilottima saï uvvellaï
ghattā:
appaṇu asura-surahũ abbhantarĕ  $  mokkhu jema thiu savvahũ upparĕ
        dīsaï jasu evaḍḍu pahuttaṇu  $  pattu phaleṇa keṇa indattaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi kulabhūsaṇĕṇa  $  kandappa-dappa-viddhaṃsaṇĕṇa
"suṇu akkhami" vuccaï teṇa valu  $  āẏaṇṇahi dhammahŏ taṇaü phalu
mahu majju maṃsu jo pariharaï  $  chajjīva-ṇikāẏahŏ daẏa karaï
puṇu pacchaï sallehaṇĕ maraï  $  so mokkha-mahā-purĕ païsaraï
jo ghaĩ darisāvaï pāṇivaha  $  aṇṇu vi mahu-maṃsahŏ taṇiẏa kaha
so joṇī-joṇi paribbhamaï  $  caürāsī lakkha jāma kamaï
ĕu sukkiẏa-dukkiẏa-kamma-phalu  $  suṇu evahĩ saccahŏ taṇaü phalu
tula-toliẏa mahi sa-mahīhariẏa  $  sa-surāsura sa-ghaṇa sa-sāẏariẏa
ghattā:
varuṇu kuveru meru kaïlāsu vi  $  tula-toliu taïlokku asesu vi
        to vi ṇa garuvattaṇaü pagāsiu  $  saccu saüttaru savvahũ pāsiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 5:
jo saccaü ṇa cavaï kāpurisu  $  so jīvaï jaṇavaĕ tiṇa-sarisu
jo ṇaru para-davvu ṇa ahilasaï  $  so uttima-sagga-loĕ vasaï
jo ghaĩ rattiddiṇu mūḍha-maṇu  $  corantu ṇa thakkaï ekku khaṇu
so hammaï chijjaï bhijjaï vi  $  kappijjaï sūlĕ bharijjaï vi
jo duddharu vambhaceru dharaï  $  tahŏ jamu āruṭṭhaü kiṃ karaï
jo ghaĩ taṃ joṇi cāru ramaï  $  so paṅkaĕ bhamaru jema maraï
jo karaï ṇivitti pariggahahŏ  $  so mokkhahŏ jāi suhāvahahŏ
jo ghaĩ aviaṇhu pariggahahŏ  $  so jāi purahŏ tamatamapahahŏ
ghattā:
ahavaï ṇivvaṇṇijjaï kettiu  $  ekkekkahŏ vaẏahŏ phalu ettiu
        jo ghaĩ pañca vi dharaï vaẏāĩ  $  tāsu mokkhu pucchijjaï kāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 6:
phalu ettiu pañca-mahavvaẏahŏ  $  suṇu evahĩ pañcāṇuvvaẏahŏ
jo karaï ṇirantara jīva-daẏā  $  paviralu asaccu saccaü mi saẏā
kisa hiṃsa ahiṃsa saüttariẏa  $  te ṇaraẏa-mahāṇaï-uttariẏa
je ṇara sa-dāra-saṃtuṭṭha-maṇa  $  parahaṇa-paraṇārī-pariharaṇa
apariggaha-dāṇa-karaṇa purisa  $  te honti purandara-samasarisu
phalu ettiu pañcāṇuvvaẏahũ  $  suṇu evahĩ tihi mi guṇavvaẏahũ
disa-paccakkhāṇu pamāṇa-vaü  $  khala-saṃgahu jāsu ṇa vaḍḍhiẏaü
ghattā:
iẏa tihĩ guṇavaehĩ guṇavantaü  $  acchaï saggĕ suhaĩ bhuñjantaü
       jāsu ṇa tihi mi majjhĕ ekku vi  $  guṇu tahŏ saṃsārahŏ cheu kahĩ puṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 7:
phalu ettiu tihi mi guṇavvaẏahũ  $  suṇu evahĩ caü-sikkhāvaẏahũ
jo pahilaü sikkhāvaü dharaï  $  jiṇavarĕ tikāla-vandaṇa karaï
so ṇaru uppajjaï jahĩ jĕ jahĩ  $  vandijjaï loĕhĩ tahĩ jĕ tahĩ
jo ghaĩ puṇu visaẏāsatta-maṇu  $  varisahŏ vi ṇa pecchaï jiṇa-bhavaṇu
so sāvaü majjhĕ ṇa sāvaẏahũ  $  aṇuharaï ṇavara vaṇa-sāvaẏahũ
jo vīẏaü sikkhāvaü dharaï  $  posaha-uvavāsa-saẏaĩ karaï
so ṇaru devattaṇu ahilasaï  $  sohammĕ vahuva-majjhĕ ramaï
jo taïẏaü sikkhāvaü dharaï  $  tavasihĩ āhāra-dāṇu karaï
aṇṇu vi sammatta-bhāru vahaï  $  devattaṇu devaloĕ lahaï
jo caüthaü sikkhāvaü dharaï  $  saṇṇāsu kareppiṇu puṇu maraï
so hoi tiloẏahŏ vaḍḍhiẏaü  $  ṇaü jammaṇa-maraṇa-vioa-bhaü
ghattā:
sāmāiu uvavāsu sa-bhoẏaṇu  $  pacchima-kālĕ aṇṇu sallehaṇu
      caü sikkhāvaẏāĩ jo pālaï  $  so indahŏ indattaṇu ṭālaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 8:
ĕu phalu sikkhāvaĕ saṃthaviĕ  $  suṇu evahĩ kahami aṇatthamiĕ
vari khaddhu maṃsu vari majju mahu  $  vari aliu vaẏaṇu hiṃsāĕ sahũ
vari jīviu gaü sarīru lhasiu  $  ṇaü raẏaṇihĩ bhoẏaṇu ahilasiu
puvvaṇhaü gaṇa-gandhavvaẏahũ  $  majjhaṇhaü savvahũ devaẏahũ
avaraṇhaü piẏara-piẏāmahahũ  $  ṇisi rakkhasa-bhūẏa-peẏa-gahahũ
ṇisi-bhoẏaṇu jeṇa ṇa parihariu  $  bhaṇu teṇa kāĩ ṇa samāẏariu
kimi-kīḍa-paẏaṅga-saẏaĩ asaï  $  kusarīra-kujoṇihĩ so vasaï
jo ghaĩ ṇisi-bhoẏaṇu ummahaï  $  vimalattaṇu vimala-gottu lahaï"
ghattā:
suaü ṇa suṇaï ṇa diṭṭhaü dekkhaï  $  keṇa vi volliu kahŏ vi ṇa akkhaï
    bhoaṇĕ maüṇu caütthaü pālaï  $  so siva-sāsaẏa-gamaṇu ṇihālaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 9:
paramesaru suṭṭhu ema kahaï  $  jo jaṃ maggaï so taṃ lahaï
sammattaĩ ko vi ko vi vaẏaĩ  $  kŏ vi guṇa-gaṇa-vaẏaṇa-raẏaṇa-saẏaĩ
tavacaraṇu laïjjaï patthivĕṇa  $  vaṃsatthala-ṇaẏara-ṇarāhivĕṇa
gaẏa vandaṇahatti karevi sura  $  jāṇaïĕ dharijjaï dhamma-dhura
rāhavĕṇa vi vaẏaĩ samicchiẏaĩ  $  guru-diṇṇaĩ sirĕṇa paḍicchiẏaĩ
vaü ṇavara ṇa thakkaï lakkhaṇahŏ  $  vāluapaha-ṇaraẏa-ṇirikkhaṇahŏ
tahĩ tiṇṇi vi kaï vi divasa thiẏaĩ  $  jiṇa-pujjaü jiṇa-ṇhavaṇaĩ kiẏaĩ
ṇiggantha-saẏaĩ bhuñjāviẏaĩ  $  dīṇahã dāṇaĩ devāviẏaĩ
ghattā:
tihuaṇa-jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandahŏ  $  vandaṇahatti karevi jiṇindahŏ
    jāṇaï-hari-halaharaĩ pahiṭṭhaĩ  $  tiṇṇi vi daṇḍāraṇṇu païṭṭhaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 10:
diṭṭha mahāḍaï ṇāĩ vilāsiṇi  $  girivara-thaṇahara-sihara-pagāsiṇi
pañcāṇaṇa-ṇaha-ṇiẏara-viẏāriẏa  $  dīhara-sara-loẏaṇa-vipphāriẏa
kandara-dari-muha-kuhara-vihūsiẏa  $  taruvara-romāvali-uddhūsiẏa
candaṇa-agaru-gandha-ḍiviḍikkiẏa  $  indagova-kuṅkuma-cañcikkiẏa
ahavaï kiṃ vahuṇā vitthāreṃ  $  ṇaṃ ṇaccaï gaẏa-paẏa-saṃcāreṃ
ujjhara-muravapphāliẏa-saddeṃ  $  varahiṇa-thira-supariṭṭhiẏa-chandeṃ
mahuari-tiẏa-uvagīẏa-vamāleṃ  $  ahiṇava-pallava-kara-saṃcāleṃ
sīhorāli-samuṭṭhiẏa-kalaẏalu  $  ṇāĩ paḍhaï muṇi-suvvaẏa-maṅgalu
ghattā:
tahŏ abbhantarĕ amara-maṇoharu  $  ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhiu ekku laẏāharu
    tahĩ raï karĕvi thiẏaĩ sacchandaĩ  $  jogu laeviṇu jema muṇindaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 11:
tahĩ tehaĕ vaṇĕ riu-ḍamara-karu  $  paribhamaï samuddāvatta-dharu
āraṇṇa-gaïndĕ samāruhaï  $  vaṇa-govaü vaṇa-mahisiu duhaï
taṃ khīru vi ciriḍihillu mahiu  $  jāṇaïhĕ samappaï ghiẏa-sahiu
sa vi pakkāvaï ghaṇa-haṇḍiẏahĩ  $  vaṇa-dhaṇṇandulĕhĩ sukaṇḍiĕhĩ
ṇāṇāviha-phala-rasa-timmaṇĕhĩ  $  karavanda-karīrĕhĩ sālaṇĕhĩ
iẏa viviha-bhakkha bhuñjantāhũ  $  vaṇa-vāsĕ tihi mi acchantāhũ
muṇi gutta-sugutta tāva aïẏa  $  asudāṇiẏa doḍḍa-mahavvaïẏa
kālāmuha-kāvāliẏa bhagava  $  muṇi saṃkara tavaṇa tavasi gurava
ghattā:
vandāiriẏa bhoẏa pavvaïẏā  $  havi jiha bhūi-puñja-pacchaviẏā
    te jara-jammaṇā-maraṇa-viẏārā  $  vaṇa-cariẏaĕ païsanti bhaḍārā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ païsanta padīsiẏa muṇivara  $  sāvaẏa jiha tiha paṇaviẏa taruvara
ali-muhaliẏa khara-pavaṇāẏampiẏa  $  "thāhu thāhu" ṇaṃ ema pajampiẏa
ke vi kusuma-pabbhāru muanti  $  pāẏa-pujja ṇaṃ vihi mi karanti
to vi ṇa thakka mahavvaẏa-dhārā  $  rāmāsamĕ païsanti bhaḍārā
risi pekkheppiṇu sīẏa viṇiggaẏa  $  ṇaṃ paccakkha mahā-vaṇadevaẏa
"rāhava pekkhu pekkhu acchariẏaü  $  sāhu-jualu cariẏaĕ ṇīsariẏaü"
valu vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa gañjolliu  $  "thāhu thāhu" siru ṇavĕvi pavolliu
viṇaẏaṅkusĕṇa sāhu-gaẏa vāliẏa  $  kiu sammajjaṇu pāẏa pakhāliẏa
diṇṇa ti-vāra dhāra salileṇa vi  $  kama cacciẏa gosīra-raseṇa vi
pupphakkhaẏa-vali-dīvaṅgārĕhĩ  $  ema paẏaccĕvi aṭṭha-paẏārĕhĩ
ghattā:
vandiẏa guru guru-bhatti karevi  $  lagga parīsavi sīẏāevi
      muha-piẏa accha paccha maṇa-bhāviṇi  $  bhutta pejja kāmuĕhĩ va kāmiṇi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 34, Kaḍavaka 13:
diṇṇu pāṇu puṇu muhahŏ piẏāraü  $  cāraṇa-bhoggu jema haluvāraü
siddhaü siddhu jema siddhīhaü  $  jiṇavara-āu jema aïdīhaü
puṇu aggimaü diṇṇu hiẏaïcchiu  $  jiha su-kalattu su-ṇehu sa-icchaü
suddhaĩ puṇu sālaṇaĩ vicittaĩ  $  tikkhaĩ ṇāĩ vilāsiṇi-cittaĩ
diṇṇaĩ puṇu timmaṇaĩ maṇiṭṭhaĩ  $  ahiṇava-kaï-vaẏaṇā iva miṭṭhaĩ
pacchaï sisiru sa-maccharu suddhaü  $  duṭṭha-kalattu jema aï-thaddhaü
puṇu maẏa-salilu diṇṇu sīẏālaü  $  ṇaṃ jiṇa-vaẏaṇu pāva-pakkhālaü
līlaĕ jimiẏa bhaḍārā jāvĕhĩ  $  pañcacchariu padarisiu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
dunduhi gandhavāu raẏaṇāvali  $  sāhukkāru aṇṇu kusumañjali
     puṇṇa-pavittaĩ sāsaẏa-dūaĩ  $  pañca vi acchariẏaĩ sa ïṃ bhū aĩ
----------  [35. pañcatīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
gutta-suguttahã taṇĕṇa pahāveṃ rāmu sa-sīẏa parama-sabbhāveṃ
devĕhĩ dāṇa-riddhi khaṇĕ darisiẏa vala-mandirĕ vasuhāra pavarisiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 1:
jāẏa mahaggha raẏaṇa su-pagāsaĩ  $  lakkhahã tiṇṇi saẏaĩ pañcāsaĩ
varisĕvi raẏaṇa-varisu saĩ hattheṃ  $  rāmu pasaṃsiu suravara-sattheṃ
"tihuvaṇĕ ṇavara ekku valu dhaṇṇaü  $  divvāhāru jeṇa vaṇĕ diṇṇaü"
maṇĕ parituṭṭhaĩ amara-saẏāĩ  $  "aṇṇeṃ dāṇeṃ kijjaï kāĩ
aṇṇeṃ dhariu bhuvaṇu saẏarāẏaru  $  aṇṇeṃ dhammu kammu purisāẏaru
aṇṇeṃ riddhi-viddhi vaṃsubbhaü  $  aṇṇeṃ pemmu vilāsu sa-vibbhamu
aṇṇeṃ geu veu siddhakkharu  $  aṇṇeṃ jāṇu jhāṇu paramakkharu
aṇṇu muevi aṇṇu kiṃ dijjaï  $  jeṇa mahantu bhogu pāvijjaï
ghattā:
aṇṇa-suvaṇṇa-kaṇṇa-godāṇahũ  $  meiṇi-maṇi-siddhanta-purāṇahũ
    savvahũ aṇṇa-dāṇu uccāsaṇu  $  para-sāsaṇahũ jema jiṇa-sāsaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 2:
dāṇa-riddhi pekkhevi khagesaru  $  ṇavara jaḍāi jāu jāīsaru
gaggara-vaẏaṇaü muṇi-aṇurāeṃ  $  pahaü ṇāĩ sirĕ moggara-ghāeṃ
jiha jiha sumaraï ṇiẏaẏa-bhavantaru  $  tiha tiha mellei aṃsu ṇirantaru
"maĩ pāveṇa tiloẏāṇandahũ  $  pañca-saẏaĩ pīliẏaĩ muṇindahũ"
ema palāu karantu vihaṅgaü  $  guru-calaṇehĩ paḍiu mucchaṃgaü
paẏa-pakkhālaṇa-jalĕṇāsāsiu  $  rāhavacandeṃ puṇu uvaẏāsiu
sīẏaĕ vuttu "puttu mahu evahĩ  $  chuḍu vaddhaü chuḍu dharaü sukhevĕhĩ"
tāva raẏaṇa-ujjoveṃ bhiṇṇā  $  jāẏa pakkha cāmīẏara-vaṇṇā
ghattā:
vidduma-cañcu ṇīla-ṇiha-kaṇṭhaü  $  paẏa-veruliẏa-vaṇṇa maṇi-paṭṭhaü
    takkhaṇĕ pañca-vaṇṇu ṇivvaḍiẏaü  $  vīẏaü raẏaṇa-puñju ṇaṃ paḍiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 3:
bhāveṃ vihi mi paẏāhiṇa dentaü  $  ṇaḍu jiha harisa-visāĕhĩ jantaü
diṭṭhu pakkhi jaṃ ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu  $  bhaṇaï ṇaveppiṇu dasaraha-ṇandaṇu
"he muṇivara gaẏaṇaṅgaṇa-gāmiẏa  $  caügaï-dukkha-mahāṇaï-ṇāmiẏa
kahi kajjeṇa keṇa sacchāẏaü  $  pakkhi suvaṇṇa-vaṇṇu jaṃ jāẏaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vuttu ṇīsaṅgeṃ  $  "saẏalu vi uttima-purisa-pasaṅgeṃ
ṇaru haluvo vi hoi garuāraü  $  rukkhu vi sela-siharĕ vaḍḍāraü
meru-ṇiẏamvĕ tiṇu vi hemujjalu  $  sippiuḍesu jalu vi muttāhalu
tiha vihaṅgu maṇi-raẏaṇujjoeṃ  $  jāu suvaṇṇa-vaṇṇu muṇi-toeṃ"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu asagāheṃ  $  pucchiu puṇu vi ṇāhu ṇaraṇāheṃ
    "vihalaṅghalu ghummantu vihaṅgaü  $  kavaṇeṃ kāraṇeṇa mucchaṃgaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 4:
bhaṇaï ti-ṇāṇa-piṇḍa-paramesaru  $  "ehu vihaṅgu āsi rajjesaru
paṭṭaṇu daṇḍāuru bhuñjantaü  $  daṇḍaü ṇāmu vaüddhahã bhattaü
ekka-divasĕ pāraddhiĕ caliẏaü  $  tāva tikāla-jogi muṇi miliẏaü
thiu attāvaṇĕ lamviẏa-vāhaü  $  avicalu meru jema duggāhaü
taṃ pekkhĕvi āruṭṭhu mahavvalu  $  "avasu ajju avasavaṇu amaṅgalu"
ema cavanteṃ visaharu ghāĕvi  $  roseṃ muṇivara kaṇṭheṃ lāĕvi
gaü ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaru ṇarāhiu jāvĕhĩ  $  thiu ṇīsaṅgu ṇiroheṃ tāvĕhĩ
"eu ko vi pheḍesaï jaïẏahũ  $  lamviẏa hatthuccāẏami taïẏahũ"
ghattā:
jāvaṇṇekka-divasĕ pahu āvaï  $  taṃ jĕ bhaḍāraü tahĩ jĕ vihāvaï
    galaĕ bhuaṅgama-maḍaü ṇivaddhaü  $  kaṇṭhāharaṇu ṇāĩ āiddhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 5:
jaṃ avicalu vi diṭṭhu muṇi-kesari  $  pheḍĕvi visahara-kaṇṭhā-mañjari
vollāviu "vollahi paramesara  $  tava-caraṇeṇa kāĩ tavaṇesara
khaṇiu sarīru jīu khaṇa-mettaü  $  jo jhāẏahi so gaẏaü atītaü
tuhu mi khaṇiu ṇa 'jja vi siddhattaṇu  $  āẏahŏ kiṃ pamāṇu kiṃ lakkhaṇu"
saẏalu ṇiratthu vuttu jaṃ rāeṃ  $  muṇivaru cavĕvi laggu ṇaẏavāeṃ
"jaï puṇu so jjĕ pakkhu vollevaü  $  tā khaṇa-saddu ṇa uccārevaü
khaṇiu khaẏāru ṇaẏāru vi hosaï  $  khaṇa-saddahŏ uccāru ṇa dīsaï
ghattā:
aghaḍiu aghaḍamāṇu aghaḍantaü  $  khaṇieṃ khaṇiu khaṇantara-mettaü
    suṇṇeṃ suṇṇa-vaẏaṇu suṇṇāsaṇu  $  savvu ṇiratthu vaüddhahũ sāsaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 6:
khaṇa-saddeṇa ṇiruttaru jāẏaü  $  puṇu vi pavolliu daṇḍaẏa-rāẏaü
"to ghaĩ savvu atthi jaṃ dīsaï  $  puṇu tavacaraṇu kāsu kijjesaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï muṇīsaru  $  jo kaï-gavaẏa vāi vāīsaru
"amhaĩ rāẏa ṇa vollahũ evaṃ  $  ṇeāiĕhĩ hasijjahũ jevaṃ
atthi ṇatthi doṇṇi vi paḍivajjahũ  $  tuhũ jiha ṇaü khaṇavāeṃ bhajjahũ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi bhaṇaï daṇudāraü  $  "jāṇiu parama-pakkhu tumhāraü
atthi ṇa atthi ṇicca-saṃdeho  $  puṇu dhavalaü puṇu sāmala-deho
puṇu vi matta-kari puṇu pañcāṇaṇu  $  khattiu vaïsu suddu puṇu vambhaṇu"
ghattā:
bhaṇiu bhaḍāraü "kiṃ vitthāreṃ  $  ekku coru ciru dhariu talāreṃ
    gīvā-muha-ṇāsacchi gaviṭṭhaü  $  sīsu laentahũ kahi mi ṇa diṭṭhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 7:
ahavaï eṇa kāĩ saṃdeheṃ  $  atthi vi ṇatthi vi ṇīsaṃdeheṃ
jetthu atthi tahĩ atthi bhaṇevaü  $  jahĩ ṇa atthi tahĩ ṇatthi bhaṇevaü"
sacchandeṇa ṇarāhiu bhāviu  $  laïu dhammu puṇu muṇi pārāviu
sāhuhũ pañca-saẏaĩ dhariẏāĩ  $  ṇisuaĩ tesaṭṭhi vi cariẏāĩ
to etthantarĕ jaṇa-maṇa-bhāviṇi  $  kuiẏa khaṇaddheṃ duṇṇaẏa-sāmiṇi
puṇu maẏavaddhaṇu puttu mahantaü  $  "ṇaravaï jāu jiṇesara-bhattaü
ghattā:
to vari mantu kiṃ pi mantijjaï  $  jiṇaharĕ savvu davvu puñjijjaï
    jeṇa gavesaṇa pahu kārāvaï  $  sāhuhũ pañca-saẏaĩ mārāvaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 8:
ekka-divasĕ taṃ tema karāviu  $  jiṇaharĕ savvu davvu puñjāviu
maẏavaddhaṇĕṇa ṇivahŏ vajjariẏaü  $  "tuha bhaṇḍāru muṇindĕhĩ hariẏaü"
teṃ ālāveṃ daṇḍaẏarāeṃ  $  hasiẏaü puṇu puṇu sīha-ṇiṇāeṃ
"pattiẏa sela-siharĕ saẏavattaĩ  $  pattiẏa mahiẏalĕ gaha-ṇakkhattaĩ
pattiẏa vivariẏa canda-divāẏara  $  pattiẏa paribhamanti raẏaṇāẏara
pattiẏa ṇahĕ havanti kulapavvaẏa  $  pattiẏa ekkahĩ miliẏa disā-gaẏa
pattiẏa ṇaü caüvīsa vi jiṇavara  $  pattiẏa ṇaü cakkavaï ṇa kulaẏara
pattiẏa ṇaü tesaṭṭhi purāṇaïm  $  pañcendiẏaĩ ṇa pañca vi ṇāṇaïṃ
solaha sagga bhaggaĩ uppattiẏa  $  muṇi coranti manti maṃ pattiẏa"
ghattā:
jaṃ ṇaravaï volliu kaïvāreṃ  $  mantiu mantu puṇu vi parivāreṃ
      "lahu risi-rūu ekku darisāvahũ  $  puṇu mahaevi-pāsu vaïsārahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 9:
avaseṃ roseṃ pura-paramesaru  $  muṇivara ghallesaï rajjesaru
ema bhaṇevi puṇu vi kokkāviu  $  takkhaṇĕ muṇivara-vesu dharāviu
teṇa samāṇaü jaṇa-maṇa-bhāviṇi  $  lagga viẏārĕhĩ duṇṇaẏa-sāmiṇi
to etthantarĕ gañjoliẏa-taṇu  $  gaü ṇiẏa-ṇivahŏ pāsu maẏavaddhaṇu
"ṇaravaï pekkhu pekkhu muṇi-kammaĩ  $  ḍhukku pamāṇahŏ volliu jaṃ maĩ
mūḍha avuha ṇa vujjhahi ajja vi  $  hiu bhaṇḍāru jāva hiẏa bhajja vi"
ghattā:
jāṇanto vi to vi maṇĕ mūḍhaü  $  ṇaravaï kova-gaïndārūḍhaü
    diṇṇāṇattī ṇaravara-vindahũ  $  dhariẏaĩ pañca vi saẏaĩ muṇindahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 10:
pahu-āeseṃ dhariẏa bhaḍārā  $  je pañcendiẏa-pasara-ṇivārā
je kali-kalusa-kasāẏa-viẏārā  $  je saṃsāra-ghora-uttārā
je cāritta-purahŏ pāgārā  $  je kammaṭṭha-duṭṭha-daṇu-dārā
je ṇīsaṅga aṇaṅga-viẏārā  $  je bhaviẏāẏaṇa-abbhuddhārā
je siva-sāsaẏa-suha-hakkārā  $  je gārava-pamāẏa-viṇivārā
je dālidda-dukkha-khaẏakārā  $  siddhi-varaṅgaṇa-pāṇa-piẏārā
je vāẏaraṇa-purāṇaĩ jāṇā  $  siddhantiẏa ekkekka-pahāṇā
teṃ tehā risi jantĕ chuhāviẏa  $  rasamasakasamasanta pīlāviẏa
ghattā:
pañca vi saẏa pīlāviẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  muṇivara veṇṇi parāviẏa tāvĕhĩ
    ghora-vīra-tavacaraṇu careppiṇu  $  ātāvaṇĕ tava-tavaṇu taveppiṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 11:
keṇa vi tāma vuttu "maṃ païsahŏ  $  veṇṇi vi pāṇa laeppiṇu ṇāsahŏ
guru tumhārā āvaï pāviẏa  $  rāeṃ jantĕ chuhĕvi pīlāviẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ekku muṇi kuddhaü  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālĕ kiẏantu viruddhaü
ghoru raüddu jhāṇu āūriu  $  vaü sammattu saẏalu saṃcūriu
appāṇeṇappāṇu vihattiu  $  takkhaṇĕ chāra-puñju pariattiu
jo kovāṇalu teṇa vimukkaü  $  gaü ṇaẏarahŏ savaḍammuhu ḍhukkaü
ghattā:
paṭṭaṇu cāuddisu saṃdīviu  $  sa-dharu sa-rāulu jālālīviu
    jaṃ jaṃ kumbha-sahāsĕhĩ ghippaï  $  vihi-pariṇāmeṃ jalu vi palippaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 12:
paṭṭaṇu daḍḍhu asesu vi jāvĕhĩ  $  khala jama-joha parāviẏa tāvĕhĩ
je taïlokku vi jiṇĕvi samatthā  $  asi-ghaṇa-saṅkhala-ṇiẏala-vihatthā
kakkaḍa-kavila-kesa bhīsāvaṇa  $  kāla-kiẏanta-līla-darisāvaṇa
kasaṇa-sarīra vīra phuriẏādhara  $  piṅgala-ṇaẏaṇa jhasara-moggara-dhara
jīha-lalanta danta-uddantura  $  ubbhaḍa-viẏaḍa-dāḍha bhaẏa-bhāsura
jama-dūehĩ tehĩ kandantaü  $  ṇaravaï ṇiu sa-manti sa-kalattaü
gampiṇu jamarāẏahŏ jāṇāviu  $  "eṇa muṇinda-ṇivahu pīlāviu"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu kuiu paẏāvaï  $  "tīhi mi darisāvahŏ garuẏāvaï"
ghattā:
pahu-āeseṃ duṇṇaẏa-sāmiṇi  $  ghattiẏa chaṭṭhihĩ puḍhavihĩ pāviṇi
    jahĩ dukkhaĩ aï-ghora-raüddaĩ  $  ṇavarāusu vāvīsa-samuddaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 13:
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa jetthu hakkāriu  $  aṇṇoṇeṇa pahara-ṇiddāriu
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa dalĕvi dalavaṭṭiu  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa haṇĕvi ṇivvaṭṭiu
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa tisūleṃ bhiṇṇaü  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa disā-vali diṇṇaü
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa kaḍāhĕ pamelliu  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa huāsaṇĕ pelliu
aṇṇoṇṇĕṇa vaïtaraṇihĕ ghattiu  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa dharĕvi ṇijjantiu
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa silahu apphāliu  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa duhāĕhĩ phāliu
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa dharĕvi āvīliu  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa vatthu jiha pīliu
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa gharaṭṭaĕ daliẏaü  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa paẏaru jiha miliẏaü
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa vi kūvĕ pamukkaü  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa dhareppiṇu rukkaü
ghattā:
aṇṇoṇṇeṇa paloiu rāgeṃ  $  aṇṇoṇṇeṇa viẏāriu khaggeṃ
     aṇṇoṇṇeṇa gilijjaï jetthu  $  duṇṇaẏa-sāmiṇi pattiẏa tetthu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 14:
aṇṇu vi kiẏaü jeṇa mantittaṇu  $  ghattiu asipattavaṇĕ alakkhaṇu
jahĩ taṃ tiṇu mi silīmuha-sarisaü  $  aṇṇu vi aggi-vaṇṇu ṇippharisaü
jahĩ te loha-rukkha kaṇṭālā  $  asi-pattala asarāla visālā
duggama duṇṇirikkha dullaliẏa  $  ṇāṇāviha-paharaṇa-phala-bhariẏā
jahĩ ṇivaḍanti tāhã phala-pattaĩ  $  tahĩ chindanti ṇirantara gattaĩ
taṃ tehaü vaṇu muĕvi paṇaṭṭhaü  $  puṇu vaïtaraṇihĕ gampi païṭṭhaü
jahĩ taṃ salilu vahaï duggandhaü  $  rasa-vasa-soṇiẏa-maṃsa-samiddhaü
uṇhaü khāru toru aï-virasaü  $  maṇḍa piẏāviu pūẏa-vimissaü
ghattā:
iẏa saṃtāva-dukkha-saṃtattaü  $  khaṇĕ khaṇĕ uppajjantu marantaü
    thiu sattaṃaĕ ṇaraĕ maẏavaddhaṇu  $  meiṇi jāma meru gaẏaṇaṅgaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 15:
tāva viruddhaehĩ hakkāriu  $  ṇaravaï ṇāraehĩ paccāriu
"maru maru saṃbharu duccariẏāĩ  $  jāĩ āsi paĩ saṃcariẏāĩ
pañca-saẏaĩ muṇivarahũ haẏāĩ  $  laï aṇuhuñjahi tāĩ duhāĩ"
ema bhaṇeppiṇu khaggĕhĩ chiṇṇaü  $  puṇu vāṇĕhĩ bhallehĩ bhiṇṇaü
puṇu tilu tilu karavattĕhĩ kappiu  $  puṇu giddhahũ siva-sāṇahũ appiu
puṇu pellāviu magga-gaïndĕhĩ  $  puṇu veḍhāviu paṇṇaẏa-vindĕhĩ
puṇu khaṇḍiu puṇu jantĕ chuhāviu  $  addhu sahāsu vāra pīlāviu
dukkhu dukkhu puṇu kaha vi kilesĕhĩ  $  paribhamantu bhava-joṇi-sahāsĕhĩ
etthu vihaṅgu jāu ṇiẏa-kāṇaṇĕ  $  evahĩ acchaï tumha-gharaṅgaṇĕ"
ghattā:
tāva pakkhi maṇĕ pacchuttāviu  $  "kiha maĩ savaṇa-saṅghu saṃtāviu
      ettiẏa-matteṃ abbhuddharaṇaü  $  mahu muẏahŏ vi jiṇavaru saraṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 35, Kaḍavaka 16:
jaṃ āẏaṇṇiu pakkhi-bhavantaru  $  jāṇaï-kanteṃ pabhaṇiu muṇivaru
"to vari amhahũ vaẏaĩ caḍāvahu  $  pakkhihĕ suhaẏa-panthu darisāvahu"
taṃ valaevahŏ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu  $  pañcāṇuvvaẏa uccāreppiṇu
diṇṇa paḍicchiẏa tihi mi jaṇehĩ  $  puṇu ahiṇandiẏa ekka-maṇehĩ
muṇivara gaẏa āẏāsahŏ jāvĕhĩ  $  lakkhaṇu bhavaṇu parāiu tāvĕhĩ
"rāhava eu kāĩ acchariẏaü  $  jaṃ mandiru ṇiẏa-raẏaṇĕhĩ bhariẏaü"
teṇa vi kahiu savvu jaṃ vittaü  $  "maĩ āhāra-dāṇa-phalu pattaü
takkhaṇĕ pañcacchariu padarisiu  $  mehĕhĩ jiha aṇavaraü pavarisiu"
ghattā:
rāmahŏ vaẏaṇu suṇevi aṇanteṃ  $  geṇhavi maṇi-raẏaṇaĩ valavanteṃ
    vaḍa-pāroha-samehĩ pacaṇḍĕhĩ  $  rahavaru ghaḍiu sa ẏaṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [36. chattīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
rahu koḍḍāvaṇaü maṇi-raẏaṇa-sahāsĕhĩ ghaḍiẏaü
gaẏaṇahŏ ucchalĕvi ṇaṃ diṇaẏara-sandaṇu paḍiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 1:
tahĩ tehaĕ sundarĕ suppavahĕ  $  āraṇṇa-mahāgaẏa-jutta-rahĕ
dhurĕ lakkhaṇu rahavarĕ dāsarahi  $  sura-līlaĕ puṇu viharanti mahi
taṃ kaṇhavaṇṇa-ṇaï muĕvi gaẏa  $  vaṇĕ kahi mi ṇihāliẏa matta gaẏa
kattha vi pañcāṇaṇa giri-guhĕhĩ  $  muttāvali vikkhiranti ṇahĕhĩ
kattha vi uḍḍāviẏa saüṇa-saẏa  $  ṇaṃ aḍavihĕ uḍḍĕvi pāṇa gaẏa
kattha vi kalāva ṇaccanti vaṇĕ  $  ṇāvaï ṇaṭṭāvā juvaï-jaṇĕ
kattha i hariṇaĩ bhaẏa-bhīẏāĩ  $  saṃsārahŏ jiha pavvaïẏāĩ
kattha vi ṇāṇāviha-rukkha-rāi  $  ṇaṃ mahi-kulavahuahĕ roma-rāi
ghattā:
tahŏ daṇḍaẏavaṇahŏ  $  aggaĕ dīsaï jalavāhiṇi
     ṇāmeṃ koñcaṇaï  $  thira-gamaṇa ṇāĩ vara-kāmiṇi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 2:
koñcaṇaïhĕ tīrĕṇa saṃṭhiẏaĩ  $  laẏa-maṇḍavĕ gampi pariṭṭhiẏaĩ
chuḍu jĕ chuḍu jĕ saraẏahŏ āgamaṇĕ  $  sacchāẏa mahāduma jāẏa vaṇĕ
ṇava-ṇaliṇihĕ kamalaĩ vihasiẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ kāmiṇi-vaẏaṇaĩ pahasiẏaïṃ
dhavaleṇa ṇirantara-ṇiggaĕṇa  $  ghaṇa-kalasĕhĩ gaẏaṇa-mahaggaĕṇa
ahisiñcĕvi takkhaṇĕ vasuha-siri  $  ṇaṃ thaviẏa avāhiṇi kumbhaïri
tahĩ tehaĕ saraĕ suhāvaṇaĕ  $  paribhamaï jaṇaddaṇu kāṇaṇaĕ
kovaṇḍa-silīmuha-gahiẏa-karu  $  gajjanta-matta-māẏaṅga-dharu
vaṇĕ tāma suandhu vāu aïu  $  jo pāriẏāẏa-kusumabbhahiu
ghattā:
kaḍḍhiu bhamaru jiha  $  teṃ vāeṃ suṭṭhu suandheṃ
    dhāiu mahumahaṇu  $  jiha gaü gaṇiẏārihĕ gandheṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 3:
thovantarĕ pariosiẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  vaṃsatthalu lakkhiu lakkhaṇĕṇa
ṇaṃ saẏaṇa-vindu āvāsiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ maẏaülu vāheṃ tāsiẏaü
aṇṇekka-pāsĕ koḍḍāvaṇaüü  $  jama-jiha jema bhīsāvaṇaü
gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ khaggu ṇihāliẏaü  $  ṇāṇāviha-kusumomāliẏaü
lakkhaṇahŏ ṇāĩ abbhuddharaṇu  $  ṇaṃ samvukumārahŏ jamakaraṇu
taṃ sūrahāsu ṇāmeṇa asi  $  jasu teeṃ ṇiẏa paha muaï sasi
jasu dhārahŏ kāla-diṭṭhi vasaï  $  jasu kālu kiẏantu vi jamu tasaï
teṃ hatthu pasārĕvi laïu kiha  $  para-ṇara-ṇippasaru kalattu jiha
ghattā:
puṇu kīlantaĕṇa  $  asivatteṃ haü vaṃsatthalu
    tāva samucchalĕvi  $  siru paḍiu sa-maüḍu sa-kuṇḍalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 4:
jaṃ diṭṭhu vivāiu sira-kamalu  $  sirivaccheṃ vihuṇiu bhuẏa-jualu
"dhimmaĩ ṇikkāraṇu vahiu ṇaru  $  vattīsa vi lakkhaṇa-lakkha-dharu"
puṇu jāma ṇihālaï vaṃsa-vaṇu  $  ṇara-ruṇḍu diṭṭhu phandanta-taṇu
taṃ pekkhĕvi cintaï khaggadharu  $  "thiu māẏā-rūveṃ ko vi ṇaru"
gaü ema bhaṇeppiṇu mahumahaṇu  $  ṇiviseṇa parāẏaü ṇiẏa-bhavaṇu
rāhaveṇa vuttu "bho suhaḍa-sasi  $  kahĩ laddhu khaggu kahĩ gaẏaü asi
teṇa vi taṃ saẏalu vi akkhiẏaü  $  vaṃsatthalu jiha vaṇĕ lakkhiẏaü
jiha laddhu khaggu taṃ atula-valu  $  jiha khuḍiu kumārahŏ sira-kamalu
ghattā:
vuccaï rāhavĕṇa  $  "maṃ ettiẏa muhivaĕ sāḍiẏa
   asi sāvaṇṇu ṇavi  $  paĩ jamahŏ jīha uppāḍiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 5:
jaṃ ehiẏa bhīsaṇa vatta suẏa  $  vevanti pajampiẏa jaṇaẏa-suẏa
"laẏa-maṇḍavĕ viulĕ ṇiviṭṭhāhũ  $  suhu ṇāhi vaṇĕ vi païṭṭhāhũ
paribhamaï jaṇaddaṇu jahĩ jĕ jahĩ  $  divĕdivĕ kaḍamaddaṇu tahĩ jĕ tahĩ
kara-calaṇa-deha-sira-khaṇḍaṇahũ  $  ṇivviṇṇa māĕ haũ bhaṇḍaṇahũ
haũ tāeṃ diṇṇī kehāhũ  $  kali-kāla-kiẏantahũ jehāhũ"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï hari  $  "jaï rāju ṇa porisu hoi vari
jima dāṇeṃ jĕma sukaïttaṇĕṇa  $  jima āuheṇa jima kittaṇĕṇa
paribhamaï kitti savvahŏ ṇarahŏ  $  dhavalanti bhuvaṇu jiha jiṇavarahŏ
ghattā:
āẏahũ ettiẏahũ  $  jasu ekku vi cittĕ ṇa bhāvaï
    so jāu jji muu  $  parimisu jaṃ jamu ṇevāvaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 6:
etthantarĕ sura-saṃtāvaṇahŏ  $  lahu vahiṇi sahoẏara rāvaṇahŏ
pāẏālalaṅka-laṅkesarahŏ  $  dhaṇa pāṇa-piẏārī tahŏ kharahŏ
candaṇahi ṇāma rahasucchaliẏa  $  ṇiẏa-puttahŏ pāsu samuccaliẏa
"laï vāraha-varisaĩ bhariẏāĩ  $  caü-divasĕhĩ puṇu sottariẏāĩ
aṇṇahĩ tahĩ divasahĩ karĕ caḍaï  $  taṃ khaggu ajju ṇahĕ ṇivvaḍaï"
so eva cavantī mahura-sara  $  vali-dīvaṅgāraẏa-gahiẏa-kara
sajjaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇahŏ  $  gaẏa pāsu patta ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇahŏ
tāṇantarĕ asi-dalavaṭṭiẏaü  $  vaṃsatthalu diṭṭhu ṇivaṭṭiẏaü
ghattā:
diṭṭhu kumāra-siru  $  sa-maüḍu maṇi-kuṇḍala-maṇḍiu
    jantĕhĩ kiṇṇarĕhĩ  $  vara-kaṇaẏa-kamalu ṇaṃ chaṇḍiu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 7:
sira-kamalu ṇieppiṇu gīḍha-bhaẏa  $  romantī mahiẏalĕ muccha-gaẏa
kandanti ruvanti sa-veẏaṇiẏa  $  ṇijjīva jāẏa ṇicceẏaṇiẏa
puṇu dukkhu dukkhu saṃvariẏa-maṇa  $  muha-kāẏara dara-maüliẏa-ṇaẏaṇa

puṇu kokkaï puṇu dhāhahĩ raḍaï  $  puṇu dīsaü ṇihālaï puṇu paḍaï
puṇu uṭṭhaï puṇu kandaï kaṇaï  $  puṇuruttĕhĩ appaü āhaṇaï
puṇu siru apphālaï dharaṇivahĕ  $  rovantihĕ sura rovanti ṇahĕ
ghattā:
je caüdisĕhĩ thiẏa  $  ṇiẏa ḍāla pasārĕvi taruvara
   "mā ruva candaṇahi"  $  ṇaṃ sāhāranti sahoẏara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 8:
appāṇaü to vi ṇa saṃthavaï  $  rovanti puṇu vi puṇu uṭṭhavaï
"hā putta viujjhahi luhahi muhu  $  hā viruaĕ ṇiddaĕ suttu tuhũ
hā kiṇṇālāvahi putta maĩ  $  hā kiṃ darisāviẏa māẏa paĩ
hā uvasaṃhārahi rūvu lahu  $  hā putta dehi piẏa-vaẏaṇu mahu
hā putta kāĩ kiu ruhira-vaḍu  $  hā putta ehi ucchaṅgĕ caḍu
hā putta lāi muhĕ muha-kamalu  $  hā putta ehi piu thaṇa-jualu
hā putta dehi āliṅgaṇaü  $  jeṃ ṇaccami vaṇĕ vaddhāvaṇaü
ṇava-māsu chuddhu jeṃ maĩ uarĕ  $  taṃ sahala maṇoraha ajju jaṇĕ
ghattā:
hā hā daḍḍha vihi  $  kahĩ ṇiẏaü puttu kahŏ saṅghami
    kāĩ kiẏanta kiu  $  hā daïva kavaṇa disa laṅghami
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 9:
hā ajju amaṅgalu vihĩ purahã  $  pāẏālalaṅka-laṅkāurahã
hā ajju dukkhu vandhava-jaṇahŏ  $  hā ajju paḍiẏa bhua rāvaṇahŏ
hā ajju kharahŏ rovāvaṇaü  $  hā ajju riuhũ vaddhāvaṇaü
hā ajju phuṭṭu ki ṇa jamahŏ siru  $  hā putta ṇivāriu maï mi ciru
taṃ khaggu ṇa sāvaṇṇahŏ ṇarahŏ  $  para hoi addha-cakkesarahŏ
kiṃ teṇa ji pāḍiu sira-kamalu  $  maṇi-kuṇḍala-maṇḍiẏa-gaṇḍaẏalu"
puṇu puṇu darisāvaï sura ẏaṇahŏ  $  ravi-huavaha-varuṇa-pahañjaṇahŏ
"ahŏ devahŏ vālu ṇa rakkhiẏaü  $  savvĕhĩ milevi upekkhiẏaü
ghattā:
tumhahã dosu ṇavi  $  mahu dosu jāhĕ maṇu tāviu
    mañchuḍu aṇṇa-bhavĕ  $  
maĩ aṇṇu ko vi saṃtāviu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 10:
etthantarĕ soeṃ pariẏariẏa  $  ṇaḍi jiha tiha puṇu macchara-bhariẏa
ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇa vipphuriẏa-muha  $  vikarāla ṇāĩ khaẏa-kāla-chuha
parivaddhiẏa ravi-maṇḍalĕ miliẏa  $  jama-jīha jema ṇahĕ kiligiliẏa
"jeṃ ghāiu puttu mahu ttaṇaü  $  khara-ṇandaṇu rāvaṇa-bhāẏaṇaü
tahŏ jīviu jaï ṇa ajju harami  $  to huẏavaha-puñjĕ paīsarami"
iẏa païja kareppiṇu candaṇahi  $  kira valĕvi palovaï jāma mahi
laẏa-maṇḍavĕ lakkhiẏa ve vi ṇara  $  ṇaṃ dharaṇihĕ ubbhiẏa ubhaẏa kara
tahĩ ekku diṭṭhu karavāla-bhuu  $  "laï eṇa ji haü mahu taṇaü suu
ghattā:
eṇa ji asivarĕṇa  $  ṇiẏamatthahŏ kula-pāẏārahŏ
   sahũ vaṃsatthalĕṇa  $  siru pāḍiu samvukumārahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 11:
jaṃ diṭṭha vaṇantarĕ ve vi ṇara  $  gaü putta-viou kou ṇavara
āẏāmiẏa viraha-mahābhaḍĕṇa  $  ṇaccāviẏa maẏaraddhaẏa-ṇaḍĕṇa
pulaïjjaï pāseijjaï vi  $  paritappaï jara-kheijjaï vi
mucchijjaï ummucchijjaï vi  $  ruṇuruṇaï viẏārahĩ bhajjaï vi
"vari eu rūu uvasaṃgharami  $  sura-sundaru kaṇṇa-vesu karami

hiẏaïcchiu takkhaṇĕ rūu kiu  $  ṇaṃ kāmahŏ koḍu jĕ tiṃ vihiu
gaẏa tahĩ jahĩ tiṇṇi vi jaṇaĩ vaṇĕ  $  puṇu dhāhahĩ ruaṇahĩ lagga khaṇĕ
ghattā:
pabhaṇaï jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  "vala pekkhu kaṇṇa kiha rovaï
    jaṃ kālantariu  $  taṃ dukkhu ṇāĩ ukkovaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 12:
rovantī vaḍḍeṃ malaharĕṇa  $  hakkārĕvi pucchiẏa halaharĕṇa

kiṃ keṇa vi kahĩ vi paribbhaviẏa"  $  taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi vāla caviẏa
"haũ pāviṇi dīṇa daẏāvaṇiẏa  $  ṇivvandhava ruvami varāẏa ṇiẏa
vaṇĕ bhullī ṇaü jāṇami disaü  $  ṇaü jāṇami kavaṇu desu visaü
kahĩ gacchami cakkavūhĕ paḍiẏa  $  mahu puṇṇĕhĩ tumha samāvaḍiẏa
jaï amhahũ uppari atthi maṇu  $  to pariṇaü viṇha vi ekku jaṇu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi halāuhĕṇa  $  kiẏa ṇakkhacchoḍī rāhavĕṇa
ghattā:
karaẏalu diṇṇu muhĕ  $  kiẏa vaṅka bhaũha siru cāliu
    "sundara ṇa hoi vahu"  $  somittihĕ vaẏaṇu ṇihāliu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 13:
jo ṇaravaï aï-sammāṇa-karu  $  so pattiẏa attha-samattha-haru
jo hoi uvāẏaṇĕ vacchalaü  $  so pattiẏa visaharu kevalaü
jo mittu akāraṇĕ ei gharu  $  so pattiẏa duṭṭhu kalatta-haru
jo panthiu aliẏa-saṇehiẏaü  $  so pattiẏa coru aṇehiẏaü
jo ṇaru atthakkaĕ lalli-karu  $  so sattu ṇiruttaü jīva-haru
jā kāmiṇi kavaḍa-cāḍu kuṇaï  $  sā pattiẏa sira-kamalu vi luṇaï
jā kulavahu savahĕhĩ vavaharaï  $  sā pattiẏa viruẏa-saẏaĩ karaï
jā kaṇṇa hovi para-ṇaru varaï  $  sā kiṃ vaḍḍhantī pariharaï
ghattā:
āẏahũ aṭṭhahu mi  $  jo ṇaru mūḍhaü vīsambhaï
     loiu dhammu jiha  $  chuḍu vippaü paĕ paĕ labbhaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 14:
cinteppiṇu therāsaṇa-muhĕṇa  $  somitti vuttu sīrāuhĕṇa
"mahu atthi bhajja sumaṇohariẏa  $  laï lakkhaṇa vahu lakkhaṇa-bhariẏa"
jaṃ eva samāsaĕ akkhiẏaü  $  kaṇheṇa vi maṇĕ uvalakkhiẏaü
"haũ lemi kumāri sa-lakkhaṇiẏa  $  jā āgamĕ sāmuddaĕ bhaṇiẏa
jaṅghoru-ahaṅgaẏa vaṭṭa-thaṇa  $  dīhara-kara-ṇakkhaṅguli-ṇaẏaṇa
rattaṃhi gaïnda-ṇirikkhaṇiẏa  $  cāmīẏara-vaṇṇa sapujjaṇiẏa
jā uṇṇaẏa ṇāsĕ ṇilāḍĕ tiẏa  $  sā hoi ti-puttahũ māẏariẏa
kāẏaṅghi sa-gaggara tāvasiẏa  $  sama-calaṇaṅguli acirāusiẏa
jā haṃsa-vaṃsa varavīṇa-sara  $  mahu-vaṇṇa mahā-ghaṇa-chāẏa-dhara
suha-bhamara-ṇāhi-sira-bhamara-thaṇa  $  sā vahu-suẏa vahu-dhaṇa vahu-saẏaṇa
jahĕ vāmaĕ karaẏalĕ honti saẏa  $  mīṇāravinda-visa-dāma-dhaẏa
gouru gharu girivaru ahava sila  $  su-pasattha sa-lakkhaṇa sā mahila
cakkaṅkusa-kuṇḍala-uddhariha  $  romāvali valiẏa bhuẏaṅgu jiha
addhendu-ṇiḍāleṃ sundarĕṇa  $  muttāhala-sama-dantantarĕṇa
ghattā:
āĕhĩ lakkhaṇĕhĩ  $  sāmuddĕhĩ vaṇiẏa suṇijjaï
      cakkāhivahŏ tiẏa  $  cakkavaï puttu uppajjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 36, Kaḍavaka 15:
vahu rāhava eha alakkhaṇiẏa  $  haũ bhaṇami ṇa lakkhaṇeṇa bhaṇiẏa
jaṅghoru-karehĩ samaṃsaliẏa  $  cala-loẏaṇa gamaṇuttāvaliẏa
kummuṇṇaẏa-paẏa visamaṅguliẏa  $  dhuẏa-kavila-kesi khari paṅguliẏa
savvaṅga-samuṭṭhiẏa-roma-raï  $  tahĕ puttu vi bhattāru vi maraï
kaḍi-lañchaṇa bhaũhāvali-miliẏa  $  sā deva ṇiruttaü jhenduliẏa
dāliddiṇi tittira-loẏaṇiẏa  $  pārevaẏacchi jaṇa-bhojaṇiẏa
virasaüha-diṭṭhi virasaüha-sara  $  sā dukkhahũ bhāẏaṇa hoi para
ṇāsaggeṃ thoreṃ mantharĕṇa  $  sā lañjiẏa kiṃ vahu-vitthareṇa
kaḍi-cihura-ṇāhi muha-māsuriẏa  $  sā rakkhasi vahu-bhaẏa-bhāsuriẏa
kaḍu-aṅgiẏa matta-gaïnda-chavi  $  haũ ehiẏa pariṇami kaṇṇa ṇavi"
ghattā:
pabhaṇaï candaṇahi  $  "kiṃ ṇiẏaẏa-sahāveṃ lajjami
      jaï haũ ṇisiẏariẏa  $  to paï mi ajju sa ïṃ bhu ñjami"
----------  [37. sattatīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
candaṇahi alajjiẏa ema pagajjiẏa "maru maru bhūẏahũ demi vali"
ṇiẏa-rūveṃ vaḍḍhiẏa raṇa-rasĕ aḍḍhiẏa rāvaṇa-rāmahũ ṇāĩ kali
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 1:
puṇu puṇu vi pavaḍḍhiẏa kilikilanti  $  jālāvali-jālā-saẏa muanti
bhaẏa-bhīsaṇa kovāṇala-saṇāha  $  ṇaṃ dharaĕ samubbhiẏa pavara vāha
ṇaha-sari-ravi-kamalahŏ kāraṇatthi  $  ahavaï ṇaṃ abbhuddhāraṇatthi
ṇaṃ ghusalaï abbha-ciriḍḍihillu  $  tārā-vuvvuva-saẏa-viḍḍirillu
sasi-loṇiẏa-piṇḍaü levi dhāi  $  gaha-ḍimbhahŏ pīhaü dei ṇāĩ
ahavaï kiṃ vahuṇā vitthareṇa  $  ṇaṃ ṇahaẏala-sila geṇhaï sireṇa
ṇaṃ hari-vala-mottiẏa-kāraṇeṇa  $  mahi-gaẏaṇa-sippi phoḍaï khaṇeṇa
valaeveṃ vuccaï "vaccha vaccha  $  tuhũ vahuẏahĕ cariẏaĩ peccha peccha"
ghattā:
candaṇahi pajampiẏa  $  tiṇu vi ṇa kampiẏa  $  "laïu khaggu haü puttu jiha
    tiṇṇi vi khajjantaĩ  $  mārijjantaĩ  $  rakkhejjahŏ appāṇu tiha"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 2:
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa asuhāvaṇeṇa  $  karavālu padarisiu mahumaheṇa
daḍha-kaḍhiṇa-kaḍhoruppīlaṇeṇa  $  aṅguli-aṅguṭṭhāvīlaṇeṇa
taṃ maṇḍalaggu tharaharaï kema  $  bhattāra-bhaeṃ sukalattu jema
aṇavaraẏa-maüjjharĕ ṇara-ṇisumbhĕ  $  tahĩ dārijjantĕ gaïnda-kumbhĕ
jo dhārahĩ mottiẏa-ṇiẏaru laggu  $  pāseva-phuliṅgu vahu va valaggu
taṃ tehaü khaggu laevi teṇa  $  vijjāhari pabhaṇiẏa lakkhaṇeṇa
"jeṃ laïu sīsu tuha ṇandaṇāsu  $  karavālu eu taṃ sūrahāsu
jaï atthi ko vi raṇa-bhara-samatthu  $  tahŏ savvahŏ ubbhiu dhamma-hatthu"
khara-gharaṇiĕ vuttu "ṇa hoi kajju  $  ko vāraï māraï maï mi ajju"
ghattā:
sā eva bhaṇeppiṇu  $  galagajjeppiṇu  $  calaṇĕhĩ apphālevi mahi
      khara-dūsaṇa-vīrahũ  $  atula-sarīrahũ  $  gaẏa kūvāreṃ candaṇahi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 3:
rovanti padhāiẏa dīṇa-vaẏaṇa  $  jalahara jiha jiha varisanti ṇaẏaṇa
lamvanti lamva-kaḍiẏala-samagga  $  ṇaṃ candaṇa-laẏahĕ bhuaṅga lagga
vīẏā-maẏalañchaṇa-saṇṇihehĩ  $  appāṇu viẏāriu ṇiẏa-ṇahehĩ
ruhirolliẏa-thaṇaghippanta-ratta  $  ṇaṃ kaṇaẏa-kalasa kuṅkuma-vilitta
ṇaṃ dāvaï lakkhaṇa-rāma-kitti  $  ṇaṃ khara-dūsaṇa-rāvaṇa-bhavitti
ṇaṃ ṇisiẏara-loẏahŏ dukkha-khāṇi  $  ṇaṃ mandoẏarihĕ supurisa-hāṇi
ṇaṃ laṅkahĕ païsāranti saṅka  $  ṇiviseṇa patta pāẏālalaṅka
ṇiẏa-mandirĕ dhāhāvanti ṇāri  $  ṇaṃ kharadūsaṇahŏ païṭṭha māri
attā
kūvāru suṇeppiṇu  $  dhaṇa pekkheppiṇu  $  rāeṃ valĕvi paloiẏaü
    tihuẏaṇu saṃghārĕvi  $  palaü samārĕvi  $  ṇāĩ kiẏanteṃ joiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 4:
kūvāru suṇĕvi kula-bhūsaṇeṇa  $  candaṇahi papucchiẏa dūsaṇeṇa
"kahĕ keṇuppāḍiu jamahŏ ṇaẏaṇu  $  kahĕ keṇa pajoiu kāla-vaẏaṇu
kahi keṇa kiẏantahŏ kiẏaü maraṇu  $  kahi keṇa kiẏaü visa-kanda-caraṇu
kahi keṇa vaddhu pavaṇeṇa pavaṇu  $  kahi keṇa daḍḍhu jalaṇeṇa jalaṇu
kahi keṇa bhiṇṇu vajjeṇa vajju  $  kahi keṇa dhariu jalu jalĕṇa ajju
kahi keṇa bhāṇu uṇheṇa taviu  $  kahi keṇa samuddu tisāĕ khaviu
kahi keṇa khuḍiu phaṇi-maṇi-ṇihāu  $  kahĕ keṇa sahiu sura-kulisa-ghāu

ghattā:
candaṇahi pavolliẏa  $  aṃsujalolliẏa  $  "jaṇa-vallahu mahu taṇaü suu
    olaggaï pāṇĕhĩ  $  viṇaẏa-samāṇĕhĩ  $  ṇaravaï samvukumāru muu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 5:
āẏaṇṇĕvi samvukumāra-maraṇu  $  saṃtāvaṇa-soẏa-vioẏa-karaṇu
pavirala-muhu vāha-bharanta-ṇaẏaṇu  $  dukkhāuru dara-ohulla-vaẏaṇu
kharu ruẏaï sa-dukkhaü "atula-piṇḍu  $  hā ajju paḍiu mahu vāhu-daṇḍu
hā ajju jāẏa maṇĕ garua saṅka  $  hā ajju suṇṇa pāẏālalaṅka
hā ṇandaṇa sura-pañcāṇaṇāsu  $  kavaṇuttaru demi dasāṇaṇāsu"
etthantarĕ tāma timuṇḍa-dhāri  $  vahu-vuddhi pajampiu vambhaẏāri
"he ṇaravaï mūḍhā ruahi kāĩ  $  saṃsārĕ bhamantahũ sua-saẏāĩ
āẏāĩ muāĩ gaẏāĩ jāĩ  $  ko sakkaï rāẏa gaṇevi tāĩ
ghattā:
kahŏ gharu kahŏ pariẏaṇu  $  kahŏ sampaẏa-dhaṇu  $  māẏa vappu kahŏ puttu tiẏa
    keṃ kajjeṃ rovahi  $  appaü soẏahi  $  bhava-saṃsārahŏ eha kiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 6:
jaṃ dukkhu dukkhu saṃthaviu rāu  $  paḍivolliu ṇiẏa-ghariṇiĕ sahāu
"kahĕ keṇa vahiu mahu taṇaü puttu"  $  taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi dhaṇiaĕ vuttu
"suṇu ṇaravaï duggamĕ duppavesĕ  $  dugghoṭṭa-thaṭṭa-ghaṭṭaṇa-pavesĕ
pañcāṇaṇa-lakkhukkhaẏa-karālĕ  $  tahĩ tehaĕ daṇḍaẏa-vaṇĕ visālĕ
ve maṇusa diṭṭha soṇḍīra vīra  $  mehāravinda-saṇṇiha-sarīra
kovaṇḍa-silīmuha-gahiẏa-hattha  $  para-vala-vala-utthallaṇa-samattha
tahĩ ekku diṭṭhu tiẏasahũ asajjhu  $  teṃ laïu khaggu haü puttu majjhu
aṇṇu vi avalovahi deva deva  $  kakkhoru viẏāriu pekkhu keva
ghattā:
vaṇĕ dharĕvi ruẏantī  $  dhāha muantī  $  kaha vi ṇa bhutta teṇa ṇarĕṇa
    ṇiẏa-puṇṇĕhĩ cukkī  $  ṇaha-muha-lukkī  $  ṇaliṇi jema sarĕ kuñjarĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi vahu-jāṇaehĩ  $  uvalakkhiẏa aṇṇĕhĩ rāṇaehĩ
"mālūra-pavara-pīvara-thaṇāĕ  $  para eẏaĩ kammaĩ aḍaẏaṇāĕ
mañchuḍu ṇa samicchiẏa supuriseṇa  $  appaü viddhaṃsĕvi  āẏa teṇa"
etthantarĕ ṇivaï ṇiei jāva  $  ṇaha-ṇiẏara-viẏāriẏa diṭṭha tāva
kiṃsuẏa-laẏa vva āratta-vaṇṇa  $  rattuppala-māla va bhamara-chaṇṇa
tahĩ aharu diṭṭhu dasaṇagga-bhiṇṇu  $  ṇaṃ vāla-tavaṇu phagguṇĕ uiṇṇu
taṃ ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhĕvi kharu viruddhu  $  ṇaṃ  kesari maẏagala-gandha-luddhu
bhaḍu bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkaru muha-karālu  $  ṇaṃ jagahŏ samuṭṭhiu palaẏa-kālu
ghattā:
amara vi ākampiẏa  $  ema pajampiẏa  $  "kahŏ uppari āruṭṭhu kharu"
   rahu khañciu aruṇeṃ  $  sahũ sasi-varuṇeṃ  $  "maĩ vi gilesaï ṇavara ṇaru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 8:
uṭṭhanteṃ uṭṭhiu bhaḍa-ṇihāu  $  aṭṭhāṇa-khohu ṇiviseṇa jāu
cūranta paropparu suhaḍa ḍhukka  $  ṇaṃ jalaṇihi ṇiẏa-majjāẏa-cukka
sīseṇa sīsu paṭṭeṇa paṭṭu  $  calaṇeṇa calaṇu karu kara-ṇihaṭṭhu
maüḍeṇa maüḍu tuṭṭevi laggu  $  mehalu mehala-ṇivaheṇa bhaggu
uṭṭhanti ke vi tiṇa-samu gaṇanti  $  ohāvaṇa-māṇeṃ ṇa vi ṇamanti
aha ṇamaï ko vi kivaṇattaṇeṇa  $  paḍio vi ṇa uṭṭhaï bhaḍu bhareṇa
dūsaṇeṇa ṇivāriẏa vaddha-koha  $  vihaḍapphaḍa saṇṇajjhanti joha
"jaï paü vi dehu ārūsamāṇa  $  to hosaï rāẏahŏ taṇiẏa āṇa
ghattā:
maṃ kajju viṇāsahŏ  $  tāma vaīsahŏ  $  jo asi-raẏaṇu maṇḍa haraï
    siru khuḍaï kumārahŏ  $  vijjā-pārahŏ  $  so kiṃ tumhahĩ osaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 9:
to vari kijjaü mahu taṇiẏa vuddhi  $  ṇaravaï asahāẏahŏ ṇatthi siddhi
ṇāva vi ṇa vahaï viṇu tāraeṇa  $  jalaṇu vi ṇa jalaï viṇu mārueṇa
ekkallaü gampiṇu kāĩ karahi  $  raẏaṇāẏarĕ santĕ tisāĕ marahi
sante vi mahaggaĕ visahĕ caḍahi  $  jiṇĕ accie vi saṃsārĕ paḍahi
jasu sārahi phuḍu bhuvaṇekkavīru  $  suravara-paharaṇa-caḍḍiẏa-sarīru
jaga-kesari ari-kula-palaẏa-kālu  $  para-vala-vagalāmuhu bhua-visālu
duddama-dāṇava-duggāha-gāhu  $  surakari-kara-sama-thira-thora-vāhu
telokka-bhuvaggala-bhaḍa-taḍakka  $  duddarisaṇa bhīsaṇa jama-jhaḍakka
ghattā:
tahŏ tihuaṇa-mallahŏ  $  sura-maṇa-sallahŏ  $  tiẏasa-vinda-saṃtāvaṇahŏ
    gaü samvu suhaggaï  $  paĩ olaggaï  $  gampi kahijjaï rāvaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 10:
āẏaṇṇĕvi taṃ dūsaṇahŏ vaẏaṇu  $  kharu kharaü pavolliu guñja-ṇaẏaṇu
"dhiddhĩ lajjijjaï supurisāhũ  $  para eẏaĩ kammaĩ kupurisāhũ
sāhīṇu jīu dehatthu jāva  $  kiha gammaï aṇṇahŏ pāsu tāva
jāeṃ jīveṃ marievaüṃ jĕ  $  to vari pahariu vara-vaïri-puñjĕ
jeṃ labbhaï sāhukkāru loĕ  $  ajarāmaru ko vi ṇa macca-loĕ
jima bhiḍiu ajju ari-vara-samuddĕ  $  jima jaṇiẏa maṇoraha saẏaṇa-vindĕ
jima asi-savvala-kontehĩ bhiṇṇu  $  jima jasa-paḍahaü taïlokkĕ diṇṇu
jima ṇahĕ tosāviu sura-ṇihāu  $  jima mahu mi ajju khaẏa-kālu āu
ghattā:
jima sattu-silāẏalĕ  $  vahu-soṇiẏa-jalĕ  $  dhuu parihava-paḍu appaṇaü
    jima sa-dhaü sa-sāhaṇu  $  sa-bhaḍu sa-paharaṇu  $  gaü ṇiẏa-puttahŏ pāhuṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇiẏa-kula-bhūsaṇeṇa  $  lahu lehu visajjiu dūsaṇeṇa
saṇṇaddhu kharu vi vahu-samara-sūru  $  apphālĕvi valĕ saṃgāma-tūru
vihaḍapphaḍa bhaḍa saṇṇaddha ke vi  $  sammāṇa-dāṇu riṇu saṃbharevi
keṇa vi kareṇa karavālu gahiu  $  keṇa vi dhaṇuharu toṇīra-sahiu
keṇa vi musaṇḍhi moggaru pacaṇḍu  $  keṇa vi huli keṇa vi cittadaṇḍu
ṇāṇāviha-paharaṇa-gahiẏa-hattha  $  saṇṇaddha suhaḍa raṇa-bhara-samattha
ṇīsariu seṇṇu pariharĕvi saṅku  $  ṇaṃ vamĕvi lagga pāẏāla-laṅka
raha-turaẏa-gaïnda-ṇarinda-vinda  $  ṇaṃ su-kaï-muhahŏ ṇigganti sadda
ghattā:
khara-dūsaṇa-sāhaṇu  $  harisa-pasāhaṇu  $  amarisa-kuddhaü dhāiẏaü
    gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ līẏaü  $  ṇāvaï vīẏaü  $  joisa-cakku parāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ diṭṭhu ṇahaṅgaṇĕ daṇu-ṇihāu  $  valaeveṃ vuttu sumitti-jāu
"ĕu dīsaï kāĩ ṇahagga-maggĕ  $  kiṃ kiṇṇara-ṇivahu va caliu saggĕ
kiṃ pavara pakkhi kiṃ ghaṇa visaṭṭa  $  kiṃ vandaṇa-hattiĕ sura paẏaṭṭa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï viṇhu  $  "vala dīsaï vaïrihĩ taṇaü ciṇhu
khaggeṇa vivāiu sīsu jāsu  $  kuḍhĕ laggaü mañchuḍu ko vi tāsu"
avaropparu e ālāva jāva  $  hakkāriu lakkhaṇu kharĕṇa tāva
"jiha samvukumārahŏ laïẏa pāṇa  $  tiha pāva paḍicchahi enta vāṇa
jiha laïu khaggu para-ṇāri bhutta  $  tiha paharu paharu puṇṇāli-putta"
ghattā:
ekkekka-pahāṇahũ  $  kharĕṇa samāṇahũ  $  caüdaha sahasa samāvaḍiẏa
    gaẏa jema maïndahŏ  $  riu govindahŏ  $  hakkāreppiṇu abbhiḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 13:
etthantarĕ bhaḍa-kaḍamaddaṇeṇa  $  jokkāriu rāmu jaṇaddaṇeṇa
"tuhũ sīẏa paẏatteṃ rakkhu deva  $  haũ dharami seṇṇu miga-jūhu jema
javvela karesami sīha-ṇāu  $  tavvela ejja dhaṇuhara-sahāu
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi vihasiẏa-muheṇa  $  āsīsa diṇṇa sīrāuheṇa
"jasavantu cirāusu hohi vaccha  $  karĕ laggaü jaẏa-siri-vahua saccha"
taṃ levi ṇimittu jaṇaddaṇeṇa  $  vaïdehi ṇamiẏa riu-maddaṇeṇa
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sīẏaĕ vuttu ema  $  "pañcindiẏa bhagga jiṇeṇa jema
vāvīsa parīsaha caü kasāẏa  $  jara-jamma-maraṇa maṇa-kāẏa-vāẏa
ghattā:
jiha bhaggu parammuhu  $  raṇĕ kusumāuhu  $  lohu mohu maü māṇu khalu
    tiha tuhũ bhañjejjahi  $  samarĕ jiṇejjahi  $  saẏalu vi vaïrihĩ taṇaü valu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 14:
āsīsa-vaẏaṇu taṃ levi teṇa  $  apphāliu dhaṇuharu mahumaheṇa
teṃ saddeṃ vahiriu jagu asesu  $  tharahariẏa vasundharī ḍariu sesu
kharalakkhaṇa ve vi bhiḍanti jāva  $  hakkāriu hari tisireṇa tāva
te bhiḍiẏa paroppara haṇu bhaṇanta  $  ṇaṃ matta mahāgaẏa gulugulanta
ṇaṃ kesari ghororāli denta  $  vāṇehĩ vāṇa chindanti enta
moggara-khuruppa-kaṇṇiẏa paḍanti  $  jīvehĩ jīva ṇaṃ khaẏahŏ janti
etthantarĕ atula-parakkameṇa  $  addhendu mukku purisottameṇa
tahŏ tisiraü cukku ṇa kaha vi bhiṇṇu  $  dhaṇuharu pāḍiu dhaẏa-daṇḍu chiṇṇu
ghattā:
aṇṇuṇṇa puṇuppuṇu  $  samarĕ vahugguṇu  $  jaṃ jaṃ tisiraü levi dhaṇu
    taṃ taṃ ukkaṇṭhaï  $  khaṇu vi ṇa saṃthaï  $  daïva-vihūṇahŏ jema dhaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 37, Kaḍavaka 15:
dhaṇuharu saru sārahi chatta-daṇḍu  $  jaṃ vāṇahĩ kiu saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu
taṃ amarisa-kuddheṃ duddhareṇa  $  saṃbhariẏa vijja vijjāhareṇa
appāṇu padarisiu vaddhamāṇu  $  tihĩ vaẏaṇĕhĩ tihĩ sīsĕhĩ samāṇu
pahilaü siru kakkaḍa-kavila-kesu  $  piṅgala-loẏaṇu kiẏa-vāla-vesu
vīẏaü siru vaẏaṇu vi ṇava-juvāṇu  $  ubbhiṇṇa-viẏaḍa-māsuri-samāṇu
taïẏaü siru dhavalaü dhavala-vaẏaṇu  $  phuriāharu dara-ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
duddarisaṇu bhīsaṇu viẏaḍa-dāḍhu  $  jiṇa-bhattaü jiṇavara-dhamma-gāḍhu
etthantarĕ para-vala-maddaṇeṇa  $  vacchatthalĕ viddhu jaṇaddaṇeṇa
ghattā:
ṇārāĕhĩ bhindĕvi  $  sīsaĩ chindĕvi  $  riu mahi-maṇḍalĕ pāḍiẏaü
    suravarĕhĩ pacaṇḍĕhĩ  $  sa iṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ  $  kusuma-vāsu sirĕ pāḍiẏaü
----------  [38. aṭṭhatīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
tisiraü lakkhaṇĕṇa samaraṅgaṇĕ ghāiu jāvĕhĩ
tihuaṇa-ḍamara-karu dahavaẏaṇu parāiu tāvĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 1:
lehu visajjiu jo sura-sīhahŏ  $  aggaĕ paḍiu gampi dasagīvahŏ
paḍiu ṇāĩ vahu-dukkhahã bhāru  $  ṇāĩ ṇisāẏara-kula-saṃghāru
ṇāĩ bhaẏaṅkaru kalahahŏ mūlu  $  ṇāĩ dasāṇaṇa-matthā-sūlu
leheṃ kahiu savvu ahiṇāṇĕhĩ  $  "samvukumāru ulaggaï pāṇĕhĩ
aṇṇu vi khagga-raẏaṇu uddāliu  $  khara-ghariṇihĕ hiẏavaü viddāriu
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ve vi jasabhūsaṇa  $  para-valĕ bhiḍiẏa gampi khara-dūsaṇa
ṇāri-raẏaṇu ṇiruvamu sohaggaü  $  acchaï rāvaṇa tujjhu jĕ joggaü"
lehu ṇiĕvi atthāṇu visajjĕvi  $  pupphavimāṇĕ caḍiu galagajjĕvi
karĕ karavālu kareppiṇu dhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ daṇḍāraṇṇu parāiu
ghattā:
tāva jaṇaddaṇĕṇa  $  kharadūsaṇa-sāhaṇu ruddhaü
     thiu caüraṅgu valu  $  ṇahĕ ṇiccalu saṃsaĕ chuddhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 2:
to etthantarĕ dīhara-ṇaẏaṇeṃ  $  lakkhaṇu pomāiu dahavaẏaṇeṃ
"vari ekkallao vi pañcāṇaṇu  $  ṇaü sāraṅga-ṇivahu vuṇṇāṇaṇu
vari ekkallao vi maẏalañchaṇu  $  ṇa ẏa ṇakkhatta-ṇivahu ṇillañchaṇu
vari ekkallao vi raẏaṇāẏaru  $  ṇaü jalavāhiṇi-ṇiẏaru sa-vittharu
vari ekkallao vi vaïsāṇaru  $  ṇaü vaṇa-ṇivahu sa-rukkhu sa-girivaru
caüdaha sahasa ekku jo rumbhaï  $  so samaraṅgaṇĕ maï mi ṇisumbhaï
pekkhu kema paharantu paīsaï  $  dhaṇudharu saru saṃdhāṇu ṇa dīsaï
ghattā:
ṇahi gaẏa ṇahi turaẏa  $  ṇahi rahavara ṇahi dhaẏa-daṇḍaĩ
    ṇavari paḍantāĩ  $  dīsanti mahiẏale ruṇḍaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 3:
hari paharantu pasaṃsiu jāvĕhĩ  $  jāṇaï ṇaẏaṇakaḍakkhiẏa tāvĕhĩ
sukaï-kaha vva su-sandhi su-sandhiẏa  $  su-paẏa su-vaẏaṇa su-sadda su-vaddhiẏa
thira-kalahaṃsa-gamaṇa gaï-manthara  $  kisa majjhārĕ ṇiẏamvĕ su-vitthara
romāvali maẏaraharuttiṇṇī  $  ṇaṃ pimpili-riñcholi viliṇṇī
ahiṇava-huṇḍa-piṇḍa-pīṇa-tthaṇa  $  ṇaṃ maẏagala ura-khambha-ṇisumbhaṇa
rehaï vaẏaṇa-kamalu akalaṅkaü  $  ṇaṃ māṇasa-sarĕ viẏasiu paṅkaü
su-laliẏa-loẏaṇa laliẏa-pasaṇṇahã  $  ṇaṃ varaïtta-miliẏa vara-kaṇṇahã
gholaï puṭṭhihĩ veṇi mahāiṇi  $  candaṇa-laẏahĩ lalaï ṇaṃ ṇāiṇi
ghattā:
kiṃ vahu-jampiĕṇa  $  tihĩ bhuvaṇĕhĩ jaṃ jaṃ caṅgaü
    taṃ taṃ melavĕvi  $  ṇaṃ daïveṃ ṇimmiu aṅgaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 4:
to etthantarĕ ṇiẏa-kula-dīveṃ  $  rāmu pasaṃsiu puṇu dahagīveṃ
"jīviu ekku sahalu para eẏahŏ  $  jasu suhavattaṇu gaü paricheẏahŏ
jeṇa samāṇu eha dhaṇa jampaï  $  muha-muheṇa tamvolu samappaï
hattheṃ hattha dharĕvi ālāvaï  $  calaṇa-jualu ucchaṅgĕ caḍāvaï
jaṃ āliṅgaï valaẏa-saṇāhahĩ  $  mālaï-mālā-komala-vāhahĩ
jaṃ pellāvaï thaṇa-māẏaṅgĕhĩ  $  muhu paricumvaï ṇāṇā-bhaṅgĕhĩ
jaṃ avaloẏaï ṇimmala-tārĕhĩ  $  ṇaẏaṇahĩ vibbhama-bhariẏa-viẏārĕhĩ
jaṃ aṇuhuñjaï icchĕvi ṇiẏa-maṇĕ  $  tāsu mallu ko saẏalĕ vi tihuaṇĕ
ghattā:
dhaṇṇaü ehu ṇaru  $  jasu eha ṇāri hiẏaïcchiẏa
   jāva ṇa laïẏa maĩ  $  kaü aṅgahŏ tāva suhacchiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 5:
sīẏa ṇievi jāu ummāhaü  $  dahamuhu vammaha-sara-paharāhaü
pahilaĕ vaẏaṇu viẏārĕhĩ bhajjaï  $  pemma-paravvasu kahŏ vi ṇa lajjaï
vīẏaĕ muha-pāseu valaggaï  $  sarahasu gāḍhāliṅgaṇu maggaï
taïẏaĕ aï virahāṇalu tappaï  $  kāma-gahillaü puṇu puṇu jampaï
caüthaĕ ṇīsasantu ṇaü thakkaï  $  siru saṃcālaï bhaũhaü vaṅkaï
pañcamĕ pañcama-jhuṇi ālāvaï  $  vihasĕvi danta-panti darisāvaï
chaṭṭhaĕ aṅgu valaï karu moḍaï  $  puṇu dāḍhiẏaü laeppiṇu toḍaï
vaṭṭaï tallavella sattamaẏahŏ  $  mucchaü enti janti aṭṭhamaẏahŏ
ṇavamaü vaṭṭaï maraṇahŏ ḍhukkaü  $  dasamaĕ pāṇahĩ kaha vi ṇa mukkaü
ghattā:
dahamuhu "dahamuhĕhĩ  $  jāṇaï kira maṇḍaĕ bhuñjami"
      appaü saṃthavaï  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ sura-loẏahŏ lajjami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 6:
to etthantarĕ sura-saṃtāseṃ  $  cintiu ekku uvāu dasāseṃ
avaloẏaṇiẏa vijja maṇĕ jhāiẏa  $  "de āesu" bhaṇanti parāiẏa
"kiṃ ghoṭṭeṇa mahovahi ghoṭṭami  $  kiṃ pāẏālu ṇahaṅgaṇĕ loṭṭami
kiṃ sahũ surĕhĩ surendu parajjami  $  kiṃ maẏaraddhaẏa-puri-gaü bhañjami
kiṃ jama-mahisa-siṅgu musumūrami  $  kiṃ sesahŏ phaṇimaṇi saṃcūrami
kiṃ takkhaẏahŏ dāḍha uppāḍami  $  kāla-kiẏanta-vaẏaṇu kiṃ phāḍami
kiṃ ravi-raha-turaṅga uddālami  $  kiṃ giri meru karaggeṃ ṭālami
kiṃ taïlokka-cakku saṃghārami  $  kiṃ atthakkaĕ palaü samārami"
ghattā:
vuttu dasāṇaṇĕṇa  $  "ekkeṇa vi ṇa vi mahu kajju
    taṃ saṅkeu kahĕ  $  jeṃ harami eha tiẏa ajju"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 7:
dahavaẏaṇahŏ vaẏaṇeṇa su-pujjaĕ  $  pabhaṇiu puṇu avaloẏaṇi-vijjaĕ
"jāva samuddāvattu karekkahŏ  $  vajjāvattu cāu aṇṇekkahŏ
jāvaggeu vāṇu karĕ ekkahŏ  $  vāẏavu vāruṇatthu aṇṇekkahŏ
jāma sīru gambhīru karekkahŏ  $  karaẏalĕ cakkāuhu aṇṇekkahŏ
tāva ṇāri ko haraï disevahũ  $  maṇḍaĕ vāsueva-valaevahũ
iẏa pacchaṇṇa vasanti vaṇantarĕ  $  tesaṭṭhī-purisahũ abbhantarĕ
jiṇa caüvīsa addha govaddhaṇa  $  ṇava kesava rāma ṇava rāvaṇa
ghattā:
oe bhavaṭṭhama  $  iẏa vāsueva-valaeva
    jāva ṇa vahiẏa raṇĕ  $  tiẏa tāma laïjjaï keva

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 8:
ahavaï eṇa kāĩ suṇĕ rāvaṇa  $  eha ṇāri tihuaṇa-saṃtāvaṇa
laï laï jaï ajarāmaru vaṭṭahi  $  laï laï jaï uppahĕṇa paẏaṭṭahi
laï laï jaï vaḍḍattaṇu khaṇḍahi  $  laï laï jaï jiṇa-sāsaṇu chaṇḍahi

laï laï jaï paralou ṇa jāṇahi  $  laï laï jaï ṇiẏa-āu ṇa māṇahi

laï laï jaï ṇivviṇṇaü pāṇahũ  $  laï laï jaï uru-uḍḍahi vāṇahũ"

"māṇavi eha tiẏa  $  jaṃ jijjaï ekku muhuttaü
     siva-sāsaẏa-suhahŏ  $  tahŏ pāsiu eu vahuttaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 9:
visaẏāsatta-cittu pariẏāṇĕvi  $  vijjaĕ vuttu ṇiruttaü jāṇĕvi
"ṇisuṇu dasāṇaṇa pisuṇami bheu  $  veṇha vi atthi ekku saṅkeu
ehu jo dīsaï suhaḍu raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  vāvarantu khara-dūsaṇa-sāhaṇĕ
eẏahŏ sīhaṇāu āẏaṇṇĕvi  $  iṭṭha-kalattu va tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi
dhāvaï sīhu jema orālĕvi  $  vajjāvattu cāu apphālĕvi
tuhũ puṇu pacchaĕ dhaṇa uddālahi  $  puppha-vimāṇĕ chuhĕvi saṃcālahi"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu pabhaṇiu rāu  $  "to ghaĩ paĩ jĕ karevaü ṇāu"
pahu-āeseṃ vijja padhāiẏa  $  ṇiviseṃ taṃ saṃgāmu parāiẏa

lakkhaṇu gahiẏa-saru  $  jaṃ ṇisuṇiu ṇāu bhaẏaṅkaru
     dhāiu dāsarahi  $  ṇahĕ sa-dhaṇu ṇāĩ ṇava-jalaharu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 10:
bhīsaṇu sīha-ṇāu ṇisuṇeppiṇu  $  dhaṇuharu karĕ sajjīu kareppiṇu
toṇā-juvalu laevi padhāiu  $  "mañchuḍu lakkhaṇu raṇĕ viṇivāiu"
kuḍhĕ laggantĕ rāmĕ suṇimittaĩ  $  saüṇu ṇa denti honti du-ṇimittaĩ
phuraï sa-vāhaü vāmaü loẏaṇu  $  pavahaï dāhiṇa-pavaṇu alakkhaṇu
vāẏasu virasu rasaï siva kandaï  $  aggaĕ kuhiṇi bhuaṅgamu chindaï
jamvū paṅguranta uddhāiẏa  $  ṇāĩ ṇivārā saẏaṇa parāiẏa
dāhiṇeṇa piṅgalaẏa samuṭṭhiẏa  $  ṇahĕ ṇava gaha vivarīẏa pariṭṭhiẏa
to vi vīru avagaṇṇĕvi dhāiu  $  takkhaṇĕ taṃ saṅgāmu parāiu
ghattā:
diṭṭhaĩ rāhavĕṇa  $  lakkhaṇa-sara-haṃsĕhĩ khuḍiẏaĩ
    gaẏaṇa-mahāsarahŏ  $  sira-kamalaĩ mahiẏalĕ paḍiẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 11:
diṭṭhu raṇaṅgaṇu rāhavacandeṃ  $  ramiu vasantu ṇāĩ govindeṃ
kuṇḍala-kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-phala darisiẏa  $  daṇu-davaṇā-mañjariẏa padarisiẏa
giddhāvali-kiẏa-cakkandolaü  $  ṇaravara-siraĩ laeppiṇu kelaü
raṇĕ khellanti paropparu caccari  $  puṇu piẏanti soṇiẏa-kāẏamvari
tehaü samara-vasantu ramantaü  $  lakkhaṇu pomāiu paharantaü
"sāhu vaccha para tujjhu ji chajjaï  $  aṇṇahŏ kāsu eu paḍivajjaï
paĩ ikkhāu-vaṃsu ujjāliu  $  jasa-paḍahaü tihuaṇĕ apphāliu"
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï mahāiu  $  "viruaü kiẏaü deva jaṃ āiu
ghattā:
mellĕvi jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  kiṃ rāhava thāṇahŏ caliẏaü
    akkhaï majjhu maṇu  $  hiẏa jāṇaï keṇa vi chaliẏaü"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 12:
puṇaravi vuccaï maragaẏa-vaṇṇeṃ  $  "haũ ṇa karemi ṇāu kiu aṇṇeṃ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ṇiẏattaï jāvĕhĩ  $  sīẏā-haraṇu paḍhukkiu tāvĕhĩ
āu dasāṇaṇu puppha-vimāṇeṃ  $  ṇāĩ purandaru siviẏā-jāṇeṃ
pāsu paḍhukkiu rāhava-ghariṇihĕ  $  matta-gaïndu jema para-kariṇihĕ
ubhaẏa-karĕhĩ saṃcāliẏa thāṇahŏ  $  ṇāĩ sarīra-hāṇi appāṇahŏ
ṇāĩ kulahŏ bhavitti hakkāriẏa  $  laṅkahĕ saṅka ṇāĩ païsāriẏa
ṇisiẏara-loẏahŏ ṇaṃ vajjāsaṇi  $  ṇāĩ bhaẏaṅkara-rāma-sarāsaṇi
ṇaṃ jasa-hāṇi khāṇi vahu-dukkhahũ  $  ṇaṃ paraloẏa-kuhiṇi kiẏa mukkhahũ
ghattā:
takkhaṇĕ rāvaṇĕṇa  $  ḍhoiu vimāṇu āẏāsahŏ
    kāleṃ kuddhaĕṇa  $  hiu jīviu ṇaṃ vaṇa-vāsahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 13:
caliu vimāṇu jaṃ jĕ gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  sīẏaĕ kaluṇu pakandiu takkhaṇĕ
taṃ kūvāru suṇevi mahāiu  $  dhuṇĕvi sarīru jaḍāi padhāiu
pahaü dasāṇaṇu cañcū-ghāĕhĩ  $  pakkhukkhevĕhĩ ṇahara-ṇihāĕhĩ
ekka-vāra osasaï ṇa jāvĕhĩ  $  saẏasaẏa-vāra jhaḍappaï tāvĕhĩ
jāu visaṇṭhulu vaïri-viẏāraṇu  $  candahāsu maṇĕ sumaraï paharaṇu
sīẏa vi dharaï ṇiẏaṅgu vi rakkhaï  $  lajjaï caüdisu ṇaẏaṇakaḍakkhaï
dukkhu dukkhu teṃ dhīrĕvi appaü  $  kara-ṇiṭṭhura-daḍha-kaḍhiṇa-talappaü
pahaü vihaṅgu paḍiu samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  devĕhĩ kalaẏalu kiẏaü ṇahaṅgaṇĕ
ghattā:
paḍiu jaḍāi raṇĕ  $  khara-pahara-vihura-phandantaü
    jāṇaï-hari-valahũ  $  tiṇhi mi cittaĩ pāḍantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 14:
paḍiu jaḍāi jaṃ jĕ phandantaü  $  sīẏaĕ kiu akkandu mahantaü
"ahŏ ahŏ devahŏ raṇĕ duviẏaḍḍhahŏ  $  ṇiẏa parihāsa ṇa pāliẏa saṇḍhahŏ
vari suhaḍattaṇu cañcū-jīvahŏ  $  jo abbhiṭṭu samarĕ dasagīvahŏ
ṇaü tumhĕhĩ rakkhiu vaḍḍattaṇu  $  sūrahŏ taṇaü diṭṭhu sūrattaṇu
saccaü candu vi canda-gahillaü  $  vambhu vi sottiu haru dummahilaü
vāu vi cavalattaṇĕṇa damijjaï  $  dhammu vi raṇḍa-saehĩ laïjjaï
varuṇu vi hoi sahāveṃ sīẏalu  $  tāsu kahi mi kiṃ saṅkaï para-valu
indu vi indavaheṇa ramijjaï  $  ko suravara-saṇḍĕhĩ rakkhijjaï
ghattā:
jāu kiṃ jampiĕṇa  $  jagĕ aṇṇu ṇa abbhuddharaṇaü
    rāhaü iha-bhavahŏ  $  para-loẏahŏ jiṇavaru saraṇaü"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 15:
puṇu vi palāu karanti ṇa thakkaï  $  "kuḍhĕ laggaü laggaü jo sakkaï
haũ pāveṇa eṇa avagaṇṇĕvi  $  ṇiẏa tihuaṇu a-maṇūsaü maṇṇĕvi"
puṇu vi kaluṇu kandanti paẏaṭṭaï  $  "ĕu avasaru sappurisahŏ vaṭṭaï
aha maĩ kavaṇu ṇei kandantī  $  lakkhaṇa-rāma ve vi jaï huntī
hā hā dasaraha māma guṇovahi  $  hā hā jaṇaẏa jaṇaẏa avaloẏahi
hā aparāiĕ hā hā kekkaï  $  hā suppahĕ sumittĕ sundara-maï
hā sattuhaṇa bharaha bharahesara  $  hā bhāmaṇḍala bhāi sahoẏara
hā hā puṇu vi rāma hā lakkhaṇa  $  ko sumarami kahŏ kahami a-lakkhaṇa
ghattā:
ko saṃthavaï maĩ  $  ko suhi kahŏ dukkhu mahantaü
    jahĩ jahĩ jāmi haũ  $  taṃ taṃ ji paesu palittaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 16:
tahĩ avasarĕ vaṭṭantĕ su-viulaĕ  $  dāhiṇa-lavaṇa-samuddahŏ kūlaĕ
atthi pacaṇḍu ekku vijjāharu  $  vara-karavāla-hatthu raṇĕ duddharu
bhāmaṇḍalahŏ caliu olaggaĕ  $  sua kandanti sīẏa tāmaggaĕ
valiu vimāṇu teṇa paḍivakkhahŏ  $  "ṇaṃ tiẏa kā vi bhaṇaï maĩ rakkhahŏ
lakkhaṇa-rāma ve vi hakkāraï  $  bhāmaṇḍalahŏ ṇāmu uccāraï
mañchuḍu eha sīẏa ĕhu rāvaṇu  $  aṇṇu ṇa para-kalatta-saṃtāvaṇu
acchaü ṇivahŏ pāsu jāevaü  $  eṇa samāṇu ajju jujjhevaü"
ema bhaṇevi teṇa hakkāriu  $  "kahĩ tiẏa levi jāhi" paccāriu
ghattā:
"vihi mi bhiḍantāhũ  $  jiha haṇaï ekku jiha hammaï
     geṇhĕvi jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  valu valu kahĩ rāvaṇa gammaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 17:
valiu dasāṇaṇu tihuaṇa-kaṇṭaü  $  sīhahŏ sīhu jema abbhiṭṭaü
jema gaïndu gaïndahŏ dhāiu  $  mehahŏ mehu jema uddhāiu
bhiḍiẏa mahāvala vijjā-pāṇĕhĩ  $  ve vi pariṭṭhiẏa siviẏā-jāṇĕhĩ
ve vi pasāhiẏa ṇāṇāharaṇĕhĩ  $  veṇṇi vi vāvaranti ṇiẏa-karaṇĕhĩ
veṇṇi vi ghāẏa denti avaropparu  $  maṇĕ viruddhu bhāmaṇḍala-kiṅkaru
vara-karavālu kareppiṇu karaẏalĕ  $  pahaü dasāṇaṇu viẏaḍa-uratthalĕ
paḍiu ghuleppiṇu jaṇhuva-jottĕhĩ  $  ruhiru padarisiu dasahi mi sottĕhĩ
puṇu vijjāhareṇa paccāriu  $  "suravara-samara-saĕhĩ a-ṇivāriu
tuhũ so rāvaṇu tihuvaṇa-kaṇṭaü  $  ekkeṃ ghāeṃ ṇavara paloṭṭiu"
ghattā:
ceẏaṇu lahĕvi raṇĕ  $  bhaḍu uṭṭhiu kuruḍu sa-maccharu
      tahŏ vijjāharahŏ  $  thiu rāsihĩ ṇāĩ saṇiccharu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 18:
uṭṭhiu vīsapāṇi asi lentaü  $  ṇāĩ sa-vijju mehu gajjantaü
vijjā-cheu karĕvi vijjāharĕ  $  ghattiu kamvūdīvabbhantarĕ
puṇu dasasiru saṃcallu sa-sīẏaü  $  ṇahaẏalĕ ṇāĩ divāẏaru vīẏaü
majjhĕ samuddahŏ jaẏasiri-māṇaṇu  $  puṇu vollevaĕ laggu dasāṇaṇu

ema bhaṇĕvi āliṅgaï jāvĕhĩ  $  jaṇaẏa-suẏaĕ ṇibbhacchiu tāvĕhĩ

"divasĕhĩ thovĕhĩ  $  tuhũ rāvaṇa samarĕ jiṇevaü
     amhahũ vāriẏaĕ  $  rāma-sarĕhĩ āliṅgevaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 38, Kaḍavaka 19:
ṇiṭṭhura-vaẏaṇĕhĩ docchiu jāvĕhĩ  $  dahamuhu huaü vilakkhaü tāvĕhĩ
"jaï mārami to eha ṇa pecchami  $  vollaü savvu haseppiṇu acchami
avaseṃ kaṃ divasu i icchesaï  $  sarahasu kaṇṭha-ggahaṇu karesaï
"aṇṇu vi maĩ ṇiẏa-vaü pālevvaü  $  maṇḍaĕ para-kalattu ṇa laevvaü"
ema bhaṇevi caliu sura-ḍāmaru  $  laṅka parāiu laddha-mahāvaru

taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi uvavaṇĕ païsāriẏa  $  sīsava-rukkha-mūlĕ vaïsāriẏa
ghattā:
mellĕvi sīẏa vaṇĕ  $  gaü rāvaṇu gharahŏ turantaü
   dhavalĕhĩ maṅgalĕhĩ  $  thiu rajju sa ïṃ bhu ñjantaü
----------  [39. eguṇacālīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
kuḍhĕ laggeppiṇu lakkhaṇahŏ valu jāma paḍīvaü āvaï
taṃ ji laẏāharu taṃ ji taru para sīẏa ṇa appaü dāvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 39, Kaḍavaka 1:
ṇīsīẏaü vaṇu avaẏajjiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ sararuhu lacchi-visajjiẏaü
ṇaṃ meha-vindu ṇivvijjulaü  $  ṇaṃ muṇivara-vaẏaṇu a-vacchalaü
ṇaṃ bhoẏaṇu lavaṇa-jutti-rahiu  $  arahanta-vimvu ṇaṃ a-vasahiu
ṇaṃ datti-vivajjiu kiviṇa-dhaṇu  $  tiha sīẏa-vihūṇaü diṭṭhu vaṇu
puṇu joaï guhilĕhĩ païsarĕvi  $  thiẏa jāṇaï jāṇaï osarĕvi
puṇu jovaï giri-vivarantarĕhĩ  $  thiẏa jāṇaï lhikkĕvi kandarĕhĩ
tāṇantarĕ diṭṭhu jaḍāi vaṇĕ  $  saṃsūḍiẏa-gattaü paḍiu raṇĕ
ghattā:
pahara-vihura-ghummanta-taṇu  $  jaṃ diṭṭhu pakkhi ṇiddaliẏaü
    tāvĕhĩ vujjhiu rāhavĕṇa  $  hiẏa jāṇaï keṇa vi chaliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 39, Kaḍavaka 2:
puṇu diṇṇa teṇa suha vasu-hārā  $  uccārĕvi pañca ṇamokkārā
je sārabhūẏa jiṇa-sāsaṇahŏ  $  je maraṇa-sahāẏa bhavva-jaṇahŏ
laddhehĩ jehĩ diḍha hoi maï  $  laddhehĩ jehĩ paraloẏa-gaï
laddhehĩ jehĩ saṃbhavaï suhu  $  laddhehĩ jehĩ ṇijjaraï duhu
te diṇṇa vihaṅgahŏ rāhavĕṇa  $  kiẏa-ṇisiẏara-ṇiẏara-parāhavĕṇa
"jāejjahi parama-suhāvahĕṇa  $  aṇaraṇṇāṇantavīra-pahĕṇa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi savvāẏarĕṇa  $  lahu pāṇa visajjiẏa ṇahaẏarĕṇa
jaṃ muu jaḍāi hiẏa jaṇaẏa-sua  $  dhāhāviu ubbhā karĕvi bhua
ghattā:
"kahĩ haũ kahĩ hari kahĩ ghariṇi  $  kahĩ gharu kahĩ pariẏaṇu chiṇṇaü
     bhūẏa-vali vva kuḍumvu jagĕ  $  haẏa-daïveṃ kaha vikkhiṇṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 39, Kaḍavaka 3:
valu ema bhaṇevi pamucchiẏaü  $  puṇu cāraṇa-risihĩ ṇiẏacchiẏaü
cāraṇa vi honti aṭṭhaviha-guṇa  $  je ṇāṇa-piṇḍa sīlāharaṇa
phala-phulla-patta-ṇaha-giri-gamaṇa  $  jala-tantua-jaṅghā-saṃcaraṇa
tahĩ vīra sudhīra visuddha-maṇa  $  ṇaha-cāraṇa āiẏa veṇṇi jaṇa
teṃ avahī-ṇāṇeṃ joiẏaü  $  rāmahŏ kalattu vicchoiẏaü
āūrĕvi gala-gambhīra-jhuṇi  $  puṇu laggu cavevaĕ jeṭṭha-muṇi
"bho carama-deha sāsaẏa-gamaṇa  $  keṃ kajjeṃ rovahi mūḍha-maṇa
tiẏa dukkhahũ khāṇi vioẏa-ṇihi  $  tahĕ kāraṇĕ rovahi kāĩ vihi
ghattā:
kiṃ paĩ ṇa suiẏa eha kaha  $  chajjīva-ṇikāẏa-daẏāvaru
    jiha guṇavaï-aṇuattaṇĕṇa  $  jiṇaẏāsu jāu vaṇĕ vāṇaru"
_______________________________________________________________
START

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 2:

dhīrī hohi pamāẏahi soo  $  kāsu ṇa jammaṇa-maraṇa-vioo
ghattā:
ko vi ṇa vajjamaü  $  jāeṃ jīveṃ marievaü
    amhĕhĩ tumhĕhĩ mi  $  khara-dūsaṇa-pahĕ jāevaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 3:
dhīrĕvi ṇiẏaẏa vahiṇi siẏa-māṇaṇu  $  raẏaṇihĩ gaü sovaṇaĕ dasāṇaṇu
vara-pallaṅkĕ caḍiu laṅkesaru  $  ṇaṃ giri-siharĕ maïndu sa-kesaru
ṇaṃ visaharu ṇīsāsu muantaü  $  ṇaṃ sajjaṇu khala-kheijjantaü
sīẏā-moheṃ mohiu rāvaṇu  $  gāẏaï vāẏaï paḍhaï suhāvaṇu
ṇaccaï hasaï viẏārĕhĩ bhajjaï  $  ṇiẏa-bhūahũ ji paḍīvaü lajjaï
daṃsaṇa-ṇāṇa-caritta-virohaü  $  iha-loẏahŏ para-loẏahŏ dohaü
maẏaṇa-paravvasu eu ṇa jāṇaï  $  jiha saṃgharu karesaï jāṇaï
acchaï maẏaṇa-sarĕhĩ jajjariẏaü  $  khara-dūsaṇa-ṇāu mi vīsariẏaü
ghattā:
cintaï dahavaẏaṇu  $  "dhaṇu dhaṇṇu suvaṇṇu samatthaü
    rajju vi jīviu vi  $  viṇu sīẏaĕ savvu ṇiratthaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 4:
tahĩ avasarĕ āiẏa mandovari  $  sīhahŏ pāsu va sīha-kisoẏari
vara-gaṇiẏāri va līlā-gāmiṇi  $  piẏamāhaviẏa va mahurālāviṇi
sāraṅgi va vipphāriẏa-ṇaẏaṇī  $  sattāvīsaṃjoẏaṇa-vaẏaṇī
kalahaṃsi va thira-manthara-gamaṇī  $  lacchi va tiẏa-rūveṃ jūravaṇī
aha pomāṇihĕ aṇuharamāṇī  $  jiha sā tiha eha vi paürāṇī
jiha sā tiha eha vi vahu-jāṇī  $  jiha sā tiha eha vi vahu-māṇī
jiha sā tiha eha vi sumaṇohara  $  jiha sā tiha eha vi piẏa-sundara
jiha sā tiha eha vi jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ  $  jiha sā tiha eha vi ṇa ku-sāsaṇĕ
ghattā:
kiṃ vahu-jampiĕṇa  $  uvamijjaï kāhĕ kisoẏari
    ṇiẏa-paḍichandaĕṇa  $  thiẏa saĩ jĕ ṇāĩ mandoẏari
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 5:
tahĩ pallaṅkĕ caḍĕvi rajjesari  $  pabhaṇiẏa laṅkāpura-paramesari
"ahŏ dahamuha dahavaẏaṇa dasāṇaṇa  $  ahŏ dasasira dasāsa siẏa-māṇaṇa
ahŏ taïlokka-cakka-cūḍāmaṇi  $  vaïri-mahīhara-khara-vajjāsaṇi
vīsapāṇi ṇisiẏara-ṇarakesari  $  sura-miga-vāraṇa dāraṇa-ari-kari
para-ṇaravara-pāẏāra-paloṭṭaṇa  $  duddama-dāṇava-vala-dalavaṭṭaṇa
jaïẏahũ bhiḍiu raṇaṅgaṇĕ indahŏ  $  jāu kula-kkhaü sajjaṇa-vindahŏ
tahĩ vi kālĕ paĩ dukkhu ṇa ṇāẏaü  $  jiha khara-dūsaṇa-maraṇeṃ jāẏaü"
bhaṇaï paḍīvaü ṇisiẏara-ṇāho  $  "sundari jaï ṇa karaï avarāho
ghattā:
to haũ kahami taü  $  ṇaü khara-dūsaṇa-dukkhu 'cchaï
    ettiu ḍāhu para  $  jaṃ maĩ vaïdehi ṇa icchaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu sasivaẏaṇaĕ  $  puṇu vi hasevi vuttu migaṇaẏaṇaĕ
"ahŏ dahagīva jīva-saṃtāvaṇa  $  eu ajuttu vuttu paĩ rāvaṇa
kiṃ jagĕ aẏasa-paḍahu apphālahi  $  ubhaẏa visuddha vaṃsa kiṃ maïlahi
kiṃ ṇāraïẏahŏ ṇaraĕ ṇa vīhahi  $  para-dhaṇu para-kalattu jaṃ īhahi
jiṇavara-sāsaṇĕ pañca viruddhaĩ  $  duggaï jāi ṇinti avisuddhaĩ
pahilaü vahu chajjīva-ṇikāẏahũ  $  vīẏaü gammaï micchāvāẏahũ
taïẏaü jaṃ para-davvu laïjjaï  $  caütthaü para-kalattu sevijjaï
pañcamu ṇaü pamāṇu gharavārahŏ  $  āẏahĩ gammaï bhava-saṃsārahŏ
ghattā:
para-loĕ vi ṇa suhu  $  iha-loĕ vi aẏasa-paḍāiẏa
    sundara hoi ṇa tiẏa  $  ĕẏa-veseṃ jamaüri āiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 7:
puṇu puṇu pihula-ṇiẏamva kisoẏari  $  bhaṇaï hiẏattaṇeṇa mandoẏari
"jaṃ suhu kālakūḍu visu khantahũ  $  jaṃ suhu palaẏāṇalu païsantahũ
jaṃ suhu bhava-saṃsārĕ bhamantahũ  $  jaṃ suhu ṇāraïẏahũ ṇivasantahũ
jaṃ suhu jama-sāsaṇu pecchantahũ  $  jaṃ suhu asi-pañjarĕ acchantahũ
jaṃ suhu palaẏāṇala-muha-kandarĕ  $  jaṃ suhu pañcāṇaṇa-dāḍhantarĕ
jaṃ suhu phaṇi-māṇikku khuḍantahũ  $  taṃ suhu eha ṇāri bhuñjantahũ
jāṇanto vi to vi jaï vañchahi  $  to kajjeṇa keṇa maĩ pucchahi
taü pāsiu kiṃ koi vi valiẏaü  $  jeṇa purandaro vi paḍikhaliẏaü
ghattā:
jaṃ jasu āvaḍaï  $  tahŏ taṃ aṇurāu ṇa bhajjaï
    jaï vi asundaraü  $  jaṃ pahu karei taṃ chajjaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu dahavaẏaṇeṃ  $  pabhaṇiẏa ṇāri virilliẏa-ṇaẏaṇeṃ
"jaïẏahũ gaẏaü āsi acalindahŏ  $  vandaṇa-hattiĕ parama-jiṇindahŏ
taïẏahũ diṭṭhu ekku maĩ muṇivaru  $  ṇāuṃ aṇantavīru paramesaru
tāsu pāsĕ vaü laïu ṇa bhañjami  $  maṇḍaĕ para-kalattu ṇaü bhuñjami
ahavaï eṇa kāĩ mandoari  $  jaï ṇandanti ṇiẏahi laṅkāuri
jaï maggahi dhaṇu dhaṇṇu suvaṇṇaü  $  rāulu riddhi-viddhi-saṃpaṇṇaü
jaï āruhahi turaṅga-gaïndĕhĩ  $  jaï vandijjaï vandiṇa-vandĕhĩ
jaï maggahi ṇikkaṇṭaü rajju  $  jaï kira vi maĩ jiẏantĕṇa kajju
ghattā:
saẏalanteurahŏ  $  jaï icchahi ṇaü raṇḍattaṇu
    to vari jāṇaïhĕ  $  mandoẏari karĕ dūattaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vaẏaṇu dahavaẏaṇahŏ  $  pabhaṇiẏa mandoẏari puri maẏaṇahŏ
"ho ho savvu lou jagĕ dūhaü  $  paĩ melleviṇu aṇṇu ṇa sūhaü
surakari-ahisiñciẏa-siẏa-sevihĕ  $  jo āesu dehi mahaevihĕ
eva vi karami tuhāraü vuttaü  $  pahu-chandeṇa ajuttu vi juttaü"
e ālāva paropparu jāvĕhĩ  $  raẏaṇihĕ caü paharā haẏa tāvĕhĩ
aruṇuggamĕ accanta-kisoẏari  $  sīẏahĕ dūī gaẏa mandoẏari
sahũ anteureṇa uddhūsiẏa  $  gaṇiẏāri va gaṇiẏāri-vihūsiẏa
vaṇu givvāṇaravaṇu saṃpāiẏa  $  rāhava-ghariṇi tetthu ṇijjhāiẏa
ghattā:
ve vi maṇohariu  $  rāvaṇa-rāmahũ piẏa-ṇāriu
   dāhiṇa-uttareṇa  $  ṇaṃ disa-gaïnda-gaṇiẏāriu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 10:
rāma-ghariṇi jaṃ diṭṭha kisoẏari  $  harisiẏa ṇiẏa-maṇeṇa mandoẏari
"ahiṇava-ṇāri-raẏaṇu avaïṇṇaü  $  eu ṇa jāṇahũ kahĩ uppaṇṇaü
surahũ mi kāmukkoẏaṇa-gāraü  $  muṇi-maṇa-mohaṇu ṇaẏaṇa-piẏāraü
sāhu sāhu ṇiuṇo 'si paẏāvaï  $  tuha viṇṇāṇa-satti ko pāvaï
aha kiṃ vitthareṇa vahu-vollaĕ  $  saïm kāmo vi paḍaï kāmillaĕ
kavaṇu gahaṇu to laṅkā-rāeṃ"  $  ema pasaṃsĕvi maṇĕ aṇurāeṃ
piẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ dasāṇaṇa-pattiĕ  $  vuccaï rāma-ghariṇi vihasantiĕ
"kiṃ vahu-jampieṇa paramesari  $  jīviu ekku sahalu taü sundari
ghattā:
suravara-ḍamara-karu  $  taïlokka-cakka-saṃtāvaṇu
    kāĩ ṇa atthi taü  $  jahĕ āṇavaḍicchaü rāvaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 11:
indaï-bhāṇukaṇṇa-ghaṇavāhaṇa  $  akkhaẏa-maẏa-māricca-vihīsaṇa
jaṃ calaṇehĩ ghivahi ārūsĕvi  $  taṃ sīseṇa laẏanti asesa vi
aṇṇu vi saẏalu eu anteuru  $  sālaṅkāru sa-doru sa-ṇeuru
aṭṭhāraha sahāsa vara-vilaẏahũ  $  ṇicca-pasāhiẏa-sohiẏa-tilaẏahũ
āẏahũ savvahũ tuhũ paramesari  $  ṇīsāvaṇṇu rajju kari sundari
rāvaṇu muĕvi aṇṇu ko caṅgaü  $  rāvaṇu muĕvi kavaṇu taṇu-aṅgaü
rāvaṇu muĕvi aṇṇu ko sūraü  $  para-vala-mahaṇu kulāsā-pūraü
rāvaṇu muĕvi aṇṇu ko valiẏaü  $  suravara-ṇiẏaru jeṇa paḍikhaliẏaü
rāvaṇu muĕvi aṇṇu ko bhallaü  $  jo tihuẏaṇahŏ mallu ekkallaü
rāvaṇu muĕvi aṇṇu ko sūhaü  $  jaṃ āpekkhĕvi maẏaṇu vi dūhaü
ghattā:
tahŏ laṅkesarahŏ  $  kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-ṇaẏaṇahŏ
      bhuñjahi saẏala mahi  $  mahaevi hohi dahavaẏaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ tahĕ kaḍua-vaẏaṇu āẏaṇṇĕvi  $  rāvaṇu jīviu tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi
sīla-valeṇa valiẏa ṇaü kampiẏa  $  rūsĕvi ṇiṭṭhura vaẏaṇa pajampiẏa
"halĕ halĕ kāĩ kāĩ paĩ vuttaü  $  uttima-ṇārihĕ eu ṇa juttaü
kiha daïẏahŏ dūattaṇu kijjaï  $  eṇa ṇāĩ mahu hāsaü dijjaï
mañchuḍu tuhũ para-purisa-païddhī  $  teṃ kajjeṃ mahu dehi duvuddhi
matthaĕ paḍaü vajju tahŏ jārahŏ  $  haũ puṇu bhattivanta bhattārahŏ"
sīẏaĕ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi maṇĕ ḍolliẏa  $  ṇisiẏara-ṇāha-ṇāri paḍivolliẏa
"jaï mahaevi-paṭṭu ṇa paḍicchahi  $  jaï laṅkāhiu kaha vi ṇa icchahi
ghattā:
to kandanti paĩ  $  tilu tilu karavattĕhĩ kappaï
    aṇṇu muhuttaĕṇa  $  ṇisiẏarahã vihañjĕvi appaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 13:
puṇupuṇuruttĕhĩ jaṇaẏahŏ dhīẏaĕ  $  ṇibbhacchiẏa mandoẏari sīẏaĕ
"kettiu vāravāra vollijjaï  $  jaṃ cintiu maṇeṇa taṃ kijjaï
jaï vi ajju karavattĕhĩ kappahŏ  $  jaï vi dharĕvi siva-sāṇahŏ appahŏ
jaï vi valantĕ huāsaṇĕ mellahŏ  $  jaï vi mahaggaẏa-dantĕhĩ pellahŏ
to vi khalahŏ tahŏ dukkiẏa-kammahŏ  $  para-purisahŏ ṇivitti iha jammahŏ
ekku ji ṇiẏa-bhattāru pahuccaï  $  jo jaẏa-lacchiĕ khaṇu vi ṇa muccaï
jo asurā-sura-jaṇa-maṇa-vallahu  $  tumhārisahũ kuṇārihĩ dullahu
jo ṇaravara-maïndu bhīsāvaṇu  $  dhaṇu-laṅgūla-līla-darisāvaṇu
ghattā:
sara-ṇaharāruṇĕṇa  $  dhaṇuveẏa-lalāviẏa-jīheṃ
    dahamuha-matta-gaü  $  phāḍevaü rāhava-sīheṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 14:
rāmaṇa-rāmacanda-ramaṇīẏahũ  $  jāma volla mandovari-sīẏahũ
tāva dasāṇaṇu saẏam evāiu  $  hatthi va gaṅgā-veṇi parāiu
bhasalu va gandha-luddhu vihaḍapphaḍu  $  jāṇaï-vaẏaṇa-kamala-rasa-lampaḍu
karaẏala dhuṇaï jhuṇaï vukkāraï  $  kheḍḍu karevi devi paccāraï
"viṇṇattiĕ pasāu paramesari  $  haũ kavaṇeṇa hīṇu sura-sundari
kiṃ sohaggeṃ bhoggeṃ ūṇaü  $  kiṃ viruẏaü kiṃ attha-vihūṇaü
kiṃ lāvaṇṇeṃ vaṇṇeṃ hīṇaü  $  kiṃ saṃmāṇĕ dāṇĕ raṇĕ dīṇaü
kahĕ kajjeṇa keṇa ṇa samicchahi  $  jeṃ mahaevi-paṭṭu ṇa paḍicchahi"
ghattā:
rāhava-gehiṇiĕ  $  ṇibbhacchiu ṇisiẏara-rāṇaü
    "osaru dahavaẏaṇa  $  tuhũ amhahũ jaṇaẏa-samāṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 15:
jāṇanto vi to vi maṃ mujjhahi  $  geṇhĕvi para-kalattu kahĩ sujjhahi
jāma ṇa aẏasa- paḍahu ubbhāsaï  $  jāma ṇa laṅkāṇaẏari viṇāsaï
jāma ṇa lakkhaṇa-sīhu virujjhaï  $  jāma ṇa rāma-kiẏantu vivujjhaï
jāma ṇa saravara-dhoraṇi sandhaï  $  jāma ṇa toṇā-jualu ṇivandhaï
jāva ṇa viẏaḍa-uratthalu bhindaï  $  jāva ṇa vāhu-daṇḍa taü chindaï
saravarĕ haṃsu jema dala-vimalaĩ  $  jāva ṇa toḍaï dasa-sira-kamalaïṃ
jāma ṇa giddha-panti ṇivvaṭṭaï  $  jāma ṇa ṇisiẏara-valu āvaṭṭaï
jāma ṇa darisāvaï dhaẏa-cindhaĩ  $  jāma ṇa raṇĕ ṇaccanti kavandhaĩ
ghattā:
jāma ṇa āhaẏaṇĕ  $  kappijjaï vara-ṇārāẏahĩ
    tāva ṇarāhivaï  $  paḍu rāhavacandahŏ pāẏahĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 16:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi āruṭṭhu dasāṇaṇu  $  ṇaṃ ghaṇĕ gajjamāṇĕ pañcāṇaṇu
kovāṇala-palittu laṅkesaru  $  cintaï vijjāhara-paramesaru
"kiṃ jama-sāsaṇa-pantheṃ lāẏami  $  kiṃ uvasaggu kiṃ pi darisāvami
avaseṃ bhaẏa-vaseṇa icchesaï  $  mahu maẏaṇaggi samulhāvesaï"
tahĩ avasarĕ sa-turaṅgu sa-rahavaru  $  gaü atthavaṇahŏ tāma divāẏaru
āẏa ratti ṇāṇāviha-rūvĕhĩ  $  aṭṭahāsa mellantĕhĩ bhūĕhĩ
khara-sāṇaüla-virāla-siẏālĕhĩ  $  vahu-cāmuṇḍa-ruṇḍa-veẏālĕhĩ
rakkhasa-sīha-vaggha-gaẏa-gaṇḍĕhĩ  $  mesa-mahisa-vasa-turaẏa-ṇisaṇḍĕhĩ
taṃ uvasaggu ṇievi bhaẏāvaṇu  $  to vi ṇa sīẏahĕ saraṇu dasāṇaṇu
ghoru raüddu jhāṇu saṃcūrĕvi  $  thiẏa maṇĕ dhamma-jhāṇu āūrĕvi
ghattā:
"jāva ṇa ṇīsariẏa  $  uvasagga-bhaẏahŏ gambhīrahŏ
      tāva ṇivitti mahu  $  caüviha-āhāra-sarīrahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 17:
pahaẏa paosa paṇāsĕvi ṇiggaẏa  $  hatthi-haḍa vva sūra-paharāhaẏa
ṇisiẏari vva gaẏa ghoṇāvaṅkiẏa  $  bhagga-maḍapphara māṇa-kalaṅkiẏa
sūra-bhaeṇa ṇāĩ raṇu mellĕvi  $  païsaï ṇaẏaru kavāḍaĩ pellĕvi
dīvā pajjalanti je saẏaṇĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ ṇisi valĕvi ṇihālaï ṇaẏaṇĕhĩ
uṭṭhiu ravi aravindāṇandaü  $  ṇaṃ mahi-kāmiṇi-keraü andaü
ṇaṃ sañjhāĕ tilaü darisāviu  $  ṇaṃ sukaïhĕ jasa-puñju pahāviu
ṇaṃ mambhīsa dentu vala-pattihĕ  $  pacchalĕ ṇāĩ padhāiu rattihĕ
ṇaṃ jaga-bhavaṇahŏ vohiu dīvaü  $  ṇāĩ puṇu vi puṇu so jjĕ paḍīvaü
ghattā:
tihuaṇa-rakkhasahŏ  $  dārĕvi disi-vahu-muha-kandaru
    uvarĕ paīsarĕvi  $  ṇaṃ sīẏa gavesaï diṇaẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa II, Saṃdhi 41, Kaḍavaka 18:
raẏaṇihĕ timira-ṇiẏara-raĕ bhaggaĕ  $  ṇiva rāvaṇahŏ āẏa olaggaĕ
maẏa-māricca-vihīsaṇa-rāṇā  $  avarĕ vi bhuvaṇekkekka-pahāṇā
khara-dūsaṇa-soeṇa ṇaẏāṇaṇa  $  ṇaṃ ṇikkesara vara pañcāṇaṇa
ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-āsaṇehĩ thiẏa avicala  $  bhagga-visāṇa ṇāĩ vara maẏagala
manti-mahallaehĩ etthantarĕ  $  ṇisuṇiẏa sīẏa ruanti paḍantarĕ
bhaṇaï vihīsaṇu "ĕhu ko rovaï  $  vāravāra appāṇaü soaï
