teṇa vi riu jiṇĕvi ṇa sakkiẏaü  $  paccelliu haũ ṇiratthu kiẏaü
kiṃ abbhatthijjaï dahavaẏaṇu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ tiẏa-lampaḍu luddha-maṇu
amhaĩ viṇivāĕvi ve vi jaṇa  $  sahũ rajjeṃ appuṇu lei dhaṇa
khara-dūsaṇa-deha-vimaddaṇahũ  $  varu saraṇu jāmi rahu-ṇandaṇahũ"
cinteviṇu kikkindhāhivĕṇa  $  hakkāriu mehaṇāu ṇivĕṇa
"taṃ gampi virāhiu ema bhaṇu  $  vuccaï suggīu āu saraṇu"
piẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ dūu visajjiẏaü  $  gaü macchara-māṇa-vivajjiẏaü
pāẏāla-laṅka-purĕ païsarĕvi  $  teṃ vuttu virāhiu jokkarĕvi
ghattā:
"suggīu sutārā-kāraṇĕṇa  $  viḍa-suggīveṃ ghalliẏaü
      kiṃ païsaraü kiṃ ma païsaraü  $  tumhahã saraṇu samalliẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi harisa-kāraṇĕṇa  $  "païsaraü" pavuttu virāhieṇa
"haũ dhaṇṇaü jasu kikkindharāu  $  ahimāṇu mueppiṇu pāsu āu"
saṃmāṇiu gaü pallaṭṭu dūu  $  païsāriu pahu āṇandu hūu
taṃ tūrahã saddu suṇevi teṇa  $  so vuttu virāhiu rāhaveṇa
"sahũ sāhaṇeṇa kaṇṭaïẏa-dehu  $  āvantaü dīsaï kavaṇu ehu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇeṇa  $  vuccaï candoẏara-ṇandaṇeṇa
"suggīva-vāli iẏa bhāi ve vi  $  vaḍḍāraü gaü pavvajja levi
ehu vi jiṇevi keṇa vi khaleṇa  $  vaṇa-vāsahŏ ghalliu bhua-valeṇa
ghattā:
vara-vāṇara-dhaü sūraraẏa-suu  $  tārā-vallahu viulamaï
    jo suvvaï kahi mi kahāṇaĕhĩ  $  ĕhu so kikkindhāhivaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 5:
sa-virāhiẏa lakkhaṇa-rāmaeva  $  vollanti paropparu jāva eva
tiṇṇi mi suggīveṃ diṭṭha kema  $  āgamĕṇa tiloa tivāẏa jema
caü disa-gaẏa ekkahĩ miliẏa ṇāĩ  $  vaïsāriẏa ṇaravaï jamvavāi
saṃmāṇĕvi pucchiẏa lakkhaṇeṇa  $  "tumhahã avahariu kalattu keṇa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi savvahũ mahantu  $  ṇamiẏāṇaṇu pabhaṇaï jamvavantu
"vaṇa-kīlaĕ gaü suggīu jāma  $  thiu païsĕvi viḍasuggīu tāma
thovantarĕ vāli-kaṇiṭṭhu āu  $  sāmanta-manti-maṇḍala-sahāu
ṇaü jāṇiu viṇhi mi kavaṇu rāu  $  maṇĕ vimbhaü savvahŏ jaṇahŏ jāu
ghattā:
suggīva-jualu koḍḍāvaṇaü  $  pekkhĕvi rahasa-samucchaliu
    valu addhaü suggīvahŏ taṇaü  $  māẏāsuggīvahŏ miliu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 6:
ettahĕ vi satta akkhohaṇīu  $  ettahĕ vi satta akkhohaṇīu
thiu sāhaṇu addhovaddhi hovi  $  aṅgaṅgaẏa vihaḍiẏa suhaḍa ve vi
māẏāsuggīvahŏ miliu aṅgu  $  aṅgaü suggīvahŏ raṇĕ abhaṅgu
vihĩ simirĕhĩ ve vi sahanti bhāi  $  ṇisi-divasĕhĩ candāicca ṇāĩ
ettahĕ vi vīru vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇu  $  suu vālihĕ ṇāmeṃ candakiraṇu
thiu tārahĕ rakkhaṇu abhaü devi  $  "jaï ḍhukkahŏ to mahu marahŏ ve vi"
jujjhantu jiṇesaï jo jji ajju  $  tahŏ saẏalu sa-tāraü demi rajju"
vihĩ ekku vi ṇaü païsāru lahaï  $  ṇala-ṇīlahũ puṇu suggīu kahaï
"saccaü āhāṇaü ehu āu  $  paraẏāriu jji ghara-sāmi jāu"
asahanta paropparu ḍhukka ve vi  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-karavālaĩ karĕhĩ levi
ghattā:
kira jāma bhiḍanti bhiḍanti ṇa vi  $  tāva ṇivāriẏa vāraĕhĩ
      mukkaṅkusa matta gaïnda jiha  $  osāriẏa kaṇṇāraĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 7:
osāriẏa jaṃ puravara-jaṇeṇa  $  thiẏa ṇaẏarahŏ uttara-dāhiṇeṇa
aṇṇekka-diẏahĕ jujjhanti jāma  $  pavaṇañjaẏa-ṇandaṇu kuviu tāma
"maru maru suggīvahŏ maliu māṇu"  $  saṇṇaddhu suhaḍa-sāhaṇa-samāṇu
"haṇu haṇu" bhaṇantu haṇuvantu pattu  $  pabhaṇaï ṇiru rahasucchaliẏa-gattu
"suggīva māma mā maṇĕṇa mujjhu  $  viḍa-bhaḍahŏ padīvaü dehi jujjhu
jaï ṇa vi bhañjami bhuja-daṇḍu tāsu  $  to ṇa homi puttu pavaṇañjaẏāsu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi kikkindharāu  $  tahŏ uppari galagajjantu āu
te bhiḍiẏa ve vi kaṇṭaïẏa-deha  $  ṇava-pāusĕ ṇaṃ jala-bhariẏa-meha
ghattā:
asi-cāva-cakka-gaẏa-moggarĕhĩ  $  jiha sakkiu tiha jujjhiẏaü
   haṇuvanteṃ aṇṇāṇeṇa jiha  $  appaü paru vi ṇa vujjhiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 8:
jaṃ vihi mi majjhĕ ekku vi ṇa ṇāu  $  gaü valĕvi paḍīvaü pavaṇajāu
suggīu vi pāṇa laevi ṇaṭṭhu  $  ṇaṃ maẏagalu kesari-ghāẏa-taṭṭhu
kira païsaï khara-dūsaṇahã saraṇu  $  kiu ṇavara kiẏanteṃ tahu mi maraṇu
tahĩ ṇisuṇiẏa tumhahã taṇiẏa vatta  $  jiha caüdaha sahasekkahŏ samatta
to vari suggīvahŏ karĕ paritta  $  saraṇāiu rakkhahi parama-mitta"
jaṃ hari abbhatthiu jamvaveṇa  $  suggīu vuttu puṇu rāhaveṇa
"tuhũ maĩ āsaṅghĕvi āu pāsu  $  akkhahi haũ saraṇaü jāmi kāsu
jiha tuhũ tiha haü mi kalatta-rahiu  $  vaṇĕ hiṇḍami kāma-gaheṇa gahiu"
ghattā:
suggīveṃ vuccaï "deva suṇĕ  $  kusala-vatta sīẏahĕ taṇiẏa
    jaï ṇāṇami to sattamaĕ diṇĕ  $  païsami salahã huāsaṇiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ jāṇaï-keraü laïu ṇāmu  $  taṃ viraha-visanthulu bhaṇaï rāmu
"jaï āṇahi kantahĕ taṇiẏa vatta  $  to vaẏaṇu mahāraü ṇisuṇi mitta
sattamĕ divasĕ ettaḍaü vujjhu  $  karĕ lāẏami tārāevi tujjhu
bhuñjāvami taṃ kikkindha-ṇaẏaru  $  dakkhavami chatta-dhaẏa-daṇḍa-pavaru
aṇṇu mi tuha keraü haṇami sattu  $  parirakkhaï jaï vi kiẏanta-mittu
vambhāṇu bhāṇu gaṅgāhiseu  $  aṅgāraü sasaharu rāhu keu
vuhu vihaphaï sukku saṇiccharo vi  $  jamu varuṇu kuveru purandaro vi
ettiẏa milevi rakkhanti jo vi  $  jīvantu ṇa chuṭṭaï vaïri to vi
ghattā:
jaï païja ṇa pūrami ettaḍiẏa  $  jaï ṇa karami sajjaṇahã dihi
    sattamaĕ divasĕ suggīva mahu  $  pattiẏa to saṇṇāsa-vihi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 10:
sīrāuhu païjārūḍhu jaṃ jĕ  $  saṃcallu asesu vi simiru taṃ jĕ
saṃcallu virāhiu duṇṇivāru  $  suggīu rāmu lakkhaṇa-kumāru
te caliẏa cāẏari vi parama-mitta  $  ṇāvaï kali-kāla-kaẏanta-mitta
ṇaṃ caliẏa cāẏari vi disa-gaïnda  $  ṇaṃ caliẏa cāẏari vi khaẏa-samudda
ṇaṃ caliẏa cāẏari vi sura-ṇikāẏa  $  ṇaṃ caliẏa cavala caüviha kasāẏa
ṇaṃ caliẏa cāẏari viriñca-veẏa  $  uvadāṇa-daṇḍa ṇaṃ sāma-bheẏa
aha vaṇṇieṇa kiṃ ettaḍeṇa  $  ṇaṃ caliẏa cāẏari vi appaṇeṇa
thovantarĕ tarala-tamāla-chaṇṇu  $  jiṇa-dhammu jema sāvaẏa-ravaṇṇu
ghattā:
suggīveṃ rāmeṃ lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  giri kikkindhu vihāviẏaü
    pihimiĕ uccāĕvi sira-kamalu  $  maüḍu ṇāĩ darisāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 11:
thovantarĕ dhaṇa-kañcaṇa-paüru  $  lakkhijjaï taṃ kikkindhaṇaẏaru
ṇaṃ ṇahaẏalu tārā-maṇḍiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ kavvu kaïddhaẏa-caḍḍiẏaü
ṇaṃ haṇua-vihūsiu muha-kamalu  $  vihasiu saẏavattu ṇāĩ sa-ṇalu
ṇaṃ ṇīlālaṅkiu āharaṇu  $  ṇaṃ kunda-pasāhiu viula-vaṇu
suggīva-vantu ṇaṃ haṃsa-siru  $  ṇaṃ jhāṇu muṇindahũ taṇaü thiru
māẏā-suggīveṃ mohiẏaü  $  kusaleṇa ṇāĩ kāmiṇi-hiẏaü
etthantarĕ vaddhiẏa-kalaẏalĕhĩ  $  jamvava-kundendaṇīla-ṇalĕhĩ
somitti-virāhiẏa-rāhavĕhĩ  $  savvĕhĩ ṇivvūḍha-mahāhavĕhĩ
ghattā:
suggīvahŏ vihurĕ samāvaḍiĕ  $  vahu-saṃmāṇa-dāṇa-maṇĕhĩ
    veḍhijjaï taṃ kikkindhapuru  $  ṇaṃ ravi-maṇḍalu ṇava-ghaṇĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 12:
veḍheppiṇu paṭṭaṇu ṇiravasesu  $  paṭṭhaviu dūu viḍa-bhaḍahŏ pāsu
suggīveṃ rāmeṃ lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  sandesaü pesiu takkhaṇĕṇa
"kiṃ vahuṇā kahĕ paramatthu tāsu  $  jima bhiḍu jima pāṇa laevi ṇāsu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi kappūracandu  $  saṃcallu ṇāĩ khaẏakāla-daṇḍu
dujjaü māẏā-suggīu jetthu  $  saha-maṇḍavĕ dūu païṭṭhu tetthu
jo pesiu rāmeṃ lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  sandesaü akkhiu takkhaṇĕṇa
"ṇaü ṇāsaï ajju vi eu kajju  $  kahŏ taṇiẏa tāra kahŏ taṇaü rajju
pahu pāṇa laeppiṇu ṇāsu ṇāsu  $  jīvantu ṇa chuṭṭahi avasu tāsu
ghattā:
sandesaü viḍa-suggīva suṇĕ  $  puṇaravi suggīvahŏ taṇaü
    sahũ sira-kamaleṇa tuhāraĕṇa  $  rajju laevvaü appaṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 13:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi vaẏaṇubbhaḍĕṇa  $  āruṭṭheṃ duṭṭheṃ viḍa-bhaḍĕṇa
āesu diṇṇu ṇiẏa-sāhaṇahŏ  $  "vitthārahŏ mārahŏ āhaṇahŏ
pāvahŏ muṇḍāvahŏ sira-kamalu  $  sahu ṇāseṃ chindahŏ bhua-jualu
dūahŏ dūattaṇu dakkhavahŏ  $  pāhuṇaü kaẏantahŏ paṭṭhavahŏ"
pahu mantihĩ dukkhu ṇivāriẏaü  $  suggīva-dūu gaü khāriẏaü
ettahĕ vi ṇarindu ṇa saṃthiẏaü  $  ṇiẏa-sandaṇa-vīḍhĕ pariṭṭhiẏaü
saṇṇahĕvi sa-sāhaṇu ṇīsariu  $  paccakkhu ṇāĩ jamu avaẏariu
paḍivakkha-pakkha-saṃkkhohaṇihĩ  $  ṇiggaü sattĕhĩ akkhohaṇihĩ
ghattā:
suggīvahŏ rāmahŏ lakkhaṇahŏ  $  viḍa-suggīu gampi bhiḍiu
    hemantahŏ gimbhahŏ pāusahŏ  $  ṇaṃ dukkālu samāvaḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 14:
abbhiṭṭaĩ veṇṇi mi sāhaṇāĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha harisiẏa-maṇāĩ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha aṇurattāĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha para-tattāĩ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha kalaẏala-karaĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha melliẏa-saraïṃ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha ḍasiẏāharaĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha sara-jajjaraĩ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha jujjhāuraĩ  $  6. jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha accubbhaḍaĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha vihaḍapphaḍaĩ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha ṇiru veviẏaĩ  $  jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha pāseiẏaĩ
jiha mihuṇaĩ tiha ṇicceṭṭhiẏaĩ  $  ṇipphandaĩ jujjhantaĩ thiẏaïm
ghattā:
tehaĕ avasarĕ viṇṇi vi valaĩ  $  osāriẏaĩ mahallaĕhĩ
    "para tumhĕhĩ khatta-dhammu sarĕvi  $  jujjhevvaü ekkallaĕhĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 15:
etthantarĕ simiraĩ pariharevi  $  khattiẏa khatteṃ abbhiṭṭa ve vi
suggīveṃ viḍasuggīu vuttu  $  "jiha māẏā-kavaḍeṃ rajju bhuttu
khala khudda pisuṇa tiha thāhi thāhi  $  kahĩ gammaï rahavaru vāhi vāhi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vipphuriẏāṇaṇeṇa  $  docchiu jalaṇukkā-paharaṇeṇa
"kiṃ uttima-purisahũ ehu maggu  $  maṇu asaïhĕ jiha saẏa-vāra bhaggu
jujjhantu ṇa lajjahi to vi dhiṭṭha  $  raṇĕ pāḍiu pāḍiu lehi ceṭṭha"
asahanta paropparu vāvaranti  $  ṇaṃ palaẏa-mahāghaṇa uttharanti
puṇu vāṇĕhĩ puṇu taru-girivarehĩ  $  karavālĕhĩ sūlĕhĩ moggarehĩ
ghattā:
māẏāsuggīveṃ kuddhaĕṇa  $  laüḍi bhamāḍĕvi mukka kiha
    suggīvahŏ gampiṇu sira-kamalĕ  $  mahiharĕ paḍiẏa caḍakka jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 16:
pāḍiu suggīu gaẏāsaṇiĕ  $  kulapavvaü ṇaṃ vajjāsaṇiĕ
viṇivāiu kira ṇijjīu thiu  $  riu-sāhaṇĕ tūra-vamālu kiu
ettahĕ vi su-tārahĕ pāṇa-piu  $  uccāĕvi rāmahŏ rāmahŏ pāsu ṇiu
vaïdehi-daïu viṇṇattu lahu  $  "paĩ honteṃ ehāvattha mahu"
rāhavĕṇa vuttu "haũ kiṃ karami  $  ko mārami ko kira pariharami
veṇṇi mi samaraṅgaṇĕ atula-vala  $  veṇṇi mi dujjaẏa vijjahĩ pavala
veṇṇi mi viṇṇāṇa-karaṇa-kusala  $  viṇṇi vi thira-thora-vāhu-juala
veṇṇi vi viẏaḍuṇṇaẏa-vacchaẏala  $  veṇṇi vi papphulliẏa-muha-kamala
ghattā:
saẏalu vi sohaï suggīva taü  $  jaṃ vollahi avamāṇiẏaü
    mahu diṭṭhiĕ kula-vahuāĕ jiha  $  khalu para-purisu ṇa jāṇiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 17:
maṇu dhīrĕvi suggīvahŏ taṇaü  $  avaloiu dhaṇuharu appaṇaü
sukalattu jema supaṇāmi[ẏa]ü  $  sukalattu jema āẏāmiẏaü
sukalattu jema diḍha-guṇa-ghaṇaü  $  sukalattu jema koḍḍāvaṇaü
sukalattu jema ṇivvūḍha-bharu  $  sukalattu jema para-ṇippasaru
sukalattu jema saïvarĕ gahiu  $  gharĕ jaṇaẏahŏ jaṇaẏa-suaĕ sahiu
taṃ vajjāvattu hatthĕ caḍiu  $  apphāliu disahĩ ṇāĩ raḍiu
ṇaṃ kāleṃ palaẏa-kālĕ hasiu  $  ṇaṃ juẏa-khaĕ sāẏareṇa rasiu
ṇaṃ paḍiẏa caḍakka khaḍakka-ẏalĕ  $  bhaḍa kampiẏa viḍasuggīva-valĕ
ghattā:
taṃ bhīsaṇu cāva-saddu suṇĕvi  $  keli va vāeṃ tharahariẏa
    para-purisu rameppiṇu asaï jiha  $  vijja sarīrahŏ ṇīsariẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 18:
māẏāsuggīu visāliẏaĕ  $  melliu vijjaĕ veẏāliẏaĕ
ṇaṃ ṇiddhaṇu mukku vilāsiṇiĕ  $  ṇaṃ vara-maẏalañchaṇu rohiṇiĕ
ṇaṃ suravaï parisesiu saïĕ  $  ṇaṃ rāhaü sīẏa-mahāsaïĕ
ṇaṃ maẏaṇa-rāu melliu raïĕ  $  ṇaṃ pāva-piṇḍu sāsaẏa-gaïĕ
ṇaṃ visamaṇaẏaṇu himapavvaïĕ  $  dharaṇendu ṇāĩ paümāvaïĕ
ṇiẏa-vijjaĕ jaṃ avamāṇiẏaü  $  sahasagaï paẏaḍu jaṇĕ jāṇiẏaü
jaṃ vihaḍiu suggīvahŏ taṇaü  $  valu miliu paḍīvaü appaṇaü
ekkallaü pekkhĕvi vaïri thiu  $  valaeveṃ sara-sandhāṇu kiu
ghattā:
khaṇĕ khaṇĕ aṇavaraẏa-guṇaḍḍhiĕhĩ  $  tikkhĕhĩ rāma-silīmuhĕhĩ
     viṇibhiṇṇu kavaḍasuggīu raṇĕ  $  paccāhāru jema vuhĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 43, Kaḍavaka 19:
riu ṇivaḍiu sarĕhĩ viẏāriẏaü  $  suggīu vi purĕ païsāriẏaü
jaẏa-maṅgala-tūra-ṇighosu kiu  $  sahũ tāraĕ rajju karantu thiu
ettahĕ vi rāmu parituṭṭha-maṇu  $  ṇiviseṇa parāiu jiṇa-bhavaṇu
kiẏa vandaṇa suha-gaï-gāmiẏahŏ  $  bhāveṃ candappaha-sāmiẏahŏ
"jaẏa tuhũ gaï tuhũ maï tuhũ saraṇu  $  tuhũ māẏa vappu tuhũ vandhu-jaṇu
tuhũ parama-pakkhu paramatti-haru  $  tuhũ savvahũ parahũ parāhiparu
tuhũ daṃsaṇĕ ṇāṇĕ carittĕ thiu  $  tuhũ saẏala-surāsurehĩ ṇamiu
siddhantĕ mantĕ tuhũ vāẏaraṇĕ  $  sajjhāĕ jhāṇĕ tuhũ tava-caraṇĕ
ghattā:
arahantu vuddhu tuhũ hari haru vi  $  tuhũ aṇṇāṇa-tamoha-riu
    tuhũ suhumu ṇirañjaṇu paramapaü  $  tuhũ ravi vambhu saẏa mbhu siu"
----------  [44. caüẏālīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
maṇu jūraï āsa ṇa pūraï  $  khaṇu vi sahāraṇu ṇaü karaï
so lakkhaṇu rāmāeseṃ  $  gharu suggīvahŏ païsaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 1:
viḍasuggīvĕ samarĕ sara-bhiṇṇaĕ  $  gaĕ sattamaĕ divasĕ volīṇaĕ
vuttu sumitti-puttu valaeveṃ  $  "bhaṇu suggīu gampi viṇu kheveṃ
taṃ diṭṭhantu ṇiruttaü jāẏaü  $  savvahŏ sīẏalu kajju parāẏaü
jaṃ bhuñjāviu rajju sa-tāraü  $  kālahŏ pheḍiu vaïri tuhāraü
taṃ uvaẏāru kiṃ pi jaï jāṇahi  $  kantahĕ taṇiẏa vatta to āṇahi"
gaü somitti visajjiu rāmeṃ  $  saru pañcamaü mukku ṇaṃ kāmeṃ
giri-kikkindha-ṇaẏaru mohantaü  $  kāmiṇi-jaṇa-maṇa-saṃkhohantaü
jiha jiha gharu suggīvahŏ pāvaï  $  tiha tiha jaṇu vihaḍapphaḍu dhāvaï
ṇa gaṇaï kaṇṭhaü kaḍaü galiṇṇaü  $  ṇāĩ kumāreṃ mohaṇu diṇṇaü
ghattā:
kikkindha-ṇarāhiva-keraü  $  diṭṭhu puraü paḍihāru kiha
      thiu mokkha-vārĕ paḍikūlaü  $  jīvahŏ duppariṇāmu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 2:
"kahĕ paḍihāra gampi suggīvahŏ  $  jo paramesaru jamvū-dīvahŏ
acchaï so vaṇa-vāsĕ bhavantaü  $  appuṇu rajju karahi ṇiccintaü
jaṃ tuha keraü avasaru sāriu  $  caṅgaü paümaṇāu uvaẏāriu
to vari haũ uvaẏāru samārami  $  viḍasuggīu jema tiha mārami"
jaṃ saṃdesaü diṇṇu kumāreṃ  $  gampiṇu kahiẏa vatta paḍihāreṃ
"deva deva jo samarĕ aṇiṭṭhiu  $  acchaï lakkhaṇu vārĕ pariṭṭhiu
āu mahavvalu rāmāeseṃ  $  jamu pacchaṇṇu ṇāĩ ṇara-veseṃ
kiṃ païsaraü kiṃ va maṃ païsaü  $  gampiṇu vatta kāĩ sīsaü"
ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi suggīvĕṇa  $  muhu paḍihārahŏ joiẏaü
    "kiṃ keṇa vi gāhā-lakkhaṇu  $  vārĕ mahāraĕ ḍhoiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 3:
kiṃ lakkhaṇu jaṃ lakkha-visuddhaü  $  kiṃ lakkhaṇu jo geẏa-ṇivaddhaü
kiṃ lakkhaṇu jaṃ pāiẏa-kavvahŏ  $  kiṃ lakkhaṇu vāẏaraṇahŏ savvahŏ
kiṃ lakkhaṇu jaṃ chandĕ ṇidiṭṭhaü  $  kiṃ lakkhaṇu jaṃ bharahĕ gaviṭṭhaü
kiṃ lakkhaṇu ṇara-ṇārī-aṅgahũ  $  kiṃ lakkhaṇu māẏaṅga-turaṅgahũ"
pabhaṇaï puṇu paḍihāru viẏakkhaṇu  $  "eẏahũ majjhĕ ṇa ekku vi lakkhaṇu
so lakkhaṇu jo dasaraha-ṇandaṇu  $  so lakkhaṇu jo para-vala-maddaṇu
so lakkhaṇu jo ṇisiẏara-māraṇu  $  samvu-kumāra-vīra-saṃghāraṇu
so lakkhaṇu jo rāma-sahoẏaru  $  so lakkhaṇu jo sīẏahĕ devaru
so lakkhaṇu jo ṇaravara-kesari  $  so lakkhaṇu jo khara-dūsaṇa-ari
dasaraha-taṇaü sumittihĕ jāẏaü  $  rāmeṃ sahũ vaṇa-vāsahŏ āẏaü
ghattā:
aṇuṇijjaü deva paẏatteṃ  $  jāva ṇa kuppaï ṇiẏa-maṇĕṇa
      maṃ pantheṃ paĩ pesesaï  $  māẏāsuggīvahŏ taṇĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 4:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu paḍihārahŏ  $  hiẏavaü bhiṇṇu kaïddhaẏa-sārahŏ
"ĕhu so lakkhaṇu rāma-kaṇiṭṭhaü  $  jāsu āsi haũ saraṇu païṭṭhaü"
sīsu va guru-vaẏaṇĕhĩ ummūḍhaü  $  ṇaravaï viṇaẏa-gaïndārūḍhaü
sa-valu sa-piṇḍavāsu sa-kalattaü  $  calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu visanthula-gattaü
pabhaṇiu kaluṇu kiẏañjali-hatthaü  $  "haũ pāviṭṭhu dhiṭṭhu akiẏatthaü
tārā-ṇaẏaṇa-sarĕhĩ jajjariẏaü  $  tumhāraü ṇāu mi vīsariẏaü
ahŏ paramesara para-uvaẏārā  $  ekka-vāra mahu khamahi bhaḍārā"
jaṃ piẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ viṇaü paẏāsiu  $  ṇaravaï lakkhaṇĕṇa āsāsiu
"abhaü vaccha chuḍu sīẏa gavesahi  $  lahu vijjāhara dasa-disi pesahi"
ghattā:
somittihĕ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu  $  suhaḍa-sahāsĕhĩ pariẏariu
      ṇaṃ sāẏaru samaẏahŏ cukkaü  $  kikkindhāhiu ṇīsariu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 5:
ṇarāhio visālaẏaṃ  $  parāio jiṇālaẏaṃ
thuo tiloẏa-sāmio  $  aṇanta-sokkha-gāmio
"jaẏaṭṭha-kamma-dāraṇā  $  aṇaṅga-saṅga-vāraṇā
pasiddha-siddha-sāsaṇā  $  tamoha-moha-ṇāsaṇā
kasāẏa-māẏa-vajjiẏā  $  tiloẏa-loẏa-pujjiẏā
maẏaṭṭha-duṭṭha-maddaṇā  $  tisalla-velli-chindaṇā"
thuo ema ṇāho  $  vihūī-saṇāho
mahādeva-devo  $  ṇa tuṅgo ṇa cheo
ṇa cheo ṇa mūlaṃ  $  ṇa cāvaṃ ṇa sūlaṃ
ṇa kaṅkāla-mālā  $  ṇa diṭṭhi karālā
ṇa gaürī ṇa gaṅgā  $  ṇa cando ṇa ṇāgā
ṇa putto ṇa kantā  $  ṇa ḍāho ṇa cintā
ṇa kāmo ṇa koho  $  ṇa loho ṇa moho
ṇa māṇaṃ ṇa māẏā  $  ṇa sāmaṇṇa-chāẏā
ghattā:
paṇaveppiṇu jiṇavara-sāmiu  $  suha-gaï-gāmiu païjārūḍhu ṇarāhivaï
      "jaï sīẏahĕ vatta ṇa-ẏāṇami  $  tumha parāṇami to vala mahu saṇṇāsa-gaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 6:
eva bhaṇevi aṇiṭṭhiẏa-vāhaṇu  $  kokkāviu vijjāhara-sāhaṇu
"jāhũ gavesā jahĩ āsaṅghahŏ  $  jala-duggaĩ thala-duggaĩ laṅghahŏ
païsĕvi dīveṃ dīu gavesahŏ"  $  gaẏa aṅgaṅgaẏa uttara-desahŏ
gavaẏa-gavakkha ve vi puvvaddheṃ  $  ṇala-kundenda-ṇīla pacchaddheṃ
dāhiṇeṇa suggīu sa-sāhaṇu  $  aṇṇu vi jamvavantu harisiẏa-maṇu
caliẏa vimāṇārūḍha mahāiẏa  $  ṇiviseṃ kamvū-dīu parāiẏa
tāva tetthu vijjāhara-keraü  $  kampaï calaï valaï vivareraü
dīhara-daṇḍu pavaṇa-paḍipelliu  $  ṇaṃ jasa-puñju mahaṇṇave melliu
ghattā:
so rāeṃ dhaü dhuvvantaü  $  dīsaï ṇaẏaṇa-suhāvaṇaü
    "lahu ehu ehu" hakkāraï  $  ṇāĩ hatthu sīẏahĕ taṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 7:
teṇa vi diṭṭhu cindhu suggīvahŏ  $  uppari entaü kamvū-dīvahŏ
cintaï raẏaṇakesi "laï vujjhiu  $  jeṇa samāṇu āsi haũ jujjhiu
so taïlokka-cakka-saṃtāvaṇu  $  mañchuḍu āu paḍīvaü rāvaṇu
kahĩ ṇāsami kahŏ saraṇu paḍhukkami  $  eẏahŏ haũ jīvantu ṇa cukkami"
dukkhu dukkhu sāhāriu ṇiẏa-maṇu  $  "jaï saẏam eva parāiu rāvaṇu
to kiṃ tāsu mahaddhaĕ vāṇaru  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ dīsaï kikkindhesaru"
tahĩ avasarĕ suggīu parāiu  $  ṇāĩ purandaru saggahŏ āiu
"bho bho raẏaṇakesi kiṃ bhullaü  $  acchahi kāĩ etthu ekkallaü"
ghattā:
suggīvahŏ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu  $  hiẏavaĕ harisu ṇa māiẏaü
    ṇava-pāusĕ salileṃ sittaü  $  viñjhu jema appāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 8:
ṇiẏa kaha kahahũ laggu vijjāharu  $  atula-mallu bhāmaṇḍala-kiṅkaru
"sāmihĕ jāmi jāma olaggaĕ  $  diṭṭhu vimāṇu tāma gaẏaṇaggaĕ
tahĩ kandanti sīẏa āẏaṇṇĕvi  $  dhāiu rāvaṇu tiṇa-samu maṇṇĕvi
haü vacchatthalĕ asivara-ghāeṃ  $  giri va paloṭṭiu vajja-ṇihāeṃ
dukkhu dukkhu ceẏaṇaü laheppiṇu  $  pāḍiu vijjā-cheu kareppiṇu
jiha jaccandhu disāu vibhullaü  $  acchami teṇa etthu ekkallaü"
ṇisuṇĕvi sīẏā-haraṇu mahāguṇu  $  ubhaẏa-karĕhĩ avagūḍhu puṇuppuṇu
aṇṇu vi tuṭṭhaeṇa maṇa-bhāviṇi  $  diṇṇa vijja tahŏ ṇahaẏala-gāmiṇi
ghattā:
ṇiu raẏaṇakesi suggīvĕṇa  $  jahĩ acchaï valu dummaṇaü
    jasu maṇḍaĕ ṇāĩ hareppiṇu  $  āṇiu dahavaẏaṇahŏ taṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 9:
vijjāhara-kula-bhavaṇa-paīveṃ  $  rāmahŏ vaddhāviu suggīveṃ
"deva deva taru dukkha-mahāṇaï  $  sīẏahĕ taṇiẏa vatta ĕhu jāṇaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu valahaddeṃ  $  hasiu sa-vibbhamu kahakaha-saddeṃ
"bho bho vaccha vaccha de sāiu  $  jīviu ṇavara ajju āsāiu"
eva bhaṇevi teṇa savvaṅgiu  $  ṇeha-mahābhareṇa āliṅgiu
"kahĕ kahĕ keṇa kanta uddāliẏa  $  kiṃ mua kiṃ jīvanti ṇihāliẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi caviu vijjāharu  $  ṇāĩ jiṇindahŏ aggaĕ gaṇaharu
"deva deva kaluṇaĩ kandantī  $  hā lakkhaṇa hā rāma bhaṇantī
ghattā:
ṇāgindi va garuḍa-vihaṅgamĕṇa  $  sāraṅgi va pañcāṇaṇĕṇa
    mahu vijjā-cheu kareppiṇu  $  ṇiẏa vaïdehi dasāṇaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 10:
tahĩ tehaĕ vi kālĕ bhaẏa-bhīẏahĕ  $  keṇa vi sīlu ṇa khaṇḍiu sīẏahĕ
para-purisĕhĩ ṇaü cittu laïjjaï  $  vālĕhĩ jiha vāẏaraṇu ṇa bhijjaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vijjāhara-vuttaü  $  kaṇṭhaü diṇṇu kaḍaü kaḍisuttaü
tahĩ avasarĕ je gaẏā gavesā  $  āẏa paḍīvā te vi asesā
pucchiẏa rāhaveṇa "vara-vīrahŏ  $  jamvava aṅgaṅgaẏa soṇḍīrahŏ
ahŏ ṇala-ṇīlahŏ gavaẏa-gavakkhahŏ  $  sā kiṃ dūrĕ laṅkā mahu akkhahŏ"
jamvaü kahahŏ laggu halaheihĕ  $  "rakkhasa-dīvahŏ sāẏara-veihĕ
joẏaṇa-saẏaĩ satta vihĩ antaru  $  tahi mi samuddu raüddu bhaẏaṅkaru
laṅkā-dīu vi teṇa pamāṇeṃ  $  kahiu jiṇindeṃ kevala-ṇāṇeṃ
tahĩ tikūḍu ṇāmeṇa mahīharu  $  joẏaṇāĩ pañcāsa sa-vittharu
ṇava tuṅgattaṇeṇa tahŏ uppari  $  thiẏa joẏaṇa vattīsa laṅkāuri
ghattā:
ekku vi ṇarindu ṇīsaṅkaü  $  aṇṇu samuddeṃ pariẏariu
      ekku vi kesari duppekkhaü  $  aṇṇu paḍīvaü pakkhariu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 11:
jasu taïlokka-cakku āsaṅkaï  $  teṇa samāṇu bhiḍĕvi ko sakkaï
rāhava eṇa kāĩ ālāveṃ  $  kāĩ va sīẏahĕ taṇĕṇa palāveṃ
piṇḍatthaṇiu laḍaha-lāẏaṇṇaü  $  laï mahu taṇiẏaü teraha kaṇṇaü
guṇavaï hiẏaẏavamma hiẏaẏāvali  $  suravaï paümāvaï raẏaṇāvali
candakanta sirikantāṇuddhari  $  cārulacchi maṇavāhiṇi sundari
sahũ jiṇavaïĕ rūva-saṃpaṇṇaü  $  pariṇi bhaḍārā eẏaü kaṇṇaü"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi valaeveṃ vuccaï  $  "āẏahũ majjhĕ ṇa ekka vi ruccaï
jaï vi rambha aha hoi tilottima  $  sīẏahĕ pāsiu aṇṇa ṇa uttima"
ghattā:
valaevahŏ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu  $  kikkindhāhiveṇa hasiu
    "kiu rattahŏ taṇaü kahāṇaü  $  bhoẏaṇu muĕvi chāṇu asiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 12:
khaṇĕ khaṇĕ vollahi ṇāĩ aẏāṇaü  $  kiṃ paĩ ṇa suẏaü loẏāhāṇaü
jaï vi kiṃ pi accharaĕ ṇa kijjaï  $  tā kiṃ māṇusa-metteṃ dijjaï
pūsamāṇu jaï sīẏahĕ pāsiu  $  to karĕ vaẏaṇu mahāraü bhāsiu
varisĕ varisĕ tihuvaṇa-saṃtāvaṇu  $  jaï vi ṇei ekkekkī rāvaṇu
to vi janti taü teraha varisaĩ  $  jāĩ surinda-bhoga-aṇusarisaĩ
upparantĕ puṇu kāi mi hosaï"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu valu ghosaï
"maï mārevaü vaïri sa-hattheṃ  $  lāevaü khara-dūsaṇa-pantheṃ
tiẏa-parihavu savvaha mi garūvaü  $  ṇaṃ to paï mi saĩ ji aṇuhūaü
ghattā:
jo maïliu vihi-pariṇāmĕṇa  $  aẏasa-kalaṅka-paṅka-malĕhĩ
    so jasa-paḍu pakkhālevaü  $  dahamuha-sīsa-silāẏalĕhĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 13:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vuttu suggīveṃ  $  "viggahu kavaṇu samaü dahagīveṃ
ekku kuraṅgu ekku aïrāvaü  $  pāhaṇu ekku ekku kula-pāvaü
ekku samuddu ekku kamalāẏaru  $  ekku bhuaṅgamu ekku khagesaru
ekku maṇusu ekku vi vijjāharu  $  tahŏ tumhahũ vaḍḍāraü antaru
jagĕ jasa-paḍahu jeṇa apphāliu  $  giri kaïlāsu karĕhĩ saṃcāliu
jeṇa mahāhavĕ bhaggu purandaru  $  jamu vaïsavaṇu varuṇu vaïsāṇaru
jeṇa samīraṇo vi jiu khatteṃ  $  kavaṇu gahaṇu tahŏ māṇusa-metteṃ"
hari vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa āruṭṭhaü  $  ṇāĩ saṇiccharu citteṃ duṭṭhaü
ghattā:
"aṅgaṅgaẏa-ṇala-suggīvahŏ  $  vāhu-sahejjā hohu chuḍu
     haũ lakkhaṇu ekku pahuccami  $  jo dahagīvahŏ jīva-khuḍu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi vaẏaṇuṇṇaĕṇa  $  suggīu vuttu jamvuṇṇaĕṇa
"ĕhu hoi ṇa kŏ vi sāvaṇṇu ṇaru  $  saccaü paḍivakkha-viṇāsaẏaru
jaṃ cavaï savvu taṃ ṇivvahaï  $  ko asivaru sūrahāsu lahaï
jo jīviu samvukkahŏ haraï  $  jo khara-dūsaṇa-kulakhaü karaï
so raṇĕ paharantu keṇa dhariu  $  khaẏa-kālu dasāsahŏ avaẏariu
paramāgamu ṇīsandehu thiu  $  kevalihĩ āsi āesu kiu
āliṅgĕvi vāhahĩ jiha mahila  $  jo saṃcālesaï koḍi-sila
so hosaï mallu dasāṇaṇahŏ  $  sāmiu vijjāhara-sāhaṇahŏ
ghattā:
jamvavahŏ vaẏaṇu ṇisuṇeppiṇu  $  dhuṇiu kumāreṃ bhua-jualu
    "kiṃ ekkeṃ pāhaṇa-khaṇḍĕṇa  $  dharami sa-sāẏaru dharaṇi-ẏalu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 15:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu parituṭṭheṃ  $  vuttu jaṇaddaṇu vāli-kaṇiṭṭheṃ
"jaṃ jaṃ cavahi deva taṃ saccaü  $  aṇṇu vi eu karahi jaï paccaü
to haũ bhiccu homi hiẏaïcchiu  $  sūrahŏ divasu va vela paḍicchiu
taṃ ṇisuṇevi samara-dussīlĕhĩ  $  ṇaravaï vujjhāviu ṇala-ṇīlĕhĩ
"jeṇa sarĕhĩ khara-dūsaṇa ghāiẏa  $  pattiẏa koḍi-sila vi uccāiẏa"
ema cavevi caliẏa vijjāhara  $  ṇava-kaṅkālĕ ṇāĩ ṇava jalahara
lakkhaṇa-rāma caḍāviẏa jāṇĕhĩ  $  ghaṇṭā-jhuṇi-jhaṅkāra-pahāṇĕhĩ
koḍi-silā-uddesu parāiẏa  $  siddhĕhĩ siddhi jema ṇijjhāiẏa
ghattā:
jā saẏala-kāla hiṇḍantahũ  $  hua vaṇa-vāsĕ parammuhiẏa
   sā evahĩ lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ  $  ṇaṃ thiẏa siẏa savaḍammuhiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 44, Kaḍavaka 16:
loẏaggahŏ siva-sāsaẏa-sokkhahŏ  $  jahĩ muṇivarahũ koḍi gaẏa mokkhahŏ
sā koḍi-sila tehĩ pariañciẏa  $  gandha-dhūva-vali-pupphĕhĩ añciẏa
diṇṇa sa-saṅkha paḍaha kiu kalaẏalu  $  ghosiu caü-paẏāru jiṇa-maṅgalu
"jasu dunduhi asou bhāmaṇḍalu  $  so arahantu deu taü maṅgalu
je gaẏa tihuẏaṇaggu taṃ ṇikkalu  $  te siddhavara dentu taü maṅgalu
jehĩ aṇaṅgu bhaggu jiu kali-malu  $  te vara-sāhu dentu taü maṅgalu
jo chajjīva-ṇikāẏahã vacchalu  $  so daẏa-dhammu deu taü maṅgalu"
ema su-maṅgalu  uccāreppiṇu  $  siddhavarahũ ṇavakāru kareppiṇu
jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ sila saṃcāliẏa  $  rāvaṇa-riddhi ṇāĩ uddāliẏa
mukka paḍīvī karaẏala-tāḍiẏa  $  dahamuha-hiẏaẏa-gaṇṭhi ṇaṃ phāḍiẏa
ghattā:
parituṭṭheṃ suravara-loĕṇa  $  jaẏa-siri-ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhaṇahŏ
      pammukku sa ïṃ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ  $  kusuma-vāsu sirĕ lakkhaṇahŏ
----------  [45. pañcacālīsamo sandhi]  ----------
koḍi-silaĕ saṃcāliẏaĕ dahamuha-jīviu saṃcāli(ẏa)ü
ṇahĕ devĕhĩ mahiẏalĕ ṇarĕhĩ āṇanda-tūru apphāli(ẏa)ü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 1:
raha-vimāṇa-māẏaṅga-turaṅgama-vāhaṇe  $  vijaü ghuṭṭhu suggīvahŏ keraĕ sāhaṇe
etthantarĕ sirĕ lāiẏa karehĩ  $  jokkāriu valu vijjāharehĩ
jagĕ jiṇavara-bhavaṇaïm jāĩ jāĩ  $  pariañcĕvi añcĕvi tāĩ tāĩ
pallaṭṭu paḍīvaü suhaḍa-paẏaru  $  ṇiviseṇa pattu kikkindha-ṇaẏaru
ettiẏaĩ kiẏaĩ sāhasaĩ jaï vi  $  suggīvahŏ maṇĕ saṃdehu to vi
"ahŏ jamvava cariu mahantu kāsu  $  kiṃ dahavaẏaṇahŏ kiṃ lakkhaṇāsu
kaïlāsu tuliu ekkeṃ pacaṇḍu  $  aṇṇekkeṃ puṇu pāhāṇa-khaṇḍu
vaḍḍāraü sāhasu vihi mi kavaṇu  $  kiṃ suhagaï kiṃ saṃsāra-gamaṇu"
jamvavĕṇa vuttu "mā maṇĕṇa mujjhu  $  kiṃ ajja vi pahu sandehu tujjhu
ghattā:
vaḍḍāraü vaḍḍantarĕṇa  $  paramāgamu savvahŏ pāsiu
       jamma-sae vi ṇarāhivaï  $  kiṃ cukkaï muṇivara-bhāsiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 2:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi suggīvahŏ harisiẏa-gattaho  $  phiṭṭa bhanti jiṇā-vaẏaṇĕhĩ jiha micchattaho
āgama-valeṇa uvaladdhaeṇa  $  avaloiu seṇṇu kaïddhaeṇa
"kiṃ ko vi atthi ettiẏahã majjhĕ  $  jo khandhu samoḍḍaï garua-vojjhe
jo ujjālaï mahu taṇaü vaẏaṇu  $  jo darisaï valahŏ kalatta-raẏaṇu
jo tāraï dukkha-mahāṇaīhĕ  $  jo jāi gavesaü jāṇaīhĕ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jamvaü caviu eva  $  "haṇuvantu muĕvi ko jāi deva
ṇaü jāṇahũ kiṃ āruṭṭho so vi  $  jaṃ ṇihaü samvu kharu dūsaṇo vi
taṃ rosu dharĕvi majjhāra-taṇua  $  rāvaṇahŏ milesaï ṇavara haṇua
jaṃ jāṇahŏ cintahŏ taṃ paesu  $  teṃ milieṃ miliẏaü jagu asesu
ghattā:
vihi mi rāma-rāmaṇa-valahũ  $  ekku vi vaḍḍhimaü ṇa dīsaï
      sahũ jaẏa-lacchiĕ vijaü tahĩ  $  para jahĩ haṇuvantu milesaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 3:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kikkindha-ṇarāhiu rañjio  $  lacchibhutti haṇuvantahŏ pāsu visajjio
"paĩ muĕvi aṇṇu ko vuddhivantu  $  jiha milaï tema kari kiṃ pi mantu
guṇa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ gampiṇu pavaṇa-puttu  $  bhaṇu "etthu kālĕ rūsĕvi ṇa juttu
khara-dūsaṇa-samvu pasāhiẏatta  $  appaṇu duccariĕhĩ maraṇu patta
ṇaü rāmahŏ ṇaü lakkhaṇahŏ dosu  $  jiha tahŏ tiha savvahŏ hoi rosu"
bhaṇu "ettieṇa kāleṇa kāĩ  $  candaṇahihĕ cariẏaĩ ṇa vi suẏāĩ
lakkhaṇa-mukkaĕ virahāurāĕ  $  khara-dūsaṇa mārāviẏa khalāĕ""
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi āṇandu hūu  $  ārūḍhu vimāṇĕ turantu dūu
saṃcalliu pulaẏa-visaṭṭa-gattu  $  ṇivisaddheṃ lacchīṇaẏaru pattu
ghattā:
paṭṭaṇu pavaṇa-suahŏ taṇaü  $  thiu haṇuruha-dīvĕ ravaṇṇaü
      mahiẏalĕ keṇa vi kāraṇĕṇa  $  ṇa sagga-khaṇḍu avaïṇṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 4:
lacchibhutti taṃ lacchīṇaẏaru paīsaī  $  vavaharantu jaṃ sundaru taṃ taṃ dīsaī
deulavāḍaü paṇṇu pahillaü  $  phopphalu aṇṇu mūlu ceullaü
jāihullu karahāḍaü cuṇṇaü  $  cittaüḍaü kañcuaü ravaṇṇaü
rāmaüraü gulu saru païṭhāṇaü  $  aïvaḍḍaü bhujaṅgu vahu-jāṇaü
addha-vesu piu avvua-keraü  $  jovvaṇu kaṇṇāḍaü saviẏāraü
celaü harikelaü sacchāẏaü  $  vaḍḍāẏaraü loṇu vikkhāẏaü
vaïrāẏaraü vajju maṇi siṅghalu  $  ṇevālaü katthūriẏa-parimalu
mottiẏa-hāra-ṇiẏaru sañjāṇaü  $  kharu vajjaraü turaü kekkāṇaü
vara kāviṭṭhi suṭṭhu paüṇārī  $  vāṇi suhāsiṇi ṇanduravārī
kañcī-keraü ṇaẏaru visiṭṭhaü  $  cīṇaü ṇettu viẏaḍḍhĕhĩ diṭṭhaü
aṇṇu inda-vāẏaraṇu guṇijjaï  $  bhūvāvallaü geu jhuṇijjaï
ema ṇaẏaru gaü ṇivvaṇṇantaü  $  rāulu pavaṇa-suahŏ saṃpattaü
ghattā:
so paḍihāriĕ ṇammaẏaĕ  $  suggīva-dūu ṇa ṇivāriu
      ṇāĩ mahaṇṇavĕ ṇammaẏaĕ  $  ṇiẏa-jalapavāhu païsāriu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 5:
diṭṭhu teṇa dūrahŏ vi samīraṇa-ṇandaṇo  $  sisira-kālĕ divasaẏaru va ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇo
sirisaïlu ṇareṇa ṇihāliẏaü  $  ṇaṃ kari kariṇihĩ parimāliẏaü
ekkettahĕ ekka ṇiviṭṭha tiẏa  $  vara-vīṇa-vihatthī pāṇa-piẏa
ṇāmeṇaṇaṅgakusuma subhua  $  sasa samvukumārahŏ kharahŏ sua
aṇṇekkettahĕ aṇṇekka tiẏa  $  vara-kamala-vihatthī ṇāĩ siẏa
sā paṅkaẏarāẏa abhaṅgaẏahŏ  $  suggīvahŏ sua sasa aṅgaẏahŏ
vihĩ pāsĕhĩ ve vi varaṅgaṇaü  $  kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-loẏaṇaü
rehaï sundaru majjhatthu kiha  $  vihĩ sañjhahĩ parimiu divasu jiha
etthantarĕ guñjhu ṇa rakkhiẏaü  $  haṇuvantahŏ dūeṃ akkhiẏaü
ghattā:
"khemu kusalu kallāṇu jaü  $  suggīvaṅgaṅgaẏa-vīrahũ
       akusalu maraṇu viṇāsu khaü  $  khara-dūsaṇa-samvukumārahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 6:
kahiu savvu taṃ lakkhaṇa-rāma-kahāṇaüṃ  $  daṇḍaẏāi muṇi-koḍi-silā-avasāṇaüṃ
taṃ suṇĕvi aṇaṅgakusuma ḍariẏa  $  paṅkaẏarāẏāṇurāẏa-bhariẏa
ekkahĕ ṇaṃ vajjāsaṇi paḍiẏa  $  aṇṇekkahĕ romāvali caḍiẏa
ekkahĕ maṇĕ ṇāĩ palevaṇaü  $  aṇṇekkahĕ puṇu vaddhāvaṇaü
ekkahĕ sarīru ṇicceẏaṇaü  $  aṇṇekkahĕ vavagaẏa-veẏaṇaü
ekkahĕ hiẏavaü palu palu lhasiu  $  aṇṇekkahĕ palu palu osasiu
ekkahĕ ohulliu muha-kamalu  $  aṇṇekkahĕ viẏasiu ahara-dalu
ekkahĕ jala-bhariẏaĩ loẏaṇaĩ  $  aṇṇekkahĕ rahasa-paloẏaṇaĩ
ekkahĕ saru vara-geẏahŏ taṇaü  $  aṇṇekkahĕ kaluṇu ruvāvaṇaü
ekkahĕ thiu rāulu vimaṇa-maṇu  $  aṇṇekkahĕ vaḍḍhaï ṇāĩ chaṇu
ghattā:
addhaü aṃsu-jalolliẏaü  $  addhaü sarahasu romañciẏaü
      rāula pavaṇa-suẏahŏ taṇaü  $  ṇaṃ harisa-visāẏa-paṇacciẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 7:
kharahŏ dhīẏa mucchaṅgaẏa puṇu vi paḍīviẏā  $  candaṇeṇa pavvāliẏa paccujjīviẏā
uṭṭhiẏa rovanti aṇaṅgakusuma  $  ṇaṃ candaṇa-laẏa ubbhiṇṇa-kusuma
"hā tāẏa keṇa viṇivāio 'si  $  vijjāharu hontaü ghāio 'si
sūrāṇa sūra jasa-ṇikkalaṅka  $  vijjāhara-kula-ṇahaẏala-maẏaṅka
hā bhāi sahoẏara dehi vāẏa  $  vilavanti kāsu paĩ mukka māẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kusalĕhĩ paṇḍiehĩ  $  saddattha-sattha-paricaḍḍiehĩ
"kiṃ ṇa suu jiṇāgamu jagĕ pagāsu  $  jāẏahŏ jīvahŏ savvahŏ viṇāsu
jala-vindu jema ghaṅghalĕ paḍantu  $  jaṃ dīsaï taṃ sāhasu mahantu
sāhāru ṇa vandhaï ei jāi  $  arahaṭṭa-jantĕ ṇava ghaḍiẏa ṇāĩ
ghattā:
rovahi kāĩ akaraṇĕṇa  $  dhīravahi māĕ appāṇaü
      amhahã tumhahũ avarahu mi  $  kaddivasu vi avasa-paẏāṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 8:
kharahŏ dhīẏa paridhīraviẏā parivārĕṇaṃ  $  maẏa-jalaṃ ca devāviẏa loẏācārĕṇaṃ
iherisammi velae  $  pariṭṭhie vamālae
samuṭṭhio 'rimaddaṇo  $  samīraṇassa ṇandaṇo
palamva-vāhu-pañjaro  $  ṇiraṅkuso vva kuñjaro
mahīharassa upparī  $  viruddhaü vva kesarī
phuranta-ratta-loẏaṇo  $  saṇi vva sāvaloẏaṇo
duvāraso vva bhakkharo  $  jamo vva diṭṭhi-ṇiṭṭhuro
vihi vva kiñciduṭṭhio  $  sasi vva aṭṭhamo ṭhio
vihapphaï vva jammaṇĕ  $  ahi vva kūra-kammaṇĕ
ghattā:
"maĩ haṇuvanteṃ kuddhaĕṇa  $  kahĩ jīviu lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ
      divasĕ caütthaĕ paṭṭhavami  $  pantheṃ khara-dūsaṇa-māmahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 9:
lacchibhutti pabhaṇiu suhi-sumahura-vāẏae  $  "eu savvu kiu samvukumārahŏ māẏae
deva gaẏaṇa-goẏarīĕ  $  kāmakusuma-māẏarīĕ
uvavaṇaṃ paḍhukkiẏāĕ  $  sua-vioẏa-mukkiẏāĕ
rāvaṇassa lahu-sasāĕ  $  kāma-sara-paravvasāĕ
lakkhaṇammi gaẏa-maṇāĕ  $  divva-rūva-dāvaṇāĕ
paraharaṃ samalliẏāĕ  $  supurisehĩ ghalliẏāĕ
viraha-dāha-bhimbhalāĕ  $  thaṇa viẏāriẏā khalāĕ
kharo sa-dūsaṇo vi jetthu  $  gaẏa ruanti ḍhukka tetthu
te vi takkhaṇammi kuiẏa  $  canda-bhakkhara vva uiẏa
bhiḍiẏa rāma-lakkhaṇāhã  $  jiha kuraṅga vāraṇāhã
viṇhuṇā sarehĩ bhiṇṇa  $  paḍiẏa pāẏava vva chiṇṇa
ettahĕ vi raṇĕ thireṇa  $  ṇīẏa sīẏa dasasireṇa
hari valā vi ve vi tāsu  $  gaẏa puraṃ virāhiẏāsu
etthu avasarammi rāu  $  miliu aṅgaẏassa tāu
viḍa-bhaḍo vi rāhaveṇa  $  viṇihao alāhaveṇa
ghattā:
taṃ kiu koḍi-siluddharaṇu  $  kevalihĩ āsi jaṃ bhāsiu
      amhahũ jaü rāvaṇahŏ khaü  $  phuḍu lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ pāsiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 10:
kahiu savvu jaṃ candaṇahihĕ guṇa-kittaṇu  $  aṇila-puttu lajjāviu thiu heṭṭhāṇaṇu
jaṃ pisuṇiu koḍi-siluddharaṇu  $  aṇṇu vi viṣasuggīvahŏ maraṇu
taṃ pavaṇa-puttu romañciẏaü  $  ṇaḍu jiha rasa-bhāva-paṇacciẏaü
kulu ṇāmu pasaṃsiu lakkhaṇahŏ  $  sura-sundari-ṇaẏaṇa-kaḍakkhaṇahŏ
"saccaü ṇārāẏaṇu aṭṭhamaü  $  dahavaẏaṇahŏ candu va aṭṭhamaü
māẏāsuggīu jeṇa vahiu  $  halaharu aṭṭhamaü so vi kahiu"
maṇu jāṇĕvi haṇuvantahŏ taṇaü  $  dūahŏ hiẏavaĕ vaddhāvaṇaü
siru ṇavĕvi ṇirāriu piu cavaï  $  "suggīu deva paĩ sambharaï
acchaï guṇa-salila-tisāiẏaü  $  teṃ haũ hakkāraü āiẏaü
ghattā:
paĩ virahiu chullucchulaü  $  puṇṇālihĕ cittu va ūṇaü
      ṇa vi sohaï suggīva-valu  $  jiha jovvaṇu dhamma-vihūṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 11:
eha volla ṇisuṇevi samīraṇa-ṇandaṇu  $  sa-gaü sa-dhaü sa-turaṅgamu sa-bhaḍu sa-sandaṇu
sa-vimāṇu sa-sāhaṇu pavaṇa-suu  $  saṃcalliu pulaẏa-visaṭṭa-bhuu
saṃcallĕ haṇuĕ saṃcallu valu  $  ṇaṃ pāusĕ meha-jālu sa-jalu
ṇaṃ risaha-jiṇinda-samosaraṇu  $  ṇaṃ ṇāṇa-samaĕ devāgamaṇu
ṇaṃ tārā-maṇḍalu uggamiu  $  ṇaṃ ṇahĕ māẏāmaü ṇimmaviu
āṇanda-ghosu haṇuvahŏ taṇaü  $  ṇisuṇevi tūru koḍḍāvaṇaü
pamaẏaddhaẏa-sāhaṇĕ jāẏa dihi  $  ghaṇĕ gajjiĕ ṇaṃ parituṭṭha sihi
ṇaravaï suggīu karevi dhurĕ  $  kiẏa haṭṭa-soha kikkindha-purĕ
kañcaṇa-toraṇaĩ ṇivaddhāĩ  $  gharĕ gharĕ mihuṇaĩ samaladdhāĩ
gharĕ gharĕ parihiẏaĩ ravaṇṇāĩ  $  lāḍaï paḍipāṇiẏa-vaṇṇāĩ
lahu gahiẏa-pasāhaṇa saẏala ṇara  $  ṇiggaẏa savaḍammuha aggha-kara
ghattā:
jamvava-ṇala-ṇīlaṅgaṅgaĕhĩ  $  haṇuvantu entu jaẏakāriu
      ṇāṇa-carittĕhĩ daṃsaṇĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ siddhu mokkhĕ païsāriu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 12:
païsarantu purĕ pekkhaï ṇimmala-tāraĩ  $  gharĕ gharĕ ji maṇi-kañcaṇa-toraṇa-vāraĩ
candaṇa-caccarāĩ sirikhaṇḍaĩ  $  pekkhaï purĕ ṇāṇāviha-bhaṇḍaĩ
kuṅkuma-katthūriẏa-kappūraĩ  $  agaru-gandha-silhaẏa-sindūraĩ
katthaï kallūriẏahũ kaṇikkaü  $  ṇaṃ siñjhanti tiẏaü piẏa-mukkaü
aï-vaṇṇujjalāu ṇaü miṭṭhaü  $  ṇaṃ vara-vesaü vāhira-miṭṭhaü
katthaï puṇu tamvoliẏa-santhaü  $  ṇaṃ muṇivara-maīu majjhatthaü
ahavaï sura-mahilaü vahulatthaü  $  jaṇa-muham ujjālevi samatthaü
katthaï paḍiẏaĩ pāsā-jūaĩ  $  ṇaṭṭaharaĩ pekkhaṇaĩ va hūaĩ
muṇivara iva jiṇa-ṇāmu laẏantaĩ  $  vandiṇa iva su-dāẏa maggantaĩ
katthaï vara-mālāhara-santhaü  $  ṇaṃ vāẏaraṇa-kahaü suttatthaü
katthaï lavaṇaĩ ṇimmala-tāraĩ  $  khala-dujjaṇa-vaẏaṇaĩ va su-khāraĩ
katthaï tuppaĩ tella-vimīsaĩ  $  ṇāĩ kumittattaṇaĩ asarisaĩ
katthaï ummavanti ṇara māṇaĩ  $  ṇaṃ jama-dūā āu-pamāṇaĩ
katthaï kāmiṇīu maẏa-mattaü  $  ṇaṃ riha-vahulaü adhiẏa-kaḍattaü
ema asesu ṇaẏaru vaṇṇantaü  $  mottiẏa-raṅgāvali cūrantaü
līlaĕ païṭhu samīraṇa-ṇandaṇu  $  jahĩ halaharu suggīu jaṇaddaṇu
ghattā:
rāmahŏ harihĕ kaïddhaẏahŏ  $  haṇuvantu kaẏañjali-hatthaü
      kālahŏ jamahŏ saṇiccharahŏ  $  ṇaṃ miliu kaẏantu caütthaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 13:
rāhaveṇa vaïsāriu ṇiẏa-addhāsaṇe  $  muṇivaro vva thiu ṇiccalu jiṇavara-sāsaṇe
ekkahĩ ṇiviṭṭha haṇuvanta-rāma  $  maṇa-mohaṇa ṇāĩ vasanta-kāma
jamvava-suggīva sahanti te vi  $  ṇaṃ inda-paḍinda vaïṭṭha ve vi
somitti-virāhiẏa parama mitta  $  ṇami-viṇami ṇāĩ thira-thora-citta
aṅgaṅgaẏa suhaḍa sahanti ve vi  $  ṇaṃ canda-sūra thiẏa avaẏarevi
ṇala-ṇīla-ṇarinda ṇiviṭṭha kema  $  ekkāsaṇĕ jama-vaïsavaṇa jema
gaẏa-gavaẏa-gavakkha vi raṇa-samattha  $  ṇaṃ vara-pañcāṇaṇa girivarattha
avara vi ekekka pacaṇḍa vīra  $  thiẏa pāsĕhĩ pavara-sarīra dhīra
etthantarĕ jaẏa-siri-kulahareṇa  $  haṇuvantu pasaṃsiu halahareṇa
ghattā:
"ajju maṇoraha ajju dihi  $  mahu sāhaṇu ajju pacaṇḍaü
      cintā-sāẏarĕ paḍiẏaĕṇa  $  jaṃ mārui laddhu taraṇḍaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 14:
pavaṇa-puttĕ miliĕ miliẏaü taïlokku vi  $  riuhĕ seṇṇĕ eẏahŏ dhura dharaï ṇa ekku vi"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jaẏakāru karanteṃ  $  jāṇaï-kantu vuttu haṇuvanteṃ
"deva deva vahu-raẏaṇa vasundhari  $  atthi etthu kesarihi mi kesari
jahĩ jamvava-ṇala-ṇīlaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  ṇaṃ mukkaṅkusa matta mahāgaẏa
jahĩ suggīva-kumāra-virāhiẏa  $  atula-malla jaẏa-lacchi-pasāhiẏa
gavaẏa-gavakkha-samuṇṇaẏa-māṇā  $  aṇṇa vi suhaḍekkekka-pahāṇā
tahĩ haũ kavaṇu gahaṇu kira kehaü  $  sīhahũ majjhĕ kuraṅgamu jehaü
to vi tuhāraü avasaru sārami  $  de āesu deva ko mārami
māṇu maraṭṭu kāsu raṇĕ bhajjaü  $  jagĕ jasa-paḍahu tuhāraü vajjaü"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi parituṭṭhaĕṇa  $  jamvavĕṇa diṇṇu sandesaü
      "pūrĕ maṇoraha rāhavahŏ  $  vaïdehihĕ jāhi gavesaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 45, Kaḍavaka 15:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi jaẏakāriu sīrappaharaṇu  $  "deva deva jāevaü kettiu kāraṇu
aṇṇu vi vaḍḍāraü sa-visesaü  $  rāhava kiṃ pi dehi āesaü
jeṇa dasāṇaṇu jama-uri pāvami  $  sīẏa tuhāraĕ karaẏalĕ lāvami"
ṇisuṇĕvi galagajjiu haṇuvantahŏ  $  harisu pavaḍḍhiu jāṇaï-kantahŏ
"bho bho sāhu sāhu pavañjaï  $  aṇṇahŏ kāsu viẏambhiu chajjaï
to vi karevaü muṇivara-bhāsiu  $  tahŏ khaẏa-kālu kumārahŏ pāsiu
ṇa vi paĩ ṇa maĩ ṇa vi suggīveṃ  $  jujjhevaü samāṇu dahagīveṃ
ṇavari ekku sandesaü ṇejjahi  $  jaï jīvaï to ema kahejjahi
vuccaï "sundari tujjha vioeṃ  $  jhīṇu karī va kariṇi-vicchoeṃ
jhīṇu su-dhammu va kali-pariṇāmeṃ  $  jhīṇu su-purisu va pisuṇālāveṃ
jhīṇu maẏaṅku va vara-pakkha-kkhaĕ  $  jhīṇu muṇindu va siddhihĕ kaṅkhaĕ
jhīṇu du-rāuleṇa vara-desu va  $  avuha-majjhĕ kaï-kavva-visesu va
jhīṇu su-panthu va jaṇa-paricattaü  $  rāmacandu tiha paĩ sumarantaü"
ghattā:
aṇṇa vi laï aṅgutthalaü  $  ahiṇāṇu samappahi meraü
      āṇejjahi sa ïṃ bhū saṇaü  $  cūḍāmaṇi sīẏahĕ keraü
----------  [46. chāẏālīsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
jaṃ aṅgutthalaü uvaladdhu rāma-sandesaü
gaü kaṇṭaïẏa-bhuu sīẏahĕ haṇuvantu gavesaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 1:
maṇi-maūha-sacchāẏĕ ṇiccaṃ deva-ṇimmie
candakanti-khacie raẏaṇī-cande va ṇimmie
candasāla-sālā-visālae  $  ṭaṇaṭaṇanta-ghaṇṭā-vamālaĕ
raṇaraṇanta-kiṅkiṇi-sughosae  $  ghavaghavanta-ghagghara-ṇighosae
dhavala-dhaẏavaḍāḍoẏa-ḍamvare  $  pavaṇa-pellaṇuvvelliẏamvare
chatta-daṇḍa-uddaṇḍa-paṇḍure  $  cāru-camara-pabbhāra-bhāsure
maṇi-gavakkha-maṇi-mattavāraṇe  $  maṇi-kavāḍa-maṇi-vāra-toraṇe
maṇi-pavāla-muttāli-jhumvire  $  bhamira-bhamara-pabbhāra-cumvire
paḍaha-maddalullola-tālae  $  jiṇavaro vva suragiri-jiṇālae
tahĩ vimāṇĕ thiu pavaṇa-ṇandaṇo  $  caliu ṇāĩ ṇahĕ ravi sa-sandaṇo
ghattā:
gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ thiĕṇa  $  vijjāhara-pavara-ṇarindahŏ
      ṇāĩ saṇiccharĕṇa  $  avaloiu ṇaẏaru mahindahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 2:
caü-duvāru caü-gouru caü-pāẏāru paṇḍuraṃ  $  gaẏaṇa-lagga-pavaṇāhaẏa-dhaẏa-mālāulaṃ puraṃ
giri-mahinda-sihare ramāulaṃ  $  riddhi-viddhi-dhaṇa-dhaṇṇa-saṃkulaṃ
taṃ ṇievi haṇueṇa cintiẏaṃ  $  "surapuraṃ kim indeṇa ghattiẏaṃ"
pucchiẏāravindābha-loẏaṇī  $  kahahũ lagga vijjāvaloẏaṇī
"deva gabbha-sambhavĕ tuhārae  $  savva-jaṇa-maṇāṇanda-gārae
jeṇa ghalliẏaṃjaṇa pasūẏaṇe  $  vaggha-siṅgha-gaẏa-saṅkule vaṇe
so mahindu ṇivvūḍha-sāhaso  $  vasaï etthu khalu khudda-māṇaso
eha ṇaẏari māhinda-ṇāmĕṇaṃ  $  kāmapuri va ṇimmaviẏa kāmĕṇaṃ
taṃ suṇevi vahu-bhariẏa-maccharo  $  mīṇa-rāsi ṇaṃ gaü saṇiccharo
ghattā:
amarisa-kuddhaĕṇa  $  maṇe cintiu "gavaṇu vivajjami
      āẏahŏ āhaẏaṇĕ  $  laï tāma maḍappharu bhañjami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 3:
takkhaṇĕ jjĕ paṇṇatti-valeṇa viṇimmiẏaṃ valaṃ  $  raha-vimāṇa-maẏaṅga-turaṅgama-joha-saṃkulaṃ
meha-jālam iva vijjulujjalaṃ  $  paḍaha-mandaluddāma-gondalaṃ
dhuddhuvanta-saẏa-saṅkha-saṃghaḍaṃ  $  dhavala-chatta-dhuvvanta-dhaẏavaḍaṃ
matta-gilla-gillola-gaẏa-ghaḍaṃ  $  kaṇṇa-camara-callanta-muhavaḍaṃ
hilihilanta-turaẏāṇaṇubbhaḍaṃ  $  tuṭṭa-phuṭṭa-ghaḍa-suhaḍa-saṅkaḍaṃ
kalaẏalāra-ugghuṭṭha-bhaḍa-thaḍaṃ  $  jhasara-satti-savvali-viẏāvaḍaṃ
taṃ ṇievi para-vala-paloṭṭaṇe  $  khohu jāu māhinda-paṭṭaṇe
bhaḍa viruddha saṇṇaddha duddharā  $  parasu-cakka-moggara-dhaṇuddharā
vaddha-parikarākāra-bhāsurā  $  kuruḍa-diṭṭhi-daṭṭhoṭṭha-ṇiṭṭhurā
ghattā:
sa-valu mahinda-suu  $  saṇṇahĕvi mahā-bhaẏa-bhīsaṇu
      haṇuvahŏ abbhiḍiu  $  viñjhaïrihĕ jema huāsaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 4:
maru-mahinda-ṇandaṇa-valāṇa jāẏaṃ mahāhavaṃ  $  cāru-jaẏasirī-rāmāliṅgaṇa-pasara-lāhavaṃ
haṇuva-haṇahaṇākāra-bhīsāvaṇaṃ  $  bheṭṭa-dugghoṭṭa-saṃghaṭṭa-loṭṭāvaṇaṃ
khagga-khaṇakhaṇākāra-gambhīraẏaṃ  $  jāẏa-kiliviṇḍi-guppanta-vara-vīraẏaṃ
bhiuḍi-bhūbhaṅgurākāra-rattacchaẏaṃ  $  pahara-pabbhāra-vāvāra-duppecchaẏaṃ
hakka-mukkekka-huṅkāra-lallakkaẏaṃ  $  danti-dantagga-lagganta-pāikkaẏaṃ
bhiṇṇa-vacchatthaluddesa-vihalaṅghalaṃ  $  ṇīsarantanta-mālāvalī-cumbhalaṃ
tetthu vaṭṭantae dāruṇe bhaṇḍaṇe  $  haṇuva-māhindi abbhiṭṭa samaraṅgaṇe
ve vi suṇḍīra-saṅghāẏa-saṅghāraṇā  $  ve vi māẏaṅga-kumbhatthaluddāraṇa
ve vi ṇaha-gāmiṇo ve vi vijjāharā  $  ve vi jasa-kaṅkhiṇo ve vi phuriẏāharā
ghattā:
pavaṇa-mahindajahũ  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-vāhaṇĕhĩ ṇiviṭṭhahũ
      jujjhu samabbhiḍiu  $  ṇāvaï haẏagīva-tiviṭṭhahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 5:
tahĩ mahinda-ṇandaṇĕṇa viruddheṃ paḍhama-abbhiḍe  $  tharaharanti sara-dhoraṇi lāiẏa haṇuva-dhaẏavaḍe
vāiṇā vi riu-vāṇa-jālaẏaṃ  $  ṇisi-khaĕ vva raviṇā tamālaẏaṃ
daḍḍham atula-māẏā-davaggiṇā  $  moha-jālam iva parama-joggiṇā
jalaï ṇaha-ẏalaṃ jalaṇa-dīviẏaṃ  $  para-valaṃ asesaṃ palīviẏaṃ
kahŏ vi chattu kāsu vi dhaẏaggaẏaṃ  $  kahŏ vi pajaliẏaṃ uttamaṅgaẏaṃ
kahŏ vi kavaü kāsu kaḍillaẏaṃ  $  kahŏ vi kañcuẏaṃ saṃkaḍillaẏaṃ
ema pavara-huavaha-jhulukkiẏaṃ  $  riu-valaṃ gaẏaṃ ghoṇa-vaṅkiẏaṃ
ṇavara ekku māhindi thakkao  $  kesari vva kesarihĕ ḍhukkao
vāruṇatthu sandhaï ṇa jāvĕhĩ  $  rosieṇa haṇueṇa tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
kaṇaẏa-samujjalĕhĩ  $  tihĩ sarĕhĩ sarāsaṇu tāḍiu
      dujjaṇa-hiẏaü jiha  $  ucchindĕvi dhaṇuvaru pāḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 6:
avaru cāu kira geṇhaï jāma mahinda-ṇaṃdaṇo  $  maru-sueṇa viddhaṃsiu tāva sarehĩ sandaṇo
khaṇḍa-khaṇḍa-kkie rahavarā-vīḍhae  $  vara-turaṅgama-jue paḍiĕ bhaẏa-gīḍhae
moḍie chatta-daṇḍe dhae chiṇṇae  $  lahu vimāṇe samārūḍhu vitthiṇṇae
taṃ pi haṇuveṇa vāṇehĩ ṇiṇṇāsiẏaṃ  $  ṇaraẏa-dukkhaṃ va siddhehĩ viddhaṃsiẏaṃ
ṇiggao vipphuranto ṇirattho ṇaro  $  ṇāĩ ṇiggantha-rūvo thio muṇivaro
pavaṇa-putteṇa ghettūṇa riu vaddhao  $  vara-bhuaṅgu vva garuḍeṇa uṭṭhaddhao
puttĕ vehe sue savara-vāvārio  $  aṇila-putto mahindeṇa hakkārio
añjaṇā-piẏara-puttāṇa duddarisaṇo  $  saṃpahāro samālaggu bhaẏa-bhīsaṇo
khagga-tikkhagga-vara-moggaruggāmaṇo  $  sella-vāvalla-bhallāi-saṅkāvaṇo
ghattā:
paḍhama-bhiḍantaĕṇa  $  sara-pañjaru mukku mahindeṃ
     chiṇṇu kaïddhaĕṇa  $  jiha bhava-saṃsāru jiṇindeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 7:
chiṇṇu jaṃ jĕ sara-pañjaru raṇaühĕ pavaṇa-jāĕṇaṃ  $  dhagadhagantu aggeu vimukku mahinda-rāĕṇaṃ
dhuddhuvantu jāla 'saṇi-ghosaṇo  $  jalajalantu jāloli-bhīsaṇo
diṭṭhu vāṇu jaṃ pavaṇa-puttĕṇaṃ  $  vāruṇatthu melliu turantĕṇaṃ
jiha ghaṇeṇa galagajjamāṇĕṇaṃ  $  pasamio vi gimbho vva ṇāĕṇaṃ
vāẏavo mahindeṇa mellio  $  pavaṇa-puttu teṇa vi ṇa bhellio
cāva-laṭṭhi ghattĕvi turantĕṇaṃ  $  vaḍa-mahaddumo vipphurantĕṇaṃ
mellio mahā-vahala-pattalo  $  kaḍhiṇa-mūlu thira-thora-gattalo
khaṇḍu khaṇḍu kiu pavaṇa-puttĕṇaṃ  $  kukaï-kavva-vandho vva dhuttĕṇaṃ
ṇavara mukku mahiharu viruddhĕṇaṃ  $  so vi chiṇṇu ṇaraü vva siddhĕṇaṃ
ghattā:
jaṃ jaṃ lei riu  $  taṃ taṃ haṇuvantu viṇāsaï
      jiha ṇillakkhaṇahŏ  $  karĕ ekku vi atthu ṇa dīsaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 8:
añjaṇāĕ jaṇaṇeṇa vilakkhīhūẏa-cittĕṇaṃ  $  gaẏa vimukka bhāmeppiṇu kovāṇala-palittĕṇaṃ
teṇa laüḍi-daṇḍāhighāĕṇaṃ  $  taruvaro va pāḍiu duvāĕṇaṃ
giri va vajjĕṇaṃ duṇṇivārĕṇaṃ  $  aṇila-puttu tiha gaẏa-pahārĕṇaṃ
ṇivaḍie sirīselĕ vimbhalĕ  $  jāẏa volla suravarahã ṇahaẏale
"ṇipphalaṃ gaẏaṃ haṇuva-gajjiẏaṃ  $  ghaṇa-samūham iva salila-vajjiẏaṃ
rāma-dūakajjaṃ ṇa sāhiẏaṃ  $  jāṇaīhĕ vaẏaṇaṃ ṇa cāhiẏaṃ
rāvaṇassa ṇa vaṇaṃ viṇāsiẏaṃ  $  vihalu āsi kevalihĩ bhāsiẏaṃ"
eva volla sura-satthĕ jāvĕhĩ  $  haṇua hūu sajjīu tāvĕhĩ
uṭṭhio sarāsaṇa-vihatthao  $  saravarehĩ kiu riu ṇiratthao
ghattā:
maṇḍa kaïddhaĕṇa  $  sara-pañjarĕ chuhĕvi raüddeṃ
      dhariu mahindu raṇĕ  $  ṇaṃ gaṅgā-vāhu samuddeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 9:
kuddhaeṇa samaraṅgaṇĕ māẏā-vaïra-heuṇā  $  dhariẏa ve vi māhindi-mahinda kaïddha-keuṇā
māṇu malevi karĕvi kaḍamaddaṇu  $  calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu samīraṇa-ṇandaṇu
"ahŏ māhinda māma marusejjahi  $  jaṃ vimuhiu taṃ saẏalu khamejjahi
ahŏ ahŏ tāẏa tāẏa riu-bhañjaṇa  $  ṇiẏa-suẏa taṃ vīsariẏa kim añjaṇa
haũ tahĕ taṇaü tujjhu dohittaü  $  ṇimmala-vaṃsu samujjala-gottaü
bhaggu maraṭṭu jeṇa raṇĕ varuṇahŏ  $  haũ haṇuvantu puttu tahŏ pavaṇahŏ
pesiu abbhatthĕvi suggīveṃ  $  rāmahŏ hiu kalattu dahagīveṃ
dūa-kajjĕ saṃcalliu jāvĕhĩ  $  paṭṭaṇu diṭṭhu tuhāraü tāvĕhĩ
māẏā-vaïru asesu vivujjhiu  $  teṃ tumhahĩ samāṇu maĩ jujjhiu
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vaẏaṇu  $  vijjāhara-ṇaẏaṇāṇandeṃ
      ṇeha-mahābharĕṇa  $  mārui avagūḍhu mahindeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 46, Kaḍavaka 10:
"sāhu sāhu bho sundara suu saccaü jĕ pavaṇaho  $  paĩ muevi suhaḍattaṇu aṇṇahŏ hoi kavaṇaho
jo sattu-saṅgāma-lakkhehĩ jasa-ṇilaü  $  jo ubhaẏa-kula-dīvao ubhaẏa-kula-tilaü
jo ubhaẏa-vaṃsujjalo sasi va akalaṅku  $  jo sīhavara-vikkamo samarĕ ṇīsaṅku
jo dasa-disā-valaẏa-paricatta-gaẏa-ṇāmu  $  jo matta-māẏaṅga-kumbhatthalāẏāmu
jo pavara-jaẏalacchi-āliṅgaṇāvāsu  $  jo saẏala-paḍivakkha-duppekkha-ṇiṇṇāsu
jo kitti-raẏaṇāẏaro jasa-jalāvattu  $  jo vīra-ṇārāẏaṇo jaẏasirī-kantu
jo saẏaṇa-kappaddumo sacca-acalendu  $  jo pavara-paharaṇa-phaḍā-ḍoẏa-bhuaïndu
jo māṇa-viñjhaïri ahimāṇa-saẏa-siharu  $  dhaṇuveẏa-pañcāṇaṇo vāṇa-ṇaha-ṇiẏaru
jo ari-kuraṅgoha-ṇitthavaṇa-dugghoṭṭu  $  paḍivakkha-jalavāhiṇī-simira-jala-ghoṭṭu
ghattā:
jo keṇa vi ṇa jiu  $  āsaṅka-kalaṅka-vivajjiu
      so haũ āhaẏaṇĕ  $  paĩ ekkeṃ ṇavari parajjiu"

START

acchaï ajju kallĕ riu-keraü  $  vāṇĕhĩ karami seṇṇu vivareraü
acchaï ajju kallĕ ṇīsesaĩ  $  lemi chatta-dhaẏa-cindha-sahāsaĩ"
ghattā:
teṃ kajjeṃ āu gavesaü  $  haũ suggīvahŏ pesaṇĕṇa
      maṃ laṅkāhiva-kappaddumo  $  ḍajjhaü rāma-huvāsaṇĕṇa

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 3:
aṇṇu vihīsaṇa eu muṇĕ  $  jamvava-keraü vaẏaṇu suṇĕ

sumaṇa-duaï sumarantiẏā

paĩ honteṇa vi rāvaṇu mūḍhaü  $  acchaï māṇa-gaïndārūḍhaü
paĩ honteṇa vi ghora-raüddahŏ  $  gamu sajjiu saṃsāra-samuddahŏ
paĩ honteṇa vi dhammu ṇa jāṇiu  $  raẏaṇīẏara-vaṃsahŏ khaü āṇiu

paĩ honteṇa vi ṇa kiu ṇivāriu  $  eu kammu lajjaṇaü ṇirāriu
ghattā:
jasa-hāṇi khāṇi duha-aẏasahũ  $  iha-para-loẏahŏ jampaṇaü
      appijjaü gehiṇi rāmahŏ  $  kiṃ lajjāvahŏ appaṇaü"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 4:
aṇṇu parajjiẏa-para-valahŏ  $  suṇi sandesaü tahŏ ṇalahŏ

sumaṇa-duaï sumarantiẏā
samvukumāru jehĩ viṇivāiu  $  tisiraü jehĩ raṇaṅgaṇĕ ghāiu

rahavara-ṇakka-ggāha-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  pavara-turaṅga-taraṅga-ṇirantaru
vara-gaẏa-bhaḍa-thaḍa-velā-bhīsaṇu  $  dhaẏa-kallola-vola-saṃdarisaṇu
tehaü riu-samuddu raṇĕ ghoṭṭiu  $  sāhasagaï-kappaẏaru paloṭṭiu

ghattā:
appijjaü sīẏa paẏattĕṇa  $  āẏaḍḍhiẏa-kovaṇḍa-kara
    jāma ṇa pāvanti raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  dujjaẏa duddhara rāma-sara"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 5:
aṇṇu vihīsaṇa guṇa-ghaṇaü  $  sandesaü ṇīlahŏ taṇaü

jo para-dāra ramaï ṇaru mūḍhaü  $  acchaï ṇaraẏa-mahaṇṇavĕ chūḍhaü
para-dāreṇa ti-akkhu viṇaṭṭhaü  $  jaïẏahũ ciru dāru-vaṇĕ païṭṭhaü
paradārahŏ phaleṇa kamalāsaṇu  $  takkhaṇeṇa thiu so caürāṇaṇu
paradārahŏ phaleṇa sura-sundaru  $  sahasa-ṇaẏaṇu kiu ṇavara purandaru
paradārahŏ phaleṇa ṇillañchaṇu  $  kiu sa-kalaṅku ṇavara maẏalañchaṇu
paradārahŏ phaleṇa vaïsāṇaru  $  vara-vāhiĕ uṭṭhaddhu ṇirantaru

aṇṇu vi kari jiha jo ummeṭṭhaü  $  bhaṇu paradāreṃ ko ṇa vi ṇaṭṭhaü
ghattā:
appāhiu lakkhaṇa-rāmĕhĩ  $  ṇiẏa-parihava-paḍa-dhovaĕhĩ
      pekkhesahi rāvaṇu paḍiẏaü  $  aṇṇĕhĩ divasĕhĩ thovaĕhĩ"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ḍolliẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  mārui vuttu vihīsaṇĕṇa
"ṇa gavesaï jaṃ caviu paĩ  $  saẏavāraü sikkhaviu maĩ
to vi mahāraü ṇa kiu ṇivāriu  $  pajjaliẏaü maẏaṇaggi ṇirāriu
ṇa gaṇaï jiṇa-bhāsiẏa-guṇa-vaẏaṇaĩ  $  ṇa gaṇaï indaṇīla-maṇi-raẏaṇaĩ

jaï ema vi ṇa kiu ṇivāriu  $  to āẏāmiẏa-āhavahŏ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu pavaṇa-suu  $  sa-rahasu pulaẏa-visaṭṭa-bhuu

paṭṭaṇu ṇiravasesu parisesĕvi  $  avaloẏaṇiẏahĕ valĕṇa gavesĕvi
ravi-atthavaṇĕ suhaḍa-cūḍāmaṇi  $  pavarujjāṇu paẏaṭṭiu pāvaṇi

lavalīlaẏa-lavaṅga-ṇāraṅgĕhĩ  $  campaẏa-vaüla-tilaẏa-puṇṇaggĕhĩ

bhua-paümakkha-dakkha-khajjūrĕhĩ  $  kuṅkuma-devadāru-kappūrĕhĩ
vara-karamara-karīra-karavandĕhĩ  $  elā-kakkolehĩ sumandĕhĩ
candaṇa-vandaṇehĩ sāhārĕhĩ  $  eva tarūhĩ aṇeẏa-paẏārĕhĩ

tahŏ vaṇahŏ majjhĕ haṇuvantĕṇa  $  sīẏa ṇihāliẏa dummaṇiẏa

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 8:
sahiẏa-sahāsĕhĩ pariẏariẏa  $  ṇaṃ vaṇa-devaẏa avaẏariẏa
tila-mittu ṇa 'valakkhaṇu jahĕ  $  ṇivvaṇṇijjaï kāĩ tahĕ
vara-pāẏa-talĕhĩ paüṇāraehĩ  $  siṅghala-ṇahehĩ dihi-gāraĕhĩ
uccaṅguliĕhĩ ceulliehĩ  $  vaṭṭuliĕhĩ gupphĕhĩ golliehĩ

vara-soṇiĕ kañcī-keriẏāĕ  $  taṇu-ṇāhieṇa gambhīriẏāĕ
sulaliẏa-puṭṭhiĕ siṅgāriẏāĕ  $  piṇḍatthaṇiẏaĕ elaüriẏāĕ
vacchaẏaleṃ majjhimaesaeṇa  $  bhua-siharĕhĩ pacchima-desaeṇa
vāramaī-kerĕhĩ vāhulehĩ  $  sindhava-maṇivandhahĩ vaṭṭulehĩ
māṇuggīvaĕ kacchāẏaṇeṇa  $  uṭṭhaüḍeṃ goggaḍiẏahĕ taṇeṇa

aha kiṃ vahuṇā vittharĕṇa  $  a-ṇiviṇṇĕṇa sundara-maïṇa

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 9:
rāma-vioeṃ dummaṇiẏa  $  aṃsu-jalolliẏa-loẏaṇiẏa

vaṇĕ acchanti diṭṭha paramesari  $  sesa-sarīhĩ majjhĕ ṇaṃ sura-sari

jo tiẏa eha āsi māṇantaü  $  rāvaṇu saĩ jĕ maraï alahantaü
ṇiralaṅkāra vi hontī sohaï  $  jaï maṇḍiẏa to tihuaṇu mohaï"
sīẏahĕ taṇaü rūu vaṇṇeppiṇu  $  appaü ṇahĕ pacchaṇṇu kareppiṇu

jo pesiu rāhavacandĕṇa  $  so ghattiu aṅgutthalaü

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 10:
pekkhĕvi rāmaṅgutthalaü  $  sarahasu hasiu sukomalaü

joaï ajju deva daha vaẏaṇaĩ  $  laddhaĩ ajju caüddaha raẏaṇaĩ
ubbhahi ajju chatta-dhaẏa-daṇḍaĩ  $  bhuñjahi ajju pihimi chakkhaṇḍa i
ajju matta-gaẏa-ghaḍaü pasāhahi  $  ajjuttuṅga turaṅgama vāhahi

ettiu vujjhami ṇīsaṃdeheṃ  $  jaï āliṅgaṇu dei saṇeheṃ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi dasāṇaṇu harisiu  $  savvaṅgiu romañcu padarisiu

jo cappĕvi cappĕvi bhariẏaü  $  saẏala-bhuvaṇa-saṃtāvaṇahŏ

START

ṇisuṇevi aṇāgaẏa-jāṇī  $  saṃcalliẏa mandoẏari rāṇī

jaṃ papphulliẏa-paṅkaẏa-vaẏaṇaü  $  jaṃ kuvalaẏa-dala-dīhara-ṇaẏaṇaü
jaṃ surakari-kara-manthara-gamaṇaü  $  jaṃ para-ṇaravara-maṇa-jūravaṇaü

jaṃ kañcī-kalāva-pabbhāraü  $  jaṃ vibbhama-bhūbhaṅga-viẏāraü
ghattā:
taṃ tehaü rāvaṇa-keraü  $  anteuru saṃcalliẏaü
      ṇaṃ sa-bhamaru māṇasa-saravarĕ  $  kamaliṇi-vaṇu papphulliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 12:
uṇṇaẏa-pīṇa-paoharihĩ  $  rāvaṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-suhaṅkarihĩ

ṇimmiẏalañchaṇa sasi-joṇhā iva  $  titti-virahiẏa amiẏa-taṇhā iva
ṇivviẏāra jiṇavara-paḍimā iva  $  raï-vihi viṇṇāṇiẏa-ghaḍiẏā iva

kanti-samujjala taḍi-mālā iva  $  savva-saloṇa uvahi-velā iva
ṇimmala kitti va rāmahŏ kerī  $  tihuaṇu bhamĕvi pariṭṭhiẏa serī

aṭṭhāraha juvaï-sahāsaĩ  $  sīẏahĕ pāsu samalliẏaĩ
    ṇaṃ saravarĕ siẏahĕ ṇisaṇṇaĩ  $  saẏavattaĩ papphulliẏaĩ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 13:
gampiṇu pāsĕ vaīsarĕvi  $  kavaḍeṃ cāḍu-saẏaĩ karĕvi

"halĕ halĕ sīẏĕ sīẏĕ kiṃ mūḍhī  $  acchahi dukkha-mahaṇṇavĕ chūḍhī
halĕ halĕ sīẏĕ sīẏĕ kari vuttaü  $  laï cūḍaü kaṇṭhaü kaḍisuttaü

halĕ halĕ sīẏĕ sīẏĕ uttuṅgĕhĩ  $  caḍu caḍulĕhĩ hiṃsanta-turaṅgĕhĩ
halĕ halĕ sīẏĕ sīẏĕ mahi bhuñjahi  $  māṇusa-jammahŏ phalu aṇuhuñjahi
ghattā:
piu icchahi paṭṭu paḍicchahi  $  jaï sabbhāveṃ hasiu paĩ
      to laï mahaevi-pasāhaṇu  $  abbhatthiẏa ettaḍaü maĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 14:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi videha-sua  $  pabhaṇaï pulaẏa-visaṭṭa-bhua

icchami para-kalattu jaï vañcaï  $  icchami jaï aṇudiṇu jiṇu añcaï

icchami jaï paḍimāu samāraï  $  icchami jaï pujjaü ṇīsāraï
icchami abhaẏa-dāṇu jaï desaï  $  icchami jaï tava-caraṇu laesaï
icchami jaï ti-kālu jiṇu vandaï  $  icchami jaï maṇu garahaï ṇindaï

aṇṇu mi icchami mandoẏari  $  āẏāmiẏa-pavarāhavahŏ
      sirasā calaṇĕhĩ ṇivaḍeppiṇu  $  jaï maĩ appaï rāhavahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 15:
jaï puṇu ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇahŏ  $  ṇa samappiẏa rahu-ṇandaṇahŏ
to haũ icchami eu halĕ  $  puri khippantī uvahi-jalĕ

icchami ṇisiẏara-valu atthantaü  $  icchami gharu pāẏālahŏ jantaü
icchami dahamuha-taru chijjantaü  $  tilu tilu rāma-sarĕhĩ bhijjantaü
icchami dasa vi siraĩ ṇivaḍantaĩ  $  sarĕ haṃsāhaẏaĩ va saẏavattaĩ
icchami anteuru rovantaü  $  kesa-visanthulu dhāhāvantaü
icchami chijjantaĩ dhaẏa-cindhaĩ  $  icchami ṇaccantāĩ kavandhaĩ
icchami dhūmandhārijjantaĩ  $  caü-disu suhaḍa-ciẏāĩ valantaĩ
jaṃ jaṃ icchami taṃ taṃ saccaü  $  ṇaṃ [to] karami ajju halĕ paccaü

jo āiu rāhava-keraü  $  ehu acchaï aṅgutthalaü
      mahu sahala-maṇoraha-gāraü  $  tumhahã dukkhahã poṭṭalaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 49, Kaḍavaka 16:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi viruddha-maṇa  $  suravara-kari-kumbhaẏala-thaṇa

ehu siviṇaü sīẏahĕ sahalu  $  jasu rāmahŏ vi jaü jaṇaddaṇahŏ
      sahũ parivāreṃ sahũ valĕṇa  $  khaẏa-kālu paḍhukku dasāṇaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 50, Kaḍavaka 10:
tahĩ avasarĕ pīṇa-paohariĕ  $  aruṇuggamĕ laṅkāsundariĕ
ira-aïraü viṇṇi mi pesiẏaü  $  haṇuvantahŏ pāsu gavesiẏaü
jahĩ ujjāṇĕ pariṭṭhiu pāvaṇi  $  saẏala-ṇarinda-vinda-cūḍāmaṇi
tahĩ saṃpattaü viṇṇi vi juvaïu  $  ṇaṃ siva-sāsaĕ tavasiri-sugaïu
ṇaṃ khama-daẏaü jiṇāgamĕ diṭṭhaü  $  jaẏakāreppiṇu pāsĕ ṇiviṭṭhaü
teṇa vi tāhĩ samaü piu jampĕvi  $  kaṇṭhaü kañcī-dāmu samappĕvi
puṇu viṇṇatta halīsa-maṇohari  $  "bhoaṇu tumha kema paramesari"
akkhaï sīẏa samīraṇa-puttahŏ  $  "vāsara ekkavīsa maĩ bhuttahŏ
jāma ṇa patta vatta bhattārahŏ  $  tāma ṇivitti majjhu āhārahŏ
ajju ṇavara paripuṇṇa maṇoraha  $  taṃ jĕ bhojju jaṃ sua rāmahŏ kaha"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pavaṇahŏ suĕṇa  $  avaloiu muhu aïrahŏ taṇaü
      "gampiṇu akkhu vihīsaṇahŏ  $  vuccaï sīẏahĕ kari pāraṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 50, Kaḍavaka 11:
irĕ tuhu mi jāhi paramesarihĕ  $  taṃ mandiru laṅkāsundarihĕ
lahu bhoẏaṇu āṇahi maṇaharaü  $  jaṃ sa-rasu sa-ṇehaü jiha suraü"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ve vi saṃcalliu  $  ṇaṃ surasari-jaüṇaü utthalliu
raddhu bhattu lahu leviṇu āẏaü  $  ṇaṃ sarasaï-lacchiu vikkhāẏaü
vaḍḍhiu bhoẏaṇu bhoẏaṇa-sejjaĕ  $  acchaĕ pacchaĕ laṇhaĕ pejjaĕ
sakkara-khaṇḍĕhĩ pāẏasa-paẏasĕhĩ  $  laḍḍuva-lāvaṇa-guḍa-ikkhurasĕhĩ
maṇḍā-soẏavatti-ghiẏaūrĕhĩ  $  mugga-sūa-ṇāṇāviha-kūrĕhĩ
sālaṇaĕhĩ vahu-viviha-vicittĕhĩ  $  māiṇi-māẏandehĩ vicittĕhĩ
allaẏa-pippali-miriẏāmalaĕhĩ  $  lāvaṇa-mālūrĕhĩ komalaĕhĩ
cibbhiḍiẏā-kacora-vāsuttĕhĩ  $  peua-pappaḍehĩ sa-pahuttĕhĩ
kelaẏa-ṇālikera-jamvīrĕhĩ  $  karamara-karavandehĩ karīrĕhĩ
timmaṇehĩ ṇāṇāviha-vaṇṇĕhĩ  $  sāḍiva-bhajjiẏa-khaṭṭāvaṇṇĕhĩ
aṇṇu mi khaṇḍasolla-guḍasollĕhĩ  $  vaḍavāiṅgaṇehĩ kārellĕhĩ
viñjaṇehĩ sa-mahiẏa-dahi-khīrĕhĩ  $  sihariṇi-dhūmavatti-sovīrĕhĩ
ghattā:
acchaü eu (?) muharasiu  $  aviẏaṇhaü ulhāvaṇaü kiha
      jahĩ jĕ laïjjaï tahĩ jĕ tahĩ  $  guliẏāraü jiṇavara-vaẏaṇu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 50, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ tehaü bhuñjĕvi bhoẏaṇaü  $  puṇu karĕvi vaẏaṇa-pakkhālaṇaü
samalahĕvi aṅgu vara-candaṇĕṇa  $  viṇṇatta devi maru-ṇandaṇĕṇa
"caḍu mahu taṇaĕ khandhĕ paramesari  $  ṇemi tetthu jahĩ rāhava-kesari
milahŏ ve vi pūrantu maṇoraha  $  phiṭṭaü jaṇavaĕ rāmāẏaṇa-kaha"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi devi gañjolliẏa  $  sāhukkāru karanti pavolliẏa
"sundara ṇiẏa-gharu gaẏa-guṇa-vahuahĕ(?)  $  eha ṇa ṇitti hoi kula-vahuahĕ
gammaï vaccha jaï vi ṇiẏa-kulaharu  $  viṇu bhattāreṃ gamaṇu asundaru
jaṇavaü hoi duguñchaṇa-sīlaü  $  khala-sahāu ṇiẏa-citteṃ maïlaü
jahĩ jĕ ajuttu tahĩ jĕ āsaṅkaï  $  maṇu rañjĕvi sakko vi ṇa sakkaï
ṇihaĕ dasāṇaṇĕ jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ  $  maĩ jāevaü sahũ valahaddeṃ
ghattā:
jāhi vaccha acchāmi haũ  $  ṇimmala-dasaraha-vaṃsubbhavahŏ
      laï cūḍāmaṇi mahu taṇaü  $  ahiṇāṇu samappahi rāhavahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 50, Kaḍavaka 13:
aṇṇu vi āliṅgĕvi guṇa-ghaṇaü  $  sandesaü akkhu mahu ttaṇaü
"vala tujjhu vioeṃ jaṇaẏa-suẏa  $  thiẏa līha-visesa ṇa kaha vi mua
jhīṇa maẏaṅka-leha gaha-gahiẏa va  $  jhīṇa surinda-riddhi tava-rahiẏa va
jhīṇa kudesa-majjhĕ vāsāṇi va  $  jhīṇāvuha-muhĕ sukaï-suvāṇi
jhīṇa divāẏara-daṃsaṇĕ ratti va  $  jhīṇa ku-jaṇavaĕ jiṇavara-bhatti va
jhīṇa dubhikkhĕ attha-sampatti va  $  jhīṇa vuḍhattaṇĕṇa vala-satti va
jhīṇa caritta-vihūṇahŏ kitti va  $  jhīṇa ku-kulaharĕ kulavahu-ṇitti va
aṇṇu vi dasaraha-vaṃsa-pagāsahŏ  $  vacchatthalĕ jaẏa-lacchi-ṇivāsahŏ
raṇĕ duvvāra-vaïri-viṇivārahŏ  $  tahŏ saṃdesaü ṇehi kumārahŏ
vuccaï "paĩ honteṇa vi lakkhaṇa  $  acchaï sīẏa ruẏanti alakkhaṇu
ghattā:
ṇaü devĕhĩ ṇaü dāṇavĕhĩ  $  ṇaü rāmeṃ vaïri-viẏāraĕṇa
      para mārevvaü dahavaẏaṇu  $  sa ĩ bhu a-jualeṇa tuhāraĕṇa""
----------  [51. ekkavaṇṇāsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
taṃ cūḍāmaṇi levi gaü lacchi-ṇivāsahŏ akhaliẏa-māṇahŏ
ṇaṃ sura-kari kamaliṇi-vaṇahŏ mārui valiu samuhu ujjāṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 1:
duvaī
vihuṇĕvi vāhu-daṇḍa paricintaï riu-jaẏalacchi-maddaṇo
"tāma ṇa jāmi ajju jāma ṇa romāviu maĩ dasāṇaṇo
vaṇu bhañjami rasamasakasamasantu  $  mahivīḍha-gāḍhu virasorasantu
ṇāẏaüla-viula-cumbhala-valantu  $  rukkhukkhaẏa-khara-khoṇiĕ khalantu
ṇīsesa-diẏantara-parimalantu  $  kaṅkelli-velli-lavalī-lalantu
tuṅgaṅga-bhiṅga-gumugumugumantu  $  taru lagga-bhagga-dumudumudumantu (?)
elā-kakkolaẏa-kaḍaẏaḍantu  $  vaḍa-viḍava-tāḍa-taḍataḍataḍantu
karamara-karīra-karakaraẏarantu  $  āsatthāgatthiẏa-tharaharantu
maḍḍaḍḍa-maḍḍa saẏa-khaṇḍa jantu  $  sattacchaẏa-kusumāmoẏa-dintu
ghattā:
ummūlantu asesa taru  $  ekku muhuttu etthu parisakkami
    jovvaṇu jema vilāsiṇihĕ  $  vaṇu daramalami ajju jiha sakkami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 2:
duvaī
puṇaravi vāravāra pariañcĕvi ṇiẏaẏa-maṇeṇa sundaro  $  ṇandaṇa-vaṇĕ païṭṭhu ṇaṃ māṇasa-saravarĕ amara-kuñjaro
ṇavari uvavaṇālae tetthu ṇijjhāiẏāsoga-ṇāraṅga-puṇṇāga-ṇāgā lavaṅgā piẏaṅgū-viḍaṅgā samuttuṅga-sattacchaẏā
karamara-karavanda-rattandaṇā dāḍimī-devadārū-haliddī-bhuā dakkha-ruddakkha-paümakkha-aïmuttaẏā
taru tarala-tamāla-tālela-kakkola-sālā visālañjaṇā vañjulā ṇimva-sindīu sindūra-mandāra-kundenda-sajjajjuṇā
surataru-kaẏalī-kaẏamvamva-jamvīra-jamvumvarā limva-kosamva-khajjūra-kappūra-tārūra-mālūra-āsattha-ṇaggohaẏā
tilaẏa-vaüla-campaẏā ṇāgavellī-vaẏā pippalī pupphalī pāḍalī keẏaī māhavī malliẏā māhuliṅgī-tarū
sa-phaṇasa-lavalī-sirīkhaṇḍa-mandāgarū-silhaẏā puttajīvā sirīsetthiẏāriṭṭhiẏā-kojjaẏā jūhiẏā ṇālikeravvaī
hariḍaï-hariẏā-lakaccālalāvañjaẏā pikka-vandukka-koraṇṭa-vāṇikkha-veṇū-tisañjhā-mirī-allaẏā-ḍhaüa-ciñcā-mahū
kaṇaïra-kaṇiẏāri-sellū-karīrā karañjāmalī-kaṅguṇī-kañcaṇā evamāitti aṇṇe vi je pāẏavā keṇa te vujjhiẏā
ghattā:
āẏahũ pavara-mahaddumahũ  $  pahilaü pāriẏāu āẏāmiu
      ṇaṃ dharaṇihĕ jemaṇaü karu  $  uppāḍeppiṇu ṇahaẏalĕ bhāmiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 3:
duvaī
surataru parighivevi ummūliu puṇu ṇaggoha-taruvaro
āẏāmĕvi bhuehĩ dahavaẏaṇeṃ jiha kaïlāsa-girivaro
kaḍḍhiu vara-pāẏavu tharaharantu  $  ṇaṃ vaïri rasāẏalĕ païsarantu
ṇaṃ ṇandaṇa-vaṇahŏ rasantu jīu  $  ṇaṃ dharaṇihĕ vāhā-daṇḍu vīu
ṇaṃ dahavaẏaṇahŏ ahimāṇa-khambhu  $  ṇaṃ puhaï-pasūẏaṇe pavara-gabbhu
tuṭṭanta-saẏala-ghaṇa-mūla-jālu  $  pāroha-lalantu visāla-ḍālu
āratta-patta-parigholamāṇu  $  ḍhaṇḍhara-vara-pariẏandijjamāṇu
kalaẏaṇṭhi-kalāvārāva-muhalu  $  ṇimmaüru vi sappuriso vva suhalu
ghattā:
so sohaï ṇaggoha-taru  $  māruẏa-suẏa-bhuẏalaṭṭhihĩ laïẏaü
    ṇāvaï gaṅgahĕ jaüṇahĕ vi  $  majjhĕ paẏāgu pariṭṭhiu taïẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 4:
duvaī
vaḍa-pāẏavu ghivevi ummūliu puṇu kaṅkelli-taruvaro  $  ubhaẏa-karehĩ levi ṇaṃ vāhuvalindeṃ bharaha-ṇaravaro
āratta-patta-pallava-lalantu  $  kāmiṇi-karakamalahũ aṇuharantu
ubbhiṇṇa-kusuma-gocchucchalantu  $  ṇaṃ mahihĕ ghusiṇa-caccikka dentu
cañcariẏa-cāru-cumvijjamāṇu  $  vahuviha-vihaṅga-sevijjamāṇu
kaṅkelli-vacchu iẏa-guṇa-vicittu  $  ṇaṃ dahamuha-māṇu malevi ghittu
puṇu laïu ṇāẏa-campaü kareṇa  $  ṇaṃ disa-pāẏavu disa-kuñjareṇa
ummūliu gaẏaṇahŏ aṇuharantu  $  ali-joisa-cakka-paribbhamantu
ṇava-pallava-gaha-vikkhiṇṇa-paẏaru  $  ubbhiṇṇa-kusuma-ṇakkhatta-ṇiẏaru
so campaü gaẏaṇaṅgaṇa-samaggu  $  dahavaẏaṇa-maḍappharu ṇāĩ bhaggu
ghattā:
campaẏa-pāẏavu parighivĕvi  $  kaḍḍhiẏa vaüla-tilaẏa mahi tāḍĕvi
      gajjaï matta-gaïndu jiha  $  ve ālāṇa-khambha uppāḍĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 5:
duvaī
campaẏa-tilaẏa-vaüla-vaḍapāẏava-surataru bhagga jāvĕhĩ  $  caürujjāṇapāla saṃpāiẏa galagajjanta tāvĕhĩ
hakkārĕvi para-vala-vala-galatthu  $  dāḍhāvali dhāiu laüḍi-hatthu
jo uttara-vārahŏ rakkhavālu  $  jo pasariẏa-jasa-bhuvaṇantarālu
jo gillagaṇḍa-gaẏa-ghaḍa-gharaṭṭu  $  paḍivakkha-khalaṇu akhaliẏa-maraṭṭu
so haṇuvahŏ bhiḍiu palamva-vāhu  $  ṇaṃ gaṅgā-vāhahŏ jaüṇa-vāhu
jo teṇa pamelliu laüḍi-daṇḍu  $  so bhañjĕvi gaü saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu
sirisaïlu vi pahasiu pulaïẏaṅgu  $  "vaṇa-bhaṅgahŏ vīẏaü suhaḍa-bhaṅgu
darisāvami" ema cavantaeṇa  $  ummūliu tālu turantaeṇa
ku-jaṇu va sura-bhāẏaṇu thaḍḍha-bhāu  $  dūra-halaü aṇṇu vi duppaṇāu
ghattā:
teṇa ṇisāẏaru āhaẏaṇĕ  $  āẏāmevi samāhaü tāleṃ
      paḍiu ghuleppiṇu dharaṇiẏalĕ  $  ghāiu desu ṇāĩ dukkāleṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 6:
duvaī
jaṃ haṇuveṇa ṇihaü samaraṅgaṇĕ dāḍhāvali sa-maccharo
dhāiu ekkadantu galagajjĕvi ṇaṃ gaẏavarahŏ gaẏavaro
jo puvva-vārĕ vaṇa-rakkhavālu  $  saṃpāiu ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālĕ kālu
diḍha-kaḍhiṇa-dehu thira-thora-hatthu  $  para-vala-paoli-bhellaṇa-samatthu
āẏāmĕvi satti pamukka teṇa  $  ṇaṃ sari sāẏarahŏ mahīhareṇa
sā sāmīraṇihĕ parāẏaṇattha  $  asaï va sappurisahŏ akiẏattha
haṇuveṇa vi raṇaühĕ duṇṇirikkhu  $  uppāḍiu vara-sāhāru rukkhu
kāmiṇi-muha-kuharahŏ aṇuharantu  $  paripakka-phalāharu kusuma-dantu
ṇava-pallava-jīhā-lavalavantu  $  kalaẏaṇṭhi-kaṇṭha-mahurullavantu
mahakavva-viẏāru va dala-ṇivesu  $  pacchaṇṇa-pariṭṭhiẏa-rasa-visesu
ghattā:
mārui-kara-pammukkaĕṇa  $  teṇa pavara-kappadduma-ghāeṃ
      ekkadantu ghummantu raṇĕ  $  pāḍiu rukkhu jema duvvāeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 7:
duvaī
tāma kaẏantavakku āhavĕ asakku sakkakka-sama-valo  $  hatthi va gilla-gaṇḍu tiẏasahũ pacaṇḍu kodaṇḍa-karaẏalo
jo dāhiṇa-vārahŏ rakkhavālu  $  kokkantu padhāiu muha-karālu
"vaṇu bhañjĕvi kahĩ haṇuvanta jāhi  $  laï paharaṇu ahimuhu thāhi thāhi
jiha haü dāḍhāvali uttharantu  $  aṇṇu vi viṇivāiu ekkadantu
tiha paharu paharu bho pavaṇajāẏa  $  dahavaẏaṇahŏ kerā kuddha pāẏa"
paccārĕvi pāvaṇi dhaṇudhareṇa  $  vihĩ sarĕhĩ viddhu raṇĕ duddhareṇa
pariañcĕvi ṇivaḍiẏa puraü tāsu  $  ṇami-viṇami va paḍhama-jiṇesarāsu
etthantarĕ raṇĕ ṇīsandaṇeṇa  $  āruṭṭheṃ pavaṇahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa
āẏāmĕvi ummūliu tamālu  $  ṇaṃ diṇaẏareṇa tama-timira-jālu
ghattā:
ubhaẏa-karĕhĩ bhāmevi taru  $  pahaü kaẏantavakku daṇu-dāreṃ
      vihalaṅghalu ghummanta-taṇu  $  giri va paloṭṭiu kulisa-pahāreṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 8:
duvaī
ṇihaĕ kaẏantavakkĕ aṇṇekku ṇisāẏaru bhaẏa-vivajjio  $  vara-karavāla-hatthu kokkantu padhāiu mehagajjio
so pacchima-vārahŏ rakkhavālu  $  ubbhaḍa-bhiuḍī-bhaṅgura-karālu
rattuppala-dala-saṃkāsa-ṇaẏaṇu  $  aṭṭaṭṭa-hāsa-mellanta-vaẏaṇu
ṇava-jalahara-līla-samuvvahantu  $  khaggujjala-vara-vijjula-lavantu
bhaühāvali-kiẏa-dhaṇuhara-pavaṅku  $  haṇuvahŏ abbhiḍiu vimukka-saṅku
etthantarĕ aṇilahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa  $  uppāḍiu candaṇu diḍha-maṇeṇa
sappurisu jema vahu-khama-sarīru  $  sappurisu jema chee vi dhīru
sappurisu jema sīẏala-sahāu  $  sappurisu jema sāmaṇṇa-bhāu
sappurisu jema jaṇavaĕ mahagghu  $  sappurisu jema savvahũ salagghu
ghattā:
teṇa pavara-candaṇa-dumĕṇa  $  ehaü mehaṇāu vacchatthalĕ
      laüḍi-pahāreṃ ghāiẏaü  $  paḍiu phaṇindu ṇāĩ mahi-maṇḍalĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 51, Kaḍavaka 9:
duvaī
pavarujjāṇavāla cattāri vi haẏa haṇuveṇa jāvĕhĩ  $  sesārakkhiehĩ dahavaẏaṇahŏ gampiṇu kahiu tāvĕhĩ
"bho bho bhū-bhūsaṇa bhuvaṇa-pāla  $  āruṭṭha-duṭṭha-ṇiṭṭhavaṇa-kāla
pavarāmara-ḍāmara-raṇĕ raüdda  $  ṇaravara-cūḍāmaṇi jaẏa-samudda
daṇu-inda-vinda-maddaṇa-sahāva  $  saggagga-magga-ṇiggaẏa-paẏāva
kāmiṇi-jaṇa-thaṇa-caḍḍaṇa-viẏaḍḍha  $  laṅkālaṅkāra mahāguṇaḍḍha
ṇiccintaü acchahi kāĩ deva  $  vaṇu bhaggu ku-muṇivara-hiẏaü jeva
ekkeṇa ṇareṇa viruddhaeṇa  $  paharanteṃ amarisa-kuddhaeṇa
uppāḍĕvi tarala-tamāla-tāla  $  ceẏāri vi haẏa ujjāṇa-pāla"
tahĩ avasarĕ āẏa 'ṇṇekka vatta  $  vajjāuhu āsālī samatta
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu dahavaẏaṇu  $  kuviu davaggi va sittu ghieṇa
      "ko jama-rāeṃ sambhariu  $  uvavaṇu bhaggu mahāraü jeṇa"

START

vāraha-varisaha(hã) ekkaĕ vāraĕ  $  vāsaü devi miliu khandhāraĕ
pavaṇa-jaṇeriĕ puṇu īsāĕvi  $  ghalliẏa gharahŏ kalaṅkaü lāĕvi
maĩ vi tāhĕ païsāru ṇa diṇṇaü  $  vaṇĕ pasaviẏa tahĩ ĕhu uppaṇṇaü
taṃ ji vaïru sumarĕvi haṇuvanteṃ  $  taü āeseṃ dūeṃ jaṃteṃ
ṇaẏarĕ mahāraĕ kiu kaḍamaddaṇu  $  haü mi dhariu sa-kalattu sa-ṇandaṇu
ghattā:
bhaggaĩ suhaḍa-saẏāĩ  $  gaẏa-jūhaĩ disahĩ paṇaṭṭhaĩ
    eẏahŏ raṇa-cariẏāĩ  $  ettiẏaĩ deva maĩ diṭṭhaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 55, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi ti-kaṇṇa-sahāeṃ  $  puṇu pomāiu dahimuha-rāeṃ
"appuṇu jaï vi purandaru āvaï  $  eẏahŏ taṇaü cariu ko pāvaï
veṇṇi mahārisi paḍimā-joeṃ  $  aṭṭha divasa thiẏa ṇiẏaẏa-ṇioeṃ
aṇṇekkettahĕ accāsaṇṇaü  $  mahu dhīẏaü imāu ti-kaṇṇaü
tāma huāsaṇeṇa saṃdīviu  $  vaṇu cāuddisu  jālālīviu
dhagadhagadhagadhaganta-dhūmantaĕ  $  chuḍu chuḍu guruhũ pāsĕ ḍhukkantaĕ
tahĩ avasarĕ haṇuvanteṃ chāĕvi  $  māẏā-pāusu ṇahĕ uppāĕvi
so dāvāṇalu pasamiu jāvĕhĩ  $  haü mi tetthu saṃpāiu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
tahĩ kaṇṇāĕ samāṇu  $  maĩ tumhahũ pāsĕ visajjĕvi
    eẏahŏ raṇa-cariẏāĩ  $  ettiẏaĩ deva maĩ diṭṭhaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 55, Kaḍavaka 12:
dahimuha-vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi gañjolliu  $  pihumaï haṇuvahŏ manti pavolliu
"ṇisuṇĕ bhaḍārā ṇahaẏalĕ janteṃ  $  paḍhamāsālī haẏa haṇuvanteṃ
puṇu vajjāuhu ṇaravara-kesari  $  kalahĕvi pariṇiẏa laṅkāsundari
garuva-saṇeheṃ diṭṭhu vihīsaṇu  $  teṇa samāṇu karĕvi saṃbhāsaṇu
kaḍuvālāva-kālĕ avaṇīẏahũ  $  antarĕ thiu mandoari-sīẏahũ
ṇandaṇa-vaṇu mi bhaggu haü akkhaü  $  indaï kiu paharantu vilakkhaü
eṇa vi vandhāviu appāṇaü  $  kira uvasamaï dasāṇaṇa-rāṇaü
ṇavari viruddheṃ kaha vi ṇa ghāiu  $  tahŏ ghara-siharu daleppiṇu āiu"
ghattā:
iẏa cariẏāĩ suṇevi  $  vaḍa-duma-pāroha-visālĕhĩ
    avaruṇḍiu haṇuvantu  $  rāhavĕṇa sa ĩ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [56. chappaṇṇāsamo saṃdhi]  ----------
haṇuvāgamĕ divasaẏaruggamĕ  $  dasaraha-vaṃsa-jasubbhavĕṇa
gajjĕvi dahavaẏaṇahŏ uppari  $  diṇṇu paẏāṇaü rāhavĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 1:
haẏāṇanda-bherī daḍī diṇṇa saṅkhā  $  karapphāliẏāṇeẏa-tūrāṇa lakkhā
jaẏaṃ ṇandaṇam ṇandighosaṃ sughosaṃ  $  suhaṃ sundaraṃ sohaṇaṃ devaghosaṃ
varaṅgaṃ variṭṭhaṃ gahīraṃ pahāṇaṃ  $  jaṇāṇanda-tūraṃ sirīvaddhamāṇaṃ
sivaṃ santiẏatthaṃ sukallāṇa-dheẏaṃ  $  mahāmaṅgalatthaṃ ṇarindāhiseẏaṃ
pasaṇṇajjhuṇi dunduhī ṇandisaddaṃ  $  pavittaṃ pasatthaṃ ca bhaddaṃ subhaddam
vivāhappiẏaṃ patthivaṃ ṇāẏarīẏaṃ  $  paẏāṇuttamaṃ vaddhaṇaṃ puṇḍarīẏaṃ
maṅgala-tūraĩ ṇāmĕhĩ eĕhĩ  $  puṇu aṇṇaṇṇaĩ aṇṇĕhĩ bheĕhĩ
ḍaũḍaũ-ḍaũḍaũ-ḍamarua-saddĕhĩ  $  taraḍaka-taraḍaka-taraḍaka-ṇaddĕhĩ
dhummuku-dhummuku-dhummuku-tālĕhĩ  $  ruṃ-ruṃ-ruṃ-ruñjanta-vamālĕhĩ
takkisa-takkisa-sarĕhĩ maṇojjĕhĩ  $  duṇikiṭi-duṇikiṭi-tharimadi-vajjĕhĩ
geggadu-geggadu-geggadu-ghāĕhĩ  $  eẏāṇeẏa-bheẏa-saṃghāĕhĩ
ghattā:
taṃ tūrahã saddu suṇeppiṇu  $  rāhava-sāhaṇu saṃmilaï
      sari-sottĕhĩ āvĕvi āvĕvi  $  salilu samuddahŏ jiha milaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 2:
saṇṇaddhu kaïddhaẏa-pavara-rāu  $  saṇṇaddhu aṅgu aṅgaẏa-sahāu
saṇṇaddhu haṇuu paharisa-visaṭṭu  $  rāvaṇa-ṇandaṇavaṇa-maïẏavaṭṭu
saṇṇaddhu gavaü aṇṇu vi gavakkhu  $  jamvuṇṇaü dahimuhu duṇṇirikkhu
saṇṇaddhu virāhiu sīhaṇāu  $  saṇṇaddhu kundu kumueṃ sahāu
saṇṇaddhu ṇīlu ṇalu parimiẏaṅgu  $  saṇṇaddhu suseṇu i raṇĕ abhaṅgu
saṇṇaddhu sīharahu raẏaṇakesi  $  saṇṇaddhu vāli-suu candarāsi
saṇṇaddhu sa-taṇaü mahindarāu  $  bhaḍu lacchibhutti pihumaï-sahāu
saṇṇaddhu candamarīci aṇṇu  $  saṇṇaddhu asesu vi rāma-seṇṇu
ghattā:
aṇṇekku vi saṇṇajjhantaü  $  uppari jaẏa-siri-māṇaṇahŏ
   lakkhijjaï lakkhaṇu kuddhaü  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālu dasāṇaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 3:
aṇṇekka suhaḍa saṇṇaddha ke vi  $  ṇiẏa-kantahã āliṅgaṇaü devi
aṇṇekkahŏ dhaṇa tamvolu dei  $  aṇṇekku samappiẏaü vi ṇa lei
"maĩ kantĕ samāṇevvaü dalehĩ  $  gaẏa-paṇṇĕhĩ rahavara-popphalehĩ
ṇaravara-saṃcūriẏa-cuṇṇaeṇa  $  riu-jaẏa-siri-vahuae diṇṇaeṇa
aṇṇekkahŏ jāĩ su-kanta dei  $  ohullaĩ phullaĩ ṇaru ṇa lei
"ṇa samicchami haũ tuhũ lehi bhajjĕ  $  ettiu siru ṇivaḍaï sāmi-kajjĕ"
aṇṇekkahŏ dhaṇa bhūsaṇaü dei  $  aṇṇekku taṃ pi tiṇa-samu gaṇei
"kiṃ gandheṃ kiṃ candaṇa-raseṇa  $  maĩ aṅgu pasāhevvaü jaseṇa"
ghattā:
aṇṇekkahŏ dhaṇa appāhaï  $  "hima-sasi-saṅkha-samujjalaĩ
    kari-kumbhaĩ ṇāha daleppiṇu  $  āṇejjahi muttāphalaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 4:
aṇṇekkettahĕ vi suhaṅkarāĩ  $  sajjiẏaĩ vimāṇaĩ sundarāĩ
ghaṇṭā-ṭaṅkāra-maṇoharāĩ  $  ruṇṭanta-matta-mahuara-sarāĩ
sasi-sūrakanta-kara-ṇibbharāĩ  $  vahu-indaṇīla-kiẏa-seharāĩ
pavalaẏa-mālā-raṅkholirāĩ  $  maragaẏa-riñcholi-pasohirāĩ
maṇi-paümarāẏa-vaṇṇujjalāĩ  $  veḍujja-vajja-paha-ṇimmalāĩ
muttāhala-mālā-dhavaliẏāĩ  $  kiṅkiṇi-ghagghara-sara-muhaliẏāĩ
dhūvaṃta-dhavala-dhua-dhaẏavaḍāĩ  $  vajjanta-saṅkha-saẏa-saṅghaḍāĩ
suggīveṃ raẏaṇujjoviẏāĩ  $  vihĩ viṇṇi vimāṇaĩ ḍhoiẏāĩ
ghattā:
vandiṇa-jaṇa-jaẏa-jaẏakārĕṇa  $  lakkhaṇa-rāmārūḍha kiha
    sura-parimiẏa-pavara-vimāṇĕhĩ  $  veṇṇi vi inda-paḍīnda jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 5:
aṇekka-pāsĕ kiẏa sāri-sajja  $  suvisāla-sughaṇṭā-juvala-gejja
ali-jhaṅkāriẏa gaẏa-ghaḍa paẏaṭṭa  $  vihalaṅghala ṇibbhara-maẏa-visaṭṭa
sindūra-paṅka-paṅkiẏa-sarīra  $  sikkāra-phāra-gajjaṇa-gahīra
ummeṭṭha ṇiraṅkusa jāi thāi  $  malhanti maṇohara vesa ṇāĩ
aṇṇekka-pāsĕ raha rahiẏa-thaṭṭa  $  cūranta paropparu pahĕ paẏaṭṭa
sa-turaṅga sa-sārahi sa-kaïcindha  $  ṇāṇāviha-vara-paharaṇa-samiddha
aṇekka-pāsĕ vala-darisaṇāĩ  $  vajjanta-tūra-sara-bhīsaṇāĩ
āẏaḍḍhiẏa-cāva-mahāsarāĩ  $  uggāmiẏa-bhāmiẏa-asivarāĩ
ghattā:
aṇṇekka-pāsĕ hiṃsantaü  $  haẏavara-sāhaṇu ṇīsaraï
    sukalattu jemva sukulīṇaü  $  paẏa-saṃcāru ṇa vīsaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 6:
aṇṇekkettahĕ aṇṇekka vīra  $  gajjanti samara-saṃghaṭṭa-dhīra
ekkeṇa vuttu "sosami samuddu"  $  aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "mahu ṇisiẏarindu"
aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "haũ dharami seṇṇu"  $  aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "mahu kumbhaẏaṇṇu"
aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "mahu mehaṇāu"  $  aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "mahu bhaḍa-ṇihāu"
aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "bho ṇisuṇi mitta  $  haũ valahŏ sa-hattheṃ demi kanta"
aṇṇekku bhaṇaï "kiṃ gajjieṇa  $  ajja vi saṅgāma-vivajjieṇa
saẏalu vi jāṇijjaï tahĩ ji kālĕ  $  para-valĕ ovaḍiẏaĕ sāmi-sālĕ"
aṇṇekku vīru ṇiẏa-maṇĕ visaṇṇu  $  "maĩ sāmihĕ avasarĕ kāĩ diṇṇu"
ghattā:
aṇṇekku suhaḍu ovaggaï  $  aggaĕ thāĕvi halaharahŏ
    "jaṃ vūḍhaü maĩ siru khandhĕṇa  $  taṃ hosaï pahu avasarahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 7:
aṇṇekka-pāsĕ suvisāliẏāu  $  vijjaü vijjāhara-pāliẏāu
paṇṇattī vahuva-virūviṇī  $  veẏālī ṇahaẏala-gāmiṇī
 $  thambhaṇiẏākarisaṇī mohaṇī
sāmuddī ruddī kesavī  $  bhuvaïndī khandī vāsavī
vambhāṇī raürava-dāruṇī  $  ṇerittī vāẏava-vāruṇī
candī sūri vaïsāṇarī  $  māẏaṅgi maẏandī vāṇarī
hariṇī vārāhi turaṅgamī  $  vala-sosaṇī garuḍa-vihaṅgamī
pavvaï maẏaraddhaẏa-rūviṇī  $  āsāla-vijja vahu-rūviṇī
ghattā:
saṇṇaddhu asesu vi sāhaṇu  $  rāmahŏ suggīvahŏ taṇaü
    ṇaṃ jamvūdīu paẏaṭṭaü  $  laṅkādīvahŏ pāhuṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 8:
saṃcalleṃ ṇiẏa-vaṃsubbhaveṇa  $  diṭṭhaĩ su-ṇimittaĩ rāhaveṇa
gandhovaü candaṇu siddha-sesa  $  jiṇa pujjĕvi vāhu suvesa vesa
dappaṇaü su-saṅkhu su-sahasavattu  $  ṇiggantha-rūu paṇḍuraü chattu

suṇimittaĩ ṇiĕvi jasuṇṇaeṇa  $  valaeu vuttu jamvuṇṇaeṇa
"dhaṇṇo 'si deva taü sahalu gamaṇu  $  āẏaĩ su-ṇimittaĩ lahaï kavaṇu
ghattā:
vihaseppiṇu vuccaï rāmĕṇa  $  saï su-ṇimittaĩ jantāhũ
    jaga-laggaṇa-khambhu bhaḍāraü  $  jiṇavaru hiẏaĕ vahantāhũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 9:
saṃcalleṃ rāhava-sāhaṇeṇa  $  saṃghaṭṭiu vāhaṇu vāhaṇeṇa
cindheṇa cindhu rahu rahavareṇa  $  chatteṇa chattu gaü gaẏavareṇa
turaeṇa turaṅgamu ṇaru ṇareṇa  $  calaṇeṇa calaṇu karaẏalu kareṇa
valu raṇa-rahasaḍḍhiu ṇahĕ ṇa māi  $  saṃcalliu devāgamaṇu ṇāĩ

macchohara-ṇakka-ggāha-ghoru  $  kallolavantu taraṅga-thoru
velā-vaḍḍhantu padūhaṇantu  $  pheṇujjala-toẏa-tusāra dentu
tahŏ uvari paẏaṭṭaü rāma-seṇṇu  $  ṇaṃ meha-jālu ṇahaẏalĕ ṇisaṇṇu
ghattā:
ṇaravaïhĩ vimāṇārūḍhĕhĩ  $  laṅghiu lavaṇa-samuddu kiha
    siddhĕhĩ siddhālaü jantĕhĩ  $  caügaï-bhava-saṃsāru jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 10:
thovantarĕ tahŏ sāẏarahŏ majjhĕ  $  velandhara-purĕ tiẏasahã asajjhĕ
vijjāhara seu-samudda ve vi  $  thiẏa aggaĕ dāruṇu jujjhu devi
"maru tumhahã kuiu kaẏantu ajju  $  ko sakkaï sakkahŏ harĕvi rajju
ko païsaï bhīsaṇĕ jalaṇa-jālĕ  $  ko jīvaï ḍhukkaĕ palaẏa-kālĕ
ko sesa-phaṇā-maṇi-raẏaṇu lei  $  ko laṅkahĕ ahimuhu paü vi dei"
paccāriẏa saẏala vi amariseṇa  $  "ahŏ kikkindhāhiva ahŏ suseṇa
ahŏ kumua kunda suṇi mehaṇāẏa  $  ṇala ṇīla virāhiẏa pavaṇa-jāẏa
dahimuha māhinda mahinda-rāẏa  $  avara vi je ṇaravara ke vi āẏa
ghattā:
laï valahŏ valahŏ jaï sakkahŏ  $  hevāiẏa pārakkaĕhĩ
    kahĩ laṅkā-uvari paẏāṇaü  $  seu-samuddĕhĩ thakkaĕhĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 11:
etthantarĕ jaẏasiri-lāhaveṇa  $  suggīu papucchiu rāhaveṇa
"ee je daṇu dīsanti ke vi  $  kasu kerā thiẏa paharaṇaĩ levi"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi paṇamiẏa-sireṇa  $  puṇu puṇu thottuggīriẏa-gireṇa
suggīveṃ pabhaṇiu rāmacandu  $  "ĕhu seu bhaḍārā ĕhu samuddu

āẏahũ paḍimallu ṇa ko vi samarĕ  $  jaï dinti jujjhu ṇala-ṇīla ṇavarĕ
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rāmahŏ hiẏaü bhiṇṇu  $  ṇiviseṇa vihi mi āesu diṇṇu
paṇivāu kareppiṇu te paẏaṭṭa  $  romañca-ucca-kañcua-visaṭṭa
ghattā:
ṇalu dhāiu samuhu samuddahŏ  $  seuhĕ ṇīlu samāvaḍiu
    gaü gaẏahŏ maïndu maïndahŏ  $  jiha orālĕvi abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 12:
te bhiḍiẏa paropparu raṇĕ raüdda  $  vijjāhara veṇṇi vi ṇala-samudda
viṇṇāṇĕhĩ karaṇĕhĩ kararuhehĩ  $  aṇṇehĩ asesĕhĩ āuhehĩ
paharanti dhanti vipphuriẏa-vaẏaṇa  $  rattuppala-dala-sāriccha-ṇaẏaṇa
etthantarĕ rāvaṇa-kiṅkareṇa  $  melliẏa maẏaraharī vijja teṇa
dhāiẏa gajjanti pagulugulanti  $  velā-kallolullola lenti
ettahĕ vi ṇaleṇa viruddhaeṇa  $  samaraṅgaṇĕ jaẏasiri-luddhaeṇa
āẏāmĕvi mahihara-vijja mukka  $  jalu saẏalu vi paḍipūranti ḍhukka
taṃ māẏā-sāẏaru daramalevi  $  vijjāhara-karaṇeṃ ullalevi
ghattā:
ṇalu uppari ḍīṇu samuddahŏ  $  ṇīlu vi seuhĕ sira-kamalĕ
    vihĩ veṇṇi mi maṇḍa dhareppiṇu  $  ghalliẏa rāmahŏ paẏa-jualĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa III, Saṃdhi 56, Kaḍavaka 13:
seu-samudda ve vi jaṃ āṇiẏa  $  ṇala-ṇīlĕhĩ samāṇu sammāṇiẏa
tehi mi pavara pasāhĕvi kaṇṇaü  $  tahŏ lakkhaṇahŏ sa-hattheṃ diṇṇaü
saccasirī kamalacchi visālā  $  aṇṇa vi raẏaṇacūla guṇamālā
pañca vi kaṇṇaü devi kumārahŏ  $  thiẏa pāikka sīẏa-bhattārahŏ
ekka raẏaṇi gaẏa kaha vi vihāṇaü  $  puṇu aruṇuggamĕ diṇṇu paẏāṇaü
sāhaṇu pattu suvelu mahīharu  $  tahi mi suvelu ṇavara vijjāharu
dhāiu jiha gaïndu orālĕvi  $  bhīsaṇu karĕ dhaṇuharu apphālĕvi
bhiḍaï ṇa bhiḍaï raṇaṅgaṇĕ jāvĕhĩ  $  seu-samuddĕhĩ vāriu tāvĕhĩ
ghattā:
"eĕhĩ samāṇu jujjhantahã  $  jaï para-jaṇavaĕ jampaṇaü
    paḍu pāĕhĩ rāhavacandahŏ  $  maṃ mārāvahi appaṇaü

duppiẏa-dummarikkha-dujjohaṇa-tāra-sutāra-tāsaṇā

ghattā:
ee ṇaravaï  $  samara-saĕhĩ ṇivvūḍhā
    caliẏa asesa vi  $  pavara-vimāṇārūḍhā

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 60, Kaḍavaka 8:

sattāsī lakkha sa-maccharāhũ  $  valĕ ekkavīsa koḍiu ṇarāhũ
ghattā:
teraha koḍiu  $  vāraha lakkha ahaṅgahũ
    vīsa sahāsaĩ  $  iu parimāṇu turaṅgahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 60, Kaḍavaka 9:
saṃcalleṃ rāhava-sāhaṇĕṇa  $  romañcucchaliẏa-pasāhaṇĕṇa
ālāva hūa harisiẏa-maṇahŏ  $  gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ sura-kāmiṇi-jaṇahŏ
