kavaṇahĩ pakkhariẏa turaṅga-thaḍa  $  kavaṇahĩ mukkaṅkusa hatthi-haḍa
kavaṇahĩ sara-dhoraṇi duvvisaha  $  kavaṇahĩ mahihara-saṅkāsa-raha
kavaṇahĩ sārahi sandaṇa-kusala  $  kavaṇahĩ seṇāvaï atula-vala
kavaṇahĩ paharaṇaĩ bhaẏaṅkaraĩ  $  kavaṇahĩ cindhāĩ ṇirantaraĩ
ghattā:
kavaṇu raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  vāṇahũ sāiu desaï
    rāvaṇa-rāmahũ  $  jaẏasiri kavaṇu laesaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 60, Kaḍavaka 10:
aṇṇekkaĕ dīhara-ṇaẏaṇiẏāĕ  $  pabhaṇiu papphulliẏa-vaẏaṇiẏāĕ
"halĕ veṇṇi mi atula-mahāvalāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi parivaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalāĩ
veṇṇi mi kuruḍāĩ sa-maccharāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi dāruṇa-paharaṇa-karāĩ
veṇṇi mi savaḍammuha kiẏa-gamāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi pakkhariẏa-turaṅgamāĩ
veṇṇi mi galagajjiẏa-gaẏaghaḍāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi pavaṇuddhua-dhaẏavaḍāĩ
veṇṇi mi sañjottiẏa-sandaṇāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi sura-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇāĩ
veṇṇi mi sārahi-duddarisaṇāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi seṇāvaï-bhīsaṇāĩ
veṇṇi mi chattoha-ṇirantarāĩ  $  veṇṇi mi bhaḍa-bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkarāĩ
ghattā:
viṇṇi mi seṇṇaĩ  $  aṇusarisāĩ mahāhavĕ
    vijaü ṇa jāṇahũ  $  kiṃ rāvaṇĕ kiṃ rāhavĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 60, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi vahu-maccharāĕ  $  aṇṇāĕ ṇibbhacchiẏa accharāĕ

jahĩ akkakitti mahu mehaṇāu  $  jahĩ maẏaru mahoẏaru bhīmakāu

jahĩ sambhu saẏambhu ṇisumbhu sumbhu  $  jahĩ sundu ṇisundu ṇikumbhu kumbhu
jahĩ sīhaṇiẏamvu palamvavāhu  $  jahĩ ḍiṇḍimu ḍamvaru nakkagāhu
jahĩ jamu jamaghaṇṭu jamakkhu sīhu  $  jahĩ mallavantu jahĩ vijjujīhu
ghattā:
jahĩ suu sāraṇu  $  vajjoaru hālāhalu
    tahĩ rāvaṇa-valĕ  $  kavaṇu gahaṇu rāhava-valu"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 60, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vipphuriẏāṇaṇāĕ  $  aṇṇekkaĕ vuttu varaṅgaṇāĕ
"jahĩ rāhaü viḍasuggīva-mahaṇu  $  jahĩ gavaü gavakkhu vivakkha-vahaṇu
jahĩ lakkhaṇu khara-dūsaṇa-viṇāsu  $  jahĩ bhāmaṇḍalu jaẏasiri ṇivāsu
jahĩ aṅgaü aṅgu suseṇu tāru  $  jahĩ ṇīlu ṇahusu ṇalu duṇṇivāru
jahĩ ahimuhu dahimuhu maïsamuddu  $  maïkantu virāhiu kumuu kundu
jahĩ jamvaü jamvava-raẏaṇakesi  $  jahĩ komui-candaṇu candarāsi
jahĩ mārui ṇandaṇavaṇa-kaẏantu  $  jahĩ rambhu mahindu vihīsa-vantu
jahĩ suhaḍu vihīsaṇu sūla-hatthu  $  seṇāvaï saĩ suggīu jetthu
ghattā:
taṃ valu halĕ sahi  $  ettiu eu karesaï
   rāvaṇu pāḍĕvi  $  laṅka sa iṃ bhu ñjesaï"
----------  [61. ekkasaṭṭhimo saṃdhi]  ----------
jasa-luddhaĩ  $  amarisa-kuddhaĩ  $  haẏa-tūraĩ kiẏa-kalakalaĩ
abbhiṭṭaĩ  $  rahasa-visaṭṭaĩ  $  tāmva rāmva-rāmaṇa-valaĩ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 1:
vaïdehihĕ kāraṇĕ atula-valaĩ  $  abbhiṭṭaĩ rāmaṇa-rāma-valaĩ
ṇaṃ jua-khaĕ mahiẏala-gaẏaṇaẏalaĩ  $  savimāṇaĩ vijjula-veẏa-calaĩ
paḍu-paḍaha-bheri-gambhīra-saraĩ  $  avaropparu ahiṇava-rosa-bharaĩ
sila-pāhaṇa-taru-giri-gahiẏa-karaĩ  $  savvala-huli-hala-karavāla-dharaĩ
uggāmiẏa-bhāmiẏa-bhīma-gaẏaĩ  $  orāli-garua-gajjanta-gaẏaĩ
paḍipelliẏa-raha-hiṃsanta-haẏaĩ  $  dhua-dhavala-chatta-dhūvanta-dhaẏaĩ
sāhīṇa-pāṇa-paricatta-bhaẏaĩ  $  pammukka-ghāẏa-saṅghāẏa-saẏaĩ
samuhekkamekka-sañchuddha-paẏaĩ  $  saẏavāra-vāra-ugghuṭṭha-jaẏaĩ
ghattā:
sa-paẏāvaĩ  $  kaḍḍhiẏa-cāvaĩ  $  sara-sandhanta-muantāĩ
    ṇaṃ ghaḍiẏaĩ  $  viṇṇi vi bhiḍiẏaĩ  $  paẏaĩ suvanta-tiṅantāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 2:
tahĩ tehaĕ samaraṅgaṇĕ dāruṇĕ  $  kuṅkuma-kesua-aravindāruṇĕ
ko vi vīru ṇāsaṅkaï pāṇahũ  $  puṇu puṇu aṅgu samoḍaï vāṇahũ
ko vi vīru paḍipaharaï para-valĕ  $  puraü dhāi paü dei ṇa pacchalĕ
ko vi vīru asahantu raṇaṅgaṇĕ  $  jhampa dei para-ṇaravara-sandaṇĕ
ko vi vaïri karĕ dharĕvi pakaḍḍhaï  $  paharĕ paharĕ pariosu pavaḍḍhaï
ko vi sarāhaü paḍaï vimāṇahŏ  $  ṇāvaï vijju-puñju ṇiẏa-thāṇahŏ
ko vi dharijjaï vāṇĕhĩ entaü  $  ṇaṃ gurūhĩ ṇaru ṇaraĕ paḍantaü
ko vi danti-dantĕhĩ ālaggaï  $  karaṇu devi kŏ vi uvari valaggaï
ghattā:
gaü mārĕvi  $  kumbhu viẏārĕvi  $  jāĩ tāĩ kundujjalaĩ
    guṇavantahĕ  $  pāhuḍu kantahĕ  $  ko vi lei muttāhalaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 3:
hemujjala-daṇḍa-valaggāĩ  $  keṇa vi toḍiẏaĩ dhaẏaggāĩ
ṇa samicchiu jeṇa piẏahĕ taṇaü  $  teṃ ruhireṃ laïu pasāhaṇaü
muhapatti ṇa icchiẏa jeṇa gharĕ  $  kiẏa teṇa suhaḍa bhañjĕvi samarĕ
ciru jeṇa ṇa icchiu dappaṇaü  $  rahĕ teṇa ṇihāliu appaṇaü
muhĕ paṇṇaĩ jeṇa ṇa lāviẏaĩ  $  teṃ ruṇḍa-saẏaĩ ṇaccāviẏaĩ
ciru jeṇa ṇa suraü samāṇiẏaü  $  teṃ raṇa-vahuaĕ sahũ māṇiẏaü
ṇiẏa-ṇāri ṇa icchiẏa āsi jĕṇa  $  āliṅgiẏa gaẏa-ghaḍa vahuẏa tĕṇa
jo ṇahaĩ ṇa dentaü ṇiẏa-piẏāĕ  $  so phāḍiu samaraṅgaṇa-tiẏāĕ
ghattā:
sammāṇa-dāṇa-riṇa-bhariẏaü  $  acchiu jo jhūrantu ciru
    so raṇaühĕ suhaḍu paṇacciu  $  sāmihĕ aggaĕ devi siru

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 4:
kahiṃci ghora-bhaṇḍaṇaṃ  $  siroha-deha-khaṇḍaṇaṃ
ṇarinda-vinda-dāraṇaṃ  $  turaṅga-magga-vāraṇaṃ
disagga-bhagga-sandaṇaṃ  $  bhamanta-suṇṇa-vāraṇaṃ
bhiḍanta-vīra-ṇibbharaṃ  $  cavanta-ṇiṭṭhuraṃ kharaṃ
vimukka-cakka-savvalaṃ  $  tisūla-satti-saṅkulaṃ
aṇeẏa-ghāẏa-jajjaraṃ  $  paḍanta-vāhu-pañjaraṃ
muanta-hakka-ḍakkaẏaṃ  $  haṇanta-ekkamekkaẏaṃ
luṇanta-aḍḍa-haḍḍaẏaṃ  $  kuṇanta-khaṇḍakhaṇḍaẏaṃ
paḍanta-joha-vimbhalaṃ  $  lalanta-anta-cumbhalaṃ
galanta-lohiohaẏaṃ  $  milanta-pakkhi-jūhaẏaṃ
kahiṃ ci āhaẏā haẏā  $  mahīẏalaṃ gaẏā gaẏā
kahiṃ ji bhāsurā surā  $  pahāra-dāruṇāruṇā
kahiṃ ci viddhaẏā dhaẏā  $  jasoha-bhūriṇā 'riṇā
ghattā:
tahĩ āhavĕ paḍhama-bhiḍantaü  $  rāhava-sāhaṇu bhaggu kiha
      divĕ divĕ duviẏaḍḍhahŏ māṇĕṇa  $  poḍha-vilāsiṇi-suraü jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 5:
rāhava-valu rāvaṇa-valĕṇa bhaggu  $  ṇaṃ duggaï-gamaṇeṃ sugaï-maggu
ṇaṃ kali-pariṇāmeṃ parama-dhammu  $  ṇaṃ ghorācaraṇeṃ maṇua-jammu
viẏaliẏa-paharaṇu ṇiẏa-maṇĕ visaṇṇu  $  bhajjantaü pekkhĕvi rāma-seṇṇu
kiu kalaẏalu kamala-dalakkhiehĩ  $  sura-vahuahĩ rāvaṇa-pakkhiehĩ
"halĕ pekkhu pekkhu ṇāsantu simiru  $  ṇaṃ ravi-ẏara-ṇiẏarahŏ raẏaṇi-timiru
suṭṭhu vi sīẏālu mahanta-kāu  $  kiṃ visahaï kesari-ṇahara-ghāu
suṭṭhu vi joiṅgaṇu teẏavantu  $  kiṃ teṇa tavaṇu jijjaï tavantu
suṭṭhu vi sundara rāsahahŏ kīla  $  kiṃ pāvaï vara-māẏaṅga-līla
ghattā:
suṭṭhu vi bhūgoẏaru dujjaü  $  kiṃ pujjaï vijjāharahŏ
    suṭṭhu vi vālāhiu vaḍḍaü  $  kiṃ sarisaü raẏaṇāẏarahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 6:
tāva turaṅgama-raha-gaẏa-vāhaṇu  $  valiu paḍīvaü rāhava-sāhaṇu
ṇaṃ ucchalliu khaẏa-sāẏara-jalu  $  āhaẏa-tūra-ṇivahu kiẏa-kalaẏalu
ubbhiẏa-kaṇaẏa-daṇḍu dhuẏa-dhaẏavaḍu  $  uddha-soṇḍa-uddhaṅkusa-gaẏa-ghaḍu
jutta-turaṅgama-vāhiẏa-sandaṇu  $  jāu paḍīvaü bhaḍa-kaḍamaddaṇu
dhāiẏa ṇaravara ṇaravara-vindahũ  $  sīhahũ sīha gaïnda gaïndahũ
rahiẏahũ rahiẏa dhaẏagga dhaẏaggahũ  $  raha rahavarahũ turaṅga turaṅgahũ
dhāṇukkiẏahũ bhiḍiẏa dhāṇukkiẏa  $  phārakkiẏahũ pavara phārakkiẏa
asivara-hatthā asivara-hatthahũ  $  emva hūa kiliviṇḍi samatthahũ
ghattā:
dugghoṭṭa-thaṭṭa-saṅghaṭṭaṇa  $  pāḍiẏa-muha-vaḍa paḍiẏa-guḍa
    aḍḍāuha avasarĕ phiṭṭaĕ  $  vālāluñji karanti bhaḍa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 7:
kiẏa-kuruḍa-bhiuḍi-bhaḍa-bhāsurāĩ  $  paharanti paropparu ṇiṭṭhurāĩ
ubhaẏa-valaĩ ruhira-jalolliẏāĩ  $  tammiccha-vaṇaĩ ṇaṃ phulliẏāĩ
etthantarĕ jaṇa-maṇa-bhāviṇīu  $  kalahanti gaẏaṇĕ sura-kāmiṇīu
"halĕ vāsavaẏattĕ vasantalehĕ  $  halĕ kāmaseṇĕ halĕ kāmalehĕ
halĕ kusuma-maṇohari halĕ aṇaṅgĕ  $  cittaṅgĕ varaṅgaṇĕ halĕ varaṅgĕ
jo dīsaï raṇaühĕ suhaḍu ehu  $  kaṇṇiẏa-khuruppa-kappariẏa-dehu
savvaü milevi ĕhu majjhu dehu  $  raṇĕ aṇṇu gavesavi tumhĕ lehu"
aṇṇekkaĕ harisiẏa-gattiẏāĕ  $  pabhaṇiu papphulliẏa-vattiẏāĕ
ghattā:
"jo danti-dantĕ ālaggĕvi  $  uru bhindāviu appaṇaü
      halĕ dhāvahi kāĩ gahilliĕ  $  ĕhu bhattāru mahu ttaṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 8:
jāmva volla sura-kāmiṇi-satthahŏ  $  tāva valeṇa samarĕ kākutthahŏ

vihuṇiẏakara-muha-kāẏara-ṇaravaru  $  vuṇṇa-turaṅgamu moḍiẏa-rahavaru
cattachatta-āmelliẏa-dhaẏavaḍu  $  garuẏa-ghāẏa-kaḍuvāviẏa-gaẏa-ghaḍu
jaṃ ṇāsantu padīsiu para-valu  $  rāhava-pakkhiehĩ kiu kalaẏalu
"halĕ halĕ vāravāra jaṃ vaṇṇahi  $  jeṇa samāṇu aṇṇu ṇaü maṇṇahi
taṃ valu pekkhu pekkhu bhajjantaü  $  ṇaṃ uvavaṇu duvvāeṃ chittaü
ṇaṃ sajjaṇa-kuḍumvu khala-saṅgeṃ  $  ṇāĩ kumuṇivara-cittu aṇaṅgeṃ
ghattā:
riu-hariṇa-jūhu hiṇḍantaü  $  puṇṇahĩ kaha va samāvaḍiu
    ṇāseppiṇu kahĩ jāesaï  $  rāhava-sīhahŏ kamĕ paḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 9:
etthantarĕ valĕ mambhīsa devi  $  vitthakkā hattha-pahattha ve vi
ṇaṃ palaĕ samuṭṭhiẏa canda-sūra  $  ṇaṃ rāhu-keu accanta-kūra
ṇaṃ palaẏa-huāsaṇa pavaṇa-caṇḍa  $  ṇaṃ matta mahaggaẏa gilla-gaṇḍa
ṇaṃ sīha samuddhūsiẏa-sarīra  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-jalaṇihi gambhīra dhīra
duvvāra-vaïri-saṅghāraṇehĩ  $  utthariẏāṇeĕhĩ paharaṇehĩ
aggeĕhĩ vāruṇa-vāẏavehĩ  $  sila-pāhaṇa-pavvaẏa-pāẏavehĩ
jahĩ jahĩ bhiḍanti tahĩ maṇĕ visaṇṇu  $  sāhāru ṇa vandhaï rāma-seṇṇu
vihaḍapphaḍu ṇāsaï pāṇa levi  $  tahĩ avasarĕ thiẏa ṇala-ṇīla ve vi
ghattā:
ṇaṃ pavara-gaïndu gaïndahŏ  $  sīhahŏ sīhu samāvaḍiu
    ṇalu hatthahŏ ṇīlu pahatthahŏ  $  sarahasa-paharaṇu abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 10:
ṇala-hattha ve vi raṇĕ ovaḍiẏā  $  veṇṇi vi gaẏa-sandaṇehĩ caḍiẏā
veṇṇi vi abhaṅga-māẏaṅga-dhaẏā  $  veṇṇi vi supasiddha laddha-vijaẏa
veṇṇi vi bhiuḍī-bhaṅgura-vaẏaṇā  $  veṇṇi vi guñjāhala-sama-ṇaẏaṇā
veṇṇi vi pacaṇḍa-kovaṇḍa-dharā  $  veṇṇi vi aṇavaraẏa-vimukka-sarā
veṇṇi vi dhaṇu-viṇṇāṇanta-gaẏā  $  veṇṇi vi saẏavārocchiṇṇa-dhaẏā
veṇṇi vi samaraṅgaṇĕ duvvisahā  $  veṇṇi vi saẏavāra-hūẏa-virahā
veṇṇi vi thiẏa ahiṇava-rahavarehĩ  $  veṇṇi vi pomāiẏa suravarehĩ
veṇṇi vi ṇīsandaṇa puṇu vi kiẏā  $  veṇṇi vi vimāṇa-vāhaṇĕhĩ thiẏā
ghattā:
veṇṇi vi karanti raṇĕ ṇikkaü  $  pahu-sammāṇa-dāṇa-riṇahŏ
    paḍipaharĕ paharĕ ṇivaḍantaĕ  $  veṇṇi vi ṇāmu lenti jiṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 11:
etthantarĕ āẏāmiẏa-ṇaleṇa  $  paẏa-bhārakkanta-rasāẏaleṇa
haẏa-tūra-paüra-kiẏa-kalaẏaleṇa  $  orasiẏa-saṅkha-daḍi-kāhaleṇa
hariṇinda-runda-kaḍi-kaḍiẏaleṇa  $  sundara-raṅkholira-mehaleṇa
diḍha-kaḍhiṇa-viẏaḍa-vacchatthaleṇa  $  pāroha-soha-sama-bhuavaleṇa
chaṇa-canda-runda-muha-maṇḍaleṇa  $  gholanta-kaṇṇa-maṇikuṇḍaleṇa
toṇīrahŏ rāvaṇa-kiṅkareṇa  $  kaḍḍhiu bhaḍa-bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkareṇa
viuruvvaṇa-saru raṇĕ duṇṇivāru  $  guṇa-sandhiẏa-mettaü saẏa-paẏāru
āmellijjantu sahāsa-bheu  $  thovantarĕ ṇavara aladdha-cheu
ghattā:
jalĕ thalĕ pāẏālĕ ṇahaṅgaṇĕ  $  vāṇa-ṇivahu sandarisiẏaü
    riu-jalaharu sara-dhārāharu  $  ṇala-kulapavvaĕ varisiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ hatthahŏ keraü vāṇa-jālu  $  pūrantu asesu diẏantarālu
āẏāmĕvi ṇalĕṇa dudarisaṇeṇa  $  ākarisiu sarĕṇākarisaṇeṇa
dhārā-timiru va kiraṇāẏareṇa  $  mīṇattheṃ jagu va saṇicchareṇa
dahimuha-purĕ risi-kaṇṇovasaggĕ  $  haṇuveṇa va sāẏara-jalu kha-maggĕ
aṇṇekkeṃ vāṇeṃ chiṇṇu cindhu  $  aṇṇekkeṃ riu vacchaẏalĕ viddhu
vihalaṅghalu mahiẏalĕ paḍiu hatthu  $  ṇaṃ dahavaẏaṇahŏ jevaṇaü hatthu
ettahĕ vi ve vi raṇa-bhara-samattha  $  ovaḍiẏa bhiḍiẏa ṇīla-ppahattha
veṇṇi vi sa-rosa veṇṇi vi pacaṇḍa  $  veṇṇi vi gañjolliẏa-vāhudaṇḍa
ghattā:
paccāriu ṇīlu pahatthĕṇa  $  "paharu paharu ekkahŏ jaṇahŏ
    jaẏa-lacchi deu āliṅgaṇu  $  jima rāmahŏ jima rāmaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 13:
etthantarĕ ṇīleṃ ṇa kiu kheu  $  ṇārāu visajjiu caṇḍa-veu
guṇa-dhammāmelliu caliu kema  $  vindhaṇaü sahāveṃ pisuṇu jemva
so entu pahattheṃ kuddhaeṇa  $  karivara-sandaṇĕṇa kari-ddhaeṇa
chakkhaṇḍaĩ kiu chahĩ saravarehĩ  $  ṇaṃ mahiẏalu āgamĕ muṇivarehĩ
caüvīsa ṇavara ṇīleṇa mukka  $  ekkekkahŏ ve ve vāṇa ḍhukka
vihĩ kari kappariẏa samottharanta  $  vihĩ sārahi vihĩ dhaẏa tharaharanta
rahu ekkeṃ ekkeṃ kavaü chiṇṇu  $  dhaü ekkeṃ ekkeṃ hiẏaü bhiṇṇu
vihĩ vāhu-daṇḍa vihĩ vilua pāẏa  $  evaṃ tahŏ maraṇāvattha jāẏa
ghattā:
sira-kama-karoru chakkhaṇḍaĩ  $  jāu silīmuha-kappariu
    lakkhijjaï suhaḍu paḍantaü  $  ṇaṃ bhūahã vali vikkhiriu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 61, Kaḍavaka 14:
jaṃ viṇihaẏa hattha-pahattha ve vi  $  thiu rāvaṇu muhĕ kara-kamalu devi
ṇaṃ matta-mahāgaü gaẏa-visāṇu  $  ṇaṃ vāsarĕ teẏa-vihīṇu bhāṇu
ṇaṃ ṇī-sasi-sūraü gaẏaṇa-maggu  $  ṇaṃ inda-paḍinda-vimukku saggu
ṇaṃ muṇivaru iha-para-loẏa-cukku  $  ṇaṃ kukaï-kavvu lakkhaṇa-vimukku
thiu valu vi ṇirujjamu galiẏa-gāu  $  rāhava-valu parivaddhiẏa-paẏāvu
ettahĕ sa-paḍaha ṇīsadda saṅkha  $  ettahĕ apphāliẏa tūra-lakkha
ettahĕ valĕ hāhākāru suṭṭhu  $  ettahĕ puṇu jaẏajaẏa-saddu ghuṭṭhu
ettahĕ vi gaẏaṇĕ atthamiu mittu  $  ṇaṃ hattha-pahatthahã taṇaü mittu
ghattā:
jujjhantaĩ veṇṇi vi seṇṇaĩ  $  raẏaṇiĕ ṇāĩ ṇivāriẏaĩ
    bhūĕhĩ sa ĩ bhū a-sahāsaĩ  $  raṇĕ bhoẏaṇĕ hakkāriẏaĩ
----------  [62. bāsaṭṭhimo saṃdhi]  ----------
pāḍiĕ hatthĕ pahatthĕ  $  valaĩ ve vi pariẏattaĩ
ṇāĩ samattaĕ kajjĕ  $  mihuṇaĩ ṇisuḍhiẏa-gattaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 1:
gaĕ rāvaṇĕ ṇiẏa-mandirĕ païṭṭhĕ  $  hari-halaharĕ raṇa-vāhirĕ ṇiviṭṭhĕ
tahĩ avasarĕ jaga-vitthiṇṇa-ṇāmu  $  jokkāriu ṇala-ṇīlehĩ rāmu
teṇa vi vahu-raẏaṇa-samujjalāĩ  $  diṇṇaĩ ṇīlahŏ maṇi-kuṇḍalāĩ
iẏarahŏ vi maüḍu maṇi-teẏa-bhiṇṇu  $  jo rāmaürihĩ jakkheṇa diṇṇu
jaṃ ve vi papujjiẏa rāhaveṇa  $  pañcaṅgu vūhu kiu jamvaveṇa
ṇara dāhiṇeṇa haẏa uttareṇa  $  gaẏa puvveṃ raha avarattaṇeṇa
viraïẏaĩ vimāṇaĩ gaẏaṇa-maggĕ  $  thiẏa hari-halahara sīhāsaṇaggĕ
devahu mi accheu abheu vūhu  $  ṇaṃ thiu milevi pañcamuhu jūhu
ghattā:
tāva raṇaṅgaṇa-majjhĕ  $  puṇu puṇu siva phekkāraï
    "rāmaṇa dujjaü rāmu"  $  ṇāĩ samāsaĕ vāraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 2:
kattha vi siva kā vi kaluṇu lavaï  $  "raṇu thovaü jaï aṇṇu vi havaï"
kattha vi siva kā vi samalliẏaï  $  ṇaṃ joaï "ko muu ko jiẏaï
kattha vi siva suhaḍahŏ ḍīṇa sirĕ  $  vivarokkhaĕ aṇṇuĕ bhutti karĕ
kattha vi siva cumvaï muha-kamalu  $  ṇaṃ poḍha-vilāsiṇi ahara-dalu
kattha vi siva bhaḍahŏ lei hiẏaü  $  puṇu mellaï "maru aṇṇahĕ hiẏaü"
kattha vi raṇĕ bhūahũ kalahaṇaü  $  "siru tujjhu kavandhu mahu ttaṇaü"
abbhiḍaï aṇṇu aṇṇeṇa sahũ  $  "ĕu bhaḍu āvaggaü dehi mahu"
aṇṇeṃ vuccaï "khaṇḍu vi ṇa taü  $  chuḍu ekku gāsu mahu hou gaü"
ghattā:
bhūahũ bhoaṇa-līla  $  rāmahŏ vaẏaṇu samujjalu
    sīẏahĕ maṇĕ pariosu  $  ṇisiẏara-valahŏ amaṅgalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 3:
jaṃ ṇisuṇiu hatthu pahatthu haü  $  ṇala-ṇīla-sarĕhĩ tamvāru gaü
taṃ palaẏa-kālu ovatthiẏaü  $  purĕ hāhākāru samutthiẏaü
ṇaṃ pakkhiuleṇa vimukka raḍi  $  ṇaṃ ṇivaḍiẏa mahihara-siharĕ taḍi
taṃ ṇaü gharu jetthu ṇa ruvaï dhaṇa  $  ubbhiẏa-kara dhāhāviẏa-vaẏaṇa
so ṇaü bhaḍu jāsu ṇa aṅgĕ vaṇu  $  so ṇaü pahu jo ṇaü vimaṇa-maṇu
so ṇaü rahu jo ṇa vi kappiẏaü  $  so ṇaü haü jo ṇa vi sara-bhariu
so ṇa vi gaü jāsu ṇa asi-paharu  $  so ṇa vi hari jo abhagga-ṇaharu
jaṇĕ ema kaṇantĕ pariṭṭhiẏaĕ  $  dukkhāurĕ ṇiddā-vasikiẏaĕ
ghattā:
addharattĕ paḍivaṇṇĕ  $  vijjāhara-paramesaru
    purĕ pacchaṇṇa-sarīru  $  bhamaï ṇāĩ jogesaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 4:
papphuliẏa-kuvalaẏa-dala-ṇaẏaṇu  $  karavāla-bhaẏaṅkaru dahavaẏaṇu
āhiṇḍaï raẏaṇihĩ gharĕṇa gharu  $  pekkhahũ ko kehaü cavaï ṇaru
païsaï accanta-maṇoharaĩ  $  pavaraĩ vara-kāmiṇi-raïharaĩ
jahĩ suraẏārambhu ṇaṭṭa-sarisu  $  jiha taṃ tiha tiṃ (?) vaḍḍhiẏa-harisu
jiha taṃ tiha bhū-bhaṅgura-vaẏaṇu  $  jiha taṃ tiha cala-cāliẏa-ṇaẏaṇu
jiha taṃ tiha āẏaḍḍhiẏa-ṇaharu  $  jiha taṃ tiha uggāmiẏa-paharu
jiha taṃ tiha gala-gambhīra-saru  $  jiha taṃ tiha darisiẏa-aṅgaharu
jiha taṃ tiha karaṇa-vandha-paüru  $  jiha taṃ tiha chanda-sadda-gahiru
ghattā:
pekkhĕvi suraẏārambhu  $  ṇaṭṭahŏ aṇuharamāṇaü
    sīẏa sarevi dasāsu  $  pariṇindaï appāṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 5:
thovantaru jāva paribbhamaï  $  sahũ kantaĕ ko vi vīru cavaï
"sundari miga-ṇaẏaṇĕ marāla-gaï  $  taṃ pahu-pasāu kiṃ vīsaraï
taṃ pesaṇu taṃ olaggiẏaü  $  taṃ jīviẏa-dāṇu amaggiẏaü
taṃ uccāsaṇu maṇi-veẏaḍiu  $  taṃ matta-gaïnda-khandhĕ caḍiu
taṃ mehalu taṃ kaṇṭhāharaṇu  $  taṃ celiu taṃ jĕ samālahaṇu
taṃ phullu sahattheṃ tamvolu  $  taṃ asaṇu su-parimalu kaccolu
taṃ cīru bhāru cāmīẏarahŏ  $  avara vi pasāẏa laṅkesarahŏ
eẏahũ jasu ekku ṇa āvaḍaï  $  so sattamĕ ṇaraẏaṇṇavĕ paḍaï
ghattā:
tahŏ uvagārahŏ kantĕ  $  ṇikkaü karami mahāhavĕ
    lāvami vaṇṇa-vicitta  $  tharaharanta sara rāhavĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi gaü rāvaṇu tettahĕ  $  mandoari-jaṇeru maü jettahĕ
jāla-gavakkhaĕ thiu ekkantaĕ  $  ṇisuu cavantu so vi sahũ kantaĕ
"dhaṇĕ vihāṇĕ maĩ eu karevaü  $  taṃ vaḍḍu pphara-jūu ramevaü
dāruṇu raṇa-kaḍittu maṇḍevaü  $  jīviu visarisu ṭhaülu ṭhavevaü
cāuraṅgu valu caü-dhura devī  $  jāṇaï khaḍiẏā-jutti laevī
paḍikattaü rahavara tāḍevā  $  haẏa-gaẏa-joha-choha pāḍevā
khagga-laṭṭhi karĕ katti karevī  $  jaẏasiri-līha dīha kaḍḍhevī
suhaḍa-kavandhu lekkhu piṇḍevaü  $  jīvagāhi riu-gahaṇu laevaü
ghattā:
daṇḍāsahiu kiẏantu  $  luhaü līha pisuṇa-ẏaṇahŏ
    para-valu jiṇĕvi asesu  $  appevaü dahavaẏaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rāvaṇu tuṭṭha-maṇu  $  sañcalliu māriccahŏ bhavaṇu
pacchaṇṇu pariṭṭhiu pavara-bhuu  $  sahũ kantaĕ so vi cavantu suu
"kallaĕ soṇiẏa-sammajjaṇaĕ  $  païsevaü maĩ raṇa-majjaṇaĕ
raha-gaẏa-vaḍḍhiẏa-gandhāmalaĕ  $  vara-asivara-kaṅkā-thāmalaĕ
ṇaravara-vihuraṅga-bhaṅga-karaṇĕ  $  jasa-uvvaṭṭaṇĕ vahu-mala-haraṇĕ
jaẏalacchi-haridda-vihūsiẏaĕ  $  samaraṅgaṇĕ kuṇḍa-padīsiẏaĕ
paravala-jalohĕ melāviẏaĕ  $  paharaṇa-davaggi-santāviẏaĕ
bhūgoẏara-ruhira-toa-bhariĕ  $  asidhārā-ṇiẏarĕ pavitthariĕ
ghattā:
vaïsĕvi kari-sira-vīḍhĕ  $  ṇhāmi paraĕ ṇīsaṅkaü
    jeṇa ṇa ḍhukkaï kantĕ  $  jammĕvi aẏasa-kalaṅkaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu adaẏāvaṇu  $  sua-sāraṇahã gharaĩ gaü rāvaṇu
ekkeṃ vuttu puraü ṇiẏa-bhajjahĕ  $  "kallaĕ caḍami kantĕ raṇa-sejjahĕ
bhuaṇa-ttaẏahŏ majjhĕ vikkhāẏahĕ  $  cāuraṅga-sāhaṇa-caüpāẏahĕ
gaẏavara-gatta-paīhara-gattahĕ  $  anta-lalanta-sumva-sañjuttahĕ
haḍḍa-ruṇḍa-vicchaḍḍatthariẏahĕ  $  kari-kumbhovahāṇa-vitthariẏahĕ
jasa-vaḍāẏa-hatthiṇiẏā-rūḍhahĕ  $  vāraṇa-mattavāraṇālīḍhahĕ"
aṇṇekkeṇa vuttu "suṇu sundari  $  guru-ṇiẏamvĕ viẏaḍa-urĕ kisoari
rahavara-gaẏavara-ṇaravara-valiẏahĕ  $  dhaẏa-toraṇahĕ samara-vāhaliẏahĕ
ghattā:
asi-covāṇa laevi  $  haṇuhaṇukāru karevaü
    kallaĕ suhaḍa-sirehĩ  $  maĩ jhinduĕṇa ramevaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 9:
duvvāra-vaïri-viṇivāraṇahũ  $  taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi sua-sāraṇahũ
sa-kalattahŏ gahiẏa-pasāhaṇahŏ  $  gaü mandiru toẏadavāhaṇahŏ
thiu jāla-gavakkhaĕ vaïsarĕvi  $  ṇaṃ kesari giri-guha païsarĕvi
ṇiẏa-ṇandaṇu galagajjantu suu  $  vaẏaṇubbhaḍu rahasubbhiṇṇa-bhuu
"ṇiẏa līla kantĕ taü dakkhavami  $  haũ kallaĕ raṇa-vasantu ravami
riu-soṇiẏa-ghusiṇeṃ cacciẏaü  $  sajjaṇa-caccari-pariañciẏaü
jasu demi vihajjĕvi suravarahũ  $  jama-varuṇa-kuvera-purandarahũ
rāvaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-suhāvaṇiẏa  $  dāvami daṇu-davaṇā-bhañjaṇiẏa
ghattā:
kari-kumbha-tthala-vīḍhĕ  $  asi vāra-ttī sandhami
   lakkhaṇa-rāma-sarehĩ  $  dhaṇĕ hiṃdolā vandhami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 10:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi ghaṇavāhaṇahŏ  $  
dujjaẏahŏ aṇiṭṭhiẏa-sāhaṇahŏ
gaü rāvaṇu para-maṇa-uddahaṇu  $  jahĩ jamvumāli païjāruhaṇu
teṇa vi galagajjiu gehiṇihĕ  $  sīheṇa va aggĕ sīhiṇihĕ
"suṇu kantĕ kallĕ kāĩ karami  $  jiha khaẏa-pāusu tiha uttharami
majjanta-matta-maẏagala-ghaṇĕhĩ  $  daḍi-daddura-bherī-varahiṇĕhĩ
vandiṇĕhĩ lavantaĕhĩ vappihĕhĩ  $  paharaṇa-duvvāĕhĩ vahu-vihĕhĩ
rahavara-pavarabbhāḍamvarĕhĩ  $  asivara-vijjulĕhĩ bhaẏaṅkarĕhĩ
ghattā:
chatta-valāẏā-panti  $  dhaṇu-suradhaṇu darisantaü
    varisami sara-dhārehĩ  $  para-valĕ palaü karantaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi gaü laṅkesu tahĩ  $  sa-kalattaü indaï-rāu jahĩ
teṇa vi galagajjiu ṇiẏa-bhavaṇĕ  $  ṇāvaï khala-jalahareṇa gaẏaṇĕ
"haũ kallaĕ palaẏa-huāsu dhaṇĕ  $  laggesami rāhava-seṇṇa-vaṇĕ
paharaṇa-sippīra-pahara-paürĕ  $  duddhara-ṇaravara-taruvara-ṇiẏarĕ
bhuvadaṇḍa-caṇḍa-jāloli-dharĕ  $  karaẏala-pallava-ṇaha-kusuma-bharĕ
maṇahara-kāmiṇi-laẏa-vellahalĕ  $  chatta-ddhaẏa-sukka-rukkha-vahalĕ
haẏa-gaẏa-vaṇaẏara-ṇāṇāvihaĕ  $  riu-pāṇa-samuḍḍāviẏa-vihaĕ
uttaṭṭha-turaṅgama-hariṇa-harĕ  $  hari-halahara-vara-pavvaẏa-siharĕ
ghattā:
tahĩ haũ palaẏa-davaggi  $  kallaĕ vaṇĕ laggesami
    para-vala-kāṇaṇu savvu  $  chārahŏ puñju karesami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 62, Kaḍavaka 12:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi sañcallu tahĩ  $  bhaḍu kumbhaẏaṇṇu ṇiẏa-bhavaṇĕ jahĩ
teṇa vi pavuttu "he haṃsagaï  $  kallaĕ raṇa-ṇahaẏalĕ bhāṇuvaï
duppekkhu bhaẏaṅkaru duppagaü  $  saĩ hosami joisa-cakku haũ
karikumbha-kumbhu kovaṇḍa-dhaṇu  $  duvvāra-vāra-vāruvvahaṇu

      sampāiu  $  ṇāĩ sa iṃ bhu va ṇāhivaï
----------  [64. caüsaṭṭhimo saṃdhi]  ----------
daṇu-dāraṇa-paharaṇa-hatthaĩ  $  jaẏasiri-gahaṇa-samatthaĩ
raṇa-rasa-romañca-visaṭṭaĩ  $  valaĩ ve vi abbhiṭṭaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 1:
abbhiṭṭaĩ ve vi sa-vāhaṇāĩ  $  vāẏaraṇa-paẏāĩ va sāhaṇāĩ
jiha tāĩ temva hala-saṅgahāĩ  $  jiha tāĩ tema kiẏa-viggahāĩ
jiha tāĩ tema sandhiẏa-sarāĩ  $  jiha tāĩ tema paccaẏa-karāĩ
jiha tāĩ tema uvasaggirāĩ  $  jiha tāĩ temva jasa-maggirāĩ
jiha tāĩ tema para-loppirāĩ  $  vahu-ekka-du-vaẏaṇa-pajampirāĩ
jiha tāĩ temva atthujjalāĩ  $  pariẏāṇiẏa-saẏala-valāvalāĩ
jiha tāĩ temva ṇāsāẏarāĩ  $  jiha tāĩ tema vahu-bhāsirāĩ
aṇṇaṇṇa-sadda-viṇṇāsirāĩ  $  
ghattā:
jiha tāĩ tema āẏariẏaĩ  $  vāi-ṇivāẏahũ cariẏaĩ
    dīhara-samāsa-ahiẏaraṇaĩ  $  valaĩ ṇāĩ vāẏaraṇaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 2:
tahĩ tehaĕ raṇĕ raẏaṇīẏarāsu  $  saddūlu valiu vajjoarāsu
te bhiḍiẏa caṇḍa-kovaṇḍa-hattha  $  sura-samara-pavara-dhura-dhara-samattha
paü aggaĕ denti ṇa osaranti  $  paharanti ṇa paharaṇu vīsaranti
darisanti maḍappharu ṇeẏa puṭṭhi  $  jīviu siḍhilanti ṇa cāva-muṭṭhi
mellanti vāṇa ṇa muanti dhīru  $  parihaü rakkhanti ṇa ṇiẏa-sarīru
laggaï ṇārāu ṇa kulĕ kalaṅku  $  saru vaṅkaï vaẏaṇu ṇa hoi vaṅku
guṇu chijjaï sīsu ṇa duṇṇivāru  $  dhaü paḍaï ṇa hiẏaü ṇa purisaẏāru
ovuṇṇa-turaṅgama-dhura-visaṭṭu  $  rahu bhajjaï bhajjaï ṇaü maraṭṭu
ghattā:
paḍivakkha-pakkha-paḍikūlahũ  $  vajjoara-saddūlahũ
    vihĩ ko garuāraü kijjaï  $  ekku vi jiṇaï ṇa jijjaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 3:
ettahĕ vi bhiuḍi-bhaṅgura-vaẏaṇa  $  te vāhuvalinda-sīhadamaṇa
abbhiṭṭa ve vi vaddhāmarisa  $  girimalaẏa-suvelasela-sarisa
haridamaṇeṃ "paharu paharu" bhaṇĕvi  $  sirĕ moggara-ghāeṃ āhaṇĕvi
mahi-maṇḍalĕ pāḍiu vāhuvali  $  toseṇa va parivaḍḍhanta-kali
puṇu ceẏaṇa lahĕvi bhaẏaṅkarĕṇa  $  āruṭṭheṃ rāhava-kiṅkarĕṇa
paḍivāraü āhaü moggarĕṇa  $  vacchatthalĕ ṇaṃ indīvarĕṇa
tahĩ tehaĕ kālĕ samāvaḍiẏa  $  bhaḍa vijaẏa-saẏambhu ve vi bhiḍiẏa
raṇĕ parisakkanti bhamanti kiha  $  cala cañcala vijjula-puñja jiha
ghattā:
āẏāmĕvi rāvaṇa-bhiccĕṇa  $  ṇiẏa-kula-ṇaha-āiccĕṇa
    jaṭṭhiẏaĕ vijaü viṇibhiṇṇaũ  $  paḍiu ṇāĩ dumu chiṇṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 4:
raṇĕ vijaü saẏambhu vi ṇihaü jaṃ jĕ  $  khaviẏāri-vīra-saṅkoha taṃ jĕ
abbhiṭṭa paropparu pulaïaṅga  $  ṇaṃ khara-ṇārāẏaṇa raṇĕ abhaṅga
ṇaṃ rāvaṇinda vipphuriẏa-tuṇḍa  $  ṇaṃ gandhahatthi uddaṇḍa-suṇḍa
etthantarĕ suravarahu mi asakku  $  saṅkoheṃ melliu paḍhamu cakku
gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ taṃ pajalantu jāi  $  atthaïrihĕ diṇaẏara-vimvu ṇāĩ
khaviẏāri-ṇivahŏ vacchaẏalĕ laggu  $  jiha ṇaliṇi-pattu tiha tahĩ ji bhaggu
teṇa vi paḍivakkhahŏ cakku mukku  $  saṅkohahŏ ṇaṃ jamakaraṇu ḍhukku
siru khuḍiu marāleṃ jema kamalu  $  ṇaṃ indindiru ruṇṭanta-muhalu
ghattā:
siru gaẏaü kavandhu jĕ bhaṇḍaï  $  muhu bhaḍa-vokka ṇa chaṇḍaï
    ṇiẏa-sāmihĕ pesaṇu saraï (?)  $  viuṇaü ṇaṃ bhaḍu paharaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 5:
vala-kiṅkaru jaṃ saṅkohu haü  $  dhāviu vitāvi taṃ raṇĕ ajaü
"kahĩ gacchahi acchami jāma haũ  $  rahu vāhĕ vāhĕ savaḍammuhaü
saṅkohu jema ghāiu chaleṇa  $  tiha paharu paharu ṇiẏa-bhuva-valeṇa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi kira ovaḍaï  $  vihi-rāu tāmva tahŏ abbhiḍaï
te vihi-vitāvi āruṭṭha-maṇā  $  utthariẏa sa-macchara ve vi jaṇā
ṇaṃ palaẏa-kālĕ palaẏamvuharā  $  jiha te tiha sara-dhārā-vaẏarā
jiha te tiha paricakkaliẏa-dhaṇu  $  jiha te tiha vijjujjaliẏa-taṇu
jiha te tiha bhīma-ṇiṇāẏa-karā  $  jiha te tiha sūra-cchāẏa-harā
ghattā:
vihi-rāeṃ amarisa-kuddhĕṇa  $  ahiṇava-jaẏasiri-luddhĕṇa
     pāḍiu vitāvi ṇārāĕṇa  $  giri jiha vajja-ṇihāĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 6:
jaṃ haü vitāvi taṃ ṇa kiu kheu  $  kovaggi-palittu visālateu
vihi-rāẏahŏ bhiḍaï ṇa bhiḍaï jāma  $  hakkāriu sambhu-ṇiveṇa tāmva
te ve vi paropparu abbhiḍanti  $  ṇaṃ giri sa-parakkama ovaḍanti
etthantarĕ sambhũ ṇa kiu kheu  $  urĕ sattiĕ bhiṇṇu visālateu
oṇalliu mahiẏalĕ vigaẏa-pāṇu  $  ṇiẏa-sāhaṇu pekkhĕvi loṭṭamāṇu
suggīu padhāiu vipphurantu  $  "laï valahŏ valahŏ" samu uttharantu
ṇaṃ ṇisiẏara-seṇṇahŏ maïẏavaṭṭu  $  ṇaṃ kesari miga-jūhahŏ visaṭṭu
ṇaṃ tihuẏaṇa-cakkahŏ kāla-daṇḍu  $  ṇaṃ jalahara-vindahŏ palaẏa-caṇḍu
ghattā:
vijjāhara-vaṃsa-paīvahŏ  $  bhiḍamāṇahŏ suggīvahŏ
    thiu antarĕ vāhiẏa-sandaṇu  $  tāma pahañjaṇa-ṇandaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 7:
haṇuvanteṃ vuccaï "māma māma  $  tuhũ acchahi jahĩ somitti-rāma
haũ ekku pahuccami ṇisiẏarāhũ  $  jiha garuḍu asesahũ visaharāhũ
jiha dhūmakeu jagĕ ṇaravarāhũ  $  palaẏāṇalu jiha jara-taruvarāhũ
jiha palaẏa-pahañjaṇu jalaharāhũ  $  sura-kulisa-daṇḍu jiha girivarāhũ
valu ṇaṃ vaṇu bhañjami rasamasantu  $  vaṃsujjala-mūla-tarukkhaṇantu
raẏaṇīẏara-taruvara ṇiddalantu  $  bhuva-daṇḍa-caṇḍa-ḍālāhaṇantu
sulaliẏa-karaẏala-pallava lulantu  $  ṇakkhāvali-kusuma samucchalantu
dhaẏa-chattaĩ pattaĩ vikkhirantu  $  ṇaravara-sira-phala-sahasaĩ khuḍantu
ghattā:
galagajjĕvi añjaṇa-ṇandaṇu  $  sa-kavaü sa-gaü sa-sandaṇu
    para-valĕ païsaraï mahavvalu  $  viñjhĕ jema dāvāṇalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 8:
paḍhama-bhiḍanteṃ teṇa vāiṇā  $  vāsueva-vala-pakkhavāiṇā
haẏavareṇa ṇavarāhao hao  $  gaẏavareṇa jo āgao gao
rahavareṇa khaẏa-sūraho raho  $  dhaẏavaḍeṇa jasa-luddhao dhao
ṇaravareṇa vaẏaṇubbhaḍo bhaḍo  $  para-sireṇa para-saṃsiraṃ siraṃ
karaẏaleṇa su-bhaẏaṅkaro karo  $  bhaḍa-kameṇa sa-parakkamo kamo
dāruṇaṃ kaẏaṃ eva sañjuẏaṃ  $  haḍḍa-ruṇḍa-vicchaḍḍa-sañjuẏaṃ
suhaḍa-suhaḍa-sandāṇavantaẏaṃ  $  ghora-māri-sandāṇavantaẏaṃ
jattha tattha atthamiẏa-sūraẏaṃ  $  ṇisi-ṇahaṃ va atthamiẏa-sūraẏaṃ
chiṇṇa-vāhu-ṇibbhiṇṇa-vacchaẏaṃ  $  kāṇaṇaṃ va oṇalla-vacchaẏaṃ
ṇirasi pāṇi ṇīvikkamaṃ thiẏaṃ  $  khīra-jalahi-salilaṃ va manthiẏaṃ
ghattā:
jaṃ haṇuvahŏ valu ālaggaü  $  līlaĕ jimva timva bhaggaü
     savaḍammuhu vajjiẏa-saṅkaü  $  ekku māli para thakkaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 9:
thakkanteṃ kokkiu pavaṇa-puttu  $  "kiṃ kāẏarehĩ sahũ bhiḍĕvi juttu
valu valu sāmīraṇi dehi jujjhu  $  maĩ muĕvi mallu ko aṇṇu tujjhu
tuhũ rāmahŏ haũ rāmaṇahŏ dāsu  $  jiha tuhũ tiha haü mi mahi-ppagāsu
chuḍu ekku ma maïlaü ṇiẏaẏa-vaṃsu  $  jasu ruccaï jaẏa-siri hou tāsu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi uvavaṇa-maddaṇeṇa  $  docchiu pavaṇañjaẏa-ṇandaṇeṇa
"tuhũ kavaṇu gahaṇu maĩ dujjaeṇa  $  haṇuvanta-kaẏanteṃ kuddhaeṇa
kiṃ ṇa suaü khaü vajjāuhāsu  $  ujjāṇa-bhaṅgu kiṅkara-viṇāsu
akkhahŏ kaẏantu paṭṭaṇahŏ keu  $  haũ so jjĕ paḍīvaü añjaṇeu
ghattā:
rahu vāhi vāhi savaḍammuhu  $  paharu paharu laï āuhu
    haũ paĩ ghāeṇa ji mārami  $  pahilaü teṇa ṇa paharami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 10:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi māliṃ ṇa kiu kheu  $  sara-jāleṃ chāiu añjaṇeu
ṇaṃ suaṇu aṇeĕhĩ dujjaṇehĩ  $  ṇaṃ pāusĕ diṇaẏaru ṇava-ghaṇehĩ
haṇuveṇa vi sara aṭṭha-uṇa mukka  $  pasaranta haṇanta diẏanta ḍhukka
āẏāsĕ ṇa manti ṇa dharaṇi-vīḍhĕ  $  ṇa dhaẏaggĕ ṇa rahavarĕ haẏa-pagīḍhĕ
aggalĕ pacchalĕ a-parippamāṇa  $  jaü jaü jĕ diṭṭhi taü taü ji vāṇa
osariu māli ṇivisantareṇa  $  rahu diṇṇu tāmva vajjoareṇa
hakkāriu ahimuhu pavaṇa-jāu  $  "kahĩ jāhi pāva khaẏa-kālu āu
ettaḍeṇa ji tujjhu maraṭṭu jāu  $  jaṃ bhaggu bhiḍanteṃ māli-rāu
ghattā:
haũ vajjoẏaru bhaḍa-maddaṇu  $  tuhũ pavaṇañjaẏa-ṇandaṇu
    abbhiḍahũ ve vi bhaẏa-bhāsura  $  raṇu pekkhantu surāsura"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 11:
te viṇṇi vi galagajjanta emva  $  mukkaṅkusa matta-gaïnda jemva
abbhiṭṭa mahāhavĕ atula-malla  $  paḍivakkha-pakkha-ṇikkhanta-salla
ahimāṇa-aṇubbhaḍa suddha-vaṃsa  $  saṅgāma-saĕhĩ laddha-ppasaṃsa
to ṇavara samīraṇa-ṇandaṇeṇa  $  khara-sūra-samappaha-sandaṇeṇa
vihĩ sarĕhĩ sarāsaṇu chiṇṇu tāsu  $  ṇaṃ hiẏaü khuḍiu vajjoẏarāsu
kira avaru cāu karĕ caḍaï jāmva  $  saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu rahu kiẏaü tāmva
jāmaṇṇa-mahārahĕ caḍaï vīru  $  dhaṇuharu vi tāvã kiu haẏa-sarīru
taïẏaü kovaṇḍu ṇa lei jāma  $  vīo vi mahārahu chiṇṇu tāma
ghattā:
to ṇisiẏaru jujjha-piẏāraü  $  vi-rahu kiẏaü ve-vāraü
    puṇu pacchalĕ vāṇĕhĩ salliu  $  mahiharu jiha oṇalliu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ haü vajjoaru bhaggu māli  $  taṃ sa-rahasu dhāiu jamvumāli
mandoari-ṇandaṇu daṇu-viṇāsu  $  saü sīhahũ rahĕ sañjuttu tāsu
te viẏaḍa-dāḍha orāli-vaẏaṇa  $  uddhusiẏa-kesa ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇa
kandhara-valagga-laṅgūla-daṇḍa  $  ṇaha-ṇiẏara-bhaẏaṅkara calaṇa-caṇḍa
āĕhĩ kari-kumbha-viẏāraṇehĩ  $  jasu ujjhaï rahu pañcāṇaṇehĩ
so jamvumāli maru-ṇandaṇāsu  $  givvāṇaravaṇa-vaṇa-maddaṇāsu
ālaggu su-karaẏalĕ karĕvi cāu  $  su-kalattu jeṃva jaṃ su-ppaṇāu
taṃ āẏāmĕvi vahu-macchareṇa  $  ṇārāu visajjiu ṇisiẏareṇa
ghattā:
jaṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇanda-jaṇeraü  $  dhaü haṇuvantahŏ keraü
    vindheppiṇu mahiẏalĕ pāḍiu  $  ṇaha-siri-hāru va toḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 13:
jaṃ chiṇṇu mahaddhaü duddhareṇa  $  taṃ pavaṇa-sueṇa dhaṇuddhareṇa
do dīhara vara-ṇārāẏa mukka  $  riu-rahavara-vīḍhāsaṇṇa ḍhukka
ekkeṇa kavaü ekkeṇa cāu  $  viddhaṃsiu ṇāĩ jiṇeṇa pāu
saṇṇāhu aṇṇu parihĕvi bhaḍeṇa  $  dhaṇuharu vi levi vihaḍapphaḍeṇa
haṇuvantu viddhu dīhara-sarehĩ  $  ṇaṃ komala-dala-indīvarehĩ
haṇuveṇa vi melliu addhaẏandu  $  aï-dīharu ṇāĩ samāsa-daṇḍu
ujjottiẏa teṇa samattha sīha  $  mattebha-kumbha-muttāhalīha
jagaḍanta pahiṇḍiẏa valu asesu  $  ohāiẏa-haẏa-gaẏa-ṇaravaresu
ghattā:
uddhuẏa-laṅgūla-paīhĕhĩ  $  valu khajjantaü sīhĕhĩ
    ṇāsaï bhaẏa-vevira-gattaü  $  avaropparu loṭṭantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 14:
valu saẏalu vi kiu bhaẏa-vihalu jāmva  $  haṇuvantu dasāṇaṇĕ bhiḍiu tāma
pañcāṇaṇa-sandaṇu pamaẏa-cindhu  $  thiu uḍḍĕvi raṇa-bhara-dhurahĕ khandhu
so jujjhamāṇu jaṃ diṭṭhu teṇa  $  saṇṇāhu laïu laṅkāhiveṇa
raṇa-rahasucchaliẏahŏ urĕ ṇa māi  $  suhi-saṅgamĕ garua-saṇehu ṇāĩ
puṇu dukkhu dukkhu āiddhu aṅgĕ  $  sīsakku kareppiṇu uttamaṅgĕ
āẏāmiu dhaṇuharu laïu vāṇu  $  pāraddhu samaru haṇuveṃ samāṇu
tahĩ tehaĕ kālĕ dhaṇuddhareṇa  $  rahu antarĕ diṇṇu mahoareṇa
hakkāriu mārui "thāhi thāhi  $  savaḍammuhu rahavaru vāhi vāhi"
ghattā:
taṃ suṇĕvi mahoaru jettahĕ  $  rahavaru vāhiu tettahĕ
    utthariẏa ve vi samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  ṇaṃ khaẏa-meha ṇahaṅgaṇĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 64, Kaḍavaka 15:
haṇuvantĕ mahoaru bhiḍiu jāma  $  so jamvumāli sampattu tāmva
sañjottĕvi rahavarĕ saẏala sīha  $  uddaṇḍa caṇḍa laṅgūla-dīha
sahũ teṇa parāiu mallavantu  $  dhundhuru dhūmakkhu kaẏantadantu
hālāhalu vijjulu vijjujīhu  $  bhiṇṇañjaṇu pahu bhua-phaliha-dīhu
jamahaṇṭu jamāṇaṇu kāladaṇḍu  $  vihi ḍiṇḍimu ḍamvaru ḍamaru caṇḍu
kusumāuhu akku maẏaṅku sakku  $  khaviẏāri sambhu kari maẏaraṇakku
suu sāraṇu maü māricci-rāu  $  vībhacchu mahoaru bhīmakāu
āĕhĩ laṅkāhiva-kiṅkarehĩ  $  veḍhiu haṇuvantu bhaẏaṅkarehĩ
ghattā:
jeṃ savvĕhĩ laïu akhattĕṇa  $  haṇuveṃ harisiẏa-gattĕṇa
    āẏāmiẏa samarĕ pacaṇḍĕhĩ  $  vaïri sa ĩ bhu va-daṇḍĕhĩ
----------  [65. paṃcasaṭṭhimo saṃdhi]  ----------
haṇuvantu raṇĕ  $  pariveḍhijjaï  $  ṇisiẏarĕhĩ
ṇaṃ gaẏaṇaẏalĕ  $  vāla-divāẏaru  $  jalaharĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 1:
para-valu aṇantu haṇuvantu ekku  $  gaẏa-jūhahŏ ṇāĩ maïndu thakku
ārokkaï kokkaï samuhu thāi  $  jahĩ jahĩ jĕ thaṭṭu tahĩ tahĩ jĕ dhāi
gaẏa-ghaḍa bhaḍa-thaḍa bhañjantu jāi  $  vaṃsatthalĕ laggu davaggi ṇāĩ
ekku  rahu mahāhavĕ rasa-visaṭṭu  $  paribhamaï ṇāĩ valĕ maïẏavaṭṭu
so ṇa vi bhaḍu jāsu ṇa maliu māṇu  $  so ṇa vi dhaü jāsu ṇa laggu vāṇu
so ṇa vi pahu jāsu ṇa kavaü chiṇṇu  $  so ṇa vi gaü jāsu ṇa kumbhu bhiṇṇu
so ṇa vi turaṅgu jasu guḍu ṇa tuṭṭu  $  so ṇa vi rahu jasu ṇa rahaṅgu phuṭṭu
so ṇa vi bhaḍu jāsu ṇa chiṇṇu gattu  $  taṃ ṇa vi vimāṇu jaṃ saru ṇa pattu
ghattā:
jagaḍantu valu  $  mārui hiṇḍaï jahĩ jĕ jahĩ
    saṅgāma-mahi  $  ruṇḍa-ṇirantara tahĩ jĕ tahĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 2:
jaṃ jiṇĕvi ṇa sakkiu vara-bhaḍehĩ  $  veḍhāviu mārui gaẏa-ghaḍehĩ
giri-sihara-gahira-kumbhatthalehĩ  $  aṇavaraẏa-galiẏa-gaṇḍatthalehĩ
chappaẏa-jhaṅkāra-maṇoharehĩ  $  ghaṇṭā-ṭaṅkāra-bhaẏaṅkarehĩ
taṇḍaviẏa-kaṇṇa-uddhua-karehĩ  $  mukkaṅkusehĩ maẏa-ṇibbharehĩ
jaṃ veḍhiu raṇa-muhĕ pavaṇa-jāu  $  taṃ dhāiu kaïdhaẏa-bhaḍa-ṇihāu
jahĩ jamvaü ṇīlu suseṇu haṃsu  $  gaü gavaü gavakkhu visuddha-vaṃsu
santāsu virāhiu sūrajotti  $  pīiṅkaru kiṅkaru lacchibhutti
candappahu candamarīci rambhu  $  saddūlu viulu kulapavaṇathambhu
ghattā:
āĕhĩ bhaḍĕhĩ  $  mārui uvveḍḍhāviẏaü
    ṇaṃ ṇiẏa-guṇĕhĩ  $  jīu va bhava mellāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 3:
raṇa-rasiĕhĩ vehāviddhaehĩ  $  pelliu paḍivakkhu kaïddhaehĩ
ṇāsaï vihaḍapphaḍu galiẏa-khaggu  $  cūrantu paropparu calaṇa-maggu
bhajjantaü pekkhĕvi ṇiẏaẏa-seṇṇu  $  rāvaṇu jaẏakārĕvi kumbhaẏaṇṇu
dhāiu bhaẏa-bhīsaṇu bhīma-kāu  $  ṇaṃ rāma-valahŏ khaẏa-kālu āu
parisakkaï raṇa-bhūmihĕ ṇa māi  $  giri mandaru thāṇahŏ caliu ṇāĩ
jaü jaü jĕ sa-maccharu dei diṭṭhi  $  taü taü jĕ paḍaï ṇaṃ palaẏa-viṭṭhi"
kŏ vi vāeṃ kŏ vi bhiuḍiĕ paṇaṭṭhu  $  kŏ vi ṭhiu avaṭhambhĕvi dharaṇi-vaṭṭhu
kŏ vi kaha vi kaḍacchaĕ ṇiru ṇilukku  $  kŏ vi dūrahŏ jjĕ pāṇĕhĩ vimukku
ghattā:
suggīva-valĕ  $  garuaü huaü halapphalaü
    ṇaṃ aggaharĕ  $  hatthi païṭṭhaü rāulaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 4:
uvveḍhāviu haṇuvantu jehĩ  $  ṇaü sakkiu vaẏaṇu vi ṇiĕvi tehĩ
paricintiu "laï āiu viṇāsu  $  kiẏa(?) valu jĕ karesaï ekku gāsu"
tahĩ avasarĕ dhāiu amiẏavindu  $  dahimuhu māhindu mahindu indu
raïvaddhaṇu ṇandaṇu kumuu kundu  $  maïkantu mahovahi maïsamuddu
kolāhalu taralu taraṅgu tāru  $  suggīu aṅgu aṅgaẏakumāru
sammeu seu sasimaṇḍalo vi  $  candāhu kandu bhāmaṇḍalo vi
pihumaï vasantu velandharo vi  $  velacchu suvelu jaẏandharo vi
āẏāmĕvi vaïrihi taṇaü seṇṇu  $  samakaṇḍiu savvĕhĩ kumbhaẏaṇṇu
ghattā:
ekkallaĕṇa  $  to vi calanteṃ sammuhĕṇa
    valu tāsiẏaü  $  gaẏa-jūhu va pañcāṇaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 5:
jaṃ khattu muevi kaïddhaehĩ  $  samakaṇḍiu vehāviddhaehĩ
tahĩ kaïkasi-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇeṇa  $  rūsĕvi raẏaṇāsava-ṇandaṇeṇa
dāruṇu thambhaṇa-mohaṇa-samatthu  $  pammukku daṃsaṇāvaraṇa-atthu
sovāviu sāhaṇu saẏalu teṇa  $  ṇaṃ jagu atthanteṃ diṇaẏareṇa
ko vi ghummaï ko vi sarīru valaï  $  kāsu vi kivāṇu karaẏalahŏ galaï
ghuruhuraï ko vi ṇiddaĕ bhuttu  $  ko vi gabbhantarĕ ṇaru ṇāĩ suttu
etthantarĕ kikkindhāhiveṇa  $  paḍivohaṇatthu pammukku teṇa
ummohiu uṭṭhiu valu turantu  $  "kahĩ kumbhaẏaṇṇu valu valu" bhaṇantu
ghattā:
savaḍammuhaü  $  puṇu vi paḍīvaü dhāviẏaü
    ṇaṃ uvahi-jalu  $  mahi rellantu parāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 6:
para-valu ṇievi raṇĕ uttharantu  $  laṅkāhiveṇa tharatharaharantu
karĕ kaḍḍhiu ṇimmalu candahāsu  $  uggamiu ṇāĩ diṇaẏara-sahāsu
riu-sāhaṇĕ bhiḍaï ṇa bhiḍaï jāma  $  soṇḍīra vīra ṇara tiṇṇi tāmva
indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa-vajjaṇakka  $  sira-ṇamiẏa-kiẏañjali-hattha thakka
"amhĕhĩ jīvantĕhĩ kiṅkarehĩ  $  tuhũ appaṇu paharahi kiṃ karehĩ"
sāmiu sammāṇĕvi vaddha-koha  $  tiṇṇi vi samaraṅgaṇĕ bhiḍiẏa joha
candoara-taṇaẏahŏ vajjaṇakku  $  ghaṇavāhaṇu bhāmaṇḍalahŏ thakku
indaï suggīvahŏ samuhu valiu  $  ṇaṃ meru mahoahi mahahũ caliu
ghattā:
ṇaru ṇaravarahŏ  $  turaẏahŏ turaü samāvaḍiu
    rahu rahavarahŏ  $  gaẏahŏ mahaggaü abbhiḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 7:
sañjuĕ jaẏa-lacchi-pasāhaṇeṇa  $  tihuaṇakaṇṭaẏa-gaẏa-vāhaṇeṇa
hakkāriu suravaï-maddaṇeṇa  $  suggīu dasāṇaṇa-ṇandaṇeṇa
"khala khudda pisuṇa kaï-keu rāẏa  $  laṅkāhiva-kerā kuddha pāẏa
jiha rāvaṇu mellĕvi dhariu rāmu  $  tiha paharu paharu taü luhami ṇāmu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kikkindhesareṇa  $  vijjāhara-ṇara-paramesareṇa
ṇibbhacchiu indaï "arĕ ku-malla  $  ko tuhũ ko rāvaṇu kavaṇu (?) volla"
docchanta paropparu bhiḍiẏa ve vi  $  su-paṇāmaĩ cāvaĩ karĕhĩ levi
dīhara-ṇārāĕhĩ uttharanta  $  ṇaṃ palaẏa-jalaẏa ṇava-jalu muanta
ghattā:
vihĩ mi jaṇĕhĩ  $  chāiu gaẏaṇu mahāsarĕhĩ
    ṇava-gabbhiṇĕhĩ  $  pāusa-kālĕ va jalaharĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 8:
duddama-daṇuvaï-dāraṇa-samatthu  $  indaïṇāmelliu vāruṇatthu
atthakkaĕ sura-dhaṇu pāẏaḍantu  $  gajjanta-jalaü taḍi-taḍaẏaḍantu
aṇavaraü ṇīra-dhāraü muantu  $  ahiṇava-kalāva-kekkāra-dentu
taṃ pekkhĕvi tārāvaï palittu  $  dhūmaddhaü ṇaṃ māruĕṇa chittu
vāẏava-saru suggīveṇa mukku  $  ṇaṃ palaẏa-kālu para-valahŏ ḍhukku
vāoli dhūli pāhaṇa muantu  $  dhaẏa-chattadaṇḍa-daṇḍuddhuvantu
dugghoṭṭa-thaṭṭa loṭṭantu savva  $  moḍantu mahāraha atula-gavva
duvvāu āu jaṃ vala-viṇāsu  $  teṇa vi āmelliu ṇāga-vāsu
ghattā:
suggīu raṇĕ  $  veḍhiu pavara-sareṇa kiha
    valavantaĕṇa  $  ṇāṇāvaraṇeṃ jīu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 9:
kikkindha-ṇarāhiu dhariu jāma  $  ghaṇavāhaṇa-bhāmaṇḍalahã tāma
abbhiṭṭu paropparu jujjhu ghoru  $  sari-sotta-saüttara-pahara-thoru
chijjanta-mahaggaẏa-garua-gattu  $  ṇivaḍanta-samuddhuẏa-dhavala-chattu
loṭṭanta-mahāraha-haẏa-rahaṅgu  $  ghummanta-paḍanta-mahāturaṅgu
phuṭṭanta-kavaü tuṭṭanta-khaggu  $  ṇaccanta-kavandhaẏa-asi-karaggu
āẏāmĕvi raṇĕ rosiẏa-maṇeṇa  $  aggeu mukku ghaṇavāhaṇeṇa
āmelliu āiu dhagadhagantu  $  aṅgāra-varisu ṇahĕ dakkhavantu
vāruṇu vimukku bhāmaṇḍaleṇa  $  ṇaṃ girihĕ vajju ākhaṇḍaleṇa
ulhāviu jalaṇu jaleṇa jaṃ jĕ  $  saru ṇāga-pāsu pammukku taṃ jĕ
ghattā:
pupphavaï-suu  $  dīhara-pavara-mahāsarĕhĩ
      pariveḍhiẏaü  $  malaẏadharendu va visaharĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 10:
jaṃ jiu tārāvaï pavara-bhuu  $  aṇṇu vi bhāmaṇḍalu jaṇaẏa-suu
taṃ bhaggu asesu vi rāma-valu  $  ṇaṃ pavaṇa-galitthaü uvahi-jalu
ettahĕ vi tāma samāvaḍiẏa  $  maruṇandaṇa-kumbhaẏaṇṇa bhiḍiẏa
paharantahũ vaïri-viẏāraṇaĩ  $  ṇiṭṭhiẏaĩ aṇeẏaĩ paharaṇaĩ
puṇu vāhāuddheṃ lagga kiha  $  uddaṇḍa-soṇḍa veẏaṇḍa jiha
haṇuvantu laïu raẏaṇīẏarĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ meru-mahāgiri jiṇavarĕṇa
caraṇehĩ dharĕvi uccāiẏaü  $  ṇaṃ giri-sihareṇa caḍāviẏaü
puṇu laṅkā-ṇaẏarihĩ uccaliu  $  tārā-taṇaeṇa tāma khaliu
ghattā:
dhuttattaṇĕṇa  $  samara-saehĩ ahaṅgaĕṇa
    ṇīsaṅgu  $  riu vivatthu kiu aṅgaĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 11:
jaṃ kiu vivatthu raṇĕ raẏaṇiẏaru  $  taṃ laggu hasevaĕ sura-ṇiẏaru
rāvaṇa-anteuru lajjiẏaü  $  thiu vaṅka-vaẏaṇu dihi-vajjiẏaü
santhavaï jāmva ṇiẏa-parihaṇaü  $  mārui vimāṇu gaü appaṇaü
tahĩ avasarĕ bhaḍa-bhañjaṇa-maṇĕṇa  $  jaẏakāriu rāmu vihīsaṇeṇa
"maĩ deva bhiḍantaü pekkhu raṇĕ  $  jiha jalaṇu jalantaü sukka-vaṇĕ
jaï maïlami vaẏaṇu ṇa para-valahŏ  $  to païsami dhūmaddhaĕ salahŏ"
galagajjĕvi ema ṇisāẏarĕṇa  $  kiu karĕ kovaṇḍu a-kāẏareṇa
saṇṇāhu laïu rahavarĕ caḍiu  $  rāvaṇa-ṇandaṇahŏ gampi bhiḍiu
hakkāraï paharaï ṇindaï vi  $  paṇavaï ghaṇavāhaṇu indaï vi
"tuhũ amhahã vandaṇa-joggu kiha  $  tihĩ sañjhahĩ parama-jiṇindu jiha
ghattā:
jo jaṇaṇa-samu  $  tahŏ kiṃ pāveṃ cintiĕṇa
     kira kavaṇu jasu  $  jujjhantahũ sahũ pittiĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 12:
raṇu pittieṇa sahũ pariharĕvi  $  viṇṇi vi kumāra gaẏa osarĕvi
ekkeṃ bhāmaṇḍalu dharĕvi ṇiu  $  aṇṇekkeṃ tārā-pāṇapiu
kuḍhĕ laggĕvi ko vi ṇa sakkiẏaü  $  amvarĕ amarĕhĩ kalaẏalu kiẏaü
tahĩ avasarĕ āsaṅkiẏa-maṇĕṇa  $  vuccaï valaeu vihīsaṇĕṇa
"jaï viṇṇi vi ṇiẏa ṇaravaï pavara  $  to ṇa vi haũ ṇa vi tuhũ ṇa vi iẏara
ṇa vi haẏa ṇa vi gaẏa rahavarĕhĩ sahũ  $  jaṃ jāṇahi taṃ cintavahi lahu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vūḍha-mahāhavĕṇa  $  mahaloẏaṇu cintiu rāhavĕṇa
uvasagga-haraṇĕ viṇṇi mi jaṇāhũ  $  kulabhūsaṇa-desavihūsaṇāhũ
ghattā:
parituṭṭhaĕṇa  $  vijjaü jiha vara-gehiṇiu
    jaṃ (?) diṇṇiẏaü  $  garuḍa-migāhiva-vāhiṇiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 65, Kaḍavaka 13:
so garuḍu deu jhāiu maṇĕṇa  $  tharahariu ṇavara sahũ āsaṇĕṇa
kira avahi paüñjĕvi saṅkiẏaü  $  "laï vujjhiu rāmeṃ cintiẏaü"
puṇu cintĕvi deu samuṭṭhiẏaü  $  lahu vijjaü leppiṇu paṭṭhaviu
harivāhaṇi satta-saĕhĩ sahiẏa  $  gāruḍa tāhĕ vi ti-saĕhĩ ahiẏa
ve chattaĩ sasi-sūra-ppahaĩ  $  raẏaṇāĩ tiṇṇi raṇĕ dūsahaĩ
gaẏa vijja patta ṇārāẏaṇahŏ  $  hala-musalaĩ sīra-ppaharaṇahŏ
cintiẏa-mettaĩ sampāiẏaĩ  $  mukkaĩ para-valahŏ padhāiẏaĩ
tahĕ gāruḍa-vijjahĕ daṃsaṇĕṇa  $  gaẏa ṇāga-pāsa ṇāsĕvi khaṇĕṇa
ghattā:
bhāmaṇḍalĕṇa  $  suggīveṇa vi gampi valu
    jokkāriẏaü  $  lāĕvi sirĕ sa ĩ bhu va-juvalu
----------  [66. chāsaṭṭhimo saṃdhi]  ----------
jujjhaṇa-maṇaĩ  $  aruṇuggamĕ kiẏa-kalaẏalaĩ
abbhiṭṭāĩ  $  puṇu vi rāma-rāmvaṇa-valaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 66, Kaḍavaka 1:
gaẏavara-turaẏa-joha-raha-sīha-vimāṇa-pavāhaṇāiṃ  $  raṇa-tūraĩ haẏāĩ kiu kalaẏalu bhiḍiẏaĩ sāhaṇāiṃ
jāu mahāhavu vehāviddhahũ  $  valahũ ṇisāẏara-vāṇara-cindhahũ
daṇu-viṇivāraṇa-paharaṇa-hatthahũ  $  amara-varaṅgaṇa-gahaṇa-samatthahũ
pariosāviẏa-suravara-satthahũ  $  vaddhiẏa-jaẏasiri-vikkama-panthahũ
galagajjanta-matta-māẏaṅgahũ  $  pavaṇa-gamaṇa-pakkhariẏa-turaṅgahũ
dappubbhaḍahũ samuṇṇaẏa-māṇahũ  $  ghaṇṭā-ghaṇa-ṭaṅkāra-vimāṇahũ
saguḍa-saṇāhahũ sandaṇa-vīḍhahũ  $  puvva-vaïra-macchara-parigīḍhahũ
uddhuva-dhavala-chatta-dhaẏa-daṇḍahũ  $  pavara-karapphāliẏa-kovaṇḍahũ
melliẏa-ekkamekka-sara-jālahũ  $  tikkhuggāmiẏa-kara-karavālahũ
ghattā:
bhiḍĕ paḍhamaẏarĕ  $  raü calaṇāhaü laïẏa-chalu
      ṇaṃ utthiẏaü  $  suaṇa-muhaĩ maïlantu khalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 66, Kaḍavaka 2:
khura-khara-chajjamāṇu ṇaṃ ṇāsaï bhaïẏaĕ haẏavarāhuṃ  $  ṇaṃ āiu ṇivārao ṇaṃ hakkāraü suravarāhuṃ
ṇaṃ pāẏa-pahārahŏ osarĕvi  $  dhāiu ṇiẏa-parihaü sambharĕvi
ṇaṃ dujjaṇu sīsa-valaggu kiu  $  ṇaṃ uttamu savvahũ uari thiu
so ṇa vi rahu jetthu ṇa païsariu  $  so ṇa vi gaü jo ṇa vi dhūsariu
so ṇa vi haü jo ṇa vi maïliẏaü  $  so ṇa vi dhaü jo ṇa vi kavaliẏaü
jaü ramaï diṭṭhi taü raẏa-ṇiẏaru  $  ṇaü ṇāvaï maṇusu ṇa raẏaṇiẏaru
tettahĕ vi ke vi dhāvanti bhaḍa  $  jettahĕ galagajjaï hatthi-haḍa
jettahĕ sandaṇa daṇu-mīsiẏaĩ  $  suvvanti turaṅgama-hiṃsiẏaĩ
jettahĕ dhaṇuhara guṇa-gahiẏa-sara  $  jettahĕ huṅkāra muanti ṇara
ghattā:
tehaĕ samarĕ  $  sūrāha mi bhajjanti maï
      gaẏa-girivarĕhĩ  $  tāma samuṭṭhiẏa ruhira-ṇaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 66, Kaḍavaka 3:
gaẏavara-gaṇḍa-sela-sihagga-viṇiggaẏa ṇaï turanti  $  uddhuva-dhavala-chatta ḍiṇḍīruppīla-samuvvahanti
pavarojjhara-soṇiẏa-jala-pavāha  $  kari-maẏara-turaṅgama-ṇakka-gāha
cakkohara-sandaṇa-suṃsumāra  $  karavāla-maccha-parihaccha-vāra
mattebha-kumbha-bhīsaṇa-siloha  $  siẏa-camara-valāẏā-panti-soha
taṃ ṇaï tarevi kĕ vi vāvaranti  $  vuḍḍanti ke vi kĕ vi uvvaranti
ke vi raẏa-dhūsara kĕ vi ruhira-litta  $  kĕ vi hatthi-haḍaĕ vihuṇevi ghitta
kĕ vi lagga paḍīvā danta-musalĕ  $  ṇaṃ dhutta vilāsiṇi-sihiṇa-jualĕ
kĕ vi ṇiẏaẏa-vimāṇahŏ jhampa denti  $  ṇahĕ ṇivaḍĕvi vaïrihĩ siraĩ lenti
tahĩ tehaĕ raṇĕ soṇiẏa-jaleṇa  $  raü ṇāsiu sajjaṇu jiha khaleṇa
ghattā:
rāvaṇa-valĕṇa  $  kiu vivarāmuhu rāma-valu
      paḍipelliẏaü  $  ṇaṃ duvvāeṃ uvahi-jalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 66, Kaḍavaka 4:

tahŏ suravara-paramesarahŏ  $  kiẏa vandaṇa bharaha-ṇarindeṃ

ṇiruvama-taṇu aïsaeṇa sahaï  $  vammaha-dhāṇukkiẏa-līla vahaï

bhaüha-cāva-loẏaṇa-guṇĕhĩ  $  jasu diṭṭhi-sarāsaṇi lāvaï

START

ṇivaḍiẏa diṭṭhi tāva tahŏ tettahĕ  $  vasaï aṇaṅgavāṇa sā jettahĕ
muddhaẏanda-muha muddhaḍa vālī  $  ahiṇava-rambha-gabbha-somālī

mālaï-mālā-maüẏa-karālaĕ  $  ṇaẏaṇahĩ viddhu aṇaṅgasarālaĕ
viṇu cāveṃ viṇu viraïẏa-thāṇeṃ  $  viṇu guṇehĩ viṇu sara-sandhāṇeṃ

loẏaṇa-sara-paharāhaĕṇa  $  karavālu bhaẏaṅkaru dāvĕvi

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 68, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ ahiṇava-komala-kamala-karā  $  valimaṇḍaĕ levi aṇaṅgasarā
sa-vimāṇu pavaṇa-maṇa-gamaṇa-gaü  $  devahũ dāṇavahu mi raṇĕ ajaü

kovaggi-palitta-phuriẏa-vaẏaṇā  $  daṭṭhāhara bhū-bhaṅgura-ṇaẏaṇā

taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kovāṇala-jaliu  $  ṇaṃ sīhu gaïnda-thaṭṭĕ valiu
teṃ paḍhama-bhiḍanteṃ bhaggu valu  $  ṇāvaï avasaddeṃ kavva-dalu
ghattā:
kaha vi paropparu santhavĕvi  $  sa-dhaẏaggu sa-hei sa-vāhaṇu
    girivarĕ jalahara-vindu jiha  $  utthariu paḍīvaü sāhaṇu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 68, Kaḍavaka 10:

ṇāsaṅghiu jaṃ arivara-ṇivahu  $  taṃ vijja sareppiṇu paṇṇalahu
ghattiẏa dharaṇiẏalĕ aṇaṅgasarā  $  ṇaṃ saraẏa-miẏaṅkeṃ joṇha varā
su paṇaṭṭhu puṇavvasu gīḍha-bhaü  $  ṇaṃ hariṇu sarāsaṇi-tāsu gaü
alahanta vatta kaṇṇahĕ taṇiẏa  $  kiṅkara vi patta puri appaṇiẏa
anteuru lakkhiu vimaṇa-maṇu  $  ṇaṃ tuhiṇa-chittu saẏavatta-vaṇu
atthāṇu vi soha ṇa dei kiha  $  jovvaṇu viṇu kāma-kahāĕ jiha
ghattā:
kahiu ṇarindahŏ kiṅkarĕhĩ  $  "jalĕ thalĕ gaẏaṇaẏalĕ gaviṭṭhī

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 68, Kaḍavaka 11:
etthantarĕ chaṇa-miẏaṅka-muhiẏa  $  tihuaṇaāṇanda-rāẏa-duhiẏa
paṇṇalahua-vijjaĕ ghitta tahĩ  $  suṇṇāsaṇu bhīsaṇu raṇṇu jahĩ
jahĩ dāriẏa-kari-kumbha-tthalaĩ  $  ucchaliẏa-dhavala-muttāhalaĩ
duppekkha-tikkha-ṇakkhaṅkiẏaĩ  $  dīsanti sīha-parisakkiẏaĩ
jahĩ danti-danta-musalāhaẏaĩ  $  dīsanti bhagga pāẏava-saẏaĩ
jahĩ visama-taḍaĩ mahiẏalĕ gaẏaĩ  $  vaṇamahisa-siṅga-juvalukkhaẏaĩ
suvvanti jetthu kaï-vukkiẏaĩ  $  ekalla-kola-ārukkiẏaĩ
vaṇavasaha-jūha-muha-ḍhekkiẏaĩ  $  vāẏasa-raḍiẏaĩ siva-phokkiẏaĩ

tahĩ tehaĕ vaṇĕ kāmasara  $  jala-vāhiṇi viula vihāvaï
    vaṅka-valaẏa-vibbhama-guṇĕhĩ  $  sari poḍha-vilāsiṇi ṇāvaï

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 68, Kaḍavaka 12:
tahĩ jalavāhiṇi-taḍĕ vaïsarĕvi  $  dhāhāviu kulaharu sambharĕvi

hā bhāi bhāi mambhīsa karĕ  $  gaẏa vaggha siṅgha ḍhukkanta dharĕ
hā vihi hā kāĩ kiẏanta kiu  $  eu vasaṇu kāĩ mahu dakkhaviu
hā kāĩ kiẏaĩ maĩ dukkiẏaĩ  $  jaṃ ṇihi dāvĕvi ṇaẏaṇaĩ hiẏaĩ

jeṃ bhava-saṃsārahŏ uttarami  $  ajarāmara-puravaru païsarami"
sā ema bhaṇĕvi saṇṇāsĕ thiẏa  $  hattha-saẏahŏ uvari ṇivitti kiẏa
ghattā:
varisahũ saṭṭhi sahāsa thiẏa  $  tava-caraṇĕ pariṭṭhiẏa jāvĕhĩ
    ṇava-maẏalañchaṇa-leha jiha  $  saüdāseṃ dīsaï tāvĕhĩ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 68, Kaḍavaka 13:
chuḍu chuḍu tahĩ pavara-bhuaṅgamĕṇa  $  dehaddhu giliu ura-jaṅgamĕṇa
vollijjaï to vijjāharĕṇa  $  "kiṃ hammaü ajagaru asivarĕṇa"

akkhejjahi tāẏahŏ eha vihi  $  tuha duhiẏaĕ rakkhiẏa sīla-ṇihi
tava-caraṇu ṇirosahu ujjaviu  $  ajaẏarahŏ sarīru samallaviu"

saẏaṇahũ uppāiu dāhu para  $  jiṇu jaẏa-bhaṇanti mua 'ṇaṅgasara

eha vi marĕvi aṇaṅgasara  $  uppaṇṇa visallā-sundari

vijjāhara-vaẏaṇa-rasāẏaṇĕṇa  $  āsāsiu valahaddu kiha
ṇahĕ paḍivā-ẏandeṃ diṭṭhaĕṇa  $  kahi mi ṇa māiu uvahi jiha

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 1:
sarahasĕṇa parajjiẏa-āhaveṇa  $  sāmanta pajoiẏa rāhaveṇa

te jaṇaẏa-pavaṇa-suggīva-suẏa  $  rāmahŏ calaṇĕhĩ paḍiẏa kiha

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 2:
ārūḍha vimāṇĕhĩ sundarehĩ  $  amarehi va savva-suhaṅkarehĩ
cumvaṇĕhĩ va ṇāṇāviha-sarehĩ  $  siva-paẏahĩ va muttāvali-dharehĩ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 4:
jahĩ juvaï-paūru-parajjiẏāĩ  $  rattuppala-kaẏali-vaṇaĩ thiẏāĩ

kara-karaẏala-ohāmiẏa-maṇāĩ  $  jahĩ mālaï-kaṅkellī-vaṇāĩ

bhaühāvali-chāẏā-vaṅkiẏāĩ  $  jahĩ ṇimva-dalaĩ kaḍuẏaĩ kiẏāĩ
jahĩ cihura-bhāra-ohāmiẏāĩ  $  varahiṇa-kulāĩ rovāviẏāĩ

kikkindha-mahāgiri lakkhiẏaü  $  tuṅga-siharu koḍḍāvaṇaü

_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 5:
jahĩ indaṇīla-kara-bhijjamāṇu  $  sasi thāi juṇṇa-dappaṇa-samāṇu

jahĩ maragaẏa-khāṇi vi vipphuranti  $  sasi-vimvu bhisiṇi-pattu va karanti

puṇu diṭṭha mahāṇaï tuṅgabhadda  $  kari-maẏara-maccha-ohara-raüdda
ghattā:
asahanteṃ vaṇadava-pavaṇa-jhaḍa  $  dūsaha-kiraṇa-divāẏarahŏ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 6:
puṇu diṭṭha pavāhiṇi kiṇhavaṇṇa  $  kiviṇattha-paütti va mahi-ṇisaṇṇa

puṇu sari bhīmarahi jaloha-phāra  $  jā seuṇa-desahŏ amiẏa-dhāra

thovantarālĕ puṇu viñjhu thāi  $  sīmantaü pihimihĕ taṇaü ṇāi
puṇu revā-ṇaï haṇuvaṅgaehĩ  $  sā ṇindiẏa rosa-vasaṅgaehĩ

"jaṃ viñjhu muĕvi gaẏa sāẏarahŏ  $  mā rūsahŏ revā-ṇaïhĕ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 7:
sā ṇammaẏa dūrantarĕṇa catta  $  puṇu ujjaẏaṇi ṇiviseṇa patta
jahĩ jaṇavaü sa-dhaṇu mahā-ghaṇo vva  $  rāmovari vacchalu lakkhaṇo vva
guṇavantaü dhaṇuhara-saṅgaha vva  $  amuṇiẏa-kara-sira-taṇu vammaho vva
sa vi dummahila va ujjeṇi mukka  $  puṇu pāriẏattu mālavaü ḍhukka
jo dhaṇṇālaṅkiu ṇaravaï vva  $  ucchuhaṇu kusumasaru raïvaï vva
taṃ mellĕvi jaüṇā-ṇaï pavaṇṇa  $  jā alaẏa-jalaẏa-gavalāli-vaṇṇa
jā kasiṇa bhuaṅgi va visahŏ bhariẏa  $  kajjala-reha va ṇaṃ dharaĕ dhariẏa
thovantarĕ jala-ṇimmala-taraṅga  $  sasi-saṅkha-samappaha diṭṭha gaṅga
ghattā:
amhahã vihĩ garuvaü kavaṇu jaĕ  $  jujjhĕvi āeṃ maccharĕṇa
    himavantahŏ ṇaṃ avaharĕvi ṇiẏa  $  dhaẏa-vaḍāẏa raẏaṇāẏarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 8:
thovantarĕ tihi mi aüjjha diṭṭha  $  puṇu siddhipurihĩ siddha va païṭṭha
jahĩ mihuṇaĩ ārambhiẏa-raẏāĩ  $  panthiẏa iva uccāiẏa-paẏāĩ
pāhuṇa iva avaruṇḍaṇa-maṇāĩ  $  girivara-gattā iva savvaṇāĩ
avicala-rajjā iva su-karaṇāĩ  $  risiula iva bhāva-parāẏaṇāĩ
dhaṇuhara iva guṇa-melliẏa-sarāĩ  $  aharattā iva paharāurāĩ
puṇu ṇaravaï maṃdirĕ gaẏa turanta  $  muṇi-suvvaẏa-jiṇa-maṅgalaĩ ganta
saggāvaẏārĕ jammābhiseĕ  $  ṇikkhavaṇĕ ṇāṇĕ ṇivvāṇacchaĕ
titthaẏara-parama-devāhã jāĩ  $  pañca vi kallāṇaĩ honti tāĩ
ghattā:
"mahi mandaru sāẏaru jāva ṇahu  $  jāva disaü mahaṇaï-jalaĩ
     taü hontu tāva jiṇa-kerāĩ  $  puṇṇa-pavittaĩ maṅgalaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 9:
teṃ maṅgala-saddeṃ pahu viuddhu  $  ṇaṃ chaṇa-maẏalañchaṇu addha-addhu
ṇaṃ uaẏa-mahīharĕ taruṇa-mittu  $  ṇaṃ māṇasa-saru ravi-kiraṇa-chittu
ṇaṃ vāla-līlu kesari-kisoru  $  ṇaṃ suravaï sura-vahu-citta-coru
uṭṭhanteṃ vahu-maṇi-gaṇa-ciẏāĩ  $  lakkhiẏaĩ vimāṇaĩ khañciẏāĩ
ṇaṃ ṇahaẏala-kamalaĩ vihasiẏāĩ  $  sajjaṇa-vaẏaṇāĩ va pahasiẏāĩ
ṇikkāraṇĕ jāĩ papphulliẏāĩ  $  su-kalattaĩ ṇāĩ samalliẏāĩ
ṇiddiṭṭha vimāṇĕhĩ tehĩ vīra  $  savvāharaṇālaṅkiẏa-sarīra
paripucchiẏa "tumhĕ paẏaṭṭa ketthu  $  kiṃ māẏāpurisa paḍhukka etthu
ghattā:
hemanta-gimha-pāusa-samaẏa  $  kiṃ avaẏavĕhĩ alaṅkariẏa
    kiṃ tiṇṇi vi hari-hara-caüvaẏaṇa  $  āeṃ veseṃ avaẏariẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 10:
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa bharahahŏ taṇeṇa  $  vollijjaï jaṇaẏahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa
"haũ bhāmaṇḍalu haṇuvantu ehu  $  uhu aṅgaü rahasucchaliẏa-dehu
tiṇṇi vi āiẏa kajjeṇa jeṇa  $  suṇu akkhami kiṃ vahu-vitthareṇa
sīẏahĕ kāraṇĕ rosiẏa-maṇāhã  $  raṇu vaṭṭaï rāhava-rāvaṇāhã
lakkhaṇu sattiĕ viṇibhiṇṇu tetthu  $  dukkaru jīvaï teṃ āẏa etthu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi paripālielu  $  ṇaṃ kulisa-samāhaü paḍiu selu
ṇaṃ cavaṇa-kālĕ saggahŏ surindu  $  ummucchiu kaha vi kaha vi ṇarindu
dukkhāuru dhāhāvaṇahĩ laggu  $  puṇṇa-kkhaĕ hari va muantu saggu
ghattā:
"hā paĩ somitti marantaĕṇa  $  maraï ṇiruttaü dāsarahi
    bhattāra-vihūṇiẏa ṇāri jiha  $  ajju aṇāhīhūẏa mahi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 11:
hā bhāẏara ekkasi dehi vāẏa  $  hā paĩ viṇu jaẏa-siri vihava jāẏa
hā bhāẏara mahu sirĕ paḍiu gaẏaṇu  $  hā hiẏaü phuṭṭu dakkhavahi vaẏaṇu
hā bhāẏara varahiṇa-mahura-vāṇi  $  mahu ṇivaḍio 'si dāhiṇaü pāṇi
hā kiṃ samuddĕ jala-ṇivahu khuṭṭu  $  hā kiha diḍhu kumma-kaḍāhu phuṭṭu
hā kiha suravaï lacchiĕ vimukku  $  hā kiha jamarāẏahŏ maraṇu ḍhukku
hā kiha diṇaẏaru kara-ṇiẏara-cattu  $  hā kiha aṇaṅgu dohaggu pattu
hā cañcalihūaü kema meru  $  hā kema jāu ṇiddhaṇu kuveru
ghattā:
hā ṇivvisu kiha dharaṇindu thiu  $  ṇippahu sasi sihi sīẏalaü
    ṭalaṭalihūī kema mahi  $  kema samīraṇu ṇiccalaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 12:
labbhaï raẏaṇāẏarĕ raẏaṇa-khāṇi  $  labbhaï koila-kulĕ mahura-vāṇi
labbhaï candaṇu giri-malaẏa-siṅgĕ  $  labbhaï suhavattaṇu juvaï-aṅgĕ
labbhaï dhaṇu dhaṇaĕ dharā-pavaṇṇu  $  labbhaï kañcaṇa-pāvaĕ suvaṇṇu
labbhaï pesaṇĕ sāmiẏa-pasāu  $  labbhaï kiĕ viṇaĕ jaṇāṇurāu
labbhaï sajjaṇĕ guṇa-dāṇa-kitti  $  siẏa asivarĕ guru-kulĕ parama titti
labbhaï vasiẏaraṇĕ kalatta-raẏaṇu  $  mahakavvĕ suhāsiu sukaï-vaẏaṇu
labbhaï uvaẏāra-maïĕ su-mittu  $  maddavĕhĩ vilāsiṇi-cāru-cittu
labbhaï para-tīrĕ mahagghu bhaṇḍu  $  vara-velu-mūlĕ veḍujja-khaṇḍu
ghattā:
gaĕ mottiu siṅghala-dīvĕ maṇi  $  vaïrāgarahŏ vajju paüru
    āẏaĩ savvaĩ labbhanti jaĕ  $  ṇavara ṇa labbhaï bhāi-varu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 13:
rovanteṃ dasaraha-ṇandaṇeṇa  $  dhāhāviu savveṃ pariẏaṇeṇa
dukkhāuru rovaï saẏalu lou  $  ṇaṃ cappĕvi cappĕvi bhariu sou
rovaï bhiccaẏaṇu samudda-hatthu  $  ṇaṃ kamala-saṇḍu hima-pavaṇa-ghatthu
rovaï anteuru soẏa-puṇṇu  $  ṇaṃ chijjamāṇu saṅkha-ulu vuṇṇu
rovaï avarāiva rāma-jaṇaṇi  $  kekkaẏa dāiẏa-taru-mūla-khaṇaṇi
rovaï suppaha vicchāẏa jāẏa  $  rovaï sumitta somitti-māẏa
"hā putta putta kettahi gao 'si  $  kiha sattiĕ vaccha-tthalĕ hao 'si
hā putta marantu ṇa joio 'si  $  daïveṇa keṇa vicchoio 'si
ghattā:
rovantiĕ lakkhaṇa-māẏariĕ  $  saẏalu lou rovāviẏaü
    kāruṇṇaĕ kavva-kahāĕ jiha  $  ko va ṇa aṃsu muāviẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 14:
pariharĕvi sou bharahesareṇa  $  karavālu laïu dāhiṇa-kareṇa
raṇa-bheri samāhaẏa diṇṇa saṅkha  $  sāhaṇu saṇṇaddhu aladdha saṅkha
raha jottiẏa kiẏa kari sāri-sajja  $  pakkhariẏa turaṅgama jaẏa-jasajja
sarahasu saṇṇajjhaï bharahu jāva  $  bhāmaṇḍaleṇa viṇṇattu tā̃va
"paĩ gaĕṇa vi sijjhaï ṇāhĩ kajju  $  taṃ kari hari jīvaï jeṇa ajju
jaï diṇṇu visallahĕ taṇaü ṇhavaṇu  $  to akkhahi pesaṇu ṇa kiu kavaṇu"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï rāu  $  "kiṃ salileṃ saĩ jĕ visalla jāu"
paṭṭhaviẏa mahallā gaẏa turanta  $  kaütikamaṅgalu ṇiviseṇa patta
ghattā:
viṇṇaviu ṇaveppiṇu doṇaghaṇu  $  "jīviu deva dehi harihĕ
    ṇīsaraü satti vacchatthalahŏ  $  jalĕṇa visallāsundarihĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 15:
ettaḍiẏa volla paḍivaṇṇa jāva  $  kekkaï sampāviẏa tahĩ ji tāva
paṇaveppiṇu bhāẏaru vuttu tīĕ  $  "karĕ gamaṇu visallā-sundariĕ
jīvaü lakkhaṇu hammaü dasāsu  $  pūrantu maṇoraha rāhavāsu
āṇandu pavaḍḍhaü jāṇaīhĕ  $  taṇu tāraü dukkha-mahāṇaīhĕ
aṇṇu vi visalla tahŏ puvva-diṇṇa  $  laggaü karaẏalĕ sabbhāva-bhiṇṇa"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi parituṭṭhu doṇu  $  "uṭṭhaü ṇārāẏaṇu akhaẏa-toṇu"
paṭṭhaviẏa visalla khaṇantareṇa  $  sahũ kaṇṇa-sahāseṃ uttareṇa
gaẏa jaẏakāreppiṇu doṇamehu  $  kekkaïẏa parāiẏa ṇiẏaẏa-gehu
ghattā:
haṇuvaṅgaẏa-bhāmaṇḍala-bharaha  $  diṭṭha visallā-sundariĕ
    ṇaṃ majjha-padesĕ païṭṭhiẏaĕ  $  caü maẏarahara vasundhariĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 16:
sa vi ṇaẏaṇakaḍakkhiẏa dujjaehĩ  $  siẏa ṇāvaï caühu mi disa-gaehĩ
teṃ pulaïẏa ṇava-ṇīluppalacchi  $  vavasāu karantahŏ kahŏ ṇa lacchi
puṇu pomāiu lakkhaṇu kumāru  $  "saṃsārahŏ laï ettaḍaü sāru
jaï jīviu keva vi kaha vi pattu  $  to dhaṇṇaü jasu ehaü kalattu"
bhāmaṇḍaleṇa kokkāviẏāu  $  lahu ṇiẏaẏa-vimāṇĕ caḍāviẏāu
tiṇṇi vi saṃcalla ṇahaṅgaṇeṇa  $  gaẏa laṅka parāiẏa takkhaṇeṇa
jiha jiha kaṇṇaü ḍhukkanti tāu  $  tiha tiha vimalīhūẏaü disāu
rāmeṇa vuttu "jamvava vihāṇu  $  laï appaü dahami hariṃ samāṇu"
ghattā:
dhīriu rāhavu ricchaddhaĕṇa  $  "jaṇiẏa visallaĕ vimala disi
    kiṃ kahami bhaḍārā dāsarahi  $  tihĩ paharĕhĩ sambhavaï ṇisi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 17:
ṇa vihāṇu ṇa bhāṇu maṇoharīhĕ  $  uhu teu visallā-sundarīhĕ"
vala-jamvava ve vi cavanti jāva  $  ṇīsariẏa sarīrahŏ satti tāva
puṇṇāli ṇāĩ para-ṇaravarāu  $  ṇaṃ ṇammaẏa viñjha-mahīharāu
ṇaṃ sadda-māla vara kaïvarāu  $  ṇaṃ divva vāṇi titthaṅkarāu
etthantarĕ amvarĕ dhagadhaganti  $  pavaṇañjaẏa-taṇaeṃ dhariẏa janti
ṇaṃ vesa viẏaḍḍheṃ ṇaravareṇa  $  ṇaṃ pavara mahāṇaï sāẏareṇa
pacaviẏa vevanti amoha-satti  $  "maṃ dharĕ maṃ dharĕ muĕ muĕ davatti
ṇaü duṭṭha-savattihĕ samuhu thāmi  $  ĕha acchaü haũ ṇiẏa-ṇilaü jāmi
ghattā:
asahantihĕ hiẏaẏa-viṇiggaẏahĕ  $  kavaṇu etthu abbhuddharaṇu
    savvahĕ bhattāreṃ ghattiẏahĕ  $  kula-vahuahĕ kulaharu saraṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 18:
kiṃ ṇa muṇiẏa paĩ mahu taṇiẏa thatti  $  haũ sā ṇāmeṇāmoha-satti
kaïlāsuddhareṇa bhaẏāvaṇāsu  $  dharaṇindeṃ diṇṇī rāvaṇāsu
saṅgāma-kālĕ lakkhaṇahŏ mukka  $  hari-āṇaĕ vijju va girihĕ ḍhukka
asahanti visallahĕ taṇaü teu  $  ṇāsami laggī kiṃ karahi kheu
āẏaĕ avalamvĕvi parama-dhīru  $  aṇṇahĩ jammantarĕ ghora-vīru
tava-caraṇu ṇirosahu ciṇṇu tā̃va  $  gaẏa varisahũ saṭṭhi sahāsa jā̃va"
haṇueṇa vuttu "jaï saccu dehi  $  to muẏami paḍīvī jaï ṇa ehi"
vijjaĕ pabhaṇiu "laï diṇṇu diṇṇu  $  ṇaü bhiṇṇami jiha evahĩ vibhiṇṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pavaṇa-sueṇa mukka  $  vihaḍapphaḍa gaẏa ṇiẏa-ṇilaü ḍhukka
ettahĕ vi tāva sarahasa païṭṭha  $  sa-valeṇa valeṇa visalla diṭṭha
ghattā:
siu santi karanti haranti duhu  $  sīẏahĕ rāmahŏ lakkhaṇahŏ
     atthakkaĕ ḍhukka bhavitti jiha  $  laṅkahĕ rajjahŏ rāvaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 19:
savvaṅgiu hari paramesarīĕ  $  parimaṭṭhu visallā-sundarīĕ
samaladdhu suandheṃ candaṇeṇa  $  rāmahŏ vi samappiu takkhaṇeṇa
teṇa vi paṭṭhaviu kaïddhaẏāhã  $  jamvava-suggīvaṅgaṅgaẏāhã
bhāmaṇḍala-haṇuva-virāhiẏāhã  $  ṇala-ṇīlahã harisa-pasāhiẏāhã
gaẏa-gavaẏa-gavakkhāṇuddharāhã  $  kundendu-maïnda-vasundharāhã
avaraha mi cindha-uvalakkhiẏāhã  $  sāmantahã rāvaṇa-pakkhiẏāhã
kesariṇiẏamva-suẏa-sāraṇāhã  $  ravikaṇṇendaï-ghaṇavāhaṇāhã
jamaghaṇṭa-jamāṇa[ṇa]-jamamuhāhã  $  dhūmakkha-durāṇaṇa-dummuhāhã
ghattā:
avaraha mi asesahũ ṇaravaïhũ  $  diṇṇu vihañjĕvi gandha-jalu
    atthakkaĕ jāu puṇaṇṇavaü  $  saẏalu vi rāmahŏ taṇaü valu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 20:
jaṃ rāma-seṇṇu ṇimmala-jaleṇa  $  saṃjīviu saṃjīvaṇi-valeṇa
taṃ vīrĕhĩ vīra-rasāhiehĩ  $  vaggantĕhĩ pulaẏa-pasāhiehĩ
vajjantĕhĩ paḍahĕhĩ maddalehĩ  $  gijjantĕhĩ dhavalĕhĩ maṅgalĕhĩ
ṇaccantĕhĩ khujjaẏa-vāmaṇehĩ  $  jaju-riẏaü paḍhantĕhĩ vambhaṇehĩ
gāẏantĕhĩ ahiṇava-gāẏaṇehĩ  $  vāẏantĕhĩ vīṇā-vāẏaṇehĩ
savvĕhĩ uṇṇiddāviu aṇantu  $  uṭṭhiu "kettahĕ rāvaṇu" bhaṇantu
vihaseppiṇu uccaï halahareṇa  $  "kiṃ khalĕṇa gaviṭṭheṃ ṇisiẏareṇa
tā duddama-daṇu-ṇiddalaṇa-dappa  $  uva vaẏaṇu visallahĕ taṇaü vappa
jamamuhahŏ jāĕ ṇīsārio 'si  $  laṅkahĕ viṇāsu païsārio 'si"
ghattā:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi joiẏa lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  takkhaṇa maẏaṇāalliẏaü
     ṇaṃ ekkaĕ sattiĕ parihariu  $  puṇu aṇṇekkaĕ salliẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 21:
sā kaṇṇa ṇiĕvi harisiẏa-maṇāsu  $  uppaṇṇa bhanti ṇārāẏaṇāsu
"kiṃ calaṇa-talaggaĩ komalāĩ  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ahiṇava-rattuppalāĩ
kiṃ ūru paropparu bhiṇṇa-teẏa  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ṇava-rambhā-khambha eẏa
kiṃ kaṇaẏa-doru gholaï visālu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ahi raẏaṇa-ṇihāṇa-pālu
kiṃ tivaliu jaḍharĕ padhāviẏāu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ kāmaürihĕ khāiẏāu
kiṃ romāvali ghaṇa kasaṇa eha  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ maẏaṇāṇala-dhūma-leha
kiṃ ṇava-thaṇa ṇaṃ ṇaṃ kaṇaẏa-kalasa  $  kiṃ kara ṇaṃ ṇaṃ pāroha-sarisa
kiṃ āẏamvira kara-ẏala calanti  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ asoẏa-pallava lalanti
kiṃ āṇaṇu ṇaṃ ṇaṃ canda-vimvu  $  kiṃ aharaü ṇaṃ ṇaṃ pakka-vimvu
kiṃ dasaṇāvaliu sa-muttiẏāu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ malliẏa-kaliẏaü imāu
kiṃ gaṇḍavāsa ṇaṃ danti-dāṇa  $  kiṃ loẏaṇa ṇaṃ ṇaṃ kāma-vāṇa
kiṃ bhaüha imāu pariṭṭhiẏāu  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ vammaha-dhaṇulaṭṭhiẏāu
kiṃ kaṇṇa kuṇḍalāharaṇa eẏa  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ravi-sasi vipphuriẏa-teẏa
kiṃ bhālaü ṇaṃ ṇaṃ sasaharaddhu  $  kiṃ siru ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ali-ula-ṇivaddhu"
ghattā:
jāṇeppiṇu savvĕhĩ rāṇaĕhĩ  $  rūvāsattaü mahumahaṇu
      viṇṇattu kiẏañjali-hatthaĕhĩ  $  "karĕ kumāra pāṇi-ggahaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 69, Kaḍavaka 22:

ghattā:
acchaü kiṃ sāvaṇṇeṃ  $  keṇa vi aṇṇeṃ  $  jahĩ aïmuttaü raï karaï
      taṃ jaṇa-[maṇa-]majjāvaṇu  $  savva-suhāvaṇu  $  ko mahu-māsu ṇa sambharaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 2:
katthaï aṅgarāẏa-saṅkāsaü  $  rehaï tamviru phullu palāsaü
ṇaṃ dāvāṇalu āu gavesaü  $  ko maĩ daḍḍhu ṇa daḍḍhu paesaü
katthavi māhaviẏaĕ ṇiẏa-mandiru  $  entu ṇivāriu taṃ indindiru
"osaru osaru tuhũ apavittaü  $  aṇṇaĕ ṇava-pupphavaïĕ chittaü
katthaï cūa-kusuma-mañjariẏaü  $  ṇāĩ vasanta-vaḍāẏaü dhariẏaü
katthaï pavaṇa-haẏaĩ puṇṇāẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ jagĕ ucchaliẏaĩ puṇṇāẏaĩ
katthaï ahiṇavāĩ bhamara-ulaĩ  $  thiẏaĩ vasanta-sirihĕ ṇaṃ kurulaĩ
phaṇasaĩ avuha-muhā iva jaḍḍaĩ  $  sirihalāĩ siri-hala iva vaḍḍaĩ
ghattā:
tehaĕ kālĕ maṇoharĕ  $  ṇava-ṇandīsarĕ  $  laṅka purandara-puri va thiẏa
    raẏaṇiẏarĕhĩ guru-attiĕ(?)  $  avicala-bhattiĕ  $  jiṇaharĕ jiṇaharĕ pujja kiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 3:
gharĕ gharĕ mahimaü ṇīsāriẏaü  $  gharĕ gharĕ paḍimaü ahisāriẏaü
gharĕ gharĕ tūraĩ apphāliẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ sīha-ulaĩ orāliẏaĩ
gharĕ gharĕ ravi-kiraṇa-ṇivāraṇaĩ  $  ubbhiẏaĩ vitāṇaĩ toraṇaĩ
gharĕ gharĕ mālaü gandhukkaḍaü  $  gharĕ gharĕ ṇivaḍiẏa-candaṇa-chaḍaü
gharĕ gharĕ mottiẏa-raṅgāvaliu  $  gharĕ gharĕ davaṇullaü ṇava-phaliu
gharĕ gharĕ ahiṇava-pupphaccaṇiẏa  $  gharĕ gharĕ caccari koḍḍāvaṇiẏa
gharĕ gharĕ mihuṇaĩ pariosiẏaĩ  $  gharĕ gharĕ maha-dāṇaĩ ghosiẏaĩ
gharĕ gharĕ bhoẏaṇa-sāmaggi kiẏa  $  gharĕ gharĕ siri-devaẏa ṇāĩ thiẏa
ghattā:
karĕvi mahocchaü paṭṭaṇĕ  $  daṇu-dalavaṭṭaṇĕ  $  sapparivāru ṇirāuhaü
    aṭṭhāvaẏa-kampāvaṇu  $  sarahasu rāvaṇu  $  gaü santiharahŏ sammuhaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 4:
kusumāuha-āuha-sama-ṇaẏaṇĕ  $  ṇīsariẏaĕ sariẏaĕ dahavaẏaṇĕ
maṇaharaṇāharaṇālaṅkariĕ  $  sa-pasāhaṇa-sāhaṇa-pariẏariĕ
dappaharaṇa-paharaṇa-vajjiẏaĕ  $  tūrāulĕ rāulĕ gajjiẏaĕ
jaẏa-maṅgalĕ maṅgalĕ ghosiẏaĕ  $  raẏaṇiẏara-ṇiẏarĕ pariosiẏaĕ
jaṇu ṇiggaü ṇiggaü ṇitturaü  $  mahirakkhahŏ rakkhahŏ thiu puraü
dappa-rahiẏa para-hiẏa ke vi ṇara  $  uvavāsiẏa vāsiẏa dhamma-para
daï(?ẏa)-mahiẏaĕ mahiẏaĕ kā vi tiẏa  $  kaṃjaẏa-kari jaẏa-kari ṇāĩ siẏa
ka vi rāma rāma-ullāvaẏari  $  ka vi vattī vattī-dīvaẏari
ghattā:
vāla-maïndāloeṃ  $  ṇāẏara-loeṃ  $  santi-jiṇālaü diṭṭhu kiha
   ṇaha-saravara-āvāseṃ  $  sasahara-haṃseṃ  $  khuṭṭĕvi ghattiu kamalu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 5:
vimalaṃ ravi-rāsi-haraṃ siharaṃ  $  lakkhijjaï santi-haraṃ tiharaṃ
vuḍhḍhattaṇa-jamma-raṇaṃ maraṇaṃ  $  vārei va kampavaṇaṃ pavaṇaṃ
vīsamaï va rambha-vaṇe bhavaṇe  $  paṅguraï va kusuma-vaḍaṃ avaḍaṃ
bhaṇaï va alimā bhamare bhamare  $  vaḍḍhaï va (?) sasi-samaẏaṃ sa-maẏaṃ
toḍei va ṇaha-ẏalaẏaṃ alaẏaṃ  $  āruhaï va akka-rahĕ kara-he
maïlei va ujjalaẏaṃ jalaẏaṃ  $  parihei va divvalaẏaṃ valaẏaṃ
chaḍḍei va avaṇilaẏaṃ ṇilaẏaṃ  $  hasaï va parimukka-malaṃ kamalaṃ
joei va savva-suhaṃ vasuhaṃ  $  dharaï va ahiṭhāṇaṃ ahi-ṭhāṇaṃ
ghattā:
puṇṇa-pavittu visālaü  $  santi-jiṇālaü  $  savvahŏ loahŏ santi-karu
    ṇavarekkahŏ vaẏa-bhaṅgahŏ  $  para-tiẏa-saṅgahŏ  $  laṅkāhivahŏ asanti-karu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 6:
dasāṇaṇo samālaẏaṃ  $  païṭṭhao jiṇālaẏaṃ
tao kao mahocchavo  $  vitāṇa-vīṇa-maṇḍavo
visāriẏā carū valī  $  ṇivaddha toraṇāvalī
samubbhiẏā mahaddhaẏā  $  siẏāẏavatta cindhaẏā
jiṇāhiseẏa-tūraẏaṃ  $  samāhaẏaṃ gahīraẏaṃ
maünda-ṇandi-maddalā  $  huḍukka-ḍhakka-kāhalā
saruñja-bheri-jhallarī  $  daḍikka-pāṇikattarī
sa-daddurā-ravukkaḍā  $  sa-tāla-saṅkha-saṃghaḍā
ḍaüṇḍa-ḍakka-ṭaṭṭarī  $  jhuṇukka-bhambha-jhiṅkirī
vavīsa-vaṃsa-kaṃsiẏā  $  tihāsarī samāsiẏā
pavīṇa vīṇa pāviẏā  $  paḍū jhuṇī suhāviẏā
pasaṇḍi-daṇḍa-ḍamvarā  $  aṇeẏa seẏa cāmarā
surāṇa jaṃ ṇivandhaṇaṃ  $  kaẏaṃ ca tehĩ pesaṇaṃ
jamassa savva-rakkhaṇaṃ  $  pahañjaṇeṇa paṅgaṇaṃ
kaẏaṃ a-reṇu-mettaẏaṃ  $  mahāghaṇehĩ sittaẏaṃ
vaṇāsaīhĩ acciẏaṃ  $  varaṅgaṇāhĩ ṇacciẏaṃ
sarassaīĕ gāiẏaṃ  $  paüñjīehĩ vāiẏaṃ
ghattā:
ṇaravaï bhāmari deppiṇu  $  ṇāhu ṇaveppiṇu  $  ekku khaṇantaru ekku maṇu
     rāvaṇahatthaü vāĕvi  $  maṅgalu gāĕvi  $  puṇu pārambhaï jiṇa-ṇhavaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 7:
āḍhattu sattu-santāvaṇeṇa  $  ahiseu jiṇindahŏ rāvaṇeṇa
pahilaü ji bhūmi-pakkhālaṇeṇa  $  puṇu maṅgalaggi-pajjālaṇeṇa
bhuvaṇinda-vinda-paḍivohaṇeṇa  $  amieṇa vasundhara-sohaṇeṇa
vara-meru-pīḍha-pakkhālaṇeṇa  $  jaṇṇovaïe riva-cālaṇeṇa (?)
kaḍaẏaṅguli-sehara-vandhaṇeṇa  $  kusumañjali-paḍimā-thāvaṇeṇa
mahi-saṃsaṇa-kalasa-ṇirohaṇeṇa  $  puṇaravi pupphañjali-ghattaṇeṇa
aggheṇa amara-āvāhaṇeṇa  $  ṇāṇāviheṇa avaẏāraṇeṇa
jaẏa-maṅgala-kalasukkhippaṇeṇa  $  jaladhārovari-parighippaṇeṇa
ghattā:
aïrāvaẏa-maẏa-riddheṃ  $  bhasalāiddheṃ  $  kiṅkara-pavara-parāṇiĕṇa
    ahisiñciu sura-sāraü  $  santi-bhaḍāraü  $  puṇṇa-pavitteṃ pāṇiĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 8:
kari-maẏara-karaggapphālieṇa  $  bhiṅgāra-phāra-saṃcālieṇa
mahuari-uvagīẏa-vamālieṇa  $  ali-valaẏa-muhala-sama-lālieṇa
aha para-dukkheṇa va sīẏaleṇa  $  sajjaṇa-vaẏaṇeṇa va ujjaleṇa
malaẏa-ruha-vaṇeṇa va surahieṇa  $  saï-citteṇa va mala-virahieṇa
ahisiñciu teṇāmala-jaleṇa  $  puṇu ṇava-ghaeṇa mahu-piṅgaleṇa
puṇu saṅkha-kunda-jasa-paṇḍureṇa  $  gaṅgā-taraṅga-ubbhaṅgureṇa
himagiri-sihareṇa va sāḍieṇa  $  sasahara-vimveṇa va pāḍieṇa
mottiẏa-hāreṇa va tuṭṭaeṇa  $  saraẏabbha-ureṇa va phuṭṭaeṇa
khīreṇa teṇa su-maṇohareṇa  $  puṇu sisira-pavāheṃ manthareṇa
aviṇaẏa-puriseṇa va thaḍḍhaeṇa  $  ṇava-dumĕṇa va sāhā-vaddhaeṇa
puṇu paḍimuvvattaṇa-dhovaṇeṇa  $  cuṇṇeṇa jaleṇa gandhovaeṇa
ghattā:
kappūrāẏaru-vāsiu  $  ghusiṇummīsiu  $  taṃ gandha-jalu sa-ṇeurahŏ
      diṇṇu vihañjĕvi rāeṃ  $  ṇaṃ aṇurāeṃ  $  hiẏaü savvu anteurahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 9:
divveṇa aṇulevaṇeṇa suandheṇa  $  sirikhaṇḍa-kappūra-kuṅkuma-samiddheṇa
divvehĩ ṇāṇā-paẏārehĩ pupphehĩ  $  rattuppalindīvarambhoẏa-gupphehĩ
aïuttaẏāsoẏa-puṇṇāẏa-ṇāehĩ  $  saẏavattiẏā-mālaī-pārijāehĩ
kaṇiẏāra-karavīra-mandāra-kundehĩ  $  viaïlla-varatilaẏa-vaülehĩ mandehĩ
sindūra-vandhukka-koraṇṭa-kujjehĩ  $  damaṇeṇa marueṇa pikkā-tisañjhehĩ
evaṃ ca mālāhĩ aṇṇaṇṇa-rūvāhĩ  $  kaṇṇāḍiẏāhĩ va sara-sāra-bhūāhĩ
āhīriẏāhĩ va vāẏāla-bhasalāhĩ  $  vara-lāḍiẏāhĩ va muha-vaṇṇa-kusalāhĩ
soraṭṭhiẏāhĩ va savvaṅga-maüāhĩ  $  mālaviṇiẏāhĩ va majjhāra-chaüāhĩ
marahaṭṭhiẏāhĩ va uddāma-vāẏāhĩ  $  geẏa-jhuṇihĩ va aṇṇaṇṇa-chāẏāhĩ
ghattā:
ṇāṇāviha-maṇimaïẏahĩ  $  kiraṇabbhaïẏahĩ  $  canda-sūra-sāricchaĕhĩ
      accaṇa kiẏa jaga-ṇāhahŏ  $  kevala-vāhahŏ  $  puṇṇa-saehĩ va akkhaĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 10:
pacchā carueṇa maṇohareṇa  $  gaṅgā-vāheṇa va dīhareṇa
muttā-ṇiẏareṇa va paṇḍureṇa  $  su-kalatta-muheṇa va su-mahureṇa
vara-amiẏa-raseṇa va surahieṇa  $  suaṇeṇa va suṭṭhu saṇehieṇa
titthaẏara-vareṇa va siddhaeṇa  $  suraeṇa va timmaṇa-riddhaeṇa
puṇu dīvaehĩ ṇāṇāvihehĩ  $  varahiṇĕhĩ va aïdīhara-sihehĩ
suhaḍehĩ va vaṇiĕhĩ valiẏaehĩ  $  ṭiṇṭāuttehĩ va jaliẏaehĩ
dhūveṇa viviha-gandhaḍḍhaeṇa  $  maẏaṇeṇa va jiṇavara-daḍḍhaeṇa
puṇu phala-ṇivaheṇa susohieṇa  $  kavveṇa va savva-rasāhieṇa
sāhāreṇa va aï-pakkaeṇa  $  takkeṇa va sāhā-mukkaeṇa
pahu-accaṇa emva karei jāma  $  gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ sura vollanti tāmva
ghattā:
"jaï vi santi ehu ghosaï  $  kallaĕ hosaï  $  to vi rāma-lakkhaṇahũ jaü
     indiẏa-vasi ṇa karantahũ  $  sīẏa ṇa dentahũ  $  siẏa-maṅgalu kallāṇu kaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 11:
laggu thuṇehũ paẏattha-vicittaṃ  $  "ṇāẏa-ṇarāṇa surāṇa vicittaṃ
mokkhapurī-paripāliẏa-gattaṃ  $  santi-jiṇaṃ sasi-ṇimmala-vattaṃ
soma-suhaṃ paripuṇṇa-pavittaṃ  $  jassa ciraṃ cariẏaṃ su-pavittaṃ
siddhi-vahū-muha-daṃsaṇa-pattaṃ  $  sīla-guṇavvaẏa-sañjama-pattaṃ
bhāvalaẏāmara-cāmara-chattaṃ  $  dunduhi-divva-jhuṇī-paha-vattaṃ
jassa bhavāhi-ulesu khagattaṃ  $  aṭṭha-saẏaṃ ciẏa lakkhaṇa-gattaṃ
canda-divāẏara-saṇṇiha-chattaṃ  $  cāru-asoẏa-mahadduma-chattaṃ
daṇḍiẏa jeṇa maṇindiẏa chattaṃ  $  ṇomi jiṇottamam ambuja-ṇettaṃ
dodhakaṃ)
paraṃ paramapāraṃ  $  sivaṃ saẏala-sāraṃ
jarā-maraṇa-ṇāsaṃ  $  jaẏa-ssiri-ṇivāsaṃ
ṇirāharaṇa-sohaṃ  $  surāsura-vivohaṃ
aẏāṇiẏa-pamāṇaṃ  $  guruṃ ṇiruvamāṇaṃ
mahā-kaluṇa-bhāvaṃ  $  disāẏaḍa-sahāvaṃ
ṇirāuha-karaggaṃ  $  viṇāsiẏa-kumaggaṃ
haraṃ huẏavahaṃ vā  $  hariṃ caümuhaṃ vā
sasiṃ diṇaẏaraṃ vā  $  purandara-varaṃ vā
mahāpāva-bhīruṃ pi ekkalla-vīraṃ  $  kalā-bhāẏa-hīṇaṃ pi merūhi dhīraṃ
vimuttaṃ pi muttāvali-saṇṇikāsaṃ  $  viṇiggantha-maggaṃ pi ganthāvaẏāsaṃ
mahā-vīẏarāẏaṃ pi sīhāsaṇatthaṃ  $  a-bhūbhaṅguratthaṃ pi ṇaṭṭhāri-satthaṃ
samāṇaṅgadhammaṃ pi devāhidevaṃ  $  jiīsā-vihīṇaṃ pi savvūḍha-sevaṃ
aṇāẏappamāṇaṃ pi savva-ppasiddhaṃ  $  aṇantaṃ pi santaṃ aṇeẏatta-viddhaṃ
malulitta-gattaṃ pi ṇiccāhiseẏaṃ  $  ajaḍḍaṃ pi loe ṇirāṇeẏa-ṇeẏaṃ
surā-ṇāma-ṇāsaṃ pi ṇāṇā-suresaṃ  $  jaḍā-jūḍa-dhāraṃ pi dūrattha-kesaṃ
amāẏā-virūvaṃ pi vikkhiṇṇa-sīsaṃ  $  saẏā-āgamillaṃ pi ṇiccaṃ adīsaṃ
(bhujaṃgaprayātaṃ)
mahā-guruṃ vi ṇibbharaṃ  $  aṇiṭṭhiẏaṃ pi dummaraṃ
paraṃ pi savva-vacchalaṃ  $  varaṃ pi ṇicca-kevalaṃ
pahuṃ pi ṇippariggahaṃ  $  haraṃ pi duṭṭha-ṇiggahaṃ
suhiṃ pi suṭṭhu-dūraẏaṃ  $  a-viggahaṃ pi sūraẏaṃ
ṇirakkharaṃ pi vuddhaẏaṃ  $  amaccharaṃ pi kuddhaẏaṃ
mahesaraṃ pi ṇiddhaṇaṃ  $  gaẏaṃ pi mukka-vandhaṇaṃ
arūviẏaṃ pi sundaraṃ  $  a-vaḍḍhiẏaṃ pi dīharaṃ
a-sāriẏaṃ pi vitthaẏaṃ  $  thiraṃ pi ṇicca-patthaẏaṃ"
(ṇārācaṃ)
ghattā:
aggaĕ thuṇĕvi jiṇindahŏ  $  bhuvaṇāṇandahŏ  $  mahiẏalĕ jaṇṇu-jottu karĕvi
      ṇāsaggāṇiẏa-loaṇu  $  aṇimisa-joaṇu thiu  $  maṇĕ acalu jhāṇu dharĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 12:
vahurūviṇi-vijjāsatta-maṇu  $  ṇiẏamatthu suṇeppiṇu dahavaẏaṇu
to jāẏa volla valĕ rāhavahŏ  $  suggīvahŏ haṇuvahŏ jamvavahŏ
somittihĕ aṅgahŏ aṅgaẏahŏ  $  sa-gavakkhahŏ taha gavaẏahŏ gaẏahŏ
tārahŏ rambhahŏ bhāmaṇḍalahŏ  $  kumuẏahŏ kundahŏ ṇīlahŏ ṇalahŏ
avarahu mi asesahũ kiṅkarahũ  $  ekkeṇa vuttu "laï kiṃ karahũ
aṭṭhāhiĕ āhaü pariharĕvi  $  thiu santi-jiṇālaü païsarĕvi
ārāhaï laggaï ekka-maṇu  $  rāvaṇa-akkhohaṇi dahavaẏaṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vihīsaṇu viṇṇavaï  $  "sāhiẏa vahurūviṇi-vijja jaï
to ṇa vi haũ ṇa vi tuhũ ṇa vi ẏa hari  $  vari ehaĕ avasarĕ ṇihaü ari
ghattā:
cora-jāra-ahi-vaïrahũ  $  huavaha-ḍamarahũ  $  jo avaheri karei ṇaru
     so aïreṇa viṇāsaï  $  vasaṇu paẏāsaï  $  mūla-talukkhaü jema taru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 71, Kaḍavaka 13:
sakkeṇa vi kiẏa avaheri ciru  $  jaṃ vaddhāviu vīsaddha-siru
taṃ khaü appāṇahŏ āṇiẏaü  $  ṇittihĕ ahiẏāru ṇa jāṇiẏaü
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi sīrāuhu bhaṇaï  $  "jo riu paṇamantaü āhaṇaï
so khattiẏa-kulĕ kalaṅku karaï  $  jo ghaĩ puṇu tavasi ṇa pariharaï
tahŏ kiṃ pucchijjaï cārahaḍi  $  vari bhindaï ṇiẏa-sirĕ chāra-haḍi
jettiu daṇu dujjaü saṃbhavaï  $  tettiu paharantahũ jasu bhamaï"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kaṇṭaïẏaṅgaĕhĩ  $  rahu-taṇaü vuttu aṅgaṅgaĕhĩ
"tā khohahũ jāma jhāṇu daliu"  $  maṇu harĕvi kumāra-seṇṇu caliu
ghattā:
taṃ sa-vimāṇu sa-vāhaṇu  $  ukkhaẏa-paharaṇu  $  ṇiĕvi kumārahŏ taṇaü valu
