khaṇĕ mahi-kampu mahīhara-halliu  $  khaṇĕ raẏaṇāẏara-salilucchalliu
taṃ tehaü ṇievi sasi-muhiẏaĕ  $  tiẏaḍa papucchiẏa jaṇaẏahŏ duhiẏaĕ
"eu mahantu kāĩ accariẏaü  $  kiṃ keṇa vi jagu uvasaṅghariẏaü"
ghattā:
pabhaṇaï tiẏaḍāevi  $  "vahurūviṇi-rūvāviddha-taṇu
    āvaï laggaü ehu  $  taü vaẏaṇu ṇihālaü dahavaẏaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi mahāsaï kampiẏa  $  vāhu bharanti cakkhu dara jampiẏa
"māĕ ṇa jāṇahũ kāĩ karesaï  $  sīlu mahāraü kiṃ maïlesaï"
tāva surinda-vinda-kandāvaṇu  $  kaṇṭhāharaṇa-viviha-kaṃ-dāvaṇu
sīẏahĕ pāsu paḍhukkiu sarahasu  $  ṇāvaï vammahasarahĕ puṇavvasu
ṇāvaï dīha-samāsu vihattihĕ  $  ṇāvaï chandu deva-gāittihĕ
vollāviẏa "vollahi paramesari  $  homi ṇa homi dasāṇaṇa-kesari
suaü ṇa suaü mahāraü ḍhaḍḍhasu  $  diṭṭhu ṇa diṭṭhu viuvvaṇa-sāhasu
evahĩ kiṃ karanti te hari-vala  $  ṇala-suggīva-ṇīla-bhāmaṇḍala
ghattā:
aṇṇa vi je je duṭṭha  $  te te mahu savva samāvaḍiẏa
    evahĩ kahĩ ṇāsanti  $  sāraṅga va sīhahŏ kamĕ paḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 10:
sīmantiṇi maẏaraharuttiṇṇahŏ  $  luhami līha kaïddhaẏa-seṇṇahŏ
rāmu tuhāraü jama-pahĕ lāẏami  $  indaï kumbhakaṇṇu mellāvami
jo visallu kiu kaha vi visallaĕ  $  so vi bhiḍantu ṇa cukkaï kallaĕ
jīviẏāsa tahũ kerī chaṇḍahi  $  caḍu vimāṇĕ appāṇaü maṇḍahi
sa-raẏaṇa sa-ṇihi pihimi paripālahi  $  jāhũ meru jiṇaharaĩ ṇihālahi
pekkhu samudda dīva sari saravara  $  ṇandaṇa-vaṇaĩ maha-dduma mahihara
aha ettaḍaü kālu jaṃ cukkī  $  taṃ mahu vaẏa-cārahaḍi gurukkī
jaï vi tilottima rambhāevī  $  jā ṇa samicchaï sā ṇa laevī
vāra-vāra teṃ taĩ abbhatthami  $  daẏa kari anteuru avahatthami
tuhũ jĕ ekka mahaeviẏa vuccahi  $  cāmara-gāhiṇīhĩ mā muccahi
ghattā:
suravara seva karantu  $  ghaṇa chaḍaü dintu purĕ païsarahi
      lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ tatti  $  duvvuddhi va dūreṃ pariharahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 11:
jāṇĕvi duṭṭha-kammu pārambhiu  $  vahurūviṇi-vahu-rūva-viẏambhiu
cintiu dasaraha-ṇandaṇa-pattiĕ  $  "lakkhaṇa-rāma jiṇaï viṇu bhantiĕ
jāsu ima i evaḍḍaĩ cindhaĩ  $  vahurūviṇi-vahu-rūvaĩ siddhaĩ
aṇṇa i suravara seva karāviẏa  $  vandi-vinda kaluṇaĩ kandāviẏa
so kiṃ maĩ ṇa lei piu ṇa haṇaï"  $  āsaṅkevi devi puṇu pabhaṇaï
"dahamuha bhuvaṇa-viṇiggaẏa-ṇāmeṃ  $  khaṇu mi ṇa jiẏami maranteṃ rāmeṃ
jetthu paīvu tetthu siha ṇajjaï  $  jetthu aṇaṅgu tetthu raï jujjaï
jetthu saṇehu tetthu paṇaẏañjali  $  jetthu paẏaṅgu tetthu kiraṇāvali
ghattā:
jahĩ sasaharu tahĩ joṇha  $  jahĩ parama-dhammu tahĩ jīva-daẏa
    jahĩ rāhavu tahĩ sīẏa"  $  sā ema bhaṇeppiṇu muccha gaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 12:
muccha ṇieppiṇu rahuvaï-ghariṇihĕ  $  kari osariu va pāsahŏ kariṇihĕ
"dhiddhigatthu paraẏāru asāraü  $  duggaï-gamaṇu sugaï-viṇivāraü
maĩ pāveṇa kāĩ kiu ehaü  $  jeṃ vicchoiu mihuṇu sa-ṇehaü
ko vi ṇa maĩ sarisaü viruvāraü  $  dūhaü dummuhu dukkiẏa-gāraü
dujjaṇu duṭṭhu durāsu dullakkhaṇu  $  ku-purisu manda-bhaggu a-viẏakkhaṇu
duṇṇaẏavantu viṇaẏa-parivajjiu  $  duccārittu ku-sīlu a-lajjiu
ṇiddaü para-kalatta-santāvaü  $  vari jalaẏaru thalaẏaru vaṇa-sāvaü
vari pasu vari vihaṅgu kimi kīḍaü  $  ṇaü amhārisu jaga-paripīḍaü
ghattā:
vari tiṇu vari pāhāṇu  $  vari loha-piṇḍu vari sukka-taru
    ṇaü ṇigguṇu vaẏa-hīṇu  $  māṇusu uppaṇṇu mahīhĕ bharu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 13:
ahŏ ahŏ dārā paribhava-gārā  $  kaẏali va savvaṅgiu ṇīsārā
cālaṇi vva kevala-mala-gāhiṇi  $  sari va kuḍila heṭṭhāmuha-vāhiṇi
pāusa-kuhiṇi va dūsañcāriṇi  $  kumuiṇi vva gahavaï-uvagāriṇi
kamaliṇi vva paṅkeṇa ṇa muccaï  $  maṇu dārei dāra teṃ vuccaï
vaṇiẏa vaṇei sarīru samattaü  $  gaṇiẏa gaṇei asesu viḍhattaü
daïẏahŏ daïu lei teṃ daïẏā  $  paru tiviheṇa teṇa tiẏamaïẏā
dhaṇiẏa dhaṇei appu avaẏāreṃ  $  jāẏa jāi ṇījantī jāreṃ
ku vasundhari tahĩ māri kumārī  $  ṇā ṇaru tāsu aritteṃ ṇārī
ghattā:
vaṭṭaï suravaï jema  $  vandheppiṇu lakkhaṇu rāmu raṇĕ
    demi vihāṇaĕ sīẏa  $  saccaü parisujjhami jema jaṇĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 73, Kaḍavaka 14:
ema bhaṇeppiṇu gaü ṇiẏa-gehahŏ  $  anteurahŏ pavaḍḍhiẏa-ṇehahŏ
rāẏahaṃsu ṇaṃ haṃsī-jūhahŏ  $  ṇaṃ gaẏavaru gaṇiẏāri-samūhahŏ
ṇaṃ maẏalañchaṇu tārā-vandahŏ  $  ṇaṃ dhuvagāu ṇaliṇi-maẏarandahŏ
paṇaïṇīu paṇaeṃ paṇavantaü  $  māṇiṇīu saĩ sammāṇantaü
rasaṇā-dāmaehĩ vajjhantaü  $  līlā-kamalĕhĩ tāḍijjantaü
eva pariṭṭhiu ṇisi-sambhogeṃ  $  siṅgāreṇa viviha-viṇiuggeṃ
sīẏa vi ṇiẏa-jīviẏahŏ aṇiṭṭhiẏa  $  ṇaṃ dasasirahŏ siratti samuṭṭhiẏa
tāva ṇihāẏa paḍiẏa mahi kampiẏa  $  "ṇaṭṭha laṅka" ṇahĕ deva pajampiẏa
ghattā:
"dahamuha mūḍhaü kāĩ  $  para-ṇāri ramantahŏ kavaṇu suhu
    ṇacchahi suravaï jeva  $  ṇiẏa-rajju sa iṃ bhu ñjantu tuhũ"
----------  [74. caüsattarimo saṃdhi]  ----------
divasaẏarĕ viuddhĕ viuddhāĩ  $  raṇa-rasiẏaĩ amarisa-kuddhāĩ
sa-rahasaĩ pavaḍḍhiẏa-kalaẏalaĩ  $  bhiḍiẏaĩ rāhava-rāmaṇa-valaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 1:
jāva rāvaṇu jāi ṇiẏa-gehu
anteuru païsaraï  $  karaï raẏaṇi saĩ bhoggĕ āẏaru
tā tāḍiẏa caü-pahari  $  uaẏa-siharĕ uṭṭhiu divāẏaru
(mattā-chandu)
kesari vva ṇaha-bhāsura-kara-pasarantaü
paharĕ paharĕ ṇisi-gaẏa-ghaḍa osārantaü
tahĩ avasarĕ pakkhāliẏa-ṇaẏaṇu  $  atthāṇĕ pariṭṭhiu dahavaẏaṇu
sāmarisa-ṇisāẏara-pariẏariu  $  ṇaṃ jamu jamakaraṇālaṅkariu
ṇaṃ kesari ṇaharāruṇa-gahiu  $  ṇaṃ gahavaï tārāẏaṇa-sahiu
ṇaṃ diṇaẏaru pasariẏa-kara-ṇiẏaru  $  ṇaṃ vipphāliẏa-jalu maẏaraharu
ṇaṃ suravaï sura-pariveḍḍhiẏaü  $  toḍantu karaggeṃ dāḍhiẏaü
rosuggaü ummūliẏaü hatthu  $  ṇiḍḍariẏa-ṇaẏaṇu sīhāsaṇatthu
suẏa-bhāẏara-paribhaü sambharevi  $  bhaü jīviu rajju vi pariharevi
ghattā:
asahantu surāsura-ḍamara-karu  $  jama-dhaṇaẏa-purandara-varuṇa-dharu
    sajjaṇa-dujjaṇahã jaṇantu bhaü  $  phuriẏāharu āuha-sāla gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 2:
tāva hūaĩ duṇṇimittāĩ
uḍḍāviu uttariu  $  āẏavattu moḍiu du-vāĕṇa
hāhā-raü uṭṭhiẏaü  $  chiṇṇa kuhiṇi ghaṇa-kasaṇa-ṇāĕṇa
ṇiĕvi tāĩ du-ṇimittaĩ ṇaẏa-sira-pantihĩ
"jāhi māẏa" mandoẏari vuccaï mantihĩ
"mā ṇāsaü sundaru purisa-raẏaṇu  $  jaï kaha vi tuhāraü karaï vaẏaṇu
to pariacchāvahi vuddhi devi  $  ālāvĕhĩ tehĩ paẏaṭṭa devi
vihaḍapphaḍa pāsu dasāṇaṇāsu  $  hari-bhaĕṇa kareṇu va vāraṇāsu
ṇaṃ saï-mahaevi purandarāsu  $  ṇaṃ raï sarasuttha-dhaṇuddharāsu
paṇaveppiṇu kappiṇu paṇaẏa-kou  $  darisanti aṃsu-jalu thovu thovu
pabhaṇaï "paramesara kāĩ mūḍhu  $  mohandha-kūvĕ kiṃ deva chūḍhu
ghattā:
ku-sarīrahŏ kāraṇĕ jāṇaïhĕ  $  mā ṇivaḍahi ṇaraẏa-mahāṇaïhĕ
   laï vūhi kim icchahi puhaïvaï  $  kiṃ homi suraṅgaṇa lacchi raï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 3:
taṃ suṇeppiṇu bhaṇaï dahavaẏaṇu
"kiṃ rambha-tilottimahĩ  $  uvvasīĕ accharaĕ lacchiĕ
kiṃ sīẏaĕ kiṃ raïĕ  $  paĩ vi kāĩ kuvalaẏa-dalacchiĕ
jāhi kantĕ haũ laggaü vandhu-parāhave
tharaharanti sara-dhoraṇi lāẏami rāhave
lakkhaṇĕ puṇu mi satti saṃcārami  $  aṅgaṅgaẏa jamaüri païsārami
pāḍami vāṇara-vaṃsa-paīvahŏ  $  matthaĕ vajja-daṇḍu suggīvahŏ
candahāsu candoẏara-ṇandaṇĕ  $  vāẏavu vāueva-suẏa-sandaṇĕ
vāruṇu bhāmaṇḍalĕ bhaẏa-bhīsaṇĕ  $  dhagadhagantu aggeu vihīsaṇĕ
ṇāgavāsu māhinda-mahindahũ  $  vaïsavaṇatthu kumua-kundendahũ
moḍami gavaẏa-gavakkhahũ cindhaĩ  $  ṇaccāvami ṇala-ṇīla-kavandhaĩ
tāra-suseṇa demi vali bhūẏahũ  $  avara vi ṇemi pāsu jama-dūẏahũ
ghattā:
jasu indādeva vi āṇakara  $  dāsi vva kiẏañjali sa-dhara dhara
    so jaï ārūsami dahavaẏaṇu  $  to hari-vala saṇḍha kavaṇu gahaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 4:
teṇa vaẏaṇeṃ kuiẏa mahaevi
"hevāiu suravarahĩ  $  teṇa tujjhu evaḍḍu vikkamu
khara-dūsaṇa-tisira-vahĕ  $  kiṇṇa ṇāu lakkhaṇa-parakkamu
jeṇa maṇḍa pāẏālalaṅka uddāliẏa
diṇṇa tāra suggīvahŏ sila saṃcāliẏa
aṇṇa vi vahu-dukkha-jaṇerāĩ  $  cariẏaĩ haṇuvantahŏ kerāĩ
paĩ rāvaṇa kāĩ ṇa diṭṭhāĩ  $  hiẏavaĕ sallaĩ va païṭṭhāĩ
ajja vi acchanti mahantāĩ  $  dujjaṇa-vaẏaṇa vva duhantāĩ
aṇṇa i ṇala-ṇīla keṇa sahiẏa  $  raṇĕ hattha-pahattha jehĩ vahiẏa
rahuvaïhĕ ṇihāliu keṇa muhu  $  cha-vvāra vi-rahu jeṃ kiẏaü tuhũ
aṅgaṅgaehĩ kira ko gahaṇu  $  kiu tehi mi mahu kesa-ggahaṇu
ghattā:
māẏāsuggīva-vimaddaṇahŏ  $  ettiẏa metti vi rahu-ṇandaṇahŏ
    ṇava-mālaï-mālā-maüa-bhua  $  ajja vi appijjaü jaṇaẏa-suẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 5:
ṇiẏaẏa-pakkhahŏ diṇṇĕ ahikhevĕ
para-pakkhĕ pasaṃsiẏaĕ  $  dasa-sirehĩ dasasiru palittaü
jālā-saẏa-pajjaliu  $  huavaho vva vāeṇa chittaü
ratta-ṇettu (vi)phuriẏāharu maliẏa-karuppalu
caliẏa-gaṇḍu bhū-bhaṅguru tāḍiẏa-mahiẏalu
"jaï aṇṇeṃ keṇa vi vuttu eva  $  to siru pāḍami tāla-halu jema
tuhũ ghaĩ paṇaïṇi paṇaeṇa cukka  $  osaru pāsahŏ mā puraü ḍhukka
kiṇṇa karami sandhi tahĩ jĕ kālĕ  $  khara-dūsaṇa-raṇĕ haẏa-koṭṭavālĕ
ujjāṇa-bhaṅgĕ mandira-viṇāsĕ  $  rāmāgamĕ ekkoẏara-pavāsĕ
paḍhamabbhiḍĕ hattha-pahattha-maraṇĕ  $  indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa-vandi-dharaṇĕ
evahĩ puṇu dūsanthavaü kajju  $  ekkantaru tāha mi mahu mi ajju
ghattā:
evahĩ tuha vaẏaṇĕhĩ vibhava-jua  $  vihĩ gaïhĩ samappami jaṇaẏa-sua
   jima lakkhaṇa-rāmahĩ bhaggaĕhĩ  $  jima mahu pāṇĕhĩ mi viṇiggaĕhĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 6:
ema bhaṇevi pahaẏa raṇa-bheri
tūraĩ apphāliẏaĩ  $  diṇṇa saṅkha ubbhiẏa mahaddhaẏa
sajjiẏa raha jutta haẏa  $  sāri-sajja kiẏa danti dujjaẏa
miliu seṇṇu kiu kalaẏalu raṇa-pariosĕṇa
ṇiravasesu jagu vahiriu tūra-ṇighosĕṇa
vahurūviṇi-kiẏa-māẏāviggahu  $  sajjiu turiu gaïnda-mahārahu
tuṅga-rahaṅgu ṇahĕ jjĕ ṇa māiu  $  vīẏaü mandaru ṇaṃ uppāiu
tahĩ gaẏavara-sahāsu jotteppiṇu  $  dasa sahāsa paẏa-rakkha kareppiṇu
jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ caḍiu dasāṇaṇu  $  ṇaṃ giri-siharovari pañcāṇaṇu
dahahĩ muhehĩ bhaẏaṅkaru dahamuhu  $  bhuvaṇa-kosu ṇaṃ jaliu disā-muhu
viviha-vāhu vivihukkhaẏa-paharaṇu  $  ṇāĩ viuvvaṇĕ thiu sura-vāraṇu
dasa-viha loẏa-pāla maṇĕ jhāĕvi  $  daïveṃ mukka ṇāĩ uppāĕvi
bhuvaṇa-bhaẏaṅkaru kahŏ vi ṇa bhāvaï  $  daṇḍu jameṇa visajjiu ṇāvaï
ghattā:
dhaẏa-daṇḍu samubbhiu seẏa-vaḍu  $  ṇijjīvaü laṅkāhiva-suhaḍu
      purĕ (?) sāẏarĕ raha-vohittha-kaü  $  paravala-paratīrahŏ ṇāĩ gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 7:
rahu ṇirantaru bhariu paharaṇahũ
sammaï sāratthi kiu  $  vahurūviṇi-vijjā-viṇimmiu
kaṇṭaïeṃ rāvaṇĕṇa  $  urĕ ṇa mantu saṇṇāhu parihiu
vāhu-daṇḍa vihuṇeppiṇu raṇĕ dullaliĕṇa
paharaṇāĩ parigīḍhaĩ rahasucchaliĕṇa
pahilaĕ karĕ dhaṇuharu saru vīẏaĕ  $  gaẏahũ kaẏanta gaẏāsaṇi taïẏaĕ
saṅkhu caütthaĕ pañcamĕ aḍḍaü  $  chaṭṭheṃ asi sattamĕ vasuṇandaü
aṭṭhamĕ citta-daṇḍu ṇavamaĕ halu  $  jhasu dasameẏārasamaĕ savvalu
bhīsaṇu bhiṇḍimālu vārahamaĕ  $  cakku asaṅku thakku terahamaĕ
pattu mahantu kontu caüdahamaĕ  $  satti bhaẏaṅkara paṇṇārahamaĕ
solahamaĕ tisūlu aï-bhīsaṇu  $  sattārahamaĕ kaṇaü dudarisaṇu
aṭṭhārahamaĕ moggaru dāruṇu  $  eguṇavīsamĕ ghaṇu ghusiṇāruṇu
vīsamae musuṇḍhi uggāmiu  $  kāleṃ kāla-daṇḍu ṇaṃ bhāmiu
ghattā:
vīsahi mi bhua(daṇḍe)hĩ vīsāuhĕhĩ  $  dasahi mi bhiuḍi-bhaẏaṅkara-muhĕhĩ
      bhīsāvaṇu rāvaṇu jāu kiha  $  sahũ gahĕhĩ kaẏantu viruddhu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 8:
dasahĩ kaṇṭhĕhĩ dasa jĕ kaṇṭhāĩ
dasa-bhālahĩ tilaẏa dasa  $  dasa-sirehĩ dasa maüḍa pajaliẏa
dahahi mi kuṇḍala-juĕhĩ  $  kaṇṇa-juala sukaüla(?) muhaliẏa
huriu raẏaṇa-saṅghāu dasāṇaṇa-rosu va
aha thio sa-tārāẏaṇu vahala-paosu va
paḍhama-vaẏaṇu khaẏa-sūra-sama-ppahu  $  sindūrāruṇu suraha mi dūsahu
vīẏaü vaẏaṇu dhavalu dhavalacchaü  $  puṇṇima-ẏanda-vimva-sāricchaü
taïẏaü vaẏaṇu bhuvaṇa-bhaẏagāraü  $  aṅgārāruṇu mukkaṅgāraü
vaẏaṇu caütthaü vuha-muha-bhāsuru  $  pañcamaeṇa saĩ jĕ ṇaṃ sura-guru
chaṭṭhaü sukku sukka-saṅkāsaü  $  dāṇava-vakkhiu sura-santāsaü
sattamu kasaṇu saṇicchara-bhīsaṇu  $  danturu viẏaḍa-dāḍhu duddarisaṇu
aṭṭhamu rāhu-vaẏaṇu vikarālaü  $  ṇavamaü dhūmakeu dhūmālaü
dasamaü vaẏaṇu dasāṇaṇa-keraü  $  savva-jaṇahŏ bhaẏa-dukkha-jaṇeraü
ghattā:
vahu-rūvaü vahu-siru vahu-vaẏaṇu  $  vahuviha-kavolu vahuviha-ṇaẏaṇu
      vahu-kaṇṭhaü vahu-karu vi vahu-paü  $  ṇaṃ ṇaṭṭa-purisu rasa-bhāva-gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 9:
to ṇieppiṇu ṇisiẏarindassa
sīsaĩ ṇaẏaṇaĩ muhaĩ  $  paharaṇāĩ raẏaṇiẏara-bhīsaṇu
āharaṇaĩ vaccha-ẏalu  $  rāhaveṇa pucchiu vihīsaṇu
"kiṃ tikūḍa-selovari dīsaï ṇava-ghaṇu"
"deva deva ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ĕhu rahĕ thiu rāvaṇu"
"kiṃ giri-siharaĩ ṇahĕ dīsirāĩ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ āẏaĩ dasasira-sirāĩ"
"kim palaẏa-divāẏara-maṇḍalāĩ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ āẏaĩ maṇi-kuṇḍalāĩ"
"kiṃ kuvalaẏāĩ māṇasa-sarahŏ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ ṇaẏaṇaĩ laṅkesarahŏ"
"kiṃ giri-kandaraĩ bhaẏāṇaṇāĩ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ dahavaẏaṇĕ dasāṇaṇāĩ"
"kiṃ sura-cāvaĩ cāvuttamāĩ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ kaṇṭhāharaṇaĩ imāĩ"
"kiṃ tārā-ẏaṇaĩ taṇujjalāĩ"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ dhavalaĩ muttāhalāĩ"
"kiṃ kasaṇu vihīsaṇa gaẏaṇa-ẏalu"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ laṅkāhiva-vacchaẏalu"
"kiṃ disa-veẏaṇḍa-soṇḍa-paẏaro"  $  "ṇaṃ ṇaṃ dahakandhara-kara-ṇiẏaro"
ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  loẏaṇaĩ virillĕvi takkhaṇĕṇa
      avaloiu rāvaṇu maccharĕṇa  $  ṇaṃ rāsi-gaeṇa saṇiccharĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 10:
karĕ kareppiṇu sāẏarāvattu
thiu lakkhaṇu garuḍa-rahĕ  $  gāruḍatthu gāruḍa-mahaddhaü
valu vajjāvatta-dharu  $  sīha-cindhu vara-sīha-sandaṇu
gaẏa-vihatthu gaẏa-rahavaru pamaẏa-mahaddhaü
vipphurantu kikkindhāhiu saṇṇaddhaü
akkhohaṇi-pañca-saĕhĩ samāṇu  $  suggīvu ṇiĕvi saṇṇajjhamāṇu
bhāmaṇḍalu akkhohaṇi-sahāsu  $  saṇṇahĕvi ḍhukku lakkhaṇahŏ pāsu
aṅgaṅgaẏa akkhohaṇi-saeṇa  $  ṇala-ṇīla tāhã addhaddhaeṇa
paḍivakkha-lakkha-saṃkhohaṇīhĩ  $  mārui cālīsakkhohaṇīhĩ
tīsakkhohaṇi-valu ahiẏa-māṇi  $  rahĕ caḍiu vihīsaṇu sūla-pāṇi
tīsahĩ dahimuhu tīsahĩ mahindu  $  vīsahĩ suseṇu vīsahĩ jĕ kundu
solahahĩ kumuu caüdahahĩ saṅkhu  $  vārahahĩ gavaü aṭṭhahĩ gavakkhu
candoẏara-suu sattahĩ sahāu  $  suu vālihĕ tehattarihĩ āu
ghattā:
saṇṇahĕvi pāsu ḍhukkaĩ valahŏ  $  akkhohaṇi-vīsa-saẏaĩ valahŏ
      viraevi vūhu saṃcalliẏaĩ  $  ṇaṃ uvahi-muhaĩ utthalliẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 11:
ghuṭṭhu kalaẏalu diṇṇa raṇa-bheri
cindhāĩ samubbhiẏaĩ  $  laïẏa kavaẏa kiẏa hei-saṅgaha
gaẏa-ghaḍaü pacoiẏaü  $  mukka turaẏa vāhiẏa mahāraha
rāma-seṇṇu raṇa-rahasiu kahi mi ṇa māiu
jagu gilevi ṇaṃ para-valu gilahũ padhāiu
abbhiṭṭu jujjhu rosiẏa-maṇāhũ  $  raẏaṇīẏara-vāṇara-lañchaṇāhũ
orasiẏa-saṅkha-saẏa-saṃghaḍāhũ  $  raṇavahu-pheḍāviẏa-muhavaḍāhũ
uddhaṅkusa-dhāiẏa-gaẏa-ghaḍāhũ  $  khara-pavaṇandoliẏa-dhaẏavaḍāhũ
kampāviẏa-saẏala-vasundharāhũ  $  rosāviẏa-āsīvisaharāhũ
mellāviẏa-ṇaẏaṇa-huvāsaṇāhũ  $  saṃjaliẏa-disāmuha-indhaṇāhũ
jaẏalacchi-vahua-geṇhaṇa-maṇāhũ  $  jūrāviẏa-surakāmiṇi-jaṇāhũ
uggāmiẏa-bhāmiẏa-asivarāhũ  $  ṇivvaṭṭiẏa-loṭṭiẏa-haẏavarāhũ
ṇiddaliẏa-kumbhi-kumbhatthalāhũ  $  ucchaliẏa-dhavala-muttāhalāhũ
ghattā:
bhaḍa-thaḍa-gaẏa-ghaḍahĩ bhiḍantaĕhĩ  $  raha-turaẏahĩ turiu bhiḍantaĕhĩ
      raẏa-ṇiẏaru samuṭṭhiu jhatti kiha  $  ṇiẏa-kulu maïlantu du-puttu jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 12:
hari-khurāhaü raü samucchaliu
gaẏa-paẏa-bhara-bhāriẏaĕ  $  dharaĕ ṇāĩ ṇīsāsu melliu
ahava vi mucchāviẏahĕ  $  andhaẏāru jīu vva melliu
aha ṇarinda-kovāṇaleṇa ḍajjhantihĕ
vahala-dhūma-vicchaḍḍaĕ dhūmāẏantihĕ
ahavaï dīhara-dharaṇinda-ṇālĕ  $  jaga-kamalĕ disāmuha-dala-visālĕ
raṇa-meiṇi-kaṇṇiẏa-sohamāṇĕ  $  hari-bhamara-kkhura-vihaḍijjamāṇĕ
ucchaliu mandu maẏarandu ṇāĩ  $  raẏa-ṇihĕṇa va ṇahahŏ dharitti jāi
uḍḍaï va samara-paḍa-vāsacuṇṇu  $  ṇāsaï va so jjĕ rahu turaẏa-chaṇṇu
vārei va raṇu viṇṇi vi valāhã  $  sāiu dei va vaccha-tthalāhã
maïlei va vaẏaṇaĩ ṇaravarāhã  $  āruhaï va upparĕ rahavarāhã
majjaï va maeṇa mahā-gaẏāhã  $  ṇaccaï va kaṇṇa-tālehĩ tāva (?hã)
vīsamaï va chatta-dhaĕhĩ caḍevi  $  tavaï va gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ ṇivvaḍevi
ghattā:
pasarantuṭṭhantu mahantu raü  $  lakkhijjaï kavilaü kavvuraü
      mahi-maḍaü gilantahŏ sa-rahasahŏ  $  ṇaṃ kesa-bhāru raṇa-rakkhasahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 13:
so ṇa sandaṇu so ṇa māẏaṅgu
ṇa turaṅgamu ṇa vi ẏa dhaü  $  ṇāẏavattu jaṃ ṇaü kalaṅkiu
para ṇimmalu āhaẏaṇĕ  $  bhaḍahũ cittu maïlĕvi ṇa sakkiu
jāu suṭṭhu samaraṅgaṇu dūsaṃcāraü
tahi mi ke vi paharanti sa-sāhukkāraü
kehi mi kari-kumbhaĩ paramaṭṭhaĩ  $  ṇaṃ saṅgāma-sirihĕ thaṇavaṭṭaĩ
kehi mi laïẏaĩ ṇara-sira-pavaraĩ  $  ṇaṃ jaẏalacchi-varaṅgaṇa-camaraĩ
kehi mi hiẏaĩ valā riu-chattaĩ  $  ṇaṃ jaẏasiri-līlā-saẏavattaĩ
kehi mi cakkhu-pasaru alahantĕhĩ  $  pahariu vālāluñci karantĕhĩ
keṇa vi khagga-laṭṭhi pariẏaḍḍḥiẏa  $  raṇa-rakkhasahŏ jīha ṇaṃ kaḍḍhiẏa
keṇa vi kari-kumbhatthalu phāḍiu  $  ṇaṃ raṇa-bhavaṇa-vāru ugghāḍiu
katthaï musumūriẏa asi-dhārĕhĩ  $  mottiẏa-danturu hasiẏaü aharĕhĩ
katthaï ruhira-pavāhiṇi dhāvaï  $  jāu mahāhaü pāusu ṇāvaï
ghattā:
soṇiẏa-jala-paharaṇaggiraĕhĩ  $  vasuhantarāla-ṇahaẏala-gaĕhĩ
      pajjalaï valaï dhūmāi raṇu  $  ṇaṃ juga-khaẏa-kālĕ kāla-vaẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 14:
tāva raṇa-raü bhuvaṇu maïlantu
ravi-maṇḍalu païsaraï  $  tahĩ mi sūra-kara-ṇiẏara-tattaü
paḍikhalĕvi disāmuhĕhĩ  $  suḍhiẏa-gattu ṇāvaï ṇiẏattaü
sura-muhāĩ a-lahantaü thiu heṭṭhāmuhu
palaẏa-dhūmakeu va dhūmanta-disāmuhu
lakkhijjaï pallaṭṭantu reṇu  $  raṇa-vasahahŏ ṇaṃ romantha-pheṇu
somittihĕ rāmahŏ rāvaṇāsu  $  ṇaṃ surĕhĩ visajjiu kusuma-vāsu
raṇaevihĕ ṇaṃ suravahu-jaṇeṇa  $  dhūmohu diṇṇu ṇaha-bhāẏaṇeṇa
sara-ṇiẏara-ṇirantara-jajjaraṅgu  $  ṇaṃ dhūlihovi ṇahu paḍahũ laggu
saẏam eva sūra-kara-kheiu vva  $  tisiu vva suṭṭhu pāseiu vva
jalu piẏaï va gaẏa-maẏa-dahĕ atthāhĕ  $  ṇhāï va soṇiẏa-vāhiṇi-pavāhĕ
siñcaï va kumbhi-kara-sīẏarehĩ  $  vijjijjaï vva cala-cāmarehĩ
ṇaṃ sāvarāhu asivara-karāhã  $  kama-kamalĕhĩ ṇivaḍaï ṇaravarāhã
ghattā:
muaü va paharaṇa-saẏa-salliẏaü  $  daḍḍhu va kovaggihĕ ghalliẏaü
      sahasatti samujjalu jāu raṇu  $  khala-virahiu ṇaṃ sajjaṇa-vaẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 15:
raĕ paṇaṭṭhaĕ jāu raṇu ghoru
rāhava-rāvaṇa-valahũ  $  karaṇa-vandha-sara-pahara-ṇiuṇahũ
andhāra-vivajjiẏaü  $  suraü ṇāĩ aṇuratta-mihuṇahũ
raha rahāhã ṇara ṇarahũ turaṅga turaṅgahũ
bhiḍiẏa matta māẏaṅga matta-māẏaṅgahũ
ko vi bhaḍahŏ bhaḍu bhiḍĕvi ṇa icchaï  $  sagga-gamaṇu sahũ surĕhĩ paḍicchaï
ko vi sarāūriẏa-karu dhāvaï  $  raṇa-vahu-avaruṇḍantaü ṇāvaï
kāsu i vāhu-daṇḍu vāṇaggeṃ  $  ṇiu bhuaṅgu ṇaṃ garuḍa-vihaṅgeṃ
kāsu i vāṇa ṇirantara laggā  $  paḍiva ṇa devi ṇa keṇa vi bhaggā
ṇigguṇa jaï vi dhamma-paricattā  $  te ji vandhu je avasarĕ pattā
ṇaccaï kahi mi ruṇḍu raṇa-bhūmihĕ  $  ṇīriṇu huu ṇiẏa-sirĕṇa su-sāmihĕ
kāsu i bhaḍahŏ sīsu utthaliẏaü  $  gaẏaṇahŏ gampi paḍīvaü valiẏaü
dhua-dhavalāẏavattĕ ālīṇaü  $  rāhu-vimvu sasi-vimvĕ caḍīṇaü
ghattā:
keṇa vi siru diṇṇu sāmi-riṇahŏ  $  uru vāṇahũ hiẏaü savvu jiṇahŏ
      saüṇahũ sarīru jīviu jamahŏ  $  aï-cāeṃ ṇāsu ṇa hoi kahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 16:
ko vi gaẏaghaḍa-varavilāsiṇiĕ
kumbhaẏala-paoharĕhĩ  $  bhiṇṇu danti-dantaggĕ laggaï
kara-chittuccāiẏaü  $  ko vi ṇāhi-upparĕ valaggaï
ko vi suṭṭhu heṭṭhāmuhu ṭhiu cintantaü
"kiṇṇa majjhu haẏa-daïveṃ diṇṇu sira-ttaü
jeṃ ṇiriṇu homi tīhi mi jaṇahũ  $  sāmiẏa-saraṇāiẏa-sajjaṇahũ"
kŏ vi sāmihĕ aggaĕ vāvaraï  $  sira-kamalĕhĩ patta-vāḍu karaï
keṇa vi asahāeṃ hontaĕṇa  $  cintiu raṇa-muhĕ jujjhantaĕṇa
"ve vāhaü taïẏaü hiẏaü chuḍu  $  vaïsārami gaẏa-ghaḍa-pīḍhe phuḍu"
kāsu vi sa-vāhu asi-laṭṭhi gaẏa  $  ṇaṃ soraga candaṇa-rukkha-laẏa
kattha i antĕhĩ guppantu haü  $  sāmiu leppiṇu ṇiẏa-simiru gaü
ghattā:
kattha i gaẏa-ghaḍa kovāruhiẏa  $  dhāiẏa suhaḍahŏ savaḍammuhiẏa
    siru dhuṇaï ṇa ḍhukkaï pāsu kiha  $  pahilāraĕ raĕ ṇava-vahua jiha
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 17:
ko vi maẏagalu danta-musalehĩ
āruhĕvi maïndu jiha  $  asivareṇa kumbha-ẏalu dāraï
kaḍḍhĕvi muttāhalaĩ  $  karĕvi dhūli dhavalei ṇāvaï
ko vi danta uppāḍĕvi matta-gaïndahŏ
muaï taṃ jĕ paharaṇu aṇṇahŏ gaẏa-vindahŏ
uddaṇḍa-soṇḍa-maṇḍavĕ visālĕ  $  bhijjanta-danti-gattantarālĕ
kari-kaṇṇa-camara-vijjijjamāṇu  $  ṇaṃ suvaï ko vi raṇa-vahu-samāṇu
gaẏa-maẏa-ṇaï-ruhira-ṇaï-ppavāhĕ  $  vihi veṇī-saṅgamĕ dahĕ athāhĕ
asi kaḍḍhĕvi pharu tappaü karevi  $  jujjhaṇa-maṇa vīra taranti ke vi
kari-kumbhandolaẏa-pāẏavīḍhĕ  $  somāliẏa-ṇāḍā-juala-gīḍhĕ
ubhaẏa-valaĩ pekkhā-jaṇu karevi  $  andoliẏa andolanti ke vi
raṇa-piḍi(?) rahavara-sāriu karevi  $  gaẏa-pāsā pihu pāḍanti ke vi
kattha i siva suhaḍahŏ hiẏaü levi  $  gaẏa vesa va cāḍu-saẏaĩ karevi
ghattā:
kattha i bhaḍu gaẏa-ghaḍa-pelliẏaü  $  bhāmĕvi āẏāsahŏ melliẏaü
      pallaṭṭu paḍīvaü asi dharĕvi  $  ṇaṃ sāmihĕ avasaru sambharĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 74, Kaḍavaka 18:
tahĩ mahāhavĕ amiu haṇuvassa
suggīvahŏ aïẏakaü  $  vijjudaṇḍu ṇīlahŏ viruddhaü
jamaghaṇṭu tāra-suahŏ  $  maẏa-ṇarindu jamvavahŏ kuddhaü
sīhaṇāẏa-sīhoẏara gavaẏa-gavakkhahũ
vijjudāḍha-vijjuppaha saṅkha-susaṅkhahũ
tārāṇaṇu tārahŏ ovaḍiu  $  kallolu taraṅgahŏ abbhiḍiu
jālakkhu suseṇahŏ utthariu  $  candamuheṃ candoẏaru dhariu
abbhiṭṭu kiẏantavattu ṇalahŏ  $  ṇakkhattadavaṇu bhāmaṇḍalahŏ
sañjhāgajagajjiu dahimuhahŏ  $  haẏagīu mahindahŏ ahimuhahŏ
ghaṇaghosu pasaṇṇakitti-ṇivahŏ  $  vajjakkhu vihīsaṇa-patthivahŏ
pavi kundahŏ kumuahŏ sīharahu  $  saddūlahŏ dummuhu duvvisahu
dhūmāṇaṇu kuddhu aṇuddharahŏ  $  jālandhara-rāu vasundharahŏ
viẏaḍoẏaru ṇahusahŏ ovaḍiu  $  taḍikesi raẏaṇakesihĕ bhiḍiu
ghattā:
raṇĕ eva ṇarāhiva utthariẏa  $  sa-rahasa sāmarisa rosa-bhariẏa
      daṇu-dāraṇa-paharaṇa-saṃjuĕhĩ  $  paharanta paropparu sa ĩ bhu ĕhĩ
----------  [75. paṃcahattarimo saṃdhi]  ----------
jama-dhaṇaẏa-purandara-ḍāmarahŏ  $  sa-uraga-jaga-jagaḍāvaṇahŏ
jiha uttara-gaü dāhiṇa-gaẏahŏ  $  bhiḍiu rāmu raṇĕ rāvaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 1:
duvaī
tuṅga-turaṅga-tikkha-ṇakkhukkhaẏa-raẏa-kaẏa-jalaṇa-jālae
duddama-danti-danta-ṇihasuṭṭhiẏa-sihi-siha-vijjumālae
dappubbhaḍa-bhaḍa-thaḍa-saṃkaḍillĕ  $  haẏa-pheṇa-taraṅgiṇi-duttarillĕ
gaẏa-maẏa-ṇaï-kaddama-bhagga-maggĕ  $  kari-kaṇṇa-pavaṇa-pelliẏa-dhaẏaggĕ
cāmīẏara-cāmara-diṇṇa-sohĕ  $  chattoha-pihiẏa-diṇaẏara-karohĕ
dhaẏa-daṇḍa-saṇḍa-maṇḍiẏa-diẏantĕ  $  ṇara-ruṇḍa-khaṇḍa-khāiẏa-kiẏantĕ
haẏa-hiṃsiẏa-bhesiẏa-ravi-turaṅgĕ  $  raha-cakka-cāru-cūriẏa-bhuaṅgĕ
rahasuddha-khandha-ṇacciẏa-kavandhĕ  $  kaṅkāla-māla-kiẏa-seu-vandhĕ
sara-ṇiẏara-diṇṇa-bhuvaṇantarālĕ  $  paḍu-paḍaha-saṅkha-jhallari-vamālĕ
sura-vahu-vimāṇĕ chaïẏantarikkhĕ  $  duvvisamĕ du-saṃcarĕ duṇṇirikkhĕ
ghattā:
tahĩ tehaĕ dāruṇĕ āhaẏaṇĕ  $  gandhavahuddhua-dhavala-dhaẏa
      gajjanta-matta-māẏaṅga jiha  $  bhiḍiẏa paropparu haṇuva-maẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 2:
duvaī
duddama-deha do vi dūrujjhiẏa-dhaṇuhara pavara-vikkamā
jaṇiẏa-jaṇāṇurāẏa jasa-lālasa sa-rahasa sura-parakkamā
paharanti paropparu paharaṇehĩ  $  daṇu-inda-vinda-dappaharaṇehĩ
jala-thala-ṇaha-ẏala-pacchāẏaṇehĩ  $  taḍi-tāmasa-tavaṇuppāẏaṇehĩ
giri-gāruḍa-pāhaṇa-pāẏavehĩ  $  vāruṇa-aggeẏahĩ vāẏavehĩ
to ahimuha-dahimuha-māuleṇa  $  ubbhiẏa-dhuẏa-dhaẏamālāuleṇa
kañcaṇagiri-sarisa-mahāraheṇa  $  sura-ghāẏa-kiṇaṅkiẏa-viggaheṇa
pajjāliẏa-kova-huāsaṇeṇa  $  āẏaḍḍhiẏa-sasara-sarāsaṇeṇa
indaï-kumāra-māẏāmaheṇa  $  haṇuvanta-mahaddhaü chiṇṇu teṇa
to rāvaṇa-uvavaṇa-maddaṇeṇa  $  cala-gamaṇahŏ pavaṇahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa
ghattā:
sa-turaṅgu sa-sārahi sa-dhaü rahu  $  haṇĕvi sarĕhĩ saẏa-khaṇḍu kaü
      ṇaha-laṅghaṇa-karaṇĕhĩ uppaĕvi  $  aṇṇahĩ sandaṇĕ caḍiu maü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 3:
duvaī
raṇa-bhara-dhavala-dhūli-dhūsariẏa-dhaẏavaḍāḍoẏa-ḍamvaro
pakkala-cakka-ṇemi-ṇigghosa-ṇirantara-vahiriẏamvaro
so vi pavaṇa-putteṇa sandaṇo  $  jaṇiẏa-vandi-vandāhiṇandaṇo
mahiharo vva taḍi-vaḍaṇa-tāḍio  $  dāruṇaddhaẏandeṇa pāḍio
to tahiṃ ṇieūṇa ṇiẏa-bhaḍaṃ  $  bhagga-rahavaraṃ chiṇṇa-dhaẏavaḍaṃ
dahamuheṇa māẏā-viṇimmio  $  kari-vimukka-sikkāra-timmio
saṃcaranta-cāmiẏara-cāmaro  $  sāhilāsa-pariosiẏāmaro
acchara-cchavi-cchoha-phasalio  $  ṭaṇaṭaṇanta-ghaṇṭāli-muhalio
kaṇaẏa-kiṅkiṇī-jāla-bhūsio  $  rahavaro turanteṇa pesio
to tahiṃ valaggo ṇisāẏaro  $  toṇa-vāṇa-dhaṇu-guṇa-kiẏāẏaro
ghattā:
mandoẏari-vappeṃ kuddhaĕṇa  $  tikkha-khuruppĕhĩ khaṇḍiẏaü
    haṇuvanteṃ vihalīhūaĕṇa  $  rahu duputtu iva chaṇḍiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 4:
duvaī
jaṃ ṇisiẏara-khuruppa-paharāhihaü haṇuvanta-sandaṇo
taṃ kovaggi-jāla-mālāva(?)palīviu jaṇaẏa-ṇandaṇo
bhāmaṇḍalu maṇḍala-dhammapālu  $  akkhohaṇi-dasa-saẏa-sāmisālu
solaha-āharaṇa-vihūsiẏaṅgu  $  ṇaṃ māṇusa-veseṃ thiu aṇaṅgu
siẏa-cāmaru dhariẏa-siẏāẏavattu  $  vāhĕvi rahu kovāiddhu pattu
"raẏaṇīẏara-lañchaṇa thāhi thāhi  $  valu valu uri rahavaru vāhi vāhi
paĩ muĕvi mahīẏalĕ maṇusu kavaṇu  $  dahasīsa-sasuru sura-manti-damaṇu"
to ẽva bhaṇĕvi bhāmaṇḍaleṇa  $  riu chāiu sahũ ravi-maṇḍaleṇa
sara-jāleṃ jalahara-saṇṇiheṇa  $  viṇṇāṇa-jāṇa-ṇāṇāviheṇa
to maĕṇa vi rosa-vasaṃgaeṇa  $  vaïdehi samāhaü sara-saeṇa
ghattā:
saṇṇāhu chattu dhaẏavara-turaẏa  $  sārahi rahu raṇĕ jajjariu
      bhāmaṇḍalu a-viṇaẏavantu jiha  $  para ekkellaü uvvariu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 5:
duvaī
tāva sutāra-tāra-tārāvaï tārāvaï-samappaho
suravara-pavara-kari-karāẏāra-karāhaẏa-haẏa-mahāraho
so jaṇaẏa-taṇaẏa-maẏa-kaẏa-vamālĕ  $  suggīu pariṭṭhiu antarālĕ
viñjhu va jiha dāhiṇa-uttarāhã  $  abbhiṭṭu parupparu samaru tāhã
raẏaṇīẏara-vāṇara-lañchaṇāhã  $  dhavaliẏa-ṇiẏa-kulahã a-lañchaṇāhã
vijjāhara-pura-paramesarāhã  $  ekkekkama-chiṇṇa-mahārahāhã
sara-vaḍaṇa-viẏāriẏa-sāhaṇāhã  $  jaẏasiri-jaẏa-diṇṇa-pasāhaṇāhã
saṃcaraï kaïddhaü jahĩ ji jahĩ  $  rivu sarahĩ ṇirumbhaï tahĩ jĕ tahĩ
jahĩ jahĩ rahavarĕ āruhaï gampi  $  indaï-māẏāmahu haṇaï taṃ pi
jaṃ jaṃ dhaṇuharu suggīvu lei  $  taṃ taṃ raẏaṇīẏaru khaẏahŏ ṇei
ghattā:
kiṃ ekkahŏ kikkindhāhivahŏ  $  hiẏaïcchiẏaü ṇa saṃpaḍaï
      dhaṇu savvahŏ lakkhaṇa-virahiẏahŏ  $  laïu laïu hatthahŏ paḍaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 6:
duvaī
tāva vihīsaṇeṇa dhūvanta-dhaẏavaḍāliddha-ṇahaẏalo
sūla-mahāuheṇa rahu vāhiu vahulucchaliẏa-kalaẏalo
"valu valu maẏa māma maṇohirāma  $  sura-samara-sahāsa-paẏāsa-ṇāma
maĩ muĕvi vihīsaṇu jhaḍa-jhaḍakka  $  ko sahaï tuhārī ṇara-caḍakka"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi mandoẏari-jaṇeru  $  ṇikkampu pariṭṭhiu ṇāĩ meru
"osaru osaru maṃ puraü thāhi  $  chala-virahiu raṇu pariharĕvi jāhi
pārakkaĕ thakkaĕ haṃsa-dīvĕ  $  guṇu jaï vi ṇāhi vīsaddha-gīvĕ
tahĩ avasarĕ kiṃ taü muĕvi juttu  $  jaï saccaü raẏaṇāsavahŏ puttu"
to ẽva bhaṇĕvi vavagaẏa-bhaeṇa  $  rahu kavaü chattu chijjaï maeṇa
kiu kalaẏalu ṇisiẏara-sāhaṇeṇa  $  vollijjaï sura-kāmiṇi-jaṇeṇa
ghattā:
"mārui bhāmaṇḍalu pamaẏavaï  $  sa-vihīsaṇa vicchāiẏaĩ
      gaẏa-pāeṃ vuḍḍhīhūẏaĕṇa  $  maĕṇa ji kaha va ṇa māriẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 7:
duvaī
to khara-ṇahara-pahara-dhuva-kesara-kesari-jutta-sandaṇo
dhavala-mahaddhao samuddhāiu dasaraha-jeṭṭha-ṇandaṇo
jasa-dhavala-dhūli-dhūsariẏa-aṅgu  $  dhavalamvaru dhavalāvara-turaṅgu
dhavalāṇaṇu dhavala-palamva-vāhu  $  dhavalāmala-komala-kamalaṇāhu
dhavalaü jĕ sahāveṃ dhavala-vaṃsu  $  dhavalacchi-marālihĕ rāẏahaṃsu
dhavalāhã dhavalu dhavalāẏavatta  $  rahuṇandaṇu daṇu paharantu pattu
helaĕ jĕ viṇāsiu maẏa-maraṭṭu  $  rahu khañcĕvi pacchāmuhu paẏaṭṭu
tahĩ avasarĕ sura-saṃtāvaṇeṇa  $  rahu antarĕ dijjaï rāvaṇeṇa
vahurūviṇi-rūva-ṇirūviẏaṅgu  $  gaẏa-dasa-saẏa-saṃcāliẏa-rahaṅgu
dasa sahasa pariṭṭhiẏa gatta-rakkha  $  sāraccha karāviẏa aggalakkha
ghattā:
ṇaṃ añjaṇa-mahihara-tuhiṇa-giri  $  vahu-kālahŏ ekkahĩ ghaḍiẏa
      kovāruṇĕ dāruṇĕ āhaẏaṇĕ  $  rāmaṇa-rāma ve vi bhiḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 8:
duvaī
jāṇaï-jalaṇa-jāla-mālāvalīviẏā ve vi dāruṇā
kuddha-maẏandha-gandha-sindhura va valuddhura rāma-rāmaṇā
to raṇa-bhara-pavara-dhurandhareṇa  $  apphāliu dhaṇu dasa-kandhareṇa
ṇaṃ gajjiu palaẏa-mahāghaṇeṇa  $  ṇaṃ ghoriu ghoru jamāṇaṇeṇa
appāṇu ghittu ṇaṃ ṇahaẏaleṇa  $  ṇaṃ virasiu virasu rasāẏaleṇa
ṇaṃ mahiẏalĕ ṇivaḍiu vajja-ghāu  $  valĕ rāmahŏ kampu mahantu jāu
maẏa viẏaliẏa matta-mahāgaẏāhã  $  raha phuṭṭa tuṭṭa paggaha haẏāhã
hallohalihūa ṇarinda savva  $  ṇipphanda ṇirāuha galiẏa-gavva
dhaẏa-chattĕhĩ kaḍaẏaḍa-saddu ghuṭṭhu  $  kāẏara vāṇara tharahariẏa suṭṭhu
vollanti paropparu "ṇaṭṭhu kajju  $  saṃghāra-kālu laĕ ḍhukku ajju
ghattā:
ettahĕ raẏaṇāẏaru duppagamu  $  ettahĕ dāruṇu dahavaẏaṇu
      evahĩ jīvevaü kahi taṇaü  $  diṭṭhu ṇa pariẏaṇu gharu saẏaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 9:
duvaī
to ṇaggoha-roha-pāroha-paīhara-vāhu-daṇḍĕṇaṃ
viḍasuggīva-jīva-haraṇeṇa raṇe mattaṇḍa-caṇḍĕṇaṃ
apphāliu vajjāvattu cāu  $  tahŏ saddeṃ kahŏ ṇa vi gaẏaü gāu
tahŏ saddeṃ vahiriu ṇahu asesu  $  thiu jagu jĕ ṇāĩ maraṇāvasesu
tahŏ saddeṃ ṇaṃ ṇāẏaülu tuṭṭu  $  kaha kaha vi ṇa kumma-kaḍāhu phuṭṭu
rasarasiẏa susāviẏa sāẏarā vi  $  kampāviẏa canda-divāẏarā vi
ḍollāviẏa kulagiri diggaẏā vi  $  appaṃparihūa surindaẏā vi
dasakandhara-raha-kari-ṇiẏaru raḍiu  $  laṅkahĕ pāẏāru daḍatti paḍiu
chuha-dhavalaĩ ṇaẏaṇāṇandirāĩ  $  paḍiẏāĩ asesaĩ mandirāĩ
kŏ vi pāṇĕhĩ mukku aṇāhavo vi  $  ṇaru kāẏaru kāha mi kahaï ko vi
ghattā:
"lahu ṇāsahũ laṅghĕvi maẏaraharu  $  ettha vasantahã ṇāhi dhara
      dhaṇuhara-ṭaṅkāru jĕ pāṇaharu  $  jaï ghaĩ āiẏa rāma-sara"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 10:
tāva dasāṇaṇeṇa apamāṇĕhĩ bāṇĕhĩ chāiẏaṃ ṇahaṃ
dasaraha-ṇandaṇeṇa te chiṇṇa ṇahĕ cciẏa paḍiẏa paḍivahaṃ
to hasiu rāmeṇa  $  rāmāhirāmeṇa
ucchaliẏa-ṇāmeṇa  $  laddhārithāmeṇa
"dhaṇuveẏa-parihīṇa  $  osaru parāhīṇa
jajjāhi āvāsu  $  aṇṇamaü guru-pāsu
dhaṇu-lakkhaṇaṃ vujjhu  $  divasehĩ puṇu jujjhu
eṇa ji paẏāveṇa  $  duṇṇaẏa-sahāveṇa
saṃtāviẏā deva  $  kārāviẏā seva
ahavaï asārāhã  $  raṇĕ cora-jārāhã
viẏalanti sattāĩ  $  ṇa vahanti gattāĩ"
to ṇisiẏarindeṇa  $  ṇijjiẏa-surindeṇa
jama-dhaṇaẏa-jhampeṇa  $  kaïlāsa-kampeṇa
sahasaẏara-dharaṇeṇa  $  vara-varuṇa-varaṇeṇa
sura-bhavaṇa-bhīseṇa  $  vīsaddha-sīseṇa
kovaggi-ditteṇa  $  vahaṇekka-citteṇa
tama-puñja-deheṇa  $  ṇaṃ palaẏa-meheṇa
bhū-bhaṅguraccheṇa  $  maṇa-pavaṇa-daccheṇa
ghattā:
vīsahi mi karĕhĩ vīsāuhaĩ  $  ekka-vāra raṇĕ mukkāĩ
      gharu kiviṇahŏ bhāmantu vaï jiha   $  rāmahŏ pāsu ṇa ḍhukkāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 11:
duvaī
ṇavara dasāṇaṇeṇa vāmohu tamohu saro visajjio
so vi valuddhureṇa rāmeṇa paẏaṅga-sareṇa ṇijjio
rāmaṇĕṇa visajjiu kulisa-daṇḍu  $  sŏ vi rāmeṃ kiu saẏa-khaṇḍa-khaṇḍu
rāmaṇĕṇa samāhaü pāẏaveṇa  $  sŏ vi bhaggu mahattheṃ vāẏaveṇa
rāmaṇĕṇa visajjiu giri vicittu  $  sŏ vi rāmeṃ vali jiha disahĩ ghittu
aggeu mukku dasa-kandhareṇa  $  ulhāviu so vi vāruṇa-sareṇa
rāmaṇĕṇa visajjiu paṇṇaẏatthu  $  sŏ vi gāruḍa-vāṇĕhĩ kiu ṇiratthu
rāmaṇĕṇa gaẏāṇaṇa-sara vimukka  $  tāha mi vala-vāṇa-maïnda ḍhukka
rāmaṇĕṇa visajjiu sāẏaratthu  $  taṃ mandara-ghāeṃ ṇiu ṇiratthu
jaṃ jaṃ āmellaï ṇisiẏarindu  $  taṃ taṃ vi ṇivāraï rāmacandu
ghattā:
raṇĕ rāmaṇa-rāma-sarĕhĩ valaĩ  $  samara-bhūmi mellāviẏaĩ
      dupputtahĩ jiha pahavantaĕhĩ  $  uhaẏa-kulaĩ saṃtāviẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 12:
duvaī
viṇṇi vi suddha-vaṃsa raẏaṇāsava-dasaraha-jeṭṭha-ṇandaṇā
viṇṇi vi diṇṇa-saṅkha kari-kesari-jottiẏa-pavara-sandaṇā
vihĩ hatthĕhĩ paharaï rāmacandu  $  vīsahĩ bhuva-daṇḍĕhĩ ṇisiẏarindu
a-pavāṇa vāṇa rāhavahŏ to vi  $  jajjariẏa laṅka raẏaṇāẏaro vi
chāijjaï gaẏaṇu caḍantaehĩ  $  akhaliẏa-sara-mahi-ṇivaḍantaehĩ
vāevaü cattu pahañjaṇeṇa  $  rahu khañciu aditihĕ ṇandaṇeṇa
disa-karihũ asesahuṃ galiu gāu  $  hallohalihūaü jagu jĕ sāu
bhijjanti valaĩ jalĕ jalaẏarā vi  $  ṇahĕ ṇaṭṭha deva thalĕ thalaẏarā vi
so ṇa vi gaẏavaru so ṇa vi turaṅgu  $  so ṇa vi rahavaru taṇ ṇa vi rahaṅgu
so ṇa vi dhaü taṇ ṇa vi āẏavattu  $  jahĩ rāma-sarahã saü saü ṇa pattu
ghattā:
gaẏa satta divaha jujjhantāhũ  $  to i ṇa cheu mahāhavahŏ
      lahu lakkhaṇu antarĕ devi rahu  $  vijaü ṇāĩ thiu rāhavahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 13:
duvaī
"vala maĩ kiṅkareṇa kiṃ kīraï jaï tuhũ dharahi dhaṇuharaṃ
ṇisiẏara-kula-kiẏantu haũ acchami rāvaṇa vāhĕ rahavaraṃ
dummuha duccariẏa durāẏa-rāẏa  $  taü rāhava-kerā kuddha pāẏa
valu urĕ kaü cukkahi mahu jiẏantu  $  vahu-kāleṃ pāvaü dhaü kiẏantu
to kova-jalaṇa-jāloli-jaliu  $  "haṇu haṇu" bhaṇantu lakkhaṇahŏ valiu
te vāsueva-paḍivāsueva  $  kula-dhavala dhaṇuddhara sāvaleva
gaẏa-gāruḍa-sandaṇa kasaṇa-deha  $  uṇṇaïẏa ṇāĩ ṇahĕ palaẏa-meha
ṇaṃ sīha mahīhara-matthaẏattha  $  ṇaṃ viñjha-sajjha uaẏācalattha
ṇaṃ añjaṇa-mahihara viṇṇihūa  $  ṇaṃ ṇara-ṇiheṇa thiẏa kāla-dūẏa
ṇaṃ ravi-rattuppala-toḍaṇattha  $  ṇaṃ dharaĕ pasāriẏa uhaẏa hattha
ghattā:
laṅkesara-lakkhaṇa utthariẏa  $  palaẏa-jalaẏa-gambhīra-rava
      veẏāla-sahasāĩ ṇacciẏaĩ  $  "jaï para hosaï ajja dhava
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 14:
duvaī
jaṃ kiu rāhaveṇa taṃ tuhu mi karesahi bhūmi-goẏarā"
daha-dāhiṇa-karehĩ daha-vaẏaṇeṃ daha kaḍḍhiẏa mahā-sarā
pahileṇa pavaru ṇaggoha-rukkhu  $  vīeṇa mahaggiri diṇṇa-dukkhu
jalu taïeṃ jalaṇu caütthaeṇa  $  pañcamĕṇa sīhu phaṇi chaṭṭhaeṇa
sattamĕṇa matta-māẏaṅga-līlu  $  aṭṭhamĕṇa ṇisāẏaru visama-sīlu
ṇavameṇa mahantu mahandhaẏāru  $  dahameṇa mahovahi-hatthiẏāru
dasa divva mahā-sara palaẏa-bhāva  $  dasa disaü ṇirumbhĕvi ṭhanti jāva
to lakkhaṇu vuttu vihīsaṇeṇa  $  "divvatthaĩ laïẏaĩ rāvaṇeṇa
ekkekku jĕ hoi aṇeẏa-bhāẏa  $  ekkekku jĕ darisaï viviha māẏa
ekkekku jĕ jagu jagaḍĕvi samatthu  $  laï ehaĕ avasarĕ vāhi hatthu
ghattā:
jaï āẏaĩ paĩ ṇa ṇivāriẏaĩ  $  āẏāmeppiṇu bhua-jualu
      to ṇa vi haũ ṇa vi tuhũ rāmu ṇa vi  $  ṇa vi suggīu ṇa pamaẏa-valu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 15:
duvaī
to lacchīhareṇa taru ḍajjhaï huavaha-tuṇḍa-kaṇḍĕṇaṃ
māẏā-mahiharo vi musumūriu dāruṇa-vajja-daṇḍĕṇaṃ
vāẏaveṇa viṇāsiu vāruṇatthu  $  vāruṇeṇa huāsaṇu kiu ṇiratthu
saraheṇa sīhu garuḍeṇa ṇāu  $  pañcāṇaṇeṇa gaẏa(?) diṇṇu ghāu
ṇisiẏaru ṇiruddhu ṇārāẏaṇeṇa  $  tamu ṇāsiu diṇaẏara-paharaṇeṇa
sosiu samuddu vaḍavāṇaleṇa  $  tahĩ avasarĕ āẏaü ṇahaẏaleṇa
vara kaṇṇaü aṭṭha maṇoharāu  $  sura-kari-kumbhaẏala-paoharāu
sasivaddhaṇa-vijjāhara-suāu  $  mālaï-mālā-komala-bhuāu
"vaïdehi-saẏamvarĕ vuttiẏāu  $  lacchīhara tuha kula-uttiẏāu
jaẏa ṇanda vaḍḍha siddhatthu hohi"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi harisiu hari-virohi
ghattā:
siddhatthu atthu maṇĕ sambharĕvi  $  mukku ṇisāẏara-ṇāẏagĕṇa
      tami(?taṃ) dhariu kumāreṃ entu ṇahĕ  $  attheṃ viggha-viṇāẏagĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 16:
duvaī
jaṃ jaṃ kiṃ pi paharaṇaṃ muaï ṇisāẏara-vaï dasāṇaṇo
taṃ taṃ sara-saehĩ viṇivāraï addha-vahĕ jjĕ lakkhaṇo
to tiẏasa-vinda-kandāvaṇeṇa  $  vahurūviṇi cintiẏa rāvaṇeṇa
"de de āesu" bhaṇanti āẏa  $  muha-kuharĕ viṇiggaẏa tahŏ vi vāẏa
"jaṃ aṭṭha divasa ārāhiẏā-si  $  vahu-mantĕhĩ thottĕhĩ sāhiẏā-si
teṃ sahala maṇoraha karahi ajju  $  bhū-goẏara-mahiharĕ hohi vajju
dahavaẏaṇahŏ keraü rūvu levi  $  māẏāmaü rahavaru hohi devi"
utthariẏa vijja sahũ lakkhaṇeṇa  $  dohāviẏa teṇa vi takkhaṇeṇa
darisāviẏa vijjaĕ parama māẏa  $  atthakkaĕ rāvaṇa veṇṇi jāẏa
te pahaẏa caẏāri samottharanti  $  paḍipahaẏa caẏāri vi aṭṭha honti
ghattā:
solaha vattīsa dūṇa-kamĕṇa  $  viviha-rūva-darisāvaṇahũ
      vahurūviṇi-vijjaĕ ṇimmaviẏa  $  raṇĕ akkhohaṇi rāvaṇahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 17:
duvaī
jalĕ thalĕ gaẏaṇĕ chattĕ dhaĕ toraṇĕ pacchaĕ purĕ vi rāvaṇo
to lacchīhareṇa saru melliu māẏā-uvasamāvaṇo
tahŏ sarahŏ pahāveṃ vijja pavara  $  thiu ekku dasāṇaṇu hovi ṇavara
utthariu aṇantĕhĩ saravarehĩ  $  ṇārāĕhĩ tīrĕhĩ tomarehĩ
vāvallĕhĩ bhallĕhĩ kaṇṇiehĩ  $  avarahi mi asesahĩ vaṇṇiehĩ
somittiṃ taṃ sara-jālu chiṇṇu  $  rahu khaṇḍĕvi puṇu vali disahĩ diṇṇu
aṇṇahĩ rahavarĕ āruhaï jāva  $  siru haṇĕvi khuruppeṃ chiṇṇu tāva
ṇaṃ haṃseṃ toḍiu āraṇālu  $  cala-jīhu viẏaḍa-dāḍhā-karālu
kahakahakahantu lallakka-vaẏaṇu  $  jāloli-phuliṅga-muanta-ṇaẏaṇu
ubbhaḍa-bhiuḍī-bhaṅguriẏa-bhālu  $  kampira-kavolu cala-dāḍhiẏālu
ghattā:
siru sa-maüḍu paṭṭa-vihūsiẏaü  $  sahaï phurantĕhĩ kuṇḍalĕhĩ
      ṇaṃ meru-siṅgu sahũ ṇivaḍiẏaü  $  canda-divāẏara-maṇḍalĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 18:
duvaī
tāva samuggaẏāĩ riu-dehahŏ aṇṇaĩ veṇṇi sīsaïṃ
"maru maru" "paharu paharu" pabhaṇantaĩ ubbhaḍa-bhiuḍi-bhīsaïṃ
tāĩ vi toḍiẏaĩ sa-kalaẏalāĩ  $  ṇaṃ dahavaẏaṇahŏ duṇṇaẏa-phalāĩ
to ṇavari caẏāri samuṭṭhiẏāĩ  $  ṇaṃ thala-kamaliṇi-kamalaĩ thiẏāĩ
puṇu aṇṇaĩ aṭṭha samuggaẏāĩ  $  ṇaṃ phaṇasahŏ phaṇasaĩ ṇiggaẏāĩ
puṇu solaha puṇu vattīsa honti  $  caüsaṭṭhi siraĩ puṇu ṇīsaraṃti
saü aṭṭhāvīsaü takkhaṇeṇa  $  pāḍijjaï sīsahũ lakkhaṇeṇa
chappaṇṇaĩ viṇṇi saẏaĩ kiẏāĩ  $  chiṇṇaï kumāru jiha dukkiẏāĩ
puṇu pañca saẏāĩ sa-vārahāĩ  $  kamalāĩ va toḍaï turiu tāĩ
puṇu caüvīsottaru sira-sahāsu  $  pāḍaï vaccha-tthala-siri-ṇivāsu
ghattā:
sīsaĩ chindantahŏ lakkhaṇahŏ  $  viuṇaü viuṇaü vittharaï
      raṇĕ dakkhavantu vahu-rūvāĩ  $  rāvaṇu chandahŏ aṇuharaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 19:
duvaī
jiha ṇiṭṭhanti ṇāhi riu-sīsaĩ tiha lakkhaṇa-mahāsarā
"dukkaru thatti etthu raṇĕ hosaï" ṇahĕ vollanti suravarā
to jaṇa-maṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇeṇa  $  paharanteṃ dasaraha-ṇandaṇeṇa
riu-siraĩ tāva viṇivāiẏāĩ  $  raṇa-bhūmihĩ jāva ṇa māiẏāĩ
jiha sīsaĩ tiha haẏa vāhu-daṇḍa  $  ṇaṃ garuḍeṃ visahara kaẏa du-khaṇḍa
saẏa sahasa lakkha a-parippamāṇa  $  ekkekkaĕ tahi mi aṇeẏa vāṇa
ṇaggohahŏ ṇaṃ pāroha chiṇṇa  $  ṇaṃ sura-kari-kara keṇa vi païṇṇa
savvaṅguli savva-ṇahujjalaṅga  $  ṇaṃ pañca-phaṇāvali thiẏa bhuaṅga
kŏ vi karaẏalu sahaï sa-maṇḍalaggu  $  ṇaṃ taruvara-pallaü laẏahŏ laggu
kŏ vi sahaï silimmuha-saṅgameṇa  $  ṇaṃ laïu bhuaṅgu bhuaṅgameṇa
ghattā:
mahi-maṇḍalu maṇḍiu kara-sirĕhĩ  $  chuḍu khuḍiehĩ sa-komalĕhĩ
      raṇa-devaẏa acciẏa lakkhaṇĕṇa  $  ṇāĩ sa-ṇālĕhĩ uppalĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 20:
duvaī
gaẏa dasa divasa vihi mi jujjhantahã to vi ṇa ṇiṭṭhiẏaṃ raṇaṃ
māẏā-rāvaṇeṇa vollijjaï "jaï jīveṇa kāraṇaṃ
to jaṃ jāṇahi taṃ karĕ davatti  $  laṅkesara mahu ettaḍiẏa satti"
sa-vilakkhu rakkhu saẏam eva thakku  $  palaẏakka-sama-ppahu laïu cakku
parirakkhaṇu jakkha-sahāsu jāsu  $  visahara-ṇara-suravara-jaṇiẏa-tāsu
duddarisaṇu bhīsaṇu ṇisiẏa-dhāru  $  muttāhala-mālā-māliẏāru
sa-kusuma-candaṇa-caccikkiẏaṅgu  $  ṇiẏa-ṇāsu ṇāĩ darisiu rahaṅgu
taṃ ṇiĕvi ṇaṭṭha ṇahĕ suravarā vi  $  osarĕvi dūrĕ thiẏa vāṇarā vi
to vuttu kumāreṃ ṇisiẏarindu  $  "paĩ jeṇa paẏāveṃ dhariu indu
laï teṇa paẏāveṃ duṭṭha-bhāva  $  muĕ cakku cirāvahi kāĩ pāva"
ghattā:
duvvaẏaṇuddīviĕ dahamuhĕṇa  $  karĕ rahaṅgu uggāmiẏaü
      ṇahĕ teṇa bhamāḍijjantaĕṇa  $  jagu jĕ savvu ṇaṃ bhāmiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 21:
duvaī
to lacchīhareṇa chiṇṇaṇahĩ samārambhiu rahaṅgaẏaṃ
tīriẏa-tomarehĩ ṇārāĕhĩ tahŏ vi valā samāgaẏaṃ
riu-kara-vimukku maṇa-pavaṇa-veu  $  ghaṇa-ghora-ghosu palaẏaggi-teu
raṇĕ dharĕvi ṇa sakkiu lakkhaṇeṇa  $  pahaṇanti asesa vi takkhaṇeṇa
suggīvu gaeṃ rāhaü haleṇa  $  sūleṇa vihīsaṇu paccaleṇa
bhāmaṇḍalu pattala-asivareṇa  $  haṇuvantu mahanteṃ moggareṇa
aṅgaü tikkhĕṇa kuṭṭhāraeṇa  $  ṇalu cakkeṃ vaïri-viẏāraṇeṇa
jamvaü jhaseṇa phaliheṇa ṇīlu  $  kaṇaeṇa virāhiu visama-sīlu
kunteṇa kundu dahimuhu ghaṇeṇa  $  keṇa vi ṇa ṇivāriu paharaṇeṇa
bhañjantu asesāuha-saẏāĩ  $  ṇaṃ tuhiṇu dahantu saroruhāĩ
paribhamiu ti-vāraü tarala-tuṅgu  $  ṇaṃ meruhĕ pāsĕhĩ bhāṇu-vimvu
ghattā:
jaṃ aṇṇa-bhavantarĕ ajjiẏaü  $  taṃ appaṇahi(?) samāvaḍiu
      āṇā-viheu su-kalattu jiha  $  cakku kumārahŏ karĕ caḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 75, Kaḍavaka 22:
duvaī
jaṃ uppaṇṇu cakku somittihĕ taṃ sura-ṇiẏaru tosiu
dunduhi diṇṇa mukka kusumañjali sāhukkāru ghosiu
ahiṇandiu lakkhaṇu vāṇarehĩ  $  "jaẏa ṇanda vaddha maṅgala-ravehĩ
cintavaï vihīsaṇu jāẏa saṅka  $  "laï ṇaṭṭhu kajju ucchiṇṇa laṅka
muu rāvaṇu santaï tuṭṭa ajju  $  mandoẏari vihava viṇaṭṭhu rajju"
pabhaṇaï kumāru "karĕ cittu dhīru  $  chuḍu sīẏa samappaï khamaï vīru"
to guhiẏa-candahāsāuheṇa  $  hakkāriu lakkhaṇu dahamuheṇa
"laï paharu paharu kiṃ karahi kheu  $  tuhũ ekkeṃ cakkeṃ sāvaleu
mahu ghaĩ puṇu āeṃ kavaṇu gaṇṇu  $  kiṃ sīhahŏ hoi sahāu aṇṇu"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi vipphuriẏāhareṇa  $  melliu rahaṅgu lacchīhareṇa
ghattā:
uaẏaïrihĕ ṇaṃ atthaïri gaü  $  sūra-vimvu kara-maṇḍiẏaü
      sa ĩ bhu ĕhĩ haṇantahŏ dahamuhahŏ  $  maṇḍa ura-tthalu khaṇḍiẏaü
----------  [76. chasattarimo saṃdhi]  ----------
ṇihaĕ dasāṇaṇĕ kiu surĕhĩ  $  kalaẏalu bhuvaṇa-maṇoraha-gāraü
loa-pāla sacchanda thiẏa  $  dunduhi pahaẏa paṇacciu ṇāraü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 1:
ṇivaḍiĕ rāvaṇĕ tihuaṇa-kaṇṭaĕ  $  kula-maṅgala-kalasĕ vva visaṭṭaĕ
ṇaha-siri-dappaṇĕ vva vicchuṭṭaĕ  $  lacchi-varaṅgaṇa-hārĕ va tuṭṭaĕ
puhaï-vilāsiṇi-māṇĕ va galiẏaĕ  $  raṇavahu-jovvaṇe vva daramaliẏaĕ
dāhiṇa-disa-gaĕ vva oṇallaĕ  $  ṇīsāriĕ va surāsura-sallaĕ
raṇa-devaẏa-ṇamaṃsiĕ va diṇṇaĕ  $  toẏadavāhaṇa-vaṃsĕ va chiṇṇaĕ
cavaṇa-purandarĕ vva saṃkamiĕ  $  kālahŏ diṇaẏarĕ vva atthamiĕ
laṅkāuri-pāẏārĕ va paḍiẏaĕ  $  sīẏa-saẏattaṇĕ vva ṇivvaḍiẏaĕ
tama-saṅghāĕ va puñjĕvi mukkaĕ  $  añjaṇa-selĕ va thāṇahŏ cukkaĕ
ghattā:
teṇa paḍanteṃ pāḍiẏaĩ  $  cittaĩ raṇĕ raẏaṇīẏara-ṇāmahũ
    pāṇa mahārahĕ mahiharahŏ  $  sura-kusumaĩ sirĕ lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 2:
amarĕhĩ sāhukkāriĕ hari-valĕ  $  vijaĕ paghuṭṭhĕ samuṭṭhiĕ kalaẏalĕ
tahĩ avasarĕ maṇi-gaṇa-vipphuriẏahĕ  $  upparĕ karu karevi ṇiẏa-churiẏahĕ
appaü haṇaï vihīsaṇu jāvĕhĩ   $  mucchaĕ ṇāĩ ṇivāriu tāvehĩ
ṇivaḍiu dharaṇi-paṭṭĕ ṇicceẏaṇu  $  dukkhu samuṭṭhiu pasariẏa-veẏaṇu
caraṇa dharevi ruevaĕ laggaü  $  "hā bhāẏara maĩ muĕvi kahiṃ gaü
hā hā bhāẏara ṇa kiu ṇivāriu  $  jaṇa-viruddhu vavahariu ṇirāriu
hā bhāẏara sarīrĕ sukumāraĕ  $  kema viẏāriu cakkahŏ dhāraĕ
hā bhāẏara duṇṇiddaĕ bhuttaü  $  sejja muĕvi kiṃ mahiẏalĕ suttaü
ghattā:
kiṃ avaheri karevi thiu  $  sīsĕ caḍāviẏa calaṇa tuhārā
   acchami suṭṭhummāhiẏaü  $  hiẏaü phuṭṭu āliṅgi bhaḍārā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 3:
ruaï vihīsaṇu soẏakkamiẏaü  $  "tuhũ ṇatthamiu vaṃsu atthamiẏaü
tuhũ ṇa jio 'si saẏalu jiu tihuaṇu  $  tuhũ ṇa muo 'si muaü vandiẏa-jaṇu
tuhũ paḍio 'si ṇa paḍiu purandaru  $  maüḍu ṇa bhaggu bhaggu giri-mandaru
diṭṭhi ṇa ṇaṭṭha ṇaṭṭha laṅkāuri  $  vāẏa ṇa ṇaṭṭha ṇaṭṭha mandoẏari
hāru ṇa tuṭṭu tuṭṭu tārāẏaṇu  $  hiẏaü ṇa bhiṇṇu bhiṇṇu gaẏaṇaṅgaṇu
cakku ṇa ḍhukku ḍhukku ekkantaru  $  āu ṇa khuṭṭu khuṭṭu raẏaṇāẏaru
jīu ṇa gaü gaü āsā-poṭṭalu  $  tuhũ ṇa suttu suttaü mahi-maṇḍalu
sīẏa ṇa āṇiẏa āṇiẏa jamaüri  $  hari-vala kuddha ṇa kuddhā kesari
ghattā:
suravara-saṇḍha-varāiṇā  $  saẏala-kāla je miga sambhūẏā
    rāvaṇa paĩ sīheṇa viṇu  $  te vi ajju sacchandīhūẏā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 4:
saẏala-surāsura-diṇṇa-pasaṃsahŏ  $  ajju amaṅgalu rakkhasa-vaṃsahŏ
khala-khuddahũ pisuṇahũ duviẏaḍḍhahũ  $  ajju maṇoraha suravara-saṇḍhahũ
dunduhi vajjaü gajjaü sāẏaru  $  ajju tavaü sacchandu divāẏaru
ajju miẏaṅku hou pahavantaü  $  vāu vāu jagĕ ajju saïttaü
ajju dhaṇaü dhaṇa-riddhi ṇiẏacchaü  $  ajju jalantu jalaṇu jagĕ acchaü
ajju jamahŏ ṇivvahaü jamattaṇu  $  ajju kareu indu indattaṇu
ajju ghaṇahã pūrantu maṇoraha  $  ajju ṇiraggala hontu mahāgaha
ajju papphullaü phalaü vaṇāsaï  $  ajju gāu mokkalaü sarāsaï
ghattā:
tāva dasāṇaṇu āhaẏaṇĕ  $  paḍiu suṇevi sa-doru sa-ṇeuru
    dhāiu mandoẏari-pamuhu  $  dhāhāvantu saẏalu anteuru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 5:
dummaṇu dukkha-mahaṇṇavĕ ghittaü  $  piẏa-vioẏa-jāloli-palittaü
mokkala-kesu visaṇṭhula-gattaü  $  vihaḍapphaḍu ṇivaḍantuṭṭhantaü
uddha-hatthu uddhāhāvantaü  $  aṃsu-jaleṇa vasuha siñcantaü
ṇeura-hāra-dora-guppantaü  $  candaṇa-chaḍa-kaddamĕ khuppantaü
pīṇa-paohara-bhārakkantaü  $  kajjala-jala-mala-maïlijjantaü
ṇaṃ koila-kulu kahi mi paẏaṭṭaü  $  ṇaṃ gaṇiẏāri-jūhu vicchuṭṭaü
ṇaṃ kamaliṇi-vaṇu thāṇahŏ cukkaü  $  ṇaṃ haṃsiulu mahāsara-mukkaü
kaluṇa-sareṇa rasantu padhāiu  $  ṇiviseṃ raṇa-dharitti sampāiu
ghattā:
haẏa-gaẏa-bhaḍa-ruhirāruṇiẏa  $  samara-vasundhari soha ṇa pāvaï
    rattaü parihĕvi paṅgurĕvi  $  thiẏa rāvaṇa-aṇumaraṇeṃ ṇāvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 6:
diṭṭhu mahāhavu viṇivāiẏa-bhaḍu  $  āmisa-soṇiẏa-rasa-vasa-vīsaḍu
haḍḍa-ruṇḍa-vicchaḍḍa-bhaẏaṅkaru  $  loṭṭāviẏa-dhaẏa-cindha-ṇirantaru
ṇacciẏa-uddha-kavandha-visanthulu  $  vāẏasa-ghora-giddha-siva-saṅkulu
kahi mi āẏavattaĩ sasi-dhavalaĩ  $  ṇaṃ raṇa-devaẏa-accaṇa-kamalaĩ
kahi mi turaṅga vāṇa-viṇibhiṇṇā  $  raṇa-devaẏahĕ ṇāĩ vali diṇṇā
kahi mi sarehĩ dhariẏa ṇahĕ kuñjara  $  ṇaṃ jala-dhārā-ūriẏa jalahara
kahi mi rahaṅga-bhagga thiẏa rahavara  $  ṇaṃ vajjāsaṇi-sūḍiẏa mahihara
tahĩ dahavaẏaṇu diṭṭhu vahu-vāhaü  $  kappa-taru vva paloṭṭiẏa-sāhaü
rajja-gaẏālaṇa-khambhu va chiṇṇaü  $  lakkhaṇa-cakka-raẏaṇa-viṇibhiṇṇaü
ghattā:
daha diẏahāĩ sa-rattiẏaĩ  $  jaṃ jujjhantu ṇa ṇiddaĕ bhuttaü
      teṇa cakka-sejjahĩ caḍĕvi  $  raṇa-vahuaĕ samāṇu ṇaṃ suttaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 76, Kaḍavaka 7:

dhaẏa tharahariẏa masāṇa-bhaeṇa va  $  pūriẏa saṅkha vandhu dukkheṇa va
tūraĩ haẏaĩ puvva-vaïrā iva  $  vaddhaĩ toraṇāĩ corā iva
camaraĩ pāḍiẏāĩ cittāĩ va  $  ghittaĩ paṇṇaĩ ku-kalattāĩ va
phāḍiẏāĩ dohāĩ va ṇettaĩ  $  dhariẏaĩ saṃgahaṇāĩ va chattaĩ
cūriẏāĩ khala-muhaĩ va raẏaṇaĩ  $  khuddhaĩ saṅkha-ulāĩ va vaẏaṇāĩ
āeṃ maraṇāvattha-vihoeṃ  $  kaluṇakkandu karanteṃ loeṃ
ṇiu masāṇu suravara-santāvaṇu  $  viraïu salu vaïsāriu rāvaṇu

jo paricaḍḍiu  $  saẏala-kāla kāmiṇi-thaṇa-vaṭṭehĩ

START

puṇu vi paḍīvaü  $  cintaï eva ṇāĩ dhūmaddhaü

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 77, Kaḍavaka 8:

gaẏaĩ kalattaĩ jammantaraĩ va  $  tūra-sahāsaĩ suiṇantaraĩ va

jaï vi sa-hatthĕṇa  $  ṇa kiu āsi garuẏaü sammāṇu

PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 77, Kaḍavaka 9:

andhāriẏa-ṇaha-maggaü  $  rāvaṇa-aẏasu ṇa ṇiggaü
dasa-disi-vaha maïlantu padhāiu  $  jiha akulīṇaü kahi mi ṇa māiu

te kama-kamala kanti-pariẏaḍḍhā  $  sihi-khaleṇa suẏaṇā iva daḍḍhā

sīhāsaṇa-pallaṅkĕhĩ ṭhantaü  $  rasaṇā-kiṅkiṇi-muhalijjantaü
taṃ ṇiẏamvu jalaṇeṇa vihattiu  $  takkhaṇĕ chārahŏ puñju parattiu

je sa-surāsura-  $  jaga-jūrāvaṇa jiha jama-dūvā

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 77, Kaḍavaka 11:

tehaü evahĩ  $  hoi ṇa hoi va kiha muha-rāu

PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 77, Kaḍavaka 19:

te ji asesa bhicca hiẏaïcchā  $  te ji ṇarāhiva āṇa-vaḍicchā
sā tuhũ sā jĕ laṅka paramesari  $  indaï bhuñjaü saẏala vasundhari"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi pavolliu rāvaṇi  $  vijjāhara-kumāra-cūḍāmaṇi
"lacchi kumāri va cañcala-cittī  $  kiha bhuñjami jā tāeṃ bhuttī
ghattā:
pahu maĩ kallaĕ  $  savva-saṅga-paricāu karevvaü
     sahũ parivārĕṇa  $  pāṇi-pattĕ āhāru laevvaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa IV, Saṃdhi 77, Kaḍavaka 20:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇīsāmĕṇa  $  pulaü vahanteṃ rāmĕṇa
sāhukkāriu rāvaṇi  $  "hohi bhavva-cūḍāmaṇi"
ema bhaṇĕvi jaẏalacchi-ṇivāsahŏ  $  savvaĩ ṇiẏaĩ ṇiẏaẏa-āvāsahŏ
parihāviẏaĩ dukūlaĩ vatthaĩ  $  vāẏaraṇaĩ va laddha-saddatthaĩ
parihāviẏaü dasāṇaṇa-pattiu  $  sahu keurĕhĩ vimukkaü pottiu
ṇeura-ṇivahu samaü laẏa-maggeṃ  $  rasaṇā-dāmaĩ sahũ sohaggeṃ
aṅgutthaliẏaü vantaṇi-sohĕhĩ(?)  $  cūḍā-vandha samaü ghara-mohĕhĩ
sahũ keūrāliṅgaṇa-bhāvĕhĩ  $  kaṇṭhā kaṇṭha-ggahaṇa-sahāvĕhĩ
maṇi-kuṇḍalaĩ samaü taṇu-teĕhĩ  $  vara-kaṇṇāvaẏaṃsa sahũ geĕhĩ
luhiẏa hiẏa(?) tilaẏa sahũ māṇĕhĩ  $  cūḍāmaṇi piẏa-paṇaẏa-paṇāmĕhĩ
ghattā:
eva vimukkaĩ   $  visaẏa-suhehĩ samaü maṇi-raẏaṇaĩ
     ṇavara ṇa mukkaĩ  $  diḍhaĩ sa iṃ bhu eṇa guru-vaẏaṇaĩ
jujjhakaṃḍaṃ samāptam
________________________________________________________________________
*************************  V. uttarakaṇḍaṃ  *************************  
________________________________________________________________________
----------  [78. aṭṭhasattarimo saṃdhi]  ----------
rāvaṇĕṇa maranteṃ diṇṇu suhu  $  surahũ dukkhu vandhava-jaṇahŏ
rāmahŏ kalattu lakkhaṇahŏ  $  jaü avicalu rajju vihīsaṇahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 1:
jasasesīhūaĕ dahavaẏaṇĕ  $  paḍivaṇṇaĕ diṇamaṇi-atthavaṇĕ
chappaṇṇa-saehĩ mahā-risihĩ  $  tava-sūrahũ ṇāsiẏa-bhava-ṇisihĩ
ṇāmeṇa sāhu apameẏavalu  $  thiu ṇandaṇa-vaṇĕ meru va acalu
uppaṇṇu ṇāṇu tahŏ muṇivarahŏ  $  ettahĕ vi parama-titthaṅkarahŏ
dhaṇa-kaṇaẏa-raẏaṇa-kāmiṇi-paürĕ  $  aïsundarĕ sundararaẏaṇa-purĕ
je vandaṇahattiĕ tetthu gaẏa  $  te iha vi parāiẏa amara-saẏa
ettahĕ rahu-taṇaü sa-sāhaṇu vi  $  ettahĕ indaï ghaṇavāhaṇu vi
saẏalehĩ vi vandaṇahatti kiẏa  $  raẏaṇīẏara puṇu vollanta thiẏa
ghattā:
"tumhāgamu uggamu kevalahŏ  $  aṇṇu eu devāgamaṇu
    gaẏa-divasĕ bhaḍārā hontu jaï  $  to marantu kiṃ dahavaẏaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 2:
paramesaru kevala-ṇāṇa-ṇihi  $  ṇisiẏarahã viakkhaï dhamma-vihi
"visamahŏ dīharahŏ aṇiṭṭhiẏahŏ  $  tihuẏaṇa-vammīẏa-pariṭṭhiẏahŏ
ko kāla-bhuẏaṅgahŏ uvvaraï  $  jo jagu jĕ savvu uvasaṅgharaï
tahŏ jahĩ jahĩ kahi mi diṭṭhi ramaï  $  tahĩ tahĩ ṇaṃ maïẏavaṭṭu bhamaï
kĕ vi gilaï gilĕvi kĕ vi uggilaï  $  kāhi (?) mi jammāvasāṇĕ milaï
kĕ vi ṇaraẏa-vilĕhĩ païsĕvi gasaï  $  kāhi (?) vi aṇulaggaü jjĕ vasaï
kĕ vi kaḍḍhaï saggahŏ vari caḍĕvi  $  kĕ vi khaẏahŏ ṇei upparĕ paḍĕvi
kĕ vi ghāraï ghŏraĕ pāva-visĕṇa  $  kĕ vi bhakkhaï ṇāṇāviha-misĕṇa
ghattā:
tahŏ ko vi ṇa cukkaï bhukkhiẏahŏ  $  kāla-bhuaṅgahŏ dūsahahŏ
    jiṇa-vaẏaṇa-rasāẏaṇu lahu piẏahŏ  $  jeṃ ajarāmaru paü lahahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 3:
jaï kāla-bhuaggu ṇa uvaḍasaï  $  to kiṃ suravaï saggahŏ khasaï
kahĩ rāvaṇu suravara-ḍamara-karu  $  dasa-kandharu dasa-muhu vīsa-karu
vahurūviṇi jasu pesaṇu karaï  $  jasu ṇāmeṃ tihuẏaṇu tharaharaï
jasu candu ṇa ṇahaẏalĕ tavaï ravi  $  jamu talavaru vatthaĩ dhuvaï havi
jasu paṅgaṇu vohāraï pavaṇu  $  kosāṇupālu jasu vaïsavaṇu
ghaṇa chaḍaü denti sarasaï jhuṇaï  $  jasu vaṇasaï pupphaccaṇu kuṇaï
sā sampaẏa gaẏa kahĩ rāvaṇahŏ  $  kahĩ rāvaṇu kahĩ suhu pariẏaṇahŏ
ghattā:
amha vi tumha vi avaraha mi (?)  $  savvaĩ ekkahĩ miliẏāĩ
    pekkhesahũ kāla-bhuaṅgamĕṇa  $  ajja va kalla va giliẏāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 4:
so kāla-bhuaṅgamu duvvisahŏ  $  aṇṇu vi visamaü parivāru tahŏ
acchaï pariveḍhiu sappiṇihĩ  $  vihĩ osappiṇi-avasappiṇihĩ
ekkekkahĕ tiṇṇi tiṇṇi samaẏa  $  su-du-paḍhama-samuttara-ṇāma ṇaẏa
tāhã vi uppaṇṇa saṭṭhi taṇaẏa  $  saṃvacchara-ṇāma pasiddhi gaẏa
ekkekkahŏ viṇṇi kalattāĩ  $  aẏaṇaĩ ṇāmeṇa pahuttāĩ
ekkekkahŏ tahĩ cha-cchaṅgaruha  $  phagguṇa-avasāṇa cetta-pamuha
ekkekkahŏ tahŏ vi dhavala-kasaṇa  $  uppaṇṇa putta dui dui jĕ jaṇa
ekkekkahŏ tahĩ vi pāṇa-piẏaü  $  paṇṇāraha paṇṇāraha tiẏaü
ghattā:
ĕhu pariẏaṇu kāla-bhuaṅgamahŏ  $  avaru gaṇĕvi keṃ sakkiẏaü
    so tehaü tihuaṇĕ ko vi ṇa vi  $  jo ṇa vi āeṃ ḍaṅkiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi karuṇa-rasabbhaïẏa  $  indaï-ghaṇavāhaṇa pavvaïẏa
maẏa-kumbhaẏaṇṇa-māricci tiha  $  avara vi ṇarinda amarinda-ṇiha
sahasatti jāẏa sīlāharaṇa  $  āẏāsa-vāsa kara-pāvaraṇa
mandoẏari vaẏa-guṇa-vantiẏahĕ  $  kantiẏahĕ pāsĕ sasikantiẏahĕ
ṇikkhanta samaü anteurĕṇa  $  sāharaṇottāriẏa-ṇeurĕṇa
pavvaïu ko vi pavvaïu ṇa vi  $  ṇahĕ ṇāĩ ṇihālaü āu ravi
ravi uiu vihīsaṇu gaẏaü tahĩ  $  ṇandaṇa-vaṇĕ jaṇaẏahŏ taṇaẏa jahĩ
āharaṇaĩ vatthaĩ ḍhoiẏaĩ  $  vaïdehiĕ tāĩ ṇa joiẏaĩ
ghattā:
"malu kevalu āẏaĩ savvaï mi  $  jaï maṇĕ maliṇu maṇammaṇaü
    ṇiẏa-païhĕ milantihĕ kula-vahuhĕ  $  sīlu ji hoi pasāhaṇaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 6:
"jaï jāmi āsi paricatta-bhaẏa  $  to sahũ haṇuvanteṃ kiṇṇa gaẏa"
"viṇu ṇiẏa-bhattāreṃ jantiẏahĕ   $  kulaharu jĕ pisuṇu kulaüttiẏahĕ
purisahũ cittaĩ āsīvisaĩ  $  alahanta vi uddisanti misaĩ
vīsāsu janti ṇaü iẏarahu mi  $  suẏa-devara-bhāẏara-piẏarahu mi"
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇevi mahāsaïhĕ  $  gaü pāsu vihīsaṇu rahuvaïhĕ
"ahŏ ahŏ paramesara dāsarahi  $  pacchaĕ laṅkāuri païsarahi
mili tāva bhaḍārā jāṇaïhĕ  $  taru duttara-viraha-mahāṇaïhĕ
caḍu tijagavihūsaṇa-kumbhaẏalĕ  $  maẏa-parimala-melāviẏa-bhasalĕ"
attā
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi halaharu cakkaharu  $  sīẏahĕ pāsĕ samuccaliẏa
    ahiseẏa-samaĕ siri-devaẏahĕ   $  diggaẏa viṇṇi ṇāĩ miliẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 7:
vaïdehi diṭṭha hari-halaharĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ candaleha vihĩ jalaharĕhĩ
ṇaṃ saraẏa-lacchi paṅkaẏa-sarĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ puṇṇima vihĩ pakkhantarĕhĩ
ṇaṃ sura-sari himagiri-sāẏarĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ ṇaha-siri canda-divāẏarĕhĩ
paripuṇṇa maṇoraha jāṇaïhĕ  $  taraï va lāẏaṇṇa-mahāṇaïhĕ
ṇiẏa-ṇaẏaṇa-sarāsaṇi sandhaï va  $  piu paguṇa-guṇehĩ ṇivandhaï va
jasa-kaddamĕ ṇaṃ jagu limpaï va  $  harisaṃsu-pavāheṃ sippaï va
vijjei va karaẏala-pallavĕhĩ  $  accei va ṇaha-kusumĕhĩ ṇavĕhĩ
païsaraï va hiẏaĕ halāuhahŏ  $  karaï va ujjou disāmuhahŏ
ghattā:
mehaliĕ milantahŏ rahuvaïhĕ  $  suhu uppaṇṇaü jettaḍaü
    indahŏ indattaṇu pattāhŏ    $  hojja ṇa hojja va tettaḍaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 8:
sa-kalattaü lakkhaṇu paṇaẏa-siru  $  pabhaṇaï jalahara-gambhīra-giru
"jaṃ kiu khara-dūsaṇa-tisira-vahu  $  jaṃ haṃsadīvĕ jiu haṃsarahu
jaṃ satti paḍicchiẏa samara-muhĕ  $  jaṃ lagga visalla karamvuruhĕ
jaṃ raṇĕ uppaṇṇu cakka-raẏaṇu   $  jaṃ ṇihaü valuddharu dahavaẏaṇu
jaṃ devi pasāeṃ taü taṇĕṇa  $  kulu dhavaliu jāĕ saïttaṇĕṇa"
ahivāẏaṇu kiu lakkhaṇĕṇa jiha  $  suggīva-pamuha-ṇaravarahĩ tiha
saẏala vi ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-vāhaṇĕhĩ thiẏa  $  para-pura-pavesa-sāmaggi kiẏa
jaẏa-maṅgala-tūraĩ tāḍiẏaĩ  $  riu-ghariṇihĩ cittaĩ pāḍiẏaĩ
ghattā:
païsantahã vala-ṇārāẏaṇahã  $  ṇaẏaru maṇoharu āvaḍiu
    ṇaṃ surahũ dharanta-dharantāhũ  $  tuṭṭĕvi sagga-khaṇḍu paḍiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 9:
païsanteṃ vala-ṇārāẏaṇĕṇa  $  cava cāliẏa ṇāẏariẏāṇaṇĕṇa
"ĕhu sundari sokkhuppāẏaṇahŏ  $  ahirāmu rāmu rāmā-ẏaṇahŏ
ĕhu lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇa-lakkha-dharu  $  jūrāvaṇa-rāvaṇa-palaẏa-karu
ĕhu bhāmaṇḍalu bhā-bhūsa-bhuu  $  vaïdehi-sahoẏaru jaṇaẏa-suu
ĕhu kikkindhāhiu duddarisu   $  tārāvaï tārāvaï-sarisu
ĕhu aṅgaü jeṇa maṇoharihĕ  $  kesaggahu kiu mandoẏarihĕ
ĕhu suravaï-kari-kara-pavara-bhuu  $  ṇandaṇa-vaṇa-maddaṇu pavaṇa-suu
ĕhu kumuu virāhiu ṇīlu ṇalu  $  ĕhu gavaü gavakkhu saṅkhu pavalu"
ghattā:
tahĩ kālĕ laṅka païsantāhŏ  $  parama riddhi jā halaharahŏ
    so amarāuri bhuñjantāhŏ  $  hojja ṇa hojja purandarahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 10:
païsaraï rāmu rāvaṇa-bhavaṇu  $  dakkhavaï ṇivāṇaĩ saẏalu jaṇu
"iha meha-ulĕhĩ dijjaï chaḍaü  $  iha sakku pasāhaï gaẏa-ghaḍaü
kiẏa accaṇa etthu vaṇassaïĕ  $  iha gāẏ(?)aü geu sarassaïĕ
iha ṇikkaü karaï āsi pavaṇu  $  iha bhaṇḍāgāriu vaïsavaṇu
iha vatthaĩ sihiṇa paḍicchiẏaĩ  $  sura-vandi-saẏaĩ iha acchiẏaĩ
aṇavasaru piẏāmaha-hari-harahŏ  $  atthāṇu etthu dasakandharahŏ
āẏaraṇu etthu jama-talavarahŏ  $  iha melaü ṇāga-ṇarāmarahŏ
iha ṇava-gaha damiẏa dasāṇaṇĕṇa  $  iha acchiu sahũ vaṇiẏāẏaṇĕṇa"
ghattā:
pekkhantu ṇivāṇaĩ rāvaṇahŏ   $  kahi mi ṇa rahuvaï raï karaï
    sa-kalattu sa-bhāi sa-bhiccaẏaṇu  $  santi-jiṇālaü païsaraï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 11:
thuo santi-ṇāho  $  kaẏakkhāvarāho
haẏāṇaṅga-saṅgo  $  pabhā-bhūsiẏaṅgo
daẏā-mūla-dhammo  $  paṇaṭṭhaṭṭha-kammo
tiloẏagga-gāmī  $  suṇāsīra-sāmī
mahā-deva-devo  $  pahāṇūḍha-sevo
jarā-roga-ṇāso  $  asāmaṇṇa-bhāso
samuppaṇṇa-ṇāṇo  $  kaẏaṅgi-ppamāṇo
ti-seẏāẏavatto  $  mahā-riddhi-patto
aṇanto mahanto  $  a-kanto a-cinto
a-ḍāho avāho  $  a-loho a-moho
a-koho aroho  $  a-joho a-moho
a-dukkho a-bhukkho  $  a-māṇo samāṇo
a-jāṇo sajāṇo  $  a-ṇāho vi ṇāho
ghattā:
thui ema karĕvi kira vīsamaï  $  tāva paḍicchiẏa-pesaṇĕṇa
      sa-kalattu sa-lakkhaṇu sa-valu valu  $  ṇiu ṇiẏa-ṇilaü vihīsaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 12:
su-viẏaḍḍha viẏaḍḍhāevi lahu  $  vara-juvaïhũ dasahĩ saehĩ sahũ
dahi-dova-jalakkhaẏa-gahiẏa-kara  $  gaẏa tahĩ jahĩ halahara-cakkahara
āsīsahĩ sesahĩ paṇavaṇĕhĩ  $  jaẏa-ṇanda-vaddha-vaddhāvaṇĕhĩ
ucchāhĕhĩ dhavalĕhĩ maṅgalĕhĩ  $  paḍu-paḍahĕhĩ saṅkhĕhĩ mandalĕhĩ
kaï-kahaĕhĩ ṇaḍa-ṇaṭṭāvaĕhĩ  $  gāẏaṇa-vāẏaṇa-phamphāvaĕhĩ
ṇara-ṇāẏara-vambhaṇa-ghosaṇĕhĩ  $  avarĕhi mi citta-pariosaṇĕhĩ
mandiru païsaraï vihīsaṇahŏ  $  majjaṇaü bhariu rahu-ṇandaṇahŏ
puṇu ṇhavaṇāsaṇa-parihāvaṇĕhĩ  $  dasakaṇṭha-kosa-darisāvaṇĕhĩ
ghattā:
gaü divasu savvu pāhuṇṇaĕṇa  $  labbhaï to vi pamāṇu ṇa vi
    "suhu suaü sīẏa sahũ rahu-suĕṇa"  $  ema bhaṇĕvi ṇaṃ lhikku ravi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 13:
to bhaṇaï vihīsaṇu "dāsarahi  $  aṇuhuñji bhaḍārā saẏala mahi
sīẏa 'gga-mahisi tuhũ rajja-dharu  $  somitti manti haũ āṇa-karu
ramaṇīẏa eha laṅkā-ṇaẏari  $  ĕhu tijagavihūsaṇu pavara-kari
ĕhu puppha-vimāṇu pahāṇu gharĕ  $  ĕu candahāsu karavālu karĕ
siṃhāsaṇa-chattaĩ cāmaraĩ  $  laï uvasamantu riu-ḍāmaraĩ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi pabhaṇaï dāsarahi  $  "aṇuhuñji vihīsaṇu tuhũ jĕ mahi
amhahũ gharĕ bharahu jĕ rajja-dharu  $  jasu jaṇaṇihĕ tāeṃ diṇṇu varu
tumhahũ gharĕ tujjhu jĕ rāẏa-siẏa  $  saï jāsu viẏaḍḍhāevi tiẏa
ghattā:
ṇahĕ suravara mahiẏalĕ meru-giri  $  jāva mahā-jalu maẏaraharĕ
    paribhamaï kitti jagĕ jāva mahu  $  tāva vihīsaṇa rajju karĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 14:
ahiseu vihīsaṇĕ āḍhaviu  $  bhāmaṇḍalu kalasu laevi thiu
suggīu virāhiu ṇīlu ṇalu  $  dahimuhu mahindu mārui pavalu
aṭṭhahi mi tehĩ suha-daṃsaṇahŏ  $  palhatthiẏa kalasa vihīsaṇahŏ
saĩ vaddhu paṭṭu rahu-ṇandaṇĕṇa  $  vahu-divasĕhĩ rāma-jaṇaddaṇĕṇa
jāu vi māṇiẏaü ṇa māṇiẏaü  $  tāu vi tahĩ turiu parāṇiẏaü
ṇaṃ sura-vahuaü saggahŏ cuaü  $  sīhoẏara-vajjaẏaṇṇa-suaü
kallāṇamāla vaṇamāla taha  $  jiẏapoma soma jiṇa-paḍima jiha
kaïpuṅgama-dahimuha-ṇandaṇiu  $  sasivaddhaṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇiu
ghattā:
vahu-vindaĩ āẏaĩ avaraï mi  $  savvaĩ tahĩ jĕ samāgaẏaĩ
    acchantahã vala-ṇārāẏaṇahã  $  laṅkahĕ varisaĩ chaha gaẏaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 78, Kaḍavaka 15:
tahĩ kālĕ sukosala-rāṇiẏahĕ  $  ṇandaṇa-vioẏa-viddāṇiẏahĕ

to kallāṇamāla-vaṇamālahĩ  $  guṇavaï-guṇamahaggha-guṇamālahĩ
salla-visallāsundari-sīẏahĩ  $  vajjaẏaṇṇa-sīhoẏara-dhīẏahĩ
ghattā:
vuccaï bharaha-ṇarāhivaï  $  "sara-majjhĕ taranta-tarantāĩ
    devara thoḍī vāra vari  $  acchahũ jala-kīla karantāĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 79, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ paḍivaṇṇu païṭṭhu mahā-saru  $  jala-kīlahĕ vi acalu paramesaru
laggaü sundarīu caü-pāsĕhĩ  $  gāḍhāliṅgaṇa-cumvaṇa-hāsĕhĩ
helā-hāva-bhāva-viṇṇāsĕhĩ  $  kilikiñciẏa-vicchitti-vilāsĕhĩ
moṭṭāviẏa-koṭṭamiẏa-viẏārĕhĩ  $  vibbhama-vara-vivvokka-paẏārĕhĩ
to vi ṇa khuhiu bharahu sahasuṭṭhiu  $  avicalu ṇaṃ giri meru pariṭṭhiu
acchaï jāva tīrĕ suha-daṃsaṇu  $  tāva mahā-gaü tijagavihūsaṇu
ṇiẏa-ālāṇa-khambhu uppāḍĕvi  $  mandira-saẏaĩ aṇeẏaĩ pāḍĕvi
paribhamantu gaü taṃ jĕ mahā-saru  $  bharahu ṇievi jāu jāī-saru
"parama-mittu ihu aṇṇa-bhavantarĕ  $  ṇivasiẏa saggĕ ve vi vambhottarĕ
ghattā:
puṇṇa-pahāveṃ sambhaviu  $  ihu ṇaravaï haũ puṇu matta-gaü"
      kavalu ṇa lei ṇa piẏaï jalu  $  atthakkaĕ thiu leppamaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 79, Kaḍavaka 12:
kari sambharaï bhavantaru jāvahĩ  $  puppha-vimāṇu caḍeppiṇu tāvahĩ
lakkhaṇa-rāma parāiẏa bhāẏara  $  ṇaṃ sañcārima canda-divāẏara
ṇavara visallāsundari-vīẏaĕ  $  bharaha-ṇarāhivo vi sahũ sīẏaĕ
caḍiu mahā-gaĕ tihuaṇabhūsaṇĕ  $  suravara-ṇāhu ṇāĩ aïrāvaṇĕ
purĕ païsanteṃ jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ  $  vandiṇa-vambhaṇa-tūra-ṇiṇaddeṃ
to ālāṇa-khambhĕ karĕ āliu  $  aviralāli-riñcholi-vamāliu
kavalu ṇa lei ṇa geṇhaï pāṇiu  $  kuñjara-cariu ṇa keṇa vi jāṇiu
kahiu karillĕhĩ paṅkaẏaṇāhahŏ  $  "dukkaru jīviu vāraṇa-ṇāhahŏ"
ghattā:
taṃ gaẏavara-vaïẏaru suṇĕvi  $  uppaṇṇa cinta vala-lakkhaṇahũ
    āẏaü tāva samosaraṇu  $  kulabhūsaṇa-desavihūsaṇahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 79, Kaḍavaka 13:
risi-āgamaṇu suṇĕvi paramantiĕ  $  gaü rahu-ṇandaṇu vandaṇahattiĕ
gaẏa sattuhaṇa-bharaha sa-jaṇaddaṇa  $  sa-turaṅgama sa-gaïnda sa-sandaṇa
bhāmaṇḍala-suggīva-virāhiẏa  $  gavaẏa-gavakkha-saṅkha rahasāhiẏa
sa-vihīsaṇa ṇala-ṇīlaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  tāra-taraṅga-rambha-pavaṇañjaẏa
kosala-kaïkaï-kekkaẏa-suppaha  $  santeura vaïdehi viṇiggaẏa
sāhuhũ vandaṇahatti kareppiṇu  $  dasa-paẏāru jiṇa-dhammu suṇeppiṇu
pucchiu jeṭṭha-mahārisi rāmeṃ  $  "ĕhu kari tijagavihūsaṇu ṇāmeṃ
kavalu ṇa lei ṇa ḍhukkaï salilahŏ  $  jema mahārisindu kali-kalilahŏ"
ghattā:
kuñjara-bharata-bhavantaraĩ  $  akkhiẏaĩ asesaĩ muṇivarĕṇa
   kekkaï-ṇandaṇu pavvaïu  $  sāmanta-sahāseṃ uttarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 79, Kaḍavaka 14:
vikkama-ṇaẏa-viṇaẏa-pasāhieṇa  $  sāmanta-sahāseṃ sāhieṇa
thiu bharahu mahārisi-rūvu levi  $  maṇi-raẏaṇāharaṇaĩ pariharevi
tahĩ juvaï-saĕhĩ sahũ kekkaẏā vi  $  thiẏa kesuppāḍu karevi sā vi
so tijagavihūsaṇu marĕvi ṇāu  $  vamhuttarĕ saggĕ surindu jāu
bharahāhivo vi uppaṇṇa-ṇāṇu  $  vahu-divasĕhĩ gaü logāvasāṇu
ahisittu rāmu vijjāharehĩ  $  bhāmaṇḍala-kikkindhesarehĩ
ṇala-ṇīla-vihīsaṇa-aṅgaehĩ  $  dahimuha-mahinda-pavaṇaṅgaehĩ
candoẏarasuẏa-jamvuṇṇaehĩ  $  avarehi mi bhaḍĕhĩ saüṇṇaehĩ
ghattā:
vaddhu paṭṭu rahu-ṇandaṇahŏ  $  kañcaṇa-kalasĕhĩ ahiseu kiu
    lakkhaṇu cakka-raẏaṇa-sahiu  $  dhara sa-dhara sa iṃ bhu ñjantu thiu
----------  [80. asīimo saṃdhi]  ----------
rahuvaï rajju karantu thiu  $  gaü bharahu tavovaṇu
diṇṇa vihañjĕvi saẏala mahi  $  sāmantahũ jīvaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 1:
vasumaï ti-khaṇḍa-maṇḍiẏa harihĕ  $  pāẏālalaṅka candoẏarihĕ
dhaṇa-kaṇaẏa-samiddhu paüra-pavaru  $  suggīvahŏ giri-kikkindha-puru
sasi-phaliha-lihiẏa-jasa-sāsaṇahŏ  $  laṅkāuri acala vihīsaṇahŏ
vaṇa-bhaṅgahŏ bhaḍa-cūḍāmaṇihĕ  $  siripavvaẏa-maṇḍalu pāvaṇihĕ
rahaṇeura-puru bhāmaṇḍalahŏ  $  kaï-dīvu diṇṇu ṇīlahŏ ṇalahŏ
māhindi mahindahŏ dujjaẏahŏ  $  āicca-ṇaẏaru pavaṇañjaẏahŏ
avarāha mi avaraĩ paṭṭaṇaĩ  $  ghara-sihara-ravindu-vihaṭṭaṇaĩ
valu jīvaṇu dei vighosaï vi  $  "jo ṇaravaï hūvaü hosaï vi
so saẏalu vi maĩ abbhatthiẏaü  $  mā hou ko vi jagĕ dutthiẏaü
ghattā:
ṇāeṃ bhāeṃ dasamaĕṇa  $  paẏa paripālejjahŏ
      devahã savaṇahã vambhaṇahã  $  maṃ pīḍa karejjahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 2:
puṇu puṇu abbhatthaï dāsarahi  $  "so ṇaravaï jo pālei mahi
aṇurattu paẏaĕ ṇaẏa-viṇaẏa-paru  $  so avicalu rajju karei ṇaru
jo ghaĩ puṇu deva-bhoga haraï  $  vara-thāvara-vitti-cheu karaï
so khaẏahŏ jāi tihĩ vāsarĕhĩ  $  tihĩ māsahĩ tihĩ saṃvaccharĕhĩ
jaï kaha vi cukku tahŏ avasarahŏ  $  to akusalu aṇṇa-bhavantarahŏ"
sāmanta ṇijantĕvi rāhavĕṇa  $  sattuhaṇu vuttu jīẏāhavĕṇa
"ṇa pahuccaï kāĩ eha pihimi  $  somittihĕ tujjhu majjhu tihi mi
paẏaḍijjaï to i majjhĕ jaṇahŏ  $  laï maṇḍalu jaṃ bhāvaï maṇahŏ"
ghattā:
vuccaï suppaha-ṇandaṇĕṇa  $  "jaï mahu daẏa kijjaï
    to vari mahurāẏahŏ taṇiẏa  $  mahurāuri dijjaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 3:
to maṇĕ cintāviu dāsarahi  $  "duggejjha mahura kiha païsarahi
dummahu mahu mahu vi asajjhu raṇĕ  $  ajju vi rāvaṇu ṇaü muu jĕ gaṇĕ
bhaẏa-bhāvi-bhāṇu-bhā-bhāsurĕṇa  $  jasu diṇṇu sūlu camarāsurĕṇa
so mahura-ṇarāhiu keṇa jiu  $  phaṇavaïhĕ phaṇāmaṇi keṇa hiu
tuhũ ajju vi vālu kālu kavaṇu  $  tiẏasahu mi bhaẏaṅkaru hoi raṇu
duddama-daṇu-deha-viẏāraṇahũ  $  kiha aṅgu samoḍḍahi paharaṇahũ"
paṇaveppiṇu pabhaṇaï sattuhaṇu  $  "haũ deva ṇiruttaü sattu-haṇu
jaï mahura-ṇarāhiu ṇaü haṇami  $  to rahuvaï paï mi ṇa jaẏa bhaṇami
ghattā:
païsaï jaï vi saraṇu jamahŏ  $  ahavaï jama-vappahŏ
    jīẏa-mahāvisu avaharami  $  mahurāhiva-sappahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 4:
gajjantu ṇivāriu suppahaĕ  $  "kiṃ putta païjjā sampaẏaĕ
vollijjaï taṃ jaṃ ṇivvahaï  $  bhaḍa-vokkĕhĩ suhaḍu ṇa jaü lahaï
kiṃ sāhasu diṭṭhu ṇa bhāẏarahũ  $  kiu vihĩ jĕ viṇāsu ṇisāẏarahũ
kiṇṇa muṇiu ṇiruvama-guṇa-bhariu  $  aṇaraṇṇāṇantavīra-cariu
taü dasaraha-bharahahĩ ghoru kiu  $  ikkhukka-vaṃsu ĕhu ema thiu
tuhũ ṇavara karesahi jampaṇaü  $  to vari jasu rakkhiu appaṇaü
jaï mahu uppaṇṇu maṇorahĕṇa  $  jaï jaṇiu jaṇereṃ dasarahĕṇa
to paü vi ma dehi parammuhaü  $  paḍivakkhu jiṇesahi sammuhaü
ghattā:
keu-sumālālaṅkariẏa  $  mahu-rāẏa-ṇivāsiṇi
    putta paẏatteṃ bhuñjĕ tuhũ  $  taṃ mahura-vilāsiṇi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 5:
āsīsa diṇṇa jaṃ suppahāĕ  $  vaddhāriẏa-ṇiẏa-guṇa-sampaẏāĕ
to sa-saru sarāsaṇu rāhavĕṇa  $  dijjaï ṇivvūḍha-mahāhavĕṇa
lakkhaṇĕṇa vi dhaṇuharu appaṇaü  $  dasasira-sira-kamalukkappaṇaü
ṇāmeṇa kiẏantavattu pavalu  $  seṇāvaï diṇṇu samanta-valu
sāmantahã lakkheṃ pariẏariu  $  sattuhaṇu aüjjhahĕ ṇīsariu
su-ṇimittaĩ hūaĩ jantāhũ  $  savvaĩ milanti siẏavantāhũ
ukkhandheṃ dūrujjhiẏa-sivahŏ  $  gaü upparĕ mahura-ṇarāhivahŏ
to mantihĩ pabhaṇiu sattuhaṇu  $  "jaẏa ṇanda vaddha vahu-sattu-haṇu
ghattā:
mahu-mattahŏ mahurāhivahŏ  $  cara-purisa-gaviṭṭhahŏ
    ajju bhaḍārā cha-ddivasa  $  ujjāṇu païṭṭhahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 6:
karĕ laggaï jāva ṇa sūlu tahŏ  $  laï tāva mahura mahurāhivahŏ
vaẏaṇeṇa teṇa rahasucchaliu  $  paḍivaṇṇaĕ addha-rattĕ caliu
purĕ veḍhiĕ vāraĩ ruddhāĩ   $  bhaẏa-vihalaĩ saṃsaĕ chuddhāĩ
kiu kalaẏalu tūraĩ āhaẏaĩ  $  virasiẏaĩ asaṅkha-saṅkha-saẏaĩ
dhaẏaraṭṭha-mahāgaï-gāmiṇihĩ  $  parigaliẏa-gabbha-riu-kāmiṇihĩ
diḍha-loha-kavāḍaĩ phoḍiẏaĩ  $  ghara-sihara-sahāsaĩ moḍiẏaĩ
ṇara-ṇāẏāmara-dappa-haraṇaĩ  $  laïẏaĩ sāvaraṇaĩ paharaṇaĩ
sihi-jālā-mālā-līviẏaĩ  $  gharĕ gharĕ joĕvi maṇi-dīviẏaĩ
ghattā:
sattuhaṇahŏ paṇamiẏa-sirĕhĩ  $  sāmantĕhĩ sīsaï
    "paṭṭaṇĕ jiṇavara-dhammĕ jiha  $  mahu kahi mi ṇa dīsaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 7:
sattuhaṇāgamĕ pavaṇañjaẏahŏ  $  mahu-puttahŏ lavaṇamahaṇṇavahŏ
uppaṇṇu rosu rahavarĕ caḍiu  $  saṇṇāhu laïu para-valĕ bhiḍiu
kiu kalaẏalu tūra-ravabbhaïu  $  saravarĕhĩ kiẏantavattu chaïu
teṇa vi ohāmiẏa-sandaṇahŏ  $  dhaẏa-daṇḍu chiṇṇu mahu-ṇandaṇahŏ
dhaṇu tāḍiu pāḍiu āhaẏaṇĕ  $  duvvāeṃ ṇaṃ mehāgamaṇĕ
teṇa vi kiẏantavattahŏ taṇaü  $  sahũ cindheṃ chiṇṇu sarāsaṇaü
teṃ dūru varujjhiẏa-pāṇa-bhaẏa  $  dhaṇuveẏa-bheẏa-para-pāru gaẏa
kaṇṇiẏa-khuruppa-kappariẏa-kavaẏa(?)  $  loṭṭāviẏa-sārahi pahaẏa-haẏa
ghattā:
vihi mi paropparu vi-rahu kiu  $  thiẏa ve vi gaïndĕhĩ
    sāhukkāriẏa gaẏaṇa-ẏalĕ  $  jama-dhaṇaẏa-surindĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 8:
pacoiẏā gaïndaẏā  $  milāviẏāli-vindaẏā
khaẏaggi-puñja-dussahā  $  giri vva tuṅga-viggahā
valāhaẏa vva gajjiẏā  $  jiẏāri sāri-sajjaẏā
maïlla-gilla-gaṇḍaẏā  $  dhuṇanta-puccha-daṇḍaẏā
karaggi-chitta-amvarā  $  kaẏamvuvāha-ḍamvarā
sa-ḍhakka ḍhukka dujjaẏā  $  jhaṇajjhaṇanta-gejjaẏā
vivakkha-tikkha-kaṇṭaẏā  $  ṭaṇaṭṭaṇanta-ghaṇṭaẏā
visāṇa-bhiṇṇa-dimmuhā  $  raẏaṅghi-pukkharāuhā
ghattā:
tāva kiẏantavatta-bhaḍĕṇa  $  riu āhaü sattiĕ
    paḍaṇatthavaṇaĩ dāviẏaĩ   $  ṇaṃ sūrahŏ rattiĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 9:
jaṃ lavaṇamahaṇṇaü ṇihaü raṇĕ  $  taṃ mahura-ṇarāhiu kuiu maṇĕ
āruhiu mahā-rahĕ juppi haẏa  $  ubbhaviẏa-dhavala-dhūvanta-dhaẏa
duddama-ṇarinda-ṇiddāraṇahũ  $  rahu bhariu aṇantahũ paharaṇahũ
haẏa samara-bheri amarisa-caḍiu  $  sa-rahasu kiẏantavattahŏ bhiḍiu
"mahu taṇaü taṇaü jiha ṇihaü raṇĕ  $  tiha paharu paharu diḍhu hohi maṇĕ"
tahĩ avasarĕ antarĕ thiu sa-dhaṇu  $  saĩ dasaraha-ṇandaṇu sattuhaṇu
te bhiḍiẏa paropparu kuiẏa-maṇa  $  ṇaṃ ve vi purandara-dahavaẏaṇa
mahi-kāraṇĕ parivaḍḍhanta-kali  $  ṇaṃ bharaha-ṇarāhiva-vāhuvali
ghattā:
vihi mi ṇirantara-vāvaraṇĕ  $  sara-jālu pahāvaï
   viñjhahŏ sañjhahŏ majjhĕ thiu  $  ghaṇa-ḍamvaru ṇāvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 10:
avaropparu vāṇĕhĩ chāiẏaü  $  avaropparu kaha vi ṇa ghāiẏaü
avaropparu kavaẏaĩ tāḍiẏaĩ  $  avaropparu cindhaĩ phāḍiẏaĩ
avaropparu chattaĩ chiṇṇāĩ  $  avaropparu aṅgaĩ bhiṇṇāĩ
avaropparu haẏaĩ sarāsaṇaĩ  $  jala-thalaĩ vi jāẏaĩ sa-vvaṇaĩ
avaropparu sārahi ṇiṭṭhaviẏa  $  sa-turaṅgama jamaüri paṭṭhaviẏa
avaropparu khaṇḍiẏa pavara raha  $  thiẏa matta-gaïndĕhĩ duvvisaha
te mahura-ṇarāhiva-sattuhaṇa  $  ṇaṃ ṇahaẏala-laṅghaṇa sa-ghaṇa ghaṇa
ṇaṃ kesari giri-siharĕhĩ caḍiẏa  $  ṇaṃ rāvaṇa-rāma samāvaḍiẏa
ghattā:
ve vi sa-paharaṇa sāmarisa  $  karivarĕhĩ valaggā
    malaẏa-mahinda-mahīharĕhĩ  $  ṇaṃ vaṇa-ẏava laggā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 11:
samuddhāiẏā sindhurā juddha-luddhā  $  valuttāla-dukkāla-kāla vva kuddhā
vimukkaṅkusā ummuhā uddha-soṇḍā  $  sa-sindūra-kumbhatthalā gilla-gaṇḍā
maẏambhehĩ sippanta-pāẏa-ppaesā  $  milantāli-mālā-ṇirandhī-kaẏāsā
visāṇappahā-paṇḍurijjanta-dehā  $  valāẏāvalī-diṇṇa-soha vva mehā
calantehĩ sañcālio sesa-ṇāo  $  bhamantehĩ pabbhāmio bhūmi-bhāo
girindā samuddāvalībhāva jāẏā  $  gaïndesu tesuṭṭhiẏā ve vi rāẏā
mahā-bhīsaṇā bhū-laẏā-bhaṅguracchā  $  pamukkekkamekkāuhā vijju-dacchā
karindeṇa ohāmio vāraṇindo  $  kumāreṇa ohāmio māhurindo
ghattā:
mahu ṇārāẏa-kaḍantariu  $  ruhirāruṇu gaẏavarĕ
    phagguṇĕ phulla-palāsu jiha  $  lakkhijjaï girivarĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 12:
avasāṇĕ kālu jaṃ ḍhukkiẏaü  $  jaṃ rahu-suu jiṇĕvi ṇa sakkiẏaü
jaṃ sūlu ṇa dāhiṇa-karĕ caḍiu  $  jaṃ puttahŏ maraṇu samāvaḍiu
taṃ parama-visāu jāu mahuhĕ  $  "maĩ ṇa kiẏa pujja tihuaṇa-pahuhĕ
pañcendiẏa duddama damiẏa ṇa vi  $  dhamma-kkiẏa ekka vi ṇa kiẏa ka vi
maĩ pāveṃ pāvāsattaĕṇa   $  ṇaü vandiẏa deva jiẏantaĕṇa
saṃjou savvu ko kahŏ taṇaü  $  ṇipphalu jammu gaü mahu ttaṇaü
vari evahĩ sallehaṇu karami  $  vaẏa pañca mahā-duddhara dharami"
to ema bhaṇĕvi ṇigganthu thiu  $  saĩ hattheṃ kesuppāḍu kiu
ghattā:
"ekku ji jīu mahu ttaṇaü  $  savvahŏ parihāraü
    raṇu jĕ tavovaṇu jiṇu saraṇu  $  gaẏavaru santhāraü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 80, Kaḍavaka 13:

arahantahũ kerā satta sarā  $  je savvahã sokkhahã paḍhamaẏarā
puṇu siddhahũ kerā pañca sarā  $  je sāsaẏa-puravara-siddhiẏarā
āẏariẏahũ kerā satta sarā  $  je paramācāra-vicāra-parā
sattovajjhāẏa-ṇamokkaraṇā  $  ṇava sāhuhũ bhava-bhaẏa-pariharaṇā
iẏa pañcatīsa paramakkharaĩ  $  suẏa-pārāvāra-paramparaĩ
visa-visama-visaẏa-ṇiddhāḍaṇaĩ  $  sivaüri-kavāḍa-ugghāḍaṇaĩ

kusumaĩ surĕhĩ visajjiẏaĩ  $  kiu sāhukkāru
    mahura sa iṃ bhu ñjantu thiu  $  sattuhaṇu kumāru

dukkhukkoẏaṇu  $  dāhiṇu loẏaṇu

hiẏavaĕ ṇivasaï visu hālāhalu  $  amiu vaẏaṇĕ diṭṭhihĕ jamu kevalu

PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 81, Kaḍavaka 6:
jambheṭṭiẏā
