ghattā:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi sīẏahĕ taṇaü  $  deva-lou cintāviẏaü
      ṇaṃ saï-sāvantara-bhīẏaĕṇa  $  vajjajaṅghu melāviẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 81, Kaḍavaka 14:
jambheṭṭiẏā
tāva ṇarindĕṇa  $  sa-suhaḍa-vindĕṇa
gaẏam ārūḍhĕṇa  $  raṇĕ ṇivvūḍhĕṇa
diṭṭha devi rattuppala-calaṇī  $  ṇaha-kiraṇujjoiẏa-saï-bhuvaṇī
kāẏa-kanti-uṇhaviẏa-surindī  $  loẏāṇanda-runda-muha-ẏandī
ṇaẏaṇohāmiẏa-vammaha-vāṇī  $  pucchiẏa "kāsu dhīẏa kahŏ rāṇī"
"haũ ṇillakkhaṇa ṇijjaṇa-thāmeṃ  $  loẏahŏ chandeṃ ghalliẏa rāmeṃ
rāma-ṇāri lakkhaṇu mahu devaru  $  bhāmaṇḍalu ekkoẏaru bhāẏaru
jaṇaü jaṇeru videha jaṇerī  $  suṇha ṇarindahŏ dasaraha-kerī"
pabhaṇaï vajjajaṅghu "mahi-pālā  $  lakkhaṇa-rāma māĕ mahu sālā
tuhũ puṇu dhamma-vahiṇi haũ bhāẏaru"  $  sāhukkāriu surĕhĩ ṇaresaru
ghattā:
lāẏaṇṇu ṇiĕvi sīẏahĕ taṇaü  $  tihuaṇĕ kāsu ṇa khuhiu maṇu
      giri dhīreṃ sāẏaru gahirimaĕ  $  vajjajaṅghu para ekku jaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 81, Kaḍavaka 15:
jambheṭṭiẏā
mambhīseppiṇu  $  vaẏa-guṇa-thāṇĕṇaṃ
ṇiẏa paramesari  $  siviẏā-jāṇĕṇaṃ
puṇḍarīẏa-puravaru païsanteṃ  $  haṭṭa-soha ṇimmaviẏa turanteṃ
sasa bhaṇevi paḍahaü devāviu  $  jaṇu āsaṅkā-thāṇu muāviu
tahĩ uppaṇṇa putta lavaṇaṅkusa  $  lakkhaṇa-lakkhaṅkiẏa dīhāusa
sīẏāevihĕ ṇaẏaṇa-suhaṅkara  $  puvva-disihĕ ṇaṃ canda-divāẏara
viddhiṃ-gaẏa sikkhaviẏa mahatthaĩ  $  vāẏaraṇāi-aṇeẏaĩ satthaĩ
saẏala-kalā-kalāva-kavaṇīẏā  $  mandara-meru ṇāĩ thiẏa vīẏā
tehĩ pahāveṃ tahĩ riu thambhiẏa  $  rahukula-bhavaṇa-khambha ṇaṃ ubbhiẏa
sa-rahasa sāvaleva sa-kiẏatthā  $  lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ samara-samatthā
ghattā:
riu lavaṇaṅgusĕhĩ ṇiraṅkusĕhĩ  $  daṇḍa-sajjhu kiu ṇāĩ ahi
      cappĕvi vappikkī dāsi jiha  $  laïẏa sa ẏam bhu va leṇa mahi
----------  [82. bāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
suravara-ḍāmara-ḍāmarĕhĩ  $  sasahara-cakkaṅkiẏa-ṇāmahũ
bhiḍiẏā āhavĕ ve vi jaṇa  $  lavaṇaṅkusa lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 1:
lavaṇaṅkusa ṇiĕvi juvāṇa-bhāva  $  kali-kavalaṇa kaliẏa-kalā-kalāva
saẏalāmala-kula-ṇahaẏala-miẏaṅka  $  ṇaṃ ari-kari-kesari mukka-saṅka
raṇa-bhara-dhura-dhoriẏa dhīra-khandha  $  guṇa-gaṇa-gaṇāli ṇaṃ seu-vandha
dhara-dhāraṇa duddhara-dhara-dharinda  $  vandiẏa-jiṇinda-caraṇāravinda
parirakkhiẏa-sāmiẏa saraṇa-mitta  $  vandiggahĕ goggahĕ kiẏa-paritta
bhū-bhūsaṇa bhuvaṇābharaṇa-bhāva  $  dasa-disa-pasatta-ṇiggaẏa-paẏāva
rāmāhirāma rāmāṇusarisa  $  jaṇa-jāṇaï-jaṇaṇahã jaṇiẏa-harisa
para-pavara-purañjaẏa jaṇiẏa-tāsa  $  muha-canda-candimā-dhavaliẏāsa
ghattā:
māṇusa-veseṃ avaẏarĕvi  $  ve bhāẏa ṇāĩ thiẏa kāmahŏ
    "kiha pariṇāvami jamala-maï"   $  uppaṇṇa cinta maṇĕ māmahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 2:
paṭṭhaviẏa mahantā teṇa tāsu  $  pihimī-puravarĕ pihu-pahuhĕ pāsu
"de dehi amaẏamaï-taṇiẏa vāla  $  kamaṇīẏa-kisoẏari kaṇaẏamāla"
dūẏahŏ vaẏaṇeṃ dūmiu ṇarindu  $  ṇaṃ phuriẏa-phaṇā-maṇi thiu phaṇindu
"kula-sīla-kitti-parivajjiẏāhã  $  ko kaṇṇaü dei alajjiẏāhã
gaü dūu durakkhara-dūmiẏaṅgu  $  ṇaṃ daṇḍa-ghāẏa-ghāiu bhuaṅgu
lavaṇaṅkusa-māmahŏ kahiu teva  $  "pihu-rāeṃ duhiẏa ṇa diṇṇa" jeva
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu laïẏa kheri  $  devāviẏa lahu saṇṇāha-bheri
ukkhandheṃ uppari caliu tāsu  $  pihimī-puravara-paramesarāsu
ghattā:
tāva ṇarāhiu vaggharahu  $  pihu-pakkhiu raṇa-mahi maṇḍĕvi
      jalahara khīlĕvi sukku jiha  $  thiu aggaĕ jujjhu samoḍḍĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 3:
te vagghamahāraha-vajjajaṅgha  $  abbhiṭṭa paropparu raṇĕ alaṅgha
vahu divasa kareppiṇu saṃpahāru  $  pariẏāṇĕvi para-vala-parama-sāru
to puṇḍarīẏa-pura-patthiveṇa  $  saddūla-mahārahu dhariu teṇa
tahĩ kālĕ kuiu pihu pihula-kāu  $  sāmanta-saẏaĩ melavĕvi āu
ettahĕ vi kumārĕhĩ dujjaehĩ  $  jaẏakāriẏa sīẏa raṇujjaehĩ
lavaṇaṅkusa-ṇāma-pagāsaṇehĩ  $  hattha-tthiẏa-sasara-sarāsaṇehĩ
raṇa-rāmāliṅgiẏa-viggahehĩ  $  paharaṇa-paḍahattha-mahārahehĩ
"veḍhijjaï māĕ ṇa māmu jāva  $  jāevaü amhahĩ tetthu tāva"
ghattā:
to volāviẏa ve vi jaṇa  $  jaṇaṇiĕ harisaṃsu-vimīsaĕ
    "sa-giri sa-sāẏara saẏala mahi  $  bhuñjejjahu mahu āsīsaĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 4:
āsīsa laĕvi vinni vi paẏaṭṭa  $  alamala-vala-maẏagala-maïẏavaṭṭa
gaẏa tettahĕ jettahĕ raṇu alaṅghu  $  jaẏakāriu ṇaravaï vajjajaṅghu
"amhĕhĩ jīvantĕhĩ dukkhu kavaṇu  $  jahĩ aṅkusu huavahu lavaṇu pavaṇu
kā gaṇaṇa tetthu vihi-patthiveṇa  $  avareṇa vi pavara-ṇarāhiveṇa"
pahu dhīrĕvi bhaḍa-kaḍamaddaṇehĩ  $  dasasandaṇa-ṇandaṇa-ṇandaṇehĩ
rahu vāhiu tūraĩ vāiẏāĩ  $  kiu kalaẏalu seṇṇaĩ dhāiẏāĩ
abbhiṭṭaĩ valaĩ valuddhurāĩ  $  avaropparu coiẏa-sindhurāĩ
saravara-saṅghāẏa-pavarisirāĩ  $  raẏa-ruhira-mahāṇaï-harisirāĩ
ghattā:
pihu-patthiu lavaṇaṅkusĕhĩ  $  helaĕ jĕ parammuhu laggaü
    ṇāvaï jhatti jhaḍappiẏaü  $  vihĩ sīhahĩ matta-mahāgaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 5:
tahĩ avasarĕ samara-ṇiraṅkusehĩ  $  paccāriu pihu lavaṇaṅkusehĩ
"kula-sīla-vihūṇahũ lhasiẏa kema  $  valu valu dūvāgamĕ caviu jema"
pihu-patthiu calaṇĕhĩ paḍiu tāhã  $  "rūsevaü ṇaü amhārisāhã
laï lavaṇa tuhārī kaṇaẏamāla  $  maẏaṇaṅkusa tuhu mi taraṅgamāla"
païsārĕvi puravarĕ kiu vivāhu  $  thiu vajjajaṅghu jaẏa-siri-saṇāhu
teṇa vi vattīsa taṇubbhavāu  $  ṇiẏa-kaṇṇaü diṇṇa sa-vibbhamāu
saẏalālaṅkārālaṅkiẏāu  $  hala-kamala-kulisa-kalasaṅkiẏāu
sāmantahã miliẏa aṇeẏa lakkha  $  pāikkahã vujjhiẏa keṇa saṅkha
ghattā:
je alamala-vala pavala-vala  $  hari-vala-valĕhĩ ṇa sāhiẏa
    te ṇaravaï lavaṇaṅkusĕhĩ  $  savasikareppiṇu desa pasāhiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 6:
khasa-savvara-vavvara-ṭakka-kīra  $  kaüvera-kurava-sovīra dhīra
tuṅgaṅga-vaṅga-kambhojja-bhoṭṭa  $  jālandhara-javaṇā-jāṇa-jaṭṭa
kambhīrosīṇara-kāmarūva  $  tāiẏa-pārasa-kāhāra-sūva
ṇepāla-vaṭṭi-hiṇḍiva-tisira  $  kerala-kohala-kaïlāsa-vasira
gandhāra-magaha-maddāhivā vi  $  saka-sūraseṇa-maru-patthivā vi
eẏa vi avara vi kiẏa vasa-viheẏa  $  pallaṭṭa paḍīvā mehileẏa
taṃ puṇḍarīẏa-puravaru païṭṭha  $  thuu vajjajaṅghu vaïdehi diṭṭha
tahĩ kālĕ akali-kaliẏāraeṇa  $  pomāiẏa veṇṇi vi ṇāraeṇa
ghattā:
"maḍḍa laeppiṇu saẏala mahi  $  kiẏa dāsi va pesaṇa-gārī
     para jīvantĕhĩ hari-valĕhĩ  $  ṇaü tumhahã siẏa vaḍḍārī"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 7:
taṃ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi lavaṇaṅkuseṇa  $  vollijjaï parama-mahāuseṇa
"kahi kahi ko hari-vala eu kavaṇu"  $  to kahaï kumārahŏ gaẏaṇa-gamaṇu
"ṇāmeṇa atthi ikkhāẏa-vaṃsu  $  tahĩ dasarahu uttama-rāẏahaṃsu
tahŏ ṇandaṇa lakkhaṇa-rāma ve vi   $  vaṇa-vāsahŏ ghalliẏa teṇa te vi
gaẏa daṇḍāraṇṇu païṭṭha jāva  $  avahariẏa sīẏa rāvaṇeṇa tāva
tehi mi melāviu pamaẏa-seṇṇu  $  haẏa bheri paẏāṇaü ṇavara diṇṇu
veḍhiẏa laṅkāuri haü dasāsu  $  paḍivalĕvi aüjjhahĩ kiu ṇivāsu
jaṇa-vaẏa-vaseṇa saï suddha-citta  $  ṇikkāraṇĕ kāṇaṇĕ ṇevi ghitta
ghattā:
vajjajaṅghu tahĩ kahi mi gaü  $  teṃ diṭṭha ruvanti varāiẏa
    sasa bhaṇevi saṅgahiẏa gharĕ  $  lavaṇaṅkusa putta viẏāiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi bhaṇaï aṇaṅgalavaṇu  $  "amhāṇa samāṇu kulīṇu kavaṇu
kiu jeṇa ṇavara jaṇaṇihĕ malittu  $  tahũ haũ davaggi ḍahaṇekka-cittu
vaṭṭaï jāṇijjaï tahĩ jĕ kālĕ  $  duddarisaṇĕ bhīsaṇĕ bhaḍa-vamālĕ
jima lakkhaṇa-rāmahũ palaü jāu  $  jima amhahã vihi mi viṇāsu āu
kahŏ taṇaü vappu kahŏ taṇaü puttu  $  jo haṇaï so jivaï riu ṇiruttu
jāṇĕvi kumāra-vikkamu alaṅghu  $  suṭṭheriu rosiu vajjajaṅghu
"jo tumhahã tihi mi aṇiṭṭhu pāu  $  so mahu mi ṇa bhāvaï pisuṇa-bhāu"
paripucchiu ṇāraü parama-joi  $  "etthahŏ aüjjha kiṃ dūra hoi"
ghattā:
kahaï mahā-risi gaẏaṇa-gaï  $  tahŏ lavaṇahŏ samarĕ samatthahŏ
    "saü saṭṭhuttaru joẏaṇahã  $  sākeẏa-mahāpuri etthahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 9:
vaïdehi ṇivāraï dara ruvanti  $  "te dujjaẏa lakkhaṇa-rāma honti
haṇuvantu jāhã gharĕ karaï seva  $  āruṭṭhahŏ jasu deva vi a-deva
suggīu vihīsaṇu bhicca jāhã  $  ko raṇĕ dhura dharĕvi samatthu tāhã
dasakandharu duddharu ṇihaü jehĩ  $  ko paharĕvi sakkaï samaü tehĩ"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi lavaṇaṅkusa palitta  $  ṇaṃ viṇṇi huāsaṇa ghiĕṇa sitta
"kiṃ amhahã valĕ sāmanta ṇatthi  $  kiṃ amhahã ṇa-vi raha-turaẏa-hatthi
kiṃ amhahã diḍhaĩ ṇa vāraṇāĩ  $  kiṃ amhahã karĕhĩ ṇa paharaṇāĩ
kiṃ amhahã taṇaü ṇa hoi ghāu  $  sāmaṇṇa-maraṇĕ ko bhaẏahŏ thāu"
ghattā:
to vuccaï maẏaṇaṅkusĕṇa  $  "ettaḍaü tāva darisāvami
    jeṇa ruvāviẏa māẏa mahu  $  tahŏ taṇiẏa māẏa rovāvami"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 10:
haẏa bheri paẏāṇaü diṇṇu tehĩ  $  raṇa-rasa-bhariẏahĩ lavaṇaṅkusehĩ
aggaĕ dasa saẏa kuṭṭhāriẏāhã  $  dasa dāruṇa kuddala-dhāriẏāhã
paṇṇāraha khevaṇi-karaẏalāhã  $  jhasiẏahã caüvīsa mahā-valāhã
chavvīsaĩ kusiẏa-visohiẏāhã  $  vattīsa sahāsaĩ cakkiẏāhã
dasa lakkha gaẏahũ maẏa-ṇibbharāhũ  $  dasa rahahũ aṭṭhāraha haẏavarāhũ
vattīsa lakkha phārakkiẏāhũ  $  caüsaṭṭhi pavara dhāṇukkiẏāhũ
raṇa-rasiẏahã rahasāūriẏāhũ  $  akkhohaṇi sāhaṇĕ tūriẏāhũ
ṇaravaïhĩ koḍi dasa kiṅkarāhã  $  sāvaraṇahã vara-paharaṇa-karāhã
ghattā:
sa-rahasu lavaṇaṅkusahã valu  $  pahĕ uppahĕ kaha vi ṇa māiẏaü
    ṇaṃ khaẏa-kālĕ samudda-jalu  $  rellantu aüjjha parāiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 11:
to dappuddharĕhĩ ṇiraṅkusehĩ  $  paṭṭhaviu dūu lavaṇaṅkusehĩ
gaü jhatti aüjjhāuri païṭṭhu  $  sa-jaṇaddaṇu sīẏā-daïu diṭṭhu
"ahŏ rahuvaï ahŏ lakkhaṇa-kumāra  $  vollijjaï kettiu vāra-vāra
para-ṇārī-haraṇa-daẏāvaṇeṇa  $  tumhaĩ hevāiẏa rāvaṇeṇa
ihu ghaĩ puṇu ṇaravaï vajjajaṅghu  $  uvahi va a-khohu meru va a-laṅghu
paramuttama-sattu mahāṇubhāvu  $  sura-bhuvaṇantara-ṇiggaẏa-paẏāvu
raṇa-rāmāliṅgaṇa-rasa-pasattu  $  jasu tiṇa-samu para-dhaṇu para-kalattu
lavaṇaṅkusa-māmu mahā-pacaṇḍu  $  so tumhahã āiu kāla-daṇḍu
ghattā:
teṃ sahũ kāĩ mahāhavĕṇa  $  ṇiẏa-kosu asesu vi deppiṇu
    suhu jīvahŏ ujjhāurihĕ  $  lavaṇaṅkusa-kera kareppiṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 12:
āsīvisa-visahara-visama-cittu  $  ṇārāẏaṇu huavahu jiha palittu
"jā jāhi dūa kiṃ gajjieṇa  $  jalaeṇa va jala-parivajjieṇa
ko vajjajaṅghu ko 'ṇaṅgalavaṇu  $  ko aṅkusu tāsu paẏāvu kavaṇu
jiha sakkahŏ tiha uttharahŏ tumhĕ  $  gahiẏāuha thiẏa saṇṇahĕvi amhĕ"
gaü dūu turantu vahantu kheri  $  haẏa hari-vala-valĕ saṇṇāha-bheri
saṇṇaddhu rāmu rāmāhirāmu  $  taïlokkabbhantarĕ bhamiu ṇāmu
saṇṇaddhu palaẏa-kālāṇukāri  $  lakkhaṇu suha-lakkhaṇa-lakkha-dhāri
saṇṇaddha ṇarāhiva ṇiravasesa  $  vīsambhara-goẏara kheẏaresa
ghattā:
haẏa-tūraĩ kiẏa-kalaẏalaĩ  $  dāruṇa-raṇabhūmi-paẏaṭṭaĩ
   lavaṇaṅkusa-hari-vala-valaĩ  $  sa-rahasaĩ ve vi abbhiṭṭaĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 13:
abbhiṭṭaĩ harisa-pasāhaṇāĩ  $  lavaṇaṅkusa-hari-vala-sāhaṇāĩ
duvvāra-vaïri-viṇivāraṇāĩ  $  dhāiẏa-uddhaṅkusa-vāraṇāĩ
duddhara-para-ṇara-dappa-haraṇāĩ  $  avaropparu pesiẏa-paharaṇāĩ
jasa-luddhaĩ vaḍḍhiẏa-viggahāĩ  $  raṇa-rāmāliṅgiẏa-viggahāĩ
hari-khura-khaẏa-raẏa-kaẏa-dhūsarāĩ  $  āẏāmiẏa-bhāmiẏa-asivarāĩ
asi-kiraṇa-karāliẏa-ṇahaẏalāĩ  $  gaẏa-maẏa-kaddamiẏa-mahīẏalāĩ
ruhira-ṇaï-pūra-pūriẏa-pahāĩ  $  khura-khoṇī-khutta-mahārahāĩ
paẏa-bhara-bhāriẏa-vīsambharāĩ  $  paharanti paropparu ṇibbharāĩ
ghattā:
vajjajaṅgha-rahuvaï-valaĩ  $  diṭṭhaĩ surapura-paripāleṃ
    raṇa-bhoẏaṇu bhuñjantaĕṇa  $  ve muhaĩ kiẏaĩ ṇaṃ kāleṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 14:
kahiṃ ji dhāiẏā bhaḍā  $  maïnda-vikkamubbhaḍā
sa-rosa-vāvarantaẏā  $  paropparu haṇantaẏā
kahiṃ ji āgaẏā gaẏā  $  pahāra-saṃgaẏā gaẏā
kahiṃ jĕ vāṇa-jajjarā  $  bhamanta matta kuñjarā
kahiṃ jĕ danti dantaẏā  $  rasanti bhagga-dantaẏā
kahiṃ jĕ te su-lohiẏā  $  giri vva dhāu-lohiẏā
kahiṃ jĕ āhaẏā haẏā  $  paḍanti cindhaẏā dhaẏā
kahiṃ jĕ uddha-khaṇḍaẏaṃ  $  paṇacciẏaṃ kavandhaẏaṃ
tao tahiṃ mahā-raṇe  $  bhaḍekkamekka-dāruṇe
galanta-soṇiẏāruṇe  $  vimukka-hakka-dāruṇe
pisāẏa-ṇāẏa-bhīsaṇe  $  aṇeẏa-tūra-ṇīsaṇe
milanta-ṭhanta-vāẏase  $  sivā-ṇiẏanta-phopphase
ghattā:
tāva valuddhuru vaïri-valu  $  jagaḍantu majjhĕ saṃgāmahŏ
      dhāiu aṅkusu lakkhaṇahŏ  $  abbhiṭṭu lavaṇu raṇĕ rāmahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 15:
abbhiṭṭa paropparu lavaṇa-rāma  $  ṇaṃ daïveṃ ṇimmiẏa viṇṇi kāma
viṇṇi vi bhūgoẏara-sāra-bhūẏa  $  thiẏa viṇṇi vi ṇāĩ kiẏanta-dūẏa
ṇaṃ saggahŏ inda-paḍinda paḍiẏa  $  viṇṇi vi ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-rahavarĕhĩ caḍiẏa
viṇṇi vi apphāliẏa-caṇḍa-cāva  $  viṇṇi vi avaropparu palaẏa-bhāva
viṇṇi vi dappuddhara vaddha-rosa  $  viṇṇi vi surasundari-jaṇiẏa-tosa
viṇṇi vi raṇa-rāmāliṅgiẏaṅga  $  viṇṇi vi dūrujjhiẏa-pisuṇa-saṅga
viṇṇi vi avahatthiẏa-maraṇa-saṅka  $  viṇṇi vi pakkhāliẏa-pāva-paṅka
ghattā:
tāva raṇaṅgaṇĕ rāhavahŏ  $  āẏāmĕvi vikkama-sāreṃ
    sahũ dhaẏa-dhavala-mahaddhaĕṇa  $  dhaṇu pāḍiu lavaṇa-kumāreṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 16:
rahu-ṇandaṇa-ṇandaṇa-ṇandaṇeṇa  $  dhaṇu avaru laïu riu-maddaṇeṇa
jaṃ palaẏa-vālavamuhāṇukaraṇu  $  jaṃ viḍasuggīvahŏ pāṇa-haraṇu
suggīvahŏ jeṇa su-diṇṇa tāra  $  jeṃ rāvaṇu bhaggu aṇeẏa-vāra
taṃ pavaru sarāsaṇu sa-saru levi  $  kira vindhaï ālakkhiu karevi
rahu khaṇḍiu sīẏa-sueṇa tāva  $  pariosiẏa sura samarekka-bhāva
haü sārahi āhaẏa vara turaṅga  $  ṇaṃ pārāvārahŏ hiẏa taraṅga
pabhaṇiu aṇaṅgalavaṇeṇa rāmu  $  "tuhũ jaï uvavāsĕṇa huẏaü khāmu
to vāvaru savva-parakkameṇa  $  jiẏa ṇisiẏara eṇa ji vikkameṇa"
ghattā:
valĕṇa vilakkhīhūẏaĕṇa  $  sara-dhoraṇi mukka kumārahŏ
    valĕvi paḍīvī lagga karĕ  $  ṇaṃ kula-vahu ṇiẏa-bhattārahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 17:
jiha mukku ṇa ḍhukkaï koi vāṇu  $  tiha halu tiha moggaru tiha kivāṇu
tiha musalu gaẏāsaṇi tiha rahaṅgu  $  tiha avaru vi paharaṇu raṇĕ ahaṅgu
lakkhaṇu vi tāva maẏaṇaṅkuseṇa  $  ṇaṃ ruddhu mahā-gaü aṅkuseṇa
āmellaï paharaṇu jaṃ jĕ jaṃ jĕ  $  lavaṇāṇuu chindaï taṃ jĕ taṃ jĕ
dhaṇu pāḍiu pāḍiu āẏavattu  $  haẏa haẏavara sārahi dharaṇi-pattu
gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ to vollanti deva  $  "jiẏa vālĕhĩ lakkhaṇa-rāma keva"
hāsaṃ gaü suravara-paüra-vindu  $  "haü aṇṇeṃ keṇa vi ṇisiẏarindu
khara-dūsaṇu samvukumāru jo vi  $  aṇṇeṇa ji keṇa vi ṇihaü so vi"
ghattā:
jagu jĕ virattaü hari-valahã  $  sisu-sāhasa-pavaṇuddhūaü
    ṇahu mahiẏalu pāẏālaẏalu  $  saẏalu vi lavaṇaṅkusihūaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 18:
kharadūsaṇa-rāvaṇa-ghāẏaṇeṇa  $  to laïu cakku ṇārāẏaṇeṇa
saẏa-sūra-samappahu ṇisiẏa-dhāru  $  dasakandhara-dāraṇu dasasaẏāru
khaẏa-jalaṇa-jāla-mālā-raüddu  $  kuṇḍalĕvi ṇāĩ thiu visaharindu
dhavalujjalu hari-karaẏalĕ vihāi  $  vara-kamalahŏ uppari kamalu ṇāĩ
āẏāmĕvi melliu lakkhaṇeṇa  $  gaü pharaharantu ṇahĕ takkhaṇeṇa
āsaṅkiẏa sura ṇara je 'ṇuratta  $  "laï evahĩ sīẏā-suẏa samatta"
ti-paẏāhiṇa ṇavaraṅkusahŏ devi  $  thiu harihĕ paḍīvaü karĕ caḍevi
paḍivāraü ghattiu lakkhaṇeṇa  $  paḍivāraü āiu takkhaṇeṇa
ghattā:
hari āmellaï amarisĕṇa  $  tahŏ vālahŏ taṇṇa pahāvaï
    vāhira-viddhu kalattu jiha  $  paribhamevi puṇu puṇu āvaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 82, Kaḍavaka 19:
to saẏala-kāla-kaliāraeṇa  $  āṇandu paṇacciu ṇāraeṇa
"hari-valahŏ eha kira kavaṇa vuddhi  $  ṇiẏa-putta vahĕvi kahĩ lahahŏ suddhi
guru-hāra vaṇantarĕ mukka devi  $  uppaṇṇa taṇaẏa tahĕ eẏa ve vi
pahilāraü ehu aṇaṅgalavaṇu  $  kula-maṇḍaṇu jaẏasiri-vāsa-bhavaṇu
vīẏaü maẏaṇaṅkusu ehu deva  $  sahũ āẏahũ paharahŏ tumhi keva"
risi-vaẏaṇu suṇevi mahā-valehĩ  $  paricattaĩ karaṇaĩ hari-valehĩ
avaruṇḍiẏa cumviẏa vihĩ vi ve vi  $  kama-kamalahã ṇivaḍiẏa tāma te vi
lavaṇaṅkusa-lakkhaṇa-rāma miliẏa  $  caü sāẏara ekkahĩ ṇāĩ miliẏa
ghattā:
vajjajaṅghu sa ĩ bhu a juĕhĩ  $  avaruṇḍiu jāṇaï-kantĕṇa
    vāra-vāra pomāiẏaü  $  "mahu miliẏa putta paĩ hontĕṇa"
----------  [83. teāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
lavaṇaṅkusa purĕ païsārĕvi  $  jiẏa-raẏaṇiẏara-mahāhavĕṇa
vaïdehihĕ dujjasa-bhīẏaĕṇa  $  divvu samoḍḍiu rāhavĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 1:
lavaṇaṅkusa-kumāra valahaddeṃ  $  purĕ païsāriẏa jaẏa-jaẏa-saddeṃ
jhallari-paḍaha-bheri-daḍi-saṅkhĕhĩ  $  vajjantahĩ avarehĩ a-saṅkhĕhĩ
rāmu aṇaṅgalavaṇu rahĕ ekkahĩ  $  lakkhaṇu maẏaṇaṅkusu aṇṇekkahĩ
vajjajaṅghu thiu duddama-vāraṇĕ  $  vīẏā-ẏandu ṇāĩ gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ
jaẏa-jaẏakāriu bhaḍa-saṅghāeṃ  $  "rāmahŏ sua melāviẏa āeṃ"
jaṇavaü rahaseṃ aṅgĕ ṇa māiu  $  ekkamekka-cūrantu padhāiu
pekkhĕvi te kumāra païsantā  $  ṇāriu ṇa vi gaṇanti paï santā
sīẏā-ṇandaṇa-rūvāloẏaṇĕ  $  lāẏaï kā vi alattaü loẏaṇĕ
kā vi dei aharullaĕ kajjalu  $  kāĕ vi ghattiu pacchaĕ añcalu
ghattā:
vivareraü ṇāẏariẏā-ẏaṇu  $  kiu lavaṇaṅkusa-daṃsaṇĕṇa
      jagĕ kāmeṃ ko vi ṇa vaddhaü  $  sa-sareṃ kusuma-sarāsaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 2:
āẏallaü karanta taruṇī-ẏaṇĕ  $  lavaṇaṅkusa païsāriẏa paṭṭaṇĕ
tahĩ tehaĕ pamāṇĕ vijjāhara  $  laṅkāhiva-kikkindha-puresara
bhāmaṇḍala-ṇala-ṇīlaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  jaṇaẏa-kaṇaẏa-marutaṇaẏa samāgaẏa
je paṭṭhaviẏa gāma-pura-desahũ  $  gaẏa hakkārā tāhũ asesahũ
ṇāṇā-jāṇa-vimāṇĕhĩ āiẏa  $  ṇaṃ jiṇa-jammaṇĕ amara parāiẏa
diṭṭhu rāmu somitti mahāusu  $  diṭṭhu aṇaṅgalavaṇu maẏaṇaṅkusu
sattuhaṇo vi diṭṭhu tahĩ sundara  $  ekkahĩ miliẏa pañca ṇaṃ mandara
puṇaravi rāmahŏ kiẏa ahivandaṇa  $  "dhaṇṇaü tuhũ jasu ehā ṇandaṇa
ghattā:
ettaḍaü dosu para rahuvaïhĕ  $  jaṃ paramesari ṇāhĩ gharĕ
    ma pamāẏahi loẏahũ chandĕṇa  $  āṇĕvi kā vi parikkha karĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 3:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi cavaï rahuṇandaṇu  $  "jāṇami sīẏahĕ taṇaü saïttaṇu
jāṇami jiha hari-vaṃsuppaṇṇī  $  jāṇami jiha vaẏa guṇa-saṃpaṇṇī
jāṇami jiha jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ bhattī  $  jāṇami jiha mahu sokkhuppattī
jā aṇu-guṇa-sikkhā-vaẏa-dhārī  $  jā sammatta-raẏaṇa-maṇi-sārī
jāṇami jiha sāẏara-gambhīrī  $  jāṇami jiha sura-mahihara-dhīrī
jāṇami aṅkusa-lavaṇa-jaṇerī  $  jāṇami jiha suẏa jaṇaẏahŏ kerī
jāṇami sasa bhāmaṇḍala-rāẏahŏ  $  jāṇami sāmiṇi rajjahŏ āẏahŏ
jāṇami jiha anteura-sārī  $  jāṇami jiha mahu pesaṇa-gārī
ghattā:
mellepiṇu ṇāẏara-loĕṇa  $  mahu gharĕ ubbhā karĕvi kara
    jo dujjasu upparĕ ghittaü  $  eu ṇa jāṇahŏ ekku para"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 4:
tahĩ avasarĕ raẏaṇāsava-jāeṃ  $  kokkiẏa tiẏaḍa vihīsaṇa-rāeṃ
vollāviẏa ettahĕ vi turanteṃ  $  laṅkāsundari to haṇuvanteṃ
viṇṇi vi viṇṇavanti paṇamantiu  $  sīẏa-saïttaṇa-gavvu vahantiu
"deva deva jaï huavahu ḍajjhaï  $  jaï māruu paḍa-poṭṭalĕ vajjhaï
jaï pāẏālĕ ṇahaṅgaṇu loṭṭaï  $  kālantarĕṇa kālu jaï tiṭṭhaï
jaï uppajjaï maraṇu kiẏantahŏ  $  jaï ṇāsaï sāsaṇu arahantahŏ
jaï avareṃ uggamaï divāẏaru  $  meru-siharĕ jaï ṇivasaï sāẏaru
eu asesu vi sambhāvijjaï  $  sīẏahĕ sīlu ṇa puṇu maïlijjaï
ghattā:
jaï eva vi ṇaü pattijjahi  $  to paramesara eu karĕ
    tula-cāula-visa-jala-jalaṇahã  $  pañcahã ekku ji divvu dharĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rahuvaï pariosiu  $  "eva hou" hakkāraü pesiu
gaü suggīu vihīsaṇu aṅgaü  $  candoẏara-ṇandaṇu pavaṇaṅgaü
pesiu puppha-vimāṇu paẏaṭṭaü  $  ṇaṃ ṇahaẏala-sarĕ kamalu visaṭṭaü
puṇḍarīẏa-puravaru sampāiẏa  $  diṭṭha devi rahaseṇa ṇa māiẏa
"ṇanda vaḍḍha jaẏa hohi cirāusa  $  viṇṇi vi jāhĕ putta lavaṇaṅkusa
lakkhaṇa-rāma jehĩ āẏāmiẏa  $  sīhahĩ jiha gaïnda ohāmiẏa
rakkhiẏa ṇāraeṇa samaraṅgaṇĕ  $  tehi mi te païsāriẏa paṭṭaṇĕ
amhaĩ āẏa tumha-hakkārā  $  diahā hontu maṇoraha-gārā
ghattā:
caḍu puppha-vimāṇĕ bhaḍāriĕ  $  milu puttahã paï-devarahã
    sahũ acchahĩ majjhĕ pariṭṭhiẏa  $  pihimi jema caü-sāẏarahã"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 6:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi lavaṇaṅkusa-māẏaĕ  $  vuttu vihīsaṇu gaggira-vāẏaĕ
"ṇiṭṭhura-hiẏaẏahŏ a-laïẏa-ṇāmahŏ  $  jāṇami tatti ṇa kijjaï rāmahŏ
ghalliẏa jeṇa ruvanti vaṇantarĕ  $  ḍāiṇi-rakkhasa-bhūẏa-bhaẏaṅkarĕ
jahĩ saddūla-sīha-gaẏa-gaṇḍā  $  vavvara-savara-pulinda-paẏaṇḍā
jahĩ vahu taccha-riccha-ruru-samvara  $  sa-uraga-khaga-miga-viga-siva-sūẏara
jahĩ māṇusu jīvantu vi luccaï  $  vihi kali-kālu vi pāṇahũ muccaï
tahĩ vaṇĕ ghallāviẏa aṇṇāṇeṃ  $  evahĩ kiṃ tahŏ taṇĕṇa vimāṇeṃ
ghattā:
so teṇa ḍāhu uppāiẏaü  $  pisuṇālāva-marīsiĕṇa
    so dukkaru ulhāvijjaï  $  meha-saeṇa vi varisiĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 7:
jaï vi ṇa kāraṇu rāhava-candeṃ  $  to vi jāmi laï tumhahã chandeṃ"
ẽva bhaṇevi devi jaẏa-sundari  $  kama-kamalahĩ accanti vasundhari
puppha-vimāṇĕ caḍiẏa aṇurāeṃ  $  parimiẏa vijjāhara-saṅghāeṃ
kosala-ṇaẏari parāiẏa jāvĕhĩ  $  diṇamaṇi gaü atthavaṇahŏ tāvĕhĩ
jetthahŏ piẏaẏameṇa ṇivvāsiẏa  $  tahŏ uvavaṇahŏ majjhĕ āvāsiẏa
kaha vi vihāṇu bhāṇu ṇahĕ uggaü  $  ahimuhu sajjaṇa-lou samāgaü
diṇṇaĩ tūraĩ maṅgalu ghosiu  $  paṭṭaṇu ṇiravasesu pariosiu
sīẏa paviṭṭha ṇiviṭṭha varāsaṇĕ  $  sāsaṇa-devaẏa ṇaṃ jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ
ghattā:
paramesari paḍhama-samāgamĕ  $  jhatti ṇihāliẏa halaharĕṇa
    siẏa-pakkhahŏ divasĕ pahillaĕ  $  candaleha ṇaṃ sāẏarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 8:
kantahĕ taṇiẏa kanti pekkheppiṇu  $  pabhaṇaï pomaṇāhu vihaseppiṇu
"jaï vi kuluggaẏāu ṇiravajjaü  $  mahilaü honti suṭṭhu ṇillajjaü
dara-dāviẏa-kaḍakkha-vikkhevaü  $  kuḍila-maïu vaḍḍhiẏa-avalevaü
vāhira-dhiṭṭhaü guṇa-parihīṇaü  $  kiha saẏa-khaṇḍa ṇa janti ṇihīṇaü
ṇaü gaṇanti ṇiẏa-kulu maïlantaü  $  tihuaṇĕ aẏasa-paḍahu vajjantaü
aṅgu samoḍḍĕvi dhiddhikkārahŏ  $  vaẏaṇu ṇienti kema bhattārahŏ"
sīẏa ṇa bhīẏa saïttaṇa-gavveṃ  $  valĕvi pavolliẏa macchara-gavveṃ
"purisa ṇihīṇa honti guṇavanta vi  $  tiẏahĕ ṇa pattijjanti maranta vi
ghattā:
khaḍu lakkaḍu salilu vahantiẏahĕ  $  paürāṇiẏahĕ kuluggaẏahĕ
    raẏaṇāẏaru khāraĩ dentaü  $  to vi ṇa thakkaï ṇammaẏahĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 9:
sāṇu ṇa keṇa vi jaṇĕṇa gaṇijjaï  $  gaṅgā-ṇaïhĩ taṃ ji ṇhāijjaï
sasi sa-kalaṅku tahĩ ji paha ṇimmala  $  kālaü mehu tahĩ jĕ taḍi ujjala
uvalu apujju ṇa keṇa vi chippaï  $  tahĩ ji paḍima candaṇĕṇa vilippaï
dhujjaï pāu paṅku jaï laggaï  $  kamala-māla puṇu jiṇahŏ valaggaï
dīvaü hoi sahāveṃ kālaü  $  vaṭṭi-sihaĕ maṇḍijjaï ālaü
ṇara-ṇārihĩ evaḍḍaü antaru  $  maraṇĕ vi velli ṇa mellaï taruvaru
ĕhu paĩ kavaṇa volla pārambhiẏa  $  saï-vaḍāẏa maĩ ajju samubbhiẏa
tuhũ pekkhantu acchu vīsatthaü  $  ḍahaü jalaṇu jaï ḍahĕvi samatthaü
ghattā:
kiṃ kijjaï aṇṇeṃ divveṃ  $  jaṃ ṇa vi sujjhaï mahu maṇahŏ
    jiha kaṇaẏa-loli ḍāhuttara  $  acchami majjhĕ huāsaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 10:
sīẏahĕ vaẏaṇu suṇĕvi jaṇu harisiu  $  uccāraü romañcu padarisiu
mahura-ṇarāhiva-jasa-līha-luhaṇeṃ  $  harisiu lakkhaṇu sahũ sattuhaṇeṃ
tiṇṇi vi vipphuranta-maṇi-kuṇḍala  $  harisiẏa jaṇaẏa-kaṇaẏa-bhāmaṇḍala
harisiẏa lavaṇaṅkusa dussīla vi  $  harisiẏa vajjajaṅgha-ṇala-ṇīla vi
tāra-taraṅga-rambha-visaseṇa vi  $  dahimuha-kumuẏa-mahinda-suseṇa vi
gavaẏa-gavakkha-saṅkha-sakkandaṇa  $  candarāsi-candoẏara-ṇandaṇa
laṅkāhiva-suggīvaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  jamvava-pavaṇañjaẏa-pavaṇaṅgaẏa
loẏavāla-giri-ṇaïu samudda vi  $  visaharinda amarinda ṇarinda vi
ghattā:
taïlokkabbhantara-vattiu  $  saẏalu vi jaṇavaü harisiẏaü
    para hiẏavaĕ kalusu vahantaü  $  rahuvaï ekku ṇa harisiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 11:
sīẏaĕ jaṃ jĕ vuttu avaleveṃ  $  taṃ ji samatthiu puṇu valaeveṃ
kokkiẏa khaṇaẏa khaṇāviẏa khoṇī  $  hattha-saẏāĩ tiṇṇi caü-koṇī
pūriẏa khaḍa-lakkaḍa-vicchaḍḍĕhĩ  $  kālāguru-candaṇa-sirikhaṇḍĕhĩ
devadāru-kappūra-sahāsĕhĩ  $  kañcaṇa-mañca raïẏa caü-pāsĕhĩ
caḍiẏa rāẏa āẏā givvāṇa vi  $  inda-canda-ravi-hari-vambhāṇa vi
indhaṇa-puñjĕ caḍiẏa paramesari  $  ṇaṃ saṃthiẏa vaẏa-sīlahã uppari
"ahŏ devahŏ mahu taṇaü saïttaṇu  $  joejjahŏ rahuvaï-duṭṭhattaṇu
ahŏ vaïsāṇara tuhu mi ḍahejjahi  $  jaï viruārī to ma khamejjahi"
ghattā:
kiu kalaẏalu diṇṇu huāsaṇu  $  mahi jĕ jāẏa sama-jālaḍiẏa
    so ṇāhĩ ko vi tahĩ avasarĕ  $  jeṇa ṇa mukkī dhāhaḍiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 12:
khaḍa-lakkaḍa-vicchaḍḍa-palittaĕ  $  dhāhāviu kosalaĕ sumittaĕ
dhāhāviu somitti-kumāreṃ  $  "ajju māẏa mua mahu aviẏāreṃ"
dhāhāviu bhāmaṇḍala-jaṇaĕhĩ  $  dhāhāviu lavaṇaṅkusa-taṇaĕhĩ
dhāhāviu laṅkālaṅkāreṃ  $  dhāhāviu haṇuvanta-kumāreṃ
dhāhāviu suggīva-ṇarindeṃ  $  dhāhāviu mahinda-māhindeṃ
dhāhāviu savvĕhĩ sāmantĕhĩ  $  rāmahŏ dhiddhikkāru karantĕhĩ
dhāhāviu vaïdehi-kaeṃ vihĩ  $  laṅkāsundari-tiẏaḍāevihĩ
uddha-muheṇa pavaḍḍhiẏa-soeṃ  $  dhāhāviu ṇāẏarieṃ loeṃ
ghattā:
"ṇiṭṭhuru ṇirāsu māẏāraü  $  dukkiẏa-gāraü kūra-maï
    ṇaü jāṇahũ sīẏa vaheviṇu  $  rāmu lahesaï kavaṇa gaï"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 13:
thiu etthantarĕ kāraṇu bhāriu  $  ṇiravasesu jagu dhūmandhāriu
jālaü vipphuranti tahĩ avasarĕ  $  ṇaṃ vijjulaü jalaẏa-jālantarĕ
sīẏa saïttaṇeṇa ṇaü kampiẏa  $  "ḍhukku ḍhukku sihi" ema pajampiẏa
"ehu dehu guṇa-gahaṇa-ṇivāsaṇu  $  ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï saccaü jĕ huāsaṇu
ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï jiṇa-sāsaṇu chaḍḍiu  $  ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï ṇiẏa-gottu ṇa maṇḍiu
ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï haũ keṇa vi ūṇī  $  ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï cāritta-vihūṇī
ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï bhattārahŏ dohī  $  ḍahĕ ḍahĕ jaï paraloẏa-virohī
ḍahĕ ḍahĕ saẏala-bhuvaṇa-santāvaṇu  $  jaï maĩ maṇĕṇa vi icchiu rāvaṇu"
taṃ evaḍḍu dhīru ko pāvaï  $  sihi sīẏalaü hoi ṇa pahāvaï
ghattā:
tahĩ avasarĕ maṇĕ parituṭṭhaü  $  kahaï purandaru sura-ẏaṇahŏ
"sihi saṅkaï ḍahĕvi ṇa sakkaï  $  pekkhu pahāu saïttaṇahŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 14:
tāma taruṇa-tāmarasĕhĩ chaṇṇaü  $  so jjĕ jalaṇu saravaru uppaṇṇaü
sārasa-haṃsa-koñca-kāraṇḍĕhĩ  $  gumugumanta-chappaẏa-vicchaḍḍĕhĩ
jalu atthakkaĕ kahi mi ṇa māiu  $  mañca-saẏaĩ rellantu padhāiẏa
ṇāsaï savvu lou sahũ rāmeṃ  $  salilu pavaḍḍhiu sīẏahĕ ṇāmeṃ
aṇṇu vi sahasavattu uppaṇṇaü  $  diẏavaĕ āsaṇu ṇaṃ avaïṇṇaü
tāsu majjhĕ maṇi-kaṇaẏa-ravaṇṇaü  $  divvāsaṇu samuccu uppaṇṇaü
tahĩ jāṇaï jaṇa-sāhukkāriẏa  $  saĩ suravara-vahūhĩ vaïsāriẏa
tahĩ velahĩ sohaï paramesari  $  ṇaṃ paccakkha lacchi kamalovari
āhaẏa dunduhi suravara-sattheṃ  $  melliu kusuma-vāsu saĩ hattheṃ
ghattā:
jaẏa-jaẏa-kāru paghuṭṭhaü  $  suha-vaẏaṇāvaṇṇaṇa-bhariu
      ṇāṇāviha-tūra-mahā-raü  $  jāṇaï-jasu va pavitthariu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 15:
to etthantarĕ ṇiru dīhāusa  $  sīẏahĕ pāsu ḍhukka lavaṇaṅkusa
jiha te tiha viṇṇi vi hari-halahara  $  tiha bhāmaṇḍala-ṇala-velandhara
tiha suggīva-ṇīla-maïsāẏara  $  tiha suseṇa-visaseṇa-jasāẏara
tiha sa-vihīsaṇa kumuaṅgaṅgaẏa  $  jaṇaẏa-kaṇaẏa-mārui-pavaṇañjaẏa
tiha gaẏa-gavaẏa-gavakkha-virāhiẏa  $  vajjajaṅgha-sattuhaṇa-guṇāhiẏa
tiha mahinda-māhindi sa-dahimuha  $  tāra-taraṅga-rambha-pahu-dummuha
tiha maïkanta-vasanta-ravippaha  $  candamarīci-haṃsa-pahu-diḍharaha
candarāsi-santāṇa ṇaresara  $  raẏaṇakesi-pīiṅkara kheẏara
tiha jamvava-jamvavi-indāuha  $  mandahattha-sasipaha-tārāmuha
tiha sasivaddhaṇa-seẏa-samudda vi  $  raïvaddhaṇa-ṇandaṇa-kundeda(?) vi
lacchibhutti-kolāhala-sarala vi  $  ṇahusa-kiẏantavatta-cala-tarala vi
ghattā:
avara vi ekkekka-pahāṇā  $  ura-romañca-samucchaliẏa
      ahiseẏa-samaĕ ṇaṃ lacchihĕ  $  saẏala-disā-gaïnda miliẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 16:
to vollijjaï rāhava-candeṃ  $  "ṇikkāraṇĕ khala-pisuṇahã chandeṃ
jaṃ aviẏappeṃ maĩ avamāṇiẏa  $  aṇṇu vi duhu evaḍḍu parāṇiẏa
taṃ paramesari mahu marusejjahi  $  ekka-vāra avarāhu khamejjahi
āu jāhũ ghara-vāsu ṇihālahi  $  saẏalu vi ṇiẏa-pariẏaṇu paripālahi
puppha-vimāṇĕ caḍahi sura-sundarĕ  $  vandahi jiṇa-bhavaṇaĩ giri-mandarĕ
uvavaṇa-ṇaïu mahaddaha-saravarĕ  $  khettaĩ kappadduma-kulagirivarĕ
ṇandaṇavaṇa-kāṇaṇaĩ mahāẏara  $  jaṇavaẏa-vei-dīva-raẏaṇāẏara
ghattā:
maṇĕ dharahi eu mahu vuttaü  $  maccharu saẏalu vi pariharahi
    saï jiha suravaï-saṃsaggiĕ  $  ṇīsāvaṇṇu rajju karahi"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 17:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi paricatta-saṇehiĕ  $  eva pajampiu puṇu vaïdehiĕ
"ahŏ rāhava maṃ jāhi visāẏahŏ  $  ṇa vi taü dosu ṇa jaṇa-saṅghāẏahŏ
bhava-bhava-saĕhĩ viṇāsiẏa-dhammahŏ  $  savvu dosu ĕu dukkiẏa-kammahŏ
ko sakkaï ṇāsaṇahã purāiu  $  jaṃ aṇulaggaü jīvahũ āiu
vala maĩ vahuviha-desa-ṇiuttī  $  tujjhu pasāeṃ vasumaï bhuttī
vahu-vāraü tamvolu samāṇiu  $  ihaloiu suhu saẏalu vi māṇiu
vahu-vāraü paẏaḍiẏa-vahu-bhoggī  $  paĩ sahũ puppha-vimāṇĕ valaggī
vahu-vāraü bhavaṇantarĕ hiṇḍiu  $  appaü vahu-maṇḍaṇĕhĩ pamaṇḍiu
evahĩ tiha karemi puṇu rahuvaï  $  jiha ṇa homi paḍivārī tiẏamaï
ghattā:
mahu visaẏa-suhĕhĩ pajjattaü  $  chindami jāi-jarā-maraṇu
      ṇivviṇṇī bhava-saṃsārahŏ  $  lemi ajju dhuvu tava-caraṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 18:
ema tāĕ ĕu vaẏaṇu caveppiṇu  $  dāhiṇa-karĕṇa samuppāḍeppiṇu
ṇiẏa-sira-cihura tiloẏāṇandahŏ  $  puraü paghalliẏa rāhava-candahŏ
kesa ṇievi so vi mucchaṃgaü  $  paḍiu ṇāĩ taruvaru maru-āhaü
mahihĩ ṇisaṇṇu suṭṭhu ṇicceẏaṇu  $  jāva kaha vi kira hoi sa-ceẏaṇu
tāva ṇiẏantahã jiṇa-paẏa-sevahã  $  vijjāhara-bhūgoẏara-devahã
sīẏaĕ sīla-taraṇḍaĕ thāĕvi  $  laïẏa dikkha risi-āsamĕ jāĕvi
pāsĕ savvabhūsaṇa-muṇiṇāhahŏ  $  ṇimmala-kevala-ṇāṇa-saṇāhahŏ
jāẏa turiu tava-bhūsiẏa-viggahu  $  mukka-savva-para-vatthu-pariggahu
ghattā:
etthantarĕ valu ummucchiẏaü  $  jo rahu-kula-āẏāsa-ravi
    taṃ āsaṇu jāva ṇihālaï  $  jaṇaẏa-taṇaẏa tahĩ tāva ṇa vi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 19:
puṇu savvāu disāu ṇiẏantaü  $  uṭṭhiu "kettahĕ sīẏa" bhaṇantaü
keṇa vi sa-viṇaeṇa to sīsaï  $  "pavarujjāṇu eu jaṃ dīsaï
iha ṇiẏa surĕhĩ susīlālaṅkiẏa  $  muṇi-puṅgavahŏ pāsu dikkhaṅkiẏa"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi rahu-ṇandaṇu kuddhaü  $  jua-khaĕ ṇāĩ kiẏantu viruddhaü
ratta-ṇettu bhaühā-bhaṅgura-muhu  $  gaü tahŏ ujjāṇahŏ savaḍaṃmuhu
gaĕ ārūḍhaü macchara-bhariẏaü  $  vahu-vijjāharehĩ pariẏariẏaü
ubbhiẏa-sasi-dhavalāẏavavāraṇu  $  dāhiṇa-karĕ kaẏa-sīra-ppaharaṇu
"jaṃ kiu ciru māẏāsuggīvahŏ  $  jaṃ lakkhaṇĕṇa samarĕ dahagīvahŏ
taṃ karemi vaḍḍhiẏa-avalevahã  $  vāsava-pamuha-asesahã devahã"
sahũ ṇiẏa-bhiccĕhĩ eva cavantaü  $  taṃ mahinda-ṇandaṇavaṇu pattaü
pekkhĕvi ṇāṇuppaṇṇu muṇindahŏ  $  viẏaliu maccharu saẏalu ṇarindahŏ
ghattā:
oẏarĕvi mahā-gaẏa-khandhahŏ  $  paẏahiṇa devi sa-ṇaravarĕṇa
     kara maüli karĕvi muṇi vandiu  $  ṇaẏa-sireṇa siri-halaharĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 83, Kaḍavaka 20:
jiha teṃ tiha vandiu sāṇandĕhĩ  $  lakkhaṇa-pamuha-asesa-ṇarindĕhĩ
diṭṭha sīẏa tahĩ rāhava-candeṃ  $  ṇaṃ tihuaṇa-siri parama-jiṇindeṃ
sasi-dhavalamvara-juvalālaṅkiẏa  $  mahi-ṇiviṭṭha chuḍu chuḍu dikkhaṅkiẏa
puṇu ṇiẏa-jasa-bhuvaṇa-ttaẏa-dhavaleṃ  $  sira-sīharovari-kiẏa-kara-kamaleṃ
pucchiu valĕṇa "aṇaṅga-viẏārā  $  parama-dhammu vajjarahi bhaḍārā"
teṇa vi kahiu savvu saṅkheveṃ  $  bharahesarahŏ jeva puraeveṃ
tava-caritta-vaẏa-daṃsaṇa-ṇāṇaĩ  $  pañca vi gaïu jīva-guṇathāṇaĩ
khama-dama-dhammāhamma-purāṇaĩ  $  jaga-jīvuccheāu-pamāṇaĩ
samaẏa-palla-raẏaṇāẏara-puvvaĩ  $  vandha-mokkha-lesaü vara-davvaĩ
ghattā:
āẏaĩ avaraĩ vi asesaĩ  $  kahiẏaĩ muṇi-gaṇa-sāraĕṇa
      paramāgamĕ jiha uddiṭṭhaĩ  $  āsi sa ẏa m bhu-bhaḍāraĕṇa
iẏa paümacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvariĕ
tihuvaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  samāṇiẏaṃ sīẏa-dīva-pavvam iṇaṃ
vandaïāsiẏa-tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-  $  kaï-kahiẏa-pomacariẏassa
sese bhuvaṇa-pagāse  $  teāsīmo imo saggo
kaïrāẏassa vijaẏa-sesiẏassa  $  vitthario jaso bhuvaṇe
tihuaṇa-saẏambhuṇā  $  pomacariẏaseseṇa ṇisseso
----------  [84. caürāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
etthantarĕ saẏalavihūsaṇu  $  paṇavĕvi vuttu vihīsaṇĕṇa
"kahĕ muṇivara sīẏa mahāsaï  $  kiṃ kajjeṃ hiẏa rāvaṇĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 1:
aṇṇu vi jiẏa-raẏaṇiẏarāhaveṇa  $  aṇṇahĩ jammantarĕ rāhaveṇa
kahĕ guru kiu sukkiu kāĩ eṇa  $  evaḍḍu pahuttaṇu pattu jeṇa
aṇṇu vi dhārāẏara-vaṃsa-sāru  $  paramāgama-jalaṇihi-vigaẏa-pāru
dasakandharu taraṇi va dosa-cattu  $  kiha mūḍhaü pekkhĕvi para-kalattu
jo ṇa vi āẏāmiu suravarehĩ  $  visahara-vijjāhara-ṇaravarehĩ
so dahamuhu kamala-dalakkhaṇeṇa  $  kiha raṇĕ viṇivāiu lakkhaṇeṇa
melleppiṇu ṇiẏa-bhāẏaru mahantu  $  haũ kiha hari-valahã saṇehavantu
kiha bhāmaṇḍalu suggīu ehu  $  rāmovari vaḍḍhiẏa-garua-ṇehu
ghattā:
aṇṇahĩ bhavĕ jaṇaẏahŏ duhiaĕ  $  kāĩ kiẏaĩ guru-dukkiẏaĩ
    jeṃ jammahŏ laggĕvi dussahaĩ  $  patta mahanta-dukkha-saẏaĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 2:
taṃ ṇisuṇeppiṇu haẏa-maẏaraddhaü  $  kahaï saẏalabhūsaṇu dhammaddhaü
"iha jamvūdīvahŏ abbhantarĕ  $  bharaha-khettĕ dāhiṇa-kaühantarĕ
khemaürihĕ ṇaẏadattu vaṇīsaru  $  cāva-vaḍāu ṇāĩ koḍīsaru
tahŏ suṇanda piẏa pīṇa-paohara   $  ṇaṃ dhaṇaẏahŏ dhaṇaevi maṇohara
tahŏ dhaṇadattu puttu pahilāraü  $  puṇu vasudattu vīu dihi-gāraü
tahŏ jaṇṇavali-ṇāu suhi diẏavaru  $  sāẏaradattu avaru purĕ vaṇivaru
raẏaṇappaha-piẏa-gehiṇi-vantaü  $  tahŏ guṇavaï sua suu guṇavantaü
viṇṇi vi ṇava-jovvaṇa-pāẏaḍiẏaĩ  $  suravara iva chuḍu saggahŏ paḍiẏaĩ
ekka-divasĕ paramuttama-satteṃ  $  sāẏaradattu vuttu ṇaẏadatteṃ
ghattā:
"taruṇīẏaṇa-maṇa-dhaṇa-theṇahŏ  $  ahiṇava-jovvaṇa-dhārāhŏ
     tuha taṇiẏa taṇaẏa dhaṇadattahŏ  $  dijjaü suẏahŏ mahārāhŏ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 3:
taṇ ṇisuṇĕvi vaḍḍhiẏa-aṇurāeṃ  $  diṇṇa vāẏa tahŏ guṇavaï-tāeṃ
to purĕ tahĩ jĕ avaru ṇiru vahu-dhaṇu  $  vaṇi-taṇuruhu kumāri-geṇhaṇa-maṇu
siri-kantu va sirikantu pasiddhaü  $  vara-siẏa-sampaẏa-riddhi-pasiddhaü
tāsu jaṇaṇi suẏa devi samicchaï  $  thova-dhaṇahŏ cira-varahŏ na icchaï
eha vatta ṇisuṇĕvi vasudatteṃ  $  paḍhama-sahoẏara-aṇaẏāṇanteṃ
suhi-jaṇṇavali-diṇṇa-uvaeseṃ  $  parihiẏa-ṇava-jalaẏāsiẏa-vāseṃ
phuriẏa-daṭṭha-oṭṭhubbhaḍa-vaẏaṇeṃ  $  caliẏa-gaṇḍa-bhū-bhaṅgura-ṇaẏaṇeṃ
ṇiru-ṇīsadda-calaṇa-saṃcāreṃ  $  sihi-siha-ṇiha-asivara-phara-dhāreṃ
mandira-pāsujjāṇĕ pamāiu  $  gampiṇu raẏaṇi-samaĕ sambhāiu
āẏāmĕvi āhaü asi-ghāeṃ  $  ṇāĩ mahīharu asaṇi-ṇihāeṃ
teṇa vi duṇṇirikkha-tikkhaggeṃ  $  tāḍiu ṇandā-ṇandaṇu khaggeṃ
viṇṇi vi vaṇa-viṇitta ruhirolliẏa  $  ṇaṃ phagguṇĕ palāsa papphulliẏa
ghattā:
to tāva eva vahu-macchara  $  jujjhiẏa ujjhiẏa-maraṇa-bhaẏa
      jā pāṇa vihi mi sama-ghāĕhĩ  $  vihurĕ ku-bhicca va muĕvi gaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 4:
puṇu uttuṅga-visāla-paīharĕ  $  jāẏa ve vi miga viñjha-mahīharĕ
dhaṇadattu vi guṇavaï a-lahantaü  $  bhāihĕ taṇaü dukkhu a-sahantaü
muĕvi ṇiẏaẏa-gharu suṭṭhu ramāulu  $  gaü puravarahŏ desa-bhamaṇāulu
vāla vi ṇiẏa-maṇĕ tahŏ aṇurattī  $  saẏalāvara-vara-varahã virattī
dhaṇadattahŏ gamaṇeṃ vicchāiẏa  $  jaṇaṇeṃ aṇṇa-ṇioẏahŏ lāiẏa
chāiẏa aï-raüdda-pariṇāmeṃ  $  sihi va palippaï sāhuhũ ṇāmeṃ
ṇiẏavi muṇinda-rūvu uvahāsaï  $  kaḍuẏakkhara-khara-vaẏaṇaĩ bhāsaï
akkosaï ṇindaï ṇibbhacchaï  $  jaïṇa-dhammu suiṇe vi ṇa icchaï
ttā
vahu-kāleṃ aṭṭa-jhāṇeṇa  $  puṇṇāusa avasāṇĕ maẏa
    uppaṇṇa tetthu puṇu kāṇaṇĕ  $  jahĩ vasanti te ve vi maẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 5:
māruẏa-vāhaṇa-hariṇa-samāṇā  $  viṇṇi vi miga puṇṇāu-pamāṇā
tahĩ vi tāhĕ kāraṇĕṇa virujjhĕvi  $  maraṇu patta avaropparu jhujjhĕvi
jāẏa mahisa jama-mahisa-bhaẏaṅkara  $  puṇu varāha aṇṇoṇṇa-khaẏaṅkara
puṇu añjaṇa-giri-garua mahāgaẏa  $  kaṇṇa-pavaṇa-uḍḍāviẏa-chappaẏa
puṇu īsāṇa-visoru-dhurandhara  $  uṇṇaẏa-kaüa thora-thira-kandhara
puṇu visadaṃsa ghora puṇu vāṇara  $  puṇu viga puṇu kasaṇujjala migavara
puṇu ṇāṇāviha avara vi thalaẏara  $  puṇu kameṇa ṇahaẏara puṇu jalaẏara
aï-dūsaha-dukkhaĩ visahantā  $  ekkamekka-sāmarisa-vahantā
ghattā:
bhavĕ eva bhamanti bhaẏaṅkarĕ  $  puvva-vaïra-samvandha-para
    teṃ kajjeṃ jagĕ riṇa-vaïraĩ  $  jo ṇa kuṇaï sa(?) viẏaḍḍhu para
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 6:
to dhaṇadattu vi suṭṭhummāhiu  $  mala-dhūsaru tisa-bhukkhahĩ vāhiu
deseṃ desu asesu bhamantaü  $  dūrāgamaṇa-parīsama-santaü
pattu jiṇālaü raẏaṇimuhantarĕ  $  laggu cavevaĕ ṇivisabbhantarĕ
"ahŏ ahŏ sukkiẏa-kiẏa pavvaïẏahŏ  $  mahu tisa-chuha-mahavāhiṃ laïẏahŏ
dehũ kahi mi jaï atthi jalosahu  $  jaṃ kāraṇu mahanta-pariosahŏ"
vihasĕvi cavaï pahāṇa-muṇīsaru  $  "salilu pievaĕ ko kira avasaru
mūḍha hiẏattaṇeṇa taü sīsaï  $  jahĩ andhāraĕ kiṃ pi ṇa dīsaï
sūratthavaṇahŏ laggĕvi diḍha-maṇu  $  jahĩ bhaviẏa-ẏaṇu ṇa bhuñjaï bhoẏaṇu
jahĩ para-goẏaru atthi pahūahã  $  peẏa-mahaggaha-ḍāiṇi-bhūahã
ghattā:
aï-pīḍiẏaha mi vara-vāhiĕ  $  ṇa laïjjaï osahu vi jahĩ
     iẏa savvari-samaĕ dusañcarĕ  $  kiha paripijjaï salilu tahĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 7:
ṇahĕ ṇiĕvi saẏā ravi atthamiu  $  jo pālaï jīu aṇatthamiu
so pāvaï maṇahara deva-gaï  $  suhu bhuñjaï hoĕvi amara-vaï
aṇuattĕvi uttamu kulu lahaï  $  puṇu aṭṭha vi kammaĩ ṇiḍḍahaï
ṇisi-bhojju ṇa chaṇḍiu jeṇa puṇu  $  tahŏ bhavĕ bhavĕ dukkhu aṇanta-guṇu
allalla-maṃsu teṃ bhakkhiẏaü  $  teṃ piẏa maïrā mahu cakkhiẏaü
saṇa-hullā ṇimva-samiddhāĩ  $  teṃ pañcumvaraï mi khaddhāĩ
teṃ vaẏaṇu asaccaü jampiẏaü  $  teṃ aṇṇahŏ taṇaü davvu hiẏaü
teṃ suṭṭhu ṇirantara hiṃsa kiẏa  $  para-ṇāri vi teṃ ṇiruttu laïẏa
ghattā:
ahavaï kiṃ vahueṃ caviĕṇa  $  eu jĕ mūlu saccu vaẏahã
    jeṃ honteṃ hoi samīvaü  $  mokkhu vi bhavva-jīva-saẏahã"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 8:
risi-vaẏaṇeṃ vimukka-micchatteṃ  $  laïẏaĩ aṇuvaẏāĩ dhaṇadatteṃ
gaü tetthahŏ vi gaeṇa tamāleṃ  $  bhamĕvi mahīẏalĕ vahaveṃ kāleṃ
samaü samāhiĕ maraṇu pavaṇṇaü  $  puṇu sohammĕ deu uppaṇṇaü
tahĩ ve sāẏarāĩ ṇivaseviṇu  $  kiṃ pi sesĕ thiĕ puṇṇĕ caveppiṇu
jāu mahā-pura vahu-dhaṇa-juttaü  $  chattacchāẏa-ṇaresara-bhattaü
pahu-piẏaẏama-siridattālaṅkiẏa  $  para-puravara-ṇara-ṇiẏarāsaṅkiẏa
dhāriṇi-meru-vaṇīsahã taṇuruhu  $  ṇāmeṃ paṅkaẏarui paṅkaẏa-muhu
ekkahĩ diṇĕ sa-turaṅgu paẏaṭṭaü  $  goṭṭhu paloĕvi paḍipallaṭṭaü
ghattā:
tāvaggaĕ mahihĕ ṇisaṇṇaü  $  tuhiṇagirindu va ṇiru dhavalu
    puṇṇāusu pāṇakkantaü  $  dīsaï ekku juṇṇa-dhavalu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 9:
taṃ goindu ṇiĕvi caḍulaṅgahŏ  $  meru-taṇaü oẏariu turaṅgahŏ
pāsu paḍhukkĕvi tahŏ kaṇṇantarĕ  $  diṇṇa pañca ṇamukāra khaṇantarĕ
tahŏ phaleṇa jiṇa-sāsaṇa-bhattahĕ  $  gabbhabbhantarĕ tahĕ siridattahĕ
jāu puttu parivaḍḍhiẏa-chāẏahŏ  $  vasahaddhaü tahŏ chattacchāẏahŏ
ekkahĩ diṇĕ ṇandaṇavaṇu jantaü  $  ṇiẏa ciru maraṇa-bhūmi sampattaü
thiu ṇiccalu joẏantu ṇirantaru  $  sumariu saẏalu vi ṇiẏaẏa-bhavantaru
disaü ṇiĕvi gaü parama-visāẏahŏ   $  puṇu uttariu aṇovama-ṇāẏahŏ
"etthu āsi aṇaḍuhu haũ hontaü  $  etthu paesĕ āsi ṇivasantaü
iha carantu iha salilu piẏantaü  $  iha ṇivaḍiu ciru pāṇakkantaü
ghattā:
tahĩ kālĕ kaṇṇĕ mahu keraĕ   $  jeṇa diṇṇu javu jīva-hiu
      pekkhemi keṇovāeṇa (?) "  $  ema suiru cintantu thiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 10:
puṇu sahasā uttuṅgu visālaü  $  tetthu karāviu parama-jiṇālaü
ṇiẏaẏa-bhavantaru paḍĕ vi lihāvĕvi  $  vāra-paesĕ tāsu vandhāvĕvi
thavĕvi aṇeẏa suhaḍa parirakkhaṇu  $  gaü rāulu kumāru vahu-lakkhaṇu
ekkahĩ diṇĕ paümarui mahāiu  $  vandaṇahattiĕ jiṇaharu āiu
diṭṭhu tāva paḍu lihiẏa-kahantaru  $  vimbhiu jovaï jāva ṇirantaru
tāvārakkhiehĩ duvvārahŏ  $  kahiu gampi tahŏ rāẏa-kumārahŏ
so vi iṭṭha-saṅgama-aṇurāiu  $  jhatti parama-jiṇa-bhavaṇu parāiu
diṭṭhu teṇa paḍĕ vittu ṇiẏantaü  $  acala-diṭṭhi vara-vimhiẏa-vantaü
ghattā:
puṇu vasahaddhaĕṇa papucchiu  $  ṇiẏa-siẏa-vaṃsuddhāraṇĕṇa
    "ehu paḍu ṇiĕvi taü hūaü  $  koūhalu kiṃ kāraṇĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 11:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi akkhaï vaṇi-taṇuruhu  $  "etthu paesĕ ekku muu aṇaḍuhu
tahŏ ṇavakāra pañca maĩ diṇṇā  $  je paṇatīsakkhara-sampuṇṇā
taṃ ĕu saẏalu vi ṇiĕvi cirāṇaü  $  gaü vimhaẏahŏ sarevi kahāṇaü
to siridattā-suĕṇa suvīreṃ  $  rahasāūriẏa-saẏala-sarīreṃ
"so govaï haũ" eva caveppiṇu  $  kara-maülañjali turiu kareppiṇu
hāra-kaḍaẏa-kaḍisuttĕhĩ pujjiu  $  guru va su-sīseṃ kumaï-vivajjiu
"ṇa vi taṃ karaï piẏaru ṇa vi māẏari  $  ṇa vi kalattu ṇa vi puttu ṇa bhāẏari
ṇa vi sasa duhiẏa ṇa mitta ṇa kiṅkara  $  sahasaṇaẏaṇa-pamuha vi ṇa vi suravara
jaṃ paĩ mahu suhi-iṭṭhu samāriu  $  ṇaraẏa-tiriẏa-gaï-gamaṇu ṇivāriu
attā
jaṃ diṇṇu samāhi-rasāẏaṇu  $  tetthu vihurĕ paĩ ṇiruvamaü
      tahŏ phalĕṇa ṇarindahŏ ṇandaṇu  $  puṇu etthu jĕ purĕ hūu haũ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 12:
jaṃ uvaladdhaü maĩ maṇuattaṇu  $  aṇṇu vi ĕhu vihaḍaü vaḍḍattaṇu
jaṃ thuvvami ṇaravara-saṅghāeṃ  $  taṃ saẏalu vi ĕu tujjhu pasāeṃ
laï ṇīsesu rajju siṃhāsaṇu  $  haũ taü dāsu paḍicchiẏa-pesaṇu"
evamāi saṃbhāsĕvi vaṇi-varu  $  puṇu ṇiu ṇiẏa-rāulu jaṇa-maṇaharu
viṇṇi vi jaṇa ṇiviṭṭha ekkāsaṇĕ  $  candāicca ṇāĩ gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ
inda-paḍinda va sundara-dehā  $  avaropparu parivaḍḍhiẏa-ṇehā
viṇṇi vi jaṇa sammatta-ṇiuttā  $  sāvaẏa-vaẏa-bhara-dhura-saṃjuttā
vihi vi karāviẏāĩ jiṇa-bhavaṇaĩ  $  uṇṇaẏa-siharullaṅghiẏa-gaẏaṇaĩ
ghattā:
jiha sāẏara-siri maṇi-raẏaṇĕhĩ  $  jiha kulavahu guṇehĩ varĕhĩ
    jiha sukaha suhāsiẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ  $  tiha mahi bhūsiẏa jiṇaharĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 13:
vahu-kāleṃ sallehaṇĕ marevi  $  īsāṇa-saggĕ sura jāẏa ve vi
raẏaṇāẏarāĩ tahĩ dui gamevi  $  paümappahu suravaru puṇu cavevi
huu avaravidehĕ jaẏaïri-siharĕ  $  su-maṇoharĕ candāvatta-ṇaẏarĕ
ṇandīsarapahu-kaṇaẏappahāhã  $  suu ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu ṇāmu tāhã
tahĩ rajju amara-līlaĕ karevi  $  tava-caraṇu careppiṇu puṇu marevi
māhinda-saggĕ givvāṇu jāu  $  sāẏaraĩ satta ṇivasevi āu
meruhĕ puvveṃ khemāurīhĕ  $  ṇiẏa-vihi-ohāmiẏa-surapurīhĕ
paümāvaï-gabbhĕ guṇāhiguttu  $  ṇaravaïhĕ vimalavāhaṇahŏ puttu
muhaẏanda-rundu siricanda-ṇāmu  $  thiu māṇusa-veseṃ ṇāĩ kāmu
vahu-kālu karevi maṇojju rajju  $  puṇu cintiu maṇĕ paraloẏa-kajju
ghattā:
ṇiẏa-puttahŏ paṭṭu ṇivandhĕvi  $  dihikantahŏ sundaramaïhĕ
      tava-caraṇu laïu siricandĕṇa  $  pāsĕ samāhigutta-jaïhĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 14:
so siricanda-sāhu a-pariggahu  $  ghaṇa-malakañcua-bhūsiẏa-viggahu
ṇiru ṇiruvama-raẏaṇa-ttaẏa-maṇḍaṇu  $  pañcendiẏa-duddama-daṇu-daṇḍaṇu
pañca-mahavvaẏa-bhāruddhāraṇu  $  māsa-pakkha-chaṭṭhaṭṭhama-pāraṇu
kandara-puliṇujjāṇa-ṇivāsaṇu  $  rāga-dosa-bhaẏa-moha-viṇāsaṇu
ekku cittu suha-bhāvaṇa-bhāvaṇu  $  kiẏa-sāsaṇa-vacchalla-pahāvaṇu
vahukāleṃ avasāṇu pavaṇṇaü  $  gampiṇu vambhaloĕ uppaṇṇaü
suravara-ṇāhu vimāṇĕ visālaĕ  $  maṇi-muttāhala-vidduma-mālaĕ
ghattā:
tahĩ tiẏasāhiva-siẏa māṇĕvi  $  dasa-sāẏarĕhĩ gaehĩ cuu
    uppaṇṇu etthu ĕhu rāhaü  $  dasaraha-rāẏahŏ paḍhama-suu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 15:
cira-tava-caraṇa-pahāveṃ āẏahŏ  $  vikkama-rūva-vihūi-sahāẏahŏ
iẏa-bhuvaṇa-ttaĕ ko uvamijjaï  $  jāsu sahasa-ṇaẏaṇu vi ṇaü pujjaï
jo ciru vasahamahaddhaü hontaü  $  jo īsāṇĕ surattaṇu pattaü
dui sāẏaraĩ vaseppiṇu āẏaü  $  kāleṃ so tārāvaï jāẏaü
suu sūraraẏahŏ kheẏara-ṇesaru  $  giri-kikkindha-ṇaẏara-paramesaru
ĕhu suggīvu jagattaẏa-pāẏaḍu  $  vāli-kaṇiṭṭhaü vāṇara-dhaẏavaḍu
sirikantu vi guru-dukkha-ṇivāsahĩ  $  paribhamantu vahu-joṇi-sahāsahĩ
ṇaẏarĕ muṇālakuṇḍĕ riu-maddahŏ  $  hemavaïhĕ vaïkaṇṭha-ṇarindahŏ
jāu sambhu-ṇāmeṃ vara-ṇandaṇu  $  surahã mi dujjaü ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu
vasudattu vi jammantara-lakkhĕhĩ  $  uppajjantu kameṇa asaṅkhĕhĩ
ghattā:
siribhūi-ṇāmu tetthu jĕ purĕ  $  ṇiẏa-jasa-bhuvaṇujjāliẏahŏ
      huu sambhuhĕ parama-purohiu  $  sarasaï-ṇāmeṃ bhajja tahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 16:
guṇavaï vi aṇeẏa-bhavehĩ āẏa  $  puṇu kariṇi amarasari-tīrĕ jāẏa
ekkahĩ diṇĕ paṅkuppaṅkĕ khutta  $  pāṇāula maülīhūa-ṇetta
pekkhĕvi taraṅgajava-kheẏareṇa  $  ṇavakāra pañca tahĩ diṇṇa teṇa
puṇu siribhūihĕ uppaṇṇa duhiẏa  $  veẏavaï ṇāmu chaṇa-ẏanda-muhiẏa
ṇaṃ kā vi devi pacchaṇṇa āẏa  $  sā maggiẏa sambhuṃ jaṇiẏa-rāẏa
siribhūi pajampiu "kaṇaẏa-vaṇṇa  $  kiha micchādiṭṭhihĕ demi kaṇṇa
to teṇa vi suṭṭhu viruddhaeṇa   $  ṇiṭṭhaviu purohiu kuddhaeṇa
jiṇa-dhammeṃ suravaru saggĕ jāu  $  jaraḍhāruṇa-chavi sacchāẏa-chāu
ghattā:
to veẏavaïhĕ ṇaraṇāhĕṇa  $  jeṃ saẏaluttama-maṇḍaṇaü
    valimaṇḍaĕ ṇa samicchantihĕ  $  kiu tahĕ sīlahŏ khaṇḍaṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 17:
jaṃ cārittu viṇāsiu rāeṃ  $  jaṇaṇu vivāiu garua-kasāeṃ
ṇaṃ sarasaï-sua jhatti palittī  $  jalaṇa-tiḍikka palālĕ va ghittī
veviraṅgi āẏamvira-ṇaẏaṇī  $  pabhaṇaï dara-phuriẏāhara-vaẏaṇī
"re ṇisaṃsa kappurisa a-lajjiẏa  $  khala varāẏa duggaï-gama-sajjiẏa
jaṃ paĩ mahu jaṇeru saṅghārĕvi  $  haũ parihutta valā tahŏ hārĕvi
taṃ taü garua-kamma-saṃcaraṇahŏ  $  hosami vāhi va kāraṇu maraṇahŏ"
eva bhaṇĕvi ṇaravaïhĕ ṇilukkĕvi  $  kaha vi kaha vi jiṇa-bhavaṇu paḍhukkĕvi
harikantiẏahĕ pāsu ṇikkhantī  $  vambha-lou vahu-kāleṃ pattī
ghattā:
sambhu vi siẏa-saẏaṇa-vimukkaü  $  jiṇavara-vaẏaṇa-parammuhaü
    micchāhimāṇu maṇĕ mūḍhaü  $  vahu-divasĕhĩ duggaïhĕ gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 18:
tahĩ mahanta-dukkhaĩ pāveppiṇu  $  tiriẏa-gaï vi ṇīsesa bhameppiṇu
puṇu sāvitti-gabbhĕ paṅkaẏa-muhu  $  jāu kusaddhaẏa-vippahŏ taṇuruhu
ṇāmu pahāsakundu supasiddhaü  $  dullaha-vohi-raẏaṇa-susamiddhaü
dikkhaṅkiu caü-ṇāṇa-saṇāhahŏ  $  pāsĕ vicittaseṇa-muṇiṇāhahŏ
tavu karantu paramāgama-juttiĕ  $  ekka-divasĕ gaü vandaṇahattiĕ
sammeirihĕ parāẏaü jāvĕhĩ  $  kaṇaẏappahu vijjāharu tāvĕhĩ
gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ lakkhijjaï jantaü  $  jo suravaïhĕ vi siẏaĕ mahantaü
taṃ ṇievi paricintiu sāhuṃ  $  maẏarakeu-maẏalañchaṇa-rāhuṃ
"hou tāva mahu sāsaẏa-sokkheṃ  $  vihava-vivajjieṇa teṃ mokkheṃ
ghattā:
dūsahahŏ jiṇāgama-kahiẏahŏ  $  atthi kiṃ pi jaï tavahŏ phalu
      to ehaü aṇṇa-bhavantarĕ  $  hou pahuttaṇu mahu saẏalu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 19:
iẏa ṇiẏāṇa-dūsiẏa-tava-ciṇṇaü  $  parama-samāhiĕ maraṇu pavaṇṇaü
saggeṃ saṇakumārĕ uppajjĕvi  $  tahĩ sāẏaraĩ satta suhu bhuñjĕvi
cavĕvi jāu suu jaẏa-siri-māṇaṇu  $  kaïkasi-raẏaṇāsavahũ dasāṇaṇu
ṇiẏa-jasa-bhūsaṇa-bhūsiẏa-tihuaṇu  $  kampāviẏa-visahara-ṇara-suraẏaṇu
toẏadavāhaṇa-vaṃsuddhāraṇu  $  sahasaṇaẏaṇa-viṇivandhaṇa-kāraṇu
jo sambhuṃ siribhūi vivāiu  $  puṇu sohamma-saggu sampāiu
cavĕvi pariṭṭhāpurĕ uppajjĕvi  $  khaẏaru puṇavvasu tavu āvajjĕvi
taïẏaü tiẏasāvāsu caḍeppiṇu  $  satta samuddovamaĩ gameppiṇu
ghattā:
so jāẏaü gabbhĕ sumittihĕ  $  dasasandaṇa-ṇaravaïhĕ suu
    ĕu lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇavantaü  $  cakkāhivu rāhava-aṇuu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 20:
jo guṇavaïhĕ āsi guṇavantaü  $  bhāẏaru lahuu paguṇa-guṇa-vantaü
bhavĕ paribhamĕvi cāru-muha-maṇḍalu  $  so uppaṇṇu ehu bhāmaṇḍalu
jo jaṇṇavali āsi guṇa-bhūsaṇu  $  so tuhũ ĕhu saṃjāu vihīsaṇu
teṃ saẏala vi rāmahŏ aṇurattā  $  puvva-bhavantara-ṇeha-ṇiuttā
jā ciru huntī guṇavaï vaṇi-suẏa  $  bhavĕ paribhamĕvi kamĕṇa diẏaharĕ huẏa
siribhūihĕ sua rūva-ravaṇṇī  $  jā ciru vambha-kappĕ uppaṇṇī
tahĩ teraha pallaĩ ṇivaseppiṇu  $  puṇṇa-puñjĕ thiĕ sesĕ caveppiṇu
ĕha sā jāẏa sīẏa jaṇaẏahŏ suẏa  $  ṇiru mahurālāviṇi ṇaṃ parahuẏa
ciru veẏavaï ṇeha-samvandheṃ  $  hiẏa dasakandhareṇa kāmandheṃ
jaṃ muṇi puvva-jammĕ ṇindantī  $  taṃ iha duhaĩ mahantaĩ pattī
ghattā:
siribhūi kālĕ sua-kāraṇĕ  $  jaṃ haü sambhu-ṇaresarĕṇa
      teṃ laṅkesaru ciru hiṃsaṇu  $  viṇivāiu lacchīharĕṇa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 21:
guru-vaẏaṇehĩ tehĩ gañjolliu  $  puṇu vi vihīsaṇu ema pavolliu
"kahĕ keṃ kammeṃ jaṇaṇa-viṇīẏahĕ  $  saïhĕ vi lañchaṇu lāiu sīẏahĕ"
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu muṇi-puṅgamu  $  akkhaï ṇāṇa-mahāṇaï-saṅgamu
"muṇi suarisaṇu āsi viharantaü  $  maṇḍali-ṇāmu gāmu saṃpattaü
thiu ṇandaṇavaṇĕ ṇiru ṇimmala-maṇu  $  taṃ vandeppiṇu gaü saẏalu vi jaṇu
muṇivaro vi lahu-vahiṇiĕ savaṇaĕ  $  saï mahasaïhĕ samaü suarisaṇaĕ
kiṃ pi cavantu ṇiĕvi veavaïĕ  $  kahiu asesahã loẏahã kumaïĕ
ghattā:
kiṃ cojju eu jaṃ ṇāĕhĩ  $  dūsijjaï gharu harihĩ vaṇu
    rāula-ṇihāu dugghariṇihĩ  $  pisuṇa-sahāseṃ sāhu-jaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 22:
"tumhahĩ bhaṇahu cāru dhammaddhaü  $  ṇijjiẏa-pañcendiẏa-maẏaraddhaü
maĩ puṇu ĕhu saẏam eva parikkhiu  $  sahũ mahilaĕ eantĕ pariṭṭhiu"
ema tāĕ tava-ṇiẏama-saṇāhahŏ  $  loĕ aṇāẏaru kiu muṇi-ṇāhahŏ
so vi karevi avaggahu thakkaü  $  "jā ṇa phiṭṭu saṃvāu gurukkaü
tā ṇivitti mahu saẏalāhārahŏ"  $  jāṇavi ṇicchaü haẏa-saṃsārahŏ
sāsaṇa-devaẏāĕ atthakkaĕ  $  muhu sūṇāviu garuāsaṅkaĕ
tāĕ vi eu vuttu "ahŏ loẏahŏ   $  ṇiẏa-maṇu mā sandehahŏ ḍhoẏahŏ
jaṃ maĩ kahiu savvu taṃ aliẏaü  $  ajju vi pāu asesu vi phaliẏaü"
ghattā:
jaṃ bhāi-jualu taṃ ṇindiẏaü  $  puvva-bhavantarĕ khala-maïĕ
    saṃvāu ettha uvaladdhaü  $  jaṇahŏ majjhĕ teṃ jāṇaïĕ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 23:
paḍibhaṇaï vihīsaṇu vimala-maï  $  "kahi vāli-bhavantaru parama-jaï"
to kahaï bhaḍāraü gahira-giru  $  "vindāraṇṇa-tthalĕ viulĕ ciru
hīṇaṅgu bhamantu vi ekku maü  $  so risi-sajjhāu suṇevi maü
puṇu jāu kaṇaẏa-dhaṇa-kaṇa-paürĕ  $  aïrāvaĕ khettĕ ditti-ṇaẏarĕ
sāvaẏahŏ vihiẏa-ṇāmahŏ su-bhuu  $  sivamaïhĕ gabbhĕ mahadattu suu
tahĩ pālĕvi pañcāṇuvvaẏaĩ  $  tiṇṇi guṇavvaẏa (caü) sikkhāvaẏaĩ
jiṇavara-pujjaü ṇhavaṇaü karĕvi  $  vahu-kāleṃ saṇṇāsĕṇa marĕvi
īsāṇa-saggĕ vara-devu huu  $  vihĩ raẏaṇāẏarĕhĩ gaehĩ cuu
iha puvva-videhabbhantaraĕ  $  vijaẏāvaï-purĕ ṇiẏaḍantaraĕ
ṇāmeṇa mattakoilaviulu  $  vara-gāmu rahaṅgi va dhaṇa-vahulu
ghattā:
tahĩ kantasou vara-rāṇaü  $  raẏaṇāvaï piẏa haṃsa-gaï
      tahũ vīhi mi suppahu ṇāmĕṇa  $  ṇandaṇu jāu (?) vimala-maï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 24:
teṇa juvāṇa-bhāu pāvanteṃ  $  ṇiẏa-maṇĕ jaïṇa-dhammu bhāvanteṃ
sammattoru-bhāru pavahanteṃ  $  diṇĕ diṇĕ jiṇu ti-kālu paṇavanteṃ
ṇiru ṇiruvama-guṇa-gaṇa-saṃjutteṃ  $  kantasoẏa-raẏaṇāvaï-putteṃ
sasahara-saṇṇiheṇa jasa-vanteṃ  $  taṇu-teohāmiẏa-raïkanteṃ
dullaha-tava-ṇihāṇu uvaladdhaü  $  ṇāṇāviha-laddhīhĩ samiddhaü
vahu-saṃvacchara-sahasĕhĩ vigaĕhĩ  $  duddhara-visaẏa-mahārihĩ ṇihaĕhĩ
āūriu suha-jhāṇu pahāṇaü  $  kira uppajjaï kevala-ṇāṇaü
tā avasāṇa-kālu tahŏ āiu  $  puṇu savvattha-siddhi sampāiu
ekka-raẏaṇi-taṇu suravaru jāẏaü  $  sūra-koḍi-chāẏā-saṃchāẏaü
tahĩ tetīsa-jalahi-parimāṇaĩ  $  bhuñjĕvi sokkhaĩ amiẏa-samāṇaĩ
ghattā:
so amaru caveppiṇu etthahŏ   $  jāu vāli iha khaẏara-pahu
      akhaliẏa-paẏāvu suha-daṃsaṇu  $  carama-sarīru samarĕ aï-dūsahu(?)
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 84, Kaḍavaka 25:
jo ṇigganthu muĕvi sāmaṇṇahŏ  $  ṇa vi jaẏakāru karaï jagĕ aṇṇahŏ
jo ṇivisantarĕ pihimi kameppiṇu  $  ei saẏala-jiṇaharaĩ ṇaveppiṇu
jeṇa samarĕ sahũ puppha-vimāṇeṃ  $  aṇṇu candahāseṇa kivāṇeṃ
dāhiṇa-bhuĕṇa bhuvaṇa-santāvaṇu  $  helāĕ jĕ uccāiu rāvaṇu
pacchaĕ dhruva sasikiraṇa mueppiṇu  $  rāẏa-lacchi suggīvahŏ deppiṇu
laïẏa dikkha bhava-gahaṇa-viratteṃ  $  giri-kaïlāsu caḍevi paẏatteṃ
diṇṇu silovari paramattāvaṇu  $  ṇahĕ jantaü rosāviu rāvaṇu
puṇu vi maḍappharu bhaggu khaṇantarĕ  $  ko uvamijjaï tahŏ bhuvaṇantarĕ
ghattā:
uppaṇṇa-ṇāṇu so muṇivaru  $  aṭṭha-duṭṭha-kammāri-khaü
    jhāevi sa ẏa m bhu bhaḍāraü  $  siddhi-khetta-vara-ṇaẏaru gaü"
iẏa paümacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kahi vi uvvarie
tihuẏaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  sapariẏaṇa-halīsa-bhava-kahaṇaṃ
iẏa rāmaeva-carie  $  vandaïāsiẏa-saẏambhu-sua-raïe
vuhaẏaṇa-maṇa-suha-jaṇaṇo  $  caürāsīmo imo saggo
----------  [85. paṃcāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
puṇu vihīsaṇĕṇa  $  pucchijjaï "maẏaṇa-viẏārā
sīẏā-ṇandaṇahã  $  kahi jammantaraĩ bhaḍārā"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 1:
helā
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu jaga-bhavaṇa-bhūsaṇeṇaṃ  $  vuccaï muṇivarindeṇaṃ saẏalabhūsaṇeṇaṃ
"suṇi akkhami pariosiẏa-suravarĕ  $  jagĕ pasiddhĕ kāẏandī-puravarĕ
vāmaeva-vippahŏ vikkhāẏahŏ  $  sāmalīĕ ghariṇīĕ sahāẏahŏ
suẏa vasueva-sueva viẏakkhaṇa  $  viẏasiẏa-vimala-jamala-kamalekkhaṇa
tāhã piẏaü dui ṇimmala-cittaü  $  visaẏa-piẏaṅgu-ṇāma-samjuttaü
ekkahĩ diṇĕ maẏaṇāẏa-maïndahŏ  $  aṇṇa-dāṇu siritilaẏa-muṇindahŏ
vihi mi jaṇehĩ tehĩ guruentie(?)  $  diṇṇu samujjala-avicala-bhattiĕ
vahu-kāleṃ avasāṇu pavaṇṇā  $  uttarakuruhĕ gampi uppaṇṇā
tahi mi tiṇṇi pallaĩ ṇivaseppiṇu  $  maṇĕ cintaviẏa bhoga bhuñjeppiṇu
puṇu īsāṇa-saggĕ hua suravara  $  palaẏa-samuggaẏa ṇaṃ ravi-sasahara
ghattā:
vihĩ raẏaṇāẏarĕhĩ  $  aïkantĕhĩ sammaẏa-bhariẏā
     cavaṇa karevi puṇu  $  tahĕ kāẏandihĕ avaẏariẏā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 2:
helā
raïvaddhaṇa-ṇarindaho para-parāẏaṇāsu
sasi-ṇimmala-jasāsu siva-sokkha-bhāẏaṇāsu
jāẏa ve vi jiṇavara-paẏa-sevihĕ  $  ṇandaṇa suarisaṇā-mahaevihĕ
tahĩ pahilāraü ṇāmu piẏaṅkaru  $  taṇu taṇuaü puṇu aṇuu hiẏaṅkaru
sohaï dittiĕ ṇāĩ diṇesara  $  ṇāĩ bharaha-pahu-vāhuvalīsara
vahu-kāleṃ tava-caraṇu laeppiṇu  $  saṇṇāseṇa sarīru mueppiṇu
huva gevajja-ṇivāsiẏa suravara  $  sa-maüḍa divva-kaḍaẏa-kuṇḍala-dhara
dui-raẏaṇī-sarīra-uvvahiẏā  $  aṇimāihĩ guṇehĩ saĩ sahiẏā
sūrappahĕ vimāṇĕ vitthiṇṇaĕ  $  ṇāṇāviha-maṇi-gaṇahĩ ravaṇṇaĕ
tahĩ icchiẏaĩ suhaĩ māṇeppiṇu  $  sāẏarāĩ caüvīsa gameppiṇu
cavĕvi jāẏa puṇu ari-kari-aṅkusa  $  sīẏahĕ ṇandaṇa iha lavaṇaṅkusa"
ghattā:
taṃ tehaü vaẏaṇu  $  ṇisuṇeppiṇu parama-muṇindahŏ
      huu vimbhaü garuu  $  vijjāhara-suravara-vindahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 3:
helā
jāṇĕvi puvva-vaïra-samvandhu vihi mi tāhaṃ  $  sīẏahĕ kāraṇeṇa somitti-rāvaṇāhaṃ
aṇṇu vi vahu-dukkha-ṇirantarāĩ  $  a-pamāṇaĩ suṇĕvi bhavantarāĩ
dahamuha-bhāẏara-jāṇaï-valāhã  $  suggīva-vāli-bhāmaṇḍalāhã
kĕ vi āsaṅkiẏa gaẏa bhaẏahŏ ke vi  $  kĕ vi thiẏa ṇiẏa-maṇĕ maccharu muevi
kĕ vi thiẏa cintā-sāẏarĕ visevi  $  kĕ vi huva maha-dukkha viuddha ke vi
kĕ vi saẏalu pariggahu pariharevi  $  atthakkaĕ thiẏa pāvajja levi
aṇṇekka ke vi thiẏa vaü dharevi  $  sammatta-mahabbharĕ khandhu devi
bhūgoẏara-khaẏara-surāsurehĩ  $  saẏalĕhĩ mi muṇihĩ ṇāmiẏa-sirehĩ
ṇīsesa-jīva-mambhīsaṇāsu  $  kiu sāhukkāru vihīsaṇāsu
ghattā:
"bho bho guṇa-uvahi  $  paĩ honteṃ viṇaẏa-sahāveṃ
      amhĕhĩ ĕu cariu  $  āẏaṇṇiu muṇihĩ pasāeṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 4:
helā
to etthantarĕ tiloẏagga-patta-ṇāmo  $  vuttu kiẏantavattĕṇa sarahaseṇa rāmo
"paramesara sadhara-dharitti-pāla  $  maĩ tujjhu pasāeṃ sāmisāla
supaẏāma-gāma-paṭṭaṇa-ṇiutta  $  raẏaṇāẏara desa aṇeẏa bhutta
māṇiẏaü pavara-pīvara-thaṇāu  $  suravahu-rūvohāmiẏa-dhaṇāu
acchiu viulĕhĩ jaṇa-maṇaharehĩ  $  givvāṇa-vimāṇĕhĩ vara-gharehĩ
ārūḍhu turaẏa-gaẏa-rahavarehĩ  $  kīliu vaṇa-sari-sara-laẏaharehĩ
devaṅgaĩ vatthaĩ parihiẏāĩ  $  icchaĕ aṅgāĩ pasāhiẏāĩ
ṇiruvama-ṇacciẏaĩ paloiẏāĩ  $  vahu-bheẏa-geẏa-vajjaĩ suāĩ
aṇuhuttu saẏalu ihaloẏa-sokkhu  $  jammahŏ vi ṇa lakkhiu kahi mi dukkhu
mahu puttu vivāiu devi jujjhu  $  ṇiẏa-sattiĕ pesaṇu kiẏaü tujjhu
ghattā:
evahĩ dāsarahi  $  uvaḍhukkaï jāva ṇa maraṇaü
      mukka-pariggahaü  $  vari tāma lemi tava-caraṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 5:
helā
labbhaï jagĕ asesu kiẏa-ṇaravarinda-seva  $  dullahu ṇavara ekku pāvajja-raẏaṇu deva
teṃ kajjeṃ lahu hatthutthallahi  $  maĩ paraloẏa-kaṅkha mokkallahi
iẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ jaṇa-jaṇiẏāṇandeṃ  $  vuttu kiẏantavattu valahaddeṃ
"vaccha vaccha pāvajja laeppiṇu  $  savva-saṅga-paricāu kareppiṇu
kiha cariẏaĕ para-harĕhĩ bhamesahi  $  pāṇi-pattĕ bhoẏaṇu bhuñjesahi
kiha dūsaha parisaha vi sahesahi  $  aṅgĕ mahā-mala-paḍalu dharesahi
kiha dharaṇiẏala-saẏaṇĕ sovesahi  $  kāṇaṇĕ viẏaṇĕ ghorĕ ṇisi ṇesahi
kiha dukkara-uvavāsa karesahi  $  pakkhu māsu chammāsa gamesahi
rukkha-mūlĕ āẏāvaṇu desahi  $  tuhiṇa-kaṇāvali dehĕ dharesahi
to seṇāṇi bhaṇaï "suha-bhāẏaṇu  $  jo chaḍḍami tuha ṇeha-rasāẏaṇu
jo lacchīharu ujjhĕvi sakkami  $  so kiṃ avaraĩ sahĕvi ṇa sakkami
ghattā:
miccu-surāuhĕṇa  $  deha-iri jāva ṇihammaï
      tāva khaṇeṇa vari  $  ajarāmara-desahŏ gammaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 6:
helā
kāleṇa vi ṇarinda vaḍḍhiẏa-mahanta-sou  $  hosaï tuha samāṇu avarĕhĩ vi sahũ viou
taïẏahũ dukkaru jīviu chuṭṭaï  $  vahu-dukkhĕhĩ mahu hiẏavaü phuṭṭaï
teṃ kajjeṃ ṇa vi vāriu thakkami  $  caü-gaï-kāṇaṇĕ bhamĕvi ṇa sakkami"
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi valu dummaṇa-vaẏaṇaü  $  vollaï aṃsu-jalolliẏa-ṇaẏaṇaü
"tuhũ sa-kiẏatthaü jo iu vujjhĕvi  $  mahu-sama siẏa jara-tiṇam iva ujjhĕvi
ghoru vīru tava-caraṇu samicchahi  $  iẏa jammeṃ jaï mokkhu ṇa pecchahi
avasaru pariẏāṇĕvi saṃkheveṃ  $  samvohevaü haũ paĩ deveṃ
jaï jāṇahi uvaẏāru ṇiruttaü  $  sambharejja to ĕu jaṃ vuttaü"
sŏ vi sarahasu sa-viṇaü paṇaveppiṇu  $  "ema karemi deva" pabhaṇeppiṇu
ghattā:
vandĕvi muṇi-pavaru  $  "dikkhahĕ pasāu" pabhaṇantaü
     khaṇĕ kiẏantavaẏaṇu  $  vahu-ṇarahĩ samaü ṇikkhantaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 7:
helā
sahasā huu maharisi bhava-bhava-saẏāhã bhīu  $  sīlāharaṇa-bhūsio karaẏaluttarīu
to muṇi ahiṇandĕvi amara-saẏa  $  ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-bhavaṇahã sahasatti gaẏa
sīrāuho vi saṃcallu tahĩ  $  sā acchaï sīẏāevi jahĩ
dīsaï ajjiẏa-gaṇa-pariẏariẏa  $  dhruva-tāra va tārālaṅkariẏa
ṇaṃ samaẏa-lacchi vimalamvariẏa  $  ṇaṃ sāsaṇa-devaẏa avaẏariẏa
pekkhĕvi puṇu thiu āsaṇṇu valu  $  ṇaṃ saraẏa-jalaẏa-mālahĕ acalu
cintantu pariṭṭhiu ekku khaṇu  $  dara-vāha-bhariẏa-avicala-ṇaẏaṇu
"jā ciru ghaṇa-ravahŏ vi tasaï maṇĕ  $  sovaï hiẏa-icchiẏa-vara-saẏaṇĕ
sā vaṇaẏara-sadda-bhaẏāulaĕ  $  vahu-hīra-khuṇṭa-kusa-saṅkulaĕ
vara-kāṇaṇĕ paguṇa guṇabbhahiẏa  $  kiha raẏaṇi gamesaï bhaẏa-rahiẏa
ghattā:
jampiẏa-piẏa-vaẏaṇa  $  aṇukūla maṇojja mahāsaï
      suha-uppāẏaṇiẏa  $  kahĩ labbhaï erisa tiẏamaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 8:
helā
dhi maĩ kiẏaü asundaraṃ jaṇahũ kāraṇeṇaṃ  $  jaṃ ghallāviẏāsi piẏa vaṇĕ akāraṇeṇaṃ"
cintĕvi eva sīẏa ahiṇandiẏa  $  ṇaṃ jiṇa-paḍima surindeṃ vandiẏa
jiha teṃ tema sumittihĕ jāeṃ  $  tiha vara-vijjāhara-saṅghāeṃ
"tuhũ sa-kiẏattha jāĕ supasiddhaü  $  jiṇavara-vaẏaṇāmiu uvaladdhaü
jā vandaṇiẏa jāẏa ṇīsesahũ  $  vāla-juvāṇa-jaraṅkiẏavesahũ
kanta-jaṇera-kulaĩ appaü jaṇu  $  paĩ ujjāliu saẏalu vi tihuẏaṇu"
puṇu ṇīsallu karevi mahavvala  $  jāṇaï ahiṇandĕvi gaẏa hari-vala
lavaṇaṅkusa-kumāra vicchāẏā  $  ṇaṃ ravi-sasahara ṇippaha jāẏā
gaẏa ṇara-ṇaravarinda-vijjāhara  $  sundara-kaḍaẏa-maüḍa-kuṇḍala-dhara
ghattā:
dasaraha-rāẏa-suẏa  $  ṇaravara-lakkhĕhĩ pariẏariẏa
      inda-paḍinda jiha  $  tiha ujjhāuri païsariẏa

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 9:
helā
etthantarĕ ṇievi valaeu païsaranto  $  risaha-jiṇinda-paḍhama-ṇandaṇahŏ aṇuharanto
ṇāṇā-rasa-sampuṇṇa-ṇirantaru  $  ṇāẏariẏā-ẏaṇu cavaï paropparu
"ĕhu so valu ṇiẏa-bhua-vala-vīẏaü  $  dīsaï gimbhu jema ṇissīẏaü
soha ṇa pāvaï uttama-sattaü  $  ṇaṃ jiṇa-dhammu daẏā-paricattaü
ṇaṃ joṇhaĕ āmelliu sasaharu  $  ṇaṃ dittiĕ dūrujjhiu diṇaẏaru
ĕhu so jeṃ viṇivāiu rāvaṇu  $  lakkhaṇu lakkhaṇa-lakkhaṅkiẏa-taṇu
iẏa veṇṇi vi jaṇa te lavaṇaṅkusa  $  sīẏā-ṇandaṇa kari va ṇiraṅkusa
taraṇi-teẏa ṇivvūḍha-mahāhava  $  jehĩ parajjiẏa lakkhaṇa-rāhava
ĕhu so vajjajaṅghu vala-sālaü  $  puṇḍarīẏa-puravara-paripālaü
ghattā:
ĕhu so sattuhaṇu  $  sattuhaṇu samarĕ aṇivāriu
     ṇandaṇu suppahahĕ  $  jeṃ mahu mahurāhiu māriu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 10:
helā
ĕhu so jaṇaẏa-ṇandaṇo jaẏasirī-ṇivāso  $  rahaṇeura-purāhivo tihuaṇe paẏāso
ĕhu so suggīvu varāhimāṇu  $  pamaẏaddhaẏa-vijjāhara-pahāṇu
kikkindha-ṇarāhivu vāli-bhāi  $  tārāvaï tārā-vaï va bhāi
ĕhu so mārui akkhaẏa-viṇāsu  $  jeṃ diṇṇu pāu sirĕ rāvaṇāsu
ĕhu so suviẏaḍḍhāevi-kantu  $  laṅkesu vihīsaṇu viṇaẏa-vantu
ĕhu so ṇalu ghāiu jeṇa hatthu  $  ĕhu ṇīlu vivāiu jeṃ pahatthu
ĕhu so aṅgaü thira-thora-vāhu  $  jeṃ kiu mandoẏari-kesa-gāhu
ĕhu so pavaṇañjaü suhaḍa-pavaru  $  paripālaï jo āicca-ṇaẏaru
ĕhu so mahindu añjaṇahĕ tāu  $  maṇaveẏa-mahāeviĕ sahāu
āẏaü sahi tiṇṇi vi jaṇiu tāu  $  avarāiẏa-kaïkaẏa-suppahāu
ghattā:
puṇṇaghaṇahŏ taṇaẏa  $  sā eha visallā-sundari
      satti-haü (?) jāĕ raṇĕ  $  parirakkhiu lakkhaṇa-kesari"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 11:
helā
ṇāẏariẏā-ẏaṇāsu ālāva eva jā̃va  $  lakkhaṇa-paümaṇāha rāulĕ païṭṭha tā̃va
surasari-jaüṇa-pavāha va sāẏarĕ  $  sasi-divasaẏara va attha-dharāharĕ
kesari vva giri-kuharabbhantarĕ  $  saddattha va vāẏaraṇa-kahantarĕ
cintaï valu piẏa-soẏabbhaïẏaü  $  "pekkhu keva sīẏaĕ tavu laïẏaü
haũ bhattāru jaṇaddaṇu devaru  $  jaṇaü jaṇaṇu bhāmaṇḍalu bhāẏaru
ṇandaṇa dui vi eẏa lavaṇaṅkusa  $  avarāiẏa sāsuva dīhāusa
iha mahi eu rajju ĕu paṭṭaṇu  $  ĕu gharu ĕhu avaru vi vandhava-jaṇu
iẏa puṇṇima-sasi-saṇṇiha-chattaĩ  $  kaha savvaï mi jhatti paricattaĩ
suravaraha mi asakku kiu sāhasu  $  vahu-kālahŏ vi thaviu mahiẏalĕ jasu
evahĩ ubbhāsiẏa-parivāẏahŏ  $  hontu maṇoraha paẏa-saṅghāẏahŏ"
ghattā:
lakkhaṇu cintavaï  $  sīẏā-guṇa-gaṇa-maṇa-rañjiu
      "haũ viṇu jāṇaïĕ  $  huu ajju jaṇeri-vivajjiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 85, Kaḍavaka 12:
to ettahĕ vi tāva paï-putta-moha-cattā  $  tiẏa-saṃbhūi-ṇindiẏā aï-mahanta-sattā
jā pāusa-siri vva su-paohara  $  āsi tiẏasa-juvaïhĩ va maṇohara
sā taveṇa parisosiẏa jāṇaï  $  ṇaṃ divasaẏareṃ gimbhĕ mahā-ṇaï
duppariṇāma dūrĕ parisesiẏa  $  ghaṇa-maloha-kañcuĕṇa vihūsiẏa
paramāgama-juttiĕ kiẏa pāraṇa  $  vasikiẏa pañcendiẏa-vara-vāraṇa
ruhira-maṃsa-parivajjiẏa-dehī  $  jīviĕ jaṇahŏ jaṇiẏa-sandehī
pāẏaḍa-atthi-ṇivaha-sira-jālī  $  pharusāiṇa savvaṅga-karālī
ghoru vīru tava-caraṇu kareppiṇu  $  hāẏaṇāĩ vāsaṭṭhi gameppiṇu
diṇa tettīsa samāhi laheppiṇu  $  thiẏa indahŏ indattaṇu leppiṇu
tiẏasāvāsĕ gampi solahamaĕ  $  vara-vimāṇĕ sūrappaha-ṇāmaĕ
kañcaṇa-sihari-sihara-saṅkāsaĕ  $  viviha-raẏaṇa-paha-kiẏa-vimalāsaĕ
ghattā:
hari-rāmujjhiẏaü  $  avaru vi jo dikkha laesaï
     sagga-mokkha-suhaĩ  $  so savvaĩ sa ĩ bhu ñjesaï
iẏa pomacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvarie
tihuẏaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  sīẏā-saṇṇāsa-pavvam iṇaṃ
vandaïāsiẏa-mahakaï-saẏambhu-  $  lahu-aṅgajāẏa-viṇivaddhe
siri-pomacariẏa-sese  $  pañcāsimo imo saggo
----------  [86. chāẏāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
uvaladdhĕṇa indattaṇĕṇa  $  sīẏa-pahuttaṇu kiṃ vaṇṇijjaï
tihi mi jagĕhĩ jaṃ ṇiruvamaü  $  jaï para taṃ ji tāsu uvamijjaï"
hruvakam
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 1:
to uttamaṅgĕ lāiẏa-kareṇa  $  pabhaṇiu gottamu magahesareṇa
"paramesara ṇiru thira-thora-gattĕ  $  ṇikkhantĕ su-sattĕ kiẏantavattĕ
volīṇaĕ sāsaĕ suha-ṇihāṇĕ  $  vaïdehī-saṇṇāsaṇa-vihāṇĕ
kantujjhiu evahĩ daṇu-vimaddu  $  kahi kāĩ karesaï rāmacandu
kiṃ lakkhaṇu kāĩ samīra-taṇaü  $  kiṃ bhāmaṇḍalu kiṃ jaṇaü kaṇaü
kiṃ lavaṇu kāĩ aṅkusu kumāru  $  kiṃ laṅkāhivu suggīu tāru
kiṃ pavaṇañjaü dahimuhu mahindu  $  candoẏari jamvavu indu kundu
kiṃ ṇalu ṇīlu vi sattuhaṇu aṅgu  $  pihumaï suseṇu aṅgaü taraṅgu
aṭṭha vi ṇārāẏaṇa-taṇaẏa kāĩ  $  aṇṇu vi āhuṭṭha vi sua-saẏāĩ
gaü gavaü candakaru dummuho vi  $  avaru vi kiṅkaru jo valahŏ ko vi
ghattā:
kiṃ avarāiẏa vimala-maï  $  kiṃ sumitta suppaha guṇa-sārā
      kāĩ karesaï doṇa-suẏa  $  ĕu saẏalu vi vajjarahi bhaḍārā"
