START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 2:
iẏa vaẏaṇĕhĩ muṇi-jaṇa-maṇahareṇa  $  vuccaï pacchima-jiṇa-gaṇahareṇa
"āẏaṇṇahi seṇiẏa diḍha-maṇāhã  $  vahu-divasĕhĩ rāhava-lakkhaṇāhã
dasa-disi-paribhamiẏa-mahājasāhã  $  amuṇiẏa-pamāṇa-kaẏa-sāhasāhã
suravara-jaṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-maṇoharāhã  $  musumūriẏa-arivara-puravarāhã
kañcaṇathāṇahŏ kañcaṇaraheṇa  $  paṭṭhaviu lehu kañcaṇa-raheṇa
"mahu ghariṇi jaẏaddaha jagĕ pasiddha  $  sura-sari va suvāṇiẏa kula-visuddha
dui duhiẏaü tāhĕ viẏakkhaṇāu  $  ahiṇava-jovvaṇaü sa-lakkhaṇāu
mandāiṇi-ṇāmeṃ tahĩ mahanta  $  lahu candabhāẏa puṇu rūvavanta
ghattā:
tāhã saẏamvara-kāraṇĕṇa  $  miliẏa saẏala mahi-goẏara kheẏara
    tumhahĩ viṇu sohanti ṇa vi  $  inda-paḍinda-rahiẏa ṇaṃ suravara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 3:
ĕu pariẏāṇĕvi sahasatti tehĩ  $  sarahasĕhĩ rāma-cakkesarehĩ
paripesiẏa aṅkusa-lavaṇa ve vi  $  hari-ṇandaṇa aṭṭha kumāra je vi
ṇaṃ pacaliẏa aṭṭha vi disa-karinda  $  ṇaṃ vasu ṇaṃ aṭṭha vi visaharinda
aṇṇekka taṇaẏa sāhaṇa-samāṇa  $  paṭṭhaviẏāhuṭṭha-saẏa-ppamāṇa
avara vi kumāra diḍha-kaḍhiṇa-deha  $  avaropparu parivaḍḍhiẏa-saṇeha
sa-vimāṇa paẏaṭṭa ṇahaṅgaṇeṇa  $  pariveḍhiẏa vijjāhara-gaṇeṇa
ṇaṃ juga-khaĕ huavahu canda-sūra  $  saṇi-kaṇaẏa-keu-guru-rāhu kūra
joẏanta caüddisu mahi samatta  $  taṃ kañcaṇathāṇu khaṇeṇa patta
ghattā:
chatta-cindha-siggiri-ṇiẏaru  $  dīsaï purĕ kumāra-saṅghāeṃ
    ṇaṃ vivāha-maṇḍavu viulu  $  ṇimmiu lavaṇaṅkusahã vihāeṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 4:
to ṇahĕ pekkhĕvi āgamaṇu tāhã  $  dasasandaṇa-ṇandaṇa-ṇandaṇāhã
veẏaḍḍha-ṇivāsiẏa sāṇurāẏa  $  ahimuha vijjāhara saẏala āẏa
sahũ tehĩ milĕvi kañcaṇarahāsu  $  gaẏa samuha saẏamvara-maṇḍavāsu
jahĩ gāḍha ṇiviḍa vahu mañca vaddha  $  ṇāvaï sakkaï-kaẏa kavva-vandha
jahĩ ṇaravara paẏaḍiẏa-vahu-viẏāra  $  khaṇĕ galĕ vandhanti muẏanti hāra
khaṇĕ lenti aṇeẏaĩ bhūsaṇāĩ  $  caü-disu joẏanti ṇiẏaṃsaṇāĩ
jahĩ suvvaï vīṇā-veṇu-saddu  $  paḍu-paḍaha-murava-ruñjā-ṇiṇaddu
jahĩ maṇaharu kĕ vi gāẏanti geu  $  aï-su-saru suhāvaü viviha-bheu
tahĩ te kumāra saẏala vi païṭṭha  $  ṇāṇā-maṇimaẏa-mañcĕhĩ ṇiviṭṭha
ghattā:
ṇiẏa-rūvohāmiẏa-maẏaṇa  $  solaha-āharaṇālaṅkariẏā
      māṇusa-veseṃ dharaṇi-ẏalĕ  $  amara-kumāra ṇāĩ avaẏariẏā
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 5:
to rūva-pasaṇṇaü  $  veṇṇi vi kaṇṇaü  $  gahiẏa-pasāhaṇaü
    ṇiruvama-sohaggaü  $  kariṇi-valaggaü  $  jaṇa-maṇa-vindhaṇaü
maṇi-vimala-kaẏāsahŏ  $  ṇiẏaẏa-ṇivāsahŏ  $  suha-diṇĕ ṇiggaẏaü
    ṇava-kamala-dalacchiu  $  sarasaï-lacchiu  $  ṇāĩ samāgaẏaü
sa-viseseṃ bhalliu  $  ṇaṃ dui bhalliu  $  maẏaṇeṃ melliẏaü
    guṇa-gaṇa-paḍihatthiu  $  vara-vaṇa-lacchiu  $  ṇaṃ saṃcalliẏaü
thiẏa caühu mi pāsahĩ  $  mañca-sahāsahĩ  $  vara joẏantiẏaü
    mohaṇa-laẏa-māẏaü  $  ekkahĩ āẏaü  $  ṇaṃ mohantiẏaü
ṇaṃ sukaï-ṇivaddhaü  $  kahaü rasaḍḍhaü  $  maṇĕ païsantiẏaü
    sohagga-viseseṃ  $  teṃ vavaeseṃ  $  ṇaṃ ṇāsantiẏaü
aï-visama-visāḍhaü  $  visahara-dāḍhaü  $  ṇaṃ mārantiẏaü
    ṇaṃ raṇĕ ḍhukkantiu  $  maggaṇa-pantiu  $  virahu karantiẏaü
ṇaṃ gimbhĕ phurantiu  $  diṇaẏara-dittiu  $  santāvantiẏaü
   ṇaṃ āuha-dhāraü  $  diṇṇa-pahāraü  $  mucchāvantiẏaü
ghattā:
aggaĕ kariṇi samāruhiẏa  $  dhāi saẏala darisāvaï ṇaravara
    ṇāvaï cāru vasanta-siri  $  vihĩ phullandhua-pantihĩ taruvara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 6:
joẏavi bhū-goẏara catta keva  $  khama-daĕhĩ kugaï-gaï-maggu jeva
puṇu melliẏa vijjāhara-ṇarinda  $  ṇaṃ gaṅgā-jaüṇĕhĩ vahu-girinda
avarĕ vi pariharĕvi gaẏāu tetthu  $  te sīẏā-ṇandaṇa ve vi jetthu
jahĩ chatta-saṇḍa-maṇḍavu mahantu  $  sura-maṇi-kara-ṇiẏarandhāra-vantu
ravikanta-pahujjoiẏa-diẏantu  $  avarĕhi mi maṇihĩ maha-soha dintu
pekkhĕvi lavaṇaṅkusa turiu savvu  $  gaü parigalevi ciru rūva-gavvu
jeṭṭhovari puṇu mandāiṇīĕ  $  parighitta māla gaẏa-gāmiṇīĕ
aṅkusahŏ candabhāẏāĕ teva  $  pariosiẏa ṇahaẏalĕ saẏala deva
kiu kalaẏalu tūraĩ āhaẏāĩ  $  vicchāẏaĩ jāẏaĩ vara-saāĩ
ṇaṃ ṇihi-cukkaĩ vāiẏa-kulāĩ  $  cintanti gamaṇa-hiẏaẏāulāĩ
ghattā:
"kiṃ viṇibhindahũ mahi gaẏaṇu  $  kiṃ sāẏarĕ giri-vivarĕ paīsahũ
      dhīsohagga-bhagga-rahiẏa  $  jāhũ tetthu jahĩ jaṇĕṇa ṇa dīsahũ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 7:
tāva duṇṇivārāri-maddaṇā  $  maṇĕ viruddha somitti-ṇandaṇā
tisaẏa-tīsa-vīsa-ppamāṇaẏā  $  palaẏa-kāla-rūvāṇumāṇaẏā
muṇĕvi vāla vikkama-gurukkaẏā  $  saẏala avara vara pāsĕ ḍhukkaẏā
saṇṇiẏaṃ duaṃ tehĩ seṇṇaẏaṃ  $  ghaṇa-ulaṃ va ṇaha-ẏalĕ ṇisaṇṇaẏaṃ
phaṇi-ulaṃ va accanta-kūraẏaṃ  $  diṇṇa-ghora-gambhīra-tūraẏaṃ
samara-rasa-diḍhāvaddha-pariẏaraṃ  $  pāusamvaraṃ ṇaṃ sa-dhaṇuharaṃ
raha-vimāṇa-haẏa-gaẏa-ṇirantaraṃ  $  viviha-cindha-chāiẏa-diẏantaraṃ
jāva valaï kira bhīsaṇāuhaṃ  $  vihi mi rāma-ṇandaṇahã sammuhaṃ
ghattā:
tāva tehĩ aṭṭhahĩ vi tahĩ  $  lacchīhara-mahaevī-jāĕhĩ
    dhariu ṇiẏaẏa-bhāẏarĕhĩ sahũ  $  ṇaṃ taïlokka-cakku disa-ṇāĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 8:
"ahŏ ahŏ bhāẏarahŏ ma karahŏ kohu  $  maṃ vaḍḍhārahŏ rahu-kulĕ virohu
jo jāẏa-diṇahŏ laggĕvi saṇehu  $  so vala-lakkhaṇahã ma khaẏahŏ ṇehu
āẏahã para kaṇṇahã kāraṇeṇa  $  avaropparu kāĩ mahā-raṇeṇa
guṇa-viṇaẏa-saẏaṇa-khama-ṇāsaṇeṇa  $  tihuaṇĕ dhikkāra-pagāsaṇeṇa
kalahanti e vi para jeva rāẏa  $  ku-purisa viṇṇāṇa-kalā-aṇāẏa
tumhĕhĩ puṇu saẏalaĩ aï-samattha  $  guṇavanta viẏāṇiẏa-atthasattha
lajjijjaï aṇṇu vi rāhavāsu  $  kiha vaẏaṇu ṇiesahũ gampi tāsu
suṭṭhu vi maẏa-mattaü miliẏa-bhiṅgu  $  kiṃ ṇiẏa-karu paricappaï maẏaṅgu"
ghattā:
iẏa piẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ avarĕhi mi  $  te uvasāmiẏa māṇa-samuṇṇaẏa
    ṇaṃ vara-guru-mantakkharĕhĩ  $  kiẏa gaï-muha-ṇivaddha vahu paṇṇaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 9:
puṇu te avaloĕvi vāra-vāra  $  sahũ kaṇṇahĩ lavaṇaṅkusa-kumāra
vahu-vandiṇa-vandĕhĩ thuvvamāṇa  $  caü-disa-jaṇa-pomāijjamāṇa
ṇisuṇĕvi gijjantaĩ maṅgalāĩ  $  tūraĩ gahirāĩ sa-kāhalāĩ
pekkheppiṇu siẏa-sampaẏa-vihou  $  vara-āṇavaḍicchiu saẏalu lou
appāṇaü pariṇindanti kẽva  $  hari-daṃsaṇĕ sura tava-hīṇa jẽva
"amhaĩ tikhaṇḍa-mahivaïhĕ putta  $  lāẏaṇṇa-rūva-jovvaṇa-ṇirutta
vahu-guṇa vahu-sāhaṇa vahu-sahāẏa  $  su-paẏāva atula-bhuẏa-vala-sahāẏa
ṇa vi jāṇahũ hīṇa guṇeṇa keṇa  $  ekkahŏ vi ṇa ghattiẏa māla jeṇa
ghattā:
ahavaï kāĩ visūriĕṇa  $  labbhaï saẏalu vi ciru kaẏa-puṇṇĕhĩ
    jīvahŏ maṇĕṇa samicchiẏaü  $  kiṃ saṃpaḍaï kiĕhĩ païsuṇṇĕhĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 10:
vari turiu gampi tava-caraṇu lehũ  $  jeṃ siddhi-vahua-karaẏalu dharehũ"
ĕu cintĕvi avahatthiẏa-bhaẏāsu  $  puṇu gaẏa valevi lakkhaṇahŏ pāsu
viṇṇaviu ṇaveppiṇu "ṇisuṇi tāẏa  $  pajjattaü visaẏa-suhehĩ rāẏa
amhaĩ saṃsāra-mahāsamuddĕ  $  duṭṭhaṭṭha-kamma-jalaẏara-raüddĕ
duggaï-gama-khārāpāra-ṇīrĕ  $  bhaẏa-kāma-koha-indiẏa-gahīrĕ
micchatta-garuẏa-vāẏanta-vāĕ  $  jara-maraṇa-jāi-velā-ṇihāĕ
vara-viviha-vāhi-kallola-juttĕ  $  paribhamaṇāṇantāvattaïttĕ
maẏa-māṇa-viula-pāẏāla-vivarĕ  $  aliẏāgama-saẏala-kudīva-ṇiẏarĕ
maha-mohubbhaḍa-cala-pheṇa-sohĕ  $  savioẏa-soẏa-vaḍavāṇalohĕ
paribhamiẏa suiru a-lahanta dhammu  $  kaha kaha vi laddhu puṇu maṇua-jammu
ghattā:
evahĩ eṇa kalevarĕṇa  $  jahiṃ kahiṃ vi ṇatthi jama-ḍāmaru
      jiṇa-pāvajja-taraṇḍaĕṇa  $  jāhũ desu jahĩ jaṇu ajarāmaru"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 11:
suẏa-vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu lakkhaṇeṇa  $  avaloĕvi puṇu puṇu takkhaṇeṇa
paricumvĕvi matthaĕ vāra-vāra  $  gaggara-gireṇa pabhaṇiẏa kumāra
"iha siẏa iha sampaẏa eu rajju  $  ĕhu sura-tiẏa-samu piẏa-ẏaṇu maṇojju
kula-jāẏaü āẏaü māẏarīu  $  āẏaü savvaha mi mahattarīu
pāsāẏa eẏa aï-sohamāṇa  $  kañcaṇa-girivara-siharāṇumāṇa
āẏaĩ avarāĩ vi pariharevi  $  kiha vaṇĕ ṇivasesahũ dikkha levi
haũ tumha ṇeha-vandhaṇĕ ṇiuttu  $  kiṃ parisesĕvi savvahu mi juttu"
paḍivuttu kumārĕhĩ "kāĩ eṇa  $  vahueṇa ṇirattheṃ jampieṇa
mokkalli tāẏa mā hou vigghu  $  sijjhaü tava-caraṇa-ṇihāṇu sigghu"
ghattā:
ema bhaṇeppiṇu sa-rahasĕhĩ  $  gampiṇu mahindodhuẏa(?)ṇandaṇa-vaṇĕ
     pāsĕ mahavvala-muṇivarahã  $  laïẏa dikkha ṇīsesahũ takkhaṇĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 12:
ettahĕ vi tāma bhāmaṇḍalāsu  $  vihavohāmiẏa-ākhaṇḍalāsu
rahaṇeura-pura-paramesarāsu  $  ṇiṇṇāsiẏa-sattu-ṇaresarāsu
kāmiṇi-muha-paṅkaẏa-mahuarāsu  $  vara-bhogāsattahŏ maṇaharāsu
mandara-ṇiẏamva-kīlaṇa-maṇāsu  $  ṇivisu vi a-mukku muddhaṅgaṇāsu
sirimāliṇi-bhajjālaṅkiẏāsu  $  maẏagalahŏ va suṭṭhu maẏaṅkiẏāsu
āharaṇa-vihūsiẏa-avaẏavāsu  $  acchantahŏ sura-līlāĕ tāsu
ekkahĩ diṇĕ sihi-ula-kaẏa-vamālu  $  sampāiu vāsārattu kālu
kasaṇujjala-ṇava-ghaṇa-pihiẏa-gaẏaṇu  $  paẏaḍiẏa-suracāu adiṭṭha-tavaṇu
aṇavaraẏa-thora-khara-ṇīra-dhāru  $  cala-vijjula-kaẏa-kakuhandhaẏāru
ghattā:
tetthu kālĕ bhāmaṇḍalahŏ  $  mandira-sattama-bhūmihĕ thakkahŏ
      matthaĕ paḍiẏa taḍatti taḍi  $  sela-siharĕ ṇaṃ paharaṇu sakkahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 13:
jaṃ uttamaṅgĕ ṇivaḍiu ṇihāu  $  taṃ pāṇahĩ melliu jaṇaẏa-jāu
gaẏa turiẏa rāma-lakkhaṇahŏ vatta  $  "bhāmaṇḍala-kaha kālahŏ samatta"
tehi mi pabhaṇiu "raṇa-saẏa-samatthu  $  amhahã ṇivaḍiu dāhiṇaü hatthu"
lavaṇaṅkusa sattuhaṇeṇa sahiẏa  $  ṇisuṇeviṇu soẏa-ggahĕṇa gahiẏa
"hā māma māma guṇa-raẏaṇa-khāṇi  $  kahĩ gaü muevi garuāhimāṇi
ettiẏa-kālahŏ sihi-mahura-vāẏa  $  hā muẏa amhāriẏa ajju māẏa"
ṇisuṇāviu jaṇaü vi turiu āu  $  lahu-bhāẏareṇa kaṇaeṃ sahāu
tahŏ puṇu pucchijjaï dukkhu kāĩ  $  to vaṇṇijjaï jaï vahu-muhāĩ
ghattā:
me(?mi)lĕvi asesahĩ vandhavĕhĩ   $  soẏāmaṇi-saṃcūriẏa-kāẏahŏ
    sahasā loẏācāru kiu  $  diṇṇu salilu bhāmaṇḍala-rāẏahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 14:
to vahu-divasĕhĩ māruvi sa-jāu  $  sa-vimāṇu kaṇṇakuṇḍala-purāu
pariẏariẏaü vahu-kheẏara-jaṇeṇa  $  anteura-sahiu ṇahaṅgaṇeṇa
gaü vandaṇa-hattiĕ turiu meru  $  ṇaṃ jakkhiṇi-jakkhĕhĩ sahũ kuveru
pekkhantu desa-desantarāĩ  $  veẏaḍḍha-ubhaẏa-seḍhihĩ purāĩ
kula-giri-siri-saravara-jiṇavarāĩ  $  vāviu kappadduma-laẏaharāĩ
guha-kūḍaĩ khettaĩ kāṇaṇāĩ  $  viṇṇi vi kuru-bhūmiu uvavaṇāĩ
savvaĩ piẏa-ghariṇihĩ dakkhavantu  $  vihasantu khaṇe khaṇĕ puṇu ramantu
uru-rahasuddhasiẏa-samatta-gattu  $  maṇahara-giri-mandara-siharu pattu
ghattā:
pavara-vimāṇahŏ oẏarĕvi  $  karĕvi paẏāhiṇa turiẏa sa-kanteṃ
    ṇimmala-bhattiĕ jiṇa-bhavaṇĕ  $  thui pārambhiẏa puṇu haṇuvanteṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 15:
"jaẏa jaẏa jiṇavarinda dharaṇinda-ṇarinda-surinda-vandiẏā  $  jaẏa jaẏa canda-khanda-vara-vintara-vahu-vindāhiṇandiẏā
jaẏa jaẏa vambha-sambhu-maṇa-bhañjaṇa-maẏaraddhaẏa-viṇāsaṇā  $  jaẏa jaẏa saẏala-samagga-dubbheẏa-paẏāsiẏa-cāru-sāsaṇā
jaẏa jaẏa suṭṭhu puṭṭha-duṭṭhaṭṭha-kamma-diḍha-vandha-toḍaṇā  $  jaẏa jaẏa koha-loha-aṇṇāṇa-māṇa-duma-panti-moḍaṇā
jaẏa jaẏa bhavva-jīva saṃsāra-samuddahŏ turiu tāraṇā  $  jaẏa jaẏa haẏa-tisalla jaẏa jāi-jarā-maraṇaĩ ṇivāraṇā
jaẏa jaẏa saẏala-vimala-kevala-ṇāṇujjala-divva-loẏaṇā  $  jaẏa jaẏa bhava-bhavantarāvajjiẏa-duriẏa-maloha-coẏaṇā
jaẏa jaẏa tijaẏa-kamala-vaẏa-daẏa-ṇaẏa-ṇiruvama-guṇa-gaṇālaẏā  $  jaẏa jaẏa visaẏa-vigaẏa jaẏa jaẏa dasa-viha-dhammāṇuvālaẏā
tuhũ savvaṇhu savva-ṇiravekkhu ṇirañjaṇu ṇikkalo paro  $  tuhũ ṇiravaẏavu suhumu paramappaü paramu lahu paramparo
tuhũ ṇilleu a-guru paramāṇuu akkhaü vīẏarāẏao  $  tuhũ gaï maï jaṇeru sasa māẏari bhāẏari suhi sahāẏao"
ghattā:
ẽva viviha-thottĕhĩ thuṇĕvi  $  [puṇu] puṇu jiṇavaru pujjĕvi añcĕvi
    pavaṇa-puttu pallaṭṭu ṇahĕ  $  mandara-giri-siharaĩ pariañcĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 16:
tahŏ haṇuvahŏ ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇāsu  $  jiṇa-vandaṇa-aṇurāiẏa-maṇāsu
ṇiẏa-līlaĕ entahŏ bharaha-khettu  $  parigaliu divasu atthamiu mittu
aṇuratta sañjha ṇaṃ vesa āẏa  $  ṇaṃ rakkhasi rattāratta jāẏa
vahalandhaẏāra puṇu ḍhukka rāi  $  masi-khapparu vihiu samattha (?) ṇāĩ
tahĩ kālĕ haṇuu taṇu-paha-jiẏakku  $  suradunduhi-selĕ sa-seṇṇu thakku
joaï kasaṇujjalu jāva gaẏaṇu  $  sasi-virahiu ṇiddīvaü va bhavaṇu
tahĩ tāva ṇiẏacchiẏa ṇiru gurukka  $  ṇahaẏalahŏ paḍanti samujjalukka
savvahŏ vi jaṇahŏ sajjhasu karanti  $  ṇaṃ vijjula-leha paripphuranti
gaha-tārā-rikkhĕhĩ paha haranti  $  palaẏāṇala-jālahĕ aṇuharanti
sā thovantarĕ a-muṇiẏa-pamāṇa  $  atthakkaĕ ṇiĕvi vilīẏamāṇa
ghattā:
cintiu ṇiẏa-maṇĕ sundarĕṇa  $  "dhiddhigatthu saṃsāra-ṇivāsu
      taṃ tila-mittu vi kiṃ pi ṇa vi  $  jāsu ṇa dīsaï bhuvaṇĕ viṇāsu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 17:
divasĕhĩ maṇa-mūḍhahũ ārisāhũ  $  eha jĕ avattha amhārisāhũ
lhikkantahã giri-vara-kandare vi  $  mañjūsahã asivara-pañjare vi
caü-disahĩ bhavantahã amvare vi  $  lukkantahã sāẏarĕ mandare vi
āĕhĩ avarehĩ ṇa muaï mittu  $  to vari para-loẏahŏ diṇṇu cittu
jovvaṇu vara-kuñjara-kaṇṇa-cavalu  $  jīviu taṇagga-jala-vindu-taralu
sampaẏa dappaṇa-chāẏā-samāṇa  $  siẏa maru-haẏa-dīva-sihāṇumāṇa
saraẏabbha-chāhi-sacchāu atthu  $  tiṇa-jaliẏa-jalaṇa-samu saẏaṇa-satthu
tusa-muṭṭhi va ṇiru ṇīsāru dehu  $  jala-reha va diṭṭha-paṇaṭṭhu ṇehu
ghattā:
ĕu jāṇantu vi pekkhu kiha  $  acchami chāiu mohaṇa-jāleṃ
    iẏa girivarĕ sūruggamaṇĕ  $  kallĕ ji dikkha lemi kiṃ kāleṃ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 18:
cintantahŏ hiẏavaĕ tāsu eva  $  gaẏa raẏaṇi kameṇa ku-vuddhi jeva
uggamiu divāẏaru ṇahĕ vihāi  $  pāvajja-ṇihālaü āu ṇāĩ
āucchĕvi piẏa-mahilā-ṇihāu  $  santāṇĕ ṭhavevi ṇiẏaṅgajāu
ṇīsarĕvi vimāṇahŏ aṇila-puttu  $  ṇara-jāṇu caḍiu maṇi-gaṇa-ṇiuttu
gaü ṇaravara-sahiu jiṇinda-bhavaṇu  $  cāraṇa-risi lakkhiu dhammaraẏaṇu
pariẏañcĕvi jiṇa-vandaṇa karevi  $  puṇu du-vihu pariggahu pariharevi
paṇṇāsahĩ satta-saĕhĩ sahāu  $  khaẏarahã dikkhaṅkiu sāṇurāu
vandhumaïhĕ pāsĕ su-paümarāẏa  $  dikkhaṅkiẏa pahu-suggīva-jāẏa
sāṇaṅgakusuma tiha kharahŏ dhīẏa  $  tiha sirimāliṇi ṇala-suẏa viṇīẏa
tiha laṅkāsundari guṇahã rāsi  $  jā pariṇiẏa laṅkāurihĩ āsi
avaraü vi maṇohara tiẏaü tāva  $  ṇikkhantaü aṭṭha sahāsa jāva
ghattā:
iẏa ekkekka-pahāṇiẏaü  $  sirisaïlahŏ aï-pāṇa-piẏāriu
     aṇṇaü puṇu kiṃ jāṇiẏaü  $  jāu tetthu pavvaïẏaü ṇāriu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 86, Kaḍavaka 19:
vatta suṇĕvi rovaï maru-añjaṇa  $  "hā haṇuvanta rāma-maṇa-rañjaṇa
hā hā uhaẏa-vaṃsa-saṃvaddhaṇa  $  hā varuṇāhiva-suẏa-saẏa-vandhaṇa
hā mahinda-māhindi-parāẏaṇa  $  hā hā āsālī-viṇivāẏaṇa
hā hā vajjāuha-darisiẏa-vaha  $  laṅkāsundari-kiẏa-pāṇiggaha
hā givvāṇaravaṇa-vaṇa-cūraṇa  $  akkhakumāra-savala-musumūraṇa
hā ghaṇavāhaṇa-raṇa-osāraṇa  $  hā vijjā-laṅgūla-pahāraṇa
hā hā ṇāga-pāsa-vahu-toḍaṇa  $  hā hā rāvaṇa-mandira-moḍaṇa
hā hā laṅkā-paüli-ṇiloṭṭaṇa  $  hā hā vajjoẏara-dalavaṭṭaṇa
hā lakkhaṇa-visalla-melāvaṇa  $  saẏa-vāraü jūrāviẏa-rāvaṇa
amhahũ vihi mi putta ṇa kahantaü  $  kiha ekkallaü jji ṇikkhantaü"
eva bhaṇĕvi suẏa-soẏabbhaïẏaĩ  $  jiṇaharu gampi tāĩ pavvaïẏaĩ
ghattā:
sŏ vi maẏaraddhaü vīsamaü  $  mārui ghora-vīra-tava-tattaü
      vahu-divasĕhĩ kevalu lahĕvi  $  jetthu sa ẏa mbhu-deu tahĩ pattaü
kaïrāẏassa vijaẏasesiẏassa  $  vitthāriu jaso bhuvaṇe
tihuẏaṇa-saẏambhuṇā  $  pomacariẏa-seseṇa ṇisseso
iẏa pomacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvarie
tihuẏaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  mārui-ṇivvāṇa-pavvam iṇaṃ
vandaïāsiẏa-tihuẏaṇa-saẏambhu-  $  pariraïẏa-rāmacariẏassa
sesammi jaga-pasiddhe  $  chāẏāsīmo imo saggo
----------  [87. sattāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
vahu-divasĕhĩ te lakkhaṇa-sua vi  $  duddharu dūsahu tavu karĕvi
jiha haṇuu tema dhuẏa-kamma-raẏa  $  thiẏa siva-sāsaĕ païsarĕvi
dhruvakam
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 1:
to iẏa vatta suṇĕvi riu-maddeṃ  $  vihasĕvi vollijjaï valahaddeṃ
"lahavi eẏa vara-bhoẏa maṇohara  $  haẏavara gaẏavara rahavara ṇaravara
vahu-sīmantiṇīu suhi-saẏaṇaĩ  $  dhaṇa-kalahoẏa-dhaṇṇa-maṇi-raẏaṇaĩ
ṇa vi māṇanti kamala-saṇṇiha-muha  $  ṇārāẏaṇa-pavaṇañjaẏa-taṇuruha
mahu ṇa muṇantahŏ bhava-bhaẏa-laïẏā  $  pekkhu keva saẏala vi pavvaïẏā
maṃchuḍu te vāeṃ uṭṭhaddhā  $  ahavaï kahi mi pisāeṃ laddhā
jima vāmohiẏa jima ummāhiẏa  $  kusalu ṇa atthi vejjĕ ṇa vi vāiẏa
teṃ kajjeṃ vihoẏa parisesĕvi  $  gaẏa taveṇa appāṇaü bhūsĕvi"
ghattā:
dhavalaṅgahŏ siva-suha-bhāẏaṇahŏ  $  jiṇavara-vaṃsa-samubbhavahŏ
    rāhavahŏ vi jahĩ jaḍa-maï havaï  $  tahĩ aṇṇahŏ ṇa vi hoi kahŏ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 2:
aṇṇahĩ diṇĕ suravarahã variṭṭhaü  $  sahasaṇaẏaṇu ṇiẏa-sahaĕ ṇiviṭṭhaü
ṇaṃ suragiri sesa-iri-sahāẏaü  $  diṇaẏara-koḍi-teẏa-sacchāẏaü
vara-sīhāsaṇa-siharāruhiẏaü  $  ṇava-tiẏa-acchara-koḍihĩ sahiẏaü
vivihāharaṇa-phuranta-sarīraü  $  giri va dhīru jalahi va gambhīraü
maha-riddhiĕ sattiĕ sampuṇṇaü  $  uttama-vala-rūveṇa pasaṇṇaü
loẏavāla-pamuhahã suha-pavarahã  $  vollaï samaü asesahã amarahã
"jāsu pasāeṃ ĕu indattaṇu  $  labbhaï devattaṇu siddhattaṇu
jeṃ saṃsāra-ghora-rivu ekkeṃ  $  viṇihaü ṇāṇa-samujjala-cakkeṃ
jo bhava-sāẏara-duhaĩ ṇivāraï  $  bhaviẏa-lou helāĕ ji tāraï
ghattā:
uppaṇṇahŏ jasu mandara-siharĕ  $  tiẏasendĕhĩ ahiseu kiu
     taṃ paṇavahŏ saĩ savvāẏarĕṇa  $  jaï icchahŏ bhava-maraṇa-khaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 3:
jo saẏarāẏara pihimi mueppiṇu  $  thiu bhuvaṇa-ttaẏa-siharĕ caḍeppiṇu
jāsu ṇāmu sivu sambhu jiṇesaru  $  deva-devu mahaevu mahesaru
jiṇu jiṇindu kāleñjaru saṅkaru  $  thāṇu hiraṇṇagabbhu titthaṅkaru
vihu saẏambhu saddhammu saẏampahu  $  bhaẏaü aruhu arahantu jaẏappahu
sūri ṇāṇa-loẏaṇu tihuẏaṇa-guru  $  kevali ruddu viṇhu haru jaga-guru
suhumu sokkhu ṇiravekkhu paramparu  $  paramappaü paramāṇu paramaparu
a-guru a-lahuu ṇirañjaṇu ṇikkalu  $  jaga-maṅgalu ṇiravaẏavu su-ṇimmalu
ghattā:
iẏa ṇāmĕhĩ sura-ṇara-visaharĕhĩ  $  jo saṃthuvvaï bhuvaṇa-ẏalĕ
    tahŏ aṇudiṇu risaha-bhaḍārāhŏ  $  bhattiĕ laggahŏ paẏa-juvalĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 4:
jīvu aṇāi-ṇihaṇu bhava-sāẏarĕ  $  kamma-vaseṇa bhamantu duhāẏarĕ
kema vi maṇuẏa-jammĕ uppajjaï  $  dhammahŏ ṇavara tahi mi mohijjaï
micchā-tavĕṇa jāu hīṇāmaru  $  mujjhaï cavĕvi hoi vi paḍivaü ṇaru
maha-riddhiẏahŏ vi surahŏ su-vallaha  $  hoi ṇarattĕ vohi aï-dullaha
dukkhu dukkhu so dhammahŏ laggaï  $  aṇṇāṇiu puṇu kira kahĩ laggaï
aha devo vi hovi paḍivaü ṇaru  $  ṇaru vi hovi puṇu paḍivaü suravaru
ahŏ devahŏ kaïẏahã maṇuattaṇĕ  $  vohi lahesahũ jiṇavara-sāsaṇĕ
aṭṭha-duṭṭha-kammāri haṇesahũ  $  avicalu siddhālaü pāvesahũ"
ekkeṃ sureṇa vuttu to suravaï  $  "saggĕ vasantahã amhahã iẏa maï
maṇuattaṇĕ puṇu savvahã mujjhaï  $  koha-loha-maẏa-māṇĕhĩ rujjhaï
ahavaï jaï ṇa vi maṇĕ pariacchahi  $  to kiṃ paümaṇāhu ṇa ṇiẏacchahi
cavĕvi vamha-ṇāmahŏ sura-loẏahŏ  $  kiha āsattaü maṇua-vihoẏahŏ
ghattā:
vihasevi vuttu saṅkandaṇĕṇa  $  "jīva-ṇihāẏa-ṇirundhaṇahã
      saṃsārĕ saṇeha-ṇivandhu diḍhu  $  majjhĕ asesahã vandhaṇahã
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 5:
lacchīharu kasaṇujjala-dehaü  $  rāmovari-parivaḍḍhiẏa-ṇehaü
ekku vi ṇivisu viou ṇa icchaï  $  uvagarehũ pāṇehĩ vi vañchaï
ettiu jāṇami haũ ahŏ devahŏ  $  maraṇahŏ ṇāmeṇa ji valaevahŏ
ṇa vi jīvaï ṇiruttu dāmoẏaru  $  rāmu muaü teṃ kema sahoẏaru
kiha vīsaraü viviha-uvaẏārā  $  je cintaviẏa-maṇoraha-gārā
kiha vīsaraü aüjjha muevaü  $  samaü saẏalĕ vaṇa-vāsĕ bhamevaü
kiha vīsaraü raüddu mahāraṇu  $  sa-tisira-khara-dūsaṇa-saṅghāraṇu
kiha vīsaraü samarĕ paharevaü  $  indaï vi-rahu karevi dharevaü
kiha vīsaraü sa-rosu bhiḍevaü  $  laṅkesara-sira-kamala khuḍevaü
ghattā:
avara vi uvaẏāra jaṇaddaṇahŏ  $  kiha rahuvaï maṇĕ vīsaraï
     teṃ acchaï paḍiuvaẏāra-maï  $  ṇeha-vasaṃgaü kiṃ karaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 6:
āẏaṇṇĕvi iẏa vaẏaṇaĩ cavantu  $  aṇṇu vi jāṇĕvi āsaṇṇa-mittu
jaẏakārĕvi vāsavu cāru-vesa  $  gaẏa ṇiẏa-ṇiẏa-ṇilaẏahã sura asesa
tahĩ ṇavara sa-vibbhama viṇṇi deva  $  pacaliẏa lakkhaṇahŏ viṇāsu jeva
"valu muẏaü suṇevi saṇehavantu  $  pekkhahũ so kāĩ karaï aṇantu
kiha rūaï pajampaï kāĩ vaẏaṇu  $  ārūsaï kahŏ kahĩ kuṇaï gamaṇu
muhu soeṃ kehaü hoi tāsu  $  kerisaü dukkhu anteurāsu"
eu vaẏaṇu pajampĕvi raẏaṇacūlu  $  aṇṇekku vi ṇāmeṃ amiẏacūlu
viṇṇi vi kaẏa-ṇicchaẏa gaẏa turanta  $  ṇiviseṇa aüjjhā-ṇaẏari patta
ghattā:
māẏāmaü valaevahŏ bhavaṇĕ  $  devahĩ kaluṇu saddu garaü
    kiu juvaï-ṇivaha-dhāhā-gahiru  $  "hā hā rāhavacandu muu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 7:
jaṃ halahara-maraṇa-saddu ṇisuu  $  taṃ bhaṇaï visaṇṇu sumitti-suu
"hā kāĩ jāu phuḍu rāhavahŏ"  $  lahu addhu cavantahŏ eva tahŏ
sahũ vāẏaĕ jīviu ṇiggaẏaü  $  hari-dehahŏ ṇaṃ rūsĕvi gaẏaü
vara-jāẏarūva-khambhāsiẏaü  $  sīhāsaṇĕ vitthiṇṇaĕ thiẏaü
a-ṇimīliẏa-loẏaṇu thaḍḍha-taṇu  $  leppamaü ṇāĩ thiu mahumahaṇu
taṃ pekkhĕvi suravara ve vi jaṇa  $  appaü ṇindanti visaṇṇa-maṇa
aïlajjiẏa pacchātāva-kaẏa  $  sohamma-saggu sahasatti gaẏa
ghattā:
suravara-māẏaĕ viuruvviẏaü  $  pariẏāṇĕvi hari-gehiṇihĩ
    āḍhattu paṇaẏa-kuviẏaĩ karĕvi  $  savvĕhĩ suṭṭhu saṇehiṇihĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 8:
to pāsĕ ḍhukka āula-maṇāhã  $  sattāraha sahasa varaṅgaṇāhã
ka vi paṇaïṇi paṇaeṃ bhaṇaï eva  $  "rosāviu kavaṇeṃ akkhu deva
jo ku-maïĕ kiu avarāhu tujjhu  $  so saẏalu vi ekkasi khamahi majjhu'
sabbhāveṃ aggaĕ kā vi ṇaḍaï  $  ka vi daïẏahŏ calaṇa-ẏalehĩ paḍaï
ka vi maṇaharu vīṇā-vajju vāi  $  ka vi viviha-bheu gandhavvu gāi
ka vi āliṅgaï ṇibbhara-saṇeha  $  cumvaï kavolu somāla-deha
ka vi kusumaĩ sīsĕ samuddharevi  $  tosāvaï sirĕ seharikarevi
ka vi muhu joĕvi maliẏaṅgavaṅgu  $  uṭṭhāvaï kiẏa-kara-sāha-bhaṅgu
ghattā:
aṇṇāu vi ceṭṭhaü vahu-vihaü  $  juaïhĩ jāu jāu kiẏaü
    jiha kiviṇa-loĕ siẏa-sampaẏaü  $  savvaü gaẏaü ṇiratthiẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 9:
to ĕha vatta ṇisuṇeppiṇu rāmu  $  sahasatti āu jagĕ ṇāẏa-ṇāmu
lakkhaṇu kumāru jahĩ tahĩ païṭṭhu  $  vahu-piẏahã majjhĕ ṇiẏa-bhāu diṭṭhu
savvarĕ (?) virāmĕ sasi-vaẏaṇa-chāu  $  ṇiru ṇiccalu siri-parihariẏa-kāu
kākutthu pacintaï raṇĕ dusajjhu  $  "maṃchuḍu lacchīharu kuiu majjhu
teṃ kajjeṃ ṇa vi āẏaü vi gaṇaï  $  ṇa vi kāĩ vi abbhutthāṇu kuṇaï"
sirĕ cumvĕvi pabhaṇiu "sundaraccha  $  kiṃ mahu ālāvu ṇa dehi vaccha
kahĕ kāĩ thiẏaü kaṭṭhamaü ṇāĩ"  $  pariẏāṇiu ciṇhĕhĩ muaü bhāi
avaloiu puṇu saẏalu vi sarīru  $  mucchāviu khaṇĕ valaeva-vīru
ghattā:
jiha taruvaru chiṇṇaü mūlĕ tiha  $  mahihĕ paḍiu ṇicceẏaṇaü
    maru-hāra-ṇīra-candaṇa-jalĕhĩ  $  huu kaha kaha vi sa-ceẏaṇaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 10:
uṭṭhiu soāuru rahu-taṇaü  $  vahu-vāha-pihiẏa-dīṇāṇaṇaü
taṃ bhāu ṇievi sa-ṇeurĕṇa  $  dhāhāviu hari-anteurĕṇa
"hā ṇāha āu saĩ dāsarahi  $  kiṃ sīhāsaṇahŏ ṇa oẏarahi
hā ṇāhatthāṇu samāgaẏahã   $  sammāṇu karahi ṇaravara-saẏahã
hā ṇāha pasaṇṇa-cittu havahi  $  ṇiẏa-piẏaü ruantiu saṃthavahi"
etthantarĕ tiṇṇi vi āiẏaü  $  suppaha-sumitti-avarāiẏaü
"hā lakkhaṇa putta" bhaṇantiẏaü  $  appaü karaẏalĕhĩ haṇantiẏaü
tiha āu khaṇaddheṃ sattuhaṇu  $  ṇivaḍiu hari-calaṇahĩ vimaṇa-maṇu
ghattā:
"hā hā bhāẏari ṇiẏa-māẏariu  $  dhīrahi soẏāuṇṇiẏaü
    paĩ viṇu dhuvu jāẏaü ajju mahu  $  disaü asesaü suṇṇiẏaü"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 11:
to hari-māẏari sumitti ruaï  $  guṇa sumarĕvi garua dhāha muaï
" hā putta putta kahĩ gaẏaü tuhũ  $  hā thiu vicchāẏaü kāĩ muhu
hā maĩ atthāṇĕ ṇiacchiẏaü  $  evahĩ jĕ cavantaü acchiẏaü
hā kāĩ jāu ĕu acchariu  $  jeṃ mahu ṇillakkhaṇa ṇāmu kiu
hā putta putta sīẏāhavahŏ  $  kiṃ maṇĕ ṇivviṇṇaü rāhavahŏ
ekkellaü chaḍḍĕvi jeṇa gaü  $  hā putta ajuttaü eu taü"
etthantarĕ suṇĕvi mahāusĕhĩ  $  asahantĕhĩ duhu lavaṇaṅkusĕhĩ
pariẏāṇĕvi jīviu dehu calu  $  jaẏakārĕvi rāmahŏ paẏa-jualu
ghattā:
gampiṇu jiṇaharu jahĩ amiẏasaru  $  ṇivasaï muṇi bhava-bhaẏa-haraṇu
    kaïvaẏa-kumāra-ṇaravarĕhĩ sahũ  $  vīhi mi laïẏaü tava-caraṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 12:
lacchīhara-maraṇaü ekkattahĩ  $  lavaṇaṅkusa-viou aṇṇettahĩ
ekkeṇa ji khaṇeṇa mucchijjaï  $  vihĩ duhehĩ puṇu kiṃ pucchijjaï
bhāi ṇiĕvi pariẏaḍḍhiẏa-malaharu  $  puṇu vi puṇu vi dhāhāvaï halaharu
"hā lakkhaṇa lakkhaṇa-lakkhaṅkiẏa  $  pekkhu kema mahu sua dikkhaṅkiẏa
paĩ viṇu ko mahu sahũ gamu sandhaï  $  ko sīhoẏaru samarĕ ṇivandhaï
paĩ viṇu ko mahu pesaṇu sāraï  $  vajjaẏaṇṇu ṇaravaru sāhāraï
paĩ viṇu vālikhillu ko dhāraï  $  ko taṃ ruddabhutti viṇivāraï
paĩ viṇu ko bhañjaï dharaṇīdharu  $  dharaï aṇantavīru ko duddharu
ghattā:
sattiu aridamaṇa-ṇarāhivahŏ  $  pañca paḍicchĕvi saĩ samarĕ
  paĩ viṇu lakkhaṇa khemañjalihĕ  $  kahŏ laggaï jiẏapaüma karĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 13:
hā lakkhaṇa paĩ viṇu guṇaharāhã  $  uvasaggu haraï ko muṇivarāhã
paĩ viṇu a-kileseṃ bhuvaṇĕ kāsu  $  karĕ laggaï asivaru sūrahāsu
paĩ viṇu ko helaĕ garua-dhīru  $  viṇivāẏaï samvukumāru vīru
paĩ viṇu saṃdarisiẏa-vahu-viẏāru  $  ko pariẏāṇaï candaṇahi-cāru
paĩ viṇu ko jīviu haraï tāhã  $  tīhi mi tisiraẏa-khara-dūsaṇāhã
paĩ viṇu ko dhīraï pamaẏa-satthu  $  ko koḍi-siluddharaṇahũ samatthu
paĩ viṇu laṅkā-ṇaẏarihĕ samīvĕ  $  ko jiṇaï haṃsarahu haṃsa-dīvĕ
paĩ viṇu ko indaï dharaï bhāi  $  ko rāvaṇa-sattiĕ samuhu thāi
paĩ viṇu kahŏ āvaï kiẏa-visalla  $  divasaẏarĕ aṇuṭṭhantaĕ visalla
paĩ viṇu uppajjaï kahŏ rahaṅgu  $  ko darisaï vahurūviṇihĕ bhaṅgu
paĩ viṇu kiẏantu ko rāvaṇāsu  $  ko siẏa-dāẏāru vihīsaṇāsu
ghattā:
paĩ viṇu maṇiṭṭha mahu bhāiṇara  $  ko melāvaï piẏa-ghariṇi
      pālesaï ṇiru ṇiruvaddaviẏa  $  ko ti-khaṇḍa-maṇḍiẏa dharaṇi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 14:
hā tavahŏ vigaẏa mahu putta ve vi  $  lacchīhara gampiṇu āu levi
hā muĕ maccharu lahu pāliela  $  vaṭṭaï aṇagāra-muṇinda-vela
hā kiṃ mahu uvari paṇaṭṭhu ṇehu  $  hā jaṇu saṃthavahi ruvantu ehu
iha cakkeṃ jeṃ haü vaïri-cakku  $  so visahahi keva kiẏanta-cakku
hā kāĩ karami saṃcarami ketthu  $  ṇa vi taṃ paesu suhu lahami jetthu
ṇiḍḍahaï jema bhāẏara-viou  $  tiha ṇa vi visu visamu ṇa pisuṇu lou
ṇa vi gimha-ẏālĕ khara-diṇaẏaro vi  $  ṇa vi pajjāliu vaïsāṇaro vi
hā ujjhāuri-pāẏāru khasiu  $  ikkhukka-vaṃsa-maẏaraharu susiu"
ghattā:
puṇu āliṅgaï cumvaï pusaï  $  aṅkĕ thaveppiṇu puṇu ruvaï
    jīviĕṇa vi mukkaü mahumahaṇu  $  rāmu saṇeheṃ ṇa vi muẏaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 15:
lakkhaṇa-guṇa-gaṇa maṇĕ sumaranteṃ  $  dasaraha-jeṭṭha-sueṇa ruvanteṃ
ruṇṇu aüjjhā-jaṇĕṇa aseseṃ  $  avarāiĕ suppahaĕ viseseṃ
ruṇṇu sallasundariĕ visālaĕ  $  ruṇṇu visallaĕ tiha guṇamālaĕ
ruṇṇu raẏaṇacūlaĕ vaṇamālaĕ  $  tiha kallāṇamāla-ṇāmālaĕ
ruṇṇu saccasiri-jaẏasiri-somĕhĩ  $  dahimuha-sua-guṇavaï-jiẏapomĕhĩ
ruṇṇu kamalaloẏaṇa-sasimuhiẏahĩ  $  sasivaddhaṇa-sīhoẏara-duhiẏahĩ
ruṇṇu aṇeẏahĩ vandhava-saẏaṇĕhĩ  $  khaṇĕ khaṇĕ vihihĕ diṇṇa-duvvaẏaṇĕhĩ
ghattā:
jasu soeṃ mukkala mukka-sara  $  saĩ jaẏa-siri lacchi vi ruvaï
    tahĕ ujjhāurihĕ kamāgaĕhĩ  $  ko vi ṇa garua dhāha muaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 16:
to dasa-disu pasariẏa eha vatta  $  sahasā vijjāharavarahã patta
saẏala vi sa-kalatta sa-putta āẏa  $  suggīva-vihīsaṇa-sīhaṇāẏa
sasivaddhaṇa-tāra-taraṅga-jaṇaẏa  $  sa-virāhiẏa gavaẏa-gavakkha-kaṇaẏa
kolāhala-inda-mahinda-kunda  $  dahimuha-suseṇa-jamvava-samudda
sasikara-ṇala-ṇīla-pasaṇṇakitti  $  maẏa-saṅkha-rambha-divasaẏara-jotti
saẏala vi aṃsua-jala-bhariẏa-ṇaẏaṇa  $  tuhiṇāhaẏa-kamala-vivaṇṇa-vaẏaṇa
valaevahŏ calaṇĕhĩ paḍiẏa kẽva  $  taïlokka-guruhĕ givvāṇa jẽva
ghattā:
avaloiu puṇu asahantaĕhĩ  $  cakkāhiu sampattu khaü
    vigaẏa-ppahu dara-oṇalla-siru  $  ṇaṃ kiu keṇa vi leppamaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 17:
taṃ ṇiĕvi sumittā-taṇaü tehĩ  $  dhāhāviu vara-vijjāharehĩ
"hā hā kālaho ṇihāṇa-pāla  $  aï-dūrīhūaü sāmisāla
hā hā kahĕ pesaṇu kiṃ pi ṇāha  $  hā ajju jāẏa amhaĩ aṇāha
hā hā jaṇa-maṇa-jaṇiẏāṇurāẏa  $  kahĕ ko pesesaï vahu-pasāẏa
hā hā sāmiẏa jaẏa-siri-ṇivāsa  $  paĩ viṇu ṇa vi rāhava-jīviẏāsa
hā hā sāmiẏa savvovaẏāri  $  hā hā maẏaraharāvatta-dhāri
hā sāmiẏa tuha daẏa-riṇu imeṇa  $  parisujjhaï ṇa vi ekkeṃ bhaveṇa
teṃ kajjeṃ kiṃ ĕu juttu tujjhu  $  jeṃ muĕvi jāhi ṇa kahantu gujjhu"
ghattā:
teṃ kaluṇārāveṃ ṇaravarahã  $  dasa-disi kaṇṇaü suravara vi
    vaṇasaïu ṇaïu maha-jalahi giri  $  rovāviẏa vara visahara vi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 87, Kaḍavaka 18:
appaü santhaviu vihīsaṇeṇa  $  puṇu pabhaṇiu rāhavacandu teṇa
"parisesahi deva mahantu sou  $  kāsu ṇa bhuvaṇantarĕ huu viou
ṇa vi ekkahŏ eẏahŏ antakaraṇu  $  savvahŏ vi jaṇahŏ jara-jamma-maraṇu
jīvahŏ bhava-gahaṇĕ ṇa kā vi bhanti  $  cañcalaĩ sarīraĩ honti janti
uppatti jeva tiha dhuvu viṇāsu  $  kiṃ rovahi kāraṇĕ lakkhaṇāsu
kaïu vi amhehĩ tumhehĩ eva  $  pahu gamaṇu karevaü eṇa jeva
jaï jīva-rāsi āvaï ṇa jāi  $  to meiṇi-maṇḍalĕ ketthu māi
jaï maraṇu ṇāhĩ bho rāmaẏanda  $  to kahĩ gaẏa kulaẏara jiṇavarinda
kahĩ bharaha-pamuha cakkavaï pavara  $  kahĩ rudda-kaṇha-valaeva avara
ghattā:
ĕu jāṇĕvi saẏalāgama-kusala  $  vaẏaṇu mahāraü maṇĕ dharahi
      jhāẏahi sa ẏa mbhu taïlokka-guru  $  duhu du-kalattu va pariharahi
iẏa pomacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvarie
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  hari-maraṇaṃ ṇāma pavvam iṇaṃ
vandaïāsiẏa-kaïrāẏa-  $  taṇaẏa-tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-ṇimmavie
pomacariẏassa sese  $  sattāsīmo imo saggo
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu ṇavaraṃ  $  ekko kaïrāẏa-cakkiṇuppaṇṇo
paümacariẏassa cūlāmaṇi vva  $  sesaṃ kaẏaṃ jeṇa
----------  [88. aṭṭhāsīmo saṃdhi]  ----------
tahĩ avasarĕ sirasā paṇavantĕhĩ  $  valu viṇṇaviu saẏala-sāmantĕhĩ
"paramesara uvasoha samārahŏ  $  lacchīhara-kumāru saṃkārahŏ"
dhruvakaṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 1:
pabhaṇaï sīrāuhu iẏa vaẏaṇĕhĩ  $  "ḍajjhahŏ tumhĕhĩ sahũ ṇiẏa-saẏaṇĕhĩ
ḍajjhaü māẏa-vappu tumhāraü  $  hou cirāusu bhāi mahāraü
uṭṭhi jāhũ lakkhaṇa lahu tettahĕ  $  khala-vaẏaṇaĩ suvvanti ṇa jettahĕ
ẽva cavĕvi cumvĕvi ālāvĕvi  $  vāsueu ṇiẏa-khandhĕ caḍāvĕvi
gaü valaeu aṇṇu thāṇantaru  $  païṭhu turantu pavara-majjaṇaharu
"bhāi viujjhahi kettiu sovahi  $  ṇhāṇa-vela parilhasiẏa ṇa joẏahi"
puṇu pīḍhovari thavĕvi ṇavamhĕhĩ  $  ahisiñcaï vara-kañcaṇa-kumbhĕhĩ
puṇu bhūsaï maṇi-raẏaṇāharaṇĕhĩ  $  sasahara-tavaṇa-teẏa-avaharaṇĕhĩ
puṇu vollaï samāṇu sūẏārahŏ  $  "bhoẏaṇa-vihi lahu karahŏ kumārahŏ
teṇa vi vitthāriu hari-pariẏalu  $  dei piṇḍa muhĕ maṇĕ mohiu valu
ṇa vi ahilasaï ṇa pekkhaï lakkhaṇu  $  jiṇa-vaẏaṇu va a-bhavvu a-viẏakkhaṇu
ghattā:
tahŏ āẏaĩ avaraĩ vi karantahŏ  $  ṇiẏa-khandheṃ hari-maḍaü vahantahŏ
      bhāi-vioẏa-jāẏa-aï-khāmahŏ  $  addhu varisu volīṇaü rāmahŏ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 2:
to tāva eu vaïẏaru suṇevi  $  lacchīhara-maraṇaü maṇĕ muṇevi
khara-dūsaṇa-rāvaṇa sambharevi  $  samvukka-vaïru ṇiẏa-maṇĕ dharevi
pariẏāṇĕvi rahuvaï soẏa-gahiu  $  ṇīsesa-seṇa-vāvāra-rahiu
sāmarisa-khaẏara-ṇaravara-ṇiutta  $  āiẏa vahu indaï-sunda-putta
ṇahĕ vajjamāli-raẏaṇakkha-pamuha-  $  valaïẏa-kiẏanta-dhaṇu-bhīma-pamuha
"maru chindahũ ajju kumāra-sīsu  $  vahu-kālahŏ saṃbhāiu havīsu
jaṃ laïu khaggu ciru sūrahāsu  $  jaṃ samvukumārahŏ kiu viṇāsu
jaṃ khara-dūsaṇa-tisaraẏahã maraṇu  $  kiu akkhaẏa-rāvaṇa-pāṇa-haraṇu
ghattā:
jaṃ vahu-ṭhāĕhĩ amhahã aṇudiṇu  $  diṇṇu aṇantaru vaïru mahā-riṇu
    taṃ saẏalu vi melĕvi ṇiẏa-vuddhiĕ  $  pheḍahũ ajju savvu sahũ viddhiĕ"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 3:
to suṇĕvi āẏa rivu rāhaveṇa  $  āẏāmiu vajjāvattu teṇa
rahĕ caḍĕvi thaviu ucchaṅgĕ bhāi  $  joiẏa paḍivakkha jameṇa ṇāĩ
etthantarĕ je māhinda patta  $  sura jāẏa jaḍāi-kiẏantavatta
te takkhaṇĕ āsaṇa-kampa hovi  $  avahiĕ pariẏāṇĕvi āẏa ve vi
guṇa sumarĕvi sāmihĕ bhatti-vanta  $  sampāiẏa ujjhāuri turanta
viuruvviu suravara-valu aṇantu  $  "maru valahŏ valahŏ ḍhukkahŏ" bhaṇantu
taṃ pekkhĕvi hari-vala-rivu paṇaṭṭha  $  laṅghanti disaü ṇaṃ hariṇa taṭṭha
vollaï raẏaṇakkhu sa-vajjamāli  $  "duhu ko va ṇa pāvaï kiẏa-duvāli
amhahĩ saẏala vi galiẏāhimāṇa  $  ṇillajja duṭṭha dujjaṇa aẏāṇa
kiha laṅka gampi suha-daṃsaṇāsu  $  pekkhesahũ vaẏaṇu vihīsaṇāsu"
ghattā:
ema bhaṇĕvi indiẏa-dubbheẏahŏ  $  gampiṇu pāsĕ muṇihĕ raïveẏahŏ
      bhava-viratta ṇara-ṇiẏarālaṅkiẏa  $  te sundindaï-suẏa dikkhaṅkiẏa

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 4:
to rivu-bhaĕ vigaẏaĕ saẏalĕ guṇa-raẏaṇa-sāẏareṇaṃ  $  seṇāṇiẏa-surĕṇa rāma-vohaṇa-kiẏāẏareṇaṃ
ṇimmiu siñcijjamāṇu salileṇa sukka-rukkho  $  sampattĕ vasanta-māsĕ virahi vva suṭṭhu sukkho
olaggiu ku-pahu ṇāĩ ṇipphalu adiṇṇa-chāo  $  kiviṇu va saĩ patta-phulla-paricattu samala-kāo
vasaha-kalevara-juammi halu thavĕvi ṇa-kiẏa-khevo  $  vāhaï pakkhiraï vīu silavaṭṭĕ vīẏa-devo
rovaï pāhāṇe kamala-uppala-ṇihāu pavaro  $  pavirolaï manthaṇīĕ pāṇiu kiẏanta-amaro
puṇu pīlaï vāluāĕ ghāṇaü jaḍāi-ṇāmo  $  attha-viruddhāĩ tāĩ avaraï mi ṇiĕvi rāmo
pabhaṇaï "bho bho aẏāṇa tuhũ mūḍha ṇiẏa-maṇeṇaṃ  $  kiṃ salilahŏ karahi hāṇi jara-rukkha-siñcaṇeṇaṃ
māẏāsahi piẏara maḍaẏa-juale ẏa vīẏa-sīre  $  ṇa vi loṇiu hoi parimanthie vi ṇīre (?)
vālua-paripīlaṇeṇa tellovaladdhi katto  $  icchiẏa-phalu kiṃ vi ṇatthi āẏāsu para mahanto"
ghattā:
to vuccaï kiẏanta-givvāṇeṃ  $  "tuhu mi eu parivajjiu pāṇeṃ
      vahahi sarīru jeṇa avisiṭṭhaü  $  kahĕ phalu kāĩ etthu paĩ diṭṭhaü"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 5:
taṃ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu ṇīsāmeṃ  $  hari avaruṇḍĕvi vuccaï rāmeṃ
"kiṃ siri-ṇilaü kumāru dugucchahi  $  jaï ṇa muṇahi to seraü acchahi
kettiu cavahi aṇiṭṭhu amaṅgalu  $  dosu paḍhukkaï taü para kevalu"
jampaï jāva vaẏaṇu iu halaharu  $  tāva laeviṇu suhaḍa-kalevaru
āu jaḍāi vahantaü khandheṃ  $  vuttu valeṇa bhāi-soandheṃ
ṇeha-vaseṇa vivajjiẏa-rajjeṃ  $  "ĕhu ṇara-dehu vahahi kiṃ kajjeṃ"
teṇa caviu "maĩ kira kiṃ pucchahi  $  appāṇaü kira kāĩ ṇa pecchahi
jiha haũ tema tuhu mi maṇĕ mūḍhaü  $  acchahi khandhĕ kalevara-vūḍhaü
paĩ pekkheppiṇu mahu aṇurūvaü  $  maṇĕ pariaḍḍhiu ṇehu garūaü
ghattā:
bho bho maĩ-pamuhahũ ciru jāẏahũ  $  tuhũ rāṇaü savvahu mi pisāẏahũ
      āu dui vi maha-moha-bbhantā  $  hiṇḍahũ gahilaü lou karantā"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 6:
iẏa vaẏaṇĕhĩ hali-vala-paüma-ṇāmu  $  aïlajjiu siḍhiliẏa-mohu rāmu
sahasā huu viẏasiẏa-kamala-ṇaẏaṇu  $  paricintahũ laggu jiṇinda-vaẏaṇu
jaṃ dukkiẏa-kammaĩ khaẏahŏ ṇei  $  jaṃ avicala-sāsaẏa-suhaĩ dei
"haũ ṇeha-vasaṅgaü pekkhu keva  $  jāṇanto vi acchami mukkhu jema
dhaṇṇaü tihuaṇĕ aṇaraṇṇa-rāu  $  jo chindĕvi mohu muṇindu jāu
dhaṇṇaü dasarahu ciru jāsu jhatti  $  kañcui pekkheppiṇu hua viratti
dhaṇṇaü bharahu vi jeṃ cattu rajju  $  voddahĕṇa vi kiu paraloẏa-kajju
dhaṇṇaü seṇāṇi kiẏantavattu  $  jeṃ muṇĕvi aṇāgaẏa (?) laïu tattu
dhaṇṇī sīẏa vihaẏa-kugaï-pantha  $  ṇa vi diṭṭha jāĕ ehī avattha
dhaṇṇaü haṇuvantu vi jo garūvĕ  $  ṇa vi ṇivaḍiu iẏa-mohandha-kūvĕ
dhaṇṇā lavaṇaṅkusa hari-suā vi  $  je dikkhālaṅkiẏa ṇava-juvā vi
ghattā:
haũ ghaĩ puṇu pāeṇa gaeṇa vi  $  aṇṇu vi lacchīharĕṇa maeṇa vi
      karami kāiṃ vi appa-hiẏattaṇu  $  kahŏ ṇiẏa-kajjĕ ṇa hoi vaḍhattaṇu"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 7:
puṇu puṇu rahukula-gaẏaṇaẏala-candu  $  paricintaï hiẏavaĕ rāmacandu
"labbhanti kalattaĩ maṇaharāĩ  $  chattaĩ labbhanti sa-cāmarāĩ
labbhaï vahu-vandhava-saẏaṇa-satthu  $  labbhaï aṇāẏa-parimāṇu atthu
labbhanti hatthi raha turaẏa pavara  $  aï-dullahu vohi-ṇihāṇu ṇavara"
pariẏāṇĕvi valu paḍibuddhu eva  $  ṇiẏa-riddhi ve vi darisanti deva
suravahu-saṅgīu suandha-pavaṇu  $  jampāṇa-vimāṇĕhĩ chaṇṇu gaẏaṇu
"ahŏ rahuvaï kiṃ gaẏa-diṇa-suheṇa"  $  teṇa vi pavuttu viẏasiẏa-muheṇa
"ciru puṇṇa-vihūṇahŏ majjhu etthu  $  maṇĕ mūḍhahŏ ṇivisu vi sokkhu ketthu
iẏa maṇuẏa-jammĕ para kusalu tāhã  $  jiṇa-sāsaṇĕ avicala bhatti jāhã
ghattā:
aṇṇu vi ṇisuṇahŏ kahami viseseṃ  $  tāhã kusalu te mukka kileseṃ
      catta-pariggaha vaẏahĩ alaṅkiẏa  $  je jiṇa-pāẏa-mūlĕ dikkhaṅkiẏa"

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 8:
puṇar avi eva vuttu kākuttheṃ  $  "ke tumhe akkhahŏ paramattheṃ
keṃ kajjeṃ iẏa riddhi pagāsiẏa  $  rivu-sāhaṇahŏ paẏatti viṇāsiẏa"
sarahasu ekku pajampiu suravaru  $  "kiṃ sāmiẏa vīsariẏaü ṇahaẏaru
tujjhu païṭṭhahŏ ciru daṇḍaẏa-vaṇĕ  $  jo allīṇu mahārisi-daṃsaṇĕ
tuha ghariṇiĕ jo lāliu tāliu  $  ṇiẏaẏa-sarīrubbhavu jiha pāliu
sīẏāharaṇĕ samuḍḍĕvi gaẏaṇahŏ  $  jo abbhiḍiu āsi dahavaẏaṇahŏ
jāsu marantahŏ suha-vaḍḍhāriẏa  $  paĩ ṇavakāra pañca uccāriẏa
tujjhu pasāeṃ riddhi-pasaṇṇaü  $  suru māhenda-saggĕ uppaṇṇaü
ghattā:
jo accanta āsi uvaẏāriu  $  bhava-sāẏarĕ paḍantu uddhāriu
    haũ so deu jaḍāi mahāiu  $  paḍiuvaẏāru karevaĕ āiu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 9:
to tāva kiẏanta-deu cavaï  $  "kiṃ maĩ vīsariu ṇarāhivaï
jo seṇāvaï taü hontu ciru  $  lallakka-mahāraṇa-saĕhĩ thiru
jo pesiu paĩ sahũ bhāẏarahŏ  $  sattuhaṇahŏ samarĕ kiẏāẏarahŏ
jeṃ veḍhĕvi mahura palamba-bhuu  $  haü lavaṇa-mahaṇṇaü mahuhĕ suu
jasu kevali-pāsĕ ṇirantaraĩ  $  āẏaṇṇĕvi tumha-bhavantaraĩ
pariẏāṇĕvi caü-gaï-bhavaṇa-ḍaru  $  sahasā vaïrāu jāu pavaru
jo paĩ pabhaṇiu "avasaru muṇĕvi  $  vohijjahi maĩ āẏaru kuṇĕvi"
so haũ kiẏa-ghora-tavaccaraṇu  $  māhindĕ jāu suru divva-taṇu
avahiĕ pariẏāṇĕvi hari-maraṇu  $  aṇṇu vi uddhāiu vaïri-gaṇu
iha āẏaü akkhahi kiṃ karami  $  taü savva-paẏāreṃ uvagarami"
teṃ vaẏaṇu suṇeppiṇu cavaï valu  $  "haũ vohiu bhaggu arāi-valu
appaü darisiu riddhīĕ sahũ  $  ṇa pahuccaï eṇa jĕ kāĩ mahu"
iẏa vaẏaṇĕhĩ te parituṭṭha maṇĕ  $  gaẏa saggahŏ suravara ve vi khaṇĕ
ghattā:
puṇu pariharĕvi sou saṅkheveṃ  $  aṭṭhamu vāsueu valaeveṃ
      ṇiẏa-khandhahŏ mahiẏalĕ oẏāriu  $  saraū-sarihĕ tīrĕ saṃkāriu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 10:
taṃ ḍahĕvi sahattheṃ mahumahaṇu  $  puṇu pabhaṇiu rāmeṃ sattuhaṇu
"laï vaccha sahoẏara rajju karĕ  $  rahu-kula-siri-ṇava-vahu dharahi karĕ
haũ saẏalu pariggahu pariharĕvi  $  tavu lemi tavovaṇu païsarĕvi"
taṃ suṇĕvi cavaï mahurāhivaï  $  "jā tumhahã gaï sā mahu vi gaï"

tahŏ sirĕ viṇivaddhu paṭṭu pavaru  $  sahasatti samappiu rajja-bharu
gampiṇu viṇihaẏa-caügaï-ṇisihĕ  $  suvvaẏahŏ pāsĕ cāraṇa-risihĕ
parisesĕvi mohu guṇabbhaïu  $  uppaṇṇa-vohi valu pavvaïu
ghattā:
to givvāṇĕhĩ dunduhi tāḍiẏa  $  kusuma-viṭṭhi gaẏaṇa-ẏalahŏ pāḍiẏa
    surahi-gandha-māruu khaṇĕ ā(?)iu  $  tūra-mahāraü jagĕ jĕ ṇa māiu

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 11:
mellĕvi rāẏa-lacchi viẏasiẏa-muhu  $  ṇiẏa-santāṇĕ ṭhavĕvi ṇiẏa-taṇuruhu
sattuhaṇu vi sa-bhiccu risi jāẏaü  $  vajjajaṅghu ṇiẏa-bhajja-sahāẏaü
laṅkahĕ ṇiẏa-paĕ thavĕvi su-bhūsaṇu  $  sahũ tiẏaḍaĕ pavvaïu vihīsaṇu

jamvaü raẏaṇakesi mahusāẏaru   $  aṅgaü aṅgu suvelu guṇāẏaru
jaṇaü kaṇaü sasikiraṇu jaẏandharu  $  kundu pasaṇṇakitti velandharu
iẏa avara vi jiṇa-guṇa sumarantā  $  solaha sahasa pahuhũ ṇikkhantā

hari-vala-māẏari-suppaha-pamuhahũ  $  suggaï-gamaṇa-pariṭṭhiẏa-samuhahũ

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 12:
so rāma-mahārisi vigaẏa-ṇehu  $  chaṇadiṇa-sasahara-kara-dhavala-dehu

vihaḍiẏa-diḍha-dukkiẏa-kamma-pāsu  $  aïkanta-pavara-chaṭṭhovavāsu
viharantu pattu dhaṇa-kaṇaẏa-pavaru  $  sandaṇathali-ṇāmu païṭṭhu ṇaẏaru
tahĩ pārāviu ṇāmiẏa-sireṇa  $  bhattiĕ paḍiṇandi-ṇaresareṇa

tahŏ sura-dunduhi sāhukkāraü  $  gandha-vāu vasu-varisu apāraü

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 88, Kaḍavaka 13:

uvari caḍevi palamviẏa-vāhaü  $  ṇaṃ taruvaru giri-siharĕ sa-sāhaü

rāmāẏaṇassa sese  $  aṭṭhāsīmo imo saggo

tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-dhavalo  $  jiṇa-titthe vahaü kavva-bharaṃ
to avahiĕ jāṇĕvi tetthu  $  rāhaü muṇi thiẏaü
accuẏa-saggahŏ sīendu  $  takkhaṇĕ āiẏaü
dhruvakam

START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 1:
ṇiẏaẏa-bhavantarāĩ sumareppiṇu  $  jiṇa-dhammahŏ vi pahāu muṇeppiṇu
cintaï takkhaṇĕ accua-suravaï  $  "ĕhu so maĩ maṇĕ jāṇiu rahuvaï
jo maṇuattaṇĕ kantu mahāraü  $  jasu cakkavaï bhāi lahuāraü
so gaü ṇaraẏahŏ ṇeheṃ chaïẏaü  $  ehu vi tahŏ vioĕ pavvaïẏaü
khavaẏa-seḍhi ārūḍhahŏ āẏahŏ  $  tiha karemi iha jhāṇa-sahāẏahŏ
jiha maṇu ṭalaï ṇa hoi pahāṇaü  $  dhavalujjala-vara-kevala-ṇāṇaü
jiha vaïmāṇiu jāẏaï suravaru  $  mittu maṇiṭṭhu majjhu maṇi-gaṇa-dharu
puṇu teṃ sahũ bhamevi ahiṇandĕvi  $  savvaĩ jiṇa-bhavaṇaĩ jagĕ vandĕvi
pañca vi mandara ṇavĕvi surohaĕ  $  jāmi dīvu ṇandīsaru sohaĕ
puttu sumittahĕ ṇaraẏahŏ hontaü  $  āṇĕvi laddha-vohi-sammattaü
puṇu taïlokka-cakka-jasa-bhāmeṃ  $  jampami suha-dukkhaĩ sahũ rāmeṃ"
ghattā:
cintantu ema so deu  $  āu ṇahantarĕṇa
      taṃ koḍi-silā-ẏalu pattu  $  ṇivisabbhantarĕṇa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 2:
puṇu caü-pāsiu tahĩ viṇu kheveṃ  $  kaü ujjāṇu saẏampaha-deveṃ
jaṃ ṇavalla-pallava-sohillaü  $  jaṃ allalla-phulla-riddhillaü
jaṃ vahu-komala-kompala-phala-dalu  $  jaṃ kala-koila-kula-kiẏa-kalaẏalu
jaṃ sīẏala-malaẏāṇila-cāliu  $  jaṃ cala-mahuliha-valaẏa-vamāliu
jaṃ sāhāra-ṇiẏara-mañjariẏaü  $  jaṃ kusuma-raẏa-puñja-piñjariẏaü
jaṃ suẏa-saẏaĩ(?) su-kiṃsua-bhariẏaü  $  jaṃ vahuviha-vihaṅga-saṃcariẏaü
jaṃ dasa-disi-vaha-pasariẏa-parimalu  $  taru-pabbhārandhāriẏa-mahiẏalu
jaṃ surapura-ujjāṇa-samāṇaü  $  mandara-ṇandaṇa-vaṇa-aṇumāṇaü
ghattā:
tahĩ viẏaṇĕ mahāvaṇĕ rammĕ  $  mantharu ṇāĩ gaü
    suru jāṇaï-rūvu dharevi  $  rāmahŏ pāsu gaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 3:
puṇu ṇiẏaḍantarĕ līlaĕ jāĕvi  $  ẽva pavollaï aggaĕ thāĕvi
"viraha-vasaṅgaïẏaĕ sumarantiĕ  $  sagga-paesu asesu bhamantiĕ
ṇiẏa-puṇṇĕhĩ garuehĩ maṇiṭṭhaü  $  vahu-kālahŏ kema vi tuhũ diṭṭhaü
ṇivisu vi sahĕvi ṇa sakkami rāhava  $  de sāiu ṇivvūḍha-mahāhava
piẏa-mahurālāvĕhĩ sammāṇahi  $  kiṃ taveṇa mahu jovvaṇu māṇahi
ṇiccalu pāhāṇu va kiṃ acchahi  $  savaḍammuhu sa-viāru ṇiẏacchahi
laïu pisāeṃ jema alajjiu  $  kālu ma khevahi vattha-vivajjiu
ghattā:
so loẏāhāṇaü ehu  $  saccaü paĩ kiẏaü
    sundaru ṇandantaü jema  $  jo ṇiẏa-ṇiggaẏaü
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 4:
haũ sā sīẏa tuhũ jĕ so rahuvaï  $  eha jĕ pihimi te ji iẏa ṇaravaï
sā ji aüjjhā-ṇaẏari pasiddhī  $  dhaṇa-kaṇa-jaṇa-maṇi-raẏaṇa-samiddhī
rāulu taṃ jĕ te ji haẏa-gaẏa-vara  $  puppha-vimāṇu taṃ jĕ te rahavara
ĕu maĩ-pamuhu savvu anteuru  $  avaïṇṇaü maẏaraddhaẏa ṇaṃ puru
bhuñjahi kāma-bhoẏa hiẏaïcchiẏa  $  chaḍḍahi lacchīhara-dukkhu cciẏa
aṇṇu vi paüma honti aï-dūsaha  $  caü kasāẏa vāvīsa parīsaha
pañca vi indiẏa satta mahabbhaẏa  $  ko visahaï puṇu aṭṭha mahā-maẏa
jiṇa-tavacaraṇu jāi kahŏ cheẏahŏ  $  bhajjevaü kāleṇa vi eẏahŏ
ghattā:
to vari evahĩ jĕ ṇa laggu  $  hāsaü diṇĕhĩ para
    sañjama-bhaṇḍaṇĕ païsevi  $  bhagga aṇeẏa ṇara
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 5:
mahu kāraṇĕ paĩ āsi caḍantaĩ  $  cāvaĩ sāẏara-vajjāvattaĩ
mahu kāraṇĕ sāhasagaï māriu  $  kikkindhesaru ṇiru uvaẏāriu
mahu kāraṇĕ mārui paṭṭhaviẏaü  $  teṃ vajjāuhu raṇĕ ṇiṭṭhaviẏaü
mahu kāraṇĕ koḍi-siluccāiẏa  $  aṇṇu vi āsālī viṇivāiẏa
mahu kāraṇĕ bhaggaü ṇandaṇa-vaṇu  $  ghāiu akkha-kumāru sa-sāhaṇu
mahu kāraṇĕ raẏaṇāẏaru laṅghiu  $  jiu haṃsarahu seu āsaṅghiu
paripesiu aṅgaü mahu kāraṇĕ  $  māriẏa hattha-pahattha mahāraṇĕ
indaï vandhĕvi raṇĕ levāviu  $  ṇārāẏaṇu sattiĕ bhindāviu
ghattā:
mahu kāraṇĕ laṅkā-ṇāhu  $  viṇivāiu samarĕ
teṃ maĩ sahũ rāhavacanda  $  avicalu rajju karĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 6:
taü pekkhantahŏ uvavaṇu gaïẏa  $  jaïẏahũ sahasā haũ pavvaïẏa
taïẏahũ viharantī guṇa-bhariẏā  $  vijjāhara-kaṇṇĕhĩ avaẏariẏā
puṇu tehĩ pavolliu "daẏa karahi  $  darisāvahi amhahũ dāsarahi
jeṃ so bhattāru turiu varahũ  $  paĩ-pamuhaü gampi kīla karahũ"
to etthantarĕ suravaï-kiẏaü  $  ṇāṇālaṅkāra-vihūsiẏaü
dasa-saẏa-saṅkhaü vara-bhāmiṇiu   $  pattaü sa-vilāsaü kāmiṇiu
aṇṇaü maṇaharu gāẏantiẏaü  $  aṇṇaü vīṇaü vāẏantiẏaü
aṇṇaü caüdisĕhĩ ṇaḍantiẏaü  $  sa-kaḍakkha diṭṭhi paẏaḍantiẏaü
kuṅkuma-caccikka karantiẏaü  $  aṇṇaü thaṇaharu darisantiẏaü
ghattā:
to vianti(?mbhi)u ṇimmala-jhāṇu  $  haẏa-parisaha-vaïri
      thiu ṇiccalu rāmu muṇindu  $  ṇāvaï meru-giri
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 7:
jaṃ kema vi duriẏa-khaẏaṅkarāsu  $  maṇu ṭaliu ṇa rāhava-muṇivarāsu
taṃ māha-māsĕ siẏa-pakkhĕ pavarĕ  $  vārasi-diṇĕ ṇisihĕ caüttha-paharĕ
caü-ghāi-kamma-jiṇiẏāvasāṇu  $  uppaṇṇu samujjalu parama-ṇāṇu
khaṇĕ kevala-cakkhuhĕ jāu saẏalu  $  gopaẏa-samu loẏāloẏa-jualu
sahasā caü-deva-ṇikāu āu  $  aï-garua-vihūiĕ amara-rāu
kiẏa bhattiĕ vandaṇa jā 'ṇavajja  $  vara kevala-ṇāṇuppatti-pujja
to tāva saẏampaha-ṇāmu evi  $  sīendu kevalaccaṇa karevi
ṇaviuttamaṅgu so bhaṇaï eva  $  "maĩ tumhahĕ aṇṇāṇeṇa deva
ghattā:
"jo aviṇaẏa-vanteṃ suṭṭhu  $  guru avarāha kiẏa
    te saẏala khamejjahi sigghu  $  tihuaṇa-jaṇa-ṇamiẏa"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 8:
appāṇaü garahĕvi saẏa-vāraü  $  kaha vi khamāvĕvi rāmu bhaḍāraü
puṇu puṇu vandaṇa-hatti kareppiṇu  $  somittihĕ guṇa-gaṇa sumareppiṇu
paḍivohaṇahĩ paẏaṭṭu saẏampahu  $  laṅghĕvi paḍhama-ṇaraü raẏaṇappahu
puṇu aïkamĕvi puḍhavi-sakkarapahu  $  sampāiu khaṇeṇa vāluppahu
tetthu ko vi kaṇu jiha kaṇḍijjaï  $  kŏ vi puṇu rukkhu jeva khaṇḍijjaï
kŏ vi sarasucchu jema pīlijjaï  $  tilu tilu karavattĕhĩ kappijjaï
kŏ vi vali jiha dasa-disu ghallijjaï  $  kŏ vi maẏagala-dantĕhĩ pellijjaï
kŏ vi piṭṭijjaï vajjhaï muccaï  $  kŏ vi loṭṭijjaï rujjhaï luñcaï
kŏ vi puṇu ḍajjhaï rajjhaï sijjhaï  $  kŏ vi ṇaru chijjaï chajjaï vijjhaï
kŏ vi mārijjaï khajjaï pijjaï  $  kŏ vi cūrijjaï puṇu mūrijjaï
kŏ vi paülijjaï ko vi vali dijjaï  $  ko vi dalijjaï ko vi malijjaï
ko vi kaṇaï kandaï dhāhāvaï  $  ko vi puvva-riu ṇiĕvi padhāvaï
ghattā:
tahĩ samvukkeṃ hammantu  $  ghorāruṇa-ṇaẏaṇu
      gaẏa-pāṇi-savanta-sarīru  $  dīsaï dahavaẏaṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 9:
puṇu samvukumārahŏ samaü teṇa  $  vollijjaï jhatti surāhiveṇa
"re re khala-bhāvaṇa asura pāva  $  āḍhattu kāĩ ĕu duṭṭha-bhāva
ajja vi durāsa uvasamu ṇa hoi  $  duhu pattaü aṇṇu ji ṇāĩ koi
kūrattaṇu muĕ karĕ vimala-cittu"  $  taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi ṇaṃ amieṇa sittu
uvasama-bhāvahŏ samvukku ḍhukku  $  puṇu puṇu vi pavohaï sīẏa-sakku
to ṇavari vimāṇovari ṇievi  $  lakkhaṇa-rāvaṇa pucchanti ve vi
"ko tuhũ keṃ kajjeṃ etthu āu"  $  vihaseppiṇu akkhaï amara-rāu
"haũ sā ciru hontī jaṇaẏa-dhīẏa  $  jā rāvaṇa paĩ avaharĕvi ṇīẏa
jā mattĕ sāra rāmā-ẏaṇāsu  $  jā jama-diṭṭhi va ṇisiẏara-jaṇāsu
tava-caraṇa-pahāveṃ jāẏa indu  $  aṇṇu vi dikkhaṅkiu rāmacandu
tahŏ koḍi-silāẏalĕ ṇāṇu jāu  $  haũ puṇu tumhahã vohaṇahã āu
ghattā:
mahu kāraṇĕ vihi mi jaṇehĩ  $  jāĩ mahantāĩ
      bhava-sāẏarĕ koha-vaseṇa  $  dukkhaĩ pattāĩ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 10:
kohu mūlu savvahũ vi aṇatthahũ  $  kohu mūlu saṃsārāvatthahũ
kohu viṇāsa-karaṇu daẏa-dhammahŏ  $  kohu jĕ mūlu ghora-dukkammahŏ
kohu jĕ mūlu jaga-ttaẏa-maraṇahŏ  $  kohu jĕ mūlu ṇaraẏa-païsaraṇahŏ
kohu jĕ vaïriu savvahŏ jīvahŏ  $  teṃ kajjeṃ ahŏ hari-dahagīvahŏ
kohu visajjahŏ visama-sahāvahŏ  $  avaropparu mittattaṇu bhāvahŏ"
taṇ ṇisuṇĕvi iẏa vaẏaṇāṇantarĕ  $  tiṇṇi vi te uvasamiẏa khaṇantarĕ
"kiṃ daẏa-dhammĕ ṇa kiẏa dihi taïẏahũ  $  āsi laddhu maṇuattaṇu jaïẏahũ
hā hā kāĩ pāu kiu vaḍḍaü  $  jeṃ sampāiẏa duhu evaḍḍaü
ghattā:
tuhũ para dhaṇṇaü jiẏa-loẏaĕ  $  jeṃ chaṇḍiẏa ku-maï
     jiṇa-vaẏaṇāmaẏa-paripīẏaü  $  jāu surāhivaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 11:
to parivaḍḍhiẏa maṇĕ kāruṇṇeṃ  $  vāsaveṇa duvvaṅkura-vaṇṇeṃ
sadda-paramparāĕ mambhīsiẏa  $  "ehu ehu" ālāva pabhāsiẏa
"laï vaṭṭaï etthahŏ uddhārami  $  duggaï-duttara-taḍiṇihĕ tārami
viṇṇi vi jaṇa sahasā solahamaü  $  saggu parāṇami accua-ṇāmaü"
ẽva bhaṇevi lei kira jāvahĩ  $  loṇiu jema vilĕvi gaẏa tāvahĩ
jalaṇeṃ tuppu jema tiha tāviẏa  $  aï-dugejjha dappaṇa-chāẏa va thiẏa
savvovāẏahĩ bhaggāṇandeṃ  $  kema vi levi ṇa sakkiẏa indeṃ
aha jahĩ jeṇa jeva pāvevaü  $  suhu va duhu va tihuaṇĕ bhuñjevaü
taṃ samatthu ko viṇivārevaĕ  $  kāsu satti parirakkha karevaĕ
puṇu vahu-dukkhāṇala-santattā  $  ve vi cavanti eva vevantā
ghattā:
"uvaesu daẏāvara kiṃ pi  $  kahĕ givvāṇa-vaï
      jeṃ puṇu vi ṇa pāvahũ eha  $  bhīsaṇa ṇaraẏa-gaï"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 12:
teṇa vi pavuttu "jaï karahŏ vaẏaṇu  $  to lehu turiu sammatta-raẏaṇu
jaṃ paramuttamu tihuaṇĕ pasiddhu  $  aï-dullahu puṇṇa-pavittu suddhu
jaṃ kamma-mahaṇu kallāṇa-tattu  $  duṇṇeu abhavvahã bhava-bhaẏantu
jaṃ kahiu parama-titthaṅkarehĩ  $  paripujjiu sura-ṇara-visaharehĩ
jaṃ sundaru kāleṃ vohi dei  $  sāsaẏa-siva-thāṇu pahāṇu ṇei"
iẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ dūrujjhiẏa-bhaehĩ  $  sammattu vihi mi paḍivaṇṇu tehĩ
gaü sīẏā-hari vi sa-saṅku tetthu  $  valaeu sa-kevala-ṇāṇu jetthu
samasaraṇabbhantarĕ païsarevi  $  bhattiĕ puṇu puṇu vandaṇa karevi
ghattā:
vollaṇahũ laggu "mahu hohi  $  paramesara-saraṇu
    tiha karĕ parichindami(?)  $  jema jarā-maraṇu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 89, Kaḍavaka 13:
tuhũ para ekku viẏaḍḍhu viẏaḍḍhahũ  $  sūrahũ sūru guṇaḍḍhu guṇaḍḍhahũ
ṇāṇa-mesavāhaṇĕṇa bhaẏāvaṇu  $  jeṇa daḍḍhu bhava-caügaï-kāṇaṇu
uttama-lesa-tisūleṃ duddharu  $  jeṃ kiu moha-vaïri saẏa-sakkaru
diḍha-mahanta-vaïraggahŏ pāsiu  $  jeṇa ṇeha-ṇāmu vi ṇiṇṇāsiu
aṇṇu vi eu kāĩ taü juttaü  $  siva-paü ekkeṃ jaï vi viḍhattaü
to vi kiṃ maĩ muĕvi jāijjaï  $  āvami jema haü mi taha kijjaï"
pabhaṇaï muṇivarindu "suṇĕ sundara  $  dūrĕ pamāẏahi rāu purandara
jiṇĕhĩ pagāsiu mokkhu vi-rāẏahŏ  $  kamma-vandhu diḍhu hoi sa-rāẏahŏ"
ghattā:
iẏa-vaẏaṇĕhĩ vimala-maṇeṇa  $  añjali-uḍa-juĕhĩ
    sīendeṃ rāma-muṇindu  $  ṇamiu sa ẏa mbhu ĕhĩ
iẏa-pomacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvarie
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  vala-ṇāṇuppatti-pavvam iṇaṃ
iẏa ettha mahākavve  $  vandaïāsiẏa-saẏambhu-taṇaẏa-kae
rāmāẏaṇassa sese  $  eso saggo ṇavīsamo
----------  [90. ṇavaïmo saṃdhi]  ----------
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-dhavalassa  $  ko guṇe vaṇṇiuṃ jae taraï
vāleṇa vi jeṇa saẏambhu-kavva-bhāro samuvvūḍho
puṇar avi suravaï āhāsaï  $  "jo tava-sañjama-ṇiẏama-juu
paramesara kahĕ saṅkhevĕṇa  $  dasaraha-rāṇaü ketthu huu
dhruvakaṃ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 1:
aṇṇu vi paĩ lakkhiẏa suddha-maï  $  kahĕ lavaṇaṅkusaha mi kavaṇa gaï
kā jaṇaẏahŏ kaṇaẏahŏ kekkaẏahĕ  $  kā avarāiẏahĕ su-suppahahĕ
kā lakkhaṇa-māẏahĕ kekkaẏahĕ  $  kā bhāmaṇḍalahŏ cāru-maïhĕ"
akkhaï kevali sura-ṇamiẏa-paü  $  "dasarahu terahamaü saggu gaü
paramāu vīsa sāẏaraĩ jahĩ  $  jaṇaü vi kaṇaü vi uppaṇṇu tahĩ
parimāṇu jetthu āhuṭṭha kara  $  avara vi aṇeẏa tahĩ jāẏa ṇara
avarāiẏa-kekkaẏa-suppahaü  $  kaïkaï-sahiẏaü parisaha-sahaü
aṇṇaü vi ghora-tava-tattiẏaü  $  savvaü devattaṇu pattiẏaü
ghattā:
je puvva-jammĕ taü ṇandaṇa  $  viṇṇi vi tihuaṇĕkka-vijaï
    lavaṇaṅkusa-ṇāmālaṅkiẏa  $  tahũ hosaï pañcamiẏa gaï
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 2:
ṇandaṇa-vaṇa-bhūsiẏa-kandarahŏ  $  dāhiṇa-disāĕ giri-mandarahŏ
kuru-bhūmihĕ bhāmaṇḍalu vi huu  $  palla-ttaẏa-āu-pamāṇa-juu
pucchiu suravaïṇa "keṇa phalĕṇa"  $  "āẏaṇṇahi" taṃ pi vuttu valĕṇa
ujjhahĕ ciru kulavaï pavara-bhuu  $  maẏariĕ maṇiṭṭha-mehaliẏa-juu
vajjaẏa-ṇāmaṅkiu tahu taṇaü  $  ṇiẏa-dhaṇa-sampattiĕ jiẏa-dhaṇaü
ṇivvāsiẏa sīẏa muṇevi khaṇĕ  $  so cintāviẏaü sa-sou maṇĕ
"sā divvĕhĩ guṇĕhĩ alaṅkariẏa  $  somāla-deha aï-sundariẏa
vara-rūveṃ siri-devaẏahĕ ṇiha  $  kā 'vattha pekkhu vaṇĕ patta kiha
ghattā:
vaïrāu taṃ jĕ teṃ bhāvĕvi  $  putta-kalattaĩ pariharĕvi
    dui-muṇihĕ pāsĕ tavu laïẏaü  $  muṇi-suvvaẏa-jiṇu maṇĕ dharĕvi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 3:
tāsu asoẏa-tilaẏa dui ṇandaṇa  $  jaṇaṇa-ṇeha-kiẏa-guru-akkandaṇa
sahũ kantĕhĩ vaïrāeṃ laïẏā  $  tĕ vi dui-muṇihĕ pāsĕ pavvaïẏā
vahu-divasahĩ taü ghoru karantā  $  paramāgama-juttiĕ viharantā
tamvacūḍa-puravaru gaẏa attiĕ  $  tiṇṇi vi gaẏa jiṇa-vandaṇa-hattiĕ
tāva 'ggaĕ vāluẏa-raẏaṇāẏaru  $  dīsaï ṇaraü va duggama-duttaru
tavaṇa-tatta-vālua-ṇivahālaü  $  maṇu sappurisahŏ ṇāĩ visālaü
so kaha kaha vi dukkhu āsaṅghiu  $  siddhĕhĩ bhava-saṃsāru va laṅghiu
ghattā:
te tiṇṇi vi jaṇa muṇi-puṅgava  $  ṇiṇṇāsiẏa-duṭṭhaṭṭha-maẏa
    vajjaẏa-asoẏa-tilaesara  $  joẏaṇāĩ pañcāsa gaẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 4:
to ghaṇa-ghaṇa-ghororāli dintu  $  suradhaṇu-paīha-ṇaṅgūlavantu
aï-dhavala-valāẏā-panti-dāḍhu  $  jaladhārā-dhoraṇi-kesarāḍhu
osāriẏa-sūrāẏava-kuraṅgu  $  ṇiddāriẏa-gimbha-mahā-maẏaṅgu
harivara-varahiṇa-rava-ruñjamāṇu  $  phullanta-ṇīma-ṇaharĕhĩ samāṇu
jala-pūriẏa-taḍiṇi-pavāha-calaṇu  $  vāvī-talāẏa-sara-ṇiẏara-savaṇu
pacalanta-mahaddaha-runda-vaẏaṇu  $  duttāra-khaḍḍa-vicchiḍḍa-ṇaẏaṇu
cala-vijju-lalāviẏa-dīha-jīhu  $  sampāiu vāsāratta-sīhu
ghattā:
taṃ pekkhĕvi ṇiru āsaṇṇaü  $  viẏaṇĕ mahā-vaṇĕ bhaẏa-rahiẏa
   vaḍa-pāẏava-mūlĕ su-vitthaĕ  $  tiṇṇi vi jogu laevi thiẏa
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 5:
tahĩ avasarĕ sirimāliṇi-kanteṃ  $  ujjhāuri gaẏaṇaṅgaṇĕ janteṃ
jaṇaẏahŏ ṇandaṇeṇa vikkhāeṃ  $  pekkhĕvi cintiu viṇaẏa-sahāeṃ
ĕu mahantu accariu maṇohara  $  kahĩ vāluẏa-samuddu kahĩ muṇivara
kahĩ bhava-pahu kahĩ siddha-bhaḍārā   $  kahĩ a-ṇiuṇu kahĩ guṇa-garuārā
kahĩ desiu kahĩ vara-ṇihi-raẏaṇaĩ  $  kahĩ dujjaṇu kahĩ sundara-vaẏaṇaĩ
kahĩ duggandha-raṇṇu kahĩ mahuẏara  $  kahĩ maha-ṇaraẏa-bhūmi kahĩ suravara
dūrabhavvu kahĩ kahĩ su-pahāṇaĩ  $  tava-caritta-vaẏa-daṃsaṇa-ṇāṇaĩ
aha jāṇiẏa-kaṅkālāsaṇṇā  $  mahu puṇṇodaeṇa sampaṇṇā"
ghattā:
ĕu bhāmaṇḍalĕṇa viẏappĕvi  $  accāsaṇṇaü paẏa-paüru
    vara-vijjā-valĕṇa sa-desaü  $  kiu māẏāmaü parama-puru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 6:
ṇimmiẏāĩ viulaĩ a-pamāṇaĩ  $  thāmĕ thāmĕ maṇahara-ujjāṇaĩ
thāmĕ thāmĕ dhaṇa-kaṇa-jua-ṇaẏaraĩ  $  goṭṭhaĩ gohaṇa-gorasa-paüraĩ
thāmĕ thāmĕ jiṇahara-devaülaĩ  $  ḍimbhaĩ ṇāĩ mahacchuha-vahulaĩ
thāmĕ thāmĕ vahu-gāma purovama  $  thāmĕ thāmĕ ārāma maṇorama
thāmĕ thāmĕ pokkharaṇiu saravara  $  vāvī-kūva-talāẏa laẏāhara
thāmĕ thāmĕ ṇimmala ṇiru ṇīraĩ  $  mahiẏa-sasāha-sisira-ghiẏa-khīraĩ
thāmĕ thāmĕ sāliu phala-sāraü  $  ikkhu-mahārasu aï-guliẏāraü
thāmĕ thāmĕ jaṇa-ṇaẏaṇāṇandaṇu  $  bhaviẏa-lou jiṇavara-kaẏa-vandaṇu
ghattā:
taṃ karĕvi eva ṇivisaddhĕṇa  $  cariẏā-gaẏa khama-dama-darisi
    saddhāi-guṇālaṅkariĕṇa  $  teṃ bhuñjāviẏa parama risi
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 7:
jiha te tiha avara vi vahu-desahĩ  $  duggama-dīva-samudduddesahĩ
bharaha-pamuha-khettĕhĩ giri-vivarĕhĩ  $  kāṇaṇehĩ jiṇa-titthĕhĩ pavarĕhĩ
ṇijjaṇa-ṇippāṇiẏa-dupavesĕhĩ  $  muṇi pārāviẏa visama-pavesĕhĩ
teṇa phaleṇa marevi sa-kantaü  $  uttama-bhoga-bhūmi sampattaü
tahĩ acchaï jaṇa-ṇaẏaṇa-maṇoharu  $  tuha keraü cira-paḍhama-sahoẏaru
daṇḍa-saṭṭhi-saẏa-taṇu-parimāṇaü  $  tiṇṇi-palla-paramāu-samāṇaü
taṇ ṇisuṇevi vaẏaṇu siẏa-indeṃ(?)  $  puṇu vi papucchiu guru-āṇandeṃ
"ṇārāẏaṇu dasa-kandharu dummaï  $  veṇṇi vi jaṇa sampāiẏa duggaï
ghattā:
duriẏahŏ avasāṇĕ viṇiggĕvi  $  kahĕ kiṃ hosaï mahumahaṇu
    ko haü mi bhaḍārā hosami  $  ko hoesaï dahavaẏaṇu"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 8:
taṃ ṇisuṇĕvi kevala-ṇāṇa-dharu  $  pabhaṇaï sīrāuhu muṇi-pavaru
"āẏaṇṇahi puvveṃ suragirihĕ  $  jaga-pāẏaḍa-vijaẏāvaï-purihĕ
sammatta-dhīra-avalamviẏahŏ  $  hosanti suṇanda-kuḍumviẏahŏ
rohiṇihĕ gabbhĕ diḍha-kaḍhiṇa-bhua  $  to aruhadāsa-risidāsa sua
vahu-kāleṃ vaẏa-guṇa-ṇiẏama-dhara  $  hosanti surālaĕ puṇu amara
tetthahŏ cavevi ṇimmala-viulĕ  $  hosanti paḍīvā tahĩ jĕ kulĕ
darisāviẏa caüviha-dāṇa-guṇu  $  hari-khettĕ ve vi hosanti puṇu
tetthahŏ vi pīẏa-jiṇa-dhamma-rasa  $  hosanti saṇaẏa-kumārĕ tiẏasa
ghattā:
sāẏaraĩ satta suhu bhuñjĕvi  $  cavaṇu kareppiṇu surapurihĕ
    hosanti paḍīvā veṇṇi vi  $  tāhĕ jĕ vijaẏāvaï-purihĕ
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 9:
jasa-dhaṇahŏ kumāra-kitti-pahuhĕ  $  gabbhabbhantarĕ lacchī-vahuhĕ
hosanti maṇiṭṭha pahāṇa suẏa  $  jaẏakanta-jaẏappaha-ṇāma-jua
tahĩ dharĕvi ghora-tava-bhāra-dhura  $  sattamaĕ saggĕ hosanti sura
tahĩ kālĕ saẏala-ṇihi-raẏaṇavaï  $  tuhũ bharahĕ havesahi cakkavaï
lantava-saggahŏ cavevi vivuha   $  hosanti ve vi taü aṅgaruha
ṇāmeṃ indarahambhoẏaraha  $  tiẏasahã vi raṇaṅgaṇĕ duvvisaha
raẏaṇatthalĕ ṇaẏarĕ rajju karĕvi  $  pacchaĕ puṇu duddharu taü carĕvi
pāvĕvi samāhi tuhũ vimala-maṇu  $  hoesahi vejaẏantĕ sumaṇu
indarahu vi jo ciru dahavaẏaṇu  $  jeṃ vasikiu ṇīsesu vi bhavaṇu
ghattā:
sŏ maṇuattaṇĕ devattaṇĕhĩ  $  kaïhi mi bhavĕhĩ bhavevi ṇaru
      aṭṭhaviha-kamma-viṇivāraṇu  $  hosaï kāleṃ titthaẏaru
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 10:
ahaminda-mahāsuhu aṇuhavĕvi  $  vara-vaïjaẏanta-saggahŏ cavĕvi
puṇu gaṇaharu hosahi tāsu tuhũ  $  tahĩ kālĕ lahesahi mokkha-suhu
ambhoẏaraho vi jŏ āsi hari  $  ṇāmeṇa ji jasu kampanti ari
so bhamĕvi cāru jammantaraĩ  $  bhāviẏa-jiṇadhamma-ṇirantaraĩ
puvvavidehĕ pukkhara-dīvĕ varĕ  $  hosaï saẏavattajjhaẏa-ṇaẏarĕ
bharahesara-saṇṇihu cakkaharu  $  puṇu hosaï titthahŏ titthaẏaru
ṇāṇa-maruḍḍāviẏa-kamma-raü  $  jāesaï vara-ṇivvāṇa-paü
ghattā:
volīṇĕhĩ sattĕhĩ varisĕhĩ  $  gamaṇu karesami haü mi tahĩ
    bharahesa-pamuha vahu-muṇivara  $  avicala-suhu ṇivasanti jahĩ"
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 11:
suṇĕvi bhavissa-kāla-bhava-vaïẏaru  $  puṇu puṇu paṇavĕvi halaharu muṇivaru
appaü so sīendu paṇindaï  $  garahaï maṇu jiṇa-bhavaṇaĩ vandaï
titthaṅkara-tava-caraṇuddesaĩ  $  kevala-ṇāṇuggamaṇa-paesaĩ
divva-jjhuṇi-ṇivvāṇa-ṇivesaĩ  $  añcĕvi pujjĕvi ṇavĕvi asesaĩ
suṭṭhu visāla tuṅga sakkandara  $  khaṇĕ pariañcĕvi pañca vi mandara
puṇu gampiṇu ṇandīsara-dīvahŏ  $  thui karevi taïlokka-paīvahŏ
kuru-bhūmihĕ ciru bhāi gavesĕvi  $  bhāmaṇḍalu sa-kantu saṃbhāsĕvi
gaü rāhava-guṇa-gaṇa-aṇurāiu  $  sarahasu accua-saggu parāiu
ghattā:
tahĩ suha-bhāvaṇa-saṃjuttaü  $  amara-sahāsĕhĩ pariẏariu
    ṇiẏa-līlaĕ sīẏā-suravaï  $  saĩ accharahĩ ramantu thiu
_______________________________________________________________
START
PAUMACARIU, Kaṇḍa V, Saṃdhi 90, Kaḍavaka 12:
lavaṇaṅkusa vi ve vi vahu-divasĕhĩ  $  ṇāṇuppaṇṇa ṇamiẏa vara-tiẏasĕhĩ
kaẏa-kamma-kkhaẏa ṇāṇā-taruvarĕ  $  gaẏa ṇivvāṇahŏ pāvā-mahiharĕ
vahu-kāleṃ puṇu indaï-muṇivaru  $  ṇiẏa-taṇu teohāmiẏa-diṇaẏaru
deula-vīḍhiāĕ vara-sattaü  $  ṇāṇuppāĕvi ṇivvui pattaü
jiha so tiha aṇanta-suha-thāṇahŏ  $  gaü ghaṇavāhaṇo vi ṇivvāṇahŏ
jasu keraü ajja vi ahiṇandaï  $  lou meharahu titthu pavandaï
kumbhaẏaṇṇu puṇu sāsaẏa-sokkhahŏ  $  so vi vaḍahĕ kheḍḍahĕ gaü mokkhahŏ
ghattā:
gaü rahuvaï kaïhi mi divasĕhĩ  $  tihuaṇa-maṅgalagārāhŏ
     ajarāmara-pura-paripālahŏ  $  pāsu sa ẏa mbhu-bhaḍārāhŏ
iẏa pomacariẏa-sese  $  saẏambhuevassa kaha vi uvvarie
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-raïe  $  rāhava-ṇivvāṇa-pavvam iṇaṃ
vandaïāsiẏa-tihuẏaṇa-  $  saẏambhu-pariviraïẏammi maha-kavve
pomacariẏassa sese  $  saṃpuṇṇo ṇavaïmo saggo
pomacariẏaṃ samattaṃ
praśastigāthāḥ
siri-vijjāhara-kaṇḍe saṃdhīo honti vīsa-parimāṇā  $  ujjhā-kaṇḍammi tahā vāvīsa muṇeha gaṇaṇāe
caüdaha sundara-kaṇḍe ekkāhiẏa-vīsa jujjha-kaṇḍe ẏa  $  uttara-kaṇḍe teraha sandhīo ṇavaï savvāu
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu ṇavaram ekko kaïrāẏa-cakkiṇuppaṇṇo  $  paümacariẏassa cūlāmaṇi vva sesaṃ kaẏaṃ jeṇa
kaïrāẏassa vijaẏa-sesiẏassa vitthārio jaso bhuvaṇe  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhuṇā pomacariẏa-seseṇa ṇisseso
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-dhavalassa ko guṇe vaṇṇiuṃ jae taraï  $  vāleṇa vi jeṇa saẏambhu-kavva-bhāro samuvvūḍho
vāẏaraṇa-daḍha-kkhandho āgama-aṅgo pamāṇa-viẏaḍa-pao  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-dhavalo jiṇa-titthe vahaü kavva-bharaṃ
caümuha-saẏambhuevāṇa vāṇiẏatthaṃ acakkhamāṇeṇa  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-raïẏaṃ pañcamicariẏaṃ mahacchariẏaṃ
savve vi suā pañjara-sua vva paḍhiẏakkharāĩ sikkhanti  $  kaïrāẏassa suo puṇa suẏa vva sui-gabbha-sambhūo
tihuaṇa-saẏambhu jaï ṇa hontu (?) ṇandaṇo siri-saẏambhudevassa  $  kavvaṃ kulaṃ kavittaṃ to pacchā ko samuddharaï
jaï ṇa huu chandacūḍāmaṇissa tihuaṇa-saẏambhu lahu-taṇao  $  to paddhiḍaẏā-kavvaṃ siri-pañcami ko samāreu
savvo vi jaṇo geṇhaï ṇiẏa-tāẏa-viḍhatta-davva-santāṇaṃ  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhuṇā puṇu gahiẏaṃ sukaïtta-santāṇaṃ
tihuaṇa-saẏambhum ekkaṃ mottūṇa saẏambhu-kavva-maẏaraharo  $  ko taraï gantum antaṃ majjhe ṇissesa-sīsāṇaṃ
iẏa cāru pomacariẏaṃ saẏambhueveṇa raïẏaṃ(ẏama?) samattaṃ  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhuṇā taṃ samāṇiẏaṃ parisamattam iṇaṃ
"ceṣṭitam ayanaṃ caritaṃ karaṇaṃ cāritram ity amī yac-chabdāḥ  $  paryāyā rāmāyaṇam ity uktaṃ tena ceṣṭitaṃ rāmasya
vācayati śruṇoti janas tasyāyur vṛddhim īyate puṇyaṃ ca  $  ākṛṣṭa-khaṅga-hasto ripur api na karoti vairam upaśamam eti"
māura-sua-sirikaïrāẏa-taṇaẏa-kaẏa-pomacariẏa-avasesaṃ  $  saṃpuṇṇaṃ saṃpuṇṇaṃ vandaïo lahaï saṃpuṇṇaṃ
goinda-maẏaṇa-suẏaṇanta-viraïẏaṃ vandaï-paḍhama-taṇaẏassa  $  vacchalladāĕ tihuaṇa-saẏambhuṇā raïẏaṃ (?) mahappaẏaṃ
vandaïẏa-ṇāga-siripāla-pahui-bhavvaẏaṇa-gaṇa-samūhassa  $  ārogatta-samiddhī-santi-suhaṃ hou savvassa
satta-mahāsaggaṅgī ti-raẏaṇa-bhūsā su-rāmakaha-kaṇṇā  $  tihuaṇa-saẏambhu-jaṇiẏā pariṇaü vandaïẏa-maṇa-taṇaẏaṃ
