U/3 cāuraṃgijjaṃ tṛtīyam adhyayanam /
cattāri param aṃgāṇi | dullahāṇīha jantuṇo /
māṇusattaṃ suī saddhā | saṃjamaṃmi ya vīriyaṃ 
samāvannāṇa saṃsāre | nāṇāgottāsu jāisu /
kammā nāṇāvihā kau | puḍho vissaṃbhiyā payā 
egayā devaloesu | naraesu vi egayā /
egayā āsuraṃ kāyaṃ | āhākammehiṃ gacchaī 
egayā khattio hoi | tao caṇḍālavokkaso /
tao kīḍapayaṃgo ya | tao kunthupivīliyā 
evam āvaajoṇīsu | pāṇiṇo kammakivvisā /
na nivijjanti saṃsāre | savvaṭhesu va khattiyā 
kammasaṃgehiṃ sammūḍhā | dukkhiyā bahuveyaṇā /
amāṇusāsu joṇīsu | viṇihammanti pāṇiṇo 
kammāṇaṃ tu pahāṇāe | āṇupuvvī kayāi u /
jīvā sohim aṇuppattā | āyayanti maṇussayaṃ 
māṇussaṃ viggahaṃ laddhuṃ | suī dhammassa dullahā /
jaṃ soccā paḍivajjanti | tavaṃ khantim ahiṃsayaṃ 
āhacca savaṇaṃ laddhuṃ | saddhā paramadullahā /
soccā neāuyaṃ maggaṃ | bahave paribhassaī 
suiṃ ca laddhuṃ saddhaṃ ca | vīriyaṃ puṇa dullahaṃ /
bahave royamāṇā vi | no ya -aṃ paḍivajjae 
māṇusattaṃmi āyāo | jo dhammaṃ socca saddahe /
tavassī vīriyaṃ laddhuṃ | saṃvuḍe niddhuṇe rayaṃ 
sohī ujjuyabhūyassa | dhammo suddhassa ciṭhaī /
nivvāṇaṃ paramaṃ jāi | ghayasitti vva pāvae 
vigiṃca kammuṇo heuṃ | jasaṃ saṃciṇu khantie /
sarīraṃ pāḍhavaṃ hiccā | uḍḍhaṃ pakkamaī disaṃ 
visālisehiṃ sīlehiṃ | jakkhā uttarauttarā /
mahāsukkā va dippantā | mannantā apuṇaccavaṃ 
appiyā devakāmāṇaṃ | kāmarūvaviuvviṇo /
uḍḍhaṃ kappesu ciṭhanti | puvvā vāsasayā bahū 
tattha ṭhiccā jahāṭhāṇaṃ | jakkhā āukkhae cuyā /
uventi māṇusaṃ joṇiṃ | se dasaṃge 'bhijāyaī 
khettaṃ vatthuṃ hiraṇṇaṃ ca | pasavo dāsaporusaṃ /
cattāri kāmakhandhāṇi | tattha se uvavajjaī 
mittavaṃ nāyavaṃ hoi | uccāgoe ya vaṇṇavaṃ /
appāyake mahāpanne | abhijāe jasobale 
bhoccā māṇussae bhoe | appaḍirūve ahāuyaṃ /
puvviṃ visuddhasaddhamme | kevalaṃ bohi bujjhiyā 
cauraṃgaṃ dullahaṃ mattā | saṃjamaṃ paḍivajjiyā /
tavasā dhuyakammaṃse | siddhe havai sāsae  tti bemi ||
      || cāuraṃgijjaṃ samattaṃ 
U/4 asaṃkhayaṃ catuturthaṃ adhyayanam /
asaṃkhayaṃ jīviya mā pamāyae | jarovaṇīyassa hu natthi tāṇaṃ /
evaṃ vijāṇāhi jaṇe pamatte | ki- -ū vihiṃsā ajayā gahinti 
je pāvakammehi dhaṇaṃ maṇūsā | samāyayantī amaiṃ gahāya /
pahāya te pāsapayaie nare | verāṇubaddhā narayaṃ uventi 
teṇe jahā sandhimuhe gahīe | sakammuṇā kiccai pāvakārī /
evaṃ payā pecca ihaṃ ca loe | kaḍāṇa kammāṇa na mukkha atthi 
saṃsāram āvanna parassa aṭhā | sāhāraṇaṃ jaṃ ca karei kammaṃ /
kammassa te tassa u veyakāle | na bandhavā bandhavayaṃ uventi 
vitteṇa tāṇaṃ na labhe pamatte | imaṃmi loe aduvā paratthā /
dīvappaṇaṭhe va aṇantamohe | neyāuyaṃ daṭhum adaṭhum eva 
sattesu yāvī paḍibuddhajīvī | na vīsase paṇḍie āsupanne /
ghorā muhuttā abalaṃ sarīraṃ | bhāruṇḍapakkhī va carappamatte 
care payāiṃ parisaṃkamāṇo | jaṃ kiṃci pāsaṃ iha maṇṇamāṇo /
lābhantare jīviya vūhaittā | pacchā parinnāya malāvadhaṃsī 
chandaṃniroheṇa uvei mokkhaṃ | āse jahā sikkhiya vammadhārī /
puvvāiṃ vāsāiṃ carappamatte | tamhā muṇī khippam uvei mokkhaṃ 
sa puvvam evaṃ na labhejja pacchā | esovamā sāsayavāiyāṇaṃ /
visīyaī siḍhile āuyaṃmi | kālovaṇīe sarīrassa bhee 
khippaṃ na sakkei vivegameuṃ | tamhā samuṭhāya pahāya kāme /
samicca loyaṃ samayā mahesī | āyāṇurakkhī caramappamatte 
muhuṃ muhuṃ mohaguṇe jayantaṃ | aṇegarūvā samaṇaṃ carantaṃ /
phāṃsā phusantī asamaṃjasaṃ ca | na tesi bhikkhū maṇasā pausse 
mandā ya phāsā bahulohaṇijjā | tahappagāresu maṇaṃ na kujjā /
rakkhijja kohaṃ viṇaejja māṇaṃ | māyaṃ na seve payahejja lohaṃ 
je 'saṃkhayā tucchā parappavāī | te pijjadosāṇugayā parabbhā /
ee ahamme tti duguṃchamāṇo | kaṃkhe guṇe jāva sarīrabheu  tti bemi ||
        ||asaṃkhyaṃ samattaṃ 
U/5 akāmamaraṇijjaṃ pañcamaṃ adhyayanam /
aṇṇavaṃsi mahoghaṃsi | ege tiṇṇe duruttaraṃ /
tattha ege mahāpanne | imaṃ paṇham udāhare 
santime ya duve ṭhāṇā | akkhāyā māraṇantiyā /
akāmamaraṇaṃ ceva | sakāmamaraṇaṃ tahā 
bālāṇaṃ tu akāmaṃ tu | maraṇaṃ asaiṃ bhave /
paṇḍiyāṇaṃ sakāmaṃ tu | ukkoseṇa saiṃ bhave 
tatthimaṃ paḍhamaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ | mahāvīreṇa desiyaṃ /
kāmagiddhe jahā bāle | bhisaṃ kūrāiṃ kuvvaī 
je giddhe kāmabhogesu | ege kūḍāya gacchaī /
na me diṭhe pare loe | cakkhudiṭhā imā raī 
hatthāgayā ime kāmā | kāliyā je aṇāgayā /
ko jāṇai pare loe | atthi vā natthi vā puṇo 
jaṇeṇa saddhiṃ hokkhāmi | ii bāle pagabbhaī /
kāmabhogāṇurāeṇaṃ | kesaṃ saṃpaḍivajjaī 
tao se daṇḍaṃ samārabhaī | tasesu thāvaresu ya /
aṭhāe ya aṇaṭhāe | bhūyagāmaṃ vihiṃsaī 
hiṃse bāle musāvāī | māille pisuṇe saḍhe /
bhuṃjamāṇe suraṃ maṃsaṃ | seyam eyaṃ ti mannaī 
kāyasā vayasā matte | vitte giddhe ya itthisu /
duhao malaṃ saṃciṇai | siṃsuṇāgu vva maiyaṃ 
tao puṭho āyaṃkeṇaṃ | gilāṇo paritappaī /
pabhīo paralogassa | kammāṇuppehi appaṇo 
suyā me narae ṭhāṇā | asīlāṇaṃ ca jā gaī /
bālāṇaṃ kūrakammāṇaṃ | pagāḍhā jattha veyaṇā 
tatthovavāiyaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ | jahā meyam aṇussuyaṃ /
āhākammehiṃ gacchanto | so pacchā paritappaī 
jahā sāgaḍio jāṇaṃ | samaṃ hiccā mahāpahaṃ /
visamaṃ maggam oiṇṇo | akkhe bhaggaṃmi soyaī 
evaṃ dhammaṃ viukkammaṃ | ahammaṃ paḍivajjiyā /
bāle maccumuhaṃ patte | akkhe bhagge va soyaī 
tao sa maraṇantaṃmi | bāle santasaī bhayā /
akāmamaraṇaṃ maraī | dhutte va kalinā jie 
eyaṃ akāmamaraṇaṃ | bālāṇaṃ tu paveiyaṃ /
etto sakāmamaraṇaṃ | paṇḍiyāṇaṃ suṇeha me 
maraṇaṃ pi sapuṇṇāṇaṃ | jahā meyam aṇussuyaṃ /
vippasaṇṇam aṇāghāyaṃ | saṃjayāṇa vusīmao 
na imaṃ savvesu bhikkhūsu | na imaṃ savvesu 'gārisu /
nāṇāsīlā agāratthā | visamasīlā ya bhikkhuṇo 
santi egehiṃ bhikkhūhiṃ | gāratthā saṃjam uttarā /
gāratthehi ya savvehiṃ | sāhavo saṃjam uttarā 
cīrājiṇaṃ nagiṇiṇaṃ | jaḍī saṃghāḍimuṇḍiṇaṃ /
eyāṇi vi na tāyanti | dussīlaṃ pariyāgayaṃ 
piṇḍola evva dussīle | naragāo na muccaī /
bhikkhāe vā gihatthe vā | suvvae kammaī divaṃ 
agārisāmāiyaṃgāṇi | saḍḍhī kāeṇa phāsae /
posahaṃ duhao pakkhaṃ | egarāyaṃ na hāvae 
evaṃ sikkhāsamāvanne | gihivāse vi suvvae /
muccaī chavipavvāo | gacche jakkhasalogayaṃ 
aha je saṃvuḍe bhikkhū | doṇhaṃ annayare siyā /
savvadukkhapahīṇe vā | deve vāvi mahiḍḍhie 
uttarāiṃ vimohāiṃ | juīmantāṇupuvvaso /
samāiṇṇāiṃ jakkhehiṃ | āvāsāiṃ jasaṃsiṇo 
dīhāuyā iḍḍhimantā | samiddhā kāmarūviṇo /
ahuṇovavannasaṃkāsā | bhujjo accimalippabhā 
tāṇi ṭhāṇāṇi gacchanti | sikkhittā saṃjamaṃ tavaṃ /
bhikkhāge vā gihitthe vā | je santi paḍinivvuḍā 
tesiṃ soccā sapujjāṇaṃ | saṃjayāṇa vusīmao /
na saṃtasanti maraṇante | sīlavantā bahussuyā 
tuliyā visesamādāya | dayādhammassa khantie /
vippasīejja mehāvī | tahābhūeṇa appaṇā 
tao kāle abhippee | saḍḍhī tālisamantie /
viṇaejja lomaharisaṃ | bheyaṃ dehassa kaṃkhae 
aha kālaṃmi saṃpatte | āghāyāya samussayaṃ /
sakāmamaraṇaṃ maraī | tiṇham annayaraṃ muṇī  tti bemi ||
       || akāmamaraṇijjaṃ samattaṃ 
U/6 khuḍḍāganiyaṇṭhijjaṃ ṣaṣṭham adhyayanam /
jāvantavijjāpurisā | savve te dukkhasaṃbhavā /
luppanti bahuso mūḍhā | saṃsāraṃmi aṇantae 
samikkha paṃḍie tamhā | pāsajāī pahe bahū /
appaṇā saccam esejjā | mettiṃ bhūesu kappae 
māyā piyā nhusā bhāyā | bhajjā puttā ya orasā /
nālaṃ te mama tāṇāe | luppantassa sakammuṇā 
eyam aṭhaṃ sapehāe | pāse samiyadaṃsaṇe /
chinda geddhiṃ siṇehaṃ ca | na kaṃkhe puvvasaṃthuyaṃ 
gavāsaṃ maṇikuṃḍalaṃ | pasavo dāsaporusaṃ /
savvam eyaṃ caittāṇaṃ | kāmarūvī bhavissasi 
ajjhatthaṃ savvao savvaṃ | dissa pāṇe piyāyae /
na haṇe pāṇiṇo pāṇe | bhayaverāo uvarae 
āyāṇaṃ narayaṃ dissa | nāyaejja taṇām avi /
doguṃchī appaṇo pāe | dinnaṃ bhuṃjejja bhoyaṇaṃ 
iham ege u mannanti | appaccakkhāya pāvagaṃ /
āyāriyaṃ vidittāṇaṃ | savvadukkhāṇa muccaī 
bhaṇantā akarentā ya | bandhamokkhapaiṇṇiṇo /
vāyāviriyametteṇa | samāsāsenti appayaṃ 
na cittā tāyae bhāsā | kuo vijjāṇusāsaṇaṃ /
visannā pāvakammehiṃ | bālā paṃḍiyamāṇiṇo 
je kei sarīre sattā | vaṇṇe rūve ya savvaso /
maṇasā kāyavakkeṇaṃ | savve te dukkhasanbhavā 
āvannā dīham addhāṇaṃ | saṃsāraṃmi aṇantae /
tamhā savvadisaṃ passaṃ | appamatto parivvae 
bahiyā uḍḍham ādāya | nāvakaṃkhe kayāi vi /
puvvakammakhayaṭhāe | imaṃ dehaṃ samuddhare 
vivicca kammuṇo heuṃ | kālakaṃkhī parivvae /
māyaṃ piṃḍassa pāṇassa | kaḍaṃ laddhūṇa bhakkhae 
sannihiṃ ca na kuvvejjā | levamāyāe saṃjae /
pakkhī pattaṃ samādāya | niravekkho parivvae 
esaṇāsamio lajjū | gāme aṇiyao care /
appamatto pamattehiṃ | piṃḍavāyaṃ gavesae 
      || khuḍḍāganiyaṃṭhijjaṃ samattaṃ 
U/7 elayaṃ saptamam adhyayanam /
jahāesaṃ samuddissa | koi posejja elayaṃ /
oyaṇaṃ javasaṃ dejjā | posejjā vi sayaṃgaṇe 
tao se puṭhe parivūḍhe | jāyamee mahodare /
pīṇie viule dehe | āesaṃ parikaṃkhae 
jāva na ei āese | tāva jīvai so duhī /
aha pattaṃmi āese | sīsaṃ chettūṇa bhujjaī 
jahā se khalu urabbhe | āesāe samīhie /
evaṃ bāle ahammiṭhe | īhaī narayāuyaṃ 
hiṃse bāle musāvāī | addhāṇaṃsi vilovae /
annadattahare teṇe | māī kaṃ nu hare saḍhe 
itthīvisayagiddhe ya | mahāraṃbhapariggahe /
bhuṃjamāṇe suraṃ maṃsaṃ | parivūḍhe paraṃdame 
ayakakkarabhoī ya | tuṃḍille ciyalohie /
āuyaṃ narae kaṃkhe | jahāesaṃ va elae 
āsaṇaṃ sayaṇaṃ jāṇaṃ | vittaṃ kāme ya bhuṃjiyā /
dussāhaḍaṃ dhaṇaṃ hiccā | bahuṃ saṃciṇiyā rayaṃ 
tao kammagurū jantū | paccuppannaparāyaṇe /
aya vva āgayāese | maraṇantaṃmi soyaī 
tao āuparikkhīṇe | cuyā dehā vihiṃsagā /
āsurīyaṃ disaṃ bālā | gacchanti avasā tamaṃ 
jahā kāgaṇie heuṃ | sahassaṃ hārae naro /
apacchaṃ ambagaṃ bhoccā | rāyā rajjaṃ tu hārae 
evaṃ māṇussagā kāmā | devakāmāṇa antie /
sahassaguṇiyā bhujjo | āuṃ kāmā ya divviyā 
aṇegavāsānauyā | jā sā pannavao ṭhiī /
jāṇi jīyanti dummehā | ūṇavāsayāue 
jahā ya tinni vāṇiyā | mūlaṃ ghettūṇa niggayā /
ego 'ttha lahaī lābhaṃ | ego mūleṇa āgao 
ego mūlaṃ pi hārittā | āgao tattha vāṇio /
vavahāre uvamā esā | evaṃ dhamme viyāṇaha 
māṇusattaṃ bhave mūlaṃ | lābho devagaī bhave /
mūlaccheeṇa jīvāṇaṃ | naragatirikkhattaṇaṃ dhuvaṃ 
duhao gaī bālassa | āvaī vahamūliyā /
devattaṃ māṇusattaṃ ca | jaṃ jie lolayāsaḍhe 
tao jie saī hoi | duvihaṃ doggaiṃ gae /
dullahā tassa ummuggā | addhāe suirādavi 
evaṃ jiyaṃ sapehāe | tuliyā bālaṃ ca paṃḍiyaṃ /
mūliyaṃ te pavesanti | māṇusiṃ joṇim enti je 
vemāyāhiṃ sikkhāhiṃ | je narā gihisuvvayā /
uventi māṇusaṃ joṇiṃ | kammasaccā hu pāṇiṇo 
jesiṃ tu viulā sikkhā | mūliyaṃ te aicchithā /
sīlavantā savīsesā | adīṇā janti devayaṃ 
evam addīṇavaṃ bhikkhuṃ | āgāriṃ ca viyāṇiyā /
kaha- -u jiccam elikkhaṃ | jiccamāṇe na saṃvide 
jahā kusagge udagaṃ | samuddeṇa samaṃ miṇe /
evaṃ māṇussagā kāmā | devakāmāṇa antie 
kusaggamettā ime kāmā | sanniruddhaṃmi āue /
kassa heuṃ purākāuṃ | jogakkhemaṃ na saṃvide 
iha kāmāṇiyaṭhassa | attaṭhe avarajjhaī /
soccā neyāuyaṃ maggaṃ | jaṃ bhujjo paribhassaī 
iha kāmaṇiyaṭhassa | attaṭhe nāvarajjhaī /
pūidehaniroheṇaṃ | bhave devi tti me suyaṃ 
iḍḍhī juī jaso vaṇṇo | āuṃ suham aṇuttaraṃ /
bhujjo jattha maṇussesu | tattha se uvavajjaī 
bālassa passa bālattaṃ | ahammaṃ paḍivajjiyā /
ciccā dhammaṃ ahammiṭhe | narae uvavajjaī 
dhīrassa passa dhīrattaṃ | saccadhammāṇuvattiṇo /
ciccā adhammaṃ dhammiṭhe | devesu uvavajjaī 
tuliyāṇa bālabhāvaṃ | abālaṃ ceva paṇḍie /
caiūṇa bālabhāvaṃ | abālaṃ sevaī muṇi  tti bemi ||
      || elayajjhayaṇaṃ samattaṃ 
U/8 kāvilīyaṃ aṣamam adhyayanam /
adhuve asāsayaṃmī | saṃsāraṃmi dukkhapaurāe /
kiṃ nāma hojja taṃ kammayaṃ | jeṇāhaṃ doggaiṃ na gacchejjā 
vijahittu puvvasaṃjoyaṃ | na siṇehaṃ kahiṃci kuvvejjā /
asiṇehasiṇehakarehiṃ | dosapaosehi muccae bhikkhū 
to nāṇadaṃsaṇasamaggo | hiyanissesāya savvajīvāṇaṃ /
tesiṃ vimokkhaṇaṭhāe | bhāsaī muṇivaro vigayamoho 
savvaṃ ganthaṃ kalahaṃ ca | vippajahe tahāvihaṃ bhikkhū /
savvesu kāmajāesu | pāsamāṇo na lippaī tāī 
bhogāmisadosavisanne | hiyanisseyasabuddhivoccatthe /
bāle ya mandie mūḍhe | bajjhaī macchiyā va khelaṃmi 
dupariccayā ime kāmā | no sujahā adhīrapurisehiṃ /
aha santi suvvayā sāhū | je taranti ataraṃ vaṇiyā vā 
samaṇā mu ege vayamāṇā | pāṇavahaṃ miyā ayāṇantā /
mandā nirayaṃ gacchanti | bālā pāviyāhiṃ diṭhīhiṃ 
na hu pāṇavahaṃ aṇujāṇe | muccejja kayāi savvadukkhāṇaṃ /
evāriehiṃ akkhāyaṃ | jehiṃ imo sāhudhammo pannatto 
pāṇe ya nāivāejjā | se samīi tti vuccaī tāī /
tao se pāvayaṃ kammaṃ | nijjāi udagaṃ va thalāo 
jaganissiehiṃ bhūehiṃ | tasanāmehiṃ thāvarehiṃ ca /
no tesim ārabhe daṃḍaṃ | maṇasā vayasā kāyasā ceva 
suddhesaṇāo naccāṇaṃ | tattha ṭhavejja bhikkhū appāṇaṃ /
jāyāe ghāsam esejjā | rasagiddhe na siyā bhikkhāe 
pantāṇi ceva sevejjā | sīyapiṃḍaṃ purāṇakummāsaṃ /
adu vakkasaṃ pulāgaṃ vā | javaṇaṭhāe nisevae maṃghuṃ 
je lakkhaṇaṃ ca suviṇaṃ | aṃgavijjaṃ ca je pauṃjanti /
na hu te samaṇā vuccanti | evaṃ āyariehiṃ akkhāyaṃ 
ihajīviyaṃ aṇiyamettā | pabhaṭhā samāhijoehiṃ /
te kāmabhogarasagiddhā | uvavajjanti āsure kāe 
tatto vi ya uvvaittā | saṃsāraṃ bahuṃ aṇupariyaḍanti /
bahukammalevalittāṇaṃ | bohī hoi sudullahā tesiṃ 
kasiṇaṃ pi jo imaṃ loyaṃ | paḍipuṇṇaṃ dalejja ikkassa /
teṇāvi se na saṃtusse | ii duppūrae ime āyā 
jahā lāhā tahā loho | lāhā loho pavaḍḍhaī /
domāsakayaṃ kajjaṃ | koḍīe vi na niṭhiyaṃ 
no rakkhasīsu gijjhejjā | gaṃḍavacchāsu 'egacittāsu /
jāo purisaṃ palobhittā | khellanti jahā va dāsehiṃ 
nārīsu novagijjhejjā | itthī vippajahe aṇāgāre /
dhammaṃ ca pesalaṃ naccā | tattha ṭhavejja bhikkhū appāṇaṃ 
ii esa dhamme akkhāe | kavileṇaṃ ca visuddhapanneṇaṃ /
tarihinti je u kāhinti | tehiṃ ārāhiyā duve loga  tti bemi ||
      || kāvilīyaṃ samattaṃ 
U/9 namipavvajjā navamam adhyayanam /
caiūṇa devalogāo | uvavanno māṇusaṃmi logaṃmi /
uvasantamohaṇijjo | saraī porāṇiyaṃ jāiṃ 
jāiṃ sarittu bhayavaṃ | sahasaṃbuddho aṇuttare dhamme /
puttaṃ ṭhavettu rajje | abhiṇikkhamaī namī rāyā 
se devalogasarise | anteuravaragao vare bhoe /
bhuṃjittu namī rāyā | budho bhoge pariccayaī 
mihilaṃ sapurajaṇavayaṃ | balam orohaṃ ca pariyaṇaṃ savvaṃ /
ciccā abhinikkhanto | egantam ahiḍḍhio bhayavaṃ 
kolāhalagabhūyaṃ | āsī mihilāe pavvayantaṃmi /
taiyā rāyarisiṃmi | namiṃmi abhiṇikkhamantaṃmi 
abbhuṭhiyaṃ rāyarisiṃ | pavvajjāṭhāṇam uttamaṃ /
sakko māhaṇarūveṇa | imaṃ vayaṇam abbavī 
ki- -u bho ajja mihilā | kolāhalagasaṃkulā /
suvvanti dāruṇā saddā | pāsāesu gihesu ya 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
mihilāe ceie vacche | sīyacchāe maṇorame /
pattapupphaphalovee | bahūṇaṃ bahuguṇe sayā 
vāeṇa hīramāṇaṃmi | ceiyaṃmi maṇorame /
duhiyā asaraṇā attā | ee kandanti bho khagā 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namiṃ rāyarisiṃ | devindo iṇam abbavī 
esa aggī ya vāū ya | eyaṃ ḍajjhai mandiraṃ /
bhayavaṃ anteuraṃ teṇaṃ | kīsa -aṃ nāvapekkhaha 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
suhaṃ vasāmo jīvāmo | jesi mo natthi kiṃcaṇa /
mihilāe ḍajjhamāṇīe | na me ḍajjhai kiṃcaṇa 
cattaputtakalattassa | nivvāvārassa bhikkhuṇo /
piyaṃ na vijjaī kiṃci | appiyaṃ pi na vijjaī 
bahuṃ khu muṇiṇo bhaddaṃ | aṇagārassa bhikkhuṇo /
savvao vippamukkassa | egantam aṇupassao 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namiṃ rāyarisiṃ | devindo iṇam abbavī 
pāgāraṃ kāraittāṇaṃ | gopuraālagāṇi ca /
ussūlagasayagghīo | tao gacchasi khattiyā 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
saddhaṃ nagaraṃ kiccā | tavasaṃvaram aggalaṃ /
khantiṃ niuṇapāgāraṃ | tiguttaṃ duppadhaṃsayaṃ 
dhaṇuṃ parakkamaṃ kiccā | jīvaṃ ca iriyaṃ sayā /
dhiiṃ ca keyaṇaṃ kiccā | sacceṇa palimanthae 
tavanārāyajutteṇa | bhittūṇaṃ kammakaṃcuyaṃ /
muṇī vigayasaṃgāmo | bhavāo parimuccae 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namiṃ rāyarisiṃ | devindo iṇam abbavī 
pāsāe kāraittāṇaṃ | vaddhamāṇagihāṇi ya /
bālaggapoiyāo ya | tao gacchasi khattiyā 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
saṃsayaṃ khalu so kuṇaī | jo maggo kuṇaī gharaṃ /
jattheva gantum icchejjā | tattha kuvvejja sāsayaṃ 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namiṃ rāyarisiṃ | devindo iṇam abbavī 
āmose lomahāre ya | gaṃṭhibhee ya takkare /
nagarassa khemaṃ kāūṇaṃ | tao gacchasi khattiyā 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
asaiṃ tu maṇussehiṃ | micchā daṃḍo pajuṃjaī /
akāriṇo 'ttha bajjhanti | muccaī kārao jaṇo 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namiṃ rāyarisiṃ | devindo iṇam abbavī 
je kei patthivā tujjhaṃ | nānamanti narāhivā /
vase te ṭhāvaittāṇaṃ | tao gacchasi khattiyā 
eyam aṭhaṃ nisāmittā | heūkāraṇacoio /
tao namī rāyarisī | devindaṃ iṇam abbavī 
jo sahassaṃ sahassāṇaṃ | saṃgāme dujjae jiṇe /

U/11 bahussuyapujjam ekādaśaṃ adhyayanam ||

U/12 hariesijjaṃ dvādaśam adhyayanam ||
sovāgakulasaṃbhūo | guṇuttaradharo muṇī /
hariesabalo nāma | āsi bhikkhū jiindio 
iriesaṇabhāsāe | uccārasamiīsu ya /
jao āyāṇanikkheve | saṃjao susamāhio 
maṇagutto vayagutto | kāyagutto jiindio /
bhikkhaṭhā bambhaijjammi | jannavāḍe uvaṭhio 
taṃ pāsiūṇam ejjantaṃ | taveṇa parisosiyaṃ /
pantovahiuvagaraṇaṃ | uvahasanti aṇāriyā 
jāīmayapaḍithaddhā | hiṃsagā ajiindiyā /
abambhacāriṇo bālā | imaṃ vayaṇam abbavī 
kayare āgacchai dittarūve | kāle vigarāle phokkanāse /
omacelae paṃsupisāyabhūe | saṃkaradūsaṃ parivariya kaṇṭhe 
ko re tuvaṃ iya adaṃsaṇijje | kāe va āsāihamāgao si /
omacelayā paṃsupisāyabhūyā | gaccha kkhalāhi kim ihaṃ ṭhio si 
jakkhe tahiṃ tinduyarukkhavāsī | aṇukampao tassa mahāmuṇissa /
pacchāyaittā niyagaṃ sarīraṃ | imāiṃ vayaṇāim udāharitthā 
samaṇo ahaṃ saṃjao bambhayārī | virao dhaṇapayaṇapariggahāo /
parappavittassa u bhikkhakāle | annassa aṭhā ihamāgao mi 
viyarijjai khajjai bhujjaī | annaṃ pabhūyaṃ bhavayāṇam eyaṃ /
jāṇeha me jāyaṇajīviṇu tti | sesāvasesaṃ labhaū tavassī 
uvakkhaḍaṃ bhoyaṇa māhaṇāṇaṃ | attaṭhiyaṃ siddham ihegapakkhaṃ /
na ū vayaṃ erisam annapāṇaṃ | dāhāmu tujjhaṃ kim ihaṃ ṭhiosi 
thalesu bīyāi vavanti kāsagā | taheva ninnesu ya āsasāe /
eyāe saddhāe dalāha majjhaṃ | ārāhae puṇṇam iṇaṃ khu khittaṃ 
khettāṇi amhaṃ viiyāṇi loe | jahiṃ pakiṇṇā viruhanti puṇṇā /
je māhaṇā jāivijjovaveyā | tāiṃ tu khettāi supesalāiṃ 
koho ya māṇo ya vaho ya jesiṃ | mosaṃ adattaṃ ca pariggahaṃ ca /
te māhaṇā jāivijjāvihūṇā | tāiṃ tu khettāi supāvayāiṃ 
tubbhettha bho bhāradharā girāṇaṃ | aṭhaṃ na jāṇeha ahijja vee /
uccāvayāiṃ muṇiṇo caranti | tāiṃ tu khettāi supesalāiṃ 
ajjhāvayāṇaṃ paḍikūlabhāsī | pabhāsase kiṃ tu sagāsi amhaṃ /
avi eyaṃ viṇassau annapāṇaṃ | na ya -aṃ dāhāmu tumaṃ niyaṇṭhā 
samiīhi majjhaṃ susamāhiyassa | guttīhi guttassa jiindiyassa /
jai me na dāhittha ahesaṇijjaṃ | kim ajja jannāṇa lahittha lāhaṃ 
ke ettha khattā uvajoiyā vā | ajjhāvayā vā saha khaṇḍiehiṃ /
eyaṃ daṇḍeṇa phalaeṇa hantā | kaṇṭhammi ghettūṇa khalejja jo -aṃ 
ajjhāvayāṇaṃ vayaṇaṃ suṇettā | uddhāiyā tattha bahū kumārā /
daṇḍehi vittehi kasehi ceva | samāgayā taṃ isi tālayanti 
ranno tahiṃ kosaliyassa dhūyā | bhadda tti nāmeṇa aṇindiyaṃgī /
taṃ pāsiyā saṃjaya hammamāṇaṃ | kuddhe kumāre parinivvavei 
devābhiogeṇa nioieṇaṃ | dinnā mu rannā maṇasā na jhāyā /
narindadevindabhivandieṇaṃ | jeṇam hi vantā isiṇā sa eso 
eso hu so uggatavo mahappā | jitindio saṃjao bambhayārī /
jo me tayā necchai dijjamāṇiṃ | piuṇā sayaṃ kosalieṇa rannā 
mahājaso eso mahāṇubhāgo | ghoravvao ghoraparakkamo ya /
mā eyaṃ hīleha ahīlaṇijjaṃ | mā savve teeṇa bhe niddahejjā 
eyāiṃ tīse vayaṇāi soccā | pattīi bhaddāi suhāsiyāiṃ /
isissa veyāvaḍiyaṭhayāe | jakkhā kumāre viṇivārayanti 
te ghorarūvā ṭhiya antalikkhe | 'surā tahiṃ taṃ jaṇa tālayanti /
te bhinnadehe ruhiraṃ vamante | pāsittu bhaddā iṇam āhu bhujjo 
giriṃ nahehiṃ khaṇaha | ayaṃ dantehiṃ khāyaha /
jāyateyaṃ pāehi haṇaha | je bhikkhuṃ avamannaha 
āsīviso uggatavo mahesī | ghoravvao ghoraparakkamo ya /
agaṇiṃ va pakkhanda payaṃgaseṇā | je bhikkhuyaṃ bhattakāle vaheha 
sīseṇa eyaṃ saraṇaṃ uveha | samāgayā savvajaṇeṇa tubbhe /
jai icchaha jīviyaṃ vā dhaṇaṃ vā | logaṃ pi eso kuvio ḍahejjā 
avaheḍiya piṭhisauttamaṃge | pasāriyā bāhu akammaceṭhe /
nijjheriyacche ruhiraṃ vamante | uddhaṃ muhe niggayajīhanette 
te pāsiyā khaṇḍiyakaṭhabhūe | vimaṇo visaṇṇo aha māhaṇo so /
isiṃ pasāei sabhāriyāo | hīlaṃ ca nindaṃ ca khamāha bhante 
bālehi mūḍhehi ayāṇaehiṃ | jaṃ hīliyā tassa khamāha bhante /
mahappasāyā isiṇo havanti | na hu muṇī kovaparā havanti 
puvviṃ ca iṇhiṃ ca aṇāgayaṃ ca | maṇappadoso na me atthi koi /
jakkhā hu veyāvaḍiyaṃ karenti | tamhā hu ee nihayā kumārā 
atthaṃ ca dhammaṃ ca viyāṇamāṇā | tubbhaṃ na vi kuppaha bhūipannā /
tubbhaṃ tu pāe saraṇaṃ uvemo | samāgayā savvajaṇeṇa amhe 
accemu te mahābhāga | na te kiṃci na accimo /
bhuṃjāhi sālimaṃ kūraṃ | nāṇāvaṃjaṇasaṃjuyaṃ 
imaṃ ca me atthi pabhūyam annaṃ | taṃ bhuṃjasū amha aṇuggahaṭhā /
bāḍhaṃ ti paḍicchai bhattapāṇaṃ | māsassa ū pāraṇae mahappā 
tahiyaṃ gandhodayapupphavāsaṃ | divvā tahiṃ vasuhārā ya vuṭhā /
pahayāo dunduhīo surehiṃ | āgāse aho dāṇaṃ ca ghuṭhaṃ 
sakkhaṃ khu dīsai tavoviseso | na dīsaī jāivisesa koī /
sovāgaputtaṃ hariesasāhuṃ | jasserisā iḍḍhi mahāṇubhāgā 
kiṃ māhaṇā joisamārabhantā | udaeṇa sohiṃ bahiyā vimaggaha /
jaṃ maggahā bāhiriyaṃ visohiṃ | na taṃ suiṭhaṃ kusalā vayanti 
kusaṃ ca jūvaṃ taṇakaṭham aggiṃ | sāyaṃ ca pāyaṃ udagaṃ phusantā /
pāṇāi bhūyāi viheḍayantā | bhujjo vi mandā pagareha pāvaṃ 
kahaṃ ca re bhikkhu vayaṃ jayāmo | pāvāi kammāi puṇollayāmo /
akkhāhi -e saṃjaya jakkhapūiyā | kahaṃ sujaṭhaṃ kusalā vayanti 
chajjīvakāe asamārabhantā | mosaṃ adattaṃ ca asevamāṇā /
pariggahaṃ itthio māṇamāyaṃ | eyaṃ parinnāya caranti dantā 
susaṃvuḍā paṃcahi saṃvarehiṃ | iha jīviyaṃ aṇavakaṃkhamāṇā /
vosaṭhakāi suicattadehā | mahājayaṃ jayai jannasiṭhaṃ 
ke te joī ke va te joiṭhāṇe | kā te suyā kiṃ va te kārisaṃgaṃ /
ehā ya te kayarā santi bhikkhū | kayareṇa homeṇa huṇāsi joiṃ 
tavo joī jīvo joiṭhāṇaṃ | jogā suyā sarīraṃ kārisaṃgaṃ /
kammehā saṃjamajogasantī | homaṃ huṇāmi isiṇaṃ pasatthaṃ 
ke te harae ke ya te santititthe | kahiṃ siṇāo va rayaṃ jahāsi /
āikkha -e saṃjaya jakkhapūiyā | icchāmo nāuṃ bhavao sagāse 
dhamme harae bambhe santititthe | aṇāvile attapasannalese /
jahiṃ siṇāo vimalo visuddho | susīibhūo pajahāmi dosaṃ 
eyaṃ siṇāṇaṃ kusalehi diṭhaṃ | mahāsiṇāṇa isiṇaṃ pasatthaṃ /
jahi siṇāyā vimalā visuddhā | mahārisī uttamaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ patta  tti bemi ||

U/13 cittasambhūijjaṃ trayodaśam adhyayanam /
jāīparāio khalu | kāsi niyāṇaṃ tu hatthiṇapurammi /

saccasoyappagaḍā | kammā mae purā kaḍā /

bhuṃjāhi bhogāi imāi bhikkhū | mama royaī pavvajjā hu dukkhaṃ

dhammassio tassa hiyāṇupehī | citto imaṃ vayaṇam udāharitthā 
savvaṃ vilaviyaṃ gīyaṃ | savvaṃ naaṃ viḍambiyaṃ /
savve ābharaṇā bhārā | savve kāmā duhāvahā 
bālābhirāmesu duhāvahesu | na taṃ suhaṃ kāmaguṇesu rāyaṃ /

tīse ya jāīi u pāviyāe | vucchāmu sovāganivesaṇesu /

iha jīvie rāya asāsayammi | dhaṇiyaṃ tu puṇṇāi akuvvamāṇo /

na tassa dukkhaṃ vibhayanti nāio | na mittavaggā na suyā na baṃdhavā /
ekko sayaṃ paccaṇuhoi dukkhaṃ | kattāram eva aṇujāi kammaṃ 
ceccā dupayaṃ ca cauppayaṃ ca | khettaṃ gihaṃ dhaṇadhannaṃ ca savvaṃ /
sakammabīo avaso payāi | paraṃ bhavaṃ suṃdara pāvagaṃ vā 
taṃ ekkaṃ tucchasarīragaṃ se | ciīgayaṃ dahiya u pāvageṇaṃ /
bhajjā ya puttāvi ya nāyao ya | dāyāram annaṃ aṇusaṃkamanti 
uvaṇijjaī jīviyam appamāyaṃ | vaṇṇaṃ jarā harai narassa rāya /
paṃcālarāyā vayaṇaṃ suṇāhi | mā kāsi kammāi mahālayāiṃ 
ahaṃ pi jāṇāmi jaheha sāhū | jaṃ me tumaṃ sāhasi vakkam eyaṃ /
bhogā ime saṃgakarā havanti | je dujjayā ajjo amhārisehiṃ 
hatthiṇapurammi cittā | daṭhūṇaṃ naravaiṃ mahiḍḍhīyaṃ /
kāmabhogesu giddheṇaṃ | niyāṇam asuhaṃ kaḍaṃ 
tassa me apaḍikantassa | imaṃ eyārisaṃ phalaṃ /
jāṇamāṇo vi jaṃ dhammaṃ | kāmabhogesu mucchio 
nāgo jahā paṃkajalāvasanno | daṭhuṃ thalaṃ nābhisamei tīraṃ /
evaṃ vayaṃ kāmaguṇesu giddhā | na bhikkhuṇo maggam aṇuvvayāmo 
accei kālo taranti rāio | na yāvi bhogā purisāṇa niccā /
uvicca bhogā purisaṃ cayanti | dumaṃ jahā khīṇaphalaṃ va pakkhī 
jai taṃ si bhoge caiuṃ asatto | ajjāi kammāi karehi rāyaṃ /
dhamme ṭhio savvapayāṇukampī | to hohisi devo io viuvvī 
na tujjha bhoge caiūṇa buddhī | giddho si ārambhapariggahesu /
mohaṃ kao ettiu vippalāvu | gacchāmi rāyaṃ āmantio si 
paṃcālarāyā vi ya bambhadatto | sāhussa tassa vayaṇaṃ akāuṃ /
aṇuttare bhuṃjiya kāmabhoge | aṇuttare so narae paviṭho 
citto vi kāmehi virattakāmo | udaggacārittatavo mahesī /
aṇuttaraṃ saṃjama pālaittā | aṇuttaraṃ siddhigaiṃ gao  tti bemi ||

U/14 usuyārijjaṃ caturdaśam adhyayanam /

bhoge bhoccā vamittā ya | lahubhūyavihāriṇo /

ime ya baddhā phandanti | mama hatthajjamāgayā /

caittā viulaṃ rajjaṃ | kāmabhoge ya duccae /
nivvisayā nirāmisā | ninnehā nippariggahā

U/15 sabhikkhū pañcadaśm adhyayanam /
moṇaṃ carissāmi samicca dhammaṃ | sahie ujjukaḍe niyāṇachinne /

jeṇa puṇa jahāi jīviyaṃ | mohaṃ vā kasiṇaṃ niyacchaī /

aṃgaviyāraṃ sarassa vijayaṃ | je vijjāhiṃ na jīvai sa bhikkhū 
mantaṃ mūlaṃ vivihaṃ vejjacintaṃ | vamaṇavireyaṇadhūmaṇettasiṇāṇaṃ /
āure saraṇaṃ tigicchiyaṃ ca | taṃ parinnāya parivvae sa bhikkhū 
khattiyagaṇa ugga rāyaputtā | māhaṇa bhoiya vivihā ya sippiṇo /
no tesiṃ vayai silogapūyaṃ | taṃ parinnāya parivvae sa bhikkhū 
gihiṇo je pavvaieṇa diṭhā | appavaieṇa va saṃthuyā havijjā /

sayaṇāsaṇapāṇabhoyaṇaṃ | vivihaṃ khāimasāimaṃ paresiṃ /

asippajīvī agihe amitte | jiindie savvao vippamukke /

jaṃ vivittam aṇāiṇṇaṃ | rahiyaṃ itthijaṇeṇa ya /

samaṃ ca saṃthavaṃ thīhiṃ | saṃkahaṃ ca abhikkhaṇaṃ /

aṃgapaccaṃgasaṃṭhāṇaṃ | cārullaviyapehiyaṃ /
bambhacerarao thīṇaṃ | cakkhugijjhaṃ vivajjae 
kūiyaṃ ruiyaṃ gīyaṃ | hasiyaṃ thaṇiyakandiyaṃ /
bambhacerarao thīṇaṃ | soyagejjhaṃ vivajjae 
hāsaṃ kiḍḍaṃ raiṃ dappaṃ | sahasāvittāsiyāṇi ya /

bambhacerarao bhikkhū | niccaso parivajjae 
dhammaladdhaṃ miyaṃ kāle | jattatthaṃ paṇihāṇavaṃ /
nāimattaṃ tu bhuṃjejjā | bambhacerarao sayā 
vibhūsaṃ parivajjejjā | sarīraparimaṇḍaṇaṃ /
bambhacerarao bhikkhū | siṃgāratthaṃ na dhārae 
sadde rūve ya gandhe ya | rase phāse taheva ya /
paṃcavihe kāmaguṇe | niccaso parivajjae 
ālao thījaṇāiṇṇo | thīkahā ya maṇoramā /
saṃthavo ceva nārīṇaṃ | tāsiṃ indiyadarisaṇaṃ 
kūiyaṃ ruiyaṃ gīyaṃ | hāsabhuttāsiyāṇi ya /
paṇīyaṃ bhattapāṇaṃ ca | aimāyaṃ pāṇabhoyaṇaṃ 
gattabhūsaṇam iṭhaṃ ca | kāmabhogā ya dujjayā /
narassattagavesissa | visaṃ tālauḍaṃ jahā

devadāṇavagandhavvā | jakkharakkhasakinnarā /
bambhayāriṃ namaṃsanti | dukkaraṃ je karanti taṃ 
esa dhamme dhuve nicce | sāsae jiṇadesie /

U/18 saṃjaijjaṃ aṣādaśam adhyayanam /
kampille nayare rāyā | udiṇṇabalavāhaṇe /
nāmeṇaṃ saṃjae nāmaṃ | migavvaṃ uvaṇiggae 
hayāṇīe gayāṇīe | rahāṇīe taheva ya /
pāyattāṇīe mahayā | savvao parivārie 
mie chuhittā hayagao | kampillujjāṇa kesare /
bhīe sante mie tattha | vahei rasamucchie 
aha kesarammi ujjāṇe | aṇagāre tavodhaṇe /
sajjhāyajjhāṇasaṃjutte | dhammajjhāṇaṃ jhiyāyai 
apphovamaṇḍavammi | jhāyai kkhaviyāsave /

aha āsagao rāyā | khippam āgamma so tahiṃ /
hae mie u pāsittā | aṇagāraṃ tattha pāsaī 
aha rāyā tattha saṃbhanto | aṇagāro maṇā hao /
mae u mandapuṇṇeṇaṃ | rasagiddheṇa ghannuṇā 
āsaṃ visajjaittāṇaṃ | aṇagārassa so nivo /
viṇaeṇa vandae pāe | bhagavaṃ ettha me khame 
aha moṇeṇa so bhagavaṃ | aṇagāre jhāṇam assie /
rāyāṇaṃ na paḍimantei | tao rāyā bhayadduo 
saṃjao aham ammīti | bhagavaṃ vāharāhi me /
kuddhe teeṇa aṇagāre | ḍahejja narakoḍio 
abhao patthivā tubbhaṃ | abhayadāyā bhavāhi ya /
aṇicce jīvalogammi | kiṃ hiṃsāe pasajjasī 
jayā savvaṃ pariccajja | gantavvam avasassa te /
aṇicce jīvalogammi | kiṃ rajjammi pasajjasī 
jīviyaṃ ceva rūvaṃ ca | vijjusaṃpāyacaṃcalaṃ /

dārāṇi ya suyā ceva | mittā ya taha bandhavā /
jīvantam aṇujīvanti | mayaṃ nāṇuvvayanti ya 
nīharanti mayaṃ puttā | pitaraṃ paramadukkhiyā /
pitaro vi tahā putte | bandhū rāyaṃ tavaṃ care 
tao teṇajjie davve | dāre ya parirakkhie /
kīlanti 'nne narā rāyaṃ | haṭhatuṭhamalaṃkiyā 
teṇāvi jaṃ kayaṃ kammaṃ | suhaṃ vā jai vā duhaṃ /
kammuṇā teṇa saṃjutto | gacchaī u paraṃ bhavaṃ 
soūṇa tassa so dhammaṃ | aṇagārassa antie /
mahayā saṃveganivvedaṃ | samāvanno narāhivo 
saṃjao caiuṃ rajjaṃ | nikkhanto jiṇasāsaṇe /
gaddabhālissa bhagavao | aṇagārassa antie 
ciccā raṭhaṃ pavvaie | khattie paribhāsai /

kiṃ nāme kiṃ gotte | kassa ṭhāe va māhaṇe /
kahaṃ paḍiyarasī buddhe | kahaṃ viṇīe tti vuccasī 
saṃjao nāma nāmeṇaṃ | tahā gotteṇa goyamo /
gaddabhālī mamāyariyā | vijjācaraṇapāragā 
kiriyaṃ akiriyaṃ viṇayaṃ | annāṇaṃ ca mahāmuṇī /
eehiṃ cauhiṃ ṭhāṇehiṃ | meyanne kiṃ pabhāsaī 
ii pāukare buddhe | nāyae parinivvue /
vijjācaraṇasaṃpanne | sacce saccaparakkame 
paḍanti narae ghore | je narā pāvakāriṇo /

māyāvuiyam eyaṃ tu | musābhāsā niratthiyā /

savvee viiyā majjhaṃ | micchādiṭhī aṇāriyā /

aham āsi mahāpāṇe | juimaṃ varisasaovame /
jā sā pālīmahāpālī | divvā varisasaovamā 
se cue bambhalogāo | māṇusaṃ bhavamāgae /

aho uṭhie ahorāyaṃ | ii vijjā tavaṃ care

eyaṃ puṇṇapayaṃ soccā | atthadhammovasohiyaṃ /

ikkhāgarāyavasabho | kunthū nāma narīsaro /

caittā bhārahaṃ vāsaṃ | caittā balavāhaṇaṃ /

hariseṇo maṇussindo | patto gaim aṇuttaraṃ 
annio rāyasahassehiṃ | supariccāī damaṃ care /
jayanāmo jiṇakkhāyaṃ | patto gaim aṇuttaraṃ 
dasaṇṇarajjaṃ mudiyaṃ | caittāṇaṃ muṇī care /

namī namei appāṇaṃ | sakkhaṃ sakkeṇa coio /
caiūṇa gehaṃ vaidehī | sāmaṇṇe pajjuvaṭhio 
karakaṇḍū kaliṃgesu | paṃcālesu ya dummuho /
namī rāyā videhesu | gandhāresu ya naggaī 
ee narindavasabhā | nikkhantā jiṇasāsaṇe /
putte rajje ṭhaveūṇaṃ | sāmaṇṇe pajjuvaṭhiyā 
sovīrarāyavasabho | caittāṇa muṇī care /
udāyaṇo pavvaio | patto gaim aṇuttaraṃ 
taheva kāsīrāyā | seosaccaparakkame /

āyāṇanikkhevaduguṃchaṇāe | na dhīrajāyaṃ aṇujāi maggaṃ 
ciraṃ pi se muṇḍaruī bhavittā | athiravvae tavaniyamehi bhaṭhe /
ciraṃ pi appāṇa kilesaittā | na pārae hoi hu saṃparāe 
polleva muṭhī jaha se asāre | ayantie kūḍakahāvaṇe vā /
rāḍhāmaṇī veruliyappagāse | amahagghae hoi hu jāṇaesu 
kusīlaliṃgaṃ iha dhāraittā | isijjhayaṃ jīviya būhaittā /
asaṃjae saṃjayalappamāṇe | viṇigghāyam āgacchai se ciraṃ pi 
visaṃ tu pīyaṃ jaha kālakūḍaṃ | haṇāi satthaṃ jaha kuggahīyaṃ /
eso vi dhammo visaovavanno | haṇāi veyāla ivāvivanno 
je lakkhaṇaṃ suviṇa pauṃjamāṇe | nimittakoūhalasaṃpagāḍhe /
kuheḍavijjāsavadārajīvī | na gacchaī saraṇaṃ tammi kāle 
tamaṃ tameṇeva u se asīle | sayā duhī vippariyāsuvei /
saṃdhāvaī naragatirikkhajoṇiṃ | moṇaṃ virāhettu asāhurūve 
ūddesiyaṃ kīyagaḍaṃ niyāgaṃ | na muṃcaī kiṃci aṇesaṇijjaṃ /
aggī vivā savvabhakkhī bhavittā | itto cue gacchai kau pāvaṃ 
na taṃ arī kaṇṭhachettā karei | jaṃ se kare appaṇiyā durappayā /
se nāhaī maccumuhaṃ tu patte | pacchāṇutāveṇa dayāvihūṇo 
niraṭhiyā naggaruī u tassa | je uttamaṭhaṃ vivajjāsamei /
ime vi se natthi pare vi loe | duhao vi se jhijjai tattha loe 
emeva hā chandakusīlarūve | maggaṃ virāhettu jiṇuttamāṇaṃ /
kurarī vivā bhogarasāṇugiddhā | niraṭhasoyā pariyāvamei 
soccāṇa mehāvi subhāsiyaṃ imaṃ | aṇusāsaṇaṃ nāṇaguṇovaveyaṃ /
maggaṃ kusīlāṇa jahāya savvaṃ | mahāniyaṇṭhāṇa vae paheṇa 
carittamāyāraguṇannie tao | aṇuttaraṃ saṃjama pāliyāṇa /
nirāsave saṃkhaviyāṇa kammaṃ | uvei ṭhāṇaṃ viuluttamaṃ dhuvaṃ 
evuggadante vi mahātavodhaṇe | mahāmuṇī mahāpainne mahāyase /
mahāniyaṇṭhijjam iṇaṃ mahāsuyaṃ | se kāheī mahayā vitthareṇaṃ 
tuṭho ya seṇio rāyā | iṇam udāhu kayaṃjalī /
aṇāhattaṃ jahābhūyaṃ | suṭhu me uvadaṃsiyaṃ 
tujjhaṃ suladdhaṃ khu maṇussajammaṃ | lābhā suladdhā ya tume mahesī /
tubbhe saṇāhā ya sabandhavā ya | jaṃ bhe ṭhiyā magge jiṇuttamāṇa 
taṃ si nāho aṇāhāṇaṃ | savvabhūyāṇa saṃjayā /
khāmemi te mahābhāga | icchāmi aṇusāsiuṃ 
pucchiūṇa mae tubbhaṃ | jhāṇavigghāo jo kao /
nimantiyā ya bhogehiṃ | taṃ savvaṃ marisehi me 
evaṃ thuṇittāṇa sa rāyasīho | aṇagārasīhaṃ paramāi bhattīe /
saoroho sapariyaṇo sabandhavo | dhammāṇuratto vimaleṇa ceyasā 
ūsasiyaromakūvo | kāūṇa ya payāhiṇaṃ /
abhivandiūṇa sirasā | aiyāo narāhivo 
iyaro vi guṇasamiddho | tiguttigutto tidaṇḍavirao ya /
vihaga iva vippamukko | viharai vasuhaṃ vigayamoho  tti bemi ||
     || mahāniyaṇṭhijjaṃ samattaṃ 
U/21 samuddapālīyam ekaviṃśam adhyayanam /
campāe pālie nāma | sāvae āsi vāṇie /
mahāvīrassa bhagavao | sīse so u mahappaṇo 
nigganthe pāvayaṇe | sāvae se vi kovie /
poeṇa vavaharante | pihuṇḍaṃ nagaram āgae 
pihuṇḍe vavaharantassa | vāṇio dei dhūyaraṃ /
taṃ sasattaṃ paigijjha | sadesam aha patthio 
aha pāliyassa gharaṇī | samuddaṃmi pasavaī /
aha bālae tahiṃ jāe | samuddapāli tti nāmae 
khemeṇa āgae campaṃ | sāvae vāṇie gharaṃ /
saṃvaḍḍhaī tassa ghare | dārae se suhoie 
bāvattarī kalāo ya | sikkhaī nīikovie /
jovvaṇeṇa ya saṃpanne | surūve piyadaṃsaṇe 
tassa rūvavaiṃ bhajjaṃ | piyā āṇei rūviṇiṃ /
pāsāe kīlae ramme | devo dogundao jahā 
aha annayā kayāī | pāsāyāloyaṇe ṭhio /
vajjhamaṇḍaṇasobhāgaṃ | vajjhaṃ pāsai vajjhagaṃ 
taṃ pāsiūṇa saṃvegaṃ | samuddapālo iṇam abbavī /
aho 'subhāṇa kammāṇaṃ | nijjāṇaṃ pāvagaṃ imaṃ 
saṃbuddho so tahiṃ bhagavaṃ | paramasaṃvegam āgao /
āpucchammāpiyaro | pavvae aṇagāriyaṃ 
jahittu 'sagganthamahākilesaṃ | mahantamohaṃ kasiṇaṃ bhayāvahaṃ /
pariyāyadhammaṃ cabhiroyaejjā | vayāṇi sīlāṇi parīsahe ya 
ahiṃsasaccaṃ ca ateṇagaṃ ca | tatto ya bambhaṃ apariggahaṃ ca /
paḍivajjiyā paṃca mahavvayāṇi | carijja dhammaṃ jiṇadesiyaṃ vidū 
savvehiṃ bhūehiṃ dayāṇukampī | khantikkhame saṃjayabambhayārī /
sāvajjajogaṃ parivajjayanto | carijja bhikkhū susamāhiindie 
kāleṇa kālaṃ viharejja raṭhe | balābalaṃ jāṇiya appaṇo ya /
sīho va saddeṇa na saṃtasejjā | vayajoga succā na asaccamāhu 
uvehamāṇo u parivvaejjā | piyam appiyaṃ savva titikkhaejjā /
na savva savvattha 'bhiroyaejjā | na yāvi pūyaṃ garahaṃ ca saṃjae 
aṇegachandām iha māṇavehiṃ | je bhāvao saṃpagarei bhikkhū /
bhayabheravā tattha uinti bhīmā | divvā maṇussā aduvā tiricchā 
parīsahā duvvisahā aṇege | sīyanti jatthā bahukāyarā narā / 
se tattha patte na vahijja bhikkhū | saṃgāmasīse iva nāgarāyā 
sīosiṇā daṃsamasā ya phāsā | āyaṃkā vivihā phusanti dehaṃ /
akukkuo tattha 'hiyāsaejjā | rayāi khevejja pure kayāiṃ 
pahāya rāgaṃ ca taheva dosaṃ | mohaṃ ca bhikkhū satataṃ viyakkhaṇo /
meru vva vāeṇa akampamāṇo | parīsahe āyagutte sahejjā 
aṇunnae nāvaṇae mahesī | na yāvi pūyaṃ garahaṃ ca saṃjae /
sa ujjabhāvaṃ paḍivajja saṃjae | nivvāṇamaggaṃ virae uvei 
arairaisahe pahīṇasaṃthave | virae āyahie pahāṇavaṃ /
paramaṭhapaehiṃ ciṭhaī | chinnasoe amame akiṃcaṇe 
vivittalayaṇāi bhaejja tāī | nirovalevāi asaṃthaḍāiṃ /
isīhi ciṇṇāi mahāyasehiṃ | kāeṇa phāsejja parīsahāiṃ 
sannāṇanāṇovagae mahesī | aṇuttaraṃ cariuṃ dhammasaṃcayaṃ /
aṇuttare nāṇadhare jasaṃsī | obhāsaī sūrie vantalikkhe 
duvihaṃ khaveūṇa ya puṇṇapāvaṃ | niraṃgaṇe savvao vippamukke /
tarittā samuddaṃ va mahābhavoghaṃ | samuddapāle apuṇāgamaṃ gae  tti bemi ||
     || samuddapālīyaṃ samattaṃ 
U/22 rahanemijjaṃ ddhāviṃśam adhyayanam /
soriyapuraṃmi nayare | āsi rāyā mahiḍḍhie /
vasudevu tti nāmeṇaṃ | rāyalakkhaṇasaṃjue 
tassa bhajjā duve āsī | rohiṇī devaī tahā /
tāsiṃ doṇhaṃ duve puttā | iṭhā rāmakesavā 
soriyapuraṃmi nayare | āsī rāyā mahiḍḍhie /
samuddavijae nāmaṃ | rāyalakkhaṇasaṃjue 
tassa bhajjā sivā nāma | tīse putto mahāyaso /
bhagavaṃ ariṭhanemi tti | loganāhe damīsare 
so 'riṭhanemināmo u | lakkhaṇassarasaṃjuo /
aṭhasahassalakkhaṇadharo | goyamo kālagacchavī 
vajjarisahasaṃghayaṇo | samacauraṃso jhasoyaro /
tassa rāyamaīkannaṃ | bhajjaṃ jāyai kesavo 
aha sā rāyavarakannā | susīlā cārupehaṇī /
savvalakkhaṇasaṃpannā | vijjusoyāmaṇippabhā 
ahāha jaṇao tīse | vāsudevaṃ mahiḍḍhiyaṃ /
ihāgacchaū kumāro | jā se kannaṃ dadāmi haṃ 
savvosahīhiṃ ṇhavio | kayakouyamaṃgalo /
divvajuyalaparihio | ābharaṇehiṃ vibhūsio 
mattaṃ ca gandhahatthi | vāsudevassa jeṭhagaṃ /
ārūḍho sohae ahiyaṃ | sire cūḍāmaṇī jahā 
aha ūsieṇa chatteṇa | cāmarāhi ya sohie /
dasāracakkeṇa ya so | savvao parivārio 
cauraṃgiṇīe senāe | raiyāe jahakkamaṃ /
turiyāṇa sannināeṇa | divveṇa gagaṇaṃ phuse 
eyārisāe iḍḍhīe | jutīe uttamāi ya /
niyagāo bhavaṇāo | nijjāo vaṇhipuṃgavo 
aha so tattha nijjanto | dissa pāṇe bhayaddue /
vāḍehiṃ paṃjarehiṃ ca | sanniruddhe sudukkhie 
jīviyantaṃ tu saṃpatte | maṃsaṭhā bhakkhiyavvae /
pāsettā se mahāpanne | sārahiṃ iṇam abbavī 
kassa aṭhā ime pāṇā | ee savve suhesiṇo /
vāḍehiṃ paṃjarehiṃ ca | sanniruddhā ya acchahiṃ 
aha sārahī tao bhaṇai | ee bhaddā u pāṇiṇo /
tujjhaṃ vivāhakajjaṃmi | bhoyāveuṃ bahuṃ jaṇaṃ 
soūṇa tassa vayaṇaṃ | bahupāṇiviṇāsaṇaṃ /
cintei se mahāpanno | sāṇukkose jiehiu 
jai majjha kāraṇā ee | hammanti subahū jiyā /
na me eyaṃ tu nissesaṃ | paraloge bhavissaī 
so kuṇḍalāṇa juyalaṃ | suttagaṃ ca mahāyaso /
ābharaṇāṇi ya savvāṇi | sārahissa paṇāmae 
maṇapariṇāme ya kae | devā ya jahoiyaṃ samoiṇṇā /
savviḍḍhīi saparisā | nikkhamaṇaṃ tassa kāuṃ je 
devamaṇussaparivuḍo | sīyārayaṇaṃ tao samārūḍho /
nikkhamiya bāragāo | revayayaṃmi ṭhio bhagavaṃ 
ujjāṇaṃ saṃpatto | oiṇṇo uttimāu sīyāo /
sāhassīi parivuḍo | aha nikkhamaī u cittāhiṃ 
aha se sugandhagandhie | turiyaṃ maukuṃcie /
sayam eva luṃcaī kese | paṃcamuṭhīhiṃ samāhio 
vāsudevo ya -aṃ bhaṇai | luttakesaṃ jiindiyaṃ /
icchiyamaṇorahaṃ turiyaṃ | pāvasū taṃ damīsarā 
nāṇeṇaṃ daṃsaṇeṇaṃ ya | caritteṇa taheva ya /
khantīe muttīe | vaḍḍhamāṇo bhavāhi ya 
evaṃ te rāmakesavā | dasārā ya bahū jaṇā /
ariṭhaṇemiṃ vandittā | abhigayā bāragāpuriṃ 
soūṇa rāyakannā | pavvajjaṃ sā jiṇassa u /
nīhāsā ya nirāṇandā | sogeṇa u samutthiyā 
rāīmaī vicintei | dhiratthu mama jīviyaṃ /
jā haṃ teṇa pariccattā | seyaṃ pavvaiuṃ mama 
aha sā bhamarasannibhe | kuccaphaṇagasāhie /
sayameva luṃcaī kese | dhiimantā vavassiyā 
vāsudevo ya -aṃ bhaṇai | luttakesaṃ jiindiyaṃ /
saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoraṃ | tara kanne lahuṃ lahuṃ 
sā pavvaiyā santī | pavvāvesī tahiṃ bahuṃ /
sayaṇaṃ pariyaṇaṃ ceva | sīlavantā bahussuyā 
giriṃ revatayaṃ jantī | vāseṇullā u antarā /
vāsante andhayāraṃmi | anto layaṇassa sā ṭhiyā 
cīvarāiṃ visārantī | jahā jāya tti pāsiyā /
rahanemī bhaggacitto | pacchā diṭho ya tīi vi 
bhīyā ya sā tahiṃ daṭhuṃ | egante saṃjayaṃ tayaṃ /
bāhāhiṃ kāu saṃgopphaṃ | vevamāṇī nisīyaī 
aha so vi rāyaputto | samuddavijayaṃgao /
bhīyaṃ paveviyaṃ daṭhuṃ | imaṃ vakkaṃ udāhare 
rahanemī ahaṃ bhadde | surūve cārubhāsiṇi /
mamaṃ bhayāhi suyaṇu | na te pīlā bhavissaī 
ehi tā bhuṃjimo bhoe | māṇussaṃ khu sudullahaṃ /
bhuttabhogī puṇo pacchā | jiṇamaggaṃ carissamo 
daṭhūṇa rahanemiṃ taṃ | bhaggujjoyaparājiyaṃ /
rāīmaī asambhantā | appāṇaṃ saṃvare tahiṃ 
aha sā rāyavarakannā | suṭhiyā niyamavvae /
jāī kulaṃ ca sīlaṃ ca | rakkhamāṇī tayaṃ vae 
jai si rūveṇa vesamaṇo | lalieṇa nalakuvvaro /
tahā vi te na icchāmi | jai si sakkhaṃ purandaro 
dhiratthu te jasokāmī | jo taṃ jīviyakāraṇā /
vantaṃ icchasi āvāuṃ | seyaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhave 
ahaṃ ca bhogarāyassa | taṃ ca si andhagavaṇhiṇo /
mā kule gandhaṇā homo | saṃjamaṃ nihuo cara 
jai taṃ kāhisi bhāvaṃ | jā jā dacchasi nārio /
vāyāiddho vva haḍho | aṭhiappā bhavissasi 
govālo bhaṇḍavālo vā | jahā tad davvaṇissaro /
evaṃ aṇissaro taṃ pi | sāmaṇṇassa bhavissasi 
tīse so vayaṇaṃ soccā | saṃjayāe subhāsiyaṃ /
aṃkuseṇa jahā nāgo | dhamme saṃpaḍivāio 
maṇagutto vayagutto | kāyagutto jiindio /
sāmaṇṇaṃ niccalaṃ phāse | jāvaj jīvaṃ daḍhavvao 
uggaṃ tavaṃ carittāṇaṃ | jāyā doṇṇi vi kevalī /
savvaṃ kammaṃ khavittāṇaṃ | siddhiṃ pattā aṇuttaraṃ 
evaṃ karenti saṃbuddhā | paṇḍiyā paviyakkhaṇā /
viṇiyaanti bhogesu | jahā so purisottamo  tti bemi ||
     || rahanemijjaṃ samattaṃ

ubhao vi tattha vihariṃsu | allīṇā susamāhiyā

kesim evaṃ buvaṃtaṃ tu | goyamo iṇam abbavī

U/24 samiīo catuviṃśaṃ adhyayanam /
aṭha pavayaṇamāyāo | samiī guttī taheva ya /
paṃceva ya samiīo | tao guttīo āhiyā 
iriyābhāsesaṇādāṇe | uccāre samiī iya /
maṇaguttī vayaguttī | kāyaguttī ya aṭhamā 
eyāo aṭha samiīo | samāseṇa viyāhiyā /
duvālasaṃgaṃ jiṇakkhāyaṃ | māyaṃ jattha u pavayaṇaṃ 
ālambaṇeṇa kāleṇa | maggeṇa jayaṇāya ya /
caukāraṇaparisuddhaṃ | saṃjae iriyaṃ rie 
tattha ālambaṇaṃ nāṇaṃ | daṃsaṇaṃ caraṇaṃ tahā /
kāle ya divase vutte | magge uppahavajjie 
davvao khettao ceva | kālao bhāvao tahā /
jāyaṇā cauvvihā vuttā | taṃ me kittayao suṇa 
davvao cakkhusā pehe | jugamittaṃ ca khettao /
kālao jāva rīijjā | uvautte ya bhāvao 
indiyatthe vivajjittā | sajjhāyaṃ ceva paṃcahā /
tam muttī tap purakkāre | uvautte riyaṃ rie 
kohe māṇe ya māyāe | lobhe ya uvauttayā /
hāse bhae moharie | vikahāsu taheva ca 
eyāiṃ aṭha ṭhāṇāiṃ | parivajjittu saṃjae /
asāvajjaṃ miyaṃ kāle | bhāsaṃ bhāsijja pannavaṃ 
gavesaṇāe gahaṇe ya | paribhogesaṇāya ya /
āhārovahisejjāe | ee tinni visohae 
uggamuppāyaṇaṃ paḍhame | bīe sohejja esaṇaṃ /
paribhoyaṃmi caukkaṃ | visohejja jayaṃ jaī 
ohovahovaggahiyaṃ | bhaṇḍagaṃ duvihaṃ muṇī /
giṇhanto nikkhivanto vā | pauṃjejja imaṃ vihiṃ 
cakkhusā paḍilehittā | pamajjejja jayaṃ jaī /
āie nikkhivejjā vā | duhao vī samie sayā 
uccāraṃ pāsavaṇaṃ | khelaṃ siṃghāṇajalliyaṃ /
āhāraṃ uvahiṃ dehaṃ | annaṃ vāvi tahāvihaṃ 
aṇāvāyam asaṃloe | aṇovāe ceva hoi saṃloe /
āvāyam asaṃloe | āvāe ceva saṃloe 
aṇāvāyam asaṃloe | parassaṇuvaghāie /
same ajjhusire yāvi | acirakālakayaṃmi ya 
vitthiṇṇe dūram ogāḍhe | nāsanne vilavajjie /
tasapāṇabīyarahie | uccārāīṇi vosire 
eyāo paṃca samiīo | samāseṇa viyāhiyā /
etto ya tatto guttīo | vocchāmi aṇupuvvaso 
saccā taheva mosā ya | saccamosā taheva ya /
cautthī asaccamosā ya | maṇaguttīo cauvvihā 
saṃrambhasamārambhe | ārambhe ya taheva ya /
maṇaṃ pavattamāṇaṃ tu | niyattejja jayaṃ jaī 
saccā taheva mosā ya | saccamosā taheva ya /

U/25 jannaijjaṃ paṃcaviṃśam adhyayanam/
māhaṇakulasaṃbhūo | āsi vippo mahāyaso /
jāyāī jamajannaṃmi | jayaghosi tti nāmao 
indiyaggāmaniggāhī | maggagāmī mahāmuṇī /
gāmāṇuggāmaṃ rīyaṃte | patte vāṇārasiṃ puriṃ 
vāṇārasīe bahiyā | ujjāṇaṃmi maṇorame /
phāsue sejjasaṃthāre | tattha vāsam uvāgae 
aha teṇeva kāleṇaṃ | purīe tattha māhaṇe /
vijayaghosi tti nāmeṇa | jannaṃ jayai veyavī 
aha se tattha aṇagāre | māsakkhamaṇapāraṇe /
vijayaghosassa jannaṃmi | bhikkhamaṭhā uvaṭhie 
samuvaṭhiyaṃ tahiṃ santaṃ | jāyago paḍisehae /
na hu dāhāmi te bhikkhaṃ | bhikkhū jāyāhi annao 
je ya veyaviū vippā | jannaṭhā ya je diyā /
joisaṃgaviū je ya | je ya dhammāṇa pāragā 
je samatthā samuddhattuṃ | param appāṇam eva ya /
tesiṃ annamiṇaṃ deyaṃ | bho bhikkhū savvakāmiyaṃ 
so tattha eva paḍisiddho | jāyageṇa mahāmuṇī /
na vi ruṭho na vi tuṭho | uttimaṭhagavesao 
nannaṭhaṃ pāṇaheuṃ vā | na vi nivvāhaṇāya vā /
tesiṃ vimokkhaṇaṭhāe | iṇaṃ vayaṇam abbavī 
navi jāṇasi veyamuhaṃ | navi jannāṇa jaṃ muhaṃ /
nakkhattāṇa muhaṃ jaṃ ca | jaṃ ca dhammāṇa vā muhaṃ 
je samatthā samuddhattuṃ | param appāṇam eva ya /
na te tumaṃ viyāṇāsi | aha jāṇāsi to bhaṇa 
tassakkhevapamokkhaṃ tu | avayanto tahiṃ dio /
sapariso paṃjalī houṃ | pucchaī taṃ mahāmuṇiṃ 
veyāṇaṃ ca muhaṃ būhi | būhi jannāṇa jaṃ muhaṃ /
nakkhattāṇa muhaṃ būhi | būhi dhammāṇa vā muhaṃ 
je samatthā samuddhattuṃ | param appāṇam eva ya /
eyaṃ me saṃsayaṃ savvaṃ | sāhū kahasu pucchio 
aggihuttamuhā veyā | jannaṭhī veyasā muhaṃ /
nakkhattāṇa muhaṃ cando | dhammāṇa kāsavo muhaṃ 
jahā candaṃ gahāīyā | ciṭhantī paṃjalīuḍā /
vandamāṇā namaṃsantā | uttamaṃ maṇahāriṇo 
ajāṇagā jannavāī | vijjāmāhaṇasaṃpayā /
gūḍhā sajjhāyatavasā | bhāsacchannā ivaggiṇo 
jo loe bambhaṇo vutto | aggīva mahio jahā /
sayā kusalasaṃdiṭhaṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
jo na sajjai āgantuṃ | pavvayanto na soyaī /
ramai ajjavayaṇaṃmi | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ  
jāyarūvaṃ jahāmaṭhaṃ | niddhantamalapāvagaṃ /
rāgadosabhayāīyaṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
tavassiyaṃ kisaṃ dantaṃ | avaciyamaṃsasoṇiyaṃ /
suvvayaṃ pattanivvāṇaṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
tasapāṇe viyāṇettā | saṃgaheṇa ya thāvare /
jo na hiṃsai tiviheṇa | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
kohā vā jai vā hāsā | lohā vā jai vā bhayā /
musaṃ na vayaī jo u | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
cittamantam acittaṃ vā | appaṃ vā jai vā bahuṃ /
na giṇhāi adattaṃ je | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
divvamāṇusatericchaṃ | jo na sevai mehuṇaṃ /
maṇasā kāyavakkeṇaṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
jahā pomaṃ jale jāyaṃ | novalippai vāriṇā /
evaṃ alittaṃ kāmehiṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
aloluyaṃ muhājīviṃ | aṇagāraṃ akiṃcanaṃ /
asaṃsattaṃ gihatthesu | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
jahittā puvvasaṃjogaṃ | nāisaṃge ya bandhave /
jo na sajjai bhogesuṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
pasubandhā savvaveyā ya | jaṭhaṃ ca pāvakammuṇā /
na taṃ tāyanti dussīlaṃ | kammāṇi balavanti hi 
na vi muṇḍieṇa samaṇo | na oṃkāreṇa bambhaṇo /
na muṇī raṇṇavāseṇaṃ | kusacīreṇa tāvaso 
samayāe samaṇo hoi | bambhacereṇa bambhaṇo /
nāṇeṇa u muṇī hoi | taveṇa hoi tāvaso 
kammuṇā bambhaṇo hoi | kammuṇā hoi khattio /
vaiso kammuṇā hoi | suddo havai kammuṇā 
ee pāukare buddhe | jehiṃ hoi siṇāyao /
savvakammavinimmukkaṃ | taṃ vayaṃ būma māhaṇaṃ 
evaṃ guṇasamāuttā | je bhavanti diuttamā /
te samatthā u uddhattuṃ | param appāṇam eva ya 
evaṃ tu saṃsae chinne | vijayaghose ya māhaṇe /
samudāya tayaṃ taṃ tu | jayaghosaṃ mahāmuṇiṃ 
tuṭhe ya vijayaghose | iṇam udāhu kayaṃjalī /
māhaṇattaṃ jahābhūyaṃ | suṭhu me uvadaṃsiyaṃ 
tubbhe jaiyā jannāṇaṃ | tubbhe veyaviūviū /
joisaṃgaviū tubbhe | tubbhe dhammāṇa pāragā 
tubbhe samatthā uddhattuṃ | param appāṇam eva ya /
tam aṇuggahaṃ karehamhaṃ | bhikkheṇaṃ bhikkhu uttamā 
na kajjaṃ majjha bhikkheṇa | khippaṃ nikkhamasū diyā /
mā bhamihisi bhayāvae | ghore saṃsārasāgare 
uvalevo hoi bhogesu | abhogī novalippaī /
bhogī bhamai saṃsāre | abhogī vippamuccaī 
ullo sukkho ya do chūḍhā | golayā maiyāmayā /
do vi āvaḍiyā kuḍḍe | jo ullo so 'ttha laggaī 
evaṃ lagganti dummehā | je narā kāmalālasā /
virattā u na lagganti | jahā se sukkhagolae 
evaṃ se vijayaghose | jayaghosassa antie /
aṇagārassa nikkhanto | dhammaṃ soccā aṇuttaraṃ 
khavittā puvvakammāiṃ | saṃjameṇa taveṇa ya /
jayaghosavijayaghosā | siddhiṃ pattā aṇuttaraṃ   || tti bemi ||

U/26 sāmāyārī ṣaḍviṃśatitamam adhyayanam /
sāmāyāriṃ pavakkhāmi | savvadukkhavimokkhaṇiṃ /
jaṃ carittāṇa nigganthā | tiṇṇā saṃsārasāgaraṃ 
paḍhamā āvassiyā nāma | biiyā ya nisīhiyā ũ/
āpucchaṇā ya taiyā | cautthī paḍipucchaṇā 
paṃcamī chandaṇā nāma | icchākāro ya chaṭhao /
sattamo micchakāro u | tahakkāro ya aṭhamo 
abbhuṭhāṇaṃ ca navamaṃ | dasamī uvasaṃpadā /
esā dasaṃgā sāhūṇaṃ | sāmāyarī paveiyā 
gamaṇe āvassiyaṃ kujjā | ṭhāṇe kujja nisīhiyaṃũ/
āpucchaṇaṃ sayaṃkaraṇe | parakaraṇe paḍipucchaṇaṃ 
chandaṇā davvajāeṇaṃ | icchākāro ya sāraṇe /
micchākāro ya nindāe | tahakkāro paḍissue 
abbhuṭhāṇaṃ gurūpūyā | acchaṇe uvasaṃpadā /
evaṃ dupaṃcasaṃjuttā | sāmāyārī paveiyāũ
puvvillaṃmi caubbhāe | āiccaṃmi samuṭhie /
bhaṇḍayaṃ paḍilehittā | vandittā ya tao guruṃ 
pucchijja paṃjaliuḍo | kiṃ kāyavvaṃ mae iha /
icchaṃ nioiuṃ bhante | veyāvacce va sajjhāe 
veyāvacce niutteṇa | kāyavvaṃ agilāyao /

divasassa cauro bhāge | bhikkhū kujjā viyakkhaṇo /

paḍhamaṃ porisi sajjhāyaṃ | bīyaṃ jhāṇaṃ jhiyāyaī /
taiyāe bhikkhāyariyaṃ | puṇo cautthīi sajjhāyaṃ 
āsāḍhe māse dupayā | pose māse cauppayā /
cittāsoesu māsesu | tippayā havai porisī 
aṃgulaṃ sattaratteṇaṃ | pakkheṇaṃ ca duraṃgulaṃ /
vaḍḍhae hāyae vāvi | māseṇaṃ cauraṃgulaṃ 
āsāḍhabahulapakkhe | bhaddavae kattie ya pose ya /
phagguṇavāisāhesu ya | boddhavvā omarattāo 
jeṭhāmūle āsāḍhasāvaṇe | chahiṃ aṃgulehiṃ paḍilehā /
aṭhahiṃ bīyatayaṃmi | taie dasa aṭhahiṃ cautthe 
rattiṃ pi cauro bhāge | bhikkhū kujjā viyakkhaṇo /
tao uttaraguṇe kujjā | rāibhāesu causu vi 
paḍhamaṃ porisi sajjhāyaṃ | bīyaṃ jhāṇaṃ jhiyāyaī /
taiyāe niddamokkhaṃ tu | cautthī bhujjo vi sajjhāyaṃ 
jaṃ nei jayā rattiṃ | nakkhattaṃ taṃmi nahacaubbhāe /
saṃpatte viramejjā | sajjhāyaṃ paosakālammi 
tammeva ya nakkhatte | gayaṇacaubbhāgasāvasesaṃmi /
verattiyaṃ pi kālaṃ | paḍilehittā muṇī kujjā 
puvvillaṃmi caubbhāe | paḍilehittāṇa bhaṇḍayaṃ /
guruṃ vandittu sajjhāyaṃ | kujjā dukkhavimokkhaṇaṃ 
porisīe caubbhāe | vandittāṇa tao guruṃ /
apaḍikkamittā kālassa | bhāyaṇaṃ paḍilehae

caurindiyaāuṭhiī | antomuhuttaṃ jahanniyā

sā tesiṃ kāyaṭhiī | jahannam ukkosiyā bhave 
aṇantakālam ukkosaṃ | antomuhuttaṃ jahannayaṃ /
vijaḍhaṃmi sae kāe | devāṇaṃ hujja antaraṃ 
eesiṃ vaṇṇao ceva | gandhao rasaphāsao /

saṃsāratthā ya siddhā ya | iya jīvā viyāhiyā /

iya jīvamajīve ya | soccā saddahiūṇa ya /
savvanayāṇam aṇumae | ramejja saṃjame muṇī 
tao bahūṇi vāsāṇi | sāmaṇṇam aṇupāliya /

bāraseva u vāsāiṃ | saṃlehukkosiyā bhave /

paḍhame vāsacaukkaṃmi | vigaī-nijjūhaṇaṃ kare /
biīe vāsacaukkammi | vicittaṃ tu tavaṃ care 
egantaram āyāmaṃ | kau saṃvacchare duve /
tao saṃvaccharaddhaṃ tu | nāivigiṭhaṃ tavaṃ care 
tao saṃvaccharaddhaṃ tu | vigiṭhaṃ tu tavaṃ care /
parimiyaṃ ceva āyāmaṃ | taṃmi saṃvacchare kare 
koḍīsahiyam āyāmaṃ | kau saṃvacchare muṇī /
māsaddhamāsieṇaṃ tu | āhāreṇa tavaṃ care 
kandappam ābhiogaṃ ca | kivvisiyaṃ moham āsuruttaṃ ca /

micchādaṃsaṇarattā | saniyāṇā kaṇhalesam ogāḍhā /
iya je maranti jīvā | tesiṃ puṇa dullahā bohī 
jiṇavayaṇe aṇurattā | jiṇavayaṇaṃ karenti bhāveṇa /

bālamaraṇāṇi bahuso | akāmamaraṇāṇi ceva ya bahūṇi /

bahuāgamavinnāṇā | samāhiuppāyagā ya guṇagāhī /

kandappakukkuyāiṃ | taha sīlasahāvahasaṇavigahāiṃ /
vimhāvento vi paraṃ | kandappaṃ bhāvaṇaṃ kuṇai 
mantājogaṃ kāuṃ | bhūīkammaṃ ca je pauṃjanti /

nāṇassa kevalīṇaṃ | dhammāyariyassa saṃghasāhūṇaṃ /
māī avaṇṇavāī | kivvisiyaṃ bhāvaṇaṃ kuṇai 
aṇubaddharosapasaro | taha ya nimittaṃmi hoi paḍisevī /
eehi kāraṇehiṃ | āsuriyaṃ bhāvaṇaṃ kuṇai 
satthagahaṇaṃ visabhakkhaṇaṃ ca | jalaṇaṃ ca jalapaveso ya /
aṇāyārabhaṇḍasevā | jammaṇamaraṇāṇi bandhanti 
iya pāukare buddhe | nāyae parinivvue /
chattīsaṃ uttarajjhāe | bhavasiddhīyasaṃvuḍe  tti bemi ||

texts.content:
nijjariya-jarā-maraṇaṁ vandittā jiṇa-varaṁ mahāvīraṁ
chappaṇṇaya-gāhāo vocchaṁ suyaṇassa joggāo // Chapp.1

purisesacca-samiddhe, aliya-daliddesahāve-santuṭṭhe
tava-niyama-dhamma-maïevisamā visamā honti // Chapp.2

gayaṇammi gahā sayaṇammisumiṇayāsaüṇayā vaṇaggesu
taha vāharanti purisaṁ jaha diṭṭhaṁ puvva-kammehiṁ // Chapp.3

savve tāha pasatthāsumiṇā saüṇāgahā ya nakkhattā
ti-huyaṇa-maṅgala-nilayaṁ hiyaeṇa jiṇaṁ vahantassa // Chapp.4

katthaï na karaïmollaṁ suvaṇṇayaṁ kattha dūhavo vando
katthaïsarala-sahāvo jaṇona saṁmāṇaṇaṁ lahaï // Chapp.5

dūra-ttho ḍahaï ravī, aggī aṅgehĩpharasioḍahaï
ḍahaï piya-vippaogo, suyaṇovi a-daṁsaṇe ḍahaï // Chapp.6

ḍahae suyaṇa-viogo,ḍahaïa-ṇāhattaṇaṁ para-viese
ḍahaïya abbhakkhāṇaṁ,ḍahaïa-kajjaṁkayaṁpacchā // Chapp.7

santa-guṇa-vippaṇāse asanta-dosubbhaveyajaṁ dukkhaṁ
taṁ sosei samuddaṁ; kiṁ puṇa hiyayaṁ maṇussāṇaṁ? // Chapp.8

santehi a-santehiyaparassa kiṁ jampiyehi dosehiṁ?
attho jaso na labbhaï, soyaa-mitto kao hoi // Chapp.9

mahureṇa jiṇaha kaḍuyaṁ, khamāĕ dappaṁ guruṁ paṇāmeṇa
santoseṇa yalohaṁ, kalahaṁ ca ajampiyavveṇa // Chapp.10

ekka-sukaeṇa tūsaha jāva sayaṁ dukkiyāṇa volei
sa-sarīre vi na sakkā diyahe diyahe piyaṁ kāuṁ // Chapp.11

kaha nāma tassa pāvaṁ cintijjaïāgae vikohammi
uppala-dala-sukumālo jassa ghareŏlliohattho? // Chapp.12

piya-pāhuṇa-āgamaṇea-pahuppantassasajjaṇa-jaṇassa
maraṇāoabbhahiyaṁuppajjaïmāṇasaṁdukkhaṁ // Chapp.13

na hu aï-bhariyaṁdhammaï; jaha bhariyaṁ taha suhāvahaṁ hoi;
pancammi na yakilimmaïgao vi piya-pāhuṇo hoi. // Chapp.14

te dhannā je dhammaṁ suṭṭhu vi jāṇanti suṭṭhu vikaranti
jīviya-sāram a-sāraṁ:khaṇeṇa pariyattae savvaṁ // Chapp.15

sā māyā so ya piyā, taṁ mittaṁbandhavo yaso ceva
jo hiya-nissesa-karaṁ dhammassa pahe nayaṁ dei // Chapp.16

na vi taṁ karei māyā piyā ya putto ya bandhava-jaṇo ya
jaṁ purisassāyariyā karanti dhammaṁ uvaïsantā. // Chapp.17

kiṁ acchaha vīsatthā? diyahā volenti turiya-pahiya vva;
te ya na gaṇanti tubbhe, tubbhehi na vi ya gaṇijjanti. // Chapp.18

tuṭṭhā honti maṇussā: Indamaho āgao tti ramaṇīo;
na vi jāṇanti varāyā: paḍiyā saṁvacchara-salāyā! // Chapp.19

uccāsaṇo mah-iccho, āṇāinto ya nir-uvayārīo
alaso piya-jimmaṇa rūsaṇo ya na ciraṁ pio hoi. // Chapp.20

sahasatti pīimantā a-tthakke jaṁ va taṁ va jampantā
pāse ya nivesantāpiyā yasattuttaṇam uventi. // Chapp.21

nīyaṁ aïkkamanto puvvābhāsī piyāĩ jampanto
chandaṁ aṇuyattanto veso vi jaṇo piyo hoi. // Chapp.22

chandaṁ jo aṇuyattaï mammaṁ rohaï guṇā payāsei
na hu navari māṇusāṇa ya, devāṇa vi dullaho hoi. // Chapp.23

āvaṁ ti ya evaṁ ti ya vottavvaṁ paṇḍieṇa puriseṇa:
iyaro vi hoi tuṭṭho, iyaraṁ pi (ya) tattiyaṁ ceva. // Chapp.24

chajjaï pahussa laliyaṁ, piyāĕ māṇaṁ, khamā samatthassa
jāṇantassa ya bhaṇiyaṁ, moṇaṁ ca a-yāṇamāṇassa. // Chapp.25

sahaï na kaḍuyaṁ jampaï, dose na lahaï guṇā payāsei
rūsantāṇa na rūsaï, dakkhiṇṇa-mahābhaḍo suyaṇo. // Chapp.26

suyaṇo na ceva rūsaï: aha rūsaï mangulaṁ na cintei:
aha cintei na jampaï; aha jampaï lajjio hoi. // Chapp.27

jaṁ dujjaṇassa suyaṇo lajjāe sahaï chinna-lajjassa
taṁ jāṇaï nillajjo, eso a-samatthao sahaï. // Chapp.28

aṇuyattiyaṁ na yāṇaï, piye vi bhaṇie vi a-ppiyaṁ bhaṇaï,
dāṇeṇa na sampajjaï; natthi uvāo khala-yaṇassa. // Chapp.29

bajjhaï mantehi visaṁ, hatthi rajjūhi seuṇā salilaṁ;
payaï-visamassa bandho na yāṇimo dujjaṇa-jaṇassa. // Chapp.30

savvassa esa payaī: piyammi uppāie piyaṁ kāuṁ:
suyaṇassa kā vi payaī: a-kae vi pie piyaṁ kāuṁ. // Chapp.31

kajjammi samāvaḍie aṇuyattaha dujjaṇaṁ payatteṇa
visam āsā kira jāyaï amayāŏ visaṁ na saṁbhavaï. // Chapp.32

jaï vi khamā paribhūyā, jaï vi khamantassa āyaro natthi
taha vi khamā khamiyavvā; khama-sariso bandhavo natthi. // Chapp.33

kaha tassa rūsiyavvaṁ jassa paṇāmo puṇo vi kāyavvo?
accanta-nigguṇassa vi kaha sakkā rūsiuṁ tassa? // Chapp.34

rosassa khamā daṇḍo, kāma-guṇāṇaṁ nirumbhaṇā daṇḍo;
dujjaṇa-jaṇassa kalah-ujjayassa parivajjaṇā daṇḍo. // Chapp.35

bhaddaṁ pahū suyāṇaṁ avarāheūṇa baddha-vaïrāṇa
paṇivaïya-vacchalāṇaṁ muhutta-caṇḍ-ĕkka-rosāṇaṁ. // Chapp.36

bīheyavvaṁ dujjaṇa-jaṇassa niccaṁ paloṭṭa-jīhassa
vara-rayaṇa-nijjharassa va vayaṇa-karālaṁ vahantassa. // Chapp.37

atthakkŏ jampae payaï-pāyaḍaṁ savva-loya-tattillaṁ;
taṁ māṇusa-veyālaṁ puhaī vi sa-sankiyā bhamaï. // Chapp.38

nīo khaṇeṇa raccaï; ratto santo viraccaï khaṇeṇa,
nīo viratta-metto bhāmei gharā-ghariṁ dose. // Chapp.39

suyaṇo cirassa raccaï; ratto santo viraccaï cirassa;
suyaṇo jaï vi viraccaï; taha vi na dose payāsei. // Chapp.40

chullucchalei jaṁ hoi ūṇayaṁ rittayaṁ kaṇayaṇei;
bhariyāī na vuccanti supurisa-viṇṇāṇa-bhaṇḍāīṁ. // Chapp.41

taṁ khāha jaṁ jarijjaï, taṁ jampaha jaṁ mahā-yaṇe joggaṁ;
taṁ jampanti su-purisā, kāleṇa vi jaṁ na langhei. // Chapp.42

tattiya-mettaṁ jampahajettiya-mettassa nikkalaṁ cavaha
taṁukkhivehabhāraṁ jaṁ addha-pahe na chaḍḍeha. // Chapp.43

vujjhanti nāma bhārā, te cciya vujjhanti vīsamantehiṁ
sīla-bharo voḍhavvo jāvaj-jīvaṁa-vīsāmo. // Chapp.44

jo sakkayaṁ na yāṇaï suvisuddha-pāiyaṁ pi vottuṁ-je
moṇaṁtutassa saraṇaṁ, nīsaraṇaṁ ahava parisāe. // Chapp.45

uccaṁ na sikkhio addha-sikkhio sikkhio ku-sālāe
jo vahaï viusa-vāyaṁ so sariso sanniyāeṇa. // Chapp.46

ko kuvalayāṇa gandhaṁ karei mahurattaṇaṁ ca ucchūṇaṁ
vara-hatthīṇa ya līlaṁ, viṇayaṁ ca kula-ppasūyāṇaṁ? // Chapp.47

aṇuyattaha bhaṇaha piyaṁ, jaṁ kajjaṁ taṁmuṇehahiyaeṇa:
mahuraṁ lavaï mayūro sa-visaṁ ca bhuyangamaṁ gilaï. // Chapp.48

ucchū mahuro somo cando (taha) candaṇaṁ ciya su-surabhiṁ
abhijāo ya kulīṇo; ko doso āyaro c'eva? // Chapp.49

jo guḍa-kayāĕ vāyāĕ jampae visa-kaeṇa hiyaeṇa
so bila-gao va sappo vajjeyavvo payatteṇa // Chapp.50

a-ddiṭṭhe vi khala-yaṇe nāma-ggahaṇe vi hoi āsankā
aliya-palatte vi ahī ahi tti bhaṇa ko na bīhei? // Chapp.51

saṇḍeva-paḍiya-paccuṭṭhieṇa sīeṇa tharaharanteṇa
thereṇa pahe runnaṁ tāruṇṇaṁ sambharanteṇaṁ. // Chapp.52

vivarīyā thera-maī vārijjantī ya jāi thera-maī
kālo tettiya-thāmaṁ na pecchase paṇḍuraṁ sīsaṁ. // Chapp.53

taṁ hi sarīraṁ taṁ ji muhu, tāī ji lōyaṇayāĩ
nāi vihī sīsaṁ caraï, dinnau pāu jarāĕ. // Chapp.54

taĩ pahu dhaṇiya ghareṇa gharu nayaṇihĩ dāiya sō hu;
ēvahi jara-nīhōḍiyau, paḍijiya acchaï ēhu. // Chapp.55

laṭṭhī-dhariya-kaḍevara gaya-jovaṇa evam eva santuṭṭha;
sahaï kaḍuyaṁ pi bhaṇio: gao tumaṁ rūsiuṁ kālo! // Chapp.56

siru paliyaũ muhũ vali-bhariu; jara laggī haya nāma
maraṇaṁ hōi acintiyaũ; dhammu karahi jiya nāma. // Chapp.57

caya mahilaṁ muha-kaḍuyaṁ, caya mittaṁ natthi jattha sab-bhāvaṁ
caya sāmiyaṁ a-dāyaṁ, cayāhi paribhūyā vāsaṁ ca. // Chapp.58

ālattaṁ ciya rūsaï, bhiuḍiṁ kāūṇa dei ullāvaṁ
mahilā-chaleṇa purisaṁ bāhei purāṇayaṁ kammaṁ. // Chapp.59

mahilāṇa esa payaī: savvassa karenti vemaṇassāiṁ;
tassa na karenti navaraṁ jassa alaṁ kāmayanteṇaṁ. // Chapp.60

piya-jaṇa-apatta-bhogā bālattaṇayammi gahiya-sāmaṇṇā
a-ddiṭṭha-piya-viogā jiyanti muṇiṇo suhaṁ loe. // Chapp.61

su-labho vimāṇa-vāso, ega-cchattā ya meiṇī su-labhā;
logammi navari du-lahā pāyā jiṇa-vaddhamāṇassa. // Chapp.62

ucchū sahāva-mahuro, nimbo kaḍuo huyāsaṇo ḍahaṇo
suyaṇassa dujjaṇassa ya payaï-viseso sahāveṇa. // Chapp.63

jaṁ uppalassa patteṇa chijjae kiṁ va sattha-maggeṇaṁ?
mahurammi bhāṇiyavve, kiṁ te kaḍueṇa bhaṇieṇa? // Chapp.64

mahura-vayaṇehĩ āsāsiellayā je gayā para-viesaṁ
te tāĩ sambharantā, annattha raïṁ na bandhanti. // Chapp.65

kaḍuya-vayaṇehĩ nibbhacchiyallayā chinna-pema-sambandhā
te tāĩ sambharantā, tatto yapareṇavaccanti. // Chapp.66

dhannāṇa hiyaṁ ca miyaṁ ca gāhayaṁ desa-kāla-bhaṇiyaṁ ca
na ya para-loya-viruddhaṁ guṇa-pattaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇaï jīhā. // Chapp.67

esā satti-pahāre ya kasa-pahāre ya bala-pahāre ya
ucchahaï davāveuṁ du-viṇīyā attaṇo jīhā. // Chapp.68

jo dujjaṇeṇa mettī karei suyaṇo tti nāma kaliūṇa
suviṇaya-laddho va nihī pacchā icchaṁ na pūrei. // Chapp.69

dujjaṇa-saṁsaggīe āvāe ucchu-khaṇḍa-mahurāe;
visam iva aṇāya-giliyaṁpacchā hoī a-patthāo. // Chapp.70

jaï kancaṇaṁ girīo jāyaï (jaï) (mottiyaṁ) ca hattīo
viṇao ya kulīṇāo, ko doso āyaro ceva? // Chapp.71

paḍivayaṇa-samattheṇaṁ sahiyavvaṁ dujjaṇassa suyaṇaeṇa:
na ya paṭṭhimmi nilīṇo vasahassa siriṁ haraï kāo. // Chapp.72

ekko khamāĕ doso savvālankāra-bhūsiya-guṇāe
a-samattho tti gaṇijjaï jaṁ puriso dujjaṇa-jaṇeṇa. // Chapp.73

tisu je a-diṭṭha-puvvā rāya-kule guru-kule ya vesāsu
viṇṇāṇa-māṇa-laḍahattaṇāṇa te bāhirā honti. // Chapp.74

nāūṇa ya viṇṇāṇaṁ kāūṇa ya samara-sāhasaṁ kammaṁ
langheūṇa ya Meruṁ puṇṇehĩ viṇā suhaṁ katto? // Chapp.75

kāle uvaṇijjantī thevā vi mahosahī jiyāvei:
amaya-rasa-mīsieṇa vi mayassa kiṁ lāvaya-raseṇa? // Chapp.76

nhāyassa ya dhovattī jimiyassa ya jaṁ ca taṁ ca tambolaṁ
avasara-paḍhiyā gāhā, tinni vi saggaṁ visesanti. // Chapp.77

nīyaṁ ca laddha-pasaraṁ sippi-pauttaṁ ca attha-saṁjuttaṁ
mahilāyattaṁ ca gharaṁ, tinni vi sūlaṁ visesanti. // Chapp.78

thakke bhaṇiyaṁ sohaï, thakke bhaṇiyaṁ suhāvahaṁ hoi;
a-tthakke puṇa bhaṇiyaṁ kayaṁ pi kajjaṁ viṇāsei. // Chapp.79

kiṁ tammeha palāyaha jaṁ saraṇaṁ natthi ti-huyaṇe sayale
mottuṁ jiṇenda-vayaṇaṁ, sesaṁ savvaṁ kalayalei. // Chapp.80

suyaṇo sarala-sahāvo maïlijjanto vi dujjaṇa-jaṇeṇa
chāreṇa dappaṇo vviya ahiyayaraṁ nimmalo hoi. // Chapp.81

suyaṇassa dujjaṇārūsiyassa kaḍuyāĩ bhannamāṇassa
kamala-maule vva bhamaro bāhira-hiṇḍī bhamaï roso. // Chapp.82

jaha jaha aṇuyattijjaï taha taha nīyattaṇassa doseṇa
vaṭṭā-dhūlō va khalo caḍaï sire natthi sandeho. // Chapp.83

jeṇa viṇā na jivijjaï aṇuṇijjaï so kayāvarāho vi:
patte ya nagara-dāhe bhaṇa kassa na vallaho aggī? // Chapp.84

taṁ jampanti su-purisā taṁ ciya pamuhe karenti paḍivattī
rayaṇāyaro vva velaṁ kāleṇa vi jaṁ na langhei. // Chapp.85

para-tatti-taggaya-maṇo du-ssīlo aliya-jampao cavalo
jattha na dīsaï loo vaṇaṁ pi taṁ c'eva ramaṇīyaṁ. // Chapp.86

jo jassa niya-sahāvo sajjaṇa-saṁge vi so tahā ceva
bāṇo dhamme vi ṭhio guṇa-gahio taha vi mārei. // Chapp.87

khala-saṁge pariharie, pecchaha tilleṇa jaṁ phalaṁ pattaṁ:
mayaṇāhi-surabhi-gandhaṁ pahu-sīsaṁ pāviyaṁ jeṇa. // Chapp.88

jehiṁ ciya ubbhaviyā jāṇa pasāeṇa vaḍḍhiya-payāvā
samarā ḍahanti viṁjhaṁ: khalāṇa saṁgo cciya viṇāso. // Chapp.89

suyaṇāṇa neurāṇa ya suvvanto sui-maṇoraho saddo
so c'eva kaṇṇa-kaḍuo niyalāṇaṁ daḍḍha-pisuṇāṇaṁ. // Chapp.90

nāgehĩ vaṇaṁ kāgehĩ uvavaṇaṁ rāulaṁ pisuṇaehiṁ
ruddhaṁ mayarehĩ jalaṁ: haya-vihi suyaṇo kahiṁ jāu. // Chapp.91

taṁ natthi narenda-gharaṁ sayale mahi-maṇḍale bhamantāṇaṁ
jattha a-kāraṇa-kuviyā do tiṇṇi khalā na dīsanti. // Chapp.92

accanta-nimmalāṇa vi molla-mahagghāṇa sāra-garuyāṇaṁ
maṇiyārŏ vva khala-yaṇo rayaṇāṇa vi kuṇaï chiḍḍāiṁ. // Chapp.93

jāsiṁ c'eva naīṇaṁ vasahā ghuṇṭanti pāṇiyaṁ tisiyā
tāsiṁ c'eva naīṇaṁ siṁgehiṁ taḍī viṇāsenti. // Chapp.94

sarise māṇusa-jamme, ḍahaï khalo saj-jaṇo suhāvei:
lohaṁ ciya sannāho rakkhaï jīyaṁ asī haraï. // Chapp.95

jonhā-jaleṇa cando dhuvaï kalaṁkaṁ disā-vahu-muhāṇa
na ya dhuvaï niya-kalaṁkaṁ; savvo mujjhaï sa-kajjesu. // Chapp.96

jo jassa vaṭṭaĕ hiyaĕ so taṁ ṭhāvei sundara-sahāvaṁ:
vagghī-chāvaṁ jaṇaṇī bhaddaṁ somaṁ ca mannei. // Chapp.97

ratto duṭṭho mūḍho puvviṁ ku-ggāhio ya cattāri
uvaesassa aṇarihā; ariho puṇa hoi majjha-ttho. // Chapp.98

savvo parassa pecchaï vāl'-aggāo taṇūṇi chiḍḍāṇi;
niyaya-kayāĩ na pecchaï Himagirī-sihara-ppamāṇāiṁ. // Chapp.99

rattā pecchanti guṇā, dosā pecchanti je virajjanti;
majjha-tthā puṇa purisā dosā vi guṇā vi pecchanti. // Chapp.100

kariṇo kari-sanghaṭṭe, patthara-niyare suvaṇṇa-reha vva
nivvaḍaï vasaṇa-kasavaṭṭayammi sāro kulīṇāṇaṁ. // Chapp.101

sabbhāva-nehamaïe ratte raccijaï tti juttam iṇaṁ
aṇa-hiyae puṇa hiyayaṁ jaṁ dijjaï taṁ jaṇo hasaï. // Chapp.102

hīranti je guṇehiṁ vavagaya-nehā vi je na najjanti
runnaṁ pi jesu agghaï te putta kalimmi atthamiyā. // Chapp.103

visama-sahāvammi jaṇe na yāṇimo kaha guṇā viḍhappanti
hima-sīyale vi kiraṇe necchaï naliṇī miyankassa. // Chapp.104

sohiya-saṁvavahāro sab-bhāvo garuyayā khamā tucchā
vihaḍanti bandhavāṇa ya kali-kāla-payāva-doseṇa. // Chapp.105

kaṇhassa kālio phaṇa-maṇimmi siṭṭho A Ā A Ā Ā Ā
deh'-uppannā vi visaṁ cayanti deve parāhutte. // Chapp.106

ko va na dukkhaṁ patto? suhaṁ va bhaṇa kassa sāsayaṁ atthi?
kassa nirantara-paṇao? sohaggaṁ kassa a-kkhaliyaṁ? // Chapp.107

savvo puvva-kayāṇaṁ kammāṇaṁ pāvae phala-vivāgaṁ;
avarāhesu guṇesu ya nimitta-mettaṁ paro hoi. // Chapp.108

nau vi karantaha su-purisaha, jaï daïvaha na suhāi
kā vi avattha sa sampaḍaï jā cintaṇaha na jāi. // Chapp.109

annaha paricintijjaï saharisa-kaṇḍ'-ujjueṇa hiyaeṇa;
pariṇamaï annaha cciya kajjārambho vihi-vaseṇa. // Chapp.110

vihiṇā vi naḍijjanto savvo cciya bhaṇaï aṭṭhamo cando;
candassa Rāhu-gahaṇe, taïyā ko aṭṭhamo āsi? // Chapp.111

viupu naha-yalu rahavarāruḍhu
du-ppecchā tasu kiraṇa
attha-siharu duggamu suṇijjaï,
vihi-vihiyaṁ thū pariṇamaï
tēṇa sūru rāhĩ gilijjaï. // Chapp.112

bhuvaṇapphālu vi dhaṇu samaï,
vabbula-heṭṭhi ṭṭhiō
ōhu pekkhu na kiṁ gilantaïṁ
dēvāha vi ēha dasa
vihi karantu kiṁ kiṁ pilijjaï? // Chapp.113

dhannu suvaṇṇaũ ti-huyaṇahu, dinnau hōi hareṇa
tassa vi thū vihi-vihiu dhaṇu; saṅkaru naggaï teṇa. // Chapp.114

jā taï-lukkaha nāha kira sampaï phēḍaï dēi;
taha vi jarāau Haraha dhaṇu; gali haḍḍaĩ parihēi. // Chapp.115

annē bhaṇanti Jaṇaddaṇa Haraha tiijjau bhāu
tassa vi daïviṁ nimmiyau sayaṇiu kālau kāu. // Chapp.116

vihi-vihiyaṁ ciya labbhaï, amayaṁ devāṇa Mahumahe Lacchī
rayaṇāyare vi mahie, Harassa bhāe visaṁ jāyaṁ. // Chapp.117

puttaya vihi-vasi vinaḍiyaï, ko ti-ṇayaṇi sāhāru?
jiṁ Hara-vasahu vi tiṇa caraï, Vāsugi pavaṇāhāru. // Chapp.118

jaï vi ti-ṇayaṇu ekku puhaïhiṁ
vandijjaï sura-gaṇihiṁ
tō vi tāsi vaḍha kiha ṇamijjaï?
saraṇāgau jāsu sira A
sirahu lēvi Rāhiṁ gilijjaï. // Chapp.119

majjhe jaḍāṇa nivasantayassa katto guṇāṇa vitthāro?
Hara-sasiṇo taṁ bahuyaṁ sā vi kalā jaṁ na se jhīṇā. // Chapp.120

thevehi vi hoi guṇehĩ gāravaṁ ni-gguṇāṇa majjhammi
bhaṇṇanti jeṇa maṇuyā, sarehĩ kūyā vi kūya-sarā. // Chapp.121

jaha mūsagassa ekkeṇa vīhiṇā do vi vāvaḍā hatthā
taha a-muṇia-kallāṇā theveṇa vi uttuṇā honti // Chapp.122

guṇavantayāṇa jāṇaha honti guṇā pāyaḍā mah'-agghāyā
maṇi-rayaṇaṁ ciya goṭṭhe govā takkeṇa magganti. // Chapp.123

a-bhaṇantāṇa vi najjaï viṇṇāṇaṁ su-purisāṇa cariehiṁ
kiṁ bollanti maṇīo, jāŏ sahassehĩ gheppanti? // Chapp.124

aṭṭhattaṇāĩ Ā Ā A Ā jah'-icchāĕ ni-gguṇāṇaṁ pi
sajjaṇa-salāhaṇijjā sokkhehĩ guṇā viḍhappanti. // Chapp.125

puvva-kaya-asuha-kammo puriso a-suhassa uvviyanto vi
nivaḍaï a-suha-kkhalio kali-kalaha-kilesa-jālammi. // Chapp.126

jāṇaï su-y-andhayāre vi vacchao māyaraṁ gavesanto
daïyaṁ ca muṇaï hiyayaṁ, vesaṁ jāṇanti nayaṇāĩ. // Chapp.127

jassa na vaṇṇei jaṇo sajjaṇa-goṭṭhīsu guṇa-sahassāiṁ
kiṁ tassa jaṇaṇi-jovvaṇa-viuḍaṇa-metteṇa jammeṇaṁ? // Chapp.128

mā dosu cciya geṇhaha; virale ya guṇe pasaṁsaha jaṇassa:
akkha-pauro vi uyahī bhaṇṇaï rayaṇāyaro loke. // Chapp.129

savvo guṇesu rajjaï; guṇa-rahiyaṁ ko jaṇaṁ sammalliyaï?
kusumaṁ pi gandha-rahiyaṁ pattiya bhamarā na sevanti. // Chapp.130

guṇa-jāla-baddha-mūle sacca-phale neya-pallava-saṇāhe
nehamaïyammi suyaṇe, mitta-dume ko na vīsamaï? // Chapp.131

sa-bbhāviyaṁ siṇehaṁ sama-dukkha-sahejjayaṁ su-sīlaṁ ca
dūrāloya-vihasiyaṁ ko mitta-suhaṁ na sambharaï? // Chapp.132

gujjhassa saṁnihāṇaṁ, suhassa dukhassa kahaṇa-vīsamaṇaṁ,
ekkaṁ pi jassa mittaṁ natthi hu kiṁ tassa jīeṇaṁ? // Chapp.133

taṁ mittaṁ kāyavvaṁ jaṁ mittaṁ vasaṇa-desa-yālammi
ālihiya-bhitti-vāullayaṁ va na parammuhaṁ ṭhāi. // Chapp.134

baddha-siṇeho aïyāra-vallaho appa-kajja-maï-kusalo
vajjasu kao vi mitto eyāvattho tumaṁ su-yaṇu. // Chapp.135

majjha-ttheṇa vi sasiṇā cakkāṇa na tīrae piyaṁ kāuṁ;
vihaḍaṇa-sanghaḍaṇaṁ ciya, puṇo vi mitto cciya karei. // Chapp.136

jaha sa-rase taha sukkhe vi pāyave vahaï aṇudiṇaṁ viṁjho:
ucchanga-vaḍḍhiyaṁ nigguṇaṁ pi garuyā na siḍhilanti. // Chapp.137

uttama-jaṇa-saṁsaggī kāyavvā jaï vi ni-pphalā hoi.
merussa kaḍaĕ laggaṁ taṇaṁ pi taṁ kancaṇaṁ hoi. // Chapp.138

ēha na cinta mahā-dumaha jiva mahu mūlu palīṇu
nisi andhārī vappuḍā sauṇā kattha nilīṇā. // Chapp.139

jonhā-jaleṇa bhuvaṇ'-antarāĩ de bharasu puṇṇimā-yanda:
ko jāṇaï a-thirā ke-ciraṁ ca tuha erisā riddhī? // Chapp.140

dijjaï dhaṇu maggantāhã; patta-parikkhaha kāĩ?
kiṁ varisantau anka-haru, jōvaï sama-visamāĩ? // Chapp.141

bali-bandhaṇa pekkhēvi naru, patta-parikkha karēha
ōhu bhaṭṭau na ucchuḍaï, jō ni-ssīlaha dēi. // Chapp.142

dejjasu mā sankejjasu; esā su-mahaggha-rayaṇa-nimmaviyā
putta srī mayahara-thāla vva ya vāreṇa sankamaï. // Chapp.143

aṇ-avarayaṁ ciya dento, koi naro hoi viula-riddhillo;
niccaṁ ciya sancanto koi sayā duggao hoi. // Chapp.144

rāy'-aggi-cora-harie lakkha-sahasse kahei para-naṭṭhe
abbhatthio u jamhā, dāliddaṁ dāṇa-gahaṇaṁ ca. // Chapp.145

thevā vi sā gaṇijjaï riddhī jā sayala-loya-sāmannā:
pijjaï vāviĕ jalaṁ, na uṇa samuddassa thevaṁ pi. // Chapp.146

taṁ tattiyaṁ jalaṁ sāyarassa so cceva parama-vitthāro;
ekkaṁ pi palaṁ taṁ natthi jaṁ pivāsā nivārei. // Chapp.147

nā khajjaï nā pijjaï
nā dijjaï vihalāhaṁ
dhattūrā-halu jaïsi
sampai hoi khalāhaṁ. // Chapp.148

cāi-aṇa-kara-parampara-pariyattaṇa-kheya-vasaṇa-parisantā
atthā kivaṇa-ghara-tthā satthāvatthā suvanti vva. // Chapp.149

savvāyareṇa taïyā thutthukkiya-rakkhiyā payatteṇa
kiviṇāṇaṁ jā riddhī para-sāvatthā kumāri vva. // Chapp.150

ōhaya acchaï thutthukiya sampaya kiviṇa-gharēhĩ
thērēṇa vi vivāhīya bhunjēsī avarēhĩ. // Chapp.151

sīsaṁ paliya-palittaṁ thaṇ-antaraṁ viyaliyā muhe dantā,
kampanti do vi hatthā; taha vi maṇaṁ jovvaṇaṁ vahaï. // Chapp.152

dūrōṇāmiya-bhamuhā, pae pae kiṁ visesa-pucchantā
naṭṭhaṁ ca jovvaṇaṁ mahi-yalammi therā gavesanti. // Chapp.153

parihaṇu para-karēhĩ parihijjaï
diyahi diyahi angaṁ parijhijjaï,
bhūmihi kara ṭhāvēvi uṭhijjaï,
taha vi dhammu aṇudiṇu na vi kijjaï. // Chapp.154

siri ekk'-ekkaṁ paliyaḍaṁ, païṭṭhaṁ aggī-bāṇu
nīsaru jovvaṇa-pāhuṇā, jara khaṇḍēsī māṇu. // Chapp.155

bhaviyāṇa taṁ mahāyasa saṁsāra-samudda-nicca-paḍiyāṇaṁ
nijjāmao si sāmiya duggaya-salile nibuḍḍāṇaṁ. // Chapp.156

eaṁ gāhā-kosaṁ jo paḍhaï viyaḍḍha-viraïyaṁ loke
so pāvi viula-riddhī jaṇammi sohaggayaṁ lahaï. // Chapp.157

[(supplément)]
jiṇa-sāsaṇammi bhattī, paṇḍiya-goṭṭhī visiṭṭha-saṁsaggī
muṇivara-dāṇa-pasango na hoi thevehi puṇṇehiṁ. // Chapp.158

na ya bāhaï kamala-vaṇaṁ; appā pīṇaï piei mayarandaṁ
eso bhamara-juvāṇo keṇaï niuṇattaṇa-guṇeṇa. // Chapp.159

lajjijjaï jeṇa jaṇe, maïlijjaï niya-kula-kkamo jeṇa
kaṇṭha-ṭṭhie vi jīe, mā sundara taṁ kuṇijjāsu. // Chapp.160

ārogga-sāriyaṁ māṇusattaṇaṁ sacca-sārio dhammo
vijjā nicchaya-sārā, suhāĩ santosa-sārāiṁ. // Chapp.161

pattammi ya pāhuṇae, kiṁ kāhī duggao turanto vi?
andho maliehiṁ loyaṇehĩ andho cciya varāo. // Chapp.162

jeṇa ṇa kiṁci vi kajjaṁ tassa vi gharam āgayassa je suyaṇā
niccaṁ pahasiya-vayaṇā niya-sīsaṁ āsaṇaṁ denti. // Chapp.163

viṇu dhammiṁ hiya-icchiyaĩ āsā-vahi vaṭṭanti
kaṇḍu kavilu jimu kāurisa para-lālaha ghuṇṭanti. // Chapp.164
