---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 191]
[purisaṇindāvajjāpuruṣanindāpaddhatiḥ]

uḍḍhaṁ vaccanti ahō vayanti mūlaṅkura vva bhuvaṇammi ।
vijjāhiyaē kattō kulāhi purisā samuppannā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.702

niyakammēhi vi nīyaṁ uccaṁ purisā lahanti saṇṭhāṇaṁ ।
suramandirakūvayarā uḍḍhaddhamuhā ya vaccanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.703

ēkkammi kulē ēkkammi mandirē ēkkakukkhisambhūyā ।
ēkkō narasayasāmī annō ēkkassa asamatthō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.704

sajjaṇasalāhaṇijjē payammi appā na ṭhāviō jēhiṁ ।
susamatthā jē na parōvayāriṇō tēhi vi na kiṁ pi2 ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.705



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 192]
[kamalavajjākamalapaddhatiḥ]

hiṭṭhakayakaṇṭayāṇaṁ payaḍiyakōsāṇa mittasamuhāṇaṁ ।
māmi guṇavantayāṇaṁ kaha kamalē vasaü na hu kamalā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.706

annanna1laggakayapattapariyaṇē nihayagurujaḍājālē ।
mittālōyaṇasuhiē kaha kamalē vasaü na hu kamalā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.707

payaḍiyakōsaguṇaḍḍhē taha ya kulīṇē supattaparivārē ।
ēvaṁvihē vasantī kamalē kamalē kayatthā si ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.708

jaḍasaṁvāhiyapharusattaṇassa niṇhaviyaṇiyaguṇōhassa ।
rē kamala tujjha kamalā nivasaï rattāṇa pattāṇa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.709


[p. 193]
jaha palahiguṇā parachiddachāyaṇē1 taha nu kamala jaï tujjha ।
tā iha sayalē lōē kā avamā tava ṭhavijjanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.710



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[kamalaṇindāvajjā ( kamalanindāpaddhatiḥ )]

aliyālāvē viyasanta kamala kaliō si rāyahaṁsēhiṁ ।
tā sundaraṁ na hōhī tujjha phalaṁ kālapariṇāmē ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.711

appaṁ2 paraṁ na yāṇasi nūṇaṁ saüṇō si lacchipariyariō ।
ujjalasamuhō pēcchaha tā vayaṇaṁ pi hu na ṭhāvēi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.712

lacchīē parigahiyā uḍḍhamuhā jaï na hunti tā pēccha ।
jēhiṁ ciya uḍḍhaviyā taṁ ciya nālaṁ na pēcchanti ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.713


[p. 194]
lacchiṇilayattaṇuttāṇavayaṇa guṇiṇō sayāṇulaggassa ।
niyaṇālassa vi vimuhō tā paṅkaya kassa samuhō si ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.714

vaḍḍhāviyakōsō jaṁ si kamala parisōsiēhi pattēhiṁ ।
acchaü tā lacchivaō taṁ ciya nāmaṁ pi hārihisi ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.715

mittō sūrō kayapattapariyarō lacchiyālaō kamalō ।
payahīṇassa sahārō kēṇāvi na sakkiō nimisaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.716

sarasāṇa sūrapariṁsaṇṭhiyāṇa kamalāṇa kīsa uvayārō ।
ukkhayamūlā sukkhantapaṅkayā kaha na saṇṭhaviyā ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.717



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 195]
[haṁsamāṇasavajjāhaṁsamānasapaddhatiḥ]

chaṇḍijjaï haṁsa saraṁ kattō vāsō parammuhē divvē ।
jāva na ṭhavēi calaṇē kūḍabaō matthaē ēṇhiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.718

paḍhamaṁ ciya jē vigayā ghaṇāgamē sāhu tāṇa haṁsāṇaṁ ।
jēhi na diṭṭhaṁ uccāsaṇaṭṭhiyaṁ khalabayakuḍumbaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.719

iyaravihaṅgamapayapanticittalā jattha puliṇapērantā ।
tattha sarē na hu juttaṁ vasiyavvaṁ rāyahaṁsāṇaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.720

vivihavihaṅgamaṇivahēṇa maṇḍiyaṁ pēcchiūṇa kamalavaṇaṁ ।
mukkaṁ māṇabbhariēhi māṇasaṁ rāyahaṁsēhiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.721



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 196]
[cakkavāyavajjācakravākapaddhatiḥ]

addhatthamiē surē jaṁ dukkhaṁ hōi cakkavāyassa ।
taṁ hōu tuha riūṇaṁ ahavā tāṇaṁ pi mā hōu ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.722

bhūmīgayaṁ na cattā sūraṁ daṭaṭhūṇa cakkavāēṇa ।
jīyaggala vva dinnā muṇāliyā virahabhīēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.723

aggi vva paümasaṇḍaṁ ciya vva naliṇī maḍō vva appā ṇaṁ ।
cakkēṇa piṁyāvirahē masāṇasarisaṁ saraṁ diṭṭhaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.724

āsāsijjaï cakkō jalagayapaḍibimbadaṁsaṇāsāē ।
taṁ pi haranti taraṅgā pēcchaha niuṇṇattaṇaṁ vihiṇō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.725


[p. 197]
āsanti saṅgamāsā gamanti rayaṇiṁ suhēṇa cakkāyā ।
diyahā na ya hunti viōyakāyarā kaha nu vōlanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.726

aliyaṁ jampēi jaṇō jaṁ pēmmaṁ hōi atthalōhēṇa ।
sēvālajīviyāṇaṁ kaō dhaṇaṁ cakkavāyāṇaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.727



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[candaṇavajjācandanapaddhatiḥ]

susiēṇa nihasiēṇa vi taha kaha vi hu candaṇēṇa mahamahiyaṁ ।
sarasā vi kusumamālā jaha jāyā parimalavilakkhā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.728


[p. 198]
parasucchēyapaharaṇēṇa nihasaṇēm̐ nēya ujjhiyā payaī ।
candaṇa saṁnayasīsō tēṇa tumaṁ vandaē lōō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.729

uttamakulēsu jammaṁ tuha candaṇa taruvarāṇa majjhammi ।
dujjīhāṇa khalāṇa ya niccaṁ ciya tēṇa aṇurattō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.730

ēkkō ciya dōsō tārisassa candaṇadumassa vihighaḍiō ।
jīsē duṭṭhabhuyaṅgā khaṇaṁ pi pāsaṁ na mēllanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.731

bahutaruvarāṇa majjhē candaṇaviḍavō bhuyaṅgadōsēṇa ।
chijjaï nirāvarāhō sāhu vva asāhusaṅgēṇa ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.732



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[vaḍavajjāvaṭapaddhatiḥ]

jāō si kīsa panthē ahavā jāō si kīsa phaliō si ।
aha phaliō si mahāduma tā saüṇabiḍambaṇaṁ sahasu ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.733


[p. 199]
nīrasa-karīra-kharakhaïrasaṅkulē visamasamimaruddēsē ।
kā hōjja gaī pahiyāṇa jaṁ si vaḍapāyava na hōntō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.734

bhūmīguṇēṇa vaḍapāyavassa jaï tuṅgimā ihaṁ hōi ।
taha vi hu phalāṇa riddhī hōsaï bīyāṇusārēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.735



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[tālavajjātālapaddhatiḥ]

kiṁ tāla tujjha tuṅgattaṇēṇa gayaṇaddharuddhamaggēṇa ।
chuhajalaṇatāviēhi vi uvahēppasi jaṁ na pahiēhiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.736

chāyārahiyassa nirāsayassa dūrayaradāviyaphalassa ।
dōsēhi samā jā kā vi tuṅgimā tujjha rē tāla ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.737


[p. 200]
jēhiṁ nīō vaḍḍhiṁ tālō sayasaliladāṇasēvāē ।
tassēva jō na phaliō sō phaliō kaha nu annassa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.738



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[palāsavajjāpalāśapaddhatiḥ]

maülantassa ya mukkā tujjha palāsā palāsa saüṇēhiṁ ।
jēṇa mahumāsasamaē niyavayaṇaṁ jhatti sāmaliyaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.739

acchaü tā phalaṇivahaṁ phullaṇadiyahammi kalusiyaṁ vayaṇaṁ ।
iya kaliūṇa palāsō jhaḍa tti mukkō sapattēhiṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.740

daṭṭhūṇa kiṁsuyā sāhā taṁ bālāi kīsa vēlaviō ।
ahavā na tujjha dōsō kō na hu chaliō palāsēhiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.741


[p. 201]
guruvihavavittharutthambhirē vi kiviṇammi atthiṇō vihalā ।
bhaṇa phaliē vi palāsē maṇōrahā kassa jāyanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.742

saccaṁ palāsa jaṁ phulliō si phaliō si rahaṇiuñjēsu ।
jaï hōjja sukhajjaphalō maṇaṁ pi tā tujjha kō mullō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.743



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[vaḍavāṇalavajjāvaḍavānalapaddhatiḥ]

sōsaṇamaī u nivasasu vaḍavāṇala muṇaï jāva na samuddō ।
jāva ya jāṇihii phuḍaṁ tā na tumaṁ nēya bhuvaṇayalaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.744


[p. 202]
kā samasīsī tiyasindayāṇa vaḍavāṇalassa sarisammi ।
uvasamiyasihippasarō mayaraharō indhaṇaṁ jassa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.745



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[rayaṇāyaravajjāratnākarapadghatiḥ]

rayaṇāyarēṇa rayaṇaṁ parimukkaṁ jaï vi amuṇiyaguṇēṇa ।
taha vi hu maragayakhaṇḍaṁ jattha gayaṁ tattha vi mahagdhaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.746

jalaṇihimukkēṇa vi kutthuhēṇa pattaṁ murārivacchayalaṁ ।
tēṇa puṇa tassa ṭhāṇē na yāṇimō kō pariṭṭhaviō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.747

mā dōsaṁ ciya gēṇhaha viralē vi guṇē pasaṁsaha jaṇassa ।
akkhapaürō vi uvahī bhaṇṇaï rayaṇāyarō lōē ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.748


[p. 203]
vēlāmahallakallōlapēlliyaṁ jaï vi giriṇaïṁ pattaṁ ।
aṇusaraï maggalaggaṁ puṇō vi rayaṇāyarē rayaṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.749

lacchīi viṇā rayaṇāyarassa gambhīrimā taha ccēva ।
sā lacchī tēṇa viṇā bhaṇa kassa na mandiraṁ pattā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.750

vaḍavāṇalēṇa gahiō mahiō ya surāsurēhi sayalēhiṁ ।
lacchīi uvahi mukkō pēcchaï gambhīrimā tassa ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.751

jalaṇaṁ jalaṁ ca, amiyaṁ, visaṁ ca, kaṇhō sadāṇavō ccēva ।
khīrōyahi tujjha tahā paramahimā ahiyaahiyayarō ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.752


[p. 204]
rayaṇēhi nirantarapūriēhi rayaṇāyarassa na hu gavvō ।
kariṇō muttāhalasaṁsaē vi mayavibbhalā1 diṭṭhī ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.753

aṇavarayaṁ dēntassa vi tuṭṭanti na sāyarē vi rayaṇāiṁ ।
puṇṇakkhaēṇa khijjaï na hu lacchī cāyabhōēhiṁ ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.754

rayaṇāyarassa na hu hōi tucchimā niggaēhi rayaṇēhiṁ ।
taha vi hu candasaricchā viralā rayaṇāyarē rayaṇā ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.755

rayaṇāyaracattēṇa vi pattaṁ candēṇa haraha tilayattaṁ ।
tēṇa uṇa tassa ṭhāṇē na yāṇimō kō piriṭṭhaviō ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.756


[p. 205]
jaï vi hu kālavasēṇaṁ sasī samuddāu kaha vi vicchuḍiō ।
taha vi hu tassa payāvaṁ ( ? payāsō ) āṇandaṁ kuṇaï dūrē vi ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.757

rayaṇāi surāṇa samappiūṇa vaḍavāṇalassa chuhiyassa ।
appā ( ? appaṁ ) dēntēṇa taē samudda muddaṅkiyaṁ bhuvaṇaṁ ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.758

atthi asaṅkhā saṅkhā dhavalā rayaṇāyarassa sambhūyā ।
na hu tāṇa saddaladdhī jā jāyā pañcajannassa ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.759

jāēṇa tēṇa dhavalīkaō si nūṇaṁ samudda saṅkhēṇa ।
atthittaṇēṇa hatthaṁ pasāriyaṁ jassa kaṇhēṇa ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.760



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 206]
[samuddaṇindāvajjāsamudranindāpaddhatiḥ]

sāhīṇāmayarayaṇō amaramarōraṁ ca bhuvaṇamakarantō ।
ullasirīhi na lajjasi laharīhi taraṅgiṇīṇāha ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.761

rayaṇāyara tti nāmaṁ vahanta tā uvahi kiṁ na susiō si ।
majjhē na jāṇavattī atthatthī jaṁ gayā pārē ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.762

uvahi laharīhi gavvira gajjantō kiṁ na dīha susiō si ।
jīsē gimhapivāsā valanti vi parammuhā pahiyā ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.763

sāyara lajjāi kahaṁ na muō cintāi kaha na vīsannō ।
paï huntē bōhitthiyahi kaō jalasaṅgahō annō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.764


[p. 207]
baddhō si tumaṁ pīō si puvvayaṁ laṅghiō si taṁ uvahi1 ।
kiṁ gajjasi aliyajaē na lajjasē uyahi kiṁ bhaṇimō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.765

niddhōyaüdayakaṅkhira panthiya mā vacca sāyarō ēsa ।
jattha niyattaï taṇhā anna cciya tē saruddēsā ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.766



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[suvaṇṇavajjāsuvarṇapaddhatiḥ]

jalaṇapavēsō cāmīyarassa kaha sahi na jujjaē kāuṁ ।
haddhī jassa parikkhanti pattharā navari guṇaṇivahaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.767


[p. 208]
jalaṇaḍahaṇēṇa na tahā pattharaghasaṇēṇa khaṇḍaṇē taha ya ।
guñjāhalasamatulaṇē jaṁ dukkhaṁ hōi kaṇayassa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.768

jūrijjaï kiṁ na jaē kiṁ na jarā āvaē akālammi ।
jaha sakkhara tulaï khalī nirakkharō kañcaṇaṁ khaṇḍaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.769

nārāya nirakkhara lōhavanta dōmuha1 ya tujjha kiṁ bhaṇimō ।
guñjāi samaṁ kaṇayaṁ2 tōlantō kaha na lajjēsi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.770

jaha kaṇayaṁ taha paḍimāṇapattharaṁ pēccha tulaï nārāō ।
ahavā nirakkharāṇaṁ guṇadōsaviyāraṇā kattō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.771



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 209]
[āiccavajjāādityapaddhatiḥ]

bhamiō si bhamasi bhamihisi aṇudiṇu1 pāsammi mērusiharassa ।
jaï pāvasi kañcaṇamāsayaṁ pi tā sūra sūrō si ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.772

viyaliyatēēṇa vi sasaharēṇa jaha daṁsiō diṇē appā ।
taha jaï rayaṇīi tumaṁ tā saccaṁ sūra sūrō si ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.773

uyaṇaṁ bhuvaṇakkamaṇaṁ atthamaṇaṁ ēkkadivasamajjhammi2 ।
sūrassa vi tinni dasā3 kā gaṇaṇā iyaralōyassa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.774



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[dīvayavajjādīpakapaddhatiḥ]

saüṇō nēhasaüṇṇō lōillō lōyalōyaṇāṇandō ।
nāsiyatamōhapasarō kiṁ suyaṇō nēha4 jōikkhō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.775


[p. 210]
jōikkhō gilaï tamaṁ taṁ ciya uggilaï kajjalamisēṇaṁ ।
ahavā suddhasahāvā hiyaē kalusaṁ na dhārēnti1 ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.776

niyayālaēsu maliṇā kuṇanti maliṇattaṇaṁ jaïcchāē ।
guṇaṇēhakantijuttaya na jujjaē tujjha jōikkha ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.777

niyaguṇaṇēhakhayaṅkara maliṇaṁ niyayālayaṁ kuṇantassa ।
jōikkha tujjha chāyā paricattā tēṇa suyaṇēhiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.778


[p. 211]
kiṁ tujjha pahāē kiṁ guṇēṇa kiṁ dīva tujjha nēhēṇa ।
chāyaṁ jassa visiṭṭhā dūrē vi cayanti nindantā1 ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.779



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[piyōllāvavajjāpriyōllāpapaddhatiḥ]

ēkkēṇa viṇā piyamāṇusēṇa bahuyāi hunti dukkhāiṁ ।
ālassō raṇaraṇaō'ṇiddā pulaō sasajjhasaō2 ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.780

ēkkēṇa viṇā piyamāṇusēṇa sabbhāvaṇēhabhariēṇaṁ3 ।
jaṇasaṅkulā vi puhavī avvō raṇṇaṁ va paḍihāi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.781

sō kattha gaō sō suyaṇavallahō sō suhāṇa sayakhāṇī ।
sō mayaṇaggiviṇāsō sō sō sōsēi maha hiyayaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.782


[p. 212]
sō hōhii kō vi diṇō jattha piō bāhupañjaravilīṇō ।
raïrahasakhēyakhinnō nijjharaï pavāsadukkhāiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.783

āvihii piō cumbihii niṭṭhuraṁ1 cumbiūṇa pucchihii ।
daïē kusala tti tumaṁ namō2 namō tāṇa divasāṇaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.784

dhannaṁ taṁ cēva diṇaṁ sā rayaṇī sayalalakkhaṇasaüṇṇā ।
amayaṁ3 taṁ pi muhuttaṁ jattha piō jhatti dīsihii ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.785

dūrayaradēsaparisaṇṭhiyassa piyasaṅgamaṁ mahantassa ।
āsābandhō cciya māṇusassa avalambaē jīvaṁ4 ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.786


[p. 213]
hiyayaṭiṭhaō vi suhavō taha vi hu nayaṇāṇa hōi duppēcchō ।
pēcchaha vihiṇā va kayā1 maha hiyaē jālayagavakkhā ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.787



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[dōsiyavajjādauṣikapaddhatiḥ]

dīhaṁ laṇhaṁ bahusuttarundayaṁ kaḍiyalammi suhajaṇayaṁ ।
taha vāsaṁ ca mahagghaṁ dōsiya kaḍilamha paḍihāi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.788

māṇavihūṇaṁ rundīi chōḍayaṁ siladhōyagayachāyaṁ ।
jaṁ vasaṇaṁ na suhāvaï muya dūraṁ nammayāḍē taṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.789

pammuhasuttaṁ aṭṭhīsuhāvahaṁ jaṇiyarāyapulaïllaṁ ।
dōsiya dijjantaṁ pi hu nāraṅgaṁ amha paḍihāi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.790


[p. 214]
jaṁ pakkhāliyasāraṁ jaṁ garuyaṁ cēva samamahagghaṁ ca ।
taṁ dōsiya amhāṇaṁ daṁsijjaü kiṁ viyārēṇa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.791

dōsiya ghaṇaguṇasāraṁ suviṇīyaṁ suṭṭhu sōhasañjaṇayaṁ ।
daṁsahi mā kuṇa khēyaṁ taṁ amhaṁ jaṇaï pariōsaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.792

jaha paḍhamē taha dīsaï avasāṇē sāḍayassa nivvahaṇaṁ ।
taṁ phuḍu amha niyambē dōsiya phuṭṭaṁ pi paḍihāi ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.793



---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 215]
[pajjantagāhājuyalaṁparyantagāthāyugalam]

aha pajjantagāhājuyalaṁ bhaṇṇaï ।

iya kaïyaṇēhi raïē vajjālaē sayalalōyahiṭṭhiē2 ।
patthāvē gōṭṭhiṭṭhiya icchiyagāhā paḍhijjanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.794

ēyaṁ vajjālaggaṁ ṭhāṇaṁ gahiūṇa paḍhaï jō kō vi ।
niyaṭhāṇē patthāvē guruttaṇaṁ lahaï sō purisō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.795


[p. 216]

[gāhāvajjā]
gāhā ruaï aṇāhā sīsē kāūṇa dō vi hatthāō ।
sukaīhi dukkharaïyā suhēṇa mukkhō viṇāsēi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.15-1

kuppāḍhaēhi kullēhaēhi atthaṁ ayāṇamāṇōhiṁ ।
nayari vva chattabhaṅgē luñcapaluñcīkiyā gāhā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.16-1

vāsasaēṇa vi baddhā ēkkā vi maṇōharā varaṁ gāhā ।
lakkhaṇarahiyā na uṇō kōḍī vi khaṇaddhamēttēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.16-2


[p. 217]
gāhāhi kō na hīraï piyāṇa mittāṇa kō na sambharaï ।
dūmijjaï kō na vi dūmiēṇa suyaṇēṇa rayaṇēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.18-1

[kavvavajjā]
sarasā vi hu kavvakahā pariōsaṁ jaṇaï kassa vi maṇammi ।
viyasanti na sayalatarū varataruṇīcaraṇaphāsēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.31-1

aṇusaraï maggalaggaṁ ajja vi kaïmahuyarāṇa riñchōlī ।
tāṇa chiillāṇa namō pāiya kaïgandhahatthīṇaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.31-2

ḍajjhaü sakkapakavvaṁ sakkapakavvaṁ ca nimmiyaṁ jēṇa ।
vaṁsaharammi palittē taḍayaḍataṭṭattaṇaṁ kuṇaï ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.31-3


[p. 218]
pāiyakavvullāvē paḍivayaṇaṁ sakkaēṇa jō dēi ।
sō kusumasattharaṁ pattharēṇa daliuṁ viṇāsēi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.31-4

chandēṇa viṇā kavvaṁ lakkhaṇarahiyammi sakkayālāvaṁ ।
rūvaṁ viṇā maraṭṭhō tiṇṇi vi sōhaṁ na pāvanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.31-5

taṁ kiṁ vuccaï kavvaṁ tēṇa kaēṇāvi viṇaḍiō appā ।
ēkkasuya vva kuḍumbē hatthā hatthē na jaṁ bhamaï ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.31-6

aïcampiyaṁ viṇassaï dantacchēēṇa hōi vicchāyaṁ ।
ḍhalahalayaṁ ciya muccaï pāiyakavvaṁ ca pēmmaṁ ca ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.31-7


[p. 219]
[sajjaṇavajjā]
khuhaï na kaḍuyaṁ jampaï lēi na dōsē guṇē pasāsēi ।
rūsantāṇa na rūsaï dakkhiṇṇamahōyahī suyaṇō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.48-1

suyaṇassa hōi sukkhaṁ na tēttiyaṁ jēttiyaṁ duhaṁ hōi ।
jaṁ jaṁ picchaha duhiyaṁ taṁ taṁ aṇusōyamāṇassa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.48-2

hōnti parakajjaṇirayā niyakajjaparaṁmuhā phuḍaṁ suyaṇā ।
candō dhavalēi mahiṁ na kalaṅkaṁ attaṇō phusaï ॥ 3॥ // VajLag.48-3

saccuccaraṇā paḍivannapālaṇā garuyabhāraṇivvahaṇā ।
dhīrā pasannavayaṇā suyaṇā cirajīvaṇā hōntu ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.48-4


[p. 220]
vihavakkhaē vi suyaṇō sēvaï raṇṇaṁ na jampaē dīṇaṁ ।
maraṇē vi mahagghayaraṁ vikkaē māṇamāṇikkaṁ1 ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.48-5

[dujjaṇavajjā]
taṁ natthi gharaṁ taṁ natthi dēulaṁ rāulaṁ pi taṁ natti ।
jattha akāraṇakuviyā dō tinni khalā na dīsanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.64-1

khalasaṅgē paricattē pēcchaha tillēṇa jaṁ phalaṁ pattaṁ ।
miyaṇāhisurahivāsiyapahusīsaṁ uvalahantēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.64-2

dhannā bahirandhaliyā dō cciya jīvanti māṇusē lōē ।
na suṇanti pisuṇavayaṇaṁ khalassa riddhī na pēcchanti ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.64-3


[p. 221]
ārambha cciya caḍuyārayāṇa nippannakajjavimuhāṇaṁ ।
maṇḍalasurayāṇa va dujjaṇāṇa maggō cciya aüvvō1 ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.64-4

payaḍiyapayāvaguṇakittaṇēṇa lajjanti jē mahāsattā ।
iyarā puṇa aliyapasaṁsaṇē vi aṅgē na māyanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.64-5

[mittavajjā]
surasaripūraṁ vaḍaviḍavituṅgimā suyaṇalōyapaḍivannaṁ ।
paḍhamaṁ ciya tē lahuyā pacchā jāyanti garuyāiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.72-1


[p. 222]
addiṭṭhē raṇaraṇaō diṭṭhē īsā ādiṭṭhaē māṇō ।
dūraṁ gaē vi dukkhaṁ piē jaṇē sahi suhaṁ kattō1 ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.72-2

ajjāhaṁ pupphavaī tumaṁ pi rē cumbaṇasayaṇhō ।
taha cumba jaha na chippasi bhaṇiūṇa samappiō aharō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.72-3

hatthē ṭhiyaṁ kavālaṁ na muyaï varāī khaṇaṁ pi khaṭṭaṅgaṁ ।
sā niddaya tujjha kaē bālā kāvāliṇī jāyā2 ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.72-4

kīraï samuddataraṇaṁ pavisijjaï huyavahammi pajjaliē ।
āyāmijjaï maraṇaṁ natthi dulandhaṁ simēhassa ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.72-5


[p. 223]
mā jāṇasi1 vīsariyaṁ tuha muhakamalaṁ vidēsagamaṇammi ।
sunnaṁ bhamaï karaṅkaṁ jattha tumaṁ jīviyaṁ tattha ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.72-6

raṇaraṇaï gharaṁ raṇaraṇaï dēulaṁ rāulaṁ pi raṇaraṇaï ।
ēkkēṇa viṇā sundari raṇaraṇaï sasāyarā puhavī ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.72-7

bahalē tamandhayārē vijjujjōēṇa dīsaē maggō ।
ahisāriyāṇa nēhō atthi-aṇatthī payāsēi ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.72-8

[nēhavajjā]
guṇavajjiē vi nēhō aha nēhō hōi kassa vi kahaṁ pi2 ।
mōttūṇa maṇaharadumē nimbammi divāyarō vasaï ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.80-1


[p. 224]
dūrayaradēsaparisaṇṭhiyassa piyasaṅgamaṁ vahantassa ।
āsābandhō cciya māṇusassa parirakkhē jīyaṁ1 ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.80-2

ēkkēṇa viṇā piyamāṇusēṇa sabbhāvaṇēhabhariēṇa ।
jaṇasaṅkulā vi puhavī avvō raṇṇaṁ va paḍibhāi2 ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.80-3

[nīivajjā]
lavaṇasamō natthi rasō vinnāṇasamō ya bandhavō natthi ।
dhammasabhō nanthi nihī kōhasamō vēriō nanthi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.90-1

mahilā jattha pahāṇā ḍimbhō rāyā nirakkharō mantī ।
acchaü tā dhaṇāriddhī jīyaṁ rakkhaü payattēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.90-2

jassa na giṇhanti guṇā suyaṇā gō़ṭṭhīsu ramamuhē suhaḍā ।
niyajaṇaṇijōbvaṇulluraṇēṇa jāēṇa kiṁ tēṇa3 ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.90-3


[p. 225]
kupputtēhi kulāiṁ gāmaṇagarāi pisuṇasīlēhiṁ ।
nāsanti kumantīhiṁ narāhivā suṭṭhu vi samiddhā ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.90-4

nāsaï vāēṇa tusaṁ nāsaï gēyaṁ jaṇassa saddēṇaṁ ।
aguṇijjantī vijjā nāsaï bhajjā pavāsēṇaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.90-5

kajjaṁ ēvva pamāṇaṁ kaha va tulaggēṇa kajjaïttāṇaṁ ।
jaï taṁ avahērijjaï pacchā uṇa dullahaṁ hōi ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.90-6

mā hōsu suyaggāhī mā pattīya jaṁ na diṭṭha paccakkhaṁ ।
paccakkhē vi tha diṭṭhē juttājuttaṁ viyārēha ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.90-7

dhammō dhaṇāṇa mūlaṁ jāyā mūlaṁ suhāṇa sayalāṇaṁ ।
viṇaō guṇāṇa mūlaṁ dappō mūlaṁ viṇāsassa ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.90-8


[p. 226]
nāsaï jūēṇa dhaṇaṁ nāsēi kulaṁ asīlavantāṇaṁ ।
aïrūvēṇa vi mahilā nāsaï rāyā kumantīhiṁ ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.90-9

jammantaraṁ na garuyaṁ purisassa guṇagaṇaggahaṇaṁ ।
muttāhalaṁ ca garuyaṁ na hu garuyaṁ sippisaṁuḍayaṁ ॥ 10 ॥1 // VajLag.90-10

jaṁ jāṇaï bhaṇaü jaṇō guṇāṇa vihavassa antaraṁ garuyaṁ ।
labbhaï guṇēhi vihavō vihavēṇa guṇā na labbhanti2 ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.90-11

12) buddhī saccaṁ mittaṁ caranta nō mahākavvaṁ ( ? ) ।
puvvaṁ savvaṁ pi suhaṁ pacchā dukkhēṇa nivvahaï ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.90

kiṁ vā guṇēhi kīraï kiṁ vā rūvēṇa kiṁ ca sīlēṇa ।
dhaṇavirahiyāṇa sundari narāṇa kō āyaraṁ kuṇaï3 ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.90-13

ṭhāṇaṁ guṇēhi labbhaï tā guṇagahaṇaṁ avassa kāyavvaṁ ।
hārō vi guṇavihūṇō na pāvaē taruṇithaṇavaṭṭaṁ ॥ 14 ॥4 // VajLag.90-14


[p. 227]
dēsē gāmē nayarē rāyapahē tiyacaükkamaggē vā ।
jassa na viyaraï kittī dhiratthu kiṁ tēṇa jāēṇa1 ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.90-15

[sāhasavajjā]
vihavakkhaē vi dāṇaṁ māṇaṁ vasaṇē vi dhīrimā maraṇē ।
kajjasaē vi amōhō pasāhaṇaṁ dhīrapurisāṇaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.119-1

dhīrā mayā vi kajjaṁ niyayaṁ sāhanti, pēcchaha harassa ।
daḍḍhēṇa vi avaraddhaṁ avahariyaṁ kusumabāṇēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.119-2

jaha jaha vāēi vihī visarisakaraṇēhi niṭṭhuraṁ paḍahaṁ ।
dhīrā pahasiyavayaṇā naccanti ya taha taha ccēva ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.119-3


[p. 228]
appatthiyaṁ na labbhaï, patthijjantō vi kuppasi narinda ।
haddhī kahaṁ sahijjaï kayantavasahiṁ gaē santē ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.161-1

[suhaḍavajjā]
cirayālasaṇṭhiyāiṁ sāmiyajaṇiyāi māṇadukkhāēṁ ।
riugayadasaṇappēllaṇavivarēhi bhaḍassa galiyāiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.178-1

kaddamaruhiravilittō raṇaṅgaṇē nēya nivaḍiō suhaḍō ।
aïsāhasēṇa bhīō indō amaēṇa siñcēi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.178-2

ēkkattō ruyaï piyā annattō samaratūraṇigghōsā ।
pēmmēṇa raṇarasēṇa ya bhaḍassa dōlāiyaṁ hiyayaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.178-3


[p. 229]
[gayavajjā]
siddhaṅgaṇāuratthalathaṇabharucchalantamantharataraṅgaṁ ।
sumarantō cciya marihisi gaïnda rē nammayāṇīraṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.199-1

dantullihaṇaṁ savvaṅgamajjaṇaṁ hatthacallaṇāyāsaṁ ।
pōḍhagaïndāṇa mayaṁ puṇō vi jaï nammayā sahaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.199-2

sayalajaṇapicchaṇijjō jō appā āsi sō taē mūḍha ।
kēsaribhaēṇa bhajjanta ajja lahuyattaṇaṁ pattō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.199-3


[p. 230]
saralā muhē na jīhā thōvō hatthō maübbhaḍā diṭṭhī ।
rē rayaṇakōḍigavvira gaïnda na hu sēvaṇijjō si ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.199-4

kuñjara maïndadaṁsaṇavimukkapukkāramayapasaṅgēṇa ।
na hu navari taē appā vi sō vi lahuyattaṇaṁ pattō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.199-5

[vāhavajjā]
ō suyaï villaravvillaluliyadhammillakuntalakalāvō ।
annattha vacca vāṇiya amhaṁ muttāhalaṁ kattō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.214-1

intīi kulaharāō nāyaṁ vāhīi bhattuṇō maraṇaṁ ।
gayamayakavōlaṇihasaṇamalamaïlakarañjasāhāhiṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.214-2


[p. 231]
na tahā païmaraṇē vi hu ruṇṇaṁ vāhīi nibbharakkaṇṭhaṁ ।
jaha pallisamāsannē gaïndagalagajjiyaṁ sōuṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.214-3

pallipaēsē pajjūsaṇiggayaṁ luliyakuntalakalāvaṁ ।
daṭṭhūṇa vāhavandaṁ dantakkaïyā niyattanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.214-4

acchaü tā karivahaṇaṁ tuha taṇuō dhaṇuharaṁ samullihaï ।
thōrathirathaṇaharāṇaṁ kiṁ amha māhappaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.214-5


[p. 232]
dē jaṁ pi taṁ pi ahilasasu pallavaṁ mā kahiṁ pi1 rē karaha ।
uḍḍhamuhadīhasāsō valli sarantō vivajjihisi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.226-1

kaha vi tulaggāvaḍiyaṁ mahupaḍalaṁ cakkhiūṇa mā khijja ।
hiyaïcchiyāi kattō aṇudiyahaṁ karaha labbhanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.226-2

nīsasasi ruyasi khijjasi jūrasi cintēsi bhamasi ubbimbō ।
sā maraṇassa kaē ṇaṁ karaha taē cakkhiyā vallī ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.226-3

[indindiravajjā]
mōttūṇa viyaḍakēsaramayaranduddāmasurahisayavattaṁ ।
jaṁ mahaï mahuyarō pāḍalāi taṁ kēṇa va guṇēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.252-1


[p. 233]
taṁ kiṁ pi paēsaṁ paṅkayassa bhamiūṇa chappaō chivaï ।
naliṇīṇa jēṇa kaḍḍhaï āmūlagayaṁ pi mayarandaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.252-2

indindira mā khijjasu dē nilasu kahiṁ pi mālaīvirahē ।
hiyaïcchiyāi na hu sampaḍanti divvē parāhuttē1 ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.252-3

bahugandhaluddha mahuyara kamalaüḍaṇiruddha khijjasē kīsa ।
ahavā vasaṇāsattā annē vi suhaṁ na pāvanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.252-4

[haṁsavajjā]
vaccihisi tumaṁ pāvihisi saravaraṁ rāyahaṁsa, kiṁ cōjjaṁ ।
māṇasasarasārikkhaṁ puhavi bhamantō na pāvihisi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.263-1


[p. 234]
māṇasasarōruhāṇaṁ mā sāyaṁ sarasu rē haṁsa ।
kajjāi divvavasasaṇṭhiyāi dukkhēhi labbhanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.263-2

haṁsēhi samaṁ jaha ramaï kamaliṇī taha ya mahuyarēṇāvi ।
siyakasiṇaṇivvisēsāi hōnti mahilāṇa hiyayāiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.263-3

viulaṁ pi jalaṁ jalaraṅkuēhi taha kalusiyaṁ hayāsēhiṁ ।
jaha avasaravaḍiyāṇa vi na hu niyalaṁ rāyahaṁsāṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.263-4

[chaïllavajjā]
akkhaṇḍiyaüvayārā puvvābhāvē abhinnamuharāyā ।
siḍhilantā vi siṇēhaṁ chēyā dukkhēhi najjanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.284-1

tāva cciya ḍhalahalayā jāva cciya nēhapūriyasarīrā ।
chēyā nēhavihūṇā tilasacchāyā khalā hunti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.284-2


[p. 235]
vaṅkabhaṇiyāi kattō kattō addhacchipēcchiyavvāiṁ ।
ūsasiyaṁ pi muṇijjaï chaïllajaṇasaṅkulē gāmē ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.284-3

aṇuṇayakusalaṁ parihāsapēsalaṁ laḍahavāṇisōhillaṁ ।
ālāva cciya chēyāṇa kammaṇaṁ kiṁ ca mūlīhiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.284-4

tē dhannā tāṇa namō tē kusalā tāṇa vammahapasāō ।
jē bālataruṇipariṇayavayāhi hiyaē dharijjanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.284-5

vaṅkaṁ tāṇa na kīraï kiṁ kajjaṁ jassa tē vi yāṇanti ।
sabbhāvēṇa ya chēyā putti dēva vva ghēppanti ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.284-6


[p. 236]
dinnā puṇō vi dijjaü rēhā chēyattaṇammi kaṇhassa ।
jō ramaï gōvisatthaṁ hiyayaṇihittāi lacchīē ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.284-7

hiyaē jaṁ ca nihittaṁ taṁ pi hu jāṇanti buddhīē ।
mā putti vaṅkabandhaṁ jampasi puraō chaïllāṇaṁ ॥ 8 ॥1 // VajLag.284-8

[nayaṇavajjā]
dhaṇu sandhaï bhuyavalayaṁ2 āyaḍḍhaï nayaṇabāṇa kaṇṇantā ।
vindhaï maṇaṁ na jīyaṁ aüvvadhāṇukkiṇī bālā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.300-1

pāmaravahuyāi savammahāṇa nayaṇāṇa rakkhasāṇaṁ va ।
sāsaṅkō bhamaï jaṇō jōyaï maggaṁ pulōyantō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.300-2


[p. 237]
ajjaṁ vi ya tēṇa viṇā imīi ēyāi kasiṇadhavalāiṁ ।
jaccandhagōruyāi va disāsu ghōlanti nayaṇāiṁ ॥ 3 ॥2 // VajLag.300-3

siyakasiṇadīharujjalapamhalaghōlantatāraṇayaṇāṇaṁ ।
taruṇāṇa mā hu hayavihi diṭṭhīpasaraṁ pi bhañjihisi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.300-4

rattaṁ rattēhi siyaṁ siēhi kasiṇaṁ kuṇanti kasiṇēhiṁ ।
siyakasiṇacchīhi taē mayacchi rattō jaṇō cōjjaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.300-5


[p. 238]
gāḍhayaracumbaṇupphusiyabahalaṇīlañjaṇāi rēhanti ।
bapphabhbhintarapasariyagalantabāhāhi acchīiṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.300-6

na maē ruṇṇaṁ na kayamamaṅgalaṁ hōntu sayalasiddhīō ।
virahaggidhūmakaḍuyāviyāi pagalanti nayaṇāiṁ ॥ 7 ॥1 // VajLag.300-7

[thaṇavajjā]
nahakuntaggayabhinnā hārāvalisuttamaṇḍalaggaṭhiyā ।
rēhanti surayarajjāhisēyakalasa vva sē thaṇayā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.312-1

sō taṇhāiyapahiya vva dūmiō tīi diṭṭhamēttēhiṁ ।
panthapavākalasēhi va thaṇēhi ummanthiyamuhēhiṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.312-2


[p. 239]
thaṇakaṇayakalasajuyalaṁ rōmāvalilōhasaṅkalābaddhaṁ ।
kassa kaē ṇaṁ bālā rayaṇaṇihāṇaṁ samuvvahaï ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.312-3

aṇurāyarayaṇabhariyaṁ kañcaṇakalasammi1 taruṇithaṇajuyalaṁ ।
tā kiṁ muhammi kālaṁ masimuddā mayaṇarāyassa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.312-4

ṭhāṇaccuyāṇa sundari maṇḍalarahiyāṇa vihavacattāṇaṁ ।
thaṇayāṇa supurisāṇa ya kō hatthaṁ dēi paḍiyāṇaṁ ॥ 5 ॥2 // VajLag.312-5

nahakuntaggayabhinnā samuhāgayakumbhapīlaṇasamatthā ।
thaṇayā nivvūḍhabharā bhaḍu vva paḍiyā vi sōhanti ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.312-6


[p. 240]
āsannapaḍaṇabhayabhīruēhi jamalēhi sāmalamuhēhiṁ ।
duddhaṁsuēhi ruṇṇaṁ thaṇēhi ṭhāṇaṁ muyantēhiṁ । // VajLag.312-7

aliyā khala vva ku़ḍilā majjhaṁsē kiviṇadāṇasāricchā ।
thaṇayā unnayacintiya na tīi hiyaē na māyanti ॥ 8 ॥1 // VajLag.312-8

thaṇahāraṁ tīi samunnayaṁ pi daṭūṭhūṇa tārisaṁ paḍiyaṁ ।
mā kuṇaü kō vi gavvaṁ ēttha asārammi saṁsārē ॥ 9 ॥2 // VajLag.312-9


[p. 241]
uccaṭṭhāṇā vi susaṅgayā vi sampuṇṇayā vi tuha thaṇayā ।
taruṇamaṇarayaṇasāraṁ haranti jaṁ taṁ mahacchariyaṁ ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.312-10

ṭhāṇayarēhiṁ ēhiṁ ahōmuhēhiṁ aṇavarayapōḍhēhiṁ ।
sihiṇēhi narindēhi va kiṁ kijjaï payavimukkēhiṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.312-11

[lāvaṇṇavajjā]
iha tivaliramaṇē/?/ iha vayaṇakamalē/?/ iha kaḍhiṇaviulathaṇavaṭṭē ।
ajjhāē lāvaṇṇaṁ phaliyaṁ piva ḍhuṅgaḍhuṅgēhiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.318-1

annannā mēhalayā annannō kañcuō navavahūē ।
parihēuṁ na samappaï samāruhantammi tāruṇṇē ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.318-2


[p. 242]
antōkaḍhanta mayaṇaggitāviyaṁ vahaï kaṇayakantillaṁ ।
bālāē lāvaṇṇaṁ upphiṇiyaṁ thaṇabharamisēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.318-3

sahasa tti jaṁ na bhajjaï thaṇaharabhārēṇa majjhataṇuyaṅgī ।
bhañjaṇabhaēṇa vihiṇā dinnō rōmāvalīkhabhō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.318-4

bālākavōlalāvaṇṇaṇijjiō canda khijjasē kīsa ।
aha māṇō na hu kīraü bahurayaṇavibhūsiyā puhavī ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.318-5

bālā lāvaṇṇaṇihī navallavalli vva māuliṅgassa ।
ciñci vva dūrapakkā karēi lālāuyaṁ hiyayaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.318-6


[p. 243]
[surayavajj]
annōnnaṇēhaṇijjhara/?/viiṇṇahiyayāṇa aliyakuviyāṇaṁ ।
pattiyajaṇāṇa suraē jaṁ sōkkhaṁ taṁ phuḍaṁ amayaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.328-1

surayāvasāṇasamaē maüliyaṇayaṇāṇaṇā ya bimbōṭṭhī ।
alahantī surayasuhaṁ pāsatthamuhī piyaṁ bhaṇaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.328-2

surayappasutta kōvaṇa appambhara mā hu rē nivajjihisi ।
kayakajja kiṁ na yāṇasi asamattarayāṇa jaṁ dukkhaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.328-3

calavalayamēhalaravaṁ kalakaliramaṇōharaṁ ca sōūṇa ।
īsā rōsō mahilattaṇaṁ ca mukkaṁ savattīhiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.328-4


[p. 244]
bālā asamattarayā rayāvasāṇammi paharisī bhaṇaï ।
kiṁ suyasi nāha, haṁ 1suyami, kiṁ nu pajjattakajjō si ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.328-5

[pemmavajjā]
paḍhamārambhamaṇaharaṁ ghaṇalaggaṁ māṇarāyaramaṇijjaṁ ।
pēmmaṁ surindacāvaṁ va cañcalaṁ jhatti vōlēi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.349-1

khaṇabhaṅgurēṇa visamēṇa hāriṇā duṇṇivārapasarēṇa ।
aṇavaṭṭhiyasabbhāvēṇa savvahā hōu pēmmēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.349-2


[p. 245]
jaï dēva maha pasannō mā jammaṁ dēhi māṇusē lōē ।
aha jammaṁ mā pēmmaṁ, aha pēmmaṁ mā viōyaṁ ca ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.349-3

annaṁ taṁ sayadaliyaṁ pi milaï rasagōliya vva jaṁ pēmmaṁ ।
amhaṁ mayacchi muttāhalaṁ va phuṭṭaṁ na saṅghaḍaï ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.349-4

daḍhaṇēhaṇālapasariyasabbhāvadalassa raïsuyandhassa ।
pēmmuppalassa muddhē māṇatusārō cciya viṇāsō ॥ 5 ॥1 // VajLag.349-5

avvō jāṇāmi ahaṁ pēmmaṁ ca ivēi lōyamajjhammi ।
thiraāsāē raïyaṁ na pīḍiyaṁ navari divvēṇa ॥ 6 ॥2 // VajLag.349-6


[p. 246]
jā na calaï tā amayaṁ caliyaṁ pēmmaṁ visaṁ visēsēi ।
diṭṭhaṁ suyaṁ va kattha vi mayacchi visagabbhiṇaṁ amayaṁ ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.349-7

bhaggaṁ na jāi ghaḍiuṁ dujjaṇahiyayaṁ kulālabhaṇḍaṁ va ।
sayakhaṇḍaṁ pi ghaḍijjaï kañcaṇakalasō suyaṇacittaṁ ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.349-8

bhaggaṁ puṇō ghaḍijjaï kaṇayaṁ kaṅkaṇayaṇēuraṁ nayaraṁ ।
puṇa bhaggaṁ na ghaḍijjaï pēmmaṁ muttāhalaṁ jaccaṁ ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.349-9

sō kō vi na dīsaï sāmalaṅgi jō ghaḍaï vighaḍiyaṁ pēmmaṁ ।
ghaḍakapparaṁ ca bhaggaṁ na ēi tēhiṁ ciya salēhiṁ ॥ 10 ॥1 // VajLag.349-10


[p. 247]
[māṇavajjā]
dantē tiṇāi kaṇṭhē kuvārayaṁ sundaraṁ ca tuha ēyaṁ ।
māṇamaḍappharaṇaḍiē tuha māṇō kēṇa niddiṭṭhō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.364-1

ēmēva kaha vi mā ṇaṁsiṇīi taha mahamahāviō māṇō ।
jaha khēmakusalasambhāsabhētta sō piō jāō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.364-2

[pavasiyavajjā]
vāsārattē pāvāsiyāṇa virahaggitāvataviyāṇaṁ ।
aṅgēsu laggamāṇō paḍhamāsārō chamacchamaï ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.373-1

[virahavajjā]
jēhiṁ sōhaggaṇihī diṭṭhō nayaṇēhi tē cciya ruyantu ।
aṅgāi apāviyasaṅgamāi tā kīsa khijjanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.389-1


[p. 248]
tuha surayapavaratarupallavaggakavalāṇa laddhamāhappō ।
maha maṇakarahō muddhē dakkhākabalaṁ pi pariharaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.389-2

virahaggijalaṇajālākarāliyaṁ kuvalayacchi maha aṅgaṁ ।
tuha ramaṇamahāṇaïpāṇiēṇa muddhē pavijjhāhi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.389-3

rēhaï piyapaḍirumbhaṇa1 pasāriyaṁ surayamandiraddārē ।
hēlāhallāviyathōrathaṇaharaṁ bhuyalayājuyalaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.389-4

tā jāi tā niyattaï ṭhāṇaṁ gantūṇa jhatti vāhuḍaï ।
piyavirahō ghōḍā viggahō vva hiyaē na saṇṭhāi ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.389-5


[p. 249]
na jalanti na dhagadhaganti na simasimanti na muyanti dhūmavattīō ।
aṅgāi aṇaṅgaparavvasāi ēmēva ḍajjhanti ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.389-6

vaḍḍhasi virahē hassasi samāgamē hā nisē nisaṁsā si ।
bhaddē tumaṁ pi mahilā taha vi hu dukkhaṁ na yāṇāsi ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.389-7

[aṇaṅgavajjā]
tā kiṁ karēmi māē nijjiyarūvassa kāmadēvassa ।
daḍḍhaṁ pi ḍahaï aṅgaṁ niddhūmō saṅkhacuṇṇu vva ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.397-1


[p. 250]
hārēṇa māmi kusumacchaḍāyaluppannacicciṇā daḍḍhō ।
vammīsaṇō na mannaï ulūviō tēṇa maṁ ḍahaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.397-2

[piyāṇurāyavajjā]
jē kē vi rasā diṭṭhīu jāu jē bharahabhāviyā bhāvā ।
tē naccijjanti aṇacciyā vi sahasā piē diṭṭhē ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.412-1

sō kattha gaō sō suyaṇavallahō sō suhāsiyasamuddō ।
sō mayaṇaggiviṇāsō jō sō sōsēi maha hiyayaṁ1 ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.412-2

sō māsō taṁ pi diṇaṁ sā rāī savvalakkhaṇasaüṇṇā ।
amayaṁ va taṁ muhuttaṁ jattha piō jhatti dīsihii2 ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.412-3


[p. 251]
hiyayaṭṭhiō vi piō taha vi hu nayaṇāṇa hōi duppēcchō ।
pēcchaha vihiṇā na kayā maha uyarē jālayagavakkhā ॥ 4 ॥1 // VajLag.412-4

hōhī taṁ kiṁ pi diṇaṁ jattha piō bāhupañjaraṇibaddhō ।
vittē surayapasaṅgē pucchihii pavāsadukkhāiṁ2 ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.412-5

dinnaṁ gēṇhaï, appēi patthiyaṁ, asaï, bhōyaṇaṁ dēi ।
akkhaï gujjhaṁ pucchēi paḍivayaṁ jāṇa taṁ rattaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.412-6

[dūīvajjā]
ahavā tujjha na dōsō tassa u rūvassa hiyakilēsassa ।
ajjāvi na ppasīyaï īsāyanti vva giritaṇayā3 ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.421-1


[p. 252]
kassa kahijjanti phuḍaṁ dūhaviṇaṭṭhāi sahi kajjāiṁ ।
ahavā lōyapasiddhaṁ na phalanti samakkaḍārāmā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.421-2

[ōluggāviyāvajjā]
sā diyahaṁ ciya pēcchaï nayaṇā paḍiyāi dappaṇatalammi ।
ēēhi tumaṁ diṭṭhō si suhaya dōhiṁ pi acchīhiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.438-1

dukkhēhi vi tuha virahē bālaya dukkhaṁ ṭhiyaṁ, aha ccāē ।
aṁsūjalēhi rūṇṇaṁ nīsāsēhiṁ pi nīsasiyaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.438-2

bālaya nāhaṁ dūī tīi piō si tti namha vāvārō ।
sā maraï tujjha aasō tti tēṇa dhammakkharaṁ bhaṇimō1 ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.438-3


[p. 253]
sā suhaya sāmalaṅgī jā sā nīsāsasōsiyasarīrā ।
āsāsijjaï1 sahasā jāva na sāsā samappanti2 ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.438-4

parapurapavēsavinnāṇalāhavaṁ suhaya sikkhiyaṁ kattha ।
jēṇa paviṭṭhō hiyaē paḍhama cciya daṁsaṇē majjha ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.438-5

[panthiyavajjā]
uddhacchō piyaï jalaṁ jaha jaha viralaṅgulī ciraṁ pahiō ।
pāvāliyā vi taha taha dhāraṁ taṇuyaṁ pi taṇuēi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.445-1


[p. 254]
ahiṇavagajjiyasaddaṁ mōrāṇa ya kalayalaṁ nisāmantō ।
mā pavasa dhiṭṭha panthiya, marihisi, kiṁ tē paütthēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.445-2

vāsārattē vāuddhuēṇa vāsaṁ vimaggamāṇēṇa ।
pahiēṇa pahiyaghariṇō ruyāviyā tharaharantēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.445-3

sihiraḍiyaṁ ghaṇaraḍiyaṁ dūraṁ pi gharaṁ ghaṇatthaṇaṁ ramaṇiṁ ।
sambhariūṇa saēsaṁ pahiēṇa ghaṇagghaṇaṁ rūṇṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.445-4

taï vōlantē bālaya tissā valiyāi taha nu aṅgāiṁ ।
jaha paṭṭhimajjhaṇivaḍantavāhadhārā va dīsanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.445-5


[p. 255]
[dhannavajjā]
iya taruṇitaruṇasambharaṇakāraṇaṁ turagataraṇaraṇucchaliyaṁ ।
raïyaṁ iya varakulayaṁ pāiyasīlēṇa līlēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.449-1

[hiyayasaṁvaraṇavajjā]
hē hiyaya avvavaṭṭhiya agaṇijjantō vi taṁ jaṇaṁ mahasi ।
kandu vva silāvaḍiyaṁ aladdhapasaraṁ niyattihisi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.454-1

sātammi hiyaya dulahammi māṇusē aliyasaṅgamāsāē ।
hariṇa vva mūḍha mayataṇhiyāi dūraṁ harijjihisi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.454-2


[p. 256]
nayaṇāi nayanti nayantu, hiyaya kō ēttha tujjha vāvārō ।
hōhinti imāi taḍē tuha paḍihii vammahacaḍakkā ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.454-3

nayaṇāi phusasu mā ruyasu aṇudiṇaṁ, muyasu tassa aṇubandhaṁ ।
gāijjaï kiṁ mariūṇa pañcamaṁ muddha hariṇacchi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.454-4

indīvaracchi sayavāravāriyā kīsa taṁ jaṇaṁ mahasi ।
jaï kaṇayamayacchuriyā tā kiṁ ghāijjaē appā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.454-5

[sughariṇīvajjā]
paragharagamaṇālasiṇī parapurisavilōyaṇē ya jaccandhā ।
paraālāvē bahirā gharassa lacchī, na sā ghariṇī ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.462-1


[p. 257]
ajjēva piyapavāsō, asaī dūrē, viḍambaē mayaṇō ।
caraṇuggaō vi aggī kayā vi sīsaṁ samāruhaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.462-2

[saīvajjā]
bhaddaṁ kulaṅgaṇāṇaṁ jāsiṁ maṇakamalakōsamaṇupattō ।
mayaṇabhamarō varāō vaccaï nihaṇaṁ tahiṁ cēva ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.471-1

sakulakalaṅkaṁ niyakantavañcaṇaṁ ajasapaḍahaṇigghōsō ।
sarisavamēttē ca suhē kō dūi viḍambaē appaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.472-2


[p. 258]
[asaīvajjā]
jēṇa samaṁ sambandhō giṇhaha nāmaṁ puṇō puṇō tassa ।
pucchēi mittavaggaṁ bhaṇṇaï ēvaṁvihā rattā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.496-1

asaī asamattarayā sayaḍaṁ daṭaṭhūṇa gāmamajjhammi ।
dhannā hu cakkaṇāhī niccaṁ akkhō hiō jissā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.496-2

ḍimbhattaṇabhmi ḍimbhēhi rāmiyā jōvvaṇē juvāṇēhiṁ ।
thērī vi gayavaēhiṁ mayā vi asaī pisāēhiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.496-3

bhayavaṁ huyāsa ēkkamha dukkayaṁ khamasu jaṁ paī ramiō ।
nihaṇaï pāvaṁ jārāṇumaraṇakayaṇicchayā asaī ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.496-4


[p. 259]
saṅkēyakuḍaṅgōḍḍīṇasaüṇakōlāhalaṁ suṇantīē ।
gharakammavāvaḍāē vahūi khijjanti aṅgāiṁ1 ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.496-5

jāraṭhṭhaviṇimmiyamēhalāvaliṁ jā na bandhaï nivambē ।
tāva cciya navakāmāliṇīi ramaṇaṁ va pajjhariyaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.496-6

jāramasāṇasamubbhavabhūīsuhaphaṁsasijjiraṅgīē ।
na samappaï navakāmāliṇīi uddhūlaṇārambhō ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.496-7

bahalē tamandhayārē ramiyapamukkāṇa sāsusuṇhāṇaṁ ।
samayaṁ ciya abbhiḍiyā dōṇhaṁ pi saraddahē hatthā ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.496-8


[p. 260]
sampattiyā vi khajjaï pattacchēyabhmi, mābhi kō dōsō ।
niyayavaī vi ramijjaï parapurisavivajjiē gāmē ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.496-9

racchātulaggavaḍiō nālattō jaṁ jaṇassa bhīyāē ।
sō cēya virahaḍāhō ajja vi hiyaē chamacchamaï ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.496-10

acchīhi tēṇa bhaṇiyaṁ maē vi hiyaēṇa tassa paḍivannaṁ ।
jā pattiyaṁ pi jāyaṁ ghuṇahuṇiyaṁ tā hayaggāmē ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.496-11

siñcantō vi miyaṅkō jōṇhāsalilēṇa paṅkayavaṇāiṁ ।
taha vi aṇiṭṭhayarō cciya, sakalaṅkō kassa paḍihāi ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.496-12


[p. 261]
attā jāṇaï suṇhaṁ suṇhā jāṇēi attacariyāiṁ ।
vaccaü suhēṇa kālō mā phuṭṭaü billa billēṇa ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.496-13

paḍhamaṁ ciya maha rēhā asaīmajjhammi ubbhiō hatthō ।
saraṇāmi tujjha pāyā surasari dūyattaṇaṁ kuṇaï ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.496-14

[jōisiyavajjā]
sīsēṇa kaha na kīraï niumbaṇaṁ māmi tassa gaṇayassa ।
asamattasukkasaṅkamaṇavēyaṇājēṇa maha muṇiyā ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.507-1


[p. 262]
[dhammiyavajjā]
dhuttīraēṇa dhammiya jō hōi caḍāviēṇa ēkkēṇa ।
sō kurayāṇa saēṇa vi na hōi liṅgassa pariōsō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.532-1

dhammiya dhammō suvvaï dāṇēṇa tavēṇa titthajattāē ।
taruṇatarupallavullūraṇēṇa dhammō kahiṁ diṭṭhō ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.532-2

[bālāsaṁvaraṇavajjā]
tōlijjanti na kēṇa vi savvaṅgāyāragōvaṇasamatthā ।
annaṁ uṇa hiyayatulāi diṭṭhaṁ ciya tulanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.551-1

[kuṭṭiṇīsikkhāvajjā]
pajjharaṇaṁ rōmañcō vayaṇē saccaṁ sayā mahādiṭṭhī ।
ēyaṁ puṇō vi sikkhasu muddhē atthakkavinnāṇaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.559-1


[p. 263]
karaphaṁsamalaṇacumbaṇapīlaṇaṇihaṇāi harisavayaṇēhiṁ ।
attā māyandaṇihīṇa kiṁ pi kumarīu sikkhavaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.559-2

[vēsāvajjā]
amuṇiyajammuppattī savvagayā bahubhuyaṅgaparimaliyā ।
mayaṇaviṇāsaṇasīlā harō vva vēsā suhaṁ dēu ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.578-1

savvaṅgarāgarattaṁ daṁsaï kaṇavīrakusumasāricchaṁ ।
gabbhē kaha vi na rattaṁ vēsāhiyayaṁ taha ccēva ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.578-2


[p. 264]
[kaṇhavajjā]
uvvūḍhabhuvaṇabhārō vi kēsavō thaṇaharēṇa rāhāē ।
mālaïdala vva kaliō lahuijjaï kō na pēmmēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.605-1

taha ruṇṇaṁ tīi taḍaṭṭhiyāi rāhāi kaṇhavirahammi ।
jaha sē kajjalamaïlaṁ ajja vi jaüṇājalaṁ vahaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.605-2

[hiyālīvajjā]
chīē jīva na bhaṇiyaṁ pariyaṇamajjhammi pōḍhamahilāē ।
chōḍēi cihurabhāraṁ puṇa baddhaṁ kēṇa kajjēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.624-1

kulabāliyā pasūyā puttavaī surayakajjatattillā ।
ērisaguṇasampannā bhaṇa kīsa na vāsiyā païṇā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.624-2


[p. 265]
kassa kaēṇa kisōyari varaṇayaraṁ vahasi uttamaṅgēṇaṁ ।
kaṇṇēṇa kaṇṇavaṁhaṇaṁ vāṇarasaṅkhaṁ ca hatthēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.624-3

[vasantavajjā]
laṅkālaēṇa rattambaravēsiṇa dinnapupphayāṇēṇa ।
dahavayaṇēṇēva kayaṁ sīyāharaṇaṁ palāsēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.637-1


[p. 266]
guruvirahasandhiviggahaṇimmavaṇō atthi kō vi jaï mattō ।
paḍhamikkamañjariṁ aṅguliṁ va ubbhēi sahayārō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.641-1

cañcupuḍakōḍiviyaliyamāyandarasōhasittadēhassa ।
kīrassa maggalaggaṁ bhamaraülaṁ bhamaï gandhaḍḍhaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.641-2

saccaṁ cēva palāsō asaï palaṁ virahiyāṇa mahumāsē ।
tittiṁ avaccamāṇō jalaï vva chuhāi savvaṅgaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.641-3


[p. 267]
suhiyāṇa suhañjaṇayā dukkhañjaṇayā ya dukkhiyajaṇassa ।
ēē sōhañjaṇayā sōhañjaṇayā vasantassa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.641-4

[pāusavajjā]
vijjubhuyaṅgamasahiyaṁ cavalabalāyākavālakayasōhaṁ ।
gajjiyaphuḍaṭṭahāsaṁ bhaïravarūvaṁ nahaṁ jāyaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.652-1

[p. 1]

anēnaiva paddhatikramēṇa gāthāratnakōśaprakramā jñātavyāḥ.



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[maṅgalamabhidhēyaṁ ca]

paṇamaha purisottamanāhitaṇayamuhanaliṇavāsiṇiṁ vāṇiṁ
jīē pavayaṇajōnhaṁ sukaïcaōrā parilihanti // GāRaKō.1

sukaïvayaṇa'ṇṇavāō vicittarayaṇāṇi suttirayaṇāṇi
gahiūṇa kaō kōsō aō a gāhārayaṇakōsō // GāRaKō.2



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[1. 1. atha jinastutiḥ]

paḍhamaṁ ciya paḍhamajiṇassa namaha nahamaṇimaūharamaṇijjaṁ
aṅkuriamokkhapāyavabīyanihāṇaṁ va payakamalaṁ // GāRaKō.3


[p. 2]
paḍivajjantō vi sayā kalantaraṁ nēa jassa muhacinhaṁ
pāvaï candō taṁ kamalakulagihaṁ namaha vīrajiṇaṁ // GāRaKō.4



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[2. 2. atha brahmaṇaḥ stutiḥ]

taṁ paṇamaha tiginnicchalaṁ[?]ṇa nivasaï nivēsaka[ma]lammi
jassa parimāṇanivahō vva bhuvaṇanimmāṇapaḍivannō // GāRaKō.5

paḍhamaṁ ciya dhavalakaōvavīyamamburuhagōyaraṁ namaha
harinija[ya]jaḍharamōkhittanālasuttaṁ piva sayambhuṁ // GāRaKō.6



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[3. atha viṣṇustutiḥ]

sēsaphaṇāmaṇidappaṇaviṁvijjantassa kōlarūvassa
dharaṇidharaṇammi hariṇō varāhajūhāiyaṁ namaha // GāRaKō.7

taṁ namaha jassa vacchē lacchimuhaṁ kotthuhammi saṅkantaṁ
dīsaï mayaparihīṇaṁ sasivimbaṁ sūraviṁvammi // GāRaKō.8

rakkhatu vō rōmalayā māyāmahilattaṇē mahumahassa
gūḍhōyaratāmarasāṇusāriṇī bhamaramāla vva // GāRaKō.9

viyaḍasasimaṇḍalāyantasalilabhariyammi bhuvaṇavalayammi
hariṇō hariṇacchāyāvilāsaparisaṇṭhiyaṁ jayaï // GāRaKō.10



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[4. 4. atha mahēśvarastutiḥ]

taṁ namaha jassa rēhaï viyaḍajaḍāhārapāsapaḍilaggaṁ
raïkalahakuviapavvaïvibhiṇṇavalayaṁ va sasikhaṇḍaṁ // GāRaKō.11

paṇamaha paṇayapakuvviyagōrīcalaṇaggalaggapaḍiviṁvaṁ
dasasu nahadappaṇēsuṁ ēyārahataṇuharaṁ ruddaṁ // GāRaKō.12

taṁ namaha jō jaḍāyaḍalīlāsandāṇiyaṁ samuvvahaï
gōrīkavō[laü]vvariyakantisēsaṁ piva mayaṅkaṁ // GāRaKō.13

pamuvaïṇō rōsāruṇapaḍimāsaṅkantagōrimuhayandaṁ
gahiya'gghapaṅkayaṁ piva sañjhāsalilañjaliṁ namaha // GāRaKō.14


[p. 3]


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[5. 5. atha sarasvatīstutiprakramaḥ]

nandaü sacchandagaī nimmalapayapūragāravamahagghō
jalahipaḍiruddhapasarō sukaīṇa sarassaīpavahō // GāRaKō.15

āsaṁsāraṁ kaïpuṅgavēhiṁ taddiyahagahiyasārō vi
ajja vi abhinnamuddō vva jayaï vāyāparipphandō // GāRaKō.16

paṇamaha paṇamantamahākaïndasaṅkantanayaṇapaḍiviṁvaṁ
kayanīluppalapūyaṁ va bhāraīcaraṇanahanivahaṁ // GāRaKō.17

taṁ namaha bhāraïṁ jīē caraṇanahadappaṇēsu saṅkantā
bahuvayaṇā hōnti phuḍaṁ paṇamantā takkhaṇē kaïṇō // GāRaKō.18



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[6. 6. atha kāvyapraśaṁsā]

sarasā vi hu kavvakahā pariōsaṁ kuṇaï kassa vi maṇammi
phullanti na sayalatarū varataruṇīcaraṇaphaṁsēṇa // GāRaKō.19

laliē mahura'kkhariē juvaījaṇavallahē sasiṅgārē
santē pāiyakavvē kō sakkaï sakkayaṁ paḍhiuṁ? // GāRaKō.20

pāiyakavvaṁ paḍhiuṁ gumphēuṁ taha ya kujjayapasūṇaṁ
kuviyaṁ ca pasāhēuṁ ajja vi vahavē na yāṇanti // GāRaKō.21

cintāmandaramanthāṇamanthiē vitthiyammi atthāhē
uppajjanti[ya]kaïhiyayasāyarē kavvarayaṇāiṁ // GāRaKō.22

aṇavarayabahularōmañcakañcuyaṁ jaṇiyajaṇamaṇāṇandaṁ
jaṁ na dhuṇāvaï sīsaṁ kavvaṁ pimmaṁ ca kiṁ tēṇa? // GāRaKō.23

kaïṇō jayantu tē jalahiṇō vva uvajī viūṇa jāṇa payaṁ
annē vijaṇā bhuvaṇē kuṇanti ghannāṇa ukkarisaṁ // GāRaKō.24

hiyayāiṁ sajjaṇāṁṇaṁ rañjaï kasiṇēi khalayaṇamuhāṁi
kavvaṁ suhāsiaṁ pi hu jāṇa namō tāṇa sukaīṇaṁ // GāRaKō.25

sālaṅkārāhiṁ maṇōharāhiṁ annunnarāyarasiyāhi
gāhāhiṁ paṇaïṇīhiṁ vi ḍajjhaï hiyayaṁ ayantī hiṁ // GāRaKō.26

chandaṁ ayāṇamāṇēhi jā kayā sā na hōi ramaṇīā
kiṁ gāhā na hu sēvā? ahavā gāhā vi sēvā vi // GāRaKō.27


[p. 4]
addhakkharabhaṇiyāiṁ nūṇaṁ savilāsaaddhahasiyāiṁ
addhacchipecchiāiṁ vi gāhāhiṁ viṇā na najjanti // GāRaKō.28

aïcampiya viṇassaï dantacchēēṇa hōi vicchāyaṁ
ḍhalahalayaṁ viya muccaï pāiyakavvaṁ ca pimmaṁ ca // GāRaKō.29



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[7. atha samudraprakramaḥ]

rayaṇēhiṁ nirantarapūriyassa rayaṇāyarassa na hu gavvō
kariṇō muttāhalasaṁsaē hi mayabhimbhalā diṭṭhī // GāRaKō.30

rayaṇāyarassa na hu hōi tucchimā niggaēhiṁ rayaṇēhiṁ
taha vi hu candasaricchā viralā rayaṇāyarē rayaṇā // GāRaKō.31

jaï kahava animmahiō dintō tiyasāṇa rayaṇasaṅghāyaṁ
tā tihuyaṇē vi uvamā na hojja mannēsamuddassa // GāRaKō.32

tuhiṇakarasīyalō cciya vaḍavānalaḍajjhiō vi mayaraharō
na muṇijjanti vahantā gaṅgōda … … … // GāRaKō.33

tē aïgahirā phuḍaphēṇapaṇḍurā gāhagajjiraraüddā
sāyaraayatthihatthē[?]kattha gayā tuha taraṅgōhā? // GāRaKō.34

jalaṇaṁ jalaṁ ca amiyaṁ visaṁ ca kaṇhaṁ sadāṇavaṁ cēva
uyarē dharanta! mayarahara! tujjha mahima ccia apuvvō // GāRaKō.35

sāhīṇāmaya rayaṇē amaramarōraṁ ca bhuvaṇamakuṇantō
ullasirēhiṁ na lajjasi laharīhiṁ taraṅgiṇīnāha! // GāRaKō.36

iyarō gāmatalāō pūrijjaï pūyarāṇa niyarēṇa
ghaṇamacchapucchaghāyaṁ puṇō vi rayaṇāyarō sahaï // GāRaKō.37

vāraṁ vāraṁ viṇivāriā vi rēvā na sāyaraṁ muyaï
ahavā savvasalūṇē piyammi kō rūsiuṁ taraï? // GāRaKō.38

hiyayanivēsiyavaḍavānalō vi visakulaharaṁ pi jalarāsī
rayaṇāyaru tti lambhaï peccha pasiddhiē māhappaṁ // GāRaKō.39


[p. 5]
lacchī dhūā, jāmāuō harī, taha ya paṇaïṇī gaṅgā
amaya-miyaṅkā ya suā ahō! kuḍumbaṁ mahōahiṇō // GāRaKō.40

māhappaṁ taṁ khalu lavaṇimāē jaṁ kila sayaṁ samuddammi
nivaḍanti kūrasattē vi jaḍasahāvē vi sariyāō // GāRaKō.41

jaha jaha sariyāō jalaṁ khivanti taha taha kilammaē uyahī
mahilāhintōriddhiṁ īhanti kahaṁ mahāsattā? // GāRaKō.42

pūrijjantō vi jalēhiṁ jalanihī jalaharēhiṁ taṇuāi
uvayariyaṁ pi hu uvariddhiēhiṁ garuyāṇa avayariyaṁ // GāRaKō.43

sōsaṁ na gaō, na gaō rasāyalaṁ, jalahi! kiṁ na phuḍiō si?
taḍasaṇṭhiyā vi saüṇā taṇhaïyā jassa vōlīṇā // GāRaKō.44

lacchīē viṇā rayaṇāyarassa gambhīrimā taha jjēva
sā lacchī tassa viṇā kassa na gēhē paribbhamaï? // GāRaKō.45

vihalaṁ paḍicchiuṁ guruyayāṇa payaī, na kāraṇāvikkhā
girisarigalatthiē pattharē vi rayaṇāyarō dharaï // GāRaKō.46



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[8. atha vaḍavānalaprakramaḥ]

jaṁ atthīhiṁ na pijjaï āsāijjaï na saüṇasatthēhi
taṁ sāyarassa salilaṁ khavanta! vaḍavānala! namō tē // GāRaKō.47

sōsaü ma sōsaü cciya salilaṁ rayaṇāyarassa vaḍava'ggī
jaṁ lahaï jalē jalaṇō tēṇaṁ ciya kiṁ na pajjattaṁ? // GāRaKō.48

pāyāluyaragaharīhiṁ sāyaralaharīhiṁ jā na ulhaviyā
sā vaḍavānalataṇhā kaha phiṭṭaï sarijhalakkēhiṁ? // GāRaKō.49

kā samasīsī vaḍavānalēṇa iyarāṇa tēyavantāṇaṁ?
ulhaviyasihisamūhō vi indhaṇaṁ jassa mayaraharō // GāRaKō.50

uyahi-vaḍavānalāṇaṁ parapparulhavaṇa-sōsaṇamaṇāṇa
jā vaṭṭaï saṁrambhō tāva suhaṁ jiyaï jiyalōō // GāRaKō.51

du ccēya pattarēhā uttama-ahamāsu purisapantīsu
dintāṇaṁ rayaṇanihī, maggantāṇaṁ tu vaḍavaggī // GāRaKō.52


[p. 6]


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[9. atha kr̥ṣṇakrīḍāprakramaḥ]

sō kō vi guṇō gōvāliyāṇa jaï natthi kanha! ekkō vi
ujjayasīlāvasarē taha vi hu māvibharijjāsu // GāRaKō.53

uya ūḍhabhuvaṇabhārō vi kēsavō sihibharēṇa rāhāē
kuvalayadalaṁ va tuliō, haluijjaï kō na pimmēṇa? // GāRaKō.54

kisiō si kīsa kēsava! jaṁ na kaō dhannasaṅgahō mūḍha!
kattō maṇapariōsō vi sāhiyaṁ bhuñjamāṇassa? // GāRaKō.55

saccaṁ cēya bhuyaṅgī vi sāhiyā kira visāhiyā kaṇha!
sāhīṇaviṇayapaṇaō vi jīē ghummāviō taṁ si // GāRaKō.56

kasiṇē vi jalē kaṇhassa kāliō phaṇimaṇīhiṁ uvadiṭṭhō
dēhuppannā vi visaṁvayanti divvē parāhuttē // GāRaKō.57

uppajjanti cayanti ya bahusō jalamāṇusīō jalahimmi
sā lacchī vacchayalaṁ alaṅkiyaṁ jīē kanhassa // GāRaKō.58

jalanihimukkēṇa vi kutthuhēṇapattaṁmurāriṇō hiyayaṁ
tēṇa uṇa tammi ṭhāṇē na yāṇimō kiṁ pi viṇihittaṁ // GāRaKō.59

sō saggō sā lacchī tāiṁ vatthāiṁ tē alaṅkārā
rāhāpalōyahīṇāhariṇō hiyaē khuḍukkhuḍaï // GāRaKō.60

hiyayāu jā na mukkā, ahamāṇa vi saṅgayaṁ aṇucarantī
kaṇhassa tīē lacchīē paḍikayaṁ kiṁ nu kāyavvaṁ? // GāRaKō.61



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[10. atha nagaravarṇanaprakramaḥ]

jattha sasikantakavisīsayaṅkiō sūrakantamaṇisālō
ravisasisaṅgē parihājalāiṁ sōsēi pōsēi // GāRaKō.62

parihājalasaṅkantō maragayasiharaṅkiō phalihasālō
sahaï jahiṁ jalahijalantasēsasayaṇatthaviṇhuvva // GāRaKō.63

siyakarakiraṇanirantaraphurantasasikantasālabhañjīhi
rayaṇīsu tiyasabhavaṇāiṁ jattha dhārāgihāyanti // GāRaKō.64

païdiyahaṁ vilasantē daṭṭhuṁ gōrī-mahēsarē jattha
kuḍḍēṇa āgaō himagiri vva dhavalō sahaï sālō // GāRaKō.65


[p. 7]
jattha maṇibhavaṇabhittīsu picchituṁ attaṇō vi paḍibimbaṁ
paḍijuvaïsaṅkirīō piēsu kuppanti muddhāō // GāRaKō.66

jattha'cchaphalihabhūmisusālattayataruṇicaraṇapaḍibimbaṁ
cubanti muddhabhasalā jalavilasirakamalabhantīē // GāRaKō.67

jattha anīiparāiṁ khettāiṁ cēva na uṇa sappurisā
dīsanti diyavara cciya kusā''saṇaggahaṇatallicchā // GāRaKō.68

vilayāulāiṁ vitthinnapattapunnāiṁ pavarasālāiṁ
jattha bhavaṇāiṁ majjhē, vaṇāiṁ vāhiṁ virāyanti // GāRaKō.69

nīlamaṇikuṭṭimē jattha navavahū picchiūṇa saṅkantaṁ
samuhaṁ taggahaṇatthaṁ hatthaṁ kamalabbhamā khivaï // GāRaKō.70

gharasirapasuttakāmiṇikavōlasaṅkantasasikalāvalayaṁ
haṁsēhiṁ ahilasijjaï muṇālasaddhāluēhiṁ jahiṁ // GāRaKō.71



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[11. atha sujanaprakramaḥ]

icchanti na nēhalavaṁ, sakajjalaggā na hōnti maṇayaṁ pi
amuṇiyadasāvisēsā suyaṇā rayaṇappaīva vva // GāRaKō.72

chāïllōpiyaï tamaṁ, taṁ ca[?u]uvvamaï kajjalamisēṇa
annē vi suisahāvā hiyaē kalusaṁ na hu dharanti // GāRaKō.73

daḍharōsakalusiassa vi suaṇassa muhāō vippiyaṁ kattō?
rāhumuhammi vi sasiṇō kiraṇā amayaṁ ciya muyanti // GāRaKō.74

pisuṇō aïdittaggī nēhasahassāiṁ jhatti jō jaraï
suyaṇō uṇa mandaggī ekkaṁ nēhaṁ na jō jaraï // GāRaKō.75

vimalēṇa vi kaha uvamā ekkasarūvassa suyaṇahiyayassa
phalihōvalēṇa kīraï āsayavasabhinnarūvēṇa? // GāRaKō.76

abhaṇantāṇa vi najjaï pariṇāmaṁ supurisāṇa cariēhiṁ
kiṁ jampanti maṇīō jēṇa sahassēhiṁ ghippanti? // GāRaKō.77

paḍivannapakkhavāō guṇasañjuttō samujjaō saphalō
bāṇō vva hiyayalaggō māraï suyaṇō adīsantō // GāRaKō.78


[p. 8]
cāvaguṇāṇaṁ duṇhaṁ rēhanti mahāṇubhāvacariyāiṁ
ūharasamuṇṇayāṇaṁ kōḍīō dinta-lintāṇaṁ // GāRaKō.79

sahaï samūlāṇa samuṇṇayāṇa vahusaüṇasatthanilayāṇa
sappurisāṇa dumāṇa va parōvayārapphalā riddhī // GāRaKō.80

sō jayaü jēṇa suyaṇā vi dujjaṇā iha viṇimmiyā bhuvaṇē
na tamēṇa viṇā pāvanti candakiraṇā vi parabhāgaṁ // GāRaKō.81

taṁ parivaḍūḍhanti khaṇaṁ khaṇaṁ pi nivasanti jattha sappurisā
jāō kalimmi jassiṁ taïṁ uṇa sō cēva niṭṭhaviō // GāRaKō.82

kalahantāṇa vi na hu niggayāiṁ, hiyaē jaraṁ aïgayāiṁ
suyaṇakayāiṁ rahassāiṁ dahaï āukkhaē aggī // GāRaKō.83

khajjanti ṭasa tti na bhañjiūṇa, pijjanti nēya ghuṇṭēhiṁ
taha vi hu kuṇanti titti ālāvā sajjaṇajaṇassa // GāRaKō.84

īsiṁ pi na lakkhijjaï suttaṁ hārēsu muttiutthaïyaṁ
suguṇā vi guṇabbhahiēhiṁ antarijjanti kiṁ cojjaṁ? // GāRaKō.85

kalikālakavalanovvariyasupurisā santi kattha va paēsē
vīyaṁ va kayajuyatthē ajja vi parirakkhiyaṁ vihiṇā // GāRaKō.86

pasamiyasōhāsasaharassa'llīṇassa vaṅkimā jaṁ sē[?]
riddhīsu pañjalā hōnti supurisā, na ya vivattīsu // GāRaKō.87

viralā uvayariūṇaṁ niravekkhā jalahara vva vaccanti
jhijjhanti tāṇa virahē virala cciya saripavāhō vva // GāRaKō.88

santiasaṅkhā saṅkhā dhavalā rayaṇāyarubbhavā bhuvaṇē
na hu tāṇa saddaladdhī jāyā jā pañcajaṇṇassa // GāRaKō.89

chinnāṇa sōsiyāṇa ya dāhaṁ pattāṇa chiddabhariyāṇa
ahamamuhadūsiyāṇa vi suhō u saddō suvaṁsāṇa // GāRaKō.90

hiyaē jāō,nōcēva pasariō, nēya payaḍiō lōē
vavasāyapāyavō supurisāṇa lakkhijjaï phalēhiṁ // GāRaKō.91

na hu mahumahassa vacchē, matthē kamalāṇa, nēya khīrōē
vavasāyapāyavē supurisāṇa lacchī phuḍaṁ hōi // GāRaKō.92


[p. 9]
sabbhāvakhalāṇa vi kuṇaï kiṁ pi suyaṇattaṇaṁ suyaṇasaṅgō
jhīṇassa vi kajjalamīsi ghaḍaïṇayaṇassa lāyaṇṇaṁ // GāRaKō.93

saccariyanimmalāṇaṁ aliaparāṇa vi sirīō vaḍḍhanti
sacchiddāṇaṁ muttāṇa rāyavacchatthalārōhō // GāRaKō.94

kiṁ ittiēṇa gayaṇaṅgaṇassa garuattaṇaṁ samōsaraï?
sajjaṇahiyayassa na jittitēēṇa sarisāiyaṁ tēṇa // GāRaKō.95



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[12. atha durjanaprakramaḥ]

suyaṇō tusārasarisō tāvijjantō vilāi, na hu jalaï
iyarō dīvayasarisō kayanēhō jalaï ahiayaraṁ // GāRaKō.96

suyaṇattaṇaṁ na kēṇa vi antōmaliṇāṇa tīraē kāuṁ
sīsēṇa vahantassa vi harassa vaṅkō cciya mayaṅkō // GāRaKō.97

purisā jē guṇarahiyā kulēṇa gavvaṁ vahanti tē mūḍhā
vaṁsuppaṇṇaṁ pi dhaṇu guṇarahiaṁ bhaṇaha kiṁ kuṇaï? // GāRaKō.98

guruā vi jēsu maḍahā saṅkantā dappaṇēsu dīsanti
juttamiṇaṁ jaṁ dijjaï jaṇēṇa chāraṁ muhē tassa // GāRaKō.99

purisāṇa kulīṇāṇa vi na kulaṁ viṇayassa kāraṇaṁ hōi
candā'maya-lacchisahōyaraṁ pi mārēi kiṁ na visaṁ? // GāRaKō.100

jaha kaṇayaṁ taha parimāṇapattharaṁ bē vi tulaï nārāō
ahavā nirakkharāṇaṁ guṇa-dōsaviyāraṇā kattō? // GāRaKō.101

dōmuhaṁ! nirakkhara[?ya]! lōhamaïya! nārāya! kittiyaṁ bhaṇimō
guñjāhiṁ samaṁ kaṇayaṁ tulanta na gaō'si pāyālaṁ // GāRaKō.102

viddaviyaguṇō dōsekkapāyaḍō nēhakhavaṇatattillō
dīvō vva khalō āsannasaṇṭhiō kaṁ na maïlēi? // GāRaKō.103

sajjaṇasaṅgēṇa vi dujjaṇassa na hu kalusimā samōsaraï
sasimaṇḍalamajjhapariṭṭhiō vi kasiṇō cciya kuraṅgō // GāRaKō.104

guṇalēsō vi[?ya]na suyaṇa! tujjha ghaḍantassa kiṁ pi uvvariō
mannē dōsamaō cciya tēṇa jaē dujjaṇō ghaḍiō // GāRaKō.105


[p. 10]
maliṇāyāraṁ daṭṭhūṇa maṇḍalō bhasaü tassa na hu dōsō
duṭṭhakhalō aparokkhē vimalasahāvāṇa vi bhasēi // GāRaKō.106

vasaï jahiṁ cēva khalō pōsijjantō vi nēhadāṇēṇa
taṁ cēva ālayaṁ dīvaō vva acirēṇa maïlēi // GāRaKō.107

akulīṇō dōmuhaō tā mahurō bhōyaṇaṁ muhē jāva
muraō vva khalō jinnammi bhōyaṇē virasamārasaï // GāRaKō.108

niddhammō guṇarahiōcāvavimukkō ya loddasambhūō
vindhaï jaṇassa hiyayaṁ pisuṇō vāṇa vva bhaggantō // GāRaKō.109

na saddaï abbhatthaṇiyaṁ, asaï gayāṇaṁ pi piṭṭhimaṁsāiṁ
daṭṭhūṇa bhāsuramuhaṁ khalasīhaṁ kō na vīhēi? // GāRaKō.110

khalasaṅgē paricattē pecchaha tellēṇa jaṁ phalaṁ pattaṁ
mayaṇāhisurahivāsaṁ pahusīsaṁ pāviyaṁ tēṇa // GāRaKō.111

hōhī khalu tti kaliūṇa ṇiyamaṇē māmi jantadiyaēhi
pattēhiṁ navari mukkō phaliō vi tilō avēkkhāē // GāRaKō.112

sō saddō, taṁ dhavalattaṇaṁ ca, rayaṇāyarammi uppattī
saṅkhassa hiyayakuḍilattaṇēṇa savvaṁ pi pabbhaṭṭhaṁ // GāRaKō.113

mēhā iva dōjīddā payaṁ samāsāiūṇa aïkalusā
sacchandagamaṇasīlā sayalaṁ pi jaṇaṁ kayatthanti // GāRaKō.14

suyaṇō muhā kilammaï, haraï khalō jjēva navara pahuhiyayaṁ
taruṇō phalāi gahiuṁ taraï kaī, na uṇa pañcamuhō // GāRaKō.115



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[13. atha susvāmiprakramaḥ]

lahuvittassa vi pahuṇō garuyā līyanti suddhahiyayassa
maḍahē vi dappaṇē saṅkamanti garuā vi gayavaïṇō // GāRaKō.116

tēyassīṇa pasāō lahū vi viyaḍaṁ ghaḍēi mahimāṇaṁ
ekkēṇa vi ravikiraṇēṇa gayaṇamakkamaï hariṇaṅkō // GāRaKō.117

pagaïkhalēsuṁ pi piyaṁvaēsu pahuṇō vahanti pariōsaṁ
kuḍilahiyayassa saṅkhassa haraï hiyayaṁ sarō muharō // GāRaKō.118


[p. 11]
unnayasihō vi dīvō na haṇaï hiṭṭhaṭṭhiyaṁ timiraniyaraṁ
ahavā'bhimāṇamukkaṁ pahuṇō pālēnti riuvaggaṁ // GāRaKō.119

nīyā vi samatthēhi gahiyā uccaṁ lahanti saṇṭhāṇaṁ
dhūlikaṇā puhavīē caranti gayaṇammi vāēṇaṁ // GāRaKō.120

hiṭṭhaṭṭhiyajaḍaniyaraṁ taha ya supattāiṁ uttamaṅgammi
jaha dharaï tarū taha jaï pahū vi tā kiṁ na pajjattaṁ? // GāRaKō.121



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[14. atha lakṣmīprakramaḥ]

naviṇā jaṁ sahaï guṇō vi, sahaï dōsō vi jīē pariyariō
kammaṇamēgaṁ bhuyaṇassa saraha taṁ bhayavaïṁ lacchiṁ // GāRaKō.122

guṇagaruyāṇa vi dhaṇavajjiyāṇa na havanti citiyā atthā
lakkhēṇa vi dīvāṇaṁ na diṇaṁ diṇanāhavirahammi // GāRaKō.123

lacchī-sarassaīṇaṁ lacchī garuī, sarassaī lahuī
iharā kahamīsaramaṇusaranti sampamnavijjā vi // GāRaKō.124

lacchīē guṇā niyamēṇa hōnti, na guṇēhiṁ havaï puṇa lacchī
vijjūō khalu samēhā havanti, mēhā na saha vijjū // GāRaKō.125

aïsīyalakarapasarō jāō sampuṇṇamaṇḍalō rāyā
iya cintiūṇa lacchī savvaṅgaṁ tammi nivasēi // GāRaKō.126

lacchīlayāi mūlaṁ guṇa-sattipayaṁ pariṭṭhiyaṁ lōē
jēṇa ahōgamaṇaṁ cēva tāṇa parivaḍḍhaṇē tīē // GāRaKō.127



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[15. atha dānaprakramaḥ]

dintāṇa dāṇamēva hi saṁsai, na ya paribhavaṁ kuṇaï kō u
dāṇēṇa virahiāṇaṁ na ḍhalaï lōgō karīṇaṁ pi // GāRaKō.128

kōḍiṁ dintā vi namanti, maggaṇatthaṁ dharanti jē jīyaṁ
tāṇa dhaṇūṇa va purisāṇa kaha ṇu mā hōu ṭaṅkārō // GāRaKō.129

sō vaṁsaguṇō cciya ēsa kō vi cāvāṇa phuriyasārāṇa
jaṁ guṇamukkāṇa vi maggaṇāṇa lakkhaṁ samappanti // GāRaKō.130


[p. 12]
cāvāṇa navari ekkāṇa sahaï cāruttaṇammi ṭaṅkārō
sahalō maggaṇanivahō visajjiō jēṇa namiūṇa // GāRaKō.131

dintō jalaṁ pi jalaō sa vallahō hōi sayallōyāṇaṁ
niccaṁ pasāriyakarō karēi mittō vi santāvaṁ // GāRaKō.132

dinti phalāiṁ jahicchaṁ kappadumā, nēya kipi jampanti
dhūmaliyajalaharā pāṇiyaṁ pi dāūṇa gajjanti // GāRaKō.133

lahaï garuyattaṇaṁ ciya dintāṇa karō vimukkadāṇō vi
acchariyaṁ lahuyāyaï suvaṇṇabhariō vi lintāṇaṁ // GāRaKō.134

na vi taha dūmēi maṇaṁ gayassa vandhō vva kariṇivirahō vva
dāṇaviōyavimuhiē jaha bhamaraülē bhamantammi // GāRaKō.135

jō sahaï samaramajjhē muṇālalīlāē paharaṇasayāiṁ
nūṇaṁ dāṇāvasarē tassa vi hiyayaṁ camakkēi // GāRaKō.136



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[16. atha kusvāmiprakramaḥ]

jaḍasaṁsaggullasiō vilasantō virasavāṇiō niccaṁ
payaḍiyavahuvihadōsō kiṁ jalahī? na hi, kusāmī vi // GāRaKō.137

palaē mahāguṇāṇāṁ havanti sēvārihā lahuguṇā vi
atthamiē diṇanāhē ahilasaï jaṇō paīvaṁ pi // GāRaKō.138

ōlaggiō'si dhamma'mha hojja iṇhiṁ naḍida! vaccāmō
ālihiyakuñjarassa va tuha dāṇaṁ kēṇa vi na diṭṭhaṁ // GāRaKō.139

jē kēi pahū mahimaṇḍalammi tē ucchudaṇḍasāricchā
sarasā jaḍāṇa majjhē visamā pattēsu dīsanti // GāRaKō.140

iṇhimpahuṇō pahuṇō pahuttaṇaṁ, kiṁ cirantaṇapahūṇaṁ?
dōsaguṇā guṇādōsājēhiṁ kayā, na hu kayā tēhiṁ // GāRaKō.141

appāyattaṁ sampayamavaṇēi pahū parammuhō, na guṇaṁ
ṭhāṇaṁ uvari nirumbhaï maṇīṇa jalahī, na uṇa chāyaṁ // GāRaKō.142

tōsō maṇassa kassa vi āvaïpaḍiyammi bhiccavaggammi
sariyāmu dariddāsuṁ sariyāddivaī samullasaï // GāRaKō.143


[p. 13]
acchaü kā vi apuvvā riddhī tārāhivassa riddhīsu
jā kā vi purāṇā tārayāṇa riddhī hayā sā vi // GāRaKō.144

suhiē suhiyāiṁ ravimmi, dukkhiē dukkhiyāiṁ kamalāiṁ
taha vi hu na tēṇa tāṇaṁ avayariō paṅkayakalaṅkō // GāRaKō.145

jaha jaha pāvanti payaṁ unnayamunnayayaraṁ diṇayaru vva
lahūībhavanti santāvayanti taha taha daḍhaṁ kēī // GāRaKō.146

tārāvaïṇā jaṁ tārayāṇa riddhēṇa nihaṇiyā riddhī
sayalakalāṭhāṇassa vi tēṇaṁ ciya jhijjhaē lacchī // GāRaKō.147

parivārāṇaṁ suyaṇattaṇaṁ pi pisuṇē pahummi na hu kiṁ pi
paḍikūlammi ravisuē suhā vi avarē gahā vihalā // GāRaKō.148

mahumāsavāsarāṇaṁ niḍālasañjaṇiyasēyabindūṇaṁ
kāṇa vi parivuḍiḍhamahīyalassa santāvamāvahaï // GāRaKō.149



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[17. atha kr̥paṇaprakramaḥ]

akayavvaō na sōhaï vihavō vihavō vva aṅgaṇānivahō
kattha vi apattabhōgō suvaṇṇatāruṇṇaōbhavai // GāRaKō.150

kiṁ vaṁsēṇa guṇēṇa ya? kiṁvā kōḍīē? tujjha rē cāva!
jāyanti jassa puraō maggaṇayā mukkasikkārā // GāRaKō.151

kasiṇaṁ kāūṇa muhaṁ, pacchā rattaṁ muhēṇa hōūṇaṁ
diṇṇaṁ phalaṁ palāsēṇa taṁ pi saüṇēhiṁ paricattaṁ // GāRaKō.152

lōhamayassa vi maliṇassa gāḍhamuṭṭhissa kōsanirayassa
kivaṇassa kivāṇassa ya āyārēṇēva bhiṇṇattaṁ // GāRaKō.153

andhāriūṇa vayaṇaṁ dīhaṁ rasiūṇa māmikhatthēhiṁ[?]
paüraṁ pi kahava diṇṇaṁ jalaēṇa jalaṁ alaṁ tēṇa // GāRaKō.154


[p. 14]
kariṇō harinaharavidāriyassa dīsanti muttiyā kumbhē
ahava kivaṇāṇa maraṇē payaḍa cciya hōnti bhaṇḍārā // GāRaKō.155



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[18. atha dāridryaprakramaḥ]

dīsanti jōyasiddhā, añjaṇasiddhā tahēva dīsati
dāliddajōyasiddhā pāsē vi ṭhiyā na dīsanti // GāRaKō.156

mahurollāvasalūṇō laliyapaō rūvajāiparisuddhō
taha vi na agghaï adhaṇō paccakkhakaīṇa kavvaṁ va // GāRaKō.157

uppajjanti tahiṁ ciya, viyasanti tahiṁ, tahiṁ vilijjanti
puṇṇasarē kamalāiṁ va maṇōrahā rōrahiyayammi // GāRaKō.158

santā vi guṇavisēsā narāṇa payaḍā havanti tā kattō
jātāṇa dappaṇāṇa va kaō ṇa bhūīē sakkārō? // GāRaKō.159

jē jē guṇiṇō jē jē ya māṇiṇō jē viḍhattavinnāṇā
dālidda! rē viyakkhaṇa! tāṇa tumaṁ sāṇurāō si // GāRaKō.160

santavaï gasaï savvaṁ jaï vi[hu]dhūmēṇa paḍhamamandhēi
uarabharaṇatthiṇō taha vi niccamagaṇiṁ aṇusaranti // GāRaKō.161

santā vi guṇā guṇavantayāṇa dāliddatamabharakkantā
atthojjōēṇa viṇā payaḍā vi na pāyaḍā hōnti // GāRaKō.162

appāṇaṁ ciya dubharaṁ jāṇa jaē ki va tēhiṁ jāēhiṁ?
susamatthā vi[ya]na parōvayāriṇī tē vi na kiṁ pi // GāRaKō.163

lacchīkarakamalaviyāsarēṇupūrijjamāṇanayaṇēhiṁ
dīsanti nēya rōrā puraō vi ṭhiyā dhaṇaḍḍhēhiṁ // GāRaKō.164

haraï parihīṇavihavassa nūṇa niyapaṇaïṇō vi appāṇaṁ
savvaṅgamasampuṇṇassa ghaḍaï na hu jāmiṇī sasiṇō // GāRaKō.165



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[19. atha sthairya-dhairyādiguṇāḥ]

dhīrāṇa ramaï ghusiṇāruṇammi na tahā piyāthaṇucchaṅgē
diṭṭhī riugayakumbhatthalammi jaha bahalasindūrē // GāRaKō.166


[p. 15]
sō kēṇa vijjhavijjaï vīrapayāvānalō tiṇikkhantō?
uppattikāraṇaṁ jassa khaggadhārājalō ccēya // GāRaKō.167

sāvikkhō dahavayaṇō varappayāṇēṇa sāhasukkarisō
santē vi karasamūhē ekkekkaṁ jō siraṁ luyaē // GāRaKō.168

supaōharāē suhaḍō pulayasaṇāhāi khaggalaṭṭhīē
jāyaï maülianayaṇō daïāi va kaṇṭhalaggāē // GāRaKō.169

ikkattō ruyaï piyā aṇṇattō samaratūranigghōsō
nēhēṇa raṇarasēṇa ya bhaḍassa dōlāiyaṁ hiyayaṁ // GāRaKō.170

ajja vi vihurammi pahū ajja vi paharanti vaïrisaṅghāyā
ajja vi majjhatthā jayasirī vi rē jīva! mā vacca // GāRaKō.171

taṁ natthi jaṁ na sijjhaï vavasāyasamujjayassa dhīrassa
jaṁ sīsamettasēsō rāhū sasi-diṇayarē galaï // GāRaKō.172

aghaḍiyaparāvalavā jaha jaha garuyattaṇē na vihaḍanti
taha taha garuāṇa havanti baddhamūlāō kittīō // GāRaKō.173

diggayakaōlaviyaliyamayapaṅkāmōyavāsiyamaṇassa
bhasalassa kaṇṇatālāhayassa maraṇaṁ pi ramaṇijjaṁ // GāRaKō.174

khaggammi nivāsō jayasirīē, samarammi hōi sā hatthē
hatthaṭṭhiē vi vihavē vimukka dhīrā visūrinti // GāRaKō.175

vivarummuhā vi garuyā uvayārī hōnti sayalalōyassa
kummēṇa niyayapiṭṭhiṭṭhiyaṁ pi bhuvaṇaṁ samuddhariyaṁ // GāRaKō.176

cittuttinnō vi tulāgaō vi mittō tahā vi na hu mukkō
kō hariuṁ tassa nahaṅgaṇassa gambhīrimaṁ taraï? // GāRaKō.177

sabbhāvaṁ pahuhiyaē, jīyaṁ saggē, jasaṁ jaē sayalē
ṭhaviūṇa raṇē sīsaṁ kayakajjō nacciō suhaḍō // GāRaKō.178

kulamuddharanti ēgē vaḍavīyakaṇaṅkurēṇa sāricchā
annē vālayasarisā jāyā mūlaṁ viṇāsanti // GāRaKō.179

kaha nāma sahijjaï kāyarēṇa samuhintagayaghaḍāvīḍhē
garuyagayacalaṇacampiyakarōḍikaḍuō kaḍakkārō? // GāRaKō.180

tuṅgattaṇaṁ gayandē saṅgarasārattaṇaṁ ca kēsariṇō
saṅgāmasūrimā tuṅgimā ya sarabhē samappanti // GāRaKō.181


[p. 16]
mahiūṇa mahājalahiṁ mahumahaṇō tattha suyaï vīsatthō
ēyaṁ nīiviruddhaṁ, chajjaï savvaṁ samatthāṇaṁ // GāRaKō.182

ummūlēi na pavaṇō tiṇāiṁ kila uṇṇaō asārāiṁ
bhañjēi mahallatarū, garuyā garuē virōhanti // GāRaKō.183

dhīrō arikarikumbhayaḍapāḍaṇocchaliyamottiyacchuriō
rēhaï raṇammi jayasirisiyakkhaēhiṁ[va]ahisittō // GāRaKō.184

samarē dhārāgōyara muñcantivērimaṇḍalaggēṇa[?]
taṁtammi valā khalu nivasirīē lacchīē vippanti // GāRaKō.185

saccaṁ kalānihi cciya candō tēyammi jō paṇaṭṭhammi
pavasiyatavaṇassa vi gayaṇacakkamakkamaï pāēhiṁ // GāRaKō.186

païṇō sulahāiṁ dhāṇāiṁ dinti, pattī ya dinti puṇa pāṇē
garuyattaṁ taha vi paīṇa na uṇa pattīṇa, acchariyaṁ // GāRaKō.187

suhaḍāṇa samaravajjantatūravararavaṇaghaṇajalāsittō
pulayacchalēṇa ucchāhamahiruhō muyaï kisalāiṁ // GāRaKō.188

sattūṇa pāyavīḍhē luḍhanti māṇaṁsiṇō vi jaṁ kaha vi
taṁ abbhatthinti mahiṁ vivaraṁ pāyālagamaṇatthaṁ // GāRaKō.189

hiyaïcchiamalahantō pañjarasaüṇu vva dhīravavasāō
kōsasayasampuḍa[?]niruddhapasarō taḍapphaḍaï // GāRaKō.190



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[20. atha rājavarṇakaprakramaḥ]

uvvahasi kīsa gavvaṁ ettha jaē gayavaī ahaṁ ekkō?
tuha vēriyāṇa naravaï! mahilāsatthāvi gayavaïṇō // GāRaKō.191

nūṇaṁ dhaṇummi tuha pahu! saṅkamaï vivakkhajīviyaṁ samarē
iharā tammi sajīvē kaha riuṇō hōnti ajjīvā? // GāRaKō.192

sampuṇṇakōsadaṇḍaṁ jaladuggagayaṁ piḍhalaï kamalavaṇaṁ
diṭṭhammi jammi, kaha sō sūrō? mā bhuvaṇamakkamaü // GāRaKō.193

vahulakkhaēṇa vahusō mahāpasāēṇa tujjha naranāha!
paṇaïsamūhō candō vva vandaṇijjō jaē jāō // GāRaKō.194


[p. 17]
tuha riuṇō nāha! suhatthiṇō vi bhaddattaṇaṁ kaha vahantu?
jāṇa duha ccēya gaī — ekkē mandā, mayā aṇṇē // GāRaKō.204

bahusōhaggāō avihavāo vaṭṭanti tujjha vērīṇa
antēurīō[...]nahu nahu naranāha! nayarīō // GāRaKō.205

harahāsa-haṁsa-hārindu-kunda-balahadda-saṅkhadhavalēṇa
tujjha jasēṇa riūṇaṁ sāhasu kaha mayaliyaṁ vayaṇaṁ? // GāRaKō.206

kamalānilaō vi tumaṁ nāha! na dōsāyarō si sukaī vi
na ya atthalaīō jaṁ tēṇa jaē vimhayaṁ kuṇasi // GāRaKō.207

uddāmapiyālavaṇō saralattaṇajaṇiyajaṇamaṇāṇandō
sasaharakandaravisamō naranāha! tumaṁ himagiri vva // GāRaKō.208

athirā vi thirā lacchī, thirā vi bhamirī taē kayā kittī
aha muyaï cciya tuha daṁsaṇēṇa mahilāyaṇō payaïṁ // GāRaKō.209

samarammi tujjha khaggē vimalattaṇaēṇa jhatti saṅkantā
paḍimāmisēṇa sayalā najjaï saraṇāgayā riuṇō // GāRaKō.210

pāṇiggahiyā vi ciraṁ asiyaṭṭhī tujjha nāha! aïcavalā
aṇurāyapulaïyaṅgī riūṇa kaṇṭhaggahaṁ kuṇaï // GāRaKō.211

kiṁ nāha! imaṁ juttaṁ caürō vaṇṇāi pālayantassa
jaṁ tuha jasēṇa sayalā vi ēkavaṇṇā kayā puhavī? // GāRaKō.212

lacchīē gāḍham āliṅgiō ttiiya cintiūṇa kittīē
īsāurēva pecchasu narindabhuvaṇē paribbhamaï ॥ // GāRaKō.213

riuramaṇīāṇaṇakāṇaṇēsu vilasantapattavallīō
nīyāō khayaṁ taravārivāriṇā jassa acchariyaṁ // GāRaKō.214

samarammi jō samaggē vivakkhavaggē palāyamāṇammi
sammuhamappāṇaṁ ciya pecchaï karavālasaṅkantaṁ // GāRaKō.215

paṇaīṇa dēva! dintō bahusō lakkhāiṁ uttuṇō kīsa?
paḍivakkhāṇa vi tuha diti gayavarā rayaṇakōḍīō // GāRaKō.216

jāhē cciya taṁ calaṇē ṇayāṇa uvariṁ karaṁ pasārēsi
lacchī bhuyaṭṭhiyā vō tāhē cciya tēsu saṅkamaï // GāRaKō.217


[p. 18]
aggamahisīō jāyā savva cciya patthivā na sandēhō
aṇṇaha khalāhilāsō kaha tāṇa maṇammi vipphuraï? // GāRaKō.218

daṭṭhūṇa tujjha udayaṁ puvvāvara-dakkhiṇottaradisāmu
iya maccharēṇa naravara! peccha ravī rāyamuvvahaï // GāRaKō.219

sañjhāvasarē sañjhāvahūē uvariṁ bhamāḍiūṇa raviṁ
khippaï ārattiyadīvaō vva tuha rāyarāyassa // GāRaKō.220

jassa ya samarē arikumbhipaharasaṅkantamottiō khaggō
arijīaluddhajamajīhadantapantīō uvahasaï // GāRaKō.221

arikumbhikumbhanibbhēyapūraruhiracchaḍāruṇacchāō
parikuviyajamakaḍakkhō vva jassa khaggō raṇē sahaï // GāRaKō.222

alikulakuvalayakajjalatamālanīlammi jassa dhāraharē
saï raṇasarāō nāsanti rāyahaṁsā pavarapakkhā // GāRaKō.223

jassa karē karavālō chajjaï tāvicchagucchasacchāhō
samarammi haḍhāyaḍiḍhayajayalacchīvēṇidaṇḍō vva // GāRaKō.224

arikāmiṇīṇa kuṅkuma-katthūrī-kajjalāiṁ aṅgēsu
jassa karavāladhārājalēṇa sahasa tti dhōāiṁ // GāRaKō.225

jassa asibhiṇṇaarikarikumbhatthalagaliyamottiyagaṇēṇa
bīēṇa va jaṇiā samarabhūmipaḍiēṇa kittilayā // GāRaKō.226

nahayalavisālaphalaē sasaharakhaḍiyāē tārasārīhi
jassa payāvō kittī ya dō vi dīvantiavirāmaṁ // GāRaKō.227

mēhaṁ va sajaladhāraṁ raṇagayaṇasamuṇṇayaṁ tamālanihaṁ
daṭṭhūṇa jassa khaggaṁ palāiyaṁ rāyahaṁsēhi // GāRaKō.228

karikumbhadalaṇasaṁsattamottiō jassa raṇabharē khaggō
sattūṇa saggamaggō vva sahaï nakkhattasañjuttō // GāRaKō.229

samarammi jassa khaggō vibhiṇṇariukumbhikumbharuhirullō
rēhaï jayasiricalaṇālattayapayapantirattō vva // GāRaKō.230

jassa karavāladaṇḍēṇa khaṇḍiā rēhaē raṇamahīē
arikuñjaradantā aṅkura vva najjanti jasataruṇō // GāRaKō.231


[p. 19]


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[21. atha rājanītiprakramaḥ]

virasāiṁ jāiṁ pamuhē, amayarasāyanti jāiṁ pariṇāmē
kajjāiṁ tāiṁ suviyāriyāiṁ na jaṇē hasijjanti // GāRaKō.232

sālūrī kasiṇabhuyaṅgamassa jaṁ khivaï matthaē calaṇaṁ
taṁ mannē kassa vi mantavāiṇō phuraï māhappaṁ // GāRaKō.233

ambayaphalaṁ supakkaṁ kuhiyaṁ biṇṭaṁ samuddhaō vāō
sāhā ḍollaṇasīlā na yāṇimō kattha pariṇāmō? // GāRaKō.234

kajjaṁ phalaṁ va sarasaṁ jāyaï niyakālapariṇaīpaḍiya
tamakālē ghippantaṁ duhāvahaṁ hōi virasaṁ ca // GāRaKō.235

tisu jē avutthapuvvā rāyakulē mahiyalē ya sēvāsu
viṇṇāṇa-nāṇa-laṭṭhattaṇāṇa tē bāhirā purisā // GāRaKō.236

siddhaṁ taṁ mannijjaï jaṁ sijjhaï sāma-bhēyanīīē
siddhaṁ pi taṁ asiddhaṁ pahāṇapurisakkhaō jattha // GāRaKō.237

aṇuyattaha bhaṇaha piyaṁ jaṁ kajjaṁ taṁ muṇēha cittēṇa
mahuraṁ lavaï maūrō savisaṁ ca bhuyaṅgamaṁ gilaï // GāRaKō.238

garuyāiṁ ciya sāhaï purisō kajjāiṁ natthi sandēhō
rōsō suraṅgadhūli vva jassa na hu pāyaḍō hōi // GāRaKō.239

suhaḍō na sō payaṅgō āvaṭṭhaï jō jaḍōpaïṭṭhō vva
apahāriyasuhakajjō nikkajjaṁ cēva khaggammi // GāRaKō.240

kaḍuyaṁ pi nāgaraṁ ciya pariṇāmamayaṁ, visaṁ na mahuraṁ pi
riuṇō vi varaṁ suyaṇā, mittāiṁ na uṇa khalapagaī // GāRaKō.241

samaē cciya kīrantā phalanti kiriyā suhā va asuhā vā
mēhāṇaṁ pi jalāiṁ dahanti cittāsu paḍiyāiṁ // GāRaKō.242

kiṁ cojjaṁ ṭhāṇavasēṇa jaṁ asantō vi jāyaē mahimā
saṅghaḍaï mahurimā ghaṇagayāṇa lavaṇōyahijalāṇaṁ // GāRaKō.243

paḍivakkhēsuṁ tēyassiṇā vi cariyavvamappamattēṇa
vuṭṭhīsu ravī purakayavāō cciya payaḍaï payāvaṁ // GāRaKō.244

kimpi payaṁ ahirūḍhō lahuō vi daḍhaṁ tavēi garuyaṁ pi
payatalakaṇṭayalēsō vi dahaï āmatthayaṁ dēhaṁ // GāRaKō.245


[p. 20]
avarēhiṁ vi jaṁ sijjhaï tammi kaē kiṁ parassa uvayariyaṁ
taraṇimmi daliyatimirē uvayaraï jaṇassa kiṁ dīvō? // GāRaKō.246

uvayariēsu vi kēsu vi ayasō vipphuraï sajjaṇāṇaṁ pi
maliṇattaṇaṁ pijalasōhaṇēṇa vimalāṇa vi karāṇaṁ // GāRaKō.247

dēvagharāṇa vi kāṇa va vaḍḍhantāṇaṁ kamēṇa saṅkōō
kēsiṁ pipuṇō jāyaï vitthārō pāyavāṇa vva // GāRaKō.248

lahuēṇa vi guruālambaṇēṇaahiyaṁ lahanti apasaṁsaṁ
nahabhaṅgēṇa vi paḍimāō dēvayāṇaṁ apujjāō // GāRaKō.249

payamunnayamahirōhanti kēvi dunnayapahēṇa vaccantā
mayagahilavibbhamāṇaṁ gayāṇa paviyambhaē agghō // GāRaKō.250

garuyāyanti aṇēgē vasaṇēsu aṇāulā puṇō viralā
vahusō santi mahagghā jalaṇē kaṇayassa puṇasuddhī // GāRaKō.251

avalaṁviyaṁ taṇāī vihalaṁ dhāranti ahava tuṭṭanti
avalaṁviya jē na hu taṇasamā vi ki tāṇa uṇa bhaṇimō? // GāRaKō.252

aviyāriūṇa kajjaṁ sahasa cciya jē narā payaṭṭanti
ḍajjhanti tē varāyā dīvasihāē payaṅgō vva // GāRaKō.253

avaraguṇēṇaṁ jāṇaṁ maḍappharō tāṇa nāma kō gavvō?
vāuvasārūḍhanahaṅgaṇāṇa dhūlīṇa kō mahimā? // GāRaKō.254



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[22. atha chēkaprakramaḥ]

vaṅkabhaṇiyāiṁ kattō? kattō addhacchipicchiyavvāiṁ?
ūsasiyaṁ pi muṇijjaï chaïllajaṇasaṅkulē gāmē // GāRaKō.255

līlāvalōyaṇēṇa vi muṇanti jē hiyayakajjaparamatthaṁ
tē kārimōvayārēhiṁ kaha ṇu chaïllā chalijjanti? // GāRaKō.256

sahasa tti jaṁ na diṭṭhō, sarahasacittēṇa jaṁ na ālattō
uvayārō jaṁ na kaō taṁ ciya kaliyaṁ chaïllēhiṁ // GāRaKō.257


[p. 21]
akkhaṇḍiyamuharāyāpuvvābhāsī abhinnamuharāyā
siḍhilantā vi siṇēhaṁ chēyā dukkhēṇa najjanti // GāRaKō.258

raccāvanti, na raccati, dinti dukkhaṁ, na dukkhiyā hōnti
asuṇivi ṇiyattaïṇhi dukkhārāhā jaē chēyā // GāRaKō.259

mā ruyasu suyaṇa! chēyāṇa aggaē jhijjhihinti nayaṇāiṁ
na hu bhijjaï tāṇa maṇaṁ vajjaṁ piva salilanivahēṇa // GāRaKō.260

raccanti nēya kassa vi, rattā vi mayacchi! na hu muṇijjanti
diṇakarakara vva chēyā adiṭṭhadōsā niyaṭṭanti // GāRaKō.261

rattē rattā, kasiṇammi kasiṇayā, majjhimammi majjhimayā
phalihamaṇi vva chayallā jattha gayā tattha raṅgillā // GāRaKō.262

jaha paḍhamadiṇē taha pacchimammi pharusāiṁ nēya jampanti
vvōchaïllapurisā viraccamāṇā vi dullakkhā // GāRaKō.263

jovvaṇabharēṇa aha maṇḍaṇēṇa hiyayaṁ haranti ramaṇīō
aṅganivēsabhavaṁ ciya chēyā magganti caṅgattaṁ // GāRaKō.264



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[23. atha hiyālīprakramaḥ]

vivarīyaraē lacchī bambhaṁ daṭṭhūṇa nāhikamalatthaṁ
hariṇō dāhiṇanayaṇaṁ karēṇabhaṇa jhampaē kīsa? // GāRaKō.265

sihipicchakannaūrā jāyā vāhassa gavvirī kīsa
muttāhalaraïyapasāhaṇāṇa majjhē savattīṇa? // GāRaKō.266

jaï sāsuyāē bhaṇiyā païvāsaharammi dīvayaṁ dēsu
tā kīsa pōḍhamahilā hasiūṇa palōvaē hiyaya? // GāRaKō.267

jaï sā sahīhiṁ bhaṇiā tujjha muhaṁ punnacandasāricchaṁ
tā kīsa muddhaḍamuhī karēṇa gaṇḍatthalaṁ phusaï? // GāRaKō.268

maḍayāvatthābharaṇā muyamaḍaēṇaṁ ca maṇḍiyakaraggā
maḍayārūḍhā muiyā piyassa muyapāṇiyaṁ dēi // GāRaKō.269


[p. 22]
daṭṭhūṇa taṁ juyāṇaṁ pariyaṇamajjhammi pōḍhamahilāē
upphulladalaṁ kamalaṁ karēṇa maülāviyaṁ kīsa? // GāRaKō.270

acchīhiṁ paī, sihaṇēhiṁ dēvarō, guruaṇō niaṁvēṇa
tinni visūrēivahū taṁ jāṇahakēṇa kajjēṇa? // GāRaKō.271

hiyayaṁ rōmuggiṇṇaṁpāyapahāraṁ sirēṇa icchantō
pahaō na piō māṇaṁsiṇīē thōraṁsuyaṁ ruyaṇaṁ // GāRaKō.272

daṭṭhr̥ṇa sāmisālaṁ kaṇṭhaṁ gahiūṇa nibbharaṁ runna
pattē viyālasamaē tā kīsa juyajjuyā sijjā? // GāRaKō.273

hantūṇa vaggayandaṁ vāhō vāhāṇa majjhayārammi
dhuyaï saraṁ piyaï jalaṁ taṁ jāṇaha kēṇa kajjēṇaṁ? // GāRaKō.274

ahiṇavapēmasamāgamajovvaṇariddhī vasantamāsammi
pavasantassa ya piuṇō bhaṇa kīsa palōiyaṁ sīsaṁ? // GāRaKō.275

viddhō vāhēṇa maō maēṇa vāhassa vaṇṭhiyaṁ kaṇḍaṁ
chinnaṁ mayassa sīsaṁ taha vi maō taṁ taṇaṁ caraï // GāRaKō.276

amuṇiya payāriharisaṅkarāṇasaddō ṇa[?]palāyanti
tāhi ciya garuigamaṇē! hā muddhē! kattha dīsihisi? // GāRaKō.277

jalajāyajāyavāhaṇagaīē ddaravahakalaṅkanayaṇīē
karanāsasīsasaghaṇatthaṇīē maha vimhiyaṁ hiyayaṁ // GāRaKō.278



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[24. atha vēśyāprakramaḥ]

dūrāgaya tti āyarapaḍicchiyaṁ pāyamūlapaḍiyaṁ pi
ujjhanti phāliūṇaṁ vēsā lēhaṁ va gahiatthaṁ // GāRaKō.279

lōhamayī guṇamukkā rattaṁ daṭṭhūṇa jīviyaṁ haraï
visabhalliya vva vēsā jaṁ pāvaï taṁ viṇāsēi // GāRaKō.280

sāmannasundarīṇaṁ vibbhamamāvahaï aviṇaō cēva
dhūmu cciya pajjaliyāṇa vahumaō surahidārūṇaṁ // GāRaKō.281

kayakaḍhiṇakōsapāṇā lōhapasāriyasarīrasaṭhāṇā
sundarasiyaṅgasōhā khaṇḍaï vēsā'silaṭṭi vva // GāRaKō.282


[p. 23]
annōnnarāyarasiyaṁ āsannapaōharaṁ guṇavihūṇaṁ
dhaṭṭaṁ sahāvavaṅkaṁ vēsāhiyayaṁ suradhaṇu vva // GāRaKō.283

ahiṇi vva kuḍilagamaṇē! rōraharē dīviya vva ninnēhē!
sukaï vva atthaluddhē! vēsē! diṭṭhā si, vaccāmō // GāRaKō.284

jaha laḍahatta jaha sā viaḍiḍhamā paṇavahūṇa jaha viṇaō
taha jaï pimmaṁ pi havejja kō salāhijja tā amayaṁ? // GāRaKō.285

nimmalapaüttahārā bahulōhā pulaïēṇa aṅgēṇa
khaggalaïya vva vēsā kōsēṇa viṇā na saṁvahaï // GāRaKō.286

sarasā nihasaṇasārā gandhaḍḍhā bahubhuyaṅgaparimiliyā
candaṇalaya vva vēsā bhaṇa kassa na vallahā hōī? // GāRaKō.287

atthacchēēṇa muhāiṁ hōnti visaübbhavāiṁ sēsāṇaṁ
tāiṁ ciya uṇa vēsāṇa, mūlamatthassa acchariyaṁ // GāRaKō.288



---------------------------------------------------------------------
[25. atha sarvāṅgastrīvarṇanaprakramaḥ]

maragayamañjīramaūhamiliyanaharayaṇakanticaraṇajuyaṁ
bālāruṇatimirāṇaṁ samaē[… // GāRaKō.289

… … …
… … … // GāRaKō.290

… … …] vihiṇō lattāirañjiyaṁ tassa
hiyayassa va vidū[?]nivaḍiyarōmāvalī jāyā // GāRaKō.291

rūvēṇa sē na sarisī annā atthi tti dappiyamaṇēṇa
majjhammi rōmarāī rēha vva kayā payāvaïṇā // GāRaKō.292

taddiyasakayāhāyā jaha jaha sihiṇō viṇinti vālāē
taha taha laddhāvāsa vva vammahō hiyayamāvisaï // GāRaKō.293

pīṇā ghaṇā sudūraṁ samuṇṇayā mahaviyambhiyacchāyā
mēhā thaṇā ya sē nivvavinti taṇhāuraṁ hiyayaṁ // GāRaKō.294


[p. 24]
muhacandamasandiddhaṁ sundaracandiyapavāhapāṇakaē
jīē caōramihuṇaṁ va āgayaṁ sahaï sihiṇajuaṁ // GāRaKō.295

rasasariyāē tīē tivalitaraṅgāē sihiṇacakkāē
ramaṇapuliṇammi kīlaṁ karēi ajja vi sisū mayaṇō // GāRaKō.296

visamēsumahīnāhassa vijayajattāē kayanivāsassa
raïpīiguḍḍarā iva urōruhā jīē rēhanti // GāRaKō.297

bhariuvvariyaṁ vihiṇō jaṁ amayaṁ taruṇisihiṇakalasāō
tattō mannē ghaḍiō asēsajaṇavallahō candō // GāRaKō.298

vayaṇāravindanīsandamāṇalāvannabidupanti vva
mottiyamālā kaṇṭhammi tīē parighōlirī sahaï // GāRaKō.299

niuṇavihikammanimmiyakavōlalāyaṇṇatacchaṇocchaliyā
tissā muhāō jāyā bāhirachalli vva sasirēhā // GāRaKō.300

ṇṇaṁciya sasivivaṁ vihiṇā sē nimmiyaṁ tayā vayaṇaṁ
jassa na kīttī[hāyaï]vahulavisāhāhi diyasēhi // GāRaKō.301

paḍibiṁviō jīē kavōlamaṇḍalēsuṁ nisāē nisināhō
nhāṇatthaṁ piva tammuhajōnhāē kalaṅkamalakalusō // GāRaKō.302

tuha muhasāricchaṁ na lahaï tti sampuṇṇamaṇḍalō vihiṇā
annamayaṁ va ghaḍēuṁ puṇō vi khaṇḍijjaï mayaṅkō // GāRaKō.303

aïsurahisāsaparibhamirabhamaraparibimbacumbiyakavōlaṁ
vayaṇaṁ calantamayaṇāhipattakōūhalaṁ jaṇaï // GāRaKō.304

aharacchalēṇa dinnā vihiṇā sindūrarāyamudda vva
vayaṇē viṁvanihā sē lāyannaṁ rakkhamāṇēṇa // GāRaKō.305

ēīē[?]aharahayāṇi mandāiṁ lajjamāṇāiṁ
viṁvaphalāiṁ ubbandhaṇaṁ va vallīsu virayanti // GāRaKō.306

vayaṇēṇa imīē viṇijjiyāiṁ jaṁ paṅkayāiṁ viyasanti
taṁ jalasaṁsaggakayaṁ mūḍhattaṁ phuraï tāṇa dhuvaṁ // GāRaKō.307

nayaṇāiṁ sāmalīē ghōlāviyamahuramandatārāiṁ
kassa na haranti hiyayaṁ gēyāiṁ va kannalaggāiṁ? // GāRaKō.308

nayaṇanaīsu ya jissā vāhōiva pavisiūṇa pañcasarō
bhūjualamisēṇa dhaṇuṁ taḍammi mottūṇa majjēi // GāRaKō.309


[p. 25]
sōhanti jīē savaṇā nayaṇanaīpavaharayahayappasarā
taruṇamaṇahariṇabandhē mayaṇamahāvāhapāsa vva // GāRaKō.310

addhindubinbasarisaṁ niḍālaphalayaṁ vihāyanippaṅkaṁ
jovvaṇasirīē muhadappaṇaṁ va vihiṇā viṇimmaviyaṁ // GāRaKō.311

ukkīriuṁmayaṅkaṁ vihiṇā muhamaṇḍalammi nimmaviē
tacchiyalañchaṇavallarikaraṇiṁ kuralāvalī kuṇaī // GāRaKō.312

piṭṭhiṭṭhiēṇa rēhaï muddhā pihulēṇa ciurabhārēṇa
niyamuhamayaṅkanijjiabhīēṇa va timiranivahēṇa // GāRaKō.313

mayaṇaggiṇō vva dhūmaṁ, mōhaṇapicchaṁ va lōyadiṭṭhīē
jovvaṇadhayaṁ va muddhā vahaï suyandhaṁ ciurabhāraṁ // GāRaKō.314

pāusasiri vva unnayapaōharā, dhaṇulaya vva guṇakaliyā
nayara vva dīharacchā bālāsukahā ii mahatthā // GāRaKō.315

ekkō vi paēsō avayavāṇa sō natthi sāmalaṅgīē
saṁvaṭṭiyacā[?]vakkhanti taruṇīō // GāRaKō.316

taïya'cchisihisihābhāsurēṇa bhuvaṇē harēṇa akkantē
aharaṭṭhāṇē tuha suyaṇu! vasaï niruvaddavamaṇaṅgō // GāRaKō.317

taha pāviyakhaṇḍaṇa-pīlaṇō vi jō vaïi nibbharaṁ rāyaṁ
jaï sō vi hōi aharō kō uṇa tuha uttarō suyaṇu! // GāRaKō.318

jaï koṭṭimō si ujjayasayalatihīcandadaṁsaṇasayaṇhō
tā[?]karō jattha aṇaṅgōna vīsamaï // GāRaKō.319

amaekkanihīṇaṁ taraï kō ṇu juvaīṇa vanniuṁ mahimaṁ?
jāṇa pabhāvē sahalattamēi sakkassa vi samiddhī // GāRaKō.320
