texts.content:
[p. 1]
jō vivihamattasāarapāraṁ pattō vi vimalamaïhēlaṁ ।
paḍhamabbhāsataraṁḍōṇāō sō piṅgalō jaaï ॥ // PrāPi.1 [gāthā]


[p. 2]
dīhō sañjuttaparōbindujuō pāḍiō a caraṇantē ।
sa gurū vaṅka dumattōaṇṇō lahu hōi suddha aïkālō ॥ // PrāPi.2 [udgāthā]

[jihā]
māī rūē hēōhiṇṇō jiṇṇō a vuḍḍaō dēō ।
sambhuṁ kāmantī sāgōrī gahilattaṇaṁ kuṇaï ॥ // PrāPi.3 [gāthā]


[p. 3]
katthavi sañjuttaparōvaṇṇō lahu hōi daṁsaṇēṇa jahā ।
parilhasaï cittadhijjaṁtaruṇikaḍakkhammi ṇivvuttam ॥ // PrāPi.4 [gāthā]


[p. 4]
ihikārā bindujuāēō suddhā a vaṇṇamiliā vi lahū ।
rahavañjaṇasañjōēparē asēsaṁ vi hōi savihāsaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.5 [siṁhinī]

māṇiṇi māṇahĩ kāĩ phalaēō ja caraṇa paḍu kanta ।
sahaja bhuaṅgama jaï ṇamaïkiṁ kariē maṇimanta ॥ // PrāPi.6 [dōhā]


[p. 5]
[rahavañjaṇasañjōassa jahā]
cēu sahaja tuhum̐ cañcalāsundarihadahĩ valanta ।
paa uṇa ghallasi khullaṇākīlasi uṇa ulhasanta ॥ // PrāPi.7 [dōhā]


[p. 6]
jaï dīhō vi a vaṇṇōlahu jīhā paḍhaï hōi sō vi lahū ।
vaṇṇō vi turiapaḍhiōdāttiṇṇi vi ēka jāṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.8 [gāthā]

[jahā]
arērē vāhahi kānha ṇāvachōḍi ḍagamaga kugati ṇa dēhi ।
taī ithi ṇadihĩ sam̐tāra dēijō cāhahi sō lēhi ॥ // PrāPi.9 [dōhā]


[p. 7]
jama ṇa sahaï kaṇaatulātila tuliaṁ addhaaddhēṇa ।
tama ṇa sahaï savaṇatulāavachandaṁ chandabhaṅgēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.10 [gāhū]

abuha buhāṇaṁ majjhēkavvaṁ jō paḍhaï lakkhaṇavihūṇaṁ ।
bhūaggalaggakhaggahĩsīsaṁ khuḍiaṁ ṇa jāṇēi ॥ // PrāPi.11 [gāthā]


[p. 8]
ṭṭhaḍaḍhāṇaha majjhēgaṇabhēā hōti pañca akkharaō ।
chapacatadā jahasaṅkhaṁchappañcacaüttidukalāsu ॥ // PrāPi.12 [gāthā]

ṭagaṇō tērahabhēōbhēā aṭṭhāi hōnti ṭhagaṇassa ।
ḍagaṇassa pañca bhēā tia ḍhagaṇē bē vi ṇagaṇassa ॥ // PrāPi.13 [gāthā]


[p. 9]
[aha patthārō]
paḍhama guru hēṭṭhaṭhāṇēlahuā pariṭhavahu appabuddhīē ।
sarisā sarisā pantīuvvariā gurulahū dēhu ॥ // PrāPi.14 [gāthā]

[aha chakalapatthārē gaṇāṇaṁ ṇāmāī]
hara sasi sūrō sakkō sēsō ahi kamala bambha kali candō ।
dhua dhammō sāliarō tēraha bhēā chamattāṇaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.15 [gāthā]


[p. 10]
[aha pañcakalāṇaṁ ṇāmā]
indāsaṇa aru sūrōcāō hīrō a sēharō kusumō ।
ahigaṇa pāpagaṇō dhuapañcakalē piṅgalēṁ kahiō ॥ // PrāPi.16 [gāthā]

[aha caükkalāṇaṁ ṇāmāī]
gurujua kaṇṇō guruanta karaala paōharammi gurumajjhō ।
āiguru vvasucaraṇō vipyō savvēhi lahuēhĩ ॥ // PrāPi.17 [gāthā]

[aha tiṇṇakalāṇaṁ ṇāmāī]
dhaa ciṇha cira cirālaa tōmaratumbūrupatta cuamālā ।
rasavāsapavaṇavalaaṁ lahuālambēṇa jāṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.18 [gāthā]


[p. 11]
[aha tialagaṇa [dui patthārassa ṇāmāī]
suravaï paṭavva tālā karatālāṇanda chandēṇa ।
ṇivvāṇaṁ sasamudaṁ tūraṁ ēha pyamāṇēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.19 [gāhū]

[aha tialagaṇa taïa patthārassa ṇāmāī]
bhāvā rasatāṁḍava ṇārīaṁ kuṇaha bhāviṇiaṁ ।
tilahugaṇassa kaïarō ia ṇāmaṁ piṅgalō kahaï ॥ // PrāPi.20 [gāhū]

[aha dukalāṇaṁ ṇāmāī]
ṇēurarasaṇābharaṇaṁ cāmaraphaṇimuddhakaṇaakuṁḍalaaṁ ।
vaṅkaṁ māṇasavalaaṁ hārāvali ēha guruassa ॥ // PrāPi.21 [gāthā]

[bilahu ṇāmāī]
ṇiapia paramaü supiē bilhu ti samāsu kaïdiṭṭha ।
aha caümattaha ṇāmaṁ phaṇirāō païgaṇaṁ bhaṇaï ॥ // PrāPi.22 [gāhū]

suraalaaṁ gurujualaṁ kaṇṇasamāṇēṇa rasiarasalaggaṁ ।
maṇaharaṇa sumaïlambia lahalahiaṁ tā suvaṇṇēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.23 [gāthā]


[p. 12]
[aha antaguru ṇāmāī]
karapāṇikamalahatthaṁ bāhū bhuadaṁḍapaharaṇaasaṇiaṁ ।
gaabharaṇaraaṇaṇāṇābhuabharaṇaṁ hōti supasiddhaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.24 [gāthā]

[aha majjhaguru ṇāmāī]
bhuavaïasaṇaragaavaï vasuhāhivarajjugōvālō ।
uṇṇāakacakkavaī paaharathaṇaaṁ ṇarindāĩ ॥ // PrāPi.25 [gāhū]

[aha āiguru ṇāmāī]
paapāacaraṇajualaṁ avaru paāsēi gaṁḍavalahaddam ।
tāapiāmahadahaṇaṁ ṇēuraraïjaṅghajualēhĩ ॥ // PrāPi.26 [gāthā]

[aha savvalahuassa ṇāmāī]
paḍhamaṁ ērisi vippō bīē sarapañca jāisiharēhĩ ।
diavaraparamōpāē hōi caükkēṇa lahuēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.27 [gāthā]


[p. 13]
[aha pañcakalāṇaṁ āilahuassa ṇāmāī]
suṇarindaahiakuñjarugaavarudantāi danti aha mēhō ।
ērāvaïtārāvaïgaaṇaṁ jhampaṁ ta lampēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.28 [gāthā]

[aha majjhala assa (ṇāmāī)]
pakkhivirāḍamaïndahavīṇāahijakkhaamiajōhalaaṁ ।
suppaṇṇapaṇṇagāsaṇagaruḍa viāṇēhu majjhalahuēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.29 [udgāthā]

bahuvivihapaharaṇēhiṁ pañcakalaō gaṇō hōi ।
gaarahaturaṅgapāikka ēhu ṇāmēṇa jāṇa caümattā ॥ // PrāPi.30 [viggāhā]

tāḍaṅkahāraṇēurakēuraō hōti gurubhēā ।
saramērudaṁḍakāhala lahubhēā hōti ēttāĩ ॥ // PrāPi.31 [gāhū]


[p. 14]
saṅkhaṁ phullaṁ kāhala ravaṁ asēsēhĩ hōnti kaṇaalaaṁ।
rūaṁ ṇāṇākusumaṁ rasagandhaṁ saddaparamāṇaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.32 [gāhā]

[aha vaṇagaṇā]
mō tigurū ṇō tilahū lahuguruāīṁ yabhā ja majjhagurū ।
majjhalahū rō sō uṇa antagurū tō vi antalahuēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.33 [udgāthā]

[aha gaṇadēvatā.]
puhavījalasihikālō gaaṇaṁ sūrō a candamā ṇāō ।
gaṇa aṭṭha iṭṭhadēō jahasaṅkhaṁ piṅgalē kahiō ॥ // PrāPi.34 [gāthā]


[p. 15]
magaṇa ṇagaṇa dui mitta hō bhagaṇa yagaṇa hō bhicca ।
āsīṇa jata duaü gaṇa avasiṭṭhaü ari ṇicca ॥ // PrāPi.35 [dōhā]

[ahaṁ gaṇaphala]
magaṇa riddhi thirakajja yagaṇa suhasampaa dijjaï ।
ragaṇa maraṇa sampalaï jagaṇa kharakiraṇa visajjaḍa ॥
tagaṇa suṇṇa phala kahaï sagaṇa sahadēsu vvāsaï
bhagaṇa racaï maṅgala aṇēka kaï piṅgala bhāsaï ॥
jata kavva gāha dōhaï muṇahu ṇagaṇa hōi paḍhamakkharahi ।
tasu riddhi buddhi savvaī phurahi raṇa rāula duttara taraï ॥ // PrāPi.36 [chappaa]


[p. 16]
[aha dugaṇa viārō]
mitta mitta dē riddhi buddhi aru maṅgala dijjaï
mitta bhicca thirakajja jujjha ṇibbhaa jaa kijjaï ।
mitta āsē kajjabandha ṇahi puṇu puṇu chijjaï
mitta hōi jaï sattu gōttabandhava pīḍijjaï ॥
aru bhicca mitta sava kajjahō bhicca bhicca āatti cala
sava bhicca uāsē dhaṇu ṇasaï bhicca vaïri hākanda phala ॥ // PrāPi.37 [chappaa]

uāsīṇa jaï mitta kajja kichu manda dikhāvaï
uāsīṇa jaï bhicca savva āatti calāvaï ।
uāsīṇa uāsē mandabhala kichu ṇahi dakkhia
āsīṇa jaï sattu gōtta vaïriu kaï lakkhia ।
jaï sattu mitta hō suṇṇaphala sattu bhiccahō gharaṇiṇasa
puṇu sattu āsē dhaṇa ṇasaï sattu sattu ṇāakka khasa ॥ // PrāPi.38 [chappaa]


[p. 17]
[aha mattāṇaṁ uddiṭuṁ]
puvva juala sari aṅkā dijjasu । gurusira aṅkē sēsa maṭijjasu ।
uvaralaaṅka lakkhi kahu āṇahu । tē paridhua uddiṭṭhā jāṇahu ॥ // PrāPi.39 [aḍillā-arillā]

ṇaḍhē savvakalā kārijjasu । puvva juala sari aṅkā dijjasu ।
pucchalaaṅka miṭāvahi sēkha । uvarala aṅka lōpi kahu lēkha ॥ // PrāPi.40

jattha jattha pāvijjaï bhāga । ēhu kahaï phura piṅgala ṇāga ।
paramattā lēi gurutā jāi । jata lakkhahu tata lakkhahu āi ॥ // PrāPi.41 [pādākulaka]


[p. 18]
[aha vaṇṇāṇaṁ uddiṭuṁ]
akkhara uppari duṇṇāaṅkā dijjahu muṇēhu uddiṭṭhā ।
lahu uppari jō aṅkō taṁ dēi ēkkēṇa jāṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.42 [gāthā]


[p. 19]
[āsāṁ ṇaṭuṁ]
ṇaḍhē aṅkē bhāga karijjasu । samabhāgahĩ tahi lahu mūṇijjasu ।
visama ēka dēi vaṁṭaṇa kijjasu । piṅgala jampaï guru āṇijjasu ॥ // PrāPi.43 [aḍillā]


[p. 20]
[aha vaṇṇamēru]
akkhara saṅkhē kāḍha karuāi anta paḍhamaka ।
sira dui aṅkē avaru bharusūī mēru ṇisaṅka ॥ // PrāPi.44 [dōhā]


[p. 21]

[p. 22]
[aha assa patākā]
udiṭhṭhā sari aṅkā dijjasu । puvva aṅka parabharaṇa karijjasu ।
pāvala aṅka paḍhama paridijjasu । pattharasaṅkha patākā kijjasu ॥ // PrāPi.45 [aḍillā]

[aha mattā mēru]
dui dui kāṭṭhā sari lihahu paḍhama aṅka tasu anta ।
tasu āihi puṇa ēkka saü paḍhamē bē vi milanta ॥ // PrāPi.46 [dōhā]

sira aṅkē tasu sira para aṅkē । uvarala kāṭṭa purahu ṇīsakē ।
mattāmēru aṅka sañcāri । bujjhahu bujjhahu jaṇa dui cāri ॥ // PrāPi.47 [pādākulaka]


[p. 23]

[p. 24]
[aha mattā patākā]
uddiṭṭhā sari aṅkā thappahu । vāmāvattē para lē luppahu ।
ēkka lōpa aïkka guru āṇahu । dui tiṇi lōpē dui tiṇi jāṇahu ।
matta patākā piṅgala gāva । jō pāvaï sō parahi milāva ॥ // PrāPi.48 [aḍillā+ pādākularka]

[aha vittassa lahuguruāṇaṁ]
pucchala chanda kalā kaī pucchala vaṇṇa miṭāva ।
avasiṭē guru jāṇiahu lahu jāṇivvaü tāva ॥।dōhā। // PrāPi.49


[p. 25]

[p. 26]
[aha sakalapatthāra saṅkhā]
chabbīsā sattasaā taha sattāraha sahassāĩ ।
bāālīsaṁ lakkhaṁ tēraha kōḍī samaggāī॥50॥ // PrāPi.50 [gāhū]


[p. 27]
[aha gāhāpaaraṇaṁ (atha gāthāprakaraṇam)]
hōi gāhū matta caüaṇṇa gāhāi sattāvaṇī ।
taha viggāha palaṭṭi kijjaï uggāhaü saṭṭhi kala ॥
gāhiṇī a bāsaṭṭi kijjaï ।
taha vi palaṭṭaï siṁhiṇī bē aggala hō sahi ।
sattarūa aṇṇōṇṇa gaṇa khandha matta caüsaṭṭhi ॥ // PrāPi.51 [raḍḍā]


[p. 28]
[aha gāhū]
puvvaddhē uttaddhē sattaggala matta vīsā ।
chaṭṭhamagaṇa paamajjhē gāhū mēru vva jualāĩ ।52॥ // PrāPi.52 [gāhū]

[jahā]
candō candaṇa hārō tāva a rūaṁ paāsanti ।
caṁḍēsaravarakittī jāva ṇa appaṁ ṇidaṁsēi ॥ // PrāPi.53 [gāhū]


[p. 29]
[aha gāhā]
paḍhamaṁ bāraha mattā bīē aṭṭhārahēhĩ sañjuttā ।
jaha paḍhamaṁ taha tīaṁ dahapañca vihūsiā gāhā ॥ // PrāPi.54 [gāhā]

[jahā]
jēṇa viṇā ṇa jivijjaï aṇuṇijjaï sō kaāvarāhō vi ।
pattē vi ṇaaraḍāhē bhaṇa kassa ṇa vallahō aggī ॥ // PrāPi.55 [gāhā]


[p. 30]
sattagaṇā dīhantā jō ṇa lahū chaṭṭha ṇēha jō visamē ।
taha gāhē vi a addhē chaṭhē lahuaṁ viāṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.56 [gāhā]

savvāē gāhāē sattāvaṇṇāi hōti mattāī।
puvvaddhami a tīsā sattāīsā paradami ॥ // PrāPi.57 [gāhā]

sattāīsā hārā sallā jassaṁmi tiṇṇi rēhāī।
sā gāhāṇaṁ gāhā āā tīsakkharā lacchī ॥ // PrāPi.58 [gāhā]


[p. 31]
tīsakkharāhĩ lacchī savvē vandanti hōi vikkhāā ।
hāsaï ēvaṁ ēkkaṁ vaṇṇaṁ tā kuṇaha ṇāmāī ॥ // PrāPi.59 [gāhā]

lacchī riddhī buddhī lajjā vijjā khamā a dēhīā ।
gōrī dhāī cuṇṇā chāā kantī mahāmāī ॥ // PrāPi.60 [lacchī]

kittī siddhī māṇī rāmā gāhiṇī visā a vāsīā ।
sōhā hariṇī cakkī sārasi kurarī sihī a haṁsīā ॥ // PrāPi.61 [uggāhā]


[p. 32]
paḍhamaṁ vī haṁsapaaṁ bīē sīhassa vikkama jāā ।
tīē gaavaraluliaṁ ahivaraluliaṁ caütthaē gāhā ॥ // PrāPi.62 [gāhā]

ēkkē jē kulamantī bē ṇāakkēhĩ hōi saṅgahiṇī ।
ṇāakahīṇā raṁḍā vēsā bahuṇāakā hōi ॥ // PrāPi.63 [gāhā]

tēraha lahuā vippī ēāīsēhiṁ khattiṇī bhaṇiā ।
sattāīsā vēsī sēsā sā suddiṇī hōi ॥ // PrāPi.64 [gāhā]


[p. 33]
jā paḍhama tīa pañcama sattama ṭhāṇē ṇa hōi gurumajjhā ।
guvviṇiē guṇarahiā gāhā dōsaṁ paāsēi ॥ // PrāPi.65 [gāhā]

[aha viggāhā ।]
viggāhā paḍhama dalē sattāīsāī mattāī।
pacchima dalē ṇa tīsā ia jampia piṅgalēṇa ṇāēṇa ॥ // PrāPi.66 [viggāhā]


[p. 34]
[jahā]
parihara māṇiṇi māṇaṁ pakkhahi kusumāī ṇīvassa ।
tumha kaē kharahiaō gaṇhaï guḍiādhaṇuṁ a kira kāmō ॥ // PrāPi.67 [viggāhā]

[aha uggāhā]
puvvaddhē uttaddhē mattā tīsanti suhaa sambhaṇiā।
sō uggāhō vuttō piṅgala kaï diṭṭha saṭṭi mattaṅgō ॥ // PrāPi.68 [uggāhā]


[p. 35]
[jahā]
sōūṇa jassa ṇāmaṁ aṁsū ṇaaṇāī sumuhi rundhati ।
bhaṇa vīra cēivaïṇō pakkhāmi muhaṁ kahaṁ jahicchaṁ sē ॥ // PrāPi.69 [uggāhā]

[aha gāhiṇī siṁhiṇī]
puvvaddha tīsa mattāpiṅgala pabhaṇēi muddhiṇi suṇēhi ।
uttaddhē battīsāgāhiṇi vivarīa siṁhiṇī bhaṇu saccaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.70 [gāhiṇī]


[p. 36]
[gāhiṇī jahā]
muñcahi sundari pāaṁ appahi hasiūṇa sumuhi khaggaṁ mē ।
kappia mēcchaśarīraṁ pacchaḍa vaaṇāīṁ tumha dhua hammīrō ॥ // PrāPi.71 [gāhiṇī]

[siṁhiṇī jahā]
varisaï kaṇaaha viḍhēi tappaï bhuaṇē diāṇisaṁ jaggantō।
ṇīsaṅka sāhasakō ṇidaï indaṁ a sūrabimbaṁ a ॥ // PrāPi.72 [siṁhiṇī]


[p. 37]
[aha khandhaā (atha skandhaka)]
caümattā aṭṭhagaṇā puvvaddhē uttaraddha hōi samarūā ।
sā khandhaā viāṇahu piṅgala pabhaṇēi muddhi bahusambhēā ॥ // PrāPi.73 [khandhaā]

[jahā]
jaṁ jaṁ āṇēi giri raïrahacakkaparighaṭṭaṇasahaṁ haṇuā ।
taṁ taṁ līlāi ṇalō vāmakaratthaṁhiaṁ raēi samuddē ॥ // PrāPi.74 [skandhaka]


[p. 38]
ṇandaü bhaddaü sēsa saraṅgasiva bambha vāraṇa varuṇa ।
ṇīlu maaṇa tālaṅka sēharusaru gaaṇu sarahu vimaï ॥
khīra ṇaaru ṇaru ṇiddha ṇēhalu ॥
maagalu bhōalu suddha sarikumbha kalasa sasi jāṇa ।
sarahasēsasasahara muṇahu sattāisa khandhāṇa ॥ // PrāPi.75 [rājasēnā]

caü lahu katthavi pasara jahiṁ sō sahi ṇandaü jāṇa ।
guru ṭuṭṭaï bi bi lahu vaḍhaï taṁ taṁ ṇāma viāṇa ॥ // PrāPi.76 [dōhā]

[jahā]
candā kundā kāsāhārā hīrā tilōaṇā kēlāsā ।
jēttā jēttā sēttā tēttā kāsīsa jiṇṇiā tē kittī ॥. // PrāPi.77 [nanda-skandhaka]


[p. 39]
[aha dōhā]
tēraha mattā paḍhama paapuṇu ēārahĩ dēha ।
puṇu tēraha ēārahaïdōhā lakkhaṇa ēha ॥ // PrāPi.78 [dōhā]

[jahā]
suraaru surahī parasamaṇiṇahi vīrēśa samāṇa ।
ō vakkala ō kaṭhiṇataṇuō pasu ō pāsāṇa ॥ // PrāPi.79 [dōhā]


[p. 40]
bhamaru bhāmaru sarahu sēvāṇamaṁḍūka makkaḍu karahu ।
ṇaru marālu maagalu paōharubalu vāṇaru tiṇṇi kalu ॥
kaccha maccha sahūla ahivaru ।
vaghya virāḍaü suṇaha tahaundura sappapamāṇa ।
guru ṭuṭṭaï bē lahu vaḍhaïtaṁ taṁ ṇāma viāṇa ॥ // PrāPi.80 [raḍā]

chabbīsakkhara bhamara hō guru bāisa lahu cāri ।
guru ṭuṭṭaï bē lahu vaḍhaï taṁ taṁ ṇāma viāri ॥ // PrāPi.41 [dōhā]

[jahā]
jā addhaṅgē pavvaīsīsē gaṅgā jāsu ।
jō dēāṇaṁ vallahōvandē pāaṁ tāsu ॥ // PrāPi.82 [dōhā-bhramara]


[p. 41]
bāraha lahuā vippītaha bāīsēhiṁ khattiṇī bhaṇiā ।
battīsa hōi bēsījā iarā suddiṇī hōī ॥ // PrāPi.83 [gāhā]

jassā paḍhamahiṁ tīōjagaṇā dīsanti pāa pāēṇa ।
caṁḍālaha ghararahiādōhā dōsaṁ paāsēi ॥ // PrāPi.84 [gāhā]

chakkalu cakkalu tiṇi kalu ēma pari visama paanti ।
sama pāhĩ antakka kalu ṭhavi dōhā ṇibhanti ॥ // PrāPi.85 [dōhā]


[p. 42]
diavaragaṇa dhari jualapuṇa via tialahu paala
ima vihi vihu chaü paaṇijima suhaï susasi raaṇi
iha rasiaü miaṇaaṇiēadaha kala gaagamaṇi ॥ // PrāPi.86 [rasikā]

[jahā]
vimuha calia raṇa acalupariharia haagaavalu
halahalia malaaṇivaïjasu jasa tihuaṇa piaï
varaṇasi ṇakhaï luliasaala uvari jasu phulia ॥ // PrāPi.87 [rasikā]


[p. 43]
āikavva ukkacchakiu lōhaṅgiṇi maha sāru ।
guru vaḍḍaï bi bi lahu ghaṭaïtaṁ taṁ ṇāma viāru ॥ // PrāPi.88 [dōhā]

lōhaṅgiṇi haṁsīārēhā tālaṅki kampi gambhīrā ।
kālī kalarudāṇī ukkacchā aṭṭha ṇāmāī ॥ // PrāPi.89 [gāhā]


[p. 44]
lōhaṅgiṇi savva lahū jattha guru ēkka sā haṁsī ।
jaṁ jaṁ vaḍḍaï hārō ṇāmaṁ jō jattha sō tattha ॥[iti ukkacchā] // PrāPi.90 [gāhū]

[aha rōlā]
paḍhama hōi caüvīsa matta antara guru juttēpiṅgala hām̐tē sēsa ṇāa taṇhi rōlā uttē ।
ēggārāhā hārā rōlā chandō jujjaïēkkē ēkkē ṭuṭṭaï aṇṇō aṇṇō vaḍḍaï ॥ // PrāPi.91 [rōlā]


[p. 45]
[jahā]
paabharu daramaru dharaṇi taraṇiraha dhullia jhampiakamaṭhapiṭṭha ṭaraparia mēru mandara sira kampia ।
kōha calia hammīravīra gaajūha sam̐juttēkiaü kaṭṭha hākanda mucchimēcchahakē puttē ॥ // PrāPi.92 [rōlā]


[p. 46]

[p. 47]
kunda karaala mēha tālaṅkakalarudda kōila kamalu ।
indu sambhu cāmaru gaṇēsarusahasakkhō sēsa bhaṇa ॥
ṇāarāa jampaï phaṇīsaru ।
tēraha akkhara jaṁ palaïiggāraha vaṅkēhĩ ।
akkhara akkhara jaṁ vaḍhaïtaṁ taṁ ṇāma kuṇēhi ॥[iti rōlā] // PrāPi.93 [raḍḍā]

[aha gandhāṇa]
dahasatta vaṇṇa paḍhama paa bhaṇaha suaṇā
taha bīaṁmi aṭṭhārahahiṁ jamaa jua caraṇā ।
ērisi a bīa dala kuṇahu bhaṇaï piṅgalō
gandhāṇā ṇāma rūaü hō paṁḍiajaṇacittaharō ॥ // PrāPi.94 [gandhāṇa]

dahasattakkhara saṁṭhavahu paḍhamacaraṇa gandhāṇa ।
bīakkhara puṇu jamaa daï aṭṭhārahaï viāṇa ॥ // PrāPi.95 [dōhā]


[p. 48]
[jahā]
kaṇṇa calatē kumma calaï puṇuvi asaraṇā ।
kumma calatē mahi calaï bhuaṇabhaakaraṇā ।
mahi a calatē mahiharu taha a suraaṇā
cakkavaï calatē calaï cakka taha tihuaṇā ॥ // PrāPi.96 [gandhāṇa]

[aha caüpaïyā]
caüpaïā chandā bhaṇaï phaṇindācaümattā gaṇa sattā ।
pāēhi saguru kari tīsa matta dharicaü saa asi a ṇiruttā ।
caü chanda lavijjaï ēkku ṇa kijjaïkō jāṇaï ēhu bhēū ।
kaḍa piṅgala bhāsaï chanda paāsaï miaṇaaṇi amia ēhū ॥ // PrāPi.97 [caüpaïā]


[p. 49]
[jahā]
jasu sīsahi gaṅgā gōri adhaṅgā giva pahiria phaṇihārā ।
kaṁṭhaṭṭia vīsā pindhaṇa dīsā santāria saṁsārā ॥
kiraṇāvalikandā vandia candā ṇaaṇahi aṇala phurantā ।
sō sampaa dijjaü bahu suha kijjaü tumha bhavāṇīkantā ॥ // PrāPi.98 [caüpaïā]


[p. 50]
[aha ghattā]
piṅgala kaī diṭṭhaü chanda ukiṭṭhaü ghatta matta bāsaṭṭi kari ।
caümatta satta gaṇa bē vipāa bhaṇa tiṇṇi tiṇi lahu anta dhari ॥ // PrāPi.99 [ghattā]

paḍhamaṁ daha bīsāmō bīē mattāĩ aṭṭhāī।
tīē tēraha viraī ghattā mattāī bāsaṭṭhi ॥ // PrāPi.100 [gāhā]

[jahā]
raṇadakkha dakkhahaṇu jiṇṇa kusumadhaṇu andhaagandhaviṇāsakaru ।
sō rakkhaü saṅkaru asurabhaaṅkaru gōri ṇāri addhaṅga dharu ॥ // PrāPi.101 [ghattā]


[p. 51]
[aha ghattānanda]
sō ghattaha kulasāra kitti apāru ṇāarāa piṅgala kahaï ।
ēāraha vīsāma ṇandaü ṇāma puṇu vi satta tēraha viraï ॥ // PrāPi.102 [ghattā]

uḍḍuuṇahapaha bhamaü khagga riusīsahi jhallaü ।
pakkhara pakkhara ṭhēlli palli pavvaa apphālā ॥
hammīrakajju jajjala bhaṇaha kōhāṇalamaha maï jalaü ।
sulatāṇa sīsa karavāla daï tajji kalēvara dia calaü ॥ // PrāPi.103 [chappaya]

[jahā]
jō vandia sira gaṅga haṇia aṇaṅga addhaṅgahi parikara dharaṇu ।
sō jōī jaṇamitta haraü duritta saṅkāharu saṅkaracaraṇu ॥ // PrāPi.104 [dhattāṇanda]


[p. 52]
[aha chappaü]
chappaa chanda chaïla suṇahu akkharasañjuttaü ।
ēāraha tasu viraï ta puṇu tēraha ṇibbhantaü ॥
bē mattā dhari paḍhama ta puṇu caü caü kala kijjaï ।
majjhaṭṭhia gaṇa pañca hēṭṭha biṇṇa vi lahu dijjaï ॥
ulāla viraï bē paṇṇaraha mattā aṭṭhāisa sōi ।
ēma bhaṇaha muṇaha chappaa paa aṇahā itthi ṇa kimpi hōi ॥ // PrāPi.105

[jahā]
pindhaü diḍha saṇṇāha vāha uppara pakkhara daï ।
bandhu samadi raṇa dhasaü sāmi hammīra vaaṇa laï ॥

[p. 53]
uḍḍuuṇahapaha bhamaü khagga riusīsahi jhallaü ।
pakkhara pakkhara ṭhēlli palli pavvaa apphālā ॥
hammīrakajju jajjala bhaṇaha kōhāṇalamaha maï jalaü ।
sulatāṇa sīsa karavāla daï tajji kalēvara dia calaü ॥ // PrāPi.106 [chappaya]


[p. 54]
paa paa talaü ṇibaddha matta caübīsaha kijjaï ।
akkhara ḍambara sarisa chanda ia suddha bhaṇijjaï ॥
āihi chakkalu hōi cāri caükalaü ṇiruttaü ।
dukkala anta ṇibaddha sēsa kaï vatthu ṇivuttaü ।
bāvaṇṇa saü vi mattaha muṇahu ullālaü sahiaü guṇaha ।
chappaa chanda ērisi vi hōi kāĩ ganthi ganthi vi maraha ॥ // PrāPi.107 [chappaya]


[p. 55]
[jahā]
jahā saraa sasi bimba jahā harahāra haṁsa ṭhia ।
jahā phula sia kamala jahā sirikhaṁḍa khaṁḍa kia॥
jahā gaṅga kallōla jahā rōsāṇia ruppaï ।
jahā duddhavara suddha phēṇa phamphāi talapphaï ॥
pia pāa pasāē diṭṭhi puṇu ṇihua hasaï jaha taruṇijaṇa ।
varamanti caṁḍasara kitti tua tattha dēkkha haribambha bhaṇa ॥ // PrāPi.108 [chappaya]


[p. 56]
[aha kavva lakkhaṇa]
āi anta duhu chakkalaü tiṇṇi turaṅgama majjha ।
tīē jagaṇu ki vippagaṇu kavvaha lakkhaṇa bujjha ॥ // PrāPi.109 [dōhā]

caü aggala cālīsa guru ēkkakkē guru lēhu ।
jō guruhīṇaü sakka sō ṇāma ggahaṇa kuṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.110 [dōhā]

[jahā]
jasu kara phaṇivaï valaa taruṇivara taṇumaha vilasaï ।
ṇaaṇa aṇala gala garala vimala sasahara sira ṇivasaï ॥
surasari siramaha rahaï saalajaṇa durita damaṇa kara ।
hasi sasihara hara duria vihara hara atula abhaavara ॥ // PrāPi.111 [sakka]


[p. 57]
jaha jaha valaā vaḍḍihaḍa taha taha ṇāma kuṇēhu ।
sambhuhi saüm̐ bhaṇa bhiṅgagaṇa caüālīsa muṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.112 [dōhā]

tā sakkō sambhō sūrō gaṁḍō khandhō vijaō dappō
tālaṅkō samarō sīhō sīsō uttēō paḍivakkhō ।
paridhamma marālu maïndō daṁḍō makkalu maaṇu marahō
vāsantō kaṁṭhō mōrō bandhō bhamarō bhiṇṇamaraṭṭhō ॥ // PrāPi.113

valahadō rāō valiō mōhō santhāṇō bali mēhō
sahasakkhō bālō dariō sarahō dambhō'hō udambhō ।
valiaṅkō turaō hariṇō andhō muddhīē taha bhiṅgō
vatthūā ṇāmō piṅgalaṇāō jampaï chandapabandhō ॥ // PrāPi.114 [caüpaïā]

pacatālīsaha vatthuā chandē chanda viambha ।
addhā kaï piṅgala kahaï calaï ṇa harihara bambha ॥ // PrāPi.115 [dōhā]


[p. 58]
paaha asuddhaü paṅguhīṇa khōḍaü paṇijjaï
mattaggala vāulaü suṇṇakala kaṇṇa suṇijjaï ।
jhalavajjia taha bahira andha laṅkāraha rahiaü
vulaü chanda uṭṭavaṇa attha viṇu dubbala kahiaü ॥
ḍēraü haṭṭakkharahiṁ hōi kāṇā guṇa savvahĩ rahia ।
savvaṅgasuddha samarūaguṇa chappaa dōsa piṅgalu kahia ॥ // PrāPi.116 [chappaa]


[p. 59]
vippa hōi battīsa khatti bēāla kahijjasu ।
aṭhatālisa lahu vēsa sēsa suddaü salahijjasu ॥
caüaggala paü bīsa matta chāṇavaï ṭhavijjasu ।
pacatālīsaha ṇāma kavvalakkhaṇaha karijjasu ॥
chahabisa ullālahi ēkka kaï biṇṇi pāa chappaa muṇahu ।
samavaṇṇa sarisa samadōsaguṇa ṇāma aïhattari pari muṇahu ॥[chappa // PrāPi.117

[aha ullāla lakkhaṇa]
tiṇṇi turaṅgama tiala taha chaha caütia taha anta ।
aïma ullālā uṭṭavahu bihu dala chappaṇa manta ॥ // PrāPi.118 [dōhā]


[p. 60]
[jahā]
jāā jā addhaṅga sīsa gaṅgā lōlantī
savvāhā pūranti savva dukkhā tōlantī ।
ṇāā rāā hāra dīsa vāsā bhāsantā
vēālā jā saṅga ṇacca duṭṭhā ṇāsantā ॥
ṇācantā kantā ucchavvē tālē bhūmī kampalē ।
jā diḍhē mōkkhā pāvijjē sō tumhāṇaṁ sukkha dē ॥ // PrāPi.119 [chappaa]

caüālisa guru kavvakē chahabīsaü ullāla ।
jaṁ guru ṭuṭṭaï lahu vaḍhaï ēhattari patthāra ॥ // PrāPi.120 [dōhā]


[p. 61]
[[atha śālmalī prastāra]]
ajaa bēāsī akkharaü guru sattari ravirēha ।
ēkkakkhara vaḍha guru ghaṭaï dudui lahuā dēha ॥ // PrāPi.121 [dōhā]

ajaa vijaü bali kaṇṇa vīra bēāla vihaṇṇaru
makkalu hari hara bambha indu candaṇa susuhaṅkaru ।
sāṇa sīha sadūla kumma kōila khara kuñjaru
maaṇa maccha tālaṅka sēsa sāraṅga paōharu ॥
tā kunda kamalu vāraṇa bhasala sarahu jaṅgama sara bi lahaï ।
susaru samaru sārasu saraa chappaa ṇāma piṅgalu kaï ॥ // PrāPi.122

mēru maaru maa siddhi buddhi karaalu kamalāaru
dhavala maṇaü dhua kaṇaü kisaṇu rañjaṇu mēhāaru ।
gimha garuḍa sasi sūra salla ṇavaraṅga maṇōharu
gaaṇu raaṇu ṇaru hīru bhamaru sēharu kusumāaru
tā dippu saṅkha vasu sadda muṇi ṇāarāa piṅgalu kahaï ।
chappaa ṇāma ēhattarihi chanda āra patthari lahaï ॥ // PrāPi.123


[p. 62]
jattē savvahi hōi lahu addha visajjahu tāma ।
taha vi visajjahu ēkkasaru ēhi pamāṇē ṇāma ॥iti ṣaṭpadaprakaraṇam । // PrāPi.124 [dōhā]

[aha pajjhaḍiā]
caümatta karaha gaṇa cāri ṭhāīṭhavi anta paōhara pāī pāī।
caüsaṭṭhi matta pajjharaï indusama cāri pāa pajjhaḍia chandu ॥ // PrāPi.125

[jahā]
jē gañjia gōḍāhivaï rāuudaṁḍa āḍḍa jasu bhaa palāu ।
guruvikkama vikkama jiṇia jujjhatā kaṇṇa parakkama kōi bujjha ॥ // PrāPi.126 [pajjhaḍiā]


[p. 63]
[aha aḍillā]
sōlaha mattā pāu alillahabē vi jamakkā bhēu aḍillaha ।
hō ṇa paōhara kimpi aḍillahaanta supia bhaṇa chandu aḍillaha ॥ // PrāPi.127

[jahā]
jiṇi āsāvari dēsā diṇhaüsutthira ḍāhararajjā liṇhaü ।
kālañjara jiṇī kittī thappiadhaṇu āvajjia dhammaka appia ॥ // PrāPi.128 [aḍillā]


[p. 64]
[pādākulaka chanda]
lahu guru ēkka ṇiama ṇahi jēhāpaa paa lakkhaü uttamarēhā ।
sukaï pharṇidaha kaṁṭhaha valasōlahamattaṁ pāākulaaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.129

[jahā]
sēra ēka jaï pāvaüm̐ dhittāmaṁḍā vīsa pakāvaüm̐ ṇittā ।
ṭaṅku ēka jaü saïndhava pāājō haü raṅka sōi haü rāā ॥ // PrāPi.130 [pādākulaka]


[p. 65]
[caübōlā chanda]
sōlaha mattaha bē vi pamāṇahubīa caütthahĩ cāridahā ।
mattaha saṭṭhi samaggala jāṇahucāri paā caübōla kahā ॥ // PrāPi.131

[jahā]
rē dhaṇi mattamaaṅgaagāmiṇikhañjaṇalōaṇi candamuhī ।
cañcala juvvaṇa jāta ṇa jāṇahichaïla samappaï kāī ṇahī ॥ // PrāPi.132 [caübōlā]


[p. 66]
[paa bīa bāraha ṭhavahu]
tīa ṭhāi dahapañca jāṇahu
cārima ēggārahahĩ
pañcamē hi daha pañca āṇahu
aṭṭhā saṭṭhī pūravahuaggē dōhā dēhu ।
rāasēṇa supasiddha ia raḍḍa bhaṇijjaï ēhu ॥ // PrāPi.133 [rājasēnā]

visama tikala saṁṭhavahu tiṇṇi pāikka karahu laï
anta ṇarinda ki vippa paḍhama bē matta avara paï ।
samapaa tia pāikka savvalahu anta visajjahu
caüṭhā caraṇa vicāri ēka lahu kahia lijjahu ॥
ima pañca pāa uṭṭavaṇa kaï vatthu ṇāma piṅgala kuṇaï ।
ṭhavi dōsahīṇa dōhā caraṇa rāasēṇa raḍḍaha bhaṇaï ॥ // PrāPi.134


[p. 67]
[jahā]
bhamaï mahuara phulla aravindaṇava kēsukāṇaṇa julia ।
savvadēsa pikarāva vulliasiala pavaṇa lahu vahaï ॥
malaakuhara ṇavavalli pēllia ।
citta maṇōbhavasara haṇaïdūra digantara kanta ।
kima pari appaü vārihaüima paripalia duranta ॥ // PrāPi.135 [rājasēnā]

karahī ṇandā mōhiṇī cārusēṇi taha bhadda ।
rāasēṇa tālaṅka pia satta vatthu ṇipphanda ॥ // PrāPi.136

paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha tēraha mattā jāsu ।
bīa caüttha ēgārahahĩ karahi bhaṇijjaï tāsu ॥ // PrāPi.137


[p. 68]
[[nandā lakṣaṇa]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha matta hōi daha cāri ।
bīa caüttha ēgārahahĩ ṇanda bhaṇiñja viāri ॥ // PrāPi.138

[[mōhinī lakṣaṇa]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha ṇava daha mattā jāsu ।
bīa caüttha ēgārahahiṁ taṁ mōhiṇī muṇiāsu ॥ // PrāPi.139

[[cārusēnā lakṣaṇa]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha matta paṇṇaraha jāsu ।
bīa caütha ēārahahĩ cārusēṇi muṇiāsu ॥ // PrāPi.140

[bhidrā lakṣaṇa]]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha mattā dahapañcāi ।
bīa caütthē bārahahĩ bhadda ṇāma kahiāi ॥ // PrāPi.141

[rājasēnā lakṣaṇa]]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha matta paṇṇaraha pajattha ।
sama bāraha aru ēkkadaha rāasēṇu bhaṇu tattha ॥ // PrāPi.142


[p. 69]
[[tālaṅkinī lakṣaṇa]]
paḍhama tīa pañcama paaha mattā sōlaha jāsu ।
sama bāraha aru ēkkadaha tālaṅkiṇi bhaṇu tāsu ॥ // PrāPi.143 [iti raḍḍā prakaraṇam]

[(padmāvatī chandaḥ)]
bhaṇu paümāvattī ṭhāṇaṁ ṭhāṇaṁ caümattā gaṇa aṭṭhāā।
dhua kaṇṇō karaalu vippō caraṇō pāē pāa ukiṭṭhāā ॥
jaï palaï paōhara kimaï maṇōhara pīḍaï taha ṇāakkaguṇō ।
piaraha santāsaï kaï uvvāsaï ia caṁḍālacaritta gaṇē ॥ // PrāPi.144

[jahā]
bhaa bhajjia vaṅgā bhaṅgu kaliṅgā tēlaṅgā raṇa mukki calē ।
marahaṭṭhā dhiṭṭhā laggia kaṭṭhā sōhā bhaa pāa palē ॥
campāraṇa kampā pavvaa jhampā ātthā ātthī jīva harē ।
kāsīsara rāṇā kiaü paāṇā vijjāhara bhaṇa mantivarē ॥ // PrāPi.145


[p. 70]
[[atha kuṁḍaliyā chanda]]
dōhā lakkhaṇa paḍhama paḍhi kavvaha addha ṇirutta ।
kuṁḍaliā buhaaṇa muṇahu ulālē sañjutta ।
ullālē sañjutta jamaka suddhaü salahijjaï ।
caüālaha saü matta sukaï diḍhabandhu kahijjaï ।
caālaha saü matta jāsu taṇu bhūṣaṇa sōhā ।
ēma kuṁḍaliā jāṇahu paḍhama jaha paḍhiaï dōhā ॥ // PrāPi.146


[p. 71]
[jahā]
ḍhāllā māria ḍhilli maham̐ mucchi. mēcchasarīra ।
pura jajjallā mantivara calia vīra hammīra ॥
calia vīra hammīra pāabhara mēiṇi kampaī ।
diga maga ṇaha andhāra dhūli sūraha raha jhampaï ॥
diga maga ṇaha andhāra āṇa khurasāṇaka āllā ।
daramari damasi vipakkha māruḍhillī maham̐ ḍhāllā ॥ // PrāPi.147 [kuṁḍaliyā]


[p. 72]
[[atha gaganāṅgacchandaḥ]]
paa paa ṭhavahu jāṇi gaaṇaṅgaü matta vihūsiṇā
bhāaü bīsa kalaa saraaggala lahu gurusēsiṇā ॥
paḍhamahi matta cāri gaṇa kijjahu gaṇaha paāsiō
bīsakkhara saala paaha pia guru anta paāsiō ॥ // PrāPi.149

paḍhamahi cakkalu hōi gaṇa antahi dijjahu hāru ।
bīsakkhara gaaṇaṅga bhaṇu matta pacīsa viāru ॥ // PrāPi.150


[p. 73]
[jahā]
bhañjia malaa cōlavaï ṇipalia gañjia guñjarā
mālavarāa malaagiri lukkia parihari kuñjarā ।
khurāsāṇa khuhia raṇa maham̐ laṅghia muhia sāarā
hammīra calia hārava palia riugaṇaha kāarā ॥ // PrāPi.151

[[atha dvipadīchandaḥ]]
āiga indu jattha hō paḍhamahi dijjaï tiṇi dhaṇuharaṁ
taha pāikajuala parisaṁṭhavahu vivihacittasundaraṁ ॥ // PrāPi.152

sarasaï laïa pasāu taha puhavī karahi kaïtta kaïaṇā
mahuaracaraṇa anta laï dijjahu dōaï muṇahu buhaaṇā ॥ // PrāPi.153


[p. 74]
chakkalu muha saṁṭhāvi kaï cakkalu pañca ṭhavēhu ।
antahi ēkkaḍa hāra daï dōaï chanda kahēhu ॥ // PrāPi.154

[jahā]
dāṇava dēva bē vi dukkantaü girivara sihara kampiō
haagaapāaghāa utaü dhūlihi gaaṇa jhampiō ॥ // PrāPi.155 [dōaï = dvipadī]

[[atha jhullaṇa-jhūlanā-chandaḥ]]
paḍhama daha dijjiā puṇa vi taha kijjiāpuṇa vi daha satta taha viraï jāā ।
ēma pari bi bihu dalamatta satatīsa palaēhu kahu jhulaṇā ṇāarāā ॥ // PrāPi.156


[p. 75]
[jahā]
sahasa maamatta gaa lākha lakha pakkharia
sāhi dui sāji khēlanta gindū ।
kōppi pia jāhi taha thappi jasu vimala mahi
jiṇaï ṇahi kōi tuha tuluka hindū ॥ // PrāPi.157


[p. 76]
[[khañjā chandaḥ]]
dhua dharia diavara ṇava gaṇa kamalaṇaaṇi
buhaaṇa maṇa suhaï ju jima sasi raaṇi sōhaē ।
puṇa via viraï bihu paa gaavaragamaṇi
ragaṇa para phaṇivaï bhaṇa sumaru buhaaṇa mōhaē ॥ // PrāPi.158

bihu dala ṇava pala vippagaṇa jōhala anta ṭhavēhu ।
matta iālisa khañja paa dahagaṇa tattha muṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.159


[p. 77]
[jahā]
ahi lalaï mahi calaï giri khasaï hara khalaï
sasi ghumaï amia vamaï muala jivi uṭṭaē ।
puṇu dhasaï puṇu khasaï puṇu lalaï puṇu ghumaï
puṇu vamaï jivia viviha pari samara diṭṭhaē ॥[khañjā // PrāPi.160

[[atha sikhā-śikhā-chanda].]
sasivaaṇi gaagamaṇi paa paa dia chagaṇa paahara saha sikkha ।
paḍha paḍhama bi biha lahu paali diagaṇa sahia juala dala bhaṇaï sa sikkha ॥ // PrāPi.161


[p. 78]
matta aṭhāisa paḍhamē bīē battīsa mattāī।
paa paa antē lahuā suddhā sikkhā viāṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.162 [gāhū]

[jahā]
phulia mahu bhamara bahu raaṇipahukiraṇa lahu avaaru vasanta ।
malaagiri kuhara dhari pavaṇa vahasahava kaha suṇa sahi ṇiala ṇahi kanta ॥[śikhā // PrāPi.163


[p. 79]
[[mālā chanda]]
paḍhama caraṇa sasivaaṇi miaṇaaṇi ṇava diagaṇa
paala puṇa vi taha raaṇa ṭhavahu antaē kaṇṇō ।
piṅgala ṇāa bhaṇantā mālā sēsaṁ pi gāhamma ॥ // PrāPi.164

paḍhama hōi ṇava vippagaṇa jōhala kaṇṇa ṭhavēhu ।
gāhā addhā anta daï mālā chanda kahēhu ॥ // PrāPi.165


[p. 80]
[jahā;]
barisa jala bhamaï ghaṇa gaaṇa siala pavaṇa maṇaharaṇa
kaṇaapiari ṇacaï vijuri phulliā ṇīvā ।
pattharavittharahialā pialā ṇialaṁ ṇa āvēi ॥ // PrāPi.166 [mālā]

[[culiālā chandaḥ]]
culiālā jaï dēha kimu dōhā uppara mattaha pañcaï ।
paa paa uppara saṁṭhavahu suddha kusumagaṇa antaha dijjaï ॥ // PrāPi.167


[p. 81]
dōhā saṅkhā saṁṭhahu umpari pañcaï matta ।
aṭṭhadahuppari bīsa dui culiālā ukkhitta ॥ // PrāPi.168

[jahā]
rāā luddha samāja khala bahu kalahāriṇi sēvaka dhuttaü ।
jīvaṇa cāhasi mukkha jaï pariharu ghara jaï bahuguṇajuttaü ॥[culiālā // PrāPi.169

[[atha sōṭuā chandaḥ ]]
sō sōraṭṭhaü jāṇajaṁ dōhā viparīa ṭhia ।
paa paa jamaka vakhāṇaṇāarāa piṅgala kahia ॥ // PrāPi.170

[jahā]
sō māṇia puṇavantajāsu bhatta paṁḍia taṇaa ।
jāsu ghariṇi guṇavantisō vi puhavi saggaha ṇilaa ॥ // PrāPi.171 [sōraṭhā]


[p. 82]
[[atha hākali chandaḥ]]
sagaṇā bhagaṇā diagaṇaīmatta caüddaha paa palaī ।
saṁṭhaï vaṅkō viraha tahā hākali rūaü ēhu kahā ॥ // PrāPi.172

matta caüddaha paḍhama dala ēāraha vaṇṇēhi ।
duha akkhara uttara dalahi hākali chanda kahēhi ॥ // PrāPi.173 [dōhā]

[jahā]
uccaü chāaṇa vimala dharā taruṇī ghariṇī viṇaaparā ।
vittaka pūrala muddaharā varisā samaā sukkhakarā ॥ // PrāPi.174 [hākali]


[p. 83]
[[atha madhubhāracchanda]]
jasu palaï sakkha paaharaha ēka ।
caümatta bē vi mahubhāra ēvi ॥ // PrāPi.175

[jahā]
jasu canda sīsa pindhaṇaha dīsa ।
sō sambhu ēu tuha subbha dēu ॥ // PrāPi.176 [madhubhāra]


[p. 84]
[[atha ābhīracchandaḥ]]
gāraha matta karīja anta paōhara dīja।
ēhu suchanda ahīra jaṅghaï piṅgala vīra ॥ // PrāPi.177

[jahā]
sundari gujjari ṇāri lōaṇa dīha visāri ।
pīṇa paōharabhāra lōlaï mōttiahāra ॥ // PrāPi.178 [ahīra]

[[atha daṇḍakacchandaḥ]
kuntaaru dhaṇuddharu haavaru chakkalu bi bi pāikka dalē
battīsaha mattaha paa supasiddhaü jāṇaha buhaaṇa hiaatalē ।
saübīsa aṭhaggala kala sampuṇṇaü rūaü phaṇi bhāsia bhuaṇē
daṁḍaala ṇiruttaü guru sañjuttaü piṅgala aṁ japanta maṇē ॥ // PrāPi.179


[p. 85]
[jahā]
rāaha bhaggantā dia laggantā parihari haa gaa ghara ghariṇī
lōrahĩ bharu saravaru paa paru parikaru lōṭṭaī piṭṭaï taṇu dharaṇī ।
puṇu uṭṭhaï sambhali kara dantaṅguli bāla taṇaa kara jamala karē
kāsīsara rāā ṇēhalu kāā karu māā puṇu thappi dharē ॥ // PrāPi.180 [daṁḍakala]


[p. 86]
sira dēha caü mattalahu ēka kara anta ।
kuntēkka tasu majjhadīpakka sō bujjha ॥ // PrāPi.181

[jahā]
jasu hattha karavāla vippakkhakulakāla ।
sira sōha vara chatta sampuṇṇasasimatta ॥[dīpaka // PrāPi.182

[[atha siṁhāvalōkacchandaḥ]]
gaṇa vippa sagaṇa dhari paaha paaṁbhaṇa siṁhaalōaṇa chanda varaṁ ।
guṇi gaṇa maṇa bujjhahu ṇāa bhaṇāṇahi jagaṇu ṇa bhagaṇu ṇa kaṇṇa gaṇā ॥ // PrāPi.183


[p. 87]
vippa sagaṇa paa bē vi gaṇa anta visajjahi hāra ।
pacchā hēri kaïtta karu sōlaha kala patthāra ॥ // PrāPi.184

[jahā]
haṇu ujjara gujjara rāabalaṁdala dalia calia marahaṭṭhabalaṁ ।
bala mōlia mālavarāakulākula ujjala kalaculi kaṇṇa phulā ॥ // PrāPi.185 [siṁhāvalōka]

[[atha plavaṅgamacchandaḥ]]
jattha paḍhama chaa matta paappaa dijjaēpañcamatta caümatta gaṇā ṇahi kijjaē।
sambhali anta lahū guru ēkkaka cāhaēmuddhi paaṅgama chanda viakkhaṇa sōhaē ॥ // PrāPi.186


[p. 88]
paa paa āihi guruā piṅgala pabhaṇēi saala ṇibbhantī ।
chanda pavaṅgama diṭṭhō mattāṇaṁ ēkabīsantī ॥ // PrāPi.187 [gāhā]

tikkalu caükala pañcakala tia gaṇa dūra karēhu ।
chakkalu tiṇi palanta jēhi lahu guru anta muṇēhu ॥187 kā // PrāPi.187a [dōhā]

[jahā]
ṇaccaï cañcala vijjuliā sahi jāṇaēmammaha khagga kiṇīsaï jalaharasāṇaē ।
phulla kalambaa ambara ḍambara dīsaēpāusa pāu ghaṇāghaṇa sumuhi varīsaē ॥ // PrāPi.188 [plavaṅgama]

[[atha līlāvatīcchandaḥ]]
guru lahu ṇahi ṇimma ṇimma ṇahi akkhara palaï paōhara visama samaṁ
jahi kahum̐ ṇahi ṇimmaha tarala turaa jimi parasa vidisa disa agamagamaṁ ।
gaṇa pañca caükkala palaï ṇirantara anta sagaṇa dhua kanta gaṇaṁ
paricalaï supari pari līla lilāvaï kala battīsa visāmakaraṁ ॥ // PrāPi.189


[p. 89]
[jahā]
ghara laggaï aggi jalaï dhaha dhaha kaï diga maga ṇahapaha aṇala bharē
sava dīsa pasari pāikka lulaï dhaṇi thaṇahara jahaṇa diāva karē ।
bhaa lukkia thakkia vahari taruṇijaṇa bhaïrava bhēria sadda palē
mahi lāi paṭṭaï riusira ṭuṭṭaï jakkhaṇa vīra hamīra calē ॥ // PrāPi.190 [līlāvatī]


[p. 90]
[[atha harigītā chandaḥ]]
gaṇa cāri pañcakkala ṭhavijjasu bīa ṭhāmahi chakkalō
paa paaha antahi guru karijjasu vaṇṇaṇēṇa susavvalō ।
daha cāri dukkaḍa dahadu māṇahu matta ṭhāisa pāaō
harigīa chanda pasiddha jāṇahu piṅgalēṇa paāsiō ॥ // PrāPi.191

bīē chakkalu ṭhāvi kahu cāri pañcakkala dēhu ।
bāraha uttara matta saü māṇasu aṅga ṭhavēhu ॥ // PrāPi.192

[jahā]
gaa gaahi dukkia taraṇi lukkia turaa turaahi jujjhiā
raha rahahi mīlia dharaṇi pīḍia appa para ṇahi bujjhiā ।
bala milia āia patti dhāiu kampa girivarasīharā
ucchalaï sāara dīṇa kāara vaïra vaḍḍia dīharā ॥ // PrāPi.193 [harigītā]


[p. 91]
[[atha tribhaṅgī chanda]]
paḍhamaṁ daha rahaṇaṁ aṭṭhavi rahaṇaṁ puṇu vasu rahaṇaṁ rasarahaṇaṁ
antē guru sōhaï mahiala mōhaï siddha sarāhaï varataruṇaṁ ।
jaï palaï paōhara kimaï maṇōhara haraï kalēvara tāsu kaī
tibbhaṅgī chandaṁ sukkhāṇandaṁ bhaṇaï pharṇidō vimalamaī ॥ // PrāPi.194

[jahāṁ]
sira kijjia gaṅgaṁ gōri adhaṅgaṁ haṇiaaṇaṅgaṁ puradahaṇaṁ
kiaphaṇivaïhāraṁ tihuaṇasāraṁ vandiachāraṁ riumahaṇaṁ ।
surasēviacaraṇaṁ muṇigaṇasaraṇaṁ bhavabhaaharaṇaṁ sūladharaṁ
sāṇandiavaaṇaṁ sundaraṇaaṇaṁ girivarasaaṇaṁ ṇamaha haraṁ ॥ // PrāPi.195 [tribhaṅgī]


[p. 92]
[[atha durmilā chandaḥ]]
tīsa dui mattaha ēri sam̐juttaha buhaaṇa rāa bhaṇanti ṇarā
visama tia ṭhāmahi ērisa bhāahi paa paa dīsaï kaṇṇa gharā ।
tā daha paḍhama ḍhāvē aṭṭha aṁ tīa caüddaha kia ṇilaō
jō ērisi chandē tihuaṇavandē sō jaṇa bujjhaü dummilaō ॥ // PrāPi.196

daha vasu caüdaha viraha karu visama kaṇṇa gaṇa dēhu ।
antara vippa païkka gaṇa dummila chanda kahēhu ॥ // PrāPi.197 [dōhā]

[jahā]
jaï kijjia dhālā jiṇṇu ṇivālā bhāṭuntā piṭṭēta calē
bhañjāvia cīṇā dapyahi hīṇā lōhāvala hākanda palē ।
āḍḍā uḍḍāvia kittī pāvia mōḍia mālavarāabalē
tēlaṅgā bhaggia bahuriṇa laggia kāsīrāā ja khaṇa calē ॥ // PrāPi.198 [durmilā]


[p. 93]
[[atha hīracchandaḥ]]
ṇāa pabhaṇa tiṇṇi chagaṇa anta karahi jōhalaṁ
hāra ṭhavia puṇu vi supia vippagaṇahi savvalaṁ ।
tiṇi dharahi bē vi karahi anta ragaṇa lakkhaē
kōi jaṇaï dappa bhaṇaï hīra sukaï pakkhaē ॥ // PrāPi.199

hāra supia bhaṇa vippagaṇa tīē bhiṇṇa sarīra ।
jōhala antē saṁṭhavahu tēisa mattaha hīra ॥ // PrāPi.200 [dōhā]

[jahā]
dhikkadalaṇa thōṅgadalaṇa taka taruṇa riṅgaē
ṇaṁ ṇa ṇu kaṭa diṅga dukaṭa raṅga cala turaṅga ē ।
dhūli dhavala hakka sabala pakkhipabala pattiē ।
kaṇṇa calaï kumma lalaï bhummi bharaï kittiē ॥ // PrāPi.201 [hīra]


[p. 94]
[[atha jalaharaṇacchandaḥ]]
paa paḍhama palaï jahĩ suṇahi kamalamuhi daha vasu puṇu vasu viraḍa karē
saba paa muṇi diagaṇa dia virama sagaṇa siriphaṇivaï bhaṇa sukaïvarē ।
daha tiguṇa karahi kala puṇa vi dhari juala ēma pari pariṭhaü caücaraṇā
jaï palaï kavahu guru kavahu ṇa pariharu buhaaṇa maṇaharu jalaharaṇā ॥ // PrāPi.202

battīsa hōi mattā antē sagaṇāĩ ṭhāvēhi ।
savva lahū jaï guruāēkkō vā bē vi pāēhi ॥ // PrāPi.203 [gāhū]

[jahā]
khura khura khudi khudi mahi ghaghara rakha kalaï ṇaṇaṇagidi kari turaa calē
ṭaṭaṭagidi palaï ṭapu dhasaï dharaṇi dhara cakamaka kara bahu disi camalē ।

[p. 95]
calu damaki damaki dalu cala païkabalu ghulaki ghulaki karivara laliā
vada maṇusaala karaï vipakha hiaa sala hamira vīra jaba raṇa caliā ॥ // PrāPi.204 [jalaharaṇa]

[[atha maaṇaharā chandaḥ]]
pia bhaṇami maṇōharu palli paōharu suhava suhāva susiddha khaṇō thira karahi maṇō
jaï rāa vivattiu aṇusara khattia kaṭṭhikaē bahi chanda bhaṇō jima khalaï riṇō ।
bi bi salla pahillia turaa vahillia haa gaa paa pasaranta dharā guru sajjikarā
jaï jaggi ṇiruttaü dahagaṇajuttaü caü sandhihi cālīsa dharā bhaṇu maaṇaharā ॥ // PrāPi.205


[p. 96]
bē vi matta sira ṭhāvi kahu valaā anta ṭhavēhu ।
ṇava caükala gaṇa majjha dhari maaṇaharāĩ karēhu ॥ // PrāPi.206

[jahā]
jiṇi kaṁsa viṇāsia kitti paāsia muṭṭhi ariṭṭi viṇāsa karē giri hattha dharē
jamalajjuṇa bhañjia paabhara gañjia kālia kula saṁhāra karē jasa bhuaṇa bharē ।
cāṇūra vihaṁḍia ṇiakula maṁḍia rāhāmuha mahupāṇa karē jimi bhamaravarē
sō tumha ṇarāaṇa viṣpaparāaṇa cittaha cintia dēu varā bhaabhīaharā ॥ // PrāPi.207

caüsandhihi cālīsa kala daha gaṇa tattha muṇēhu ।
paahara vajjia hē supia maaṇaharāĩ kuṇēhu ॥ // PrāPi.207


[p. 97]
[[atha marahaṭṭhā chandaḥ]]
ēhu chanda sulakkhaṇa bhaṇaï viakkhaṇa jampaï piṅgala ṇāu
visamaï daha akkhara puṇu aṭṭhakkhara puṇu ēgāraha ṭhāu ।
gaṇa āihi chakkalu pañca caükkulu anta guru lahu dēhu
saü sōlaha aggala matta samaggala bhaṇa marahaṭṭhā ēhu ।208॥ // PrāPi.208

[jahā]
jasu mitta dhaṇēsā sasura girīsā taha vihu pindhaṇa dīsa
jaï amiaha kandā ṇialahi candā taha vihu bhōaṇa vīsa ।
jaï kaṇaa suraṅgā gōri adhaṅgā taha vihu ḍākiṇi saṅga
jō jasa hi diāvā dēva sahāvā kabahu ṇa hō tasu bhaṅga ॥ // PrāPi.209


[p. 98]
[[ukta mātrika chandōṁ kī anukramaṇikā]]
gāhū, gāhā, vigāhā, uggāhā, gāhiṇī, sīhiṇī, khandhā, dōhā, ukkacchā, rōlā, gandhāṇa, caüpaïā, ghattā, ghattāṇanda, chapyāā, pajjhaḍiā, aḍillā, pāāulaaṁ, caübōlā, ṇaüpaa, paümāvattī, kuṁḍaliā, gaaṇaṅgaü, dōaī, jhulaṇā, khañjapaa, sikkhā, mālā, culiālā, sōraddhā, hākali, mahuāra, mahāru, daṁḍaaru, dīpaka, siṁhālōa, pavaṅgā, līlāvaï, harigīā, tiabhaṅgī, dummilā, hīrō, janaharaṇī, maaṇaharā, marahaṭṭhā pacatālīsa dharā ।
iti mattāvitta paricchēō ।

phulakamalamuhi gaavaragamaṇīkassa sukiaphala vihi gaḍhu taruṇī ॥ // PrāPi.153 [cakrapada]


[p. 142]
[pañcadaśākṣaraprastārabhramarāvalī chandaḥ]
kara pañca pasiddha viladdhavaraṁ raaṇaṁpabhaṇanti maṇōhara chandavaraṁ raaṇaṁ ।
guru pañca dahā lahu ērisiaṁ raïaṁbhamarāvali chanda pasiddha kiaṁ ṭhaviaṁ ॥ // PrāPi.154

[jahā]
tua dēva durittagaṇāharaṇā caraṇājaï pāvaü candakalābharaṇā saraṇā ।
paripūjaü tējjia lōbha maṇā bhavaṇā suha dē maha sōkaviṇāsamaṇā samaṇā ॥ // PrāPi.155 [bhamarāvalī]

[sāraṅgikā chandaḥ]
kaṇṇā diṇṇā sattā antē ēkā hārā māṇīā
paṇṇārāhā hārā sāraṅgikkā chandā jāṇīā ।
tīsā mattā pāē pattā bhōīrāā jampantā
chandā kijjē kittī lijjē sūṇī matthā kampantā ॥ // PrāPi.156


[p. 143]
[jahā]
mattā jōhā vaḍḍē kōhā appāappī gavvīā rōsārattā savvā gattā sā bhallā uṭṭhīā ।
hatthījūhā sajjā huā pāē bhūmī kampantā lēhī dēhī chōḍō āḍḍō savvā sūrā jampantā ॥ // PrāPi.157

[cāmara chandaḥ]
cāmarassa bīsa matta tīṇī matta aggalāaṭṭa hāra satta sāra ṭhāi ṭhāi ṇimmalā ।
āi anta hāra sāra kāmiṇī muṇijjaēakkharā dahāi pañca piṅgalē bhaṇijjaē ॥ // PrāPi.158

[jahā]
jhatti jōha sajja hōha gajja vajja taṁ khaṇārōsa ratta savva gatta hakka dijja bhīsaṇā ।
dhāi āi khagga pāi dāṇavā calantaāvīrapāa ṇāarāa kampa bhūtalantaā ॥ // PrāPi.159

 - dhuvvaï dhuṇijjaï



gamādīnāṁ dvitvaṁ vā

gamādīnāṁ dhātūnāṁ dvitvaṁ vā bhavati bhāvakarmaṇōḥ.  - gammaï gamijjaï
 - rammaï ramijjaï
 - hassaï hasijjaï
 - gamyatē
 - ramyatē
 - hasyatē



[p. 105]

liharlijjhaḥ

liha āsvādanē. asya dhātōlijjhō bhavati bhāvakarmaṇōḥ.  - lijjhaï



hakrōhīrakīrau

hr̥ñ haraṇē. ḍukr̥ñ karaṇē. anayōrhīrakīrau bhavatō bhāvakarmaṇōrarthayōḥ.  - hīraï
 - kīraï



grahēr dīrghō vā

grahēr dhātōr dīrghō vā bhavati bhāvakarmaṇōr arthayōḥ.  - gāhijjaï
 - gahijjaï



ktēna diṇṇādayaḥ

raṁji.  - rattaṁ

krudha kōpē. asya jūrō bhavati.  - jūraï



carcēścaṁpaḥ

carca adhyayanē. asya dhātōścaṁpō bhavati.  - caṁpaï



trasērvajaḥ

mr̥jēlabhasupau

 - suppaï



vuṭṭakhuppō masjēḥ

ṭumasjī śuddhau. asya dhātōra vuṭṭakhuppō bhavataḥ.  - vuṭṭaï
 - khuppaï



dr̥śēḥ pulaaṇiakaavakkhāḥ

dr̥śir prēkṣaṇē. asya pulaaṇiakaavakkhā bhavanti.  - pulaaï
 - jiakkaï
 - avakkhaï



śakēs tara-vaa-tīrāḥ

śakla śaktau. asya dhātōḥ tara vaa tīra ityēta ādaśā mavanti.  - taraï
 - vaaï
 - tīraï

śēṣāṇāmaḍhantatā

śēṣāṇāṁ luptānubandhānāmadantatā bhavati.  - bhamaï

pr̥cchāyāṁ.  - huṁ sāhasu sabbhāvaṁ
nirdhāraṇē.  - huṁ huvasu tuhikkō

 - kiṁ nu hasasi

uktād anyaḥ śēṣaḥ. pratyaya-samāsa-taddhita-liṅga-varṇakādi-vidhiḥ śēṣaḥ saṁskr̥tād avagantavyaḥ. iha grantha-vistara-bhayān na darśitaḥ.

[prathamaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[ajvidhiḥ]

ādēr ataḥā samr̥ddhyādiṣu vāidīṣatpakvasvapnavētasavyajanamr̥daṅgāṅgārēṣu calōpō ’raṇyēē ca śayyādiṣuō badarē dēnamayūramayūkhayōr yvā vācaturthīcaturdaśyōs tunāadātō yathādiṣu vāit sadāit ēt piṇḍasamēṣuat pathiharidrāpr̥thivūṣuitēs taḥ padādēḥud ikṣu-vr̥ścikayōḥō ca dvidhākr̥ñaḥīt siṁha-jihvayōḥūd-uta upasargē visarjanīnaīd itaḥid ītaḥ pānīyādiṣuēn nīḍā-pīḍa-kīdr̥g-īdr̥śēṣuuta ōt tuṇḍasamēṣuulūkhalē lvā vāunmukuṭādiṣuut puruṣē rōḥud ūtō madhūkādiṣuud dukūlē vā lasya dvitvaṁēn nūpurēōta ud vā prakōṣṭē kasya var̥tō ’tid r̥ṣyādiṣuud r̥tvādiṣuyuktasyāpi riḥvr̥kṣē vēna rur vāḷta ilaḥēta id vā vēdanādēvarayōhḥaita ētdaityādiṣu aïtdaivē vāit saindhavēīt dhairyēauta ōtpaurādiṣu aütāc ca gauravēut saundaryādiṣu
iti śrīvasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ prathamō ’jvidhi-paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[dvitīyaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[athāyuktavidhir ucyatē]

ayuktasyānādaukagacajatadapayavāṁ prāyō lōpaḥyumanāyāṁ masyasphaṭika-nikaṣa-cikura-sīkarēṣu kō haḥcandrikāyāṁ maḥr̥tvādiṣu tō daḥprati-vētasa-patākāsu ḍavasati-bharatayōr haḥgarbhitē ṇaḥairāvatē vāpradīpa-kadamba-dōhadēṣu dō laḥgadgadē raḥsaṁkhyāyāś capō vaḥāpīḍē maḥuttarīyānīyayōr yōjjanē vāchāyāyāṁ haḥṭō daḥsaṭā-śakaṭa-kaitabhēṣusphaṭikē laḥḍasya caṭhō ḍhaḥaṁkōṭhē llaḥkha-gha-tha-dha-pha-bhāṁ haḥprathama-śithila-niṣadhēṣu ḍhaḥkaiṭabhē vaḥharidrādīnāṁ rō laḥādēr yō jaḥyaṣṭyāṁ laḥkirātē caḥkubjē khaḥdōlā-daṇḍa-daśanēṣu ḍaḥparuṣa-parigha-parikhāsu phaḥbisinyāṁ bhaḥmanmathē vaḥlāhala-lāṅgala-lāṅgūlēṣu vā ṇaḥṣaṭ-śāva-saptaparṇēṣu chaḥnō ṇaḥśaṣōḥ saḥdaśādiṣu haḥsaṁjñāyāṁ vādivasē sasyasnuṣāyāṁ haḥ
iti prākr̥tasañjīvanyām ayuktavidhir dvitīyaḥ paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[tr̥tīyaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[yuktavidhir ucyatē]

upari lōpaḥ ka-ga-ḍa-ta-da-pa-ṣa-sa-śāmadhō manayāmsarvatra lavarāmdrē rō vāsarvajña-tulyēṣu ñaḥmadhyāhnē hasyaśmaśru-śmaśānayōr ādēḥhna-hla-hmēṣu nalamāṁ sthitir ūrdhvamyuktasyaṣṭasya ṭhaḥasthanistasya thaḥtaḥ staṁbēstambhē khaḥsthāṇāvaharēkṣēṭakē caryaśayyābhimanyuṣu jaḥtūryadhairyasaundaryāścaryaparyantēṣusūryē vācauryasamēṣu riaḥparyasta-paryāṇa-saukumāryēṣu laḥrtasya ṭaḥmr̥ttikāpattanayōś cana dhūryādiṣugartē ca ḍaḥgardabha-saṁmarda-vitardi-vicchardiṣu rdasyatyathyadyāṁ cachajāḥdhyahyayōr jhaḥṣkaskakṣāṁ khaḥakṣyādiṣu chaḥkṣmā-vr̥kṣa-kṣaṇēṣu vāṣma-pakṣma-vismayēṣu mhaḥhna-sna-ṣṇa-kṣṇa-śnāṁ ṇhaḥcihnē ndhaḥṣpasya phaḥspasyabāṣpē ’śruṇi haḥkārṣāpaṇēścatsapsāṁ chaḥvr̥ścikē ñchaḥnōtsukōtsavayōḥnmō maḥmna-jña-pañcāśat-pañcadaśau ṇaḥtālvr̥ntē ṇṭhaḥbhindipālē ṇḍaḥvihvalē bhō vāādēś caātmani paḥkmasyaśēṣādēśayōr dvitvam anādauvargē yujaḥ pūrvaḥnīḍādiṣuāmratāmrayōr vaḥna rahōḥāṅō jñādēśasyasamāsē vāsēvādiṣu vāvikarṣaḥkliṣṭa-śliṣṭa-ratna-kriyā-śārṅgēṣu tatsvaravat pūrvasyakr̥ṣṇē vāit śrī-hrī-klānta-klēśa-mlāna-svapa-sparśādarśa-harṣēṣuaḥ kṣmāślāghayōḥsnēhē vāuḥ padmatanvīsamēṣujyāyām īt
iti vasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ yuktavarṇavidhis tr̥tīyaḥ paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[caturthaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[atha saṁkīrṇavidhir ucyatē]

sandhāv acām aḍlōpaviśēṣā bahulamudumbarē dōr vā lōpaḥkālāyasē yasyabhājanē jasyayāvadādiṣu vasyaantyasya halaḥstriyām ātna vidyutirō rākṣudhō haḥśaradō ’tdik-prāvr̥ṣō saḥmō bindur aci vā ’lōpaś canaṅōr halivakrādiṣumāṁsādiṣukapi tadvargyāntaḥnasantaprāvr̥ṭśaradaḥ puṁsina śirōnabhasīpr̥ṣṭhākṣipraśnāḥ striyāṁ vāōdavāpayōḥtaltvayōr dāttaṇauktva tūṇatr̥na ira śīlēālv-illōllālavantēntā matupaḥsvārthē kō vāvidyut-pītayōr laḥvr̥ndē dō vaḥkarēṇvāṁ raṇōḥ sthiti-parivr̥ttiḥālānē lanōḥmahārāṣṭrē harōḥvr̥haspatau bahōḥmalinē linōrilau vāgr̥hasya gharō ’pataudāḍhādayō bahulam
iti śrīvasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ saṅkīrṇavidhiś caturthaḥ paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[pañcamaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[atha subvidhir ucyatē]

ata ōt sōḥjaś-śasōr lōpaḥatō ’maḥṭāmōr ṇaḥbhisō hiṁṅasēr ādōduhayaḥbhyasō hintō suntōssō ṅasaḥṅērēmmīsupaḥ suḥjasṅasyāṁsu dīrghaḥē supyaṅiṅasōḥkvacid api lōpaḥidutō śasō ṇōṅasō vājasa ō vō vā ’ttvaṁ caṭā ṇāsubhissupsu dīrghaḥstriyāṁ śasa udōtaujasō vāami hrasvaḥṭāṅasīnām idēdādataḥnātō ’dātauādītau bahulamnapuṁsakē sōr binduḥiṁ jaśśasōr dīrghaḥnāmantraṇē sāvōttvadīrghabindavaḥāta ēīdūtōr hrasvaḥr̥ta āraḥ supimāturāu jas-śas-ṭā-ṅassu vāpitr̥-bhrātr̥-jāmātṝṇām araḥā ca saurājñaḥāmantraṇē bindur vājasaśasṅasāṁ ṇōśasa ēc caamō ṇaṁṭā ṇāṅasaś ca dvittvaṁ vā jalōpaś caidadvitvēā ṇōṇamōr aṅasiātmanō ’ppāṇō vāid dvitvavarjaṁ rājavadanādēśēbrahmādayō ’py ēvamsarvādēḥjasa ētṅēḥ ssiṁmmitthāḥidam-ētat-kiṁ-yat-tadbhyaṣ ṭā iṇā vāāma ēsiṁkiṁ-yat-tadbhyō ṅasa āsaidbhyaḥ ssāsēṅēr hiṁāhē iā kālēōttōdō ṅasēr anidamaḥtadō ṅasā sē vā striyām apiāmaḥ siṁkimaḥ kaḥidama imaḥaṁ ssiṁssayōr vāṅēr mēnē haḥna tthaḥnapuṁsakē svamōridamiṇamiṇamōētadaḥ sōrōttvaṁ vāttō ṅasēḥttatthayōs tasya lōpaḥtadētadōḥ saḥ sāvanapuṁsakēadasō dō muḥhaś ca saupadasyayuṣmadas taṁ tumaṁtuṁ cāmitujjhē tujjha tumhē jasivō ca śasiṭā-ṅyōs taï taē tumaï tumaē tumētumammi ca ṅauṅasi tumō-tuha-tujjha-tuva-tumhāḥāṅi ca tē dētumāi catujjhēhi tubbhēhi tumhēhi bhisiṅasau tattō taïttō tumāō tumāi tumāhi vātujjhāhintō tujjhāsuntō bhyasivō tē tujjhāṇaṁ tumhāṇaṁ āmitujjhēsu tubbhēsu tumhēsu supiasmadō haṁ ahaṁ ahaaṁ sauammirami camaṁ mamaṁ caamhē jas-śasōḥṇō ca śasiāṅi mē mmāiṅau ca maï maēmammi caamhēhiṁ bhisimattō maïttō mamāō mamāu mamāhi ṅasauamhāhintō amhāsuntō bhyasimē mama maha majjha ṅasiṇō amha amhāṇa amhē āmiamhēsu supidvēr dōtrēs tītiṇi jaś-śasbhyāmdvēr duvē dōṇicaturaś cattārō cattāriēṣāmāmō ṇhaṁśēśād adantavatna ṅiṅasyōr ēdātauē bhyasidvivacanasya bahuvacanamcaturthyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīkvacin na tādarthyē
iti śrīvasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ pañcamaḥ subvidhiparicchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[ṣaṣṭhō paricchēdaḥ]

[atha tiṅvidhir ucyatē]

ta-tipōr id-ētausip-thāsōḥ si sēiṇ-mipōr miḥnti-hētthā-mō-mu-mā bahuṣuata ē sēastēr lōpaḥmi-mō-mu-mānām adhō haś cayaka ia-ïjjaunāntyadvitvēnta-māṇau śatr̥-śānacōḥī ca striyāmdhātōr bhaviṣyati hiḥuttamē ssā hā caminā ssaṁ vāmō-mu-mair hissā hitthākr̥-dā-śru-vaci-gami-rudi-dr̥śi-rūpāṇāṁ kāhaṁ dāhaṁ sōcchaṁ vōcchaṁ gacchaṁ rōcchaṁ dacchaṁśrv-ādīnāṁ triṣv anusvāravarjaṁ hi-lōpaś ca vāu su mu vidhy-ādiṣv ēkasminntu-ha-mō bahuṣuvartamāna-bhaviṣyadanadyatanayōś ca jja jjā vāmadhyē canānēkācaḥīa bhūtēēkācō hīaāsir astēḥṇicaḥ ēd-ādēr ātāvē vāāviḥ kta-bhāva-karmasu vānaidāvēata ā mipi vāic ca bahuṣuktēē ca ktvā-tumun-tavya-bhaviṣyatsulādēśō vā
iti prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ tiṅvidhiḥ śaṣṭhaḥ paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[saptamaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[atha dhātuvidhir ucyatē]

bhuvō hō-huvauktē hūprādēr bhavaḥtvaras tuvaraḥghurṇō ghōla-ghumaunudō ṇōllaḥpāṭēḥ phālaḥvr̥ṣādīnām r̥tō ’riḥantē araḥkr̥ñaḥ kuṇa cajr̥bhēr jambhāgrahēr gēṇhaḥghētta ktvā-tumun-tavyēṣukr̥ñaḥ kā bhūta-bhaviṣyatōś casmaratēr bhara-sumaraubhiyō bhā-vīhaumlō vā vāatr̥pas thippaḥjñō jāṇa-muṇaughaṭēr gaḍhaḥsamlō galaḥsraṁsō lhasaḥnēḥ sadaḥ sajjaḥāṅō rabhēr ḍhavaḥudi śalēḥ thallō vāpibatēr ghōṭaḥjalpēr lō maḥsthādhyāgānāṁ ṭhāa jhāa gāaṭhā-jhā-gāś ca bhaviṣyad-vartamāna-vidhy-ādy-ēkavacanēkhādi-dhāvyōḥ khā dhāgrasēr visaḥciñaś ciṇaḥkrīñaḥ kiṇaḥvē kē caudhmō dhumāśradō dhō dahaḥavād gāhēr vāhaḥkāśēr vāsaḥnirō māṅō māṇa-mavaupadēr vvalaḥkṣiyō jhijjaḥbhidi-chidōr antyasya ndaḥkvathēr ḍhaḥvēṣṭēś caut-samōr llaḥrudō vaḥudō vijēḥvr̥dhēr ḍḍhaḥhantēr mmaḥruṣādīnāṁ dīrghaḥccō vraji-nr̥tyōḥyudhi-budhi-gr̥dhi-sidhi-krudhāṁ jjhaḥrudhēr ndha-mbhaumr̥dō laḥśadipatyōr ḍaḥśakādīnāṁ dvitvaṁsphuṭi-calōr vāprādēr mīlaḥbhujādīnāṁ ktvā-tuman-tavyēṣu lōpaḥśru-hu-ji-lū-dhūnāṁ ṇō ’ntē hrasvaś cabhāva-karmaṇōr vvaś cagamādīnāṁ dvitvaṁ vāduhi-lihi-vahāṁ dujjha-lijjha-bujjhāḥhr̥ñ-kr̥ñōr hīra-kīraujñō jāṇa-muṇaugrahēr ghēppaḥktēna diṇṇādayaḥtakṣē raṁpa-vacchaukhidēr visūraḥkrudhēr jūraḥcarcēś caraḥtrasēr vajjaḥmr̥jēr lubha-puṁsaubuḍḍa-khuppau majjēḥdr̥śēḥ pulaa-ṇiaccha-avakkha-saccavāḥśakēs tara-vaa-tīrāḥēvam anyē ’piśēṣāṇāṁ adantatāanadantānām ad vāaḍādēśā bahulam
iti śrīvasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanyāṁ dhātuvidhiḥ saptamaḥ paricchēdaḥ


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[aṣṭạmaḥ paricchēdaḥ]

[atha nipātavidhir ucyatē]

nipātāḥkīsa kim-arthēhuṁ dāna-pr̥cchā-nivāraṇēṣuccia ccēa avadhāraṇēō sūcanā-páscāttāpa-vikalpēṣuira-kira-kilā aniścayākhyānēṣuhu kkhu niścaya-vitarka-sambhāvanāsui-jē-rāḥ pādapūraṇēānantaryē ṇavariu kṣēpa-vismaya-sūcanāsukiṇō praśnēabbō duḥkha-sūcanā-saṁbhāṣaṇēṣualāhi nivāraṇēaï raṇē saṁbhāṣaṇēvēcca āmantraṇēdhū kutsāyāṁrē arē harē saṁbhāṣaṇa-ratikalaha-kṣēpēṣupiva miva viva va ivārthēśēṣāḥ saṁskr̥tāt
iti vasantarājaviracitāyāṁ prākr̥tasañjīvanīvr̥ttau nipātavidhir aṣṭamaḥ paricchēdaḥ samāptaḥ

texts.author: Vimala Suri
texts.content:
[p. 1]
[।। ṇamō aṇuōgadharāṇaṁ ।।]

[sirīvimalāyariyaviraïyaṁ
[p. ]
paümacariyaṁ]

[suttavihāṇaṁ]

[maṅgalam —]
siddha-sura-kinnarōraga-daṇuvaï-bhavaṇindavandaparimahiyaṁ
usahaṁ jiṇavaravasahaṁ, avasappiṇiāititthayaraṁ // PaumaCa.1

ajiyaṁ vijiyakasāyaṁ, apuṇabbhava saṁbhavaṁ bhavaviṇāsaṁ
abhinandaṇaṁ ca sumaī, paümābhaṁ paümasacchāyaṁ // PaumaCa.2

tijaguttamaṁ supāsaṁ, sasippabhaṁ jiṇavaraṁ kusumadantaṁ
aha sīyalaṁ muṇindaṁ, sēyaṁsaṁ cēva vasupujjaṁ // PaumaCa.3

vimalaṁ tahā aṇantaṁ, dhammaṁ dhammāsayaṁ jiṇaṁ santi
kunthu kasāyamahaṇaṁ, araṁ jiyāriṁ mahābhāgaṁ // PaumaCa.4

malliṁ maliyabhavōhaṁ, muṇisubaya suvayaṁ tiyasanāhaṁ
paümassa imaṁ cariyaṁ, jassa ya titthē samuppannaṁ // PaumaCa.5

nami nēmi taha ya pāsaṁ, uragamahāphaṇimaṇīsu pajjaliyaṁ
vīraṁ vilīṇarayamalaṁ, tihuyaṇaparivandiyaṁ bhayavaṁ // PaumaCa.6

annē vi jē mahārisi, gaṇahara aṇagāra laddhamāhappē
maṇa-vayaṇa-kāyaguttē, savvē sirasā namaṁsāmi // PaumaCa.7


[p. 2]
[abhidhēyam —]
nāmāvaliyanibaddhaṁ, āyariyaparaṁparāgayaṁ sabaṁ
vōcchāmi paümacariyaṁ, ahāṇupurvi samāsēṇa // PaumaCa.8

kō vaṇṇiūṇa tīraï, nīsēsaṁ ṣaümacariyasaṁbandhaṁ
mōttūṇa kēvalijiṇaṁ, tikālanāṇaṁ havaï jassa // PaumaCa.9

jiṇavaramuhāō atthō, jō puciṁ niggaō bahuviyapṣō
sō gaṇaharēhi dhariuṁ, saṁkhēvamiṇō ya uvaïṭṭhō // PaumaCa.10

ēvaṁ paraṁparāē, parihāṇī puvagantha-atthāṇaṁ
nāūṇa kālabhāvaṁ, na rūsiyavvaṁ buhajaṇēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.11

atthēttha visamasīlā, kēvi narā dōsagahaṇatallicchā
tuṭṭhā vi subhaṇiēhiṁ, ēvaṁ pi guṇaṁ na gēṇhanti // PaumaCa.12

sabannubhāsiyatthaṁ, bhaṇanti kaïṇō jahāgamaguṇēṇaṁ
kiṁ vajjasūibhinnē, na riyaï tantū mahārayaṇē // PaumaCa.13

ētthaṁ ciya parisāē, narāṇa cittāim̐ bahuviyappāiṁ
kō sakkō ghēttu jē pavaṇahayāī va pattāī? // PaumaCa.14

titthayarēhi vi na kayaṁ, ēkkamayaṁ tihuyaṇaṁ suyadharēhiṁ
amhārisēhi kiṁ puṇa, kīraï iha mandabuddhīhiṁ? // PaumaCa.15

jaï vi hu duggahahiyaō, lōgō bahukūḍa-kavaḍamēhāvī
taha vi ya bhaṇāmi saṁpaï, sabuddhivihavāṇusārēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.16

dēhaṁ rōgāiṇṇaṁ, jīyaṁ taḍivilasiyaṁ ṣiva aṇiccaṁ
navaraṁ kavaguṇarasō, jāva ya sasi-sūra-gahacakaṁ // PaumaCa.17

tamhā narēṇa niyayaṁ, mahaïmahāpurisakittaṇucchāhaṁ
hiyaē cciya kāyavvaṁ, attāṇaṁ cēyamāṇēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.18


[p. 3]
[dēhāvayavasāphalyam —]
tē nāma hōnti kaṇṇā, jē jiṇavarasāsaṇammi suipuṇṇā
annē vidūsagassa va, dārumayā cēva nimmaviyā // PaumaCa.19

taṁ cēva uttimaṅgaṁ, jaṁ ghummaï vaṇṇaṇāisāmannē
annaṁ puṇa guṇarahiyaṁ, nāliyarakaraṅkayaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.20

jiṇadarisaṇujjayā vi hu, jē nayaṇā tē havanti supasatthā
micchattamaïliyā puṇa, cittayarēṇaṁ va nimmaviyā // PaumaCa.21

jiṇavarakahāṇurattā, dantā tē hōnti kantisaṁjuttā
sēsā silēsakajjē, jāyā vi hu vayaṇabandhammi // PaumaCa.22

kiṁ nāsiyāe kīraï, bahuvihasasugandhagandhaluddhāē?
susuyatthagandhagandhaṁ, jā na vi jāṇēi lōgammi // PaumaCa.23

jē cciya saṁmaüllāvaṁ, bhaṇanti tē uttamā ihaṁ ōṭṭā
annē suttajalūgā-paṭṭīsaṁvukkasamasarisā // PaumaCa.24

jā jāṇaï samayarasaṁ, sā jīhā sundarā havaï lōē
duvayaṇatikkhadhārā, sēsā churiya va navaghaḍiyā // PaumaCa.25

taṁ pi ya havaï pahāṇaṁ, muhakamalaṁ jaṁ guṇēsu taïttillaṁ
annaṁ vilaṁ va bhaṇṇaï, bhariyaṁ ciya dantakīḍāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.26

jō paḍhaï suṇaï purisō, sāmaṇṇē ujjamēi sattīē
sō uttamō hu lōē, annō puṇa sippiyakaō ca // PaumaCa.27

sabāyarēṇa ēvaṁ, purisēṇaṁ ujjhiūṇa mūḍhattaṁ
hōyavvaṁ nayamaïṇā, jiṇasāsaṇabhattijuttēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.28

aha paümacariyatuṅgē, vīramahāgayavarēṇa nimmaviē
maggē paraṁparāē, ajjavi kaïkuñjarāṇa gamō // PaumaCa.29

taha kaïvaragayamayagandhalōluō mahuyarō va maggēṇaṁ
payadāṇabindudiṭṭhī, ahamavi tēṇaṁ ciya payaṭṭō // PaumaCa.30

suttāṇusārasarasaṁ, raïyaṁ gāhāhi pāyaḍaphuḍatthaṁ
vimalēṇa paümacariyaṁ, saṁkhēvēṇaṁ nisāmēha // PaumaCa.31


[p. 4]
[granthaviṣayānukramaṇikā —]
ṭhiīvaṁsasamuppattī, patthāṇaraṇaṁ lavaṁkusuppattī
nivāṇamaṇēyabhavā, satta purāṇēttha ahigārā // PaumaCa.32

paümassa cēṭṭhiyamiṇaṁ, kāraṇamiṇamō'higārasaṁjuttaṁ
tisalāsuēṇa bhaṇiyaṁ, suttaṁ saṁkhēvaō suṇaha // PaumaCa.33

vīrassa pavaraṭhāṇaṁ, viulagirīmatthaē maṇabhirāmē
taha indabhūikahiyaṁ, sēṇiyaraṇṇassa nīsēsaṁ // PaumaCa.34

kulagaravaṁsuppattī, nīīē lōgakāraṇaṁ cēva
usabhajiṇajammaṇubbhava, ahisēyaṁ mandaragirimmi // PaumaCa.35

uvaēsaṁ ciya vivihaṁ, lōgassa ya attināsaṇaṁ cēva
sāmaṇṇa kēvalubbhava, aïsaya kusumōhavuṭṭīō // PaumaCa.36

sabasurā-'suramahiyaṁ, nivāṇaṁ paramasōkkhamāhappaṁ
bharahassa bāhubaliṇō, taha saṁgāmaṁ jahāvattaṁ // PaumaCa.37

jāīṇa ya uppattī, kutitthagaṇa-vivihavēsadhārīṇaṁ
vijjāharavaṁsassa ya, uppattī vijjudantassa // PaumaCa.38

uvasaggaṁ pi ya ghōraṁ, muṇivaravasahassa saṁjayantassa
kēvalanāṇuppattī, vijāharaṇaṁ ca dharaṇēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.39

ajiyassa ya uppattī, puṇṇaghaṇasuhā-'suhaṁ samōsaraṇē
vijjāharassa dinnaṁ, saraṇaṁ jaha rakkhasindēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.40

dinnaṁ rakkhasavaïṇā, ṭhāṇaṁ ca varō jahā kumārassa
sagarassa ya uppattī, dukkhaṁ sāmaṇṇa nivāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.41

aïkantamahārakkhō, jammaṇavihavassa kittaṇaṁ cēva
taha rakkhasavaṁsassa ya, ṣavattaṇaṁ cēva nāyavvaṁ // PaumaCa.42

vāṇarakēūṇa tahā, vaṁsuppattī kamēṇa nāyabā
taḍikēsissa ya cariyaṁ, udahikumārēṇa sahiyassa // PaumaCa.43

kikkindhiandhayāṇaṁ, sirimālākhēyarāṇa āgamaṇaṁ
vahaṇaṁ ca vijayasīhassa kōvaṇaṁ asaṇivēyassa // PaumaCa.44


[p. 5]
andhayavahaṁ pavēsō, pāyālaṁkārapuravarē taïyā
kikkindhipuranivēsaṁ, mahugiriuvariṁ maṇabhirāmaṁ // PaumaCa.45

laṅkāgamaṇa-pavēsaṁ, sukēsiputtāṇa balamahantāṇaṁ
nigghāyamaraṇahēū, mālissa ya saṁpayaṁ viulaṁ // PaumaCa.46

vēyaḍḍadakkhiṇāē, sēḍhīē cakkavālanayarammi
indassa ya uppattī, vijjāharasēḍhisāmittaṁ // PaumaCa.47

mālissa vahaṁ jujjhē, vēsamaṇakumārajammaṇuppattī
kusumantavarujjāṇē, sumāliputtassa ya pavēsaṁ // PaumaCa.48

kēkasisahasaṁjōgaṁ, nidarisaṇaṁ tattha paramasumiṇāṇaṁ
jaṇaṇaṁ ca dahamuhassa ya, vijjāsamuvāsaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.49

khōhaṁ jakkhassa aṇāḍhiyassa taha āgamaṁ sumālissa
mandōyarīe lambha, kannāṇa nirikkhaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.50

taha bhāṇukaṇṇacariyaṁ, kōvaṁ vēsamaṇaünbhavaṁ cēva
rakkhasajakkhāṇa raṇaṁ, dhaṇayassa tavō ya nāyavō // PaumaCa.51

dahamuhalaṅkāgamaṇaṁ, avalōyaṇa pucchaṇaṁ jiṇaharāṇaṁ
harisēṇassa ya cariyaṁ, puṇṇaṁ taha pāvamahaṇaṁ ca // PaumaCa.52

gahaṇaṁ mattamahāgayabhuvaṇālaṁkāranāmadhēyassa
ṭhāṇaṁ jamassa laddhaṁ, rikkharayāiccakikkindhī // PaumaCa.53

dahavayaṇa-dūsaṇāṇaṁ, pāyālaṁkārapuravarapavēsaṁ
candōyarassa virahē aṇurāhādukkhasaṁghaṭṭa // PaumaCa.54

taṁ sō virāhiyapurē, suggīvasirīsamāgamaṁ cēva
vālissa khōha aṭṭhāvayanagassa // PaumaCa.55

suggīva sutārāē, lambhaṁ maraṇaṁ ca sāhasagaïssa
saṁtāvaṁ ciya paramaṁ, yaḍḍagamaṁ dahamuhassa // PaumaCa.56

aṇaraṇṇa-sahasakiraṇāṇa tāṇa vēragga jannanāsaṁ ca
mahupubabhavakkhāṇaṁ, uvarambhāē ya ahilāsaṁ // PaumaCa.57

vijāṇaṁ ciya lambha, mahindarāyassa lacchināsaṁ ca
dahamuhamandaragamaṇaṁ, puṇaravi ya niyattaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.58

aṇagāramaharisissa vi, aṇantaviriyassa kēvaluppattī
rāvaṇaniyamaggahaṇaṁ, haṇuyassa samubbhavaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.59

aṭṭhāvayassa uvariṁ, mahinda-palhāyadarisaṇasiṇēhaṁ
pavaṇañjayassa kōvaṁ, taha añjaṇaüjjhaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.60

siṭṭhaṁ ca muṇivarēṇaṁ, haṇuyaparabbhavasamūhasaṁbandhaṁ
sūī haṇurūhapurē, kayā ya paḍisūranāmēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.61


[p. 6]
bhūyāḍavīe majjhē, pavaṇañjayakhēyarassa ya niōgaṁ
taha darisaṇūsavasuhaṁ, vijjāhariañjaṇāe samaṁ // PaumaCa.62

pavaṇañjayaputtamahābalassa taha dāruṇaṁ raṇaṁ paramaṁ
rajaṁ dasāṇaṇassa ya, jiṇaüssēhantaraṁ cēva // PaumaCa.63

bala-kēsava-paḍisattūṇa cēṭṭhiyaṁ cakkavaṭṭipamuhāṇaṁ
dasaraharajjuppattī, kēgaïvarasaṁpayaṁ paramaṁ // PaumaCa.64

indēṇa samaṁ jujjhaṁ, kāūṇa ya gihiyaṁ dahamuhēṇaṁ
saṁvēgasamāvannō, naravaï dikkhaṁ samaṇupattō // PaumaCa.65

rāmassa lakkhaṇassa ya, bharahassa ya taha ya sattunihaṇassa
uppattī sīyāē, vidēha taha sōgasaṁbandhaṁ // PaumaCa.66

nārayasīyālihaṇaṁ, daddūṇa sahōyarassa mūḍhattaṁ
kannāsayaṁvaratthaṁ, uppattī cāvarayaṇassa // PaumaCa.67

dasarahanivassa dikkhaṁ, pāsē muṇisababhūyasaraṇassa
vavagayabhavāṇa kahaṇaṁ, samāgamaṁ cēva sīyāē // PaumaCa.68

kēgaïvarassa lambha, rajaṁ bharahassa paramamāhappaṁ
taha lakkhaṇō ya rāmō, sīyā ya gayā vidēsammi // PaumaCa.69

taha vajjakaṇṇanaravaï-vicēṭṭhiyaṁ varakumārilambhaṁ ca
vasikāraruddabhūī, vimōyaṇaṁ vālikhillassa // PaumaCa.70

aruṇuggāmāsannē, rāmapurinivēsaṇaṁ paramarammaṁ
vaṇamālāsaṁjōyaṁ, aïviriyasamunnaī cēva // PaumaCa.71

lābhō jiyaṣaümāē, kula-dēsavihūsaṇāṇa uvasaggaṁ
vaṁsagirimatthaōvari, jiṇaharakaraṇaṁ ca rāmēṇa // PaumaCa.72

daḍhūṇa dāṇavibhavaṁ, jaḍāuṇō niyamaladdhamāhappaṁ
nāgarahārōhaṁ ciya, saṁbukkavivāyaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.73

kēgaïputtāgamaṇaṁ, kharadūsaṇaviggahaṁ paramaghōraṁ
sīyāharaṇanimittaṁ, sōgaṁ ciya sīyāharaṇanimittaṁ, sōgaṁ ciya rāmadēvassa // PaumaCa.74

sigdhaṁ virāhiyassa ya, āgamaṇaṁ dūsaṇassa ya vahaṁ ca
rayaṇajaḍivijanāsaṁ, suggīvasamāgamaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.75

sāhasagaïssa ya vahaṁ, sīyāṣaḍivattikāraṇaṁ lambhaṁ
milaṇaṁ vihīsaṇēṇaṁ, vijjābalakēsisaṁpattī // PaumaCa.76

taha kumbhayaṇṇa-indaïbhuyaṅga pāsēsu bandhaṇaṁ paramaṁ
lakkhaṇasattiṣahāraṁ, taha ya visallāgamaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.77


[p. 7]
dahamuhaṣavēsaṇaṁ ciya, bhavaṇaṁ jiṇasantisāmināhassa
taha pāḍihēragamaṇaṁ, laṅkāe pavēsaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.78

cakkuppattī taha lakkhaṇassa dahamuhavivāyaṇaṁ cēva
varajuvaīṇa palāvaṁ, āgamaṇaṁ cēva kēvaliṇō // PaumaCa.79

indaïpamuhāṇa tahā, dikkhā sīyāsamāgamaṁ vattaṁ
nārayalakāgamaṇaṁ, sāēyapurīṣavēsaṁ ca // PaumaCa.80

puvabhavāṇa ya cariyaṁ, bharahagayāṇaṁ jahā samakkhāyaṁ
bharahassa ya pavajjā, ṭhaviō ciya lakkhaṇō rajjē // PaumaCa.81

laddhā maṇōramā vi ya, sirivacchālīḍhadēhadhārissa
maraṇaṁ ca samāvannaṁ, sumahallavaṇassa saṁgāmē // PaumaCa.82

mahurāpuridēsassa ya, uvasaggaviṇāsaṇaṁ jaṇavayassa
sattarisīṇa uvattī, sīyānivāsaṇaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.83

aha vajjajaṅghanaravaï, diṭṭhā sīyā lavaṁkusuppattī
jēūṇa naravarindē, piyarēṇa samaṁ kayaṁ jujjhaṁ // PaumaCa.84

sayalajaṇabhūsaṇāṇaṁ, nāṇuppattī surāṇa āgamaṇaṁ
vattaṁ ca pāḍihēraṁ, sīyāē bhīsaṇabhavōhaṁ // PaumaCa.85

ghōraṁ tavōvihāṇaṁ, kayantavayaṇē sayaṁvarē khōhaṁ
dikkhā ya kumārāṇaṁ, bhāmaṇḍaladuggaī cēva // PaumaCa.86

haṇuyassa ya pavajā, lakkhaṇaparalōgagamaṇahēummi
lavaṇaṁkusāṇa ya tavō, rāmapalāvaṁ ca sōgaṁ ca // PaumaCa.87

puvabhavadēvajaṇiyaṁ, dikkhaṁ ciya rāghavassa nigganthaṁ
kēvalanāṇuppattō, tahēva nivāṇagamaṇaṁ ca // PaumaCa.88

saba pi ēvamēyaṁ, suṇantu iha sajjaṇā ya majjhatthā
siddhipahaṁ saṁpattaṁ, paümaṁ vimalēṇa bhāvēṇa // PaumaCa.89

ēyaṁ aṭṭhamarāmadēvacariyaṁ vīrēṇa siṭuṁ purā, pacchā uttamasāhavēhi dhariyaṁ lōgassa ubbhāsiyaṁ
ēttāhē vimalēṇa pāyaḍaphuḍaṁ gāhānibaddhaṁ kayaṁ, suttatthaṁ nisuṇantu saṁpaï mahāpuṇṇaṁ pavittakkharaṁ // PaumaCa.90


iti paümacariē suttavihāṇō nāma uddēsō samattō


---------------------------------------------------------------------

[p. 8]
[sēṇiyaciṁtāvihāṇaṁ]

[magadhā janapadaḥ —]
iha jambudīvadīvē, dakkhiṇabharahē mahantaguṇakaliō
magahā nāma jaṇavaō, nagarā-''garamaṇḍiō rammō // PaumaCa.1

gāma-pura-khēḍa-kabbaḍa-maḍamba-dōṇīmuhēsu parikiṇṇō
gō-mahisi-valavapuṇṇō, dhaṇanivahaniruddhasīmaṣahō // PaumaCa.2

satthāha-sēṭṭhi-gahavaï-kōḍumbiyaṣamuhasuddhajaṇanivahō
maṇi-kaṇaga-rayaṇa-mōttiya-bahudhannamahantakōṭṭhārō // PaumaCa.3

dēsammi tammi lōgō, vinnāṇaviyakkhaṇō aïsurūvō
bala-vihava-kantijuttō, ahiyaṁ dhammujjuyamaīō // PaumaCa.4

naḍa-naṭṭa-chatta-laṅkhayaniccanaccantagīyasaddālō
nāṇāhārapasāhiyabhujāvijjantapahiyajaṇō // PaumaCa.5

ahiyaṁ vīvāhūsavaviyāvaḍō gandhakusumatattillō
bahupāṇa-khāṇa-bhōyaṇa–aṇavarayaṁvaḍḍiucchāhō // PaumaCa.6

pukkharaṇīsu sarēsu ya, ujjāṇēsu ya samantaō rammō
paracakka māri-takkara-dubbhikkhavivajjiō muiō // PaumaCa.7

[rājagr̥hanagaram —]
tassa bahumajjhadēsē, pāyārubbhaḍavisālaparivēḍhaṁ
nayaraṁ ciya pōrāṇaṁ, rāyapuraṁ nāma nāmēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.8

varabhavaṇa-tuṅgatōraṇa-dhavalaṭṭālaya kalaṅkaparimukkaṁ
phalihāsu saṁpaüttaṁ, kavisīsayaviraïyābhōyaṁ // PaumaCa.9


[p. 9]
bahubhaṇḍasāragaruyaṁ, jala-thalayasamiddharayaṇabhariyagharaṁ
nāṇādēsasamāgaya-vaṇiyajaṇullāvasaddālaṁ // PaumaCa.10

bhavaṇaṅgaṇaccaṇēsu ya, maragaya-māṇikkakiraṇakabburiyaṁ
aguruya-turukka-candaṇa-jaṇavayaparibhōyasusuyandhaṁ // PaumaCa.11

cēiyagharēhi ramma, ārāmujjāṇa-kāṇaṇasamiddhaṁ
sara-sarasi-bāvi-vappiṇa-saēsu aïmaṇaharālōvaṁ // PaumaCa.12

caccara-caükkamaṇahara-pēcchaṇayamahantamahuranigdhōsaṁ
paṇḍiyajaṇasusamiddhaṁ, akkhaliyacarittabahusatthaṁ // PaumaCa.13

kiṁ jaṁpiēṇa bahuṇā. taṁ nayaraṁ guṇasahassaāvāsa
amarapurassa ya sōhaṁ, ghēttūṇa va hōja nimmaviyaṁ // PaumaCa.14

[śrēṇīkō rājā —]
ēvaṁvihē ya nayarē, vasaï nivō tattha sēṇiō nāma
naravaïguṇēhi juttō, vēsamaṇō cēva pañcakkhō // PaumaCa.15

bhamaranibhaniddhakēsō, viyasiyavaraṣaümasarisamuhasōhō
ghaṇa-pīṇa-kaḍhiṇakhandhō, thōrunnaya-dīhabāhujuō // PaumaCa.16

vitthiṇṇapihulavacchō, karayalasamagijjhalaliyataṇumajjhō
mayarāyasarisakaḍiyaḍa, samahiyavarahatthihatthōrū // PaumaCa.17

kummavaracārucalaṇō, sōvaṇṇiyapavaō va dippantō
candō va sōmavayaṇō, salilanihī cēva gambhīrō // PaumaCa.18

taṁ natthi jaṁ na yāṇaï, narindavināṇa-nāṇamāhappaṁ
sammattaladdhabuddhī, guru-dēvayapūyaṇasamatthō // PaumaCa.19

vivihakalā-''gamakusalō vi māṇavō tassa varanarindassa
suciraṁ ṣi bhaṇṇamāṇō, guṇāṇa antaṁ na pāvijjā // PaumaCa.20

[sirivīrajiṇacariyaṁ]
[vīrajinajanma, surakr̥tō janmābhiṣēkaśca —]
atthēttha bharahavāsē, kuṇḍaggāmaṁ puraṁ guṇasamiddhaṁ
tattha ya narindavasahō, siddhatthō nāma nāmēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.21


[p. 10]
tassa ya bahuguṇakaliyā, bhajjā tisala tti rūvasaṁpannā
tīē gabbhammi jiṇō, āyāō carimasamayammi // PaumaCa.22

āsaṇakampēṇa surā, muṇiūṇa jiṇēsaraṁ samuppannaṁ
savē vi samuccaliyā, pariōsunbhinnarōmañcā // PaumaCa.23

āgantūṇa ya nayarē, gandhōdayavārivarisaṇaṁ kāuṁ
ghēttūṇa jiṇavarindaṁ, mandarasiharammi saṁpattā // PaumaCa.24

ṭhaviūṇa paṇḍukambala–silāe sīhāsaṇē maṇivicittē
abhisiñcanti surindā, khīrōdahivārikalasēhiṁ // PaumaCa.25

ākampiō ya jēṇaṁ, mērū aṅguṭṭaēṇa līlāē
tēṇēha mahāvīrō, nāma si kayaṁ surindēhiṁ // PaumaCa.26

namiūṇa jiṇavarinda, thōūṇa payāhiṇaṁ ca kāūṇaṁ
puṇaravi māusayāsē, ṭhavēnti dēvā tilōyaguruṁ // PaumaCa.27

suravaïdinnāhārō, aṅguṭṭayaamayalēvalēhēṇaṁ
ummukkabālabhāvō, tīsaïvarisō jiṇō jāō // PaumaCa.28

[vīrasya pravrajyā, jñānaṁ, atiśayāśca —]
aha annayā kayāī, saṁvēgaṁgaō jiṇō muṇiyadōsō
lōgantiyaparikiṇṇō, pabajjamuvāgaō vōrō // PaumaCa.29

aha aṭṭhakammarahiyassa tassa jhāṇōvaōgajuttassa
sayalajagujjōyagaraṁ, kēvalanāṇaṁ samuppannaṁ // PaumaCa.30

ruhiraṁ khīrasavaṇṇaṁ, malasēyavivajjiyaṁ surabhigandhaṁ
dēhaṁ salakkhaṇaguṇaṁ, ravippabhaṁ cēva aïvimalaṁ // PaumaCa.31


[p. 11]
nayaṇā phandaṇarahiyā, nahakēsā'vaṭṭhiyā ya niddhā ya
jōyaṇasayaṁ samantā, mārīi vivajjiō dēsō // PaumaCa.32

jattō ṭhavēi calaṇē, tattō jāyanti sahasapattāī
phalabharanamiyā ya dumā, sāsasamiddhā mahī hōi // PaumaCa.33

āyarisasamā dharaṇī, jāyaï iha addhamāgahī vāṇī
saraē va nimmalāō, disāō raya-rēṇurahiyāō // PaumaCa.34

ṭhāyaï jattha jiṇindō, tattha ya sīhāsaṇaṁ rayaṇacittaṁ
jōyaṇaghōsamaṇaharaṁ, dunduhi surakusumavuṭṭhī ya // PaumaCa.35

ēvaṁ sō muṇivasahō, aṭṭhamahāpāḍihērapariyariō
viharaï jiṇindabhāṇū, bōhintō bhaviyakamalāiṁ // PaumaCa.36

aïsayavihūisahiō, gaṇa-gaṇahara-sayalasaṅghaparivārō
viharantō ciya pattō, viulagirindaṁ mahāvīrō // PaumaCa.37

[kēvalamahimārtha dēvānāmāgamanam —]
nāūṇa dēvarāyā, viulamahāgirivarē jiṇavarindaṁ
ērāvaṇaṁ valaggō, himagirisiharassa saṁkāsaṁ // PaumaCa.38

siṁdūraraïyakumbhaṁ, viraïyanakkhattamālakayasōhaṁ
ghaṇṭāravanigdhōsaṁ, gaṇḍayalubbhinnamayalēhaṁ // PaumaCa.39

gumugumugumantamahuyara-nilōṇamayasurahivāsiyasuyandhaṁ
calacavalakaṇṇacāmara-vāuchuvantadhayamālaṁ // PaumaCa.40

sāmāṇiyaparikiṇṇō, accharasuggīyamāṇamāhappō
sabasurāsurasahiō, viulagiriṁ āgaō indō // PaumaCa.41

daḍhūṇa jiṇavarinda, karayalajuyalaṁ karīya sīsammi
sakō pahaṭṭamaṇasō, thōūṇa jiṇaṁ samāḍhattō // PaumaCa.42

[vīrastutiḥ —]
mōhandhayāratimirē, suttaṁ ciya sayalajīvalōyamiṇaṁ
kēvalakiraṇadivāyara!, tumēva ujjōiyaṁ vimalaṁ // PaumaCa.43


[p. 12]
saṁsārabhavasamuddē, sōgamahāsalilavīisaṁghaṭṭē
pōō tuma mahāyasa!, uttārō bhaviyavaṇiyāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.44

saṁsārabhavakaḍillē, saṁjōgaviōgasōgatarugahaṇē
kupahapaṇaṭṭhāṇa tuma, satthāhō nāha! uppannō // PaumaCa.45

tuha nāha! kō samatthō, sabbhūyaguṇāṇa kuṇaï parisaṁkhā?
suirammi bhaṇṇamāṇō, avi vāsasahassakōḍīhiṁ // PaumaCa.46

thōūṇa dēvarāyā, annē vi caübihā suranikāyā
bhāvēṇa kayapaṇāmā, uvaviṭṭhā sannivēsēsu // PaumaCa.47

magahāhivō vi rāyā, daṭṭaṇa surāgamaṁ jiṇasagāsē
bhaḍacaḍayarēṇa mahayā, tō rāyapurāō nīhariō // PaumaCa.48

pattō ya tamuddēsaṁ, mattamahāgayavarāō uttiṇṇō
thōūṇa jiṇavarindaṁ, uvaviṭṭhō magahasāmantō // PaumaCa.49

[samavasaraṇam —]
puvaviṇimmiyabhāgaṁ, jōyaṇaparivēḍhamaṇḍalābhōyaṁ
pāyāratiuṇamaṇimaya-gōuravitthiṇṇakayasōhaṁ // PaumaCa.50

aha dōṇi ya vakkhārā, aṭṭamahāpāḍihērasaṁjuttā
aṭṭha nāḍayāī, dārē dārē ya naccanti // PaumaCa.51

sōlasa varavāvīō, kamaluppalavimalasalilapuṇṇāō
caüsu vidisāsu majjhē, havanti cattāri cattāri // PaumaCa.52

bhayavaṁ pi tihuyaṇagurū, vicittasīhāsaṇē suhaniviṭṭhō
chattāichatta-cāmara-asōga-bhāmaṇḍalasaṇāhō // PaumaCa.53

ēvaṁvihammi tattō, suravaramēlīṇajaṇasamūhammi
pattēyaṁ pattēyaṁ, vakkhāraṁ kittaïssāmi // PaumaCa.54


[p. 13]
paḍhamammi ya vakkhārē, parisā nigganthamaharisīṇaṁ tu 1
tayaṇantaraṁ pi bīē, sōhammāīsuravahūṇaṁ2 // PaumaCa.55

taïyammi ya vakkhārē, parisā ajāṇa guṇamahantīṇaṁ3
tattō paraṁ tu niyamā, jōisakannāṇa parisā ya4 // PaumaCa.56

vantaravahūṇa tattō5, parisā uṇa bhavaṇavāsiyavahūrṇa6
tattō paraṁ tu niyamā, jōisiyāṇaṁ suravarāṇa7 // PaumaCa.57

vantarabhavaṇindāṇaṁ 8, vakkhārēsu ya havanti parisāō9
sōhammāīṇa taō, dēvāṇaṁ kappavāsīṇaṁ 10 // PaumaCa.58

avarammi ya vakkhārē, parisā maṇuyāṇa naravarindāṇaṁ 11
hōi tirikvāṇa puṇō, parisā puvuttarē bhāgē12 // PaumaCa.59

ēvaṁ pasannacittē, suravaramēlīṇapatthivasamūhē
pucchaï dhammā-'dhamma, titthayaraṁ gōyamō namiḍaṁ // PaumaCa.60

tō addhamāgahīē, bhāsāē sabajīvahiyajaṇaṇaṁ
jalaharagambhīraravō, kahēi dhammaṁ jiṇavarindō // PaumaCa.61

[vīrasya bhagavatō dēśanā —]
davaṁ ca hōi duvihaṁ, jīvā-'jīvā tahēva nāyabaṁ
jīvā havanti duvihā, siddhā saṁsāravantā ya // PaumaCa.62

jē hōnti siddhajīvā, tāṇa aṇantaṁ suhaṁ aṇōvamiyaṁ
akkhayamayalamaṇantaṁ, havaï sayā bāha parimukkaṁ // PaumaCa.63

tattha ya saṁsārasthā, duvihā tasa-thāvarā muṇēyavā
ubhaē vi hunti duvihā, pajattā taha apajjattā // PaumaCa.64

puḍhavi jala jalaṇa māruya, vaṇassaī cēva thāvarā bhaṇiyā
bēindiyāi jāva u, duviha tasā sanni iyarē ya // PaumaCa.65

naṁ taṁ ajīvadavaṁ, dhammā-'dhammāibhēyabhinnaṁ ca
bhavāṇa siddhigamaṇaṁ, taṁ vivarīyaṁ abhavāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.66

micchatta-jōgaṣaccaya, taha ya kasāēsu lēsasahiēsu
ēēsu cēva jīvō, bandhaï asuhaṁ sayā kammaṁ // PaumaCa.67


[p. 14]
nāṇēṇa daṁsaṇēṇa ya, cāritta-tavēṇa sammasahiēṇaṁ
maṇa-vayaṇa-kāyaguttō, ajjiṇaï aṇantayaṁ puṇṇaṁ // PaumaCa.68

aṭṭhavihabhēyabhinnaṁ, kammaṁ saṁkhēvaō samakkhāyaṁ
bajjhanti ya muccanti ya, jīvā pariṇāmajōgēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.69

saṁsāraṣavannāṇaṁ, jīvāṇaṁ visayasaṅgamūḍhāṇaṁ
jaṁ hōi takkhaṇasuhaṁ, taṁ puṇa dukkhaṁ aṇēgavihaṁ // PaumaCa.70

jāva ya nimisapamāṇō, kālō vaccēja narayalōgammi
tāvaṁ ciya natthi suhaṁ, jīvāṇaṁ pāvakammāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.71

damaṇēsu tāḍaṇēsu ya, bandhaṇanibbhacchaṇāidōsēsu
dukkhaṁ tirikkhajīvā, aṇuhavamāṇā ya acchanti // PaumaCa.72

saṁjōga-vippaōgē, lāhā-'lāhē ya rāga-dōsēsu
maṇuyāṇa havaï dukkhaṁ, sārīraṁ māṇasaṁ cēva // PaumaCa.73

appiḍḍiyadēvāṇa vi, daṭṭaṇa mahiḍḍiē surasamūhē
jaṁ uppajjaï dukkhaṁ, tattō guruyaṁ cavaṇakālē // PaumaCa.74

ēyārisammi ghōrē, saṁsārē cāuraṅgamaggami
dukkhēhi navari jīvō, bhaṭṭhō maṇuyattaṇaṁ lahaï // PaumaCa.75

laddhē vi māṇusattē, sabarāikulēsu manda vibhavēsu
uttamakulammi dukkhaṁ, uppattī hōi jīvassa // PaumaCa.76

uppannō vi hu sukulē, vāmaṇa-bahira-'ndha-mūya-kuṇi-khujjō
dukkhēhi lahaï jīvō, nirōgaṣañcindiyaṁ rūvaṁ // PaumaCa.77

sabāṇa sundarāṇaṁ, laddhē vi samāgamē apuṇṇassa
na havijja dhammabuddhī, mūḍhassa u lōbha-mōhēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.78

uppannā vi ya buddhī, dhammassuvariṁ kudhamma-hammēsu
taha vi ya puṇa bhāmijjaï, na lahaï jiṇadēsiyaṁ dhammaṁ // PaumaCa.79

laddhaṇa māṇusattaṁ, jassa na dhammē sayā havaï cittaṁ
tassa kira karayalatthaṁ, amayaṁ naṭuṁ ciya narassa // PaumaCa.80

kēittha dhīrapurisā, cārittaṁ gihiūṇa bhāvēṇa
akkhaṇḍiyacārittā, jāva ṭhiyā uttamajhummi // PaumaCa.81


[p. 15]
annē puṇō vi kēī, vīsaṁ jiṇakāraṇāim̐ bhāvēuṁ
tēlōkkakhōbhaṇakara, aṇantasaükkhaṁ samajanti // PaumaCa.82

annē tavaṁ vigiṭṭa, kāuṁ, thōvāvasēsasaṁsārā
dō tiṇṇi bhavē gantuṁ, nivāṇamaṇuttaramuvēnti // PaumaCa.83

kāūṇa tavamuyāraṁ, ārāhiya dhībalēṇa kālagayā
tē hōnti varaaṇuttara-vimāṇavāsēsu ahamindā // PaumaCa.84

tattō cuyā samāṇā, halahara-cakkaharabhōga-riddhīō
bhōttūṇa sucirakālaṁ, dhamma kāūṇa sijjhanti // PaumaCa.85

ghēttūṇa samaṇadhammaṁ, ghōraparīsahaparāiyā annē
bhajanti saṁjamāō, sēvanti aṇuvayāṇi puṇō // PaumaCa.86

tuṭṭhā havanti annē, darisaṇamēttēṇa jiṇavarindāṇaṁ
paccakkhāṇanivitti, na vi tē suviṇē vi gēhanti // PaumaCa.87

micchattamōhiyamaī, nissīlā nivayā gihārambhē
pavisanti mahāghōraṁ, saṁgāmaṁ visayarasalōlā // PaumaCa.88

annē vi karisaṇāī, bāvārā vivihajantusaṁbādhā
kāūṇa janti narayaṁ, tibamahāvēyaṇaṁ ghōraṁ // PaumaCa.89

māyā-kuḍilasahāvā, kūḍatulā-kūḍamāṇavavahārā
dhammaṁ asaddahantā, tirikkhajōṇī uvaṇamanti // PaumaCa.90

ujjuyadhammāyārā, taṇuyakasāyā sahāvabhaddā ya
majjhimaguṇēhi juttā, lahanti tē māṇusaṁ jammaṁ // PaumaCa.91

aṇuvaya-mahavaēhi ya, bālatavēṇa ya havanti saṁjuttā
tē hōnti dēvalōē, dēvā pariṇāmajōgēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.92


[p. 16]
dasaṇa-nāṇa-carittē, suddhā annōnnakaraṇajōēsu
dēhē vi niravayakkhā, siddhi pāvēnti dhuyakammā // PaumaCa.93

taṁ akkhayaṁ aṇantaṁ, abābāhaṁ sivaṁ paramasōkkhaṁ
pāvanti samaṇasīhā, kammaṭṭhavivajjiyā mōkkhaṁ // PaumaCa.94

caügaïmahāsamuddē, jīvā ghōlanti kammapaḍibaddhā
na ya uttarēja kēī, mōttu jiṇadhammabōhitthaṁ // PaumaCa.95

saṁsāramahāgimhē, dukkhāyavativavēyaṇumhaviyaṁ
jiṇavayaṇamēhasīyala-ulhaviyaṁ sayalajiyalōyaṁ // PaumaCa.96

[śrēṇikasya padmacaritē saṁśayaḥ —]
aha tē suṇittu dhammaṁ, jiṇavaramuhakamalaniggayaṁ dēvā
sammattaladdhabuddhī, gayā ya niyayāim̐ ṭhāṇāī // PaumaCa.97

magahāhivō vi rāyā, vīrajiṇaṁ paṇamiūṇa bhāvēṇaṁ
sabaparivārasahiō, kusagganayaraṁ samaṇupattō // PaumaCa.98

tāva ya divasavasāṇē, atthaṁ ciya diṇayarō samallīṇō
maülanti ya kamalāī, virahō cakkāyamihuṇāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.99

uccharaï tamō gayaṇē, maïlantō disivahē kasiṇavaṇṇō
sajjaṇacariujjōyaṁ, najaï tā dujaṇasahāvō // PaumaCa.100

rāyā vi niyayabhavaṇē, maṇidīvajalantakiraṇavicchuriē
sayaṇē suhappasuttō, kusumapaḍōcchaïyaṣallakē // PaumaCa.101

nidaṁ sēvantō cciya, suviṇē vi puṇō puṇō jiṇavarindaṁ
pēcchaï pucchaï ya taō, saṁsaya paramaṁ payattēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.102

ghaṇagurugabhīragajjiya-niṇāyabahutūrabandisadēṇaṁ
aha uṭṭiō mahappā, thuvantō maṅgalasaēhiṁ // PaumaCa.103


[p. 17]
cintēūṇa pavattō, bhaṇiyaṁ vīrēṇa dhammasaṁjuttaṁ
cakkaharāinarāṇaṁ, bhuvaṇamiṇaṁ havaï parihāṇaṁ // PaumaCa.104

paümacariyammi ēttō, maṇō mahaṁ kuṇaï paramasaṁdēhaṁ
kaha vāṇarēhi nihayā, rakkhasavasahā aïbalā vi? // PaumaCa.105

jiṇavaradhammēṇaṁ ciya, mahaïmahākulasamubbhavā jāyā
vijjāsayāṇa pāraṁ, gayā ya balagabiyā vīrā // PaumaCa.106

suvanti lōyasatthē, rāvaṇapamuhā ya rakkhasā savē
vasa-lōhiya-maṁsāī-bhakkhaṇa-pāṇē kayāhārā // PaumaCa.107

kira rāvaṇassa bhāyā, mahābalō nāma kumbhayaṇṇō tti
chammāsaṁ vigayabhaō, sējjāsu nirantaraṁ suyaï // PaumaCa.108

jaï vi ya gaēsu aṅga, pēllijjaï garuyapavayasamēsu
tēllaghaḍēsu ya kaṇṇā, pūrijantē suyantassa // PaumaCa.109

paḍupaḍahatūrasadaṁ, na suṇaï sō sammuhaṁ pi vajantaṁ
na ya uṭṭēi mahappā, sējjāē apuṇṇakālammi // PaumaCa.110

aha uḍhiō vi santō, asaṇamahā (ṇāmaha) ghōraparigayasarīrō
puraō havēja jō sō, kuñjara-mahisāiṇō gilaï // PaumaCa.111

kāūṇa udarabharaṇaṁ, sura-māṇusa-kuñjarāibahuēsu
puṇaravi sējjārūḍhō, bhayarahiō suyaï chammāsaṁ // PaumaCa.112

annaṁ pi ēva subaï, jaha indō rāvaṇēṇa saṁgāmē
jiṇiūṇa niyalabaddhō, laṅkānayarī samāṇīō // PaumaCa.113

kō niṇiūṇa samatthō, indaṁ sasurā-'surē vi tēlōkkē
jō sāgarapērantaṁ, jambuddīvaṁ samuddharaï // PaumaCa.114

ērāvaṇō gaïndō, jassa ya vajaṁ amōhapaharatthaṁ
tassa kira cintiēṇa vi, annō vi bhavēja masirāsiṁ(sī) // PaumaCa.115

sīhō maēṇa nihaō, sāṇēṇa ya kuñjarō jahā bhaggō
taha vivarīyaṣayatthaṁ, kaīhi rāmāyaṇaṁ raïyaṁ // PaumaCa.116

aliyaṁ pi sabamēyaṁ, uvavattiviruddhapaccayaguṇēhiṁ
na ya saddahanti purisā, havanti jē paṇḍiyā lōē // PaumaCa.117

ēvaṁ cintantō cciya, saṁsayaparihārakāraṇaṁ rāyā
jiṇadarisaṇussuyamaṇō, gamaṇucchāhō taō jāō // PaumaCa.118


[p. 18]
varakamalanibaddhā niggayālīsamattā, mahurasaranināyāccantarammā ṣadēsā
taruṣavaṇavalamgā puppharēṇuṁ muyantā, vimalakiraṇamantāiccabhāsā visuddhā // PaumaCa.119


iya paümacariē sēṇiyacintāvihāṇō nāma biīyō samuddēsaō samattō


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[vijjāharalōgavaṇṇaṇaṁ]

[śrēṇikasya gaütamapārśvē gamanam , pr̥cchā ca —]
atthāṇimaṇḍavatthō, sabālaṁkārabhūsiyasarīrō
sāmantamaüḍamōttiya-kiraṇasamujjaliyapāvīḍhō // PaumaCa.1

sō tattha magaharāyā, muṇidarisaṇakāraṇē kaücchāhō
āruhaï varagaïndaṁ, parihatthaṁ lakkhaṇaṣasatthaṁ // PaumaCa.2

aha niggaō purāō, gayavararahajōhaturayaparikiṇṇō
vaccaï narindavasahō, jattha'cchaï gōyamō bhayavaṁ // PaumaCa.3

pattō ya taṁ paēsaṁ, muṇivaragaṇasaṅghamajjhayārammi
pēcchaï gaṇaharavasahaṁ, sarayaraviṁ cēva tēēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.4

ōyariya gayavarāō, kāūṇa ṣayāhiṇaṁ muṇiṁ rāyā
paṇamaï pahaṭṭhamaṇasō, añjalimaülaṁ sirē kāuṁ // PaumaCa.5

dinnāsīsa ciya sō, uvaviṭhṭhō muṇivarassa pāmūlē
dēhakusalāi savaṁ, pucchaï paramēṇa viṇaēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.6

nāūṇa ya patthāvaṁ, puṇaravi viṇaōvayārasaṁjuttō
saṁsayatimirāvaharaṁ, aha pucchaï gōyamaṁ rāyā // PaumaCa.7

paümacariyaṁ mahāyasa!, ahayaṁ icchāmi pariphuḍaṁ sōuṁ
uppāiyā pasiddhī, kusatthavādīhi vivarīyā // PaumaCa.8

jaï rāvaṇō mahāyasa!, nisāyarō suravarō va aïviriō
kaha sō parihūō cciya, vāṇaratiriēhi raṇamajjhē // PaumaCa.9

rāmēṇa kaṇayadēhō, sarēṇa bhinnō maō araṇṇammi
suggīvasutāratthaṁ, chiddēṇa vivāiō vālī // PaumaCa.10


[p. 19]
gantūṇa dēvanilayaṁ, suravaï jiṇiūṇa samaramajjhammi
daḍhakaḍhiṇaniyalabaddhō, pavēsiō cāragēhammi // PaumaCa.11

savatthasatthakusalō, chammāsaṁ suyaï kumbhakaṇṇō vi
kaha vāṇarēhi baddhō, sēu cciya sāyarajalammi // PaumaCa.12

bhayavaṁ! kuṇaha pasāyaṁ, kahēha taccatthahētusaṁjuttaṁ
saṁdēhaandhayāraṁ, nāṇujjōēṇa nāsēha // PaumaCa.13

tō bhaṇaï gaṇaharindō, suṇēhi naravasaha! dinnakaṇṇamaṇō
jaha kēvalīṇa siṭuṁ, ahamavi tumhaṁ parikahēmi // PaumaCa.14

na ya rakkhasō tti bhaṇṇaï, dasāṇaṇō ṇēya āmisāhārō
aliyaṁ ti sabamēyaṁ, bhaṇanti jaṁ kukaïṇō mūḍhā // PaumaCa.15

na ya pīḍhabandharahiyaṁ, kahijjamāṇaṁ pi dēi bhāvatthaṁ
patthiva! hīṇaṁ ca puṇō, vayaṇamiṇaṁ chinnamūlaṁ va // PaumaCa.16

paḍhamaṁ khēttavibhāgaṁ, kālavibhāgaṁ ca tattha vaṇṇēhaṁ
mahaïmahāpurisāṇa ya, cariyaṁ ca jahakkama suṇasu // PaumaCa.17

[lōkaḥ —]
atthi aṇantāṇantaṁ, āgāsaṁ tassa majjhayārammi
lōō aṇāinihaṇō, tibhēyabhinnō havaï niccō // PaumaCa.18

vēttāsaṇasarisō cciya, aha lōgō cēva hōi nāyabō
jhallarisamō ya majjhē, uvariṁ puṇa murayasaṁṭhāṇō // PaumaCa.19

sabō ya tālasarisō, tīsu ya valaēsu hōi pariṇaddhō
majjhammi tiriyalōō, sāyaradīvēsu bahuēsu // PaumaCa.20

[jambudvīpaḥ, tadgatakṣētrādi —]
tassa vi ya majjhadēsē, jambuddīvō ya dappaṇāyārō
ēkkaṁ ca sayasahassaṁ, jōyaṇasaṁkhāṣamāṇēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.21

sō ya puṇa sabaō cciya, lavaṇasamuddēṇa saṁparikkhittō
paümavaravēiyāē, dārēsu samujjalasirīō // PaumaCa.22

majjhammi mandaragirī, caükāṇaṇamaṇḍiō rayaṇacittō
navanaüi sahassāī, samussiō dasa ya vitthiṇō // PaumaCa.23


[p. 20]
jōyaṇasahassamēgaṁ, ahōgaō vajjapaḍalamallīṇō
uvariṁ ca cūliyāē, sōhammaṁ cēva phusamāṇō // PaumaCa.24

chaccēva ya vāsaharā, vāsā sattēva hōnti nāyabā
cōdasa mahānaīō, nābhigirī cēva cattāri // PaumaCa.25

vīsaṁ vakkhāragirī, cōttīsa havanti rāyahāṇīō
vēyaḍḍaṣavayā vi ya, cōttīsaṁ cēva nāyabā // PaumaCa.26

aṭṭha ya saṭṭhīō taha, guhāṇa sīhāsaṇāṇa puṇa tīsaṁ
uttara-dēvakurūṇaṁ, majjhē varapāyavē divē // PaumaCa.27

dō kañcaṇakūḍasayā, cha cēva dahā havanti nāyabā
citta-vicittā ya duvē, jamalagirī hōnti dō cēva // PaumaCa.28

cha bbhōgabhūmibhāgā, varapāyavamaṇḍiyā maṇabhirāmā
ēēsu ya ṭhāṇēsuṁ, havanti jiṇacēiyagharāiṁ // PaumaCa.29

aha ēttō lavaṇajalē, dīvā cattāri hōnti nāyavā
jiṇacēiēsu rammā, bhōgēṇa ya divalōgasamā // PaumaCa.30

jambuddīvē bharahassa dakkhiṇē rakkhasāṇa dīvō'thi
dīvō gandhavāṇaṁ, avarēṇa ṭhiō vidēhassa // PaumaCa.31

tattō ēravayassa ya, kinnaradīvō u hōi uttaraō
puba vidēhassa puṇō, putrēṇa ṭhiō varuṇadīvō // PaumaCa.32

[kāla: —]
bharahēravaēsu tahā, hāṇī vuḍḍī ya hōi nāyabā
sēsēsu hōi kālō, khēttēsu avaṭṭhiō niccaṁ // PaumaCa.33

jambuddīvāhivaī, aṇāḍhiō suravarō mahaḍḍīō
dēvasahassasamaggō, sāmittaṁ kuṇaï savēsiṁ // PaumaCa.34

āsi purā bharahamiṇaṁ, uttarakurusarisabhōgasaṁpuṇṇaṁ
varakapparukkhaṣaüraṁ, susamāsusamāsu aïrammaṁ // PaumaCa.35

tiṇṇēva gāuyāī, uccattaṁ tāṇa hōi maṇuyāṇaṁ
caüraṁsaṁ saṁṭhāṇaṁ, āuṭhiī tiṇṇi pallāiṁ // PaumaCa.36


[p. 21]
tuḍiyaṅga1bhōyaṇaṅgāra, vihūsaṇaṅgā3 mayaṅga4vatthaṅgā5
giha6 jōi7dīviyaṅgā8 bhāyaṇa9mallaṅga10kappadumā // PaumaCa.37

ēēhi maṇabhirāmaṁ, jahicchiyaṁ dasavihaṁ mahābhōgaṁ
bhuñjanti niccasuhiyā, gayaṁ ṣi kālaṁ na yāṇanti // PaumaCa.38

āummi thōvasēsē, mihuṇaṁ jaṇiūṇa paṁvaralāyaṇaṁ
kālaṁ kāūṇa taō, suravarasōkkhaṁ puṇa labhanti // PaumaCa.39

sīhādaō vi sōmā, na vi tē kuppanti ēkkamēkkassa
sacchandasuhavihārī, tē vi hu bhuñjanti sōkkhāiṁ // PaumaCa.40

bharahēravaēsu tahā, hāṇī vuḍḍī ya havaï kālassa
na ya hāṇī na ya vuḍḍī, sēsēsu ya hōi khēttēsu // PaumaCa.41

ēvaṁ suṇiuṁ rāyā pucchaï sāhuṁ puṇō paṇamiūṇaṁ
kēṇa kaēṇa maṇūsō, uppajjaï bhōgabhūmīsu // PaumaCa.42

tō bhaṇaï gaṇaharindō, jē ētthaṁ ujjuyā narā bhaddā
tē bhōgabhūmimaggaṁ, lahanti sāhuppayāṇēṇaṁ // PaumaCa.43

[dānaphalam —]
jē kucchiēsu dāṇaṁ, dēnti suhabhōgakāraṇanimittaṁ
tē kuñjarāi jāyā, bhuñjantiha dāṇanaṁ sōkkhaṁ // PaumaCa.44

jaha khēttammi sukiṭṭē, bīyaṁ vaḍḍaï na tassa parihāṇī
ēvaṁ susāhudāṇē, viulaṁ puṇṇaṁ samajjiṇaï // PaumaCa.45

ēkkammi jaha talāē, dhēṇue sappēṇa pāṇiyaṁ pīyaṁ
sappē pariṇamaï visaṁ, ghēṇusu khīraṁ samunbhavaï // PaumaCa.46

taha nissīla-susīlē, dinnaṁ dāṇaṁ phalaṁ aphalayaṁ ca
hōhī parammi lōē, pattavisēsēṇa sē puṇṇaṁ // PaumaCa.47

[kulakarā r̥ṣabhasvāmicaritaṁ ca —]
ēvaṁ dāṇavisēsō, naravaï! kahiō maē samāsēṇaṁ
kulagaravaṁsuppattī, bhaṇāmi ēttō nisāmēhi // PaumaCa.48


[p. 22]
jaha candō parivaḍḍaï, ōsaraï ya appaṇō sabhāvēṇaṁ
ussappiṇī vi vaḍḍaï, ēvaṁ avasappiṇīhāṇī // PaumaCa.49

taïyammi kālasamaē, pallōvamaaṭṭhabhāgasēsammi
paḍhamō kulagaravasabhō, uppannō ṣaḍisuī nāmaṁ1 // PaumaCa.50

jāīsarō mahappā, jāṇaï jō tiṇṇi jammasaṁbandhē
tassa ya suī pasannā, vasaï suhaṁ sabaō vasuhā // PaumaCa.51

ēvaṁ samaïkvantē, kālē tō sammuī samuppannō2
khēmaṁkarō ya ēttō3, taō ya khēmaṁdharō jāō4 // PaumaCa.52

sīmaṁkarō mahappā5 jāō sīmaṁdharō6 payāṇandō7
tattō ya carakunāmō, uppannō bhārahē vāsē8 // PaumaCa.53

dahṇa canda-sūrē, bhīō āsāsiō jaṇō jēṇaṁ
siṭuṁ ca niravasēsaṁ, jahavattaṁ kālasamayammi // PaumaCa.54

tattō havē mahapṣā, uppannō vimalavāhaṇō dhīrō9
abhicandō10 candābhō 11 marudēva 12 pasēṇaī 13 nābhī14 // PaumaCa.55
